5179450.name: Shroom & Blade
5179450.short_description: Two players. One mushroom colony. One explores, fights ants, and hunts scouts before they summon stronger waves. The other builds, automates, and fortifies the colony. Survive escalating attacks together until the Ant Queen arrives in this asymmetric co-op base-defense game.

4915570.name: Tapis
4915570.short_description: Tapis is a score-chasing roguelike played on a game table. Tokens fall onto the board, each with its own effect based on its position and family. Your goal: score a huge amount of points.  To help you, you'll have repositioning moves to strategically place your tokens and maximize your score.

4004820.name: FreeStyle Football 2
4004820.short_description:
Freestyle Football 2 is a fast-paced, 5v5 match-based online multiplayer soccer game.
Each position has a unique role, and you'll utilize a variety of strategies and skills to achieve victory with your team.
Stylish play and unique characters transform the pitch into a stage.

3810240.name: In Full Bloom
3810240.short_description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for the world around it. There is only one way.

5053640.name: Free Company
5053640.short_description: A co-op tactical RPG set on the eve of the year 1000. Lead a free company of mercenaries across a doom-haunted medieval world. Take the contracts, win the fights, and decide what your company becomes before the millennium turns.

4506560.name: Beatrix Demo
4506560.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. The demo opens three Circles: Lust, Greed and Violence. Place tarot cards on a grid, surround enemy cards to flip them to your side, and build the board with effects that fire whenever a card lands on them.

4734520.name: Hearthsail
4734520.short_description: A cozy pixel-art sailing game. A storm washes you up in Hearth Harbor, a port whose beacon went dark years ago. Fix up your ship, fish, farm and cook, then sail an ocean with no edge where every island stays where you found it. Demo in early 2027.

4802430.name: Cubus Tower
4802430.short_description:
Cubus tower is a platformer game.
Climb the Cubus tower and find what is waiting for you at its summit.

4680830.name: Sylvaris: Black Reign
4680830.short_description: A dark steampunk Metroidvania built around Overload, a combat system that runs on your own health. Burn your life for power, heal with every hit, and fight your way through a world of iron and machinery.

5350770.name: Darts With Mates
5350770.short_description: Darts With Mates is a darts party game for 1–4 players. Host a pub night with Steam friends, play 501, Killer, High Score or Pub Bingo, team up in 2v2, and grab a pint or stay sober between throws.

5409680.name: Echo Pandemic Demo
5409680.short_description: Earth needs antibodies. You are one of them. Play as a bat who hunts by echolocation, infects alien invaders with engineered diseases, and stays one mutation ahead in a desperate biological war for the planet.

4857110.name: Path Defenders Demo
4857110.short_description: Path Defenders is a 3D action tower defense RPG. Build a strategy party and jump into real-time combat to fight alongside your summoned heroes against epic bosses, all driven by a lofi and vaporwave soundtrack.

4819620.name: Path Defenders: RPG Siege Defense
4819620.short_description: A single-player MMORPG fused with tower defense. Recruit heroes, Build bizarre but devastating towers, and fight beside them in real-time 3D combat against waves of enemies.

4157660.name: Life Balance
4157660.short_description: A physics ragdoll climber where life choices become literal baggage. Climb a tower in the sky alone or in 2-player split-screen co-op: give each other a leg-up, grab each other, and share the load. Can you reach the top, or will your responsibilities drag you down?

4619040.name: Valken
4619040.short_description: VALKEN is a realistic tactical solo shooter where you play as a lone agent infiltrating a secretive military organization. Explore varied environments, make hard choices, and face the brutal consequences in an intense, unforgiving campaign.

4175050.name: No One to See – Pinebark Camp
4175050.short_description: Going through a hard time, Ethan decided to go camping alone in the Pinebark woods. He wanted to get away from everything for a few days and find a little silence. He just didn't expect that, in Pinebark, the silence would be listening too.

5371220.name: Aequorea Victoria: The Museum
5371220.short_description: A first-person journey through a world made of art. Wander a gallery of paintings, music and film, step into surreal rooms of fear, climb a tower where every floor is a different story, and leave your dreams for strangers to find.

1110960.name: Cosmoteer Demo
1110960.short_description: Design and simulate the starship of your dreams! Command it in epic battles and manage your crew while exploring a dangerous galaxy. Play alone or with friends, test your ship in online PvP, and let your imagination reach for the stars!

5396930.name: Ouka Exorcists: Night Parade
5396930.short_description: A crimson moon rises over a spring festival and a hundred yokai pour into town. Lead six exorcists through the Night Parade, build your style from 13 Japanese weapons and 60 charms, defeat the Nine-Tailed Fox and the Great Tengu, and help the thousand-year sakura bloom again.

4900690.name: Banana Airways Demo
4900690.short_description: Feed your passengers. Or they'll eat each other. Run an airline with cannibal chickens, radioactive passengers and screaming babies you can throw off the plane. Fly, serve, repair and try to land. Play solo or with up to five friends.

4949410.name: Peg Champ Demo
4949410.short_description: Take your best shot in this Pachinko puzzle game! Break pegs, earn money, and unlock a huge upgrade tree in this satisfying physics puzzler.

4939530.name: ByteBuddies
4939530.short_description: Explore the depths of an abandonned world and figure out what what is happening while you survive 5 nights fighting for your life.

4320000.name: Whisk Demo
4320000.short_description: Whisk is a two-player platformer about shared movement and communication. Coordinate jumps, climbs and throws with a partner to get every Dreamcat home.

5139700.name: Twin Hooks Demo
5139700.short_description: Two heroes, one fight. Team up in a 2-player co-op brawler where you juggle enemies skyward together, land synchronized takedowns, shop and loot your way to stronger gear. Wholesome by day. Relentless by night.

4054790.name: Beatrix
4054790.short_description: Beatrix is a dark roguelite card battler set in Dante's Hell. Place tarot cards on a grid and surround enemy cards to flip them to your side. Between battles, you build the board by placing effects on its cells that fire whenever a card lands on them.

2885240.name: Last Moon Demo
2885240.short_description: In this demo, discover the beginning of Last Moon. Become a Lunar Knight and rekindle the light of a dying world, alone or in co-op. Explore the first lands of Eterna, master weapons, skills and runes, and face the Shadow before it consumes everything.

5039850.name: Password Not Valid Demo
5039850.short_description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

3891790.name: Caution! Platforming Ahead
3891790.short_description: Caution! Platforming Ahead is an abstract precision platformer starring Platformo. Run, jump, and blaze throughout the ether of a mysterious dimension utilizing incredible energy to defy gravity. Twenty scenes of classic platforming action await.

5338940.name: Cozy Game Restoration Soundtrack
5338940.short_description: The OST for the chill cleaning game Cozy Game Restoration. Support the composer, and get all the music from the game + some OST exclusives

5231910.name: Siegehand
5231910.short_description: Attack or build? In Siegehand, every minion has a job to do. Lead one of four factions in a free-to-play online & offline collectible card game with two paths to victory. Battle rival players in Ranked mode, build massive war chests, shape an asynchronous Arena run, and grow your collection!

3144710.name: Project Creatures
3144710.short_description: Project Creatures is a Multiplayer Creature Collection Game. Capture new creatures and battle your friends in a vast Open World!

5081740.name: Field Orders: Eastern Front
5081740.short_description: Field Orders: Eastern Front is a historically-accurate WW2 operational wargame. Features real-time battles you can zoom from a single regiment out to the whole front, a supply network that decides who wins, and a campaign army you build and refit between battles.

5306540.name: Groundwork Simulator
5306540.short_description: Dig, haul and wash for gold in an open-world heavy machinery simulator. Operate excavators, wheel loaders and bulldozers, reshape the terrain and build your washing setup. Work solo or team up in online co-op to turn untouched ground into a working site.

4980270.name: Password Not Valid
4980270.short_description: Password Not Valid is a party game for up to 6 players. You start with a normal password and end up with twelve vowels, text in quotes and even another player's name, because your friends are the ones picking the rules. Can you outlast them?

4840630.name: Green Space Demo
4840630.short_description: You're Blobby, the new Warden of Impact Park. Recycle trash into Blobbers, upgrade the park, talk to the locals, or don't — every choice you make changes how your fellow Blobs treat you. A cozy park-management game with mystery and heart.

5300960.name: KEEP IT ON HER
5300960.short_description: A first-person horror game at Sweetie's Motel, solo or in online co-op with up to 3 friends. Bring the guests forty towels and mop up after them. At nightfall the power cuts out and the front doors lock. When the lights come back, Sweetie is on the hunt.

3330230.name: AI Learning Simulator
3330230.short_description: A free AI learning lab. Design an animal's body and let neural networks discover movement through generations of trials. Explore how inputs, control and evaluation shape behavior. Save, compare and share results.

5446770.name: Haunted Schoolbag Demo
5446770.short_description: Try the first night of Haunted Schoolbag as Minato. Reach into a bag you can't see: grab hilts to use items, avoid blades, and read the numbers to survive. A Minesweeper-style deduction and item-building roguelite. Face Hanako or the After-School Broadcast.

4898790.name: Crosstalk
4898790.short_description: Crosstalk is a hardware architecture design sandbox with a built-in, fully inspectable simulator and emulator. Players build designs ranging from LED controllers to complex computers using SystemVerilog, then program them. It has a gate-level simulator, introspection tools, a compiler, and more.

5308960.name: 江湖一牌：无情武林 / Ace of Jianghu
5308960.short_description:
Reading wuxia is one thing. Living it is another.
Shaolin, Wudang, Unorthodox Alliance, Heavenly Demon Cult. Become one of four and step into a jianghu of hidden currents. You hold cards; you fight with martial arts. Your road changes who you meet and the story.
In the jianghu, a man is just a card.

4404570.name: Eternal Rift Defense
4404570.short_description: Build mazes, place towers, and fight beside them in a 3D tower defense RPG. Defend 50 rifts solo or in 4-player co-op, level towers by standing on them, collect powerful gear sets, shape your build with heroes, talents, upgrades, and join a 10-player raid to slay a dragon.

3039980.name: Sigils of Nightfall
3039980.short_description: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive the horrors that will unleash the world's end.

5121710.name: Querni
5121710.short_description: Querni is an elegant abstract strategy game. Move your numbered tiles, connect consecutive chains, and be the first to remove all your pieces. Play solo against the AI, locally for 2 players, or online via Steam Remote Play Together.

3140970.name: Firefly Trials
3140970.short_description: Firefly Trials is a 3-player boss rush raidlike with fast-paced, MMO-inspired battles against mythological beasts. Choose from a roster of animal-inspired characters, theorycraft your build, and decode escalating mechanics from E-Rank to S-Rank.

3533980.name: Prisonado
3533980.short_description: Kick rocks through the Yard in Prisonado. Aim and score pucks to draft your fight moves, then watch the prison brawls unfold in this turn-based roguelike deck slider. Land trick shots, trigger nasty combos, hustle contraband and discover busted synergies on your way to the Warden... and Freedom.

5388390.name: Table Night
5388390.short_description: A party board game where you can try anything. Write what you do, throw the dice, and a friend as game master or the game itself decides how it goes. Fire spreads, water rises, the map expands, and whoever dies comes back as a ghost to make things worse. from up to 1 to 8 players.

4868530.name: Slimy Dude
4868530.short_description: Slimy Dude is a hand-drawn action-adventure where you play as a soldier, running from kingdom to kingdom against forces greater simply to escape his past. You will meet new allies, become stronger, uncover secrets and explore new environments.

4339590.name: NO CLEAN START
4339590.short_description: No Clean Start is a first-person survival horror roguelite set in a hostile underground facility. Explore dangerous sectors, scavenge for weapons and supplies, manage limited resources, and fight or avoid deadly enemies. Complete objectives, adapt your strategy, and survive each expedition.

3635930.name: Cartoon Bash
3635930.short_description:
Cartoon Bash is a horde survivor game where our dear protagonists who just died must fight to get another chance to get back to life.

You equip multiple weapons and items, fighting off waves of enemies and bosses.

5408910.name: AuraFalls Demo
5408910.short_description: Try Aura Falls free. Roll around the island hub with up to three friends, survive waves of robots together, bowl a strike in a neon alley, and settle it one-on-one in the ring. Everything you earn carries over to the full game.

5420080.name: Great Place To Work
5420080.short_description: Welcome to the best company in the world! Work alongside your coworkers in this cooperative puzzle game, complete tasks, and overcome challenges to become the perfect employee. Here, we value teamwork, productivity, and above all, obedience.

5248460.name: Dandelion Void Demo
5248460.short_description: Take your first steps through the jungle-choked halls of a derelict arkship adrift between the stars. Explore your new surroundings, establish a refuge and forage resources from the skeletal remains of your ancestors. Fashion what weapons you can, for the jungle is alive and hostile…

5200600.name: Ashen Swarm Demo
5200600.short_description: Turn deadly sins into weapons in this gothic bullet heaven roguelite demo. Keep your Oath or embrace Corruption, claim lasting artifacts through your choices, and survive until the court arrives at 13:13. Two heroes. Three stories that continue across runs.

4446030.name: Stellar Smash
4446030.short_description: Save the universe from complete darkness by destroying bricks one by one in this brick breaking game. Challenge bosses, master ball control and upgrade your ship. Let the main character, Astra, guide you through the game.

4966600.name: LOTTERY Demo
4966600.short_description: LOTTERY's Demo allows you to experience the groundbreaking AI in a shrunken version, with the same adaptation and predictions in a tactical first person shooter format.

5354400.name: Sudoku Unlimited
5354400.short_description: Settle into a cozy garden of Sudoku. Solve classic grids and clever variants, learn with step-by-step hints, and unlock new scenery as you play. Share a board in online co-op or keep a small puzzle beside your other apps.

3441630.name: THE WASTE
3441630.short_description: THE WASTE – a brutal and stylish action game about bloody street shootouts and survival in a city after a global collapse, where authority has fallen, and crime thrives. Two factions fight for control over the city, its resources, and survivors.

5450190.name: Miko Rhythm
5450190.short_description: Miko Rhythm is a four-lane arrow rhythm game with a cute-goth heart. Hit the beat on a neon 3D highway or a classic flat lane, play 55 songs on four difficulties, dress up Miko in over 90 looks, chase the daily challenge, and make your own charts.

4611210.name: Crimson Solstice
4611210.short_description: A cozy horror adventure. Uncover the mysteries of the Crimson Solstice and decide Moonvale’s fate. Build relationships and manage resources as time is of the essence. Spend your days wisely and help the townsfolk of Moonvale survive.

5239450.name: 工場見学→
5239450.short_description: Factory Tour → is a 3D horror game where you explore a mysterious robot factory.

4966730.name: Powder Park
4966730.short_description: Shape the mountain. Build the lifts and jumps. Then ride it yourself, solo or with friends. A cozy ski resort builder from one of the original creators of Ski Resort Tycoon.

4646160.name: VR180 SyncPro
4646160.short_description: VR 3D video tool with a synchronized VR player and preset workflows for GoPro models. Play left/right videos in a headset. Auto pairing, multidimensional sync, half-frame adjustment, gyro stabilization, auto/manual horizon calibration, lens/FOV controls and RTX deblur, from footage to export.

4814200.name: 掌中帝国 HANDSET HQ
4814200.short_description: A phone company management sim. Pick a shape, swap materials, or draw the outline yourself, then develop, test, and sell it. Every change instantly shifts the cost and how buyers react. Grow a tiny startup into a phone giant, as long as people actually buy what you build.

5364900.name: Abax
5364900.short_description: A Classic Board Game Experience , Original Game design and mechanics should be engaging and challenging even for the most experienced board game enthusiast. Utilizing a Dice Roll Mechanic for all actions so even the most well planned strategy may fall apart.

1366800.name: Crosshair X
1366800.short_description: Improve your aim and accuracy in every shooter you play. Crosshair X overlays a custom crosshair on top of any game, even games that do not include one. Choose from thousands of community designs or build your own with the designer.

2648720.name: Gobby Gang
2648720.short_description: Grab your Gang and get greedy! Gobby Gang is a chaotic online co-op adventure. Dig, blast, and bumble through dangerous caves packed with treasure, troublesome Critterz, and game-changing items. Grab your loot, push your luck for a bigger haul, then make a mad dash for the exit!

5284760.name: Faithfarer: The Cathedral
5284760.short_description: A traditional, turn-based roguelike. Descend through procedurally generated dungeons, fight unique bosses, hunt rare gear, and spend Faith to shape your run. Switch between ASCII and tiles on the fly. Fully playable with a controller and on Steam Deck.

5278050.name: Fish Wrangler
5278050.short_description: The idle fishing RPG that has been running since 2008. Cast your line, walk away, and let your crew keep fishing while life happens. Catch and collect 2,200+ species across 111 towns, level up ridiculous poles, and find out what Cousin Earl keeps in the bait shed.

4465680.name: Bauble
4465680.short_description: An action-stealth roguelite about newly-sentient creatures investigating the sudden collapse of their ecosystem. Sneak, fight, and negotiate your way through expeditions, learning a little more about your planet each time.

5222340.name: Тайны Родиона Demo
5222340.short_description: A supernatural adventure with visual novel elements. Explore an antique shop filled with unusual characters, secrets, humor, and heartfelt stories.

4427660.name: The Afterlife Cafe Demo
4427660.short_description:
Travel to the world of the dead, whose stories encourage reflection on life. Chat with spirits, brew drinks to suit your mood, and bond with the people who run the afterlife cafes.

In this urban sci-fi fantasy visual novel, your choices impact the living, the departed, and your own path forward.

5140980.name: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate
5140980.short_description: The Odyssey: Threads of Fate is a story-driven adult visual novel about survival, desire, destiny, and the meaning of home. Guide Odysseus through a seductive reimagining of Greek myth filled with gods, monsters, romance, war, mystery, animated NSFW scenes, and a full gallery.

2665070.name: Skifa
2665070.short_description: A dice farklelike played at a medieval table. Shake the cup, throw, keep what scores, and decide: bank it, or throw again and risk losing everything. Real dice, real cups, rooms with their own rules, and opponents who play the way they live.

5441000.name: Alchemill: A Witch's Workshop
5441000.short_description: Alchemill is a cosy falling-sand brewing game. Brew what villagers need by hand in a living cauldron, gather from the land, mend a ruined house, and become a witch in earnest.

5317080.name: Race on Stream!
5317080.short_description: Little cars. Big grudges. Race solo, with Steam friends, or turn Twitch chat into your rivals. Upgrade your car, build your own tracks, throw a chair into the race, or leave it all behind for a long drive and some music.

5124150.name: Zero Castle
5124150.short_description: Take control of a unique flying castle, destroy enemy forces, build your playstyle with powerful upgrades, and survive every cycle.

5117630.name: Gamble Hunters
5117630.short_description: A first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players. One wallet, four hunters, zero trust. Hunt monsters for 60 seconds to fill the shared pot, then race your friends to gamble it into your own Gold. Upgrade guns, mix traits and artifacts, beat bosses, and pay off the shared debt or go bust.

4432150.name: Soulstonia
4432150.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this cozy idle RPG. Set idle goals and let your party gather, craft, and fight for you, or take control anytime. Train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world. Free-to-play at launch.

3576920.name: Loco: Rails & Tails
3576920.short_description:
Chaotic co-op for 1–4 players! Build rails, protect the train and deliver cargo on time.
Pick your favourite animal hero and embark with your friends on wild west adventure!

5094510.name: Deliwhere?
5094510.short_description: Run a chaotic air cargo business across floating islands in 1-4 player co-op or solo! Pick from 4 unique roles, board your flying platform, dodge incoming rockets and aerial mines, upgrade your hangar, and deliver packages to pay off your massive bank loan!

3106010.name: Penis Dungeon
3106010.short_description: Penis Dungeon is a roguelike action RPG with procedurally generated dungeons, bizarre enemies, and a branching skill tree. Play solo or in co-op, unlock new weapons and upgrades, and lead your unfortunate hero on a desperate escape from the depths.

5243610.name: BugPot
5243610.short_description: BugPot is a casual roguelike where every spin shapes the fight. Match weapons and charms, upgrade your weapons, build powerful combinations and adapt your strategy as you face a bizarre variety of bugs.

5073720.name: Terran Dawn
5073720.short_description: An isometric sci-fi RTS of fleet command and orbital industry. Mine asteroids, grow a station from a single command core, research new technology and design your own ships module by module, then wage war across 84 branching missions, survival runs and online battles.

4502240.name: The Legend of Chalkvania
4502240.short_description: The Legend of Chalkvania is a compact, open-world side-scrolling action RPG set in a storybook kingdom. Wander freely, hunt monsters, fish quiet waters, uncover hidden paths, meet peculiar locals or sit by the fire. Hoard gear, recover the shattered Sword of Grayscale and decide the world's fate.

3759980.name: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ Playtest

5050460.name: Butterfly Æffect: Papillons à Quatre Mains
5050460.short_description: A visual novel about love and violence set in the early 2000's.

5368450.name: Farkle: Tavern Dice
5368450.short_description: Farkle: Tavern Dice brings the classic push-your-luck dice game to a cozy medieval tavern. Roll for points, decide when to bank your score, and risk another throw for a bigger payoff—or lose the round.

5152360.name: Merge Day: Office Girls
5152360.short_description: [Merge Day: Office Girls] is a bishoujo puzzle game where you merge items to blast through a mountain of work. As a rookie in a secret department, get tangled up with 4 unique heroines. Merge items to finish your tasks, and merge your bonds to spark a thrilling office romance!

5073740.name: Furry Fable - Hentai Jigsaw
5073740.short_description:
Step into a world of forbidden fables, where sexy, bold and highly desirable furry girls await you.
Furry Fable – Hentai Jigsaw is an adult puzzle game that will keep you hard while you piece together increasingly naughty and explicit images.

4601350.name: GammaBoost+
4601350.short_description: The #1 display control tool for gamers: make games brighter, more vibrant, and easier to see in the dark. Adjust gamma, brightness, contrast, digital vibrance, and color in real time — one-click presets, per-game profiles, LUT import/export, OBS sync, Stream Deck, and eye care.

5309920.name: Alien Archeologist Demo
5309920.short_description: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

5322720.name: Here Comes the Horde Demo
5322720.short_description: Here Comes the Horde is an auto-battler incremental game where your loyal soldiers fight against hordes of undead enemies led by a formidable necromancer. Play this demo for the taste of the full experience and try yourself out in the first 7 levels of the game.

5333520.name: FUTA GIRLS
5333520.short_description: FUTA GIRLS - is a simple 2D game for adults in which you have to uncover hot images of beautiful ladies.

5337870.name: NETWORK & CYBER SECURITY SIMULATOR Demo
5337870.short_description: A 3D educational simulation game focused on networking and cybersecurity. Configure network devices, analyze security events, work with SOC tools, and learn penetration testing through hands-on, interactive scenarios.

5411910.name: Nether Abyss Demo
5411910.short_description: Scale the doomed Nether Abyss to leap into the Well of Reincarnation. In this dark Chinese Action-Roguelite with Extraction mechanics, rise as a nameless undead from the blood pools. Scavenge the fallen, endure cycles of rebirth, slay ancient demons, and draw your blade against heaven as you climb.

5436300.name: Pack Ripper Demo
5436300.short_description: Pack Ripper is a hands-on trading card incremental game. Rip open packs, fill your binder, and level up your packs for better pulls. Will you sell the hit or keep it? Play the free demo with 4 card sets to collect.

5440800.name: OMSI 2 Add-on O560 III Series
5440800.short_description: O560 III Series – add-on for OMSI 2 is a pack of legendary intercity buses intended for intercity and medium distance lines. Manufactured in Turkey, those buses are dedicated to the European market. Most popular in Germany and all over the Europe.

5085860.name: Burger Shooter Demo
5085860.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

5100940.name: Bad Pig House Demo
5100940.short_description: You lost your piggy family... Rebuild your home to stay safe.

5195140.name: Message From Aliens Demo
5195140.short_description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

5242970.name: Scratch It! Lucky Cards Demo
5242970.short_description: Scratch tickets, uncover hidden rewards, and upgrade your abilities in this relaxing casual game. Discover unique themes, collect treasures, and build your luck one scratch at a time.

5246140.name: FailRooms Demo
5246140.short_description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

5257100.name: Stupid Tankers Demo
5257100.short_description: Play as “Ze Germans” in World War II: four friends, one tank, and a chaotic co-op adventure blasting your way to the front.

5267440.name: DungeonBox Demo
5267440.short_description: A fantasy party game for up to 8 players, where everyone joins in from their phones. Type what you want to do, vote for the best idea, and roll dice to see if it works!

4683850.name: All Haul the King Demo
4683850.short_description: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.

4695090.name: FPS Chess: Ignition
4695090.short_description: FPS Chess: Ignition features the all new "wood" set of pieces with new unique weapons and abilities, plus a new map that reimagines the original FPS Chess map!

4699340.name: Iron Hunters Demo
4699340.short_description: BUILD A WAR MACHINE. BREAK THE RUN. A survivor-like where you build a mech into an absurd war machine. Upgrade, evolve, and combine weapons mid-run to create game-breaking synergies as you battle hordes of enemies across alien worlds.

4729690.name: Referee Life Simulator 2026 Demo
4729690.short_description: Play the opening weeks of a referee career for free! Create your official, take charge in the English and German second tiers, show cards, review goals with VAR and face the pressure and headlines that follow every call.

4757860.name: Inn Over Your Head Demo
4757860.short_description: An incremental game where you run a tavern with a deadly secret beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, dig deeper into the dungeon below, and lure adventurers to their doom with irresistible treasure. Then harvest their souls to do it all over again. Ready to get Inn Over Your Head?

4890760.name: THE DEAD WE KNEW
4890760.short_description: Explore a dangerous open world, loot abandoned places, build your shelter, produce food, and manage your resources. Survive alone or in co-op against zombies, hostile humans, and the growing dangers that come with the fog.

4893510.name: 1,200 Welcome Pack - Rainbow Six Siege
4893510.short_description: Get 1,200 R6 Credits, instant unlock of four operators, and a seven-day Renown Booster for the same price as a standard 1,200 R6 Credits pack. Only available while this season lasts!

4894860.name: The Hollowing Demo
4894860.short_description: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

4972430.name: Andre Miri Cipa
4972430.short_description: What if racism had been almost totally eradicated? An educational, narrative adventure, Andre Miri Cipa / In My Own Skin takes you on a journey to a hopeful future. From there, Robin, Vanessa and Marie return to painful experiences from their adolescence.

2854160.name: INAZUMA ELEVEN: Victory Road Worldwide Beta Test Demo "Leave Your Inazuma Mark on the World!"

5462520.name: Voltform Demo
5462520.short_description: Become more than a line of text in Voltform, a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Share clues, restore power, and rebuild your digital bodies from 2D to 3D. Solve puzzles together and uncover the secrets of a silent city. Demo includes Levels 1–20.

4413070.name: つみみじかん～狂オシイホド愛シテル～
4413070.short_description: “Intervene in Tsumimi’s stream” through comments and Mega Chats, then use your deductions to change their fate in this 15-day psychological horror adventure.

4423570.name: FATAL FRAME II: Crimson Butterfly REMAKE x SILENT HILL f Costume Set
4423570.short_description: Transform into Shimizu Hinako, the main character from SILENT HILL f, with this costume set.

4424890.name: Rent A Car Together Demo
4424890.short_description: Start by renting your first car in Rent A Car Together (Demo). Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

4526350.name: 深空遗民 Demo
4526350.short_description: This space survival sim lets you build a space station, construct ships to gather resources for expansion, and upgrade tech for stronger shields to withstand cosmic radiation, all while surviving in a radioactive environment.

4575720.name: Escape Simulator 2: Apocalypse DLC
4575720.short_description: The Apocalypse DLC adds 4 new escape rooms set in a near-future world devastated by an unknown catastrophe. Civilization has gone quiet. Cities are overgrown, systems are failing, and the only way forward is through the clues left by those who came before you.

4597400.name: Shadowstone Demo
4597400.short_description: Shadowstone is a 1-4 player tactics roguelite where you must master strategic positioning and powerful hero synergies to survive against the unrelenting horrors of the Sunderlands.

4607340.name: 伊莉亚娜公主的坠落之夜~她已不再属于你~
4607340.short_description: After the Demon King is defeated, hero Edmond rescues Princess Ilyana. With his fall, the balance of power unravels and darkness returns. As hidden schemes arise, you become her guardian. Will you guide her through the shadows to a brighter future?

4608570.name: Screamer Demo
4608570.short_description: Jump into the demo of Screamer and get a taste of the most brutal racing showdown!

4657880.name: Symphony of the Serpent Demo
4657880.short_description: Symphony of the Serpent is the latest thrilling chapter in the NLT saga, where a mysterious sex virus sweeps across the globe, setting the stage for the war between Heaven and Hell to reignite. As the otherworldly forces rise, humanity's fate hangs in the balance.

4199820.name: The Golden Caravan Demo
4199820.short_description:
Fight your way up The Golden Caravan Casino in this noir Roguelite where Poker Battles decide your fate.
Play bold Hands, gamble for powerful Trinkets and pull daring Tricks to shift the odds in your favor.

4249280.name: ACE COMBAT 8 - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
4249280.short_description: Grants Playable Aircraft: F-14A for ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE.

4289350.name: Funeral for the Sun Demo
4289350.short_description: Search the ashes of an abandoned town and uncover 400 years of damnation, family history and revolution. Witness the past with your own eyes, construct a web of connections between townsfolk, discover secret identities, and learn the foul supernatural truth of what sleeps beneath the rubble.

4338180.name: Dearbnb
4338180.short_description:
Buy, Decorate, Rent, Relax.
Start with a tiny apartment, decorate cozy spaces, manage rentals and businesses, and rise from a poor neighborhood to the city’s most prestigious zones.
A calming yet deep management experience where every room tells a story.

4660200.name: Oink Splash Party
4660200.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler where bouncy piggies battle across giant inflatable waterparks! Punch, bounce, and inflate your way to victory.

3796720.name: Mr. Magpie’s Harmless Card Game Demo
3796720.short_description: A surreal corporate horror deckbuilder where you gamble your life for cash, dodge murderous JERRY cards, and “maximise synergies” to climb the company ladder in Mr Magpie’s office nightmare.

3827330.name: Midnight Launch: A Gameshop Sim
3827330.short_description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

3905010.name: ONE PIECE: Grand Gourmet
3905010.short_description:
Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE!
 
Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

5417760.name: Stick Life: The Daily Grind Demo

3473530.name: BloomTale Demo
3473530.short_description: BloomTale is a cozy flower shop simulation game where creativity meets management. Arrange beautiful flower compositions, manage your shop, and satisfy your customers in a magical world of blooming potential.

3488890.name: Sayaka: My Naughty Milf Neighbor
3488890.short_description: Move in, settle down, and let Sayaka, your hot MILF neighbor, spoil you like never before! She’s warm, she’s caring, and she’s ready to make you feel very welcome. Will you resist her charms, or let her teach you a few thing about sex?

3558150.name: Duckpool
3558150.short_description: A rubber duck. Lasers. Bathroom chaos. Duckpool is a challenging top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Blast bizarre enemies, dodge traps, defeat bosses, and escape with your soap. Build a flock of 150 ducks and uncover the mystery behind the bubbles.

3559250.name: CODE VEIN II - Deluxe Upgrade Pack
3559250.short_description: The Deluxe Upgrade Pack contains an outfit pack with 3 costume sets and 1 weapon, and the Expansion DLC: Mask of Idris.

3670730.name: Horror Tales Eats The World
3670730.short_description: The Ultimate Gore & Terror Experience.Bodycam meets body horror. Explore dark, abandoned, photorealistic environments filled with gore, brutal violence, and terrifying paranormal entities. Find hidden tapes. Uncover bloody tales of horror. Your microphone is listening. Stay quiet. Stay alive

3691010.name: Glass Masquerade 3: Honeylines - Tales & Strives
3691010.short_description: The "Tales & Strives" puzzle set contains 10 new puzzles representing 2 new themes with 5 puzzles in each, respectively - FREE demo puzzles included!

3740090.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
3740090.short_description: Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros. Train, eat, fight, dope, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up — but tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal.

3762010.name: Fernbus Simulator - England
3762010.short_description: Discover England with around 15 cities and more than 60 distinctive buildings and landmarks. Travel through London, Birmingham, Manchester, Liverpool, Oxford, Leeds and other cities, and discover famous landmarks such as Big Ben, the London Eye, Westminster Bridge and Tower Bridge.

3308900.name: Monster Hunter Wilds - High Resolution Texture Pack
3308900.short_description: Experience Monster Hunter Wilds like you've never seen it before with the High Resolution Texture Pack!

5241840.name: Armament Inc
5241840.short_description: Build a global arms empire in this idle tycoon. Research weapons, automate production, ship contracts across a live world map, out-maneuver rivals in diplomacy, and flex your fortune in a private mansion on your way to the top.

3012900.name: Life is Strange: Double Exposure Ultimate Upgrade
3012900.short_description: Upgrade to Ultimate to add three exclusive Outfit Packs and cat content!

3129420.name: ASPIS
3129420.short_description: ASPIS is a story-driven first-person horror game set in the late-1980s USSR. Engineer Andrey enters an experimental system to see his deceased family again. But the machine opens worlds it was never meant to find. Explore the institute and step beyond reality.

5461880.name: Voltform
5461880.short_description: Become more than a line of text in Voltform, a two-player online co-op puzzle adventure. Share clues, restore power, and rebuild your digital bodies from 2D to 3D. Solve puzzles together and uncover the secrets of a silent city.

2679790.name: Baron
2679790.short_description: Are you ready to rule the underworld in Turkey’s first open-world action/adventure game? Take up your father’s legacy and bring down the Dark Council. Protect your neighborhood in the streets of Ankara, which are rife with betrayal, and uncover the hidden secrets behind it all!

2573830.name: Glass Masquerade 3: Honeylines Soundtrack
2573830.short_description: The Original Soundtrack for "Glass Masquerade 3: Honeylines", composed and produced by Nikita Sevalnev, known for his masterful work on soundtracks for the whole "Glass Masquerade" series.

3339970.name: WendyQuest
3339970.short_description: Welcome to WendyQuest - a well-done 2D adventure RPG from Wendy’s packed with crispy combat, handcrafted pixel art, and fresh, never frozen puzzles. Play as redheaded warrior Wendy & battle evil mech-monsters to save a culinary kingdom in peril.

2088788.name: Little Nightmares III - Klonoa Costumes Set
2088788.short_description: Bring nostalgia and darkness together with these costumes. A tribute to the beloved classic, reimagined with a creepy twist for your journey through the Spiral.

2177760.name: Half-Life 2: VR Mod - Episode Two
2177760.short_description: Prepare for unforeseen consequences as you traverse the White Forest and battle the Combine forces as Gordon Freeman in this community-made adaptation of Episode Two to glorious roomscale Virtual Reality!

4009490.name: Arctic Drive
4009490.short_description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

1661620.name: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl - Deluxe Upgrade
1661620.short_description: S.T.A.L.K.E.R. 2: Heart of Chornobyl is the unforgiving FPS survival adventure in a dark science-fiction open world. Deluxe Edition provides a unique set of firearms and suits along with an Official Artbook and Original Soundtrack Set.

1713730.name: Moadra
1713730.short_description: Endure... Evolve... or die. Embrace the unknown and traverse a vast alien world riddled with bizarre creatures, deadly hazards, and grim mysteries. Seek redemption, and confront the terrifying sin buried in the depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI.

1843460.name: HITMAN 3 Access Pass: HITMAN 1 GOTY Edition
1843460.short_description:
The HITMAN 3 Access Pass system allows you to access HITMAN 1 and HITMAN 2 locations in HITMAN 3.

Purchasing or redeeming this Access Pass will grant access to the locations from 'HITMAN 1 - GOTY Edition' in HITMAN 3. You must own HITMAN 3 to access this content.

1358520.name: Pesterquest Soundtrack
1358520.short_description: Enjoy the fine-grooving tunes of Pesterquest, the grimsical episodic visual novel adventure set in the darkly funny Homestuck universe.

1390150.name: Summer Memories+ - Expansion DLC
1390150.short_description: Were there not enough memories to be made in the original? Don't worry, we agree! Enjoy new scenes, new voices, and more memories in this expansion DLC from the developer Dojin Otome.

1234730.name: HereSphere VR Video Player
1234730.short_description: HereSphere is a cutting edge VR video player that enhances immersion. Features include an autofocus depth algorithm, software IPD adjustment, head-tracking, spatial audio, lens distortion and alignment corrections, online video streaming, and video tagging with advanced search features.

1014940.name: Nehrim: At Fate's Edge
1014940.short_description: Nehrim: At Fate's Edge is an total conversion mod for TES IV: Oblivion. is Explore the eponymous land of Nehrim and its dense forests and deserts, delve into ancient crypts and labyrinthine caves, and experience an unconventional, gripping storyline that unfolds beyond good and evil.

3923150.name: Climb King
3923150.short_description: Climb. Fall. Repeat. A high-stakes pixel-art climbing game with grab-and-swing movement, harsh drops, and “safe points” that aren’t as safe as you’d like.

949220.name: LEGO® DC Super-Villains Aquaman Bundle Pack
949220.short_description: Download now to get access to the Aquaman Movie Level Pack 1 & 2! Control your favorite characters based on the DC Aquaman film! Battle as Aquaman and rule the underwater kingdom of Atlantis! Level Packs include Aquaman, Black Manta, Mera, Orm and more.

949221.name: Shazam Movie Level Pack Bundle
949221.short_description: Download now to get access to Shazam! Movie Level Pack 1 & 2! Control your favorite characters based on the Shazam! film. Play as Billy Batson to fight against the evil Dr. Sivana and his 7 Deadly Sins! Level Pack 1 & 2 includes Shazam, The Wizard Shazam, Dr. Sivana and more.

5257620.name: One More Rule
5257620.short_description: Match fruits and survive while an ancient spirit adds more and more rules for you to follow! Win through multiple game modes and even customize your own.

720750.name: LEGO® Marvel Super Heroes 2 - Black Panther
720750.short_description: Set within the Kingdom of Wakanda, players will take the legendary Wakandan Super Hero and his sister Shuri on a dangerous mission within the darkest depths of their homeland, battling mutated creatures and arch-nemesis Erik Killmonger's vicious army.

361770.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy: Scorpion and Sub-Zero (Part 2)
361770.short_description: Jubei watches as his mother is held captive by Sub Zero's men, contemplating attacking them with one of his father's kunai.

2216850.name: Battle Vision
2216850.short_description: Battle your way to fame and glory in this cosmic tactical puzzle-battle roguelike! Recruit your ultimate team, equip them with powerful abilities and take them on a season-long run of domination in the universe’s most-watched battle-sport!

5232070.name: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard Playtest

327170.name: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham DLC: Man of Steel
327170.short_description: Help Jor-El, his wife Lara and their robot Kelex send the infant Superman into space towards the safety of Earth as Krypton falls. Find a way inside Jor-El’s home, fight General Zod’s invading forces and battle against Zod himself to save Superman.

327171.name: LEGO Batman 3: Beyond Gotham DLC: Batman 75th Anniversary
327171.short_description: Play as Joker and Harley Quinn, setting up a variety of celebration set pieces. Be the Dark Knight and play as some of the most iconic faces of Batman through the years, including his first appearance in Detective Comics #27.

5300140.name: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell Demo
5300140.short_description:
A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses.
DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

3182310.name: SubDuctis
3182310.short_description: Traverse a puzzling metallic landscape by folding away space itself. Bypass obstacles, form conductive paths, and discover new areas by folding, unfolding, and folding again.

5222050.name: The Circle of the Time Playtest

5474530.name: Halloween: Tidy Up
5474530.short_description: One witch's manor desperately in need of a little tidying up. Welcome to an old Victorian manor filled with magic, mysteries, and an unbelievable amount of clutter! Your task is simple: find a place for every item and turn this charming chaos into a perfectly organized collection.

5334200.name: Potion Approaching
5334200.short_description: A haunted manor item-crafting game where players combine three everyday objects to brew custom potions for visitors. Earned payments are used to pay off the residing ghosts before things get out of hand.

4269640.name: Monkeys Don't Fear Hell
4269640.short_description:
A cozy farming and building sim by day, a demon-slaying gauntlet by night - grow crops, raise a town and then descend to battle waves of demons and towering bosses.
DOOM & Vampire Survivors meets Stardew Valley.

5331660.name: UNSTITCHED
5331660.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4–15 players set in a creepy dollhouse. Run minigame errands by night, accuse by day and unmask the Rag Doll. Play online, against bots or Face to Face: one copy on the PC, everyone else plays from their own phone.

5243160.name: Rising Together: Nayyar & Riab
5243160.short_description:
Rising Together is a fantasy 2D action adventure coop game. With a friend pass. 

It is an emotional story-rich, includes traversal challenges, puzzles and bosses. 

With power systems for individual heroes and combined for both heroes.

4100100.name: Tabula
4100100.short_description: A peculiar virus has taken root at the heart of the Tabula CS-1, a computer system that was lost to time. Alongside Little Bit, a newly-installed anti-virus, you are tasked with freeing the computer from the malware's clutches.

5163220.name: Last Civilization: Inherited Flame
5163220.short_description: Build a village around humanity's last flame. Gather, build, and research by day; defend against Shadows at night. When a village falls, pass its records and memories to the next civilization. Learn from each generation and survive the night that stopped the last.

4998960.name: Imperionis Demo
4998960.short_description: Command a Roman centuria during the first 24 days of the campaign in Gaul. Make decisions, manage your camp, and fight three hex-based tactical battles manually or with real-time autobattle.

4993610.name: Imperionis
4993610.short_description: Imperionis is a tactical RPG about a Roman commander and his century. Develop troops, camp and doctrines, then watch them perform in autobattles. Disable autobattle at any time to command the century and fight the commander’s personal encounters manually.

4891560.name: Hidden Cat Islands
4891560.short_description: 🐱 Hidden Cat Islands is a relaxing 3D exploration game where you search for hidden cats across uniquely themed islands. Move your camera freely, use helpful hints, discover interactive objects, and find hidden photos along the way!

5404480.name: Dulat Demo
5404480.short_description: Dulat is a puzzle-platformer where you manipulate how you interact with matter to overcome obstacles and restart the universe. Embark on this adventure, unravel its mysteries, and discover the secrets behind a broken world.

5335970.name: Ostinato
5335970.short_description: The musical roguelike deckbuilder. Duel rival casters note against note, silence their melody with your own, and build outrageous combos that swell your score into the millions.

2951910.name: Project: G-216
2951910.short_description: In "Project: G-216, you are responsible for monitoring various cursed locations around the world. You will monitor surveillance camera feeds and have to react quickly to any anomalies. Don't let too many come together - it could cost your life.

1946060.name: EvilTrap
1946060.short_description: EvilTrap is set in a cursed village where an endless night forces you to seek fleeting refuge. Hunted by something that listens and remembers, you will quickly learn that a deep evil consumes this place. Hide, survive, and find a way out.

2842310.name: Among Us Story: On Guard
2842310.short_description: Live life as a Crewmate in this dangerous narrative adventure through space. As Guard, you're in charge of shipwide security and everything is fine. Until there's a MURDER?! Prove your innocence before the Impostor gets to the rest of the crew... and you.

3590820.name: 珠宝之王
3590820.short_description: Run a vintage jewelry business: hunt for bargains, haggle, appraise and sell to the right customer. Build your collection from thousands of pieces, balance stock against the bills, and solve 500 jewelry puzzles to earn new treasures.

5233490.name: Sort The Bunnies
5233490.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

5294940.name: Sort The Bunnies Demo
5294940.short_description: A cozy organizing simulator for 1–4 players. Sort 500 bunny designs, fill colorful shelves, and turn a messy shop into a collection worth admiring. Unlock handy upgrades and make a little mischief along the way.

4627010.name: Militsioner Demo
4627010.short_description: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

3797240.name: Chaos Coin Demo
3797240.short_description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Slot sequences of coins to shove, evade, and attack in turn-based combat. Fight in pairs using coins unique to each character. Upgrade and replace individual coin faces to build complex combos. Chaos is coming, so use your heads (and tails)!

4929480.name: Draft Eleven
4929480.short_description: Draft Eleven is a football auto-battler roguelite where you build your perfect XI, scout the transfer market, create powerful synergies, adapt your tactics, and compete in asynchronous PvP against squads built by real players from around the world.

4163660.name: Gun a Rat
4163660.short_description:
Don’t like rats? Don’t like your friends?
Then this game is made for you!
Hunt down the rats before they wreck the place, and methodically place your traps to slow them down as much as possible!

4578730.name: Massive Frontier
4578730.short_description: Command a growing fleet in a free-to-play, persistent real-time space MMO. Pick one of twelve rival human factions, build your starbase, mine rare resources, research alien tech and wage war across a seamless universe, while an ancient alien Tide gathers at the edge of the Frontier.

5172860.name: 亡灵苏生
5172860.short_description: Defeat the horde. Raise the fallen into a skeleton legion and lead it with your spells. Reclaim the Seal of Return, bring the dead home, and rebuild a workshop and a camp where people await your return. Eastern dark fantasy action. Play the free demo.

1037170.name: Maximum Thunderness
1037170.short_description:
An extreme response to minor problems.

MAXIMUM THUNDERNESS is a roguelike side-scrolling co-op action game where you battle space alien criminals attempting to conquer Earth through a series of increasingly petty crimes.

4796100.name: Company Captain: Westashes
4796100.short_description: You are the captain of a free company... one among many roaming this mercenary world, growing, falling, earning and betraying just as you do. The world will not bend for you, nor wait: the other companies are already writing their stories. Yours will be decided in steel, gold and a name.

5465860.name: ANOMIA
5465860.short_description:
ANOMIA - 1977.
Process signals and survive the harsh nights in your new spacious work unit, somewhere up North. Something isn't quite right in the snow, and strange messages are stashed throughout your room. Play through a 10 day story or play with friends online to survive as long as you can.

5258260.name: A Tale of Light
5258260.short_description: The Light is dying. You must restore it. Lead a party of six through the city of Sómariel and the dungeons beneath it in a first-person, grid-based dungeon crawler in the old tradition.

5310670.name: Sad Damn
5310670.short_description: Sad Damn is hiding. Use your fortress to blast your way to him. Tear through his generals' defenses, get better weapons, and try not to get blown up first.

5080510.name: Hallowed Empire
5080510.short_description: Hallowed Empire is a real-time strategy game of kingdoms, war, and corruption. Build your empire, upgrade your warriors, forge alliances with rival factions, and decide the fate of the undead. Will you destroy them, embrace them, or turn their power against your enemies?

4886320.name: 海陆空四国大战
4886320.short_description: Read the board. Read your opponents. A military board game of hidden information, bluffing and land, sea and air tactics. Play 4-player 2v2, draw identities and guess allegiances in 6-player 3v3, or face an opponent in a land duel.

5349710.name: IAFT Fear Diagnosis
5349710.short_description: A new kind of horror game that builds a stage just for you from the results of a fear diagnosis. Scary, and a little funny. Heights, tight spaces, bugs, ghosts, even paperwork: your fears combine into over 2 million stages, so no two runs are alike. Too scary? Exclude any fear in the settings.

4527960.name: Pierce Through Heavens
4527960.short_description: Pierce Through Heavens is an open-world multiplayer RPG inspired by Chinese mythology and xianxia literature. Gather rare resources, craft potent elixirs, and cultivate ancient martial arts to survive the continent’s many dangers and rise as an immortal.

4939200.name: Shadows in Sanluca
4939200.short_description: A Supernatural mystery in the beating heart of a Latin American city. Scour the past memories of an abandoned house, build out a web of connections between its inhabitants, and learn of the sinister truth that led to their downfall.

4649980.name: It's Chopping Time! - Gold Edition
4649980.short_description: Supporter Pack, which lets you pimp in gold the appearance of the game! (This DLC is purely cosmetic)

5363290.name: Phone Shop Simulator
5363290.short_description: Build and run your own phone shop! Stock phones and accessories, design your displays, set prices and serve customers. Manage your money and turn a small store into a thriving business in Phone Shop Simulator.

4088360.name: Funeral for the Sun
4088360.short_description: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

4997100.name: Aircraft Tycoon
4997100.short_description: Build an aircraft company from the pioneering age of aviation. Design and test aircraft, source engines, negotiate orders, manage production and cash flow, and grow your reputation through every successful delivery.

4220070.name: Comrade, Secrets Escape!
4220070.short_description: Comrade, thousands of bio-experiments are escaping. Line escape routes with guns, blast holes through the horde, and unlock absurd Soviet weapons in this incremental tower defence. Excessive force is authorized.

5408470.name: Glory to the Heroes Soundtrack
5408470.short_description: The original soundtrack of Glory to the Heroes: 17 tracks by Муковіз Дмитро and Воронов Сергій, including four demo recordings. Includes all 17 tracks in MP3 and FLAC formats.

5368910.name: BOOMSWEEPER
5368910.short_description: An incremental twist on classic Minesweeper. Sweep, earn, upgrade, hire a crew, dig up Finds and go deeper into boards inside boards. One wrong click... BOOM.

5452340.name: RAYBREAKER
5452340.short_description: A neon twin-stick shooter with the loot heart of an action RPG. Burn down a glowing fuse in 5 to 8 minute runs, read the swarm, break its bosses and bring home gear that rewrites your build. Six bands of a shattered spectrum, solo or in co-op for two, side by side or online.

5026650.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder Demo
5026650.short_description: Play the free demo of Deck Breaker, a roguelike deckbuilder where the cards you FOIL travel from quest to quest, forever. Build absurd combos from 200+ cards and 35 heroes that each warp the rules—then carry your favorite discoveries into the next adventure.

4332970.name: Requiem of Cards
4332970.short_description: A tactical card battler where creatures move like chess pieces across a 7×7 battlefield. Build your deck, fuse cards into greater monsters and discover all Archtypes. Duel online in 1v1, 2v2, or free-for-all.

5154680.name: Little Colony
5154680.short_description: The ant farm you had as a kid, alive at the edge of your screen. Paint a line and the ants dig it. Paint a room and they build it. Glance back later and they've been farming, foraging, and surviving the seasons. Every spring the Queens fly and the trees grows.

5475000.name: Doomigos
5475000.short_description: Doomigos is a third-person 3D bullet heaven roguelite! Survive relentless waves of enemies, unleash destruction with automatically firing weapons, and battle powerful bosses in chaotic arena combat. Keep moving, keep fighting, and survive the madness!

5376580.name: Killer in a Corn Maze
5376580.short_description: Play the killer. Or try to escape one. A top-down pixel horror game set in a corn maze on Halloween night.

5473320.name: Detective Club
5473320.short_description: Investigate crime scenes, question the people involved, and expose a lie with decisive evidence. Play two complete cases for free, including their endings and explanations. Continue your investigations with separately purchased casebooks.

5473330.name: Detective Club: The First Casebook
5473330.short_description: Add five new investigations to the free base game. Meet twenty people across a photo studio, salon, coastal village, mountain path and distribution depot, and expose a different lie in each case.

5295330.name: Water TD
5295330.short_description: Water TD is a tower defense game where the enemy is a real flood. Hundreds of thousands of drops pour downhill toward your base, piling up, finding gaps and carving the terrain as they go. Shoot it, burn it, zap it, or blow it back. Just don't expect the ground to hold.

5423430.name: My Basement is Hungry
5423430.short_description: 'My Basement is Hungry' is a Psychological Horror game with survival horror elements. You must find your way through the strange basement of your home and discover what is actually happening down there, learning more about who your father is and what strange ties he may have had.

5329910.name: The Ant Game
5329910.short_description: The Ant Game is a real-time colony sim with no floating cursor and no god's-eye view. You live in the dirt as a single ant while a whole colony runs around you: foraging by scent, digging its own nest, raising brood, and fighting beetles, spiders and rival colonies for the same patch of meadow.

4199250.name: War Tactics
4199250.short_description: 《War Tactics》is a turn-based tactical game inspired by "Advance Wars". Command military units on square grids in modern warfare scenarios. Features deep tactics, intuitive controls, rich unit variety, complex terrain interactions, and single-player campaigns. Plan and conquer with your intellect.

4932530.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights Demo
4932530.short_description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or try 20 more puzzles, Easy to Expert, in every world.

5365260.name: HOOTENANNY
5365260.short_description: HOOTENANNY is a fast-paced online first-person game of tag in the Wild West. Chase your friends as the Sheriff, or dash, slide and wall-jump to stay out of reach across frontier arenas. Keep moving. Make your shot count.

4559890.name: Blockflow
4559890.short_description: Blockflow is a roguelike puzzle game where strategic grid placement meets satisfying combo mechanics. Clear lines, manage your shape pool to hit score milestones, and draft powerful upgrades. Earn Blockcoins to unlock new shapes and permanent buffs in this highly addictive meta-progression puzzler!

5361640.name: Duck Duck Run
5361640.short_description:
The ducks are on the run, and you have 3 minutes to catch them!
Chase them down as they try to escape. Catch ducks to earn coins and unlock new items and upgrades.

5087430.name: Under the dead sun
5087430.short_description: The Sun is dead. Humanity survives in eternal darkness. Awaken among the corpses as Nameless, guided by a living heart. Explore a dying world, master forbidden magic, and decide what future humanity deserves.

5467180.name: Ludus Magna Demo
5467180.short_description: Thirty days. One Ludus. Your chance at glory. Recruit, train and equip gladiators. Watch auto-battles or intervene with quick-time events. Reach 300 Fame to unlock the Primus, then risk your finest fighter in a battle to the death.

5217350.name: Wet Streets 💧
5217350.short_description: Kenzie’s surprise was clear when she walked in the aftermath of the midnight rain. The streets were dead except for one lonely soul. A soul as hot and horny as her own! In no time at all, the two latex lovers get the streets dirty all over again! A rain is coming, but this time, it’s hot and steamy!

4931970.name: MoonDoku: Sudoku Nights
4931970.short_description: A cozy little Sudoku for quiet nights. Solve tonight’s puzzle with a cat by your side and earn a new star for your sky. Come back tomorrow for another, and watch your stars slowly come together as constellations. Or settle in with 5,000 more puzzles, Easy to Expert.

5401770.name: Tinker to the Moon
5401770.short_description: Give your little invention a chance to do something wonderful. Tinker, take a leap, and feel the joy of getting a little further than before. A cozy flying adventure about small steps, happy accidents, and a dream as big as the Moon.

5486000.name: Emberveth
5486000.short_description: A couch co-op spellcaster for one to four players. Aim every spell by hand, jump what you cannot walk around, and read fifteen bespoke bosses well enough not to burn your friends. Friendly fire is always on.

1703590.name: Abalon Demo
1703590.short_description: A turn-based tactics and deckbuilding game that challenges you to command your favorite fantasy characters in novel ways. Explore an open world of ever-changing adventures where a roll of the dice can change your fate. Master your strategy to achieve the most satisfying victories.

5206930.name: A Drop of Magenta
5206930.short_description: A Drop of Magenta is a puzzle game about painting inside (and outside) the lines.

4762410.name: 挂机放置修仙录 Demo
4762410.short_description: Recruit five cultivators, build your formation, solve a sword-mark puzzle, and challenge Qingman in automatic battles with 1x, 2x, and 3x speed. Play and save the complete Chapter 1 journey.

5296180.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em Playtest

5460370.name: Desktop Destruction
5460370.short_description: Your real desktop, frozen into a picture and made of glass, wood, metal, paper, concrete or flesh. Then you get the hammer, the chainsaw, the flamethrower and fourteen more tools, and every one breaks every material the way the real thing would.

5364990.name: Ominous Descent
5364990.short_description: Ominous Descent is a fast-paced 2D twin-stick shooter set in an alien deep-sea trench. Piercing the abyss with your headlights, pilot your submarine and blast through the inky depths as everything from small predatory fish to colossal abominations hunt you at every turn.

2352400.name: Abalon Arena
2352400.short_description: Cards, tactics and mutant squirrels! Enter the arena and compete head to head, play cooperatively or go it alone to defeat increasingly challenging onslaughts of enemies in a cunning game of wits set in the fantastical world of Abalon.

5388610.name: The Price of Empire
5388610.short_description: Grand strategy on the real Earth: found your nation anywhere you like, build cities and mines, wage war with tanks and artillery and forge alliances – against up to 20 AI rivals or with friends. But every new territory comes at a price.

5343400.name: Car Flipper
5343400.short_description: A first person car flipping game. Find underpriced used cars on your phone and inspect them yourself: pull the dipstick, test the paint, read the codes. Buy the ones that are better than they look, fix what a buyer will notice and sell them on. Play solo or with up to three friends online.

3722820.name: Onlympic Up!
3722820.short_description:
A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes:
“Your fates are now bound.”
Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable.
Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm.
Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

5357410.name: Hiveheart Demo
5357410.short_description: Your tiny colony's adventure begins! Explore the depths of nature in this pink colony, gather resources, and build your nest step by step. Just don't let the little ones go starve! Command your soldiers and workers to keep your queen safe, and turn your colony into a thriving nest.

5314760.name: DOT: KillBox TD
5314760.short_description: Dots are coming. Build a maze of barriers, mount lasers, flamers, missiles and cannons, and stop an ever-growing horde before it reaches the End. Play solo, co-op or PvP — or design your own maps in the built-in editor.

5296670.name: Beyond The Roots Demo
5296670.short_description:
Face the guardians of the sky. Beyond The Roots is a challenging 2D pixel art Boss Rush where every fight is a test of precision.

Play as a determined human aiming to rise to the rank of gods and take down the fallen angels blocking your path.

5147490.name: Darkness
5147490.short_description: Fear not only what the darkness hides, but the power that draws you toward it. Darkness is a top-down dark fantasy action game where light is your only refuge.

3343280.name: Trenchhold TD
3343280.short_description: Trenchhold TD is an incremental tower defense game set on the battlefields of World War I. Hold your trenches against thousands of enemies, strengthen your forces through permanent upgrades, and launch full-scale counterattacks to crush their defenses!

4425790.name: Static Maw
4425790.short_description:
Something out there is trying to reach you.
Work alone as a night operator in a remote antenna facility lost in the void.
Repair broken transmitters and antennas using your computer and tools.
You are not alone. Will you respond?

4799950.name: Conquer the Labyrinth Demo
4799950.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is a third-person anime-inspired ARPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

3509080.name: Forged: Reconquest
3509080.short_description: Forged: Reconquest is a couch & online co-op blacksmithing RTS for up to 4 players sets in medieval era. Team up as master smiths to forge magical gear, arm your armies, and wage war against otherworldly foes in a battle to reclaim your world.

5366080.name: Hieroheart
5366080.short_description: Hieroheart is an action-adventure RPG set in an AI realm where ancient mythology meets living code. Master magical glyphs, nurture and evolve AnimAI companions, build your own camp, and uncover the mysteries of strange and beautiful worlds.

4883880.name: CATHODE
4883880.short_description: Build sprawling defensive networks of high-tech turrets and logistics systems to repel massive enemy swarms! Take direct control of your turrets and utilize powerful support powers to repel the invasion!

4927450.name: Isentroth
4927450.short_description: Swear an oath and walk into the Isenmarch — a cold Norse frontier that does not explain itself. A Machine Game Master narrates your saga, answers the choices you make, the engine rolls, and the model can't fudge a result. No two sagas are alike. What breaks first — your isen, or your troth?

3764730.name: Winter Resort Simulator 3
3764730.short_description: Run your own ski resort in Winter Resort Simulator 3. Operate ropeways, groom slopes and manage snow. Explore the biggest world in the series alone or with friends. Whether you're operating lifts, grooming slopes, or preparing for the next busy season, WRS 3 puts you in charge of the mountain.

2721440.name: Hyper Fin
2721440.short_description: Hyper Fin is a High-Speed Arena Fighter where you Out-Maneuver your enemies and Bash into their weak points.

4880450.name: Legend of Defenders Demo
4880450.short_description: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

4768940.name: Moon Basketball
4768940.short_description: This is basketball.  On the moon.  Gravity is different and also there's jetpacks.

5164130.name: Bio Inc. Classic
5164130.short_description: Relive the original Bio Inc. experience, rebuilt from the ground up for PC to celebrate its 15th anniversary. Develop deadly diseases, cripple your victim’s body, and determine their ultimate fate in this biomedical strategy simulator.

2583700.name: Lucky Dog Rise
2583700.short_description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

3382460.name: The Remains
3382460.short_description: The Remains is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror where an intelligent AI enemy hunts your team whilst adapting to your tactics. Stay quiet and out of sight, or get picked off one by one.

5387160.name: Sumverse
5387160.short_description: Power your spaceship with number puzzles in Sumverse. Swap and stack cores, match row and column totals, and connect numbers into an unbroken trail. Brave cosmic hazards, deliver troublesome cargo, and upgrade your ship as you save for a bigger family home.

4774030.name: Conquer the Labyrinth
4774030.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.

5416650.name: Masyu: Line Logic
5416650.short_description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you draw one loop through every circle, going straight through the white ones and turning on the black ones. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 15,000 more, Easy to Expert.

5349250.name: WarSlice Demo
5349250.short_description:
Fight for the glory of battle in WarSlice!
Try out some turn-based tactical combat with the demo, which offers both offline campaign missions and online PvP!

4919380.name: Grand Theft Idiots
4919380.short_description: A chaotic free-for-all heist game where you backstab your friends for the biggest payout. Trigger fire alarms, tase your rivals, and steal their loot right out of their hands. Race to the getaway van before the cops arrive, because until you extract, nothing you stole is truly yours.

5119440.name: BOOMER Demo
5119440.short_description: A chaotic co-op horror game for up to 6 players. Scavenge eerie environments, feed your loot to a hungry steam engine, and pass Boomer between teammates in a deadly game of hot potato.

1975650.name: The Idle Undead
1975650.short_description: The Idle Undead is an Idle Clicker game set in a Zombie Apocalypse - Upgrade a base, recruit survivors, play minigames to boost your damage!

3469290.name: BRAVO, GASPAR
3469290.short_description: "SURVIVE my SADISTIC SHOW. An ACTION ROGUELIKE where your performance with COLLECTIBLE CREATURES serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: ENTERTAIN OR DIE!"

5388030.name: LEVELS Demo
5388030.short_description: Explore the first true open-world Backrooms: one infinite, procedurally generated world full of unique biomes, shared by every online player. (And the entities live here too!)

5380100.name: BroCode Demo
5380100.short_description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

2288760.name: Night Run EX
2288760.short_description: Race your motorcycle through an endless neon night. Hit checkpoints fast to build your multiplier to 99x, weave through traffic, and chase the ghost of the rider one place above you on the leaderboards. Ride and vibe to the underground electronic soundtrack in this first person arcade racer.

1889990.name: Tactics Adrift
1889990.short_description: A competitive turn-based tactics game with simultaneous planning.

4554700.name: BroCode
4554700.short_description: Escape day-to-day drudgery by immersing in this 2D logic puzzle of bathroom etiquette.

5183160.name: Kyle Coral
5183160.short_description: A serene, hand-made cave-diving adventure. Descend through a living ocean of five biomes, where your air is the only clock. Read the cave, find the air pockets, and surface before it runs out. Just you, the deep, and the next breath. Made by a dad and his two sons.

1793740.name: WILDLOTUS荒原幻想
1793740.short_description:
This work is a secondary creative game work with the theme of Oriental project.

The game type is the survival sandbox class.

Many players are online to collect all kinds of materials and improve their combat ability

1737910.name: XPELLIT
1737910.short_description: A story-driven anime survivors-like. Samara wakes up with no memories in the Eternal Forest: carve through hordes with evolving Xpells, live through events and missions that change every run, and face Mirelle in a cinematic three-phase final battle.

5350040.name: Manafest
5350040.short_description: A free 1v1 collectible card game with a mean sense of humour. Build a 30-card deck from six kinds of mana, climb the ranked ladder, draft from sealed packs and fight in weekly tournaments.

5476770.name: Armed Prisoner III
5476770.short_description: Armed Prisoner III is a 2D casual incremental idle electronic cricket game in which the core gameplay revolves around Bot AI characters using modern firearms to shoot and fight each other. The battles are random, chaotic, and unlimited in duration

4559190.name: Cosmic Fugue
4559190.short_description: A space exploration and crafting game set in a fully simulated N-body small scale solar system, where you build space infrastructure to progress and figure out the mysteries of the cosmos.

5341060.name: Dino Carnage
5341060.short_description: The staff turned. The dinosaurs didn't. ZENGEN sends your crew to its overrun island in a mobile armored rig to clear every zombie, and to mind the company's property: employees are expendable thanks to ZENGEN technology. First-person survival horror for 1-8 players.

1060490.name: ME-OS
1060490.short_description: A packed operating system simulation game that came from another world!
