Play through tons of preloaded games of various genres such as platform fighter, marble racer, first person shooter, rage platformer, level editor and have fun using the preloaded software too. Play alone or with friends!

2379350.name: Scramble Knights Online
2379350.short_description: Adventure with friends in this MMO-lite action RPG! Explore the shared online kingdom of Terracott as a knight-in-training. Team up to conquer dungeons, slay monsters, discover rare loot, and return home to forge powerful new gear before setting out on your next quest.

3712610.name: Apollyon
3712610.short_description: 1979. P.L.U.T.O keeps sending your team of researchers back through G.A.T.E into the backrooms for deeper expeditions, but they are never happy with the lengths you go to. Nearest exit gets your team back safe. Only the deepest exit will suffice.

5367510.name: RETROPULSE Halloween
5367510.short_description: RETROPULSE Halloween is an atmospheric neon puzzle game in a Halloween RETROWAVE style, where vibrant lines, retro anime, spooky neon nights, and '80s aesthetics merge into one digital world. Connect matching colored dots, create neon waves, and unlock colorful Halloween-inspired illustrations.

1207360.name: Medieval Frontiers
1207360.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

5471740.name: Tessera Start Menu
5471740.short_description: The full-screen Windows 10 Start menu, back on Windows 11. Pin apps, files and shortcuts straight from File Explorer, sort them into named groups, and keep it all over blurred wallpaper or live acrylic.

5351930.name: Against Heroes
5351930.short_description: Why wait for heroes to come for you? Build and deploy a monster army to eliminate them before they grow strong enough to defeat you. A strategy roguelite from the Demon Lord’s perspective!

5010440.name: Cozy Banker
5010440.short_description: The bank is drowning in cash. Sort eight currencies, organize over 30,000 banknotes, fill 34 safe-deposit boxes, and turn financial chaos into cozy order.

4148750.name: Dynamite Dashers
4148750.short_description: Throw bombs, upgrade your skills, and survive endless waves of enemies in this fast-paced roguelike action game. Build your explosive arsenal, discover powerful combos, and see how long you can stay alive!

4526960.name: Unfree Freesia
4526960.short_description: The Demo version of Unfree Freesia. A narrative-driven game where Deduction meets the Dark Arts. Invest crime scenes for evidence and navigate the razor's edge between "Rationality" and "Inspiration." Unlock branching paths through your choices, and decide who survives the encroaching shadows.

4689230.name: Market Manager Simulator
4689230.short_description: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

5333740.name: EGNAR
5333740.short_description: Discover the colorful world of Egnar! Learn to time your jumps precisely while using your cannon system to overcome obstacles, solve puzzles and defeat bad guys! Return to the essence of a 2D platformer, in which the player's precision, patience & problem-solving skills are put to the test.

3851590.name: HARWELL: Mars Industries
3851590.short_description: There are no safe spaces in Harwell. Compete for resources, manipulate the Mars Trade Committee, and outbid rivals in a player-driven economy. Use diplomacy – or sabotage and the black market – to disrupt opponents. Control the rules, control the market, eliminate the competition.

4719870.name: Ore Legacy
4719870.short_description: A retro CRT-style incremental mining game set in deep space. Expand your station, automate extraction fleets, harvest stars, and pay down an impossible debt.

2474130.name: Neo Junk City Demo
2474130.short_description: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a cyberpunk action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

4842110.name: Forgery
4842110.short_description: Forgery is a dark medieval roguelike about counterfeiting the King’s coins. Meet each buyer’s target with a handful of punches, then arrange stamp dies that trigger and repeat one another. One good strike can be worth a king’s ransom.

5333010.name: Valoria
5333010.short_description: A top-down survival RPG set in a pixel-art medieval countryside. Sow fields, breed livestock, mine and smelt ore, brew potions, and raise a homestead wall by wall. Fight what comes out after dark, plunder ruined watchtowers, explore the realm of Valoria.

5043620.name: Simple Wars
5043620.short_description: Hex wargame. Capture cities, train units, and fight across the map. Skirmish, campaign, missions, and multiplayer.

3804800.name: Dust
3804800.short_description: DUST: Origins is an isometric horror shooter set aboard a doomed orbital prison platform, imagined by the creators of Darksiders. Abruptly freed from cryo-prison, you fight to escape a murderer’s row of violent criminals and horrifying monsters before the station tears itself apart.

3837960.name: The Story of Noah
3837960.short_description: Welcome to the captivating world of "The Story of Noah" — a journey for you and your children into ancient times and one of the most inspiring stories of the Holy Scriptures! Step into the role of Noah — the man chosen to build an ark and save his family and all animals from the great flood.

4903720.name: Time Stop Tower Defense
4903720.short_description: A fast-paced, time-focused twist on tower defense with a strong emphasis on story, gameplay progression, and world-building.

5001870.name: Facrobry Demo
5001870.short_description: Facrobry is a strategy-simulator in which you will manage an automated robot production station. Research upgrades, assemble robots, and send them into battle!

5470040.name: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden
5470040.short_description: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that lives on your desktop. Dig with a toy shovel, pour sand and water, plant trees and build little houses, then watch crabs, fish and birds go about their day in stop-motion clay. No goals, no failing. Just a small world to poke at.

4214360.name: Dead-End Bounty
4214360.short_description:
Dead-End Bounty is an open-world top-down shooter set in the wild west!
A frontier with 3 kinds of people: the ones on wanted posters, the ones printing them, and people like Charlie—a bounty hunter with his eyes set on one particular bounty that has slipped through his hands a few too many times.

5375200.name: WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion Demo
5375200.short_description: 🧸 WINNIE-THE-POOH: Honey Distortion 🍯 is a mystery visual novel with point-and-click mechanics, inspired by A. A. Milne's stories.

5358720.name: Bleep Wildlife
5358720.short_description: Hunt dangerous animals, return to the tavern, and buy new guns and traps. Complete missions for a mysterious wizard and take on stronger prey.

5253090.name: The Undercity: Last Light
5253090.short_description: Build an underground city in this 2D colony sim. Dig, connect production chains and manage workers whose needs can’t wait. Face earthquakes, make difficult choices and explore forgotten regions as you lead a refuge toward a future beyond survival.

5387350.name: Tactical Terry
5387350.short_description: Terry has a crime problem. Six ridiculous crews have taken over town, and Terry P.D. has a rookie, a coffee machine and a budget the council keeps cutting. Breach, clear and cuff your way through a 1–4 player co-op tactical shooter that takes the shooting seriously and nothing else.

5142470.name: Genius Simulator
5142470.short_description:
**Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!**

In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

4937370.name: Cardboard Conquest
4937370.short_description: Every card is an army in a beautiful papercraft world full of surprises. Choose from slimes, ghosts, a bug hivemind, giants, and more, across 21 distinct packs with unique playstyles. Earn the cardboard crown solo or online with up to three friends.

3486420.name: Road To School
3486420.short_description: Road to School is a physics-based parkour platformer where you ride a bicycle up a treacherous mountain. Jump, balance, and explore hidden paths while tackling brutal challenges on your journey to school. Play alone or with friends in a co-op experience.

4683770.name: Secret of Circadia Demo
4683770.short_description: Secret of Circadia is a retro pixel styled RPG Deckbuilder that combines light City Builder elements and Roguelite mechanics with classic Deckbuilder Combat to create a unique, quirky, cute and fun blend!

5152760.name: Basketball Dynasty
5152760.short_description: Build your ultimate team in Basketball Dynasty, a tactical 2D basketball management sim. Make real-time coaching decisions, call plays, and scout top talents. Combine deep strategy with RPG gear progression to lead your squad to glory!

3778730.name: Psycasso® Demo
3778730.short_description: Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians in this controversial open world, pixel art, murder simulator.

5182640.name: Magic Draw: Chaos
5182640.short_description: Magic Draw Chaos is a chaotic and competitive 3D drawing and guessing party game to play with friends. Draw, race to be the first to guess the word, or score points by guiding others!

5327320.name: Battles of Arunia
5327320.short_description: Build an army of several different factions with different unique bonuses in a turn-based tactical card game. Position your troops, manage action coins and play your Commander cards to change the battle. Collect cards, refine your deck and test your strategies against bots. Climb the ranks in PvP.

1925900.name: Server Owner Tycoon
1925900.short_description: Server Owner Tycoon has you step into the shoes of a game server owner to build your own online empire. Manage your staff members, catch the latest trends, keep users satisfied, research new features, and administer your server. Do you have what it takes to become the best server owner?

4860910.name: Prison Legacy
4860910.short_description: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

3637810.name: Crystalcaller
3637810.short_description: Turn the battlefield into your weapon. In this side-view wave-survival roguelite you aim every spell yourself: mark enemies with one element, then ignite them with another. Ten elemental reactions, a spellbook full of power spells, three bosses — and four biomes to hold.

5016950.name: Hold'em Back
5016950.short_description: A tower defense where poker hands are your spawn button. Five cards, one replace: a pair buys muscle, a straight buys a specialist, and an impossible hand buys back the fighter the casino deleted. Merge, seat, and hold the floor for eight of them.

3187080.name: Reply All
3187080.short_description: A single player roguelite deckbuilder where emails are turn-based combat and you build a deck of devastating responses that will bring even your most passive-aggressive coworker to their knees.

4683430.name: ScareZone: Haunted Attraction Tycoon Demo
4683430.short_description: Build the haunted attraction of your nightmares! Design chilling walkthroughs, fill them with animatronics and actors, then watch your victims - er, guests - scream their way through your twisted creation. Play the demo this spooky season!

4410360.name: HOLD MY WHEEL
4410360.short_description: You need to visit grandma - twin brothers, apocalypse, and all. Keep the bus running, and try not to eat your friends when the hunger hits.

3450580.name: Medieval Frontiers Demo
3450580.short_description: First-person colony simulation where strategy meets survival in a demanding, medieval wilderness. Construct gridless settlements, establish production chains, and manage the needs, desires, and work morale of your villagers to ensure their survival through the harsh realities of nature and disease.

2702430.name: Usual June
2702430.short_description: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

3028380.name: Isles of Arcana
3028380.short_description: You are a Guardian, sent to a world consumed by corruption. Explore increasingly dangerous biomes, gather resources, craft powerful tools, and uncover lost technology as you fight to save Arcana. Play solo or with up to four players.

5122620.name: Fast Food Fortune Demo
5122620.short_description: Fast Food Fortune is a simulation management game. Hire and train your crew. Upgrade and maintain your equipment. Unlock upgrades that will help you on your way. You are graded on how well you do and profits are multiplied. In order to be profitable you will have to lock in when you clock in!

5264700.name: Life in the Kingdom Demo
5264700.short_description: Take the throne at twenty five. Rule until you die. Marry, raise heirs, free your towns from scheming rivals, and carve through dungeons with an evolving arsenal. One ruler, one lifetime, one unforgettable reign. An adventure packed kingdom life-sim where every year counts.

5249460.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space Demo
5249460.short_description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

4888340.name: Curse of the Chronomancer
4888340.short_description: Race against the clock in this top down action roguelike. Trade time for upgrades that will either save you time in the long run, or ultimately lead to your destruction.

5187990.name: The Royal Restoration Society
5187990.short_description: Tidy up a cozy castle, solo or with 3 other friends! Queen Zoe has called upon you to clean and redecorate her family home. Put everything in its rightful place, remove dirt and rubbish, and repair banners and rugs. Go at your own speed or try to beat your best time against your friends.

2513340.name: Project Lightbringer
2513340.short_description: Project Lightbringer is an exploration-focused bullet heaven where light is your only safe ground. Fight endless hordes, collect powerful upgrades, activate lanterns to expand your territory, and venture deeper into the mist to hunt massive creatures.

4858460.name: PARLEY
4858460.short_description: A 20-minute medieval free-for-all for 2–8 friends. Lead your army as a hero, raise your Kale, launch yourself from your own Mangonel and talk your way into alliances with proximity voice — then betray them. The last Kale standing wins.

3401960.name: Join Us
3401960.short_description: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

5089270.name: Genius Witch's Roper Ranch
5089270.short_description: Play as the elf witch Wyr Ishca in this strategy management game where you help her pay off her debts. Unlock skills, get help, produce Ropers, and rake in the money! But don't get too crazy, or else you might get in trouble with a certain someone...

5332510.name: AuraFalls
5332510.short_description: Game night, on an island. Up to four friends meet in a seasonal hub, then dive through portals into zombie survival, races, physics bowling, duels and explosive sandcastle building. Most wins takes the cup, and every cosmetic is earned just by playing.

4051260.name: Static Signal
4051260.short_description: Static Signal is an open world action horror game. Venture through your old office building and even reality as a malicious entity plans to reshape the world into a nightmare, but you can stop it before it's too late. Will you waste your time away, or will you save everyone from extinction?

5382150.name: PropAlive Demo
5382150.short_description:
PropAlive is a tense 1v4 asymmetrical PROPHUNT game where one player becomes an ancient demon, while the others are survivors who can disguise themselves as objects and use unique abilities.
Hide. Trick. Survive. Or Hunt.

5105390.name: Project Seaborne
5105390.short_description: Command a ship in the age of sail across a fully circumnavigable globe. Read the wind, trade for a reason, fight broadside to broadside, board and take prizes, and build a name — alone or in Steam co-op. Simulated sea, living crew, seventeen period hulls, a family to leave it all to.

4832650.name: EDO: Endless Demon Omen
4832650.short_description: Lead a small warband through a haunted province in this action roguelite. Move and dodge while your troops fight automatically, recruit survivors, and capture castles. Unlock commanders, combine run buffs, and face the growing Yokai threat.

3561920.name: Graveyard Simulator
3561920.short_description: Graveyard Simulator is a simulation game focused on strategy, design, and moral choices as you transform an abandoned cemetery into a prestigious memorial site. Take on daily graveyard tasks and delve deep into humanity’s relationship with death.

1808160.name: Demon Spore
1808160.short_description: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

3672980.name: Fishing Nightmares
3672980.short_description: A co-op horror fishing sim for 1–4 players. Play as SWAT operatives to retrieve a lost item deep in the Amazon jungle. Fish, sell, buy, and upgrade to achieve your mission.

5460060.name: Debriefed : Frontline Command
5460060.short_description: Commander, sixteen enemy officers stand between your armoured train and the end of the war. Beat them in card battles and they join your squad. Pour the whiskey in your quarters to unlock their animated scenes, uncensored. One purchase. No microtransactions.

5414350.name: Plunder & Booty
5414350.short_description: Sixteen pirate queens, sirens, ghost captains and navy officers, and every one of them wants to bet against you. Beat them at cards on the high seas, sign them to your crew, then pour the rum in your cabin to unlock 96 animated scenes. One purchase. No microtransactions.

4775990.name: Puppetry
4775990.short_description: Puppetry is a 3D puzzle-mystery adventure where you play as a haunted voodoo doll trapped inside a mysterious mansion.

5379890.name: GloveUp! Demo
5379890.short_description: GloveUp! demo is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters and fight through opponents of all shapes and styles!

5049000.name: 雪月の星霜
5049000.short_description: High school student Kusaka Sousuke, who has faint precognition, visits Yukizuki during winter break—a town haunted by rumors of ghosts and mysterious disappearances. In the snow-covered town, he meets the mysterious girl he saw in a dream… An adventure-type visual novel from VODALES.

5101720.name: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard
5101720.short_description: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard is a round-based co-op shooter in low-poly. Survive wave after wave, earn points for every hit and every kill, and spend them to push deeper into the base — before the next round starts.

5099130.name: Fast Food Fortune
5099130.short_description: Fast Food Fortune is a simulation management game. Hire and train your crew. Upgrade and maintain your equipment. Unlock upgrades that will help you on your way. You are graded on how well you do and profits are multiplied. In order to be profitable you will have to lock in when you clock in!

3685310.name: Mega Mouse
3685310.short_description: The Shadow Cats have built data centers that are consuming massive amounts of energy from stars across the Milky Way, threatening all life in the galaxy. Take command of Mega Mouse, a half-cyborg soldier on a mission to hunt down and destroy every data center before it’s too late!

4429430.name: Origins Trading Card Game
4429430.short_description: Outplay rivals in a fast PvP card game where both players move at once. Adapt your strategy and battle for three of 100+ rotating locations. Build decks with reimagined legends like Robin Hood and Mulan. Every competitive card is free. Rip packs for rare, limited-edition variants to trade on Steam.

3838770.name: I AM NIGHT
3838770.short_description: A folk horror roguelike deckbuilder where you tear apart and scrap together cards to face monsters, unravel mysteries, and survive a world forged in fear. Set out on a brave, twisted adventure of self-discovery.

5393000.name: Fish With Friends
5393000.short_description: Fish With Friends is a cozy online fishing world for 1–8 players. Relax solo or fish with friends, chase records, compete in comps, build your collection, and cause harmless chaos with goofy physics, wild boat rides, playful fights, and fishing rod pranks.

5230710.name: FULL THROTTLE RALLY
5230710.short_description: An arcade racing game inspired by 90s classics, where you race at high speed, master drifts, and tear through tracks inspired by Mexico.

4594630.name: Night Stocker
4594630.short_description:
Immerse yourself in the neon nostalgia of the 90s! Nightstoker is a cozy organization game where you task yourself with bringing order to a chaotic video and music rental store. Sort through thousands of tapes and listen to retro hits.
The pure joy of a perfectly organized shelf.

5316250.name: Grimlane
5316250.short_description: Build a deck of towers, buildings, and spells to defend your town against endless waves. Grow your economy, upgrade your defenders, and try new combinations on random maps. Play solo or with a friend, and meet Grimlane's characters in the story campaign.

5446660.name: Clash Pandemic: Forest Hell
5446660.short_description: You’re stuck in a gigantic forest. Chop wood, explore lost buildings, upgrade your swinging weapons, and spin your way through waves of zombies to a boss. Play alone or bring friends. Lots of blood. Much gore. Try not to die.

5364850.name: Doomward: Dungeon Autobattler
5364850.short_description: Run a guild of doomed heroes. Hire, specialize, gear and program them, then watch every fight play itself. A roguelike autobattler with permadeath, town sieges and a raid-boss Herald at the end of the Doom Clock. Solo, co-op for up to 4, or PvP.

5301350.name: Press Me Up Demo
5301350.short_description: Press Me Up is a crazy hydraulic press simulator! Crush all kinds of objects, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and unlock even more powerful ways to flatten everything. Just don’t destroy the press!

4541530.name: Seeking The Cure
4541530.short_description: Fight the infected and explore a devastated world in this 2D pixel art action-adventure. As John Austin, rescue scientists, recover supplies, and battle your way through streets, factories, and laboratories in the search for a cure.

4751790.name: TRY
4751790.short_description: A quiet evening turns into something far more unsettling. What begins as a normal night at home slowly changes as strange events, memories, and unexplained encounters begin to unfold.

4265580.name: Rent A Car Together
4265580.short_description: Rent A Car Simulator. Start by renting your first car. Expand your rental car fleet by purchasing different vehicles and grow your car rental business. Drive your cars and get them fixed when they break down. Find new customers. You can also develop your Rent A Car business by playing Co-Op.

5398880.name: Hide and Shh!!
5398880.short_description: Hide & Shh! is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where your voice can betray you! Stay quiet to remain invisible, but watch your stress! Speak to calm down, and you might reveal your location. Play as the Hunter, follow the voices, and catch everyone before time runs out!

5335980.name: Workshop Keeper
5335980.short_description: You bought the cheapest plot of land in town. Then the first tax bill arrived. Gather, craft, automate — link your workshops into a trade network, ship goods across the sea, and get rich enough to show the City-State who's boss.

5270220.name: Sound Bounded
5270220.short_description: Sound is everything. Explore a dark, misty world, activate mysterious crystals and survive a relentless hunter who sees through sound. Scream to run faster, stay quiet to hide, and use the environment to your advantage. Every noise has consequences.

5449860.name: DUNSPIN
5449860.short_description: Pull the lever. Recruit whatever heroes the reels hand you. Then watch them fight. DUNSPIN is a slot-machine auto-battler roguelike with deckbuilding, where one lucky spin can turn a losing run into a winning one.

5481420.name: Spirit Tide
5481420.short_description:
Cast your line into the ocean in Spirit Tide, a simple 2D fishing simulator! Catch legendary fish, discover new species, earn coins, and upgrade your fishing rods. Explore exciting ocean events and see what awaits you beneath the waves! 
Available for only €0.99!

5388900.name: Enter the Dungeon
5388900.short_description: Choose your unique spirit and descend into an endless procedural dungeon. Loot items, explore, and battle through hordes of enemies before they evolve and destroy you. Break the loop.. go as deep as you dare. Play the free demo now!

5448720.name: Dungeon Stage
5448720.short_description: Play DND in Dungeon Stage, a solo RPG with an AI dungeon master. Create your hero, describe your actions, meet companions, and fight turn-based tactical battles. Roll the dice and shape your adventure on an illustrated fantasy stage.

4512780.name: CENSOR
4512780.short_description: A sci-fi interrogation game. No more than ten people in the galaxy can do your job. The person across the table is already convicted. Find out why they did it, then decide what the truth will cost them.

2420580.name: ALYSSA
2420580.short_description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents, dark secrets, and a conspiracy far greater than it first appears await behind every closed door.

4653750.name: The Brave Few
4653750.short_description: The Brave Few is a combined arms WWII combat game. Experience historically based perspectives during major operations of World War II, from one of the brave few that fought in combat during World War II.

5382000.name: Gridbound Demo
5382000.short_description: GRIDBOUND is a co-op arcade action game on a shifting LED floor. Dodge red hazards, activate blue objectives, and reach green safe tiles. Coordinate with your teammates, react fast, and stay alive as the grid changes around you.

4809850.name: Esotericana: The Last Apostate
4809850.short_description: Embody the enhanced cybernetic might of the future. Scan your surroundings, gather powerful weapons and supplies, and obliterate the techno-zealots of the Church of Hope. Protect the girl in an intense third-person stealth-action experience designed for solo play.

2158670.name: RPG Architect
2158670.short_description: Want to build a game, but not sure where to start?  Focus on designing your game and let RPG Architect do the rest!  We've abstracted most of the nitty-gritty stuff out so you can focus on building your next great adventure!

5397590.name: Astra Genesis
5397590.short_description: ASTRA GENESIS is a multiplayer space strategy and management game. Develop your colonies, automate your industry, explore the unknown, research new technologies, trade with other players, and join forces to build a civilization among the stars.

5334310.name: Utterance Demo
5334310.short_description: Utterance is a Lovecraftian Western roguelite deckbuilder where you chart your own path through a corrupted world. Build a deck of letters, forge words, and battle creatures that twist your deck, your rules, and your sanity.

1735080.name: High Elo Girls
1735080.short_description: High Elo Girls is a Visual Novel set in the esports scene where you play as the latest recruit for a new all-girls team.  Can you help your squad achieve their true potential, or will you only squander your own?

2988030.name: Into the Fire
2988030.short_description: Enter a volcanic cataclysm zone in this single-player extraction survival. Scavenge supplies, rescue survivors and animals, and expand your Camp with every successful run. Face deadly fire anomalies, changing terrain, and the constant risk of losing everything before you escape.

3370490.name: Giggleland
3370490.short_description: Tolie isn’t allowed to leave the house. One night she wakes up alone in Giggleland, to a voice over the park speakers: her father is waiting for her at the information booth. A first-person psychological horror game in eight chapters. This game is not suitable for children.

4185040.name: The Great 48
4185040.short_description:
A collection 48 lovingly hand crafted and hand-drawn micro games.
Play with just a mouse and shoot for ALL the high scores! 
Try a random selection of games, or play each individually!

5040050.name: Notched
5040050.short_description: Stay on top of everything with an elegant Windows hub featuring music controls, live lyrics, weather, calendar, and real-time system and game widgets.

3037070.name: Echo Signal
3037070.short_description: An immersive survival crafting adventure game set on an alien planet. Explore the surroundings and build an understanding of the world around you. Create tools, devices, and structures to overcome the limitations of the harsh environment and unravel the mysteries of the unknown signals.

2148130.name: Evard The Hermit: Through Fears Demo

5025360.name: WEAPONS FREE
5025360.short_description: WEAPONS FREE is a tactical CQB shooter in the bodycam and helmetcam perspectives. This game prioritizes challenging AI, unpredictable scenarios, and immersion. WEAPONS FREE includes realistic combat, true-to-life bodycam, interaction with civilians, and multiple levels with their own unique feel.

5084230.name: Bathroom Please!
5084230.short_description: You really, really need the toilet, and you only have so many steps to get there. A comedy puzzle adventure where every step counts, every accident is your fault, and every level hides absurd endings.

1794000.name: Remnants of R'lyeh
1794000.short_description: Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's Great Work. An ancient dark power is calling you and you need to find an exit. Face your greatest fear, fight, hide... you must escape before the underwater city rises...

5443490.name: SYSTEM INTRUDER Demo
5443490.short_description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in a retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

5217320.name: EtelGarde
5217320.short_description: EtelGarde is an open-world fantasy RPG with narrative generated in real time by a large language model. Explore, negotiate, work, trade, build relationships, and shape a persistent world where characters and events continue to evolve in your absence, and death or separation can become irreversible.

5284640.name: Hexmental Demo
5284640.short_description: Turn-based tactics where every spell reshapes the island. Lakes freeze into roads, grass burns, lightning runs through the water, and each element feeds off the others. Both teams plan in secret and act at once. Fight CPU teams solo or in co-op, or take your friends online in 2v2 and 3v3.

5056390.name: Dead of the Brain
5056390.short_description: A cult classic Japanese PC-98 horror adventure from 1992, resurrected for modern platforms. Investigate a zombie outbreak, survive gruesome encounters, and experience unforgettable pixel art terror in this point & click nightmare.

5416760.name: His Magical Gay Awakening
5416760.short_description: Tristan swore he was straight. Then the Arcane Fashion Institute stitched desire into his skin. A gay romance visual novel in a dark academia world of magical fashion: a dangerous rival, a tempting model, a ruthless professor, 3 endings, and choices that matter.

2649560.name: Persona 6
2649560.short_description: The iconic RPG series returns! The highly anticipated next chapter delivers a bold, new standalone story blending heartfelt daily life and new characters with pulse-pounding, supernatural adventure. Whether it’s your first Persona game or you’ve been here since the beginning, this one’s for you.

5212710.name: Tragedy for Two
5212710.short_description: Experience a 2-player asymmetric co-op horror game where you and a partner investigate the strange behavior of a theater's performers. Separated into different sections of the theater, communicate with your partner to complete your assignments and survive attacks from the supernatural performers.

4263210.name: When Voices Died Demo
4263210.short_description: When Voices Died is a game of puzzles and silent emotions. Amid distant echoes and broken memories, you rebuild paths that reveal forgotten feelings — and the weight of choices that still echo.

4498560.name: Green Inferno
4498560.short_description: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

4709550.name: Behind the Corner
4709550.short_description: Explore dark vintage environments and survive encounters with a relentless entity in this first-person psychological horror game. Listen closely, watch the shadows, and face the unsettling feeling that something is waiting just around the corner.

4745600.name: Motorsport Manager 2
4745600.short_description: Motorsport Manager returns after a decade. Build your racing team, develop faster cars, and make the calls that beat your rivals in reactive racing. Your decisions shape a living world of personalities and rivalries. Build your racing legacy.

5383110.name: Goblin Problem
5383110.short_description: Goblin Problem is an RPG, co-op, tower defense game where you build and expand your fortress by day and defend it from waves of goblins by night. Control your hero, build powerful defenses, recruit troops, and reclaim the kingdom piece by piece.

4225070.name: That's My Village!
4225070.short_description: A roguelite village builder. Assign jobs, feed your villagers and keep their morale high. Defend them from disasters and monster waves. When the horns sound, will your village hold?

4527880.name: Hell's Handbook
4527880.short_description: With your trusty handbook, banishing monstrosities beyond mortal comprehension is as easy as 1-2-3!! In this turn-based tactics puzzle game, you lead a team of contractor ghost busters through a series of haunted houses, each with a different set of unidentified monstrosities.

3203530.name: Hexmental
3203530.short_description: Turn-based tactics where every spell reshapes the island. Lakes freeze into roads, grass burns, lightning runs through the water, and each element feeds off the others. Both teams plan in secret and act at once. Fight CPU teams solo or in co-op, or take your friends online in 2v2 and 3v3.

5020460.name: Debtrize
5020460.short_description: You're a debt collector tasked with tracking down everyone who owes a debt in the afterlife. Journey through grim lands full of dangerous creatures and old debts long overdue. Hunt. Kill. Negotiate. Not even death can save you from your debts.

4222250.name: BurgerJoint: Fast Food Simulator
4222250.short_description: A fast food simulator game focused on physics-based mechanics and satisfying cooking experience. Flip, stack, grill and assemble burgers however you like, manage your restaurant’s stock, take orders, and enjoy the running of your own virtual kitchen.

4272100.name: Grass
4272100.short_description: Turn overgrown yards into freshly cut lawns in this cozy lawn care simulator. Play solo or team up with friends to mow, trim, water, and clear debris. Finish jobs, earn rewards, and build your reputation one satisfying transformation at a time.

5374670.name: Paradox Demo
5374670.short_description: One player hunts. Four players run and fight back with superpowers. Use unique abilities, complete objectives, and escape through ancient Egypt, Victorian London, and more, to complete the the story.

5085590.name: Bot Survivors
5085590.short_description: Bot Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelite where you battle relentless robot swarms, evade the rising police wanted level, and conquer massive mechanical bosses. Choose upgrades, craft devastating synergies, and survive the apocalypse!

4281390.name: Orbz Collector
4281390.short_description: Orbz Collector is a 3D re-imagining of the 90s classic Chip's Challenge. Collect coloured keys to unlock the corresponding locks, avoid patrolling enemies and warp around to figure out the variety of puzzles throughout the 12 levels. Some of the levels you'll recognize and some of them are new!

4755250.name: ROMUL
4755250.short_description: ROMUL is a co-op looting horror game. Together with a voice-controlled robot with early-stage AI, explore abandoned space stations with unstable gravity and use it to your advantage. Survive among monsters and extract valuable cargo.

2666580.name: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults
2666580.short_description: Pathfinder: Abomination Vaults is the first-ever co-op Hack and Slash ARPG based on the Adventure Path, in which players lead iconic Pathfinder heroes into the depths of Gauntlight Keep and battle deadly abominations to reach the evil sorceress Belcorra Haruvex and end her vile schemes.

4467860.name: Lily2D
4467860.short_description:
A code-first 2D Game Engine featuring fast iteration using Swamp - a sleek, deterministic, custom script language. 
Lily2D has shader-based rendering, software synth for music and sound effects, networking, input handling and multi-platform export.

5339650.name: Elemental Lands Demo
5339650.short_description: A lone King holds back an elemental horde! Explore lands to mine mana & build your base to support heroes in turn-based tactical battles. Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck & RPG hero party. Play spell cards & command 3 heroes to position, capture objectives to defeat enemy hordes.

5195430.name: DriftyLands
5195430.short_description: Buy an island, clear it, automate it, then find the hole underneath. A first-person base builder, solo or co-op with up to 4 players: gather, craft, build machines, and take your tools down into the dungeon below every island you buy.

3714280.name: FLASK
3714280.short_description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

4424740.name: Agent of Strange: Arrival
4424740.short_description: The prologue to Agent of Strange — a dark role-playing thriller where every mission is a labyrinth of choices and possibilities. Start your path as a Conspirator in a desperate struggle against the secret occult regime.

5289460.name: Magnavale: Eternal Soul Demo
5289460.short_description: Eternal Soul is a gothic Metroidvania where you steal the souls of your enemies. Explore the castle, find powerful items & abilities, fight against demonic creatures, and learn the truth of your power.

5394920.name: Crimson Ark Demo
5394920.short_description: A dark fantasy action RPG with three playable heroines. Hunt for random loot, enhance your gear, and build your magic. Use optional auto-hunting in the field, then take manual control for boss fights. Explore the opening region in this level-20 demo.

4891490.name: FLASK Demo
4891490.short_description: FLASK is a roguelike autobattler about alchemical greed on the new frontier. Build unstoppable homunculi, barter with mutated merchants, and slay hordes of monsters to harvest their valuable blood. It's time to get bloody... Bloody rich!

3131640.name: Deus Ex Remastered
3131640.short_description: This is Deus Ex Remastered – the definitive version of Ion Storm’s legendary cyberpunk immersive sim, modernized with visual upgrades, modern enhancements, and quality-of-life improvements for a new generation of operatives.

286180.name: Salticidae Story
286180.short_description: Keep, feed and breed jumping spiders. A 120-trait genome inherits the way genes actually do -- dominant, recessive, carriers -- and six species cross into hybrids, so a line you breed for is a line you can keep. Level up, play the arcade, and let your favourite live on your desktop.

4696740.name: Body Kounts
4696740.short_description:
Resurrect and Summon Extinct fantastical beasts to do battle on your behalf in this Arcadelike mind game of Life vs Death.
Every defeat is fatal, you must use your wit and all the tools at your disposal to overcome challenges and survive.

5203480.name: KickOff
5203480.short_description: A kid from the outskirts wants to go pro. When his mother falls ill, the dream becomes a bill: $50,000 in treatment, rent that climbs on its own, and a clock that never stops. Work, train, take penalties — and choose where to be on the day it all lands at once.

3670110.name: AlcheMice
3670110.short_description: A tarot roguelite deckbuilder. Play a card to move like a chess piece: the knight's jump clears traps and reaches high ground. Strike with action cards and brew alchemy into your deck. Three days, then the loop resets at dawn and you keep only your deck and whatever you locked in the chest.

5331500.name: Age of Mankind
5331500.short_description: Lead your people through Antiquity, from a small tribe to a mighty empire. Experience real-time grand strategy on a living world map with thousands of provinces and hundreds of peoples. Settle, trade, research, negotiate, and wage wars whose outcome is never certain.

4518950.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum
4518950.short_description: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain predicate calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

5205770.name: Chess Variant: Chase The King Playtest

3831610.name: Yatai Master
3831610.short_description: Cook, serve, and connect with customers while managing a traditional Japanese yatai in a cozy narrative experience about food, community, and legacy.

4413880.name: Aquora
4413880.short_description: Breed, raise, and sell pixel fish in your own living aquarium. Over 400 quadrillion possible fish. Chase ultra-rare mythic traits through generations of genetics, decorate your tank, fish the river, and grow a humble starter pair into an aquatic empire, even while you're away.

5029880.name: Marque & Reprisal Demo
5029880.short_description:
Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

The demo takes place entirely in the Mediterranean.

2590490.name: Late Amusement
2590490.short_description: Late Amusement is a first-person psychological survival horror game from an independent studio. Play as Liam Snow, a young aspiring author who enters the derelict theme park alongside his girlfriend Hannah, and fight to survive as you unravel the dark history buried beneath the attractions.

4292780.name: THE CELLAR: Ashveil
4292780.short_description: A story driven RPG about isolation, choice, and the struggle to define who you are. Explore a haunting parallel realm, fight abnormal creatures, and decide whether to follow a dark legacy or break free from it.

5093710.name: Illusion Remix
5093710.short_description: Wake a forgotten museum of optical illusions with your robot curator, Luna. Explore its wonders, fill the galleries with your own creations, and go as deep as you like: shape every detail, make illusions dance to your music, and stage whole shows. Cozy, psychedelic, endlessly remixable.

2689830.name: Lost Isle Demo
2689830.short_description: Explore a new take on open-world survival in a unique and procedural fantasy world. Build your own settlement and protect it from monstrous beasts and players alike. Craft weapons and equipment from a land bathed in cosmic power.

3597820.name: Chumps Chained Demo
3597820.short_description: After a failed phishing scheme, two scam artist best friends are cursed by an evil wizard who permanently chains them together. In this 2D couch co-op platformer, join Walter and Jellybean in navigating through the wizard's mayhem and a surreal world to undo the curse!

5316540.name: Tidy Up the Halloween Shop
5316540.short_description: Something has made a spectacular mess of this cozy Halloween shop. Put pumpkins, potions and sweets back where they belong, uncover curious clues, and meet a mysterious new friend. A relaxing first-person tidy-up, with a little mischief.

3874040.name: Star Trek: Warp
3874040.short_description:
Command the lanes. Control the outcome. 
Unlock iconic characters, starships, and locations as you play to complete objectives and earn legendary cards worthy of any captain's deck.

5234680.name: Whispers of Orange Island Demo
5234680.short_description: Play as a little girl's soul in this atmospheric 2D stealth puzzle game set in a dark dystopia. Wield magical ancestral tools to rescue wandering spirits, uncover a century of tragic family history, and heal your living families.

5322590.name: Railwright
5322590.short_description: Design and build your own rail vehicles, lay the tracks they run on, drive your creations, haul cargo, and develop new technology in an open-ended railway engineering sandbox.

4416700.name: BUBBA CHOP GROVE
4416700.short_description: A short pixel art incremental clicker about chopping trees. Click to chop, hire 14 kinds of crew who chop for you, befriend 13 grumpy Legendary Trees in timed fights, then Replant and Rebloom for lasting upgrades. About 5-6 hours to the Giga Tree, then endless rematches.

5487150.name: AMMO DUMP
5487150.short_description: A first-person incremental shooter about one cube. Shoot it until it breaks and a bigger one slams down from the sky. Grab rounds from the ammo piles, chase bullseyes and gold cubes, and grow a skill tree from one pistol to lightning storms, turrets, meteors and a sun.

4040160.name: Burrowlings
4040160.short_description: Grow four tiny hard-hatted burrowlings into a swarm of over a hundred and dig to the planet's core before the oil lamp burns out. A short incremental game: spend the gold in a web of upgrades, dig again, deeper. Solo, or online in co-op and versus, where a block of ice freezes a rival's shaft.

4303930.name: Ashen Swarm
4303930.short_description: A gothic bullet heaven roguelite where deadly sins become weapons. Cut through the condemned, build around your Oath or embrace Corruption, and claim lasting artifacts through your choices. Reach the Judge and stop his sentence from consuming the last lands.

4570530.name: TTT Classic
4570530.short_description: A multiplayer social deduction shooter built on the GoldSrc engine. Investigate crime scenes as a Detective, deceive your friends as a Traitor, or fight to survive as an Innocent. Utilize forensic tools, set traps, and manage your Karma in this faithful GoldSrc demake.

5410350.name: Down to Floor Zero Demo
5410350.short_description: Down to Floor Zero is a survival horror experience set in an unreasonably large hotel. Your only means of transportation is an elevator that can solely go down. Each floor may host useful items and structures, as well as horrors beyond comprehension. Try to reach the ground floor… intact.

4516500.name: Marque & Reprisal
4516500.short_description: Explore. Trade. Fish. Whale. Colonize. Fight. Pillage. Survive. You are a sea captain in the year 1522, and the whole world is yours to discover in this roguelike sandbox historical sailing simulator.

5260090.name: Event Horizon Research
5260090.short_description: A first-person sci-fi descent into a black hole. Study it from a research station, design and assemble your own capsule from real engines and hull materials, then pilot it through the accretion disk and past the event horizon. You have limited lives.

4307320.name: Covert Koalas: Phasco
4307320.short_description:
A comfy game where you're searching for hidden koalas on unique hand-drawn levels with adjustable difficulty. Help a group of koalas escape their captivity and follow their story on a search for a new home. 
Because the world is big enough for all!

5489450.name: Workshop Valley
5489450.short_description: Chop logs, saw planks, and carve little wooden helpers who take over the hauling and crafting. Grow a small, legible production chain — no conveyor belts — sell your wares at the market stall, and bring the valley fair back to life. A cozy automation game with an actual ending.

5139480.name: Collapsle
5139480.short_description: Collapsle is a fast-paced match-three score attack roguelite set in the Gold Rush West. Create powerful synergies and score big, with tons of items, characters, customization options, and challenges to discover!

5246000.name: TileShire Demo
5246000.short_description: TileShire is a low-stakes, high-depth strategy game. Combine tiles on a living landscape to grow a home rich with life.

5332760.name: Feast, Flee or Starve
5332760.short_description: Feast, Flee or Starve is a multiplayer survival party game where stranded players must gather scarce resources, make uneasy alliances, and decide when to cooperate and when to look out for themselves.

4693590.name: Magical Ascent
4693590.short_description: This is a card game mixed with roguelike elements together to make the best single player deck builder possible. You can Craft a unique deck, encounter bizarre creatures, discover relics, curses, and Magical Ascension.

4406790.name: Imperial Kingdoms
4406790.short_description: Lead a medieval kingdom in this 4X grand strategy game with pausable real-time. Establish vital infrastructure to supply your capital and sustain your armies. Design custom military templates, manage production estates, and conquer rival kingdoms via strategic sieges and raids.

4406810.name: Imperial Kingdoms Demo
4406810.short_description: Lead a medieval kingdom in this 4X grand strategy game with pausable real-time. Establish vital infrastructure to supply your capital and sustain your armies. Design custom military templates, manage production estates, and conquer rival kingdoms via strategic sieges and raids.

4880410.name: Tenebrarium
4880410.short_description: An idle-like alien colony simulator. Study an alien species and expand the colony to discover all their peculiar behaviours.

5220880.name: Lucky Dog Rise Demo
5220880.short_description: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!

5287750.name: Polandball: The Sixth Day - Destroy
5287750.short_description: Endless waves of infected are closing in! A single-player, top-down endless survival shooter starring countryballs. Survive through your own choices and builds, create a character of your own, and fight through a living day-night cycle as the world gradually falls apart.

1477830.name: HudSight - crosshair overlay
1477830.short_description: Create unique crosshairs for any game! Choose from many built-in crosshairs or download from the Steam Workshop, and create your own. User-friendly interface, anti-cheat compatible. Customize your gaming experience!

5459010.name: SonaCraft – Instrument Repair
5459010.short_description: Take over your great-aunt's old workshop and repair real instruments. Find the fault by ear, take a trumpet, guitar or snare drum apart in 3D, replace worn parts, tune and adjust – until it passes the sound test.

4677940.name: Retail Rivals Demo
4677940.short_description: Build your retail empire inside a shopping mall. Open multiple stores, sabotage rivals, and play solo or with up to 8 players. Choose different match objectives or play endless mode and compete for retail domination.

4140510.name: Will You Be My Disciple?
4140510.short_description: Will You Be My Disciple? is a choice-driven cult management game shaped by unexpected encounters and characters.

5016110.name: COMPARTMENT 666 : ANOMALY EXPRESS
5016110.short_description: Inspect every compartment, identify anomalies, and survive a mysterious train where every mistake brings you closer to death. Reach the conductor and uncover the truth behind Compartment 666.

4299750.name: Meet Mary
4299750.short_description: Experience a thrilling and comedic 1-4 player co-op horror story puzzle game. Learn how to move forward while delving deeper and deeper into the unknown. With a compelling story, Voiced cut scenes, and casual progression. This is the perfect way to spend some time with friends.

4474910.name: Runback Demo
4474910.short_description: Fight, upgrade, and fight again! Runback is an online roguelite party fighter where the phrase ‘best-of-five’ takes on a whole new meaning. Spend points between fights to evolve your character, turn the tide, or simply cement your dominance over your friends!

3366850.name: Snipers & Airdrops
3366850.short_description: A competitive sniper game for you and your friends, 1v1 or 2v2. Fight over airdrops falling into the middle of the map, outplay each other with agent abilities and wild movement, build a rifle that's all yours, and spend your winnings at the Black Market.

5212330.name: The Loomsong Chronicle Idle Demo
5212330.short_description: Lead a growing party through dangerous expeditions in this party-based idle RPG. Recruit, equip, train, gather, craft, and fight through level 25, then carry the same campaign into the full game without restarting.

4628390.name: Pit Wizard
4628390.short_description:
Pit Wizard is a short action rpg with incremental progression where you play as a wizard custodian. Jump into magical pits, clean out hordes of dangerous monsters, and mine valuable resources while developing two massive skill trees.

PLEASE NOTE: This is not a survivors game.

3610790.name: Hope in the City
3610790.short_description: 17-year-old Hope Song thought the national exams were her biggest worry... until she got home to a ransacked apartment and two missing parents. Investigate through the eyes of an artist, turn sketches into evidence, and watch her family's mystery grow stranger and darker with every answer.

5472940.name: GRAVESHIFT
5472940.short_description: You are not a hero. You are a debtor. Clock in at dusk and hold the line until dawn with more than twenty firearms, blades and dynamite, against hordes of werewolves, vampires and the Necromancer's dead, and against Death itself. Survive the shift and the Ledger knocks off one installment.

5135740.name: Dungeoneers Idle
5135740.short_description: An endless idle RPG with no finish line. Build a party of heroes, craft the gear that makes them stronger, and let them fight and loot through procedural dungeons on their own, even in a little window on your desktop while you work. Or jump in and play any hero yourself.

5339410.name: Last Tank Standing
5339410.short_description: Last Tank Standing is a real-time tank tactics game. No base building, no resource gathering. You buy an army before the battle, you fight with what you bought, and the winner takes all.

5316300.name: Colony Battle Arena
5316300.short_description: You are dealt one of several rival factions. Destroy the enemy before your base falls. Kills move you up the tiers, from your faction's unique unit to drones, vehicles and gunships; losses strengthen your enemy. 8-player RTS: solo or co-op vs bots, ranked and casual online, LAN, mobile cross-play.

5353830.name: Tavern Aftermath
5353830.short_description: Royal soldiers ransacked your late father's tavern. Put 2,500 scattered things back where they belong, earn helpful abilities, and follow a hidden mage's notes to the secret the soldiers were after. A cozy first-person tidying game with no timers and no pressure.

5246960.name: 西游：云行散记
5246960.short_description: Journey to the West: Cloudborne Journal is a dark action RPG reimagining the classic myth. Play as one of four Chaos Monkeys, uncover the pilgrimage’s dark truth, assemble a cross-faction party, and forge your demon-slaying legend through visceral combat and strategic progression.

5018030.name: Duo Control
5018030.short_description: Two players, one character. One of you moves (Keyboard), the other aims and shoots (Mouse). Let's see if you and your friend are really as good a team as you think you are. ⭐

5449370.name: Luna Star Rancher
5449370.short_description: Explore. Progress. Build. Take care of Luna, raise creatures, and bring your inventions to life! Earn XP, grow your ranch, build your rocket, take on bosses, and uncover the secrets of unknown worlds.

4952370.name: Nightveld
4952370.short_description: A bullet heaven (a reverse bullet hell) where your only weapon is the light you see with. Widen the beam to see the swarm coming, or focus it to burn what's close, and go blind everywhere else. Survive to dawn, pick a power, and face a longer, hungrier Night. How many can you last?

5072700.name: Rerouted
5072700.short_description: Stranded deep in the North, you have just one goal: make it home alive. Solo or with friends, fight the cold, hunt for food, set up camps, watch out for wildlife, and... try not to lose anyone along the way.

5415360.name: Rocks to Riches
5415360.short_description: Start with a pickaxe and a plot. Dig ore, haul it to the trucks and pour the money into a bigger operation, then sell the whole thing and start again richer (or don't)! A cozy mining tycoon that takes you from a backyard mine to a lost jungle city and out to the asteroid belt.

5232890.name: Hush Piñata Demo
5232890.short_description: Cansada de apanhar, ela vendou os próprios olhos e voltou sedenta por vingança. Neste jogo de festa de terror e comédia para até 9 jogadores, a Piñata vendada caça pelo som, e até mesmo a sua voz no microfone faz uma silhueta brilhar na escuridão dela. Realize as tarefas em silêncio e arranque o rabo dela antes que ela perceba.

5370830.name: Grog & Grudges
5370830.short_description: Run a pirate tavern in this hectic but cozy time management game, where everything you do is one of more than 50 minigames. Serve drinks and food, seat the crews, break up brawls, fix up the place and make friends with the regulars.

5004590.name: Darcnia Monster
5004590.short_description: Place a card and its monster rises onto the board. A tactical card game, online and free, with no pay to win: every card is earned by playing, never from a gacha, and traded with other players in the Trade Hall and the Auction House.

5464270.name: Star Fire
5464270.short_description: Star Fire is a large-scale sci-fi FPS currently in development. Up to 64 players wage war across land and air. Fight alongside your squad, pilot powerful vehicles and mechs, and command massive capital ships in an all-out war for the Solar System.

5165730.name: Whispers of Orange Island
5165730.short_description: Love stealth? Discover a fresh take with escort-based stealth, unique tools, and characters with lives, relationships, and stories instead of faceless obstacles. Love story and lore? Explore rich optional narrative and uncover 100 years of history, secrets, and entwined lives on Orange Island.

5195210.name: Engagement Demo
5195210.short_description: One capital ship. Fifteen minutes until relief. Bolt salvaged guns onto your hull with a visual for every upgrade, raise a wing of named pilots who rank up, fuse and fly in squads, and hold out against a Hollow swarm that grows every minute you survive.

5382060.name: Throw Weight: Fleet Doctrine
5382060.short_description: Hard sci-fi fleet command. No shields, no lasers — just missiles, point defense and electronic warfare.

5365450.name: BRASS: Hard Contact
5365450.short_description: A realistic 2D military shooter. Rounds drop, crack past and punch through boards; fire pins men down; sandbags, smoke and the dark decide fights. Lead squad bots or fight friends over Steam in six modes across eight maps. No killstreaks, no power-ups, no health regen.

5195200.name: Engagement
5195200.short_description: One capital ship. Fifteen minutes until relief. Bolt salvaged guns onto your hull with a visual for every upgrade, raise a wing of named pilots who rank up, fuse and fly in squads, and hold out against a Hollow swarm that grows every minute you survive.

2240940.name: Recovery Syndicate
2240940.short_description:
Recovery Syndicate is a prequel to Abeyance, in which you are the leader of one of the factions trying to reconstruct the economy of the galaxy.
You must build and manage your colony's resources carefully, while watching out for rival factions who are also vying for supremacy.

4963590.name: Harvest Them
4963590.short_description: No one tells you why. You are the villain: sweep a kingdom crowd by crowd for coins, blood and souls. Every weapon must be taken off the boss who carries it. Dark fantasy idle action. The game explains itself exactly once — at the very end.

5242880.name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry? Demo
5242880.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

690800.name: Solar Warden
690800.short_description: A Space Shooter / Real-Time Strategy hybrid. Command the Solar Warden space fleet from the real-time strategy overlay or choose to assume immediate control of any of your fleet directly and combat the Silicoid menace up close!

5100290.name: Livin' the Cream: Ice Cream Simulator Demo
5100290.short_description: Run your own ice cream shop in the Livin' the Cream demo! Serve customers, make Soft Serve and Scoop Ice Cream in three flavors, serve with different types of cones, and customize your shop with different floors, walls, counters, and tables.

5133940.name: Catacrypt Demo
5133940.short_description: Catacrypt is an online co-op roguelite dungeon crawler. Enter procedurally generated dungeons to obtain powerful upgrades and craft unique weapons. Descend floors and fight increasingly harder enemies and bosses, all to reach the bottom.

2562390.name: Benny's Backrooms
2562390.short_description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

5122120.name: Sussy NPC
5122120.short_description: You're a sussy NPC in a crowd of NPCs. Hunters are hunting you. Act normal, blend in, don't flinch. Or be the Hunter, read the room and catch them. In-game voice chat is recommended for the best experience.

1754250.name: We Took That Trip
1754250.short_description: A cozy road trip adventure about friendship, loss, and reunion.  Drive and customize your van as you journey down ever-changing roads through idyllic landscapes. Meet unforgettable travelers and uncover heartfelt stories along the way, with your feline companion by your side.

4199320.name: Castle Siege Commander
4199320.short_description: Command your army with your voice in this multiplayer medieval tactical game. Create custom voice commands, control siege warfare, and fight over strategic supply routes.

5425150.name: What Da Font Demo
5425150.short_description: The free demo of a cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: search the ground floor for scattered lead type, tell one typeface from another, put the sorts back in their cases, then set and print your first two posters by hand.

2826790.name: Stormforge
2826790.short_description: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.

4519110.name: Fortain
4519110.short_description: Build your castle, raise an army and race up to 15 rivals for Glory in a fast medieval strategy game. Raid enemy castles, crush Horde camps and storm the Great Horde Fortress, alone against cunning AI lords or online with up to 8 friends. When time runs out, the most Glory wins.

5278280.name: Terminal Depth
5278280.short_description: An incremental digging game where buried salvage fuels a growing excavation to unearth ancient artifacts and piece together a lost history with every layer you uncover. Upgrade your tools, unlock automated helpers, and blast through tougher layers with powerful abilities.

5101820.name: カスペナ～カスタムペナント野球
5101820.short_description: Draft prospects, develop your players and build a championship club. Set lineups, negotiate contracts and manage your budget in this baseball management sim. Discover hidden prospects, invest in your town and customize your league. Watch games without direct player control.

5179280.name: 女神养成：放置型 / Goddess Cultivation: Idle RPG
5179280.short_description: Goddess Cultivation: Idle RPG is a fantasy idle JRPG. Summon goddesses, forge bonds, fight goblins & minotaurs, and uncover a conspiracy. It blends turn-based combat, collection & customization, balancing tactics with relaxed offline growth.

5198980.name: Apple Crumble Demo
5198980.short_description: It’s your grandma’s 84th birthday party and nobody is trying to murder her. Stop suspecting your family members, and don’t worry about the strange man in your bedroom. A new creepy-cozy mystery thriller from the creators of Duck Detective.

5220650.name: Island of Forbidden Desires
5220650.short_description:
30 DAYS. FOUR WOMEN. ONE ISLAND.
Thirty days on a deserted island. Four women. A storm, ruins, and desires that cannot all be satisfied at once.
200+ illustrations and animated explicit scenes.

5222090.name: Police Station Simulator Demo
5222090.short_description:
You’re in charge of a run-down police station. Will you manage to restore it to its former glory?
Arm yourself with some coffee and donuts, because there's a lot of renovation and micro-management work to do!

5275700.name: GrimKeep Demo
5275700.short_description: GrimKeep is a roguelite dice-builder in a nightmare fairytale. Find items, roll your dice, and optimize your build to fire off massive damage. Cut through the horrors in the cursed city to get to the Princess. Then end her.

5309200.name: GRAVHOUNDS Demo
5309200.short_description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

5351100.name: GRIDHACK Demo
5351100.short_description: GRIDHACK is a sci-fi puzzle RPG where hacking = fighting nonogram battles. Chase a rogue program and chip away at the galaxy's strongest firewall to uncover the conspiracy about what happened to Earth!

4761550.name: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD
4761550.short_description: ABSOLUTELY NOTHING GOOD is an atmospheric first-person game that blends everyday work at a roadside convenience store with supernatural events, elements of psychological horror, and dark humor.

4831440.name: I Want to Play the Villain! Demo
4831440.short_description: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

4915850.name: Overbooked Demo
4915850.short_description: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

4924230.name: Seaside Wash Demo
4924230.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Discover the first steps of your restoration journey in this demo, featuring 3 docks, 10 unique ships and variances, tool upgrades, and additional cleaning activities.

4966120.name: Bottle Flip Inc Demo
4966120.short_description: An incremental game about flipping bottles, unlocking and upgrading unique abilities, and turning simple bottle flips into increasingly satisfying moments.

4354660.name: Zone Nova
4354660.short_description: Commandant, the world is in danger! Lead powerful Novas from ancient civilizations into the Forbidden Zones in this squad‑based RTS ARPG, battle monsters from the black spheres and seduce every maiden. Enjoy real‑time combat, idle growth, explosive battles and lewd fun all in one adventure.

4448830.name: 无限弹射矿场 Demo
4448830.short_description: INFINITE BALL WELL is a Pachinko Roguelite Deckbuilder with fast-paced runs. Launch Pinballs into Pegs to score points, mix and match hundreds of distinctive Pegs and Relics, and explore endless build possibilities as you clatter and ricochet ever deeper underground!

4511560.name: Dorfromantik - Medieval Biome Pack
4511560.short_description: The Medieval Biome Pack takes your Dorfromantik worlds to the Middle Ages. Discover three new biomes and create idyllic landscapes full of historical charm.

4514280.name: Welcome, [Employee Name] Demo
4514280.short_description:
Welcome, [Employee Name]! You are our new space station controller. We trust you to make all the right decisions and keep the people of the HonkyTonk space station safe. Process as many trucks as possible but be careful, mistakes have consequences.
Welcome to the Honky Tonk Family!

4106880.name: ASUKA x Redline Reverie Demo
4106880.short_description: Play as Asuka Sakai and take on the mountain roads of Japan. Tune your car, challenge rival racers, climb the rankings, and earn your place at GRACE. A pure touge racing experience.

4207990.name: GemCraft - Legacy Collection
4207990.short_description: Forge and combine magical gems, build deadly defenses, and survive relentless waves in the Flash-era tower defense classics GemCraft, Chapter Zero, and Labyrinth. Now with up to 9x speed, new hotkeys, easier gem combining, and smoother performance.

4228490.name: Pionero Capital Demo
4228490.short_description: From one-person online store to e-commerce giant - pack, drive and deliver orders across the open world of Pionero Island. Grow with employees, vehicles, properties and new businesses until the company runs without you. Solo or co-op

5244300.name: Blacksite Lazarus Demo
5244300.short_description: Sent to investigate a medical facility gone dark, a private military contractor discovers a nightmare of death and mutation. Explore, survive, and uncover the truth behind a cancer cure that created something far worse.

3768450.name: Custom Fortress - Beta
3768450.short_description: Custom Fortress is a community-driven TF2 sourcemod that attempts to removes hardcoded limits and makes the game fully customizable. With regular updates introducing new community content and general improvements, it allows creators and players to shape the game the way they want to play.

3841550.name: 人のいない世界に 体験版
3841550.short_description: This is the story of humanity and a robot reaching their “end.” A lonely yet beautiful post-apocalyptic pixel-art narrative adventure, following a robot that awakens after humanity’s extinction until the moment it shuts itself down. Experience a rich and memorable journey lasting around two hours.

3474900.name: AnimaEngine
3474900.short_description:
Elevate your desktop with Anima Engine!

Customize with animations, APNGs, GIFs, images, videos, and audio in formats like MP4, WEBP, and more. Use AI tools to edit visuals, remove backgrounds, and create a style that's uniquely yours.

The only limit is your imagination!

3594620.name: Dream Eaters.exe Demo
3594620.short_description: Trapped in a secret sleep experiment, you and your friends must survive terrifying nightmares, completing tasks to wake up before it's too late. Play solo or in co-op, but beware the experiments are never the same and something watches from the dark.

3620040.name: Fly Cowboy Online
3620040.short_description: Fly Cowboy Online- is a massive free-to-play multiplayer online game centered around a faction war for strategic resources amidst the ruins of civilization. Fierce aerial battles in the devastated world of Naviika await you-conquer the skies or burn trying.

5266670.name: Stone & Throne
5266670.short_description: Dig beneath the mountain, march against its walls. Hook ore from the depths to fund your army, line your units across the hex battlefield, fuse the ones that stand together, and break fifteen fortress gates in a rogue-lite siege where what you mine below decides the war above.

2932420.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Renault Trucks E-Tech T
2932420.short_description: The Renault Trucks E-Tech T boasts impressive specifications, including a powerful 540kWh battery that enables it to cover up to 350 kilometres on a single charge when using a DC charger during a one-hour break.

3035040.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Scania S BEV
3035040.short_description: Enjoy the Scania S BEV in Euro Truck Simulator 2! The Scania 40 S and 45 S BEV, which are both based on the Scania S with a 4x2 chassis, feature two powertrain options, a 6-speed transmission combined with 3 electric motors with a power output of 400/450 kW. For now only as Quick Jobs trucks.

2720080.name: American Truck Simulator - Kenworth T680 2022
2720080.short_description: The moment we've all been eagerly waiting for is finally here! We're thrilled to announce the release of the much-anticipated Kenworth T680 100 Years Anniversary Edition for American Truck Simulator.

2450690.name: PAYDAY 3: Syntax Error Heist
2450690.short_description: The Payday Gang tackles a heist on tech giant Scry Digital, an industry leader in AI technology.

2450691.name: PAYDAY 3: Syntax Error Weapon Pack
2450691.short_description: This pack contains a brand new SMG, Shotgun and Marksman Rifle for heisters looking to expand their repertoir of weapons.

2593290.name: Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Expansion
2593290.short_description: The Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen Expansion enriches the classic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

2257950.name: American Truck Simulator - Western Star® 5700XE
2257950.short_description: The Western Star® 5700XE arrives in American Truck Simulator with a select choice of configurations and customizations. This includes a day cab, the 54" High Roof Stratosphere, and the 82" Ultra High Roof Stratosphere.

2386480.name: American Truck Simulator - Volvo VNL 2018
2386480.short_description: Reliability, performance, and absolute driver satisfaction. This is why the Volvo VNL is an embodiment of excellence in the trucking world, and we are excited to let you know that brand new models have arrived in American Truck Simulator as a free update!

2093200.name: American Truck Simulator - Western Star® 57X
2093200.short_description: The Western Star® 57X combines the best of two worlds – taking the X-Series DNA with bold design & rugged durability, combining it with the best of Daimler Truck North America’s on-highway platform, tested over millions of miles. The most advanced and innovative Western Star highway truck. Ever!

5184840.name: 无尽仙路 Dao Without End Demo
5184840.short_description: Enjoy continuous, automated progression through idle cultivation in your Pocket Realm. Train Mind Arts, practice alchemy, forge gear, and enter fully automated turn-based battles driven by action gauges. Defeat monsters and bosses, collect powerful loot, refine your build, and reach higher realms.

1915840.name: American Truck Simulator - International 9900i
1915840.short_description: A longtime favorite of truckers, the 9900i is making a triumphant return. The International® Eagle 9900i is a classic long-nosed tractor that represents your independent spirit without compromising comfort, durability, power or efficiency.

5240890.name: Cavern Wars
5240890.short_description: Cavern Wars is a turn-based strategy game playable with up to 8 players. Lead your cavemen to war, expand your territory and build a large army, dominate the entire map and annihilate your opponents !

1650650.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - DAF XG/XG+
1650650.short_description: Start the Future. The New-Generation DAF represents a new era in trucking. New to Euro Truck Simulator 2 is the introduction of optional digital mirrors replacing the conventional side, wide-angle and front mirrors; and a fully-digital dashboard display.

1708620.name: American Truck Simulator - International LT®
1708620.short_description: Designed and engineered to keep drivers more comfortable and productive for the long haul, the International LT® is the most driver-centric, uptime-focused truck that International Trucks has ever delivered.

1415691.name: American Truck Simulator - Western Star® 49X
1415691.short_description: Built to thrive in the most rugged of environments, on a heritage of toughness, the Western Star® 49X will easily take on any challenge it comes across. See and drive this new legend first in American Truck Simulator!

758420.name: PAYDAY 2: h3h3 Character Pack
758420.short_description: Ethan and Hila Klein never really thought they could benefit the PAYDAY gang. But Bain thought otherwise. As Ethan and Hila’s fame reached the sky, Bain saw an opportunity for some more “showmanship” and maybe improving public relations. Also, that Hila is rumoured to sit on fierce Israeli combat skills as she was part of the army was not a bad bonus.

4683900.name: Golf 5 MAX Demo
4683900.short_description: Try Golf 5 MAX free! Retro arcade golf meets real physics. Build your golfer, master your swing and take on Birdie or Bust. The full game launches November 2 on Steam with 25% off for two weeks. Wishlist it now!

630850.name: Notruf 112 - KEF - Das Kleineinsatzfahrzeug
