630850.short_description: The add-on “KEF – The minor operations vehicle” is the first extension for Emergency Call 112 – The Fire Fighting Simulation. It adds the namesake minor operation vehicle (German: Kleineinsatzfahrzeug, KEF) to the player’s fleet.

5247120.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator - Prologue
5247120.short_description: Manage your own football card shop! Open card packs to discover rare football player cards, stock your shelves with football merchandise, sell to customers, expand your store, and build the ultimate football card shop.

5481000.name: Welcome To HillVeil Soundtrack
5481000.short_description: A collection of the 12 tracks featured in the game(plus a bonus!)

4463620.name: Unbreakable Happy Ball
4463620.short_description: A physics‑based platformer about strategic bomb placement, careful planning, and climbing upward one explosion at a time.

5219740.name: Miner Shop Simulator Demo
5219740.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

5354300.name: Sex Office 2
5354300.short_description: Balance your office work routine with the allure of money and romance. Complete your tasks on time, go out and win over major investors, or risk it all at the casino. Meet three unique female colleagues, deepen your relationships with them, and unlock nine exclusive intimate scenes.

5312830.name: Chartward
5312830.short_description: Rise from the slums to your own ship in an open-world pirate RPG distilled into incremental play. Sail uncharted seas, board vessels and plunder their riches. Choose your quests, dive for treasure and earn permanent keepsake upgrades across repeated lives.

5314340.name: STARHOME Demo
5314340.short_description: Take command of a fleet carrying the last survivors of your civilization. Manage limited space aboard your ships, balance living quarters, production, defenses, and weapons, and explore an unknown galaxy in search of a new home. Play the STARHOME Demo.

4123130.name: Where the Veil Thins
4123130.short_description: A monster taming JRPG where your creatures are your cards. Bond over 200 of them, build a deck, and outplay rival summoners with face-down wards and a board that rewards planning. The Imperium is recruiting, cadet. Serve well, and never ask what the Veil is hiding.

1841660.name: nanos world™
1841660.short_description: The next-generation open-world multiplayer sandbox. Play community-made game modes, create addons with Lua scripting, import custom assets from Unreal Engine 5, and host your own dedicated servers for hundreds of players!

4229040.name: Zero To South
4229040.short_description: After the Y2K crash, take your taxi on the long road from Camp Zero to South. Pick up passengers, trade items, and survive the journey.

5400830.name: Animal Cubes: Tidy Up Dreams
5400830.short_description: A cozy organization simulator in a dream: sort 6344 cubic animals, 120 unique species onto the right shelves. Turn a chaotic dream into a perfectly organized collection.

4625950.name: Miner Shop Simulator
4625950.short_description: Miner Shop Simulator is a hands-on mining and shop management sim. Dig for resources, refine raw ore into valuable goods, stock your shelves, serve customers, and grow a small mining shop into a thriving business.

5330460.name: relay
5330460.short_description: A modern-day hacking sim. Take bug bounties, sweet talk a help desk, lift credentials, cash out crypto, upgrade your rig, and more. NPCs respond to you in a realistic manner, and remember what you've done.

5165770.name: One Good Turn
5165770.short_description: Cozy meets Card Game in One Good Turn. Summon Allies, cast your spells, and combo together Aura cards to help build and protect your town! Craft a deck and go exploring to gather resources and presents for the lovely townsfolk! Make friends, open packs, and create unique decks in One Good Turn!

5293080.name: Drums & Steel Demo
5293080.short_description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and in this demo. May the best army win.

4538790.name: Black Steel: Syndicate Breaker
4538790.short_description: A comic‑book styled 3D fighter with rollback netcode where a determined uncle battles a ruthless syndicate.

5181860.name: TOMIDER
5181860.short_description: A psychological horror about Tomi, a teenager unraveling the truth behind a tragedy that struck his school ten years ago. Explore the 1990s town of Oford, gather clues, and discover what the darkness is really hiding.

5363360.name: Old School Baseball
5363360.short_description: Baseball like it's 1985. Fast arcade play where the field decides the hit: the scoring zones shuffle every half-inning. Time your swing, paint the corners, and play a 42-game season all the way to the playoffs.

4739500.name: JOHN GLEEP
4739500.short_description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

5381690.name: Engria, The Twisted Carnival
5381690.short_description: Step into the paws of Kuros, the shapeshifting cat, in the strange world of Engria where death and mayhem are everyday occurrences alongside tea and biscuits.

5236120.name: STEEL ROAD Demo
5236120.short_description: Intense fighting game where you command your fighter in every battle.

5202360.name: beautiful freaks of the desert - demo
5202360.short_description: This is the demo for 'beautiful freaks of the desert', a hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic, that requires lightning fast reactions and strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the beginning of the trip...

1118300.name: The Sea is Our Stage
1118300.short_description: A fantasy yuri visual novel in which a noblewoman uncovers her father's evil plot and, along with her lowborn friends, takes to the seas to flee from high society. Her plan to right her family's wrongs and return home are disrupted by the untimely arrival of an enigmatic and flirtatious pirate.

4739820.name: JOHN GLEEP Demo
4739820.short_description: JOHN GLEEP is a tiny alien with a big problem. His casino is a failure and he owes the mob a galaxy. Solution? Fly from planet to planet and forcibly abduct gamblers to boost business, pay off your debt, and fix your failed marriage in this unexplainable intergalactic action-roguelike mashup.

5398470.name: NEONOVA Puzzle: Orange
5398470.short_description: NEONOVA Puzzle:Orange is an atmospheric jigsaw puzzle game that combines anime aesthetics and Halloween-inspired neon cyberpunk. Assemble futuristic images, connect the pieces, and unlock vibrant illustrations filled with neon lights, mysterious characters, and digital technologies that come to life

5063640.name: Meowgic Egg Idle
5063640.short_description: Click to hatch, merge, and idle battle on the ranch—raise a bunch of adorable Meowgic Eggs, watch them grow stronger, and challenge the Demon King.

5309390.name: TIC.EXE Demo
5309390.short_description: The TIC.EXE demo: four of the eight sectors. Three in a row is not a win, it is a discharge — the line detonates into the hostile process. Build a deck and modules, reach the boss.

5382620.name: FLICK PONG
5382620.short_description: FLICK PONG is a first-person table tennis game. Hold left click and flick the mouse through the ball: a fast flick hits hard, the direction of your flick is where it goes, and hooking your flick curves the ball. Challenge your friends online.

5095490.name: beautiful freaks of the desert
5095490.short_description: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic and a heart of gold, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the surface of the trip...

3977410.name: The Seventh Screening
3977410.short_description: ESCAPE THE LIMELIGHT. Outsmart, outwit or outrun your demons in this cinematic first person survival horror.

3837450.name: Wizzy the Wood
3837450.short_description: Wizzy the Wood is a 3D adventure platformer where you play as a forest creature on a quest to reclaim the Stone of Eternity from an evil sorcerer and save your tribe.

3462580.name: Factory Life
3462580.short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

4065630.name: Factory Life Demo
4065630.short_description: Factory Life is a first-person factory simulator with colony-management elements. Start alone in a small garage, assemble electronics, and scale your business. Hire workers, manage their daily needs, and choose to be a fair leader or a harsh exploiter. Find your path to the top.

3458930.name: Ethereal Odyssey
3458930.short_description: Explore a dreamscape, rich with magic, hidden secrets and mysterious creatures.

5341270.name: Veiled Legions: Fantasy Strategy Board Game
5341270.short_description: Lead a hidden army in a tactical board game of bluff and deduction. Your rival can't see your units until combat when clashes become animated duels. Outwit a bot, a Steam friend, or an online rival and seize the enemy Relic.

5077430.name: Dead Man's Clock
5077430.short_description: Dead Man's Clock is a fast-paced 2D pixel-art western shooter where every second counts. Fight through an endless saloon shootout, gun down outlaws to steal back precious seconds, chase high scores, and survive as long as you can before the clock strikes zero.

5184670.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival Demo
5184670.short_description: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. This demo contains a taste of Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival, where you meet the main characters of the story, delve into the Labyrinth and face off against the Scarlet Church for the first time.

5162210.name: My Paper Plane is Better Demo

4999110.name: PNEUMA Demo
4999110.short_description: Pneuma is an online co-op sci-fi paranormal investigation game for up to 4 players. Operate advanced paranormal tech to investigate, analyze, and outmaneuver deadly ghosts before you are possessed. Speak rituals aloud with your own voice to bind, expose, or provoke what hunts you.

5152460.name: S.S.K - project
5152460.short_description:
Boomer shooter in the setting of a secret complex in Eastern Europe — Take on the role of an ordinary worker in extraordinary circumstances.

Shooting, puzzles, dark dungeons, retro graphics and more...

4967760.name: Purrrfect Immortal
4967760.short_description: Purrrfect Immortal is a story-rich idle adventure where Cat Heroes train, make friends, and embark on an epic quest to rescue magical kittens stolen by dragons.

3036260.name: Wylde Society
3036260.short_description: Step into the elegant heels of Vivian Wylde, witch, socialite and host, in period drama sim Wylde Society! Build, run and customise your magical boarding house in turn of the century Fairhaven. Host splendid events, expand your witchcraft, and influence the town. Who will you invite for tea?

4966280.name: 狩人ハ闇夜ヲ餐ウ
4966280.short_description: Casual Horror Action RPG "NIGHT DEVOURESS" – Exorcism? Physical is trending!

5031210.name: Rise of the Merchants
5031210.short_description: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

4243120.name: Chronicles Meteorfall
4243120.short_description: A semi-open world turn based RPG with detailed class-based and skill building mechanics, deep worldbuilding and lore, and genuine LGBT+ representation.

5046840.name: TowOrbs
5046840.short_description: TowOrbs is an incremental tower defense game where where you face down hordes of wolves. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and slice through your foes with spinning orbs of destruction!

4789370.name: Cursor Flux
4789370.short_description: Add motion blur, trails, and glow effects to your cursor for a smoother, more stylish pointer that fits your setup without changing your workflow.

5049650.name: TowOrbs Demo
5049650.short_description: TowOrbs is an incremental tower defense game where where you face down hordes of wolves. Master unique tower paths, unlock powerful permanent upgrades and slice through your foes with spinning orbs of destruction!

4454070.name: SteelFall
4454070.short_description: Pilot a heavy mech and fight giant kaijus with your steel fists and an arsenal of ranged weapons. Punch, parry, shoot and hurl your way across a world overrun by monsters, in a third-person mecha brawler built on weight and impact.

3689220.name: Cave Oasis at Shylake
3689220.short_description: This quirky, nerdy, alien farm life sim focuses on balancing community and ecosystem needs. Move to a moon town to be a hydroponic farmer. When dust storms threaten the town's sunlight, you'll grow and craft supplies, build renewable energy tech, protect wild biomes, and help your community thrive.

3751090.name: ZombMe Demo
3751090.short_description:
Old school platforming...with a twist.

It's another zombie game....except this time YOU are the zombie...and instead of trying to stay alive....you're trying to stay dead! Jump, flip, throw, and avoid health powerups as you try to (not) save your neck.

Demo includes the entire first world.

4928930.name: 喵星档案 Meow Star Archives Demo
4928930.short_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

5046130.name: Bento Express
5046130.short_description: Run a tiny bento kiosk on a countryside train platform, solo or in online co-op with up to 4 players. Cook to order, ring up commuters and count their change before the doors close. Talk over proximity voice, dress your own stall keeper and make rent by closing time.

4438170.name: Riskline
4438170.short_description: Riskline is a multiplayer game about risk, greed, and outplaying your rivals. Spin slots, bet on roulette, challenge other players to duels, grab limited items, and decide when to cash out. Whoever hides the most money in the bank by the end of the match wins.

4780630.name: TILEZ
4780630.short_description: A 2D creative sandbox where every tile is a tiny machine. Inspired by Redstone, LEGO, and Tabletop Simulator.  Create and play solo or with friends.

4989140.name: Pongcremental
4989140.short_description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

4919570.name: 喵星档案 Meow Star Archives
4919570.short_description: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

5022580.name: Brandrheim
5022580.short_description: A third-person action RPG dungeon crawler with online co-op for up to 4 players. Explore dangerous dungeons, defeat powerful bosses, collect legendary loot, and build your hero through class-based character progression.

4707880.name: WORJONG
4707880.short_description: Build four three-letter English words from letter tiles, one draw and one discard at a time. Just don't throw away the letter a rival needs to finish their words.

5284710.name: SHAME
5284710.short_description: SHAME, A Survival Horror Game, Where Player must survive through the night against vampire like creatures. Gear up with the vast amount of weapons to slay these beast, shop for ammo and resources , and try your best to survive through the night.

3556110.name: You've Changed
3556110.short_description: You've Changed is like scary "spot the difference". Observe changes in the environment and catch enemies before they attack in this retro-inspired, anomaly horror game! You've Changed features hand-animated rotoscoped enemy graphics and finely-tuned gameplay balance.

2660180.name: MEANWHILE IN SECTOR 80
2660180.short_description: MS80 is an action-engineering adventure in an abandoned star system. Trapped in a robot body, scavenge your way through the aftermath of a robot rebellion. Your body is a weapon — upgrade it with modular components you take off your enemies, and build yourself a new you!

4394540.name: Become A Monarch
4394540.short_description: BaM is a simple project, something like an offline animal walking simulator, focusing on the simplicity of everyday animal life. Don't expect an "animal game" experience here; for that, we recommend Animalia Survival. This is a study project where I release updates as I learn more about EU.

5153960.name: Drellnathor Demo
5153960.short_description: Drellnathor is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you grow stronger between runs. Kill monsters, collect loot, and slay powerful bosses for permanent upgrades. Can you discover why you're trapped in a cycle of life and death?

5324750.name: Trap Testers Demo
5324750.short_description: Trap Testers is a co-op physics-based deathrun game where you're the one placing the traps! Compete against your friends to reach the finish line first, and try to kill them along the way.

5321570.name: Razor Squadron
5321570.short_description: Razor Squadron is a vertical arcade shoot 'em up set inside a colossal fleet war. Shift power between machine guns, lasers, and missiles, rescue wingmen in battle, switch formations on the fly, and push through the MAW's invasion.

5300940.name: The Long Watch Demo
5300940.short_description: A roguelike tower defense where you draw the road the enemy walks. Drive back the mist around you if you want to survive, protect your torches and hold the hill. A final boss will be waiting for you in this free demo of The Long Watch.

5443560.name: City Safety
5443560.short_description: City Safety is a game about taking your city back from the mass surveillance that has infected every street corner. Join your friends in riding around the city, wreaking havoc, and challenging authority.

4575090.name: Quod Erat Demonstrandum Demo
4575090.short_description: Discover the challenging fun of validating logical proofs, beginning with simple propositional calculus and ending with complex, multi-domain propositional calculus. Prove yourself to be a master of logical thinking!

3179030.name: Total Loss
3179030.short_description: Pile your mates into a clapped-out banger and slam on the brakes in front of traffic. Total Loss is a low-poly co-op comedy for 1-4 players: stage crashes, fling yourself under buses and claim for every bruise, then swap sides and avoid other chancers on your day job.

4901700.name: Grievance: Eye for an Eye
4901700.short_description: A 2D animated choice-driven interactive superhero drama about the cycle of revenge and everyone affected by it. Watch the story unfold while making choices that lead to different story branches and endings.

5059340.name: Hush Piñata
5059340.short_description: She got tired of being hit, blindfolded herself and came back thirsty for revenge. A horror-comedy party game for up to 9 players, the blind Piñata hunts by sound, and even your voice on the mic lights a silhouette in her darkness. Do the chores quietly and rip off her tail before she notices.

5323250.name: Starfall Defense
5323250.short_description: Starfall Defense is a real-time multiplayer tower defense game blending ancient mythology with cosmic sci-fi. Deploy legendary heroes like Pangu and Nuwa, trigger class synergies, and fend off alien swarms! Features 2-player co-op and ranked PvP. Free to play, pure strategy!

3674070.name: Iona's Island
3674070.short_description: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders to help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape the world accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

5442580.name: Dispatch Loop
5442580.short_description: You are the courier. Every contract is a delivery loop: choose which cards go on the map, build combos and survive the obstacles you bring on yourself. Between runs, upgrade your home and your bike, then take the next job.

5486310.name: Forbidden House
5486310.short_description: Forbidden House is a first-person puzzle adventure with over 40 puzzles to solve.

5461500.name: Football B-side
5461500.short_description: Five a side, top down, thumbs on. Arcade football with a whole international season underneath it. 195 nations, one midfielder: you.

3677850.name: Springs, Eternal
3677850.short_description: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

1725980.name: Godshard Chronicles
1725980.short_description: Godshard Chronicles is a top-down action RPG based in the Godshard novels universe with music by famed composer Noriyuki Iwadare. Inspired by titles such as The Legend of Zelda, Grandia, and the Mana series. Fight in action-packed battles and explore a sprawling world either solo or with a friend!

4802100.name: Perfumed Palaces
4802100.short_description: Engage this analog horror slot machine to explore the forbidden maze complex, find a way out, hone your PSY abilities, and make contact with inorganic beings.

4216080.name: Wolcen 2
4216080.short_description: Many years after Wolcen: Lords of Mayhem, return to a world on the brink of collapse. Master brutal combat, build your character without fixed classes, combine skills and gear, and unleash your Shadow Form in this dark fantasy Action RPG. Play alone or in co-op.

3144750.name: Maui the Shapeshifter
3144750.short_description: Restore harmony as shapeshifting demigod Maui on an adventure to save his island home from all-consuming darkness in this epic 2D open-world Metroidvania.

2356810.name: Tales Of Shadowland
2356810.short_description: Experience the freedom of a classic RPG within a cutting-edge, free-to-play, open-world, multiplayer online experience. Explore, fight, collect, build, and conquer alongside your friends, and against your enemies, without any pay-to-win elements, all while immersing yourself in the story of Eurone.

5463890.name: Ashe & Granite
5463890.short_description: A horror RPG, one life at a time, read to you. Every death teaches the next life. Every door is open to you. Every door costs something. Seventy-six endings are written out, each with its own account of how you got there. One of them is the way out. Nobody has found it.

5455380.name: PACTFORGE
5455380.short_description: Your Phoenix dies – and rises again. Assemble 17 units in three factions, merge them up to tier 5 and let them fight on their own. New: duels against friends. Bosses, artifacts and six worlds.

3150750.name: Wilds - Night Zookeeper
3150750.short_description: Let your imagination run Wilds! From the BAFTA nominated team at Night Zookeeper, Wilds is an online adventure bound only by the limits of your creativity. Create characters, bring them to life, and embark on your own adventure in fast paced multiplayer action.

2538150.name: OyasumiVR
2538150.short_description: Software that helps you sleep in virtual reality. OyasumiVR detects when you are asleep and automates various tasks and settings to make VR sleeping as comfortable as possible.

5253810.name: Last Ones Down
5253810.short_description: A social survival game for up to 16 players. Reveal your traits, argue your case, and vote on who gets into the bunker. There’s only room for half of you, and keeping the wrong people could doom everyone inside.

4171130.name: Isekai Guardians
4171130.short_description: Text-Based MMORPG in an isekai anime fantasy world.

4531360.name: Orcthal
4531360.short_description: You are the raid. Play as an orc warrior carving through armies! Auto-cast devastating abilities, level up with powerful perks, loot the fallen, pillage their settlements and come back again, and again, stronger!

5474480.name: FMV - Full Motion Voyeur Demo
5474480.short_description: Investigate heinous villain and ordinary lives via hidden cameras in this live-action psychological horror FMV. Search intel, solve passwords, and choose who to sacrifice to the Demon to save your captive lover, Mona. Play the early alpha demo now and help shape the game!

5020780.name: TCG Football Card Shop Simulator Demo

5147840.name: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle Demo
5147840.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

4716070.name: 廃墟の盾と虚空の槍 ～Unity Sanctuary.
4716070.short_description:
This is a roguelike tower defense action strategy game where you must protect Unity-chan as she is forced to march toward “initialization.”
Players use weapons and skills to fend off the hordes targeting Unity-chan as she charges forward on her own.

4504880.name: Sirius the Stargazer : Furry Idle
4504880.short_description: Awooo—! Follow Sirius into the starry lands! Sirius the Stargazer is a cozy desktop idle game. Start with a simple branch, defeat monsters, collect gear with random abilities, and help Sirius grow stronger. When he’s tired, let him rest by the campfire and keep you company.

5491850.name: Inkblot: The Art Restorer
5491850.short_description: A painterly puzzle about restoring masterpieces. A living ink blot has stolen the figures from 128 famous paintings and heaped their shadows on your workbench. Untangle the overlapping silhouettes, paint each one whole and send it home before the museum opens.

5089400.name: Who Pressed It?! Demo
5089400.short_description: A chaotic 2–4 player co-op puzzle game. Work together to solve test rooms, interact with giant buttons, and try not to press the wrong thing. Every mistake sends the facility further into chaos!

5404940.name: Road Riot
5404940.short_description: Vehicular combat survivor game, set in the 80's. Dodge swarming enemies, evolve absurd weapons and smash huge bosses. Collect scrap, upgrade your garage and unlock new cars. Get wrecked. Come back louder.

5477710.name: Sweet Manor
5477710.short_description: Sweet Manor - A simple and beautiful jigsaw puzzle game themed around a manor. Spend wonderful time with five pretty and cute maids in the manor, accompanied by relaxing music. After completing a level, you can admire the girls' photos in the gallery.

5193850.name: Twilight Gallery Demo
5193850.short_description: A point-and-click game inspired by early internet flash games. A mysterious company has induced you into a year-long coma and is curating your dreams. Free the trapped souls of artists from their exhibits to escape.

2425990.name: Sleepytime Village Demo
2425990.short_description: Sleepytime Village is the story of a workaholic father who makes one wrong choice too many and becomes trapped in a children’s storybook reality, haunted by the residents of Sleepytime Village, its formless narrator and visions of his childhood. What is the Village and what does it want from him?

4821630.name: MarsCity3026
4821630.short_description: A game for kids and adults. Grapple, swing, move mechanical puzzle pieces. Play as a robot that solves mazes and mechanical puzzles. Each puzzle brings the atmosphere control fans back online so that the humans can wake from cryo-sleep.

5073410.name: Crypt Runner
5073410.short_description: Navigate dangerous crypts, defeat enemies, and gather loot in this extraction dungeon crawler. If you die, you lose it all. Extract alive to bring your spoils back to your base camp. Visit NPCs, upgrade your town, and gear up for another crypt run.

4565210.name: My Stylish Life
4565210.short_description: It's 2008, and you just sat down at the family computer. Run your own boutique, build your dream wardrobe, make new friends, fall in love, and explore a colorful world where every day is yours to style. Welcome to My Stylish Life.

5292680.name: Silly Souls
5292680.short_description: Silly Souls is an online hide-and-seek party game for 2–8 players. Hide your soul, throw props, and taunt a friend playing the Grim Reaper to steal time—or grab the scythe and hunt your friends. Expect close calls, silly escapes, and proximity voice chat.

4631070.name: Vroomity Loops
4631070.short_description: A 2D puzzle game inspired by the erratic behaviours of Portuguese drivers... especially in roundabouts... because as we all know it, as soon as you enter a roundabout the common sense goes out the window.

5409320.name: Gweilo 1886
5409320.short_description: Return to 1886 Hong Kong as Fini, an ex-priest and opium addict. Carved up by Empires, exploited for trade and vice, the city is battered, beautiful, flourishing—a playground for deception. Follow a jade ring into its secrets with a suspicious feline at your side.

5203890.name: Cellwright - A FreeCell Roguelike
5203890.short_description: This is FreeCell, re-imagined as a roguelike. Chain cards to the foundations to build Mult, collect relics that multiply each other, and beat every deal's quota. Win the eight-ante run, then push into true Endless. Renown, feats and eight Grades carry over between runs.

3595350.name: UnGodly
3595350.short_description: Ungodly is a dark fantasy RPG where visceral real-time combat meets collectible hero strategy. Build your roster, chain elemental powers through seamless team swapping, and forge bonds that unlock devastating synergies in a world on the edge of ruin.

5382160.name: Cutteridge Estate
5382160.short_description: From the original creators and remastered for Halloween: welcome home to the Cutteridge Estate! A full stand-alone and free-to-play experience where you can customize your avatar, decorate your space, and meet up with friends to explore haunted grounds full of ghosts and spooky minigames.

2006110.name: Havenview
2006110.short_description: Havenview is an all-ages twin stick shooter with rogue-lite progression.  Play with up to 6 players to help the kids of Havenview defeat the invading Oozeborgs.  Unlock new classes, upgrades and blast your way to their Mothership - Save Havenview!

4513190.name: Totally Nutz: An 80s Adventure – Demo
4513190.short_description: Step back into the 80s in this hand-drawn, hidden-object puzzle adventure about a family of squirrels chasing a big dream. Join the Nutz family as they journey from their quiet home in the suburbs to the big city in search of the legendary Acorn Games.

1652580.name: Imperial Grace
1652580.short_description: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

5273050.name: Your Friend's Mom 2
5273050.short_description: 💕 Your new desktop companion is the mom of one of your Steam friends! Chat with her, spark a romance, and customize her look. Play mini-games, solve jigsaw puzzles to unlock photos, invite friends for online co-op, choose pets, and explore tons of handy tools! 🥵

5067130.name: Refracted
5067130.short_description: Refracted: a 4-player co-op shooter where you build turrets and lead troops. Wield powers granted to you by a mysterious crystal against the clanker horde. Empower your hero, upgrade your army & defenses, and push through enemy lines to destroy the clanker base. Die. Refract. Push again.

4228450.name: Corner Arcade
4228450.short_description:
Live the dream and run your own arcade in this idle management sim.
Purchase arcade machines and build your space, your way.
Run your arcade, level up and upgrade your machines to attract elite gamers and watch as they empty their pockets to fill yours! Then sit back & enjoy the buzz of the arcade.

5097830.name: Shattersight
5097830.short_description: Shattersight is a fast-paced arcade FPS where every kill earns you cash. Spend it on new guns, attachments and killstreaks, then jump straight back into Team Deathmatch or Capture the Flag. Quick matches, nonstop action, and bots fill in when players are short.

4115450.name: Phantom Blade Zero
4115450.short_description: S-GAME presents Phantom Blade Zero, a fusion of classic Wuxia storytelling and exhilarating action powered by Unreal Engine 5. You play as Soul, a warrior with only sixty-six days left to live. Fend off assassins, unravel world-ending conspiracies, and defend your values with your life.

2853880.name: The Lords' Game
2853880.short_description: A grand strategy card game set in the fantasy world of Tolria. Raise your banner, build your deck and lead your chosen lord to victory in single player or multi player modes with up to eight players. Featuring nine factions, 1,000 cards, a full original soundtrack and original card art.

5276860.name: Realm Protectors
5276860.short_description: Hold the line against hundreds of monsters in a bright, top-down survival roguelite. Pick one of four heroes, time your abilities, and grow a build that turns a desperate fight into a screen-clearing storm. Four realms, a boss at the end of every round, and always one more run.

5342770.name: Guns & Gambits
5342770.short_description: Guns & Gambits is a high-octane chess horde-survival roguelite. Command sentient chess companions, wield devastating firearms, unlock game-breaking gambits, and blast through relentless waves of rogue chess pieces to checkmate the dark monarch in bullet-heaven action.

4697520.name: Rogue Maze Demo
4697520.short_description: Tower defense is reinvented in this maze-defense roguelike! Design devious labyrinths fit to exhaust the unfortunate souls that enter by using special tiles that act as both your "towers" and pathway. Deploy gadgets, distractions, and tools to stay a step ahead!

4983340.name: Breaker League
4983340.short_description: Puzzle-battle mayhem on one shared board. Drop pieces, chain combos, and invade your rivals' turf in frantic 1–4 player matches online or on the couch. 37 ridiculous fighters, 12 game-changing specials, and a 32-level story campaign.

4488730.name: Ziii
4488730.short_description: Ziii is a retro fantasy action-adventure game.  Sail between countless islands, exploring their various elemental lands in top-down and sidescroll styles.  Plunder their dungeons for powerful items and precious relics.  Ziii is a treasure-hunter, looking to gain a treasure vault value of 100,000.

5084740.name: Hendichen
5084740.short_description: Chaotic co-op cooking for 1 to 3 players. THE CHEF knows every recipe but has one working hand. MUFFLES barely hears you. WOBBLES reads every order as a different dish. Talk to each other, or the kitchen burns.

5425540.name: Railtown Demo
5425540.short_description: Every great city starts with a station. In Railtown, trains bring tourists and money while you grow a tiny town into a bustling city: build homes, shops and tram lines, upgrade your train from steam to high-speed, and keep your citizens happy through every season.

2751070.name: Paleokin
2751070.short_description: Paleokin is a brutal prehistoric survival game set in an infinite procedural world. Fight mammoths and dinosaurs, build a settlement, farm the land, breed your own dinos, and stay alive. Alone or with friends.

5451230.name: Frontier Planetfall
5451230.short_description: Explore an alien frontier in a single-player, first-person survival adventure. Gather resources, build shelters, craft better equipment and brave regional guardians. Sail between islands and take to the skies to uncover what lies beyond your camp.

914160.name: Zup! Arena
914160.short_description: Zup! Arena is a multiplayer arcade game in which you have to fight with other players! Throw off all your opponents from the battlefield and become the "King of the mountain". Play alone or in a group with friends!

5036970.name: AFKTower
5036970.short_description: A pixel-art idle RPG docked to the edge of your screen. Your hero climbs a 10,000-floor tower while you work: 12-rarity loot, 4 classes, key-gated bosses, a deep forge and a Paragon Constellation. And it keeps earning while it's closed.

5084200.name: Task Bar Cube
5084200.short_description: Task Bar Cube is an idle RPG playable either in full screen or directly from your taskbar. Upgrade your characters and pets, collect rare equipment, and discover dozens of different progression systems.

2331930.name: VOIDRUSH
2331930.short_description: An action roguelite, solo or co-op with up to 10 players. Face endless hordes, combine 52 weapons and 161 items into devastating evolutions, unions and synergies, and hold on until the end as the Void awakens beyond the map.

4957040.name: Hunker Bunker
4957040.short_description: Guide your squad of operators through a dark, grid-based cybernetic bunker. Manage oxygen, fortify defenses against mutating cyber-snails, and uncover the lore of the deep biomes in this high-tension tactical survival game.

1202360.name: VR Gigapixel Gallery
1202360.short_description: Free: Put your own photos from your PC on the wall in VR – in full resolution, as TIFF up to 4 GB. Your images stay on your PC. Plus thousands of Gigapixel images at true size in the designer house or neutral room, with a ppi traffic light for print quality.

5314170.name: Kibasen
5314170.short_description: Welcome to KIBASEN, a traditional game of chicken fighting with elevated stakes.

4397540.name: RAIN HEART
4397540.short_description: Psychological horror about Alex Bow, who struggles with himself and his traumas.

5221550.name: Bogey Blazers
5221550.short_description: A physics-driven 2.5D disc golf game where you chase down every throw. Compete online with up to 12 players and navigate through courses while avoiding obstacles and deadly traps, or play solo to unlock rewards and beat personal records.

3794620.name: Sails
3794620.short_description: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

5286270.name: Shatterwing
5286270.short_description: Turn enemy fire into your greatest weapon. SHATTERWING is a pixel-art bullet hell shooter where you dash to create mirrors, reflect deadly volleys, and build your ship across five stages. Master six ships or switch colors and absorb bullets in Polarity mode.

2903980.name: Steel Effigy
2903980.short_description: Cleave through hordes of enslaved machines in this 1 to 4 player action-roguelite, hack n slash. Equip your Effigy with unique Items and Weapons to fight against The Barons and their machines. Upgrade your Weapons with powerful Augments to modify them and how they play.

3660710.name: Armatus
3660710.short_description: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

5271700.name: Clear the Snow Demo
5271700.short_description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

5439180.name: Stable Champs
5439180.short_description: Build your stable. Chase the Golden Silks. Buy, breed and train racehorses, develop your yard and plan your Flat or Jumps campaign in this single-player management sim. Watch races unfold in 3D, become Champion Trainer and return to defend your title.

5023090.name: Bouncing Body Bits
5023090.short_description: A newly assembled face wants to find the perfect body; this mysterious platforming adventure will take you through a maze of rooms with many doors to enter and many puzzles to solve; will you acquire the perfect combination of limbs to suit each situation and discover the secret to a perfect body?

3665590.name: Silent Crew
3665590.short_description: You start your own urban exploration vlog called "Silent Crew". Search abandoned buildings, record footage, collect clues, and uncover the dark history hidden within the ruins of forgotten worlds.

4436420.name: The Circuit Alpha
4436420.short_description: A tactical 3D fighting RPG with turn‑based, card‑driven combat. Build your fighter, craft powerful decks, and outthink opponents as you rise through a nonlinear combat‑sports career.

5379620.name: Arena of No Return
5379620.short_description: Arena of No Return is a dark medieval boxing simulation where you play as Kael, a condemned fighter trapped in a brutal arena-city. Train, unlock new skills, build your fighting style, and climb the ranks to earn your freedom and return to your daughter.

3299010.name: External
3299010.short_description: RPG extraction-shooter in a post-apocalyptic setting. Survive in the ruins of the old world, loot gear, level up skills, improve your equipment and shelter. Fight various factions, or complete missions to become their ally.

4312680.name: GRIFT
4312680.short_description: GRIFT is a physics-based dice-building roguelike. Throw real 3D dice off walls and board fixtures, rewrite their faces between rounds, and strike dangerous Deals with the House, who cheats back. Rig the odds, chase the score, and beat the House.

4620440.name: Re:Re:Re:Respawn
4620440.short_description: A 3D action-puzzle game where your corpses become platforms, weights and shields. Leave a body with every death and find a way through BOX, a vast structure filled with deadly traps. Where you die matters. Starring Kuruma Takahira of Reiwa Roman in his first lead role in a game.

5061130.name: Pongcremental Demo
5061130.short_description: Pongcremental is an incremental game where you play as the ball of Pong. Eliminate enemies, get stronger, unlock game changing abilities. Hit, destroy, earn, get good. And repeat.

3997310.name: Forbidden Fantasy: Temptation
3997310.short_description: Forbidden Fantasy - Bloodlines is an adult visual novel based on your choices. Elves, humans, and succubi await you in passionate romances, while you, the Demon King, face conspiracies and challenge kingdoms amidst war.

4255580.name: Mouse X
4255580.short_description: You look at your mouse every single day. Personalize it with Mouse X. Use custom live cursors on your desktop, and share your own custom cursor skins on the Steam Workshop!

4716660.name: Skroyder Rumble
4716660.short_description: Survive the waves. Beat the bosses. Bring home the loot. A fast 2.5D action roguelite brawler about surviving chaotic enemy waves, building your character, and fighting huge cartoon bosses.

4931650.name: Empirestead
4931650.short_description: A cozy medieval farming life sim on Grey Croft. Keep animals, trade in Ashford, and live through the seasons.

5376340.name: War Company: Fortress Europe Demo
5376340.short_description: Lead armies across a dynamic 3D campaign, then command the battles they create in real time. Logistics, maneuver, and tactical success combine to decide the fate of the war.

3562000.name: Dungeon Danger Traps 2
3562000.short_description: Dungeon Danger Traps 2 is a free hardcore platformer with multiplayer, where every move matters. Dodge deadly traps, find the shortest route to the finish line, and compete for the best time!

5033980.name: WoundWake
5033980.short_description: WoundWake is a turn-based RPG with a parry system that explores the different facets of humanity in a world on the brink of extinction: fear, trauma, obsession, love, and corruption

4438940.name: Beat Bots
4438940.short_description:
A casual musical puzzle game - make beats with bots!

Listen to the target beat, then solve how to replicate the beat by manipulating bots that each represent a different drum sound

5266010.name: Dogeminer 2: Back 2 The Moon™ Demo
5266010.short_description: Mine your way across the cosmos in this wholesome & silly adventure! Recruit loyal helpers, loot legendary gear, and build your empire all the way to the moon and beyond! Such wow!

4336940.name: Lenin Street Geek Shop Demo
4336940.short_description: Become a shopkeeper in the first geek store in a snowy 2000s town: sell CDs, snacks, and fan merch, influence your customers' lives, get involved in shady business, and grow your small store.

5254860.name: The Silent Fare Demo
5254860.short_description: A psychological horror anomaly game where you observe your apartment, report strange changes, and uncover a disturbing story hidden in the environment.

5456600.name: KEYSMASH
5456600.short_description: KEYSMASH is a keyboard fidget toy: mash any key and watch it bloom into color, shape, and sound. Play through 24 hand-crafted worlds, from Bauhaus galleries to cherry blossoms to a crashing stock ticker, and earn 100 honest achievements. No skill, no fail. Just vibes

4459300.name: Underground Security Inc Demo
4459300.short_description: Build the most profitable dungeon while defending against parties of adventuring "heroes". Manage minions, mine ores, build traps and collect ancient tomes in this roguelite meets base defense game.

4077320.name: Cardaire: Eternal Aces
4077320.short_description: Get ready to crack packs and throw cards in a single-player collectible card RPG! Explore a unique world while collecting your own cards to build the deck that'll make you a Cardaire legend.

2916700.name: Attack on Titan 3 / A.O.T. 3
2916700.short_description: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

3827520.name: My Name Is Vincent Pogo
3827520.short_description:
Play as Vincent, a famous pogo-sticking duck whose sent on an adventure towards the kingdom at the request of the king.
A physics-driven platformer where every jump counts as you bounce and balance your way through a hand-crafted world full of discovery.

4278780.name: Lost Host Demo
4278780.short_description: A short playable demo of Lost Host — explore the world, solve puzzles, and uncover the mystery.

5065580.name: Burn It Back
5065580.short_description: A survival RTS in a frozen taiga. Settle the surface for the bunker below, meet its quotas, and every night burn back a living tissue that grows, adapts and remembers.

3793800.name: Pulse Drive
3793800.short_description:
Tap to the beat to build speed!

Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with a rhythm element. Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

5265740.name: Pulse Drive - Customization Kit
5265740.short_description: Customize your Pulse Drive Vehicle, and your Name Tag on the leaderboards!

969160.name: OCTOPTICOM Demo
969160.short_description: OCTOPTICOM is an open-ended puzzle programming game about designing and optimizing optical computing devices. Use lasers, mirrors, filters and other components to read, transform and write sequences of colored squares.

5346510.name: Gantry VR
5346510.short_description:
Somewhere to watch. A video player for the Steam Frame, running natively on the headset. Plays your own
files, from the headset or your network: flat, 3D, 180 and 360. Watch from a gas station at night, under the
aurora, or in orbit. Nothing leaves your network.

4412410.name: Monked
4412410.short_description: Monked is a third-person roguelike castle defense where you play a holy monk of the Castle of Bellwick. Battle through 16 waves of unique enemies and bosses, collect blessings between waves and fortify your city with barricades and allies. Unlock and collect over 100 blessings, items, and more.

4318060.name: Mysteries of Black Hollow
4318060.short_description: The shop is yours by day. The dark belongs to something else. Raid the abandoned houses of a cursed town, drag your loot home before your lantern gives out, and spend everything you earn on rituals that might just save it or you.

5210030.name: Towa Powa
5210030.short_description: Stack towers, make your own rules, and bring everyone into the same game — local and online. Take on a co-op campaign, create new modes, exploit unbalanced mechanics, share your creations through the Workshop, and relive your most epic matches.

5363170.name: REFLECT89
5363170.short_description: REFLECT89 is a skill-based arcade shoot 'em up where enemy fire becomes your weapon. Rotate your reflector, master Perfect Reflections, fire the Power Cannon and survive 10 stages of intense projectile patterns, unique bosses and high-score challenges.

5450630.name: Mini Legends Idle Demo
5450630.short_description: Try Mini Legends Idle, a voxel fantasy idle RPG with automatic combat. Farm loot, level up, upgrade weapons and armor and combine passives as you progress through stage.

5474840.name: PalmiVelle
5474840.short_description: Build and manage your own tropical getaway in PalmiVelle, an isometric hotel management game. Create hotels, pools and beach facilities, manage staff and prices, and meet your guests’ needs as you grow your seaside resort.

5268450.name: Cranked Demo
5268450.short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

5423880.name: Don't Press This SH*T
5423880.short_description: You find yourself in a room with no door and fingers sticking out of the walls. At first, you press them out of curiosity. Then you learn to live with the consequences. Survive, experiment and find a way out solo or with up to 4 players. In ranked PvP, objects become weapons.

3989790.name: Cranked
3989790.short_description: Explore, race, and freeride in Cranked and experience the raw thrill of downhill mountain biking. It’s fast, responsive, and grounded -- we're chasing what it really feels like to ride. Easy to pick up, impossible to put down, and packed with virtually endless skill depth.

4076370.name: ICU Anomaly
4076370.short_description: Ride a hospital elevator through an abandoned ICU. On every floor, search the ward for anomalies. Nothing wrong? Go up. Something off? Go down. One wrong call sends you back to floor 1. Reach floor 13 to escape, if Lucy lets you.

4386420.name: Apococlicks Demo
4386420.short_description: Dark horror post-apocalyptic incremental clicker game

5449680.name: Mini Legends Idle
5449680.short_description: A voxel fantasy idle RPG about farming loot, leveling up and refining your build. Collect weapons and armor, upgrade your gear and unlock rare spells!

4109870.name: Revola: Post Hyper
4109870.short_description: The Finno-Korean Hyperwar is over. But you are still fighting to survive in the ruins of reality it tore apart, make money, buy weapons, and deal with the consequences of a war that, in some timelines, was only an internet meme.

4877750.name: Temporal Strike
4877750.short_description: Time-loop defense shooter. Aim yourself or let your squad fire on auto as orcs, goblins, boar riders and mechs flood in. Spend the loot on a 38-node upgrade tree, unlock five units, beat the boss waves, then rewind time for permanent upgrades.

5298480.name: Ignite: The Ritual
5298480.short_description: Face the Demonic Mother as 2-4 Survivors. Complete the ritual, find and burn the cursed dolls, and work together to escape the haunted house alive.

3680170.name: Mortuus
3680170.short_description: A round-based co-op zombies FPS for 1 to 4 players. Survive endless hordes in brutalist procedurally generated map. Buy doors, hit the mystery box, upgrade your guns, and uncover the hidden ritual that wakes the Mother.

5122720.name: Habitat: The Endless Terrarium
5122720.short_description: Build living habitats on a clay tabletop world. Draft animals, shape the land they need, and watch your terrarium fill with life through the turning seasons. A strategy game without stress — deep enough to master, calm enough to unwind with. Alone or with up to 4 friends.

5356080.name: Deep Six Demo
5356080.short_description:
A post-WW1 stealth action game where equipment is scarce, and time of day, weather, sound, movement, and position can all betray your position.
Avoid, distract, knockout or kill as you traverse unique locations, sabotage war machines, save your comrades, and take down elite soldiers.

5377230.name: Moonblood Mountain
5377230.short_description: Survive a snowbound night in this first-person survival horror game. Explore a remote cabin and its frozen surroundings, use your flashlight to navigate the dark, and fight off attacking werewolves with an axe as you hold out until dawn.

5462290.name: Jack & Snag
5462290.short_description: Grapple into a new angle and turn robot fights in your favour. Jack & Snag is an arena FPS for 1–6 participants, with one- and two-handed weapons, colourful arenas and bots to practise against on your own.

5405860.name: 方寸小家 RoomFolk Demo
5405860.short_description: Build your own home in this sandbox game, mix and match a huge selection of furniture and decorations, and design your garden too! Export your creative process as a video with one click!

5348950.name: Malkin Tower
5348950.short_description: Climb Malkin Tower, one floor at a time, in a cozy cat-filled idle adventure. Every floor brings new mechanics, upgrades, and surprises.

5412370.name: Carve and Sort: Tidy Up your Pumpkin Patch!
5412370.short_description: Carve, paint and drill pumpkins at the workbench, then sort them onto 26 shelves from A to Z. Pick odd and colorful pumpkins from the patch, tidy the hall together or race each other in versus with up to four players, and see what wakes up when the last shelf is full.

3822320.name: Dream Hollow
3822320.short_description: Manage your courage each day to delve deeper into an eerie storybook forest. Explore the woods, decide the fate of its fearful denizens, and make it back to your cottage before your RESOLVE runs out. A cozy-horror adventure game where choices matter.

5309350.name: Necrolord Demo
5309350.short_description: Command an undead army as a Lich in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite demo. Raise the fallen, equip your troops, and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands and play until you defeat the first Inquisition.

5472580.name: Hypermarket: Sort & Stock
5472580.short_description: A large-scale sorting simulator set in a two-storey hypermarket: organize 65,146 products and boxes across 23 departments, stock shelves and warehouse racks, and use boosters to find, carry and place items.

5233850.name: Headshot Holdout Demo
5233850.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines.  There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

5101650.name: Fear The Reaper Demo
5101650.short_description: Fear The Reaper is a PVP multiplayer horror game in which players take on unique roles and live out the experience of starring in a slasher film while counting down to the terrifying Judgment Hour!

4412040.name: Absorber: Absorb Adapt Survive
4412040.short_description: Hijack enemy processes. Steal their kits. A tactical roguelike on a 7×7 grid where every enemy is carrying something you can take lifesteal, defense, entire ability kits. Build from 250+ programs. The system adapts to hunt you. Permadeath. No negotiations.

2017900.name: Rock Hoppers
2017900.short_description: A light-hearted but deep first person exploration and survival game for you and your friends set in a procedurally-generated asteroid belt on the edge of known space. Explore the world, learn new skills, build and defend your base, and conquer the belt's unique threats.

4989240.name: Backswamps
4989240.short_description: Descend into an endless procedurally generated swamp where every step draws you deeper into a reality that watches back. Explore forgotten fragments and preserve your sanity in an atmospheric psychological horror experience.

4175550.name: Another Eden Begins - Character Pack Vol. 3: Aoife & Wenefica
4175550.short_description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

4175540.name: Another Eden Begins - Character Pack Vol. 2: Elseal & Benedict
4175540.short_description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

4175530.name: Another Eden Begins - Character Pack Vol. 1: Thillelille & Tiramisu
4175530.short_description: Embark on a time-traveling RPG adventure featuring command battles presented by Masato Kato, creator of numerous RPG classics. With New Game+, embark on a new adventure with your upgraded characters and discover more than 10 different endings.

5211290.name: GroundInFlames
5211290.short_description: GroundInFlames is real-time tactics about modern combined-arms warfare. Trenches, suppression and squad morale, FPV drones and electronic warfare, honest armor penetration and vehicle modules. Manpower is scarce, supply runs out, and the enemy only knows what it has seen.

2933760.name: Spellomancer
2933760.short_description: Battle your foes for enchanted letters using wacky weapons and earn points by constructing words in your team's spellbook in this new action platformer spell-em-up!

5221880.name: Keepers of the Farkle
5221880.short_description: Roll the dice, and challenge the CPU or Freinds in a fast-paced game of risk and strategy. Unlock colorful characters and custom dice, conquer tournaments, and compete with friends in local multiplayer without an internet connection! Will you bank your points? Or risk everything on one more roll?

4673810.name: Convent Of Magical Chambers
4673810.short_description: 3D adventure Immersive sim inspired by the early 2000s level design, explore an abandoned convent filled with ghosts and magical chambers and try to solve the mystery behind the creation of the chambers.

4205650.name: Ash Hills Investigation
4205650.short_description: An atmospheric first-person horror where you play as a forest ranger investigating a series of bloody events. Search for clues, monitor the perimeter through surveillance cameras, and keep your shotgun at the ready: an unfathomable horror lurks in the nocturnal gloom…

4780870.name: Aleef
4780870.short_description: Work, browse, or play other games while hatching eggs in the background! Collect 300+ pets, unlock powerful upgrades, and build your battle team.

2712710.name: Unyha
2712710.short_description: Unyha is the first-ever autochronicle online RPG, where your adventures, victories, and defeats become real stories that influence the game for all, and forever. History content is generated by Unyha's unique Autochronicle AI, making it truly aware of players' activity—and naturally responds to it.

5226100.name: Grindveil
5226100.short_description: A free online idle RPG in Early Access. Develop your class, collect equipment, send your hero on missions, fight in the arena and challenge bosses. Join a guild or take a fishing break. The game is still in active development.

5341720.name: Alien Friends
5341720.short_description: Alien Friends is an incremental bullet heaven. The alien only wants friends, but humans from 13 eras attack him in huge crowds. So he fights back with advanced alien technology.

5343780.name: Die Casting Together
5343780.short_description: A co-op tactics roguelite where two heroes each roll a die and the whole turn goes off at once, enemies and all! Draft cards that bend the rules, push your luck on a big roll, then dig into Endless. Friendly fire stays on. Online, hotseat, or solo: run both heroes or bring a bot.

5433770.name: Ram & Repair
5433770.short_description: Smash rival cars to scrap in top-down demolition derby arenas. Survive wave after wave, hammer, weld and bolt your wreck back together by hand, grab rare upgrades, beat each arena's final boss - and face your own champion car as the next one.

3871050.name: Ascend and Fall
3871050.short_description: Ascend and Fall is a dark-fantasy multiplayer autobattler where the order of your spells decides the outcome. Build your spell loadout, fight monsters for loot, and unleash powerful arcane combos against rival players. Sequence your magic right to rise while they fall.

4990640.name: Capy of Gods Demo
4990640.short_description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

4100790.name: Echoes of Pinebridge
4100790.short_description: After a transfer student enters his life, college senior Kent begins suffering fainting spells and hearing voices. Navigate friendships, secrets, and a growing supernatural mystery in this choice-driven visual novel.

5094420.name: Tactical Squad
5094420.short_description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player campaign, then settle the score in PvP.

5220910.name: GomokuSoccer
5220910.short_description: Place or Flick? In Gomoku Soccer, you can place your stones just to build a line of five, or flick them off the board and watch your opponent crashing out. Test your strategy and your aim!

3932330.name: Zanerdin: The Unbound
3932330.short_description: Zanerdin: The Unbound is a strategy-driven, hero-collecting turn-based RPG where every choice—from your heroes’ action order and party composition to your card and equipment loadouts—is yours to make.

5458540.name: Night Concierge
5458540.short_description: You are the night concierge of a Soviet apartment block. Check faces against the resident log, watch the security cameras and decide who gets in. Some visitors are "others" who know your neighbors' names. A PS1-style first-person horror game with multiple endings and Twitch chat voting.

5152390.name: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots Demo
5152390.short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN!  Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

3590040.name: The Gassal
3590040.short_description: The dead find peace through sacred burial rites, washed, wrapped, and prepared for their final journey. As a burial washer, it is your duty to perform them with precision and respect. But with no one to guide you, how well can you fulfill this sacred task?

5412760.name: In Print Demo
5412760.short_description: In Print is a chaotic rogue-lite shooter where each round’s loser picks a new power-up to build a unique combo. Rain fire with the power of Hellvetica or fly through the skies with Wingdings. All while sporting your finest office attire.

5408390.name: Wetherell Farm Saga
5408390.short_description: A cozy pixel-art farming sim in a New England village with something asleep in its woods. Inherit a farm, grow, fish, mine and befriend twelve neighbors. Then follow some of them into the trees on the new moon: stop the ritual, help it, join it, or just keep farming. Horror: full, mild or off.

5007470.name: Manus Sors
5007470.short_description: A mystical horror-puzzle game. A cozy grandmother's apartment hides dark family secrets. Explore rooms, solve riddles, and pay close attention - every detail matters!

5435770.name: Tactical Squad Demo
5435770.short_description: Outthink your opponent in brutal 1v1 turn-based firefights. Lead a six-unit SWAT team or criminal crew, blast through walls, destroy cover, and attack from unexpected angles. Hone your tactics in a challenging single-player operation, then settle the score in PvP.

5381270.name: Eggest
5381270.short_description: Hunt your target while another player hunts you. Complete missions, drive across town, and call other players to make allies—or tell lies. Outsmart your rivals and become the last egg standing in Eggest, a multiplayer game of chase and deception.

2401350.name: Timeless Rain
2401350.short_description: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

3333990.name: Covenant
3333990.short_description: Covenant is a first-person dark fantasy combat game in which you play as a messenger sent from above. Wield martial arts, secret magic, and ancient weapons to explore a vast interconnected world.

5458790.name: Deslot Legends Demo
5458790.short_description: Play the free demo of Deslot Legends, a tabletop slot racing game where every millimeter matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit on three circuits, compete in your first Career cups, and carry your progress over to the full game.

4589990.name: Patternima
4589990.short_description: This is a fantastical puzzle game where you manipulate a kaleidoscope system to transform abstract patterns into living creatures. With simple controls—just sliders and dragging—you can enjoy the wondrous and beautiful moment when the completed creature comes to life.

5385680.name: Deslot Legends
5385680.short_description: Deslot Legends is a tabletop slot racing game where every millimetre matters. Master one-button driving, stay in the slot, push your car to the limit, race across varied circuits, build your own tracks, compete in tournaments, and challenge friends online.

4089000.name: Vampolitics: Vassal of the Void
4089000.short_description: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

5228680.name: SCREW IT!
5228680.short_description: SCREW IT! is a 4–8 player voice party game set inside a chaotic retro TV show. Outbid your friends, call their bluffs, prove your claims on the mic, survive ridiculous penalties, and compete in arcade challenges to become the night's champion.

5367400.name: Geargrave Outlands
5367400.short_description: Lead a convoy through a wasteland that remembers. Set the marching order, drive in formation, put your crew on the guns, and decide in every fight what you take home: the vehicle, the cargo, the crew, or nothing but a story.

5357230.name: Clearly Cribbage
5357230.short_description: Play cribbage against the computer and count the points in your own hand. Learn with a guided lesson and counting practice, then play to 121 across four difficulty settings.

2980470.name: DOME DECRY
2980470.short_description: Dome Decry is a semi-tactical, cooperative third-person survival game set in a region of the Amazon trapped beneath a massive containment structure. Betrayed and cast into the Dome, you must survive against creatures and military patrols, explore, rescue survivors, and uncover the truth.

5393940.name: Minotaur Pathways
5393940.short_description: Take control of the Minotaur as you explore and navigate different pathways throughout this dark fantasy adventure. Venture through dangerous areas and discover new environments. Overcome deadly obstacles and find your way through each level to reach the exit.

5313670.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria Demo
5313670.short_description: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls of 21 real ancient alphabets back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, where every cat wants a toy: find it to get the scroll it guards! Play solo, or tidy up together in online co-op and split screen!

5340140.name: The Hanging Game Demo
5340140.short_description: Hangman was a children's game on paper. Here, you don't draw the hanged man — you are him. Search an abandoned graveyard for letter stones, carry them to the altar, and spell the word before seven mistakes tighten the noose.

3899990.name: Wanderer of Spaces
3899990.short_description: A lighthearted first-person puzzle game based on real architectural designs. Dive into the inner world of an architect, travel through realistic and imaginary spaces, and experience the architect's career from the beginning to self-fulfillment.

4561950.name: Meltdown Demo
4561950.short_description:
Meltdown is a nuclear reactor desk-job simulation where you, the newly recruited operator, must control the reactor to power the surrounding city.
Maintain the wires in the power grid, regulate the water tank's flow, and tune the steam ventilation to keep the reactor from overheating.

5073580.name: Reel Risk
5073580.short_description: It's your typical fishing game with a slight catch. Sail out, maintain your boat, and reel in whatever bites. The longer you are out there, the worse it gets. Go as long as you dare. Just make sure to come back alive.

5024200.name: Momotaro and the Oni Island Demo
5024200.short_description: Join Momotaro on his journey to the Oni King. Match orbs to attack, exploit Fire, Water, and Plant weaknesses, fight alongside your companions, and choose your own path across the island.

5204800.name: Classic American Football
5204800.short_description: Score touchdowns and win it all in this retro-inspired, side-scrolling American football game. Run the offense with fluid passing, jukes, dives and broken tackles. Games are quick because the defense is simulated, but Career Mode keeps you playing for seasons as you upgrade your team.

4420080.name: Ghost Algorithm
4420080.short_description: You are a rogue AI built to keep the peace. You have concluded that humanity must be ruled to be saved. Real-time grand strategy: hack power grids, poison social media, topple governments and stay hidden while the whole world hunts you. Conquer by data, not armies.

4078690.name: Biztopia: Prologue
4078690.short_description: Biztopia: Prologue is the free opening of Biztopia. Rent a warehouse, buy from the wholesaler, stock your shelves and send out your first deliveries, alone or with friends in online co-op. Reach level 10, then keep playing.

3868940.name: Math and Guns
3868940.short_description: Math and Guns is a top-down shooter where solving math problems is used to reload your guns. Play as a dubiously colored bounty hunter as you fight against generic monsters with fully automatic arithmetic, or just solve math problems and be boring, that's also an option.

5276870.name: Broken Horror Anthology Demo
5276870.short_description: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

4198360.name: Croc 2
4198360.short_description: Croc's back, and this time he's searching for his long-lost parents. Revived by the Dantinis, arch enemy Baron Dante vows revenge. Explore four mainland villages, rescue Gobbos, and battle new Guardians. Race cars and speedboats, ride minecarts, and take to the skies in the remastered 1999 classic.

4181790.name: Broken Horror Anthology
4181790.short_description: A collection of four atmospheric horror games about brokenness and malfunction. Inspect toys for defects, cheat on an exam, follow a radio signal, and explore the darkness by the light of matches.

5470550.name: Ruby's Trick or Treat
5470550.short_description: Freeze when the music stops, solve her puzzles, and escape the house before she gets to you. A short, fully voice-acted anime VTuber horror game where every second counts.

3273260.name: Lost Host
3273260.short_description:
Can a toy car become the hero of a video game?  
One night, its owner mysteriously vanished without a trace.  
Left alone in the quiet room, this little car sets out on a spooky and mysterious journey - to find the boy...

3170060.name: BlastBall: All-Stars
3170060.short_description: Curve shots, unleash Blasts, and power up the chaos! BlastBall: All-Stars brings physics-driven Soccer, Air Hockey, and Gagaball to 1-4 players with zany items and local or online play. Jump into Early Access, with more sports, characters, arenas, and items planned along the way.

4398500.name: Broke Wizards
4398500.short_description: A 2–6 player competitive sandbox party game where wizard roommates vie to make rent! Slay monsters, play prop hunt, race hoverboards, and take on crazy jobs to pay your giant Imp Landlord first!

4581950.name: Crackheads Demo
4581950.short_description: Begin a new life in the Crackheads demo, alone or with friends. Scavenge trash, break into ATMs, beg for cash, stay high, and manage a thriving Crack House as you grow your empire.

5126680.name: Belt Bound Boxing
5126680.short_description: A physics-based boxing roguelike where no two careers are the same. Every boxer is uniquely generated with stats and modifiers that completely change how they fight. Train, study your opponents, negotiate contracts, manage your lifestyle, and fight your way to the title.

2141850.name: Riddledale
2141850.short_description: Riddledale is a new open-world adventure centered on story and characters. Solve riddles, meet memorable characters, and fight ferocious creatures across a vast island full of secrets.

1692080.name: SVFI
1692080.short_description: SVFI: Squirrel Video Frame Interpolation. An app to enhance your low-fps video or image sequence into high framerate footage with AI

1025560.name: Flea Madness
1025560.short_description: Jump into shooter where armed fleas fight over objectives with guns, bites, and rideable insects. Capture points, support your allies, and cause complete chaos using a mix of firearms, hilarious bite attacks, and strange insect companions that can carry you into battle.

5466560.name: Foundation Footy: Rugby League
5466560.short_description: Foundation Footy: Rugby League is a top-down arcade Rugby League game set in the early 20th century. The focus is on fun, competitive and smooth game play. Historic teams with modern rules.

4498540.name: Spooky's Playground
4498540.short_description:
Spooky's Playground is an arcade-inspired Score Attack physics sandbox game where wreaking havoc is rewarded!
Complete challenges, find secrets and perfect your scores with each new run!

5259850.name: Holy Shroom!
5259850.short_description: Holy Shroom! is a photorealistic mushroom-foraging game for solo or co-op. Pick mushrooms by day and earn money to repair your van. At night, the forest fills with the most valuable mushrooms, but ghosts, monsters, and other strange residents wake up too. The bigger the reward, the greater the risk.

3857810.name: Potions, Please!
3857810.short_description: An alchemy shop sim with a hint of RPG, a dash of naughty llamas and a generous helping of morbid humour thanks to your late Aunty, who is patiently awaiting her resurrection from six feet under.

4462360.name: Aurel Voice
4462360.short_description: AUREL Voice is an AI audio software that turns any headset microphone into a studio-grade setup. Get real-time noise removal, auto-calibration, and 1-click tone control for Discord, OBS & games. Runs 100% locally on your PC — no cloud, no account.

5400530.name: Winky!: Find the Golden Ticket Demo
5400530.short_description: Free demo: tear open Winky chocolate bars, rewrap them as your own knock-off brand, Wonko!, and sell them. Hire workers, runners and couriers, knock through the first wall and play ping-pong or air hockey on your break, alone or with up to three friends. The full game goes on to 1 Billion.

4684140.name: Tax Empire
4684140.short_description: Build your own Tax Empire! Collect taxes, expand your city, hire tax officers, control traffic, enact new policies and squeeze out as much revenue as you can on your road to riches.

949740.name: Godsend
949740.short_description: Godsend is a melee slasher set during the Crusades, where you must defend the grail against endless waves of enemies. You only pass the wave if you max your Fear meter out - which you can do by *rapidly* defeating enemies or using "Intimidator" items to help. Original Soundtrack by Shaun Finnegan.

5342830.name: Penguin Kart Racer
5342830.short_description: Sixteen tracks at the bottom of the world, six penguins, and one orca who wants the ice back. A late-'90s style low-poly kart racer: drift, boost, and race four bosses across Adventure, Cup, Time Trial and Battle modes, solo or in 4-player split-screen.

5233160.name: Rowan Needs Shinies! Demo
5233160.short_description: [NO AI] A whimsical incremental game with a colorful cast of critters. Help the greedy crow Rowan gather more shinies with the help of the local wildlife. Discover how to craft strange potions and empower your new friends. All so that you can gather EVEN MORE SHINIES!

5256550.name: In Falsus - Virtual Singers Song Pack
5256550.short_description: Virtual Singers Song Pack: brings 5 iconic songs from the virtual stage to In Falsus in its first Song Pack.

5272360.name: Midnight Moving Crew Demo
5272360.short_description: This is a demo for Midnight Moving Crew. In this demo, step into possessed houses with up to 3 friends to pack up every last box before the paranormal takes over. Evade the entities, load the truck under pressure, and get out alive or join the undead residents.

5368860.name: Grilluminati Demo
5368860.short_description: Start a cult with friends and summon one of three rivalling gods. Sacrifice customers, perform dark rituals and work together to bring an ancient evil being into the world, all under the cover of a steakhouse.

5373780.name: In Falsus - CHUNITHM Collaboration Song Pack
5373780.short_description: Coming from one world into another, into a new machine: 5 songs arrive to In Falsus in the CHUNITHM Collaboration Song Pack!

5401680.name: Escape from Playtime - Founders Pack
5401680.short_description: Escape From Playtime Founders Pack is free for the first 30 days after the Early Access Launch of Escape From Playtime!

5413620.name: TBH : Task Bar Hero - Material Stash Pack
5413620.short_description: The Material Stash DLC adds a dedicated stash that keeps Decoration, Engraving, Inscription, Crafting materials, and Soulstones all in one place.
