Materials are stored separately from your regular stash, making inventory management easier. Requires the base game, TBH : Task Bar Hero.

4999300.name: Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story Demo
4999300.short_description: Meet some of your classmates, help solve the mystery behind a broken statue, and get a sense of the overall gameplay of Ravenwood Academy: A Wizard101 Story in this short Sneak Peek Demo!

5042340.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1 Demo
5042340.short_description: "The Veil Chronicles: Nix University" is an exciting and vibrant adventure in a well-thought-out author's world, combining the genres of visual novel, RPG, and turn-based combat system.

5100710.name: Orbital Madness
5100710.short_description: Orbital Madness is an incremental action roguelite where everything revolves around orbitals. Build an arsenal of spinning weapons, create ridiculous chaos, defeat hordes of enemies and grow stronger between every run.

5122390.name: KILLSEC Demo
5122390.short_description: Breach containment and carve your way out of a megacorp black site in this hardcore top-down shooter roguelite. Master your control of physics weapons to parry swords, bullets, lasers, everything. Time moves faster when you move, but staying still won't get you anywhere.

5213500.name: The 9th Dragon Demo
5213500.short_description: Fight through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City: The 9th Dragon is a brutal narrative-driven action game with tactical combat and branching choices, where every decision shapes the fate of the city.

5464210.name: Loamward
5464210.short_description: Shape a living world one spadeful at a time. Dig, level and pave the land, fell timber, mine deep veins and smith your own tools, raise houses piece by piece and found a settlement with your neighbors. Every skill grows with use in a slow, open sandbox you share online.

4439600.name: The Rabbit Haul Demo
4439600.short_description: The Rabbit Haul is a roguelite farming and tower defense game that challenges you to grow crops, build symbiotic defenses, and protect your haul from the thieving Trash Panda Posse as you rebuild your hometown one run at a time!

4541470.name: Deadzone Rogue 2 Demo
4541470.short_description: Fight as Talon 13-10 in this FPS roguelite adventure set on a fallen Earth. Combine weapons, augments, and elements to forge devastating builds, and blast through Monarch’s endless machines. Grow stronger each run, solo or with friends.

4606310.name: VoidHue Demo
4606310.short_description: VoidHue is a top-down puzzle game that fuses classic sokoban mechanics with colorful light mechanics. Mix and match colors to phase through gates, activate light-based mechanisms and solve vibrant puzzles to bring back the color to the world.

4763690.name: Beyond Yardwork Simulator Demo
4763690.short_description: Head out on your first job and transform a neglected garden. Start up the mower, grab the blower to clear leaves from the paths, and blast the dirty driveway with a pressure washer. Tackle wild weeds, sort the remaining trash, and feel the ultimate satisfaction of perfect order.

4814420.name: Shark Mart Demo
4814420.short_description: Shark Mart is a crazy co-op simulator about sharks undercover disguised as friendly dolphins. Run the shop, and scrub whales to secretly kidnap unsuspecting fish and cook up tasty delicacies! But beware - the Fish Police are out to expose your toothy secret...

4866060.name: BERGWERK - A Mining Sim Demo
4866060.short_description: Build your own mining company in the coal region of Grubental! Construct your colliery above ground, descend into procedurally generated depths, and operate over 15 heavy machines. Master mine statics, infrastructure, complex transport networks, and sell your coal on dynamic markets.

4872940.name: SpacePorts
4872940.short_description:
Build your fleet, master the market, and carve your own path among the stars.

Start with a modest ship, earn credits by transporting valuable cargo between stations, and expand your operations into a powerful interstellar empire.

Fair warning: this is a real idler, please read: About This Game

4265210.name: Gate Guard Simulator Demo
4265210.short_description: Step into the boots of the castle guard. Inspect seals, expose smugglers and reveal witches. You decide who enters and who’s turned away. Will you uphold the law, or break it for your own gain?

4265240.name: Night At The Mall Demo
4265240.short_description: A psychological horror job sim. Complete security maintenance in a sprawling, desolate mall while surviving creeping, unpredictable threats. Manage electrical systems, monitor CCTV cameras, and survive a night shift where you never know what is lurking in the dark.

3976570.name: Guns and Nuns: Storming Hell Demo
3976570.short_description: Demons are not the danger, YOU ARE THE DANGER!!! play as Angelica Amadeus, a nun with the power of faith and guns. Slay demons at your heart's content on bizarre stages with strange gravity fields. Get highscores to unlock more stages and weapons and teach those filthy demons their place.

4036120.name: My Fairy Princess Demo
4036120.short_description: In My Fairy Princess, you raise a daughter in a vibrant world of multiple endings. Plan her life and journey beside her through a fabled realm of humans, yaoguai, and immortals. Your choices shape not only the life she leads, but the one she comes to love.

4054570.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest Demo
4054570.short_description: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

4074880.name: Pixel Survivors : Defense Demo
4074880.short_description: Pixel Survivors: Defense is a pixel roguelike defense game where you fight off endless waves of monsters. Collect skills, upgrade your heroes, combine items, and survive as long as you can!

3687820.name: Claw & Load : Mine,Shoot,Meow! Demo
3687820.short_description: In the cursed Eternal Night Continent, ancient magic clashes with firearms as you battle for survival. Serve the Tsundere Demon Cat, fend off hordes of undead horrors, and command an army of Guardian Mewlings armed with bizarre weapons. Each run is a desperate loop of mining frenzy and combat chaos！

3746300.name: PRISON OF HUSKS Demo
3746300.short_description: Awaken as a doll and seek your beloved. In this nostalgic souls-like set in a painted afterlife, explore dense, interconnected levels full of secrets and shortcuts. From parries to pistols, tune your build to overcome adversity. Battle lovelorn bosses and seek your lost love.

3429540.name: Piece by Piece Demo
3429540.short_description: Piece by Piece is a literal puzzle platformer where each level is fragmented into puzzle pieces. Clear each puzzle by connecting and unconnected each piece to make your way through each of our 13 handcrafted levels in our demo. Discover new themes and mechanics along the way!

3445640.name: The Edge Of - Definitive Edition
3445640.short_description: The Edge Of is a tense mystery NTR visual novel that will keep you on The Edge Of your seat. Play as Sam, who suspects his wife, or Beth, who couldn't possibly be cheating... or is she? Now with reworked art, animated sex scenes, voice acting for Beth, new CGs, and a longer Beth route.

2943400.name: Waltz & Jam Demo
2943400.short_description: Where shadows stretch a little too long and not every whisper in the dark belongs to a friend... Waltz and Jam is an action-adventure platformer following Waltz, a pure soul, and Jam, his lovable dog companion, through a spooky afterlife reimagined from the Seven Deadly Sins.

5451450.name: 樱华退魔录 Demo
5451450.short_description: The free demo of Ouka Exorcists: Night Parade. Play 4 exorcist girls, all 20 waves of Stage 1 with the Nine-Tails final boss, the prologue, each heroine's first episode and the shrine hub. Your progress carries over to the full version.

5282860.name: Necrolord
5282860.short_description: Command an undead army in this dark fantasy auto-battler roguelite. Raise fallen enemies, equip your troops and turn battles with powerful spells. Explore procedurally generated lands. Lose your army, reincarnate and rebuild with your retained magic and lich abilities.

1556400.name: Highpoint
1556400.short_description: HIGHPOINT is Multiplayer Sports game infused with the energy of a Brawler resulting in a uniquely physical team sport! Grab your friends and hit the court in an inviting world backdropped by a vibrant summer aesthetic and a lighthearted feel - Fight to survive, fight to score!

5317740.name: Something in the Rows
5317740.short_description: First-person survival horror in a corn maze at night. Find the eight wards hidden across Halloway Farms and carry them to the chained gate. Every ward you take lets the Harvester closer. The maze is different every run. Play alone or with up to three friends online.

1436670.name: Pumpkin Jack Soundtrack
1436670.short_description: Pumpkin Jack is a Spooky Scary 3D platformer in which you embody Jack, the Mythical Pumpkin Lord! Dive into an Epic Adventure through otherworldly landscapes and help the Evil annihilate the Good!

1279910.name: Nerf Legends
1279910.short_description: NERF Legends thrusts you into a futuristic, sci-fi world where you’ll come face-to-face with legions of robot enemies and ultimate boss masters.

3230830.name: BlastBall: All-Stars Demo
3230830.short_description: Curve shots, unleash Blasts, and power up the chaos! Try the BlastBall: All-Stars demo for physics-driven Soccer and Gagaball with 1-4 players, each sport with its standard arena. Take on bots, share the couch, or invite friends to private online matches.

5414660.name: Cloudwright Demo
5414660.short_description: Build a cozy factory in the clouds. Salvage your crashed airship, set conveyors humming across your home island, and build your first balloon. Play the opening chapter of Cloudwright solo or in online co-op, up to 8 players.

1019511.name: Far Cry New Dawn - Hurk Legacy Pack
1019511.short_description:
The Hurk Legacy Pack includes : 

- The"Hurk's Wrath" M249 skin
- The Hurk Legacy Offroad skin
- The Hurkling Outfit

5240140.name: Gunstock Buddy
5240140.short_description: Align your VR gunstock, smooth tracking jitter, and save setups for your games and weapons, all without leaving SteamVR. Supports Windows PC VR and Steam Frame, both standalone and when streaming from a PC.

4304900.name: Big Dig
4304900.short_description: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway across the Animal Republic!

2388350.name: Good Luck, Little Truck!
2388350.short_description: Good Luck, Little Truck! Is a genre-bending cozy navigation puzzler/narrative delivery sim. Set in a recovering post-collapse world where robots and humans coexist, help North Pacifica Island bounce back one delivery at a time!

3728760.name: Noor
3728760.short_description: Explore an Arabian fantasy world as Siraj, wielding a magical lantern to restore lost memories, uncover hidden paths, and awaken new powers. Master fast isometric combat, face powerful bosses, and push back the darkness.

5372520.name: Instant Song Creator
5372520.short_description: A music production studio with AI-assisted composition. Describe a song, generate music and sound effects locally on your PC with Stable Audio 3, then arrange, mix and export in a full multitrack workspace.

2374540.name: DeadRoot
2374540.short_description: DeadRoot is a barbaric medieval action-adventure set in a bug-sized world of underground dungeons and towering ruins. Splatter bug guts and slay colossal bosses as Kitt, a lone snail warrior, who must draw his sword against overwhelming odds.

1325580.name: The Mighty Eighth
1325580.short_description: The Mighty 8th VR puts you in the shoes of a B-17 Flying Fortress crew member at the height of the Strategic Bombing Campaign over Europe. Partner up with friends and do your part to ensure that the plane reaches the target and returns home safely.

5162240.name: Pit & Pat
5162240.short_description: Pit & Pat is a chaotic online aerial football game where you cast spells, steal goalposts, and occasionally score a goal. Win matches in ways that would put real footballers to shame.

3978110.name: Neuron Activation
3978110.short_description: A digital fidget box of dopamine-fueled micro-challenges. Push buttons. Shoot targets. Chain actions for higher scores. Complete all tasks. Don’t ask questions.

5391010.name: Sliz
5391010.short_description: Sliz is a brutally simple platformer: jump, climb, and don’t fall. Fight your way to the very top past slippery, unforgiving obstacles — one wrong move can send you all the way back down. How far can you get? PLAY SOLO OR WITH FRIENDS ONLINE!

3952400.name: eCommerce '99
3952400.short_description: Build a 90s online store from your garage. Pack orders by hand, set your prices, then hire staff and expand across multiple warehouses. A first-person business sim with real tycoon depth, where most shop sims end and yours keeps going.

5285650.name: Warstead
5285650.short_description: Build your base, secure vital resources, and lead your troops into battle. Warstead combines base building with tactical real-time combat. Will you invest in your economy, strengthen your defenses—or launch an attack?

5249590.name: Hex and Hearth
5249590.short_description: A cozy medieval village builder on hex tiles, where nothing can be lost. Lay tiles and watch them work together: cottages beside gardens, mills beside the wheat, roads out to the woods. Feed your families through the seasons, grow cottages into manors, and see who moves in.

5159800.name: Mutual Occult Insurance
5159800.short_description: Mutual Occult Insurance is a 1-4 player co-op psychological horror and corporate satire. You investigate insurance claims for the only insurer that covers supernatural damage, and decide whether a haunting is real, or whether someone staged it for the payout, then survive whatever the answer is.

3670210.name: Julio's Adventure 3
3670210.short_description: In this first-person horror game, sanity changes everything and can turn nights into a living nightmare. Survive at Tamixa School whilst carrying out various tasks, keeping your cool and avoiding Julio and his friends.

4955350.name: 直面天命
4955350.short_description: Face Your Fate is a pixel-art deckbuilding adventure inspired by Eastern mythology. Choose Combat Cards, combine Fate Cards and gear, chain effects, parry deadly attacks, break enemy defenses, and adapt your build across randomized routes, bosses, and ever-harder cycles.

2254810.name: AirAccel
2254810.short_description: Master momentum in this pure movement platformer. Play solo or race friends in online co-op across custom surf ramps and bhop maps. Chain perfect strafes, build terminal velocity, and hit the apex in a physics-driven sandbox where speed is everything.

4990290.name: Eyeball Alley Demo
4990290.short_description: You are an eyeball, and everything is an eyeball. Roll through trippy worlds where gravity follows every curve of the surface beneath you. Roaming eyeballs knock you off course, and the fifth hit kills you. Dig tunnels through anything.

5294110.name: Absolute Dap Demo
5294110.short_description: Dap up your friend and fight bizarre bosses together! Absolute Dap is a co-op action boss rush about two best friends trying to stop an alien invasion from ruining their friend's first date. The game is ridiculous. The friendship isn't.

5331100.name: Chicken Show Demo
5331100.short_description:
Play as chickens in a TV show for 2 to 4 players, where you must betray your friends to win!
Peck, grab, and throw your rivals to gain the upper hand throughout your adventure.
Outsmart your opponents and leave them featherless!

5475960.name: Incremental Traffic
5475960.short_description: An incremental logistics game where traffic becomes a challenge. Haul goods from fields, forests and quarries through a procedurally generated town, earn money with every delivery and buy more trucks, until your own fleet jams the streets. Then fix it with traffic rules.

4043580.name: RADZIMA
4043580.short_description: RADZIMA is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.

5405070.name: Weavercraft Demo
5405070.short_description: Step into your great-aunt's old weaving house, brave the cold, and craft your first warm layers.

4422420.name: Spirit Crossing Demo
4422420.short_description: From the makers of Cozy Grove: Glide through pastel clouds, help lost spirits along the way, and design your own home nestled high on a mountain peak. Befriend strangers around a warm campfire, or share memories while lazily fishing in the sky with a friend. Welcome to your strange new home. 🏠🏔️

5122080.name: Merge Command
5122080.short_description: Merge and launch rockets in 1v1 battles, earn resources, fund research, upgrade silos, program attacks, rank up!

5333920.name: Taw Breaker
5333920.short_description: Taw Breaker is a marble battle party game on which players fight on intense 1v1 duels while managing element types, powerups and obstacles you can place anywhere on the arena. Do you have what it takes to win in Taw Breaker?

5148840.name: Graphmat
5148840.short_description: GraphMat is a real-time material editor that combines node-based workflows with familiar layers, giving you a fast and flexible way to design and export seamless PBR textures for games and 3D projects. A capable, affordable alternative for developers and artists.

4602770.name: Tower of Genn
4602770.short_description: Tower of Genn is a puzzle-strategy building game where you construct a precarious Tower using an expansive variety of pieces. Fulfill quests, discover new interactions with special blocks, and uncover the history behind the sacred people of Genn.

1170900.name: Killbot General
1170900.short_description: Satisfying roguelite tactics packed in 5-minute battles. Controller-friendly with emphasis on tactics, not speed (low APM), no micromanagement, all in a wild and irreverent roguelite campaign for solo or co-op. Put anything you want on your flag...

4390080.name: Bottled by Bears
4390080.short_description: Join a family of bears and run the buzziest little honey farm! Collect and discover rare bees, bottle honey jars, expand your farm, and watch your flowery field bloom in this cozy idle management game.

4678570.name: Chicken Show
4678570.short_description:
Play as chickens in a TV show for 2 to 4 players, where you must betray your friends to win!
Peck, grab, and throw your rivals to gain the upper hand throughout your adventure.
Outsmart your opponents and leave them featherless!

665300.name: Stream Avatars
665300.short_description: Stream Avatars is a content creation tool for live video broadcasting that adds flair to your video to promote viewer engagement and channel growth! Viewers can also spend their hard-earned stream currency on avatar customizations.

5046430.name: My Little Secret
5046430.short_description: It seems your classmate Tia wasn't expecting company and has a secret she's keen on keeping! Collect evidence and confront Tia to reveal what she's been hiding.

4570020.name: FOURSAVENT
4570020.short_description: Two Modes, CHAOS or Story Mode. Explore different universes and time eras, from cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, each with its own story and gameplay mechanics—or jump into CHAOS Mode for fast-paced fun with friends and climb the ranks.

5421340.name: Liminaut
5421340.short_description: Liminaut is a pixel-art post-apocalyptic survival game for solo play or co-op with up to four players. Explore a spore-ravaged open world, scavenge supplies and face danger. Build a base, recruit survivors and make a home among the ruins.

4413210.name: Tachyon Flow
4413210.short_description: Run around, traverse obstacle courses, and weave through environments creatively in this third person parkour runner!

5340690.name: ハムスタイピング！
5340690.short_description: Let's type together with this cute hamster! Don't squish it, okay?☆

4397050.name: The Plunge Of Sludge
4397050.short_description: The Plunge Of Sludge is a 2D bullet hell roguelite where you collect trinkets, weapons, and hats from a pool of over 500+ items to conquer a dungeon and defeat THE KEEPER. You will fail and perish, but every attempt will be different and more chaotic than the last. Will you take the plunge?

5434470.name: Wall Over
5434470.short_description: Stack furniture, combine your powers, and toss a friend over the wall in a physics adventure for 1–4 players. Play solo or team up online as four tiny creatures on a quest to bring their village’s missing music box home.

5089620.name: Ciao Pizza: Cooking Chaos Demo
5089620.short_description: Run a chaotic pizza shop alone or with up to three friends. Make every pizza by hand, deal with impatient customers, keep the kitchen running, and race deliveries across town before everything gets cold, burnt, or completely out of control.

1701840.name: Exekiller
1701840.short_description: You’re an ExeKiller, a licensed bounty hunter tracking fugitives across the ruins of New York and extracting the S.O.U.L. biochips from their skulls. Investigate, negotiate, hack, fight, and decide how each contract ends in a first-person retro-futuristic cyber-western.

3877810.name: Crispy Billiards
3877810.short_description: A realistic 3D online billiards game where you prove your skills in thrilling 1v1 duels. Challenge friends or players from around the world, improve your technique, and become the ultimate billiards champion.

431960.name: Wallpaper Engine
431960.short_description: Use stunning live wallpapers on your desktop. Animate your own images to create new wallpapers or import videos/websites and share them on the Steam Workshop!

4182850.name: Tiebreakers
4182850.short_description: A SHONEN RUN N' GUN! Discover a heated run n' gun gameplay and challenging boss-fight tiebreaks. Shoot, Parry, and blast your way through intense encounters mastering a combat system about precision and movement. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn: push your limits, and come back stronger.

4759630.name: War Asunder
4759630.short_description:
Remember the card game War? A casual deckbuilder roguelite based on War, but adds tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades. 
Fight the multiplying creatures, cleanse the corrupted realm and confront the Warlock King to stop the Asunder spell at its source.

4110680.name: SURI: The Seventh Note
4110680.short_description: Feel the beat. SURI: The Seventh Note is a rhythm platformer where you must navigate a beautiful but treacherous world to save your mother's life. Time your jumps, dashes, and tricks to the mystical music around you, and restore not just your mother's health, but the rhythm of the island itself.

2963950.name: Persona 4 Revival
2963950.short_description:
Step into a Supernatural Turn-Based RPG Adventure 
Solve Mysteries, Strengthen Bonds, and Awaken Your Persona

4051470.name: BrokenLore: ASCEND
4051470.short_description: BrokenLore: ASCEND is a first-person psychological horror with climbing and stealth mechanics. Follow Ren and Yui, two rooftop climbers facing a cursed tower and the terrifying Rokurokubi. The higher they climb, the closer they get to madness and to the truth about themselves.

3167930.name: Mimania
3167930.short_description: A survival horror game where you have to find Mimics, who are disguised as different objects, with danger lurking around every corner.

4390430.name: MUPO Demo
4390430.short_description: Grab your keyboard and jump into the rhythm in MUPO. This fast-paced rhythm game is driven by skill, creativity, and community. Build maps, climb leaderboards, and shape the game’s future. And there’s so much more to come, stay tuned. Be part of the MUPO journey!

5361570.name: Heidentor
5361570.short_description: Fantasy PvE/PvP MMORPG build around classic player based economy and gear based progression systems

5339110.name: Wren Falls
5339110.short_description: October 1994, 2:14 a.m. A 911 call from a farmhouse on Quarry Road: a child's voice, using his mother's name. You find his parents dead and the boy silent on the stairs. Investigate by day. By night, follow him as he sleepwalks, and don't wake him.

5426780.name: Grand Reopening : Shopping Center Simulator
5426780.short_description: Bring a shopping mall back to life: open your stores, manage your inventory, and hire your staff. Play solo, team up with friends, or face off against your rivals in versus mode, where every box can turn the tide of the game!

3595710.name: ScopeCreep
3595710.short_description: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short active incremental.

4993550.name: Witch's Last Curse Demo
4993550.short_description: A dark medieval fantasy RPG of mystery and magic. As the last Apprentice of a dead Witch, you must break your Master's final curse before it destroys the town, or the town turns on you. Manage stats, coin, and NPC relationships across a handful of daily actions while fighting back the curse.

5472240.name: BINARY CRINGEVESTOR
5472240.short_description: A binary options parody with a Balatro aftertaste. Take a loan, hit UP or DOWN, and 30 seconds later you’re either rich or pawning your wife’s wedding rings. 12 broker decks, 31 passives with editions, manager Billy, collectors and four weeks of payments. Just like real life, only fun.

5209570.name: Reaper GP
5209570.short_description: Fast paced anti gravity combat racing. Choose a frame, select a loadout and race to the death.  Earn new gear from sponsors to enhance your frames.

4203970.name: Ammo Station Simulator
4203970.short_description: Manage your gun shop in Ammo Station. By day, sell and repair weapons. By night, team up with friends to rob warehouses and smuggle illegal arms. Rise from a respectable shopkeeper to the city's ultimate gun baron in this first-person simulation.

4567670.name: Chick'n Slide
4567670.short_description: An incremental arcade experience where you pull adorable chicks onto giant slides, collect resources, unlock powerful talents, and upgrade your magnet to create ever-growing, chaotic runs.

5122240.name: Aveos
5122240.short_description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

5446760.name: Zeitnot Demo
5446760.short_description: Chess you already know, rules you don't. Pieces have HP and gear. Shop between fights, stack gambits, roll the dice if you're feeling stupid. Lose the trial, lose the run.

5213720.name: Trust Me, I Work Here Playtest

3730190.name: It Happened At Night - A New Nightmare
3730190.short_description: While working at a remote site deep in the woods, Chloe becomes entangled in a disturbing mystery that leads her into something far more terrifying than she could have imagined.

4124940.name: Shadow Sacrament: The Roots of Evil Playtest

5462020.name: Movimento
5462020.short_description: Teo lives in a world where stopping is forbidden — whoever stops gets collected. Cross a city that never sleeps, face the twelve collectors in fights that turn into music, and learn that the hardest thing in this world is to stand still.

4528310.name: Mimania Demo
4528310.short_description: A survival horror game where you have to find Mimics, who are disguised as different objects, with danger lurking around every corner.

5438840.name: Yollen 2
5438840.short_description: Automate your grind. Make your character run through the chain of nodes you programmed while leveling up, all the way to defeat Yollen on the Red Mountains.

2542310.name: Fatal Run 2089
2542310.short_description: Atari’s Fatal Run 2089 delivers over-the-top driving action across a post-apocalyptic landscape. You’ll have to race against a countdown clock at incredibly high-speeds and destroy enemy vehicles by any means necessary. Fail to complete your missions and you put humanity in jeopardy.

4293670.name: QuadMerge
4293670.short_description: Think from all four sides. Quad-Merge is a dynamic puzzle game where you launch numbered blocks from the edges of the grid to combine them, build massive combos, and clear the board. Strategize your angles, unlock powerful boosters, and survive an ever-escalating challenge!

5222480.name: Wonder Glider
5222480.short_description: A paraglider roguelite on a summer coast where the clouds don't always stay clouds. Every trial ends at nightfall, and there's no flying around it. Choose what you carry, change it at every Shrine, and keep something for the dark. How far will it carry you?

3186260.name: AstroTanto
3186260.short_description: You were promised a hero’s journey. You got a vacuum cleaner. Team up with 3 friends in this chaotic, physics-based co-op game. Build your space station out of "recycled" trash, dodge orbital debris, and try not to burn up in the atmosphere. In space, no one can hear you clean.

5381170.name: False Oath Demo
5381170.short_description: False Oath is a retro-style survival horror game set in a medieval era. A deadly plague spreads across the kingdom. Search for a cure before it’s too late.

5466880.name: Punch Your Way Out Demo
5466880.short_description: A free taste of Punch Your Way Out, the first person digging game for 1 to 4 players. Punch through the first 10 metres or so, vacuum the rubble, sell it and buy your first upgrade. Your run carries over into the full game.

5367450.name: PRE-ECHO
5367450.short_description: A co-op horror mystery. August 1994: in the small town of Greyford, an old radio picks up events before they happen. Explore by day, survive the Resonance Storm by night and change what is coming, alone or with up to three friends.

5352470.name: Corgi Race Live
5352470.short_description: Bring the greatest sport in the world to your Twitch stream with Corgi Race Live! Stream corgi races and have your chat compete with you; picking winners, exactas and trifectas with hopes of topping the leaderboard. Take on the mantle of corgi racing host and bring everyone to the party.

3885770.name: Darkphobia
3885770.short_description: Turn off the lights. Reach the bed. Stay alive. Play through three intertwining nightmares where light is your only lifeline. Don't stay in the dark too long, or "It" will find you.

2195490.name: The Great Sassanelli
2195490.short_description: A war of unseen ferocity is ravaging the continent. You, ringmaster dilettante, must keep the circus afloat. Travel, entertain, and keep the troupe’s spirits up while trying to find a mythical safe haven to last out the storm in this beautifully illustrated, text-based narrative adventure.

4610850.name: Gorilla Tag Contagion
4610850.short_description: Join your fellow Monke to smash, climb, and roll your way through hordes of enemies!  Unlock new characters, powerful weapons, endless gadgets, and crazy parkour skills as you fight twisted monstrosities with your unique build. Team up with other Monke in coop and outlast the outbreak, together!

2399940.name: Atomic Picnic: Prologue
2399940.short_description: A 4-Player co-op shooter roguelite! Get together with up to 4 friends, defeat hordes of monsters, and upgrade your powers to survive in an anime-style wasteland.

2155070.name: Fate/EXTRA Record
2155070.short_description: Fate/EXTRA Record is the chronicle of a war fought by modern magi who stake their existence on the bonds they form and the wishes they hold. This emotional story unfolds with a sleek, reimagined art style and a new strategic battle system. The first true RPG in the Fate series is reborn!

4634930.name: Cow Online World
4634930.short_description: Design your own animal self and meet other creatures in this colourful MMO! Graze with your friends and level skills like Basket Weaving, Trivia, Kindness, and more in a world that humans have left behind.

5415190.name: Collec
5415190.short_description: Open packs and collect a world of wildlife, dinosaurs, distant stars and curiosities. Admire your cards, trade with friends and build a team for five-card duels. A free game with one collection shared between the web and Steam.

3890650.name: Reign of Victory
3890650.short_description: Build and trade, fight and conquer or raid and steal in this multiplayer open-world RPG where you can choose your own adventure by taking part as a villager, knight or outlaw!

4302890.name: General Practice Demo
4302890.short_description: Scrub in for 6 levels in General Practice, a wacky co-op adventure where the deadlines are tight and the treatments are… questionable. Diagnose, (mis)treat, master multiple contraptions, enjoy the tomfoolery and wreak no harm! Play solo or with up to 4 friends, locally or online.

5465020.name: One More Shake Demo
5465020.short_description: Shake vending machines, collect cans, earn money and scrap, buy upgrades and automate your progress in this colorful incremental idle game. Keep improving your setup and make every shake count.

4291640.name: Sexy Santa Girls 2
4291640.short_description: Sexy Santa Girls 2 is a festive find-the-differences game with beautiful girls and cozy Christmas vibes. Carefully compare two similar images and spot hidden details in outfits, poses, decorations, and backgrounds at a relaxed, enjoyable pace.

4928450.name: Grand Theft Timeline
4928450.short_description: 1-4+ players time-travel kidnapping-collection dungeon-crawling heist with physics, guns, bosses, arena, homebase, skins, and stocks! Kidnap people across 200+ worlds of history & fiction, haul them home in cages and farm paradox in your garage. 25+ theme packs, 2,000+ NPCs and Workshop mods!

5335860.name: Onions are Life
5335860.short_description: The greatest onion game you'll ever play! Plant onions, grow onions, harvest onions, love onions, become onions, in this incremental onion-farming sim!

4144570.name: Flecto Demo
4144570.short_description: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

1709540.name: Kill King
1709540.short_description: Chess meets auto-battler. Plan your orders in secret, then watch both armies execute them at once. Predict where the enemy will step, strike that square first and land a God of War — an instant kill, even on the King. More possible matches than chess and Go combined.

5011340.name: Escape the Flood! Demo
5011340.short_description: A first person survival crafting game for 1 to 10 players. The sea keeps rising and the island is going under. Gather what you can, craft a boat and get everyone aboard before the last hill floods. Or sail without them.

5456380.name: Alchemy Workshop
5456380.short_description: Process ingredients, mix them, and infuse mana to create unique potions. Master the balance of these three principles, fulfill requests from customers and adventurers, and grow your tiny alchemy shop into the finest workshop in the kingdom.

4143420.name: Flecto
4143420.short_description: Flecto is a puzzle game where you place blocks in order to deflect bullets and shatter targets. Strategically use your tiles to split bullets, bounce them around each level, and destroy every target.

2017940.name: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
2017940.short_description: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

4500750.name: Orbit Core
4500750.short_description: Roguelite bullet heaven with mechs: mow down countless robots until you're unstoppable. Absorb their energy, level up, stack modules, unlock items, and combine them into game-breaking builds. And all with an entire planet as your battlefield!

4603250.name: One Dumb Wizard
4603250.short_description: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Craft new wands, find powerful charms, and strategically cast spells in your singular mission to GET YOUR MONEY BACK.

5322460.name: AudioCat
5322460.short_description:
AudioCat makes it easy to mix your microphone, soundboard clips, and selected app audio into one virtual input. Share
  music, videos, and sound effects through Discord, OBS, games, calls, and more—with simple controls for every source.

3292570.name: The Shattered Demo
3292570.short_description: The Shattered is a fantasy roguelite dungeon crawler, where you decide the powers of your opponents. Overcome randomly generated challenges, create a unique set of skills, and uncover the mystery of your true identity.

2691530.name: RAILRIDERS
2691530.short_description: RAILRIDERS is a fast-paced 1-4 player co-op shooter where you ride a moving train into a dieselpunk frontier overrun by hordes of cryptids. Jump off to complete dangerous contracts, survive relentless enemies, and fight your way back aboard with your crew.

4923490.name: Warden Campaigns
4923490.short_description: Build the world. Run the table. Let it react. Warden Campaigns is an all-in-one VTT where Game Masters create campaigns, build reactive encounters, automate consequences, and host their party through Steam.

3084630.name: Program Penguin
3084630.short_description: Program Penguin is a humorous, tightly paced action-adventure game with an unforgettable cast. Think classic Zelda meets Club Penguin all rolled up in a classic retro style.

4682170.name: Abyssal Merge Demo
4682170.short_description: Abyssal Merge is a chaotic bullet heaven roguelite where multitasking is your only hope of survival. As a lone captain in a monster-infested ocean, you must fight off waves of enemies while simultaneously catching and merging the fish in your net to unlock game-breaking weapon synergies.

3142820.name: Lo-Res Shaders: The Game
3142820.short_description: A single player graphics-coding puzzle game for creative coders and coding creatives. Built for people who like their graphics coding low level and retro styled.

5090660.name: Architecture & Design Demo
5090660.short_description: Try the Demo: draw a floor plan, raise walls, place doors and windows, then furnish and paint every surface on a beach lot, with a selection from the furniture catalogue. Everything uses real measurements and is fully parametric. The full game adds many more functions, objects and much more to come!

4024950.name: Space Arcade
4024950.short_description: A 3D arcade space shooter where you defend your base against endless waves of enemy ships. Earn credits, buy upgrades and perks between waves and fight Boss Waves a every few waves. Play alone, in split screen with up to 4 players on one PC, or online with friends.

5289270.name: Where the Hell Is My Game? Demo
5289270.short_description: Explore one trash pile, find rare items and collectible cards, and sell your finds to buy upgrades that make collecting easier. The full game offers more piles to explore in your search for the lost game cartridge.

3991390.name: A Kingdom of Soil
3991390.short_description: Return to a medieval borderland. Rebuild from a hoe, forge, hunt, and reclaim your tavern amid faction conflicts. Words sway deals, cooking wins hearts, choices shape your legacy. Live your legend in an open world.

4977510.name: Drone Tanks
4977510.short_description: Battle through high-energy 3D arenas, forge powerful upgrade synergies, and master fast-paced combat in a roguelite built for endless replayability. Pilot a flying tank, bonk enemies with a massive hammer, and take on bosses whose attacks are orchestrated by the soundtrack itself.

4652930.name: Knuckle Creek
4652930.short_description: Knuckle Creek is a slapstick comedy brawler designed for friends, fun and light-hearted play sessions.

3100720.name: Squares of Hell Demo
3100720.short_description: Hell is divided into squares for sinners. For each sin there is a separate square. Bad smoker square - smoker is tempted by unavailable cigarettes. Bad Driver Square - The driver is always pushing the car uphill. Those who make a lot of noise jump up and down on a large subwoofer.

5461050.name: Skull Siege
5461050.short_description: 1 knight, 30,000 skeletons. Build a tiny kingdom by day: drop gold coins into houses, towers and traps. By night a river of bones pours through the gap. Ride into it with your lance, charge through hundreds at once and hold the keep until the sun burns the rest to dust.

5172870.name: Bomb Them Ores
5172870.short_description: Bomb Them Ores is a short arcade incremental mining game. Explode caves, collect minerals and unlock upgrades to delve deeper!

3372990.name: The Backrooms: Liminalphobia
3372990.short_description: Liminalphobia is a 1-4 player online co-op horror game set in The Backrooms. A man named James is lost, leaving behind notes as the only guide to finding him. Explore the liminal levels, manage your resources, solve puzzles and avoid the entities throughout the levels.

5465470.name: Court Vision Demo
5465470.short_description: Run a basketball franchise from the front office. Draft and develop players, negotiate contracts, make trades, and manage lineups. Every decision determines your legacy.

5254790.name: Where the Hell Is My Game?
5254790.short_description: Dig through piles of trash to find your lost game cartridge. Collect trash, discover rare items and collectible cards, sell valuables, and buy upgrades to make every search faster and easier. Each new trash pile costs money, so spend wisely and keep digging.

5389260.name: My Fart Adventure
5389260.short_description: My Fart Adventure — Cursed by a bad taco, you're now doomed to fart in public. The subtle art of cutting the cheese without getting busted: blend into the crowd, escape the DGREI Agents. Solo or up to 30 players online.

5381570.name: Scrapmiles
5381570.short_description: Explore an autumn valley in an old pickup. Collect and haul scrap, take jobs and secure your cargo. Spend your earnings on repairs, restoration and truck upgrades in an open-world driving and salvage simulator with changing weather and a day-and-night cycle.

5415250.name: The Impossible Dice Game
5415250.short_description: 10 dice, each with a lower chance of success. Can you beat the odds, or will you roll enough to shift them to your favor?

3952670.name: 하숙생이 전부 미녀입니다만? 시즌2 Demo
3952670.short_description:
Boarding house owner Yuman is back!
Mal-sook, Gran, and Min-jung return—joined by three new residents: a wealthy heiress, a girl haunted by childhood scars, and a gentle nurse with a healing heart.
In a house where past memories and fresh feelings intertwine… who will steal your heart?

4435490.name: Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 - Campaign
4435490.short_description: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.

4554330.name: Escape from Vlogger: Runaway
4554330.short_description: You broke into the house of a popular blogger to uncover all his secrets, but it’s not that simple! He locks you inside, and now you must do everything you can to escape. Hide, solve puzzle quests, and make your way out in this horror escape adventure!

5022430.name: Vanguard Fusion
5022430.short_description: Merge three units into one and hold the line in a pixel-art auto-battler with tower defense. The Fusion Heart is shattered, and every creature in Eldvar has broken into furious shards. 24 heroes, 5 biomes, Endless mode and a brutal Boss Rush.

5072600.name: Family Time
5072600.short_description: Build a family of thousands of wolf children with your own wolf partner!

5169780.name: Kill All Clankers
5169780.short_description: Kill All Clankers is a fast paced 2D Platformer Rogue-lite with Bullet Heaven and Twin Stick Shooter mechanics. You play as agents of the Prohuman Revolutionary Movement. ​​​Your objective is to survive multiple levels for 30 minutes and free humanity from a tyrannical AI surveillance state.

5319100.name: Closed Case
5319100.short_description: Team up with a friend and help Marcus and Cloe escape in this co-op point-and-click puzzle game! In Closed Case, you and your partner must solve a variety of riddles to escape the mysterious house while uncovering the identity of its enigmatic owner.

5425440.name: No Good Friends
5425440.short_description: “It's a Blade.” Is it? Pass a face-down card across the felt, name it and look your friends in the eye. Every card ends in a verdict for someone. Collect the wrong ones and the table executes you: poison, a knife or the rope. No good friends here. 2–6 players, voice chat.

5428380.name: Mamka Said
5428380.short_description: Dru returns for her childhood belongings. Mamka wants a thank-you. A child knows things Dru can't remember... and the room keeps making her smaller. A short psychological horror visual novel about gratitude, uncertain memory, and the right to leave.

5462500.name: Room on Earth
5462500.short_description: A room. Probably on Earth. Somehow, it is always night, with no bearings beyond the window. Room on Earth is a 3D sandbox for building, decorating and collecting. Arrange your space, gather things you love, and make a corner into an animated wallpaper. Outside can wait.

5470000.name: Starwinder
5470000.short_description: A vertical-scrolling shoot-em-up. Each run takes you through 7 of 14 worlds, every stage ends with a mini boss with its own signature move, and a multi-part final boss waits at the end. Local co-op, Remote Play Together, Daily Challenge and Boss Rush.

5479930.name: PixelPup Town
5479930.short_description: A pixel-art desktop pet game with a little canine companion. Spend time with your pup while you work or unwind, train skills, and choose food, toys and furniture to make a cozy corner of your desktop your own.

5483960.name: One Tank Trip
5483960.short_description: Team up as three soldiers forgotten in the evacuation on their journey home by tank!

4087510.name: North Pole Defense
4087510.short_description: A blood-soaked horde shooter in a fully destructible voxel North Pole. Grab your guns, call in sleigh strikes and dig through the walls as you and up to three friends defend Christmas against endless waves of undead elves, Krampus, and worse.

4498970.name: Winterover
4498970.short_description: A cinematic narrative where you are astronaut NATALIE RAMIREZ. Face time-critical & emotional decisions leading a breakthrough discovery on Mars, while your family is in crisis on Earth. Explore freely, shape relationships through branching dialogue, and face a choice that will define your future.

4907070.name: STARE
4907070.short_description: You are alone in an unfamiliar place that grows increasingly restless with your every step. Find and break all the seals before you draw too much attention...

5148810.name: Doomed Village
5148810.short_description: Rule a village caught in the shadow of war. You cannot fight or stop it. Choose which problems to face, endure the consequences of what you neglect and shape the remains of your village when the end finally arrives.

5490060.name: Tiny Pet Salon
5490060.short_description: A small first-person pet grooming game. Muddy pets line up outside your salon. Wash them, dry them, brush them, clip their nails and pick out a bow or a party hat. Hand them back and they rate your work. You can even keep the salon open in a corner of your screen while you do other things.

2251310.name: CtrlC
2251310.short_description: CtrlC is an arcade game with the look of the 80s and the technology of today. You have to reach your goal, level by level. The coders among you know: Ctrl+C cancels a running program in the terminal. You might need that info sometime.

2355460.name: MicroWorks - Party Pass
2355460.short_description: The ultimate MicroWorks experience in a single package. Unlock exclusive customization options, new gamemodes, mutators, private hosting and more!

4067370.name: Prospice: Anomalous Logistics
4067370.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

5158740.name: Barn Rush
5158740.short_description: Grab food, haul it home, beat the clock. A colorful pixel time-attack roguelite on your own silly farm: draft upgrades until one little sheep has a tornado, a tractor and a snail on the payroll. Every run gets absurdly strong your way. Earn Feed to unlock new animals, themes, and cosmetics.

5171890.name: Per My Last Email
5171890.short_description: A 16-bit beat 'em up about the day one employee finally snaps. Brawl through every department of a dysfunctional corporation, one coworker at a time, until you reach the CEO.

5181050.name: Head Miner
5181050.short_description: Head Miner is an idle mining game where your character spins and crashes into walls to move forward. Break rocks, collect valuable ore, and spend your earnings on character upgrades. Spin, smash, mine, and grow stronger!

5202060.name: Brokeline
5202060.short_description: One new message. There goes your quiet evening. Chat, flirt, choose your replies and collect character photos in Brokeline, a story-driven messenger game. Meet the people behind the profiles while juggling work, money and plans beyond the screen.

5295050.name: Musdart
5295050.short_description: Young gnome, your mission will be to recover the crown of the champion of Musdart in this hand-carved wooden adventure. Avenge your father and reconnect with him by learning his language, the language of the ancient gnomes.

5426860.name: Elf World Adventure 14
5426860.short_description: Elf World Adventure 14 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.

5436180.name: Sloppy Warfare
5436180.short_description: A loud, dumb, fast shooter. Troops raid an island full of shady old billionaires, blow up their temple and haul them to a prison boat in their bathrobes. Buy your guns, buy your strikes, call in a pufferfish. The lead mode is Capture the Pedo. Fictional rich guys, all adults, all satire.

5440820.name: Scary Hot Dogs
5440820.short_description: Scary Hot Dogs is a horror game where you run a small hot dog stand, prepare orders, and serve creepy customers. Complete tasks, earn money, and survive terrifying night shifts filled with strange encounters, unexpected scares, and mysterious events. Not every customer is here for a hot dog...

5481550.name: Circuits: VLSI
5481550.short_description: Draw the layers of a silicon chip to build working circuits. Solve 100 puzzles, from wires and transistors to logic, memory, and small clocked machines. Inspect simulated signals, compare your layouts, and experiment freely in Sandbox.

5483980.name: Pizza Empire - Supporter Pack
5483980.short_description: Love Pizza Empire? This pack supports the dev and helps fund the next games by Bando Corp. Get 4 exclusive golden skins (cursor, pizza, rider and plane) plus a Supporter badge next to your name on the leaderboard. Cosmetic only.

3259780.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE
3259780.short_description: Return to the pixel‑art world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

3456900.name: Mega Million Fish
3456900.short_description: Cast your line, kick back and watch the fish roll in! Mega Million Fish is a cozy multiplayer idle-fishing game. Fish across many areas, unbox rods with wild auras, enhance your favourite rod to +50 and trade with anglers on a live player market.

4449080.name: Bloodfell
4449080.short_description: Tear through Hell with devastating weapon and spell builds in this gothic action roguelite. Hunt powerful loot across five procedural biomes, risk another floor, and rebuild Ashenhold for your next descent.

4622740.name: Futanatural
4622740.short_description: "Futanatural" is a side-scrolling puzzle escape game set in an abandoned hotel. Rookie reporter Mia Kirimura gets trapped in an abandoned hotel she's covering and must solve riddles to escape. By exploring the abandoned hotel and solving riddles, you can advance to new areas.

4915700.name: Ebbtide
4915700.short_description: Ebbtide is a zombie survival strategy game. Lead the last carrier task force through a world overrun by the dead, starting in Los Angeles: direct your forces on a real-time operations map, then zoom straight into the 3D pixel-art battlefield to command the fight or take direct control.

5027980.name: Dunya Arena
5027980.short_description: Lead a hero and an army in a King of the Hill arena RTS! Select your hero, commit to a Faction and playstyle, and purchase powerful items and upgrades by slaying your enemies. Fight for the Favor of the Gods at the heart of the Arena and raze your enemy’s Halls to win!

5168600.name: Alien Entity Hal-09
5168600.short_description: Explore a perilous, submerged facility and recover essential supplies that have been abandoned.

5314460.name: 이직
5314460.short_description: Fight for a better job in this pixel-art action roguelite. Wield four office weapons, combine Specs, and train after hours. Start at a tiny startup and climb toward bigger companies, where familiar coworkers and office machines reveal monstrous forms.

5393460.name: knock Time
5393460.short_description: Knock Time is a beat 'em up originally for the Game Boy Advance in which you play as a boxer on a mission through the chaotic streets of Venezuela to rescue your journalist brother, who was kidnapped by a network of corrupt police officers following a protest.

5469940.name: Pawn Shop Together
5469940.short_description: Uncle Sal left you the keys to his pawn shop on Avenue A. Haggle with sellers, spot the fakes, hand out pawn loans and flip the deals of the week. Run the counter solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op.

5471760.name: Museum Keepers
5471760.short_description: Museum Keepers blends museum management, roguelite deckbuilding and tower defense. Curate exhibits and welcome visitors by day. After dark, your collection awakens. Play tactical cards to defend the blue crystal. Spend your gold wisely: growth or survival?

5481990.name: RESTAURANTS A Culinary Adventure Pinball
5481990.short_description: Travel the world one shot at a time! Blast through ramps, spinners, bumpers and drop targets, trigger kickbacks, and unleash chaotic multiball across wildly themed restaurants from seaside shacks to haunted halls, jungle cafés and galactic diners.

4813430.name: Abyssal Elevator: Idle Breaker
4813430.short_description: An idle breaker where you can't miss. Buy and upgrade orbs. Smash skeletons. Go deeper. The orbs bounce on their own: no aiming required, and no way to lose. Click if you want to help — or don't.

5088420.name: Under the Rust
5088420.short_description: Keep an underground shelter alive after the collapse. Manage water, power and food, assign your crew, and venture into a dangerous world above. Face desperate visitors, unexpected crises and decisions with lasting consequences in this post-apocalyptic survival management game.

5327910.name: Cyber Maze
5327910.short_description: A retro-futuristic 3D maze game with traps and enemies

5384910.name: I SUCK DICKS AND HATE AI - BLACK DICK
5384910.short_description: Black Dick in the Collection — Based!

5447160.name: Wonder Garden - Supporter Pack
5447160.short_description: Support Wonder Garden and grow your desktop garden with Monstera, Dracaena and a bee house. Includes one seed of each plant and one bee house per profile, plus access to buy more of these seeds with in-game coins. Requires the base game.

5479600.name: Black Death: Russia
5479600.short_description: Take control of Russia's response to a deadly epidemic. Manage hospitals, medical personnel, public finances, quarantines and transport restrictions. Balance public trust against the need to contain the outbreak in this challenging strategy simulation.

5486690.name: Val Fortuna
5486690.short_description:
A tactical roguelite deckbuilder played on a checkerboard, set in the world of casinos.
You are the Gambler. Tonight, you’re playing for your life.
Read your opponent’s moves, go for the one combo too many, and go all in when everything falls apart.
What happens in Val Fortuna stays in Val Fortuna.

1975300.name: War: Weaponary and Resources
1975300.short_description: A top-down RTS for you and your friends, with armies in the thousands. Dig through rock, wall off chokepoints and hide bombs, then throw everything at your rivals' HQ. Every match is a new cave map. Online multiplayer only for now; AI opponents are planned.

4771220.name: Joker Madness: Supporter's Breathtaking Pack
4771220.short_description: A luxurious and absolutely elite update for those who want to support the developer with something extra (or just love gold)

5099910.name: Mist Seekers
5099910.short_description: Venture into a forbidden zone shrouded in mist. Jump, wall-climb and dash, scavenge loot, and reach extraction before you fall. The fuller your pack, the more you stand to lose: push deeper, or extract now? Your haul makes the squad stronger, and rescued allies open paths you couldn't reach before.

5230770.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm!
5230770.short_description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

5232590.name: Les Petites Rives
5232590.short_description: Fish with friends on a peaceful little island, up to 16 players in online co-op. Cast from the dock or the boat, hold your catch up high, swim, dance, break out the ukulele… and watch out for the weird fish. Some of them wear sneakers.

5281870.name: Tailgun
5281870.short_description: A minimalist snake-survivor roguelite. Steer through enemy swarms, build your arsenal with weapons and upgrades, and unlock new content with every run.

5384930.name: I SUCK DICKS AND HATE AI - DICK IN A HAT
5384930.short_description: Dick in a Little Hat — Hit of the Season!

5414840.name: Survivors' Hotel
5414840.short_description: Survivors' Hotel is a zombie apocalypse themed social deduction game inspired by Among us that uses 3D and 2D art that can host a minimum of 6 players. It also has multiple horror elements and possibly a story for those who care to look.

5434130.name: Last Pirates: Die Together - Supporter Pack
5434130.short_description: Four horror legends wash up on deck. Dress your pirate as the Flying Dutchman, Cthulhu, the Tall Vampire Lady or the Rotten Rabbit and pick from nine eye styles – pure cosmetics, zero advantage, maximum respect from your crew. Every purchase supports the small team behind Last Pirates.

5444870.name: LiarGame : Canvas
5444870.short_description:
Spot the liar in this online drawing party game for 3–8 players!
Draw clues if you know the secret word, or bluff with your drawings if you're the liar.
Decide who to trust amid suspicious sketches and convincing excuses.
Customize your character and enjoy hilarious mind games with friends!

5454090.name: Alice: Defense
5454090.short_description: Alice: Defense is a strategic roguelike defense game. Recruit heroes with gold, form a team, and hold back waves of monsters. Uncover why the World Tree has changed in Story Mode, then push your limits in Infinity Mode with Relics, Augments, and Abyss Contracts.

5481430.name: Growing Rogue
5481430.short_description:
Growing Rogue is a nature strategy roguelike game where you play as different plants trying to survive various environments.
Balance sugar, nutrient, and water use to help you grow. Withstand the elements, observe upcoming climates, and defend against pests to set your seeds before the first frost!

3259820.name: Alice's World Demo
3259820.short_description: Alice's World is a story-driven 2D adventure puzzle game. Amidst desolate ruins and deserted cities in a world filled with death, the young girl Alice hears "your" voice from in front of the screen. You must guide her forward, solve the mysteries, and reach the top of the tower.

3958670.name: Deck of Dynasties
3958670.short_description: Deck of Dynasties is a turn-based card battler where nine civilizations send their greatest figures into battle. Build a 45-card deck from 333 heroes, deploy to the front, and spend Action Points to attack and capture slots. Kill the enemy leader to win - match online or duel a friend on Steam.

4231860.name: Might & Mushroom
4231860.short_description: Draft your own shop in this deckbuilding roguelike auto battler! Summon fungal versions of legendary heroes, and take control of your fate with a unique shop building system and innovative synergy mechanics! Revolution is brewing, let's turn that evil dragon into mushroom soup!

4647070.name: Cubic Mage
4647070.short_description: An open-ended voxel RPG of elemental magic. Train, explore, craft, and fight alone or with friends to save a world collapsing into the Void.

5095390.name: Autopelago
5095390.short_description: Autopelago is a game where you automate gathering and crafting to explore the floating islands you find yourself stuck on. Call upon the islands’ friendly wisps to help restore the ancient technology that will carry you home.

5186030.name: SLAM TANK
5186030.short_description: Swing your cannon barrel and ram straight through an AI’s machine army. A stylish single-player tank action game where the more you wreck, the more the AI pays.

5199120.name: 解呈尋
5199120.short_description: A seven-day university psychological romance visual novel. Make dialogue choices and play Minesweeper while events elsewhere unfold, whether you witness them or not.

5279320.name: Taco Truck Simulator
5279320.short_description: You will run your own food truck: take orders, cook fresh ingredients, and quickly assemble delicious tacos while hungry customers wait in line. But running a food truck is about more than speed: source supplies wisely, maintain steady cash flow, and win over diners with every satisfying bite

5394760.name: Black Zero
5394760.short_description: Fight rebels, mercenaries and the infected all at once in this top-down co-op shooter for 1–4 players. Play on the couch or online, and stop a weapon with no cure before anyone can use it.

5422500.name: Who Howls?
5422500.short_description: Werewolf in a walkable, snowbound 3D village. By day, search for tracks and whisper behind the barn. At dusk, accuse and vote by the campfire. At night, the wolves creep from house to house. Online with 4–16 friends and proximity voice chat.

5425740.name: New Hope
5425740.short_description: Post-apocalyptic colony survival where you give the orders and then hold the wall yourself. Build a fortified base, send squads on risky expeditions for supplies, and fight beside your settlers in third person when zombies and mutants come for the gates.

5491190.name: 1Million Tiles
5491190.short_description: A tiny tile workshop that lives above your taskbar. Build belts and machines that press, saw, glaze and inlay ceramic tiles, then fire them in the Kiln. Hover to check in. Get back to work and it keeps firing.

4129970.name: Late Night Chats
4129970.short_description: In this game you play through a series of late night conversations within a dysfunctional friend group, while the narrator awkwardly judges every decision you make. It’s intense, suffocating, and a little unhinged. "I need to go back, I need to change my choices." - My Mom

4316370.name: Woke Busters: The Identity Affirmer
4316370.short_description: Woke Busters costs $6.99. In its binary soul it identifies as a $69.99 AAAA+ masterpiece. This DLC is its transition. Ash gets rich on crypto: a yellow Lambo instead of Chad's scooter, an optional Bitcoin cap, new lines, a certificate and a badge. Gameplay: unchanged. Morally: upgraded.

4443690.name: Cornerwitch
4443690.short_description: Cornerwitch is a cozy idler game that sits on the corner of your screen. Study new spells and advance through a magical journey. Unlock cosmetics to dress up your little witch, level up and become stronger.

4627310.name: Konvoy-X
4627310.short_description: Co-op for up to 4 players. Drive through a dark and mysterious island filled with mutations created by Mycel Corp, navigate using your vehicle’s analog controls, search for the lost complex, and recover the forgotten cargo to sell it and upgrade your gear.

5164060.name: Servo The Wildguard
5164060.short_description: A Lock On Shooter Roguelike. Defeat Enemies, collect loot, upgrade your woodland village and make new friends!

5191820.name: Female Forge
5191820.short_description: Create your own female character and customize her your way. Mix and match outfits, hairstyles, accessories, colors, body shapes, and much more to create a wide variety of unique characters.

5278380.name: The Millionth Ticket
5278380.short_description: The Millionth Ticket is a lottery simulator: Buy tickets, pick numbers and watch live draws on TV. Manage your money and pay rent so your asshole landlord won't kick you out. Hit the jackpot and escape your shitty life to spend your days drinking and watching TV.

5335340.name: The Last Ledger
5335340.short_description: The Last Ledger is a pawnshop management game that begins in war-torn Republican-era China. Examine antiques, spot fakes, bargain with customers, and profit from shifting markets. Check the newspaper for stolen goods, beware of suspicious items, and decide when to leave as war approaches.

5438620.name: 标记朋友
5438620.short_description: MarkFriends is a free Windows desktop tool. Send question marks, cheers and sound emotes to friends with hotkeys or wheels. Join Steam rooms for up to 8 people, choose random or mouse-position placement, and use the interface in 14 languages.

5460160.name: Hhoarde
5460160.short_description: Hhoarde is a multiplayer tower defense game about dragons, their hoards, and the goblins who do all the work. Build your maze, buy dubious relics from the scheming Skimworths, send hires at rival caves, and keep the Guild's endless adventurers off your gold.

4018120.name: Element TD 3
4018120.short_description: Element TD 3 takes the tradition of combining powerful elements for unique towers and adds heroes. Infinitely replayable and endless, this is a Tower Defense that blends classic gameplay with modern additions. Play with up to 8 players cooperatively or competitively.

4582120.name: Starward Iron
4582120.short_description: Hold Fort Resolute against alien assaults, or defend NORA's 15-minute code download inside the Cincture. A military sci-fi survival FPS with two AI squadmates, physical weapon racks, tactical movement and escalating enemy pressure.

1042220.name: Arma 3 Creator DLC: Global Mobilization - Cold War Germany
1042220.short_description: The Cold War hits 1980s northern Germany. Fight on an all-new 419 km2 terrain with 83 new vehicles, 39 new weapons, and a ton of additional character assets. Play a 10-mission singleplayer campaign, or choose from 18 multiplayer scenarios available in both summer and snowy winter conditions.

2443900.name: A Simple Expurriment
2443900.short_description: Exploration with puzzles, stealth and kittens with superfeline abilities. Help a cat mom rescue her abducted children by doing typical, not-so-typical and definitely atypical cat things: run walls up and down, turn to liquid and rearrange parts of the alien ship like pieces of a puzzle.

2846770.name: Stop The F
2846770.short_description:
Stop The F is a first-person puzzle.
Use the camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back. 
Use various filters that expand the camera's abilities.

3405080.name: Smile Thief
3405080.short_description: Join Eva, a young apprentice minstrel, on her mission to save her village’s joy in Trimeria - The Thief of Smiles. This graphic adventure invites you to explore a magical world, face unique challenges, and unravel the mystery of the demon threatening to steal all smiles.

5051090.name: The Cozy Funemployment
5051090.short_description: Take a well-deserved break before searching for your next job! Spend time doing all the things you've always wanted to: cook delicious meals, relax, collect cute figurines, chat with friends, and enjoy life at your own pace. Work can wait a little longer... you've earned this vacation.

5279090.name: Girlvania: Summer Lust
5279090.short_description: Play with these kind ladies in the smoothest 3D Sex Simulator. Straight to the point: scissoring, clit stimulation, anal pleasure, double penetration, threesomes... Make the girls moan and pant! Enjoy the tons of detailed clothing and makeup. Control the action and take the hottest shots!

5382310.name: EDGEBORN: Desktop RPG
5382310.short_description: EDGEBORN is a dark fantasy idle RPG in the corner of your desktop. Build your party, customize talents and ability rules, hunt for gear, and take on bosses. Your heroes fight automatically. You shape their builds and decide when to step in.

5397550.name: ゴニンカン-津軽トランプゲーム-
5397550.short_description: A five-player trick-taking card game from Tsugaru, Japan. The two "Insiders" holding the trump Ace and the Joker battle three "Outsiders" for the picture cards. Play CPUs of different skill levels, race the clock in Time Attack, or take on the Daily Challenge.

5452240.name: 空想心理戦防護課程
5452240.short_description: A first-person exam simulator: pass by observing, remembering and deducing.

5485270.name: Grinny's Night Shift
5485270.short_description: It's your first week on the night shift at Grinny's, a 24-hour burger joint with a grinning mascot statue and a list of very specific rules. Flip burgers. Serve customers. Follow the rules exactly. Grinny is always watching.

5490010.name: Grunt
5490010.short_description: Medieval Grunt Simulator. Wage battles of thousands as a king and then survive them as a common footsolider.

2939510.name: Under Canopies
2939510.short_description: Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.

3668960.name: 淫御天下
3668960.short_description: 在《淫御天下》中，你将以皇帝之身统御天下，游走于宫廷权谋、与后宫情感之间。安定后宫风格各异的爱妃，与邻国结交同盟，通过深思熟虑的策略选择，打造一个属于你的“以淫为本”的盛世王朝。

4530390.name: TCG World
4530390.short_description: Explore, build, collect Sprites, craft, farm, fish, race, and establish your place in a persistent open-world adventure.

4577260.name: Employee06
4577260.short_description: Employee06 is a psychological horror game where you monitor security cameras, manage failing systems, and survive inside a mysterious laboratory. Something started without you, and it will end without.

4787650.name: Elf World Adventure 13
4787650.short_description: Elf World Adventure 13 continues the hentai puzzle series with beautiful anime-style elf girls. Piece together revealing illustrations, enjoy a fantasy atmosphere, and choose between two difficulty levels to suit your mood.

5137980.name: 古玩掌柜
5137980.short_description: Antique Dealer is a card collecting and strategy game with 600+ antique cards from ten Chinese dynasties. Leave it running and a beautiful new card arrives every half hour. For a challenge, play the built-in card game of genuine and fake cards, and outplay rival dealers with knowledge and strategy.

5408430.name: Hold My Helmet: Moto Racing Crash Simulator
5408430.short_description: A comedy road racing game on a tiny island. Race 15 rivals or the clock over 6 km of stone walls, hedges, village streets and sheep at up to 340 km/h. Get it wrong and Dave falls apart, the local paper prints the headline and THE FILM replays it all.

5424500.name: 货与刀
5424500.short_description:
You cannot have both fish and bear's paw.Arrange your cargo and supplies wisely in your inventory.
Survive this journey.Bring enough goods to avoid a wasted trip, and become the legendary Escort King.

3218310.name: Mazestalker
3218310.short_description: Discover a world of Escher-like isometric dungeon-labyrinths. Meet Yve Allard, a treasure hunter who finds that all corners of the world have already been visited by someone else. Where in the world can you discover new mysteries anymore?

4688700.name: Project Exhibitionist
4688700.short_description: Project Exhibitionist is a 3D sandbox game about exhibitionism and humiliation. Play as Ciel, a girl who, following a challenge, decides to leave her home completely naked. Discover all the points of interest and create your own story thanks to the game's complete customization.

4998360.name: Kitty Wants Blood
4998360.short_description: The average hooman body has around 5 liters of blood. That's not enough. Kitty wants more... much more. In this incremental game, help Kitty grow so big it can eat the planet! Hunt hoomans, suck their blood, unlock powerful mutations, complete challenges and before you ask, yes you can pet the cat.

5320260.name: Sudoku Studio - Puzzle Pack 1
5320260.short_description: Free Expansion Puzzle Pack for Sudoku Studio

5418940.name: Morphic
5418940.short_description: Live wallpapers for Windows: scenes, videos, images, web pages and audio on your desktop. A built-in editor with particles, effects and keyframes, scheduled playlists, auto-pause in games, and Steam Workshop. A lightweight native engine that's easy on your system.

5441840.name: 执笔人
5441840.short_description: An ink-wash xianxia action game. You are your sect's most worthless disciple — spirit energy leaks right out of you. Then you learn the one technique only you can use: clash blades at the instant steel meets steel and take your enemy's power. Every win becomes a unique ink painting.

5455150.name: Life Warp
5455150.short_description: Ascend to an alternate dimension known as The Warp and interact with its residents in mysteriously formed worlds.

5460460.name: Realistic Battle Simulator
5460460.short_description: Two knights or twenty thousand a side: pick who fights and watch it play out. Every soldier fights by his own armour, reach, speed and nerve, and an army breaks when its courage does. March the Warpath, paint battles in the sandbox, and forge your own units and fields.

5478030.name: Sleighline
5478030.short_description: Every Christmas Eve, the same old job, in a much bigger world. Santa’s magic now bends time and opens portals, but the presents still go in by hand, so he flies low: over rooftops, through a pharaoh’s tomb, across the outback. Two buttons, seven courses, one perfect line: TRUE SANTA.

365670.name: Blender
365670.short_description: Blender is the free and open source 3D creation suite. Free to use for everyone, for any purpose.

3670480.name: Anomaly Manual: Aquarium
3670480.short_description: Work the aquarium's night shift, escort visitors out, and follow the handbook, including its strangest rules. Watch for anomalies and get home safely in this single-player, first-person horror game with a story that gradually reveals the aquarium's past.

3701460.name: Furry Fantasy Adult World
3701460.short_description: Explore a sandbox open world, customize anthro furry characters, build, fly and create your own fantasy adventures alone or with friends.

4336790.name: Cyan Soul
4336790.short_description:
An arcade style, pixel art, boss-rush puzzle action game.
Move your character up, down, right and left!
Dash through enemy attacks and obstacles!
Pick up objects and hurl them at the boss to cause damage!
Gather enough points and unleash max damage with a powerful projectile or form!

4433100.name: The Phone from Another World: My First Love
4433100.short_description:
If she’s truly gone…
Then who is answering the phone?

4993680.name: Command Line Tower Defense
4993680.short_description: A terminal tower defense where every command counts. Place and upgrade daemons, counter hostile traffic, and build card combinations in Rogue Descent. A 20-operation Campaign, Endless, and a machine full of secrets. Keyboard-first, with optional mouse controls.

5008900.name: Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack
5008900.short_description: The Call of Duty Endowment (C.O.D.E.) Valor Pack for Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4 and Call of Duty®: Warzone™ was inspired by and created in close collaboration with U.S. Marine Corps veteran, Kyle Carpenter.

5119960.name: I nailed this document!
5119960.short_description: How picky can a client be? Match document layouts, fix unruly text, and line up every detail in this office puzzle game. “Just one little tweak!” Handle changing references, scrambled layouts, and papers blocking your view. Can you deliver without getting it sent back?

5300340.name: UNREFERENCE - Image Privacy Tool
5300340.short_description: UNREFERENCE is a local desktop application for photo batching, metadata removal, and pixel-level privacy. Convert, crop, and watermark files while stripping EXIF, GPS, and camera history—or apply subtle sensor-level adjustments to disrupt tracking. Fast, private, and 100% offline.

5384920.name: I SUCK DICKS AND HATE AI - HUGE COCK

5418090.name: Mogilev: Apocalypse
5418090.short_description: Survive in post-apocalyptic Mogilev. Begin inside Tadas’s club: manage hunger, thirst and sleep, buy vital supplies, complete missions and play Durak for in-game gold. Mogilev: Apocalypse is a single-player survival horror game in development.

5438050.name: Night Viewing
5438050.short_description: A first-person psychological horror puzzle game set in a late-night apartment. Switch between nine strange TV channels, inspect the room, and piece together clues hidden in broadcasts, sounds and notes. Your choices shape the final viewing.

5442870.name: Spellriggers: Unification Protocol
5442870.short_description: Heroes of Might and Magic meets Homeworld. Five Spellriggers, six schools of magic, randomly drawn loot cards and generated battlefields: no two runs alike. Build your fleet, master cosmic-scale spells and conquer the galaxy sector by sector.

5447490.name: MOST ARE MINE
5447490.short_description: There are thousands of them. Most are mine. Lead a legion of thousands of undead as a necromancer, drown the kingdom's knights, archers and heroes in sheer numbers, and raise everyone who falls to fight for you.

5471300.name: Ink And Table
5471300.short_description: A cute action roguelike where you play a tiny doll defending a girl’s possessed home, one tabletop at a time. Dodge bullet-hell barrages with simple left-right movement as you command flying swords and fire ink bullets at haunted teacups, ink paintings, and even braised pork.

5488730.name: Half & Half Chicken
