5488730.short_description: The day you get laid off, you loosen your tie and open a chicken shop in a little side street. Fry it, sauce it, and ride it right to their door before it goes soggy. Out of chicken? Head up the hill behind town and catch some.

2392710.name: Tactics: Setting Sun
2392710.short_description:
Tactics: Setting Sun is a turn-based strategy game centered around the Pacific Theater of World War II.
Equip and command your troops as you see fit.

Features multiplayer and single-player modes, an integrated map editor, and a rogue-like campaign.

2577730.name: Golel
2577730.short_description: Immerse yourself in the disturbing world of a first-person, Dungeon Crawler, Golel. Leverage the environment to your advantage, drop a bookshelf on an enemy, or kick them into a pit. Golel brings innovation to turn-based combat.

3448070.name: BPM Bitcrushed
3448070.short_description: BPM Bitcrushed: A retro roguelite rhythm shooter where every shot, dodge, and jump must sync to the beat. Battle through dungeons where enemies attack in time with the music. Find epic loot and even import your own songs to create a custom, rhythm-fuelled soundtrack for your destruction!

4031890.name: Palworld: Palfarm
4031890.short_description: Enjoy a farming life with mysterious creatures known as Pals! Team up with them to grow your farm at your own pace in this brand new creature-collecting farming sim, fully playable in multiplayer!

4899640.name: Neural Spaceship Sandbox
4899640.short_description: Neural Spaceship Sandbox is a hybrid turn-based strategy and voxel sandbox with unlimited possibilities. Build custom spaceships, arm them to the teeth with advanced sci-fi weaponry, pilot them or hand the keys to our advanced AI, and then use them to conquer the galaxy / galaxies!

5281110.name: Anima Trium
5281110.short_description: In Anima Trium, Leop believes he and his friends may be the last survivors of an ancient war. Until he spots a boat on the horizon. Explore islands and uncover a forgotten past in an adventure RPG full of mystery, featuring turn-based combat with manual and automatic modes.

5317790.name: Crimson Ark
5317790.short_description: Forge your own magic build in Crimson Ark, a single-player dark fantasy action RPG. Choose from three heroines, hunt for gear, and refine it through upgrades and reforging. Grow through auto-hunting, take direct control against bosses, and journey with Maria through a world of endless night.

5384940.name: I SUCK DICKS AND HATE AI - SPACE MEGALODON DICK
5384940.short_description: Megalodon Dick with Tentacles from Outer Space. Only for those who invest in research!

5433370.name: The Backrealms
5433370.short_description: A dark-fantasy co-op horror game about delivering cursed artifacts through the medieval backrooms. Explore a mysterious dungeon realm in search of buyers... if you can survive what lurks inside.

5441860.name: School Grounds Survival
5441860.short_description: The school has mutated – and you are the janitor. Fight hordes of mutated students and unhinged teachers with a mop, a stapler and a Bunsen burner. 69 weapons, 20 evolutions, subject sets and 9 bullet-hell bosses: an arena roguelite for one more run.

5460320.name: Flying Disc League
5460320.short_description: The ultimate frisbee simulator. Competitive online multiplayer from 2v2 to 7v7: pick the throw, set the power, release it and the disc flies like it does in real life. Hit the open pass, fake out your defender, lay out for the catch. Play with friends, against rivals, or train vs bots.

5463440.name: Spellsmith
5463440.short_description: Spellsmith is a pixel-art action RPG where you build your own spells, over 100 billion of them, and forge the worlds you fight through. Freeze lakes, crust lava, beat each dungeon's guardian and carry its core home to wake your Master's tower. Alone or with a friend online.

5472780.name: Unique Sword
5472780.short_description: Assemble one-of-a-kind flying swords from all kinds of blades and parts, draw the Sword Intent each one flies, and deploy your lineup against waves of monsters. Beyond the campaign, the Tower of Trials, the Sword Tomb and an Endless Mode await — and yes, even a rubber chicken can be a sword.

5475680.name: Fish Island Restaurant Simulator Together
5475680.short_description: Run a seafood restaurant on a tiny tropical island with up to 4 friends. Catch fish from the pier or row out to sea, grill them in the kitchen and serve hungry guests on the terrace - all at the same time, in one chaotic co-op shift.

5475920.name: Abysses: Meridian
5475920.short_description: Your drop pod sank on Meridian, a world where the sea has risen sixty metres in six years. Swim out, wake a silent station, build your way from a leaking pod to a real submarine, and dive ever deeper toward the vast ring that made the sea rise.

5482080.name: my keyboard home!
5482080.short_description: 1 key press = 1 game coin. Make typing boring emails, essays, and code feel rewarding ! Spend them on furniture and various items to decorate a cozy home—all hand drawn on real paper !

5026580.name: Vibin' & Survivin'
5026580.short_description: Vibin’ & Survivin’ is an action-packed sci-fi horde survivor roguelike where you unleash cosmic firepower against endless waves of alien foes. Craft game-changing builds, evolve 24 unique weapons, and harness the power of the Vibe Web to conquer chaotic space arenas!

5369160.name: Padel Manager 27
5369160.short_description: Build your padel academy, recruit and train players, and take your pairs to the top. Manage from the bench or play every point. Compete online, team up in co-op, or share the court in local multiplayer.

4279750.name: Magic Academy
4279750.short_description: Play as the Headmaster of a magic academy in this adult visual novel with card-based RPG adventures. Restore your ruined estate, recruit witches as teachers, and shape their fates. Explore procedurally generated maps, battle monsters, and unlock animated NSFW scenes.

5273550.name: Ecos de Valdrenne
5273550.short_description: A turn-based JRPG with a top-down map. Eight gods from real mythologies, a rainy night in a city where the ground gave way three weeks ago, and a sword that doesn't kill: it echoes. What you cut on the map goes into the Resonator, and you fight it turn by turn when you decide.

4116110.name: Creature Kitchen Demo
4116110.short_description: Get a taste of this creepy-cozy atmospheric cooking simulator in the Creature Kitchen Demo!  Meet your local wildlife and feed them favorite snacks as you start your exploration through a strange house and the nearby woods.  The witching hour has only begun...

4074910.name: 恋爱音游痴 Demo
4074910.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games theme. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

4795460.name: The Citadel Project
4795460.short_description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite survival-horror elements, inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

5034200.name: TrueHands
5034200.short_description: TrueHands is a SteamVR overlay utility that renders your real hands and arms directly into VR in the color of your choice, so that chroma key/pass-through solutions can show your hands on your steering wheel, flight stick, or other controls while staying fully immersed in any VR experience!

4402330.name: The 9th Dragon
4402330.short_description: Fight your way through the criminal underworld of 1980s Kowloon Walled City in a brutal, story-driven action game. Master intense melee combat, take down ruthless enemies, and uncover the dark secrets lurking within the city's walls.

4626420.name: Real Life Simulator
4626420.short_description: Rise to the top of trade with your friends! Buy and sell second-hand goods, establish a car dealership, manage the real estate market, and own the biggest businesses in the city. Real Life Simulator combines all trading simulations in a 2D Co-op world.

5378110.name: One More Lawn
5378110.short_description: Mow lawns in first person on a beat-up riding mower. You're a grumpy old man who smokes, drinks cheap beer and doesn't care, but leaves perfect stripes. A picky neighbor, an abandoned golf course, an island wedding. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 players.

4681750.name: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress Demo
4681750.short_description: A co-op dungeon runner. Fight through the shifting towers, loot powerful gear and develop new skills.  Challenge bosses and free the villagers town in this Action-RPG.  The tower will change, but each fountain will save your progress until you face the evil wizard himself.

3211480.name: Hockey Computer League
3211480.short_description: Hockey Computer League is a skill based, competitive ice hockey game. In which you control one player in a team from the first or third person perspective and compete against other players or bots. Be a part of the team!

5203650.name: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade Demo
5203650.short_description: Neon Breaker is a fun twin-stick horizontal 3d retro shoot 'em up in the legacy of the great action arcade shmup classics. Shoot, evade, and hunt down cute enemy ships to make them all explode! Push your limits playing through endless waves and unlock new high scores.

5342250.name: INTERREGNUM
5342250.short_description:
INTERREGNUM is a turn-based strategy game for the Commodore 64.
Command armies across three unique scenarios and fight for control, 
survival and victory with up to 4 local players or against the computer.

5432510.name: Sudoku Studio - Puzzle Pack 2
5432510.short_description: Free Expansion Puzzle Pack for Sudoku Studio

5159210.name: Scape Demo
5159210.short_description: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

4732770.name: Legion of Judgment: Fallen Angel Demo
4732770.short_description: Legion of Judgment is a Noir action-RPG Metroidvania game that offers a new and deeper player experience. Explore forgotten memories to become stronger, manage a hotel in reality to create a powerful legion and win the war against werewolf guild.

5383000.name: RCSIM
5383000.short_description: RCSIM bridges professional Sim-Racing rigs with real physical RC cars. Drive real-world vehicles in first-person view (FPV) with immersive Force Feedback, live telemetry, and multi-tier hardware support (Audio PPM, USB RP2350, or Direct ExpressLRS).

4083990.name: Pale Incense
4083990.short_description: Pale Incense is a gothic action-simulation where you run a perfume shop by day and hunt as a vampire by night. Harvest scents and human essence from your victims, evade hunters, and craft the healing incense that may save Johanna the wife your failed transformation left dying.

4551340.name: Monsterhearts: Welcome to Drowned Lake Demo
4551340.short_description: A queer horror narrative deckbuilder about the messy lives of teen monsters.

1594360.name: War on Mars
1594360.short_description: War on Mars - become the commander of a war battalion and test your skills on the battlefield. Tame the hateful bloodthirsty beasts without putting your troops at risk. Show off your leadership skills and become a world-class commander.

5054650.name: Neon Breaker: Endless Arcade
5054650.short_description: Blast your way onto the leaderboards in a twin-stick arcade shooter built around rapid destruction, evasion, kill combos and overwhelming firepower. Fight escalating fleets, merge power-ups and face 20+ unique bosses solo or in co-op. Play roguelike Anomaly runs that stack risk-reward mutations.

5205270.name: Knight's Party
5205270.short_description: Knight's Party is a bunch of lethal tournament party games where everyone wants to become a knight yet nobody absolutely knows what they're doing. Take your friends, fire cannons, pour glasses, pursue crowns, and disintegrate to limb by limb. Here, survival is quite challenging.

4980620.name: Sanitarium Enhanced
4980620.short_description: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium™ returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

4435080.name: Tequila Moonrise
4435080.short_description: Run a bar on the moon in this story-rich card game where choices matter. Build your character sheet and your deck, make drinks and deal with a daily dose of complications, all while balancing personal relationships, space politics and your own quest to rediscover your purpose.

2209340.name: Have You Herd?
2209340.short_description: Woolbeard the bad pirate sheep set the critters loose across the country! Only Cowboy Maloy and his pups - Duke, Hazel, Rusty, Nugget and Bear - can round 'em up. Herd, bark and howl through levels solo or co-op for 4 players. End the Herdpocalypse and earn everyone their much-needed vacation!

5364560.name: Request Stop
5364560.short_description: A slow-burning commute horror. Something is slipping, a little each day. Wake up, eat, catch the bus. Work your job, then work on your life. Maybe you'll get it right tomorrow. Or another day.

5047110.name: Wardspire
5047110.short_description: Arrows won't stop a draugr. Fire won't stop a giant. Every wave in Wardspire demands a different answer - and the tower you love most is the one that gets you killed. Norse tower defense with hard counters, permanent progression and an endless mode.

4212660.name: Team Fortress 2: Rebalanced
4212660.short_description: Team Fortress 2: Rebalanced is a community-made mod focused on providing a new take on the TF2 experience by rebalancing and redefining its weapons and classes.

4482220.name: QDFracture
4482220.short_description: Fast-paced competitive FPS focused on precision, movement, and high-impact combat. Dominate intense online PvP battles or team up in cooperative modes against adaptive AI. Pure skill. Zero gimmicks.

5461450.name: RYFT STRIKE: BRIGHTER TOMORROW Demo
5461450.short_description: Three nights before her war goes on television, Lt. Vesper is found by a Halcyon nature documentary. A complete prologue mission for the bullet-hell shoot 'em up: spell-card bosses, focus and graze scoring, a submarine carrier the size of the screen, and couch or online co-op.

4813240.name: IKANDY: Music Visualizer
4813240.short_description: Sold as a music visualizer, built as a real-time visual engine. Five render engines behind one HDR finish, over 500 reactive visuals, MilkDrop on our own engine, AI and shader creation, and a shared moon. Free to play. Pro adds creation and outputs.

3891160.name: クライムライト／CRYMELIGHT
3891160.short_description: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

4468540.name: It's About Pirates
4468540.short_description: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

5271070.name: Give Them TEETH
5271070.short_description: Sort Their TEETH is a surreal first-person sorting game set inside a living mouth museum. Pick up scattered teeth, match them to bizarre creature exhibits, and gradually clear the chaotic floor. Collect Golden Teeth to unlock unusual upgrades that make sorting even more satisfying.

4028760.name: Cosmo Cargo
4028760.short_description: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelike PvE game in which you fight to maintain chaos in the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

3637620.name: Azoth
3637620.short_description: Build game-breaking combos as you ascend through challenging rituals in this strategic deck builder. Master the unique card linking resource system to tackle the patterns and bosses within.

5411990.name: No One Runs Alone
5411990.short_description: No One Runs Alone is a chaotic multiplayer survival game where you and your team are bound together by the Soulbinder. Outsmart the Hunter, grab powerful perks, adapt to wild game modes, and make every escape a hilarious fight for survival.

4286100.name: Pale Incense Demo
4286100.short_description: In the Pale Incense demo, run a perfume shop by day and hunt as a vampire by night in a gothic action-simulation. Harvest scents and human essence from victims, evade hunters, and craft healing incense that may save your wife Johanna, left dying by your failed attempt to turn her.

5292970.name: Ashburrow Demo
5292970.short_description: Descend alone or with up to five friends into a gnoll warren where death ends the run but not the story. Fight with blade, shield and spell, bank your gold into permanent unlocks, and hire militia to hold the gate when the clan musters to take it back.

4935920.name: Utterance
4935920.short_description: Utterance is a Lovecraftian Western roguelite deckbuilder where you chart your own path through a corrupted world. Build a deck of letters, forge words, and battle creatures that twist your deck, your rules, and your sanity.

5442640.name: RYFT STRIKE: BRIGHTER TOMORROW
5442640.short_description: Fly solo or team up in a story-driven bullet-hell shooter where war is prime-time entertainment. Dodge spell-card bosses, upgrade your fighter jet, and risk a life to rescue your partner—with online and couch co-op and four difficulty levels.

5376410.name: Purr Box
5376410.short_description: A little box, lots of kittens and plenty of love! Adopt cats, collect purrs, unlock upgrades and gather memories in this pixel art incremental game. Enjoy minigames and let your kittens keep you company on your desktop while you study or work.

5460740.name: High Lance
5460740.short_description:
Tap to flap. Higher lance wins.

A one-button arcade game: ride a griffin over an endless world of floating ledges, unseat rival riders from above, and catch them as they parachute down to build a capture streak. Miss them, and they'll return a rank tougher. Five lands, each ending with a dragon.

5292800.name: Ashburrow
5292800.short_description: Descend alone or with up to five friends into a gnoll warren where death ends the run but not the story. Fight with blade, shield and spell, bank your gold into permanent unlocks, and hire militia to hold the gate when the clan musters to take it back.

5451070.name: Punch Your Way Out
5451070.short_description: You wake up in a tiny room. Every wall, floor and ceiling is solid cubes. Punch your way out. Smash blocks, vacuum the rubble, sell it for upgrades, find tools buried in the rock and grow some serious arms. Solo or with up to 3 friends, the daylight is out there somewhere.

5125200.name: Drainer
5125200.short_description:
Fight waves of enemies using your HP as ammunition. Power up and unlock new weapons and abilities.
Take control of a tyrant’s heart. Find him. Punish him for his sins.

2276300.name: Age of Sail
2276300.short_description: Set sail across dangerous seas in this co-op pirate adventure. Trade goods, fish for resources, upgrade your ship, and battle ruthless pirate NPCs as you build the ultimate vessel.

3946560.name: Empires of a Tiny Universe Demo
3946560.short_description: Empires of a Tiny Universe is a relaxed single-player RTS where you build and expand your empire across space. Manage planetary infrastructure, develop new technologies for your fleet, and conquer the galaxy - all from a clear, minimalist perspective.

5199550.name: Age of Sail Demo
5199550.short_description: Set sail across dangerous seas in this co-op pirate adventure. Trade goods, fish for resources, upgrade your ship, and battle ruthless pirate NPCs as you build the ultimate vessel.

4800650.name: 7 Millimeters
4800650.short_description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

3694420.name: Voidwood
3694420.short_description: Voidwood is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror game, where your voice can save your friends or give them all away.  By day, you scavenge an inviting, cursed forest. By night, you survive the hunt. Push your luck, go deeper, and speak carefully. The forest is listening.

2260740.name: Troubleshooting Demo
2260740.short_description: chaotic FPS roguelite inside your old family computer! Blast corrupt files, grab XP, stack weird upgrades, and place desktop junk to shape the arena as the system falls apart in increasingly stupid ways.

4972460.name: ドラマライク アドベンチャー『本と鍵の季節』
4972460.short_description: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

5284320.name: Mutant Football League 2: GWAR: Antarctica Scumdogs

5442940.name: Fishbobble
5442940.short_description: A cozy pond that sits in the corner of your screen: your fisher fishes on their own while you work or play. Clear each pond's stages, upgrade your gear, adopt a pet and build a collection of one-of-a-kind fish.

4984370.name: Of Dice and Minions
4984370.short_description: Roll five dice and chase poker hands to summon a minion army, then watch it fight. Hold, reroll, recruit, and counter your way down 100 floors in this roguelite auto battler.

5370850.name: Shivaliva
5370850.short_description: Go on a space adventure, build relationships, and play mini-games along the way. A sky-pirate puzzle adventure where every job, card table, ship's station and fight is its own minigame, and the islanders remember you, gossip about you, and might fall for you.

5185990.name: Raid Lead - Echoes of Gaia Playtest

4617110.name: SunderBound Demo
4617110.short_description: SunderBound is a co-op top-down shooter with roguelite progression, set in a crumbling mega-tower. Survive floor by floor with a partner you trust, or an AI companion if you’re climbing solo. Every room’s a test. Every upgrade’s earned. And the only way out is up.

5288880.name: Feste Feiern: German Festival Tycoon
5288880.short_description: Funfair, Christmas market, festival of lights, Halloween, wine festival, flea market and more: run the festivals of a German town – each with its own stalls, visitors, season and way of making money. Steer the crowds and turn an empty meadow into the best festival in town.

5138850.name: Hodrimeydan
5138850.short_description: Choose your class, challenge Forest bosses with your party, and face rival players in the Desert. Collect equipment, represent your guild, and ride ground and flying mounts in a stylized online RPG. Play free through level 5; higher levels require membership.

5069750.name: Strange island Demo
5069750.short_description: A first-person psychological horror focused on atmosphere, exploration, and a slow descent into mystery. You wake up on a remote island with no memory and no answers — who you are or how you got there. But with every answer you find, more questions begin to surface

4830790.name: Order of the Holy Crucible Demo

5164600.name: Did You See That? Demo
5164600.short_description: A 2 Player Anomaly Horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

5079520.name: The Cup: Creature Card Battler
5079520.short_description: A free 1v1 creature card battler with roguelike runs. Draft a line of real North American animals, plus a few cryptids. Play a card, make your swing, and watch the die TV decide how hard it lands while the booth calls every roll.

5396140.name: Noctheria Demo
5396140.short_description: Classic action-adventure dungeons meet survival horror. Explore Albadusk at your own pace, solve cursed dungeons with wit alone, and bring their tools back into the world to reach secrets once out of reach. A dark N64-style adventure of faith, ancient gods, and what hides in the dark.

5340130.name: Lands of Navia
5340130.short_description: Lands of Navia is a unique take on the shoot ’em up genre set in the world of Slavic mythology. Each of the 4 gods offers different gameplay mechanics, and to fulfill your duty of protecting the realm of the dead, you’ll need to skillfully juggle the powers of the gods you control.

5084410.name: Journey TD
5084410.short_description: Classic tower defense meets roguelite: pick your elements, choose from 168 towers and merge them into stronger ones. Every tower is a wall: lure enemies onto the longest path, shape your build with power-up cards, gear and runes, and grow stronger with every run.

4459730.name: Airport Control 27 Demo
4459730.short_description: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

5236860.name: Mine of despair Demo
5236860.short_description: Sentenced to death, then pardoned... into a mining sentence. 1-8 player co-op with proximity voice: dig, pay the prison, come back up alive. You do not kill the monsters here: you understand them, or you die. And something down there blows out the torches, one by one.

5114550.name: Procession Engine Demo
5114550.short_description: Free demo of Procession Engine. Not another turn-based deckbuilder: a real-time tug of war where your cards shape a whole army. During Next Fest, play all 3 races through Act 1 and push two lanes until a stronghold falls.

4728940.name: Demon Lord's Corruption Codex
4728940.short_description: Step into the Demon Lord's throne. Command, break, and transform the adventurers who dare to invade your domain. Deep corruption mechanics driven by stats and choices, 5 unique heroines, and a full roster rendered entirely in complete CG.

5474670.name: Wild West Canyon Demo
5474670.short_description: Revolver in hand, bison in sight: Experience a ruthless survival adventure. Defy wild animals and Native Americans. Build a refuge and show who is in charge!

5397700.name: FRAGGED!
5397700.short_description: FRAGGED! is an oldskool action-movie realism shooter. Dive through windows guns blazing, roll out of the line of fire and empty two pistols at once across warehouses, city streets and rail yards. Play online with up to 16 friends, or take on bots.

5289110.name: Valenya Online
5289110.short_description: Find your place in a shared world. Dodge attacks, craft your gear and trade with other players in this free 2D MMORPG. Six classes, party dungeons and adventures to build together. No subscription. Cosmetic-only purchases.

4995080.name: Procession Engine
4995080.short_description: Not another turn-based deckbuilder. A real-time tug of war where you command a whole army: your buildings spawn it, your cards shape it, and two lanes decide whose stronghold falls first.

3866060.name: Past Mistakes Soundtrack
3866060.short_description: Indulge in the tunes of Past Mistakes - Act I with the original soundtrack, featuring all of the bespoke compositions included in the game composed by Zherovski.

5226760.name: Money Burner
5226760.short_description: Slice banknotes, smash gold and torch piles of cash in this cartoon first-person incremental game. Earn rewards, upgrade your weapons and break into new rooms. Start with scissors and work your way up to a flamethrower and a massive laser cannon.

5354020.name: Grow Your Kingdom
5354020.short_description: Grow Your Kingdom is a 3D incremental city builder where an empty riverbank grows into a kingdom. Put settlers to work, click for bonus resources and upgrade everything. Trade with neighbors or raid their towns, turn battles with spells, and one day refuse to pay the greedy Count!

5008590.name: Desktop Tower Survivor - Supporter Pack
5008590.short_description: Support the development of Desktop Tower Survivor and unlock permanent perks: double permanent coins, more gems (5 per bonus gem instead of 3), an exclusive tower skin, plus 1000 gems as a thank-you. A one-time purchase — thanks for your support!

3995200.name: Why's It Getting DARKER?! Demo
3995200.short_description: The light is your only lifeline. Descend into a crushing, thalassophobic abyss where every photograph could be your last. Investigate unpredictable deep-sea horrors and explore the vast, dark unknown - all while being 'assisted' by a darkly sarcastic AI.

3881640.name: Past Mistakes - Walkthrough & Cheats
3881640.short_description: Grant some divine knowledge in the Utility Pack for Past Mistakes! Reveal pathways and routes with in-game cheats, and plan out your journey with the ever-expanding walkthrough.

1362540.name: Battle Cry of Freedom - Dedicated Server

3719480.name: Scared by Squares
3719480.short_description: Scared by Squares is an experiment in horror. Can you create fear without ghosts, zombies, creepy dolls, or the usual tropes? What if all you had was the least scary thing in the world: a simple cube? The result might surprise you.

5458030.name: Game’s Afoot Pinball
5458030.short_description: Crack the case in Game’s Afoot Pinball! Race through ramps, smash drop targets, hit bumpers, spin for points, uncover clues, and trigger exciting multiball on a richly detailed Victorian London mystery table.

3442670.name: Past Mistakes - Adult Patch
3442670.short_description: Upgrade your Past Mistakes experience with lewd 4K images and stunning animated sex scenes! Enhance Cyrus’ story with a whole host of sexy encounters along the way!

2451080.name: Geometry TD
2451080.short_description: Tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Explore open space, mine asteroids, trade, and lead a crew of astronauts. When pirates board your ship, place geometric towers, merge them into stronger shapes, and stop every wave.

5160240.name: SWOM Demo
5160240.short_description: SWOM — a game where you survive after memory loss, using magic based on basic laws you discover during gameplay. Build shelters, explore the unexplored world, collect items and resources to survive and understand why you are here.

4586490.name: Bloodscript//END
4586490.short_description: BLOODSCRIPT//END is a dark ASCII roguelike that combines the brutal unpredictability of classic dungeon crawlers with the unhinged chaos of Japanese RPGs.

4978310.name: Geometry TD Demo
4978310.short_description: The free demo of Geometry TD: tower defense on a starship you build and fly yourself. Fly through open space, put your crew to work, and stop a pirate boarding with geometric towers. Play time is limited to 15 minutes.

4529580.name: Moving Oasis
4529580.short_description: The world is drowning in living black goo, and all you have is a water tank. Blast the goo back, grow the land green, wake the fungal cities and link them with mycelium. Bring back the rain and wash the animals free before the goo takes them.

5468120.name: Unclean Hands
5468120.short_description: A PS1-style horror card game. Play Durak against Slavic spirits in a bathhouse after midnight. They cheat. Catch them. Cheat back while they look away — alone or with up to three friends online. Lose, and you lose a finger.

5462900.name: SLABBED: Card Grader
5462900.short_description: A first-person card grading game with a story shaped by your choices. Tilt trading cards under the light, inspect their condition, and seal them in plastic. Stay honest, bend the rules, or put a price on your judgment.

5059430.name: One Second Hero
5059430.short_description: One Second Hero is a first-person puzzle game where one second is all the time you need. Observe the world in an instant, interact with objects, use the environment, and turn danger around—before that second is over.

5303040.name: Basketball Dynasty Demo
5303040.short_description: Build your ultimate team in Basketball Dynasty, a tactical 2D basketball management sim. Make real-time coaching decisions, call plays, and scout top talents. Combine deep strategy with RPG gear progression to lead your squad to glory!

5333470.name: Ricochord
5333470.short_description: RICOCHORD is a roguelite about bouncing orbs and flashing lights. And it has some music.

3657320.name: Pelikeeper: A TD Adventure
3657320.short_description: Defend fallen stars from an onslaught of shadow creatures, strategize with unique animal towers, and upgrade your lighthouse community as you adventure through the changing seasons to uncover the memories of fallen stars.

5359600.name: BIGGER BANG
5359600.short_description: 3 a.m. The neighbor is thudding again, so you pick up a hammer. Every run deals new relics that change how your hammer hits: echoes, chains, fire. The holes stay between runs. Break through, and the noise comes from farther away: apartment, city, mountain, planet, spacetime.

4607090.name: Impossible Wonders
4607090.short_description: Oversee a horde of tiny imps as they haphazardly build monuments in the imp lords honor. A cute and short arcade style game with a global leaderboard.

5105110.name: Afterwork Apocalypse
5105110.short_description: A horde-survival roguelite in a cursed office tower. Weaponise the stapler, the hot coffee and the all-hands microphone, keep your panicking colleagues from quitting mid-fight, and ride the elevator up floor by floor. Overtime is not optional.

4208990.name: Black Autumn: 1438
4208990.short_description: A realistic medieval pixel art RPG set in the Hron valley in the autumn of 1438. Fight in armour you put on piece by piece, ride horses into battle, pick locks and purses, and gamble with cards or dice. No magic and no monsters, only the real Hron valley as it was in 1438.

1270660.name: Dead Party
1270660.short_description: On Halloween, UFO‘s appeared over the peaceful town of Shady Hill. Soon after, the undead neighborhood rises from their graves. Four heroes take on the impossible task: to fight back the evil invaders!

5297110.name: NightMaw
5297110.short_description: A physics-driven multiplayer horror game where insatiably hungry, man-made monsters stalk, pounce, and devour each other in procedurally generated dungeons.

5196790.name: Coffee Keeper
5196790.short_description: Sort 4,179 scattered bags, tins, bottles, brewing gear, pastries and more throughout a two-storey coffee house. Match every piece to its proper place, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

5211080.name: Quarantine 16
5211080.short_description: Quarantine 16 is a indie multiplayer infection game for up to 16 players, featuring different zombie game modes, player-created maps, and plenty of chaotic ways to play with friends.

5308390.name: Jet Birds Demo
5308390.short_description: A challenging, physics-based, 3D platformer where you fly jetpack-powered birds through ring circuits suspended through nature. Not a casual flying game or a flight simulator, but a precision platformer that demands (and rewards) determination and practice.

4867140.name: Hold On
4867140.short_description: Struggle. Fall. Triumph. Hold on. A small yet grand journey across life. Simple interactions connect seemingly unrelated moments, from the microscopic to the cosmic.

5012760.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon Demo
5012760.short_description: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

5277680.name: Tarpit
5277680.short_description: Tarpit is a psychological indie horror game where you have to make TAR to rescue your friend from danger. Beware of the forces in your surroundings. The forces definitely see you... but do you see them?

4980170.name: Pinion
4980170.short_description: Answer an SOS from a remote island and enter a manor consumed by a spreading nightmare. Fight transformed inhabitants, search for survivors, and uncover the truth in this first-person survival horror mystery.

3810510.name: DERELIKT
3810510.short_description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.

4855310.name: Shadows of Beginnings
4855310.short_description: Explore fractured realms, battle fearsome enemies, and rebuild Novum in this dark fantasy action RPG. Gather resources, upgrade your gear, develop your class, and seamlessly switch between isometric and over-the-shoulder combat as you fight for a world on the brink of being swallowed by the void.

5438170.name: Total Neuroscience
5438170.short_description: A complete neuroscience study app with two bonus games. Drill every topic from the membrane to the clinic — then run a neuron as a factory, where the same cell biology keeps the line moving.

2570370.name: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira
2570370.short_description: Brazilian Fight: Capoeira is a fighting game that features capoeira as its main fighting style. In this game, you'll experience numerous characters and ways to fight capoeira. Let's get moving!

667430.name: A Cat's Manor
667430.short_description: Trapped in a house inhabited by a crazed family, with a hand stitched on its tail. Solve puzzles, craft items & tools, survive deadly encounters, use force or outwit bosses, hide & use stealth. Survive long enough to escape the Manor and decide how it ends.

4998870.name: Cardboard Conquest Soundtrack
4998870.short_description: The complete original soundtrack to Cardboard Conquest: Deckbuilding Autobattler - 79 tracks of sweeping, hand-crafted battle music. March your warband to war, hold the line against each warlord, and stand victorious to a score written for every commander, region, and last stand of the campaign.

5058160.name: Wretched
5058160.short_description: Wretched is a turn-based tactical game focused on strategic positioning, skill combinations and devastating attacks. Play as an ancient being of immense power. Move into range, kick enemies away and slip behind others. Chain your skills and make every turn count.

3703630.name: The Talos Principle 3
3703630.short_description: The Talos Principle 3 is the last chapter of the thought-provoking first-person puzzle series, taking you on a cosmic journey across more than a dozen worlds and testing your mind with all-new challenges.

3497960.name: The Symbiant II
3497960.short_description: The Symbiant II is a BL-Yaoi-Gay visual novel about a man who goes through change he didn't ask for. It's also a tale of ancient secrets, intimate exploration and unlikely romance.

3424380.name: From Misfortune Comes
3424380.short_description: A broke high-school senior tries to rebuild his life, while secretly exploiting a supernatural second world to acquire money, power and opportunities that transform his ordinary existence.

5358970.name: Borregada o Facto
5358970.short_description: Borregada or Facto is a quiz about current affairs, politics, history, and society. Answer questions, earn points, use cards and bonuses, and compete with your friends. Uncomfortable questions, real facts, and sources to check them yourself.

4887970.name: Borrowed Flesh
4887970.short_description: A deck-building roguelike of body horror where your whole party shares one deck: when a hero falls, every card they own dies with them. Pick 3 of 5 broken souls, survive permanent mutilation and unraveling minds, and descend as far as your flesh can bear.

4030350.name: BloodSpiller
4030350.short_description: Brutally blast through Dracula's minions and rescue your girl in this retro action platformer. Upgrade, discover, and destroy with retro flair and modern attitude.

5414820.name: Finger of Blood
5414820.short_description: A classic first-person horde shooter where your weapon is your own hand. Shoot with a finger gun, parry every blow with perfect timing and riposte with knife or fists. Survive endless waves, spend souls at the trader, stack perks into brutal builds and take down enemies.

5302340.name: Solis Chronicles
5302340.short_description: Fleeing a future that executes the obsolete, Dr. Solis Renforge crash-lands among the dinosaurs, 65 million years in the past. Build a life with a prehistoric tribe, contain the corruption you unleashed, and face a people who fear what your technology makes of them. A sci-fi isekai visual novel.

5110030.name: Echo Era
5110030.short_description: Build a party, explore a kingdom under tyranny, and choose your battles in this classic-style JRPG. Recruit adventurers by class, uncover side quests and secrets, and face enemies in turn-based combat. The goddess has called, now lead your journey to where ever it may end.

1299950.name: Unwalkable
1299950.short_description: Unwalkable is a silly physics based open-ended puzzle platformer where you control a wobbly character.  Without just one way to solve puzzles, you must use your imagination and ingenuity to create solutions to unthinkable problems.

5105320.name: The Lands of Hyberian Soundtrack
5105320.short_description: Featuring an amazing soundtrack of levels and menus heard throughout The Lands of Hyberian.

4950640.name: Serious Bigness
4950640.short_description: Serious Bigness is a co-op kaiju destruction game for 1-4 players where you start tiny and grow by smashing everything from dominoes to skyscrapers. Explore physics-driven sandbox levels solo or with friends, online or split-screen. Race the clock, climb leaderboards, and grow big, seriously big!

252950.name: Rocket League
252950.short_description: Rocket League is a high-powered hybrid of arcade-style soccer and vehicular mayhem with easy-to-understand controls and fluid, physics-driven competition. Rocket League includes casual and competitive Online Matches, a fully-featured offline Season Mode, special “Mutators” that let you change the rules entirely, hockey and basketball-inspired Extra Modes, and more than 500 trillion possible cosmetic customization combinations.

5280390.name: PatchWorld Demo
5280390.short_description: Unleash your imagination in PatchWorld, where music, art and creativity come to life. Through logic, physics and intuitive building blocks, create, share and discover worlds upon worlds. Bring your ideas to life or remix the community’s, on your own or with friends.

5441900.name: Project Kinfield
5441900.short_description: A free-to-play, cozy creature-catching adventure you share with other players. Start among the stars on the ISV Concordia or deep in the Underworld, befriend nearly 300 Kin, build a home in the wild, and follow two roads that meet at the Twinspan.

2895740.name: SporeBloom
2895740.short_description: A fungi-fueled 'battle of nutrition!' Turn-based strategy inspired by mycelium networks and territory control. Produce fantastical mushrooms and expand to outgrow your rivals. Develop peacefully or parasitize your friends in multiplayer and solo play - may the fittest fungi survive!

5423040.name: Ashes of the Swarm
5423040.short_description: Ashes of the Swarm is a cute open-ended puzzle game about creating explosive chain reactions with insect cowboys (and girls), that tries to reinvent itself in some unexpected ways.

4990410.name: Red Father Demo
4990410.short_description: RED FATHER is a PSX-style horror game set in Graham Labs, a mysterious computer research facility. The company's prized supercomputer has gone rogue, killing anyone who might shut it down. Uncover the mysteries Graham Labs tried to hide, and try to make it out alive.

5409400.name: 图灵之书 Demo
5409400.short_description: CODEX : RECALL is a single-player PvE strategy card game that combines 2.5D exploration, deckbuilding, tactical grid movement, and fragmented storytelling. Explore The World of Codex, restore Mind Spaces corrupted by breaches, and uncover the truth behind you, Lipa, and this world.

5356930.name: Sort The Dumplings
5356930.short_description: Sort a mountain of adorable dumplings into their proper homes in a chaotic, satisfying sorting game. Discover 190 unique dumplings across 19 themed collections, complete shelves, unlock changing environments, and chase faster times across multiple game modes.

4189120.name: Debauchery & Magic
4189120.short_description: In Haven, magic thrives and debauchery is strictly forbidden. Defy a ruthless new ruler as you and your friends quest, loot, party, and battle your way across the kingdom to bring freedom back to its people.

5435630.name: Hazelton Hollow
5435630.short_description: Welcome to Hazelton Hollow—a quiet mountain timber town with a double life. Maintain your vehicles down to the oil and spark plugs, haul legitimate timber and community deliveries by day, and run copper-distilled moonshine, botanical contraband, and encrypted syndicate drops after dark.

2235310.name: PatchWorld
2235310.short_description: Unleash your imagination in PatchWorld, where music, art and creativity come to life. Through logic, physics and intuitive building blocks, create, share and discover worlds upon worlds. Bring your ideas to life or remix the community’s, on your own or with friends.

3881920.name: Good Children Say Grace
3881920.short_description: My parents adopted an orphan who burned down her house. I haven't slept since my girlfriend disappeared. Now everything looks like eggs. Good Children Say Grace.

4920320.name: Tropico 7 - Demo
4920320.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

5485050.name: Wheatstead
5485050.short_description: Your harvest may fight back. Farm, battle crop monsters, and turn raw materials into bread, paper, and chocolate. Link fields and factories with conveyors, pipes, and machines. Play solo or cooperate over LAN or a direct host connection.

4529730.name: XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle
4529730.short_description:
“XX GAME: The Evolution Merge Puzzle” is a physics-based merge puzzle game about evolution.
Start as a tiny strawberry and evolve into insects, animals, humans, and beyond. Merge uniquely shaped characters and experience an evolutionary journey across 9 stages.

3872160.name: Envido
3872160.short_description: Grab your cards, play against wandering souls, unlock items at the pub and win all the matches to survive. Scheme your plays, perfect your bluffs and make strategic decisions based on your macumbas. Your match against Mandinga is about to begin!

4076530.name: Daughter of Voodoo
4076530.short_description: Daughter of Voodoo is a single player narrative horror experience where the dead are more than monsters. Investigate hauntings, uncover the truth behind lost lives, and perform voodoo rituals to help restless spirits find peace. Some souls seek understanding. Others refuse to let go.

4737230.name: Aleph's Garden
4737230.short_description: A platform-puzzle Metroidvania where knowledge unlocks the garden—learn, open new paths, and solve mysteries in more than one way.

5148710.name: No Survivors Demo
5148710.short_description: Become the slasher in a retro horror-comedy bullet heaven. Hunt campers across Camp Crestwood, unlock nine brutal weapons, weaponize a fully destructible map, and survive an escalating response in this free playable slice of No Survivors. Expect dark humour and ridiculous radio chatter.

4751060.name: Thousands of Chroma Demo
4751060.short_description: A layered logic puzzle game, where thousands of colors come to life using only □(0) and ■(1).

4354570.name: FINAL FANTASY VII REVELATION
4354570.short_description: The final battle to decide the fate of the world has begun. Take to the skies, chart your course, and stand with your companions against Sephiroth one last time. A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

5148400.name: No Survivors
5148400.short_description: Become the slasher in a retro horror-comedy bullet heaven. Hunt campers, battle an escalating police and military response, upgrade nine brutal weapons, and turn a fully destructible lakeside camp into your deadliest weapon. Expect dark humour and ridiculous radio chatter.

5443850.name: No One Left To Die Demo

5337790.name: Panda Flora
5337790.short_description: A cozy first-person game where you run your own flower shop. Grow flowers in your garden, make bouquets by hand to match your customers' wishes, and grow your shop step by step. Unlock new flowers and complete your album.

4694730.name: Diatonic Demo
4694730.short_description: Diatonic is a piano roguelike that sharpens your sight-reading. Learn songs one run at a time, no matter your skill level. Best played with a MIDI keyboard.

5293880.name: Harmony Strike
5293880.short_description: A party-based survivors-like where you lead a whole party of heroes instead of a single character. Each boss you defeat adds a new hero to your team, heroes fighting side by side combine their elements, and dozens of runes and relics shape every run.

4500460.name: What The Dog Remembers
4500460.short_description: A retro-style psychological horror roguelike. Survive a week in a claustrophobic trailer, spot reality-breaking anomalies, and document your findings. Permadeath, limited energy and time: every mistake can end the run. Your dog knows.

5417150.name: BlastMorph: Pinball Demo
5417150.short_description: I took pinball and VIDEO-GAMIFIED it!  Where else can you play video game bonus stages and play from INSIDE the pinball table!?

2671540.name: Bug Ball Demo
2671540.short_description: Bug Ball is a wacky football (soccer) game where you play as little bugs.

5120420.name: Starless Umbra Demo
5120420.short_description: Starless Umbra is a story-rich action RPG inspired by the best of classic and modern JRPGs. Engage in real-time combat and explore puzzle-filled dungeons in a couch co-op adventure where friendship and loyalty are tested in a world consumed by a noxious fog.

3348920.name: Skill Eater
3348920.short_description: Skill Eater is a roguelite game where you've been turned into a slime with no choice but to steal opponents' skills to grow stronger. Eat your way through the humans and monsters that stand in your way, claim their powers, and aim to defeat the final boss that awaits you.

4541330.name: COVR
4541330.short_description: COVR is a high-stakes tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, grounded realism, and tense CQB. Deploy solo or in co-op, complete classic tactical objectives, adapt to unpredictable missions, and make every decision count. Coming in 2026.

5382480.name: Mining Days
5382480.short_description: Step into a peaceful low-poly mining world and build your own growing mining operation! Start with a simple pickaxe, break rocks, discover valuable ores, hire different types of workers and watch your small site transform into a productive automated bussiness.

5362060.name: The Third Seal
5362060.short_description: At a table in the dark, everyone secretly grabs a cursed object. When the light comes back, you find out who had it in for you. A first-person duel of horror and deception for 1 to 4 players, solo against the AI or online with friends. The third seal sets you free.

5436920.name: We Dig the Moon
5436920.short_description: A mining adventure for 1–4 players. Stranded on the Moon, dig for valuable ores, upgrade your gear, and repair your ship. Fight hungry creatures, uncover alien secrets, and answer to a sarcastic corporate AI. Your survival matters. The company's profit matters more.

3544250.name: The Bus - Hamburg City
3544250.short_description: Experience the Hanseatic city from the perspective of a bus driver in The Bus - Hamburg City – get in and drive off!

4993800.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike
4993800.short_description: Out of Order is a cozy roguelike deckbuilder about running a vending machine. Your stockroom is your deck, every day is one round of restocking, selling, and choosing new products. A run is twelve weeks at one venue. An increasing weekly quota decides whether your contract survives.

5000580.name: Escape the Exomoon Demo
5000580.short_description: ESCAPE THE EXOMOON is a narrative driven cyberpunk sci-fi horror game. Hack, hide, and fight your way across an abandoned space colony and learn the terrifying secrets within. Will you sacrifice your sanity for survival?

4615410.name: Everburning Dark
4615410.short_description: Everburning Dark blends 2048-style roguelike merge combat, unlimited AI-driven storytelling, and companion AI bonding. Build with relics and skills, talk freely to reshape each run, and uncover the folk-horror truth of a dying dynasty.

3786840.name: Slime Slasher
3786840.short_description: You take on the role of a slime fighting alongside the rebels against Brain 738 and a spacefaring race of penguins. Become a warrior, archer, or mage and play through your own story to a unique ending!

5312680.name: The Light in the Darkness: Director's Cut
5312680.short_description: The Light in the Darkness: Director’s Cut is a free narrative game following a Polish-Jewish family living in Nazi-occupied France.

5018350.name: ur round
5018350.short_description: run a small british pub with up to 4 friends. pull pints, chop fruit, shake dodgy cocktails, and boot the troublemakers out through the window. the bar is small and so are the margins.

3867290.name: Eredian Stronghold
3867290.short_description: Push lanes, capture buildings, and defend your base in this fast-paced Action RPG. Slaughter hordes of enemies, find legendary loot, and fight your way to the Stronghold of Eredian.

4948270.name: Grimoire of Blanks Demo
4948270.short_description: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences are not. Fill the blanks with words, build devastating combos, and play through the first act with 2 of the 4 classes. Play solo or online co-op with up to 4 players.

4963980.name: Kaironia
4963980.short_description: Relive the golden age of MMOs in this friction-free 2D idle RPG. Chop trees, forge armor, and slay monsters to reach level 99. Play solo or hang out with friends in multiplayer and utilize the offline Time Bank to fast-forward the grind. Pure nostalgia, built to respect your time.

5449250.name: Quadora
5449250.short_description: A block-stacking puzzle game for friends. Drop pieces onto one shared board that grows with your group, clear lines together, draft perks and survive random events. Or battle in team duels up to 4v4 and free-for-all matches for up to 10 players. Plus a 40-level campaign.

4730300.name: Soliton Burst
4730300.short_description: Every music track builds a different battlefield: its own guardian, and a fight where your weapons fire in time with it. Play along with Spotify, YouTube or any app on your PC (Windows), or with your own music files. No audio information leaves your PC. What will your favourite track create?

5100550.name: マニ車
5100550.short_description:
A mani wheel is a Tibetan Buddhist prayer wheel said to grant the same virtue as reciting scripture when spun.

Arrange letters, spin the wheel, accumulate Virtue and Mercy, and reincarnate again and again. Discover powerful interactions and find your own path to enlightenment.

2087540.name: Escape from Playtime
2087540.short_description: An online 2-8 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

4149590.name: Project Exodus
4149590.short_description: A co-op horror game for up to 6 players in which you must hunt monsters and convert them into biomass to meet the quota for "The Ark". Collect artifacts, earn money, and buy upgrades to improve your chances of survival.

5394880.name: DYTH
5394880.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about collecting dice and climbing a tower. Place dice against enemies, combine numbers and elements to form hands and trigger Resonance, and modify your dice through battles and events. Plan your route with the dice you have left.

5023750.name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
5023750.short_description:
Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books...
Until her eyes fell out.
You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression.
There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

4793540.name: Online Boxing 3D Demo
4793540.short_description:
A physics-driven boxing simulation where every punch is calculated in real time. 
Master timing, positioning, and footwork to outbox your opponent.

4945980.name: Grimoire of Blanks
4945980.short_description: Every spell is unfinished. The consequences are not. Fill the blanks in your cards with words and turn the same sentence into traps, area attacks, or reckless combos. A roguelite deckbuilder for 1 to 4 players.

5415160.name: Hero Strike
5415160.short_description: All the strategy of a classic RTS with zero micro required. Draft your army from 75+ fantasy units, command a leveling Hero, and engineer formations that spawn fresh every wave. Counter your rival, seize the middle line for bonus gold, and crush the enemy Citadel in 3v3 tug-of-war battles.

5461540.name: Midnight Shop
5461540.short_description: Seven days after your grandmother vanished, you open her shop, which only trades after midnight. Under the counter glass lies a card of house rules in her handwriting, but not all of them are hers. Keep the rules to survive the night, or break them for the strangers who come in from the rain.

4974790.name: Ionic Drive
4974790.short_description: Plan your flight path, execute a perfect flip-and-burn manoeuvre and pray that your hull survives any impact in this space flight simulation/racing game. Can you avoid collision and finish your flight?

5175170.name: Angelfall Demo
5175170.short_description: Face the endless armies of Light and become the nightmare they fear! Angelfall is a roguelike reverse-horror game, in which you play as powerful Archdemon, slaughter hordes of humans, harvest their souls, and discover devastating synergies. Grow stronger, unlock new powers, and conquer the Light.

5377320.name: Kaiju Defense Project Demo
5377320.short_description: Kaiju Defense Project is a strategy game set in a distant world where humanity is fighting to survive against hordes of giant monsters: the Kaijus. Research, manage, and strategically build your defenses to keep humanity alive on this planet. How much time does humanity have left?

5292430.name: Uyar Party Demo
5292430.short_description: Jump into the chaos of Uyar Party! Compete in fast-paced minigames, outplay your rivals, and survive unpredictable arenas with up to 8 players online or against AI. The demo gives you a taste of the full party experience.

2526570.name: Band of Crusaders
2526570.short_description: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Craft your sandbox adventure - explore a vast simulated world, recruit crusaders, grow your camp, and face demons & human foes in real-time combat.

4698160.name: Cats Don't Carry Car Parts
4698160.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror game where a train crash strands you in a dark Soviet forest. With your friends, scavenge and carry parts to rebuild a dismantled truck, escape the Soviet Oblast of Novak, and survive cat-themed tests to convince IT you belong there.

2298250.name: GearGrit
2298250.short_description: Tansy Geargrit, charged with some crimes she did commit, and some she didn't... Explore, platform, and blast your way through GearGrit, an Action Platformer inspired by your favorite PS2 games!

5366410.name: 等等！我先升個級！
5366410.short_description: Black spores fell with the acid rain, and within three months the city drowned in the dead. You're one of the few still holding a gun: dodge through the horde, grab loot, level up, merge nine items into one back at base, and fight your way to the Cinder Revenant behind it all.

5389150.name: Keyp It Up
5389150.short_description: The mother of all slop games. Melt your brain with this hypnotic key-jingling number-go-up game, or buy it for a friend if you hate them.

4196100.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword Benchmark

4618850.name: Route 340
4618850.short_description: Build your own industrial empire, connect factories, and draw your truck routes by hand. Then get behind the wheel and experience a detailed driving simulation where cargo weight, terrain, and every decision can mean the difference between a successful delivery and ending up stranded in a ditch.

5187910.name: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed." Demo
5187910.short_description: Demo demo demo demo demo [demo] demo | Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books... Until her eyes fell out. You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression. There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

4256670.name: Picker Magnate Simulator
4256670.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

3974650.name: Onimusha: Way of the Sword DEMO

4904380.name: Climb the Fools
4904380.short_description: An insanely difficult climbing game begins here. Knocking others down—it is truly a world of survival of the fittest. There can be only one winner.

5248850.name: Picker Magnate Simulator Demo
5248850.short_description: Buy junk, hunt for rare treasures, and turn it all into profit in your own resale shop. Haggle with sellers, repair antiques yourself or through hired workers, craft handmade, and level up your skills to carry and sell more. If you hate hauling heavy stuff, buy a vehicle. Build your resale empire.

4528060.name: Dominoir
4528060.short_description:
Dominoir is a domino roguelike where every tile can make—or break—your run. Build clever chains, close wraps, stack powerful Schemes and Marks, and chase outrageous scores. Outsmart the House, bend its rules, and prove that at this table, luck is only the beginning.
Think Balatro meets Dominoes.

4306520.name: Pookie's Otherworld Tavern
4306520.short_description: Trapped in a fantasy world with zero gold? Pookie needs a fortune to buy her way home. Manage a tavern, serve drinks, and charm wealthy patrons. Will you run an honest business, or do whatever it takes to get paid?

5386950.name: Cheese Racers
5386950.short_description: Thread a hovering wheel of cheese through gaps that never stop tightening. A hit costs a slice; dodge clean and it grows back. Chase your best, race everyone on the Daily Seed, and beat friends and ranked rivals on the exact same course. Earn skins, shapes, trails and maps as you play.

5219000.name: Mountain Rescue: Caucasus
5219000.short_description: Somewhere in the snowy Caucasus, Babu needs rescuing and you're the rescue team and carry Babu home on your back. Gently.

4902280.name: Pack Rush
4902280.short_description: Wash cars, open packs and build your deck in a neighborhood where every shift hides something strange. Collect cards, challenge rivals and uncover mysteries in a blend of simulation, card strategy and retro horror.

5060740.name: Press Me Up
5060740.short_description: Press Me Up is a crazy hydraulic press simulator! Crush all kinds of objects, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and unlock even more powerful ways to flatten everything. Just don’t destroy the press!

5324610.name: Tile Former
5324610.short_description: Tile Former is a 1-bit puzzle game where the color palette dictates the mechanics. You need to transform the world in various ways and use the palettes at your disposal to solve the puzzles.

4492040.name: Restless Rites - Prologue
4492040.short_description: Experience the start of a tale about a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

4834110.name: RuinBlade
4834110.short_description: This is a small personal work. Please manage your expectations

5107550.name: Chase Buddies
5107550.short_description: Team up as four magical Runners or become the Chaser in a colorful 1v4 multiplayer game of pursuit, powers, and narrow escapes. Activate Obelisks, rescue your friends, outsmart your rival, and reach the exit before the chase is over.

5328980.name: Cosmos Knights - Abyss Survivors
5328980.short_description: Defend the worlds of the Gaia Empire against the threat of the Abyss in this pixel-art action survival roguelite. Battle hordes of creatures, combine powerful abilities, grow stronger with every run, and defeat formidable bosses.

4581800.name: Thalyn
4581800.short_description: Build a cosy world. Then step inside. Create cottages, gardens and places to stay, from above or in first person. Shape the atmosphere with simple choices, text or voice, wander through your creation, and export it as glTF to keep and share. No coding or 3D modelling needed.

5113890.name: 2in1
5113890.short_description: An asymmetrical co-op parkour adventure for two players sharing a single body: one controls and interacts with the environment, while the other sees platforms and guides them through puzzles. Solve puzzles together, progress to the end and get your lives back!

5395580.name: Gods & Liars
5395580.short_description: Gods & Liars is an 8-player social deduction game of faith, deception and survival. Hidden Heretics strike at night while the Priest and Inquisitor fight to expose them. Lie, accuse, deceive and survive — because when God is watching, no one can be trusted.

5115440.name: Duck Duck Shoot!
5115440.short_description: A top-down 2D Survivors-like where you play as a chicken! Face hordes of menacing poultry and collect powerful upgrades in an attempt to get stronger. Fight bosses, choose your own upgrades, and bring a couple together? Get ready to Duck Duck Shoot!

5084680.name: Sails of Salt
5084680.short_description: Take the helm in this atmospheric pirate roguelite. Explore uncharted seas, shape your crew's destiny and chase fortune through roaring broadsides. Capture ships for your fleet and build a lasting legacy. Will you risk it all for greed?

5045820.name: Click Start
5045820.short_description: Click Start is a branching visual novel with over 25 hours of story content about relationships, boundaries, and consequences. Meet four heroines and discover multiple endings—what matters is not only who you choose, but how you treat others along the way.

1388550.name: Human Fall Flat 2
1388550.short_description: Team up and let your creativity run wild in Human Fall Flat 2, the outrageous new sequel to the much-loved capers of everyone’s favourite physics-based human friends.

4936460.name: Mossvale
4936460.short_description: Mossvale is a small online fantasy RPG where you fight monsters, collect gear, complete quests, fish, cook, trade, and grow your character in a shared pixel world.

5376400.name: Steam & Steel
5376400.short_description: Add 16 railway and industrial jigsaw puzzles to Impression Cabinet. Assemble locomotives, bridges, rail yards, maps, technical drawings, and steelworks. Complete each Working Proof and file the finished print in a new album.

5100930.name: REOGUNA
5100930.short_description: Organize fragmented files and aim to clear the level in as few moves as possible. "REOGUNA" is a minimalist optimization puzzle game inspired by the classic disk defragmentation process.

4053860.name: Band of Crusaders Demo
4053860.short_description: Band of Crusaders is a dark medieval strategy RPG in which you become Grandmaster of a knightly order and lead it against a demonic invasion of Europe. Demo showcases all key game mechanics, which will be further expanded upon in the game release.

5006010.name: Risewards Demo
5006010.short_description: Solve tons of puzzles using logic, physics and (why not) by tricking the game itself. Sometimes the solution may be obvious to you, other times you'll need to think outside the box to progress, or maybe hack your own way to skip a puzzle. Just don't fall into the void... unless you should? ;)

5341150.name: MeowRig Demo
5341150.short_description:
MeowRig is a mining-themed incremental game.
Follow Me(ow) and search for Meow God's great treasure.

5393850.name: TRACE Demo
5393850.short_description: TRACE is a rhythm game combining arcade-style elements with the precision and competitiveness of PC rhythm games. Follow the music and experience the full energy of an arcade in the comfort of your own home!

3791920.name: Keep Chaos
3791920.short_description: Survive relentless hordes in full 3D! Keep Chaos is a fast-paced, third-person bullet-heaven roguelite. Play solo or team up with up to 4 players, master 8 distinct heroes, stack powerful upgrades, and fight to conquer the battlefield.

5063090.name: Mithril Demo
5063090.short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

5072370.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard Demo
5072370.short_description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

5103380.name: We Are Rebellion Demo
5103380.short_description:
WE ARE REBELLION is a strategy and simulation game in which you command a warship with a crew of rebels.

The game is set in the distant future, in a world that has been ravaged and polluted by capitalist corporations.

5114480.name: The Cup: Creature Card Battler Demo
5114480.short_description: The demo of The Cup, a free-to-play 1v1 creature card battler. Play THE ROAD: five cases against invasive species, back to back. Draft as you go, and a creature knocked out is gone for the road. Learn from the booth in one tutorial match, then take on the House. Plays fully offline.

5165600.name: Azure Striker Gunvolt Trilogy Enhanced - Additional mode "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX"
5165600.short_description: "Azure Striker Gunvolt GX" adds a new mode featuring Copen, protagonist of the spin-off Luminous Avenger iX 2, fighting alongside Gunvolt.

5181780.name: The Runesmith Demo
5181780.short_description: Explore ancient lands, gather rare materials, and forge powerful runes blessed by mighty gods. Craft, hunt, mine, and master the art of runesmithing: a fallen god’s path to reclaim his place among the divine.

5186750.name: Stars of Icarus Demo
5186750.short_description: From the creators of Guns of Icarus comes the ultimate spaceship PvP experience. In the forgotten arenas of space, communication with your crew is key. Form your team and pilot, repair, and man the guns on your ship. Victory or death, together.

5307340.name: MVX: London Demo
5307340.short_description: Save London in a shared-world co-op shooter set in a 1:1 recreation of the city. Battle creatures with real-world weapons and mysterious Flux powers.

5341070.name: THE WRONG WAY
5341070.short_description: The Wrong Way is a psychological horror experience about a camping trip that takes a dark turn when one friend drives home alone and ends up on a road he was never supposed to be on. Sometimes the most dangerous places are the ones you stumble into by accident.

5365790.name: Impression Cabinet
5365790.short_description: Jigsaw puzzles at a print workshop table. Assemble 24 archival and original prints with distinct piece cuts, free rotation, and room to build off the board. Finish each Working Proof to reveal the completed print, then file it in your Cabinet. Selected prints offer a Second Look challenge.

4654720.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar Demo
4654720.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

5004350.name: RV Life Sim Demo
5004350.short_description: Drive, customize, and live in your camper as you explore an open world full of adventure.

3839750.name: Skingdom Demo
3839750.short_description: Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!

3876140.name: SUPERPANEL DEMO
3876140.short_description: SUPERPANEL is a hardcore tactical shooter with high lethality for solo players or groups of friends. Customize your gear and squads, take on dangerous missions through urban labyrinths, and fight your way to the heart of Megaslavia. Enemies are both humans and monsters.

3989510.name: Rune Dice Demo
3989510.short_description: Tactical deckbuilding in bite-sized sessions. Launch dice to create magical chain reactions. Choose from distinct hero classes with unique abilities. Build synergies between dice, relics, and runes to defeat challenging bosses.

4100940.name: Poppy Playtime - Chapter 5
4100940.short_description: In the latest terrifying chapter of the Poppy Playtime saga, you are propelled further into the gruesome depths of the factory, with Playtime’s security system Huggy Wuggy in hot pursuit.

3820720.name: Wasteland Bites Demo
3820720.short_description: Wasteland Bites is a horror-based food truck sim. Cooking up questionable cuisine in your post-apocalyptic food truck is tough. Fending off mutants, UFOs, rabid dogs, and things lurking in the dark? That's the real challenge. A chaotic mix of cooking and survival in a long gone world.

4971470.name: Soliton Burst Demo
4971470.short_description: Every music track builds a different battlefield: its own guardian, and a fight where your weapons fire in time with it. Play along with Spotify, YouTube or any app on your PC (Windows), or with your own music files. No audio information leaves your PC. What will your favourite track create?

3350770.name: Kaiju Princess 2 Artbook
3350770.short_description: Dive into the Kaiju Princess 2 art book and uncover the secrets behind its character designs, planetary aesthetics, and interstellar feasts!

3502620.name: DEMONS' NIGHT FEVER
3502620.short_description: Enemies? Allies? Kill Kill Kill! The more you die, the stronger you become! Raising RTA Simulation RPG has arrived! Exhaust all forms of evil by fighting with the brutal Peon Exploitation System!

3514830.name: Moorhuhn Kart 4 Demo
3514830.short_description: The world's craziest chicken is heading back to the racetrack!  Wacky characters, cool tracks and karts, and zany items await in a worldwide online battle for first place!

3678170.name: Don't Fool Me, Beauties! Demo
3678170.short_description: "Get out!!!" Kicked out in the dead of winter, you land a job at a shady hotel. But work’s not the only challenge, there’s the CEO’s cold-hearted granddaughter, a lazy senior, a diva model, and your childhood friend who makes you do her laundry?! Which captivating woman will you win over?

3199630.name: Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II Soundtrack
3199630.short_description: Sink deep into the world of Senua’s Saga: Hellblade II with the Original Soundtrack. Composed by the award-winning David Garcia Diaz (Audio Director on the game), and a host of exciting collaborators.

2717700.name: SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! - Season Pass
2717700.short_description: Continue your Snow Day adventure with a Season Pass for SOUTH PARK: SNOW DAY! which includes and all-new Game Mode, New Weapons, a Weapon Variation, and Cosmetic Packs.

4528520.name: Scarlet Beret - Murder at the Orphanage
4528520.short_description: Fabienne a 17-year-old genius, has a rare gift: she detects lies! But when she discovers the body of one of her teachers, she’s left with no choice but to uncover the killer among the residents she’s lived with her entire life.

2298430.name: American Truck Simulator - Kansas
2298430.short_description: Introducing Kansas! A U.S State that is home to a truly authentic cowboy culture and miles of land littered with wildflowers. Located in the Midwest of the USA, Kansas is known for its native grasslands, streams, abundant blue skies, and green grassland vistas.

5248290.name: Roomy
5248290.short_description: Roomy is a customizable 3D avatar room sandbox for creating scenes, posing characters, decorating spaces, taking virtual photos, and exploring interactive environments. Customize rooms, avatars, cameras, weather, lighting, furniture, animations, and more, with support for mods and custom content.

1828210.name: Requiem Of Science
1828210.short_description: Requiem Of Science is a free modification for Half-Life 2: Episode 2. The key features are the eclectic level design, unusual storytelling and the madness of the developer.

5478590.name: First Person Basketball
5478590.short_description: First-person online basketball, from 1v1 to 5v5. Drive past defenders, find an open teammate, or finish at the rim. Simple controls: just WASD, Space and the mouse. Play with friends, challenge the AI, or practice your shot.

1182000.name: Batman Noir
1182000.short_description: Batman - The Telltale Series Shadows Mode brings a captivating new look to the storied Telltale Batman games. Enhanced with hand recolored gameplay and remastered textures, replay your favorite Telltale Batman episodes and experience the twisted world of the Dark Knight in a sinister, new way.

981590.name: VZX Player
981590.short_description: Actively developed 3D Music Visualizer - reacts in real time to the music you play, regardless of player. Free, no watermarks, no nag screens, no subscriptions. Optional DLC for more effects.

2934750.name: Brewalmighty
2934750.short_description: Turn a bucket in a garden shed into the only brewery in town. Brew, bottle and sell door to door, sabotage the lager monopoly, rob the competition and outrun the consequences, alone or with mates who are, legally speaking, "volunteers". Nice garage.

624622.name: Wolfenstein II: The Freedom Chronicles - Episode 3
624622.short_description: Gun down Nazi enemies as US Army Captain Gerald Wilkins! On the run since the Nazi war machine leveled Manhattan with an atom bomb, Wilkins returns home to reunite with an old comrade and dismantle the deadliest weapon ever made: the Sun Gun.

5231490.name: Bloom Above: Wanderisles
