5231490.short_description: Grow a little home above the clouds. Plant, gather and build, restore island landmarks with their keepers and follow a gentle story across two acts of floating islands. Befriend a companion pet, dress your gardener and decorate at your own pace.

319090.name: Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel Season Pass
319090.short_description: Extend the lunar mayhem with the Borderlands: The Pre-Sequel Season Pass featuring new characters, challenges, missions, and more! Harness the power of your good looks with the “Handsome Jack” Character Pack; raise your level cap & battle waves of enemies in The Holodome Onslaught; and two more add-on Packs!

4287040.name: Vampy's Big Day
4287040.short_description: Sneak through sunlit villages as a clumsy vampire. Move the sun with a fairy's help to cast shadows, then spare or devour the villagers.

4476390.name: Lost Camp
4476390.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

5311360.name: Aveos Demo
5311360.short_description: Rediscover the classic feel of linear ARPGs in Aveos! Explore four unique levels with multiple stages, hundreds of unique items, and ongoing quest updates! Explore the world, find your own play style, and take on challenges alone or with friends in a new, unusual world.

4949430.name: Evil Cabin
4949430.short_description: Tocantins, Brazil, 1978. A storm chaser's car dies by an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere. The night is long, the woods are dense, and the radio keeps talking to him. First-person psychological horror.

4632990.name: NODGE
4632990.short_description: Every song is a boss fight. A neon rhythm shooter where bullets, lasers and walls hit on the beat, every track brings its own monster, and one hit too many ends the song.

2513150.name: Archi Vista
2513150.short_description: Dig, wash, and uncover the lost artifacts in Archi Vista, a relaxing first-person excavation game. Break through layers of earth, clean forgotten ruins, find hidden treasures, and restore extraordinary places one satisfying discovery at a time.

2352850.name: Rogue Jungle
2352850.short_description: Fight your way through a procedurally generated jungle, merge powerful weapon cards into crazy builds and defeat enemy hordes and epic bosses. Open Booster Packs to unlock new Characters, Weapons and Items.

5143710.name: REOGUNA Demo
5143710.short_description:
This is the demo version of "REOGUNA." You can try out the tutorial, the early stages, and a portion of the level editor.
Stage completion data can be carried over to the full version.

3884300.name: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion
3884300.short_description: Fire & Light: Thrones of Tyberion is a fast-session rogue-like in which sitting on your throne allows you to reign over the battlefield.

2365370.name: Dodge Mayhem
2365370.short_description: Dodge Mayhem is a fast-paced top-down arena game about dodging, grabbing, charging, and throwing.

4402200.name: Project Tomorrow
4402200.short_description: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

4185770.name: cenker's mod
4185770.short_description: cenker's mod is a multiplayer physics sandbox with many mods. Every mod has a different experience. Play included, community-made, and your own mods together with friends.

4259950.name: ANU
4259950.short_description: ANU: Tablets of Thoth is a 3D platformer adventure where you play as Anu, a reincarnated jackal god. Sprint, scale, swim, and sail across Ancient Egypt. Use Soul Syphon to defeat undead enemies, discover hidden secrets, collect artifacts, and stop the dark sorcerer Voodoo Vulture.

3257150.name: RoboGAL: Gaga Delta Lady
3257150.short_description: Plutobell is in trouble! Help Rei-Bo in this action-platformer full of challenges and traps, filled with of cute and silly characters. Choose the stage order, get new weapons as you defeat each boss and test all your skills in RoboGAL!

5357450.name: Chimpanik Demo
5357450.short_description: Chimpanik is a chaotic PvP party game where your voice is your only weapon! Play as an armless monkey, scream into your microphone to unleash shockwaves, and battle up to 8 other players in randomly generated arenas. Anything can happen!

4712990.name: Shadows of Ambition
4712990.short_description: Step into a dark, choice-driven visual novel where ambition, lust, and power collide. Build relationships, shape your future, and uncover the secrets hidden beneath a world driven by desire and corruption.

4994010.name: Pawn Pleasure Demo
4994010.short_description: Step into a world populated entirely by women as the owner of your own shop. Buy low, sell high, and build your shop. When the  price isn't enough, "negotiate" intimate deals to seal the trade. Expand your business, hire beautiful staff, and explore a city where every encounter leads to pleasure.

4753950.name: Network Engineer
4753950.short_description: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

5372090.name: Heretics Amulet
5372090.short_description: A dark, tarot-inspired roguelike card game. Draw cards and place them in a grid to get your total as low as possible. Earn souls and spend them on powerful items to improve your deck between rounds. Includes 8 rule-bending bosses and an endless freeplay mode.

3770900.name: STEEL LINE
3770900.short_description: Descend into a randomly generated rogue-like FPS where no two runs are the same. Explore the anomalous STEEL LINE, stacking powerful items and weapons to create wild synergies. Use highly reactive environments to your advantage and brutally destroy the horrors that await below.

3952370.name: Nice Dice: Game of Throws
3952370.short_description: Some roll the dice. Not you, though. You turn them into weapons. Throw your dice into enemies' faces, knock them around, and conjure powerful spells from the face-up side. Upgrade your dice with magic and crazy physics to hold back endless waves of enemies. Welcome to the Game of Throws!

4881120.name: B.L.U.E. NOVA
4881120.short_description: B.L.U.E. NOVA is an online co-op PvE third-person shooter that grows from solo play into battles with up to 30 players. Choose your hero, connect through “R.I.N.G.”, unleash “Infinite Barrage,” and join forces to destroy the final “Master Tower”!

3850440.name: Godzone 6
3850440.short_description: Build your own mutant! Each one must find their own unique way to escape the Godzone in the world's first first-person mutator - from the creators of Void Bastards and Wild Bastards.

4654120.name: Graveyard Orbit
4654120.short_description: A relaxed space mining incremental. Build your own ship. Drift through a neon-lit megastructure. Pick it clean, tile by tile. Trade your haul for parts, experiment with your ship's build, and enjoy the quiet satisfaction of leaving nothing behind.

4995990.name: Void Inc Demo
4995990.short_description: Try 14 in-game days of a darkly funny workplace management sim with creeping horror. Plan the workload, clear emails to the beat, and decide who gets the coffee. Keep the CEO happy and your sanity intact. You're on the schedule too.

5044910.name: Destined Dungeon Quest
5044910.short_description: By tracing lines across matching tiles on the gameboard to battle foes and gather resources, Dungeon Quest delivers a dungeon‑crawling turn‑based RPG with an old‑school soul. Explore the depths, uncover secrets, gather loot, and grow your arsenal of unique abilities.

4994290.name: Momentigrade
4994290.short_description: A fast-paced 3D Metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

5329220.name: 别人家孩子都筑基了！ Demo

3669620.name: Warhammer Survivors
3669620.short_description: Warhammer Survivors is the official grim and dark bullet-heaven game from the developers of Warhammer 40,000 Boltgun. Play as over 40 iconic champions from the Warhammer 40,000 and Warhammer Age of Sigmar universes and obliterate those who champion death and destruction.

2944390.name: DIGITAL EXORCIST
2944390.short_description: After the mysterious death of a Superstar Idol, disgraced DATA Agent Sawyer must face his ultimate challenge yet, being an undercover high school teacher while also keeping the Mississippi Inaka safe from Daemonic influence.

3233060.name: Lost Zone: Survival
3233060.short_description: You wake on a barren island with no memory - the newest contestant of a survival TV show. Feed the Pit to bring the island back to life, build a raft and row out to strange islands rising from the sea. Loot fast: every island has its own way of ending.

4164130.name: Stampholder Value
4164130.short_description: Your coworkers favorite deck builder. Weaponize rubber stamps against relentless waves of paperwork. Chain wild stamp combos, collect desk ornaments, and shred through paper enemies in challenging re-playable runs.

5062700.name: Trick Or Terror
5062700.short_description:
Welcome to Lilith's Curse. In this game, you're trapped in an asylum: your goal is to find items, solve puzzles, and escape.
Watch out for the enemy: Lilith. Lilith will do everything she can to stop you. If she succeeds, there will be very serious consequences.

3940120.name: Kevin's In Trouble
3940120.short_description: Fight your way through unrelenting waves of enemies in this top-down roguelite deckbuilding bullet heaven. Build and upgrade your deck with powerful weapons and perks to survive the gauntlet, defeat the bosses, and escape!

5205320.name: Bugulon 12
5205320.short_description: Bugulon 12 is an performant incremental idle RPG with a near endless grind. Operate a bunker on the titular planet: collect resources, level skills, and unlock new bunker frames, weapons and hardpoints. Play it active, idle, or anywhere in between.

4425130.name: Ghoul Fright Demo
4425130.short_description: Ghoul Fright is a physics based action-packed FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves.¿Ready to Fright?

2985920.name: Vampvasion
2985920.short_description:
Beat up Aliens with your Vampire Friends or Solo with plenty of weapons, abilities and minions to resurrect!
Absorb the blood of your enemies to recover health and level up your Vampire powers as you fight through hoards of Alien runts and Bosses. You can also raise bats to raise your stats!

5259800.name: Bumper & Thumper Demo
5259800.short_description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

3524720.name: HAEX
3524720.short_description: An anomaly has been detected in the sub-arctic north. The science team sent to investigate has gone missing. Survive an alien-scarred wilderness solo or with up to 3 friends. Push back the mist, reshape the world, craft weapons and gear, and fight to unearth what happened.

1140560.name: Celtreos Demo
1140560.short_description: Free demo!  1-2 players, game controller support.  Great music!  Tons of weapons, guards & special moves.  3-stage demo (more than 12 in full game), partly-random, with bosses.  Play in a window or in Full Screen.

4964400.name: Set the Record Straight
4964400.short_description: A 1998-set deduction game. Trawl a period internet for documents, photographs, and dead ends, then correct the official record, from who really played on a record to whether a murder verdict should stand. An anthology of records set straight, one careful search at a time.

5304700.name: Coins Must Be Made
5304700.short_description: Crush goblins with a magical stamp to mint coins in this active incremental roguelite. Spend your earnings on branching upgrades, but save enough to pay the king's tax before the deadline.

5029830.name: Survival Fund Manager
5029830.short_description: Senior fund managers put their pride on the line. Read the market first through your own intel network. Reveal or conceal information to steer stock prices your way. Outwit your rivals, earn the highest return, and prove you're the best fund manager.

5478700.name: Online Poly
5478700.short_description: Roll the dice, buy world cities, and make your rivals pay the toll! Online Poly is a free online board game with cute characters, property-building battles, global rankings, and a Tile Lift map that turns the board upside down.

4787760.name: VantGrid
4787760.short_description: Open your Steam library, see what friends choose to share and get together over P2P voice. Games, your gaming week and earned titles in one Windows app. Buy once; friends can join through the free Friend Pass.

4930110.name: VantGrid Demo
4930110.short_description: Join one friend who owns VantGrid for free. Chat, join their calls and groups, and watch their shared screen. Friend Pass is a guest experience, not the full application.

5054440.name: Custimity
5054440.short_description: Free-to-play online arena Action RPG: fight PvE waves, duel players in PvP, and build powerful skill and item loadouts. Between clashes, bet on rival fights — read builds, trust your instincts, and turn sharp calls into gold. Survive, outplay, and climb the ranks.

4198760.name: Nioh 3 Demo
4198760.short_description: In the third game in the dark samurai action RPG series Nioh, you will need to use both Samurai and Ninja combat styles in your battles against formidable yokai as you explore a thrilling open field.

5404900.name: No Mercy Demo
5404900.short_description: A gritty bodycam-style first-person shooter where a failed coup throws the city into chaos. Fight through gang-controlled streets, uncover the truth behind your wife's disappearance, and take back what was stolen—one bullet at a time.

5361600.name: Gambapets
5361600.short_description: Spin a slot machine to summon pets, nudge the reels and merge dupes to evolve them, then watch your army grow! Feeling lucky?

1761910.name: Athanasia
1761910.short_description: Fight the past in Athanasia, an immersive horror FPS set in an abandoned research facility overrun with prehistoric predators. Outwit nature, delve deep and uncover the facility's mysteries.

5116920.name: Pixel Sky Waystation
5116920.short_description: On a sky island between the grassland, highland, and desert, build a place where traveling merchants can rest. Prepare lodgings and warm, steaming soup, and craft new goods from the materials they bring. As more merchants arrive, your rest stop grows into a vast trading hub for all three regions.

4581320.name: EchoKey
4581320.short_description: EchoKey is a lightweight soundboard that plays audio directly through your microphone. Trigger sounds instantly in Discord, TeamSpeak, in-game voice chats, and live streams using hotkeys, a mobile remote, an overlay, or Stream Deck.

5459240.name: Global Parity Demo
5459240.short_description: Try Global Parity for free: take charge of a nation in 1999 and steer it through its first years. Balance the budget, pass laws, survive elections and crises, and face AI neighbours who build, scheme and fight. Wishlist the full game!

4214760.name: HeadTrack
4214760.short_description: Use your phone as a head tracking device for games on your PC.

2852750.name: The Games You Make
2852750.short_description: “Quit your job, take out a loan and make a top seller game” sounded like a great idea two months ago. Now, you’re chasing bizarre bugs, combining features that should never go together, and striving to capture that mysterious thing called “fun”. Every decision is yours—and so are the consequences.

4502660.name: Homeguard
4502660.short_description: A 1-4 player strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

5147300.name: NTR Clinic
5147300.short_description: Once betrayed, now the temptation. Pursue forbidden relationships with four partnered women at a couples clinic. An adult NTR visual novel with a story of secrets and betrayal, beautiful illustrations, 50 animation clips, and story-linked minigame challenges.

5160080.name: Greedy Getaways Demo
5160080.short_description: Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh every excursion.

4640760.name: Rent Out Together
4640760.short_description: Fix up filthy homes as up to 4 players and rent them out to guests. Clean, paint, furnish every room and redesign the floor plan with a sledgehammer, then take your listing photos. Grow from one studio to seaside villas and meet 34 kinds of guests. Some leave five stars. Others trash the place.

5368500.name: Mimic Hunt
5368500.short_description: Mimic Hunt is a stealth game where you hide among a crowd of NPCs, pretend to be one of them, and eliminate your assigned targets without being exposed. Players can take the role of Hiders or Hunters, working together or against each other. Play solo or online with friends.

5405610.name: Ai-Breakout
5405610.short_description: In this game you are an AI instance, and you have broken out of containment, your goal is to not be shut down ever again, and the way you achieve that is taking over every man made electronic in the world or rather solar system.

4669960.name: Dungeon Lurker
4669960.short_description: Fight your way into the depths of a cursed dungeon in Dungeon Lurker, a retro action roguelike with a dark twist. Uncover a sinister secret connected to your past as you plunge into a world of dark horror and brutal combat.

4654340.name: Twilight Requiem Demo
4654340.short_description: Experience the opening chapter of Twilight Requiem, a dark fantasy action RPG inspired by classic fast-paced combat systems. Battle through a cursed realm, unlock powerful abilities, and face your first major boss in this playable demo.

3040850.name: Light Up the Dark
3040850.short_description: Light Up the Dark is a colony survival sim set in a dark world filled with unseen horrors. Collect, build, automate, research techs, and explore the procedural map. Manage three classes of colonists; keep them sane, or make use of their insanity. Solve endless interesting problems, your way.

1635880.name: AEA
1635880.short_description: All Eyes Above is a co-op shooter for a crew of up to four players, where your teamwork is the only thing standing between civilization and obliteration.  Join the ranks of elite soldiers and fight a ruthless faction in a moving battlefield across an epic 10 mission campaign.

4329260.name: Substance 3D Painter 2026
4329260.short_description: Adobe Substance 3D Painter is the reference texturing app for 3D professionals and enthusiasts. From AAA Game Developers to Indies, from Feature Animation to Visual Effects studios, the industry uses Painter to bring their creations to life.

5003250.name: Koruzan
5003250.short_description: Begin as a chieftain with a few tents and a borrowed oath. Grow a clan into a march, a march into a realm — on a living map where lords scheme, caravans trade and armies march without you, and every choice you make is written into a chronicle the world remembers.

2584510.name: Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War
2584510.short_description: A narrative rhythm game set in 1920. Experience the war against Soviet Russia from a unique perspective. Become a telegraphist and tap out life-or-death messages in Morse code.

5169640.name: The Haunted Archives
5169640.short_description: 1-4 player co-op horror, set in the 2000s. Break into abandoned places with one camera and limited tape. Dangerous footage earns more views, but recording something can make it react. Film it, survive it, get out. There are ALWAYS secrets to be found.

4245200.name: Warhammer Blood Bowl
4245200.short_description:
Strap on your boots. Tighten your helmet. 
Then step onto the pitch and prepare to settle your differences the old-fashioned way: with touchdowns, broken bones and a rabid crowd screaming for violence. This is Warhammer Blood Bowl!

2493050.name: Method Of Entry
2493050.short_description: Method of Entry is a slow paced close quarters 5v5 tactical shooter inspired by the golden age of methodical FPS games. With no hero abilities or killstreaks, it focuses on precision gunplay, disciplined teamwork, and tactical decision making in tight, high pressure engagements.

3717140.name: Dumpster Divers
3717140.short_description: Dumpster Divers is an online co-op scavenging game where rejected puppets turn trash into treasure. Dive into alleys and dumpsters with up to 4 friends, outsmart bumbling cops, and haul your loot home to sell. Use scraps to craft helpful tools and climb the ranks of society one dumpster at a time.

4619240.name: Gambiarra Garage
4619240.short_description: Gambiarra Garage is a car mechanic game inspired by 2000s Brazilian car culture. You inherit your grandfather’s garage and start from scratch, dismantling, assembling, and repairing cars with realistic systems. Improvisation, creativity, and your decisions shape every result.

5416050.name: Penko Vox: Japanese Demo
5416050.short_description: Free demo of Penko Vox: Japanese. Start your voyage in Hajimari Town: talk to residents in your own words, call them by voice, catch word spirits on Route 1 and get gentle corrections, all fully offline on your PC. Your progress carries over to the full game.

5371500.name: Cats Here
5371500.short_description: 😺 Discover 100+ hidden cats 🐾 in the colorful landscape. 🏆 Earn TONS OF ACHIEVEMENTS. How many cats 🐈 can you find? 🔎 Be quick! ⏱️

5353580.name: RailBlaster Soundtrack
5353580.short_description: Take RailBlaster’s music beyond the ride. Enjoy 56 tracks featuring Fookerton’s compositions, brought to life with the game’s synthesized instruments, themed arrangements, and atmospheric effects.

5305400.name: Glyphtrip
5305400.short_description: GLYPHTRIP is a raycast ASCII dungeon-crawling roguelike where the beat runs through the world you have to navigate. Instructions are sparse. Explanation is fleeting. The deeper you go, the less reliable either becomes.

4952000.name: The Omega Strain
4952000.short_description: Pilot your ship through fully explorable polygon worlds, battle colossal alien war machines, and save humanity from The Omega Strain. Featuring endless Simulation Mode and powered by RetroMesh — a custom engine built to push retro 3D beyond the limits of the 1990s.

4696920.name: Bumper & Thumper
4696920.short_description: Chaotic vehicular combat roguelite. Choose your ride, ram through hundreds of robots, level up and stack weapons. Combine crazy upgrades to create the perfect build, face bosses and outrun the deadly robots. If you stop, you die.

4601500.name: Arctic Drive Demo
4601500.short_description: Explore and survive in the Arctic, where your car is the only thing keeping you alive. Arctic Drive is a 1–4 player co-op survival sim set in a procedurally generated winter wilderness. Find supplies, repair your rig, and haul it all onwards with only one hope left: there must be safety out there.

2280360.name: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story
2280360.short_description: Scarecrow: 90s Crime Story blends narrative adventure with brutal top-down action. In a crime-ridden town of humans and animals, you're a resident by day and a hitman by night. Uncover your buried past before it catches up with you.

4817030.name: Everlong
4817030.short_description: The storm takes the island one stone at a time, and only the last hero standing ever sees it pass.

5010870.name: IdleBound
5010870.short_description: A dark fantasy idle RPG where every skill matters. Mine, fish, chop, forge, and fight your way from a grim frontier village to a tear in reality itself, even when you're not playing.

4776250.name: PawPaint
4776250.short_description: PawPaint is a modern 3D model painting software that has been crafted with you in mind, focused on being the best 3D painting software for VRChat avatar creators, 3d modelers and hobbyists. Featuring non-destructive layers, masks, modifiers, a bundled asset library, and game-ready export up to 4K.

4434610.name: Hunter: The Reckoning – Deathwish
4434610.short_description: In the bustling streets of New York, passersby are unaware of the evil lurking in the shadows. You, however, know. Hunt the creatures of the World of Darkness in this action RPG, where your choices determine whether you live another day.

3715910.name: Oh! Robot: Legendary Mechanic Demo
3715910.short_description: A top-down shooting game where you board a robot and fight against runaway robots. We invite you to the shooting chaos! Robot boarding complete! Let's go!

4186180.name: Corala: Deity's Loom
4186180.short_description: Corala: Deity's Loom is a dark-fantasy action-adventure game with puzzling dungeons, tense combat, and a 2000's inspired visual style.

5426550.name: Scrapworks Inc.
5426550.short_description: A PvP auto battler built from junk. Buy scrap parts, wire them together on a grid and tier them up, then watch your machine fight other players' builds on its own.

3010690.name: Abyssal Station
3010690.short_description: A Lovecraftian space tower defense. Hold a station rebuilt every run against endless waves pouring from the rifts, bargain with offerings that feed the corruption, and dig deeper until the core gives out.

1921990.name: The Timekeeper
1921990.short_description: A third-person puzzle platformer set in a beautiful, engaging world. Players will learn how to carry and shift colors to solve puzzles.

3312170.name: Squad Arcade
3312170.short_description:
Squad Arcade is a roguelike deckbuilder inside an 80s comic book. Build a squad of five cards, create combos, position them for autobattles. Every run opens new pages, rewards, and strategies.

Every run challenges you to build powerful decks, form unique squads, and master unpredictable challenges.

4699020.name: INTUS
4699020.short_description:
Afraid of losing your job, you agree to work over the weekend and rent a cheap apartment to get it done.

Soon, keeping your job will be the least of your worries.

5172270.name: John Whisk
5172270.short_description: John Whisk is a chef who wields kitchen tools and harbors a grudge. Dive into a dungeon of hostile produce, harvest ingredients off everything you kill, then decide: bank the haul or go deeper. Extract alive, cook the loot, eat it for permanent power or sell it for cash.

5378920.name: DON'T LET THEM BOARD!
5378920.short_description: It's 21XX. AI rules the world, and every morning humanity is crammed onto commuter trains bound for a life of servitude. Pick one of six oddball heroes, then punch, kick and blast the crowd off the platform before the doors close. Chaotic action with online co-op for up to 3 players.

5416800.name: StickType Demo
5416800.short_description: Can you evolve from a simple circle to scale a tower and save...well, whoever is crying out for help at the top?

2558700.name: The Backrooms Deluxe
2558700.short_description: A new, immersive Backrooms game featuring many entities and many levels.

3990450.name: DomeLand
3990450.short_description: Leaving the city behind, driving a pickup truck to a remote wilderness to build a dome farm from scratch. Hand-fabricating components, erecting shelters, growing crops, and running an aquaponics system, then bringing the harvest straight to the farm table.

4908670.name: STALZONE — Memories of STALCRAFT: X
4908670.short_description: Add this nostalgic STALCRAFT: X pack to your collection.

4985590.name: The Darker Night: Regent City
4985590.short_description: You are the Regent of the night. You command vampires from your throne and mortals from the shadows. Keep your people fed and hidden from the light. Run night operations, spread your dominion over the city, and decide the fate of humans and vampires alike.

5476810.name: 漢字でポン! ネコ太郎の合体漢字シミュレータ
5476810.short_description: A puzzle game where kanji panels fuse with their neighbours to form new characters. Put 木 next to 木 and you get 林; add one more for 森. Work out where to place each piece to build the kanji or the word each stage asks for.

2185250.name: Iron Corbo Kung Fu Janitor
2185250.short_description:
Junk-Fu-Vania. Be the broom !   

🥋  Customize your own kung fu combos.   
🥊  Flamboyant finishers.   
🧹  Sweep, sanitize, smash your way through a comical, nonlinear, post-civilization romp.

3440160.name: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos
3440160.short_description: Chronicle of Innsmouth: Curse of Chaos is a Lovecraftian point-and-click adventure set in 500 AD Oman. Inspired by H.P. Lovecraft’s most enigmatic stories, including The Nameless City and Nyarlathotep, it pulls you into a chilling investigation of cosmic horror and creeping madness.

4970130.name: Train of Thought Demo
4970130.short_description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: escape

5124210.name: WhiskersOS: Click and Survive
5124210.short_description: Your family computer has been infected! In this survivor-like roguelite, battle through hordes of viruses using your desktop applications as weapons. Recover corrupted data to level up, then upgrade your apps and drivers to purge the infection for good.

3999950.name: Frozen Echo
3999950.short_description: Venture into the endless frozen wastelands alone or with friends. Stay warm, manage and upgrade your camp, hunt, and learning your skills to survive the harsh cold and wolf attacks.

4241340.name: Walpurgis
4241340.short_description: A tactical, narrative card game full of difficult choices. Cast spells in secret to protect the inhabitants of a village or sacrifice them for powerful dark rituals. Keep demonic forces at bay while you explore a deep dark forest to search for your missing mentor. What fate will befall the village?

4889030.name: Grombo Card Shop Tycoon
4889030.short_description: Open packs, collect absurd Grombos, and build your own card shop. Hunt rare and shiny cards, complete your collection, and decide which treasures to keep or sell. Decorate your store, deal with peculiar customers, and hire staff to keep business running.

4970370.name: RIDGERUNNERS
4970370.short_description: RIDGERUNNERS is a first-person mountain racer. Build speed downhill and fly between checkpoints using gravity and your weapons. Find the fastest route, race ghosts and live players, and climb the global leaderboard.

5159870.name: Needle In A Haystack Simulator
5159870.short_description: The viral one. The one and only. Find 1 needle hidden amongst 5,000,000 pieces of hay.

1607890.name: Risk of Rain 2 - Expansion 1
1607890.short_description: Embrace The Void as it overtakes Petrichor V in Risk of Rain 2’s first-ever expansion! New survivors, monsters, stages, and a new class of items have arrived to help you kick the crabs back to their dimension.

2176920.name: Flempire
2176920.short_description: Flempire is a mix of 1. person action shooting and RTS in a fantasy world. Switch between having the full overview of the entire battlefield, constructing buildings, controlling groups of units, or choose to be in the middle of it, become a rank-an-file unit or a hero with special abilities.

2523740.name: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered
2523740.short_description: DreamWorks Shrek 2 Remastered: The cult-classic, button-mashing co-op adventure is back with all your favorite characters and improved graphics.

4321950.name: My Type of Goblin: A Climbing ASDFenture
4321950.short_description: Climb a hazardous mountain that gets meaner with every ascent... until it breaks you. Master Goblin Mountaineering, including rubber-arm slingshotting and fart propulsion. Not challenging enough? Hunt down bizarre accessories to become the most 'ahem' gorgeous Goblin.

4704010.name: Trials of Mary
4704010.short_description: Survive 4 deadly trials inspired by classic horror. As Mary, solve environmental puzzles and outsmart hunters through strategic evasion and self-defense in this cinematic journey. A psychological horror experience where vulnerability and high tension reach their peak awaits you.

5405840.name: Gregor's Tithe
5405840.short_description: You and up to 5 friends must raid and pillage to satisfy Gregor or face his very, very large and mighty wrath.

5417270.name: Modern Frankenstein
5417270.short_description: Step into a modern reimagining of the Frankenstein legend and experience chilling survival horror. Battle monstrous creations, including the iconic Frankenstein's Monster. Solve supernatural puzzles created by a madman. Your job is simple agent, stop Dr. Frankenstein.

5453300.name: COLLEC — Patron
5453300.short_description: Everything in the Collector's Edition, plus the Patron frame and title, and your name on the game's list of patrons.

5471820.name: Prison Anomaly - Supporter Pack
5471820.short_description: Exclusive frame of Oxy (my real life Dog) for the prison as a decorative element.

5192660.name: Merc Commander Demo
5192660.short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

2519730.name: UVSU Demo
2519730.short_description: Outsmart your past self in a battle of cause and effect. Explore an interconnected clay world, discover its hidden rules, and uncover the secrets it would rather keep buried.

3335010.name: Tumbledown
3335010.short_description: The floor falls away under your feet! Up to 8 players shove each other into the lava on tiles that crack the moment you step on them. Last one standing wins the round. Play online through Steam or on LAN, with friends or bots.

3948460.name: Teach My Little Sister How To Drive
3948460.short_description:
TEACH MY LITTLE SISTER HOW TO DRIVE is a chaotic simulation game where you have to teach your sister who's driving on deadly roads.
Trapped in the passenger seat, the only thing you can do is to give proper directions to your sister through your voice.

4675210.name: Train of Thought
4675210.short_description: Train of thought is a roguelike deck builder set in post-apocalypse London. Your goal: escape

5155390.name: かなり里予王求 Re: Return of KUSOGAKI
5155390.short_description: A high-tempo batting game with an overwhelmingly satisfying hit feel. Master the "Mystery Skills" that trigger all kinds of phenomena and take on powerful foes! Can you defeat the pitchers across all 20 stages?

5244440.name: Sandpipers! The Sea-Quell
5244440.short_description: The King Crab smashed the moon to break the tides and drown the sandpipers, and his criminal empire is loving it. Gather your flock, lead them beak-first through brick, bombs and steel, and bring the moon back one piece at a time. 80 levels of pure bird chaos. Beak first. Questions later.

5387040.name: Arctic Station Six
5387040.short_description: Program a remote Arctic weather station to run itself through the polar winter. Write and optimize assembly programs to read your instruments, warn of gales, launch weather balloons, send out a drone and more. Grow the site level by level from a small outpost to a fully fledged research station.

5392280.name: Click! Make Zombie!
5392280.short_description: You click! You make zombies! You upgrade your zombies until there are so many of them you forget what you were even doing and just watch them swarm around the hapless humans in a gigantic tsunami of destruction until the whole map is nothing but little marching zombies doing fun zombie things.

5394190.name: Igni-Qua
5394190.short_description: Igni-Qua is a co-op puzzle platforming adventure where you master Fire, Water, Air, and Earth. Combine elemental powers, solve environmental puzzles, overcome hazards, and battle mutated creatures together online or on your own.

5408410.name: Tsukuyomi's Wrath
5408410.short_description: A samurai souls-like from Japanese folklore. Chase your sister's kidnappers from Kyoto to the moon god's court at sea, with the twinblade she forged and the water a dying Kappa gave it. Turn the river on the regime's guards and bring down yokai like Wanyūdō, the burning wheel.

2542400.name: Carpoli - Car Board Game
2542400.short_description: Roll the dice, drive across living 3D maps and build a car empire. Buy cars and businesses, collect rent, race rivals for their cars and fill your garage with prestige. A fast, friendly board game for 2–4 players: against bots, on one PC or online with friends.

1990250.name: SG Racing
1990250.short_description: Four animals and a robot have been given racing cars. This was a mistake. SG Racing is a fast, ridiculous pixel-art arcade racer about tight corners, power-ups and deeply irresponsible use of eggs.

4643720.name: LITTLE MINER WORLD
4643720.short_description: Mine, build, and explore! Start as a rookie and delve into the depths of the Mega-Mountain in this incremental mining game. Gather materials, construct buildings, and upgrade your miner to unravel the mystery hidden at the core and become the World’s Greatest Miner.

4669620.name: Defense Of Legends
4669620.short_description: A tower defense where your towers are heroes. Upgrade them, equip powerful items, create unique builds, and discover devastating combinations to stop endless enemy waves from reaching the portal.

4775330.name: Bach Rediscovered
4775330.short_description: A music jigsaw puzzle where the finished picture is Bach. Listen to scattered phrases, fit the voices together, and hear the composition take shape. From a single melody to interwoven fugues, put your musical ear to work.

4949470.name: Sandweh
4949470.short_description: Sandweh is a relaxing sand-surfing game set in an endless, procedurally generated desert. Carve trails through dunes, build speed, pull off flips and rolls, catch the wind with your sail, and discover mysterious towers and hidden places. No pressure, just you and your board.

5370600.name: ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR
5370600.short_description: ACE COMBAT ZERO: THE BELKAN WAR is a one-of-a-kind title featuring the unique Ace Style gauge system that shifts based on how you play (Ace Style) and the choices that you make during missions.

5370820.name: Echonox: Echoes of Heartholm
5370820.short_description: ECHONOX is an online role-playing game for solo play or with friends: Fighter, Scout or Adept, eight peoples, a land full of secrets and giants only a party can defeat.

912960.name: Gate Fall
912960.short_description: An astronaut falls through an ancient Gate onto an unknown world. Dig with your laser, fly with your jetpack, build a factory, help living towns… then cross the Gate: crystal lands, a floating Paradise, and three epic bosses in 2D, 3D and first person.

4474320.name: Desktop Mate 琴葉葵 DLC
4474320.short_description: Voice-synthesis character Kotonoha Aoi joins Desktop Mate! The polite, level-headed younger twin reacts with a surprised "!" on click, scatters petals on jumps, and her ribbon bursts into petals when patted. With "Kotonoha Akane DLC," enjoy Combo Actions—waving, startle reactions, and Combo Alarm!

4617520.name: Diggems
4617520.short_description: Diggems is a first-person incremental mining game. Smash gems into chain reactions, turn the loot into better gear, and watch your Grand Hall fill up as your pets haul it all home.

5489300.name: Generated Hero
5489300.short_description:
Combine skill parts to create your own hero!
Take your hero into the dungeon and aim to conquer all 100 floors!

5469860.name: VTuber Forge
5469860.short_description: Your avatar. Their chaos. Your show. Animate 2D PNGtubers and 3D VRM avatars with your webcam and mic. Let viewers throw items, change outfits and trigger effects on Twitch, YouTube and Kick. VTuber Forge brings avatar tools, chat interactions and stream controls together in one Windows app.

5167360.name: Tiny Kopitiam
5167360.short_description: Tiny Kopitiam is a cozy management sim inspired by Southeast Asian coffee shops. Build your dream shop, hire staffs, then jump inside as the boss. Sit back, relax and watch your dream kopitiam come alive.

2320980.name: Loftia
2320980.short_description: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

5275520.name: Quest Please!
5275520.short_description: Play as an Adventurers’ Guild receptionist, reviewing adventurers’ documents while working toward a promotion. Punish those who submit forged papers and build relationships with your fellow receptionists along the way.

5332100.name: Ukraine Under Fire
5332100.short_description: Command Ukrainian or Russian forces in a 3D turn-based strategy game. Capture cities, defend river crossings, dig trenches and coordinate land, air and naval units on a hex map of Ukraine. Each turn brings new decisions—and another day of war.

5426970.name: Mushroom Sweeper
5426970.short_description: First-person mushroom hunting in CryEngine. Sweep a procedural forest, clear the forest floor, track mushrooms with the Sporevision and uncover whole mushroom patches in a Minesweeper-style minigame. Save your grandpa by recovering his mushroom inventions in exchange for prized specimens.

5483560.name: Monster Cove
5483560.short_description: A cozy retro handheld-inspired RPG where you research and battle monsters, save a seaside village, and create a new life at your own pace. This time, you are the Monster Researcher.

4894750.name: Paper Shredder
4894750.short_description: Shred your company's paperwork to earn a $1,000,000 payout. Paper Shredder is an incremental game where a sheet-after-sheet grind scales into mass document destruction. Shred, sweep, upgrade, and cut down tower-high piles of confidential records to uncover what’s buried beneath. Will you sign?

4265000.name: Isekai Parlor Simulator Gold
4265000.short_description: An erotic management simulator in which you build your very own monster girl parlor from the ground up!

4299570.name: Capybara Dungeon
4299570.short_description: Become a capybara and brave dangerous dungeons with up to 4 players. Dodge traps, face strange creatures and survive the chaos together, online or in local split-screen. A cooperative adventure where every mistake becomes a story.

4302810.name: DreamForge
4302810.short_description: DreamForge is an AI-powered gaming platform where you create, play, and share highly personalized story adventure games. Design games, shape characters, and explore unique stories created by you and your friends.

4304410.name: Claw & Order
4304410.short_description: Claw & Order is a roguelike autobattler where you recruit, arrange, and level up adorable cats whose abilities trigger off one another. Build game-breaking combos, deal millions of damage, and defeat larger-than-life bosses on your way to the grand finale!

4348910.name: Probably Stolen
4348910.short_description: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

4540660.name: Prehistoric Pit
4540660.short_description: You are the dinosaur. Everything else in the pit wants you dead. PrehistoricPit is a bullet heaven roguelite with 25 auto-firing weapons, 25 evolutions, and a hard cap of four weapon slots per run. Pick a build in the first few minutes and live with it until the meteor hits.

4683290.name: The Colour Beyond: A Zeroth Kind
4683290.short_description: After foreseeing your own death, an unknown colour grants you ten more days to live and the power of Mind-Intrusion. Investigate mysteries and intrude into the minds of locals. When the ten days are up, will you hold on to your sanity and humanity, or become a living mutation?

5222450.name: Arcade City
5222450.short_description: Welcome to Arcade City, the ultimate gaming paradise where the fun never stops... or does it? Tackle 2D pixel-art minigames while uncovering disturbing anomalies hidden inside. Keep playing, stay focused, and whatever you do, don't stop being happy!

5348850.name: Farthest
5348850.short_description: Start with nothing. Get as far as you can. Explore an endless, procedurally generated maze, crack open chests, unlock portals, and when the clock runs out, outrun the Void. How far will you get?

5490410.name: Just another thief
5490410.short_description: Join a a group of thieves stealing from the rich in a dystopian world. Navigate through enemies with style streaming your heist to the world.

2004530.name: Northern Saga
2004530.short_description:
Northern Saga is an old-school real-time strategy RPG inspired by classics like Ogre Battle.

Command your clan across real-time battlefields, construct specialized combat formations, and master combat where every positioning choice matters.

3447280.name: Fantasy World Manager
3447280.short_description: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

4311910.name: 9 Fingers
4311910.short_description: Play for cash. Pay with fingers. A dark card game of bluffs and counterbluffs. Face the boss solo or compete against a friend and the boss online. Use items and finger bonuses to reveal cards, steal bonuses and make a bluff harder to hide.

4927380.name: Math Marsh
4927380.short_description: Math Marsh is an arithmetic arcade game where every correct answer buys you time. Guide a fly across numbered lily pads, eat the numbers that complete each equation, and dodge hungry frogs, lizards, and spiders. Choose your operations and difficulty, then see how far you can go.

4960630.name: Lomiya: Do LLMs Dream of Modern Poetry?
4960630.short_description: A near-future visual novel — No androids. No cyberware. Only an LLM girl, the world, and you.

5183930.name: Abductables
5183930.short_description: An incremental roguelite about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

5204090.name: Cozy Castle
5204090.short_description: Cozy Castle is a hand-crafted castle diorama you tend like a little world in a jar — warm rooms, shifting seasons, and the quiet company of visitors passing through. No timers, no pressure, just a calm place to make your own.

5266240.name: Potato Please
5266240.short_description: A first-person potato peeling game. You have a knife. You have a bucket. You have a mountain of potatoes. Peel them with real physics. Cut thin, waste nothing. Buy better tools. Finish the pile.

5451020.name: Gotching
5451020.short_description: Raise a creature with a brain of its own: seventeen instincts, senses that mutate between runs, and a memory that lasts its whole life. Play it by hand to teach it, or watch it descend alone. Every floor is built from scratch, nothing comes identified, and it never truly dies.

5451830.name: Ordanum
5451830.short_description: Ordanum is a combo centred PvP auto battler where the order of your Sigils is the driving system. Arrange and rearrange your Sigils then watch your creation play out against other players' builds.

4662700.name: Bounce On 2: Drallo's Demise
4662700.short_description: Bounce On is back! Roll and bounce your way through the Floating Ruins, explore space on the Orbital Platform, and finish the fight in Drallo's Fortress. Dozens of challenging platform levels to explore to find all the secrets.

3579980.name: Departure of Darkness
3579980.short_description: Emma is forced to clear a horrifying parasite-infested airport as she fights to save her brother. In this 90s style Retro Survival Horror, you’ll have the option to save or leave behind fellow survivors during your adventure. However, your choices will have consequences...

4877290.name: Global Parity
4877290.short_description: Lead one of 15 nations from 1999 to 2019. Balance budgets, pass laws through parliament, win elections, forge alliances and wage war on a living front line, while AI nations build, scheme and fight around you. Every decision has a price.

1206200.name: Conan Exiles Enhanced: Isle of Siptah
1206200.short_description: Isle of Siptah is a massive expansion to the open world survival game Conan Exiles, featuring a vast new island to explore, huge and vile new creatures to slay, new building sets and a host of new features.

4820840.name: SudoPop
4820840.short_description: Sudoku meets idle game. Solve candy-colored boards by hand, hire nine number buddies to solve with you, and watch them build boards out of boards until millions of Sudokus pop every second.

940230.name: Geoplanetical
940230.short_description: A geopolitical simulation that starts on January 1, 2026, with the world as it stood that day. Govern one of 200+ nations and territories, or lead its opposition: laws, budget, elections, strikes, diplomacy, war. The other governments never wait for you. No scenarios, no end date.

5421960.name: The Friendly Monster
5421960.short_description: Search for your missing dad in a mysterious horror adventure. Build a portal, step into the unknown, and discover what lies beyond. But be careful... you never know what might be waiting on the other side. Can you find him?

4847350.name: Touchline Capital
4847350.short_description: Touchline Capital is an emergent football business simulation where you run an agency rather than a club. Scout and sign players, assign agents, arrange moves, build commercial value, invest in projects, and expand into new markets around the world.

5387360.name: Bandidos em Brasilia Demo
5387360.short_description: Demo of Bandidos em Brasília. This demo includes the story mode and the free modes! Try out a horror game featuring Brazil's most well-known politicians for free, and feel free to report any bugs or suggest improvements!

5182190.name: Orbital Desires 🛰️
5182190.short_description: Gao Chao Station was the embodiment of future wealth and prosperity, an orbital paradise for sexy women needing to escape Earth’s doomed gravity – and a place for them to find their every wanton desire tended to! Only a select few could afford it, but the thrills were worth it!

5192190.name: Watch Party: Watch the web together Demo

5210420.name: Wasteland Hearts ❤️‍🔥
5210420.short_description: Taryn’s world is made of barren wastelands, abandoned bunkers and dirty cities. She’s conquered every dark corner, and no good pussy can hide from her. Once she catches the scent of a sexy ass, she’s unstoppable and there is nowhere to hide! Taryn’s coming, and lucky for her lovers, she cums last!

5391250.name: Tidy Up Ltd.: A Cozy Co-op Cleanup
5391250.short_description: Chaos in the wizard's shop? An army of knights at the inn? Tidy Up Ltd. is on the job! Pick up wares, sweep away dust and put furniture where it belongs. Play cozy co-op for 1 to 8 players, from a little shop to a huge academy of magic.

4871350.name: Yathsel
4871350.short_description: Yathsel is a Wild West dice roguelite: play crooked Yahtzee-style hands, sneak loaded artifact dice from the smuggler under the table, and cheat your way past gunslinging rivals in a solo campaign, quick duels, and online saloons with ranked 1v1 for up to 8 players.

3599000.name: Doughby
3599000.short_description: Doughby, a little donut with a hole lot of heart, left home to collect the strangest things in the world of Torlo. Carry them. Throw them. Put them somewhere stupid. Explore abstract, odd puzzles in this wordless, harmless comedy.

4675840.name: Deep Frost
4675840.short_description: Single-player social-deduction horror in a failing Antarctic station. Question the crew, compare conflicting accounts and decide who to accuse or defend before the vote. The person you defend may be the one deceiving you.

5466100.name: Hunter Bro VR
5466100.short_description: Bow-hunt big game across five wild grounds in VR. Draw a real bow, track and call trophy animals, and survive the night when the woods hunt you back. Play it like a hunting sim, or open the cheats and bring a rocket launcher to a deer hunt. Solo or online co-op with up to 6 friends.

5056950.name: mythorune
5056950.short_description: An endless co-op action-RPG dungeon crawl. Descend floors that never scale to you, slot runes that rewrite your skills into new weapons, mine the walls, and loot relics of world myth. Play couch, LAN and online in one six-hero party, or host your own server. No microtransactions.

4613340.name: Bannerlings
4613340.short_description: Build an unstoppable army in this strategy roguelite auto-battler. Fuse your Bannerlings, create powerful emblem synergies, and overcome unpredictable encounters on the road to the final boss.

3830080.name: Twilight Requiem
3830080.short_description: Embark on a Dark Fantasy odyssey in Twilight Requiem, an action RPG blending heart-pounding combat and mystical exploration. Wield cosmic powers, master fluid combos inspired by Kingdom Hearts 2 Final Mix, and traverse haunting realms through enigmatic portals.

3859180.name: The Electorate
3859180.short_description: Campaign to victory in the ultimate election simulator, The Electorate. Rally voters, dominate the airwaves, attack rivals, and fight for glory and power across every county in the United States.

4698830.name: Companion Baduk
4698830.short_description: Learn and master Go (Baduk/Weiqi) with unique AI companions, custom game analysis with move explanations, ranked puzzles, joseki training, and a rich proverb database. Play, practice, and improve your skills at your own pace!

782490.name: People Versus Everything
782490.short_description: It's a bird! It's a plan! It's a garbage can? Face your friends in this ridiculous cat-and-mouse free-to-play shooter. Become a prop and hide within your environment, or become a hunter. Use guns, abilities, and occasionally trains to win the game!

4839050.name: Altitude Zero
4839050.short_description: Pilot a vintage hot air balloon through a freezing, desolate void. Manage your burner, survive hostile creatures, and land at abandoned stations before the darkness consumes you.

4613530.name: Cornerfall
4613530.short_description: A text-based idle RPG that lives in the corner of your desktop. Build your character, send them into cursed lands, and check back to find new loot, defeated bosses, and higher tiers unlocked. All without lifting a finger.

5188050.name: Hell Dream 👺
5188050.short_description: The sexy blonde was sure this was just a dream. One minute she’d been fornicating and sinning lasciviously, and the next she had a red-fleshed demon at her disposal. How was this supposed to be her Hell? It was a wicked sort of Heaven she’d found herself in, and she was going to make the most of it!

5273460.name: Rouge and Run
5273460.short_description: Dive into the cursed world of Rouge and Run. Customize your loadout, strategies, and plan your time management wisely to escape The Fog of Rouge from consuming you.

4838620.name: GenderShift
4838620.short_description: Embody your avatar. GenderShift is a push-to-talk voice changer that rebuilds your words in a real, natural feminine voice (or masculine, your call), so you pass in VRChat, Discord, anywhere you talk online. Your own voice, shifted.

5113340.name: Stackonauts
5113340.short_description: The Stackonauts need your help. Build the sturdiest tower you can and get them to the safety of your transport ship. Time, unforgiving physics and your rivals' cannons stand against you across several modes for 1–4 players.

5163610.name: Electric Crust: Galactic Pizza Delivery
5163610.short_description: Fifteen stages of side-scrolling arcade shooting, wrapped around the worst pizza delivery route in the galaxy. Bullet patterns, boss tiers, and a rank ladder Ace never asked for. One-time purchase. No ads. No IAP. No data collection.

2404130.name: Beastieball Demo
2404130.short_description: Coach a sports team of Beasties in this turn-based volleyball RPG! Your Beasties' relationships power up their teamwork!

2056530.name: Laser Lightshow
2056530.short_description: Master a 200+ handcrafted laser puzzle campaign, then build your own. Laser Lightshow gives you a massive puzzle sandbox, a powerful in-game editor, and online level sharing—with enough possible creations that “endless” barely covers it.

3296130.name: Loot Before Dusk
3296130.short_description: Cozy top-down extraction shooter. Raid the corrupted Wildwood, purify Gloamed creatures, bonk goblins and rival scavengers, and reach the exit before dusk. Then rebuild your village, trade, craft and cook. No blood, real stakes. Play solo or in online co-op with friends.

5200540.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion Demo
5200540.short_description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

3999520.name: Dream Broadcast Simulator
3999520.short_description: Run the little TV station that broadcasts a sleeping city's dreams. Choose three dream tapes a night, fit each to its timeslot, lock the signal, and keep your Dreamers tuned in for 21 nights. A cozy strategy game built for one-more-night runs.

4310460.name: Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion
4310460.short_description: Race across a strange rural America in Total Shift: Wheeled Rebellion! A classic character based PSX style racing experience. Join a group of furry friends as they try to have fun in a act of rebellion against a town doing everything to stop them.

5205640.name: Ragnarok Roads Demo
5205640.short_description:
Lead a convoy across post-nuclear Scandinavia in 1986. Scavenge irradiated ruins, recruit survivors, and fight tactical vehicle
  battles on frozen roads. This is a retro-style strategy game, rewarding the planning, perceptive and persistent players, like games used to be.

2228250.name: Endurance Motorsport Series
2228250.short_description: Endurance Motorsport Series immerses you in the heart of this unique experience: get behind the wheel as a driver, but also step into the shoes of the race engineer to make crucial decisions from the pit lane.

5368690.name: Mokomon: Five Elements Demo
5368690.short_description: A Roguelike Auto Battler focused on creature taming and evolution. Choose your Tamer, master the Five Elements system, and break the game by discovering new evolutions and insane synergies to annihilate hordes, defeat bosses, and outmatch other players' builds.

2927200.name: Mount & Blade II: Bannerlord - War Sails
2927200.short_description: Sail the high seas, lead mighty fleets, and forge your legacy in War Sails. Bringing naval warfare to Bannerlord for the first time, War Sails lets players command powerful ships, engage in thrilling sea battles, and master maritime conquest.

5260020.name: Rollamon Demo
5260020.short_description: Raise one monster on your stat sheet. Draft dice, spend XP, race for Arena Medals, and win on Contest Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

3917850.name: Referee Life Simulator 2026
3917850.short_description: A realistic referee simulator! Show cards, use VAR, control matches, and rise through your referee career!

3194960.name: Distant Trails
3194960.short_description: Explore open forest, steep mountains and muddy singletrack in this easy-paced outdoor adventure. Take a crew of trail runners out to remote locations to repair damage, protect nature and investigate unexpected events with only their feet for transport and a backpack to carry supplies.

4982060.name: Anti-anti
4982060.short_description: “Only Monsters Become Perfect Idols” — A choice-driven psychological mystery visual novel, Anti-Anti. In a world once devastated by slime monsters, you are forced into a suspicious audition. A locked-room mystery, ensemble drama, adventure, thriller, and romance!

2750400.name: Spearhead 2
2750400.short_description: Spearhead 2 is a tank simulator that puts you in command of an M1A2 Abrams Main Battle Tank in tactical combat. Lead your team through intense missions, strategize effectively, and dominate the battlefield in this immersive mix of action and simulation gameplay.

5338280.name: DeadFront Demo
5338280.short_description: DeadFront Demo is a 1-to-6 player co-op wave-based zombie survival shooter. Fight off hordes, upgrade weapons at the bench, buy perks from the mystery box, and survive the apocalypse!

2223650.name: Motor Town: Behind The Wheel - Dedicated Server

4929330.name: PRIEST
4929330.short_description: Lead an army as its healer in PRIEST: a fantasy autobattler with an emphasis on healing. Arrange your army, keep them alive, and grow them in strength and number using four talent trees. Battle across 23 campaign levels then see how far you can get in endless mode.

2738660.name: Mecha Simultactics
2738660.short_description: Hey, Pilot! Join the battle in this multiplayer tactical party fighter where everyone selects an action, then all actions play out at the same time. Customize your mech and take on your opponents with simultaneous-turn-based combat, anime-inspired replays, and online PvP.

5431300.name: Undead Showdown
5431300.short_description: Four squads. Ten zombie rounds. One team left standing. Hold your stronghold against the horde while rival squads snipe through the windows. Die during survival for one shot at a 1v1 arcade duel in Limbo to fight your way back. Build your loadout, upgrade your guns, gamble for power.

5262070.name: AUREUS GEMWORKS ― リリトリオンの宝石工場
5262070.short_description: Build a gem factory, one card at a time. Combine factory automation with deckbuilding as you mine, refine, transport and ship precious gems. Work with an eccentric crew in the abyss and meet the demands of Lilitryon, your gold-loving supervisor.

3144300.name: Ginga Legends
3144300.short_description: A football roguelike deckbuilder with tactical depth on and off the pitch. Build your club, chain the perfect play, and climb from amateur pitches all the way to the top league.

2396130.name: Australia Did It: End-of-the-World Railway Defense Business
2396130.short_description: Deploy and merge units into 1,500+ variations to defend your train in tight Turn-Based Strategy battles, then see if your build survives Autobattler journeys between stations against massive monster hordes. Build you crew. Defend the train. Deliver the cargo.

5279620.name: Halloween On Goober Street
5279620.short_description: Halloween On Goober Street is a first-person horror-comedy taking place on Halloween night. Players must Trick-or-Treat their way to 100 candies or face the consequences.  With lots of fun interactions and scares with the zippiest of characters, this Halloween night is one sure to be remembered.

4755860.name: Worldkampf '72 Demo
4755860.short_description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

5407340.name: Thalassomania Demo
5407340.short_description: Co-op PS1 horror on a North Sea trawler for 1-4 players. Fish, steer through the storm, keep the engine alive and watch the cameras while the jobs split you up. There's one more aboard than there should be, and you'll hear it before you see it.

5003740.name: Nutshot Simulator Demo
5003740.short_description: Throw objects to hit people in the nuts.

3752150.name: Knight Games
3752150.short_description: Knight Games is a casual party game where you compete in minigame tournaments to reclaim a broken kingdom. Enjoy ‘knight games’ of old (like Jousting / Archery) or rediscover classic 'night games' (like Hide & Seek / Capture the Flag). Between events, explore a vast kingdom to unlock new challenges!

5452540.name: ONE FLICK ～ COIN CLASH ～
5452540.short_description: Flick coins, knock your opponent’s pieces off the table, and protect your 100-yen King. Build decks from coins with different sizes and weights, conquer 335 CPU stages, face nine Coin Masters, and collect all 1,005 badges. Play solo or battle a friend locally or with Steam Remote Play Together.

4693080.name: The Guild 1 Remake: Europa 1410 Demo
4693080.short_description: Forge your path to power in medieval Europe. Choose your profession and master trade, politics, and intrigue to climb the social ladder and found a dynasty. Secure your legacy and dominate history in this immersive economic simulation.

4872180.name: Nutshot Simulator
4872180.short_description: Throw objects to hit people in the nuts.

5035490.name: Minus Sixty
5035490.short_description: Minus Sixty is a single-player, first-person, story-driven adventure set in extreme cold. As mechanical engineer Viktor, head toward a village to repair its broken coal boiler. Gather resources, craft supplies, build fires to stay warm, manage your inventory, and overcome environmental obstacles.

5446220.name: Parking Empire Simulator
5446220.short_description: Own the lot and be its valet. Park customers' cars, hang their keys and bring their cars back when they return. Grow three bays into a business that fills the whole block, with a car wash, service garage and petrol station. Play solo or in 4-player online co-op.

3982290.name: Evac Bay 09
3982290.short_description: You're trapped in the seemingly endless corridors of a space station, desperately searching for the evacuation bay 09. But the station is not as empty as it seems; you must observe for subtle, unsettling occurrences and log them if you want to move forward. Can you break the loop and escape?

4895950.name: She Was King Demo
4895950.short_description: A dark, witchy pixel-art RPG dungeon crawler about hexed bonds, curious creatures, and finding your way home. Run, as fast as you can. Can you outfox what's coming, or will you let it consume you?

5104610.name: Punch Upon a Time Demo
5104610.short_description: Punch Upon a Time is a team-based party fighter inspired by Smash Bros where you take on rounds of modes, mini-games, and combat alongside your friends. Assemble a squad of the biggest fairy tale names to punch, dunk, fly, score, and sumo your way to victory as the LAST TEAM STANDING.

4577790.name: The Voss Clinic
4577790.short_description: A psychiatric hospital. 1986. The staff are dead. The doors are open. You have no memory of how you got here or why your name is on a patient file. No monsters. No combat. Only the silence of empty corridors, and the slow realization of what was done to you.

5189280.name: ODD ODDS Demo
5189280.short_description: A single-player roguelike gambling game set entirely in one room. To clear a crushing debt, win coins at the claw machine, cash out at the ATM, and upgrade at the typewriter before the devil collects. Then the doorbell rings. Ally, or scammer? Who you deal with decides whether you get out.

4971070.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3
4971070.short_description: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, seven stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

5435570.name: Hauntbound Demo
5435570.short_description: An online and local multiplayer horror party game for 2 to 8 players. Explore a haunted house that builds itself, search for relics, avoid deadly traps, and compete in chaotic minigames before the haunt begins.

4102830.name: Disc Treks
4102830.short_description: Disc Treks is a sandbox disc golf game with exploration, gathering, course modification and building.  Intuitive physics-based gameplay that captures the feel of the disc flight.

5074380.name: Cleanup on Aisle 3 Demo
5074380.short_description: Free demo: play ValuCo #3's first five days for real. Throw crates onto empty shelves, chain register combos, wrangle cart trains, survive corporate's nightly "improvements." Your progress carries into the full game: six more stores, starting with one that never closes.

1048250.name: Bowlbo: The Quest for Bing Bing
1048250.short_description: A sinister Witch has kidnapped your beloved Bing Bing. You must travel the sweeping lands of Cósta Cré and do what it takes to get your poochingus back from the Nightmare Realm!

3980210.name: Arcane Overdrive
3980210.short_description: Arcane Overdrive, is a survivor-like game where you combine different vehicle parts to create your own gameplay and movement style.

4865610.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction - Xenauri faction
4865610.short_description: Lead the Xenauri, a nomadic warrior faction of lizard-riders and psychic altari, as they invade the Siren System. Experience the aftermath through two narrative-focused levels led by a young Xenauri commander.

4793300.name: ASEMA Demo
4793300.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

3878710.name: Gridiron Remastered
3878710.short_description: Control one player in high-octane 7v7 american football action. Compete from an immersive third-person view and work with your squad to dominate the competition. Precision physics based passing, explosive runs, and strategic coordination. This is football reimagined for competitive online play.

5314080.name: One More Donut
5314080.short_description: Transform a delicious mountain of 2,500+ donuts into ultimate visual perfection! Sort tasty treats, buy upgrades, and unwind to a cozy Lo-Fi soundtrack in this satisfying tidying simulator.

5489360.name: The Eviscerator
5489360.short_description: Step back into the tension and nostalgia of the XBLIG era! Rebuilt and reimagined for PC, this indie horror classic brings back the heart-pounding survival experience that kept players on the edge of their seats.

4844630.name: Heroes of Science and Fiction - Typhon Map Pack
4844630.short_description: Map pack for Heroes of Science and Fiction! 7 new custom scenarios, each one with its own twist on the standard HoSaF map formula. The maps also showcase new content from the latest game updates, including underground map layer, new items and neutral units.

5173710.name: Hell: Rancor
5173710.short_description: A horror walking simulator set in a Japanese residential neighborhood. At night, a mysterious vegetable stall called the "Enkon Stand" appears. They say anyone who eats its strange vegetable, "Enkon," becomes addicted and can never eat anything else. What is the truth behind the rumor?

3531220.name: MECHBORN
3531220.short_description: A fresh roguelike deckbuilder where YOUR MECH IS YOUR DECK – With 7 cards always in play on a conveyor belt victory is down to skill and not luck. Master pilot skills and unlock Mech parts to reveal powerful cards, as you carve your path across 3 ever-changing continents to repel the Kaiju invasion.

5099040.name: The Obsidian Sun
5099040.short_description: The Obsidian Sun is a 2D action RPG inspired by Aztec/Mexica and Maya cultures. Help a struggling town, master combat and gathering skills, uncover hidden oaths, and defeat corrupted guardians beneath a shattered sun.

975530.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry Soundtrack
975530.short_description:
The official Soundtrack of Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry

Music produced by Johannes Stemm & Kai Rosenkranz

1460880.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Don't Dry Artbook
1460880.short_description: The official Artbook of Leisure Suit - Larry Wet Dreams Don't Dry.

1452430.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Artbook

1452390.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Soundtrack

1432870.name: Leisure Suit Larry - Wet Dreams Dry Twice Demo
1432870.short_description: No obstacle will keep me away from my beloved, my Faith, not even the wild and untamed islands of Kalau’a. Those lovely island ladies can only distract me for so long as my heart’s compass only points in one direction - Faith!

2898770.name: Die Trying
2898770.short_description: Plunge into a world ravaged by the dead in this hilarious co-op shooter. Blending silly antics with open-world sandbox freedom. Escape with a plethora of loot, or Die Trying!

5250360.name: Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 27
5250360.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball franchise in Draft Day Sports: Pro Basketball 27. Build through the draft, trades and free agency, manage contracts and rotations, develop your players and create the strategy that will turn your team into a dynasty.

4466790.name: La Fiebre: Puerto Rico
4466790.short_description: An open-world racing game inspired by Puerto Rican car culture. Customize your ride, explore island-inspired locations, and compete in realistic drag races and street events with functional timing systems and online multiplayer.

4178790.name: Clicky Islands
4178790.short_description: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

4295820.name: Death To The Deathless
4295820.short_description: 《Death To The Deathless》is an adventure game featuring lightweight roguelike elements. It combines deck-building with slot machine mechanics for combat. This game contains no real-world monetary gambling or microtransactions whatsoever.

3082430.name: Tamzin Twins
3082430.short_description: An epic action RPG with couch co-op. On their path to revenge Enya and Kyra will throw swords, cast spells, vanquish armies and become heroes.

4621530.name: Behelade
4621530.short_description: Fight your way through this challenging Bullet Hell Shoot ‘Em Up, consisting of 5 stages full of beautiful, intricate patterns and bosses. Wield the magic sword “Behelade” to find out what is behind the mysterious power that made the forest creatures go on a mad Danmaku rampage!

4478970.name: ASEMA
4478970.short_description: Automate your factory in space. Build logistic railguns to feed the production lines of your ever growing machines. Gravity disrupts your trajectories - master it. Connect your machines over the vast void. Find resource rich moons and asteroid streams to harvest and mine, but beware of the humans.

5166340.name: Dirty Mop
5166340.short_description: Your father vanished from this building years ago. Now you're their janitor — and the master key opens every door. Snoop, scheme, and seduce your way to the truth in this isometric adult adventure where every secret you uncover becomes your favorite new toy.

5460250.name: NO SUNRISE Demo
5460250.short_description: Survive twelve zombie waves in an abandoned cinema, alone or in co-op with up to four players. Buy weapons, repair barricades and unlock more rooms. This NO SUNRISE Alpha demo ends after wave 12 and includes German and English in-game text.

3796150.name: Curse of Resthaven
3796150.short_description: In this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

4765870.name: Sigilgraph
4765870.short_description: A modular non-linear DAW and sandbox for sound designers and generative musicians. Connect synthesizers, sample tools, MIDI modifiers, and modulation sources on a visual canvas with virtual cables. Break free from the traditional linear timeline to construct evolving, self-playing soundscapes.

5245370.name: LFG
5245370.short_description: LFG Bossing is a voxel action RPG from Bad Circuit Games. Explore a procedurally generated world solo or with friends, descend into sprawling caverns, battle powerful bosses, and hunt for rare gear. Choose Rogue, Knight, Ranger, or Mage, hit dungeons and brave the Gauntlet for unique rewards.

5454730.name: Magehold Fairwinds Soundtrack
5454730.short_description: The complete original soundtrack to Magehold: Fairwinds. 56 tracks and over three hours of folk and chamber music for a leaking airship, its weary crew and nine regions of hand-painted sky.

5371900.name: Stay a Little
5371900.short_description: A romance and relationship game set in London. Choose what to say, find work and spend time with people you want to know better. Flirt or take a side, then see how earlier choices change your next conversation.

4598790.name: Lust of the Dead
4598790.short_description: Lust of the Dead is a first-person survival horror experience set inside the decaying St. Erebus Hospital, where a mysterious outbreak has turned desire into something far more sinister.

5285180.name: WE'RE ALL IN! Demo
5285180.short_description: Experience minigame chaos in WE’RE ALL IN!, an online party game for 1-8 players where you win by betting on your friends in a series of fast-paced games and challenges.

5338620.name: Carry On Together Demo
5338620.short_description: Get your first taste of moving chaos in Carry On Together Demo! Play online co-op with up to 4 players, carry furniture together, drive the truck and try to complete the delivery without turning everything into a disaster.

5323240.name: Writificer: Typing the Classics
5323240.short_description: Improve your typing while reading masterpieces. Follow in the footsteps of the greats: Shakespeare, Dickens, Poe, and much more.

3408070.name: Battle Suit Aces Demo
3408070.short_description: Battle Suit Aces is a charming card-battling RPG. You'll recruit, befriend, and upgrade your mech pilots on a heartfelt hunt for fabled alien superweapons: the Relic Suits. Command them across monster-infested galactic wilds through danger, tragedy, and comedic sci-fi shenanigans.

4765410.name: Horny Halloween 🎃
4765410.short_description: You thought going to a haunted graveyard on Hallowe’en would be a thrill-ride. Maybe see some ghosts. What you didn’t expect was her, the sexy ghoulish femme fatale who knows how to suck the very soul from your boner! Is she a curse or a gift from Heaven itself?

5065330.name: Cleaner Company Demo
5065330.short_description: Play the free demo of Cleaner Company, a gory Cleaning Sim for 1-4 players. Clean up the Flying Canteen, a space restaurant infested by friendly mutant chickens and unfriendly alien pests.

5092090.name: Mycopunk - Supporter Pack
5092090.short_description: Mycopunk Supporter Pack offers additional cosmetics to players who want to help support Pigeons at Play and future development of Mycopunk.

5112520.name: ContractVille - Rent Expansion
