5112520.short_description: Bring the real estate business to ContractVille with the Rent Expansion! Buy houses, decorate them with your furniture, and lease them to various tenants. Includes new property management mechanics to build your passive income.

5134620.name: Tea Runners: Turkish Teahouse Simulator Demo
5134620.short_description: Three days behind the counter of a traditional Turkish tea house. Brew cay, grill toasties, run trays out to the shopkeepers on the street, and keep the okey corner from turning into a fight. Around half an hour, online co-op for 1-6 players, and the first day teaches you everything.

4508240.name: ROMANCE OF THE THREE KINGDOMS XIV Complete Edition Upgrade Pack

4776680.name: Backrooms Protocol Demo
4776680.short_description: Backrooms Protocol Demo is a walk simulator designed to showcase the atmosphere and environments of the full game. It contains three different levels to explore, each featuring its own unique atmosphere.

2850910.name: Prisma
2850910.short_description: Prisma is a captivating 2D Japanese-inspired RPG featuring innovative turn-based combat with never before seen strategic use of camera lens and filters. Your camera empowers you to manipulate the world through lenses and filters, turning battles into a mesmerizing interplay of strategy and artistry.

4158580.name: DAVE THE DIVER - GGST Content Pack
4158580.short_description: LET'S ROCK! Experience the explosive energy of GGST in DAVE THE DIVER.

3791840.name: PSYCHO DEAD Demo
3791840.short_description: Uncover a chilling third-person survival horror adventure. Take the role of a girl with psychic powers, desperate to escape a secret lab while pursued by deadly stalkers. The demo includes the game’s opening sequence.

3623250.name: SnowRunner - Dragon Wagons Dual Pack
3623250.short_description:
The Dragon Wagons Dual Pack brings 2 new trucks to your garage: the Heavy-class Avenhorn A15 and the Heavy Duty-class Padera STD-4 - as well as unique add-ons!

This DLC is not included in the Year 1, Year 2, Year 3, Year 4 or Year 5 Passes.

3738600.name: Memoria Wake Demo
3738600.short_description: Parry with precision and fight through shifting, surreal landscapes in this Souls-like action-adventure. When reality turns into a living nightmare, you must ascend through a shattered realm to rescue a missing friend.

3753120.name: Turok 2: Rok Match
3753120.short_description: Turok 2: Rok Match is a fan-made remaster of the 1999 game build made with Assembly, HEX, C++ and Delphi without having any of the source code or official tools. The goal is to save maximum from original game but make it better, as if done by the original developers.

5276910.name: Age of Harvest
5276910.short_description: Age of Harvest is a deep 2D simulation traditional Roguelike. Explore a living world, manage your body and wounds, and survive an ever-changing world as you uncover its mysteries and bring about the true Age of Harvest.

2843460.name: Killing Floor 3 Shadow Agent Season 1 Deluxe Pass
2843460.short_description: Upgrade DLC for current Killing Floor 3 owners that includes premium Nightfall Supply Pass access, 1000 Creds, and exclusive Shadow Agents weapon and outfit skins

2843470.name: Killing Floor 3 Future Seasons 2-4 Deluxe Pass
2843470.short_description: Upgrade DLC for current Killing Floor 3 owners that includes future access to 3 premium Nightfall Supply Passes and 2000 Creds

4767480.name: Lords of the Fallen II
4767480.short_description: Lords of the Fallen II is a dark fantasy action-RPG where brutal, soulslike combat meets a world splitting at its core. Battle against the darkness in an epic adventure across a shattered kingdom. One world. Two realms. No mercy.

4505560.name: Call The Exterminator Demo
4505560.short_description: When the world’s most dangerous terrorists crawl out of the shadows, there’s only one number the government dials: yours. CTE is classic 90's 2.5D action. Suit up, Light up, its time to Call The Exterminator.

2369456.name: Far Cry 6 DLC 2 Pagan: Control
2369456.short_description: Become the villain as you step into the flamboyantly eccentric mind of Pagan Min from Far Cry® 4.

5282780.name: Waking Adrift
5282780.short_description: You and your crew are on a one way mission to reach the edge of space, but something sinister is lurking in the halls.

5441750.name: Midnight Bakery
5441750.short_description: Midnight Bakery is a first-person bakery simulator with a horror twist. Serve customers, prepare coffee, restock shelves, and customize your shop. But as the nights go by, strange events begin to unfold. Can you keep your bakery running when reality itself starts to unravel?

2215010.name: PAYDAY 2: Hostile Takeover Heist
2215010.short_description: Hostile Takeover Heist is available on its own or as part of the Hostile Takeover Bundle.

2222842.name: Immortals Fenyx Rising – The Lost Gods
2222842.short_description: Discover a new top-down gameplay experience featuring a daring new champion and brawler-style combat!

1576170.name: ChineseParents DLC - eSports
1576170.short_description: Chase e-sports glory in a new story! Join a team and compete for the championship, with new courses, daily activities, career paths and endings shaped by your tournament results. Clear the story to unlock a character you can befriend and romance.

4685060.name: Crown & Applause
4685060.short_description: Your boss is a Dragon King. Your audience has tomatoes. Play a mouse jester in this comic narrative rhythm game set to bardcore: hit the beat and keep the candles burning, then choose whether to please the Crown, the Crowd, or Yourself. The job comes with several possible endings.

896719.name: Train Simulator: Hudson Line: New York – Croton-Harmon Route Add-On
896719.short_description: Train Simulator’s Hudson Line route delivers fast-paced and challenging American commuter, passenger, and freight railroading at its contemporary best.

624621.name: Wolfenstein II: The Freedom Chronicles - Episode 2
624621.short_description: Play as former OSS agent and assassin, Jessica Valiant, AKA Agent Silent Death! Hot on the trail of a sinister plot, Valiant finds herself in the offices of Paragon Pictures, Tinseltown film studio turned Nazi propaganda machine.

755540.name: LIV
755540.short_description: All-in-one VR software for creators. Record mixed reality, transform into your favorite avatar, see chat inside your headset, and more.

5388790.name: Sealing Fallout Demo
5388790.short_description: A fusion reactor has blown up and it's up to sealkind to save Earth from the ensuing Runaway Electron Avalanche! Group up with up to 6 fellow seals to fix the reactor before the seventh day ends. The AI Adam predicts your failure, prove it wrong and blow it up.

361780.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy: Cyrax & Sektor
361780.short_description: The Lin Kuei clan has trained the most feared ninja assassins for over 800 years by kidnapping children as new recruits.

426820.name: Wolfenstein: The New Order - Soundtrack
426820.short_description: Soundtrack for Wolfenstein: The New Order

277752.name: Train Simulator: Miami - West Palm Beach

4874070.name: Down Range
4874070.short_description: Experience a tactical shooter that blends arcade and realism! Choose between 2 game modes and jump straight into combat solo or with friends on the battlefield, or use a game master mode to build your own scenario. Customize weapons, uniforms, gear, and gameplay parameters. Your fight, your rules!

2278060.name: Timepaths
2278060.short_description: Time is the most valuable resource. Use it wisely to play cards that give you resources that you need to build timepaths. Complete the timepath before you run out of time. Featuring an adventure mode and infinite levels.

5300300.name: Elementys
5300300.short_description: Explore a vast pixel-art MMORPG where adventure, progression, crafting, trading, PvE, and ranked PvP shape your journey. Play alone or with others, master your class, conquer powerful bosses, and build your legacy in the world of Elementys.

5352190.name: Six-Leaf Clover Hunt
5352190.short_description: A quiet first-person search in a sunlit forest clearing. Hidden among more than 500,000 life-sized clovers are 54 four-leaf clovers, 18 five-leaf clovers and just one six-leaf clover. Crouch down, part the leaves, pick a clover and count its leaflets with your own eyes. No time limit.

5416430.name: The Hero's Legacy
5416430.short_description: A hardcore co-op action RPG in pixel art: play solo, online, on LAN or in 4-player split-screen couch co-op. Dodge bullet-hell bosses, hunt loot and 6-link gear, and build your hero on a huge passive tree. Permadeath: every hero has one life, but your family keeps its Legacy.

3585490.name: Standard Procedures
3585490.short_description: A casual team vs. team FPS about gunfights and negotiation. Your character is completely physically simulated and can interact with the world and be injured dynamically.

5479330.name: X-Force Genesis 2
5479330.short_description: Chaos returns to space! Pilot different ships through 12 intense stages, dodge hundreds of projectiles, battle gigantic bosses and strengthen your firepower with upgrades and power-ups in this shmup inspired by the classics of the 80s and 90s.

4960870.name: Barnburners Demo
4960870.short_description: Free 5-on-5 arcade hockey with four playable clubs, couch and online games, fights, and a ten-game Seattle Franchise trial through the playoffs and draft. Aim your shots, throw the hits, and see how far you can take the Squall.

4509920.name: Sunrise Isles
4509920.short_description: Drive goods, chop wood, catch fish, cook food, design clothes, or just chill in a spacious island with your friends!

5170730.name: Pawperwork
5170730.short_description: An idle game about a cat stamping an absurd amount of paperwork, in a window that lives on top of everything else you are doing. Collect the package, stamp what is inside, send it out. Do it all by hand until you can afford not to, then go find out who keeps sending the work down.

5415730.name: Note Defender: A Sight Reading Arcade
5415730.short_description: Memorize the notes on the treble and bass staffs as well as 9 ledger lines above and below them. This covers every key of a standard 88 key piano and most instruments.

4846990.name: War Asunder Demo
4846990.short_description: A casual deck-building game based on the traditional card game War, but adds new, tactical features like elemental cards, special abilities, and unlockable upgrades.

4564070.name: Way Too Many Fish!
4564070.short_description: Way Too Many Fish! is a cozy sorting game aboard your own fishing boat. Haul the net, dump the catch on deck, and throw all 82 species of fish into the right crates.

5309910.name: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings Demo

5296240.name: Witches & Fairy Tails
5296240.short_description: An arcade reveal game following a coven of seductive witches on a mission to collect the vital 'essence' of magical creatures—with their own hands, or any other part of their body. Enjoy light story dialogues, tackle reflex challenges, and unlock spicy animated scenes.

3437690.name: Project Red Sun
3437690.short_description: Project Red Sun is a combat flight action game that has you fighting across the world as a heroic ace against corporate armies who will spare no expense in trying to take you down. With specialized jets and weaponry, dogfight aces, airships, and more in a campaign packed with arcade gameplay.

5416030.name: Mine Away
5416030.short_description: A relaxing incremental mining game about breaking rocks, collecting coins, and upgrading your pickaxe. Mine your worries away. And... and... well that's it just you... mine and upgrade and power, fire, explosions... that's. FUN

4577670.name: Hail of Hexes
4577670.short_description: Featuring five playable characters, over thirty gameplay-altering items, and over eight unique upgradeable spells, every Hail of Hexes run will be unique. Explore new builds and truly master the classic arcade combat in this hand-drawn side-scrolling shoot-em-up.

4700500.name: 幸福里:生门 Demo
4700500.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror puzzle game where every door is a decision. Read the clues, follow the rules, and choose carefully inside a research facility that rebuilds itself every run. Pick the wrong door—and whatever is waiting in the dark comes for you.

5395460.name: Provincia Wars
5395460.short_description: Provincia Wars is a real-time strategy game inspired by the Roman Empire. Build settlements, manage resources, expand your territory, and command armies in battles for control of the provinces. Plan your economy, strengthen your forces, and lead your civilization to victory.

2470990.name: Llamalandia
2470990.short_description:
Llamalandia is a cozy adventure game with town-building elements, about finding your family.
Build your llama sanctuary to protect your family, raise the baby llamas, and invite other cute animals to live with you in this magical place.

1030780.name: Afterconflict
1030780.short_description: A brutal tactical FPS focusing on unflinching realism and equipment accuracy, set during the twilight days of what was once the Cold War.

4630020.name: The Loopler - Supporter Pack
4630020.short_description: Unlock cosmetics for The Loopler by showing your support

5376220.name: Frontier Tavern Demo
5376220.short_description: Run a tavern in the Old West in this first-person demo. Pour drinks, serve customers, restock supplies and hire your first employees. Unlock whisky, improve your tavern and learn to defend it. Keep playing after completing the demo's missions.

5466650.name: Crosstalk: The Bloat and Greed Edition
5466650.short_description: This DLC delivers pre-compiled binaries for the x86 architecture. The delivered content matches the main app ID with the difference that in this DLC, the player gets ready-to-play executables, versus the main app ID's source.

4997300.name: Palisade Demo
4997300.short_description: Command territory directly with no squads to micromanage. Try Palisade’s real time strategy in a free solo campaign with three linked battles. Expand across the Nordic countries, land in Britain, and fight for the Seine.

3057810.name: Dungeon Depths
3057810.short_description:
Dungeoneer is a rouge-like, RPG, souls-like maybe future MMO game.

Taking big inspiration from Dark Souls, Runescape, Hypixels Skyblock, Metin 2 and Enter The Gungeon.

1905180.name: OBS Studio
1905180.short_description: Free and open-source software for video recording and live streaming

3505400.name: Let's Go Hunting
3505400.short_description: Hunt silly animals with up to 3 friends in a colourful low-poly world. Track them down, drag the loot home on a sled or in a truck, sell it at camp, upgrade your gear and take on the mighty Wolpertinger King.

5116030.name: Skullf! Demo
5116030.short_description:
You are Skullf! Disembodied skull of terror & mini-golf!

After yet another hilarious night terrorizing locals, it's time to return to your grave. Dodge traps, spelunk tombs and even go head to head with friends (Friends not included). Never before have you had so much fun a graveyard! (Probably)

4223460.name: Taj Mod
4223460.short_description: Taj Mod is a fan-made reimagining of the SCP: Secret Laboratory 'Megapatch 1' experience. Set in an alternate reality, that blends nostalgia with fresh gameplay and features.

5402530.name: FLICKSHOT
5402530.short_description: FLICKSHOT is a hyper-stylish physics-based fighting game focused on using recoil to blast your ship around the arena. Come for party game chaos, stay for deep competitive tech and skill expression. Ricochet around 40+ stages to a bumpin’ soundtrack with up to 4 players.

4888150.name: Masters of the Universe™: Legends Unite
4888150.short_description: Unique playstyles bring each legend to life in the fight against Hordak’s unstoppable horde. Battle your way through a variety of diverse biomes and obstacles with every playthrough and engage in Trials of Eternia, arcade mini games for precious bonuses.

5393310.name: GridPi: Defense 3014
5393310.short_description: Dice poker × auto battler × 1–4 player co-op defense. In GridPi, you roll five dice to make poker hands, combine units, and line up synergies to hold back the incoming waves of enemies. What matters isn't luck — it's judgment. Build all kinds of combos and claim victory.

5164850.name: Beltrunner
5164850.short_description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

5280010.name: RAT TAG! Demo
5280010.short_description: RAT TAG! is an online multiplayer tag game where you play as rats. Jump, run, and dive your way through handcrafted ratty arenas in a variety of tag-based game modes. Grab wacky items to outmaneuver or sabotage your friends. Bounce off walls, smack the cheese out of each other, and go rat feral.

5165060.name: Beltrunner Demo
5165060.short_description: Fly, dodge, salvage, repeat. Beltrunner is a sci-fi bullet-hell horde-survival roguelite: your guns fire themselves while you drift-dodge asteroids, hazards and pirate raiders. Draft 20+ weapons, fuse maxed ones into screen-clearing evolutions, and tear down multi-phase bosses solo or in co-op.

5006340.name: What the Buck?! Demo
5006340.short_description: What the Buck?! is a satisfying incremental game about destroying money. Shred stacks of cash, set off chain reactions across the table, prestige for permanent upgrades and automate your money destruction. Your demo progress carries over to the full game.

5356830.name: GRAND TIDDY ADVENTURES 🚨
5356830.short_description: A wild 1980s crime adventure where dating, dirty jobs, drag races, shootouts, and adult fun collide. Explore the city, make money, build relationships, and cause trouble as you work your way toward the biggest score of your life.

5283780.name: What Da Font
5283780.short_description: A cozy first person organizing game. Thieves turned over every case in a 1920s print shop: gather 5,000 pieces of lead type from two floors, tell one typeface from another, and put them back. Every case you finish opens a job to print, and the ten printed posters keep the combination to a safe.

4940340.name: Spinny-Roly 64
4940340.short_description: An old-school gem collection game about a roly-poly who likes to bounce around.

1334570.name: Hardship
1334570.short_description: Hardship is a set on a dynamic world in a strange solar system. Build your city, Design your buildings and progress through an in-depth technology tree.  Gather resources, craft tools, manage citizens’ needs, and battle the elements.

3815360.name: PC Versus
3815360.short_description: The first ever competitive PC building game. Go head to head with another player on the same task and budget, pick from 800+ real components and overclock for an edge. Push too hard and your build crashes. Free to play.

2433560.name: Meadgard
2433560.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends create the ultimate Viking tavern. Hunt mystical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.

4842990.name: Barnburners
4842990.short_description: 5-on-5 arcade hockey with huge hits, dirty dangles and top shelf goals. Pick from 24 fictional clubs, build a Franchise, take the game outdoors, or face friends in couch and online head to head play.

4385740.name: SCP: Antimemetics Division
4385740.short_description: Deadly memory-altering SCPs have breached containment. Most are invisible without special equipment, and can fill your mind with hazardous knowledge…or leave you an empty husk. Scavenge, survive, and escape this procedurally-generated SCP nightmare.

3903960.name: Echoes of Nothing Demo
3903960.short_description: Explore the vast ruin of a massive colony ship, find powerful weapons, ships and equipment, and decide the fate of existence itself. Dodge bullets, distract missiles and outmaneuver your enemies, then retaliate with lasers and heavy artillery.

2971410.name: Prospera
2971410.short_description: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise  to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

4644550.name: Treug Dispute: Tabletop Interpretation
4644550.short_description:
In this single-player board game, you take control of the city of Treug and overcome the crises that befell it.
Balance resources and develop the city. But most importantly: 
find out how this story truly ended.

4055250.name: Kulipari: United
4055250.short_description: Unleash your inner warrior in this high-octane 3D Beat 'Em Up! Team up with friends in 4-player local or online co-op to defend the Amphibilands. Master unique combat styles, dodge deadly hazards, and battle the Scorpion Army in a cinematic adventure expanding the Kulipari saga.

5141130.name: Dragons Invasion Demo
5141130.short_description: Dragons Invasion is a Souls 'Em Up. A 2D horizontal shooter where you roll like Dark Souls and swap colors like Ikaruga. Absorb shots, fill your power gauge, and destroy dragons — solo or in local co-op.

5438400.name: Alien Prospectors
5438400.short_description: Head out onto an alien planet with a drill, a scanner and a limited supply of air. Dig up over a thousand different finds, sell them at headquarters, and upgrade your way to the deepest, rarest deposits, on your own or alongside other prospectors. Stay hydrated!

5103950.name: One’s Trash Another’s Treasure
5103950.short_description: You spent everything on 500,000 unclaimed cargo boxes. Now you have to open every single one. A first-person incremental game about grinding boxes, feeding a hole that never fills, and calling it a business plan. Buy tools, drones, and automation. Only 499,997 to go.

4974130.name: Prison Anomaly
4974130.short_description: Trapped in a loop in a high-security prison. Inspect cells and surroundings for anomalies, avoid monsters, and press the correct button at the end of the corridor to submit your report and make it to Block A10.

2477110.name: Chess Duel
2477110.short_description: Bring chaos to the chessboard. Choose your powers, spend stone points, shield a piece or recall a fallen queen. Face Steam friends, AI rivals and tournaments in atmospheric 3D chess, with separate Classic and Chaos ranked ladders. Medieval combat is now in private testing.

3669430.name: Twilight Imperium Digital
3669430.short_description: Dominate the galaxy in the legendary strategy board game, now available digitally. Choose your faction and fight to claim the Imperial Throne!

1704950.name: The Beast Awoke To Eat Your Darlings
1704950.short_description: The Beast gets hungry. The Beast devours your cats. The Beast sees you. The Beast comes for you. You have no weapons. You have rules to learn and turn against them. Know each nightmare, outsmart the Beast and its Sentinels, and carry your darlings to safety. Every cat you save counts.

3873610.name: vrOS
3873610.short_description: vrOS puts your desktop windows on panels inside VR, with a laser pointer and a VR keyboard that work in the real window. Fix your playspace, assign and calibrate trackers, watch frame timing, and add VRChat OSC, OBS, Twitch and soundboard tools — all in one crash-resistant overlay.

5333390.name: SPLIT-S
5333390.short_description: A flight-combat roguelite inside a strange old computer. Choose your route through a hostile network, raid its defenses, and bring your earnings home. Master three flight modes in one run, then buy hardware upgrades through underground bulletin boards.

4824960.name: Crop and Claw 2 Demo
4824960.short_description: Crop and Claw 2 is an Adventure-RPG about dragons, plants, memories, and more. Delve into a whole new continent of secrets and unearth the roots of the strange events going on.

5100880.name: E-Files
5100880.short_description: E-FILES — a psychological horror game in the style of the PS1 era, centered around a secret investigation, rituals, and the mysterious “Lists.” Explore dark locations, search for clues, solve puzzles, and avoid deadly traps. Fixed camera angles, retro graphics, and limited saves.

5383710.name: The Grander Demo
5383710.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world. Learn the difference between being God and just playing.

5316210.name: Metromino
5316210.short_description: Build your own metropolis from tetromino pieces! Start with a small village, grow your city, build roads and upgrades, earn millions, and keep your residents happy.

1490990.name: Isles of Krom
1490990.short_description: Isles of Krom is a dark fantasy top-down extraction ARPG blending challenging visceral combat with a high-stakes extraction loop. Craft and upgrade gear for your Ward before deploying them into the perilous Krom archipelago to retrieve vital materials and halt the creeping Corruption.

5050520.name: Moving Company Simulator
5050520.short_description: Run your own moving company with friends! Pack fragile items, carry heavy furniture, load the truck, and deliver everything in one piece. Play solo or in 1–4 player co-op. Earn tips, build your reputation, and grow from a small crew into the city's top movers.

4870640.name: Steal Banana
4870640.short_description: Grow your banana empire in a multiplayer farming simulator where nothing is safe. Plant rare trees and collect your bananas, then visit other players farms to steal their crops and take their best trees

3997060.name: JARED
3997060.short_description: 2D puzzle platformer where you are a repair droid descending into a dangerous facility. Transport fragile, broken computers along the way and help them reach the Repair Station. Solve environmental puzzles, find helpful upgrades, and unravel the facility's dark mystery.

5113690.name: Blendead
5113690.short_description: Find me. I'm right in front of you. A multiplayer blend-and-seek where you pose as an NPC in a crowd — one mistake and you're dead.

4021250.name: Pages of Tomorrow
4021250.short_description: Challenge fate in this psychological visual novel about a juvenile psych ward patient who discovers a book that can predict the future.

5299130.name: Oblivion Line
5299130.short_description: Oblivion Line is a deckbuilding roguelike puzzle RPG set in an underground city where memories are traded. Connect drops, reshape your deck, and plan around enemy intentions. Manage your sanity and weigh difficult choices as you follow an abandoned subway line.

5052790.name: KNELL
5052790.short_description: The parish is dead, and the bell must be kept. A grim folk-horror survivors-like: hold a plague-dead churchyard from the first toll to matins, with eleven violent rites drawn from grave-craft and a night that changes as worse things answer the bell.

2184280.name: Vexlands
2184280.short_description: Vexlands is a realm of surprises. Every newly opened space brings a surprise: loot, resources, dungeons, monsters and disasters! Build your village where you craft new equipment before you explore uncharted areas, and find relics that explain who came before and why these lands are cursed.

5264860.name: Human Power Plant
5264860.short_description: The last job left for humanity in an ultimately automated society was pedaling bicycles to generate electricity.

4295650.name: Eclipse: Corrupted Galaxy
4295650.short_description: After falling into the underground of the company where you work, you must escape while game characters come to life and hunt you down. Explore dark environments, solve puzzles, and reveal the obscure secrets of Ruzu Co. to discover the story hidden behind the scenes...

5191970.name: Mimic2 - Idle MMORPG
5191970.short_description: An idle incremental MMORPG that keeps auto battling while you are AFK or offline. Clear mimic maps, hunt bosses, and pour the loot into 7,522 item levels to reach the top. A free incremental idle MMO with RPG depth: no ads, no pay-to-win. Cross-platform: desktop, browser and mobile, one character.

4500020.name: Tie Down
4500020.short_description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

5484860.name: LeechWire 2003
5484860.short_description: It's 2003. Your modem screams, pop-ups multiply, and your shared folder is your empire. Leech files, seed them for credits, close fake virus alerts before they eat your bandwidth, and keep your LeechMessenger friends happy in this Y2K idle game.

1387110.name: Hyper Snatch
1387110.short_description: A 5v5 capture the flag game built on skill-based movement, utility orbs, and ultimate abilities. Master chaining slides, dives, b-hops, and super jumps to juke defenders and run the flag home, or play tactically with team orb strategies to control the field. No guns, just tags and outplays.

1415600.name: Frequency: Chernobyl
1415600.short_description: An immersive adventure game about the secrets of radio broadcasts. Take a journey to the Exclusion Zone, face the time anomaly, and solve the mystery behind the broadcasts from 1986.

5314120.name: Seashell Hoarder: Tidy Up
5314120.short_description: A cozy first-person beachcombing game where you gather, clean, and shelve thousands of seashells along a sun-warmed coastline. Sort each find into its rightful place, restore the shore, and turn a scattered coastline into a curated collection at your own pace.

5462060.name: SheepTag: Dragons
5462060.short_description: SheepTag returns with dragons. Build your lair, unleash magical abilities, and outwit wizard hunters—or grab a staff and chase the dragons down. Dive into a frantic, round-based multiplayer hunt packed with cunning escapes and close calls. Run. Hide. Outwit.

5247790.name: DenimDoug_909
5247790.short_description: Follow Denim, a blue dog, on a bizarre adventure filled with strange characters, unexpected choices, and plenty of random outcomes. This animated FMV point-and-click game features 20+ different endings, and every choice can lead somewhere unexpected!

5010530.name: Cat and Paste!
5010530.short_description: A chaotic copy-and-paste hide-and-seek with cats that can turn into anything. "Copy" a stage object to transform into it, then "Paste" decoys everywhere to hide in plain sight! A prop hunt party game for up to 16 players online!

5271040.name: Junkyard Reseller
5271040.short_description: Explore abandoned junkyards, discover valuable items, clean and restore them, then sell them for profit. Expand your land, hire workers and delivery drivers, and turn a small resale operation into your own junkyard empire.

5089330.name: Iron Command
5089330.short_description: Command a war machine from inside the battlefield. Iron Command is a classic base-building RTS — harvest, build, research, attack — playable on your monitor or in VR, where the battlefield lies in front of you and your orders go out from a tablet on your wrist.

3097640.name: 玫昙 She From TheFuture
3097640.short_description: Mei can see hidden memories. Two years ago, Her lovers Tan died in a fire, ruled suicide. She became a detective. Then she discovered she can travel through time. She must return to the night Tan died—can she change it or just watch it burn again?

5417600.name: blockia Demo
5417600.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo. Free demo with selected parts.

4269240.name: The Orphaned House
4269240.short_description: Step into the mystery of The Orphaned House. Explore its rooms, manipulate the environment to solve puzzles, and follow your intuition to uncover every hidden secret in this atmospheric adventure game.

5401920.name: Kitty Cat Match!
5401920.short_description: A match 3 game featuring cute cats (and one dog) with multiple different modes to be played solo or with up to 49 other people or friends!

4638900.name: Greedy Getaways
4638900.short_description:
Grab your friends and cruise aboard Greedy Getaways!
Explore tropical islands, haul gold back to the captain, and pocket a little on the side. Wobbly physics, exclusive upgrades, questionable outfits, and a good laugh on every excursion!

3242710.name: Gambeat
3242710.short_description: Start with pawns, end with clowns. Build a roster of evolving pieces, stack game-breaking stickers, and chain together absurd high scores in this chess roguelike deckbuilder.

4129880.name: Emptiness Sire Demo
4129880.short_description: Three survivors in a world consumed by cosmic horror. Solve turn-based puzzles and face deadly enemies, because death is part of the journey, but you can undo its consequences.

4940850.name: Kachow Kart Racing
4940850.short_description: Race with friends, customize your kart, and create and grow your clan! Drift, boost, and use abilities to outplay your rivals in Kachow Kart Racing. Battle it out online or in local split-screen, and fight for the top spot in ranked races!

4713180.name: Tear of Stars
4713180.short_description: Control two heroes as one in this atmospheric 2D Metroidvania. Explore two ruined kingdoms, from crystalline ruins to clockwork towers. Seamlessly swap between Asir’s elemental swordplay and Layla’s tactical wire-bow to solve cooperative puzzles and seek the truth behind the Darian legacy.

5358340.name: Fieldmade Demo
5358340.short_description: Everything in this world is something you drew. Sketch a hoe and till the soil with it. Sketch an axe, a watering can, a fishing rod... and they become real, working tools with real stats. You can draw literally anything you want.

2591700.name: SetPoint Volleyball
2591700.short_description: Chaotic beach volleyball from 2v2 to 6v6! Play online with up to 12 players or with up to 4 on one PC. Nail spikes, prank your teammates and dodge tsunamis, lava and a hungry gator. Bots fill empty spots. Save your best plays and funniest fails as video clips.

5424350.name: Wonderdrift
5424350.short_description: Wonderdrift is a relaxing open-world flying exploration game. Pilot a UFO through colorful, imaginative regions, discover unusual structures, and collect Orbs and Artifacts. Explore at your own pace without the fear of dying, or pick up speed through Slipstream Rings.

2440760.name: GRAVHOUNDS
2440760.short_description: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

4180550.name: Untold Cases - Stillwater Lake
4180550.short_description: Inspired by true events. A suspicious disappearance at Stillwater Lake is quickly ruled an accident. Relying on scattered notes and your radio, explore the restricted zones to uncover her final hours. You must survive a ruthless local cult determined to keep their dark secrets hidden.

5346980.name: NitLink
5346980.short_description: Play 30 fps console games at 60 fps on your PC monitor with experimental frame generation. NitLink is a low-latency capture card viewer with real HDR10 passthrough, picture-in-picture and native support for Elgato 4K Pro, 4K X and 4K S capture cards.

1215040.name: Faith of Fate Demo
1215040.short_description: Faith of Fate, a demo made by half million dreams for a half million testers. if you just have half Faith then you'll get just half Fate, good luck <3

5344070.name: blockia
5344070.short_description: A little street corner or a furnished room. A block-building simulator with simple controls that lets children and adults enjoy creating. Adjust the background, lighting, and composition to turn your own creation into a favorite photo.

3042040.name: Project: Autumn
3042040.short_description: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.

5429180.name: Eggstra Tidy
5429180.short_description: 4,800 eggs lie scattered across a grand old egg shop. Find every one, sort it onto the right shelf by color and pattern, and hunt down 12 hidden golden eggs. Hatch helper chicks, unlock upgrades and turn total chaos into perfect order.

4475540.name: SKINFACE Demo
4475540.short_description: SKINFACE is a short-and-punchy stealth game where you embody a faceless hitman who needs to steal the faces of others to gain the trust of their target. Set in dark soviet-era apartment complexes, evade the police and get your victim to open up the door for you. Knock, knock!

4893310.name: Master Builders
4893310.short_description: Master Builders is a strategic building game about constructing Gothic cathedrals. Plan your worksites, win over craftsmen and guilds, secure resources, and outbuild rival master builders to create the city’s grandest landmark.

2350230.name: Clayverse
2350230.short_description: Embark on an epic quest in the extraordinary world of Clayverse. Mold your clay hero, master crafting, and explore a mesmerizing multiverse. Engage in tactical clay combat inspired by classic MMORPGs, and experience gory claymation for a thrilling, darkly humorous twist.

4927420.name: Idle of the Dead
4927420.short_description: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

4476520.name: Drop Command Demo
4476520.short_description: Classic '90s Mech combat at a grand scale! Build a Mech empire and conquer the stars. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds. You are the battlefield commander leading from the cockpit.

2818690.name: A Short Odyssey
2818690.short_description: Discover a mysterious 17th century Caribbean island. Perfect your swordplay, take on giant bosses, cook tasty dishes, or take in the scenery, it's your choice in this 3rd Person RPG. Investigate the secrets of the island while you freely explore a detailed simulated world.

5050670.name: Rude Supermarket Simulator
5050670.short_description:
Running the store is your job. Listening to the customers is your punishment.
Rude Supermarket Simulator is a first-person supermarket management game for 1–4 players.

3884740.name: Fred Fuches Around
3884740.short_description: Fred Fuches Around is an FPS game where a guy named Fred and (almost) all of his immediate family was killed inside of his home and now the ones who fuched around will find out.

3458270.name: Type For Speed
3458270.short_description: Your keyboard is the gas pedal. Type to accelerate, chain clean words into combos and nitro, and race friends or bots across neon retro tracks. Or survive the endless highway, where one crash ends the run. 10 languages, each typed in its own script.

3914970.name: Lucky Newt
3914970.short_description: Join Lucky Newt, Amelia Axolotl, and Murphy Mudpuppy on a vibrant, platforming adventure to stop the evil Salazar from stealing the legendary 5 Leaf Clover and taking over their home.

5338000.name: BoteK.O.
5338000.short_description: Start a band, run your bar and fight to the beat! BoteKO is a co-op rhythm beat ’em up for up to 4 players where every hit lands on the beat of your own instrument. Play locally or online, nail the timing and turn every brawl into a show.

4700300.name: Copy Cats
4700300.short_description: Utilize the power of the mysterious cloning machine and use your handy copy cats to solve puzzles and help a little kitty escape from a strange virtual dimension!

5375170.name: My Dirty Little Lake
5375170.short_description:
Cast your net to clean up a dirty lake and bring nature back in this cozy, relaxing game.
With cute dogs as helpers, recycle trash and earn money to upgrade your gear.
Lots of hidden treasures to find and wash, in a satisfying mini-game to decorate your house.
Wildlife appreciates your work.

5071780.name: Click Bait
5071780.short_description: Fight the internet’s worst monsters in a rhythm roguelite. Time your clicks on a spinning wheel to attack, block and survive chaotic minigames

5396330.name: P.A.L.S: Lost at Sea
5396330.short_description: A chaotic co-op raft survival game. After one wild night at sea, you and your friends wake up lost on a tiny raft. Fish up loot, smack flopping fish, build walls and cannons, and battle a hungry shark, storms and ridiculous bosses on the long way home.

4838230.name: Rift Crashers
4838230.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op bullet-heaven survivor. Pick from 8 characters, stack 18 weapons, and fight through 5 dark fantasy biomes before crashing the Rift itself. Build broken loadouts, survive escalating chaos, and take on a multi-boss gauntlet finale.

5297950.name: Shape Gomoku
5297950.short_description: Who says five stones have to form a straight line? Build target shapes in this fresh take on Gomoku. Challenge Easy or Hard BOTs, play locally with a friend, or invite a Steam friend online. Explore Classic, five-minute Race, and Secret Targets modes, plus 23 puzzles.

3616480.name: Grimdelve
3616480.short_description: The world above is gone. Guide two souls through a rotting underground and shape who they become with character traits in this grimdark role playing game. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Anyone can die, your choices matter, and people remember how you treat them.

3931270.name: Wolf Plot
3931270.short_description: Wolf Plot is a tricky puzzle-platformer. Help your wolves catch the sheep in over 100 levels. Use a variety of tools to control your wolves: rockets, fans, bombs, bridges, and more.

5389050.name: Nonogram Detective Demo
5389050.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

4304620.name: OVR Overlay Translator
4304620.short_description: Real-time VR translation. Via OCR, it converts foreign game and app text using machine, LLM, and offline engines, overlays results on the original, transcribes live voice into subtitles, and sends to VRChat Chatbox. 30 languages, multilingual UI, full controller support.

4815880.name: Nonogram Detective
4815880.short_description: Become a nonogram-solving detective! Complete picture puzzles to reveal clues, follow the trail, and crack silly cases for clients with unusual problems.

4483090.name: Robot Basketball League
4483090.short_description: Robot Basketball League is a gritty sports game featuring a modified version of 1v1 Basketball. This is where the most competitive robot athletes gather. Do you have what it takes to succeed in this League?

5367100.name: Farmkill Remastered
5367100.short_description: Defend your newly acquired farmhouse and garden from an ever-growing zombie horde that attacks every night. Buy deadly flowers, fences, fully automatic weapons, bombs, exploding chickens and more to defend your farm at all costs!

3205550.name: Super Mining Mechs Demo
3205550.short_description: Build your own Super Mining Mech and explore the underground in search of new natural resources. Customize your mech with unlockable parts to dig deeper than ever - by yourself or with up to 7 friends in online co-op multiplayer! So, what are you waiting for? There’s mining to be done!

5453650.name: Benson Bones Demo
5453650.short_description: You claw out of a grave with no memory, and a friendly dog named Benson finds you. Benson Bones is a top-down pixel art adventure RPG with timing-based combat, Souls-style checkpoints and a hand-built world of doors that open where they shouldn't.

4269700.name: Minutes to Meltdown
4269700.short_description: Everything breaks on your 6 minute shift in this 1960s nuclear power plant. You and up to 3 colleagues keep the power flowing, the town lit, and the reactor from melting down. Push for one more shift, or clock out while you're ahead?

5364580.name: StoneWardens
5364580.short_description: A goofy roguelike deckbuilder where your runestones are the ammo. Load them, throw them, build a wall out of them, and lead your heroes through four acts of monsters that beatbox, stink and curse. Not your classic deckbuilder - that one (has) rocks !

4042470.name: MoonVeil
4042470.short_description:
A tense co-op PvP social deduction game for 3–12 players.
Loot by day, survive the night, uncover the werewolves — or become one.

5314450.name: 方寸小家 RoomFolk
5314450.short_description: Build your own home in this sandbox game, mix and match a huge selection of furniture and decorations, and design your garden too! Export your creative process as a video and your design as architectural drawings with one click!

5385400.name: Chess War
5385400.short_description: Chess War brings chess to life in epic 3D battles between legendary armies from different historical eras. Challenge friends online or locally, face a competitive AI, and watch every capture unfold through dynamic, action-packed combat animations.

5135770.name: 炼妖录：无相之人
5135770.short_description: A first-person deckbuilding roguelite inspired by Chinese folklore. Defeat monsters and refine their souls to claim their abilities as your own. Build powerful combinations, shape your supernatural form, and forge a different playstyle with every expedition.

1171340.name: A.I.M. War Protocol
1171340.short_description: A role-playing game with survival and action-simulation elements. You are going to explore a huge world of an alien planet full of mysteries and secrets. Fight, trade, loot, evolve and collect knowledge about the world. Become the best. Survive where others die.🚀

5322140.name: Tidy Bakery
5322140.short_description:
Your cozy bakery is a little… messy 🍰

Sort, organize, and put away about 3,000 freshly baked treats. Take your time, enjoy the cozy atmosphere, and turn bakery chaos into perfect order.

4745790.name: Black Ledger: The Antique Mafia Demo
4745790.short_description:
Run an antique shop during the day.

Lead a criminal organization at night.

Maintain a balance between profit, loyalty, and suspicion... Every choice has consequences.

5463790.name: SWARM OF KILLER ROBOTS
5463790.short_description: SWARM OF KILLER ROBOTS is a 2.5D puzzle shooter where you must terminate all hostiles and rescue any hostages. Death is not the end; your previous attempts will replay alongside your current attempt. Choose between 12 unique drones to assemble your swarm and execute the perfect mission.

1828280.name: Infinity Girl
1828280.short_description: Infinity Girl is a high-speed rhythm/racer/roguelite where everything — every action, every enemy and every spectacular world you encounter — is driven by the beat of the music. Each run is unique, with procedural levels that test your skills as you grind, drift, boost and leap to the rhythm.

4174620.name: Market Moe
4174620.short_description: Work the night shift on a Japanese street… where something shouldn’t be there.

4750680.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil Demo
4750680.short_description: Atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring a fantasy world through magical portals. Explore the first location, collect rare equipment, and discover the world of Sunveil.

5039630.name: CATCAR Pit Crew
5039630.short_description: Be the pit crew of a race team. Jack the car, wrench off the wheels, swap tires and refuel by hand while the race keeps going. Co-op with friends. Things will catch fire.

4725170.name: Elven Huntress: Sunveil
4725170.short_description: An atmospheric action RPG about an elven huntress exploring fantasy worlds through magical portals. Fight, collect rare equipment, and restore the ancient fortress of Sunveil.

5380380.name: Sumo Dynasty
5380380.short_description: Run a sumo stable as its oyakata. Raise young men from amateur sumo to the top of the banzuke, survive the Yokozuna Council, buy elder names and build a dynasty, in the most in-depth sumo management game ever made. In English and full Japanese.

4245390.name: The Shaman Diary Demo
4245390.short_description:
A story-driven turn-based RPG with deep strategy and rich gameplay.
Explore a vast heroic fantasy world, master skills, gear up, and forge your own path.
The Ravagers are closing in. Will you protect Astreia?
Experience the opening chapters of an epic story inspired by a 650-page original novel.

4734800.name: Corrupted Dice
4734800.short_description: A dice roguelite where even your best dice break. Unlock upgrades across runs, combine dice and relics, reshape your collection at the Black Market, and wager in minigames while keeping heat and corruption under control.

4313640.name: NeverVeil Gate
4313640.short_description: NeverVeil Gate is an online multiplayer social deduction game where words are weapons and trust is fragile. Players complete tasks while an Imposter hides among them, unable to kill directly but able to summon the Gate’s entity with a secret keyword. Trust the wrong voice and the gate will answer.

5073520.name: Brothers Demo
5073520.short_description: A cooperative medieval action game where you and your brother fight through dangerous environments, take on powerful enemies, and grow stronger together. Brothers serves as the foundation and showcase for a much larger co-op experience currently in development.

4712690.name: Roads and Relics
4712690.short_description: A co-op horror game where you have to run an antique store and find valuables in a procedurally generated world

4335990.name: Plura Ingenia: Patient 16
4335990.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game where your personality shapes the experience. Answer unsettling questions, endure disturbing trials, and survive an evaluation that adapts to how you think and behave.

3572070.name: Athelan Battlegrounds
3572070.short_description: Made by 2 people, Athelan Battlegrounds is an old school PvP turn-based tactics where player skill matters most. Build your team and engage in a meaningful battle of wits against other players in this "Chess meets LoL" indie game!

4837000.name: Shin'ai Rewritten
4837000.short_description: Run off to the Japanese countryside to connect with your Grandfather. Breathe new life into your grandmother's garden, and get to know the locals of a rural Japanese town in this cozy life sim rpg.

4066570.name: Half Faith Tower
4066570.short_description: Ascend an endless tower in this dark fantasy roguelite where strategy meets luck. Arrange your weapons, drop the orb, and unleash powerful attacks, defenses, and magic. Face increasingly deadly enemies, grow stronger, and fight to survive. Every floor is a new challenge. How high can you climb?

4785550.name: Lucky Coin Pusher Demo
4785550.short_description: Lucky Coin Pusher is a coin pusher simulator focused on deck-building. Combine characters, coins (or bowling balls), stickers, items and other elements to build unique synergies and hit the jackpot.

5135660.name: Spear Dive
5135660.short_description: Take up your spear in this first-person freediving simulator. Study fish behavior, manage oxygen and body temperature, and upgrade your gear to dive deeper. Explore seas that change daily with temperature, turbidity, and waves. Complete your fish encyclopedia and unlock new fishing grounds.

5015450.name: DesktopPiP
5015450.short_description: DesktopPiP lets you capture regions of any window into interactive Picture-in-Picture windows. Save and restore layouts, interact through PiPs, and combine windows with Background Layers to build a beautiful customizable dashboard that fits the way you work.

5458400.name: PUNG!
5458400.short_description: Blast your friends off the arena with an air gun. No health bars, just position and terrain. Shoot the floor to rocket jump, fight on tilting floors, in blizzards and on moving trains, and land the final push in this first-person multiplayer ring-out shooter.

3671460.name: Dragon Fields
3671460.short_description: Live the simple life in this cozy game where you farm crops, go fishing, play music, raise and mutate dragons, and customize your character!

4836770.name: 熊猫喵 Panda vs Meow
4836770.short_description: Play a round little panda fighting off cat hordes in this top-down survival roguelite. Mix weapons and relics, unleash active skills, and buy traits between waves. Collect matching archetype traits to activate synergies that change how you fight.

5227900.name: PAIMT ARENA
5227900.short_description: A fast arena shooter where paint is power. Master air movement, fight with artist's tools, and shape your own arenas. Host custom matches with friends, build maps in the in-game editor, and leave your mark on every wall.

4094560.name: Hoptale Demo
4094560.short_description: Hoptale is a Roguelite adventure that fuses hopscotch with a slot machine. Play as Tuby, a rabbit whose only weapon is his jump, against the awakened God of Chaos. In battle the tiles below spin into reels — call the stop, line up attacks, strike. Collect tiles, build your run, outsmart chaos.

4848670.name: カラーリコレクション
4848670.short_description: A near-future drama ADV where you decide the fate of faulty automatons. As a doll artisan, gather keywords from dialogue and solve color-mixing puzzles. Your reports tip the balance between respecting emotion and correcting it, branching to multiple endings. Holographic UI, chill vibes.

5080030.name: SEC//SIM — Security Engineer Simulation
5080030.short_description: Stand the 1 a.m. watch as a SOC defensive AI. The intruder is already inside; you see only its traces. Tell attack from routine, pull threads across hosts and keys, win a human sign-off, excise it in one strike. Real ATT&CK techniques, detections you write, twenty-plus nights, more than one ending.

5459900.name: Bed Wars
5459900.short_description: Build across the clouds, defend your bed, and raid rival islands in a first-person team battler. Gather resources, buy guns and melee gear, and turn a narrow bridge into your next attack route. Practice solo or take on bots before the next team fight.

4379870.short_description:
"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?"
A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You."
Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.
perhaps  "Imprison" is the only mercy.

2321810.name: Lofi Ball - Founders Pack
2321810.short_description: This DLC will give you 10 more levels to play and some more customization for your ball

5292900.name: WAKABOOM
5292900.short_description: Claw Machine × Roguelike. Magical creatures turned stolen souls into dolls and opened a mysterious shop for fun. Grab cute dolls, build your doll pool, install components, choose upgrades, and stack effects to deal huge damage. Defeat Bosses and unlock new characters and stories.

5207400.name: Kiss魔咒：the accursed child
5207400.short_description: A male lord's heir gender-bends into a stunning beauty?! A single sneeze sparks a crisis where the only cure is intimate contact with dangerous suitors. Trapped between a loyal knight, a scheming fiancée, a tsundere wizard, and a toxic tutor, can you survive this rom-com?

2355030.name: Lofi Ball - Wipeout
2355030.short_description: This DLC will give you 10 more levels to play and some more customization for your ball

5289760.name: Monster Girls of Another World: Pleasure Chronicle
5289760.short_description: A casual erotic action RPG with fully animated sex scenes and over 200 animated pixel-art CGs! Explore, earn money, and visit monster girl brothels. Write about your encounters and sell your articles to fund your next visit. Enjoy simple one-button combat, fishing, and casino games along the way!

2471410.name: Lofi Ball - Dessert
2471410.short_description: This DLC contains 2 skins (Donut) (Wreath), and 10 new levels (Dessert)

1784300.name: Wookland
1784300.short_description: Build your dream festival in this management sim, then do it for 45,000. Every wook is simulated, from their rave fam to their bladder. Zone the campgrounds, book the stages, staff the gates and keep a crowd that moves like a fluid from crushing itself. Keep the wooks alive.

5352290.name: MMCitadels
5352290.short_description: A colorful RTS with rainbow skills.

3767760.name: Heart Idler Demo
3767760.short_description: Heart Idler is a  clicker/idle game where you start with nothing and build your way up to a vast collection of hearts! Click to generate hearts, invest them in powerful upgrades, and watch your heart count soar. Can you unlock all the upgrades and achieve the ultimate collection of hearts?

5005140.name: Undermoon
5005140.short_description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Step through portals, plan your moves on a square grid, choose a race, and combine weapons and skills. Use fire, ice and lightning to shape battles, explore themed areas, face bosses and find a way out of this moonlit world.

3749810.name: Rogue Shapes Demo
3749810.short_description: Rogue Shapes is a fast-paced roguelike bullet hell where you battle waves of deadly shapes, level up, and choose powerful upgrades. Complete challenges to unlock new playable shapes, each with unique weapons. How long can you survive the chaos?

5339480.name: Terra Machina
5339480.short_description: Dig deep, build big, and let science do the smashing! TerraMachina is a 2D mining and factory sandbox. Turn mountains of ore into powerful drills, weapons, and automated factories across diverse biomes. Play solo or in co-op for up to 4 players.

2356380.name: Lofi Ball - Dungeon
2356380.short_description: This DLC will give you 10 more levels to play and some more customization for your ball

5195030.name: Kingdoms in Ink
5195030.short_description: A fantasy world's history unfolds on a single map. In this grand strategy game, kingdoms rise, borders shift, and kings and generals pass through the generations. Simply watch, or command a nation and unite the world. Follow towns, people, dragons, and adventurers through a history all your own.

5019530.name: 出招吧师傅 Demo
5019530.short_description: A Roguelike strategy deckbuilder where cards determine your moves. Each card becomes an attack, defense, movement, or special skill. Arrange cards wisely to trigger combos, deal more damage, and adapt to changing enemy attacks.

5306830.name: Deckwork
5306830.short_description: Build a six-card deck that fights for you. Draft, reorder and sacrifice cards to forge powerful synergies. Discover relics that change the rules and take on dungeons and fearsome bosses in this pixel-art fantasy auto-battler roguelite.

5044750.name: Mole & Ore
5044750.short_description: Become a stylish Mole armed with a three-claw grappling hook and dig your way to fortune! Snatch valuable ores, earn gold, unlock powerful upgrades, expand your mining automation, and build the ultimate underground mining empire in this satisfying incremental adventure.

5141440.name: ALL-HU: Mahjong Puzzle
5141440.short_description: Every hand must win. ALL-HU is a single-player mahjong puzzle with every tile face-up: read the wall, plan each draw and discard, and guide two — or four — hands to victory at once. 1,100+ solver-verified puzzles, including Steam-exclusive Gambit mode. No luck, no in-app purchases: pure tile logic.

4966170.name: Unbox Super Card
4966170.short_description: Buy CardBoxes, reveal valuable cards, build your automated opening factory, and Prestige to grow your fortune even faster. Complete every collection and become the ultimate card collector.

3178040.name: Deja-Vu of the Dead
3178040.short_description: Drink. Die. Repeat. When a mysterious experimental sparks a city-wide zombie outbreak you find yourself trapped in a 25-minute temporal time loop. Every decision you make matters. Explore an interconnected city, talk to fully voiced survivors, collect weapons, and uncover 23 distinct endings.

4395460.name: Guns, Princess and Braves
4395460.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

5074470.name: 星海余烬：联合舰队
5074470.short_description: Take the helm of a ten-thousand-ton flagship and feel it answer to momentum. A 2D real-time space combat game of flagship piloting, fleet command and roguelike growth. Fly the ship yourself, order escorts, refit warships, recruit captains - alone or with three friends over LAN.

5466320.name: Leftovers: Last Fridge Standing
5466320.short_description: A co-op arena survivors roguelike for 1–4 players where the leftovers fight back. Pick a food, pick a class and survive 20 waves of germs, mold and expired dairy with a ridiculous loadout of kitchen weapons. Fuse, evolve, synergize — and vote with your friends on what horror to open next.

5467510.name: Towers of Ruin
5467510.short_description: A roguelite tower defense with 36 mythic towers. Pick cards each run, evolve your towers, counter armored waves and hold out for 30 minutes until four final bosses arrive. Then draw your own maps in the built-in editor.

5480390.name: 紫灯
5480390.short_description: A romance-included story visual novel set amid a late‑19th‑century plague. After contracting the Black Pus Sickness, protagonist Chen Qianyu is sheltered by the mysterious Dr. Xu, and strange events destroy his old life.

5300020.name: ZombieBusters: Reborn
5300020.short_description: Five heroes. One relentless zombie king. Outsmart the hunt in a 5-vs-1 survival MOBA: survive, hunt zombies, break towers or pass the curse. Play either side with AI, or invite Steam friends to a private match for up to six players. Four maps. Fast decisions.

4433700.name: 過去でバズってVTuber -2018からならバズれるんじゃ！？
4433700.short_description: Time-leap back to 2018 and restart your VTuber career from zero. Fifty-three weeks to go viral. Pull in your own avatar through the OBS / VTube Studio virtual camera and watch yourself stream inside the game. Miss a goal and time rewinds — your skills stay in your muscle memory, run after run.

2374990.name: Primeval Horizon
2374990.short_description: Sci-Fi meets survival in a world of ancient creatures and anomalous entities! Play as prehistoric species in this Open World Multiplayer Creature Survival. Grow, create bloodlines, and conquer bosses to thrive in the continually evolving Primeval universe!

4987400.name: Cult Crasher
4987400.short_description: Twenty years ago, Val Thorne's family was taken from her by a sinister cult. Now armed with nothing but her dad's old pistol and a fresh bottle of whiskey, she's vowed to get her revenge...

4160280.name: Gorilla Gauntlet
4160280.short_description: Punch, Smash, and Slam your way through an army of ragdolling enemies to become the ultimate Gorilla. Zoom across arenas with your snappy Dash and Spin moves. Unlock cosmetics and face new foes as you progress through the Gorilla Gauntlet!

4656950.name: Attack of the Astrals Demo
4656950.short_description: Turn-based strategy roguelike where every battle is a tactical puzzle. Each move of your champion trio unleashes an attack and swaps tiles with other units. Combine skills, spells and summons to defeat a cosmic army that grows stronger as you do.

5292870.name: 寻丹
5292870.short_description: The Inner Way is a Five-Element roguelike deckbuilder. Arrange ingredients, harness elemental harmony and conflict, refine your deck, discover powerful builds, and overcome tribulations on your path to ascension.

4718820.name: 锁定战机
4718820.short_description:
Aiming Fighter is a space-themed shooter that puts you right in the cockpit. Alone against endless enemies, your only lifeline is your lock-on system.
Survival depends on your strategy: choose the right targets to lock-on, build up combos to unleash skills to stay alive!

2103460.name: Stay With Me! Alien Abduction Story Demo
2103460.short_description: Psychological Horror game, seek how to survive this strange encounter with beings from another world

4377600.name: Morvex : Ash Grave
4377600.short_description: Morvex: Ash Grave adds a new haunted map with relentless zombie waves, new weapons, deeper upgrades, unique enemy variants, a brutal boss fight, a map-specific puzzle, and a dedicated leaderboard for this challenge alone. 🧟‍♂️🔥

5347600.name: Crazy City Golf
5347600.short_description: The whole city is your golf course! Tee off at once with up to 8 friends in this online party golf game. Find your own route to the cup through alleys and over rooftops in a city rebuilt every round. Summon meteors and tornadoes for shortcuts or sabotage, and turn wild accidents into comebacks!

5122760.name: COSPECO: Greedy Bullets
5122760.short_description:
Dodge enemy fire, shoot back, and keep getting stronger in this easygoing action shooter!
Switch between 9 different costumes to completely change your playstyle and turn the tide when the battle gets tough!

4957060.name: The Infinite Library Demo
4957060.short_description: Write words, fill shelves, and push the Weight of Knowledge to its first fold in this free demo. Six genres, rare Word discovery, undocumented Phrase crafting - and a library that's starting to notice you. The demo ends where the strangeness begins. Wishlist the full game.

5395710.name: 夜巡守则 Part.2
5395710.short_description: Players will explore the seven incredible night patrol rules on campus from the perspectives of five members, uncovering the terrifying truth behind mysterious and bizarre stories through investigation and selection.

5432180.name: Burn all out
5432180.short_description: Fired for missing the trash bin and dumped in the basement, channel your burnout into pure rage in this chaotic roguelike. Fight your way up the corporate ladder, crush middle management with office supplies, craft insane builds, and uncover this shady corporation's dark secrets.

5390550.name: The Wife Next Door - She Drains Me While Her Husband's Away
5390550.short_description:
We were just neighbors who exchanged a few words――or so I thought.

One day, while her husband was away, she made a bold move on me.

I knew it was wrong, but I couldn't resist her temptation...

And so begins our secret affair whenever her husband's away――.

4080650.name: DeVILSTOPIA
4080650.short_description: Devilstopia is a grid strategy battle roguelike inspired by retro classic games. Collect diverse skills, unleash creative combos, and overcome powerful foes. Unpredictable dangers await in a mysterious world.

5392330.name: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound
5392330.short_description: Shadow Princess: Crystalbound is 2D platformer focused on midair movement where you can place crystals anywhere in any level to help you reach the end of the stage. You create your own difficulty.

3955780.name: Psychotic Descent
3955780.short_description:
A narrative psychological first-person horror experience where you are trapped in the mind of a killer.

Step into the mind of a tormented soul as you navigate through fractured, corrupted memories, bend reality, reshape the mind, and piece together the truth to uncover a haunting mystery.

5470300.name: LRT-2
5470300.short_description: LRT-2 is a first-person atmospheric railway experience inspired by Manila's LRT Line 2 in the Philippines.

5329370.name: Candy Harvest
5329370.short_description: It's Halloween night and you've ventured into town for some trick-or-treating.

4882260.name: Vibe Train Demo
4882260.short_description: A cozy, casual train-themed desktop idle game. Explore the world by rail. Equip a variety of train cars, and grow crops, haul cargo, trade goods, and carry passengers along the way.

5270820.name: Pixel Sorter Factory
5270820.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

4563980.name: Survivor 53
4563980.short_description: This is a Island Defense - Survival game. You are going to start every game from zero(literally nothing). Expand your island, plant some resources(like tree, vegetables etc.) and trade with Vending Machine. Then, prepare for underwater enemies(like giant Crab, Kraken etc.). It's that simple.

5093810.name: Digsum
5093810.short_description: A relaxed incremental mining game about digging deeper, unlocking upgrades, and uncovering ancient artifacts.

2711580.name: 努斯跳跃的前奏 Soundtrack
2711580.short_description:
Do you like playing the viola as the main melody? Do you like piano, music box, finger organ, woodwind, and even string arrangement? If I let them play together! Would you like it?
There are no restless modern elements, but more direct communication of musical spirit that strikes deep into the soul.

3714800.name: Warlock: Dungeons & Dragons
3714800.short_description: Play as Kaatri in Warlock, a single-player, third-person action-adventure set in a D&D-inspired open world. Wield forbidden magic to bend the rules around you. Across exploration and combat, every challenge is a test of creativity, preparation, and cunning.

5353090.name: The Studio - Indie Grind Demo
5353090.short_description: Build a game that generates a million dollar in revenue. Or sell a million units. 10 turns is all you get. Raise capital, hire a team, pick a genre, manage productivity, run launch, clean up the post launch mess. All in a days work. How hard could it be? Minimalist, 2D, Economy, Turn based strategy.

3561600.name: Fortress Connected
3561600.short_description: Jump in and experience the tense action of Half-Life 2, Left 4 Dead, and many other worlds as your favourite gang of Mann Co. hired guns, as well as a few new faces in this crossing of various source engine worlds.

4714010.name: GloveUp!
4714010.short_description: GloveUp! is a singleplayer anime-themed female boxing game featuring realistic and physics-driven animations. Create and customize a roster of fighters, shape unique fighting styles through abilities, unlock outfits, level up and take on tougher opponents and challenges.

5464900.name: Gorilla Racers
5464900.short_description: Gorilla Racers is a colourful arcade racer. Drift, boost and fire your nitro through eleven wild arenas, alone or online with up to 4 players. Toss the Coconut Bomb, grab the Golden Banana, collect and upgrade cars and gorilla drivers, open packs and climb the trophy road.

5180790.name: Arcane Dash Demo
5180790.short_description: The Arcane Dash demo gives you full access to Episode 1 - Glimmelion - in the spirit of the shareware model from the 80s and 90s, it's 1/4 of the game completely free with no time limits and no restrictions.

5173190.name: Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure
5173190.short_description: Relive the past with Arcane Dash - A Pixel Adventure! Play the first 9 of 36 levels free. Ilenor the Brave’s wand, cauldron and diamond are stolen, and his beloved cat Shadowtongue has been catnapped! Blast through levels of pure chaos, filled with enemies and deathtraps, to get them back.

4113550.name: MIRROR CRYPT
4113550.short_description:
A surreal action RPG where dreams fight back. 
Explore vivid realms, face your nightmares, and choose what to destroy — or forgive.

2504810.name: Arcane Arena
2504810.short_description: Arcane Arena is a fast-paced multiplayer action game where spellcasters clash in team-based combat. Choose your class, master powerful abilities, and dominate the arena. Manipulate time, summon creatures, wield the elements, and combine magic with your team to claim victory.

3197360.name: 60 Seconds! Souper Scavenger
3197360.short_description: In the atomic wasteland there is but one god: SOUP. Run fast, jump high, and scavenge like crazy, or there will be no soup for you. Survive the dangers of the postapocalypse, bring back all the soup you can find, and become the SOUPER SCAVENGER.

5483650.name: The Perfect Part
5483650.short_description: Program a CNC mill like a puzzle: pick the steps, the tools and their order, press CYCLE START and watch the spindle cut real geometry in a soft clay workshop. Then the inspector measures your part against the drawing.

1173980.name: Shadow of the Road
1173980.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

5438330.name: Hotel Milgram
5438330.short_description: A short reverse horror story about a maid working at Hotel Milgram, a supernatural hotel entity.

5411840.name: Wok in Another World
5411840.short_description: A top-down action game meets hands-on restaurant management. A hot-tempered master chef wakes up as a catgirl in another world. Loot monster ingredients in the dungeon with your partners, then run your diner yourself: toss the wok, research recipes, forge gear and open a snack stall underground!

5395950.name: SOMNIMAZE
5395950.short_description:
That night, after playing a maze, I dreamed I was in one.
Find your way through five mazes and wake up to a refreshing morning.

3543960.name: 问题偶像的养成计划
3543960.short_description:
Welcome to the private performing arts college full of love and dreams - Xingmengdian~!

The sweat of youth and dreams is sprinkled in every corner of the college. Come and experience a happy and colorful campus life with the idols you meet!

4526040.name: Desk Rumble
4526040.short_description: Desk Rumble is a cute and casual desktop adventure. Play as a pencil case and round up your runaway stationery friends in short, lively rounds. Upgrade skills, evolve stationery, unlock skins, and complete your collection. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — just one more round!

4813510.name: Sanctuary of Small Things
4813510.short_description: A wholesome creature-collecting game, solo or co-op for up to four. Wander enchanting biomes, gather ingredients, brew gentle remedies, and heal the small things you find to grow your Sanctuary. Cosy, calm, and quietly addictive.

5315570.name: ZERO VISIBILITY
5315570.short_description: Survive one day at a time in a fog-drowned American town overrun by the dead. Scavenge for supplies, get back to base before dark, take in survivors and hold off night raids. Every sound draws them closer. Find five fragments of research data to learn what happened here.

5118500.name: Safari-TV
5118500.short_description: Open a safari agency with friends and turn every trip into a vlog episode. Assemble a physics-driven safari truck, drive tourists across an open world, and choose peaceful tours or dangerous, high-paying routes. Smuggle contraband, film every disaster, and repair your safari truck.

4529210.name: Iman
4529210.short_description: IMAN is an 8-bit Religious Horror Adventure inspired by "FAITH: The Unholy Trinity", putting you in the shoes of Rudi, a devout young man who must confront the possessed, the power of Dark Magic, and mystical beings.

5389300.name: Doodlefolk
5389300.short_description: Bring a little company to your Windows desktop. Meet procedural characters with distinct personalities, watch friendships and skills grow, and give your folk props and activities while you work or unwind. Customize their world with your own mods or ones from Steam Workshop.

2384221.name: Luminous Skies: A Short Adventure DLC
2384221.short_description:
Adds a few more missions.
More characters to select for the party.
More classes available for Briar.

4927690.name: Boomsday
4927690.short_description: Hordes of adorable animals and toys want you dead. Boomsday is a fast-paced top-down horde survival shooter. Mow down endless swarms, loot powerful weapons, stack game-breaking perks, and survive massive bosses every 10 waves. Solo or up to 8-player cross-play co-op or 2 on the couch.

2400840.name: Phantom Line
2400840.short_description: Join the paranormal SWAT. PHANTOM LINE is a co-op (1-4) shooter set in the post-nuclear European continent. Your mission is to search and contain paranormal events and activities (anomalies) hidden from the public eye, in an open world map full of dynamic events.

5207140.name: Seoul, The Night
5207140.short_description: The night martial law is declared, you stamp approval on papers as the situation-room coordinator. Your job is to leave no record, but the last scene is a court ruling. That night, martial law was stopped by a vote in the National Assembly. Play to find out how many times it nearly wasn't stopped.

4171430.name: Route Protocol
4171430.short_description: Route Protocol is a traversal-based racing and puzzle course builder. Control a robotic unit through modular obstacle courses filled with ramps, boosters, and hazards. Race in real-time heats, solve solo challenges, or build your own traversal gauntlets.

3245140.name: Hello Sunshine
3245140.short_description: A survival mystery set in the ruins of a corporate empire. Walk in the shadow of a giant robot during the sweltering days; stay close to keep warm during the cold nights. Scavenge, craft, upgrade — and piece together the broken puzzle of a world ruled by machines that refuse to shut down.

3760750.name: Eastwynne Demo
3760750.short_description: Demo of the upcoming CRPG, Eastwynne. In this short side-story, a group of magical college students need to stop a bad situation from getting worse.

4350100.name: Orbrix
4350100.short_description: Orbrix is a bullet heaven where you craft a unique build to defend against a swarm of bricks. Discover devastating synergies across 40+ upgrades. Survive 10 waves and bosses, then push your build to absurd limits in endless mode. Also, there are alien pets!

1368050.name: La Mer La Guerre
1368050.short_description: Experience Beautiful Age of Sail in this unique single player simulation. Pirates, smugglers, traders and navy officers. Stunning graphics, realistic sailing and combat, and deep persistent living world depending on your actions.

5321580.name: Trolley Problem Is Not Problem
5321580.short_description: A trolley-problem roguelite where everything you hit becomes a train car. Pull the lever, grow your train, plow through five tracks at once, and ram giant bosses with everything you've coupled.

5407640.name: Malignus Demo
5407640.short_description: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

5412990.name: Archival Security Demo
