5412990.short_description: The first three shifts of ARCHIVAL SECURITY. Roughly 30 to 50 minutes. A psychological horror game about a transcription job that goes wrong very slowly. Copy the slides, follow the six rules, and find out what the third one was protecting.

5423670.name: Once Human - Ocean Expansion: Isles of Abyss Bonus Pack
5423670.short_description: Claim your free Isles of Abyss Bonus Pack! Choose 1 of 7 exclusive Morphed Deviations, plus an Ocean Survival Supply Bag (Compact Water Filter, Diving Suit & more) and 2,000 Starchrom. Items available in-game starting October 21 (PT). One claim per account across all platforms — first claim only.

4895130.name: Medieval Ascendant Demo
4895130.short_description: From a serf bound to the soil to the head of a noble house. Farm, trade, build an economic empire across five provinces, claim land through war, intrigue or wealth — and forge a dynasty that outlives you.

4952170.name: Her Revenge
4952170.short_description: You are stuck inside a sealed apartment, and have to uncover a massive misunderstanding. Discover what happened to Grandma, and be completely silent. It's not your apartment. You are STUCK

5026430.name: Overwatch® Starter Pack 2026: Season 5
5026430.short_description: Get a head start to the season with 1000 Coins and Haunted Emre!

5075220.name: 叠叠不休 Demo
5075220.short_description: A card strategy game combining town building and dungeon adventures. Stack cards to manage your settlement, produce resources, battle enemies, and explore the unknown. Expand your floating island, collect treasures from the abyss, and lead your town toward greater prosperity.

5101980.name: Dungeons & Dynasties Demo
5101980.short_description: Football Manager meets D&D. Heroes die. Dynasties rise. The realm remembers both.Lead an adventuring guild through a living realm where every fixture is a dungeon, every hero can die in it, and every season is written down.

5195600.name: QuestAway
5195600.short_description: A tiny idle RPG that lives next to your taskbar. Build a party of heroes, send them off to fight and get back to work. There's loot waiting when you come back. Twelve times a day, everyone takes on a giant Colossus together.

5242440.name: Pick a Part Demo
5242440.short_description:
Clean dirty items and sell them to the locals, in the post-post-apocalyptic world of Pick a Part!
Join Sprout, the newcomer of a small island, where she has to manage her store and gain the trust of the town.

5253000.name: PENTO Demo
5253000.short_description: Five blocks instead of four change everything. Rotate and place pentominoes, clear lines, and learn to read the board in a whole new way. Chase high scores, take on different challenges, or unwind with music in your own neon lounge.

4530570.name: Book Nook Demo
4530570.short_description: Build miniature diorama scenes, piece by piece. Complete beautiful book nooks as you place furniture, decorations, and small details. Relax and enjoy the peaceful satisfaction of every detail falling into place, as you discover more about each moment in time.

4604140.name: Black Brew Simulator Demo
4604140.short_description: An open world where alcohol is illegal. Produce and sell it, find customers, take over territories, grow your gang, and build a criminal empire — alone or with friends.

4647130.name: Dead as Disco Streamer Safe Soundtrack Vol. 1
4647130.short_description: Never miss a beat with Volume 1 of Dead as Disco’s streamer safe soundtrack! A rhythm-packed double album complete with 15 streamer safe original songs and 5 bonus tracks!

4100210.name: Halls of Torment - The Lost Archives
4100210.short_description: Deep beneath the Halls lie the Lost Archives—a forbidden library where blood cultists and inquisitors hunt for secrets no mortal should know of, and even the books turn against the living.

4303660.name: Wartide
4303660.short_description: A military idle defense that runs as a desktop widget or full screen. Deploy infantry, tanks and gunships against waves from every side, evolve eight vehicle lines from WWII to modern armor and call in air strikes. Pin it beside your work, or go full screen and take command.

3533260.name: Wrap House Simulator🌯 Demo
3533260.short_description: Welcome to Wrap House Simulator Demo! Run your own wrap shop, chop, grill, and serve in this cooking adventure. Customize your shop, master the grill, and survive the rush solo or co-op with up to 4 players. Keep up with orders, satisfy customers, and build your dream restaurant!

4267480.name: Just A Dice Game
4267480.short_description: A roguelike where your deck is a bag of dice. Roll, choose some to score, and reroll to beat escalating targets. Lava erupts into obsidian, ghosts spawn on clear boards, and bombs reroll everything around them. Stack relics into game-breaking combos and laugh in the face of RNG.

3059410.name: Edenfall Demo
3059410.short_description: Unveil a mystical action-adventure where you shift between human, wolf, raccoon, and raven. Weave fluid combos across forms, purge corruption, and awaken the land’s lost beauty. Together with your spirit fox companion, embark on a soulbound journey of transformation, memory, and inner peace.

3069970.name: Elven Watcher Demo
3069970.short_description: To protect the future of the Elven race and to avenge those who have perished, wage war upon the foul Undead!

3224750.name: Slot & Dungeons Demo
3224750.short_description:
"Slot & Dungeons” is a deck-building roguelite in which the placement of enemies and items on the floor changes depending on the slots.
While developing your character, collect symbols along the way to enhance the contents of the slots and conquer the dungeon.

4298110.name: Harmony Of Tea
4298110.short_description: Small relaxing puzzle game where you need to find the right place for tea on a shelf. Travel from Yunnan Province to Shanghai as a tea courier, explore charming provinces and discover unique tea flavors.

2828790.name: Hyper Online: VTuber Avatar Studio
2828790.short_description: Hyper is the ultimate app for vtubers & avatar creators. Use our VTubing tools to make content, stream, connect, and do more. Are you ready to start your VTuber journey?

2899480.name: Bears In Space Soundtrack
2899480.short_description: Original Game Soundtrack for Bears In Space

5485650.name: 末日序列：诡域求生
5485650.short_description: ELDRITCH SEQUENCE is a Lovecraftian survival RPG that fuses rule-based horror with dungeon crawling. Uncover deadly rules, explore nightmarish dungeons, and fight to survive. Customize your attributes, develop unique builds, and combine powerful skills to forge your own path to survival.

1614780.name: BAD DREAMS
1614780.short_description:
Bad Dreams is a Solo VR Horror game with immersive gameplay based on real gesture. A unique experience, where nightmares become reality.
Fight, Run, Jump, Wipe your eyes, Cover your ears... while avoiding the game's traps and puzzles, you won't come out unscathed!

4483060.name: 8ave.
4483060.short_description:
『8ave.-Octave-』 is an 8-keyboard music game featuring a piano motif.
To focus solely on playing the keys, no special operations like flicks or slides are required.
The sheet music consists only of notes and long notes, allowing you to easily enjoy the feel of playing piano on a keyboard.

5375350.name: Pan, Please!
5375350.short_description: Grab. Sizzle on the beat. Serve. Pay the debt. A rhythm cooking roguelite where one frying pan grows a broke little shop into a fully automated kitchen storm — three pans, flying plates and GOLDEN TIME that never ends. Drag the pan, feel the beat.

5359540.name: Vampine: New Order Demo
5359540.short_description: Awaken to a world ruled by the Intelligences and reclaim your honor! A turn-based strategy roguelike deckbuilder where you lead a vampire rebellion, bonds powerful servants, craft tactical card decks, and combine unique abilities to outsmart your enemies.

5381180.name: Slaskescape 2
5381180.short_description: 40 interconnected skills fuel your next upgrade in this single-player 3D idle RPG. Gather materials, craft better gear and automate your supplies with hired workers, summons and inventions. Choose your next unlock, then let your character get to work.

3333190.name: Road Truckers: New Beginning
3333190.short_description: Be a TRUCKER, not a truck. Haul cargo, restore a forgotten town, and grow your trucking business in the first true trucking RPG. Get on foot to forge relationships, then jump back into your fully customizable rig to rule the road.

5261300.name: Wind and Cannon
5261300.short_description: Wind and Cannon is a top-down naval roguelite about sailing farther, fighting harder, and seeing how long your captain can survive. Hunt pirates and sharks, fish, trade, upgrade your ship, and push into dangerous waters before the sea finally takes you.

5379330.name: Hazzard Hearth
5379330.short_description: Survive the known (hunt, craft, fish, treat illness, mend bones, ration supplies, wolves, bears) and unknown (volatile weather, mutated beasts), stranded on a mountain. Solve the mystery and try to re-establish communications for rescue. Free roam or follow the story. Play single player or co-op.

5317250.name: Vampine: New Order
5317250.short_description: Awaken to a world ruled by the Intelligences and reclaim your honor! A turn-based strategy roguelike deckbuilder where you lead a vampire rebellion, bonds powerful servants, craft tactical card decks, and combine unique abilities to outsmart your enemies.

5190610.name: StickerScout
5190610.short_description: Welcome to Beaver Falls! Unwind with beautiful pixel art dioramas, authentic ambient nature sounds, and cozy wildlife photography. Patiently observe hidden animals, snap their photos, and turn your discoveries into adorable stickers to fill your journal.

5241190.name: 轮回小队 Demo
5241190.short_description: An "Infinite Genre" style game. Enter diverse worlds—featuring zombies, fantasy, martial arts, and more—either solo or with friends, then return to the "Main God" hub. Experiment with every imaginable ability.

4234130.name: LOST IN THE DARK LABYRINTH
4234130.short_description:
The labyrinth is waiting for challengers! Free demo available. 
Enter a giant dark labyrinth with limited light, ammo, health, and time. Find the keys, survive traps and enemies, and escape within 60 minutes.

5456860.name: Swords & Sodas
5456860.short_description: Friday night, a basement card table, and nobody wants to run the campaign. A d20 picks tonight's Game Master, and everyone else brings a character to the arena. Fight turn-based battles on a grid, roll every die yourself, and try to keep your sheet in one piece.

2779990.name: Wizarducks and the Lost Hat Demo

5414230.name: SCRATCH FEVER
5414230.short_description: Scratch tickets, merge cash 2048-style, and set off chains of rockets, TNT, and lightning to afford your next ticket. Build broken combos with dozens of lucky charms in a neon-soaked roguelike about chasing the big win, and what it really costs.

4730280.name: Hellsino Pokerlike
4730280.short_description: Gamble for your soul in a roguelike deckbuilder where your deck is your life. Build deadly poker hands, unleash massive Nexus combos, and shield your cards from demonic Dealers. Cheat the casino and break the house before it breaks your deck.

5429500.name: Abnormal Rules Cafe
5429500.short_description: In a strange household, a family member is a pig-headed impostor. Read the rules, study their routines, search for supplies, and survive the night. Execute an innocent, and they become a chicken-headed hunter.

4698090.name: The Encroaching
4698090.short_description: The Encroaching is a digital board game for 1–4 players where you build a map one tile at a time then confront the threats that follow those choices. Hidden roles, secret objectives and a corruption creeping through the city means every placement counts, and not everyone may be who they claim to be.

4797110.name: Escalation Pending
4797110.short_description:
Westvale Heights Residential is currently accepting overnight operators. Prior experience is not required.
A desktop horror game set inside a late-1990s apartment management system.

5321550.name: MindGate CornerGet Demo
5321550.short_description: A free-to-play hack-and-slash that fights on in your taskbar. Chibi heroes meet the enemy inside a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. All you do is swap the gear they picked up and respec their skills when you feel like it. No connection needed; the rest happens in the corner of your screen.

4308420.name: Arizona Sunshine®
4308420.short_description: Sharpen your machete and grab your friends. Arizona Sunshine® brings its award-winning zombie apocalypse to explosive third-person action, featuring online and split-screen co-op, brutal combat, dark humor, and Buddy, your loyal zombie-chomping canine companion.

3431600.name: Supreme Heroes
3431600.short_description: Highschool sophomore Jacob suddenly discovers he has super powers and must team up with his best friends to become the 'Elect Few', but convincing them to embrace their powers and save the world is all but easy. Events bring Jacob to battle villainous factions in order to bring peace to the nation.

5267610.name: Shoot The Cat Demo
5267610.short_description: A precision-based game where every shot has to be perfect. The targets? Extremely mischievous cats. Don't worry—here, hitting them is an act of affection.

2517940.name: Century of Steam
2517940.short_description: Century of Steam is a physics-based multiplayer railroad simulator and strategy game. Build your route through beautiful landscapes, customize and operate your fleet of historic trains, discover the sights, sounds, and stories of railroading with industry-leading steam, firing, and audio simulation.

5481170.name: Burger Truck
5481170.short_description: Run a hands-on burger truck in PC VR. Take orders, grill patties, build burgers and serve your customers. Work through daily shifts to unlock a bigger menu, or cook together in online co-op. Headset required.

5029630.name: 오늘도 모험가 길드는 평화롭습니다.
5029630.short_description:
All Peaceful at the Adventurer's Guild Today is the ultimate tiny idle RPG, designed to fit neatly at the bottom of your desktop.

Just leave it running on the side of your screen, and watch your very own guild grow.

Become the Guild Master and build a guild that's truly yours!

3137010.name: Meat Engine
3137010.short_description:
Meat Engine is a Sci-Fi boomer shooter inspired by Scorn, Quake, Dusk and Doom. 
The game is set in a dark and distant future stricken with war and death.
 Featuring fast and brutal retro combat.

4072030.name: Straying Rules
4072030.short_description: Straying Rules is a co-op horror game for 1-4 players. You need to escape from various worlds governed by strange rules within 12 hours by all means. Levels, objectives and dangers are ever-changing every time you enter. You must discover and interpret the rules to find your only hope of survival.

4732710.name: Munchy Lair
4732710.short_description: Munchy Lair is a 2D strategy game fusing turn-based snake combat with roguelite tower climbing. Plan WASD paths, preview enemy moves, then resolve. Kill snakes by collision, grab items, buy buffs, advance floor by floor within a turn limit. Endless mode unlocks after three boss layers.

4125670.name: Home Paige Demo
4125670.short_description: Home Paige is a momentum-based 3D platformer set inside a 90s Operating System. You play as Paige, a silly, optimistic girl from your computer! ⭐

5197230.name: Industrial Empire Online
5197230.short_description: Build a complete industrial empire: extract resources, produce steel, aluminum, fuel and polymers, manage logistics, manufacture heavy equipment, and compete for tenders against other players. Rent or build enterprises, control costs, fulfill contracts, climb the ranking. Every point is built.

5481820.name: THE UNWRITTEN: Shadows of Iga
5481820.short_description: 1581. Iga burns. Kirimaru, a seventeen-year-old shinobi who survived, slips through the last years of the Sengoku era as a shadow who leaves no name — from the fall of Iga through Honnoji to Sekigahara. A retro, NES-style ninja RPG where every general leads thousands of troops into battle.

5210390.name: 文具大作战 Demo
5210390.short_description: Desk Rumble is a cute and casual desktop adventure. Play as a pencil case and round up your runaway stationery friends in short, lively rounds. Upgrade skills, evolve stationery, unlock skins, and complete your collection. Easy to pick up, hard to put down — just one more round!

4645680.name: 星际探索 Star Exploration
4645680.short_description: Star Exploration is a sci-fi adventure game that blends survival, tower defense, and farming elements.

5421120.name: Wildhearth
5421120.short_description: Wildhearth is a Norse medieval-fantasy open world MMORPG. You wake as a stranger on a cold northern island. The town gives you an anthro wife to share it with. Hunt bosses at her side, or build a home and farm. Your skills rise as you use them. You choose how to live.

4893330.name: Roads & Riches Demo
4893330.short_description: Hit the road with your merchant caravan! Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets!

3948610.name: Vinash: Vengeance
3948610.short_description: Deep in the heart of rural India lies a village choked by the shadow of a Baer empire. Vinash, Returning home after ten years for personal vendetta, finding himself caught in a brutal struggle to liberate his people from the iron grip of the gangster Baer and a past that refuses to stay buried.

4336250.name: Wind's Heartbeat
4336250.short_description: In this semi-open world, cozy horse game, form a deep bond with your horse while you explore, forage, and craft. Using training techniques and knowledge passed down through the ages, tame a wild horse to ride through and discover the land's rich natural history in 1800s Idaho.

5442120.name: Selbstversorger
5442120.short_description: An old mountain farm in Upper Carinthia, a few people from the city and five years to learn from the neighbors how to live off it. A narrative game with real weather, a village full of people and decisions that come back next winter.

5414560.name: Wilderwake
5414560.short_description: A 2D pixel-art action-adventure about bringing a dead world back to life. Crush fruit to make the ground bloom and its animals return. Explore a large inter-connected world full of secrets, and use a powerful gauntlet to fight crystal creatures and restore the four giant machines that've taken over.

5385650.name: Idle Gas Station Tycoon
5385650.short_description: Turn a tiny roadside pump into a thriving highway service empire. Serve cars, grow your station, hire staff, add a shop, car wash, garage, truck stop and EV chargers, then expand to new locations. A relaxing low-poly idle tycoon, no ads, fully offline.

4076860.name: Thrice Entombed
4076860.short_description:
Your tomb has been raided and your treasure stolen, so it's time for revenge! 
Push blocks to crush enemies, solve puzzles, and level up.
Recover your treasure to permanently restore your ancient strength.
Inspired by the early 1980's arcade coin-op, Pengo.

5217600.name: Tie Down Demo
5217600.short_description: Tie Down is a first-person, open-world multiplayer driving game. Take on procedurally generated, physics-based deliveries, buy, customize and sell vehicles, earn Greystone’s trust to unlock bigger contracts, build your business, make your fortune, and drive hard.

4498140.name: 天坑追匪
4498140.short_description: A scientific expedition team composed of Chinese and foreign researchers fell into a sinkhole due to an accident, and the entire team mysteriously lost contact. As the captain of the emergency search and rescue mission, you will overcome numerous obstacles and confront the unknown fate head-on
developers: 浙江华智数媒传媒股份有限公司
publishers: 杭州天阙采样文化传媒有限公司

3759000.name: Beaver Creek
3759000.short_description: A casual, water-physics puzzle game about building dams as a beaver (2 - 3 hours). Gnaw down trees, and grab and throw objects to organically build dams, back up water, and progress to the next level.

5423310.name: Pixel Sorter Factory Demo
5423310.short_description: First day at the factory: extract pixels, sort them, sell them. Then let the machines take over, until the factory runs itself. A blend of clicker, incremental gameplay, and pixel art… with a touch of mystery: where do all those pixels go?

4539710.name: Train 404
4539710.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game where you collect coins, find the Golden Ticket, and race back to the train while monsters close in.

3320970.name: ECHO//syntax
3320970.short_description:
Awaken. Scavenge. Survive.

ECHO//syntax is a beat-em-up scrapper game set in a far future robotic world.

4407490.name: Project Prison: Prologue
4407490.short_description:
Have you ever thought about the best place to start your criminal empire without any legal consequences?

Now you will finally be able to experience prison life in Project Prison: Prologue. try to stay alive in a prison which contains’ s the world’s most ruthless inmates.

5048140.name: EinStein
5048140.short_description: An alchemy roguelike where you spin your wheel and watch items devour, merge, and upgrade one another. Collect relics, trigger chain reactions, and snowball your Magic—every run carves out a unique alchemical path.

4792160.name: 灵魂甜品 Soulcake
4792160.short_description: Soulcake: A fantasy‑romance AVG with yuri (LGBTQ+) & female-dominant dynamics. As the female lead, you can travel into others’ minds, gather ingredients to bake desserts filled with emotions. People come to you with their secrets. Forge bonds with them and…uncover the truth behind your ability.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

5004790.name: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR
5004790.short_description: A chaotic, mad run-and-gun! Flamethrowers, homing, double jumps, invincible dashes—all here! As Hijura with a Scarlet Gear, destroy the "Dokugan" horde! 35-year dev Zorge Ichizo's "AI-Toxic" showdown with AI. Will I dance to the AI's tune, or will my individuality win? See for yourself!

4742360.name: Driving Test Simulator Demo
4742360.short_description: Test your driving skills by completing challenging driving tests and precise, skill-based scenarios.

4370190.name: Refrain: Verse of Fate
4370190.short_description: A garden caught in eternal recurrence. A god who forgets everything. A witness without rest. In this narrative-driven 2D exploration game, walk, listen, and read your way through four cycles to piece together a truth hidden beneath the surface.

4559620.name: Rotten Chamber
4559620.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

1846700.name: Witchbrook
1846700.short_description: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

5318140.name: Null & Aether
5318140.short_description: Null & Aether is an isometric/top-down Action Role-Playing Game that blends  fast-paced combat with  puzzle-solving, secret-hunting, loot gathering, and dungeon crawling.

4560270.name: Rotten Chamber Demo
4560270.short_description: A single-player logic puzzle disguised as social deduction. Read the claims of a corrupt city council, catch the liars and arrest them, but every wrong call brings you closer to losing it all.

2819550.name: Temtem: Swarm Demo
2819550.short_description: Can you Survive the Swarm? Unlock mighty abilities and upgrades, find and collect Tems to evolve and become stronger, discover overpowered strategies, and battle massive bosses in this survivor-like bullet heaven! Play solo or online co-op with up to 3 players, building the wildest synergies.

5372710.name: Beadroom
5372710.short_description: Make fuse bead creations, iron them and decorate your apartment with things you have made yourself. A cozy crafting game with patterns, free mode and tools to unlock. Export your designs as printable templates to craft them in real life, too.

3971520.name: Imagine Sisyphus Happy Demo
3971520.short_description: Sisyphus is Streaming! A story-rich mixture of Streamer Simulator, Incremental game and Minigames about life, spectacle, and making the grind worth living. Push the boulder. Do tricks. Unlock new struggles. Choose your boulder, and try to Imagine Sisyphus Happy!

4603550.name: W.A.M
4603550.short_description: Command a bunker’s remote surveillance network to cull an infestation of Molemen from a dark, foggy forest. Upgrade your tactical hardware and pilot scout drones to survive, and keep your guard up; the threat behind you is constant.

4234400.name: Boys in the dark
4234400.short_description: Survival horror meets gay dark romance. Trapped in a nightmare realm, fight grotesque monsters and solve twisted puzzles. Caught between a possessive lover and a mysterious stranger, you must uncover the truth. Will you survive the horror and the heat of Boys in the Dark?

1203170.name: Darksiders 4
1203170.short_description: The legendary saga of the Four Horsemen continues in Darksiders 4, an all-new action-adventure set in an apocalyptic version of earth and continues where the original Darksiders game left off.

5298060.name: 청월시 괴이사진록 (Cheongwol: Paranormal Archives)
5298060.short_description: In Cheongwol, where spirits live among humans, a struggling photographer strikes a dangerous bargain with an eight-tailed fox seeking her ninth tail. Capture the uncanny and grow closer to Jang Sehee in this modern fantasy romance visual novel.

4299430.name: Cloud Getaway Demo
4299430.short_description: A peaceful and relaxing diorama builder that features interactive little villagers and online map sharing! Create a cozy getaway for curious visitors to enjoy!

4192780.name: Cloud Getaway
4192780.short_description: A peaceful and relaxing diorama builder that features interactive little villagers and online map sharing! Create a cozy getaway for curious visitors to enjoy!

4255850.name: Grimmloch
4255850.short_description: A persistent text-based MMORPG where NPCs remember your secrets and shape a living world rooted in European folklore. Turn-based tactical combat, criminal gameplay, and collaborative storytelling that writes itself into canon. Built by Role-players for Role-players.

5129030.name: Horror Game Creator
5129030.short_description: Horror Game Creator lets you build and explore your own liminal horror worlds. Design levels, customize enemies, lighting, and items, and create unique experiences—from quiet, eerie spaces to intense survival scenarios.

5331420.name: AKARI: Lovely Moments with You Demo
5331420.short_description: "Akari: Lovely Moments with You" is a healing desktop companion game where players experience precious moments with elder sister Akari from Yuki's perspective. By gathering "Inspiration" from pomodoro timer, you can unlock more outfits, accessories, desktop wallpapers, BGM, and more story about her.

3691230.name: Precious Feather
3691230.short_description: Hunt for the perfect feather. Feed what's waiting at home. Sleep if you can. The rent will be due.

2105440.name: Fall of Bali
2105440.short_description: Fall of Bali is a historical strategy game set in Bali set around 19th century. Divided into many kingdoms after fall of Bali Empire, Bali has seen war for nearly two centuries and now the threat of imperialism has come. With all your might and potential, can you survive and win this era?

4688510.name: Pain-Hatching Demo
4688510.short_description: Metroidvania, exploring, a deep story and characters, RPG elements, deck and stat-building. Imagine if Fur Fighters, American McGee’s Alice, and Dark Souls merged into one game.

4707640.name: Last Draft Demo
4707640.short_description: Complete your last draft before sunrise while enduring increasing paranormal activities and relentless monster stalks. Use your typing skills to progress and your instincts to hide, surviving 7 days of pure psychological horror.

5486730.name: 緋修羅 HIJURA SCARLET GEAR Soundtrack
5486730.short_description: The original soundtrack of HIJURA SCARLET GEAR, featuring the music from the game.

3389040.name: Hand Eternal
3389040.short_description: Dropkick homunculi and escape soulless machinations as an undying runner in a nauseating first-person parkour gauntlet.

4819630.name: Bowerland
4819630.short_description: The Euchre roguelite. Call trump, win tricks, deal damage and decimate your foes as you take on the Bower King's evil henchmen in this single player 1v1 card battler.

2806540.name: Travellin Cats Advent Calendar
2806540.short_description: Sweeten the countdown to Christmas with this fabulous advent calendar full of hidden cats for you to find in this relaxing hidden object game for the whole family by Travellin Cats - the original viral hidden cat game creator!

4221560.name: Puzzle Rogue
4221560.short_description: Puzzle Rogue is a roguelike homage to the original Puzzle Quest!  Guide your party through the forbidden castle, gathering equipment and items to bolster their strength!  Encounter enemies and battle them in 16-bit JRPG style gem-based combat!

3166230.name: That Which Remains
3166230.short_description: 1–4 player sci-fi ghost-hunting horror extraction sim with proximity voice chat. Travel across time to extract resources, identify and capture hostile entities as fuel for a supposed future utopia. Speak to entities using your voice, upgrade your prison, craft tools, and meet a rising daily quota.

5056070.name: Bowerland Demo
5056070.short_description: The Euchre roguelite. Call trump, win tricks, deal damage and decimate your foes as you take on the Bower King's evil henchmen in this single player 1v1 card battler.

3802140.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
3802140.short_description: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

5183890.name: Will it Stand?
5183890.short_description: Disaster strikes! With a limited budget, build structures, mechanisms, and defenses to protect your beaver from earthquakes, floods, mudslides, meteors, and enemy attacks. Brace, absorb, divert, defend—there is no single answer. If it is still standing when the disaster is over, it worked.

4433840.name: Starlit Archive: Idle Collector
4433840.short_description: Collect dazzling anime girls in an idle game at your own pace. Battles, recruiting and leveling are automatic: just leave the game running. No click spamming or constant upgrades. When you feel like it, adjust your gear and formation to deal even more damage with your favorite!

4475970.name: Prerolled
4475970.short_description:
Sell boxes of dice to silly clients in this cozy roguelike deckbuilder!
Each die has unique effects based on the positioning of other dice in the box!
Create your own crazy combos, make numbers go up, and overcharge shamelessly to pay rent!

4733710.name: Totally Normal Ramen Demo
4733710.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

4753470.name: The Deconsecration Initiative
4753470.short_description: A short incremental game about building a weapon to kill a god. Build your base, fire your laser, collect shards, Barry has turned into a slug. Upgrade your slugs.

3850340.name: Pain-Hatching
3850340.short_description: Game about a rooster, friendship, family, a cult, WOMAN, and chthonic horrors.

2635410.name: Holdfast: Nations At War - Testing Branch

5002370.name: Wyrm Warrior
5002370.short_description: WYRM WARRIOR is a brand new JRPG in retro style. Step into the shoes of a hero fighting for justice in an unfamiliar land! Brave a world full of monsters, bosses, dungeons, NPCs, and loot! Grow stronger through fighting and exploration! Can you defeat THE WYRMLORD?

4880210.name: Hammered Heroes
4880210.short_description: Hammered Heroes is a fantasy Auto-Battler Roguelite where you recruit a drunken band of heroes, build your party, and descend through an ever-deeper dungeon. Choose your classes, upgrades, and path, then watch your heroes brawl automatically. Die, grow stronger, and descend again.

4331050.name: Totally Normal Ramen
4331050.short_description: Cook ramen across the galaxy as a rogue robot chef! Explore planets, trigger wild events, battle dangerous customers, and build your ultimate space food truck.

4981510.name: The Membrane Demo
4981510.short_description: Shoot, slash and slay the enemy hordes erupting from the jungle’s Membrane in this action survival roguelite. Hold the encircling trenches, fortify them, choose your build and rise from loinclothed-servant to unstoppable Amazon king.

4068850.name: Candy Rush!
4068850.short_description: A roguelike survivor where the clock is your own greed. Fights never end on their own — the waves loop, and every loop makes enemies stronger. Bank your build and leave, or stay one more round. Choose your route, evolve your weapons, and meet the boss with whatever your greed built.

1652690.name: Alterium Shift Demo
1652690.short_description: Join three heroes in training as they learn to master their individual strengths and harness the power of Alterium Essence. With their training nearly completed, Dolion, their teacher, prepares them for the most important mission they've faced yet.

5388400.name: The City
5388400.short_description: A take on a more realistic city simulation experience. Control everything from the price of services, tickets, to how the city operates and runs. It's an experience that will continue to receive daily and weekly updates while in early release.

5005170.name: Akari: Lovely Moments with You Playtest

5382700.name: Ending Vorrak
5382700.short_description: It is thousands. You must end it. A top-down co-op shooter for 1-4 players against one living swarm, and you can throw every bug in it. Blast them into walls. Crush them under the hive's own bones. Feed them to a tornado. If you go down, the swarm turns you against your own crew.

3920400.name: Land Of The Valiants
3920400.short_description: Land of the Valiant blends RPG, survival, and life simulation in a multiplayer medieval world. Build, produce, trade, and survive in a player-driven economy where Khalendor becomes what its inhabitants make of it.

2993590.name: 0101 - Sponsor
2993590.short_description: If you think the game is worth it, you can buy this DLC to be a top sponsor! In addition, you will receive special star!

5371210.name: Little Angler
5371210.short_description: Little Angler is a cozy fishing game that lives on your desktop. Catch dozens of creatures, complete your album, explore new regions, earn coins, unlock upgrades, and customize your angler with characters, islands, bobbers, rods, vests, and more.

3260750.name: Stage Fright
3260750.short_description: From the makers of OVERCOOKED! comes an all new co-operative experience. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery.

1810920.name: Operation Lovecraft: Fallen Doll Closed Beta

2885160.name: The Sea Is Broken
2885160.short_description: Sail a cursed, ever-changing sea in this pirate roguelite for 1–4 players. Explore islands, grab loot, upgrade your ship, and battle bizarre enemies. Work together to steer, fire cannons, and patch holes. Someone should probably grab a bucket.

3862490.name: Law of Entropy
3862490.short_description: A llama seeks vengeance in a fractured abyss. Plan a grand tower defense, wreak physics-based havoc, and obliterate all who ever wronged you in this steampunk single-player action platformer.

5403020.name: Conquest of the Realms
5403020.short_description: Build your town. Rally your heroes. Fight for your realm! Conquest of the Realms blends epic boss battles, army building and territorial warfare across five fantasy realms. Capture Keeps, seize powerful loot and lead the charge toward the mysterious Nexus. Different Paths, Same Horizon!

5430540.name: Tile Farmer
5430540.short_description: Build a thriving farm, one tile at a time. Grow crops, raise livestock, upgrade tractors, and expand your land in this pixel-art farming management game. Balance costs, crop rotation, and loans as you turn a small plot into a profitable operation.

5287500.name: Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas
5287500.short_description:
Santa's Workshop: Tidy Up Christmas is a cozy first-person present sorting game where you help Santa and his elves sort 2,352 presents! With each present you sort, you get one step closer to unlocking Santa's gifts, which will help you sort even faster. 
Are you willing to help Santa this year?

3923500.name: Investigation of Room 413
3923500.short_description: A first‑person indie psychological horror set in a cursed roadside motel. Solve story‑driven puzzles, uncover twisted memories, and decide if you can ever leave Room 413.

4485010.name: Bouncy Blobs
4485010.short_description: You are a blob. Prove your worth as the greatest blob to ever live by solving puzzles or vanquishing your squishy brethren.

5318520.name: My Little Black Hole
5318520.short_description: A quiet pixel-art desktop companion. Let a little black hole absorb stress objects, discover planets and constellations, and arrange a universe of your own while you work or take a break.

5424720.name: Breast Milkshake Cafe
5424720.short_description: A strange virus left your childhood friend Miku with a very unusual side effect — nonstop lactation. Instead of losing heart, you decide to open your own milkshake cafe, bring together a team of girls sharing the same delicate predicament, and turn an old fixer-upper into the hottest spot in town!

5102640.name: Pawn'd Chess
5102640.short_description: Play, study, and improve at your own pace in a chess trainer with human-like, skill-matched AI, full FEN tools, local hotseat, and ranked play or pressure-free practice.

2210770.name: New Citizen Soundtrack
2210770.short_description: New Citizen is a modern-themed roleplay adventure game set in the vast open world of the USA. The game focuses mainly on the player, creating an environment that feels alive and that is constantly moving. Game Soundtrack

5472210.name: 旧存档里的勇者
5472210.short_description: A nostalgic pixel action RPG about fighting monsters, chasing loot, and building an adventuring party. Choose a Warrior, Mage, or Archer, explore five regions, follow treasure maps, and grow alongside NPC companions and your guild.

2208810.name: Jurassic Park: Survival
2208810.short_description: Return to Isla Nublar the day after the events of the beloved 1993 Jurassic Park film and survive thrilling first-person action as InGen scientist Dr. Maya Joshi in this single-player action-adventure game.

3739120.name: FaceRobots
3739120.short_description: Chaotic 1-4 player co-op with ragdoll physics. You're tiny robots wearing your live webcam as a face. Smash trash cans and suitcases, sell the loot, unlock new zones and take down ridiculous bosses, from a dumpster that swallows players to a giant poop king.

5194040.name: Idle Plinko
5194040.short_description: Build the ultimate Plinko machine in this incremental idle game. Level up to discover unique boards, buy powerful upgrades, unlock special balls, gamble to transform your pegs, and prestige for permanent perks. Compete with players worldwide and climb the leaderboards.

4932010.name: Chrome Circuit
4932010.short_description: A twin-stick roguelite in a 2086 cyber-dystopia. Chain kill-streaks for massive rewards, sign cursed loot contracts with brutal downsides, and stack upgrades into a new monster build every run.

5427620.name: SKYGUARD: Last Light
5427620.short_description: A minimalist incremental defense game. Start with one missile silo over your city, destroy screens full of threats, upgrade your firepower, and turn the Moon, the Sun, a black hole and even higher dimensions into weapons. Ten scales, ten chapters, ten doomsday ultimates.

5420850.name: SO-3: Caso 044
5420850.short_description: Investigate Case 044 in a psychological horror adventure that shifts between a fictional operating system and first-person 3D environments. Examine chats and files as an unseen presence distorts what you thought you knew.

3676190.name: 暗黑符文：禁忌之源
3676190.short_description: Dark Runes: Forbidden Origin - A hardcore ARPG featuring versatile skill runes and classic Rune Words. The time has come to begin your looting legend! Every battle may drop loot that changes your fate, every rune combination can create new legends. Are you ready for the challenge?

3734220.name: Guns of Eschaton
3734220.short_description: This soulslike FPS pulls you into an apocalyptic Western by the legendary Viktor Antonov: a land of dust, blood, and horror. Study your enemies, count your bullets, forge your own style with gunpowder and prayers. Solo or in co-op—go West, gunslinger, go West and die with the country!

5386790.name: Far Company
5386790.short_description: Crew a starship with up to three friends. Fly its fighters, man its guns, board enemy ships and rob them blind, and carry each other home. Or throw each other out of the hangar. Friendly fire is on. The feed remembers who did it.

5069170.name: 수용수 : to pluto
5069170.short_description: Two job seekers, two separate spaces, one set of controls. Guide a pair of characters who move in sync, solve puzzles, and get them safely to Café Pluto in this 2D puzzle platformer.

2327110.name: Snap Quest
2327110.short_description: A Photo Collection Adventure Game. Complete your research notebook, solve creature puzzles, earn research grant money. Buy upgrades for your camera, rebuild the town, bond with the locals, and reveal the paranormal mystery of Star Island.

4309310.name: Voidshift
4309310.short_description: A psychological horror game about working the night shift in a store that reacts to your mistakes. Follow procedure. Avoid irregularities.

3764290.name: Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan
3764290.short_description: A classic Asian drama series is reborn in anime style, and you’re the director with power to guide the clash between rival families! Re:Burn The Bonfire of Taiwan puts you in control of the narrative, allowing you to guide the beloved characters to endings from the original show.

3107870.name: Highland Keep
3107870.short_description: Highland Keep is a third-person survival strategy set in the dark, mist-covered medieval Scotland. As a clan leader, you will engage in base building, colony management, survival mechanics, and real-time action combat in an open world.

5276540.name: PITCHFORK Demo
5276540.short_description: An online co-op dungeon crawler where up to 4 unqualified peasants climb an ever-changing castle to slay the local vampire. Fight monsters, solve puzzles, avoid traps, and make sure somebody keeps that torch lit.

5405970.name: Bondoq: Desktop Gunners Demo
5405970.short_description: Collect, trade, and build your team of Gunners! Discover heroes with unique weapons and effects, then equip them with rare items. Watch the battles unfold automatically at the edge of your desktop while you work or browse!

4869950.name: MR. RECORDS Demo
4869950.short_description: ​Meet George, an old dreamer with an extraordinary gift that lets him transcend through music. After a lifetime of standing still, he breaks free from routine and opens the store he always wished for. ​

4888270.name: Season 5 Battlefield Pro - Battlefield™ 6 and REDSEC
4888270.short_description: Go all in with Battlefield Pro, the ultimate Battle Pass offer. Unlock premium rewards, the full Season 5 Battle Pass, including 25 Tier Skips and a +5% XP Booster, access to an exclusive Bonus Path, and more.

4970170.name: Wild Hive Demo
4970170.short_description: Build your own bee hive in this cozy roguelite. Hatch worker bees, forage nectar and sell your honey on the stock market. The royal crown demands more honey every year! How long will your hive survive?

5021500.name: Knuckle Paradise Demo
5021500.short_description: A pixel-powered, combo-packed character action game starring Jane (a retired boxer) and her sidekick, Cocotte (a warrior… chicken?). Fight everybody. Learn combos from a pirate seagull. Fight harder. Level up your chicken. Find your kidnappers. Teach them a lesson.

5120170.name: Heritage Flipper Demo
5120170.short_description: Cozy house renovation simulator where you renovate historic old ruins into luxury estates. Clean, restore & decorate homes in American, French, English, Spanish, Dutch, Japanese, Chinese & more styles. Uncovering the secret history of each home.

5120210.name: 冒牌英雄 Demo
5120210.short_description: Fight alone or alongside friends as a cast of unconventional “heroes,” each with their own unique abilities. Battle endless waves of monsters, collect items, learn skills, choose talents, and create your own powerful build as you defeat mighty foes and fight your way!

5150880.name: The  Drawratos Demo
5150880.short_description: Draw on cards, bluff, and outplay your opponents in poker games for up to 4 players. In The Drawratos, you’ll have to pass off your drawn cards as real ones so everyone believes you’ve got a strong hand.

5194080.name: A Pond Hunt Demo
5194080.short_description: Can you profit from draining ponds for fish? Hard to say! Start with muddy puddles, lease carp ponds, giant lakes, and turtle ponds. Build your empire and conquer the Dragon Pool for its treasure. What? Loch Ness? Drain it and find out!

4360730.name: One Mind Demo
4360730.short_description: A 3D puzzle-platformer where you control two characters in different locations, each facing their own challenges. Navigate through obstacles, solve interconnected puzzles, and coordinate their actions carefully — every move to help one could put the other in danger.

4380660.name: プロレゴメナ およそ3分間の交信の先に現れるであろうきわめて超次元的なインターフェースのための序論 特別予備実験
4380660.short_description: It's time to begin our preliminary experiment. My CommGear isn't fully operational yet, but I want to get started with what we have now. I'm looking forward to collaborating with you on this project.

4618810.name: Geareo Demo
4618810.short_description: Real gears that don't slip in a mechanical invention sandbox. Build freely with resizable parts and shapes, overcome physics challenges, and follow kit instructions. Unleash your engineering creativity with precision machines and intricate clockwork contraptions.

4698610.name: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.) Demo
4698610.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

4356050.name: In Full Bloom Demo
4356050.short_description: Feed and raise your little baby. Watch it grow and feed on every and anything. In Full Bloom is a Tamagotchi inspired Katamari-like about a creature with never-ending hunger for anything around it. There is only one way.

3807830.name: The Well's Blessing Demo
3807830.short_description: Explore the mystical Sanctuary of the Old Well and reconnect with your childhood friends while solving environmental puzzles. Meet quirky animals, unravel forgotten tales and immerse yourself in an interactive soundscape as you piece together your place in the world.

5255070.name: Sentinels of the Multiverse 2
5255070.short_description: Sentinels of the Multiverse 2 - The best comic-book card game in ANY multiverse!

3453940.name: Ramen Shop Simulator Demo
3453940.short_description: This game puts you in the shoes of a new ramen shop owner. Experience a preview of what’s to come. Prepare your shop, cook and serve great bowls of ramen and decorate and customize your restaurant.

3516760.name: GigaBash - MechaJURAS Free DLC
3516760.short_description: This free DLC adds “MechaJURAS”, an original character from GigaBash to the game. Equipped with a unique moveset featuring its massive Rocket Drill to decimate Titans, and a Grapple Claw to grab foes from afar, MechaJURAS is ready to roll out!

5254210.name: Coins in Place
5254210.short_description: Coins in Place is an incremental game where you work as a coin picker in a messy tavern. Pick up every coin before the day ends! Earn gems, buy upgrades, and recruit cats to help you. On Day 7, a mountain of coins awaits. Miss even one and you're stuck working another week.

3808500.name: Undertaker
3808500.short_description:
The veil between life and death is shattered. Corpses walk, the earth trembles, and chaos reigns.
As the Undertaker, your duty is clear return the dead to the dead by any means necessary.
Inspired by classic FPS games like DOOM and Blood fast-paced action in a world gone mad.

3032700.name: Sunset Devils Demo
3032700.short_description:
Sunset Devils is a top-down action shooter, Where every weapon's unique controls must be mastered through the thrill of an old west gunfight. 
A classic spaghetti western story of vengeance, portrayed in stylish pixel art.

2778590.name: ELDEN RING Shadow of the Erdtree Premium Bundle
2778590.short_description: The Premium Bundle includes the following content: ELDEN RING Shadow of the Erdtree expansion and ELDEN RING Shadow of the Erdtree Digital Artbook & Original Soundtrack

2887480.name: Pool of Madness Demo
2887480.short_description:
A horror pool roguelite with upgradable cues, guns and procedural rituals.
Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

2893830.name: The Precinct Demo
2893830.short_description: Averno City, 1983. Gangs rule the streets and your father lies restless in his grave. Clean up the city, uncover the truth, and embark on thrilling vehicle chases through destructible environments in this neon-noir action sandbox police game.

3811480.name: Undertaker Demo
3811480.short_description:
The veil between life and death is shattered. Corpses walk, the earth trembles, and chaos reigns.
As the Undertaker, your duty is clear return the dead to the dead by any means necessary.
Inspired by classic FPS games like DOOM and Blood fast-paced action in a world gone mad.

5023320.name: Warpack Demo
5023320.short_description: Build a fantasy war-band, pack each unit's backpack, and feed your champions to make them monsters. An async-PvP auto-battler: every opponent is a real player's saved army. Five factions, shaped items, commander skills. Forge a new build every run, then climb the ranked ladder.

2060280.name: Lost Judgment - The Kaito Files Story Expansion
2060280.short_description: Crack a new case as the muscle of the Yagami Detective Agency, Masaharu Kaito, and tie up loose ends of his past in this standalone story expansion to Lost Judgment.

5250930.name: Heaps
5250930.short_description: Heaps is a genre-defining sandbox game that builds the universe of you. In Heaps, your real world interests generate endless 3D worlds giving you the creative freedom to explore, discover and evolve. All in an environment designed by two neurospicy artists for interest-based nervous systems.

1412570.name: Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin Trial Version
1412570.short_description:
In this demo for Monster Hunter Stories 2: Wings of Ruin, players are able to play the opening portion of the game for free. Save data from the demo can be carried over to the retail version.

Mount up and get ready to experience an all new RPG adventure set in the world of Monster Hunter.

677310.name: MyMoney
677310.short_description: MyMoney is a lightweight, simple accounting software with an easy interface and minimal functionality, including your most basic accounting needs, easy to record your living expenses.

720780.name: LEGO® Marvel Super Heroes 2 - Infinity War
720780.short_description:
Download now to get access to the Marvel's Avengers: Infinity War Movie Inspired Character and Level Pack!

This action-packed level offers players the chance to control Thanos, one of the most dangerous Super Villains in the Marvel Universe, and his ruthless army.

720790.name: LEGO® Marvel Super Heroes 2 - Marvel's Ant-Man and the Wasp Character and Level Pack
720790.short_description: Download now to get access to the Marvel's Ant-Man and the Wasp Character and Level Pack! This action-packed level takes Ant-Man and the Wasp to Hank Pym's forgotten research lab. Players are tasked with battling Egghead's goons in an unforgettable adventure!

720800.name: LEGO® Marvel Super Heroes 2 - Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2
720800.short_description: Join the cosmic adventurers, Star-Lord, Gamora, Rocket Raccoon, Drax and Groot as you play through the epic opening sequence from Marvel Studios' Guardians of the Galaxy Vol. 2! Players will need to defend against and face an inter-dimensional monster – the Abilisk.

449390.name: LEGO® MARVEL's Avengers DLC - Classic Black Panther Pack
449390.short_description: In a re-telling of T’Challa’s origin story, the Black Panther battles to save his mother from the villainous Klaw!

533110.name: The Desolation of Mordor Story Expansion
533110.short_description:
The Desolation of Mordor Story Expansion includes:

• NEW Story campaign
• NEW Side missions featuring Torvin
• NEW Human Mercenaries and Bodyguards
• NEW Region of Mordor - The Desert of Lithlad
• NEW Beasts: Were-wyrms

362190.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: The Fall of Liu Kang
362190.short_description: We flash back to what has brought Liu Kang to such a low point in his life... we watch as his fiancée is murdered before his eyes.

4783600.name: Little Elementals Demo
4783600.short_description:
A chaotic escape of little elementals who want to become human!

The Fire Elemental and the Water Elemental
secretly visit the human world…but get caught and thrown into prison!

Who came to rescue them?
Can they escape and reach the human world?

Join the little elementals on their adventure!

4379380.name: Monster Hunter Wilds Prologue Demo
4379380.short_description: Monster Hunter Wilds Prologue Demo allows you to enjoy the game from the prologue up until you complete the ‘To the Forest’ mission.

5286110.name: Empires of the Axis and Abyss
5286110.short_description: A 4X asynchronous galactic strategy game. Eight houses, one shattered galaxy, two to eight commanders. Design fleets, fight three-band battles with named captains, and take your turn when you have ten minutes. Campaigns can run for weeks without a fixed game night.

2769870.name: Pinch n Roll
2769870.short_description: A chaotic online physics brawler where you flick, buff, and smash your bean across 15 arenas and 30+ uniquely incremental buffs! with up to 10 friends or bots. Collect balls, unlock hats, tattoos, and hair, and embrace cartoony chaos with a cheeky twist of adult humor.

5472470.name: 装甲奇兵
5472470.short_description: Drive an armored war machine through endless enemy waves. A survivors-like shooter: auto-fire, dodge, unleash ultimates, pick upgrades and set the field ablaze. 3 crews, 4 stages, 5 difficulties, 765 achievements and permanent vehicle upgrades.

5361480.name: Doodle Duel
5361480.short_description: Turn quick sketches into brave warriors in a hand-drawn 2D action RPG. Draw fighters, weapons, armor and skills, match elemental colors, defeat patterned bosses, and climb an arena tower with a team that is uniquely yours.

5016610.name: Chrome Circuit Demo
5016610.short_description: Neon twin-stick roguelite. Fight through three cyberpunk districts with an infinite-ammo sidearm and a five-slot arsenal of looted guns. Bait bosses into mistakes, beat the clock in timed encounters, sign cursed contracts. This demo is the full game — saving unlocks at launch.

4928410.name: 红色史诗：抗战 Demo
4928410.short_description: This is a TD & light RTS set in the Anti-Mop-up Campaigns of Central Hebei. Master village defense, ambushes, and raids on the North China Plain. Outsmart strong foes through terrain and strategy, forging an unbroken steel wall with the blood and valor of unsung heroes!

5470210.name: Solitaire-y Confinement
5470210.short_description:
Solitaire-y Confinement is solitaire with a twist, a gamble on every deal.

Every hand costs a buy-in.

Every card home pays. 

Can you make bank or go broke?

5479370.name: APPENDIX C
5479370.short_description: Five contracts on machines you don't own, played at a real DOS command line. You can read every file on the volume for free — taking one is what gets noticed. Every run is ranked on how much noise you made.

5206610.name: Revenant Dawn
5206610.short_description: Survive a zombie outbreak as Eric, Sarah, and Kate. Explore the town and uncover the mysteries behind the incident - Fight or flee the monsters while managing your resources in a classic Survival Horror adventure.

4567780.name: Verto Demo
4567780.short_description: Drop blocks, match colors, rotate everything. This puzzle game adds mind-bending board rotation to classic gameplay. Choose from timed challenges or endless modes, and compete for high scores. Easy to learn, impossible to master.

5109960.name: PopUp Tube
5109960.short_description: Bring channel surfing back to your own video collection. Each show gets its own channel, ready to resume where you left off. Add PopUps—precisely timed commentary cards that bring context and a fresh perspective to what you’re watching.

5077390.name: PCpill
5077390.short_description: PCpill™ is an action-packed top-down shooter where you take control of the PCpill™ Antivirus to disinfect the hard drive of an old desktop PC. Use your PillGun to blast the rot away and restore your computer, one file at a time!

5168640.name: The Bus - London
5168640.short_description: With The Bus - London South, take the wheel of a London bus for the first time. Explore South and Central London past iconic landmarks like Big Ben, the London Eye and Westminster Bridge.

4901500.name: Alpha 7: The Last Hope
4901500.short_description: Alpha 7: The Last Hope: A frantic one-button bullet hell style space cyberpunk. Survive with Dave across 6 stages, master 12 ships, unlock the Lore, and enjoy the original jukebox. An extreme, fully inclusive challenge.

5381550.name: Paper Reactions
5381550.short_description: Play cards. Trigger reactions. Build explosive chains, forge growth charms, and ace 24 Chemistry Exams to claim your A+ — then dive into Endless Mode and chase the leaderboard. One hand of materials, one chain of reactions, all the way up.

2309180.name: Halloween Tidy Up
2309180.short_description: Race through a whimsical haunted manor, gather matching clutter into your satchel, return every treasure to its proper place, and banish mischievous spirits before the clock strikes midnight.

4602620.name: Brothel Tycoon 2
4602620.short_description: Step into the heels of Yvonne in a stunningly realistic nightclub tycoon. Experience a living, breathing 24/7 business where lighting, music, and staff management collide. Unlock rooms, host events and watch your empire grow in a world where the party never stops.

3561320.name: Open Fortress
3561320.short_description: Open Fortress is a mod for Team Fortress 2 that envisions a new wave of mercenary gunfighting. Bunny hop through original maps set in the futuristic world of the 1970s, and blast your way to victory with an all-new arsenal of groovy weapons! Frequently updated with new maps, modes, and mayhem!

5310610.name: Aster Initiative Demo
5310610.short_description: Play Day 1 of Aster Initiative: navigate a huge mid-90s internet and use a variety of programs on your work computer to take down the pharmaceutical company you work for without getting caught.

4340420.name: TAKTAKTOP
4340420.short_description: Vertical jump action to escape the sky! Shoot projectiles to pave your way in Build Mode, or adapt to shifting tiles in Random Mode. Pass tokens via missiles to aid or revive allies—stay immune while tokenless. Reach the top exit with tokens to win! (Up to 12 players online)

3304700.name: AI桌面伴侣 - 艾露芙 ErufuAI
3304700.short_description: ErufuAI is a smart virtual companion app that grows with users through interactive learning. It offers personalized experiences with features like custom Live2D models, character cards, and voice cloning.

1792460.name: We Kill Monsters
1792460.short_description: We Kill Monsters is a solo or co-op adventure set in a mysterious and massive pit. You are a Husk of Edinu, homunculi created to explore the depths and kill Angels.

5073990.name: Backrooms Insane
5073990.short_description: Backrooms: Insane is a single-player psychological horror game with a found footage aesthetic. Explore disturbing levels, solve puzzles, find key items, and escape while timers, unpredictable events, and deadly entity hunts turn every objective into a fight for survival.

4514880.name: Hyperlane Highway
4514880.short_description:
A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer and dodge, no thumbstick's needed.
Use your duals blaster and abilities to dodge and build your run from 9 rival sponsors offering 90+ enhancement cards.
Clear the hyperlanes to impress the sponsors, every death is monetized.

3401570.name: Abyss Ring
3401570.short_description:
Survive, cook, and conquer!
Cook monsters to stave off hunger in this roguelike as you reach the deepest floor. With 200+ equipment items and random dungeons, every run offers endless possibilities.

3790410.name: Card Shop: Tidy Up the Trading Cards!
3790410.short_description: a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 6,010 trading cards, booster boxes and graded slabs back where they belong after prerelease night, a collection buyout and the shop cat wrecked the store. Doors open at dawn.

5357680.name: O'BLOCK
5357680.short_description: You start with $300 and a shoebox. You end up selling sneakers to billionaires, if you can read who's lying. Every buyer hides their number and some lie about it. Free to play: name your price, win the deal, climb from the block to a billion.

2663360.name: Aster Initiative
2663360.short_description: Desktop puzzle-horror. Navigate a huge mid-90s internet and use a variety of programs on your work computer to take down the pharmaceutical company you work for without getting caught.

5395140.name: Have you seen my knife?
5395140.short_description: More than 1,800 parts from 216 unique guns and 17 ammo boxes rain down on your workshop. Assemble each gun part by part, test-fire it and rack it in its case on the wall. Tidying up has never been this loud.

5242500.name: Debuilders Demo
5242500.short_description: Grab a sledgehammer and dive into the chaos! Debuilders is a physics‑based cooperative comedy for 4 players, in which each worker has a funny flaw. Destroy walls, fix fuse boxes, follow the boss’s instructions, and try to finish the repairs without accidentally destroying your friends!

5275290.name: The Bus - New York US LFS Bus
5275290.short_description: The DLC includes the US LFSA bus as a 18-meter articulated bus

3192550.name: Deeplanders
3192550.short_description: DEEPLANDERS is a minimalist construction puzzle game about populating the depths and bringing light into them. Build cozy underground cities and find the perfect place for each Deeplander to live in harmony.

4330560.name: Psycho Ripper
4330560.short_description: Psycho Ripper is a top down action shooter with modified conditional formations. Explore a randomization of challenges as you blast through a sentient crystal mine, confronting progressively baneful threats and equip unusual armaments,  as you speculate further through a grand and unknown chaos.

4195920.name: Estella Demo
4195920.short_description: A brand-new 3D rhythm game for mouse & keyboard. Ride a golden comet through the cosmos and compose your own adventure with every song and every note.

4398040.name: Poly Fighter Demo
4398040.short_description: Poly Fighter is a single-player roguelike fighting game. Learn new moves from every opponent you defeat to build your fighter’s unique style. Battle through tense retro-arcade duels with beginner-friendly controls to master your moveset and claim your title! Meet 4 playable characters in this demo!

5476580.name: Just Be Alive
5476580.short_description: You can't attack. You can only dodge. Team up in 1–4 player co-op (friends or bots) and climb a tower full of cute bosses and mechanics. If at least one of you is still standing at the end, the whole team wins.

5093110.name: Harvest Story
5093110.short_description: Merge ingredients on a tiny platform, cook up dishes, and sell your way to survival. The landlord shows up every week like clockwork, and rent only gets steeper—so merging isn't enough, you need a plan. Hire robots to automate production, unlock a tech tree to expand your farm.

1967610.name: Turok: Origins
1967610.short_description: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

812910.name: Zodiac Legion
812910.short_description: Zodiac Legion is a turn-based tactical RPG where you take command of an arcane chivalric order. Launch daring raids through ancient ruins and treacherous dungeons. Advance in steadfast formations to disrupt enemy ranks with cunning stratagems. Hold your ground in a world of reawakening cosmic magic.

5445330.name: Unscrew Therapy
5445330.short_description: A relaxing ASMR puzzle with 500 hand-drawn levels. Unscrew metal pieces, enjoy satisfying sounds, and watch them fall. No timers, no pressure — just pure unscrewing satisfaction.

3976630.name: Astrobarian
3976630.short_description: Astrobarian™ is a 3D action RPG game where you and Cordina travel to different worlds — some cultivated, others filled with deadly hazards. Along the way, you may encounter others with different motives and unresolved mysteries.

5285880.name: Munshi Meadows
5285880.short_description: Hatch a Munshi from an egg and raise it your way. Train it with potions, get to know its personality, and see which of 43 forms it grows into. Then take it racing across 70 courses, throw it into cage matches and puzzle trials, build it a garden, and bring your friends along.

4790750.name: Birds of Ascent
4790750.short_description:
Birds of Ascent is a hand-drawn pixel-art 2D flight action adventure starring a flock of birds.
Soar through the skies, explore the cavern, and fight your way back to the surface!

5361240.name: SMASH EDEN
5361240.short_description: The rules of SMASH EDEN are simple. Break a barrier and smash the ball through the opening. You don’t need to break every barrier—one shot can turn the match around. For generations, this ball game has determined who takes Eden’s throne. With the king gone, eight royal smashers clash for the throne.

5438690.name: Oh Baby Blocks
5438690.short_description: A cosy block-swapping puzzler with knitted blocks. Swap, match and chain yarn blocks to beat 24 hat-wearing bosses, solve 80 hand-made puzzles, chase the daily board, or battle friends in local and online VS, including cross-play.

5103800.name: Last Ranger
5103800.short_description: Return to a mountain reserve abandoned after the storms. Restore its radio network, repair roads, survive the wilderness, and follow a nine-year-old transmission into the sealed North Range. Play alone, online, or in local split-screen co-op.

2445430.name: Tensei Brave
2445430.short_description:
Due to the invasion of the Demon Lord, countries around the world have been destroyed.
In the last remaining country, a hero is summoned.

Players control the hero, gather allies, and set out on a journey to defeat the Demon Lord.
Can the seemingly weak protagonist indeed vanquish the Demon Lord?

5337540.name: Medovox Demo
5337540.short_description: Play the Medovox demo! It's an atmospheric sandbox and farming simulator with cozy graphics powered by Unreal Engine 5. Buy cars, plant crops, and travel across a seamless open world. Experience the gameplay right now and add the full version of the game to your wishlist!

5476210.name: Soulful Slide Demo
5476210.short_description: A comfy and cozy sliding ice puzzle game with the twist of throwing snow along the path to solve puzzles. Featuring a combination of tranquil music and colorful art to bring in peaceful winter vibes. Collect gifts within levels to customize your own snowman as well.

5292790.name: Honk
5292790.short_description: Honk is a free-to-play, one-button precision platformer where you race real players online. Tap to jump past spikes, pipes and rocket cats, climb the ranked ladder, battle through tournaments every few hours, build your own levels, and hatch over 100 skins for your collection!

5410110.name: 勇者喵傳說 Demo
5410110.short_description:
MEOWBOUND LEGENDS is an idle RPG starring a cast of adventurous cats!

A group of cats finds themselves transported to another world, where they build a village of their own. They'll head out to fight monsters, collect equipment, and grow stronger—all on their own.

3857520.name: Louloudi Asteri Demo
3857520.short_description: Switch between two fighter aces in this 3D side-scrolling shooter! Roll your ship to rotate the screen, revealing gaps in enemy fire and terrain. Life regenerates over time, and the frontal shield blocks all fire. Lock on, use special weapons, and sidestep through 3D space to save the solar system!

5438340.name: The Startling: The Witch of Startling Woods
5438340.short_description: Four friends venture into America’s most haunted woods for a fall fishing trip. As they settle into camp, it becomes clear they are not alone. Experience a first-person horror story set deep in the Startling Woods, where getting lost is the least of your worries.

4739370.name: Brick Builds
4739370.short_description: A relaxed brick building studio for curious builders. Follow a guided first build, then make it your own with custom colors and moving parts. Save your creations, make visual instructions, and explore other builders' work through Steam Workshop.

5321760.name: THE NOM MUST BE FED
5321760.short_description: A solarpunk arcade game where you harvest fruit creatures to feed NOM. Aim with your mouse, collect pulp and upgrade your ship. Pulp also pays for new equipment, so you need to split your harvest between upgrades and NOM’s food.

5182970.name: Objecipher
5182970.short_description: A competitive team game of clever clues, questionable logic, and wildly different interpretations. Identify your team's objects before your opponents identify theirs.

4522380.name: Realize in Peace
4522380.short_description: If we were to bring a loved one back to life as an AI, and then, for whatever reason, we had to let them go or part ways, would we be able to turn them off?

5471220.name: マジッククリッカー Demo

3145440.name: Becoming Pablo
3145440.short_description: Rule the underworld in Becoming Pablo. A grand-strategy city-builder set in the gritty 70s-90s drug trade. Lead a cartel, conquer territories, manage operations, and outsmart your rivals. This isn't just about building an empire. It's about surviving it.

4834850.name: Ecstatica II
4834850.short_description: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

2696110.name: Situation Succ : Inn Elysium
2696110.short_description: Situation Succ is a Dark-Fantasy game with a mythos inspired in part by both Asian and Western occult influences. As a detective who finds himself trapped inside an ancient inn by four evil entities, you have to use your wits and investigative abilities to try and escape.

3375990.name: PC Cafe Simulator
3375990.short_description: Run your own Korean PC cafe! From customer service to cooking and store management — experience life as a PC cafe owner. Start small, hire staff, expand your store, and deal with troublesome customers yourself! Play solo or co-op with up to 8 players.

4079950.name: What Hides in Dreams Demo
4079950.short_description: To the now sleeping self...welcome back. Face the horrors only a sleeping mind can conjure in the demo to the first-person psychological horror adventure What Hides in Dreams, where death leaves scars.

4916700.name: Medovox
4916700.short_description: Medovox is an incredibly atmospheric sandbox farming simulator with realistic stylized graphics. Buy cars, build up your farm, plant crops, and travel across a seamless open world with very beautiful nature. Earn your first million!

5193750.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM! Demo
5193750.short_description: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

3216600.name: KINGDOM HEARTS IV
3216600.short_description:
Our hero Sora awakes in the unfamiliar world of Quadratum. As he looks for a way to return to his world, his friends Donald and Goofy head for the Underworld to try to find him.

Wield the Keyblade in fast-paced battles that match to your own play style.

4742960.name: Wolfbane
4742960.short_description: A dark fantasy werewolf action RPG focused on exploration, hunting, and brutal melee combat. Hunt enemies, grow stronger in human and beast form, and explore a cursed medieval world filled with secrets and hunters.

5311340.name: Royal Court
5311340.short_description: A single-player card puzzle for five-minute sittings. Seat nobles, priests, soldiers, and peasants by each house's own rule, bank your chains before an event can break them, and satisfy all four houses to win the day. A fresh Daily Court is dealt to every player, every day.

3862790.name: Skate Style
3862790.short_description: Skate Style is a next-gen skateboarding game with high-end graphics, an advanced character creator, and a built-in animation editor. Skate iconic spots like Barcelona and Prague, create your style, and share it with friends. Enjoy precise dual stick controls for ultimate trick freedom.

4270910.name: Dice and Daydream
4270910.short_description: Roll five dice, use limited rerolls to shape the result, and play cards powered by your dice total. Combos like pairs and straights trigger bonus effects. Build your deck in a childhood-daydream roguelike deckbuilder.

5342930.name: Dementium II
5342930.short_description: The original Dementium II, restored by the team who made it. William Redmoor wakes with fresh staples in his skull inside an asylum for the criminally insane, where the walls peel back to reveal something worse. Fight, solve and survive the cult DS horror classic, now on PC.

5474460.name: Tripartite: Magical Engineering
5474460.short_description: The defense of the castle is up to you. Build your own network of roads and towers and discover the magical combos necessary to defend your home, all while training soldiers and siege weapons to bring the fight back to the enemy. Capture their castles before they capture yours!

5487890.name: Golf Sim Sim
5487890.short_description: Start with a bedsheet, a bargain-bin launch monitor, and a dream. Beat 40 arcade golf challenges, earn cash, and install 20 upgrades as you turn a janky garage setup into the ultimate home golf simulator.

5490870.name: Horochi's Challenge
5490870.short_description: Change gravity in six directions and push crystal orbs to their goals in this single-player 3D puzzle game. Switch between Meguru and Bimba, work out moving pillars and rail platforms, and solve 50 stages across five worlds. Then aim for the fewest moves to earn gold medals!

5019490.name: YOGRAK — the long way down
5019490.short_description: The world was ending, until Yograk's nap did. Play YOGRAK, LICH SUPREME. Battle endless hordes of demons, trolls, and piranha-mancers. Unlock 9 characters, armaments, doctrines, relics, and demonic candies. Freeze time. Unfold the FRACTAL DOMAIN. Your disciples are waiting.

5378120.name: Rune Covenant
5378120.short_description: Build a fantasy card deck, plan tactical battles, explore solo adventures, and challenge opponents in online PvP.

4786440.name: Emoji Combo Arena
4786440.short_description: Mix two emojis. Unleash ridiculous combos. Blast your friends in a chaotic online party FPS for up to 4 players! Discover 70+ combos, from exploding crying faces to screaming meteors. Battle free-for-all or 2v2, or jump into a match against bots.

5224910.name: Backwards
5224910.short_description: Backwards is a first-person psychological horror game where survival depends on three rules: walk backward, turn when you’re being watched, and move forward only when danger leaves you no choice. Read the hallway, trust your senses, and don’t get comfortable.

2861080.name: Haunted Paws
2861080.short_description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

4101710.name: Very Disco, Disco Very!
4101710.short_description: Everyone locks in moves at once, then the simulation takes over. A dense, chaotic programming game for 1 to 8 players where pushes, cards, and chain reactions ensure nothing goes as intended.

5050630.name: Cube on a Leash
5050630.short_description: Cube on a Leash is a dungeon crawler roguelike about commanding your very volatile pet cube. Use your leash to avoid collateral damage as the cube carries out your sequences of attacks -- both manually and automatically -- and becomes your customizable agent of mass destruction.

5180740.name: Oh Shear!
5180740.short_description: Grab your shears and build a cozy wool empire! Oh Shear! is a relaxing incremental game about managing a colorful flock of sheep. Upgrade your tools, automate the pasture, and master the skill tree. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the 'shear satisfaction' of numbers going up!

5402440.name: Lamplight Yard - Military Supply Line
5402440.short_description: Opens up the military supply line: airdrops, Goldie the stray dog, helicopter support, militia, scavengers, batteries, double parts and the top-tier starting boon. Each chapter's airdrop brings that chapter's best gear. Every perk has a per-level limit.

5482860.name: Death Pool Club
5482860.short_description: Oh, a new face? Welcome to Death Pool Club. Every ball you sink takes a bite out of your rival's health. But we share the table, darling. Whatever you leave lying around is mine next turn ♠ The pockets are shady and the executives cheat openly. Beat them all, if you can.

5488250.name: Zomking
5488250.short_description: Hunt zombies, collect powerful loot, and grow stronger in this third-person action RPG. Find pistols, assault rifles, shotguns, and equipment with randomized stats and effects, build your character, fight through five increasingly dangerous stages, and ultimately challenge the Zomking.

4719200.name: Unholy Maiden
4719200.short_description:
