"Unholy Maiden" is a multi ending RPG. Amnesiac girl Atra ventures alone into an underground city overflowing with desire, seeking to reclaim her stolen memories.
Freely develop her character with over 20 branching endings.
Your choices decide whether she finds salvation or descends into ruin.

4855860.name: Three-Body: Eve of Judgment
4855860.short_description: Officially licensed by the Three-Body Universe — a narrative adventure. Board the mysterious Judgment Day and infiltrate the ETO: hide your identity, tell friend from foe, and survive a perilous rescue by any means. As humanity's golden age ends, only the choice before you is your fate.

5364640.name: Wiltcards
5364640.short_description: Wiltcards is a standard turn based trading card game. Place cards on the board, give them equipment and use actions card in order to attack your opponent. In the match itself, you might use your turn's gold to buy a card from the mutual shop instead.

5372870.name: Zero League
5372870.short_description: Zero League - a cosmic football sim with vast real world tactics, trading and business environments. Sign players with celestial lore, dictate your formation in the midst of temporal disarray, and watch every match on an interactive 2D pitch impacted by galactic weather events.

5471370.name: Stack Stack Meow
5471370.short_description: Collect cats, combine abilities, and upgrade your production! A desktop idle incremental game with one goal: reach 100 million yarn balls.

5489280.name: Overload 21
5489280.short_description: Overload 21 is a sci-fi card battler about knowing when to stop. Read enemy intent, draw toward 21, then stand and attack before your hand goes over.

3995210.name: Misery Relay
3995210.short_description: Wake up. Write some code. Help Liliya with the jam. Tomorrow is yesterday. A first-person psychological mystery in a small Russian flat, where the days run backwards and your wife is never quite the same woman twice.

3570930.name: Jessica's Choices - Forced
3570930.short_description: Your story continues right where Origins left off. Whether Jessica finds herself wandering the streets alone, caught in George’s web of deceit, or trapped in the unsettling confines of Margaret Thatuals under Professor Trounch’s watchful gaze and the orderlies, every choice matters.

4150720.name: PUKEY GODDESS SHOT TRICK
4150720.short_description: Face off in a Russian roulette drinking survival with a demon who'd kill for you—or kill you—where it's puke or be puked on for your soul. The more you drink, the more the rules break down, until it all spills into one hell of a night you'll never forget.

4681170.name: Miscea: Sanguin's Laments
4681170.short_description: Fulfill your role in Soul's plan and take up arms against the bloodthirsty Buggers so that the Boubou people can survive and complete their divine task. Experience a story-rich turn-based tactics RPG set into the fantasy world of Miscea.

5488390.name: Arcane Quest Legends
5488390.short_description: A classic action RPG in the old-school hack & slash style. No fixed classes: mix warrior, wizard and ranger skills into your own hero, hire an ally, and fight through hordes of orcs, undead and demons across four story acts to face gigantic bosses.

5488430.name: Arcane Quest Legends 2
5488430.short_description: Hack & slash through time in this classic action RPG. As Death's Soul Collector you fight across medieval fantasy, samurai Japan, pirate seas, the Wild West, a modern city, a post-apocalyptic wasteland and a sci-fi future. No fixed classes: build any hero and recruit the souls you reap.

3954570.name: Lamplight Yard
3954570.short_description: By day, plant potatoes, fix the gate and build crossbows. By night, hold Grandma's little yard with a flashlight until the convoy comes. An 8-chapter campaign, a 9-stop roguelite road trip, daily routes and an endless watch.

4506030.name: Nie Xiaoqian
4506030.short_description: Nie Xiaoqian is a supernatural visual novel set in ancient China. At a ruined temple in Jinhua, scholar Ning Caichen meets a trapped young ghost. Grow closer through doubt, trust and mortal danger. Shape their story with key choices, explore different endings, and find where they belong.

4775810.name: Farm Break
4775810.short_description: Farm Break is a 3D arcade game in which you play as Piggo the piglet. Moving from wall to wall, you need to paint every corner of the pen to advance. But be careful: some of them aren't as safe as they seem.

4978080.name: CARTA CHAIN: Maou-chan’s Deal
4978080.short_description: Chain cards by matching suits or ranks, then use strategic sequencing and item combos to rack up explosive scores. Turn your debt-ridden life around at Maou-chan’s casino in this single-player card game.

5196330.name: IT THINKS!
5196330.short_description: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

5460280.name: Dungeon Defenders - Shaman Hero DLC
5460280.short_description: Shaman Hero class for Dungeon Defenders

5484960.name: NAGERU or NADERU
5484960.short_description:
Let's answer the quiz about these cute puppies!

Does this puppy want you to throw something for him!? Or does he want you to pet him!? Which is it~!

5132160.name: Selkie's Salvage&Co. Demo
5132160.short_description: Selkie’s Salvage&Co. is a first-person physics based incremental fishing game. Your task is to clean up the flooded planet! Fish up scrap, grind all of it down and collect trinkets of the past. Expand your salvaging operation and go beyond!

3371050.name: Zeverland
3371050.short_description: Welcome to Zeverland, survive & craft together with your friends in a deceptively cute apocalypse, with no limits! Everything is interactive like the real world—dismantle toilets, strap zombie heads to bats, or weld a bed to your RV. Then, try to repair bridges, make vaccines, and relight the world!

4367690.name: ZOMBUTCHER Demo
4367690.short_description: Meat shop simulator where you play as a ZOMBIE! Sell meat to humans by day, butcher them by night, and manage a dark business through stealth and resource management all while eating BRA-A-A-INS!

4741790.name: Spectrends
4741790.short_description: Two crews of four goblins rob the same doomed village. Grab the treasure. Grab each other. Throw both. Bank more gold than the rival clan before the tower comes down — and right up to the final seconds, nothing stops them wheeling it back out of your cart. Eight players, one very bad idea.

5048330.name: Haunted Ghost Hunters
5048330.short_description: Become a ghost hunter! Enter forbidden places crawling with paranormal activity. 🦇 Lost mansions, abandoned asylums, forgotten graveyards, decaying castles... Grab your gear. Enter the fog. Reveal what hides within.

5086910.name: 追命战士DreamingFighter
5086910.short_description:
DreamingFighter: real-time combat. You can't pick your origin — effort and wit change everything!
Random Characters: even nobodies can rise!
Single-Player Combat: dodge, combo, all out!
Ability Steal × Fortune Wheel: beat foes, take powers!
WorldMap: collect pieces — see full picture!
Chase destiny!

5163240.name: TrackBlitz
5163240.short_description: Three minutes, one track, your best lap counts. Compete against the world on 60 unique tracks with incredible variation. Race your friends and beat their times, climb regional leaderboards and become number one. Customize your car with endless options and show off your awesome ride to the world!

5338640.name: RATS!! - Co-op Tower Defense
5338640.short_description: Co-op tower defense for up to four farmhands: torch hordes of thousands of rats and bowl them into a catfish's mouth. Defend the farm on foot, build towers mid-wave, sell the duds and link them into combos. Play solo, on the couch or online through Steam, then face four crowned kings.

5363420.name: SpartanBit
5363420.short_description: SpartanBit is a voxel stylized arena shooter, supporting up to 8v8 in Slayer, or objective gametypes, including classics like Capture the Flag, Assault, and King of the Hill.

5423320.name: 疯狂世界超变
5423320.short_description: Mad World Ultra Evolution is a cartoon-style tower defense shooter game. Defend your rear base, face waves of incoming enemies, pick up weapons and keep shooting to fend off assaults.

5453290.name: COLLEC — Collector's Edition
5453290.short_description: Comfort for good and the collector's gold look. No cards, no packs, no shards: everything in it can also be earned by playing.

5453310.name: COLLEC — All nine worlds
5453310.short_description: All nine worlds at once: for each, the animated home backdrop, the card back and the name colour. Looks only: no cards, no packs.

5490590.name: Haunted House Director
5490590.short_description: You don’t survive the haunted house. You run it. Haunt a cast who think, argue, and panic on their own. Feed on their fear, grow your ghost, and direct the night until they break. No two hauntings go the same way.

5013290.name: Idle King: Loot Together
5013290.short_description: IdleKing is a dark fairy-tale idle loot RPG with online co-op. Auto-battle monsters and bosses, collect and upgrade your gear, and grow ever stronger. Adventure solo or team up with up to three friends to take on tougher challenges!

1880380.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Assembly Kit BETA

5450220.name: Crayon Sparks
5450220.short_description: Draw your escape route in a hand-drawn bomb arena! Chain explosions, collect upgrades and turn tricky terrain to your advantage. Challenge 50 solo stages, battle friends online with up to 8 players, or share one computer for local battles with up to 4 players.

4834840.name: Ecstatica
4834840.short_description: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

5230200.name: Deepworks
5230200.short_description: Earth is gone. The fleet is hungry. Drop a Hub on a generated claim, find the seam, and let the robots dig. Every machine you build makes noise — and noise is how the machines that took the planet find you. Hold the line, launch with the take, sell it, and go deeper.

3214900.name: What Hides in Dreams
3214900.short_description: To the now sleeping self...welcome back. Face the horrors only a sleeping mind can conjure in this first-person psychological horror adventure where dreams become reality and death leaves a permanent scar.

5372620.name: Pikabuu: Home
5372620.short_description: Rian and Febi thought they found their dream home at a cheap price, unaware of its dark history. Experience their daily life from dual perspectives in this psychological horror game. Face relentless terror, make critical choices, and uncover the truth: are they truly the only ones inside?

5176960.name: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite Demo
5176960.short_description: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies and hold the line across the demo's first three biomes.

4514090.name: PSYCHOBYL
4514090.short_description: Survive the irradiated Zone. Raid hostile territories, loot rare gear, craft powerful equipment, and upgrade your bunker in this dark atmospheric idle RPG. Die, undergo Genesis, and return stronger. Turn-based combat, deep prestige layers, and endless progression. The Zone demands evolution.

5141480.name: VOIDHOLD: Squad Survival Roguelite
5141480.short_description: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies, push through 10 biomes, and hold the line at the edge of the void.

5323500.name: DEEP SEAL
5323500.short_description: DEEP SEAL is a 1–4 player co-op underwater horror game. Dive into dark, labyrinthine caves to recover bodies, find your way through the depths, and avoid the shark that's always hunting you. Grab what you can, find your teammates, and swim back alive.

833880.name: The Unbreakable Gumball - Demo
833880.short_description: An open-world superhero game set inside of a comic book!  Jump, swing, and glide your way around the city of the future!

3281940.name: XENO DEAD
3281940.short_description:
XENO DEAD is a fast-paced FPS tinged with a melancholic atmosphere.
After aliens have come to the planet Earth to siphon its resources, the humans decide it best to call in their strongest weapon... you, the Assassin.

3859710.name: Ascentia - New Map: Cube Cave
3859710.short_description: In this cave constructed from mysterious blocks, every error is a newly created coordinate. There is no real dead end here, only the next round of refactoring that has not yet been activated by courage

1424230.name: Holdfast: Nations At War - Dedicated Server

5246470.name: SkyAid
5246470.short_description: Pilot your aircraft and dive into the disaster zone. Flames, ruins, floods — every corner holds someone waiting to be saved. Fly. Scan. Locate. Find every survivor before the clock runs out. Heal the wounded, transport the rescued, use supplies — every choice you make decides their fate.

4553990.name: Fuman Ghoul
4553990.short_description:
A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters.
Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

5244320.name: The Infinite Tower
5244320.short_description: A challenging action roguelite for 1-4 players. Battle bosses with raid-style teamwork and 2D platforming, build around 16 unusual heroes, and survive arenas that fight back. Climb alone or bring three friends. The Tower has a wish to grant.

5421500.name: Hold the Bastion
5421500.short_description: Defend your bastion against waves of goblins closing in from every direction. Choose from three classes and six weapons, each with its own skill tree. After every wave, pick one of three upgrade cards and build up your defenses for the next assault. How long can you hold out?

5068550.name: Egg Rush
5068550.short_description: Egg Rush is a 3D cartoon side-scrolling roguelite game. Collect a wealth of treasures and items to power yourself up, encounter all kinds of special events, and use their abilities wisely to overcome every challenge!

5439670.name: Londya Demo
5439670.short_description: Build your own combat styles in a single-player action RPG. Level up to unlock new attacks and evolve your styles as enemies learn your fighting patterns. Protect Londya on the road to the Lond, and adapt before your own habits become your downfall.

2586280.name: Londya
2586280.short_description: Build your own combat styles in a single-player action RPG. Level up to unlock new attacks and evolve your styles as enemies learn your fighting patterns. Protect Londya on the road to the Lond, and adapt before your own habits become your downfall.

1853440.name: Tropico 7
1853440.short_description: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

5460410.name: EVENTLOCATION SIMULATOR Demo
5460410.short_description: Try EVENTLOCATION SIMULATOR for 60 minutes of active gameplay. Build and run your own club, plan events, serve drinks, and explore a town full of odd characters and surprises. A chaotic sandbox simulator where you decide how to spend your first hour.

5301140.name: EVENTLOCATION SIMULATOR
5301140.short_description: Build your own club, plan events, and master lighting, sound, drinks, power, and guests. Design your venue freely, host parties, concerts, and more – a crazy sandbox simulator packed with systems, chaos, and surprises.

5148610.name: Drums & Steel
5148610.short_description: Command formations of 18th-century style armies in real-time strategic combat. Maneuver infantry, cavalry, and artillery through skirmishes and campaigns. May the best army win.

3619640.name: Before Peace
3619640.short_description: A "skinny wiki" app that only shows what you need to learn how to play RPGs like D&D "at the table". Skip the prep-work of character creation and just be yourself. Start playing immediately, laying on mechanics as you learn them while exploring an alien world for new foods and pets.

2929160.name: Gremlin Party '03
2929160.short_description: Gremlin Party '03 is a cartoon platform fighter loosely inspired by the game that started it all.

3475880.name: Train Goes Right
3475880.short_description: A cozy physics based railroad simulator where you chop trees, drive trains, transport materials, and build track one rail at a time in the early steam age. The goal is simple: go right.

5037410.name: Share the Load
5037410.short_description: A co-op adventure where the journey is everything. Travel alone or with friends, protect a powerful orb, and brave a world filled with peril on your quest to destroy it. Every challenge strengthens or breaks your party. Will you reach the end of the road?

4062250.name: Crim Ludus
4062250.short_description: Crim Ludus is a grim-dark PvPvE arena where enslaved mages are forced to battle beneath a world ruled by demons. Fight in deadly arena matches that combine realtime grid-based movement, strategic spellcasting, and relentless monster hordes in a brutal test of positioning and survival.

5482880.name: Death Pool Club Demo
5482880.short_description: Oh, a new face? Welcome to Death Pool Club. Every ball you sink takes a bite out of your rival's health. But we share the table, darling. Whatever you leave lying around is mine next turn ♠ The pockets are shady and the executives cheat openly. Beat them all, if you can.

5164420.name: Fate Candle: Three Kingdoms - Chronicle Restored
5164420.short_description: Armies are easy to raise. A true general is hard to recognize. After the fire at Red Cliffs, heroes scatter under aliases. Rise from one city, judge them by deeds, and restore their names. Govern, forge bonds, grow your faction, and win ten-slot battles to end the chaos before the world collapses.

5362050.name: Solareign
5362050.short_description: Solareign is a heart-pumping RTS game in the throes of the universe! Capture worlds, multiply your fleet, and extinguish empires. Inspired by roguelites and arcade classics, minus the chance: skill and quick wits are your only friends here.

5384580.name: Hatchbar
5384580.short_description: A little village lives in a strip at the bottom of your screen. While you work, adventurers hunt on their own, wielding the Hatchlings you raise as weapons. Enhance them until they take on a new look, mix any two into a new one, and follow the village journal. One price, no ads.

5395490.name: Cash & Stash: A Vaultkeeper Story Demo
5395490.short_description: After a failed robbery attempt, the bank has been torn apart and left in complete chaos. Now, as the Vaultkeeper, you must sort through more than 16,000 scattered items, return everything to its proper place, and uncover the stories behind the bank’s clients and their valuables.

5336570.name: Arcane Abyss（アーケイン・アビス） Demo
5336570.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

4098770.name: PUNCH ARENA
4098770.short_description: A physics-based arena brawler where elastic punches become projectiles, blending shooter-style spacing with chaotic melee combat.

3963380.name: Improvised Tactics Demo
3963380.short_description: Improvised Tactics is a single-player RTS focused on individual soldiers in a battlefield environment. You can command units directly or take control of them to achieve your objectives. The game offers multiple modes to keep gameplay fresh.

3692030.name: Star-Coat
3692030.short_description: Star-Coat is a third person shooter where you dive into procedurally generated maps to fight corrupted enemies and the bosses that command them. Outfit your pilot and your COAT, a fearsome walker, with a variety of weapons and armor to help you defeat evil in the universe.

5218110.name: Comic Shop Tycoon Demo
5218110.short_description: Your dream comic shop starts here! Play the free demo of Comic Shop Tycoon. Stock shelves, discover collectible back issues, prepare for New Comic Book Day, set prices, serve customers, and grow your little comic shop into a thriving business!

5299230.name: Plamo Kits Demo
5299230.short_description: Cut parts from sprues, paint them your way, apply decals, and assemble each kit. Pose your finished models, display them in your room, and take photos—all at your own pace in a relaxing model-building simulation.

5029800.name: Three Kingdoms Online
5029800.short_description:
Real-time Three Kingdoms strategy. No turns. No waiting.
Domestic affairs, diplomacy, court politics, war — all of it runs at once.
Up to 8 players in one world. Bring your friends. Lose the night.
Write a new history of the Three Kingdoms.

5362010.name: Common Darkness
5362010.short_description: An XCOM-style turn-based tactics campaign against a demonic incursion, solo or in 1–4 player online co-op. Take cover, flank, and revive your fallen under fire; then research, rebuild, and decide which calls for help to answer. Four powers. One world to lose.

4603530.name: Space Slinger Demo
4603530.short_description: Space Slinger is an arcade roguelike about a traveler and his recoil-packed gun where you shoot to move. Unlock unique weapons and broken builds as you conquer space one enemy at a time.

3079190.name: Post Apocalypse Courier Service - Delivery Simulator
3079190.short_description: 1-4 players in the postiepocalypse! Drive across treacherous environments, customize your delivery vehicles, and secure 5 star reviews for corporate by supplying the apocalyptic miracle of a package delivered on time.

4967210.name: Hot Seat Triage
4967210.short_description: Triage is easy, until your own brain starts lying to you. Pick patients from a crowded ER, spend scarce questions, and call NOW, SOON or LATER before their aura fades. Every one of 498 cases hides a real cognitive bias trap, written by an emergency physician.

5353860.name: Magehold Fairwinds
5353860.short_description: Crew a leaking airship across five acts of painted sky. Route Flow, raise wind shields, cast from the Casting Room and board your enemies in real-time-with-pause battles, then pay off the debt, if you can. An airship roguelite set in the world of Magehold.

4933450.name: CLAWSTROPHOBIA
4933450.short_description: You are trapped underground in a Japanese subway station and must pay off an impossible debt in this rogue-lite claw machine deckbuilder.

5461580.name: Better Days 2
5461580.short_description: The pioneer of bishoujo extraction shooters returns! Buy once, play solo PvE, no microtransactions. Switch first/third person, change outfits via nanotech mid-raid and fill your trunk with loot. Amid shifting weather and eerie encounters, extract now or get greedy?

4693770.name: Still Waters
4693770.short_description: A cozy idle aquarium that lives at the bottom of your screen - the kind you can reach into. Grab fish, toss them, collect them, and let a little ocean keep you company while you work, study or chill.

4493130.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
4493130.short_description: You're the Ski-E-O - build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management tycoon game. Adapt to ever-changing weather, paint trails, build lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

4821570.name: 异界碎片
4821570.short_description: Otherworld Shards is a xianxia action RPG with floating-island building. Saved by the Core of Shards, you explore void isles, fight in real time, recruit unique Nayin disciples, build your sect and rebuild the broken immortal realm.

4297790.name: Prison Fury Demo
4297790.short_description: A co-op puzzle game built to make you and your friend argue, laugh, and celebrate. Two players on opposite sides of a prison — every puzzle requires both of you, or neither of you escapes."

5370290.name: RUNTIME Demo
5370290.short_description: Dash through refill chains, flip gravity and slip past lasers in RUNTIME, a precision platformer. Play four selected chapters and race a friend on two courses, with previews of the full game’s Time Trials, level editor and cosmetic collection.

2415280.name: Agency 13
2415280.short_description: Agency 13 is a co-op supernatural horror game where you investigate mysterious deaths, locate the bodies, and gather evidence to uncover what happened. Identify the entities responsible and find a way to banish them. But beware—some secrets are better left buried.

4146710.name: Oh Puck!
4146710.short_description: Compete in the first ever curling party game! Slide, punch, and sabotage your friends in chaotic matches filled with special items. Outplay, outsmart, and out-slide your rivals in the ultimate frozen showdown!

5121940.name: 崇祯模拟器 Demo
5121940.short_description: 1644—the Ming Dynasty is collapsing. Rebels close on Beijing, Manchu armies at the gates, the treasury empty. As Chongzhen, China's last emperor, you command AI-driven ministers who flatter, scheme, and defy you. Rewrite history—or fall as the records say?

5231750.name: Dead Spin Demo
5231750.short_description: Gamble your way through a deadly casino in this dark roguelite deckbuilder. Survive the campaign or challenge other players in PvP mode. Discover broken synergies and keep spinning for your freedom!

5270550.name: Home Reset: Organizing Simulator Demo
5270550.short_description: Transform a messy home into a cozy, beautifully organized space. Clean, arrange, and decorate every room your way—there are no wrong choices. Relax, get creative, and experience the joy of a fresh home in this demo.

5285900.name: 771: Smile and work Demo
5285900.short_description: "771: Smile and Work Demo" is a first-person psychological horror game consisting of 7 unique gameplay segments, each created by a different developer.

5320330.name: Spray to Grail Demo
5320330.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

4719220.name: Denshattack! Soundtrack
4719220.short_description: Denshattack! (Original Game Soundtrack) features high-energy, electronic, breakbeat, and fast-paced arcade tunes that perfectly accompany the colorful universe of the train-flipping platformer.

4991210.name: Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit - Demo
4991210.short_description: A mystery adventure featuring a public security duo and supernatural cases. Unravel the truth behind the otherworldly "Ghosturbance Cases"!

4329280.name: Substance 3D Designer 2026
4329280.short_description: Substance 3D Designer is the industry's reference 3D Material Creation app. More than 95% of AAA game projects currently in development use Substance 3D as well as the most prestigious visual effects and animation studios.

4353760.name: 99天生存指南 Demo
4353760.short_description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

4577620.name: Bills Must Be Paid Demo
4577620.short_description: You're broke, smash piggy banks, bills must be paid. A short active incremental game. Get money, upgrade, and get debt free!

3945780.name: Football Academy Manager Demo
3945780.short_description: Run your own football academy. Scout and discover young talents, evaluate their potential, manage their development through training, and negotiate transfers with clubs to grow your prestige and influence.

4092550.name: Darkenstein 3D Soundtrack
4092550.short_description: 29 Original tracks from the score for Darkenstein 3D.

4264890.name: Cursed Words Demo
4264890.short_description: From letters to lunacy, Cursed Words is a roguelike chasing ever-stronger synergies. Start with simple words like BUY or THIS or GAME, then use game-altering combos to break the rules. Before long you’ll be ¼♖♙K5XNG the ⅗H♗4 out of these 83VK??7?!

5023550.name: Velocity - Midnight Run
5023550.short_description: Hold speed through an endless night city. Climb a 100-car field in Midnight Run, slip past traffic, shake the cops, and cash every near miss into style. Then take it to Solo, private Crew rooms, or Online matchmaking. An arcade night-driving racer built for one more run.

5052180.name: Hanafuda
5052180.short_description: Discover the traditional Japanese 🎴Hanafuda (花札 - Flower Cards) games, brought to life as a beautiful, modern 3D tabletop game. Match cards to create pairs, complete a set and collect points, or call Koi-Koi to risk it all for more. Play against the computer, or other players online.

3607920.name: Ravenswatch - Romeo & Juliet
3607920.short_description: The famous star-crossed lovers are bound by more than just their hearts: armed with rapier and musket, they face the Nightmare together. Unlock two new heroes in Ravenswatch. Playable solo, formidable as a duo.

3713610.name: Absolum Demo
3713610.short_description: Fight as the outcast heroes of Talamh in a fierce battle to retake magic from Sun King Azra’s grasp in Absolum, an original roguelite beat ‘em up by Dotemu.

3858750.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana – Prophecies of Ash
3858750.short_description: Settle on the largest island in Latium, beneath a looming volcano. Its eruptions will force you to adapt. On this bountiful new land, discover a rare resource, bargain with a trader, and bow before a new deity.

3858770.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana – The Hippodrome
3858770.short_description: Build the Hippodrome, host chariot races, and grow your splendor! Your citizens are crying out for more spectacle, and your specialists stand ready to prove themselves on the racetrack.

3350020.name: Dragon's Dogma 2 Original Soundtrack
3350020.short_description: The Dragon's Dogma 2 Original Soundtrack has arrived, complete with 87 tracks that weave the tale of your journey with your Pawns. Bend your ear to these masterworks and let them stir the fire of adventure in you anew!

3400280.name: Project Solaris Demo
3400280.short_description:
[Project Solaris] is a roguelite RPG in which "Solaris", a failed witch, aims to become a full-fledged mage with her little sidekick, "Homu". 
Train Homu, build a relationship of trust, and overcome the trials that await you in 100 days!

5135090.name: Egg Rush Demo
5135090.short_description: Egg Rush is a 3D cartoon side-scrolling roguelite game. Collect a wealth of treasures and items to power yourself up, encounter all kinds of special events, and use their abilities wisely to overcome every challenge!

3364740.name: 天書
3364740.short_description:
The Book of Heaven — Your Destiny, Your Path
A regular office worker stumbles into The Book of Heaven.
Explore vast lands, face trials, and uncover your destiny.

Your choices shape your future — hero or villain, light or shadow.
An epic journey awaits.

The Book of Heaven is open — destiny awaits.

592700.name: Dead Rising 4 - Season Pass
592700.short_description: The Dead Rising 4 Season Pass is the gift that keeps on killing. Buy the Season Pass and receive the exclusive bonus Stocking Stuffer Holiday Pack, Super Ultra Dead Rising 4 Mini Golf and Frank Rising.

593055.name: Dead Rising 4 - Super Ultra Dead Rising 4 Mini Golf
593055.short_description: You’ve mastered the outbreak – now it’s time to master the green, with eighteen holes of pure wanton destruction. Flip zombies the birdie with Super Ultra Dead Rising 4 Mini Golf where bloodthirsty, over the top zombie mayhem is par for the course.

362180.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Reunited in Macau
362180.short_description: Down and out Liu Kang gets into a drunken fight in a seedy Macau bar with the local gangsters. Liu Kang is not happy when Kung Lao comes to his rescue and the two have a tumultuous reunion.

5455450.name: 被困的芙瑞希雅 Demo
5455450.short_description: The Demo version of Unfree Freesia. A narrative-driven game where Deduction meets the Dark Arts. Invest crime scenes for evidence and navigate the razor's edge between "Rationality" and "Inspiration." Unlock branching paths through your choices, and decide who survives the encroaching shadows.

2956700.name: Captain McSpacebiff
2956700.short_description:
Hot-swap between 1st person shooting and 3rd person brawling in this Atom Punk styled adventure.
Collect crashed ship parts to gain new abilities, save the doofy locals and vanquish the Soviet Moonion!

5375730.name: Wishknot Demo
5375730.short_description: Swing, saw and squash your way through a procedurally generated world in this dangerous physics soulslike. You've fallen down an endless wishing well with nothing but a rope and far too much momentum.

4773700.name: Reforge Eden: Overlord
4773700.short_description: An open-world game blending RTS and RPG elements, set in a medieval fantasy and steampunk world. Train armies, recruit diverse races, explore  dungeons, build a kingdom from nothing, develop cities and industry, manage population and professions, and construct wonders and devastating superweapons.

4755160.name: Shotgun Monkey
4755160.short_description: Evolution was a mistake. Shotgun Monkey is a 2v2v2 competitive multiplayer shooter with unique abilities and insane movements.

5256180.name: Banner Born
5256180.short_description: Banner Born is a single-player medieval fantasy action RPG that blends directional combat, real-time troop command, and a living campaign. Begin alone, recruit companions and soldiers, master weapons and magic, and rise from mercenary to ruler.

5181290.name: It's Just a Rescue, Bro! Demo

4801640.name: 迷失小镇 Demo
4801640.short_description: Play as a maiden trapped in a foggy procedural town. Fight mutants with your starter weapon and collect glowing gems. Upgrade gear with gems to unlock new zones and random events: rewards, monster swarms, treasures, cursed trials. Level up for random magic cards;

4665870.name: Fields of Aaru Demo
4665870.short_description: A cozy life sim set in the mystical afterlife of Ancient Egypt. Farm along the Nile, befriend the locals, and decorate your eternal home. Venture into the desert and discover oases, pyramids, and tombs. Unlock magical powers by restoring ancient obelisks and making offerings to the gods.

4089380.name: Whisper Shift Pale Wing
4089380.short_description: Something in Pale Wing Institute is counting down from five. Hide before it hits zero, but don't trust the count. As reporter Rey Hestflame, scavenge weapons, solve puzzles, and fight your way to the truth about the missing victims.

4460990.name: Welcome to Harmony Demo
4460990.short_description: Build your timeline, execute your plan, and survive Harmony as it slowly slips into something darker in this 3D deckbuilding roguelite.

4916990.name: Antopolis: The Ant Colony Simulator Demo

5240630.name: Loading Dock Simulator Demo
5240630.short_description: Play your first days on the loading dock for free. Sort incoming boxes into rolltainers by area, track down misplaced boxes with your PDA, and hire your first staff. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players, about 2 hours of play. Wishlist the full game to get notified at launch!

4853710.name: Borrow or Rob
4853710.short_description: The Pantheon sends armies back from the future; humanity has never won. Now you fight backwards too. Two agents: one fights Phase 1 forward, the other refights it in reverse, where your past agent returns as a hologram to strike with you: the TEMPORAL PINCER. A retro future roguelike deckbuilder.

3901850.name: Desktop Duck
3901850.short_description: Your desktop deserves a duck. It lives on your screen, perches on your windows, and reacts to you. Earn hats together, then trade, sell, or show them off.

5189670.name: SexaroidGirlVR
5189670.short_description: VR Sex Simulation Game "Sexaroid Girl VR": The adult VR game that became a massive hit in Japan in 2017 arrives on Steam in a localized version!

3308690.name: Aether Abyss
3308690.short_description: Aether Abyss is a 2D rougelike action game. You're in the realm between worlds and must hack and slash your way through hordes of enemies in arena style levels.

5367340.name: 浮块防线 Demo
5367340.short_description: Defend a fragile base against waves of enemies drifting in on floating islands. Merge defeated isles into your main island to grow your front line, draft soldiers and buildings in limited deck slots, then spend gold to buy and deploy troops. Unique map effects add fresh tactical twists.

4753720.name: Parallax Blue
4753720.short_description: A strategy tower defence where you create the towers! Gather resources, build towers, defeat bugs, and survive. Unlock new weapons, create towers, gather resources, and die. Don't fall short of the Company's expectations... these resources are worth more than any life, including yours.

4879350.name: Cardstock City
4879350.short_description: A trading card life simulator, in a strange world where people are replaced with living cards, and every paycheck you earn can be spent on another booster pack. Work all kinds of jobs, rip packs, chase the rarest pulls, run your own shop, or just collect all the animals of a place called Earth.

3324170.name: Blamcon ARC - Advanced Remote Console
3324170.short_description: This utility is for setting up your Blamcon Light Gun. Customize key bindings, set your player config, even set your cursor smoothing algorithm. Blamcon ARC will get the most out of your light gun and nail those high scores!

5422730.name: Catch a Cheater by the Hand
5422730.short_description: Cheat your way through nine card and tile games. Peek at rivals’ hands, swap cards from your sleeve, and steal chips—but watch for tells and call out the cheats around you. Get caught, or accuse the wrong player, and the Axe Man takes a limb.

4703530.name: Tiles of the Nadirat
4703530.short_description: A traditional roguelike where every step changes your build. Collect permanent stats, trigger item combos with movement patterns, and master classes, that change how you value tiles. Fight your way up to an duel with the creator of the Nadirat and uncover its lore through koan based riddles.

2530300.name: 落叶归根 Climbing Back to the Mothership
2530300.short_description: I've spent a lot of time making new friends. Now it's time for them to pay the price.

4890050.name: Potventure
4890050.short_description: Open a restaurant on a fantasy continent and build a culinary empire, one dish at a time. Explore, gather, cook, and expand — while six rival empires plot their own rise. Survive crises, seize opportunities, and carve your own path to victory.

5093620.name: 浮块防线
5093620.short_description: Defend a fragile base against waves of enemies drifting in on floating islands. Merge defeated isles into your main island to grow your front line, draft soldiers and buildings in limited deck slots, then spend gold to buy and deploy troops. Unique map effects add fresh tactical twists.

5440630.name: Liminal Descent
5440630.short_description: Descend into a nightmare where familiar places become something terrifying. Explore eerie liminal spaces, evade creatures with unique behaviours, uncover the truth behind your disappearance, and search for a way out. **Try the free demo.**

5056340.name: Stormforge Demo
5056340.short_description: Brave magical storms where tornadoes hunt you in this open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. Outrun the tornadoes or ride their winds, sail to new islands, defeat bosses to unlock classes, and build a home that can weather the next chaos storm.

5175640.name: All-Night Ascension Demo
5175640.short_description: A cultivation backpack auto-battler built around a three-layer Bagua board. Try two sects, combine methods, artifacts and materials, and test your build in asynchronous duels. Battles run automatically; once you gain a Domain, choose when to cast it. Expedition mode is not included.

5463600.name: MINESWEEPER ARCADE Demo
5463600.short_description: A classic Minesweeper that also incorporates many modern gameplay elements.

3179870.name: Kleks Academy
3179870.short_description: A magical platformer where you draw your own solutions! Explore fairytale worlds, solve puzzles with creativity, and uncover secrets in the Kleks Academy.

5013700.name: Get Nowhere
5013700.short_description: Read immersive dialogue sequences, make crucial choices to shift the storyline, and unlock multiple distinct endings in this story-focused visual novel. Your decisions alter character relationships and rewrite the fate of every role.

4006760.name: Desktop Taxi
4006760.short_description: A cozy idle taxi sim with Lofi beats. Grow your taxi business quietly in the corner of your screen while you work.

5019810.name: Whispering Green Demo
5019810.short_description: Whispering Green is a cozy first-person magical horticulture. Explore enchanted woods, discover rare plants, and use your Arcane Gun to uncover secrets. Cultivate magical flora, brew powerful remedies, and grow your apothecary into a thriving business.

5247210.name: Cozy Cargo
5247210.short_description: Someone's having a bad week. Your job is to pack them a comforting package. A cozy roguelike where every object reacts to the ones beside it, so you really don't want the scented candle next to the old novels. Three parcels each day, Monday to Friday.

4869220.name: Feetball
4869220.short_description: A fast-paced first-person football game where precision, skill, and chaos collide. Take full control of every touch, tackle, and strike with realistic ball physics and fluid physical movement. Master the pitch with friends, or team up with others looking to dominate.

3923070.name: Asteroid Boom Cosmic Courier
3923070.short_description: Work off your corporate debt as a low-tier space courier. Deliver antimatter devices to E.L.E. asteroids, recover classified data, and tackle hazardous space operations in a chaotic 4-player physics platformer. Drop the payload, share the oxygen, and survive the shift.

4248710.name: Alea Demo
4248710.short_description: A PvP brawler where every hero is two fighters in one. Human to werewolf. Fire to ice. Shield to greatsword. Swap mid-fight to outplay a rival in a 1v1 duel, or team up for 2v2 and 3v3 clashes.

2956040.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
2956040.short_description: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

3250410.name: Yaku Slap
3250410.short_description: 🎴 Yaku Slap – A rogue-like card battler where you duel monsters, master Hanafuda combos, and slap down the perfect hand! Unlock new perks, and classes as you fight your way down the Flower Path to become a Yaku Master! 🌸

3347120.name: Above the Cloud: Time Bound Mansion
3347120.short_description: Uncover the mysteries of the mansion in this co-op classless Action RPG. Permanently unlock abilities, gear and relics to create your perfect class fantasy. Step into the nightmare of the Time-Bound and defeat its denizen to progress and uncover the fate of the estate.

4768290.name: Daughter of Dawn Demo
4768290.short_description:
"A princess who lost everything flees with the Knight Commander!"
Become a father to protect the ruined kingdom's last princess. Guide a traumatized girl—caring, teaching, and learning when to let go. Your choices shape her destiny in this emotional raising sim RPG.

5398150.name: Battle SHIRYU
5398150.short_description: Real model footage × generative AI! Show your hand to a webcam and Battle SHIRYU recognizes it automatically! Steer a handmade paper dragon, smash matching-colour Moai, and set off chain explosions. No special markers or prepared backdrop needed. Mouse controls are available too.

5391460.name: Push Back
5391460.short_description: Push Back is a frantic top-down shooter with roguelike elements. Face off against hordes of cosmic entities, dodge a constant rain of celestial bodies, and destroy any matter that threatens your existence.

3506150.name: Booty Battler
3506150.short_description: SinglePlayer Roguelike meets Auto-Battler Card game! Manage a crew of pirates to fight through endless auto-battles while collecting powerful relics, managing cursed loot, upgrading the ship and casting spells.

5252790.name: Guardian Beast
5252790.short_description: An interactive digital novel: an 11-chapter SF-fantasy with art, music, video and choices, including game-over branches. Read in Japanese, English, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, with side-by-side translation and no extra fonts or OS language changes. Journey with Reis and his dragon.

4437650.name: Stinker Golf
4437650.short_description: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you build the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

5234480.name: Sudoku Kingdom
5234480.short_description: Beyond the classic 9×9: 22 Sudoku modes and tens of thousands of puzzles, including Killer, Thermometer, Arrow, Jigsaw, Circular, Triangle, Snowflake and Cube boards. Multiple difficulties, notes, undo and hints. One purchase—no ads, energy or microtransactions.

2173770.name: The Wings of Dawn
2173770.short_description: The Wings of Dawn is an open world survival game either survive as a dragon or thrive as a human. The wildlife having evolved entirely differently to anywhere on earth will pose a challenge to everyone. Do what it takes to survive the day and make sure to be in shelter at night.

5374930.name: Fruitless Campaign
5374930.short_description: Set the azimuth, elevation and launch speed, read the wind and the weather, and lob shells across endless procedurally generated islands to destroy every fruit. Play untimed on Easy or race the clock on Normal and Hard. Earn weapons from airdropped crates, or take on up to three friends online.

5451750.name: Rope Untangle
5451750.short_description: Untangle colorful ropes, one move at a time! Drag the rope ends to free every strand. Simple controls meet clever puzzles: observe, plan, and enjoy the satisfaction of turning a tangled mess into order.

5338870.name: Tidy Tech
5338870.short_description: Tidy Tech is a relaxing first-person sorting game with over 14,000 items to put away. Fill shelves with PC parts, keyboards, consoles and more across seven rooms. Earn money, upgrade your tools and hire helper robots to make the cleanup even more satisfying.

583750.name: Akata's Adventure
583750.short_description: An idyllic VR climbing adventure. Explore a handcrafted world with Akata, your fox-like companion, on an immersive quest from the distant past of the Skyclimbers universe.

4922890.name: Flag Conquest
4922890.short_description: An incremental roguelite auto-battler. Build a persistent army, program its tactics with Gambits, and take a fallen kingdom back one flag at a time across zones that never stop scaling. Retreat, bank what you earned, come back stronger. Deep prestige, an endless Tower, and King of the Hill.

5425760.name: Survive in Spaceshit - THE REVERSAL Playtest

5024060.name: Requiem for a Dying Bloom Playtest

4520870.name: Seek Shellter
4520870.short_description: Seek Shellter is an arcade-style pathfinder full of cute snails who must collect batteries and seek shelter before the timer runs out. Team up with a friend or go solo to clear levels, win minigames and unlock worlds steeped in retro-60s atomic charm. Do you have what it takes to beat the bomb?

4830260.name: Paper Lanes
4830260.short_description: A transport strategy game: draw trade routes on 30 hand-drawn maps of real regions, from the Aegean to Malacca, and keep caravans and ships moving goods to towns that need them. Routes, vehicles and ports are scarce, so every redraw counts. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4.

5015190.name: Gorgeous Baby Bella
5015190.short_description: While her husband is away, Liora is forced to spend her days alone. But solitude is not as quiet as she thinks.

5014970.name: Tung Tung Tung Together
5014970.short_description: Tung Tung Tung Together is a co-op (1–4 players) survival horror set 10 years after Tung Tung Tung Survival. On the 1 km × 1 km Little Sahur Island, find items to repair your boat and escape while being hunted by the relentless Tung Tung Tung Sahur.

5341680.name: Tidy Tech Demo
5341680.short_description: Bring a cluttered tech shop back to life, one gadget at a time. Try the opening Stockroom and Peripheral Plaza, sort scattered gear into place, and enjoy a little company from BLIP in this relaxed taste of Tidy Tech.

5103470.name: BrouHaHa Demo
5103470.short_description:
Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy
coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

4581890.name: Kayak with friends
4581890.short_description: You and your friends, on kayaks! Master the art of kayaking and conquer fierce rivers with your friends (and against them). Explore the world’s most beautiful rivers and become the ultimate kayak warrior in this frantic racing adventure.

4810300.name: OddSpawns
4810300.short_description: Explore. Catch. Fight. Survive... Gamble! A creature-collecting auto-battler. Explore paper diorama-style worlds, catch bizarre creatures, build powerful synergies using the creatures and items you collect!

5002940.name: Realm Tycoons Demo
5002940.short_description: Build a fantasy realm in an eight-week Crown Trial. Roll across the board, capture valuable properties, recruit armies, and choose strategies for automatic real-time 3D battles. Play solo against AI or challenge friends in local hot-seat campaigns.

4084710.name: Rayman Legends Retold
4084710.short_description: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or in up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

3556830.name: Super One More Jump
3556830.short_description: Super One More Jump is an intense arcade platformer with simple to learn mechanics and hard to master levels. Test your muscle memory, concentration and sanity as you progress though ever-changing levels and gravity! Packed with content throughout various single player and multiplayer modes.

5156810.name: Tung Tung Tung Together - Supporter Pack
5156810.short_description: Tung Tung Tung Together Supporter Pack unlocks golden variants of all 4 characters, a playable Tung Tung Tung Sahur skin, and a day version of the Little Sahur Island map. Support the devs and face the nightmare in style, no balance changes, just pure flair.

5440650.name: No Dead Ends Demo
5440650.short_description: You died. Congratulations! Now you’re at the No Dead Ends Bar, and the Barman owns your soul. The price for freedom? $1,000,000. Gamble with the deceased, beat their games, and buy back your soul!

2831170.name: Color Fear
2831170.short_description: The Scariest Horror game you will ever experience. Today on The Color Fun Coloring Show they want viewers to help them find out who is breaking into their house! Survive each night against the Intruders and the Horror that comes from The Color Fun Coloring Show!

4882480.name: Family Gambling
4882480.short_description: A first-person narrative resource management game where you gamble with your son's organs to survive. Pay your debts, manage your home, and decide how much of your family you're willing to sacrifice.

5358030.name: Lumbrix
5358030.short_description: Lumbrix is a survivors-like shooter where every segment of your growing worm is both a weapon and a life. Aim your head cannon, shield yourself with your body, evolve your weapons and survive ten minutes to face the boss.

2144580.name: Super Bio-Man
2144580.short_description:
Super Bio-Man is the ultimate gunslinger and the guardian of our galaxy.
Using his arsenal and metal fist, he shows the invaders from outer space - who's the boss here.

5238690.name: Idle Legions
5238690.short_description: Your legion fights on its own, even with the game closed. Five heroes, five acts and bosses with their own mechanics. Forge your gear, raise pets, test your build against other players, and go down into the Abyss for what drops nowhere else.

1238650.name: Truck Parking Simulator
1238650.short_description: Discover your skills to park a trailer.

5046250.name: BrouHaHa
5046250.short_description:
Hear a word. Type it in 12 seconds. Get it wrong and you fall down a 12-player leaderboard until you're the one eliminated. Buy
coupons between words to distort your rivals' audio, scramble their typing, and steal their dollars.

5421220.name: Domain Expansion
5421220.short_description: Draw lines and claim territory in a 3D arcade action game. Read enemy movements, choose between safer captures and bold DEEP cuts, and take on 24 stages followed by a tougher second loop.

5360120.name: Arena Invaders
5360120.short_description: Hold the ring. Arena Invaders is a neon twin-lane shooter: orbit the rim, drop to the inner lane to fire outward, and hold back swarms that come from both sides. Play the classic Arcade campaign or survive 10 minutes of escalating chaos

5087800.name: 猫法洗衣房
5087800.short_description: Run a magical laundry on the verge of chaos! Toss single-use detergents into a physics-driven washer, chain collisions into escalating scores, buy machine parts, sign contracts, and survive nine rounds of increasingly unruly laundry.

3295510.name: Second Stab
3295510.short_description: The game is afoot. Again. A Matter of Murder: Second Stab is a roguelite detective puzzler where every playthrough serves up a fresh murder, a new web of lies, and another chance to prove your little grey cells are sharper than the killer’s knife.

5311140.name: Magic Ball Sort
5311140.short_description: Sort glowing elemental orbs in magical containers, solve hundreds of relaxing puzzles, and master an undefeated archmage's challenges. A premium puzzle game with no ads, energy, or microtransactions.

5274370.name: AETHERIA Demo
5274370.short_description: A high-speed aerial roguelite demo with full 360° 3D combat. Fly freely, fight enemy swarms, and combine automatic attacks, skills, and randomized upgrades. Explore the purple realm as the cat-eared character in this single-player demo.

5296410.name: Endangered Demo
5296410.short_description: Humanity wiped out your species. Now you're fighting back. Play as evolved animals in a brutal roguelike hack-and-slash inspired by Dynasty Warriors, Megabonk and Roboquest! Hunt down humans, adapt to a collapsing world, and collect nuclear launch codes to end the fight... permanently.

4032050.name: RTG
4032050.short_description: RTG is narrative sci-fi puzzle/platformer about a guy with no memories stranded inside strange world, where initially nothing makes sense. Solve gradually challenging puzzles and, piece by piece, unravel mystery behind what you see and experience.

4526080.name: Kukata: Word of Ghosts
4526080.short_description: Your words are your only weapon. Banish the restless dead in this Malaysian folklore typing horror. Face the Pocong and Pontianak in an abandoned school using fast-paced typing combat and ritual crafting. Can you find the words to survive? Start typing now.

4779390.name: Abyssal Guardians
4779390.short_description:
A 1-4 player fps co-op set in a dystopian future, where you are hired to take an elevator down multiple layers to eliminate hostile anomalies and gather resources for the Abyssal Company. Explore ever enlarging floors, gather items, make money, kill kill kill. 
How far will you go for glory?

5198340.name: Imperium of the Stars Demo
5198340.short_description: Build an empire, govern worlds, and command fleets in a single-player Gothic real-time 4X. Play as the Imperium for 50 in-game years with the Balanced Game Director. Your decisions shape a campaign of rival powers, unfolding events, and crises.

4743710.name: God Codex
4743710.short_description: A cinematic 2D pixel-art action adventure. Slay the Demon King, then awaken within her memories as two girls struggle against fate in a collapsing world. Heavy combat, environmental storytelling, and immersive cinematic presentation with almost no UI.

5358950.name: Rune Deep
5358950.short_description: A hundred floors of dungeon lie beneath a town built on ancient relics. Lead a party of four from six classes, unleash weapon skills and elemental reactions to carve through swarming hordes, and dig up gear that makes every build stronger in this 3D voxel hack & slash.

5077440.name: Hauntworks Demo
5077440.short_description: Run a haunted attraction where you scare guests, harvest their emotions, automate production chains, and manage a team of monsters. Hide evidence of "accidents" before the supernatural bureau comes looking.

5074150.name: Hand Me The Splorch!
5074150.short_description:
Get your dad the tools he needs before he blows a fuse!
Navigate a dark and dingy garage to find tools, fix breakers, do paperwork (those lawyers just keep calling), and much more all while your dad verbally assaults you. Will you have the fortitude to succeed?

4966990.name: Arcane Abyss
4966990.short_description: A pixel-art, turn-based roguelite deckbuilder where your cards are swords, axes and spears, and you throw them. Thrown weapons stay on the board: hit one with another to trigger Resonance, a combo attack that chains to nearby weapons. Synthesis moves abilities between weapons.

3238940.name: A Simple Life with My Unobtrusive Sister
3238940.short_description: A fully animated and voiced sister life-sim with roguelite runs. Find a cure for Mio’s illness. Share meals and quiet nights at home, then enter the Abyss each day to fight, loot, and push deeper to protect your simple life together.

5300580.name: Thornline TD
5300580.short_description: A maze tower defense where you build the path. Your towers are the walls, and the enemy walks the long way around. Play online with up to eight people and send units into each other's mazes to grow your income, or play fifty solo levels across ten worlds. Every new world changes how you build.

5444440.name: Coldchain: Depot Management
5444440.short_description: Run a temperature-controlled food service depot in this detailed management simulator. Plan delivery routes, manage warehouse operations, hire staff, maintain your fleet and balance the books as everyday challenges put your decisions to the test.

5367610.name: Pocket Chef
5367610.short_description: A tiny chef moves onto your desktop! Cook delicious meals, serve cute animal customers, collect ingredients, and start your own desktop kitchen adventure.

4971330.name: Depth Charge
4971330.short_description: Fate pulls your soul into the orange deep.

4242200.name: Hauntworks
4242200.short_description: Run a haunted attraction where you scare guests, harvest their emotions, automate production chains, and manage a team of monsters. Hide evidence of "accidents" before the supernatural bureau comes looking.

4731250.name: Moonberry Clock: Idle Pet
4731250.short_description: Watch the clock and your idle pet passively gain money to unlock clothes, toys, and fun accessories. Either customize your pet yourself, or schedule them to change looks on their own.

5127700.name: WORKS: Motorsport Factory Demo
5127700.short_description: Build a racing factory from your garage. Scavenge, buy or design parts, repair cars and climb the ranks of motorsport. Tight finances and worn parts force tough choices: repair, upgrade or pay off debts to keep your team alive.

1257610.name: Prison Architect 2
1257610.short_description: Welcome Architects! Design and develop your own personalized penitentiary in Prison Architect 2. The classic prison-builder has broken out into 3D, and it’s up to you to contain it!

5298510.name: JANKEN 100
5298510.short_description: A competitive rock-paper-scissors game focused on prediction and mind games. Freely distribute 100 attack points between Rock, Paper, and Scissors, and the value assigned to your winning hand becomes the damage dealt. Features CPU battles, Online Casual Matches, and Ranked Matches.

1661330.name: SacriFire
1661330.short_description: SacriFire is an upcoming RPG boasting a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art, and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Ezekiel Ridan, a young priest, struggles to keep his faith as the world he loves is threatened by a war between gods and demons.  The adventure begins!

4918270.name: You Have Been Slain: An Idle Tragedy Playtest

5105210.name: Small Fry Demo
5105210.short_description: Cook any meal you can imagine! Invent new ways to delight your customer’s taste buds, refine your menu to use your ingredients efficiently, and put it all together without missing an order. Unlock new ingredients and kitchen gadgets to create more and more perfect culinary creations.

1355900.name: Tattered Banners
1355900.short_description: Lead a mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a dynamic, simulated world shaped by your actions. Recruit, equip, and evolve your warband to survive a medieval-fantasy realm where cities rise and fall, noble houses pursue personal agendas, and the land bears the scars of your decisions.

5273630.name: Hyperlane Highway Demo
5273630.short_description:
A VR hoverboard roguelite. Lean your whole body to steer and dodge, no thumbstick's needed.
Use your duals blaster and abilities to dodge and build your run from 9 rival sponsors offering 90+ enhancement cards.
Clear the hyperlanes to impress the sponsors, every death is monetized.

4538350.name: Astral Trial
4538350.short_description: This is a deck-building game (DBG) that emphasizes symmetrical strategy. Your enemies, like you, possess decks, energy, and relics. Optimize your strategy, build your deck, challenge powerful female bosses, and save the world from collapse.

4575700.name: Vida:Unslain
4575700.short_description: Act first, or let your opponent go first? Card battles where cost, movement, and turn order are tightly intertwined. Choose your path, shape your options with the items you find, and press deeper into the labyrinth.

5402290.name: 你的老婆和你妈
5402290.short_description: Your wife and your mom have moved onto your desktop. They get hungry, they get tired, they bicker and sulk, and they eat peppers on their own. Plant peppers, fend off worms, launch fireworks — and watch the two of them go about their little lives in the corner of your screen.

2850290.name: Brightfall
2850290.short_description: Brightfall is an isometric open-world survival-craft for 1-4 players where light is your last defence against a living darkness. Explore cursed Celtic islands, craft powerful weapons, build a safe haven, and fight to keep your flame alive - because when it dies, your sanity follows.

5331050.name: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike Playtest

5076760.name: TinSpring Soccer
5076760.short_description:
TinSpring Soccer is a physics-driven metal spring table game with ten
authentically different boards — from a warped ~1890s oak table to a
floating hologram pitch — an opponent AI that plays like a real person,
full national tournaments, and local multiplayer for up to four players.

4535560.name: Warehouse Chaos Simulator
4535560.short_description: Warehouse Chaos Simulator is a satisfying warehouse organization simulation game where you sort identical products into boxes, organize shelves by category, and unlock skills to optimize your workflow.

5476040.name: Gilded Shoals
5476040.short_description: A relaxing incremental fishing game with short voyages and lasting upgrades. Explore five coastal locations, chase rare catches and Golden Shoals, and build a living aquarium with unlockable backdrops and freely placed decorations.

5319260.name: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike Demo
5319260.short_description: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

5052200.name: Never Stop Climbing
5052200.short_description: Fulfill the biological imperative of a hamster with your friends in up to 8 player co-op. Parkour and climb through multiple uniquely themed and nostalgic levels inspired by classic platforming games. Ascend into space but watch your step! One wrong move and you'll plummet down to Earth!

4690300.name: Slave Princess Elnea
4690300.short_description: In this RPG, play as Elnea, a former princess turned slave, as she climbs her way back to the top in pursuit of revenge! Earn money by either humiliating yourself in front of the Empire’s citizens or fighting your way through dungeons. Will you be able to preserve your dignity until the end?

5339710.name: 修仙刷怪传
5339710.short_description: This is an incremental cultivation game! Play as a cultivator, hunt demon beasts, collect resources, and roam the cultivation world! With a unique battlefield size-changing mechanic, from small demons to colossal beasts, feel the thrill of hunting!

5191400.name: Oh Shear! Demo
5191400.short_description: Grab your shears and build a cozy wool empire! Oh Shear! is a relaxing incremental game about managing a colorful flock of sheep. Upgrade your tools, automate the pasture, and master the skill tree. Sit back, relax, and enjoy the 'shear satisfaction' of numbers going up!

5302770.name: Hearth Fable Demo
5302770.short_description: Hearth Fable — Ink-wash Chinese city-building sim. Start from a blank scroll: build trades, raise mythical beasts, defend your town, and paint your own mountain-sea utopia.

4788660.name: Bunny Flags Demo
4788660.short_description: Sarge is BACK. Tactical roguelite top-down shooter. Infiltrate bases, plant flags, choose your loadout, and hunt Racabat. High replayability. Free demo available.

3787980.name: Gridfire
3787980.short_description: A fast top-down PvP shooter: capture flags, hold points and escort the VIP across six modes and dozens of maps. Build and share your own maps, play with friends — or switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

5124540.name: Too Much Baggage
5124540.short_description: Ever wonder where your bags go after check-in? In Too Much Baggage, keeping the airport moving is your problem. Build and expand a network of belts, route bags through security, and adapt as your airport grows. How long can you keep the world’s baggage flowing?

4846760.name: Gridfire Demo
4846760.short_description: Try Gridfire free. Queue into live Capture the Flag, Team Deathmatch and VIP Escort matches, vote between rounds on what to play next — and if you are brave, switch on Decibel Drive and fly your ship using your voice.

5456890.name: SLASH//SYNC Demo
5456890.short_description: SLASH//SYNC is a rhythm action game where your mouse movement becomes the blade. Slice notes racing down five lanes from the indicated direction. Chase high scores and full combos as every slash bursts into light, and experience the thrill of perfect synchronization—all with a mouse.

4985550.name: Elder Hills
4985550.short_description:
Survive fifteen minutes on six hills against rhythm-possessed hordes. Discover 29 weapons, 27 evolutions and 15 super evolutions across 8 classes. A dark-fantasy beat driven bullet-heaven roguelite.


Let the rhythm set you free.

4349850.name: Revenant Maze
4349850.short_description: A first person, action-roguelite that centres around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes and architects intent on defeating you. Create the strongest synergies and blitz all in sight.

3133210.name: Bargan's Treasure
3133210.short_description: Bargan’s Treasure is a narrative puzzle-adventure set in a forgotten village inspired by Saudi Arabia’s mountains. Explore ancient ruins, unravel Bargan’s strange inventions, and restore water and power as you uncover the mystery of a dagger lost for centuries.

5293100.name: Echo in the Lightless Deep
5293100.short_description: Echo in the Lightless Deep is a deep-sea survivor roguelite. Symbionts fight for you; you steer, dodge and build. The brighter your core, the farther you see and strike, and the more the deep sends at you. Five giants guard the way down. At the bottom, choose: return to the light, or stay dark.

1327040.name: Truck World: Australia
1327040.short_description: A trucking simulator set in Australia. Haul cargo on highways and off-road, step out of the cab, hitch trailers, connect hoses, refuel, and service your truck by hand. You don't just drive a truck - you work as a trucker.

5018560.name: Little Loops
5018560.short_description: Make a little space your own in this cozy fidget and idle game. Pop, spin and fold, trim a bonsai, or shape pottery. Collect new looks, arrange your desk and let little helpers earn joy while you relax—with a desktop companion and 25 mellow music tracks.

3596730.name: Painted Kingdoms: Tower Defense & Firefighting
3596730.short_description:
Painted Kingdoms is a minimalist strategy game where you paint, build, and defend your Kingdom of paper. 
Harness the power of paint to protect it from relentless flames and enemy hordes. 
Will your Painted Kingdom survive the next wave?

5139530.name: The Fight for Beardlandia Demo
5139530.short_description: An auto-battler roguelike gacha. Recruit your party, min-max their builds, and stack class synergies as you drag eight recruits thirty waves deep. Gear them up, roll for heroes, and bring down Hjorvan, the Frostfather. Free demo for The Fight for Beardlandia.

5398260.name: 荒山诡宿 Demo
5398260.short_description: Horror vlogger Song Qian checks into a remote mountain inn after getting lost at night. Film footage, explore the aged inn, chat with odd guests — then face inexplicable events after dark. Demo includes the full first chapter, ~15-20 minutes of gameplay.

3134200.name: D.O.T. Defence Demo
3134200.short_description: Welcome to the frontlines of D.O.T defense! Build towers, muster armies, and conquer the map. Fight local matches in 1v1, 2v2, or free-for-all battles against bots and friends. Victory comes with the last HQ standing!

5375950.name: Put It Away Please
5375950.short_description: It's summer vacation, and you put the groceries away exactly as your mother's notes say. A short puzzle-horror game in a PS1-style kitchen. Don't forget to turn around.[Estimated completion time: 30 minutes]

5127640.name: SuperNatural Market: Sell or Die Demo
5127640.short_description: Run a supernatural supermarket serving zombies and vampires! In this demo, stock your shelves, set your prices, and work the checkout. Receive UFO deliveries, stop goblin thieves with your shoe, and keep your shop running.

884670.name: Codenames
884670.short_description:
Codenames is a clever word game of deduction, teamwork, and strategy, inspired by the popular board game loved worldwide.
Give one-word clues, link multiple words, and read your teammates’ minds to win before the other team does.

5246260.name: Traha
5246260.short_description: Traha Global is RvR MMORPG based on the confrontation between two major factions. You can play multiple roles, create unique builds of your character based on unlimited class transition system. Based on vast open world, you can go on adventures in various regions, get items through raid dungeons.
developers: XIAN SKY ONLINE NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD
publishers: XIAN SKY ONLINE NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO.,LTD

5405940.name: Rosaline: The Dragon Girl
5405940.short_description: Awakening from a deadly clash with a dragon, Rosaline gains terrifying powers. Set off on an epic journey through the kingdom of Artolia, slay fearsome monsters alongside allies, and confront the corrupt shadow threatening her homeland.

3982430.name: Omertà: Mafia Novel
3982430.short_description: Noir visual novel set in 1950s New York. Infiltrate a prison, build a smuggling network, and shape fates through tough choices across branching paths.

3275780.name: Bet Your Friends
3275780.short_description:
Shocking twist on Monopoly, your FRIENDS now become your prized ASSETS!

BUY, WORK, BID or GAMBLE.

First one to REACH $1,000,000 WINS!

Have YOU ever bet with your FRIEND'S LIFE on the line?

5323120.name: STARSHIP: EMBER REACH
5323120.short_description: Build and command a modular starship in a single-player space game. Master four ship classes, deploy carrier drones, fight tactical missions and dock at your space station. Recover materials, upgrade equipment and shape your Commander through a branching talent tree.

3458920.name: A.V.E.N.A
3458920.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

5165850.name: 47都道府県にプロ野球チームが存在する世界線で日本一の球団をめざそう！ Demo

5324960.name: Rise of the Merchants Demo
5324960.short_description: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

5348550.name: Dead by Daylight: Charity Chest
5348550.short_description:
Dead by Daylight’s Charity Chest is a dedicated Collection of 10 in-game Cosmetics items for Claudette Morel, David King, Dwight Fairfield, Jake Park, Nea Karlsson, The Oni, The Huntress, The Plague, The Legion and The Nurse.

All proceeds from the sale go to the Douglas Foundation.

5369760.name: Skull Crusher Demo
5369760.short_description: SKULL CRUSHER is a retro/PSX-style round-based survival FPS. Face endless waves of skeletons, earn money to open new paths and upgrade your arsenal, and stay standing for as long as you can. Become the terror other skeletons fear.

4818660.name: The Manaworks Demo
4818660.short_description: Click, build, upgrade and automate! Click to gain resources, build to increase resource gathering potential, automate to get more and more, faster and faster, both passively and actively. Upgrade buildings, stats, and see the numbers go up!

5097910.name: Project: Autumn Demo
5097910.short_description: Join Oakley and Elmer on their whimsical adventure through a stunning archipelago filled with people to befriend and secrets to uncover. Though simply tasked with finding a strange mythical creature, the two robots are distracted by the beauty of the islands.

4539240.name: 树人：中国班主任
4539240.short_description:
“十年树木，百年树人”
《树人》是一部班主任视角的视觉小说。三年时光，12 名学生，8 条交错的故事线，和一门真实可学的高中数学课——12 小时以上的流程里，你不只是看完这个故事，你还要带着他们走完高考。
有些事会在开学第一周就摆在你面前，有些要到最后一页才明白：他们的人生，从来不是一道有标准答案的题。

4437140.name: if you stay
4437140.short_description: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

4484970.name: Wallpaper Animator
4484970.short_description: Use animated wallpapers on your desktop. Explore unlimited live wallpapers from the community, or create your own with included AI generations that refill daily.

4604900.name: HEAVYDELIC Demo
4604900.short_description: HEAVYDELIC is a 2D Slavic Synthpunk Platformer broadcasting on dead frequencies. Synthetic psychedelia, comic art, VHS tapes, analog ruins & robots resurrected from Slavic mythology. Every asset is manually drawn by Eniac. Signal lost. Game found.

4675070.name: 终末执棋者 Demo
4675070.short_description: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

4921720.name: 47都道府県にプロ野球チームが存在する世界線で日本一の球団をめざそう！
4921720.short_description: A baseball management simulation set in an alternate Japan where all 47 prefectures have pro teams. Choose one of 48 clubs and manage drafts, development, reinforcements, lineups, finances, and the road to the championship.

4081520.name: Queen's Domain Demo
4081520.short_description: A retro-fantasy action RPG with brutal combat and traversal-focused exploration. Embark on a quest to find your father who disappeared on the mysterious Isle of Neasied, where sinister forces gather, secrets hide everywhere, and the sleeping Queen has begun to stir…

4224860.name: Whiskers Tale Demo
4224860.short_description: Play as a curious cat exploring a cozy city. Run errands, solve simple puzzles, make friends, and uncover heartwarming stories in a world full of charm, kindness, and quiet adventure.

4343790.name: Party Club: Hangry Animals Demo
4343790.short_description:
A chaotic party game for up to 4 players online, on the couch, and across platforms.
Jump into ridiculous mini-games, betray your friends equally on every device, and embrace the madness.

3854250.name: Animas Demo
3854250.short_description: Animas Prologue is a standalone chapter in the Animas story, allowing you to explore the Blanco family home for the first time and begin to uncover its dark secrets.

3920230.name: Life Blood Demo
3920230.short_description: You awaken on the Altar inside the Life Cathedral. Life Blood is a first-person, Kingsfield-like action adventure game with a focus on exploration. Travel the interconnected world with fast-paced, reaction-based combat and discover the secrets within the heart of the mountain.

3924540.name: Comix Zero Demo
3924540.short_description: Comix Zero is a unique COMIXVANIA set inside a living comic book. Explore its pages, jump between panels, break their borders, uncover secrets, and fight your way through a dark fantasy world. Turn the page — or die!

3990800.name: Resident Evil Requiem - Grace's Costume: Apocalypse
3990800.short_description:
Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living.
Prepare to escape death in a heart-stopping experience that will chill you to your core.

4988110.name: 学園バドる！
4988110.short_description: Shuttle Hearts - Academy Smash is a fast-paced 2D badminton game where girls from different school clubs battle with unique abilities and special moves. Master six types of shots, unleash SP Shots and SP Skills, and play through Story Mode or face the CPU or a friend in Versus Mode.

3310090.name: Break Shot Hero
3310090.short_description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

3769620.name: Break Shot Hero Demo
3769620.short_description: Collect characters and roll them into billiards-style combat! Recruit conquered foes to build your party, customizing your skills and skins. Balls to the walls action for 1-4 players!

617870.name: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Rise of the Tomb Kings
