617870.short_description: Across the arid deserts of Nehekhara, vast legions of skeletal warriors rise from beneath the baking sands to slaughter those who trespass into their domain.

5036510.name: Kreabordis
5036510.short_description: Kreabordis is a puzzle game where you have to strategically place creatures on a board to score the most points. Defeat challengers, maximize your points in tricky puzzles and find the perfect move.

4029380.name: Pathogenic Demo
4029380.short_description: You are a disease. Infect the human body as a lone pathogen in this cellular roguelike shooter. Collect organelles to evolve your parasite in a microscopic arms race against your host's immune system. Conquer a beautiful, procedurally generated world of tiny proportions.

4451040.name: Corridor 13
4451040.short_description: Psychological anomaly horror set in an abandoned school corridor. Find what has changed and make the right choice. But even the right choice doesn't guarantee escape. The corridor won't let you leave that easily.

251810.name: Leadwerks Game Engine 5
251810.short_description: Learn, Build, and Play with an all-new update that makes game development easier than ever. Dive into our video tutorials and learn everything you need to bring your ideas to life. Create with ease using our intuitive visual editor and Lua script. Publish your projects with a royalty-free license.

209390.name: Dungeonbowl Knockout Edition
209390.short_description: Dungeonbowl ups the danger of the American Football inspired sport by adding exploding chests, teleporters, lava and other traps in dangerous dungeons!

1724080.name: Plastic
1724080.short_description: You're a plastic soldier battling on 5 acres of backyard. Fight on foot, crew tanks, fly helicopters, and command bots in a combined-arms shooter. Capture toy cities, requisition equipment, and establish defenses as you advance toward the enemy base.

4997960.name: FarmWings
4997960.short_description: A vertical idle shmup: your fighter flies, dodges and shoots on its own, and you command its evolution. Beat adaptive AI bosses across 5 biomes and 3 difficulty modes, forge gear up to +10 and trade items on the Steam Community Market. Always in a corner of your screen.

3439460.name: Powerplay Demo
3439460.short_description: Powerplay is an RTS with a focus on resources and industry. Create supply chains, transport, and explore in this thrilling base builder. Grow into a powerful industrial nation, but don't spread too thin! Resources are finite and "the others" can reclaim what is theirs at any time.

4637430.name: Everything Mart
4637430.short_description: Clock in, meet your productivity quota, and survive your shift. Divy up tasks with your coworkers... or at least make sure they are being useful as bait.

5415590.name: Hexshroom
5415590.short_description: Run inside a six-sided tunnel and leap between its faces to the beat. Hexshroom is a psychedelic audio reactive runner where every gap, hazard and glowing spore is placed by the music. 20 song-shaped levels, an Endless mode that never stops, and your own MP3s.

5078680.name: Beetleball - The Beetle Billionaire's Deluxe Golden Scarab Supporter Pack
5078680.short_description: The beetle peasants will fear you, your enemies will grow envious, and the developers will adore you as you become the richest, most extravagantly bejeweled beetle billionaire to ever grace the dung fields with your devilishly dashing presence.

4545530.name: Robovac Flashback
4545530.short_description: In Robovac Flashback, an upcoming indie adventure game, you'll play as a malfunctioning robot vacuum cleaner. Dodge hazards and meet strange characters as you vacuum up a bunch of dirt.

4305730.name: Eye of Syn
4305730.short_description: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

5349870.name: Void Walkers X64 Demo
5349870.short_description: Embark on a classic 2D overhead RPG adventure inspired by the golden era of 16-bit classics. Forge your destiny across five distinct progression paths, master tactical combat, and explore a world where your choices unlock powerful hybrid classes.

5402730.name: Core Awakened
5402730.short_description: Awaken your power in Core Awakened, a 2D fighting game without a traditional health bar. Charge your energy, master CORE I, II and III, and unleash combos and special finishers. Play Arcade, challenge a friend locally or fight other players online through Steam.

4447030.name: Welcome to Harmony
4447030.short_description: Build your timeline, adapt your strategy, and execute your plan to survive the town of Harmony as it slowly slips into something darker in this 3D deckbuilding roguelite.

5002240.name: Gamepan
5002240.short_description: The companion app for every game you play. Build each game its own workspace from 24 drag-and-drop modules: checklists, maps, trackers, timers, notes and more. Pin it as an overlay, share setups on the Steam Workshop, and keep it all on your PC. No accounts. No subscription.

4832770.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath
4832770.short_description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, hold your breath, and take the perfect shot across 40 trials in three biomes. Unlock 8 rifles, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

5163620.name: 安平 An-pêng：離群生存 Demo

5038720.name: Iron Void : Silent Space
5038720.short_description: A lone fighter against the silent void. Weave through bullet-hell barrages across 120 hand-built missions, manage your heat, lock your missiles, and tear down 10 distinct bosses. Earn ships, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

5165390.name: HOOD
5165390.short_description: Local gangs got you laid off your shit job. In the urban jungle of possibilities, your survival instincts kick in to keep a roof over your head, find ways to make bread alone or with your buddies.

4895200.name: Hunters Trial : One Breath Demo
4895200.short_description: Fixed-position, scope-only hunting. One position, one breath, one shot. Read the wild, hold your breath, and take the perfect shot across 40 trials in three biomes. Unlock 8 rifles, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

3765410.name: Blue Book Demo
3765410.short_description: Blue Book is a sci-fi detective quest with point'n'click elements, where there are no hints, there are false clues and only your conclusion. Analyze testimonies, find inconsistencies, follow the logic. Become an FBI agent and unravel a chain of mysterious disappearances in a quiet American town.

2785210.name: HYDROPUNK
2785210.short_description:
HYDROPUNK is an isometric souls-like, where the engineering obsession meets Lovecraftian dread.
Pressure above. Abyss below. Know the rules. Break the right ones.

5038740.name: Iron Void : Silent Space Demo
5038740.short_description: A lone fighter against the silent void. Weave through bullet-hell barrages across 120 hand-built missions, manage your heat, lock your missiles, and tear down 10 distinct bosses. Earn ships, upgrade your hunter, and master every star.

5309380.name: Hidden Front
5309380.short_description: Hidden Front is a military real-time strategy game for up to 6 players. Deploy your army, scout through the fog of war and combine infantry, armor, artillery and air support. Fight other commanders or team up with friends against bots.

5466340.name: ぱちぱちタイピング Demo
5466340.short_description:
A game that combines the excitement of pachinko’s ST mode with typing gameplay.
Score points by typing during bonus rounds in a score attack challenge!
A dictionary feature is planned for future implementation.

5296680.name: House of Pips: a Domino Roguelike
5296680.short_description: A turn-based domino roguelike where you draft rule-bending perks, combine their effects, and shape your playstyle through a skill tree. Read the board, plan your placements, and adapt to each hand to outwit opponents in single-player or online multiplayer.

5063650.name: ClusterForce
5063650.short_description: ClusterForce is a fast arcade 3D flying sports game for up to 8 players online, a unique combination that demands many of your skills at once. Carry energy balls from magnetic ramps to the goal without getting caught by your rivals and their glider weapons!

5051170.name: Warehouse Chaos Simulator Demo
5051170.short_description: Sort thousands of scattered products into boxes and onto the right shelves. This free demo gives you two full warehouses to work through — clean a small one end to end, or take a shift inside the 4,000-product mega warehouse. No timers, no failing.

5372210.name: UnderCarrier
5372210.short_description: A washed-up shock-jock laughs off one last caller, and his fog-choked mill town slides into Hell. Undercarrier is a fast, loud first-person shooter: arena fights at full speed, small-town fog and dread, a roguelite run carried from map to map, and a radio that hears what's coming.

5452820.name: Sorsemic
5452820.short_description: Survive an endless horde in Sorsemic, a dark fantasy horde-survival roguelike. Gather power, discover and combine spell ingredients, and shape a new build with every run. Keep moving as corruption consumes the realm, then climb the global leaderboards.

5078840.name: Grimoire of Hecate : Tower of Starlight
5078840.short_description: Combine cards into powerful spells in this roguelite deckbuilder. Build your strategy around four elements, read enemy intentions in turn-based battles, and grow stronger between runs as Ray climbs the Tower of Starlight to find her missing mother.

5380620.name: Mad Craft
5380620.short_description: An adventure-focused voxel sandbox with building, crafting, and village life. Gather resources, craft gear, and face dungeons and powerful foes with allies. Enjoy fishing, farming, cross-species romance, marriage, and raising a family—or collect items and put them on display.

4247680.name: FirstPlate
4247680.short_description: Run a restaurant under constant pressure. Build and expand your kitchen infinitely to host dozens of tables. Curate your menu and adapt your layout as you grow. Play solo, team up in co-op, or battle for customers in the upcoming competitive Versus mode.

2896770.name: Coralium
2896770.short_description: Coralium is a 2.5D platform adventure where a magical baby coral restores the dying reef. Collect bleached corals, learn powers from sea creatures, and switch between water and air to solve puzzles, uncover secrets, and bring life back to the ocean.

4846630.name: Cyber Neon: Core Protocol
4846630.short_description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

1071360.name: Greyward: Castaway Survival
1071360.short_description: Wash ashore on a misty island, build a camp and survive the Grey: a night mist that burns. Climb endless rune towers, break the Grey camps and free their chiefs, sail to eight far islands, and play solo or in Steam co-op with up to four castaways.

5022080.name: CACTBOY
5022080.short_description: Put on your sheriff hat and load your revolver! CACTBOY is a hilarious and chaotic Western multiplayer party game for up to 4 players. From split-second quick-draw duels to absurd brawls, master a variety of minigames and prove who the true CACTBOY is!

4070560.name: Crimson Furnace
4070560.short_description: Manage a clandestine tavern where gangs, poachers, and Council spies cross paths. In this cozy weird simulator, cook cursed dishes, manipulate your patrons, and build your reputation to expand your cult’s influence.

2961930.name: Temtem: Pioneers
2961930.short_description: Survive an untamed frontier in Temtem: Pioneers! Tame 200+ collectible monsters called Temtem, craft tools, build your base, and battle fearsome bosses. Take direct control of your Temtem in real-time action combat, explore biomes, and discover an open world survival craft adventure, solo or co-op!

4047750.name: The Bus - New York City
4047750.short_description: With the New York City DLC, you experience a slice of the big apple showcasing some of the most vibrant streets in the world from the perspective of a New York bus driver.

3749000.name: M.E.C.H.A. Demo
3749000.short_description: The android girl spends her time in four walls, afraid to leave her apartment, but one day her patience runs out and she decides to go out the door.

5188480.name: Ball and Stick
5188480.short_description: Two bodies, one connection. Roll, swing and launch a Ball and Stick through a physics-driven sci-fi adventure, alone or with friends, and cause chaos with wild attachments

4171850.name: Trees Hate You
4171850.short_description: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

4323390.name: Swept Under
4323390.short_description: Swept Under is a frantic top-down pixel action-survival where you play the Trash Man. Clean every piece of cafeteria garbage before the timer hits zero, earn cash, and buy weapons or tools from vending machines, because sometimes the fastest cleanup is murder.

4427080.name: Dubai Chewy Cookie Simulator
4427080.short_description: Make, pack, and ring up Dubai chewy cookies! Run a small shop all on your own in a Korean university neighborhood in this first-person management sim. Face growing crowds and comic mishaps as you discover how much more hectic a shopkeeper's day gets when business starts booming.

3194520.name: Hallelujah!
3194520.short_description: Cause an outrageous amount of bloodshed, raze countless buildings, and abuse the God-given blessings bestowed upon Samson in this raw action roguelike retelling of the Bible’s most savage warrior.

5337420.name: Hardpack Rally
5337420.short_description: Vern, a retired rally driver, leaves you an old two-door and a note on the hood. Slide through woodland bends, mountain passes, snowy hills and open desert. Beat Vern’s stage times and earn the next set of keys as you progress through a single-player arcade rally career.

2182480.name: Enmity: Warfare
2182480.short_description: Enmity: Warfare I is a modern-era multiplayer real-time strategy game where players command armies, manage logistics, and control provinces across a large-scale battlefield to shape the outcome of war.

3621390.name: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics
3621390.short_description: Tom Clancy’s Rainbow Six Tactics is a turn-based tactical game set in the R6 universe. Command operator squads in tense battles, execute synchronized breaches, exploit destruction, and unravel a conspiracy.

3296060.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School
3296060.short_description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Play in solo or co-op and explore an all-new campus, escape life-threatening puzzle rooms, and unravel a conspiracy as old as the school itself — all before the bell rings.

3939120.name: Sumalia
3939120.short_description: Foreign trawlers are emptying your sea and dumping their waste on your shore. Nobody is coming to help. Grab three friends, a skiff and whatever fuel you can scrape together, and go reclaim what once was yours, and then some. 4-player co-op piracy with proximity voice.

5073330.name: FAIL GAMES Demo
5073330.short_description: Fail Games is a collection of extremely hard but simple minigames. Win each game to unlock the next. Earn coins when you fail to buy effects and outfits. So easy to learn your grandma could play it, but so hard to master you'll throw your PC out the window. And your grandma.

5410290.name: Desktop Party: An Idle Fantasy RPG
5410290.short_description: A tiny party lives on your desktop in this idle RPG. Your heroes fight monsters and find treasure while you work or browse. Choose their gear and watch them grow into new forms. Take a break to pet them or play with toys. Sometimes it rains frogs.

4646400.name: Tiny Ramen Shop Demo
4646400.short_description: 🍜 Run your own cozy Japanese ramen shop in this charming cooking simulator! 🐱 Prepare delicious ramen, serve hungry customers, and grow your restaurant with an adorable cat assistant. 🏮 But when night falls, mysterious yokai and spirits from Japanese folklore come looking for a warm meal! 👻

5346880.name: Restora: A Poster Restoration Game
5346880.short_description: Step into your workshop and give vintage movie posters a second chance. In this calming restoration sim, restore as many posters as you can before the day ends. Inspect each poster, repair damage through mini games, and bring it back to glory. How many posters can you save in time?

4634310.name: Tuanbot Demo
4634310.short_description: Create desktop companions, discover little stories in Tuan House, and enjoy playful moments with Feihuahua. Link supported Agent tools to view quotas and manage accounts. This free TuanBot demo supports up to 3 companions and does not include AI chat.

5244250.name: Northern Saga Demo
5244250.short_description:
Northern Saga is an old-school real-time strategy RPG inspired by classics like Ogre Battle.

Command your clan across real-time battlefields, construct specialized combat formations, and master combat where every positioning choice matters.

2982680.name: Light Out of Sight
2982680.short_description: Turn The Power Back On Inside a Haunted Mansion, while Fighting Off Paranormal Monsters.

4828150.name: KON-PON SHMUP -Shapeshifter Showdown- Demo
4828150.short_description:
An Item-Building 2D Bullet Hell Shooter Has Arrived!
The unique “ENEMY ATTACK SELECT” system can turn the tide of battle in an instant.
To overcome the disadvantages you face, you’ll need to make smart choices and build the best loadout possible from limited resources.

4255910.name: Curses Cleared
4255910.short_description: Cursed villagers knock on your candlelit cabin, and the only way to lift a curse is to beat it. Win fast, combo-chaining Puzzle-Fighter match-battles, build your block set, and break the curse before it breaks you.

5264030.name: Project RedTeam: Contract Offensive Demo
5264030.short_description: A fast paced hacking roguelite built on real cybersecurity tradecraft. Recon targets, steal creds, move laterally, exfiltrate data, and ransom organizations to pay off your "Debts To Be Paid". Over 500 cards and items to discover. High risk, high reward. Unauthorized access hell.

5473160.name: Facial Expression Variety Show
5473160.short_description: Make a face. Steal the show! Mimic wild expressions on camera in Facial Expression Variety Show. Practice across 10 solo rounds or compete online with up to 6 players. Take turns in the spotlight, compare scores, and celebrate on the podium. Your face is the main event!

5409270.name: TCG: Collector’s Mess Demo
5409270.short_description: Try the first rooms of TCG: Collector’s Mess, a cozy first-person collecting game in a house buried under trading cards. Clean up the bedroom, hall, bathroom and laundry, open packs card by card and fill your binders. Your progress carries over to the full game.

4777340.name: Abyss Outpost: Auto Frontline
4777340.short_description: A roguelite auto-battler. As an explorer, venture into the perilous abyss to collect bio-data and print unit cards. Equip gear and tactical modules, build your frontline, auto-summon massive armies, survive brutal boss assaults, crush fortified enemy lines, and forge an immortal legend!

5292590.name: PW7A
5292590.short_description: You awaken from a long sleep as a robot. All you know is that this game is called PW7A. Turn your insights into the power to open new paths in this compact 2D pixel-art puzzle adventure.
developers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ
publishers: スイカ食べ食べうさぎ

2306130.name: THE SPINNER
2306130.short_description: Spin. Strike. Break. THE SPINNER is a fast-paced 1v1 action game built around rotating paddles and warp zones. Create unexpected angles, outplay your opponent with spin-powered shots, and break through their defenses to strike the Core.

4777960.name: Cats and Hats
4777960.short_description: Stack Hats on adorable Cats! A cozy roguelike memory deckbuilder where you match tiles, build multis, and stack Hats on a variety of oddly compliant Cats.

4908120.name: Outbreak Z
4908120.short_description: A post-apocalyptic party-based auto battler RPG. Recruit three survivors with nothing in common, loot a dead city for their gear, level each one down their own tree, and send them into the horde. They fight every wave on their own. Whether they come home is on you.

5300730.name: Scar of Evil Demo
5300730.short_description: The power cut off, the house need to be repowered, could you survive whiles multiples threats tries to come inside you're home while keeping the circuit breaker from breaking

3366110.name: Sil and the Fading World Demo
3366110.short_description: Solo Challenging Raid Bosses, Your Way! Craft your perfect build to master intense multi-phase raidboss encounters in this exciting ARPG. Deep customization with 9 specializations, 100s of items, skills and more. No Group, No Queue, All Boss Raids!

5444960.name: 妖怪温泉旅馆
5444960.short_description: Run a small Japanese hot spring inn in the mountains. Arrange rooms, baths, staff and meals, then welcome familiar travelers and nighttime yokai. Listen to their stories, keep memories of the changing seasons and grow humble Yama-no-Yu into a village of your own.

5347940.name: PALJA Survivors
5347940.short_description: A survival roguelike where your birth date determines your Saju character. Dodge swarming foes, choose upgrades and items, and face five years of yearly battles and Guardians shaped by your fortune. Even with the same Saju, your choices lead to a different journey.

2079820.name: Ctrl Alt Destroy
2079820.short_description: Ctrl Alt Destroy is a chaotic multiplayer party brawler where Y2K-era computers battle for power, beat each other with keyboards, and fight to be the last machine left plugged in.

2582880.name: Northrealm Tribes
2582880.short_description: Build a Viking village, manage resources and guide families through generations. Develop production chains, trade with visiting merchants and defend your settlement against longship raids. Join an online guild to strengthen a shared clan base and wage asynchronous guild wars.

4470890.name: Expedition Idle
4470890.short_description: An idle auto-battler ARPG where you create one-of-a-kind items with crafting materials you pick up from the ground, customize your adventurers with different abilities and stats, and strategize your way through difficult bosses, unique scenarios, and dynamic monsters!

5412430.name: ORUNKA
5412430.short_description: An online RPG on the island of Moruah. Catch dinos and raise them as pets. Your pet attacks whatever you attack, and Auto Battle keeps the hunt going. Pets raised from Lv 1 grow strongest, and an appraisal reveals their Bloodline. Party up with other hunters on one island. In English and Korean.

5371870.name: Afterpub
5371870.short_description: Grandpas in wheelchairs, a pub full of games and a mountain to race over. Bet on the chaos, throw everything you grab, and play with friends online in Mountain Run, 1v1 Duels and many party games.

5386480.name: Apoc Wilds Soundtrack
5386480.short_description: The original soundtrack to Apoc Wilds: 16 tracks and over 70 minutes of dark-folk drones, doom-tinged battle music and neon cyberpunk electronica, from the barrows of the Barrowlands to the Threshold Sprawl, opened by the theme song Lift the Veil.

5296660.name: Local Realm
5296660.short_description: Local Realm is an offline-first worldbuilding tool for writers, game developers, and TTRPG creators. Build interconnected characters, locations, factions, timelines, maps, and lore in a flexible local database with no accounts, subscriptions, or cloud dependency required.

5443280.name: The Arcane Archive
5443280.short_description: Step into the mystical halls of The Arcane Archive! In this cozy and atmospheric 3D puzzle game, your task is to sort and organize over 100 glowing magical potions on ancient shelves. Bring order to the chaos and unwind in the ultimate relaxing wizard's library.

4272080.name: Retired
4272080.short_description: RETRO HYPER TIRE RACING! Cruise down hills through 5 different developer created worlds competing for the best track time, or race through a nearly infinite supply of User created levels through the steam workshop!

3852650.name: The Podcaster
3852650.short_description: 🎙️ The Podcaster is a simulator where you manage your schedule, interview guests, and expand and customize your studio. Use topic cards to spark conversations and guide unique interviews. Grow your channel and rise to the top of the podcasting world!

5430730.name: popwork 职场爆爆乐 Demo
5430730.short_description: PopWork is a lightweight roguelite about popping bubbles on an endlessly regenerating bubble wrap. A tribute to the classic Ten Drops: chain-detonate with cross-shockwaves, earn coins, buy items, grab snacks, learn tips, adapt to random events and stage effects, and spend every bubble wisely.

2223980.name: Nomad Drive
2223980.short_description: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

5170280.name: Celebria
5170280.short_description: From movie star to music icon, you run the show in Celebria. Guide your entertainer through landing roles, releasing music, touring the world, climbing global charts, chasing prestigious awards, and running a celebrity brand, all while navigating the pressures of fame.

4192320.name: Gun Goose
4192320.short_description: The most realistic goose simulator ever made... Gun Goose is a fast-paced shooter where you play as a goose with guns. HONK AND LOAD!

5348230.name: The Liar King
5348230.short_description: A roguelite of dice and bluffs. Call how many dice are on the table, shout LIAR! and lift the cups. Every reveal you win pays out: Chips × Mult, amulets that chain together and numbers that go through the roof. Eight kingdoms, eight cheating kings, one crown for whoever lies best.

4103580.name: Mystery of the Mysterious Futayuri Mystery Dungeon
4103580.short_description: Adventurers, let's get exploring! Plunge into the mysterious dungeon and discover all sorts of wild mysteries...

5031370.name: Arborrosa Insidia
5031370.short_description: A retro-inspired horror game where you, as a scientist, will explore the local flora, desperately trying to find a semi-mythical plant that promises a better life. In these hazy landscapes your loneliness is only an illusion.

5384360.name: Buzzwire
5384360.short_description: Host your own buzz-in quiz show. Run it from your PC, put the board on your stream or Discord, and friends buzz in from their phones with a 4-letter room code. Viewers can play along too, and Twitch chat can pick categories and steal clues.

5439380.name: Crate Escape: Program & Deliver
5439380.short_description: Program your warehouse robot in secret, lock in, and watch every robot run its program at once. Shoves, conveyor belts and lasers will test the best plan. Race, deliver parcels, knock rivals out or capture flags, against the AI, on one screen or online. Same rules as the Crate Escape board game.

5323660.name: Good Children Say Grace - Supporter Pack
5323660.short_description: Supporter pack for Good Children Say Grace. Eggs? Hats!

5348800.name: Pig & Pup
5348800.short_description: Play as a pup with your friends in this online multiplayer party game. Carry toys home, guard your chests or steal from the other team. Bark to lure Pudding into their loot, but watch out: the pig can knock yours loose too.

5083550.name: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines） Lite
5083550.short_description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

5417070.name: PAYDIRT: Gold Mining Tycoon Demo
5417070.short_description: Build your first mining camp in this free First Crew demo. Start with hand tools and no cash, pan and sell your first gold, improve your tools and hire a helper. Choose a man or woman prospector, bring Pepper and keep exploring after the first-crew milestone.

5328830.name: Arborrosa Insidia Demo
5328830.short_description: Intro of game, that will give you to dive into atmosphere and get acquainted with the plot. Enjoy ;)

5461940.name: Black Kings Defense
5461940.short_description: Build a maze out of chess pieces and defend your king in this Tower Defense take on the timeless classic, Chess! Pawns, rooks, bishops, knights and queens strike by their own moves as the white army marches across a 3D board, through a full hand balanced campaign.

3721530.name: Motorcycle For Sale Simulator
3721530.short_description: Buy, fix, customize, and sell motorcycles. Start with old bikes, restore every part, test ride, and grow your own dealership. Take risks, make smart deals, and become the best in town!

3815370.name: TALAKA
3815370.short_description: Slash, shoot, and restore myths and beasts in fluid, fast roguelite combat through a stunning hand-drawn watercolor world, where legends and even Orishas are going rogue in fear of being forgotten.

3479370.name: Deck & Defense
3479370.short_description: Tower Defense, deckbuilder and roguelite where strategy meets action. Summon allies, cast devastating spells, and upgrade your tower! Create powerful card combinations to stop waves of enemies in this unique fantasy defence game.

5009670.name: 限界ライバー しめきり1週前
5009670.short_description:
“Never do today what you can put off till tomorrow!”
VTubers who live by that creed have their backs against the wall, and today they plunge into scheduling hell once again.
Allocate your resources wisely and survive the one week until the deadline. A last-minute, task-crunching roguelite!

4797970.name: Qteam 模拟器
4797970.short_description: Build and manage your own digital game platform. Acquire game licenses, develop original titles, hire employees, analyze market trends, manage your community, and compete with rival platforms as you grow from a small startup into an industry leader.

1165800.name: Shadow of Aya
1165800.short_description: Master the elements of poison, fire, ice, and meteorite in Shadow of Aya, a top-down action-adventure ode to the 8-bit classics. But beware—as your powers grow, so do the forces against you. The journey downward is choked with shadow, and the creatures who lurk among them.

3358740.name: SAMI
3358740.short_description: Sami is an atmospheric adventure about mental health and inner growth. Journey with Sunu through a sensory Andean world, guided by the presence of players who walked before you. Every soul you heal speaks with the words of a real person. You are never truly alone.

4985900.name: Voltwood
4985900.short_description: Voltwood is a competitive mazing tower defense with procedurally generated maps. You can't beat waves — hit par or pay. The better you do the higher your score. Compete on daily and weekly maps and a roguelike weekly gauntlet, check the boards to see who built the best maze or chill in casual mode.

5281050.name: Just A DVD Incremental
5281050.short_description: Remember waiting for the DVD logo to hit the exact corner of the TV screen? Now you don't have to wait. Upgrade speed, efficiency, and special effects to maximize your bounces in this relaxing incremental idle game. Will it hit the corner?

3765640.name: Car For Sale Together
3765640.short_description: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.

3728180.name: Dancing Wings - The Aerobatic Simulator
3728180.short_description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

5100870.name: The Sower of Kingdom
5100870.short_description: Ravaged by war, the kingdom's population is on the brink of collapse. Embodying the "Chosen Stallion," you wander between the countryside and the royal court, sowing seeds with women to preserve the bloodline. Fill the desolation with new life and rebuild the empire to its former glory!

5317210.name: Agile Team Demo
5317210.short_description: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner.  Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

3746290.name: Werewolf: The Apocalypse – Rageborn
3746290.short_description: Set in the World of Darkness, Rageborn sees Taylor rise as a pack leader to become Gaia’s fiercest warrior. Master three forms of the Garou, explore the wilds of Alaska, and confront the Wyrm in this visceral action-adventure metroidvania.

824690.name: Oroborus: Planes Of The Dead
824690.short_description: Planes Of The Dead is a different take on the ARPG genre.

3387300.name: Lost Ruins of Arnak
3387300.short_description: Uncover mysteries on an epic journey to the heart of the uncharted island of Arnak in this captivating blend of deck-building and worker placement. Become the leader of an expedition and dive deep into uncharted territory. But you’re not alone—and fame and glory await only the most successful team.

4779980.name: Stepwell
4779980.short_description: Stepwell is a puzzle game about building impossible paths. Arrange and overlap tiles to create surprising connections, discover new ways to use each piece, and guide little inhabitants as you rebuild their shattered world.

5371170.name: My Gaming Shop
5371170.short_description: Start from scratch and build the gaming shop of your dreams! Assemble your own PCs, stock the shelves, welcome your customers and expand your store to become the best in town.

5280720.name: Stepwell Demo
5280720.short_description: Stepwell is a microscopic dimension where you build optical illusions that defy the laws of physics. Snap together impossible geometry to create twisting, mind-bending paths for your Quarks. Relax in a vibrant, zen-like puzzle, and watch your creations come alive as a hypnotic, bustling colony.

5188940.name: Century of Conquest
5188940.short_description: Hex-grid tactics × elemental spell cards × hero expeditions. Command 59 unit types across four races in initiative-driven battles, weave 75 elemental spells mid-combat, besiege castles, and lead your hero through a three-layer campaign map to face the abyssal overlord.

4652090.name: ホワイトノウェイ（Stay on the white lines）
4652090.short_description: One day after school, a boy walks home along a white line. His curfew is 5:00 p.m. The white line is filled with treasures that spark his imagination, turning the walk home into an adventure. Become that boy and journey through Hakusen, the childhood sanctuary where imagination comes to life.

5288780.name: Schooligans
5288780.short_description: A chaotic school party game for 1 to 8 players. Pull off the dumbest stunts, film everything on your phone, outsmart teachers who can hear your voice, sneak out at night and betray your friends to become the most popular kid at Coolischool. A stunt nobody filmed never happened.

5352440.name: RETURN TO 1990
5352440.short_description: Reborn in 1990 Seoul with memories of 2027. Rewrite twenty years through stocks, real estate and startups in this business-sim visual novel.

5274650.name: Rock and Found Demo
5274650.short_description: Your Grandma has willed you a collection of rocks deep in the woods, but when you arrive, you find that the rocks are strewn across the floor. Armed with your Grandma's journal, a determination to clean the collection, and the tools she left behind, you begin sorting through hundreds of rocks.

5169250.name: Last Buzz Demo
5169250.short_description: Last Buzz is a 2–6 player Humans vs. Flies multiplayer game. Steal food, crawl on ceilings, hide in stupid places, and rescue your friends as a fly—or grab the bug spray, lock down the house, and hunt the little bastards before they take over.

5210340.name: ATOM RPG - Plague Island
5210340.short_description: Plague Island is a story-driven DLC that expands the world of ATOM RPG with a new region, complete with its own characters, quests, and locations, as well as your very own suit of Special Armor.

5266270.name: I Only Moved My Mouse Demo
5266270.short_description: Forty weapons, one mouse. Whirl a flail, throw a chakram, slam a warhammer: each run deals you three, and every one cuts its own way. Socket two more, raise them to FORGED, and hold the crystal through thirteen themes.

4748140.name: MatchMaker95 - A Programming Simulator
4748140.short_description: The programming simulator. MatchMaker95 is a cozy(ish) coding tycoon where you write real C++, grow a chaotic dating app startup, unlock game-changing upgrades, and turn lines of code into profit — all inside a lo-fi Win98 desktop.

4756630.name: Origins Trading Card Game Demo
4756630.short_description: Outplay rivals in a fast PvP card game where both players move at once. Adapt your strategy and battle for three of 100+ rotating locations. Build decks with reimagined legends like Robin Hood and Mulan. Every competitive card is free. Rip packs for rare, limited-edition variants to trade on Steam.

4940750.name: Vealo - Clean Desktop
4940750.short_description: Your new desktop in one click. Apply ready-made setups from the Workshop or build your own: wallpapers, widgets, effects, cursors and lighting in one app. Every detail can be changed to suit you. Start for free, save your favourite looks and share your own.

5130460.name: Guns of Eschaton Demo
5130460.short_description: A one-of-a-kind soulslike FPS set in an apocalyptic Western. Study who hunts you, count every bullet, fight through death again and again in a standalone adventure crafted just for the demo and offering a concentrated taste of the full game.

4307610.name: Vale's Echo Demo
4307610.short_description: Death isn’t the end - it’s your last chance. Solve haunting puzzles and make choices that matter as you guide Vale across the underworld. Will regret follow her into eternity?

4319270.name: Ambroise Niflette & the Gleaned Bell Demo
4319270.short_description: In this stop-motion inspired adventure, play as detective Ambroise Niflette in the thrilling investigation of the search for the stolen bell in a mysterious village.

4423560.name: Human.exe Demo
4423560.short_description: An AI has isolated the mind of a philosophy professor to evaluate human morality. As the terminal operator, you access files, run programs, and take his consciousness through ethical dilemmas.

4461500.name: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator Demo
4461500.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

4481020.name: Bushcraft Survival Demo
4481020.short_description: Alone. Hungry. Freezing. Test your grit in this unforgiving, Bushcraft Survival simulator set deep in the icy forests of Northern Canada. Collect resources, build shelters, fish, track, and trap in a brutal open world where every decision counts - and any mistake could be your last.

4694840.name: Outpour Demo
4694840.short_description: Outpour is a puzzle game where you redirect flowing water across dreamy cathedral rooftops. Manipulate your surroundings to guide a dynamic water system, traverse high places, and restore harmony to sacred structures.

3954540.name: Yinglet Creator
3954540.short_description: A character creator that lets you design your very own collection of yinglets.

3955770.name: Undertale + Deltarune Song Pack
3955770.short_description: This DLC song pack brings 21 songs from the UNDERTALE and DELTARUNE Soundtracks to Trombone Champ!

3818050.name: Project SEVER Demo
3818050.short_description: Project Sever is an adventure submarine simulator with a touch of horror. Master the controls of an old Project "Sever" submarine and learn to maintain it in working order to escape a deadly underwater trap and solve the mystery of the Anomalous Zone.

3192760.name: vHand
3192760.short_description: vHand is an app that realistically simulates your hand drawing motion, as well as, provides dynamic sketching sounds for ASMR lovers. vHand allows you to customize multiple hand presets which include pen, effects and colors. Use with your favorite streaming/capturing tool.

2941730.name: Bloodthief Demo
2941730.short_description: Bloodthief is an ultra-fast melee dungeon-runner where you use momentum to parkour through hazardous dungeons and brutally slash through enemies. Speed-run through medieval dungeons and castles and learn what dark secrets lie beneath the surface.

3049220.name: Still Wakes the Deep Soundtrack
3049220.short_description: World-class, haunting soundtrack by Jason Graves

2594010.name: Tropico 6 - Going Viral
2594010.short_description:
The dictato… err, doctor is in! Keep calm, citizens, The Mobile Doctor Squad is on the case. Carry on and vote for El Prez, or else?!
In Tropico 6's Going Viral DLC, the health and prosperity of your nation hang in the balance as contagious diseases sweep through your island paradise.

5123930.name: TCG Town
5123930.short_description: Make a living collecting cards or doing jobs in TCG Town. Create your character, play solo or join friends, and take your collection with you. Trade for that missing card, give a friend their favorite, or keep every last one for yourself.

1798090.name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE - "DLC 15" hairstyle
1798090.short_description: For those who seek a hairstyle with volume and style in abundance, look no further.

1798091.name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE - "DLC 16" hairstyle
1798091.short_description: A clean fade for a clean look and hopefully a clean hunt!

1798092.name: MONSTER HUNTER RISE - "DLC 17" hairstyle
1798092.short_description: If you want your hunter to have the tighest plaits around, this is the hairstyle for you!

1592730.name: Succubus - Unrated
1592730.short_description: A free add-on that adds Adult Only content to the game.

1222190.name: Fight Angel SE Realistic Pack
1222190.short_description: This DLC provides the original version of realistic style character customization options. Players can choose realistic style character appearances, suitable for 10 built-in characters and custom characters. You can switch between the two styles at any time.

5427130.name: Upwardly
5427130.short_description: Upwardly is a colorful 3D precision platformer built for climbers and speedrunners! Master challenging jumps, conquer 10 castles across a 5,000-meter climb, and race against your best times. Explore randomized courses or challenge friends to beat your time on identical seeded runs.

545110.name: Driver Booster 4 for Steam
545110.short_description: Driver Booster 4 for STEAM, as a powerful & easy-to-use driver updater, provides 1-click solution to rapidly & securely update 400,000+ drivers including the outdated, missing and faulty ones. Moreover, game components and game-related drivers are supported for enhanced gaming experience.

4777190.name: Long Way Gnome Demo
4777190.short_description: Grab up to 3 friends for a chaotic co-op kart road trip home! Drift through hordes of monsters, scavenge powerful items, and tow fallen friends back to safety. Can you survive the journey together?

4281650.name: Long Way Gnome
4281650.short_description: Grab up to 3 friends for a chaotic co-op kart road trip home! Drift through hordes of monsters, scavenge powerful items, and tow fallen friends back to safety. Can you survive the journey together?

4657020.name: Turnflower
4657020.short_description:
Turnflower is a survivors-like where a small Flower becomes the last line of defense against swarms of insects!
With just ONE button, spin and shoot through this intense and adorably chaotic challenge.

3976640.name: Legends of Aria Eternal Dedicated Server

5453830.name: Conspiracy at Headquarters
5453830.short_description: Investigate a conspiracy inside a corporate headquarters. Explore in first or third person, solve access-card puzzles, and fight hostile robots in this single-player action adventure. Try the free three-floor factory demo, including Lucy’s side story and a vault boss.

5395620.name: Fate & Pivot
5395620.short_description: Fate & Pivot is a fast-paced arcade puzzle game where risk brings reward. Survive as blocks appear naturally, or spawn more to double your score multiplier. Master color combinations, face unpredictable Fates, and push your luck. How far will you go?

4922180.name: Payday Poker
4922180.short_description: Play a fresh spin on traditional Poker centered around receiving a payout to bet with at the beginning of the round instead of betting real money! Play as one of several outlaws all wagering their own cut of the spoils as you duke it out to take the entire stack home. Are you ready? NOW DRAW!

4459220.name: Agile Team
4459220.short_description: Agile Team is a humorous narrative business management game where you step into the role of a Product Owner.  Focus on the human side of software delivery: conflicting priorities, executive misunderstandings, office politics, sprint compromises, and the absurdity of modern software development.

1642400.name: Burrowburrow
1642400.short_description: Build a town in a magical but dangerous wilderness as you recruit different animal dudes and grow your community from a few weirdos around a campfire to a whole village!

5380730.name: Pocket Sports
5380730.short_description: Grab a friend and split one handheld down the middle. Air hockey, bowling, sumo and Turf Wars for two: each player holds one side, or play online with a Steam friend.

4736370.name: UnderWorldMMORPG
4736370.short_description: UNDERWORLD MMORPG is an open-world MMORPG focused on immersion and freedom. Talk to NPCs via microphone, become a dragon in the Dragon World, and level up professions in mini-games. Craft items in an evolving forge where skill defines quality. A living world where your choices shape your journey.

3148980.name: SpaceSlog Demo
3148980.short_description: In this demo version of SpaceSlog, you must build a functioning spaceship ready to explore the cosmos while ensuring the needs of your crew are met. The survival of your crew heavily depends on how well your ship is designed and managed.

5322360.name: Between Empires
5322360.short_description: Lead a nation from 1700 to 1936 in a historical grand strategy game of politics, economics, diplomacy, and war. Appoint ministers, reform institutions, and face consequences that can return generations later.

5062730.name: Card Harts Reborn
5062730.short_description: A F2P 3D strategy card game. Invoke Combatants, cast Sorceries, and wager Hearts on an altar inside of an Ancient Egyptian tomb, in a game far older than this age.

5345780.name: BlockBabe
5345780.short_description: A flirty match-3 puzzle game with 10 distinct characters and 99 levels. Pop bubbles, break heart locks and ice, and master new chapter mechanics as expressions and vocal reactions heat up with your combos. Match gems. Catch feelings.

5322700.name: Eclipse Conquest
5322700.short_description: Eclipse Conquest is a 3D fantasy trading card game. Build your deck, open boosters and face other players in tactical turn-based duels, or sharpen your strategy against the AI on richly detailed battlefields.

5469840.name: Kinetile
5469840.short_description: Build a route for one rolling ball, then let physics test your plan. Arrange jumps, teleports and sliding platforms in this 3D puzzle. Solve 56 handcrafted levels, then keep going with endless generated puzzles in Infinity mode.

3589190.name: COCOBOY
3589190.short_description: Rediscover the lost ‘80s platformer COCOBOY in an alternate 2005! Hack a forgotten game with bizarre mods, decorate your bedroom with rare collectibles, and scour the forums of a budding fandom for clues to deeply puzzling secrets. Demo Disc is available now!

5047880.name: 勇桜　～Escape from the Empire～
5047880.short_description:
A sleek, fast-paced vertical bullet-hell shooter.

Harness a vast arsenal of gear and shatter the tactics of the relentless enemies closing in.

4950960.name: ASTRIDER Demo
4950960.short_description: Arcade air combat set in an alt-history Cold War gone hot in 1967, in a world where the strangest conspiracy theories turned out real. Fly three twelve-mission campaigns, one per faction, against targets on land, at sea, and in the air, with fully-voiced visual-novel scenes between sorties.

5197670.name: Babel Destiny
5197670.short_description: A hardcore isometric soulslike in the Tower of Babel. Every enemy announces its blow in a dead language. Red, you roll. Learn its letters and the same blow comes in white: now you parry it. Speak the Tower's words, climb its strata, and ring the Knell.

5222330.name: Liminal Depths Demo
5222330.short_description: A pixel liminal horror game about surviving an endless maze, recovering who you are, and escaping before the Depths take you. Explore procedural halls, complete jobs from the safehouse computer, upgrade your gear, and face monsters that hunt by sound, sight, and movement, solo or local split-screen.

4522670.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
4522670.short_description: Dominate the lanes in the most realistic bowling game ever! Enhanced true-to-life ball and pin physics make every shot feel real. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode, then dominate Online Leagues, Ranked Play, and Online Tournaments to defend your title. This is where champions are made.

4333140.name: BloodSpiller Demo
4333140.short_description:
BloodSpiller is a retro-action platformer that blends classic visuals and game play with modern flair and attitude, 
Destroy Dracula and his minions using overwhelming fire power.
Paint the town red and you blast through dozens of monsters, bosses, to eventually fight the big man himself.

4736720.name: RBM Studio's Baetis Campaign
4736720.short_description: A historical hexagonal turn-based strategy wargame using markers to represent units designed by John Fournie and originally published in C3i magazine.  Throwback to the great hex-based wargames of the 70's and 80's.  Solo and online multiplayer modes are supported.

5305480.name: Clocking Out
5305480.short_description: It's 6 PM. You're going home! Dodge everyone trying to hold you up in this arcade commute. Pick from eight office workers, reach home across ten chapters with a checkpoint every 300 steps, collect animal hoods with iced coffees, or chase a new endless-mode record.

4802900.name: LIMINAL Demo
4802900.short_description: Explore an endless seeded world without maps or waypoints as you scavenge strange orbs, arm yourself at a hidden shop, and cross thresholds into 47 impossible realms of surreal architecture, destructible environments, and hostile creatures.

4593020.name: Edge3
4593020.short_description: Edge3 is a pixel art editor featuring powerful palette management and animation tools.

4336520.name: AntiMatcher
4336520.short_description: Merge, pop, burst and... annihilate?! Play with bubbles and antibubbles to discover their strange properties in this abstract puzzle game.

5218480.name: Kleopatra Zero Demo
5218480.short_description: Free demo: the first two chapters, both bosses included. A fast-paced mech wave-shooter where every enemy attack is drawn on the floor before it lands, and the cards you pick between waves turn one hit into a cascade that clears the screen. A standalone prequel to Kleopatra.

5122300.name: Shatterflap
5122300.short_description: Fire bouncing balls into towering ceilings of ice, carve open new ricochet paths, and rescue hidden penguins including rare Gold Penguins. Earn Coins, load up on specialized ammo, and conquer 300+ increasingly tricky procedural levels in this physics incremental game.

4141760.name: NERO
4141760.short_description: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

5409130.name: Evil Cabin Demo
5409130.short_description: Tocantins, Brazil, 1978. A storm chaser's car dies by an abandoned gas station in the middle of nowhere. The night is long, the woods are dense, and the radio keeps talking to him. First-person psychological horror.

5410880.name: Void Frontier
5410880.short_description: Void Frontier is a space MMO featuring tactical combat, mining, trading, and exploration. Customize your ship, train your skills, and discover wormholes. Face pirates and rival pilots, or venture into space alongside your clan.

1899960.name: ArcanoPlay
1899960.short_description: ArcanoPlay is a curated arcade portal: jump between family-friendly HTML5 games from independent creators, track your stats and achievements, and browse the whole library with a gamepad from the couch or on Steam Deck.

2780570.name: Safo and The Moon Warriors
2780570.short_description: In a world where the sun no longer rises, Prince Safo must rescue his sister from Argus, a mysterious one-eyed monster. Joined by diverse companions, this adventure RPG features beautiful illustrations and a novel-like story as players uncover secrets in this sunless world.

1574290.name: Steel Bounty
1574290.short_description: Dive into an immersive first-person mech simulation featuring extensive customization and mercenary company management. Battle for glory and wealth in a dynamic campaign where your choices shape the course of the war.

4349540.name: Pillars of Pantheon
4349540.short_description: Pillars of Pantheon is a bullet-heaven “tower offense” roguelite. Build the ultimate Roman siege tower block by block and drive it through waves of mythological creatures while gaining divine abilities from the gods.

5406760.name: Office Party Tech Demo
5406760.short_description: Get a first look at Office Party’s technology, gameplay, and graphics in this early Tech Demo of a story-rich 3D comedy adventure. Meet characters, explore, and try optional AI interactions in a limited preview of a game still in development.

5143840.name: Meteor Spin
5143840.short_description: Meteor Spin is a cosmic roguelike deckbuilder where slot mechanics meet planetary defense. Spin the defense slots, trigger explosive module synergies, and protect your planet from incoming meteor storms!

5245950.name: Main Bastion
5245950.short_description: Take command of the final frontier as hordes of beasts march toward your stronghold. Build a powerful defense, set cunning traps, station brave defenders, and use sentry towers to protect your kingdom. Each tower has unique abilities, and choosing the right combination is key to survival.

4294030.name: Tavernia
4294030.short_description: A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

5331190.name: TheDuckening
5331190.short_description: Grab a loaf of bread and fight back! The Duckening is a chaotic bullet-heaven where a duck battles endless waves of monsters, unlocks a growing arsenal of weapons, and faces down unique bosses every 20 waves.

3878210.name: CastleOn Demo
3878210.short_description: Build a castle! Grow economy, recruit troops from Europe and the Holy Land, man the walls and towers! Place traps and defeat attackers with arrows, wood and stone, fire, disease and cold steel! Survive the Third Crusade and conquer enemy lands in this turn-based strategy!

5462530.name: Nebulon Colony
5462530.short_description: Nebulon Colony is a 3D colony sim. You take command of the first crew of astronauts, tasked with building the first colony on a distant planet. Dig, craft, build, trade, automate, level up, grow plants, herd animals, drive rovers and more.

4890380.name: Little Jimmy´s Nightmare
4890380.short_description: Little Jimmy's Nightmare is an action roguelite where cute hand-drawn 16-bit charm meets brutal combat, flying guts and powerful item synergies. Explore handcrafted worlds, build outrageous combinations and carve your way through cultists, monsters and bizarre bosses.

2718320.name: Green Again
2718320.short_description: Make the planet Green Again in this relaxing colony sim game! Help a nation of little plant people reclaim their planet taken over by defective robots, as you build, decorate, and defend your settlement. Grow crops for your citizens, explore the unknown, and protect the new natural order!

4938950.name: Fathom Reach Demo
4938950.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every run is a raid. Dive the drowned deep, build your deck on the way down, and crack a fortified base at the bottom. Free demo, unlimited dives.

5127300.name: White Christmas
5127300.short_description: Multiplayer for up to 16 players: roll ever-growing snowballs, build snowmen and start snowball fights. Explore a snowy village with a Christmas market, go sledding, ice skating or ice fishing. A cozy winter sandbox you can also play solo.

4009170.name: Obrum
4009170.short_description: OBRUM is a strategic logical puzzle roguelite where you manage an unstable system, trigger devastating chain reactions, and fight to keep the board from collapsing. OBRUM rewards pattern recognition & long-term planning. You are not solving a puzzle, you are engineering outcomes.

5208830.name: Method in the Witchness
5208830.short_description: A cozy game of sorting, riddles, and puzzles on a little witch’s table. Arrange magical objects, discover hidden secrets that may help in later puzzles, and uncover a gentle story—one uniquely sounding item at a time.

1884870.name: The Wolf Among Us 2
1884870.short_description: A neon-noir thriller where Bigby Wolf must confront the monster within that threatens the future of Fabletown.

5480680.name: Hearth of the Deep
5480680.short_description: A pixel-art incremental game about a dwarf clan digging 200 levels down to rekindle the World's Heart. Break rocks, defeat guardians, hire and upgrade dwarves, grow the Rune Tree and set out on new expeditions.

4577000.name: Void In The Darkness Demo
4577000.short_description: Here the enemy doesn't just fight — the enemy writes the rules. Mid-battle, the very laws of war are rewritten, and what was your advantage a moment ago becomes a trap. Summon your army, choose its ground, and turn those rules against the one who wrote them.

5291800.name: Beelionair Demo
5291800.short_description: A cozy idle sim about bees and their hives. Plant a wild meadow, send your swarm out to forage, and watch the honey pour in. Grow your hives, breed new bee strains, research upgrades, and re-queen your colony across four biomes. Your hives keep filling up even while you're away.

5420970.name: Snip Snap
5420970.short_description: Snip Snap is a fun game you can play with your friends!

5173970.name: Mr. Panas
5173970.short_description: Mr. Panas is an asymmetric multiplayer game for 3 to 5 players, where one player is a grumpy old man and the rest are invisible Whispers turning his house upside down. They have until morning to finish their chores. He can only use sounds, shadows and their trail of mess to catch them.

3671750.name: Ashes & Blood
3671750.short_description: Ashes & Blood is a fantasy strategy RPG blending fast-paced tactical battles, 4X-inspired strategy, and roguelite progression. Break the rules, build absurd combos, uncover Varyndel's secrets, and unlock even more chaos with each expedition. Turn-based strategy has never been this unhinged.

4840010.name: Fathom Reach
4840010.short_description: An underwater roguelike deckbuilder where every dive is a gamble. Chain explosive card combos, push deeper for richer loot, and surface before your hull breaks. Bring the haul home to upgrade your deck and build a base other players can raid while you're away.

4567600.name: One More Voyage
4567600.short_description: ONE MORE VOYAGE is a minimalist 4X game with incremental progression. On each new Voyage you explore strange planets on the hunt for vital resources to make the next warp jump on the flight from an overpowering enemy. Can you find the starcharts to escape your pursuers?

4956410.name: 海上有座极极岛 试玩版
4956410.short_description: After losing his job, Hu Yi drifts into Jiji Island, where an old scammer, a boy obsessed with love, a meat-eating monk, and a girl named Yan become part of his life. Days pass between beaches, salt fields... until he can no longer avoid the question: What kind of life do I want to live?

4184150.name: Really Illegal Golf Demo
4184150.short_description: Golf, but make it illegal. Defy your club membership ban & wreak havoc at courses across the city with your friends. Hide from security, defend yourself with a customisable arsenal, and take your games to the most outrageous places. Who said a tower crane wasn't the perfect place for a hole-in-one?

4798850.name: Reactor 13
4798850.short_description: Reactor 13 is chaotic local co-op for 1–4 players. Grab, wash, charge, and craft Dark Matter blocks to power everything from one house up to a whole planet. Overcharge for huge output; the chain reactions are half the fun, the meltdown is not. Play solo or have someone else to blame.

4803820.name: 海上有座极极岛
4803820.short_description: After losing his job, Hu Yi drifts into Jiji Island, where an old scammer, a boy obsessed with love, a meat-eating monk, and a girl named Yan become part of his life. Days pass between beaches, salt fields... until he can no longer avoid the question: What kind of life do I want to live?

5285200.name: Beelionair
5285200.short_description: A cozy idle sim about bees and their hives. Plant a wild meadow, send your swarm out to forage, and watch the honey pour in. Grow your hives, breed new bee strains, research upgrades, and re-queen your colony across four biomes. Your hives keep filling up even while you're away.

5132600.name: Touwers
5132600.short_description: Touwers is a fantasy tower defense strategy game where you place towers on a grid, hold the line through escalating enemy waves, and grow your economy to be able to unlock all kinds of perks along your way through 4 distinct campaigns.

5223320.name: Netherworld: Blood Moon Demo
5223320.short_description: You wake up shackled to a bamboo stalk in an unfamiliar forest. In the distance, something seems to be moving through the grove. You look closer... until you realize... it isn’t alive at all. One bizarre and horrifying event follows another. Under unbearable pressure, can you find a way out alive?

1651240.name: 똥겜이라 부르지 말아줘 스트리머씨: 해피 나나루
1651240.short_description: [Please Do Not Call It a Trash Game Streamer] is a reverse-progression 2D platformer. Guide the cute bakery girl Nanaru through devil Yako's trials. As you advance, you lose abilities and controls deteriorate—a trap set by someone wishing the adventure never ends.

4434530.name: 9 Layers of Hell
4434530.short_description: Carve through thousands of demons on your way down the nine layers of Hell. Combine your own spells, chase legendaries that rewrite your build and craft the perfect gear between waves. A horde survivor with the loot of an action RPG. How deep can you go?

4676960.name: Kiss or Kill
4676960.short_description: A branching romance thriller set inside a deadly holographic dating show. Raise Heartflutter Scores, protect your group, and survive seven days of eliminations.

1307150.name: MLF: Pro Catch
1307150.short_description: Grab a friend and feel every fish fight back. A fishing sim with 50+ species across six diverse waters, real casting and trolling, and authentic gear. The official Major League Fishing game.

4334240.name: Leaf Us Alone
4334240.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

3842790.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon Demo
3842790.short_description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

4733300.name: Akgwi Slash
4733300.short_description: Endless hordes of ghosts swarming in. Become a Joseon exorcist, ride the 'Geogugoe,' and shout, 'Sleep the vengeful spirits. Slay the evil spirits!'

3888080.name: Alone on the Lost Isle
3888080.short_description: An atmospheric open-world survival game featuring exploration of a mysterious island, base building, crafting, and a dog companion. Face hostile inhabitants of the island.

5269890.name: Biden Blast
5269890.short_description: Brawls on the island, cigarette-butt tossing, and a stealthy hunt for lightbulbs in the stairwell—welcome to Biden Blast. Play solo or compete against friends in absurd challenges where accuracy and audacity are everything.

5259250.name: ComfyTrans: Realtime Screen Translator
5259250.short_description: An offline screen-translation overlay that recognizes on-screen text in real time and shows the translation right where it appears. Everything runs on local, on-device AI, so your screen and personal data are never sent anywhere.

5048280.name: Netherworld: Blood Moon
5048280.short_description: You wake up shackled to a bamboo stalk in an unfamiliar forest. In the distance, something seems to be moving through the grove. You look closer... until you realize... it isn’t alive at all. One bizarre and horrifying event follows another. Under unbearable pressure, can you find a way out alive?

4420600.name: MechaCorps Draft
4420600.short_description: Outdraft your enemies in a simultaneous competitive card game with no wasted picks. Claim critical parts, deny key resources, and assemble ruthless Mechs. Prove your strategy in a decisive auto-battle. Quick PvP. Free to play. Never pay-to-win.

5364500.name: Crown of Ages
5364500.short_description: A turn-based 4X strategy game set in an organically crafted fantasy antiquity. Build cities, advance through new ages, wage wars, and unleash magic. Roguelite choices shape every city and every run anew — until the world ends and your empire is reborn from the ruins.

3344910.name: Tzark - The First Rift
3344910.short_description: TZARK: The First Rift is a dark fantasy RPG with strategic dice-based combat, character collection and permanent progression. Enter the Rifts, face increasing Torment levels, earn equipment and strengthen your heroes. Roll the dice and challenge fate!

5355270.name: 새벽별 고양이
5355270.short_description: Explore a new neighborhood with Hana, photograph stray cats, and fill your collection. Cats appear at different times and in different weather. Plan each day, meet the people around you, and follow a summer story in this single-player exploration and collection adventure.

4105040.name: Russian Village Business
4105040.short_description: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again — just like in the good old days!

5475380.name: Junk Robot
5475380.short_description: Junk Robot is a lighthearted, robot-building roguelike where you destroy enemy robots, scavenge their parts and add them straight to your own robot!ㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤㅤ

5251550.name: Dwarf Forge
5251550.short_description: Dwarf Forge is a top-down arcade forge-defense game. Heat raining metal in a rotating ring of flame, hammer it into weapons and armor, then wield your work against the goblins trying to steal your forge.

5199510.name: Undervein
5199510.short_description: Deep under the mountain there is a seam that never runs dry, a crew of dwarves who will mine it while you sleep, and a door covered in runes that nobody has opened. Click. Build. Descend. And be ready when the mountain's wrath wakes.

5105340.name: Little Drone TuTuTu Demo
5105340.short_description: Arm a tiny drone past common sense, then shoot absolutely everything. The research facility can reconsider science afterward.

2236840.name: Little Drone TuTuTu
2236840.short_description: Arm a tiny drone past common sense, then shoot absolutely everything. The research facility can reconsider science afterward.

5212370.name: Lode Builder Demo
5212370.short_description: Lode Builder is the evolution of the classic Lode Runner. Collect all the gold using new tactical tools. Need to climb? Build a ladder. Pit ahead? Stretch a chain. Tired of Robots? Burn them ALL! Gather resources across the map and don't waste a single one.

5468140.name: Voxmons
5468140.short_description: Hatch eggs, collect voxel creatures and lead them into battle. Your Voxmons orbit you in living rings, pick their own targets and fight for you while you explore. Cross floating islands, unlock rare Large and Huge forms, and build the squad that clears everything in its path.

4692490.name: Magnetic Catch Demo
4692490.short_description: A magnet fishing adventure about rusty scrap and hidden wonders. Clean your finds and upgrade your gear to explore murky city canals, countryside lakes, and forgotten places, where every pull brings a little surprise.

5486190.name: Football
5486190.short_description: Lead your nation on an epic journey to become World Cup Champions, from spectacular strikes to unforgettable victories, and write your name in football history.

4718780.name: Wandering The Corridors
4718780.short_description: Walk through an endless corridor and look for anomalies. Observe every detail, remember what you see, and discover what has changed before moving forward.

5233950.name: MIMIC HUNGER
5233950.short_description: A hungry little Mimic for your desktop! Let it ambush adventurers while you work, open loot chests, and collect 300 items. Raise familiars, evolve, and climb the rankings in this idle companion game. Sit back and watch, or lend a hand when you like.

4639580.name: MMO Botfarm Simulator
4639580.short_description: A game about running a botfarm on an oldschool MMO to gather and sell resources, level up your bots, and clear dungeons to find loot.

5194920.name: Neon Hustle
5194920.short_description: A first-person management sim set in a living crime-noir town. Recruit workers, pitch clients on the street yourself, manage rising city heat, and keep the operation running before the night forces itself to end. Mature themes, no explicit content.

5385810.name: Epsilon Zero Demo
5385810.short_description: "Epsilon Zero" is a fast-paced top-down action roguelike shooter where every mission is an all-out assault. Use devastating weapon combinations, unlock powerful upgrades, adapt your tactics, and exterminate everything standing in your way.

5360850.name: Grind Grid
5360850.short_description: A pixel-art incremental clicker-idler where 96 monsters and 32 idle blocks each level up independently. Hover your mouse — damage fires on its own. Prestige, evolutions, perks, tiers, and hundreds of upgrades. How far can you push the numbers?

5361930.name: Deck Drop Demo
5361930.short_description:
Perfect your deck or watch it burn!

Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro.

Can you beat the Tipping Point?

3248700.name: Fox Arcana
3248700.short_description: FOX ARCANA is a pixel art roguelike survivor. You play a fox against hordes of monsters, backed by the creatures you free, in a world that shifts to a new season with every boss you defeat.

2431170.name: Protos Magos Demo
2431170.short_description: Unleash powerful spells in a medieval-themed boomer shooter and blast through waves of enemies. Customize your loadout and explore a vast world full of danger and magic.

1420310.name: Quiet Rehabilitation
1420310.short_description: Imprisoned within Nova Prospekt, you are assigned to reach the nearest rebel camp with the initial goal to begin the long-awaited Uprising. Battle your way through the prison against the Combine forces and what lies within the ruins of this isolated fortress.

5461390.name: Farstrand
5461390.short_description: Seven years after HELIOBANE, a cartographer wakes on a cold world with an arm of alien glass. Freeze the hive's creatures into platforms, grow its buds into bridges, feed them until they burst, and map six worlds on the frozen roads between stars. An Amiga-style sci-fi metroidvania.

2761360.name: Hi Sudoku
2761360.short_description: Settle into classic Sudoku, one logical step at a time. Explore five difficulty levels, fixed stages and free play, with pencil marks, step-by-step hints and four visual themes. Hide the timer and solve at your own pace.

3433110.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
3433110.short_description: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

5478070.name: World Estate
5478070.short_description: Buy a worn flat, do it up, furnish it room by room and let it to a household that lives its own day in it. Then do it again, across seven cities, each with its own market, bank and mood. A relaxed property tycoon game in toy-like 3D cities.

5228660.name: Prototech Demo
5228660.short_description: Be careful, in the darkness there are surveillance robots ready to kill you at any time. Will you discover the strangeness and secrets behind Prototech's presence at the school.

4785700.name: Taiyi Saga Demo
4785700.short_description:
A roguelike deck-building adventure set across multiple worlds corrupted by unknown forces.  
Each world offers unique mechanics — from cultivation and martial arts to steampunk machinery and cosmic horror.

4960860.name: ResaleShop Simulator
4960860.short_description: "Resale Shop Simulator" is the first-person perspective resale shop management sim. Inspect items, check sellers' IDs, research resale prices, and decide what to pay. Clean your purchases, set prices, stock shelves, and work the register as you turn a small shop into your own business.

5229540.name: Kung Fu Waifus Demo
5229540.short_description: As the heir of the fallen heretical sect Nimbus Citadel, you ally with novice kung fu apprentice Shinran. Your goal: dominate the martial world with the erotic cultivation techniques inherited from your masters! Prepare to shake the martial realm with cunning schemes...and love.

5010220.name: 开拓物语 Demo
5010220.short_description: Frontier Tale is a cozy adventure farming game that blends extraction-style gameplay with town building. Forge weapons, explore a charming cel-shaded fantasy world, gather rare resources, recruit unique companions, and build your dream frontier from the ground up.

5129230.name: Underveil Demo
5129230.short_description:
Experience a new roguelike deckbuilder with no Energy and Spatial Strategy.
Your board is your Energy. Expand your board and engrave powerful effects. Fuse two cards to create new ones, then rotate and place them in limited space. Build your cards, shape your board, and make it uniquely yours.

4446280.name: SOS OPS! - BACKROOMS
4446280.short_description: Fall into the Backrooms with 1–4 friends: sprint through iconic levels, bait monsters, crawl-hide your way out, and turn horror into pure SOS OPS! chaos.

4511680.name: Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics
4511680.short_description: Step right up! We’re searching for Funfair Experts to transform the new location Riquetti Gardens into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

4286600.name: Scared by Squares Demo
4286600.short_description: Play all of Floor 01 in this free co-op horror demo. Explore alone or with up to three friends, solve puzzles, cleanse corruption with your flashlight, and survive the Cube. Just don’t be scared by squares.

4292850.name: 恋しかるべき ～迷い家からの手紙～ 体験版
4292850.short_description: Set in 1972 (Showa 47), this story follows a high school student on his yearly summer visit to his grandparents’ rural home. Spending quiet, nostalgic days with his sister and the villagers, he begins to believe this peaceful summer might last… until an encounter in the mountains changes everything.

3628930.name: The Ember Guardian Demo
3628930.short_description: Defend the embers of hope in this roguelike strategy game set in a post-apocalyptic world. Recruit and command workers to gather resources, build your camp and set up your defenses during the day. When night falls, fend off waves of deadly creatures with powerful, upgradable weapons.

3697960.name: Infinite Borders: Three Kingdoms Demo
3697960.short_description: 《万民长歌：三国》是一款单机 · 历史 · 战争策略游戏。在无缝连续、真实还原的3D沙盘地图上，玩家可以自选视角、以自己的意志重演三国。来体验真实的三国策略——真实的沙盘，真实的二十四节气，真实的百姓，真实的战争！

4880100.name: Stupid Never Dies: First Bite Demo
4880100.short_description: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

3214960.name: Bashful Adoration Demo
3214960.short_description: Bashful Adoration is a Kinetic 3D Platformer starring a cast of four competitive witches who are all in love with the same crush! Featuring Bombastic Combat, Expressive Movement Mechanics and a light-hearted Narrative with themes of love, rivalry and friendship.

1267502.name: Train Simulator: Tadami Line: Aizu-Wakamatsu - Tadami Route Add-On
1267502.short_description: Cherry blossom, beautiful forests and stunning mountains await on Union Workshop’s Tadami Line for Train Simulator!

1061100.name: Hunter's Arena: Legends
1061100.short_description: Hunter’s Arena is a multiplayer PvP & PvE melee combat-based Battle Royale set in the ancient Asia. Survive and become the deadliest Hunter in the world of Hunter's Arena!

362230.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Johnny Cage
362230.short_description: We flash back to how Johnny Cage was recruited to the tournament by Raiden... as he sits in a jail cell.

5289260.name: GRID OPS
5289260.short_description: Premium, single-player open-world extraction shooter set in a San Francisco warzone. Scout with UAV radar, hijack vehicles, take a combat helicopter armed with minigun and missiles, clear hostile territory, and reach extraction alive.

4908770.name: Rezonia
4908770.short_description: Easy to pick up. Challenging to master. Rezonia is a rhythm game built around simple controls and precision-focused gameplay. Chase your personal best and compete on the online leaderboards.

4655290.name: School Owner Simulator
