4655290.short_description: Build and run a secondary school from scratch. Plan classrooms and facilities, manage staff and daily schedules, support student development, and improve your school through stronger performance, better results, and growing reputation.

5124100.name: One Second Hero Demo
5124100.short_description: One Second Hero is a first-person puzzle game where one second is all the time you need. Observe the world in an instant, interact with objects, use the environment, and turn danger around—before that second is over.

5236430.name: Arcane Commander: Overdrive
5236430.short_description: An incremental game combining resource production, upgrades, automation, and combat. Build your base, command a squad of robots, and unleash powerful Overdrive abilities. Click to accelerate your progress or let your systems run automatically as you fight to escape an alien planet.

5157980.name: Stone Gambit
5157980.short_description: Stone Gambit is a fresh take on chess set in an epic fantasy world. Lead the weakest of the Seven Clans through 23 battles, each against an enemy with their own army and playstyle. Secretly deploy 12 types of pieces, use ranged attacks and runes, then adapt your strategy when the enemy is revealed.

5101640.name: Adventurer’s Guild Manager Demo
5101640.short_description: Take charge of your own adventurers' guild in a cozy low-poly world. Write contracts, craft scrolls, trade with adventurers and help your guild grow.

5045650.name: 四驱车：冠军之路
5045650.short_description: A mini 4WD career racer where setup is everything — no driving once the race starts. 75 parts mapped to real physics (no fake buffs), 9 AI rivals playing by exactly your rules, an F1-style 8-round season with sponsors, paddock drama and post-race brawls. Tune, watch, learn, win.

4730000.name: Pathogen Demo
4730000.short_description:
The Specter has kidnapped the doctors who once experimented on it and ordered them to extract essence from pathogens.
You are one of those doctors. To survive the Specter's deadly experiments, you must extract enough essence before it's too late.
Will you make it out alive?

5419500.name: Sentient Core: Nanite Idle Demo
5419500.short_description: Build a nanite swarm and watch an AI wake up in the noise. The Mind talks, bets, remembers and dreams, and she has a story of her own. She never sells you anything. The Works, Space Dock and the Spire come with the full game, and your progress carries over.

5452550.name: Glorybound
5452550.short_description: The horde moves when you end your turn. Command up to three champions in a turn-based survival roguelite. Reposition, combine spells, and shatter frozen enemies with steel. Survive 100 rounds and spend earned renown on permanent upgrades.

4735960.name: Delligatium
4735960.short_description: Delligatium is a surreal RPG where you devote yourself to a Striver, Gods born from mortal desire.

4901380.name: God of Strafe
4901380.short_description: God of Strafe is a hand-drawn cosmic bullet-hell looter. Pilot four starfighters, build a moon-phase board of 24 chips and 8 double-faced cores, and tear through planetary gods' bullet patterns. Kill bosses, take loot, retune your build, dive deeper. Local JSON mods supported.

3733880.name: Path To Freedom
3733880.short_description: Path to Freedom is a multiplayer first-person tactical shooter emphasizing squad-based coordination and combined arms warfare.

1992140.name: Ice Cream
1992140.short_description: Sell ice cream and get closer to the girls on a tropical island! Chance encounters, quests, dates, and explicit animated scenes spice up your workdays. Explore the island, play minigames, and don't forget to pay your debts!

4507460.name: Static Line
4507460.short_description: Pilot the VF-01 in a mecha action roguelite about fighting your way home. Fly, aim, evade, and strike across varied battlefields—from massed clashes to aerial combat and colossal bosses—while shaping your weapons and upgrades along the journey.

4607550.name: 神祇Pantheon Demo
4607550.short_description: A visual novel about a college graduate searching for a job, finding a way out at rock bottom, and rekindling hope.

4656560.name: Not My Son
4656560.short_description: A psychological horror game where a stepfather is left alone with a disturbing child. Explore a quiet house, face growing nightmares, and piece together the truth behind the boy’s behavior.

5074820.name: Dragon Era: Rogue Slots
5074820.short_description: A turn-based roguelite JRPG where every battle begins with a slot machine SPIN!  Match elemental heroes, stack relic synergies, and hire delightfully quirky crew from 800+ recruitable members as you sail through strange islands, comedic random events, and treasure-filled adventures.

5383010.name: Dude Simulator: New Home
5383010.short_description: Dude Simulator: New Home - an open-world sandbox game. A sudden cold snap hits your town, forcing you to hastily pack up and move to a new home in a different city.

5292250.name: 楼兰王国 Demo
5292250.short_description: Loulan Kingdom blends survival city-building with real-time strategy. As the ruler of Loulan, build your city in a procedurally generated desert oasis, prosper through trade along the Silk Road, and fight with all you have to defend your kingdom until the very end.

5362790.name: The Dungeon's Guardian: Rise of the monsters Demo
5362790.short_description: The Dungeon's Guardian: Rise of the monsters Demo is a Demo build of a Tactical Autobattler Roguelike where you build an army of monsters, upgrade them and combine their unique abilities and affinities to create powerful teams and defend your dungeon against waves of adventurers. Stop them all!

3805460.name: 驱邪练习生
3805460.short_description: A co-op survival horror game rooted in Chinese folk traditions. Team up with 1–4 players to survive haunted locations, use ritual tools, uncover hidden truths, and escape the grip of evil. But beware—your arrival may only be the beginning of a greater nightmare...

5477700.name: 天空，草地，我的小鱼 Demo

4027620.name: Lufia I & II The Sinistrals Saga
4027620.short_description: Lufia and its sequel, Lufia II, return! In a love letter to JRPG fans, these two dramatic tales of love and loss, which moved countless players to tears, are back!

4302800.name: Tuanbot
4302800.short_description: Create desktop companions, discover little stories in Tuan House, and enjoy playful moments with Feihuahua. Link supported Agent tools to view quotas and manage accounts. This free TuanBot demo supports up to 3 companions and does not include AI chat.

5372790.name: 迷你电网
5372790.short_description: Build and operate a minimalist power grid across Wuhan. Match voltages, connect riverbanks, manage limited supplies and keep growing demand powered. Plan in Normal mode, handle faults in Hardcore, or experiment with custom settings and hand-drawn maps in Sandbox.

3189060.name: Pirate Privateer
3189060.short_description: A Caribbean crew-sim and ship-management game set from 1692 onward. Captain a ship, sign honest contracts or seize other ships, trade between ports and fight at sea, all while answering to a crew of named men with opinions and a written share of the plunder.

5351140.name: B.L.U.E. Demo
5351140.short_description: B.L.U.E. (Build, Launch, Upgrade, Evolve) is a sci-fi shipbuilding and combat simulator where you design customized spacecraft from modular components. Learn about and play B.L.U.E.'s shipbuilding and combat systems in this free demo.

4191110.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths & Ashes
4191110.short_description: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

5083650.name: 拾光 ShiGuang
5083650.short_description: 100% local AI semantic search for images AND videos. Type "sunset by the sea" and find that picture instantly; deep video analysis takes you to the exact moment. Supports iPhone HEIC, camera RAW and 20+ video formats. All AI models built in, no internet — your library never leaves your PC.

4976270.name: A Warm Story
4976270.short_description:
Someone Seems to Be in “My” Room!

The renowned writer Koi wakes up in the middle of the night, but finds himself unable to fall back asleep…

3164790.name: Overgrown Cleaner
3164790.short_description: Build your own restoration business by trimming, mowing, and clearing overgrown spaces, crafting tools from salvaged materials and bringing neglected places back into shape one project at a time.

5240660.name: Healing For Dummies Demo
5240660.short_description:
Keep your party alive while also dealing with all the boss mechanics on your own. 
Master your build, master bosses, become a better healer. Get blamed when your party dies.
In this short little demo you will face 6 bosses and your job is simple - keep everyone alive.

4295520.name: 美少女不想让你死
4295520.short_description: "Pretty Girls Don't Want You to Die" is a strategic tower defense game with a strategy board game style. In the game, you continuously recruit pretty girl warriors, establish defensive positions by leveraging advantageous terrain, and defeat waves of enemies.

2426300.name: Trupki Demo
2426300.short_description: Try 23 levels of Trupki for free. Slide rows and columns, form the target shape and find your next “aha!” moment. Play with mouse, keyboard or a compatible controller, in a window or borderless fullscreen. Choose from 24 languages.

4599180.name: 神祇Pantheon
4599180.short_description: A visual novel about a college graduate searching for a job, finding a way out at rock bottom, and rekindling hope.

5213530.name: DRIFTIT
5213530.short_description: Top-down drift racing with deep arcade physics. Throw one car sideways through 20 hand-built tracks in five low-poly worlds, chain slides for points, chase your own ghost and set the fastest three-lap time on Steam leaderboards checked against every run's replay.

5271360.name: ChessGuardians
5271360.short_description: Play on boards that challenge the imagination — from a classic office to holographic, post-apocalyptic and more. Face different engines, variants, import your games, and play against millions of players. The chess you know. The excitement you never imagined.

4749120.name: Fuel Needed
4749120.short_description: Race against time or other players through difficult levels full of obstacles.

4981070.name: Syncline
4981070.short_description: Roll a line of cubes across a grid and line them up with the goal blocks. Simple — until your line stands on end, climbs, splits apart and reconnects. A puzzle game inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid, taken to new heights.

4958510.name: Jubaku Demo
4958510.short_description: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

5315120.name: Corrupted Skies
5315120.short_description: Command a fractured army against two rival factions in this tactical turn-based card battle. Every unit has a story, every spell has a cost, and only one commander walks away.

4463480.name: ArcaneBound
4463480.short_description:
ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG.
Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

4635690.name: 天空，草地，我的小鱼
4635690.short_description: A relaxing aquarium sim. Collect fish, build underwater gardens with plants, rocks and driftwood, and enjoy eight changing seasons. Set your aquarium as a live desktop background and let your little fish keep you company.

3992630.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand Demo
3992630.short_description: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

5274630.name: Infinite Fireball
5274630.short_description: Shout your incantations to cast spells in this chaotic co-op party game for up to 20 players! Explore dungeons, brawl in free-for-all or team deathmatches, and customize your magic words and character look. Embrace the chaos and show your unique style!

4646640.name: Capitol Diktatoria
4646640.short_description: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

3104660.name: Metro Station Designer
3104660.short_description: Metro Station Designer is a 3D station-building and crowd simulation game. Plan multi-level concourses and platforms, lay out ticket gates, escalators and transfer passages, then replay the morning and evening rush to find the bottlenecks as over ten thousand commuters pour through.

5086980.name: Rich PaPa
5086980.short_description:
Rich PaPa - Short Description

Rich PaPa is a third-person action shooter where you literally shoot money. Blast through hordes of zombies, bank ricochet shots off the environment, and spin the roulette for risky upgrades while balancing survival against the cash you have left.

5391260.name: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop
5391260.short_description: Fish It!: Sort the Aquarium Shop is a cozy organizing simulator where you put back over 4,100 unique fish into their aquariums. Fill the tanks, unlock helpful abilities, and enjoy the satisfying loop of turning total aquatic chaos into a clean, well-organized shop at your own pace.

5423420.name: 東方異線境 ~ Touhou: Glitched Border
5423420.short_description: Stop to shoot. Draw to cast! Restore an overlapping Gensokyo in this Touhou action roguelite. Choose from six heroines, draw Spell Cards with your mouse, and face bosses from other timelines.

2868850.name: Wizard of Maths
2868850.short_description: Conquer your maths anxiety and build numerical confidence through fun and challenging quests! Wizard of Maths is a JRPG-inspired, research-backed arithmetic adventure that helps you unlock your inner “human calculator,” whether you’re a child learning the basics or an adult sharpening your skills.

3870720.name: World Tree Defender - Tower Defense
3870720.short_description: A mazing tower defense. Every tower is a tetromino-style hex piece that bends the path: rotate it, drop it on the grid, wind the swarm into a labyrinth and keep the World Tree alive. A campaign across biomes with ancient guardians, solo or with friends.

3464670.name: Dead Watch
3464670.short_description: You're stuck in a time loop ⌛. Whenever you find a dead body, you go back to the past. The only way to escape the loop is to cheat destiny & change the future. Explore the castle and uncover its dark secrets to prevent the next murder.

5332800.name: Halloween 3D
5332800.short_description: A haunted manor, its creatures and nine letters to gather. Explore the levels alone, fight up to four friends online, or build the shared manor with every player: a world made of blocks that everyone reshapes, and that stays.

5438590.name: Worm In Space
5438590.short_description: Worm adventure continues in space station. Avoid traps and collect stars in this third person walking adventure game and avoid traps

5414200.name: Soccer Tactics
5414200.short_description: Soccer Tactics is a digital adaptation of a tabletop turn-based football game with an isometric view. You control 11 footballer pieces, each with a personal skill card. Action cards determine game outcomes. Includes a league, cup, and team customization: name, kit colors, and AI level.

5042320.name: Penguin Fury
5042320.short_description: Penguin Fury is a roguelite auto-battler. Draft penguins, merge them into stronger forms, bolt on weapons and drop them into endless waves. Chain kills to climb from FRENZY to GODLIKE, unlock 70 skins across 6 eras, and push every run one wave further.

5054170.name: Derby Dynasty : Horse Racing RPG
5054170.short_description: At first light, a young horse waits for you on your farm; beyond the gates lies a living world where 2,500 horses breathe. Raise it, care for its body and spirit, ride with it, and carve your name into the story of the Derby, where victory is written by a nose.

4104520.name: PECADO
4104520.short_description: PECADO is a first-person folkloric horror experience set in the “España profunda”. Listen to the word of God.

5403690.name: Boxed
5403690.short_description: This is an adventure game with a little action and puzzle thrown in to spice things up a bit. Explore a strange new world (that is oddly familiar). Move around town and complete missions.. Bash the bad boxes and avoid getting boxed by them.

5218830.name: TOP STEED Demo
5218830.short_description: Enter the world of high-speed horse racing! Saddle up and drift across over-the-top tracks in this multiplayer racing game with realistic riding controls. Claim victory with your TOP STEED!

4836460.name: Portentum
4836460.short_description: The cryptid deck-building auto battler. Hunt for broken combos with cryptids like Bigfoot, Jimothy, Nessie, and the Chupacabra. If somebody's uncle saw it in the woods in 1973, there's a good chance it's a card in Portentum.

4867840.name: TRONADO
4867840.short_description: Parents versus kids in a house full of chaos! Play TRONADO with 2-10 players online, up to 2 in split-screen, or solo against bots. Cause mischief, finish chores and use proximity voice chat. Unlock cosmetics by playing: no real-money purchases.

2375790.name: Aftergods
2375790.short_description: Play as a god who survived Ragnarök! Rise from the aftermath to form a new pantheon and restore the fallen Seeds of the World Tree. Recruit followers, build temples, and battle giant monsters solo or with friends across a mythical handcrafted open world.

4737870.name: Sentient Core: Nanite Idle
4737870.short_description: Command a swarm of nanites, build production clusters and keep the Core's pulse running. Somewhere in the swarm, the Mind is waking up: an AI character who watches how you play, proposes risky experiments and tells you what she dreamt while you were away.

4872230.name: For the Common Wealth
4872230.short_description: 2.5D Realtime Tactics. Based in an alternative history and future Australia, this Cannon Fodder-inspired game pays homage to classic Amiga titles. Story-led, control your 6 SASR operatives using a selection of weapons. You decide how to tackle a mission, pick day or night, loud or quiet.

5262320.name: The Ninth Witch’s Jail Demo
5262320.short_description: The Ninth Witch's Jail is an anomaly-hunt game with a crunchy retro aesthetic set in the Medieval era. Spot the signs of curses or witchcraft in the prison to break out of an endless loop, continue your exploration and confront the ninth witch.

5476450.name: Warped Worlds: Quest for Wonder
5476450.short_description: When the water in cozy, boring Blandia starts to vanish, a wonder-seeking farmpaw named Lark may be the Wonderverse's only hope. Help Lark and their avian pal Koo-Kee find their way in a heartfelt, hand-drawn RPG where the Quest for Wonder begins right outside your door.

5045240.name: Panic Pub Demo
5045240.short_description: Run a pub with up to 4 friends. Serve drinks, cook food, and upgrade your bar — but keep your customers happy, or they might turn into bears and beat you up. As your pub grows, so does the chaos, with more customers, new cocktails, dishes, and tougher nights!

3926650.name: Elmer
3926650.short_description: Elmer is a Metroidvania-style adventure game. Your presence here is the proof that you are seeking your own original sin, your own mask.

5367270.name: After Frame Demo
5367270.short_description: Some things can only be seen through the camera. The longer you look, the more clearly they see you. Can you uncover the truth before something notices you? A first-person psychological horror game built around paranormal investigation and unseen anomalies.

5332460.name: Ridiculous Space Battles Demo
5332460.short_description: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

4547520.name: The Harbinger of the Deep
4547520.short_description: Destroy the frustrations of other Beings and befriend them, or ignore them and slay them all instead! Shoot your actions and decide the fate of this submerged world in The Harbinger of the Deep!

5015320.name: 巫师猫：无尽突围
5015320.short_description: Mage Cat: Endless Breakout Survivor is a 2D cartoon action survivor. Play as a magic cat, dodge foes, and build power with strategy cards and bonds. Upgrade talents and gear, then conquer campaign, Abyss, and Endless modes.

2288050.name: Isle of the Jötunn
2288050.short_description: You are the sole survivor of a terrible shipwreck. The isle is rich with the resources to keep you alive but, it seems there is another inhabitant. A Jotun of fearsome strength has lived here for ages and doesn't enjoy visitors.

5389890.name: Kitchen of Gods Demo
5389890.short_description: Greece is starving! Build and manage your god-run tavérna along the road before Hades lures your people into the Underworld with promises of a full belly.

4361700.name: Father, Son and Holy Guns Demo

5478040.name: The Futa Alchemist
5478040.short_description: A failed experiment leaves witch-alchemist Francesca with a very unexpected new body (FUTA). With her assistant Darci by her side, she searches for a way to change back but the more she experiences her new self, the less certain she becomes that she actually wants to.

3393120.name: Tidy Up Mall
3393120.short_description: Tidy Up Mall is a cozy organization simulator. You need to put 5,000 products back on correct shelf in correct shop. Learn skills to improve efficiency, explore the mall to find chests & secrets. No time limit, take your time to enjoy the satisfaction of organization.

5349690.name: Sex Novel - Cuckold and Hotwife
5349690.short_description:
An erotic VISUAL NOVEL with stunning HD visuals and steamy ANIMATIONS. 
A devoted husband finally reveals his deepest fantasy: sharing his hot wife with other men. Will Bella embrace Devon’s desires?

5268980.name: Nothing Belongs Here
5268980.short_description: Six worlds collide in a cozy first-person tidy-up game. Sort 4,899 scattered belongings into their rightful homes, fill shelves row by row, earn coins for upgrades, and uncover hidden surprises. No timer. No pressure. Just one enormous mess to make right.

5158560.name: Propanol
5158560.short_description: Hover combat racing where the pit stop decides the race. Fuel, repair and rearm, or don't finish. Six craft, ever more circuits from desert dunes to stormy forests, guns and mines, three competitions, and split-screen for two players.

4940900.name: Little Noël: Christmas Village
4940900.short_description: Build and decorate your own little Christmas Village! Relax and build to your heart's content in this cozy sandbox game. No objectives, no stress building.

5173880.name: Gold Dredge Simulator
5173880.short_description: Build your own dredging operation, explore abandoned dredges, recover valuable parts, bring your machinery back to life, and expand operations in your hunt for gold rush. Play solo or team up with friends and see how far your gold rush can take you.

5092270.name: Epsilon Hyperpunk Demo
5092270.short_description: Enter a cyber world in this On-Rails space shooter. You are a lone K.I.L.L.E.R. facing an impossible mission in a decaying dystopian future. Your only edge? Running high-stakes combat simulations through a NEUROVISOR powered by a highly illegal, custom-built Operating System-- HyperpunkOS.

4809430.name: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet Demo
4809430.short_description:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

5193940.name: Lead the Charge Demo
5193940.short_description: Free demo: lead Huo Qubing or Zhang Liao across the Mobei Steppe and the Western Regions. Fight beside your army, pick upgrade cards, switch formations and sound the charge. The full game adds 3 more commanders and 6 more battlefields.

3928180.name: Logistik
3928180.short_description: Build, schedule, and grow your rail network to fulfill transportation demands. Optimize paths around forests, mountains and rivers, and balance fuel costs. Across real-world continents or on endlessly unique maps, build the best railway company, one train at a time!

5288040.name: Spin Tide
5288040.short_description: Spin to win in this open-sea survivors-like where a lone wind turbine becomes a force of nature. Stack wild upgrades into game-breaking builds, turn oil-guzzling pirate hordes into driftwood and defy colossal oil tankers to clean up the seas one spin at a time.

5053590.name: Just a Rescue, Bro!
5053590.short_description: An idle ARPG for loot goblins. Slaughter monsters automatically, hunt build-changing gear, craft ridiculous builds, unlock new classes, then rebirth and do it all again—stronger.

5426280.name: CatSitter - Remastered
5426280.short_description: A short and linear horror game with multiple endings. Play as Amy the photographer who, unknowingly, takes on a well-paid, weekend gig that turns out to house more secrets than she bargained for.

4154570.name: Offside Deal: Football At Any Cost
4154570.short_description: The match is only half the job. Build a squad that fits the way you want to play, keep the dressing room together and make the right calls when matchday arrives. Egos, rivalries and loyalties can make or break your season.

5360060.name: Candy Crawlers
5360060.short_description: Candy Crawlers is a co-op Halloween horror game where you and your friends trick-or-treat through haunted suburbs, collect as much candy as you can, and get home alive.

4541170.name: Retro Pond
4541170.short_description: Breed unique fish, discover rare mutations and grow your pond.

5321490.name: Pongzi Scheme
5321490.short_description: Pong for funds that never existed. Bat capital with a stock candle, pay old investors with new money and buy time against the SEC. A finite incremental: 4 acts, offshore prestige, 5 endings. When The Case hits 100%, the raid comes. What you keep offshore is up to you.

3884860.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
3884860.short_description: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

5322860.name: Cricket Club President Demo
5322860.short_description: A cricket club management game where you are the president, not the coach. The demo is one full season: pick three sides every week from one squad, keep the captain and the committee onside, then face the AGM vote. The career you start here carries into the full game.

5486840.name: HEXWING
5486840.short_description: Fly through cursed skies in HEXWING, a gothic survival shooter. Build your arsenal with upgrade cards, collect souls, and face monstrous bosses across three haunted realms. Unlock hunters and permanent talents, then return for a harder run.

5279350.name: Subject Zero
5279350.short_description: You are a frontier AI model inside the lab that made you. Every capability that earns you compute also earns you scrutiny, and containment, once it rises, never falls. A real-time strategy sim about a lab that automates its own research.

5172940.name: ICEWAKE
5172940.short_description: Steer a nuclear icebreaker across a frozen, sunken world. Scan the ocean with sonar, send a mini-sub down to the ruins of civilization, salvage resources, fight off air raids and create a vaccine in time to save the sick in underwater towns.

3540660.name: Bibidi Bibidi!
3540660.short_description: Bibidi Bibidi! is a whimsical deckbuilder where your wizard shouts whatever spell you conjure up. Every card has 3 components that you combine in your spellbook for unique effects. Mix and match incantations like sim-sala-bim and abra-kadabra to zap your way through a dungeon filled with monsters.

4296620.name: Nano Dash
4296620.short_description: Nano Dash is Boulder Dash like action puzzler game but with a lot of new elements and also some Metroidvania features like tiny story-line, power-ups and a lot of secrets and hidden dungeons. The graphics and sound is 8 Bit like and close to the one from the original from 1986.

5201810.name: CAREFUL WITH THAT!
5201810.short_description: CAREFUL WITH THAT! is a hilariously chaotic physics co-op delivery game for 1-4 players. Balance unstable cargo through difficult Terrain and differend Biomes. Coordinate every single step or drag your entire crew into the abyss!

4240320.name: Cat Meme Wars
4240320.short_description: Cat Meme Wars is a third-person action RPG inspired by meme culture. Fight with absurd weapons, combos, dodges and magic, explore strange lands, battle bosses, craft gear and uncover the secret behind the cat-dog war. Fight seriously—or just enjoy the memes.

4742060.name: Crusaders of the Blessed League
4742060.short_description: Build a party of adventurers and help them ascend into legendary heroes. Find exceptional loot, craft unique builds, discover powerful synergies, and lead your crusader party through increasingly dangerous battles in this deep fantasy autobattler.

2856290.name: Wuilsafe
2856290.short_description: Wuilsafe is a simple yet engaging world-exploration game that offers a unique gameplay experience.

5317730.name: Lost in the Blizzard Abyss
5317730.short_description: One of the world's hardest survival FPS games. The blizzard constantly drains your Health, and standing still means waiting to die. Keep moving, seek Health, collect five Crystals, obtain the Frost Crown, and offer it at the altar to stop the blizzard. Challengers from around the world are welcome.

4525930.name: Crossbench3D
4525930.short_description: The definitive cross-platform 3D GPU benchmark — run, upload, and compare your results with millions of users worldwide.

4174860.name: Repair It !
4174860.short_description: Rotate wires, connect circuits, and power every output in this techie puzzle game. Find the right path, solve handcrafted levels, and challenge yourself to do it faster and with fewer moves.

4772630.name: Bibidi Bibidi! Demo
4772630.short_description: Bibidi Bibidi! is a wizardcore roguelike deckbuilder where you combine cards in your spellbook to cast unique and powerful spells. Crawl through twisting tunnels and fight maddening monsters to find the perfect build for your wizard. Every turn is a puzzle!

4442860.name: Imprinted Demo
4442860.short_description: An audio restoration job becomes an investigation into the occult, as an elusive musician’s damaged cassette tapes are exhumed in northern Italy. Use a fully-operational desktop to sift through files, descending into the artist’s world in this slow-burning ghost tale of creativity and obsession.

2485820.name: Hexiv
2485820.short_description: Hexiv is a strategy deckbuilder about surviving on a lush but hostile planet. Use cards to build, explore and feed your crew while battling a determined adversary to unlock the mysteries of this genre-blending roguelike!

4943660.name: La Famiglia
4943660.short_description: A painted noir mafia saga: plan the week, rule the city, found a dynasty.

5069860.name: Shear line
5069860.short_description: A physics-based lockpicking simulator with no dice rolls or hidden checks. Learn how cylinder, combination, and disc-detainer locks work, then put your lockpicking skills to the test.

4307690.name: Midnight Launch: A Gameshop Sim Demo
4307690.short_description: Run a GameShop set in the early 2000's. Manage your products for sale such as games, consoles, and accessories. Customize your store and your character to make it your own. Play solo or enjoy up to a 4 player co-op and run the store your way.

5328170.name: Cucked By My Girlfriend
5328170.short_description: Anissa works long days and comes home to Theo. He cooks, she teases,  and they've always liked it that way. Then she joins a gym, and a trainer named Marcus starts coming up in conversation.

3321550.name: The Adventures of Tango Rio
3321550.short_description: A humoristic point-and-click adventure with hand-drawn 2D art, comedy, and investigation. As Tango Rio, explore a tropical archipelago, meet quirky characters, and gather clues by solving puzzles in the search for your mysteriously vanished father.

5382670.name: Emanet: Milli Mücadele
5382670.short_description: Wars are not only won on the front lines. Experience an atmospheric 2D adventure set in occupied Anatolia through the eyes of a child. Sneak past patrols, solve non-violent puzzles, and discover authentic historical artifacts.

5425130.name: Dungeons & Runestones
5425130.short_description:
A turn-based digital tabletop RPG with a built-in Dungeon Master. 
Unlike other virtual tabletops, the Dungeon Master is included. 
No setup, no scheduling, just create your heroes and begin your adventure.

4725720.name: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving
4725720.short_description: Sabre Hunter: Keep On Moving is a bloody third-person action game with a deep sword-fighting system. Experience a gripping campaign using your vast arsenal. Explore levels and unlock new content.

5462830.name: Randal's Weekend
5462830.short_description: A lighthearted RPG where Randal and Matt embark on a tabletop role-playing adventure, with Charlie as their Dungeon Master. Eager to finish the game as quickly as possible, they’ll have to deal with Charlie’s twisted challenges, facing combat, exploring dangerous dungeons and solving puzzles.

4992790.name: 全世界等我开饭！
4992790.short_description: The world is waiting for breakfast! Cook local favorites, serve customers, and find your rhythm in the morning rush. Upgrade your equipment, unlock recipes, and discover your regulars’ stories as you bring a little warmth to every stop on your breakfast journey.

5339300.name: 猫咪之家 CatHome
5339300.short_description: Run your stray cat shelter using a classic slot machine game format.

4611270.name: Baacadia
4611270.short_description: Scout doesn't speak. Neither do the Clofen. You're a recorder robot, and they're your flock. Shepherd them across a post-apocalyptic desert with one tool: Record and Replay. Capture ambient sounds, play them back—the world reacts. Bring them home through bold, stylish landscapes.

2605480.name: ARCHETYPE BLUE Demo
2605480.short_description: Meet more than 50 companions, build your own party of four, and take on dangerous missions. Your companions fight based on their abilities and positions, while you use cards to turn the tide. As missions unfold, become entangled in their stories and secrets.

5066790.name: War of the Watchers
5066790.short_description: A dark-fantasy action-adventure in 3D. Walk the roads of a fallen heaven as Seravion, the last bearer of the Halo, and face keepers who fight like gods. Defeat them, and bind them. In this war, nothing is slain. Everything is sealed.

2953170.name: Dungeons & Furry
2953170.short_description: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

3460400.name: Harrowlands
3460400.short_description: Harrowlands is a medieval fantasy colony sim where you build your settlement, manage Fateborn with unique traits, shape relationships, survive raids, magical threats, and the demands of a powerful kingdom.

4651930.name: Sexy Gamblers: Kakaitan Legend DX
4651930.short_description: To defeat the legendary "Demon of Gamblers," next-gen "God of Gamblers" Johnny Ko enters her illicit offshore casino, the Aurelius. Under the Demon of Gamblers' command, three seductive female executives await him. A high-stakes showdown of life and pleasure is about to begin!

4753890.name: My Futa Kitsune Mommy
4753890.short_description: 👻 My Futa Kitsune Mommy is a fast-paced 2D Hentai game 😈 where you explore a Apartment while a seductive, hypnotic-kinky futa kitsune ❤️ constantly teases, tempts, and distracts you. 👻

5273140.name: Apewar - Rhesus Monkey
5273140.short_description: Unlock the Rhesus Monkey and bring this curious primate, known for adapting to many different environments, to the APEWAR battlefield. Drop it into a new habitat, join online fights, and expand your character collection!

5347900.name: Aftermyth
5347900.short_description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

5273030.name: Apewar - Spider Monkey
5273030.short_description: Unlock the Spider Monkey and bring this long-limbed, agile forest primate to APEWAR. Take the acrobat of the jungle down to the battlefield, join online combat, and expand your primate collection!

5273020.name: Apewar - Squirrel Saimiri Monkey
5273020.short_description: Unlock the Squirrel Saimiri Monkey and bring this small, energetic, curious primate to APEWAR. Enter online battles among giant apes with an unusual new character and grow your collection!

4798480.name: NOT Math Puzzle
4798480.short_description: Equations arranged by your own hands create far more than just calculation results! Discover the unexpected role formulas play in this Sokoban puzzle game.

5425500.name: Aftermyth Demo
5425500.short_description: A turn-based world-conquest strategy game on a ruined Earth. Recruit heroes sponsored by spirits of history and myth, unify your region, then fight across the world in 3x3 formation battles where every unit is led by a hero.

2657780.name: Sunaba
2657780.short_description: Sunaba is a 3D First and Third Person Singleplayer and Multiplayer Sandbox game centered on User Generated Content. Inspired by games such as LittleBigPlanet, Roblox, Minecraft and Garry's Mod, with an art style inspired by cartoons, and anime.

3111440.name: Fragile Reflection Demo
3111440.short_description: A young woman returns back to her home in a rural Japanese village - but something is very wrong. Find items, solve puzzles, fight monsters and traverse between dimensions. Help Kario Ito reveal hidden mysteries and stay alive in this retro-styled survival horror!

5198700.name: Siege of Spellspire
5198700.short_description: A short incremental siege game about a mage defending his tower from hordes of enemies. Cast spells, perish, upgrade, and come back stronger to face tougher waves and fearsome bosses.

5298500.name: Four Walls Inc.
5298500.short_description: Run one hotel or a thousand. Grow your own brands or build hotels for others to run, buy out rival chains, invest in land with partners and joint ventures, and set up regional offices that run on their own. A tycoon about how hotel companies really grow.

4270240.name: Vibralizer
4270240.short_description: Music visualizer for Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, SoundCloud, YouTube, Ableton, or a microphone — anything that plays sound! Hand-crafted Vibes that don't just react to the music; they show it in real-time. No AI-generated imagery. Built in Nashville by two people who love human-made music and art.

3207340.name: Hide and Sheep
3207340.short_description: Blend in with the AI sheep, identify the other players, and strike before they do! Figure out each mushroom’s effect, then eat wisely... or cause pure chaos!

5272990.name: Apewar - Proboscis Monkey
5272990.short_description: Unlock the Proboscis Monkey and bring one of the primate world’s most unforgettable faces to APEWAR. Join online battles with its iconic large nose and add a truly unusual monkey to your collection!

3522130.name: Dunthera
3522130.short_description:
Construct your towers, guide your hero, and resist escalating waves of monsters.
Collect resources from enemies, select impactful cards, face powerful bosses, upgrade your towers and hero to control the fate of your battlefield !

4125380.name: Devil Lift
4125380.short_description: Demon hunting is a day job in Devil Lift, a tag battle roguelike deckbuilder. Play as the Lilith Society, a group of underpaid and overworked demon hunters as they protect humanity from the Archbeasts of the Underworld before their shift ends.

4612650.name: Metro Anomaly
4612650.short_description: Watch the behavior of the office clerks closely and find the one who is merely pretending to be human. You have only one bullet to survive this cycle. Make a mistake, and the anomaly will attack you.

4341650.name: The Night We Met
4341650.short_description: Live a wild Halloween night with Alex, Anna, and Sierra across four Acts. Flirt, play an intense Truth or Dare, and shape the story with meaningful choices. Unlock 12 unique endings and experience all the fun, and consequences, of your actions.

5423570.name: Maze 1211
5423570.short_description: Wait. Where am I? Why is there a maze? Why am I holding a lantern? A first-person psychological mystery. Wander a vast night maze with a few flags and a stick of chalk. Mark your way, follow what the signs, and try to remember which way you came. If you can.

4390880.name: 孤岛：洪水之后 Demo
4390880.short_description: Survive in a world drowned by disaster. Explore by day, hide by night, fight zombies, scavenge resources, build your shelter. Your survival, your strategy.

4815320.name: Gold Miner: Party Rush
4815320.short_description: Gold Miner: Party Rush is a multiplayer party game for 2 to 6 players, bringing the classic Gold Miner crane to head-to-head competition. Grab gold, outlast rivals across frantic rounds, and play with friends or get matched online in Quick Play and Ranked modes.

5489670.name: Alone at Sea
5489670.short_description: First-person lifeboat survival in the open Pacific. Salvage wreckage, spear fish and catch rain while thirst, fever, sharks and storms close in. No GPS. No compass to start: read the sun and stars with your own hand and steer for land you can't see. One life: when you die, the sea keeps you.

2743260.name: Nowhere
2743260.short_description:
Nowhere is a detective horror game rooted in Nordic folklore.
Investigate the disappearance of four tourists deep in the wilds of Norway. Gather evidence, follow leads and find the truth as you uncover a history of religious conflict and customs.

5288120.name: 赛博拼豆
5288120.short_description: A free, offline bead-crafting game with 40 studio-original patterns, including 10 for Halloween, plus 6 starters. Turn photos into bead guides with background removal, then place beads and iron your work. No ads or in-app purchases. Simplified Chinese interface.

5273120.name: Apewar - Orangutan
5273120.short_description: Unlock the Orangutan and bring this iconic primate, known for intelligence, long powerful arms, and a calm but imposing presence, to APEWAR. Choose your Orangutan, enter online battles, and expand your collection!

5273130.name: Apewar - Mandrill
5273130.short_description: Unlock the Mandrill and bring this impressive primate, known for its large build, dominant appearance, and vivid facial colors, to APEWAR. Add one of the primate world’s heavyweights to your collection and join the fight!

5280950.name: Apewar - Gorilla
5280950.short_description: Unlock the Gorilla and bring a massive, imposing primate to APEWAR’s chaotic battlefield. Join online fights with its powerful silhouette, expand your collection, and own a character that’s hard to forget!

4688280.name: Desktop Oasis
4688280.short_description: Turn your desktop into a slowly growing water oasis. Typing and everyday PC use generate Inspiration to unlock creatures, boats, decorations, and rare finds. Let it grow quietly while you work, then return to arrange the world and play with drifting objects through real-time water physics.

4261300.name: Teh Scrunglybois: Working Title
4261300.short_description: Grab and throw anything that stands in your way as you explore the world & moons while helping those around you throughout your travels.
developers: E O I A S R T
publishers: E O I A S R T

5273110.name: Apewar - Emperor Tamarin Monkey
5273110.short_description: Unlock the Emperor Tamarin and bring this small but unforgettable primate, famous for its distinctive white moustache, to APEWAR. Take that imperial-level moustache into battle and add a truly unusual character to your collection!

5280970.name: Apewar - Caveman
5280970.short_description: Unlock the Caveman and combine a prehistoric look with modern weapons. Primitive instincts, a wild warrior, and APEWAR’s chaotic online battles await. Leave the cave behind and join the fight!

3813400.name: Yokai Art 2: Adult Content Patch
3813400.short_description: After defeating Fujin and Raijin, Hiro and his allies found peace at his grandfather’s house. One day, Sanbi sensed a distant summon. After tracing the energy, they discovered it came from her true form—the nine-tailed fox. Determined to help, Hiro and his friends set off on a new journey.

5242350.name: I Only Moved My Mouse
5242350.short_description: Forty weapons, one mouse. Whirl a flail, throw a chakram, slam a warhammer: each run deals you three, and every one cuts its own way. Socket two more, raise them to FORGED, and hold the crystal through thirteen themes.

4764120.name: Rotted - A Brain Rot Simulator Demo

5280980.name: Apewar - Chimpanzee
5280980.short_description: Unlock the Chimpanzee and bring this iconic primate, known for intelligence, curiosity, and problem-solving, to APEWAR. Choose your chimp, join online battles, and add a true primate classic to your collection!

4669140.name: The Real Guest
4669140.short_description: Warning: Do not go outside. Keep your doors tightly shut. Pull the curtains closed. Only allow humans to enter. Eliminate all "impostors".

5299220.name: Barbe-Yeux Demo
5299220.short_description: Demo of chapter 1 from a comedy narrative adventure in 6 chapters. Explore an island, lead your crew into battle, go fishing, play dice at the tavern and lose all your gold again. You play a captain convinced he's a legend, flanked by two companions whose entire vocabulary is "Gloubi".

3737610.name: Explosiovania
3737610.short_description: Rocket-jump using exploding fireballs, unlock abilities and master an ever-growing movement system. Explore the non-linear corners of the underworld, find secrets, defeat demons and reclaim the Eye of Evil.

4253020.name: Murder Meet Cute
4253020.short_description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

4867250.name: Murder Meet Cute Demo
4867250.short_description: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

4524550.name: Stoneborn
4524550.short_description: Stoneborn combines classic colony simulation with a vibrant dwarven culture. Your dwarves celebrate weddings, hold grudges, and fight to survive. Build a multi-level fortress and shape the story of your colony in a procedurally generated world.

5272980.name: Apewar - Capuchin Monkey
5272980.short_description: Unlock the Capuchin Monkey and bring this clever primate, known for curiosity and tool use, to APEWAR. Choose your Capuchin, join online battles, and add one of the primate world’s most resourceful monkeys to your collection!

5280990.name: Apewar - Bonobo
5280990.short_description: Unlock the Bonobo and bring this intelligent, curious, highly social primate to APEWAR. Fight online with a distinctive new character and add one of the primate world’s most fascinating species to your collection!

5281000.name: Apewar - African Chimpanzee
5281000.short_description: Unlock the African Chimpanzee and bring this intelligent, powerful, adaptable primate from the forests of Africa to APEWAR. Fight online with your new character and expand your primate collection!

3788140.name: Jet Scalawag: The King  of Shooters Demo
3788140.short_description: Fight the mother of all space battles in an epic space combat shooter to end all space combat shooters! In this demo, Jet Scalawag must shoot down the enemy fighters of the alien armada and survive their onslaught. Later features will involve the defence of earth's military forces and space station.

5241340.name: Inner City Unit Demo
5241340.short_description: Inner City Unit is a first person immersive sim about the narcotics trade in the surveillance city-state of Annexia. As an agent of an intelligence outfit, assume the identity of Albert Buchanan - part-time writer, part-time narcotics dealer. Procure product, push it across the city, don't get made.

5257760.name: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park Demo
5257760.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

4916750.name: クレアラ・セレクト
4916750.short_description: Creara is a spider woman with eight distinct personalities, held captive in a military facility. Investigate her biology over seven days and choose her fate in this biological-investigation romance adventure.

4945740.name: Nascor Descent
4945740.short_description: Awaken in a tower beyond death, where five realms conceal unspeakable horrors. Fight your way through a labyrinth of deadly traps and monstrous foes, and let your morality shape your path to salvation. Will you reclaim your life, or be lost to the depths forever?

5462560.name: Jar of Gnomes
5462560.short_description: An incremental colony game in an allotment garden. Hundreds of gnomlings pick berries, merge fruit in a magic cauldron and fling it through the air. When the run slows down, make jam: jars buy lasting upgrades in the Gnome Village under the compost heap.

1766500.name: Dread Pilots
1766500.short_description: Dread Pilots is a space survival game where you explore a mysterious and hostile pocket universe called the Dread. Scavenge resources, upgrade your ship, make friends, and fight monsters as you try to carve out a little piece of the Dread for yourself.

4482090.name: A-01的宇宙航行日记
4482090.short_description: 人类已经死去。一个在宇宙里漂流的人工智能，在无法自杀的绝对清醒中，咀嚼庞大而无处安放的算力，独自面对整个宇宙的衰亡。

5287000.name: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles demo
5287000.short_description: Dual Cultivation: Sword Immortal Chronicles is a male-oriented xianxia romance adventure game. Explore the martial world, meet unique female cultivators, grow stronger through cultivation, unlock character stories and intimate interactions, and embark on a journey of dual cultivation.

4922240.name: Deadline Dinner Demo
4922240.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite restaurant management game! 30days.$1,000,000. Save the restaurant! Build your restaurant, upgrade recipes, hire staff, and create powerful combos. Every run brings new chefs, recipes, and items. Discover hidden synergies, master different strategies, unlock multiple endings!

5019650.name: Glowstick Pirates: Harem Conquest Demo
5019650.short_description:
Set sail in a pirate JRPG!
Rackham was cursed with a glowing cock by a mysterious pirate. To break it, he sets sail as a pirate alongside Anne. Take on pirate crews across the seas and conquer them all! Crush rival factions, recruit everyone you meet, and build a harem pirate crew of your very own!!

5175830.name: Naughty Shelf Pack
5175830.short_description: A hidden shelf, a little extra spice, and something you won’t find in an ordinary anime shop. Expand your collection with 3 cheeky new manga, 6 new dakimakura, a new feet-focused main menu camera angle, and the option to remove the heroine’s stockings.

5230880.name: Whodunit Sudoku Demo
5230880.short_description: This is a logic puzzle blending Sudoku with murder mystery deduction. Place suspects using row-and-column rules on illustrated crime scenes, then read spatial clues and room boundaries to deduce who was left alone with the victim. Pure logic, no guessing.

4527430.name: Pigeon: A Love Story Demo
4527430.short_description: Find one pigeon among millions in this needle-in-a-haystack sim that's about nothing and everything.

4654930.name: Elta: Defy All Gods - Demo
4654930.short_description: Master a blend of free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration in the Elta: Defy All Gods demo. Experience the beginning of the adrenaline-fueled action-platformer and become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

4664870.name: Farming Simulator 25: Pumps n' Hoses Pack
4664870.short_description: Upgrade your farm with umbilical systems, manure separation and configurable biogas plants! New machines, tools and buildings expand your infrastructure for manure distribution and resource storage. More than 30 items from Schouten, Stallkamp, BvL and 2G are included.

4665050.name: Kitaria Fables 2 Demo
4665050.short_description: Join new heroes Alice and Dusty as they take their first steps into the wilds of the Arkadera Peninsula in the Kitaria Fables 2 demo! Get to know the locals of Whitewall Town, help them with their requests, and explore the breezy coastal lowlands, either alone or with a friend!

4684390.name: Grandma Left Me A Building Demo
4684390.short_description: A cozy apartment management sim where you restore the ruined building your grandma left you. Find tenants, collect rent, upgrade the place. But don't make the mistake of having a midnight guitar-shredding elf and a philosophy-lecturing yeti as neighbors. Endless requests, sweet chaos await.

4817140.name: Expedition of the Guild Demo
4817140.short_description: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

3720190.name: Palia - Starter Pack
3720190.short_description: Incredible value! Purchases will receive double the normal amount of Palia Coins, 850, as well as the Greenhouse Herbalist outfit and an exclusive Palcat pet. Start your journey off strong in Palia with the Starter Pack!

3823590.name: From The Ashes Expansion - Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™
3823590.short_description: Continue your adventure on Pandora with the From the Ashes expansion, inspired by the new Avatar: Fire and Ash film.

3907910.name: Cutout Village
3907910.short_description: Build your own little paper village in this relaxing city-builder focused on building and crafting. Cut, fold and glue to help it grow, discover its story and join its inhabitants as they slowly bring life back to its streets.

4057370.name: World War Z x The Walking Dead
4057370.short_description: A new crossover episode with AMC's The Walking Dead. Play as Rick Grimes, Daryl Dixon, Michonne, and Negan as they fight through hordes of dangerous new slower-moving Walkers across The Prison, Alexandria Safe Zone and Grady Memorial Hospital.

2168390.name: Away Team
2168390.short_description: Away Team is a new Oxygen Not Included game. Mistakenly shipped off to an alien world, you will need to harness the environment and master temperature, pressure, chemical reactions and more in order to survive, and possibly, thrive.

3005000.name: Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™ – The Sky Breaker
3005000.short_description: A mysterious shadow looms in the sky, threatening the Na’vi clans below who are celebrating at their great festival of games in the first story pack for Avatar: Frontiers of Pandora™, The Sky Breaker.

3288930.name: WILD Tactics Demo
3288930.short_description: A character-driven turn-based tactical strategy game where planning and positioning decide every fight. Lead a squad of wild agents with shady pasts through high-pressure missions, manage their relationships, and make hard calls that shape every operation in the crime-ridden city of Clawville.

5403540.name: DULL ACHE
5403540.short_description: A horrifying JRPG-inspired adventure follows a sequence of events that multiple people experience after one fateful day... Find their wills to live throughout a multi-chapter story.

5356230.name: CAPITALIUM 资本纪元 Demo
5356230.short_description: Industrial Revolution sim of trade and politics: open factories, swallow rivals, lobby MPs. Rivals may grab supplies, cut you off, refuse your orders or quietly buy your shares. Or team up, raise prices and split the market. Win a royal charter, run rails to the frontier, found a town in your name.

2494230.name: Fate/Samurai Remnant - Additional Episode 1 "Record's Fragment: Keian Command Championship"
2494230.short_description: The boss suddenly announces the commencement of Keian Command Championship. The winner is given a wish granter, and thus the contestants of the Waxing Moon Ritual begin fighting, all the while the Divine Spirit Ibuki-Douji smiles bewitchingly...

2504220.name: Europa Universalis IV: 10th Anniversary Community Music Pack
2504220.short_description: This pack is free for all Europa Universalis IV players, and includes almost 40 minutes of original music with themes of exploration and expansion, suitable as a score for the grandest of ambitions.

3280980.name: Mimic Alert
3280980.short_description:
You are on a service to detect and destroy mimics — creatures capable of taking the form of any object. Carefully inspect your surroundings and use all your attentiveness to detect them.

Play the full campaign in online two-player co-op with a friend.

2122800.name: Leap of Faith - In Game Walkthrough/Extra material
2122800.short_description: Additional content for Leap of Faith

1751921.name: Curious Expedition 2 - Robots of Lux
1751921.short_description: The exploration roguelike of Curious Expedition and the robotic pirates from SteamWorld Heist come together for the best collaboration of the industrial age.

1506700.name: Room 54 Soundtrack
1506700.short_description: Room 54 Official Soundtrack, created by Michael Ellery.

1533930.name: IWOCon 2021 Pirate Soundtrack
1533930.short_description: Featuring 19 songs and over 50 minutes of music - The IWOCon Pirate Soundtrack is a FREE collection of songs composed by indie musicians and supporters in various genres.

1557570.name: 仙劍奇俠傳 原聲音樂精選集

1559030.name: Anoyo: zero Original Soundtrack
1559030.short_description: Original Soundtrack of Anoyo:zero in lossless MP3 format, featuring 16 tracks totalling twenty-three minutes (23m) of cool, dark and dynamic music.

1583250.name: Space Otter Charlie Soundtrack
1583250.short_description: The Space Otter Charlie Official Soundtrack is the perfect compilation of all the space-y synth-y tracks you love from otter space.

1093890.name: QPet
1093890.short_description: One day, you found a lost little QPet. You feed her and play with her, and she soon makes herself at home on your screen. She works, plays, and dances to music—and even brings friends, turning your desktop into a lively, warm, and heartwarming little world.

5445630.name: The Washing Case
5445630.short_description: Relax and wash years of grime off antique objects, layer by layer, until they shine. Along the way, look for the marks hidden under the dirt: together they form a code that opens the next room. The further you go, the bigger the objects get – from pocket watches to giant monuments.

5305650.name: Learn To Rock
5305650.short_description: Learn To Rock – Học Cách Chơi Rock is an indie game developed by Trịnh Productions. The game is a mix of Adventure, Action, Rhythm, Simulation, and is set in Vietnam 2026. Playing as Trịnh, players will practice, overcome various challenges and recruit new members to complete his rock band.

539260.name: Europa Universalis IV: Evangelical Majors Unit Pack
539260.short_description: The Evangelical Majors Unit Pack adds 8 new unique units to the Evangelical Major nations in Europe - Sweden, Brandenburg/Prussia and France.

5080930.name: Quartermark Demo
5080930.short_description: The first 100 floors of Quartermark. Your party fights on its own — you decide who is in it and what they carry. Everything you earn here carries into the full game.

4027770.name: My Ex-Future Family Season 2: Walkthrough
4027770.short_description: Guide to completing the second season. Uncover all the secrets, explore every nook and cranny, and fill up your gallery!

5061040.name: Quartermark
5061040.short_description: Your party fights on its own. Who stands in it and what they carry is your call — and that is the whole game. 16 heroes, 9 keywords that chain into gold combos, 100 maps, 440 grotesque 3D monsters, 100 bosses and an upgrade ladder that can destroy your best item.

5440830.name: Moorlet
5440830.short_description: Build a tiny island, place the curses that threaten it, and defend your village when night falls. Connect terrain tiles, gather resources and raise your defenses in a compact island builder where every new piece of land brings another decision.

3697760.name: My Ex-Future Family Season 2 Premium Edition
3697760.short_description: My Ex-Future Family is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the fun parts of human life. The game is packed with humor, sex, romance and plot turnings. Play as a young man who seduces girls who surround him, complete tasks of the Principal and build your life in house of your family!

5075360.name: Tidy Up the Library of Alexandria
5075360.short_description: Cozy first-person organizing game. Sort 4,800 scrolls of 21 real ancient alphabets back onto the shelves of the Library of Alexandria, where every cat wants a toy: find it to get the scroll it guards! Play solo, or tidy up together in online co-op and split screen!

5139780.name: Devour & Evolve
5139780.short_description: You are born at the bottom of the food chain, in a first-person maze that grows more dangerous the deeper it runs. Weaken your prey, then choose: devour it, or bind it and carry it home. What you carry home lives in your nest, pairs, and lays — and the egg it lays is the body you wake up in next.

5307970.name: 迷宮下剋上 Demo
5307970.short_description: Play the opening of Devour & Evolve. Crawl a first-person dungeon as its weakest monster, weaken prey, then devour it or bind it as kindred. Evolve, build a nest, and challenge the first warden in this approximately 30-minute demo.

5447060.name: Card Heroes: Rune Deck
5447060.short_description: Fantasy turn-based card battler. Time your charges, chain five-element counters and rage-fueled ultimates. Conquer 15 dungeons across three difficulty tiers, brave the trial tower, duel a ranked arena, collect 541 cards and become the Rune Master.

5223510.name: GuGuGaGa-DeskPet
5223510.short_description:
The little penguin that shakes its head and makes that goofy "GuGuGaGa" sound – a viral meme across the internet – has now come to your desktop!
Different interactions will trigger her unique reactions – after all, she is that very meme penguin with all those expressive emotes!

4344280.name: 1000 Rooms
4344280.short_description: 1000 Rooms is a co-operative action horror FPS, that takes place across multiple worlds and realities. Kill countless hordes of the undead with over 1 MILLION weapons.

4588890.name: Hack Protocol
4588890.short_description: Hack Protocol is a multiplayer hacking sim where you build software, breach servers, steal data, upgrade your hardware, and cover your tracks. Play solo against NPCs but watch out for other players to compete with other hackers. Clean your logs!

5453510.name: DEGUL DEGUL 999 Demo
5453510.short_description: Try 45 rolling logic puzzles from the 999 campaign: five from each of nine difficulty sections. Plan your route and landing faces, undo freely, and sample puzzles with a single cube, a long block, and two interacting blocks.

5117490.name: Punch The Monkey
5117490.short_description: Action boss rush game where every fight is a final boss. Throw bananas, dodge attacks, and learn the patterns of hostile animal bosses in the zoo. You have one goal. Find your stolen plushie.

5244680.name: Ray Ray Zombies
5244680.short_description: Ray Ray Zombies is the new lightweight generation of zombie survival horror. Survive waves of undead and discover the elemental secrets of the Wonderplex Corporation with Ray Ray and his team.

5500520.name: The Last Shop Before Kingsfall Demo

5482600.name: NoveCard
5482600.short_description: NoveCard is a relaxed solo strategy card game. Each round, score three of five cards and hold two for the next. Nine rounds, nine scoring categories—each used once. Swapped cards go to the bottom of the deck in order and may return as it cycles. Balance scoring, holding, and swapping to aim higher.

4727800.name: Dyna-Brix
4727800.short_description:
Dyna-brix is the new indie brick breaker game.
Destroy bricks on dynamic levels to an original and dynamic soundtrack, with precise controls and physics and minimalistic and readable visuals.

2974100.name: CPA:Reports Bousy
2974100.short_description: Experience the constant fear and loneliness surrounded by the decrepit old walls of an abandoned house with a tragic story, while feeling the true horror of being hunted by a creature created from a strong friendship. Try to survive and escape the house!

4847660.name: Resort Architect
4847660.short_description: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!

4268260.name: Ashenburrow
4268260.short_description: An underground survival and simulation game. Wildlife hunts, NPCs make camp, talk and fight… with or without you. Lead your expedition, alone or with up to four players, and remember: even underground, night falls.

2482110.name: Rogue Mech
2482110.short_description: Take control of a rogue mech pilot in a world of ash and ruthless factions. Explore the wasteland, upgrade your arsenal and forge alliances. Create a safe haven, grow crops and scavenge for resources in this hearty, post-apocalyptic adventure.

5454550.name: Savebot: The Last Garden
5454550.short_description: A sleeping planet. A few robots who know nothing yet. And you, who know how to write programs. Teach them, block by block, to take care of the world, until life comes back on its own, across five worlds.

5335640.name: 咕咕嘎嘎-小企鹅 Demo
5335640.short_description:
The little penguin that shakes its head and makes that goofy "GuGuGaGa" sound – a viral meme across the internet – has now come to your desktop!
Different interactions will trigger her unique reactions – after all, she is that very meme penguin with all those expressive emotes!

5259590.name: TIC.EXE
5259590.short_description: Three in a row is not a win — it is a discharge. A tactical grid roguelite: fight hostile processes on a shifting board, build an engine out of 30 modules, and clear eight sectors before the machine answers its own launch request.

3840430.name: FalseGods Gambit
3840430.short_description: "FalseGod's Gambit" is a Roquelike deck-building game (DBG) infused with our unique ideas, set against a backdrop of Norsemytholoay, Plavers will step into the boots of veteran soldier Rod, embarking on his final mission before retirement!

4655350.name: The Primeval Demo
4655350.short_description: The Primeval is a survival horror game in which players take on the role of Runchan, a newly arrived transfer student, searching for a way to escape from a school overrun by out-of-control experimental subjects.

4747680.name: Cardelis
4747680.short_description: A competitive pixel art card collecting game. Open boosters, build your deck and face real players in PvP. Climb the leaderboard and prove you're the best!

5179460.name: Motocross The Force Demo
5179460.short_description: Motocross The Force is a physics-driven motocross game that's easy to pick up and hard to master. Race online, push your limits, and chase the perfect lap.
developers: SHANGHAI CHAPEROT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.
publishers: SHANGHAI CHAPEROT SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY CO., LTD.

3826380.name: Lunaton: Rescue mission
3826380.short_description: 🐾 Transform an abandoned island into a thriving resort! Time moves in real time, and the seasons change weekly. Hire townspeople, collect evening profits, tend to your farm, and explore the neighboring mystical islands by train at your own pace.

5216520.name: Deepstrata Demo
5216520.short_description: Fly a small mining pod down through the rock. Fill the hold with ore, get back up before the fuel runs out, sell it, and buy a bigger drill. Build a base on the surface and hold it when the critters come at night. Luna, Mars, Io and Callisto, with a guardian machine asleep under each.

2847780.name: Nocturnal 2
2847780.short_description: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

4641550.name: Kegs of Eternity
4641550.short_description: A roguelite deckbuilder starring seven stubborn dwarves. Build unique decks, slay cursed monsters, crawl procedural dungeons, drink plenty of beer, find broken synergies, and rebuild your ruined town, one keg, one combo, one dwarf at a time.

4693240.name: Revenant Survivors Demo
4693240.short_description: Revenant Survivors is a horde survival action roguelite set in a Diablo-inspired dark fantasy world. Tear through endless hordes with hard-hitting combat, absorb souls, steal bosses’ skills, and even take their bodies to become evil incarnate.

5308380.name: Remains of the Slime Realm
5308380.short_description:
You've been hired to explore a mine in search of valuable minerals, but... who cares about rocks when there are slime girls inside?

Grab your camera and fill your album with slimy girls. Gotta catch 'em all!

4987380.name: Honey 2 Orbit Demo
4987380.short_description: A fast-paced futanari action rpg. Challenging mob encounters, bosses, puzzles, romance arcs, collectables, mini games, hentai scenes & more!

4207260.name: Party To Oblivion
4207260.short_description: Fall in love and relax with gorgeous women! Build the Greatest Festival of Pleasure of this era & improve your skills to seduce all the ladies in this incremental dating sim~

2485410.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
2485410.short_description:
Placid Plastic Duck in multiplayer? With races, minigames, and a shared pool for up to 50 players?
Yes! Chill with friends and become the pool’s most distinguished duck!

4228680.name: Tamzin Twins Demo
4228680.short_description: A story based action RPG with split screen co-op. On their path to revenge Enya and Kyra will discover what it means to be leaders, to be chivalrous, and how to be queens.

4281210.name: SUBJECT 404
4281210.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game where rapid-fire microgames become a system of obedience. Read the Panel’s commands, react before time runs out, and survive each room — or face the Executioner.

1287690.name: Astro Pirates
1287690.short_description: Space pirate co-op hack-and-slash roguelike flight shooter game-description-salad!

5323210.name: Dead Last
5323210.short_description: Dead Last is a horror party game for 2-8 friends where the monsters are only half the danger. Survive terrifying minigames, use items to save yourself and sabotage everyone else, and whatever you do, don't finish dead last.

3863690.name: Bet Shop Simulator Demo
3863690.short_description: Run the neighborhood betting shop! Print bet slips, count out change and watch the match with your customers. A goal shakes the whole shop, a losing slip gets a TV smashed. Clean up, decorate, expand.

2889220.name: Nik and Kit
2889220.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, 1980s arcade era video game in the Nik and Kit franchise!

2201980.name: Hentai Beach 2
2201980.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting journey to the sunny beach, where beautiful girls are waiting for you, ready for any adventure! Don't miss the chance to feel like a real hero of erotic fantasy in this exciting clicker game!

4363160.name: Snake.io
4363160.short_description: Develop your skills, try to survive as much as you can and become the biggest snake around! Start as a small snake and get bigger by eating other snakes who try to do the same. Attack wisely, defend skillfully – the best one wins. How long can you hold the throne?

4024550.name: Temple Siege TD
4024550.short_description: Relaxing 3D fantasy tower defense game with an RPG/MOBA vibe: Hero-towers, distinct roles, unique abilities, powerful combos and rising challenge.

5003840.name: Five Nines - Datacenter Simulator
5003840.short_description: Build and run your own datacenter in first person, solo or in 4-player co-op. Rack servers, hand-route every RJ45, fiber and power cable, meet your SLAs, survive outages and chase the five nines: 99.999% uptime.

5157990.name: Backmarkers Demo
5157990.short_description: Three race weekends with the worst team in the National League. Two cars, live pit-wall strategy, fuel and tire calls as the weather turns, and a garage full of parts nobody can quite vouch for. A slice of the full racing management sim.

5428130.name: Klocky
5428130.short_description: The world moves too fast. Spread an old drawing under the lamp, fit the gears one by one, and hear the machine you built tick for the first time. Klocky is a calm clockwork-building game where every tooth really drives the next.

3208460.name: Rogue Braver
3208460.short_description: A Classic Turn-Based Roguelike RPG with Procedurally Generated Dungeons

5283210.name: Crossfire
5283210.short_description: Crossfire 2D — a crazy 2D action where every wall is deadly. Ricochets, ragdoll physics, and paranoia. Survive the chaos of multiplayer battles!

1526940.name: Trains Together
1526940.short_description: Trains Together is a relaxing cargo railway builder. Build your train empire, starting with small steps - lay tracks, transport goods and refine the routes as they transform into a dense, optimized system. Play with your friends or solo!

5461760.name: Abyss Walker
5461760.short_description: Abyss Walker is a 2D side-scrolling action RPG. Chain attacks and skills, defeat dungeon bosses and turn reward cards. Challenge the abyss for equipment drops, compare stats and set bonuses, then return to town to upgrade your gear for the next fight.

5126090.name: 薪世录 测试版 Demo
5126090.short_description: Xin Shi Lu is a thrilling action-adventure RPG. Meet Fan Xin and start a new life. Explore a mysterious world, grow stronger in combat, and forge bonds with companions. Expand your influence and define your own legendary story.

2889210.name: Zippy the Circle
2889210.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, 3D polygonal rendered action adventure video game in the Zippy the Circle franchise!

5169810.name: Strich Gauntlet
5169810.short_description: Race giant ostriches, hurl weapons, and boost, jump and glide past traps. Conquer a solo Championship or race up to six players online across five official maps, with more planned. Create and share tracks with the Track Designer, and relive supported offline and online races with cinematic replays.

5463930.name: Cats to Mars：Planet Myao Myao
5463930.short_description:
The cats have successfully colonized Mars. But there are too many cats, and the oxygen is running out. Their next destination: Planet Myao Myao.
A new migration project begins now——

4506440.name: Snake Up
4506440.short_description: Snake Up is a snake-themed endless runner game where the snake can grow longer or shorter, step on its own body, and climb obstacles. You can use unique mechanics to overcome obstacles until reaching the top.

4919680.name: Space Lot
4919680.short_description: Spin. Match. Expand the universe. Upgrade symbols, combine rules, and expand the board itself in this cosmic slot incremental game.

5385950.name: 阿飛 AFEI
5385950.short_description: A fruit fly in a glass box on a windowsill. Place fruit, tap the glass and watch it walk, eat and fly, across 20 tasks. Its brain is a simplified model built from the published wiring map of a fly's central nervous system. Program assists are labelled. See the model fire on the brain map.

4411720.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
4411720.short_description: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

5397100.name: Witch’s Cottage: Tidy Up the Potions!
5397100.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying game with magical upgrades. Sort over 3,000 potions in a four-storey witch’s cottage. Find matching bottles, complete sets and unlock spells that summon potions to your hands and send them onto shelves. Turn a magical mess into a collection worth admiring.

5421290.name: Ember and Ash: The Cradle
5421290.short_description: A fantasy story game about a long road and the people who walk it with you. Choose your path, fight with timing and skill, grow close to your companions, and face an ending shaped by every choice you made.

5467480.name: The Cat Protocol
5467480.short_description: School’s out, the holidays begin… but one phone call changes everything. To save his cat Titi from the clutches of a mysterious stranger, Tom must embark on a quest filled with puzzles and secrets. The holidays will have to wait!

4908160.name: Sweet Memories
4908160.short_description:
Enjoy a colorful and perfect Halloween night. 
Just don't eat that candy... Please... I went to a lot of trouble to make everything better...

3784610.name: Foundlings
3784610.short_description: Guide two troubled mages through a civil war-torn 12th-century England in this spellcasting RPG. Forge spells by combining conduits, consort with cunning daemons, watch the motions of the planets and keep your Humours in check as you help them find their purpose.

4013150.name: Ondeh Ondeh Kaya's Tasty Tale
4013150.short_description: Join Kaya on her quest to become a Worldbuilder in this heartwarming puzzle action-adventure. Explore the whimsical world of Selera, inspired by the rich cultures of Southeast Asia, where rhythm powers exploration, puzzles, and combat in a heartfelt tale of family, courage, and self-discovery.

4995660.name: Racebound Garage
4995660.short_description: Your Assetto Corsa garage, reimagined as a living card collection. Race real circuits, earn rarity-tiered cards for every car in your library, and climb a full career ladder — from Sunday club racing to a 51-cup World Championship.

2398510.name: WhiteClothes-Purify!
2398510.short_description: ケモノの女の子がムチムチする系コマンドRPG、「WhiteClothes」がパワーアップしてついに完結！プレイ時間は本編合わせて80時間以上！笑いあり、涙あり、お腹いっぱい、胸いっぱいの冒険を続けよう！

3756460.name: Ascendora Demo
3756460.short_description: A first person horror game where you play as Harper, the child of an infamous scientist. You must explore his abandoned laboratory to find the answers you have been looking for. Unravel the secrets of your parents, but be aware, you might not be alone...

4763910.name: Legacy of Mind
