4763910.short_description: Legacy of Mind is the first gothic soulslike FPS where nightmares and reality have merged. Face colossal Monarchs that rule over the world overrun by living nightmares. Unlock otherworldy powers hidden within your mind, but with every power unlocked, something in the dark wakes with you...

3829320.name: Margin of Error
3829320.short_description: Princess Elyra is bound to a cursed grimoire. Lead her party through six monster-filled regions in this roguelite dungeon RPG, where every attack is a numbers puzzle: play number and operation cards to hit each enemy’s exact target. Miss it, and the dungeon makes you pay.

2376260.name: Mariachi Legends
2376260.short_description: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

5144170.name: 传传回收公司
5144170.short_description: ZZ SALVAGE CO. is a top-down light horror scavenging and extraction game for 1–4 players. Explore abandoned off-world research facilities, recover supplies and objects from old Earth, and face supernatural threats with limited visibility. Search one more room, or escape with your haul?

5106900.name: Backmarkers
5106900.short_description: Take over the worst team on the grid and run all of it — drivers, sponsors, the garage, every pit call. Climb a living three-tier racing pyramid where rivals rise and fall around you, in a broadcast-style management sim that remembers every result.

4991450.name: FRAGLINE: Esports Manager Demo
4991450.short_description: Build an esports org from a scrappy roster into a world champion. Scout raw talent, design your own set plays, and outcoach rivals who adapt to your tactics. Grind from open qualifiers to grand finals in a scene where every win and loss makes headlines.

4288390.name: Um Al-Saaf
4288390.short_description: On Filka Island: Explore the abandoned clinic, collect items, solve puzzles, and unlock doors while avoiding Aunt Safa. Can you find the treasure and escape before she catches you?

3185470.name: Forgiveness RPG: The First Chapter
3185470.short_description: A Christian-themed, story driven, japanese-styled role playing video game in the Forgiveness RPG franchise!

5302790.name: FrQ
5302790.short_description: FrQ is a collection of audio-reactive arcade games and music visualizer where your music becomes the game. Play anything you like through Spotify, YouTube or your favorite music app, then watch as the gameplay, levels and psychedelic visuals react to your music in real time.

4724720.name: 异世界火锅店模拟器 Demo
4724720.short_description: Play a focused demo of a cozy hand-drawn hot pot restaurant sim in an isekai village. Plan the day's menu, buy and prepare ingredients, seat fantasy guests, manage the dinner rush, and use each night's results to decide the next step for your little shop.

5342390.name: Eternal Blade Demo
5342390.short_description: An open-world souls-like built around the parry. Switch weapons mid-parry to counter, build Almighty Power, and unleash supernatural abilities. Play as Emerald, a rebellious hero called by a prophecy, searching the Baransu Realm for the Almighty Gemstones to free her father from an eternal curse.

5076930.name: DOTS VS PIXELS Demo
5076930.short_description: POINT CLOUDS HAVE INVADED YOUR FAVORITE PIXEL ART APP. Up to 1,000,000,000,000 dots flow like a fluid, hunt your core and chew through everything you paint. Your only power: the pencil. Draw walls, survive the siege, unlock broken builds. BUILD. RESIST. OVERFLOW.

4952350.name: Defense The Drone
4952350.short_description: Drone swarms close in from every side: survive 10 minutes until reinforcements arrive. Level up mid-fight, build and modify 11 towers, break shields with the right damage type and bring down giant bosses in this neon roguelite tower defense.

3218570.name: TANUKI: Pon's Summer
3218570.short_description: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

5490450.name: NeoTanker
5490450.short_description: Tiny tanks, big decisions. A turn-based tactics game where every tile changes the odds: capture cities, build your army and outplay a sharp robot general, a friend, or anyone online. Free, no ads, no pay-to-win.

4879830.name: IVORY
4879830.short_description: IVORY is a story-rich, cold weather survival game with cosmic-horror elements. Enjoy the twists and turns of its gripping, dark narrative and rich lore as you explore two open-world locations dripping with psychological terror. Play as a man driven toward his grim fate by cowardice and greed.

4468520.name: Rift Haul TD
4468520.short_description: Build, upgrade, evolve, and reposition your towers to counter new threats, explore powerful synergies, and stay one step ahead in this fast-paced fantasy tower defense.

5156680.name: Leafborn Demo
5156680.short_description: Leafborn is a fast-paced action game where you command a being made of thousands of leaves. Explore a universe of floating islands, discover new abilities, shapeshift, and mercilessly tear apart Nulls robots draining this world's life energy!

5382240.name: I SUCK DICKS AND HATE AI
5382240.short_description: A game for anyone who loves hating on AI games and, of course, sucking dicks in the evening. Hunt down slop, leave comments, collect dicks and beat the bosses!

4429720.name: Deductopia
4429720.short_description: Explore the scenes, find clues, and sort out people, pets, and belongings in this cozy slice-of-life detective puzzle game. Fans of Little Problems and The Case of the Worst Day Ever will enjoy this new deduction game for all ages.

4119020.name: Doomed Crew
4119020.short_description: Co-op Horror (1-4 players). Enemies mimic your teammates, environment lies to you. A brutal corporation promises you freedom, can your team survive the chaos?

5061070.name: One Line Wonder
5061070.short_description: The one-line puzzle, with fresh twists on the familiar rules. Find your own route through tangled paths and enjoy the satisfaction of seeing complexity fall into place.

5237430.name: Chef Knight: Desktop Adventures
5237430.short_description: Run a fantasy restaurant on your desktop while exploring dungeons for fresh monster ingredients. Cook, serve, upgrade, decorate, and grow your shop while you work, play, or relax.

4536600.name: Thieves and Tasers
4536600.short_description: A fast-paced PvP heist game for 3–6 players. Work together as Thieves to sneak and steal loot, or hunt down your friends as Guards. Tasers included.

4971410.name: Tankii
4971410.short_description: A slow paced, multiplayer bullet hell where everyone is a tank.

5424250.name: Survivor Joe Lost Island - Conquest
5424250.short_description: Stranded on an island after a job for The Jodfather goes wrong, Comrade Joe must find his own way forward. Explore, raise armies, conquer settlements, trade, forge alliances, and shape the island's future in a sandbox campaign with multiple endings.

4290750.name: Wacky Coursers
4290750.short_description: Wacky Coursers is a chaotic parkour racing game where you run, jump, shrink, smash, flip gravity 🙃, fly with wings 🪽, and get launched through surprise tubes 🌀. Race solo or online—and laugh your way to the finish! 🏁😄

4542390.name: Simon and Friends
4542390.short_description:
No heroes. No villains. Just friends.
Pilot a diverse cast of characters through battles across destructible terrain.
Level up your team to unlock more powerful weapons and tools.
Utilize abilities and passives unique to each unit to gain an edge.
Winning optional. Chaos mandatory. Fun guaranteed.

4924030.name: Malleus
4924030.short_description: A roguelite carnival arcade where a simple game of strength becomes a fight for your soul. Face an eldritch Game Master, master his rigged Hi-Striker, strategize, bargain, and ring the bell—or lose your soul forever.

5392520.name: Realpolitiks 4: Back to the Roots
5392520.short_description: Realpolitiks 4 returns to its roots. Lead your chosen nation in an accessible real-time strategy game. Develop your economy, shape politics, forge alliances and plan military operations. Face the crises of the 21st century and chart your own path to power!

5397090.name: Seal Way Demo
5397090.short_description: Always dreamed of knowing what it feels like to be a seal, but life keeps getting in the way of basking in the sun and eating fish? Here’s your chance! Explore the aquarium, solve puzzles, avoid dangers, and find your way home. We offer you a colorful world, mesmerizing scenery, and much more!

5161820.name: TRENCHWORMS
5161820.short_description: Dig, swing and blast through real-time worm battles. Choose from 26 weapons and fight on destructible maps or rope-focused arenas. Play a 15 mission campaign, battle bots, share a keyboard, connect 2-6 controllers, or take up to six players online.

4759420.name: Brick Mayhem
4759420.short_description: A physics-based autobattler where tiny plastic warriors battle across fully destructible fortresses. Customize your army, unleash explosive sieges, and enjoy chaotic brick-filled destruction.

5359410.name: Zero G Nova Adventure
5359410.short_description: Zero G Nova Adventure is a free-to-play online space sandbox. Fly through galaxies of real stars, black holes and nebulae, mine and craft, build bases, trade with other pilots and fight in PvP. Host your own server or join friends with a code.

5390450.name: Reel to the Stars
5390450.short_description: Drag your bobber and reel in a whole screen of fish! Upgrade your rod, grow a huge skill tree, and fish your way from a quiet pond through the Arctic, the deep sea and the Dragon Palace all the way to outer space. A cozy fishing incremental with 278 fish species and your own aquarium.

3367530.name: OpenCAGE
3367530.short_description: OpenCAGE is a community-created modding toolkit for Alien: Isolation which gives access to scripting, assets, configurations, and behaviour trees.

5177840.name: HEARTSLOT
5177840.short_description: Pull the lever, pay each day’s installment, and build a luck-bending skill set across a 12-day contract. Raise a holographic robot’s affection, push the machine into overclock, and survive every bill until the robot of your dreams is finally yours.

5427900.name: The Last Shop Before Kingsfall
5427900.short_description: Run the last shop on the road to Kingsfall in this cozy first-person medieval shop sim. Stock your shelves, set your prices and outfit the heroes who pass through. They have names. Out there, they can die for good. What you sell them decides who comes back.

3136000.name: They Are Rising
3136000.short_description: They Are Rising is an RTS strategy game set against the backdrop of the apocalypse. Combine skills, build a massive army, establish shelters, and fight against large numbers of enemies. How long can you survive?

5044520.name: Sea Beast Odyssey
5044520.short_description: An incremental action game set across the seas. Lead a party of 5 Heroes, upgrade your heroes and mounts, unlock 16 powerful skills, and build your skill tree as you fight through 35 levels of sea monsters. Defeat giant bosses and tame them as mounts for your next adven

4186590.name: Captain Contraption’s Safari Park
4186590.short_description: A pixel-art run based safari park sim. Clone lions, medieval knights and sentient trucks into a park with no fences, then route your visitors past the chaos. You control the paths, the buildings and your robot staff. The one thing you don’t control is the animals.

5151020.name: Aleryos : Le Réveil des Monarques
5151020.short_description: Aleryos is a free-to-play persistent space strategy MMO. Develop your planets, design fleets, master the Pillars, confront rival players and PvE threats, and build an alliance powerful enough to dominate the galaxy.

4652140.name: Dice Shepherd: Incremental
4652140.short_description: A small incremental game about rolling d4 to d100 dice on a grassy field. Every roll pays gold and fodder. Spend it on promotions and skills that sinergize. Play it idle or hands-on, the numbers keep climbing.

5169980.name: Impious Demo
5169980.short_description: Impious is a dark turn-based RPG set in a world where human imperfection is no longer tolerated, those deemed impious are captured and dragged underground. You wake inside a system designed to break you and your only way is forward:fight, negotiate, gear up and find your way out.

4733470.name: 无限循环
4733470.short_description: Infinite Loop is an unconventional roguelike bullet-hell idle incremental game. Fight monsters, loot, and level up in an ever-running world of code—your levels, skills, talents, and chips stay forever. No run resets: the longer you play, the stronger you get.

4953670.name: WAZATO: Sabotage or Mistake?
4953670.short_description: Sabotage or Mistake? A 4-player online party game mixing co-op action with social deduction. Three Crew work together while one hidden Spy sabotages the team. Read your friends’ moves and excuses, then face a final showdown shaped by your mission results.

1635500.name: Elements Destiny
1635500.short_description: Use the power of the elements and face your destiny. Elements Destiny is a 2D Fantasy RPG with pixelated retro visuals. An emotional journey with a deep story, challenging turn based combat and handcrafted artworks. And yes, the soundtrack is massive!

5057380.name: Gloomy Tavern Stories
5057380.short_description: A fantasy potion crafting game where you experience the life of an alchemist. Gather materials that you can craft into different types of potions. Potions can be used as bombs. Solve puzzles by utilizing the effects of your potions. Hire heroes as mercenaries to battle monsters and bosses.

4507410.name: Locked in love : The Office
4507410.short_description: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

2874440.name: BallsyDrop
2874440.short_description: Do you like causing chain reactions? BallsyDrop is a satisfying physics puzzler where one perfectly placed ball can set off massive chain reactions. Navigate through various levels with teleporters, blockades and score extra points with the timed balls!

5313690.name: It Will Open
5313690.short_description: You are a newly hired night-shift employee at the Arden Hotel. While controlling access to the parking lot and responding to guest complaints, you begin to experience a series of suspicious and disturbing events. Uncover the secret hidden within the hotel—and survive.

5317010.name: Temple of Glyphs Demo
5317010.short_description: No text, no tutorials—only glyphs and puzzles. Decipher the true meaning behind every enigmatic symbol, connect tiles to reshape the world, and uncover the secrets of the ancient temple.

1670160.name: Ablight
1670160.short_description: Ablight is a classic real-time strategy game set in an alternate universe where diesel, cyberpunk and medieval aesthetics meet. Join the rebellion against the zealotic Inquisition, who have been mankinds scourge for hundreds of years and fight a war for survival. Freedom is within reach!

4764690.name: PROWLER PURGE
4764690.short_description: Hunt, don't survive. Grow stronger by defeating your prey, risk everything for hidden power, and create unique skill builds in this fast-paced action roguelike.

5388310.name: Padako
5388310.short_description: Bring a cute companion to your desktop! PADAKO is a desktop companion and dress-up game. Type on your keyboard or click your mouse and watch your little buddy respond. Mix and match your favorite outfits to add a little joy to work, study, and everyday downtime.

5320350.name: Friendship Boat
5320350.short_description: Rock the boat. Test your friendship. Push, grab and throw your way through a physics party for 2–4 players, or try to keep a tiny boat afloat together in a chaotic two-player voyage. Rescue your friend, cause the next disaster, and let the aftermath do the talking.

4251460.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
4251460.short_description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

2295170.name: Emberville
2295170.short_description: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

2476610.name: Summoner Arise
2476610.short_description: Turn-based. Tactics. Roguelike. Summon units and battle your way past wave after wave of enemies. Start with a fixed amount of mana as you ascend a mysterious ruined world. Run out and you lose. With 300+ upgrades available, customize and command your army to victory!

4634660.name: Your Friends Vs Hidebehind
4634660.short_description: A co-op survival horror game for 1-6 players. Record your real scream and it plays back when it takes you. Explore a procedurally generated forest, deny it by facing the terror, and escape before the forest decides you're staying.

2956780.name: An Archers Fate
2956780.short_description: Try the first ten waves free. Hold, aim, release at the perfect moment: time every shot, dash through attacks, build your archer from 22 upgrades and bring down the Iron Warden, then take on Heat. The full game goes much deeper, with more bosses, arenas and endless waves.

5234980.name: Wickwood
5234980.short_description: A top-down pixel action game set across one long night. No crafting, no hunger, no inventory — just a bat, an axe, and a lantern burning down. The shrinking circle of light is the only clock you get. Find the parts for a dead car and drive out of Wickwood before the light goes.

4546880.name: Breaking Armor Demo
4546880.short_description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

4087530.name: Breaking Armor
4087530.short_description: Operate a super-heavy tank alone on a post-apocalyptic Earth. Face enemy tanks and alien beasts across deadly missions, and upgrade your tank to survive the escalating threats.

5124950.name: Flag Fiasco : Tidy Up
5124950.short_description: A cozy first-person tidy-up game where the whole world is a mess. Find 2,000 flags scattered across a grand oval room, spot the fakes, rescue flags from plushies and put every one back where it belongs on a giant world map. No timers, just order.

5279300.name: Story of The Needle In a Haystack Demo
5279300.short_description: A cozy co-op tidy-up game with a compelling story. Clear an old barn filled with hay, explore rooms, upgrade your tools, and sell what you collect. Team up with friends to uncover the story as you search for a tiny needle.

5282190.name: Log Drop Demo
5282190.short_description: A physics sandbox with one noble goal: get more logs into the core than physically reasonable. Chop the trees, build the contraption, then unleash a wave of logs for combo-fueled cash. Kick back and let it flow, or engineer the perfect cascade. Your sandbox, your rules.

5360210.name: Real Zombie Survivors Demo
5360210.short_description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

4881090.name: Dr. Oops! Demo
4881090.short_description:
Treat bizarre patients, solve outrageous medical mysteries, and pay off your crushing debt in this dark comedy deduction adventure!
Every diagnosis relies on your observation, deduction, and some real-world knowledge. Pay off your debt, or skip a payment if needed, and fight for your freedom.

5010570.name: From Basement with Love Demo
5010570.short_description: Conduct a high-stakes espionage operation at the height of the Cold War. Intercept and decipher classified intelligence to uncover a hidden threat. Break codes, cover your tracks, and escape before it’s too late.

5066210.name: Necrofinity Demo
5066210.short_description: Raise an ever-growing undead army. Put your skeletons to work. Conquer new regions and expand your necropolis! Death is only the beginning in this dark fantasy incremental game. There's work to do...

5146350.name: Infinite Loop: Incremental Demo
5146350.short_description: A purely minimalist, text-based idle incremental game! Focused on time management and strategic planning, carefully prioritize your action queue under strict time limits. Death is inevitable, but every loop makes you stronger. Build your automation routines and break the infinite loop!

5189890.name: My Goth Waifu: Hentai Puzzle
5189890.short_description: Solve seven types of puzzles across 100 increasingly challenging levels and unlock ever more revealing images of a bold goth beauty. Earn up to three stars, beat your best times, and fill your private gallery in My Goth Waifu: Hentai Puzzle.

4515760.name: Planet Zoo 2: Deluxe Upgrade Pack
4515760.short_description: Expand your conservation efforts with the Planet Zoo 2: Deluxe Upgrade Pack, containing an additional 6 animal species from across the globe, as well as a selection of exclusive animal signs to decorate your park.

4592490.name: 10 Second Mixtape Demo
4592490.short_description: Make mini music with other players! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

4601050.name: County of Fortune Demo
4601050.short_description: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

4661410.name: DreadHaven: The Last Colony Demo
4661410.short_description: Build by day. Survive by night. Each day, use a limited number of actions to expand your city, manage resources, reinforce defenses, and prepare for what’s coming. Each night, your towers unleash their power against ever-growing zombie hordes.

4693560.name: Split Brain Samsara Demo
4693560.short_description:
You and your friend are locked in the same body! 

In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure! Communication will be key!

3738760.name: Rain98 Demo
3738760.short_description: This is the demo version of Rain98. Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

3264080.name: Hidden Cat Outlaws Demo
3264080.short_description: Become the sheriff and catch all the wanted cats! Explore 3 levels. Find over 70 cats. Find 9 secrets. Fight 3 bosses. Have fun and relax. MEOW!

5176480.name: Trajectory:Rumble
5176480.short_description: A turn-based artillery brawl starring cats. Aim bombs, crossbows and boomerangs by hand, stack 100+ augments to flip the match, and fight 1v1 to 3v3 online or climb a co-op Expedition in a party of up to 3.

362220.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Kitana and Mileena
362220.short_description: We flash back to Kitana and Mileena getting their orders to enter the tournament... Kitana is uneasy about the truth of her past.

5265660.name: Worth the Cost
5265660.short_description:
A choice-driven sandbox visual novel where college, family, money, and ambition collide. Explore
the world, build relationships, complete quests, and decide how far you're willing to go to create the
life you want.

4147090.name: Sid Meier's Civilization VII Firaxis Feature Workshop

2638080.name: Annihilated
2638080.short_description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

5294000.name: CosmoLaunch System
5294000.short_description: CosmoLaunchSystem is a hybrid game about managing a space agency and piloting a rocket. You play as the agency director. You accept contracts, invest in research laboratories, design launch vehicles in the VAB, and deliver your clients' payloads.

5444710.name: Chop or Die: Axe of War
5444710.short_description: The world is overrun by wood mutants! Chop trees, gather resources, upgrade turrets, fortify your base, and enhance your Cyber Dog. Fight off nightly mutant hordes and save the planet from a forest apocalypse!

5410700.name: Race For Space
5410700.short_description: Pilot a freighter moving resources from Earth to the Moon that becomes ambushed by rival faction bots. Dodge and destroy hostile drones, collect scrap from destroyed drones, and upgrade your ship between missions. Choose a faction and contribute deliveries to be the strongest faction in the galaxy.

2361710.name: MEs
2361710.short_description: Take part in exploring the ever-expanding innerworlds of MEs — a personal knowledge collection for gathering the smallest sparks of ideas.

5267950.name: The Feather King
5267950.short_description: A match-3 RPG comedy roguelike. Combine runes to trigger spells, arrange them strategically, then blast down your opponents with a barrage of arcane fury. Discover a cast of colorful characters as you navigate through the Feather King's realm in this farcical, story driven adventure.

4430560.name: Joe Lost Island
4430560.short_description: A 2D action platformer with guns, a surprisingly useful plunger, roguelike runs, co-op and 8-player deathmatch.

4424420.name: Alterum
4424420.short_description: A multiplayer social deduction horror where spells are spoken aloud. One of you is altered. Cast magic with your voice, hunt the traitor, survive the ritual. Every word can save - or kill.

5276810.name: Colorways Demo
5276810.short_description: Try to complete 7 free levels in the wave-based traffic mode in Colorways!

5197600.name: GILDEN
5197600.short_description: A fast-paced dark fantasy action RPG with retro pixel art. Fight through dense hordes of enemies, discover powerful weapons, defeat deadly bosses, and descend 50 floors into the depths.

5480960.name: Grave Ambition
5480960.short_description: They used the Overlord as a training dummy. Bad idea... In this casual voxel incremental action-RPG, every recruit you smash leaves a stat in your bones. Grind, evolve into new undead forms and climb seven floors to the five heroes who put you there.

4997440.name: MonMusu Breaker
4997440.short_description: A classic Brick Breaker with a naughty twist! Smash through challenging stages, unlock new characters and scenes, and put your aim and timing to the test. Can you break your way through them all?

5366400.name: Prism Core
5366400.short_description: A neon cyberpunk color-matching survival arcade game. Sync your color with incoming blocks to survive across 3 unique modes. Features active color system, shields, and 15 achievements. Fast-paced score attack gameplay with infinite replayability.

5411100.name: NARI: Threads of Dawn
5411100.short_description: Fight with flowing sleeves and turn a last-moment dodge into a counterattack. Journey through six stages of Korean folklore, face restless spirits and bosses, and shape your dance through three progression paths and equipment combinations.

5345330.name: Permafrost - Original Soundtrack
5345330.short_description: Experience the never-ending winter with the official Permafrost Soundtrack, a collection of atmospheric tracks that captures the adventure, danger, and biting cold of this frozen world.

5373350.name: Stick A Fork Demo
5373350.short_description: Just hover. Stuck forks leap up and stab back into giant fruit, and every landing pays out gold. Buy more forks, smash the fruit into jam, Ascend, and watch the table get busier every run. An active incremental game played with your cursor.

5414290.name: Mowed Down Demo
5414290.short_description: A multiplayer prop hunt where the hunter drives a lawnmower. Hide as anything from a safety cone to a giant toilet, score only while a mower can see you, and come back as a mower or a ghost when you're caught. Free demo: the Backyard and the Haunted Manor, online lobbies of up to 6, and solo vs AI.

4937480.name: Mowed Down
4937480.short_description: A multiplayer prop hunt where the hunter drives a lawnmower. Hide as anything from a hay bale to a piano across ten arenas, score only while a mower can see you, and come back as a mower or a ghost when you're caught. Lobbies of up to 40, four mowers, and a Map Maker.

4651620.name: The Day I Started Harvesting Demo
4651620.short_description: An incremental game where a simple harvest grows into something far stranger. Expand your fields, hire workers, and survive pests, storms, and bizarre events as your peaceful routine slowly turns into chaos.

4276810.name: Dice Looter
4276810.short_description: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

4610320.name: Pine Creek Demo
4610320.short_description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the grays and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror demo set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986.

4860200.name: CosmicCritters
4860200.short_description: CosmicCritters is an action game set in a ranch. Feed your critters, collect the resources they drop, and defend them from waves of hostiles — all while juggling between your Feeder, Vacuum, and Laser Gun. The waves never stop, and your critters depend on you.

4631970.name: The Day I Started Harvesting
4631970.short_description: An incremental game where a simple harvest grows into something far stranger. Expand your fields, hire workers, and survive pests, storms, and bizarre events as your peaceful routine slowly turns into chaos.

5365410.name: ASTERIS
5365410.short_description: A 1–4 player action roguelite that fuses thousands of powerful builds with MMO-style co-op raids. Reshape every active skill to suit your style, inherit a god's mighty power and awaken. Dive into gear and growth, appearance collecting and a player marketplace.

4969600.name: Pine Creek: Prologue
4969600.short_description: Your wife has vanished. Her pager signal leads you to an abandoned water plant on the outskirts of Pine Creek. You are not alone inside. Solve puzzles, hide from the Grays, and escape the facility in this stealth survival horror prologue set in rural Pennsylvania, 1986. Play the Pine Creek prologue.

5489550.name: 溪桥志
5489550.short_description: Build a village in Song-era China with knowledge from the modern world. Plan homes and workshops, assign villagers, research and trade. Muster a roster of up to 24 soldiers for two three-battle campaigns, then return home to tend your growing settlement.

5294070.name: Chaos Table
5294070.short_description: A chaotic social deduction game for 6–10 players where roles never stop shifting. Talk, lie and betray your way to the very end. You can’t trust anyone here — not even the person sitting next to you. Play every angle and prove you’re the sharpest mind at the table.

5213990.name: Tidy Up Together: Banknotes Demo
5213990.short_description: Try Tidy Up Together: Banknotes. Pick up scattered bundles, recognize each design, and place matching notes in any open spot on their shelf. Learn sorting tools as you go, then fill the cabinets at your own pace.

4282350.name: 残存之物 Demo
4282350.short_description: A survival crafting game set after an AI uprising. Stranded on a 4km × 4km island, you must gather resources, build shelter, and craft weapons to survive. Currently in early development, with core systems evolving and new content planned

3679120.name: Metal Coffin Demo
3679120.short_description: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

3581230.name: Cozy Game Restoration
3581230.short_description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

4742270.name: Cozy Game Restoration Demo
4742270.short_description: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

5171320.name: Epoch Forge Demo
5171320.short_description: The world broke a long time ago and kept going anyway. Mining, settlements, circuitry, gods and ships all run at once, in one world, and none of them wait for you. Talk to anyone — they answer in their own words, from a model running on your machine, about things that actually happened.

4343650.name: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames
4343650.short_description: Ride attractions, play minigames and chase online high scores across three themed islands! Shoot ducks, feed raptors with a crossbow, hunt pterosaurs from a roller coaster or rescue sailors from the kraken. Win teddies at the Claw Machine and collect Dino Cards for your Lodge.

3652920.name: Netherwake
3652920.short_description: Netherwake is a story-driven first-person psychological horror game. Explore a town consumed by unnatural fog and a facility beneath the mountain. Hide from deadly anomalies, solve environmental puzzles, and uncover what happened before they find you.

3110570.name: 迷途梦境 Lost Dream Chronicle demo
3110570.short_description: "Lost Dream Chronicle" is a 3D action RPG that merges campus life simulation with 3D diorama-style Metroidvania, rooted in dream psychology. Nan, a young rookie chemistry teacher,  finds herself trapped in a dangerous dream world. Fight through the dream, uncover secrets, and save the world!

4448510.name: Deductopia Demo
4448510.short_description: So you think you're a detective? Try your skills in the world of Deductopia! This demo features three zany and creative chapters about chaos in the classroom, mix-ups on the hiking trail, and confusion at the scout camp. Match everyone with the right names, pets, goals, and belongings to win!

5378450.name: Goblin Hoarder
5378450.short_description: Sort thousands of stolen treasures and transform a chaotic goblin cave into the ultimate organized hoard.

5054900.name: Dominion Arena
5054900.short_description: A sci-fi roguelite auto battler where you recruit a squad of cyber-enhanced fighters, combine skills and items, adapt your build between rounds, and face other players' lineups in asynchronous tournaments to climb the rankings.

5404820.name: Strip Club Tycoon
5404820.short_description: Build a strip club from scratch, hire your staff, and manage your establishment to turn it into the best club in town. A management game about rent, reputation and a crowd that's hard to please. For adults only.

5195070.name: Arcade Park Islands: Rides & Minigames Demo
5195070.short_description: Free demo of Arcade Park Islands: explore parts of three themed islands, play arcade minigames, ride attractions, collect tickets and chat with friendly robot visitors. Get a first taste of the full first-person arcade park adventure!

4704520.name: Shreddead
4704520.short_description: ShredDead is a quirky relaxing incremental zombie-shredding game focused on progression with no lose conditions. Defeat endless waves, collect loot, grow your skill tree and evolve the zombies.

4551870.name: Ruffed Up
4551870.short_description: Ruffed Up is a chaotic co-op physics game where you play as dogs dragging your unconscious dog walker back home. Team up with 2–4 players online or locally to keep your human safe, cross treacherous terrain, dodge hazards, and somehow get everyone home in one piece. It’s no walk in the park!

3069980.name: Crucible Of Time
3069980.short_description: A nostalgic love-letter to 90's era 4X strategy games reimagined with the best modern features of the genre. Armies fight in groups while supply chains must be managed. Powerful diplomatic rivals and apocalypses triggered by player choices. Can you build an empire that survives the Crucible Of Time?

3685570.name: FIGHT-QUEST
3685570.short_description: Punch, slash, and blast through hordes of fairy-tale creatures in this first-person action roguelite. Stack absurd abilities, conquer deadly arenas, and bank your hard-earned gold for new unlocks.

4128260.name: Highguard
4128260.short_description: Highguard is a PvP raid shooter where players will ride, fight, and raid as Wardens, arcane gunslingers sent to fight for control of a mythical continent.

5097300.name: PUSH MID
5097300.short_description: PUSH MID is a roguelite auto-battler where MOBA heroes fight on their own. Pick your team, send each hero to a lane, equip them with items, choose powerful perks, and watch your strategy play out as they push toward the enemy base.

5099750.name: ナニワアンダーグラウンド
5099750.short_description: Earn a living while interacting with a cast of eccentric citizens, enjoy leisurely activities like fishing and gathering, or even dabble in crime—the choice is yours. This is a life simulation set in a modern-day Osaka where law and order have collapsed.

5130530.name: Kindled:To The Starlight
5130530.short_description: Kindled: To the Starlight is a life sim set in rural China during the 2015 poverty alleviation campaign. Farm, breed crops, befriend and marry NPCs, run for village director, and trade with Five Elements cards as prices follow real supply and demand. Farm, befriend, campaign, trade — all up to you.

5385160.name: Lanternborn
5385160.short_description: ▎ The city of Caldera froze one minute before midnight, and the Hollows came out of the dark. Carry the last light through ever-changing streets, light the lamps, break the Bells and decide how the longest night ends. A dark-fantasy action roguelite with a story.

5462420.name: Ballpeak
5462420.short_description: Roll, balance, and find your way through a world of challenging courses in this relaxing physics-based adventure. Control balls made from different materials, each with unique physical properties, and master the art of rolling your way to the finish. Stay balanced and complete every level!

5463740.name: The Dig Show
5463740.short_description: The Dig Show is a cozy digging game about finding treasures on a fake TV stage. Use a metal detector, wash the dirt off your finds and show them on air. Viewers pay to watch. Upgrade your gear and dig a little deeper every day.

5488360.name: Auto Mutant Creatures
5488360.short_description: A roguelite autobattler where your build can outlive your creatures. Assemble three mutants with risky powers and wild synergies, position your squad, and watch them fight. Choose a mutation and pass some upgrades to the next generation. Play Solo or asynchronous online PvP.

3810960.name: Sting Operation
3810960.short_description: Like Pacman, but the roles are reversed!  Command a squad of officers and corner the bad guys before they make off with their stash! Use your mouse and keyboard to order the officers to pinch the criminals before time runs out!

5329960.name: Tidemark
5329960.short_description: Tidemark is a dice-driven, turn-based party roguelike. Roll for action points, choose who acts and who to target, and merge matching skills into stronger versions. Position your team across two rows, chart a route through three rising tides, and defend the crossing before its walls fall.

5469130.name: Hentai Clicker: Akane is streaming
5469130.short_description: Click, collect hearts, buy upgrades, and unlock Akane’s scenes, outfits, and voice reactions in Hentai clicker: Akane is streaming, a playful adult anime clicker.

5480410.name: One Mote
5480410.short_description: Grow a glowing web from a single mote of light. Every crystal you reach feeds the core, and the light plays a song. Collapse your web into a star, fill constellations, wake whole galaxies, then fold them back into one mote. An incremental game you can watch grow.

5485580.name: Paper Pranks
5485580.short_description: Can’t jump the gap? Fold the paper. Need a bridge? Draw one. Paper Pranks is a handmade puzzle platformer where clever ideas meet tricky jumps. Pop balloons, dodge saws, then build and share your own levels. Who made this trap? Oh. You did.
developers: 阿北的甜品屋 / A BEI DESSERT HOUSE
publishers: 阿北的甜品屋 / A BEI DESSERT HOUSE

2555190.name: Poppy Playtime - Chapter 3
2555190.short_description: A decrepit orphanage known as Playcare sits beneath the once magical toy factory. You must make your way through this haunted place, solving new puzzles and avoiding the nightmares that lurk within the dark. Answers lie between the blood-stained bedsheets and screaming echoes... If you can survive.

4181810.name: Nightcap Witch
4181810.short_description: "Nightcap Witch" is a rogue-lite strategy game where you battle using a limited set of units. Build a deck of 7 cards and defend the spring from the onslaught of nightmare legions. Can you drive away the nightmares and reclaim your peaceful sleep?

4942160.name: Readerpet - Garden Décor Pack
4942160.short_description: Turn your Readerpet grove into a softer place to linger with twenty garden decor pieces: fountains, benches, lanterns, arches, vista accents, and one very formal unicorn.

5427460.name: 文字探し-JP-Not Every Letter Is a Letter
5427460.short_description:
A box full of paper scraps — and only 46 are the "correct" hiragana. The rest are katakana, kanji, fakes, and even variant forms.

Match them against the guide and fill the hiragana table. Papers you don't need? Feed them to the goat.

……If it really is a goat.

5454070.name: Puzzle Wild Cats Artbook
5454070.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5454250.name: Puzzle Nuts Artbook
5454250.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5454270.name: Puzzle Mollusks Artbook
5454270.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5480430.name: Tiny Night Market
5480430.short_description: A tiny night market lives right above your taskbar. While you work, the stalls cook, sell and grow on their own. When you have a minute, help out at the stalls, toss a few rings, fill regulars' orders and wait for rare visitors — and watch one candied-hawthorn cart grow into a glowing street.

4859690.name: DIMAZE
4859690.short_description: The instant an enemy starts casting, swallow the spell, magic circle and all. Fire their fireballs and lasers right back at them. The stronger the enemy, the stronger your weapon. Climb an ever-changing tower in this 3D action roguelite.

5177580.name: Dark Pillage
5177580.short_description: Explore forgotten dungeons and collect valuable treasure in this true 8-bit adventure!

5412590.name: Hentai Clicker: Nefira is streaming
5412590.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and charm Nefira, a very naughty Egyptian queen. Unlock outfits, scenes, upgrades, voice reactions, and seductive progression in Hentai clicker: Nefira is streaming.

5454290.name: Puzzle Lakes Artbook
5454290.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5475870.name: Rodo Maldito
5475870.short_description: Co-op horror for 1–4 friends. Haul absurd cargo in a falling-apart van down Brazil's backroads before dawn, while the Saci steals your steering wheel and something howls in the dark. It was never worth it. You went anyway.

3980510.name: Obelus Manor
3980510.short_description: Lose your mind in an ever-changing labyrinth full of spirits and paranormal forces. Uncover the secrets of an abandoned manor in this hand-drawn first person dungeon crawler.

5452260.name: Meow Dungeon: Idle Cat RPG
5452260.short_description: Build a party of pixel cats and let them auto-battle through 24 dungeons. They fight, loot and level up on their own, and keep adventuring even while the game is closed. Collect 14 breeds, hunt legendary gear and grow your cozy cat inn.

5334050.name: Pizza Turbo Demo
5334050.short_description:
A pizza box on wheels. A deadly city. Zero margin for error.
A high-speed arcade racing game where you chain together tricks, use power-ups, and survive the chaos—nuclear explosions, UFOs, and guys dressed as pineapples—before your pizza gets cold.

1374370.name: Witchcrafter: Empire Legends
1374370.short_description: A systemic immersive sim, dark fantasy slavic metroidvania RPG where you are a young witchcrafter striving to control his power of 4 elements on a journey to find a mythical fifth one and save his father. Your decisions count in this branching, thought-provoking story set in a vivid, murky world.

4513510.name: Beefy Boi
4513510.short_description: A job simulator horror. Clock in. Survive. Reach the quota. Your boss is a massive meat monster and we intentionally broke him.

5028090.name: Mochi - Supporter Pack
5028090.short_description: Support Mochi and unlock exclusive supporter benefits including Room Styles, extra decoration capacity, additional room presets, a supporter badge, and exclusive collectible rewards.

5155770.name: Empires of Black Powder
5155770.short_description: A Napoleonic RTS with card-based army building and direct commander combat on horseback to support your troops. Open packs, equip your regiments, and command combined arms of infantry, cavalry, and artillery in real-time battles. Keep your veteran guard alive and bring them into the next battle.

5410840.name: 潜梦者
5410840.short_description: Dream Divers is a multiplayer co-op adventure game where you dive into dreams. Team up with your friends to explore surreal dream worlds, overcome challenges, evade lurking dangers, uncover deeply buried memories, and make it out in one piece.

5425490.name: Pet Store: Tidy Up Sorting Simulator
5425490.short_description: Tidy up, sort, and organize your very own pet store! Put pet toys, food, and accessories back on the shelves, clean up the mess, and turn a chaotic shop into a perfectly organized pet paradise!

5469140.name: Hentai Puzzle: Lexxa
5469140.short_description: Hentai Puzzle: Lexxa: Solve seductive anime puzzles with Lexxa, a very naughty succubus. Complete challenges, progress through the game, and unlock tempting images and scenes piece by piece.

5479170.name: Soil and Steppe
5479170.short_description: From wandering tribes to mighty empires, forge your destiny in Soil and Steppe—a grand historical strategy game combining 4X depth with living geopolitical simulation. Settle fertile river basins or command vast nomadic hordes, master line-based tactical warfare, and reshape history across eras.

1241930.name: The DOTA 2 Official Soundtrack
1241930.short_description: The official soundtrack to the multi-player online battle game, Dota 2.

3841580.name: Aibond
3841580.short_description: An anime-style AI companion with true long-term memory. No installation, free to start. Chat, play, study together — your always-present everyday friend.

4304150.name: Recovered Occurrence
4304150.short_description: A new home owner documents his experience moving to Frailrock, unaware of the many unsetting events he would begin to witness there.

4942170.name: Readerpet - Cottage Furnishing Pack
4942170.short_description: Make the cottage feel lived-in with twenty-six cozy furnishings: a wood stove, reading chair, curtains, rugs, cushions, lamps, candles, plants, and art for the walls.

5408870.name: Overwitched
5408870.short_description: A cute-spooky cooking game where you run a witch's potion shop for very impatient monsters. Dig up bones in the graveyard, grow mandrakes, raise bats and frogs, toss it all in the cauldron and serve vampires, werewolves and ghosts before their patience runs out.

5454260.name: Puzzle Musical Instruments Artbook
5454260.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5468020.name: Kingshatter
5468020.short_description: KINGSHATTER is a chess roguelike about building a ridiculous army and finding out just how much trouble it can cause. Fight across small boards, collect powerful upgrades, and take on opponents with a few unpleasant tricks of their own.

5471340.name: Ottocup: Illustrated Street Football
5471340.short_description: Ottocup: Illustrated Street Football is a chaotic 4v4 online arcade football game for up to 4 players. Play as hand-drawn Ottoman miniature characters, slide, shoulder-charge and punch your way to the goal, grab power-ups, and let AI fill any empty slot.

5475030.name: Wrestle Bounce Online
5475030.short_description: Hold. Release. BONK! A one-button ragdoll physics wrestling game where the first head to hit the mat loses. Duel a friend on one keyboard, beat the AI, win tournaments or take on real players online for coin prizes. Easy to learn, impossible to play without laughing.

5480400.name: Ringfort
5480400.short_description: An asynchronous auto-battler where six ringforts fight all at once. Spend cattle on items, arrange them on your walls, chase race bonds or cross-race item styles, and take on both neighbours every round. Be the last fort standing, then climb six rings to become High King.

5016800.name: Three Kingdoms Heroic Tales
5016800.short_description: Choose your protagonist from over 450 officers and freely assemble your party in this Three Kingdoms RPG × conquest strategy game. Develop your officers, combine gear, sub-commanders, and formations, and conquer all 88 castles in an ever-changing age of war. Who becomes a hero is up to you.

5045430.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn
5045430.short_description: Japanese anomaly-horror mystery at an inn on the afterlife's border. Obey each night's new rule as something creeps in; stare to note earlier guests' traces as it comes. By morning, write in the Register who they were, how they died. The rules never lie; a thing may pose as what the rules name.

5290230.name: 龟龟生存手册
5290230.short_description: You’re an ordinary guy who meets nine beautiful women, each with a different background and personality, at a friend’s wedding. You think your happily-ever-after is about to begin—only to discover you’ll be lucky to make it out alive.

5313470.name: Figure Me Out
5313470.short_description: A multiplayer FPS where you eliminate opponents by typing the numbers on their foreheads. Read theirs before they read yours, use tactical gadgets to disrupt the fight, and battle friends or strangers in matches with up to 20 players.

5454240.name: Puzzle Penguins Artbook
5454240.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5454280.name: Puzzle Marine Fish Artbook
5454280.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5477320.name: Rockburst
5477320.short_description: Break the support. Drop the slab. Smash the rock below. Rockburst is an incremental mining game about setting off collapses, collecting ore and buying upgrades to dig deeper before your lamp runs out.

1812620.name: DSX
1812620.short_description: DSX brings out the full potential of your PlayStation controllers on PC. Personalize input response, adaptive triggers, lighting, and haptics for unmatched precision and immersion. Whether you play competitively or casually, DSX helps you play at your best.

5035870.name: フォーチュリア：交易路の開拓者 Demo
5035870.short_description: This trial version allows you to play the small and medium maps in the standard versus mode with a 6-month time limit. It supports local play between human players and the computer. More content, including campaigns, LAN matches, and online matches, is available in the full version.

4356360.name: Breakaway Hockey League
4356360.short_description: Fast, team-based competitive hockey. Lace up and take control of one skater in third-person. Dominate the ice with dynamic movement, precision shooting, skillful passing, and massive hits. Build chemistry with your squad and climb the ranks in nonstop hockey action.

4912320.name: フォーチュリア：交易路の開拓者
4912320.short_description: Set sail in *Forturia: Trade Route Pioneers*, a dice-driven board game × trading strategy adventure. Roll the dice, trade goods, build your fortune, and compete with rival captains for global dominance in a world that changes every time you play.

3063380.name: Nodal
3063380.short_description: Nodal is a logic puzzle game where you simply connect nodes by drawing lines. Every node must be connected, but special conditions on nodes change how lines can be drawn between them. Also try your hand at endlessly generated puzzles and daily challenges!

2354640.name: DIESELDOME: Ultraviolent Gladiator Shooter
2354640.short_description: DIESELDOME is an ultra-violent Roguelite FPS that fuses movement shooter combat with Survivors-like mechanics. Enter a brutal tournament, shred endless hordes, gamble your gold, bet your blood, and break the game with absurd power for the entertainment of a ruthless Roman-punk crowd.

4996880.name: TCG Shop Life Demo
4996880.short_description: Run your dream TCG shop! Stock shelves, open card packs, customize your store, and hire staff. Collect cards, build powerful decks, and even compete in tournaments all the way to the World Championship!

5228110.name: Misfortune
5228110.short_description: Fight monsters with a slot machine. Spin, hold and reroll to land deadly combinations. Build your reels with powerful symbols, collect relics and unlock extra paylines. Shape your luck—and survive long enough to cash out.

4911730.name: Jubaku
4911730.short_description: A first-person psychological horror with branching choices and multiple endings. Investigate a haunted house, document paranormal events, uncover hidden recordings, and decide whether to confront or escape the horrors lurking within.

5447840.name: Puzzle Whales Soundtrack
5447840.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5447850.name: Puzzle Water Flowers Soundtrack
5447850.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5447860.name: Puzzle Sweets Soundtrack
5447860.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5404950.name: Foodland Puzzle
5404950.short_description: Foodland puzzle is simplictic jigsaw puzzle game with food themed images

5447870.name: Puzzle Stones Soundtrack
5447870.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5447880.name: Puzzle Spiders Soundtrack
5447880.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

4651170.name: P2W : The Party Show Demo
4651170.short_description:
"Forget skills—buy your way to victory!"

<P2W: The Party Show> is a chaotic multiplayer party game where cash is king. Grab gold in hilarious minigames and shop for overpowered items to wreck your rivals. Ready to test your friendships? In this flashy show, the deepest pockets win it all!

4874970.name: Deck Forge
4874970.short_description: Forge a deck, carve your path. A dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder: five classes, 375+ original cards, deadly relics, branching trails that never play out the same way twice, and online co-op for up to four. Every run is a new gauntlet — die, learn, build deadlier.

4737770.name: VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE Demo
4737770.short_description: A top-down mecha action shooter where you instantly switch between an Energy Blade, rifle, launcher, and defense system to destroy enemy machines. Close the distance to slash, attack from range, or defend against incoming fire. Clear missions, improve your performance, and aim for higher ranks.

4663200.name: Selfie Worm Demo
4663200.short_description: Selfie Worm is a cozy adventure blending squishy 2D physics with photography. Control an elastic worm through a colorless world, capturing selfies to restore vibrancy and uncover a heartwarming narrative. Featuring a built-in "Anti-Boss Mode" and Focus Timer, it turns work breaks into healing times.

4821650.name: 月と踊ろう
4821650.short_description:
A boy who hates the night meets a vampire girl who loves it. 
As they steal blood packs and help those in need under the cover of darkness, the two gradually fall in love. 
A multi-ending visual novel that gently illuminates the lives of those lost in the night and offers comfort to the lonely.

5050970.name: Dwarf Wars
5050970.short_description: Build armies of witless dwarves and watch them fight their way to victory or fall to their doom in this physics driven, 2D battle simulator!

4195890.name: Heather's Haunted House Party
4195890.short_description: While trying to plan a party that’s to die for, a high school queen bee finds she has an uninvited guest that is much scarier than your average teenage girl.  A Visual Novel about gossip, grief and ghosts.

5440760.name: Tall Tales Inn
5440760.short_description: A cosy idle inn that grows floor by floor up the side of your desktop. Your guests furnish their rooms from the storeroom you stock, set off on quests and come home with loot and tall tales.

5447830.name: Puzzle Wild Cats Soundtrack
5447830.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5061340.name: Puzzle Wild Cats
5061340.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

1858720.name: Message From Aliens
1858720.short_description: Explore an alien logographic writing system with over 1,000 glyphs, from their number system to their culture and thought.

4763940.name: Lofi Cozy Room Demo
4763940.short_description: A transparent mini-room in a corner of your desktop and gentle Lo-Fi music to make your work time cozier. Try every feature of Lofi Cozy Room ahead of launch with the demo.

5322640.name: Bullet Breakfast
5322640.short_description: Bullet Breakfast is a 3D co-op arena shooter where you play solo or team up with other heroes. Choose your hero, wield class-specific weapons, collect powerful upgrades, survive waves of undead, and defeat the Demon King before sunrise.

5447820.name: Puzzle Lakes Soundtrack
5447820.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5232270.name: Puzzle Lakes
5232270.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5232660.name: Terminal Dice
5232660.short_description: Terminal Dice is a turn-based roguelike deckbuilder played with physical dice. Roll your hand, spend limited OPS to alter results, then arrange dice in an ordered buffer and compile a score. Win encounters to rewrite die faces, shape your build, and break rule-changing bosses.

4758520.name: Please File Accurately
4758520.short_description: Four coworkers stuck in one office. No reason to behave professionally. Complete the tasks, work together, sabotage each other, or destroy the office in this chaotic local 4-player party game.

3576240.name: Drug Dealer 2049
3576240.short_description: Drug Dealer 2049 is about building a fully automated factory that produces ever purer drugs, in a 2D world. Design your production lines, cross plants into new strains or cook synthetic drugs, sell your production to customers, and protect yourself from every threat.

5161560.name: いただきバーガー
5161560.short_description: Layers score off their neighbors: cheese melts onto the patty, tomato lifts the bacon, a full BLT multiplies the lot. Every layer adds to the score — but one greedy layer can bring the whole tower down. A physics-stacking burger roguelike deckbuilder.

5447810.name: Puzzle Marine Fish Soundtrack
5447810.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5061620.name: Puzzle Marine Fish
5061620.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

3846920.name: Anomaly Express
3846920.short_description: Anomaly Express is a 1–4 player co-op psychological horror aboard a winter train. Spot anomalies, survive deadly encounters, and uncover the supernatural force behind this endless journey.

5385500.name: 英雄塔防
5385500.short_description: Hero Tower Defense is a top-down roguelike tower defense game. Recruit 70+ unique heroes, use platforms and fences to redirect enemy routes, and combine skills, plugins, equipment, gems, and team bonds. Adapt to randomized recruits, rewards, and enemy compositions across 120 waves.

4483020.name: 火の言伝
4483020.short_description: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

5422950.name: 宗门不养闲人
5422950.short_description: Ever wanted to face the beast tides of a cultivation novel? Build a sect, raise disciples, brew elixirs and forge their gear. When hordes besiege your walls, lead the disciples you've nurtured into vast battles to defend the home you've built together.

5447980.name: Puzzle Mollusks Soundtrack
5447980.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

4965520.name: Auto Ball Arena Demo
4965520.short_description: Strategy meets physics autobattler. Bounce, spin, and slice your way through nail-biting PvP battles at your own pace.

4500530.name: Raging Blasters 2
4500530.short_description: The sequel to the "Raging Blasters" is here! It's called "Raging Blasters 2". This is an arcade-style vertical scrolling shmup. Players choose from three pilots to control, and head into battle. The graphics are pixel-perfect, and the music includes chiptune versions.

5061660.name: Puzzle Mollusks
5061660.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5347060.name: City Party Demo
5347060.short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

5105020.name: Goreticulture Demo
5105020.short_description: Nurture a visceral garden as you clean up a bloody aftermath. Mop, water, and shear your way through retro levels. Use every drop to grow plants that earn piles of coins. Turn your green thumb red in Goreticulture, where doom meets bloom!

5447970.name: Puzzle Musical Instruments Soundtrack
5447970.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5232250.name: Puzzle Musical Instruments
5232250.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5175310.name: Worst Class Ever
5175310.short_description: This is a fun 1-6 player asymmetric party game! Five player are mischievous troublemakers，hide among dozens of NPC students to sneak snacks, pass secret notes, and use phones secretly in class. One player acts as a strict teacher, track down all hidden troublemakers in the crowd.

2483450.name: Cloak Hero
2483450.short_description: Cloak Hero is a rougelite dungeon crawler with a mix of auto and manual control combat mechanism. With weapons, magic and special powers, our hero fights to survive and grows stronger to face the evil force down in the deep.

5312160.name: Ocean Dynasty Tycoon
5312160.short_description: Build your own shipping company, plan global routes, and guide a fleet through a dynamic trading network. Take on transport contracts, trade goods, upgrade ships, and react to market opportunities and unexpected events.

5074550.name: Grayscale Star灰度之星 Demo
5074550.short_description: 穿越回00年代，一起成为“国民偶像组合”吧！这是一个十位少女介于十八岁缝隙中挣扎的故事。

5317860.name: Slavlands: Tribes at War
5317860.short_description: Raise a Slavic gord, feed your people and lead your warband across a great map of the early medieval Slavic lands. A 90s-style real-time strategy with a deep simulation, where wars are won with granaries, supply trains, weather and faith long before the first blow.

5330470.name: JANOLITH
5330470.short_description: Every stone carries two letters – one on each side. Place words, then flip stones already on the board: STONE becomes STORE. A word-building roguelite where heavy letters face up drive your Mult, long fresh words send your score soaring, and bosses bend the rules.

5095060.name: AsterMaster
5095060.short_description: A roguelite shooter on a hex grid where bosses are clouds of 6,000 shards: every hit carves a real crater, dig through the plating and chunks tear off. Enemies move on the beat, you play in real time. Stack weapon mods, chase synergies, haul your ore back out alive. Steam Deck friendly.

5447960.name: Puzzle Nuts Soundtrack
5447960.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5151450.name: Puzzle Nuts
5151450.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5040610.name: Moon Swarm
5040610.short_description: Defend your moon from endless alien waves! Collect gold, upgrade defenses, unlock new weapons and planets, and build the perfect defense while you do other things.

5473520.name: Lilloville
5473520.short_description: Bring a seaside shopping street to life in this cozy shopkeeping game. Arrange bouquets, bake bread, pour latte art, style hair, cook meals, and run your own little stores. Decorate your shops, meet the neighbours, and enjoy the small joys of life in Lilloville.

4979850.name: Mystery House Demo
4979850.short_description: A first and third-person horror revival of Roberta Williams' Mystery House - the 1980 classic that invented the graphic adventure. A game night in an abandoned Victorian House turns deadly. Solve its puzzles, uncover a buried legacy, and escape before the house kills you.

4575230.name: Monster Adventure Studio
4575230.short_description: Create your own creature-collector RPG—no coding required!

3965940.name: Gunfetti
3965940.short_description: Every match is a brawl in this 2D pixel-art multiplayer shooter. Characters with completely different skills pile into the fight over the zone. Take it with your team, or clean house in a free-for-all.

5074080.name: Parry Dungeon
5074080.short_description: Created by an insane solo developer. Short first-person dungeon crawler with directional parrying, counterattacks, and monster CONSUMPTION. Parry monster. Counterattack monster. Kill monster. Eat monster. Find more monsters. Kill them too. Find more. Kill them too....or die.

5121120.name: Dark Age: Tokens of the Fallen Demo
5121120.short_description: A single-player medieval dungeon-crawler RPG where you battle bandits, defeat powerful bosses, collect souls to upgrade your skills, and recover fallen tokens to unlock new dungeons and the road to the King’s fortress.

3317110.name: Am I Nima Demo
3317110.short_description: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

5002520.name: Silicon Cozy Simulator
5002520.short_description:
Silicon Cozy Simulator is a relaxing management simulation game where you build and operate your own internet cafe.

Create your dream gaming space, customize rooms, manage computers, serve customers, upgrade equipment, and grow your small cafe into a popular gaming destination.

5013620.name: Infected Dawn 2
5013620.short_description: Infected Dawn 2 is an action oriented zombie survival game with elements of time management and puzzle solving. Get to the safehouse, and explore the neighboring landmarks to find weapons and gear before nightfall; make every second count.

5295630.name: Wok King
5295630.short_description: You and your friends run a Chinese restaurant in a cherry blossom town on an island. You travel to various places to purchase different quality ingredients, frantically completing orders in the kitchen, riding an e-bike to deliver the delicacies to customers, striving to become the wok king!

5172730.name: System Arrival Demo
5172730.short_description: A top-down action RPG that combines dangerous expeditions into the outside world with bunker building, management, and defense against relentless attacks.

5358410.name: Tidy Pills Demo
5358410.short_description: Step behind the counter of a quiet little pharmacy and bring order to its shelves. Sort, stack and arrange medicines one box at a time in this cozy organizing game. No timers, no pressure, just the simple joy of a perfectly tidy shelf.

4868600.name: 童年诡事录试玩版
4868600.short_description: Rural Nostalgia, Chinese Horror, Classic Horror，Realistic 3D Graphics, Jump Scares, Chase Sequences, Psychological Horror, Logical Deduction, Mechanism Puzzles

5086270.name: 铅雨 Demo
5086270.short_description:
Every hit is lethal, with no room for error. Switch between sword and pistol to tear through soldiers, artillery pieces, tanks — and even destroy an entire army.
You awaken without memories. A queen claiming to be your wife asks you to fight for her. Will you stand with her to the end?

4389650.name: Radiotext Demo
4389650.short_description: Rise against the corporate overlords and become a cyber activist hacker. Join the uprising in a cyberpunk world using radio waves.

4547340.name: Office Manager Demo
4547340.short_description: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

4759840.name: Abyss Ring Demo
4759840.short_description:
Survive, cook, and conquer!
Cook monsters to stave off hunger in this roguelike as you reach the deepest floor. With 200+ equipment items and random dungeons, every run offers endless possibilities.

4809830.name: Kopernicus: Incremental Suffering Demo
4809830.short_description: Burn. Build. Survive. Escape. Incinerate nightmares with the MATEJKO flamethrower, expand your ever-growing base, and unlock devastating new weapons. Every night the planet grows stronger. So do you. Recover forgotten memories and fight your way back home (with your chihuahua's help).

4809870.name: Ravenswatch - Kintaro
4809870.short_description: Kintarō, the golden boy with superhuman strength, joins the Ravenswatch. Accompanied by Kuma, unleash wild combos upon the Nightmare. Unlock a new playable hero with unique gameplay, switching between fighting on foot and on the back of a bear.

5194600.name: Face Picka
5194600.short_description:
Play board games with friends using faces you draw yourself! 
FacePicka is a board game café simulation 
where you create your own faces, enjoy fun mini-games, pull pranks, and switch expressions as you play.

2809080.name: Rollin' Rascal Demo
2809080.short_description: Rollin’ Rascal is a high-speed action platformer that will test your reflexes and creativity as you zoom through a whimsical world in search of adventure!

5121100.name: Dark Age: Tokens of the Fallen Playtest

2562770.name: Prehistoric Kingdom: Digital Artbook, Vol. 1
2562770.short_description: Go behind the scenes in Volume 1 of our digital artbook, The Art of Prehistoric Kingdom!

2243290.name: Number Machine: Math Factory Demo
2243290.short_description: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

5321350.name: Put the Ball in the Hole
5321350.short_description: The instructions are in the title. A physics trickshot game with 70 levels and 10 ways to shoot: basketball, golf, pool, bowling, baseball, soccer, ping pong, marbles, slingshots and cannons. Every shot is one motion with your mouse.

5468900.name: GeoChaos Rumble
5468900.short_description: GeoChaos Rumble is a hand-drawn 2D multiplayer brawler for 2–4 players. Battle across forts and platforms: drain your rivals' health or knock them into the sea! Discover 70+ weapons and 20+ random events that bring new twists to every fight.

5326440.name: STELLAR WING Demo
5326440.short_description: The STELLAR WING demo. Knock out the enemy carrier's turrets, bring down its shield generators, then break open the core. Play from flight training through the first three campaign missions, a 4v4 carrier assault and a hunt for the Sentinel, a giant mechanical creature.

1316182.name: Robocop
1316182.short_description: Alex Murphy was a dutiful police officer who was brutally executed by a local gang. Brought back to life through OCP technology, Murphy was transformed into RoboCop, a highly advanced cybernetic police officer designed to uphold the law and protect the innocent.

362210.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Kenshi Encounters Ermac
362210.short_description: We continue with Kenshi's origin story in feudal Japan and watch as he is blinded in his first fight with Ermac. In the present, blind Kenshi battles Ermac in the tournament, finally defeating him.

367680.name: RimWorld Name in Game Access
367680.short_description: Enter a name into the game. Players will recruit, command, and fight you for all time! (All content must follow the RimWorld creative rewards guidelines.)

5329800.name: Hide No More
5329800.short_description: Hide No More is a sound-driven Blindfold Hide and Seek game,Supports up to 8 players online. Blindfolded Hunters can sense their surroundings within just 5 meters, but sound can lead them to their targets. Hiders must use distance and the environment to evade capture.

4840700.name: The Boo Club
4840700.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op horror-comedy about amateur ghost hunters with terrible ideas. Complete rituals, unleash ridiculous gear, and mess with your friends. Gain superpowers, take flight, and fight Satan himself. Teamwork gets the job done. Taking all the glory is tempting.

5447570.name: The Shadow Crown - Frostwynd Chronicles Demo
5447570.short_description: Play Act 1 of The Shadow Crown free. Explore Eldergrove village and the Dark Forest, battle goblins, bandits and corrupted beasts, and find the key to the iron door beneath the ancient ruins. A retro text adventure in the spirit of the 1980s classics.

1798230.name: ATMOSFAR
1798230.short_description: Uncover the fate of humanity's final outpost as you survive and explore a thrilling world of floating islands. Brave the skies on your own or assemble a squadron of friends, and scavenge scrap to engineer and upgrade flying vessels, bringing your airship along for the journey.

4112670.name: VOXTOPOLIS
4112670.short_description: VOXTOPOLIS is an action-adventure RPG in endless worlds of tiny blocks! Explore towns and cities, complete quests, and unlock abilities to tackle dungeons and bosses. Master dodges and parries in combat. Break terrain for blocks and use building tools to reshape the world. Play solo or with friends!

5186230.name: TERRITORY SCRAMBLE
5186230.short_description: Step, surround, conquer! Claim hexagonal tiles by stepping on them, then enclose areas to capture them at once. Fight for bases and cannons with weapons and items in fast-paced, top-down territory battles. Play online with up to 16 players across 2-4 teams, or take on bots.

5143470.name: LINE WARLORD Demo
5143470.short_description: Real-time line defense, played in roguelite runs. Spend rations to send units to the front, pick relics between fights, and destroy the enemy base. Stacking relics, unit promotions, three commanders with their own ultimates.

5460640.name: Rockhound Hollow
5460640.short_description: Dig at 24 real rockhounding sites, crack open geodes, run a real 4-step rock tumbler and fill your Rock Journal from a cozy pixel-art cabin with Pebble the cat. A relaxing collecting game where every site, tool and fact comes from real rockhounding.

4955590.name: Datum
4955590.short_description: A roguelite quiz deckbuilder where trivia is your weapon. Answer questions across a variety of categories, then combine cards and relics into game-breaking combos. Level up and use meta progression to unlock new cards and craft powerful builds.

5473770.name: SPACE BUMPS: A Bad Space Day
5473770.short_description: Wil only wanted to fix his ship and go home. Now a corporate rescue scheme is threatening an entire station. Solve inventory puzzles, repair strange machines, follow the evidence and face the executive responsible in this sci-fi comedy adventure.

4178860.name: PinPow
4178860.short_description: PinPow is a turn-based roguelike pinball RPG where you play as a hero sucked into an otherworldly pinball machine - battling your way through chaotic dungeons, and enemies to defeat the evil Pinball Wizard. Strategize your shots, upgrade your hero, and bounce your way to victory!

5386970.name: Stream Hearts
5386970.short_description: Turn your live chat into a shared stage. Play chat games with fan characters, gather opinions with polls, and prepare schedules, timers, notes and drawings in one Windows app. Bring the scene into your broadcast with a browser source.

2974040.name: Glintland
2974040.short_description: Glintland is a magical factory-building card puzzler. Place tiles from a deck to build enchanting production chains, light up the land, and discover a cozy world full of secrets. Each Glint is a short, satisfying journey of automation and alchemy.

3680450.name: Junkyard Space Agency
3680450.short_description: Build ships from scrap and fly them in a gritty space sim. Venture solo or team up. Hunt for parts, haul vital resources, and keep your space agency afloat.

5447950.name: Puzzle Penguins Soundtrack
5447950.short_description: In this DLC you find full soundtrack from the game.

5232310.name: Puzzle Penguins
5232310.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5444190.name: 无字书
5444190.short_description: An AI-driven narrative game . No option buttons, no dialogue trees — say anything, and the characters answer like people, remembering every word.
