They gossip about you, and the story rewrites itself when you stray. Three complete worlds, no two runs alike. Requires your own AI service API key.

4938660.name: LINE WARLORD
4938660.short_description: Real-time line defense, played in roguelite runs. Spend rations to send units to the front, pick relics between fights, and destroy the enemy base. Stacking relics, unit promotions, three commanders with their own ultimates.

3689860.name: Mount Lomyst
3689860.short_description: You need to go up... but you cannot jump! Mount Lomyst is a 2D platformer where you must reach the summit using only a grappling hook and your climbing skills.

3596560.name: Stack & Brew
3596560.short_description: Stack & Brew is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

3967390.name: MagicKingdom Demo
3967390.short_description:
Legion Warfare，Roguelike，Loot Grinding，Semi-Automated Combat，Western Fantasy，Top-Down Combat.
You control a hero, command a powerful army, unleash devastating magic, build formidable defenses, and manage resource gathering to withstand relentless enemy assaults.
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

5430390.name: Brawliens
5430390.short_description: Toy aliens, total chaos, zero friendships left. Land on the planet's sites, win minigames, buy sneaky gadgets, then knock your friends out of orbit in THE FINAL BRAWL. An online alien party game for 2–8 players, with bots to fill any empty seat.

2515430.name: Sanctua
2515430.short_description: Trapped in a cursed tomb, cooperate to survive and escape the forsaken ruins in which the shadows creep closer… or succumb to corruption and hunt down those who were once your allies. An asymmetrical co-op experience for up to 6 players

4644200.name: Shadow Play: Nezha
4644200.short_description: A 2D Roguelike action game inspired by Chinese mythology, Journey to the West, Investiture of the Gods, and shadow puppetry. Cast out by Heaven, Nezha is trapped in endless Lotus Rebirths. Build divine powers, battle mythic foes, uncover the truth, and break Samsara.

3687090.name: Dice Hoarder
3687090.short_description: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

4754280.name: NODE: PROTOCOL Demo
4754280.short_description: A full immersive hacking sim based on real exploits and C2 tools. Choose missions or pure free-roam. The world adapts to your every move and strikes back. Accept contracts. Hack servers. Earn BTC. Upgrade your gear and avoid getting traced. Play solo or in Co-op / CTF with your friends.

5202530.name: Survive The Squallies
5202530.short_description: Settle into a new home, go fishing, and meet the neighbors in this retro first-person horror game. Something is watching from the woods. Explore, run, and hide as Bill discovers that getting home alive is harder than fitting in.

1785950.name: Razgovor
1785950.short_description: Razgovor Online is a Social MMORPG-Lite open world game, providing ways to explore, socialise, and grow, with Jobs, Mini-Games and player housing, or even taking long drives with your friends, the freedom is yours!

4480480.name: Potion Dealer
4480480.short_description: Potion Dealer is a dark fantasy potion-crafting survival RPG. Iva’s plan to kidnap the royal heir has failed. Now, hunted by the king’s vengeance, she hides in the mountains, brewing forbidden potions to survive.

3447560.name: Chicken Shop Simulator - Fast Food Empire
3447560.short_description: Welcome to the chicken shop! Play solo or co-op with up to 6 players. Run a chicken fast-food restaurant, and work with your friends to grow your chicken business. Take orders, fry chicken, and increase your earnings by selling food to customers.

5061440.name: TOKYO WANTED
5061440.short_description: Hide-and-seek meets tag, in a crowd of 100. The stage is TOKYO. Slip through unseen and reach the goal, or work the wanted poster and stop the escape. A 3v3 team game between fugitives and hunters. Up to six players online at once; CPU fills any empty seats, so you can play solo.

5307740.name: Clean 'Em Ocean
5307740.short_description: An incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

2786810.name: 死亡汇报
2786810.short_description: Trapped within this cursed enclosed area, you will encounter wandering dead and unexplained supernatural anomalies. Struggle to survive amid successive horrors, and gradually uncover the terrifying secrets long buried beneath this land.

4514420.name: NODE: PROTOCOL
4514420.short_description:
A full immersive hacking sim based on real exploits and C2 tools. Choose missions or pure free-roam. The world adapts to your every move and strikes back.

Accept contracts. Hack servers. Earn BTC. Upgrade your gear and avoid getting traced. Play solo or in Co-op / CTF with your friends.

4790400.name: Operative Division
4790400.short_description: Command your forces from above or take direct control on the ground. Operative Division is an intense RTS-TPS hybrid set in a post-apocalyptic world. Manage finite resources, execute surgical tactical maneuvers, and unleash devastating superweapons in a battle for humanity's future.

5280880.name: AWAITING YOUR HORDERS Demo
5280880.short_description: The best defense is offense. As long as you don't do anything stupid. Or do you? A serious and funny battle simulator where your smallest unit is an ARMY: click one soldier, 100,000 shout YAH! Up to 1,000,000 on screen climb into wobbly towers, get shelled, see stars, and charge again.

4959650.name: P.R.O.E.B.
4959650.short_description: Work, sabotage, and escape together. Complete your production quotas across dozens of Soviet factories, outsmart relentless robot supervisors, and find your way to freedom before the ruthless authoritarian machine grinds you to dust!

5462820.name: Massive Army Battle - Sandbox Pack
5462820.short_description: Unlock the limit in unit creation! God mode and unit editor. Unlock the Sandbox and make your own battles.

2863980.name: Crystallium
2863980.short_description: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

4383840.name: SANASANA
4383840.short_description: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

3205590.name: Tank vs Orcs
3205590.short_description: Tank vs Orcs is an action packed twin stick shooter in development where you get to live out the ultimate power fantasy; being a fricken' tank and battling endless hordes or orcs.

5390820.name: Fabriek
5390820.short_description: Dig into a first-person factory game. Mine resources, craft and connect machines into automated production lines. Make your space beautiful.

4838810.name: My Mom Says I’m Fine
4838810.short_description: Survive a twisted toy room in this action roguelike bullet heaven. Choose living toys, unlock weapons and spells, craft powerful builds, upgrade runes, and defeat waves of creepy enemies in fast-paced single-player runs.

5419760.name: EscapeFromSeoul
5419760.short_description: Explore, fight, and extract from a Seoul built from text and symbols. A real-time, top-down PvE extraction shooter for solo play or online co-op with up to 3 players. Scavenge gear, customize weapons, complete contracts, and upgrade your hideout.

5086530.name: PUCKVPUCK
5086530.short_description: Arcade sports with pucks — SOCCER, DODGEBALL and a top-down SHOOTER in one game. Boost, slam and charge your shots, or grab a gun off a pad and chase a kill streak. Up to 8 players, online with friends or all on one PC — or solo against bots. A minute to learn, and the skill ceiling keeps climbing.

4864140.name: Sore Losers
4864140.short_description: SORE LOSERS is a roguelike first-person movement shooter. Slide, wall run and bunny hop across multiple maps. Every time you lose, you pick an upgrade. Stack up to 46 of them until you're unstoppable, or until someone else is. Build the best build or the funniest the choice is up to you!

4940540.name: Last Convoy Demo
4940540.short_description: Speed or firepower? Survive or dominate? Build your armored convoy car by car in this survivors-like auto-shooter. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.

5320660.name: Clean 'Em Ocean Demo
5320660.short_description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean with a speedboat, unlocking upgrades, and cleaning more trash. Will you save the ocean?

4842090.name: Grab Your Deck
4842090.short_description: Build real skateboard tricks from cards: an Ollie paired with a Kickflip and two Shove-its fuse into a Tre Flip. Roll each trick into a manual or grind and land the line before bailing. Beat bosses that tape over your stickers to climb the ranks from AM to PRO. A press-your-luck skate deckbuilder.

3294080.name: Island of Embers
3294080.short_description: Build a human settlement on a volcanic island plagued by fireballs, earthquakes, and ash. Control golems, unlock buildings through research, and face a living landscape that wants you gone. Can your home survive, or will the volcano erase it?

4396640.name: Last Convoy
4396640.short_description: Speed or firepower? Survive or dominate? Build your armored convoy car by car in this survivors-like auto-shooter. The fate of the planet rides on your choices — and your convoy.

5349380.name: Loop Apartment: Visitor Demo
5349380.short_description: You visit an old friend, but Room 305 is empty - and the hallway outside has changed. Explore a shifting apartment through a retro interface, gather clues, and face tabletop RPG–style dice checks. Each time you lose consciousness, the building reshapes itself. Your clues carry over to the next loop.

1728450.name: My Cozy Home
1728450.short_description: My Cozy Home is a relaxing house building game where you get to build the house you always dreamed of.  The game offers a huge library of items to create a bedroom or a kitchen or a gaming room or anything you can dream of. Choice is yours. Add to Wishlist now!

3855060.name: Dice Throne Digital
3855060.short_description: The official digital adaptation of the hit board game, Dice Throne. Dice Throne Digital is a tactical 1v1 hero battler, where dice meet strategy. Roll for powerful abilities, play cards to bend your luck, and outplay your opponent.

5314650.name: Ultrapolis
5314650.short_description: A cyberpunk city diorama with millions of possible buildings. No city management between you and pure layout and design.

4960360.name: Ruffed Up Demo
4960360.short_description: Ruffed Up is a chaotic co-op physics game where you play as dogs dragging your unconscious dog walker back home. Team up with 2–4 players online to keep your human safe, cross treacherous terrain, dodge hazards, and somehow get everyone home in one piece. It’s no walk in the park!

4742200.name: 城市派对
4742200.short_description: Chase the crown across the board and finish with the most coins to win! Watch out for traps and lurking enemies. Use cards to turn the tide and recruit allies to help you out of tough spots. Play through levels solo or team up with a friend for ranked matches. Join the fun in City Party!

5308970.name: Lot Lot Lot Lot
5308970.short_description: The MSX classic evolves into LotLotLotLot! Race the clock, trigger Fever Mode, double your score with diamonds, and rotate the entire field! Music by Yuriko Keino (Xevious, Dig Dug). Includes the original and a lightly remixed version. Celebrating 30 years of VIDEO GAME CLASSIC!

5040390.name: GemSlasher
5040390.short_description: GemSlasher is an action roguelite where every attack is built from gems. Combine Main Gems with Support Gems, merge duplicate gems to increase their star level, and create powerful builds capable of tearing through relentless waves of monsters.

5043860.name: Aether.Garden
5043860.short_description: The original New RTS. One race, many styles, no limit. Play head-to-head, enjoy the co-op Adventure, or seek the leader board, battling to become the King of the Hill in an endless spectator-friendly five player revolving struggle.

4838060.name: ZodiacLottery
4838060.short_description: A lottery roguelike. Move animals to create winning tickets, then combine powerful synergies and unique relics to build massive jackpots!

4022170.name: Dwelling on the Hill
4022170.short_description: A devout man built his house on top of something older than scripture. He tried to seal the passage. He failed. Now you are inside, and the door is locked.

3798470.name: Alt Tab Toolkit
3798470.short_description:
Fast / Responsive Alt Tab replacement. 

Enjoy Customizable Themes, Layouts, Window Previews, Shader driven visuals and more.

Featuring Alt Tab layouts such as
Wheel, Tower 3D, Classic, List, and more.

Download Themes right from the in-app Steam Workshop, or Customize your own in the Theme Editor.

3512480.name: Drownlight
3512480.short_description: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.

5437530.name: RETRO NIGHT CHASE
5437530.short_description:
RETRO NIGHT CHASE is a top-down highway escape game.
Drift, shoot, drop oil slicks and deploy spike strips.
Keep police flashing lights and sirens behind you.
The longer you hold out, the tougher things get!

5051250.name: Sneak & Snitch
5051250.short_description: Sneak & Snitch is a multiplayer social deduction heist. Thieves disguised as museum visitors forge paintings and swap them right under the guard's nose. The guard patrols on a Segway, spotting fakes and suspicious moves. Blend in, bluff your friends, and pull off the perfect art heist.

2443590.name: Diecast
2443590.short_description: Welcome to the dice roguelite. Stuff your bag with wild dice and pins, chain ridiculous scoring combos, and build a point engine to conquer ever-escalating targets. This ain't your Grandma's dice game!

4112370.name: Hijinks High
4112370.short_description: Hijinks High turns an average school day into a disaster with up to five friends. Pull off ridiculous classroom objectives, hold off the faculty with your own bodily fluids, and make the bus before the janitor drags you to detention. Then go home to the Cul-De-Sack and do it again tomorrow.

639590.name: Cartoon Craft: Rise of Mutation
639590.short_description: A story-driven real-time strategy game inspired by classic RTS. Experience a mission campaign filled with memorable characters, unexpected alliances, and humor. Build your kingdom, command Humans and Orcs, create custom maps, and share your battles with the world.

1077310.name: Whiskers of Yesterday
1077310.short_description: You’re a cat, and the whole house is yours. Bring up to 7 friends: knock plates off the table, play cat football in the garden, swim in the pool, or curl up together in a sunbeam. No timers, no fail states. Just a warm place to be.

5429400.name: Mor10 Photo Editor
5429400.short_description: Mor10 Photo Editor is a simple, creative, and user-friendly photo editing application for Windows. Edit images, draw, adjust colors, remove backgrounds with AI, and bring your creative ideas to life — all in one convenient application!

5410850.name: BULLACATOR Demo
5410850.short_description:
A free demo of BULLACATOR. 
Try the first area of this coin pusher × roguelite × deckbuilder for free. 
Drop your shells, smash enemies with physics, and build a deck all your own.

4901640.name: SUGICHIN'S AQUA PARADISE
4901640.short_description: Raise tropical fish right on your desktop in this relaxing idle aquarium game. Collect and breed fish, discover rare mutations, and create unique Chimeras through special combinations. Decorate your tank with aquatic plants and ornaments, and build your very own Aqua Paradise.

5315130.name: Cowpokers: Dead Man's Frontier
5315130.short_description: Become a one-outlaw army in a haunted western bullet heaven. Dodge the dead, evolve your weapons, and tackle optional objectives across four frontiers. Ride home to upgrade your gear, reinforce Dustwater, and defend the town against a nighttime siege.

2776100.name: Power Network Tycoon Demo
2776100.short_description: Power Network Tycoon is a physics based power grid simulation game where you build and maintain a high-voltage power network. Build power infrastructure, monitor resources, research upgrades, adapt to environmental challenges, keep up with energy demands and protect your island community!

1763380.name: Monkey Do
1763380.short_description: Escape a crumbling zoo as Mak, a stealth-savvy monkey who dismantles robot Keepers, springs traps on them, and recruits fellow animals to stage his ultimate breakout. Will the malicious owner be able to stop him or will Mak be the monkey wrench in his operation?

5013410.name: TIDE OR HIDE
5013410.short_description: Three minutes of daylight. Ninety seconds of night. TIDE OR HIDE is a 1-4 player co-op survival game where the deep water guarding your camp drains away every night - zone by zone - and armed hunters come for what you stockpiled. Gather, arm up, and hold until dawn.

3004810.name: OPERATIVES: Revolve
3004810.short_description: Every card is both cover and weapon. In your hand, they block bullets, blades and death itself. It’s a visually intense deckbuilder built on strategic play. Your cards are destructible, their position, sequence and play matter more than just the cards you pick during a run.

5253840.name: Widget2000s
5253840.short_description: ★·.·.· Widget2000s is a 2000s-inspired audio-reactive widget creator & library. Reacts to your favorite music player's audio! Create your own easily and intuitively. Ultra-low resource usage, designed to stay out of your way. Share on Steam Workshop. Join the community and start creating! ·.·.·★

3095070.name: The Dark Aegis
3095070.short_description: The Dark Aegis blends visceral third-person combat with deep base building. Build up your fortress between missions, then defend it from relentless alien hordes solo or with up to 4 players.

5434960.name: きらめきクイズ 星見ヶ丘ダイアリー
5434960.short_description: A Japanese-language quiz game with a dating-sim twist.  Spin the roulette through a 365-day campus calendar, meet 10 heroines with 5,000+ questions. NOTE: This game is in Japanese only. No English text or voice-over.

5329780.name: Alderun
5329780.short_description: A MOBA game with a hero at its heart and many different battlegrounds to choose from. Level your champion, gear it at the merchants and lead an army through sieges, tower defense, 5v5 lane battles and 10v10 valley wars, online against real players or solo against the AI.

4455590.name: RUNTIME
4455590.short_description: Chain midair dashes, flip gravity, and escape ten chapters in a pixel-art precision platformer. Race friends online or in local split screen, or challenge a bot. Chase faster times, unlock your look, and build your own levels.

3987430.name: Roads & Riches: Traveling Merchant Simulator
3987430.short_description: Hit the road alone or with friends in your caravan! Travel across faraway lands, sell wonderful wares, and find magical treasures all in a dynamic economic world where every journey offers different opportunities - all to win over the world's hearts, minds... and wallets!

5444420.name: Test Fire: Armor Penetration Sim Demo
5444420.short_description: Real engineering simulation with any projectile, any target, any material. Test Fire is an armor penetration sandbox with a campaign of engineering challenges and an open sandbox editor for making (and breaking!) whatever you want.

5340680.name: Tiny Ring Defense
5340680.short_description: A desktop idle defense game that keeps going while you work. Monsters circle a ring around your board and your pixel heroes fight them on their own. Summon, merge and level up heroes, forge weapons, and push through ten worlds at your own pace.

5417690.name: Quiet Time Demo
5417690.short_description: Experience the first two days of Quiet Time, an atmospheric survival crafting game where every sound matters. Explore, gather, craft, and use music to awaken the world, influence creatures, and survive.

5416670.name: Isekai Reborn Girl Playtest
developers: Isekai Reborn Girl 製作委員会

5087520.name: Billy the Hero Demo
5087520.short_description:
Billy woke up on Hell Island as a bear. No memories. No regrets. Apparently, this is just who he is now.

A Dark Fantasy Turn-Based RPG where math kills, heroines are unhinged, and the truth about Billy is the one thing the game won't hand you easily.

5016320.name: Heist of Fools
5016320.short_description: Team up for chaotic fantasy heists with 2–4 players. Use four thieves’ unique abilities, outsmart guards and traps, haul enchanted loot, and escape before your mistakes bring the owner home.

5249540.name: Gemfall Demo
5249540.short_description:
The match 3 roguelike!

Battle monsters by matching gems: attack, defend, and cast spells depending on what you pop.

Combine gem enchants, spells, and relics to overcome the world of Gemfall!

5101480.name: Literally A Flying Brick Demo
5101480.short_description:
"Literally A Flying Brick" is a spaceship-building 2.5D action-shooter game.
The year is 2088, and humanity is at war with AI and aliens in space. Triumph in intense battles using your own fully customizable spaceship and a strategic skill deck!

5380860.name: Last House Standing
5380860.short_description: One house, a lab inside, and thousands of zombies outside. Hold out for 25 waves while Dr. Ferrán finishes the cure. Every run earns coins for the upgrade tree: barbed wire, bear traps, mines, a mortar on the roof and, if you make it that far, an airstrike.

5476120.name: Cruisopolis: Cruise Line Tycoon
5476120.short_description: Build your own cruise line, from a little Rhine river boat to a 5,000-guest megaship. Design every deck, staff it, plan the voyages and keep thousands of guests happy - or set loose a kraken, a lightning storm and pirates and see if she stays afloat.

5255360.name: Ichorous Demo
5255360.short_description: The blood-splattering roguelike where you shred through enemies infested with Ichor. Use the blood you spill to heal and grow stronger! As you collect ichor for the god of blood, known only as The Patron, he will grant you upgrades that not only help you but also your enemies!

5141260.name: Plague Lords Demo
5141260.short_description: A turn-based tactical party RPG with base building, set during the Black Death. Assemble peasants, craftsmen, and warriors, investigate the plague's mysterious origin, develop your settlement, and fight the infected as disease consumes medieval Europe.

5191580.name: Pikapo Demo
5191580.short_description: Pikapo is an incremental underwater exploration game. Dive into the abyssal depths and discover the creatures that inhabit them. Create chain reactions using waves to collect resources, purchase upgrades, and progress deeper.

5227080.name: Lost Camp Demo
5227080.short_description: After the death of your mother and with no other choice, you take the only job available: guarding and maintaining a lonely campsite in the mountains. But what seemed like a quiet place hides mysteries that will change everything.

5247530.name: A Place for Every Potion Demo
5247530.short_description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs, two puzzles competing for the same hands. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

5400850.name: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check - Miami Supporter Pack
5400850.short_description: Quarantine Zone: The Last Check Miami Supporter Pack delivers a bonus fan package with extra cosmetics for players who want to support the developer beyond buying the game itself.

4866530.name: Swarmslam Demo
4866530.short_description: Watch a swarm of tiny slammers hurl themselves at a planet and mine it till it breaks, then feed that ore to THE VOID to make your swarm bigger and faster. SLAM, CRACK, REPEAT

4918510.name: Sudokiller Demo
4918510.short_description: Sudokiller Demo is a cozy mystery puzzle game where you place suspects on a sudoku-style grid to unmask a killer hiding in plain sight. Every guest leaves a clue pinning down where they stood at the time of the murder. Deduce your way through case after case in this cozy, cleverly deceptive mystery.

5034310.name: Invisum Piscium 嫌魚 Demo
5034310.short_description: Explore a familiar world that can never be fully understood.

5272490.name: Catch The Ducks
5272490.short_description: Catch The Ducks is a colorful online party game where ducks and farmers clash across chaotic arenas. Chase, escape, paint and customize your character, then compete in Classic, Battle, Free Fall, Hot Potato and Infection modes.

4505440.name: Asobi: Remote Play
4505440.short_description: An independent remote streaming client for your own PS4® or PS5® console, with controller support, adaptive streaming, and optional cloud-streaming compatibility.

4069680.name: Casino Tycoon Sin&Win Demo
4069680.short_description: "Casino Tycoon: Sin & Win" Demo is an open-world experience where you can gear up, drive around, climb, and swim. In this demo version, only one island town map is available. Try your luck with lottery and slot machines to earn your first fortune — this coastal town is where your fortune begins.

4130930.name: Munchkin Digital - Pathfinder
4130930.short_description: Bring your Munchkin Digital adventures to the world of Pathfinder!

3659070.name: Giggleland Demo
3659070.short_description: Something is wrong with Terry's vegetable patch, the abandoned attraction in Giggleland Amusement Park. Uncover the truth Terry tried to bury deep in his farm... before it finds you. This game is not suitable for children.

3747250.name: Gamblers Table Demo
3747250.short_description: Gamblers Table is an automation game where you toss coins to earn money. Buy bigger and better coins, unlock upgrades and hire little helpers to automate the process and take care of all the busy flipping work for you. Simple. Satisfying. Strangely compelling...

3777650.name: SnowRunner - Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 1
3777650.short_description:
Expand your fleet of off-road heavy duty specialists with the Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 1, granting you the Mercedez-Benz Actros 3332 and Mercedez-Benz Zetros.

This DLC is not sold as part of a SnowRunner Year Pass.

1305780.name: Battle Barn: Tactics
1305780.short_description:
A roguelite tactics game about liberating cute mother fluffers from a farm animal fight club...IN SPACE! 

Capture enemies to fight for you, upgrade and genetically alter critters for combat, and take out an evil space clown overlord while you're at it!

3374930.name: Run TavernQuest Demo
3374930.short_description: A classic text adventure - but you're not the one playing it. You're the game master for an idiot player named STEVE. Parse the player's enigmatic commands and decide how NPCs react to him. Who knew that running an RPG would be so frustrating?

3407080.name: Khatun - Hero - FOR HONOR
3407080.short_description: Embrace the power of Khatun, the Mongolian ruler, and create your own vision of peace through any means necessary.

2860220.name: Hold The Noise
2860220.short_description: Listen to beautiful and captivating noises! It will be truly amazing. Are you ready to hear some great noise? Just press and hold the space bar. Are you really ready now?

3381740.name: Eisenkiefer
3381740.short_description: Eisenkiefer is an asymmetrical horror multiplayer game for quick sessions with friends. Play as a Pig, hide, sabotage a giant meat grinder, and rescue your teammates – or become the Butcher and process the Pigs before they destroy your machine.

2218560.name: PixiEditor
2218560.short_description: PixiEditor is a universal 2D editor with tools and features for all your 2D needs. It blurs the line between vector and raster graphics. Create animations, procedural graphics, draw pixel-art, edit photos, vectors and more!

1894010.name: Cyanotype Daydream Vocal Collection
1894010.short_description: This is the vocal collection soundtrack for Cyanotype Daydream, featuring 18 tracks.

1922631.name: Marvel's Midnight Suns - The Good, the Bad, and the Undead
1922631.short_description: Deadpool, everyone's favorite merc with a mouth, teams up with the Midnight Suns! Add Deadpool to your roster along with new story missions, an Abbey upgrade, and more.

1643210.name: SCUM Deluxe 2
1643210.short_description: To mark the halfway point of our Early Access development we are excited to present SCUM supporter pack #2! By popular demand we are releasing another round of extra goodies for the wonderful people that wish to further support SCUM development.

1065280.name: Unheard-FirstDLC-FREE
1065280.short_description: The DLC "The Lethal Script" takes place in The Peak Hotel. Join the investigators as they enter The Peak Hotel and see how this deadly scenario plays out!

629210.name: Extra Terrestrial Perception
629210.short_description: Walking outside one night, bright lights appear overhead. You wake aboard an alien ship. Use your resourcefulness, along with newfound psychic powers to overcome the enemies and obstacles that stand in the way of escape.

362200.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Kenshi's Origin
362200.short_description: We watch as the Earthrealm and Outworld warriors appear at the Mortal Kombat tournament island. Raiden greets the Earthrealm warriors. We also flashback to feudal Japan for the beginning of Kenshi's origin story.

5086950.name: Hotel Carnivalia
5086950.short_description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

4480260.name: ChallaChat
4480260.short_description: Capture and display any livestream chat in a customizable overlay! With multi-stream support (YouTube, Twitch, Kick), you can monitor all messages in one place with ultra-low latency. No cloud, all local.

4593190.name: Elemental Lands
4593190.short_description: Build a base to support heroes in turn-based tactical card battles & defeat enemy breaches overwhelming your land! Your base-building strategy powers your spell deck, weakens foes & heals heroes. Position 3 heroes & use spell cards to seize enemy objectives for buffs. Cards are tactics, not damage.

5218100.name: Ballpark Days
5218100.short_description:
"Ballpark Days" is a narrative-driven baseball game played from the perspective of a catcher.
The matches feature 3D action-based gameplay.

The story progresses as you play through matches, and earning the team's trust brings you closer to victory.

4592680.name: Mineral Zone
4592680.short_description: Build a factory by day, defend it by night. Mine ore, automate it over belts and keep the grid alive, then hold the line with towers your factory feeds and your own ship in the fight. Solo or online co-op for up to 4 players.

4812310.name: Hearthfield
4812310.short_description: Hearthfield is a cozy farming and small-town life sim set in a hand-built 3D valley. Every door opens, the town keeps its own hours, and you can bring up to three friends along. In development and growing, with a new post every month.

4889510.name: Choose Wrong, Die
4889510.short_description: In Six Girls: Choose or Die, six fatally seductive women crash into your life. Behind their pulse-pounding charm lies a chilling death trap. Every choice decides your fate—choose wrong and die instantly. Survive the clash of desire and terror!

5329870.name: らくがきスマッシュ / Doodle Smash
5329870.short_description: Your doodle is your fighter! Draw a character and watch it brawl in a knockout-style party fighter. Its size, shape and colours decide its stats and one of 30 elemental skills. Play up to 4 on one screen, battle the CPU, or climb the online ranked Colosseum against doodles from around the world.

4807680.name: Magic Moon Demo
4807680.short_description: Welcome to Magic Moon, a cozy mystery life sim set on a peaceful island where the air is fresh, the waters sparkle, and the ground hums with forgotten magic. You play as Hana, a magical girl starting over on a remote island full of charm, curiosity, and just a little mystery.

4898000.name: 3DMOBA
4898000.short_description: 3DMOBA is a third-person multiplayer arena game developed with Unreal Engine, inspired by classic third-person MOBA games. Choose from unique heroes, use skill-based abilities, fight against other players, and survive until the end to become the final victor.

5328860.name: Stellar Forge
5328860.short_description: You start with cold hydrogen and a dead clump of dust. Feed it, and the mix decides what ignites — 21 kinds of star, dwarf and collapsed body, none of them picked off a menu. Then send what you made into the ring with a God riding it, and knock rival bodies out of orbit.

4687030.name: Ribbit Riot!
4687030.short_description: Ribbit Riot! is a one-button chaos game where you unleash idiot frogs to destroy a tiny city. Click the frog button, stack absurd upgrades, and watch everything spiral out of control.

4288780.name: Morvex
4288780.short_description: Morvex is a free-to-play, round-based zombie survival FPS. Battle relentless undead hordes, craft and upgrade powerful weapons, face deadly bosses, and climb the global leaderboards. How long can you survive?🧟‍♂️⚡

5428620.name: IMYEON : Yokai Survivor
5428620.short_description: A pixel-art survivors game where you fight swarms of yokai with old Korean weapons and shaman tools like the Horn Bow and Spirit Knives. Pick an upgrade on every level-up and fuse two maxed weapons into one. 6 stages, a 30-minute Endless mode, 20 heroes and 12 fusion weapons.

5432350.name: Last Stream Demo
5432350.short_description: Demo of Last Stream, a 1–4 player online co-op horror game. Go live inside Grandpa's house, solve the puzzles hidden in his memories and keep your chat watching. But every clue you bring back makes him angrier. Run. Hide. Keep recording.

4151070.name: Heart Flipper: A House Flipper Dating Sim
4151070.short_description: Heart Flipper: A House Flipper Dating Sim is a visual novel that lets you date characters from the beloved renovation simulator. Mend their hearts with your choices, help through relaxing minigames, and find love… or stay single forever!

4544250.name: VVV
4544250.short_description:
Raise your Voltage in a Virtual world and seize Victory!!!  
Chain combos, master powerful Arts, and race against time.  
Roguelite × 3D Action  
Every cleared stage brings new upgrades, while the relentless countdown pushes your Voltage even higher.

4023960.name: Dragon Riders
4023960.short_description: An Ethical Gacha Game, Story-Driven BL or Bara Romance VN, and Card Battler! Bond with a SENTIENT dragon and date 1 of 4 customizable Love Interests! Card battles, team management, deck building, gacha unlocks, rich lore, dragon/dragon love, dragon/human, and a way to become a dragon yourself!

4326170.name: Esports Manager: FPS
4326170.short_description: Take a fictional esports club from the bottom of the world rankings to the trophy. Sign players with real personalities, plan every week, call the shots on a live tactical radar and live the storylines your season writes.

5094940.name: Cardsharp
5094940.short_description: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

5000880.name: Coverage
5000880.short_description: Grow to cover the board with your pieces--or absorb all of your opponent's. A board game similar to Othello and Ataxx, playable by up to 2 players online or offline, with a built-in board editor and 3 game modes! Relax with a classic experience or try a fast-paced simultaneous movement mode!

5038160.name: SQUIRT GAME 💦
5038160.short_description: You voluntarily got involved in this madness and found yourself trapped. Now you're the star of a scandalous adult reality show. Manipulate and seduce your sexual rivals to win the grand prize. Let's get dirty! 🐙💦

5354830.name: DriveDeck
5354830.short_description: Stop treating your external SSD like a dumping ground. DriveDeck turns it into a portable desktop you can live in: drop files, organize, run verified transfers and safely eject. Your workspace travels with your files.

4405820.name: Broken Soccer
4405820.short_description: Pick one of 38 ridiculous teams, roll the die and unleash a dinosaur charge, a zombie infection, a bull market (with an actual bull) or Nietzsche off the bench. Tied at full time? Boots off, fists up. Solo, co-op or online versus up to 4v4.

4481740.name: Static Maw Demo
4481740.short_description:
Something out there is trying to reach you.
Work alone as a night operator in a remote antenna facility lost in the void.
Repair broken transmitters and antennas using your computer and tools.
You are not alone. Will you respond?

4891050.name: Network Engineer Demo
4891050.short_description: Build a server empire from a rural farm. Place buildings and generators, rack routers and servers, cable real networks, power everything correctly, then sign clients and keep them online as you grow from a shed into a serious hosting business.

5105700.name: 宿の掟 / Rules of the Inn Demo
5105700.short_description: You know the rules. You still can't be sure if what you just saw was wrongness or your nerves. Take a room at an inn on the border of the afterlife and judge what slips in each night, obeying one rule more than the last. The demo runs to the third night. Past it, the rules alone will not save you.

5076440.name: Solo Tower Defense VR
5076440.short_description: A single-player VR tower defense shooter. Warp between two lanes, shoot down incoming enemies, and defend the gate. Choose upgrade cards between waves to boost your firepower, projectile speed, and more. Designed for seated play and comfort, while keeping the defense fast-paced and intense.

4374670.name: Timberworks
4374670.short_description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

5080950.name: Dimenshaper Demo
5080950.short_description: Dimenshaper is a handcrafted precision platformer about momentum, timing, and mastery. Switch dimensions to change what the world allows, and push for cleaner, faster runs through tightly designed levels.

3550670.name: 拂晓之诗Dawn's Poem
3550670.short_description: A sci-fi otome AVG game where players will take on the role of the "Spark" of a new world, encounter 6 male protagonists, and unlock different endings through puzzles and choices. Uncover the mystery behind your parents' death and discover the truth of the world.

5058410.name: Draftfall
5058410.short_description: Jake died saving a stranger and woke up in a war. Draft from 90 cards across nine affinities, pick your weapon, and build a hero who fights on his own in this story-driven fantasy auto-battler.

5362920.name: Cell Dominion
5362920.short_description: Eat. Grow. Divide. Dominate. Start as a tiny cell in a hostile microscopic ocean, build organelles, evolve deadly genes and grow into a colony that rules the deep. Blind rivals with ink, shock them with electricity and battle other players online.

5387050.name: Tinymon Tactics
5387050.short_description: A cozy roguelite autobattler. Set sail for Verdantia, an archipelago where curious little creatures called Tinymon roam every island. Befriend them, help them evolve, and shape them into a team strong enough to challenge the arena leaders waiting at the end of each island.

2810520.name: Card Shards Demo
2810520.short_description: Your cards, your rules! Create your own cards and immerse yourself in a world of limitless creativity. Challenge opponents, discover new strategies and become the architect of your own legend. Ready for your adventure?

4326820.name: Rolling Stock
4326820.short_description: An online co-op train loading game for up to 4 players. Handle various types of cargo, ensure a tight fit, and help your friends when things get heavy. This new fully physics-based puzzler is rolling out cross-platform on Windows and Linux!

2150030.name: Dark Tidings Online
2150030.short_description: A classic, Tiny-MMORPG experience. From a penniless nobody dropped with no memories into an unknown world, to a hero ... or a villain? Join a faction of your choice and learn a wide array of skills. Help out villagers in need, battle in the wilds and explore dungeons. Alone or with friends!

4931580.name: Just One Bite Demo
4931580.short_description:
A 1~4 player co-op horror game. Gather as much food as possible for the humans. 
Your mission is to gather as much food as possible for the humans. But not all food is normal. 
Can you complete this mission to the very end?

4218200.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator Demo
4218200.short_description: Start with nothing and build your own business empire in sunny Miami Beach! Sell lemonade, run vending machines, automate your companies and turn small side jobs into big profits in this relaxed first-person simulator.

4104230.name: 警觉小队A.W.A.R.E
4104230.short_description: A.W.A.R.E is a furry visual novel blending cinematic animation with QTE-style interactions. Follow Sander, a red-haired tiger courier, into a clash between rival factions over a mysterious package. Episode 1 (Chapters 1–3) is free; future chapters are planned as paid DLC.

4147650.name: Nullspace
4147650.short_description: A sci-fi action roguelite with bullet-heaven combat. Choose a Commander, build around four abilities, and survive escalating swarms. Gear up in endless Quick Play or enter Ranked Hunts with random affixes, solo bosses, and leaderboard clears.

5081760.name: Fate & Felt Demo
5081760.short_description: Fate & Felt Demo is a focused slice of a single-player poker roguelite built on Texas Hold'em. Read opponents, judge your hand, manage chips, and decide when to check, call, raise, fold, or go all-in across the Pre-Flop, Flop, Turn, and River.

4879630.name: Hauntasy
4879630.short_description:
Do you believe in ghosts?
You and your chosen partner are top influencers invited to survive seven nights inside a haunted ancestral estate for $1,000,000. Monitor the rooms, manage your candles, and uncover what the Baron and Baroness are hiding before 4 AM in this psychological fantasy horror.

5084440.name: Curse of the Ancient Grimoire Demo

5398960.name: The Lost Within II
5398960.short_description: You are trapped in dark, abandoned mines where your only way out is to run. Solve puzzles, avoid deadly traps, and try to survive while a bloodthirsty monster hunts you down in every corner. Can you make it to the light?

5377030.name: Homeguard Demo
5377030.short_description: A 1-4 player strategy game. Build your fortress by day and defend it by night.

5201760.name: ARC Raiders - Frozen Trail Collector Set
5201760.short_description: The Frozen Trail Collector Set is the ultimate way to jump-start your journey into the mysterious northern regions of the Rust Belt.

5229070.name: Never Sort By Color Demo
5229070.short_description: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

5283570.name: 파멸의 오타쿠 Soundtrack
5283570.short_description:
Doomed Otaku Official Soundtrack (Composed by KHS)
The official soundtrack for Doomed Otaku, featuring a total of 76 tracks. Provided in MP3 format.

4882390.name: Rekindled Demo
4882390.short_description: Rekindled is a co-op tavern game with a twist - there's no stress! Forage, Fish, Farm and Cook at your own pace, then decorate your dishes and tavern before welcoming your customers in.

4990230.name: Net Worthless Demo
4990230.short_description: A satirical life-and-money sim. One turn is one month: budget your hours, work the job, ride the market, outlive inflation and your own decisions. In the demo you play one character, the Student, start to finish: make their dream come true. Or at least don't die trying.

5047600.name: You are fired Demo
5047600.short_description: A fast and chaotic roguelike deckbuilder set in the absurd Hell’s Office. Build a powerful deck, collect twisted artifacts, and outplay your demonic coworkers as you claw your way up the corporate ladder. Face bizarre encounters, slay vicious foes, and crush your boss to earn your freedom.

4416560.name: 메이드 카페 시뮬레이터 Demo
4416560.short_description: Your first shift starts here! Run a maid café with two kemonomimi maids, make drinks, serve customers, and handle troublemakers in this first-person management demo. Reach café level 10 and get to know your new team.

4604810.name: Incurable: Prologue
4604810.short_description: You wake up alone in the rotting remains of the village you once called home. Wounded and hunted, your only link to reality is a dying radio. Navigate and survive a community consumed by a hypnotic curse in this standalone prologue to Incurable.

4622390.name: The Subminer Demo
4622390.short_description: An atmospheric underwater drilling roguelite beneath the icy crust of Enceladus. Pilot your submarine, explore the depths, mine resources through procedural caves and upgrade your base. Each dive is darker and more dangerous, and you must face the terrors lurking in the shadows. Live. Dive. Repeat.

4666560.name: Seamen Performance Overlay
4666560.short_description: Have you ever wondered how terrible (or good) your PC is at running VR? Well wonder no more! The Seamen Performance Overlay shows accurate real-time statistics of any VR game you play on SteamVR! Its frame time consistency graph is a first among VR overlays and uncovers issues never known before!

4159740.name: Muri: Wildwoods Demo
4159740.short_description: Step into the paws of Pelle, a regular muri out on their first solo mission as a cleaner. With the support of your friends on Teamsqueak, explore the mysterious island, restore the beach, its critters, and save the bird that led you here in the first place!

4269370.name: Ragdoll Physics Experiments Demo
4269370.short_description: A narrator-driven comedy game set inside a bizarre testing facility, where experiments, secrets, and physics-driven chaos are only part of the story.

3874230.name: Anno 117 - Marvellous Mosaic Pack
3874230.short_description: Build grand Roman city centers and plazas with the Marvellous Mosaic Pack! Elevate your metropolis with over 30 lavishly tiled ground designs and new mosaic skins for the Bathhouse and Forum.

3874260.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana – Blooming Cities Pack
3874260.short_description: Build flourishing gardens and vibrant green spaces with more than 20 ornaments, skins, and systems. Featuring a modular garden system, lush ornaments, and the grandest cosmetic ornament in Anno to date!

3874280.name: Anno 117: Pax Romana - Echoes of Kassandra Pack
3874280.short_description: In the Echoes of Kassandra Pack, Roman architecture meets the Eagle Bearer’s landmarks, including a mix of new character portraits, a flagship skin, grand harbor statues, and more.

4004340.name: 辦公室的窺視 Demo
4004340.short_description: Step into the secretive Omnituens Corp. Find keywords in conversations to unravel mysteries, get promoted, and leverage your power to forge intimate bonds with the captivating women of the office.

3491210.name: DOSMIC Demo
3491210.short_description: In a world teeming with colossal beings, a boy named Nero sets out to find the missing girl Snoa. Use a range of movement abilities, solve mysterious puzzles and sometimes fight otherworldly horrors in DOSMIC, a cinematic puzzle platformer.

1914280.name: Inkwell Infinity
1914280.short_description: A text adventure sandbox where a local AI is your Game Master. Type what you want to do, talk to characters with their own routines, and build your own worlds in the built-in editor. Runs on your PC: your stories and saves stay on your machine.

2472580.name: Light of Atlantis Demo
2472580.short_description:
Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! 
Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.

1794970.name: Powder
1794970.short_description: From Gameplay Recordings & Long Streams to Viral Clips. Get short-form videos from your gameplay recordings & streams in a few clicks.

982310.name: Slime Rancher: Galactic Bundle
982310.short_description: The Galactic Bundle DLC lets you customize your ranch and vacpack with the Ruby Chroma Pack and pretend to explore the final frontier with your slimes using the Galactic Playset!

5392300.name: Specimen Zero
5392300.short_description: Feel the horror and fear of the dark, unlock the exits to escape!

3642390.name: SCP:彻底失控
3642390.short_description: This is a multiplayer game developed by Unity. The story of the game tells the story of an organization called the Asylum in [DATA EXPUNGED], which caused a large number of objects to break out of containment in a Level 5 containment incident. You will play as a member of the re-containment team.

405370.name: Sky Break
405370.short_description: Sky Break is an open-world game on a stormy abandoned planet filled with wild mechas. Learn to master this world and to hack the mechas if you want a chance to survive.

4760770.name: 7Komada
4760770.short_description: A social deduction death game set in a backwater of alternate universe Europe. You and your class’s graduation trip has been cut short by a novel 19-man kidnapping - and as you all wake up trapped in an abandoned mansion, you take it upon yourself to figure out what’s going on before it's too late.

348690.name: Forward to the Sky - Original Sound Track

362260.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Liu Kang
362260.short_description: Flashback to the weeks before Liu Kang is recruited into the tournament. We see that Liu Kang has become a hitman as he murders Russian mobsters in a seedy motel.

5275200.name: MacroPilot
5275200.short_description: Record, edit and replay macros on Windows. Find buttons by image or on-screen text, target UI elements directly, build loops and conditions in a visual flow editor, and run everything with global hotkeys. Fully offline, no account required.

4476270.name: Crown & Coin: The Hundred Years
4476270.short_description: Survive the Hundred Years' War in this medieval ensemble sandbox. Play as 1,015 historical figures, from Joan of Arc to the imposter des Armoises. Gain glory as a knight, forge a new kingdom to crush England and France, or thrive as a bandit. Discover 22 tarot-based multiple endings!

4460030.name: 幻兽防线 Demo
4460030.short_description: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

3908150.name: NovelStudio
3908150.short_description: Novel Studio is an all-in-one editor for easily creating visual novels, without coding or drawing. Generate animated characters, backgrounds, multiple-choice dialogues and even 3D playable levels. Unleash your creativity, tell your story.

4791910.name: Alethra
4791910.short_description: A dice roguelike where every die you draft is yours forever — if you get it out alive. Chain combos, stack poker chips that break the rules, and decide at every shop: extract and keep your loot, or push one more round and risk all of it.

3300520.name: The Ardron Universe
3300520.short_description: Your choices carve scars across realms. One universe. Multiple games. No second chances.

5319740.name: Frogball
5319740.short_description: Classic 90's GameBoy style Pinball... this time with frogs! Compete against your friends and the world for the highest scores on 8 unique, interlinked pinball tables. It's fast, fun and impossible to put down!

4743040.name: Tiny Village
4743040.short_description: 《Tiny Village》 is an incremental game where you gather resources with your mouse, unlock new buildings with the resources you collect, and develop your village. Strengthen your gathering abilities, unlock a variety of buildings one by one, and turn your small village into a thriving home!

4599980.name: Unshelved Demo
4599980.short_description: Unshelved is an up to 4-player co-op Work-Life Horror Sim where you manage a cursed library. By day, handle book requests and earn an honest living. But as night falls, you must return books to their shelves and survive the horrors that haunt the halls!

5417520.name: Miso Editor
5417520.short_description: Turn one character image into an 8, 16, or 32-direction sprite sheet in minutes, with a single click. Easy mode runs 3D conversion, rigging, motion, and rendering for you. Weapons, RPG Maker MZ export, and custom cameras included.

5408600.name: Pinnacle
5408600.short_description: Build your own table, place bumpers wisely, trigger powerful synergies, and forge a unique build in every run.

2231090.name: Number Machine: Math Factory
2231090.short_description: Number Machine is an open-ended factory and automation game with math mechanics. Design, build, and optimize factories that automatically assemble and deliver complex numerical structures. Inspired by Opus Magnum and Infinifactory.

4893050.name: DinoSWORD
4893050.short_description: Dinosaurs...with SWORDS!? When dimensional tears rip through time and space, refined weaponry and prehistoric beast collide! Also includes DINO CHESS, a mode that combines the strategy of CHESS with the savage brutality of 3D DINOSAUR COMBAT!

4590720.name: Pack or Die
4590720.short_description: Face hordes of zombies in a third-person action survival game! Explore a post-apocalyptic world, find weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and strategically manage your inventory. Every slot in your case matters!

5445870.name: Vending Machine Simulator
5445870.short_description: A first-person business sim about keeping a growing network of vending machines profitable. Start with $4,000, a tired van and one snack machine, then drive around Millbrook restocking, repairing and haggling over leases. Up to four players can share one company over a LAN.

3473440.name: Sparrow Warfare
3473440.short_description: Play ever-crazier combinations of 3 tiles to free the birds in our synergy-rich deckbuilder. Let your mind take flight as you scheme and strategise. This… is Sparrow Warfare!

5356850.name: Arauto
5356850.short_description: Arauto is a turn-based board game of territorial conquest for 3 to 6 players, online against friends or bots. Roll the dice, hold continents, trade cards and chase a secret objective on the real world map or in the mythic realms of Ancalora and Asterra.

4905840.name: IfStation
4905840.short_description:
A historical card game where you place legends onto a timeline and watch civilizations rise — or collapse.

This project is currently in the initial implementation phase following the completion of the design; you can view real-time development logs via the Community tab.

4923370.name: Studs Up!
4923370.short_description: First-person football where you control your feet, with no scripted animations deciding where the ball goes. Play 1v1 to 5v5 online as a striker, keeper or referee. Have no friends? Draft a squad in the 'Cup Run' roguelite mode. Level up your players, pick upgrades and fight through a knockout cup.

2939680.name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
2939680.short_description: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

4140700.name: Cash is King! Business Simulator
4140700.short_description: Start with nothing and build your own business empire in sunny Miami Beach! Sell lemonade, run vending machines, automate your companies and turn small side jobs into big profits in this relaxed first-person simulator.

3366380.name: Scrollmapper
3366380.short_description: Scrollmapper is an open-source scripture analysis tool that creates detailed cross-references for canonical and apocryphal scriptures. It features advanced graphing, Gephi integration, and meta editing, allowing users to visualize and explore complex scripture relationships.

5061060.name: Plum
5061060.short_description:
Plum is a 3d cozy platforming and collectathon game where you will have to roll and bounce through the valley in search for home.
On your way, meet different ghost plums each which a story to share.
This game is a colorful stylized short adventure (about 1h) made to chill or speedrunning.

2810490.name: Card Shards
2810490.short_description: Your cards, your rules! Create your own cards and immerse yourself in a world of limitless creativity. Challenge opponents, discover new strategies and become the architect of your own legend. Ready for your adventure?

5219780.name: The Miner's Routine
5219780.short_description: A cozy pixel-art game about a miner sent to a remote island by order of the King. Mine resources, restore an abandoned mine, upgrade your tools, hire workers, and venture deeper underground to discover what lies beneath the mountain.

4027820.name: Asylium
4027820.short_description: A horror escape-room experience. Solve puzzles, don't get caught and escape while learing about your past.

2476950.name: Sprite Forge
2476950.short_description: Create amazing sprites for your project. Your beautiful tile map in a couple of minutes. Simplify your life, automate the generation of beautiful sprites.

5050110.name: Money Wars : Modern Ages
5050110.short_description: A country simulator built on strategy: 160 real nations, deep production chains, a live world market, diplomacy, intelligence and war. Win the world with economy, not armies.

4992280.name: Haunted Paws Demo
4992280.short_description: A cozy and spooky co-op adventure where two puppies rescue their owner from a haunted mansion. Customize your puppy, solve puzzles together, and defeat evil creatures. Play locally or invite a friend for free with Friend’s Pass.

4558680.name: Field of Heroes Demo
4558680.short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your orc players in Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online fantasy sports brawler ever. Conquer fields, sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

4808350.name: Village and Dungeon-Maze Magic Book
4808350.short_description: 《Village and Dungeon- Maze Magic Book》is an isometric casual strategy game. The player takes on the role of the village chief and recruits heroes to explore the underground caves of the village.

5248310.name: KAARTEL Demo
5248310.short_description: A hidden-movement strategy game: analyze the map, track the thief across Europe, catch them before they escape.

1918850.name: Sleepytime Village
1918850.short_description: Sleepytime Village is the story of a workaholic father who makes one wrong choice too many and becomes trapped in a children’s storybook reality, haunted by the residents, its formless narrator and visions of his childhood. What is the Village and what does it want from him?

5192360.name: Lead the Charge
5192360.short_description: Ride at the head of a living army. Lead one of 5 legendary commanders, recruit 23 more generals, switch between 8 formations and sound the charge across 8 historical battlefields in a fast single-player army roguelite.

1267290.name: Field of Heroes
1267290.short_description: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your friends and get on the Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

5332820.name: Kaiju Climber
5332820.short_description: Kaiju Climber is a surreal action-platformer where the goal is simple; Get to the next checkpoint! (Try not to die) Guide your chicken through dozens of intense levels - where falls, hazards and Kaiju wish to see you cooked. Brought to you by the one-man indie project: Capesize Entertainment.

5146420.name: Fall of the Void
5146420.short_description: Fall of the Void is a dark fantasy isometric ARPG merging high-octane hack-and-slash combat with deep build crafting. Descend into perilous dungeons across fractured realms, master evolving abilities, and forge devastating power synergies to shape your destiny.

4421600.name: PANAME
4421600.short_description: PANAME is a simulation/sandbox game project that immerses you in the heart of a stylized Paris, recreated with a PS1/retro aesthetic. Explore its different districts and interact with its inhabitants.

5396890.name: Civitas: World Simulator Demo
5396890.short_description: Civitas: World Simulator Demo gives the player the ability to experience 1936 to 1945! In this game, we model internal forces like ethnicity, culture, language, and other internal political struggles.

3131960.name: 努斯跳跃的前奏 Demo
3131960.short_description: “Prelude to Nuss Jump” Demo: A preview experience where you follow the melody to navigate a displaced world, unlock hidden memories through multiple story branches, and enjoy an accessible, immersive experience.

2434900.name: Massive Collapse
2434900.short_description: Massive Collapse is a round-based multiplayer shooter where every match begins with a new build. Choose your race, combine spells and gadgets to create new strategies built to outmaneuver, outplay, and overwhelm your opponents.

4343600.name: Mo Wu Tian Gong
4343600.short_description: Mo Wu Tian Gong is an open-world survival-action game set in mythic ancient China. As both builder and warrior, you will "plan with ink, fight with steel" in a fractured yet beautiful world. Survive by gathering resources, constructing shelters, and farming.

5101780.name: Carve The Cave Together
5101780.short_description: Dig a cave together with a friend. There's no gravity down here: throw a ball at the rock and it bounces until the rock stops it. Mine ore, run it through the machine, crack open crates, and follow four buried stones to the one golden piece hidden in the dark.

4244750.name: Ghosts With Hats Demo
4244750.short_description: Ghosts With Hats is a fast-paced top-down arcade racing game where ghosts compete on dynamic tracks. Collect relics, upgrade your unique character, and dash to victory!

3640270.name: Hunter's Hand
3640270.short_description: A dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where every clue you uncover wakes the thing hunting you. Build a lethal deck across branching paths, weather corrupting biomes, and raise the Threat - then discover how much of an Ancient's attention you can survive.

4609790.name: Here's My Target
4609790.short_description: Contract killing is just another public service. As a regulator, it's your job to review the documents, listen to the client, and decide the fate of every target, then hope you made the right call.

4278290.name: Magic Cards Duel
4278290.short_description: A wild party card game for 2-4 players. Jumpscare, stun, and blur your friends, but watch out: they can counter, reflect, or even steal your attacks. Chain epic combos and outplay everyone!

5220590.name: Massive Collapse Demo
5220590.short_description: Massive Collapse is a round-based multiplayer shooter where every match begins with a new build. Choose your race, combine spells and gadgets to create new strategies built to outmaneuver, outplay, and overwhelm your opponents.

4411030.name: Vanakan 405 Demo
4411030.short_description: It is the Golden Age of Armenia, the letters have been invented and the Bible is being translated by Mesrop Mashtots. Ohan of Van finds himself on a journey which brings him to the unknown land filled with mystery, where the monastery is his only sanctuary.

5407250.name: Planet Pilot
5407250.short_description: Fly a toy-sized Earth with nearly 2,900 real airports, 71 real cities and famous skylines. Climb from a tiny ultralight to a supersonic jet in a relaxed flying career, then swap passengers for guns in Dogfights: missions, 14 Legends battles, online PvP and co-op.

5358590.name: 潮生归港
5358590.short_description: Explore Chaoshan in a 2D pixel-art, turn-based RPG. Play as A-Cheng, a young letter writer searching for her family. Follow clues in overseas letters, solve puzzles, explore traditional towns, and battle monsters with companions using skills inspired by local arts and folklore.

4857030.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Arcade Apocalypse Pack
4857030.short_description: Expand your Walking Dead experience with endless survival modes, brutal hardcore difficulty, exclusive weapon & character skins, and digital bonus content

4857020.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Golden Survival Pack

5082260.name: Hauntasy Demo
5082260.short_description: Do you believe in ghosts? The Baron and Baroness offer $1,000,000 to survive seven nights in their haunted estate. Watch the house, conserve resources, and reach 4 AM. Investigate ghosts, uncover their stories, and find evidence to put a killer behind bars. Survive HAUNTASY, and the money is yours.

4260690.name: Hardcourt Balls
4260690.short_description: Hardcourt Balls is a fast-paced, turn-based adaptation of the real-world game of tennis. With just a few simple rules, the roll of dice, and tactical use of skill "cards", it manages to capture some of the nuances and excitement that make tennis such a great sport.

5096480.name: Shattered Void Online Demo
5096480.short_description: Fly a warship in 5v5 fleet battles, board an enemy outpost and fight for it on foot, or command a fleet across six star systems: all three sides, on the live servers, and everything you earn carries into the full game.

3886270.name: Vanakan 405
3886270.short_description: It is the Golden Age of Armenia, the letters have been invented and the Bible is being translated by Mesrop Mashtots. Ohan of Van finds himself on a journey which brings him to the unknown land filled with mystery, where the monastery is his only sanctuary.

4475480.name: Shattered Void Online
4475480.short_description: One war, three ways to fight it. Take the bridge of a warship in 5v5 fleet battles, board an enemy outpost and fight for it on foot, or command a whole fleet across six star systems. Vanguard against Ironsworn: pick your side and get on the line.

5005710.name: Kingdom of Hope Demo
5005710.short_description: Rise from nine years of tyranny to rebuild a scarred medieval land. As a celebrated hero, you’re granted a farmstead by the new King. Forge a fresh life of growth, craft, and community.

4055380.name: SpaceSim
4055380.short_description: Simulation & rendering software that uses Smoothed Particle Hydrodynamics (SPH) to simulate collisions of celestial bodies, accretion disks around black holes, or formation of galaxies in the early universe.

4092390.name: Trials Survivors Demo
4092390.short_description:
Fight through endless hordes in trials bestowed by constellation patrons.
Upgrade skills, collect relics, and craft broken builds in true roguelite fashion!
Rediscover the fantasy behind the words hack and slash and bullet heaven.
Will you survive the densest monster Survivor-like ever created?

4711310.name: How to Summon a Demon
4711310.short_description:
Ready to summon a demon this Halloween? 
Three answers decide which of 20 demons answers your call. A short, fully voiced summoning ritual with a collection book for everyone who wants to summon them all!

5122330.name: Console Space
5122330.short_description: You are the captain aboard a starship. Make decisions in the terminal's text logs: from repairing the reactor to moral dilemmas that irreversibly change the fate of the crew.

5040510.name: In Silent Walls : Inside The House
5040510.short_description: Trapped inside a house that defies all logic, explore your memories, escape the creatures hunting you, and uncover what truly connects you to the Red Hollow Sanatorium.

5380600.name: Cricket Franchise Manager
5380600.short_description: Build a T20 cricket franchise from the auction room up, then captain every ball. Outbid rivals for star players, set fields and match-ups in a deep live match engine, and manage the board, sponsors and finances across a global multi-league career.

5271920.name: boba:3
5271920.short_description: A cozy merge puzzle in a boba cup. Drop kawaii animal pearls, merge matching pairs into bigger (and weirder) lil guys, and don't let the cup overflow. Survive chaotic modifier pearls and unlock new boba flavors as your high score climbs.

5175080.name: Potion Master
5175080.short_description: Inherit your grandmother's potion shop and make it your own. Chop, squeeze, and grind ingredients to brew potions — stick to the recipe, or experiment and discover new formulas. Build your reputation, attract mighty heroes bearing rare ingredients, and decorate your shop with curious trophies.

5260710.name: Fantasy Matchmaker
5260710.short_description: This is a classic monster-catching game featuring 200 monsters, 17 elements, 17 jobs, over 360 skills, 170 passives, and 285 pieces of equipment. In the story, you will meet all kinds of friends, help them find love, explore themes of romance, and preserve peace across this fantasy world.

3256450.name: Cards of Prophecy
3256450.short_description: Cards of Prophecy combines Tower Defense, Deckbuilding, and Roguelike elements, with huge inspiration from Trading Card Games. Build an ever evolving deck to summon monsters and use powerful spells. Fuse, defend, open card packs, create new strategies. Repeat.

5400070.name: Stolen Realm: Bard Pack
5400070.short_description: Take the stage with the Bard Pack, a new Stolen Realm skill tree built around Songs and Crescendo. Empower allies, control enemies, protect your party, and build momentum before cashing it in for powerful attacks.

3764180.name: Lone City
3764180.short_description: Lone City blends romance, shooting and survival in a post-apocalyptic open world. Explore ruins, scavenge supplies and fight zombies and mutants. Drive a sports car through the city with your dog. At home, grow closer to beautiful women with distinct personalities and build a life together.

4655130.name: 天堂恋爱王 Heaven Miner
4655130.short_description: Find outfits, fall in love with angels, and build a harem! Start a relaxing journey in Heaven Miner and build a unique harem.

5430350.name: Grid & Loot
5430350.short_description: Grid & Loot is a casual turn-based RPG with unique gameplay: one click resolves combat on a 3x3 grid. Pick your class, explore areas, collect loot, forge legendary gear and survive traps, elites and bosses.

3999370.name: Deadlight Manor
3999370.short_description: A stylized survival horror built on community. Squad up with your team, battle endless waves of the infected, and let your stream audience fuel the chaos in real time.

4701520.name: Dreamer's Wake Demo
4701520.short_description: A stylized third person collectathon set in collapsing dreamscapes. Play as a Haniwa clay figure — conjure projectiles, rewind time, and explore surreal worlds to restore them from static.

4870010.name: K-pop Fucking Hunters Soundtrack
4870010.short_description: The official soundtrack to KPop Fucking Hunters: eleven original synth-pop and dance-pop tracks pulled straight from the stage. Glittering hooks, three-vocalist harmonies, and arena-sized energy scoring every performance, rehearsal, and quiet moment of the trio's rise to stardom.

5390130.name: NSFW Solitaire - Cumshots Video
5390130.short_description: 703 videos and 15 cumshot-themed video card sets for NSFW Solitaire

5040820.name: Hide Your Cash
5040820.short_description: You'll Never Find My Cash! is a 1–4 player physics party game. Hide money in toilet tanks, mattresses and fridges, then raid your friends' houses while they block doors, shove you aside and act innocent. Play online with friends or solo against a bot.

4749670.name: Pregnant Roommates, Send Help! Soundtrack
4749670.short_description: The official soundtrack to Pregnant Roommates, Send Help!: twelve original tracks from the apartment you never should have moved into. Warm acoustic mornings, soft piano leitmotifs for each roommate, and cozy lo-fi for the quiet hours in between.

5168160.name: Football Academy Simulator Demo
5168160.short_description: Manage your own football academy! Create personalized training programs to develop your players, clean and repair equipment, run your sports store, and use your earnings to expand your facilities.

4999150.name: Chesstria
4999150.short_description: Chesstria is a unique chess roguelite that blends the original chess rules with consumables, artifacts, and banners. Face unique boss banners, run the Gauntlet, and discover unique events. Fight 1v1 against your friend, or compete on the daily leaderboard. Or just solve some complex puzzles!

5256600.name: King's : The Eight Tribes
5256600.short_description: An online MMORPG where warriors and tribes clash in epic battles. Build your character, defeat monsters, fight other players, and become a legend.

5455960.name: Round and Round Inc.
5455960.short_description: A black-and-white incremental game about one revolving door. Turn it, let people in, and spend the earnings on a bigger door and better blades, until the corner shop's little door is a human pump swallowing the whole city. The goal: admit all of humanity.

5315910.name: Hasami: Moonlight Trim
5315910.short_description: Hasami is a tree pruning game where every cut cleaves through everything it crosses. Find the right angle, pull branches aside with ropes, nurture new growth, and clean endless procedural trees down to their blossom.

4681350.name: LiveWall Wallpaper for Mac
4681350.short_description: Bring your desktop to life on macOS with LiveWall. Import and run Wallpaper Engine web, video, and Scene wallpapers, with interactive effects, audio visualization, customizable settings, and performance controls for each display.

4055050.name: Abracablabla
4055050.short_description: Shout Latin spells into your mic in a chaotic 1-4 player co-op action roguelike. Call down meteor storms, open black holes, turn a friend into a sheep by accident. Friendly fire is always on, and a wall of death is closing in behind you.

5441740.name: Wonder Garden
5441740.short_description: Grow a little garden on your desktop while you work or relax. Plant seeds, water your plants, raise butterflies and discover their varieties in your almanac. Arrange your own shelves on Windows and macOS, or let plants sit on window edges on macOS.

5106680.name: DIGITRE:SUM
5106680.short_description: Link adjacent numbers to total 10 or 20 on a rising board—a fast math action puzzle. Build CHAINs, collect TARGETs, chase SCORE, and cut CLEAR TIME. Soon, 10s and 20s jump out at you. Classic arcade play where every run shows your progress. Includes VS, PUZZLE, 50-clear BLITZ, and ENDLESS.

4873650.name: Incinerator Inc
4873650.short_description:
You are a pyro for hire.

In Incinerator Inc, people come to you with their problems and you make their problems… unrecoverable… It’s a easy business model. Because some stains only fire can shift.

4460200.name: Blow The Cover
4460200.short_description: Build your mercenary organization through high-risk tactical contracts. Plan Heists, Assassinations, Extractions, and more choosing when to stay hidden, when to fight, and how to adapt when things go wrong.

3648390.name: 纳伊阿德斯的坠落
3648390.short_description: Naiads' Fall: When divine punishment drowns the realm in blood-tears and curses, you emerge into a forsaken world—where sands soak decadence, rains hold god-slaying power. Loot artifacts, forge cursed gear, and unearth secrets: build your combat system through relentless exploration.

1878170.name: Escapers
1878170.short_description: Escapers is co-op, puzzle escaping game. Your only goal is to get away!

4256330.name: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook DEMO
4256330.short_description: On Air! Taxi Detective Casebook is a pixel-art, dialogue-driven mystery game. You’re an AI in a taxi, teaming up with a talkative driver on late-night runs to hear bizarre passenger stories, solve cases in secret, and let him play the “great detective.”

5382210.name: Jade Terrace
5382210.short_description: An idle xianxia RPG with a story. Grow up in a mountain village, train six skills to 99 and raise a band of companions with offline progress, then dive into the Jade Realm, a hands-on roguelike deckbuilder.

3285880.name: MONOMOON
3285880.short_description: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

4080200.name: Once Upon a Swagman
4080200.short_description: A relaxing survival experience where you journey from place to place, camping along a pixel art coastline as a traditional Australian swagman. You will face a realistic simulated coastal bush environment, follow in the footsteps of the old swaggies, and discover what lies at the end of your journey.

4369010.name: Keko & the NightShard
4369010.short_description: a 3D-Platformer adventure where you control two interconnected characters: Keko, a pirate cat, and the Night Shard, a living fragment of the shattered night sky. Explore mysterious islands, overcome challenges, and restore the broken night sky.

4708400.name: You're Alive, Phil
4708400.short_description: Help Phil work out what it means to be alive. Guide our rocky friend through 70 handcrafted grid-based puzzles, where every step changes the path you can take.

4502500.name: モノクリ
4502500.short_description:
White or Black—
A world painted in just two colors.
Toggle the colors of your character and the blocks to "forge" your path to the goal in this brand-new puzzle experience.

5180930.name: The Last Ranger
5180930.short_description: The Last Ranger is a dark fantasy top-down survival shooter where you fight off huge waves of enemies, stack mid-round upgrades to buff yourself up and do your best to survive the night. Make the most of the permanent mastery system to make each run more rewarding, then take bosses down in style!

4617500.name: Revenant Survivors
4617500.short_description: Revenant Survivors is a horde survival action roguelite set in a Diablo-inspired dark fantasy world. Tear through endless hordes with hard-hitting combat, absorb souls, steal bosses’ skills, and even take their bodies to become evil incarnate.

4992940.name: Rogue Belt
