4992940.short_description: Fight through a storm-wracked asteroid belt in this top-down space roguelite, solo or in online co-op. Mix ships and weapons, choose an upgrade every minute, and face the boss after ten minutes. Break through to unlock new ships, weapons, and permanent upgrades.

5363390.name: Somnesis: The PSX Tapes Demo
5363390.short_description: A 2000s psychological horror game about a young girl who uncovers a box of cursed 90s VHS cartridges in her new home. Play eerie PSX-style retro games on a CRT monitor while simultaneously managing threats in your dark bedroom. Balance nostalgic retro gameplay with real-time survival.

5472790.name: Vorynth : Ashfall
5472790.short_description: Choose from 12 classes, plan every turn and hunt rare loot in a dark fantasy RPG. Explore hand-built dungeons, reforge your gear and push into harder difficulty tiers. Play solo offline or team up with up to three friends in online co-op.

5087340.name: Hide Your Cash Demo
5087340.short_description: The free demo of You'll Never Find My Cash! Hide your cash in the toilet tank, under the mattress, behind the fridge, then break into your friends' houses and find theirs while they try to look innocent. 1–4 players: online with friends or solo against a bot.

4323170.name: Iteru
4323170.short_description: A free-to-play MMO at Giza, 2540 BCE. Arrive as a laborer while Khafre's pyramid rises and the Sphinx is carved from the bedrock. Haul stone for the Great Work, craft, trade on one market and rise in rank in one shared world. Cosmetics and convenience only, never pay-to-win.

5308590.name: Bird Empire
5308590.short_description: Build a legendary bird farm in a cozy idle game. Collect six bird species, sell eggs, fulfill customer orders, develop new facilities, earn offline income, and begin new cycles to unlock permanent bonuses for your growing empire.

4967660.name: Ball-Aqua
4967660.short_description: A speedy physics ball platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure and Ballance. Spin Dash, grind rails, and roll through a sunny Frutiger Aero world, solo or in online co-op. Free demo available now.

5340380.name: A few at the Museum
5340380.short_description: A 1-4 player physics-based destruction game. Gather a crew, break all the stuff in the museum galleries, punch some ancient statues in the face, throw them away, run away from really drunk security guards, and defeat the bosses of the museum galleries. What could possibly go wrong?

3137380.name: Partylaugh
3137380.short_description: Partylaugh is a treasure hunt party game where everyone battles till the end, solo or team. Fly through canyons. Explore ruins. Crash a fireworks festival. Solid shooting. Funny fights. Party weapons blast out treasure! Final moment? One giant wave grenade. One wild grab. YOU are the Treasure King!

5235320.name: ToyOps Demo
5235320.short_description: Tiny agents. Giant world. A rookie squad’s first mission goes wrong. In this action-puzzle adventure, dodge traps and enemies, leap across oversized environments, and combine unique abilities—including teleportation—to solve platforming puzzles and infiltrate enemy territory.

4960640.name: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War
4960640.short_description: KIT Three Kingdoms: Heroes at War is a logistics-driven strategy game. Govern cities, recruit officers and move armies across a grand map, then command formations, Battle Arts, Stratagems, sieges and duels in real time. Choose a faction in seven sandbox starts and unite the realm.

4756820.name: Crosswinds
4756820.short_description: Crosswinds is a romantic adventure set in the skies. After a failed casino heist, two lovers must separate to avoid capture. Fly across 1930s Mediterranean coastal towns, follow hidden letters and intimate clues, and reunite with your beloved through a contemplative journey of self discovery.

5011940.name: Ball-Aqua Demo
5011940.short_description: A speedy physics ball platformer inspired by Sonic Adventure and Ballance. Spin Dash, grind rails, and roll through a sunny Frutiger Aero world, solo or in online co-op.

4533880.name: How to Knot Drive
4533880.short_description: Two RC cars are stuck tied together with a long way up. Navigate through challenging puzzle platforms as two kids try to drive their lost RC cars back home.

2679730.name: Scourgefall
2679730.short_description: In this challenging RPG-Platformer Permadeath Roguelike, you’ll collect resources, craft, explore, and fight for your life through challenging, procedurally generated levels with up to four players at a time, unlocking customization options to help you in future adventures! How deep can you delve?

4835870.name: Table Of Truth
4835870.short_description: What do your friends actually think of you? Vote on hilarious positive and negative call-outs in this chaotic co-op party game. Agree with the crowd to score points, but prepare for the ultimate friendship test. Will you leave as the group's mastermind or its walking disaster?

4864520.name: ゲーム画面オーバーレイ翻訳
4864520.short_description:
Real-time translation of on-screen game text, overlaid right over the original. The
English-Japanese model is bundled: no download, fully offline right after install,
unlimited use. Full-screen and region translation, one-key original/translation
toggle, and a glossary.

5213840.name: MEMOLOGY: THE 2000s
5213840.short_description: MEMOLOGY: THE 2000's is a quiz about the objects and events we’ll never forget. Test how well you remember the games, internet culture, music, technology, memes, and other symbols of that unforgettable era.

2471800.name: Something Something Spaceship
2471800.short_description:
Explore a malfunctioning spaceship and retrieve the items needed to fix it, while avoiding a colourful cast of enemies.
An isometric platform puzzler inspired by games from the 8-bit era.

5396770.name: 斗匣(Pocket Battler)
5396770.short_description: Pocket Battler is a fantasy single-player tactical deployment game. Assemble troops and set their positions, watch units battle automatically, and seize turning points with manually cast spells. Complete campaign battles, select upgrades and try new lineups in roguelike mode.

4099940.name: 勇者パーティはぜんめつしました。 Demo
4099940.short_description: A story-driven roguelite RPG about a journey through the depths with a broken hero — and what they have to answer for. The hero's party has been annihilated: you carry one of them out of a cursed dungeon, learn what broke them, and settle it together. Four routes, four heroes, four reckonings.

5271010.name: Acorn Heist!
5271010.short_description: A rock-paper-scissors roguelike deckbuilder. See your opponent’s hand and read what they’ll throw next — a battle of wits, not luck. Build your deck, play after the reveal, force wins, and break the rules of rock-paper-scissors to steal acorns from the forest’s cute animal-eared girls.

5089780.name: KRIS: The Last Good Summer
5089780.short_description: Kris has thirty days before the scrap press. Play as Sam, the fifteen-year-old who found him in an attic, and explore Cedar Falls together. Solve point-and-click puzzles, change what he can do with old floppy disks, and decide which memories you dare erase to give him a future.

3339250.name: Biztopia Demo
3339250.short_description: Biztopia Demo is a free taste of Biztopia. Rent a warehouse, buy from the wholesaler, stock your shelves and send out your first deliveries, alone or with other Demo players in online co-op. Reach level 10, then keep playing.

2893550.name: CHORDIOID
2893550.short_description: CHORDIOID is a musical, genre-bending RPG where you battle to the beat. Explore a strange world, make unlikely friends, and uncover dark secrets, all while the beat goes on.

2924780.name: CHORDIOID: First Breath
2924780.short_description: Enter the world of CHORDIOID, the musical JRPG where you battle to the beat, and get a taste of the action in CHORDIOID: First Breath, a demo spanning the opening chapter of the full game.

4962410.name: The Lifeline Demo
4962410.short_description:
To escape this terrifying hospital, you must leave your fears behind. Can you do it?

Explore, face zombies, use weapons, avoid traps, and react fast to survive.

5185030.name: Boba Escape
5185030.short_description: Get ready for an adorable yet brutal climb! You play as a tiny boba pearl trying to escape a giant bubble tea. Aim, charge, and launch your way to the top in this cute but challenging precision platformer. Every jump matters, and one tiny mistake could send you tumbling all the way back down!

4777060.name: Legend Incarnates
4777060.short_description: A momentum based 2D fighter where speed is everything. Chain lightning fast combat and powerful crystilic magic in chaotic battles online or with friends.

3603810.name: Love, Lies and Memories.
3603810.short_description: Shape your own relationships, even within the same story. In a handcrafted story, AI-powered personalized choices and free-form conversations create unique connections with three heroines in this relationship simulation.

355750.name: Miegakure
355750.short_description: Miegakure is a game where you navigate a four-dimensional world to perform miraculous feats and solve puzzles.

4959330.name: Train Station Tycoon Demo
4959330.short_description: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station, solo or with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate your teams, and handle real-time disruptions across 2 tracks to keep traffic flowing smoothly!

5424540.name: Pro Endurance Series: Running Manager Demo
5424540.short_description: Experience the Berlin 10K in 3D! Control one of three athletes with different goals, manage your pace, attack, take refreshments, and make tactical decisions in real time. Can you lead your runner to success?

5051520.name: Frog Ascension
5051520.short_description: A psychological deduction puzzle game where you play as a blind dealer. Your cards are hidden from you but visible to the audience. Read their hints, catch their lies, and flip every O card to win—flip a single X and it's instant game over. Trust wisely, or unravel their deception!

4637470.name: Thunder Training Ground
4637470.short_description: Train your skills in air combat interception, ground bombing, anti-aircraft shooting, and more! Highly customize vehicle & weapon parameters, and freely set your relative position to targets. One-click reset lets you complete 3-5 training sessions in just one minute!

5058690.name: Moostache Farm
5058690.short_description: An idle farming game about Moostache, a farmer with one small field and a big mustache. Grow wheat, eggs, milk, apples and carrots, then trade the harvest for chef hats. Big Food Inc. buys your farms each season. Spend the profit on its shares until you own the company.

5024950.name: 乌托邦的钥匙/The key of Utopia Demo
5024950.short_description: In this fairy tale-style RPG, you play as Tiwn, a child who sets out for "Utopia" with his sister Tis. But upon arrival, the gates are locked due to a missing key. Will the fairy of Utopia help you open them—or will someone else hold the answer?

3992350.name: The Machinist
3992350.short_description: A knock at the door could save a life—or end yours. The Machinist is a psychological horror management game where you must keep a train running, manage its passengers, and survive whatever waits outside.

1497850.name: SNIPER
1497850.short_description: Program for transferring mouse sensitivity in different games.

5197090.name: 第三监视局 试玩版
5197090.short_description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

4628430.name: A Proof Apart
4628430.short_description: A Proof Apart is a first-person psychological horror game. Step into the shattered mind of a mathematician. Rely on your destructive addiction to bend reality, explore ever-changing environments, and hide from the terrifying manifestations of your grief. Truth and lies are a sip apart.

3475120.name: Image2pixel-Pixel Art Generator
3475120.short_description: Image2pixel is a professional pixel art generator that transforms regular images into beautiful pixel-style artwork. Whether you're a game developer, artist, or content creator, you can easily create the pixel art you envision.

5431070.name: villanovan
5431070.short_description: Watch a little world unfold, or live as a deer or wolf. On a small island, herds graze and wolf packs hunt; births, hunger, ageing and drought shape every life. Choose where to go, where to graze or which prey to hunt. Civilization is the ambition.

2471680.name: Risimon
2471680.short_description: Risimon is an adventure & monster-taming game combining an off-the-wall tone with a retro, yet restyled, aesthetic. Experience a hilarious journey across the Issou region. Catch Risimon, train them and fight to prove to yourself that you are NOT a loser!

3771910.name: Cold Bed on Route - Artbook
3771910.short_description: This is the art and data book for the rogue-lite equation-like adventure game Cold Bed on Route.

4586780.name: Mentiss: Werewolf - Human vs AI
4586780.short_description: Play Werewolf with AI players that argue, bluff and vote on their own. Hunt the wolves with the village or lie your way to a wolf win, solo or with friends while AI fills the empty seats. Watch Mode, Parallel Mode, replays and post-game Review. Free Games every day.

5207910.name: Cozyquarium
5207910.short_description:
Create your own cozy aquarium, your own COZYQUARIUM!
Collect fishes, display your favorites, make them 5 stars!

5114220.name: Brawlbeards
5114220.short_description: Brawlbeards is a colorful 2D beat 'em up set in a rowdy world of taverns, debt and trouble. Choose your brawler, master your combos and fight through a story-driven campaign to settle every account one punch at a time.

3758400.name: Coin Factory 2
3758400.short_description: Welcome to Coin Factory 2. An idle game about placing tiles strategically to make as many coins as possible. Level them up to get the numbers growing or make them evolve to adapt your play to new needs!

5407810.name: Prison Manager
5407810.short_description: Run a prison day by day. Build wings, hire and roster your staff, and answer the decisions that land on your desk, from parole cases to riots. Every prisoner has a file and a life after release. Keep them in, keep them safe, and keep your job.

4501510.name: Sorcery Mastery
4501510.short_description: Magical duels meet roguelike builds in this fast-paced PvP arena brawler where you choose your entire skillset and other upgrades throughout the match.

5349340.name: Herexis
5349340.short_description: Herexis is a Sci-fi turn based strategy game. Designed to appeal to strategy fans that like the simple turn based games of the past with simple graphics and mechanics.  Just the stuff you need to enjoy an interstellar battle.

4503860.name: Tirona Rebirth
4503860.short_description: Say anything. Tirona is a tabletop RPG and a CRPG in one, run by an AI dungeon master. No dialogue options: type what your hero says or does, and characters with minds of their own answer in their own voices. Real 5E SRD rules, real dice and turn-based tactical combat.

4465120.name: Dice Ark
4465120.short_description: A deckbuilding roguelite RPG meets a cutthroat dungeon-crawling board game for 1–4 players. Assign dice to cards, claim crystals, and steal your rivals' fortune. Work together to beat the boss, then see who comes out richest. Friendship won't pay your tolls.

4889650.name: Edge of the Blade | 칼 끝에 서서 Demo

4569890.name: Паучок сторожит уголок
4569890.short_description: A fluffy spider. Tricky jumps. A web to call home. Explore a colourful 2D platformer, find secret worlds, then build a network of insect traps in your idle hub. Collect silk, unlock talents and characters, and fill your radio with original songs.

5434330.name: AI ROBO STADIUM
5434330.short_description: Physical AI, on your own PC. Train legged robots with real reinforcement learning (PPO), then pilot the AI you raised in obstacle races and sumo bouts. You design the rewards; the AI figures out how to walk. Training runs on your CPU, and you can keep playing while it learns.

4789320.name: Yokai Idle Demo
4789320.short_description: Yokai Idle is a relaxing idle RPG inspired by Japanese folklore. Collect over 50 Yokai, train skills, craft equipment with powerful modifiers, and create unique builds as you progress through the historical Ages of Japan and guide the island of Onigashima into a new era 🎎

5124980.name: Anomaly Corp. Demo
5124980.short_description: Escape from Amusden Corp.'s Complex by running, hiding, after a mysterious event turns your colleagues into monsters in this short demo of the pure horror game Anomaly Corp.

5327090.name: Trapout: Dungeon Run
5327090.short_description: A fast-paced first-person precision platformer where every millisecond counts. Run through deadly obstacle courses, race against player ghosts, and create ANYTHING using the built-in editor!

4043070.name: Helgnar The Conqueror
4043070.short_description: Conquerors can expect throne wars, monster hunting, the toughest moral choices, Long-Lasting Double Consequences, and 10 innovative narrative "Realistic Connections" systems that realize the incredible untapped potential of interactivity and take the Action-RPG genre to a new level of quality.

5278020.name: Kingdom Chronicle: Ancient Saga
5278020.short_description: Lead heroes and soldiers to reclaim a stolen homeland in this tactical SRPG. Build legions and win hex battles through support and encirclement. Formation outweighs individual might. Three difficulty levels; on Expert, there are more enemies and the AI is stronger.
developers: スタジオ白猫斎 / Studio Hakubyousai

3274660.name: Save Me My Hero Demo
3274660.short_description:
’Save Me, My Hero’ is a defense game with roguelike elements.
Complete your own battle style with the hero's various skills and special abilities.

5164340.name: Rainfusor Demo
5164340.short_description: COMBINE ELEMENTS into bizarre playstyles. Rip and devour segmented bugs in rooms in a side-scroller mayhem-physics rogue-arcade. No tiny stat boosts/platforming/permadeath. Instead, unlock extreme, double-edged characters, runes, spell combos and synergies to become whole again, through sacrifice

3100340.name: Veliri: Planet of Machines Demo
3100340.short_description: A hardcore 2D MMO sandbox where survival depends on your skill in trade and combat. A world with a living economy and full loot that functions even when playing solo. Become a trade magnate, pirate, mercenary, or ruins explorer in this post-apocalyptic machine-world simulator.

4018980.name: Faraway Galaxy
4018980.short_description: Faraway Galaxy is a new roguelite deckbuilder framed as a bizarre tabletop adventure narrated by a battle-hardened space wolf. Master intense tactical battles and meaningful choices between them. Fight alien pirates, collect artifacts, and uncover new encounters!

3694460.name: The Rift Machine
3694460.short_description: The Rift Machine is an incremental game where you extract resources from inter-dimensional anomalies. Build modular defenses, research advanced technology, automate complex systems, and scale your operation into an unstoppable anomaly-harvesting engine.

5000200.name: 不一样的合成：生生不息 Demo
5000200.short_description: Free demo of Genesis: From Water to Stars, a card-combining game of resource management and automation. Start with water, wind, earth and stone. Discover recipes, build a civilization, assign workers, place orders and move goods as the Witness reacts. Play up to, but not including, the Chief card.

5154520.name: One More Flight Demo
5154520.short_description: A 2D pixel-art psychological horror game set aboard a cursed airplane trapped in a time loop. Only the choices you make persist across successive deaths. Intervene in the passengers' fates, unravel their hidden secrets, and prevent the crash.

5168380.name: UNSEAM Demo
5168380.short_description: An action platformer set in a world stitched shut. Ride the cracks your attacks leave for high-speed movement, carve terrain that falls the way you cut it, and journey to recover the memories of a girl who woke from her coffin.

5306820.name: 100K ZOMBIES Demo
5306820.short_description: 100K Zombies is a route-planning incremental tower defense. No fixed paths—place walls and firepower freely, designing the zombies' route to their doom. Build winding mazes or layered defenses. Every map is yours to create. Ready? Obliterate the 100K zombie horde!

5368000.name: Vasya Run Demo
5368000.short_description: Explore, a courier and graffiti artist caught in an extraterrestrial invasion amidst a society ruled by surveillance. Can speed and infiltration skills be enough?

4880830.name: 落幕之前 Before the Fall Demo
4880830.short_description: 世纪交接的十年，港岛。一笔意外的投资让初出茅庐的剧作家姜韶平得以将首作搬上剧院舞台。这看似天降的机遇，却早已在暗中标好了筹码——渐行渐远的旧友、少时仰望的偶像、意外相识的神秘乐手、避而不见的至亲……谁能成为你的缪斯？谁又会将你推向深渊？亦或是，当掌声渐息，帷幕落下，还留在舞台上的，只有自己……

4435020.name: Unsound Love Demo
4435020.short_description:
An open-world horror escape room where nothing is explained.
You are born into a new world through the backseat of a wrecked car.
Trapped in a time loop. Understand it — or stay trapped forever.

4600710.name: No Rest for the Wicked Soundtrack

4665710.name: Winter Whiskers Demo
4665710.short_description: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

4107750.name: Shutter Story Demo
4107750.short_description:
Examine a family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. 


Their fate is in your hands.

4348500.name: Furniture Restoration Simulator: Garage Edition - Prologue
4348500.short_description: Turn old, damaged furniture into beautiful pieces again. Sand, paint, polish, and enjoy the relaxing process of restoration. Play the free Prologue and experience the first steps of your renovation workshop.

3207090.name: Gigantes Ex Machina Demo
3207090.short_description: Fast paced Top-down shooter! Smartly use IRCM to evade the constant barrage of bullets and missiles and destroy everything that stands in your way.

2613430.name: Telegraphist 1920: Beats of War Demo
2613430.short_description: A narrative rhythm game set in 1920. Experience the war against Soviet Russia from a unique perspective. Become a telegraphist and tap out life-or-death messages in Morse code.

4558490.name: ARK: Dragontopia
4558490.short_description: Take flight into ARK: Dragontopia, a new cloudbound world of floating islands, mythical dragons, powerful skill trees, invading legions, filled with new vehicles, items, and challenges. Tame the legends, and rule the skies!

1408390.name: NieR Replicant 4 YoRHa
1408390.short_description: Enjoy 4 costumes and 4 weapons from NieR:Automata in NieR Replicant ver.1.22474487139....

1249200.name: Ghostrunner Demo
1249200.short_description: Ascend humanity’s last remaining shelter, a great tower-city. The tower is torn by violence, poverty and chaos. Conquer your enemies, discover the secrets of the superstructure and your own origin and obtain the power to challenge The Keymaster.

5074650.name: Memento Resonance
5074650.short_description: Forge a Resonance with enemy monsters and welcome them into your party. Equip their skills with relics to shape your own battle style, then climb an ever-changing tower as you follow the trail of lost memories in this monster-collecting roguelite turn-based strategy game.

5083880.name: The Community Notes Are Wrong
5083880.short_description: A bisexual singer goes viral after being caught kissing a man, shattering the image her fans built around her. Navigate fame, social media, biphobia, and messy romance in this otome/yuri visual novel.

836900.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance - HD Sound Pack
836900.short_description: HD Sounds Pack for Kingdom Come: Deliverance

4917230.name: Nightshift Definitive Edition
4917230.short_description: Welcome to the Nightshift! Spend six nights at a totally notmal office job in this branching narrative. Bond with your dayshift coworker, uncover fantastical mysteries, and experience unexpected transformations. With an optional card game and plenty of endings, what will you make of your time here?

277742.name: Train Simulator: The Story of Forest Rail Route Add-On

3175290.name: Craterlands
3175290.short_description: Wake up in the future to a world on the brink of extinction. Discover the source of the calamity and save civilization from a mysterious threat. Mine, build, craft and explore a vast interconnected world!

5366760.name: Tamagong Demo
5366760.short_description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

5447230.name: Makarov Astronomy Suite
5447230.short_description: Explore space through 120 interactive astronomy modules: black holes, planetary rings, stellar evolution, galaxies and orbital flight. Change the parameters and watch the universe respond. 3D scenes, graphs and experiments that run locally.

5066590.name: Rail Ops: Subdivisions
5066590.short_description: Operate locomotives, assemble trains, switch industries, and move freight through a persistent player-driven railroad network. Every shipment feeds a living industrial economy where railcars, routes, resources, and railroad operations continue to matter long after your train reaches its destination.

1540370.name: Hans in the Internetz
1540370.short_description:
Hans in the Internetz is a first-person meme platform adventure game.
His dream to become a wizard lays deep within the internet and you, as his apprentice must do the dirty work and “figure thiz out”
Expect puzzles, toilet humour and legal drugs!

4691610.name: Deep Frost Demo
4691610.short_description: A free single-player social-deduction horror demo. Play the first three days, ending after Night 3. Question the crew, compare accounts and decide who to trust in a failing Antarctic station.

1876420.name: Northward
1876420.short_description: Northward is an open-world co-op adventure about sailing a scrappy ship through a northern archipelago, exploring the uncharted, finding lost treasure, and uncovering the mystery of a fallen star.

4806840.name: Little Frontier Demo
4806840.short_description: A story-rich Western tactical RPG set in 1836. Lead three mountain men across the vast, untamed American frontier. Explore the wilderness, engage in tactical turn-based combat, and navigate dangerous encounters where your decisions shape the story and the fate of your companions.

5119140.name: Midnight Rogues
5119140.short_description: Build the sequence that fights for you in this roguelike auto-battler. Buy cards and arrange them across your board, then watch a timer activate them in order. Change their placement to create powerful combinations and take down The City’s corrupted superheroes.

5077600.name: Marble Mill
5077600.short_description: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

5214840.name: Midnight Rogues Demo
5214840.short_description: Build the sequence that fights for you in this roguelike auto-battler. Buy cards and arrange them across your board, then watch a timer automatically activate them in order. Change their placement to create powerful combinations and take down The City’s corrupted superheroes.

4755440.name: Maximilien
4755440.short_description: A psychological horror interactive novel, Boston 1926. Explore, investigate, lose your footing. Your choices shape a branching story, while your mental state distorts the very page you read. 4 intersecting routes, 12 possible endings, 1 to 3 hours per playthrough.

5354980.name: 晚安热线
5354980.short_description: November 2008, late at night. You're on the couch, and Goodnight Hotline is on the air — the host takes calls, viewers text in. Until one night, the voices on the line start sounding wrong. A CRT-styled analog horror visual novel: five nights, six endings. English text, Chinese voice.

4906720.name: FutureFireflies
4906720.short_description: Race futuristic hovercraft through vast natural landscapes in a high-speed racing game. Master challenging terrain, discover the fastest racing lines, and chase your best lap times across different tracks and racing modes.

4681680.name: Cat Caffeine
4681680.short_description:
A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen.
Cook and serve customers dishes and decorate your café while you work or relax.

4677430.name: DüRT: Motocross Championship
4677430.short_description: Arcade motocross with a late-'90s PSX soul: throttle-controlled drifts, back-it-in braking, real air with tricks, and a screaming two-stroke. A full championship across motocross and supercross tracks, built hand-in-hand with its players. Wishlist now.

3471380.name: Star Purr
3471380.short_description: A cute bullet-heaven roguelite where one cat on far too much catnip blasts through ten thousand space mice. Build absurd auto-firing weapon combos, outlast dream-born bosses and chase the SSS combo. Every run is a brand-new build.

4431250.name: Rascal
4431250.short_description: Rascal is an action roguelike where up to 4 players fight waves of enemies, gain gold, experience and purchase abilities.

4719610.name: I Opened an Idle Bar So I Can GOON to HOT GIRLS Demo

4904700.name: Vanguard's Descent
4904700.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a 3D action roguelite where you dodge attacks in real time, command your characters using powerful abilities, and combine character-specific archetypes into powerful synergies. Recruit new Vanguard and eradicate the Plagued!

4396770.name: Sparrow Warfare Demo
4396770.short_description: Play ever-crazier combinations of 3 tiles to free the birds in our synergy-rich deckbuilder. Let your mind take flight as you scheme and strategise. In this demo version: experience the core loop, two characters & our daily challenges with leaderboards. This… is Sparrow Warfare!

5391180.name: Flippin Broke Demo
5391180.short_description: Evicted, broke, and all you've got is a stupid bottle. Flip it, raid Crusty Carl's bin for weirder bottles, and build a team where every bottle has its own chaotic trait. Kick the curb and flip it till you’re rich!

4703910.name: Moss Dwellers
4703910.short_description: Place, join and trigger chain reactions in this relaxing tile placement game. Build a world one tile at a time, with expanding mountain ranges, vibrant lakes and lush forests. Gather tiles and place them in clever combinations, letting small decisions snowball into satisfying outcomes.

3914340.name: Drug Dealer 2049 Demo
3914340.short_description: Drug Dealer 2049 is about building a fully automated factory that produces ever purer drugs, in a 2D world. Design your production lines, cross plants into new strains or cook synthetic drugs, sell your production to customers, and protect yourself from every threat.

4886650.name: 樱桃客栈
4886650.short_description:
A story-driven visual novel. Inherit your grandmother's inn, tucked deep in the mountains — Yingtao Inn. Leave the city behind.

The inn has no sign, yet wanderers find their way. Never ignore the one rule: be back before midnight.

Yingtao Inn awaits.

5335260.name: 樱桃客栈 Demo
5335260.short_description:
A story-driven visual novel. Inherit your grandmother's inn, tucked deep in the mountains — Yingtao Inn. Leave the city behind.
The inn has no sign, yet wanderers find their way. Never ignore the one rule: be back before midnight.
Yingtao Inn awaits.

2973590.name: Lady Godiva 2129.AD
2973590.short_description: In the future, a singular and enigmatic figure emerges: a mercenary who adopts the unlikely nickname “Lady Godiva”. Navigating the intricate paths of technology and cybernetic society, she appears riding an impressive motorcycle, completely naked and ready for sex.

5180300.name: Chrome Collar: Femdom Protocol
5180300.short_description: Wrong coat, wrong neck, right collar. A cyberpunk crew grabbed the wrong man and locked on a neural collar that carries every sensation both ways. One week in their workshop with three women who feel everything they do to you.

5252880.name: Chrome Collar: Femdom Protocol Demo
5252880.short_description: Wrong coat, wrong neck, right collar. A cyberpunk crew grabbed the wrong man and locked on a neural collar that carries every sensation both ways. One week in their workshop with three women who feel everything they do to you.

5323510.name: TITAN ARENA
5323510.short_description: Build and pilot your own mech in a top-down 3D action game. Pair a gun with a shield or mount guns on both arms. Choose upgrades during each run, take on tough foes, and collect new gear. Rebuild your mech and push for a new personal best.

5440660.name: Pride City Demo
5440660.short_description: Step into Pride City, where fabulous superheroes, everyday drama, and queer chaos collide! Explore Pride city, discover your powers, build relationships, and experience a first taste of a superhero life where being yourself is the greatest power of all.

4941230.name: Jackpot Poker Destruction
4941230.short_description: Build poker hands on a 5×5 grid in a roguelike deckbuilder powered by five separate 52-card decks, one for each reel. Infuse cards with Fire, Water, Earth and Air, trigger devastating Reactions, conquer eight casinos, face cheating Texas Hold'em bosses, or chase high scores in Arcade Mode.

4774430.name: Fantasy Euthanasia
4774430.short_description: “Good girls don’t cry. They bear hardship with serenity.” Reine has repeated this to herself for years. Then a stranger arrives with a destiny and a fantasy world to save. An otome-style visual novel with a psychological twist, 35 endings, and a world that wants something from her.

3458140.name: NimerWorld: Shadows of a Promise
3458140.short_description: Welcome to Valdix, a kingdom consumed by darkness. Rescue the kingdom's ducks and put an end to the plague. As you progress, everything becomes stranger. Will you be able to reach the top and overcome this challenging journey?

5421150.name: Big Climb
5421150.short_description: BIG CLIMB is a co-op climbing game for 1-4 players tied by a real physical rope. Climb the mountain together before the colossal spider gets the one lagging behind.

4599970.name: Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield
4599970.short_description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

3642450.name: A Slight Chance of Sawblades Demo
3642450.short_description: Dodge, jump and somersault over razor-sharp sawblades in an attempt to survive the deadly storm! Compete in the leaderboards and become the best blade-jumper in this supremely intense high-score chaser!

4391570.name: VOiD: Reshaped
4391570.short_description: VOiD: Reshaped is a gravity-bending 2D puzzle platformer. Flip gravity to solve tricky puzzles, dodge deadly traps and survive enigmatic bosses as you guide a tiny cube through a relaxed yet challenging adventure for all ages.

5146640.name: Farm Saga
5146640.short_description: You've inherited a lucrative farm, a strict deadline, and five women who know far more than they admit. Balance daily farm life, build deep relationships, and uncover what is really going on in this story-driven mystery visual novel.

5346440.name: Territory Battle
5346440.short_description: Real-time territory conquest against dozens of rival empires on a fresh map every game. Push your borders, build cities, ports and railways, make alliances and break them, then end it with nukes, from a light payload to a payload salvo.

2476700.name: ARIE: Moonprayer Demo
2476700.short_description: ARIE: Moonprayer is a beautiful, short 3D anime exploration experience through an ending world, where melodies weave through your final journey on earth.

4971800.name: A Dark Cave Demo
4971800.short_description: Survive a cruel world, build and expand your village, and descend into the darkness below. Gather resources, make hard choices, and uncover the unspeakable truth buried deep within the cave in this dark, text-based incremental game.

5272550.name: Sow the Stars
5272550.short_description: Fire bodies into orbit, merge them, and grow a sun. When it is fully grown it goes supernova, and a new solar system is born. Systems become galaxies, and galaxies fill the universe. Aim every shot yourself, or sit back and watch it grow: a calm incremental game about building a universe.

4561010.name: Gun Restoration Shop Simulator
4561010.short_description: Run a gun restoration workshop. Take in damaged firearms, dismantle them, and craft missing parts using various tools. Unlock advanced machinery, restore each weapon to its former glory. Track demand, negotiate prices, and run a successful restoration business.

5204250.name: 模拟穿越-三国
5204250.short_description: 穿越到群雄并起的汉末，你不是开局便号令天下的主公，而是从小卒、文吏或斥候起步的无名之人。结识会记住承诺、恩情与背叛的历史人物，完成上官任务，献上计策，积累军功与治绩，在复杂的人脉和官场中争取升迁。你可以招募亲随、经营私人部曲、组建攻城军团、治理城池、发展势力科技，也能求亲成婚、经营家庭，或在时机成熟时举旗自立。每推进一个月，战争、调任、疾病、背叛和天下大势都会继续演变；你的选择不仅决定自己的仕途，也可能让熟悉的三国历史走向另一条道路。

5452780.name: Gnom
5452780.short_description: Build and defend a settlement with an increasing number of gnomes. Gnomes chop wood, build things, and fight. Some become giants. Some become nanognomes. There are 52 buildings and 900 tech tree perks. The gnomes have options.

5021020.name: Astrocraft Demo
5021020.short_description: Try the first-person space station tycoon for free. Mine asteroids, build your first machines, open a shop for the ships that land, and hand the work to a crew of robots, solo or in online co-op for up to four players. Wishlist the full game for outposts, your own ship, and more.

4263060.name: Bird Roll 64
4263060.short_description:
This recovered copy of a lost 3D ball-rolling platformer from the 90s appears to have been created by eldritch forces from out of this world.
Would you be able to find all its secrets and escape its surreal spaces?

5360820.name: DesktopKins
5360820.short_description: This is a Desktop Companion Engine with a unique twist! Control your avatar companions and play mini games with them right  in your screen, they can interact with windows, icons and screen borders. Best feature is you can customize your character! Dress them up as you like! Or use your own 3d model

3185820.name: Buried Horrors
3185820.short_description: Survive ancient monsters together with 1-4 of your friends while stealing the treasures they guard. Use tools from the early 1900s to navigate tombs and fight back against the horrors within. Find clues, solve puzzles, avoid deadly traps and get to the treasure and back out.

3675020.name: ARK: Ragnarok Ascended
3675020.short_description: Journey through an expansive 144 sq. kilometer environment where elements from The Island, Scorched Earth, and all new biomes are combined to bring the ultimate survivor experience.

4750600.name: Planet Terminus
4750600.short_description: Planet Terminus is a top-down PvE tactical raid shooter for solo or co-op play. Infiltrate hostile industrial zones, outmaneuver reactive Security forces, recover physical gear and Blueprints, and extract before escalating pressure turns the raid against you.

4953120.name: S21
4953120.short_description:
Dear passengers:
Your train departs from Platform 9 in 20 minutes. Sounds doable. Or does it?

An absurd game about the station that will never be finished and won’t let you leave.

This game is under construction. Thank you for your understanding.

3929100.name: Project Damascus
3929100.short_description:
A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. 
Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

5053540.name: VIOLENCE DOLL バイオレンスドール
5053540.short_description: Become V.D, a cybernetic investigator pursuing a global conspiracy in this sci-fi action RPG. Hack enemies at close range to freeze them, then unleash devastating combos. Explore 2.5D stages and engage in real-time 3D battles.

3349320.name: ARK: Extinction Ascended
3349320.short_description: An Element-infested, ravaged planet Earth filled with fantastical creatures both organic & technological holds both the secrets of the past and the keys to its salvation. Can you defeat the gigantic roaming Titans which dominate the planet, and complete the ARK cycle to save Earth's future?

5355240.name: Neothree: Confront the Providence
5355240.short_description: In the Three Kingdoms Preiod, the Providence corrupts warlords and changes history. As a general of the Han, you will command proud and sorrowful armies, reclaim the Jade Seal of Emperor, uncover the secret of the First Great Gate, and finally return the founder of Han to his untroubled rest.

4191840.name: Eccentricity
4191840.short_description: Eccentricity is a Steampunk Engineering Roguelike about building the ultimate chain-reaction machine. Carefully arrange and optimize your grid of machines to discover surprising synergies and generate as much energy as possible.

2554980.name: Last Warrior Arena
2554980.short_description: Build your warrior. Outsmart your next opponent. Last Warrior Arena is a 1v1 roguelike auto-battler where equipment, skills, and enemy choices shape every run. Combine elemental powers, discover powerful builds, and take on deadly bosses as your warrior fights automatically.

3321470.name: 地铁站设计师 Metro Station Designer Playtest

4605010.name: DesktopForge
4605010.short_description: Customize your Windows desktop with widgets, living wallpapers, and Workshop creations. Wire up motion in the node editor. Unlock window animations, 3D scenes, and more with the Creator's Kit DLC.

3059650.name: ARK: Aberration Ascended
3059650.short_description: On Aberration, survivors face exotic and extreme challenges within a vast underground biome system upon a derelict, malfunctioning ARK. Survivors will uncover the ultimate secrets of the ARKs, and discover what the future holds in store for those strong and clever enough to survive!

3996350.name: Sawad | سواد
3996350.short_description: In SAWAD, you and your friends are content creators desperate for FAME and subscribers. Break into haunted locations, eliminate whatever is there. Hidden CCTVs record it all. Make the clips go viral and get filthy rich! The only catch? You must survive long enough to hit upload.

2849450.name: ARK: Scorched Earth Ascended
2849450.short_description: Stranded naked, parched and starving in a vast desert, even seasoned ARK survivors must use all their skills to stand a chance of survival. Tame, breed, and ride the desert’s mysterious new creatures including... DRAGONS!

5383340.name: DesktopKins Demo
5383340.short_description: This is a Free Demo version of Desktopkins a Desktop Companion Engine with a unique twist! Control your avatar companions, they can interact with windows, icons and screen borders. You can also Customize the DesktopKins model within the app. This demo features limited functionality of the full game.

4003640.name: Copperfell Demo
4003640.short_description: Journey to Copperfell, a magical land teeming with charming villages, dangerous monsters, and an abundance of natural resources for you to make use of.

3500460.name: Above Land: Rhapsody
3500460.short_description: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

5380090.name: Escape The Zoo
5380090.short_description: You came to escape the zoo. Somehow, you're stealing a drink first. Escape The Zoo is an adventure for 1–4 players: climb out of the monkey enclosure, run from tigers and take a break for poop-ball games. Play solo or online with your crew.

2827030.name: ARK: The Center Ascended
2827030.short_description: The Center is a free add-on for ARK: Survival Ascended that includes a massive new map for survivors to explore. The Center is nearly double the size of The Island, making it about 70 sq. kilometers and featuring a rich, hand-drawn Tolkien-esque aesthetic.

5180910.name: Dicepot Demo
5180910.short_description: You lost everything at the tavern. Now a witch offers a deal: your soul for a fortune. Roll dice that split, tick and chain-react, hire helpers, merge your dice and watch a single roll turn into a table of hundreds in this pixel-art idle game.

5178710.name: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century Demo

5179780.name: Hive Xenotype
5179780.short_description: Biopunk survival strategy — take command of the last remaining posthumans. Adapt to a harsh and forgotten planet, but keep the local ecosystem in balance — otherwise the last of humanity is doomed. Will you assimilate this world, or lead your people to extinction?

4034540.name: Lines We Draw
4034540.short_description: Lines We Draw is a 3D isometric narrative strategy game set at a tense Cold War border. Inspect documents, interrogate travelers, and manage a shifting checkpoint between rival states. Your stamp decides fates: Will you be a hero of the people, or a tool of the regime?

5419120.name: Snow Worries!
5419120.short_description: Santa crashed his sleigh into your garden and Christmas is buried under the snow. Call up to three friends and dig it all out: sell the snow, upgrade from bare cookie hands to absurd machines, and bury each other along the way. Cozy, chaotic co-op with proximity voice chat.

3483400.name: ARK: Astraeos
3483400.short_description: Embark on your next epic odyssey in the world of Astraeos! Explore a land of colossal proportions steeped in Greek mythology, brimming with stunning scenery, ancient ruins, and sacred temples, with rolling seas navigable by powerful triremes. Will you bow to fate, or rise in defiance of Olympus?

4891760.name: Celeforge
4891760.short_description: Summon and merge random heroes to create mightier heroes and fend off incoming waves of enemies! Upgrade your heroes and discover diverse relics to forge your ultimate build! It's time to conquer the Abyss!

4606230.name: DesktopForge - Creator's Kit
4606230.short_description: Take your desktop further with expanded creator tools. Unlock window animations, 3D scenes and model import, timeline keyframes, and more with the Creator's Kit. Requires the base app DesktopForge.

4719640.name: Deeper Demo
4719640.short_description: Your mission is to recover lost and forgotten artifacts. Set out with your crew on underwater expeditions ever more hostile, ever darker, ever deeper...

3442960.name: 孤星之潮-Tide of Lone Stars-
3442960.short_description: Tide of Lone Stars is an ADV / AVG with conventional gameplay and unconventional apocalyptic sci-fi narrative. As a disabled girl living outside the walls, Blanka, you will meet a strange man, Adrian. An amazing adventure of “Love, Rebirth and Death” is ready to begin.

4083130.name: Against the Horde
4083130.short_description:
A PvE roguelike deckbuilder where you can customise your deck with thousands of unique cards. Upgrade, draft, and buy new cards to field a respectable army on unique battlefields that favour tactical movement and card play.
Master the five factions and stand Against the Horde.

4305070.name: Priestess’s Delusions
4305070.short_description: ﻿She turned my summer into a mystical tale — a delusion that melts away like snow the moment I close my eyes.

4664280.name: My Necromancer's Library Demo
4664280.short_description:
Manage a medieval library: collect books, arrange shelves, assist patrons, and host community events!
Hire adventurers to delve into the depths of a dead Necromancer’s lair for rare tomes. Restore and customize books while uncovering a character-driven tale in this peculiar mining town.

4132460.name: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator
4132460.short_description: Play as Humanoid CATS in this chaotic 4 player co-op simulator as you takeover the coastal city of Los Nyangeles in pursuit of becoming true CATpitalists while helping rebuild the city along the way (kinda).

5484850.name: The Fight Business Demo
5484850.short_description: Build your MMA gym in this single-player management demo. Recruit fighters, negotiate contracts, develop prospects, hire coaches and prepare your stable for fight night. Manage the risks inside and outside the cage across 12 in-game weeks of The Fight Business.

4788020.name: Fox Two Protocol Demo
4788020.short_description: Fox Two Protocol Demo is a free first sortie into modern jet air combat, blending arcade accessibility with flight-physics feel. Try the opening missions, missiles, speed, and sunset skies. This is not the final version: the game is still growing, and your feedback and wishlists help shape it.

3834950.name: Skyborn:IronWings
3834950.short_description: A reimagined 3D arcade shooter that transforms the classic vertical scrolling formula with full spatial depth, immersive air-to-ground combat, and intense bullet hell action.

3058660.name: Hark the Ghoul
3058660.short_description:
Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! 
HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

4957400.name: Gulovacka Demo
4957400.short_description: Snowballs knock you back so hard that you will be flying. Your friends having a blast watching it happen. Put on a snowsuit of your choice and dive into chaotic snowball fight in Gulovacka.

5116540.name: TurnLimit100
5116540.short_description: A speedrun-focused deck-building roguelike set in Nagoria, where East meets West. You have exactly 100 turns — run out, and it's a forced defeat. Play fast, not safe. Three characters, branching paths, and 28 achievements await.

4459960.name: Discord Bot Factory
4459960.short_description: Build powerful Discord bots visually. Design complex bot logic, debug and Run it live from one place. Drag and connect nodes to build commands, automations, and full workflows in minutes.

4718660.name: Slightly Used Sorcery
4718660.short_description: Run a cozy second-hand magic shop: buy suspicious junk, study ridiculous enchantments, craft bizarre artifacts, and haggle with eccentric customers who pay premium prices for magical nonsense.

5312330.name: I Refuse the Bad Ending for fear of Muscle Loss Demo

4676360.name: Makehuman 2
4676360.short_description: This is a stand alone character creation & customizing software suite. It offers many in program options, as well as the ability to export game ready models to most existing platforms. At present we are existing in Alpha release, we have much more to come!

4892020.name: Walk Around the World
4892020.short_description: A cozy desktop companion where BilBil explores the world while you work or stream. Talk, click, and help your tiny traveler visit real countries, unlock charming outfits, and take every step of the journey.

5018500.name: Football on Paper Demo
5018500.short_description: A simultaneous turn-based football game. You talk big. Draw the next minute. Watch your boys run it. Guess what the other manager will do — because they are guessing you.

340220.name: Shadows of War
340220.short_description:
Shadows of War is a 2D Real-Time Strategy sidescroller game.
The game combines classical RTS elements with new ideas into a 2D game.

5100510.name: Heart Harvest
5100510.short_description: Passionate murders. Ripped out hearts. And something crawling within the walls. Find clues, gather the evidence and connect the dots in this point and click detective thriller game. Solve each murder and uncover the horror linking them all..

4241820.name: Arcade Warlord
4241820.short_description: A business strategy game set in the 80s arcade boom, where your company exists on the map. Develop hit games, deploy specialist Agents, move cabinets and cash across the city, and compete for strategic locations while managing the logistics of expansion.

5310410.name: Hermitap
5310410.short_description: Use your mouse to single-handedly gather resources, fight creatures, build a gnome base, and explore shrines as you purchase more land! Play it in short bursts while you work, or grind it out in longer sessions.

3357310.name: ASUKA x Redline Reverie
3357310.short_description: Play as Asuka Sakai and take on the mountain roads of Japan. Tune your car, challenge rival racers, climb the rankings, and earn your place at GRACE. A pure touge racing experience.

4917940.name: Panic Pub
4917940.short_description: Run a pub with your friends. Serve drinks, cook food, and upgrade your bar — but keep your customers happy, or they might turn into bears and beat you up. As your pub grows, so does the chaos, with more customers, new cocktails, dishes, and tougher nights!

4847090.name: Halls of the Deep
4847090.short_description: Explore eerie pools and surreal spaces as you search for hidden puzzle pieces and coins, using your bow and arrow to silently eliminate the enemies that drift through the depths of these forgotten halls.

5079560.name: Wasteland Frenzy
5079560.short_description: Bullet Reign is a roguelike action shooter in a wasteland. Fight endless mutant waves as an armed survivor, choosing classes, weapons, and items to craft unique builds. Every run offers new progression choices—blast through the swarm and be the last one standing.

5416710.name: 修仙98
5416710.short_description: An old computer from another world comes with a cultivation sect management system! Recruit promising disciples, guide their growth, and manage resources. Watch them win tournaments and ascend to Spirit Transformation as your humble sect earns renown.

5169050.name: 放置边境
5169050.short_description: An offline idle survival game for the gaps in your day. Keep its resizable window beside your work, start gathering and check back between tasks. Tend camps, craft, farm and explore at your own pace. Supplies still need care; pause whenever you need a break.

4357680.name: Lilifel
4357680.short_description: High roll your way through an everchanging dungeon in this roguelike, turn-based dungeon crawler. Fight enemies using your elemental runes to conjure powerful spells. Synergize your elements as you loot items that combo with just about everything. Ever Low roll? Just SLAM your way out of it!

5118530.name: CHROMATIC CRISIS Demo
5118530.short_description:
CHROMATIC CRISIS is a colorful metroidvania with unique mechanics!

Try to get out of these artificial biomes and save the colors of the real world!

5472530.name: Big Fox Family Time
5472530.short_description: A cozy first-person family sim where your fox family doubles every night. Hunt, chop, build a den and tuck your kits into bed, then command a crowd of thousands at once, from three kits up to 65,536. Play solo or in online co-op with up to four parents.

4883480.name: To Be Seen
4883480.short_description: In To Be Seen, a narrative puzzle game, you play as a spirit trapped between life and death. To find your way home, you must possess your family members to relive their memories. By experiencing the world—and yourself—through their eyes, you discover what it truly means to be seen.

5312290.name: Doomsday tidy up Demo
5312290.short_description: Every inch of space matters in the apocalypse. Organize firearms and survival supplies inside your shelter, find a place for every item, and turn cluttered storage into orderly reserves for the days ahead.

4852920.name: Space Tenacity Demo
4852920.short_description: Chuck space aliens into each other! Dodge giant asteroids! Engage your tractor beam, force field and phase shifting technology to navigate the unknown in this 2D side scrolling physics based space adventure.

2835130.name: 在りし日のわたし達へ
2835130.short_description:
A juvenile visual novel leaving proof that we truly lived.
Collect ancient relics known as "Traces" and update your journal to unravel hidden emotions and the mysteries of the world.
A dream-chasing girl's fateful step forward—one that ultimately leads to a cruel destiny with a steep price.

5451280.name: Ritual Chamber Demo
5451280.short_description: It's 1978 and Mara Venn cleans the treatment rooms at a private clinic, nights only. The register says Chamber Six is empty. There's someone in the chair. A first-person psychological horror game about a job you can't afford to lose.

5077930.name: Tire Dealer Simulator
5077930.short_description: Take over your father’s debt-ridden tire shop and turn it into a thriving business. Buy and manage stock, negotiate with customers, change and balance tires, hire mechanics, upgrade your shop, take on contracts, and make the financial decisions that determine your future.

5275590.name: Dirt Town
5275590.short_description: Push dirt, haul dirt, ride dirt. There is no solid ground in this game: every bucketful moves, slumps, packs and stays where you left it, and it's up to you to rip it up any way you want. Drive real machines, alone or with friends, on the road to the greatest dirt sim in existence.

4721060.name: Elite Engineering
4721060.short_description: Elite Engineering is the ultimate sandbox engineering game, characters, environments and creations all created by you and the community.

3578550.name: Hood Tales Part 1: Morocco
3578550.short_description: Step into the streets of Rabat in Hood Tales Part 1: Morocco. Follow the journey of a young artist trying to escape the hood through music, only to get entangled in the crime world. Experience an untold side of Moroccan society in a vibrant, stylized world full of challenges and choices.

5294540.name: Sparrow Warfare Soundtrack
5294540.short_description: From the lush gardens to the vast desert, Emil Smith's music perfectly captures the atmosphere of Sparrow Warfare.

4419770.name: Space Tenacity
4419770.short_description: Chuck space aliens into each other! Dodge giant asteroids! Engage your tractor beam, force field and phase shifting technology to navigate the unknown in this 2D side scrolling physics based space adventure.

4947250.name: Kebab Dynasty
4947250.short_description: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

5117810.name: Frankenship
5117810.short_description: A co-op space mining game for 1-4 players. Drill through hostile moons, blast crystal seams open and haul the ore back to your patched-together ship while the swarm closes in. Then run for the pod. Play on one screen or online with friends.

5225480.name: Emberholme
5225480.short_description: Emberholme is an old-school open-world RPG inhabited by 100 simulated adventurers who learn and progress by the same rules as you. Train skills, craft, trade, build a home, fight bosses, play alone or with up to three friends, and grow stronger across ten Ember Cycles.

5403680.name: Kebab Dynasty Demo
5403680.short_description: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

5397750.name: WildBonds
5397750.short_description: Play as a little fox and help the forest animals find what they've lost! Each request hides three items in random spots, and a mischievous fox may run off with one. Dash through the woods, beat your best time, and climb the global leaderboard in this charming 3D exploration time-attack game.

5302300.name: Sweet Memories Demo
5302300.short_description:
Enjoy a colorful and perfect Halloween night. 
Just don't eat that candy... Please... I went to a lot of trouble to make everything better...

4811390.name: The Fight for Beardlandia
4811390.short_description: An auto-battler roguelike gacha. Recruit your party, min-max their builds, and stack class synergies, as you drag eight recruits deeper each run. Watch them fall, roll for powerful heroes, upgrade the skill tree, and march a stronger party into the fight for Beardlandia!

4826310.name: Solbrand Demo
4826310.short_description: 2409. As the new Spook on HMS Solbrand you dive deep into a past steeped in grand norse myth and quiet local legend. Command your submersible, survey sunken ruins, uncover puzzling fragments, commune with the dead, and begin to untangle a pseudo-historical knot of cosmic proportions.

5434620.name: Hall of Minds Demo
5434620.short_description: Enter the minds of your patients and explore disturbing worlds shaped by trauma, fear, and buried secrets.

5297290.name: Cats and Hats Demo
5297290.short_description: Stack Hats on adorable Cats. A cozy roguelike memory deckbuilder where you match tiles, build multis, and stack Hats on a variety of oddly compliant Cats.

1384140.name: AutoLand Soundtrack
1384140.short_description: The original soundtrack for AutoLand contains 4 original tracks featured in the game.

5385170.name: ByeByeObake!
5385170.short_description: "Those who can see cannot shoot, those who can shoot cannot see!" An online asymmetrical cooperative action game for 2-8 players where exorcists and guardian spirits communicate with each other. Rely on your teammates' voices and landmarks to drive away evil spirits.

4747920.name: Undervalued
4747920.short_description: You didn't want a real job. So here you are. Run an antique shop in Vienna with your friends or on your own. Buy low, sell high, pretend you know what you're doing. Oh, and keep your mood up. That last part is kind of the whole game.

4927770.name: The Joust Autochess
4927770.short_description:
The Joust Autochess allows you to see your favorite zany physics brawlers in an environment like you've never seen them before... tactical autochess combat!

Combine like cards to upgrade your forces!  Strategize with items to find the perfect build!

1857670.name: Block Collide Soundtrack
1857670.short_description: The original soundtrack for Block Collide contains 4 original tracks featured in the game.

2825550.name: Police Simulator
2825550.short_description: The latest entry in the Police Simulator franchise lets you build your career in Faremont City. Take on over 50 missions and callouts, patrol with a K9 partner, drive specialized police vehicles, and play solo or with a friend.

5224210.name: Demonfall Continent
5224210.short_description: Explore a magic-soaked continent, battle beasts and towering bosses, learn a wide variety of skills, and shape your build with Inner Arts, attributes, and gear. Hunt for loot, cook useful food, reforge affixes, and grow stronger through every expedition in this dark mythic single-player action RPG.
developers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Nanjing Shangxiangyujiu Network Technology Co., Ltd.

5243870.name: Labyrinthine: Lost in the Sands
5243870.short_description: Venture into ancient Egypt with two new maps, four deadly enemies, themed cosmetics, collectible lobby music, and an official crossover with FOREWARNED.

5035950.name: Zap Rat
5035950.short_description: Zap Rat is a 3D Multiplayer Party Game, where you and your friends are test subjects in the laboratory of Dr. Feli. One of you will be zapped by the large ray gun, and transform into a cat. As rats your goal is to outsmart the cat. As the cat you wreak mayhem and must catch all the rats to win.

4832550.name: Gather and Rule
4832550.short_description: A turn based strategy board game for 4 players or AI. Maneuver your units and resolve battle using the dice. Place your workers to receive income and recruit or build more units. Kill the enemy rulers one by one, lay waste to their bases or capture and retrieve the relic to win a complete Victory.

1143750.name: VRocker
1143750.short_description:
Use your body to move in any SteamVR game that uses joystick/pad 'smooth locomotion'.

VRock to increase immersion, keep active, free up your hands or just to fulfil that desire to look (even more) silly in VR!

4931690.name: VOID PROFIT Demo
4931690.short_description: Fly a rented corporate vessel through the Core system in this free demo of VOID PROFIT. Navigate risky routes, trade in changing markets and take on jobs. Smuggle cargo or keep your manifest clean. Stay profitable.

5157790.name: Sabado Demo
5157790.short_description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

5178720.name: Radia Island Demo
5178720.short_description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

5278100.name: Way Too Many Eggs Demo
5278100.short_description: Play the free demo of Way Too Many Eggs, an incremental game about turning a tiny chicken farm into egg-filled chaos. Collect eggs, grow your flock, hire helpers, crack giant eggs and unlock permanent upgrades in the skill tree!

5057550.name: Once,in Times of Chaos Demo
5057550.short_description: Once, in Times of Chaos is a live-action FMV espionage game set in Republican-era China. You will take on the role of an operative codenamed “Oak” and live through an extraordinary tale of intrigue in 1920s China.

5092780.name: Heirs of the Moon Demo
5092780.short_description: Live, hunt, and lead as an apex predator embarked on a brutal survival adventure where every choice shapes your legacy. Find a mate, raise your pups, establish a pack and survive the dangers of the wild. Death is inevitable, but your journey continues with your bloodline.

5096200.name: Get Outta My Gut Demo
5096200.short_description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

4342760.name: Custom Cursor
4342760.short_description: Make your mouse cursor your own with Playsaurus's Custom Cursor. Swap in custom packs, layer on visual effects like glow, color, and zoom, and bring your desktop to life with animated overlays, applied system-wide or per application.

4397900.name: Obstacle Overdrive Demo
4397900.short_description: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

4404470.name: Corpus et Spiritus Demo
4404470.short_description: Corpus et Spiritus is an alchemy deckbuilder without combat. You signed a pact with a demon, and it was a bad idea… Gather rare metals, then use your workshop to transform them into powerful cards and magical talismans. Find the best combos and break out of the pact before your partner kills you!

4570990.name: Might & Mushroom Demo
4570990.short_description: Draft your own shop in this deckbuilding roguelike auto-battler! Summon fungal versions of legendary heroes, construct your custom unit pool, and lead an unstoppable shroom army. Take control of the RNG. Revolution is brewing—let's turn that evil dragon into mushroom soup!

4257800.name: Skydimo
4257800.short_description: Skydimo is a professional RGB lighting control platform for synchronizing lighting effects across LED strips, USB RGB controllers, and PC RGB devices. It supports real-time screen capture, music visualization, and customizable lighting layouts for immersive ambient lighting experiences.
developers: Shenzhen Light Universe Technology Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shenzhen Light Universe Technology Co., Ltd.

4297010.name: Comatose Demo
4297010.short_description: Explore your decaying mind in this retro survival horror FPS. Manage scarce resources, solve puzzles, and push forward through the dread.

3987580.name: 盛夏离与合 试用版
3987580.short_description:
毕业自驾游？不，是「心动修罗场」！
《盛夏离与合》是现象级互动影像系列《完蛋！我被美女包围了！》IP的全新篇章。本次我们将填补“完蛋宇宙”时间线上的关键一块，带你回到那个承前启后、充满无限可能的毕业季，体验一段关于成长、抉择与命运交织的动人故事。
这段承前启后的夏日篇章，都会因你每一次的抉择，导向独一无二的盛夏结局。

3453960.name: Farming Simulator 25: Mercedes-Benz Trucks Pack
3453960.short_description: Align your farming business with the stars of Mercedes-Benz and Daimler Truck AG! The Mercedes-Benz Trucks Pack includes 17 machines and tools.

3540710.name: Deskie
3540710.short_description: Chat with animated AI characters, play branching story worlds, and create your own Live2D/3D companions. Deskie brings voice, expressions, memory, desktop companions, and community-made visual-novel stories to desktop and web.

3642080.name: ガールズメイドプディング BGM Soundtrack
3642080.short_description: This soundtrack features 8 original BGM tracks that color the world of "GIRLS MADE PUDDING".

4947090.name: Ring's Guard
4947090.short_description:
A 3D roguelite action game set in an endlessly looping map, where you fight off waves of enemies and bosses.
Strengthen your characters through combat and exploration, and use the items you collect, as well as the enemies themselves, to overcome the threats closing in around you.

3196880.name: Project: Null Hypothesis Demo
3196880.short_description: Explore the anomalous space with Elias and his found notes. Wander through endless corridors, uncovering the sinister secrets of the backrooms and the distorted reality.

3289470.name: Tiny Terraces Demo
3289470.short_description: A cozy idle farming game, watch tiny guys do tasks around the terrace, expand, progress, and decorate your Tiny Terrace.

2478320.name: SuchArt - Miserable Artist Experience
2478320.short_description: Are your clients treating you too well? Do you think you deserve less praise, and much more pettiness? The Miserable Artist Experience DLC is here to fix that for you. Discover a fresh take on the game’s story, and experience the life of a not-so-genius artist, after all.

2249340.name: 互联网大亨
2249340.short_description: At the dawn of the Internet Age, could the player take up the role of a dauntless entrepreneur and establish the most successful internet company? When the player becomes CEO, will they still treat their employees well or have a change of heart?

4265280.name: Nile Express
4265280.short_description: Build the first railway network in Africa. Create profitable routes in Egypt, from Alexandria to Aswan. Deliver passengers and goods to the right destinations. Take care of your railway network and deal with accidents.

4905190.name: Beyond The Roots
4905190.short_description: Rise to the ranks of gods. Defeat the powerful fallen angels standing in your way in this challenging pixel-art boss rush, and earn your place in paradise.

937890.name: Assassin's Creed Odyssey - Season Pass
937890.short_description:
Continue your epic odyssey with two new, major story arcs in the SEASON PASS with three exciting episodes per story.
Season pass owners also receive the games Assassin's Creed III REMASTERED and Assassin's Creed Liberation REMASTERED.

954350.name: NOLO HOME
954350.short_description: NOLO HOME is a streaming software that allows you to play SteamVR games with your standalone VR headset and Gear VR. For room-scale VR titles, NOLO CV1 VR controller is highly recommended.
developers: 北京凌宇智控科技有限公司
publishers: 北京凌宇智控科技有限公司

504990.name: VoxVR Viewer
504990.short_description: VoxVR Viewer enables you to view your voxel models from a whole new perspective! You can import all common voxel file formats like .vox, .qb, and more from other voxel software like Magica Voxel, Qubicle or Voxelshop to explore them from within VR.

577357.name: Train Sim World®: Northeast Corridor New York
577357.short_description: Train Sim World®: Northeast Corridor New York is an all new First-Person Simulator that brings to life the experience of driving passenger and freight trains on the Northeast Corridor in New York. Transport passengers in the state-of-the-art Amtrak ACS-64 and serve the city in the CSX GP38-2 freight locomotive in and around New York.

613920.name: A CHALLENGE
613920.short_description: An oddly captivating live action VR thriller. Shot on Ozo. Full 3D 360.

362250.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Scorpion and Sub-Zero (Part 2)
362250.short_description: We flash back to feudal Japan and reference the moments in Season 1 where Scorpion's family is seemingly murdered by Sub Zero and his clan.

5196880.name: Tire Dealer Simulator Demo
5196880.short_description: Take over your father’s debt-ridden tire shop and turn it into a thriving business. Buy and manage stock, negotiate with customers, change and balance tires, hire mechanics, upgrade your shop, take on contracts, and make the financial decisions that determine your future.

4687990.name: VOID PROFIT
4687990.short_description: Fly a rented corporate vessel in a procedurally-generated universe, navigate risky routes, profit from changing markets before the opportunity disappears and you lose it all. Take jobs, navigate the markets, smuggle, lie. Do everything in order to keep flying.

4993360.name: Rest Assured
4993360.short_description: A classic-inspired survival horror story told through two contrasting perspectives. Trapped inside a corporate cryopreservation facility on the night its “preserved” occupants stop staying preserved, fight through monstrous aberrations, uncover the mystery, and escape alive while you still can.

2127020.name: Riftswarm
2127020.short_description: The order is the spell. Riftswarm is a spell-building co-op bullet heaven for you and up to three friends, or solo. Your weapon casts its Rune Row left to right, so the same runes in a new order make a new spell. Split the party across gates, each a map of its own with a hidden objective.

5175990.name: Mors Blade - UNSLASHED
5175990.short_description:
Blades and scarabs locked in a tango of death. A multi-ending sci-fi seinen visual novel inspired by 90s anime OVAs.
Will you find the truth behind the alien invasion? Or will you bring the world to the brink of destruction again?

5321150.name: Mors Blade - UNSLASHED: Uncut Patch
5321150.short_description: An official patch for Mors Blade - UNSLASHED which restores all the additional content and scenes cut from the 16+ version of the game.

3780570.name: pond thing
3780570.short_description: PondThing is a micro-horror narrative puzzle game. It follows Shen Qingheng, a narcissistic young man who is drawn into a sacrificial ritual. As his mind grows numb and begins to break down, he is ultimately saved by his family’s “love.”

4689950.name: Cluster Burst VR
4689950.short_description: Break incoming cube clusters across multiple lanes in fast, reactive VR shooter.

5402490.name: Bound by Valor Demo
5402490.short_description: Defend the Flower of Life in a chaotic co-op action roguelike. Combine elemental powers, create broken builds on the fly, and survive relentless waves together.

4669910.name: STONEFEATHER Demo
4669910.short_description: STONEFEATHER is an atmospheric flying adventure where you fly as a stone-born bird across silent ruins. Ride updrafts, build momentum, and restore the vanished wind on a mystical journey.

4122610.name: Dark Watching Chapter 1  Soundtrack
4122610.short_description: Are you ready to listen to the dark music of Dark Watching and support the creator?

5076520.name: StrongGirls Tactics
5076520.short_description: Turn-based tactics RPG where your girls grow muscles as they get stronger. Recruit 18 girls, each with their personal stories and struggles. As your bonds deepen, they grow stronger and more muscular. Wrapped in a Norse themed world where you fight to reclaim the kingdom.

2659410.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
2659410.short_description: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

5336540.name: Chronicle Hands
5336540.short_description: Build high-scoring hands from shared traits in this deck-building roguelike. Combine 100 historical figures, 124 Legacies and 114 Event Cards. Add marks, draw or import your own cards, and challenge 100 historical bosses!

4479090.name: Stewart The Fox: Swing it!
4479090.short_description: A fast-paced speedrun platformer where you play as Stewart The Fox, improve your runs, and compete on worldwide leaderboards. Master the movement across 15+ maps, race against your ghost, and beat your personal best. Can you become a World Record Holder?

4599130.name: Brasil Assombrado: Arquivo 01
4599130.short_description: Discover the dark side of Northeastern Brazil in a first-person horror mystery. Uncover century-old secrets, solve puzzles, and evade a relentless pursuer. The clock is ticking... Can you figure out which Brazilian legend is behind it all?

5377960.name: Crusaders of the Blessed League Demo
5377960.short_description: Build a party of adventurers and help them ascend into legendary heroes. Find exceptional loot, craft unique builds, discover powerful synergies, and lead your crusader party through increasingly dangerous battles in this deep fantasy autobattler.

4113960.name: History of war: Napoleon in Spain
4113960.short_description: Command your armies in Napoleonic Spain. Plan your movements on the campaign map and fight real-time tactical battles. Coordinate infantry, cavalry and artillery, use the terrain to your advantage and commit your reserves to turn the tide of battle.

3794870.name: Cyan Breach
3794870.short_description: Cyan Breach is a 2D action RPG set in a post-apocalypse world with classic Castlevania-like combat and exploration. Explore the intersected game world map, defeat enemies, gain unique weapons, skills and items, increase character's power, and finally reveal the secret that caused the apocalypse.

4606800.name: Lark
4606800.short_description: Lark is a chaotic solo/co-op survival roguelite where tiny Wildthings harvest, build, steal, fight, and sacrifice loot to THE PIT for ridiculous buffs. Play alone or with up to five friends, stack broken builds, and grow from forest nuisance to unhinged little god.

5438200.name: Danelaw
5438200.short_description: Northumbria, 875. Land with a Danish war-band and carve out a saga of your own: fight in the shield wall, raid and ride, feud with named war-leaders who remember you, and rise from a hired spear to king in the north. Alone, or with up to three friends in online co-op.

1363940.name: Tenjutsu
1363940.short_description: Step into the shoes of a renegade yakuza hellbent on defying her former associates and loosening their grip on the Secret Garden City in this fast and fluid rogue-jutsu from Sébastien Benard, the designer of Dead Cells.

4930390.name: FerzGate
