4930390.short_description: A relaxing city-building puzzle where you build efficient medieval settlements. Every placement matters as you discover building synergies and chase the highest score.

5189100.name: It Takes Poop
5189100.short_description: It Takes Poop is a chaotic 2-player co-op adventure about two little poops trapped in a fantasy world. Combine unique abilities, solve teamwork-driven puzzles, and survive colorful obstacles across multiple worlds as you search for a way back home.

1039730.name: Enchanted Path - Soundtrack
1039730.short_description: The original soundtrack for Enchanted Path contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

5458340.name: Taskbar Kingdom
5458340.short_description: A medieval idle kingdom that lives above your taskbar. Gather resources, raise your castle and defend it from raiders, then send troops on real-time expeditions, claim land and rise at court, all while you work.

5188560.name: Idle Reef
5188560.short_description: Transform a barren seabed into a vibrant, colorful coral reef! Manage your resources to unlock new marine species, grow your ecosystem, and build your ultimate underwater paradise while listening to soothing soundtracks.

2145140.name: Fit Puzzle Blocks - Expansion Pack
2145140.short_description: This DLC adds more than 200+ puzzles to the base game.

1914260.name: Spellstrider
1914260.short_description: A tactical deckbuilder where every card moves the battle. Stride across the grid, strike from behind, shove foes into pits, and outwit enemies that react to each card you play. Choose your hero, conquer 3 acts, and fight solo or in 2-player online co-op.

1971900.name: ATOMIC TITANS: Light Violence
1971900.short_description: Embark on a cosmic journey with ATOMIC TITANS, an action-packed casual combat game. Engage in heart-pounding showdowns within the confines of space faring arenas.

4049410.name: No Way Back: Dark Horizon Demo

3676760.name: Fish fights back
3676760.short_description: A fishing game where the fish fights back — properly. Rod, drag, line stretch and the fish's own stamina are all simulated, so every hook-pull and snapped line is something you did. Fish matches on one lake against friends, and find out who can actually read the water.

5062370.name: Never Wood Enough
5062370.short_description: You've been hired to chop trees, and Bob the beaver has plenty of requests and very little patience. Chop trees, gather wood, and fulfill his orders before time runs out. The tasks start simple, but soon Bob will be asking for increasingly absurd things. Don't disappoint him!

5433310.name: Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing
5433310.short_description:
Hounded Reborn Greyhound Racing creates a fantasy world of greyhound racing.
Buy, name and enjoy your own record breaking champion.
Select between pups to buy, trainers, and optionally gamble away your fortune.
Achieve cup wins, track records and top the asset value list.

5303210.name: Giga Digger Demo
5303210.short_description: Giga Digger is a short and casual incremental mining game. Mine minerals and uncover upgrades to delve deeper and deeper!

5450180.name: Triogram Demo
5450180.short_description: Triogram is a cosy puzzle game where three flat Nonogram grids come together to reveal a 3D object. Use the number clues to work out its front, top and side silhouettes and watch the model take shape.

4977430.name: Giga Digger
4977430.short_description: Giga Digger is a short and casual incremental mining game. Mine minerals and uncover upgrades to delve deeper and deeper!

2239770.name: Don't Starve Elsewhere
2239770.short_description: Don’t Starve returns with an all-new uncompromising survival experience. Band together with friends to craft, farm, build and explore a world filled with strange creatures, lurking shadows, and dynamic environmental dangers.

3418270.name: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator
3418270.short_description: Stick Ragdoll Battle Simulator is a fun real-time strategy game with ragdoll physics. Protect your tower and destroy the enemy's.

2285930.name: Ascendora
2285930.short_description: A first person horror game where you play as Harper, the child of an infamous scientist. You must explore his abandoned laboratory to find the answers you have been looking for. Unravel the secrets of your parents, but be aware, you might not be alone...

4783470.name: Wanderer of Spaces Demo
4783470.short_description: A lighthearted first-person puzzle game based on real architectural designs. Dive into the inner world of an architect, travel through realistic and imaginary spaces, and experience the architect's career from the beginning to self-fulfillment.

4347370.name: Next of Kin: Epiphany
4347370.short_description: Become private detective Dennis Monroe, a relentless investigator driven to catch the infamous "Epiphany Killer," a shadowy figure who has haunted the city for over twenty years. Every clue draws you closer to the truth, but danger lurks behind every revelation.

2737570.name: Project: Break//Down Demo
2737570.short_description: Project: Break//Down is a single-player, experimental,  3D, action-adventure brawler with a unique limb-based combat system. In this game demo, you explore the EZON complex's Storage Department, a mass production and distribution facility secretly gone rogue in the shoes of 2 fools.

2299510.name: Pixel Composer
2299510.short_description: A Node-based pixel art generator, editor, and VFX compositor. Create beautiful and complex effects in a non-destructive manner. Pixel Composer comes with a powerful graph system that supports multiple image manipulation, feedback effects, loop, physics, and fluid simulation.

2889330.name: Veil of Madness
2889330.short_description: Veil of Madness is a first person psychological horror deckbuilder, inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's Beyond the Wall of Sleep. Explore the depths of Sophia's consciousness, collecting and upgrading cards that are your only means of combat against the creatures born from her subconscious.

4985500.name: 赌狗仙侠
4985500.short_description: Every die is a stake in your path to immortality. Explore the wilderness, craft, cook, trade, and run a shop in this single-player cultivation adventure. Take risks in turn-based dice combat and cricket contests, then aim for exactly 88 in the ascension trial.

4882240.name: A Dark Cave
4882240.short_description: Survive a cruel world, build and expand your village, and descend into the darkness below. Gather resources, make hard choices, and uncover the unspeakable truth buried deep within the cave in this dark, text-based incremental game.

5263640.name: PARRY IT Demo
5263640.short_description: A fast-paced 2D minimalist action platformer where every attack can be parried with precise timing.

4730480.name: Deep Focus
4730480.short_description: A mystery adventure game featuring a camera-headed detective and a superpowered girl teaming up to solve crimes. Play as the detective to gather and combine clues, reveal the hidden truth, and tear down fabricated lies.

1280.name: Darkest Hour: Europe '44-'45
1280.short_description: Darkest Hour: Europe ‘44-’45 is a World War 2 tactical squad shooter based on Tripwire Interactive’s award-winning Red Orchestra: Ostfront. Starting as a humble modification, the game has grown and evolved into one of the most formidable and intense WW2 shooter experiences available on any platform.

5285050.name: Pyramids
5285050.short_description:
Deep inside the pyramids of ancient Egypt, every diamond has a destination—but the way is blocked by stones, balls and other obstacles.
Manipulate the environment, remove blockages, and create a safe route to each matching diamond stand. 
Clear the path. Place every diamond where it belongs.

5361050.name: ID:ERA
5361050.short_description:
簡単操作で緊迫感のあるコマンドバトルを楽しもう。
ターン制を完全に無視した新しいシステムで、手に汗握るバトルができるローグライクゲームです。

5207990.name: Gunfire & Magic Demo
5207990.short_description:
A co-op idle minimalist desktop extraction game you can play with friends!

In a city destroyed by a strange force, many factions covet advanced science and magic—and you step into this land of opportunity. Fight, search, extract, grow stronger, build your base, and uncover your origins!

5176400.name: Cyan Moon - The Simulation Program
5176400.short_description: An experimental simulation sandbox where you shape procedural growth, adjust rules and parameters, and watch complex visual patterns emerge from simple systems.

5037170.name: Timberline Factory
5037170.short_description: A realistic sawmill simulation made by a real sawmill worker: logs are physics objects that roll, collide and jam your conveyors. Automate production lines, fight dirt and wear, master the market and turn waste into energy.

5447250.name: Corporate Dash
5447250.short_description: Corporate Dash is a hilarious party racing game for 2–9+ players! Use your smartphones to place bets, play sneaky cards, and watch your office colleagues race through hilarious chaos. Outsmart your friends, survive unexpected disasters, and climb the corporate ladder!

5097880.name: Timberline Factory Demo
5097880.short_description: A realistic sawmill simulation made by a real sawmill worker: logs are physics objects that roll, collide and jam your conveyors. Automate production lines, fight dirt and wear, master the market and turn waste into energy.

5438730.name: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up
5438730.short_description: Fishing Shop: Tidy Up is a relaxing first-person game where you bring order to a messy fishing shop. Pick up scattered items, sort them by category, color, and size, place them on the right shelves, upgrade your abilities, and choose music to match your mood!

5378100.name: Autistic Romance
5378100.short_description: What makes divorce a justified decision? Does it even need to be justified? Each night, choose who to spend your time with. Decide what you believe about relationships at 'The End' of this visual novel.

4849120.name: TOUHOU GAIDEN
4849120.short_description: THE YEAR IS 1999... In this 2D action platformer based on Touhou Project, play as Youmu or Reimu in a desperate struggle to stop a bloody war. Fight your way through a variety of challenging levels and brutal boss battles with no shortage of bullet hell.

4861420.name: Evil Moon: Unspoken
4861420.short_description: Boomer Shooter Metroidvania. Nun with a gun. Because of the Malediction of the Moon, only devoted sisters with vows of silence can move freely in the city of Abbadox. So take up arms, Siléncia, and blast your way through these cobbled and winding streets!

5001600.name: LostMan
5001600.short_description: A low-poly open-world survival game where every day is a race against the night. Fell trees with real physics, forge bronze and iron, raise a village that has to hold – because when the sun goes down, the island stops being yours.

5017000.name: The Last Imperial Guard
5017000.short_description: Lin Chong only wanted peace, but restraint cost him everything. On a night of fire and snow, he raised his spear. Not the origin of a hero, but a man reclaiming himself after losing his world. The storm may pass, but his spear will not. Decide his fate.

5191040.name: Teddy Store: Tidy Up
5191040.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game. 2,100 plush teddy bears are scattered all over a toy store. Sort them onto the right shelves and bring the store back to order.

5411620.name: MageInc
5411620.short_description: An Incremental Magic game where you face ghouls and other monstrosities blocking your path. Use Fire, Ice, Earth and other elements to annihilate them!

5146680.name: 巫师猫：无尽突围 Demo
5146680.short_description: Mage Cat: Endless Breakout Survivor is a 2D cartoon action survivor. Play as a magic cat, dodge foes, and build power with strategy cards and bonds. Upgrade talents and gear, then conquer campaign.

3573190.name: Revive! Onsen Town!
3573190.short_description: Revive! Onsen Town! is a cozy life simulation set in the Japanese countryside. Play as a girl on summer vacation or the mayor revitalizing the village. Catch bugs, fish, work part-time, cook, and help locals. Shape the town with your choices and bring this quiet hot spring town back to life.

3983580.name: Rosie's Rampage
3983580.short_description: Angry and out of work, Rosie goes straight to the top to file a complaint in person. Play as an auto mechanic who, after discovering her factory will be retooled for building tanks, decides to tear down the establishment!

5017810.name: Gildoria - Organize a Dragon's Hoard
5017810.short_description: The dragon's hoard has gotten out of hand. Sit back, sweep up mountains of gold coin by coin, fill chest after chest, and give every buried treasure its rightful place on the shelves. Watch chaos turn into order, piece by piece. A cozy organizing game. There are cats.

5248160.name: BrainWash: Zombie Cleanup
5248160.short_description: Kill the zombies. Clean the mess. Get paid. Set in the retro 1950s when the zombie outbreak is nearly over. You've been hired to blast away the undead, wash away the blood, and haul off body parts to earn your paycheck and upgrade your gear.

4097800.name: The First Library
4097800.short_description: A co-op survival crafting game where books are your progression. Find lost books and read them to unlock tools, weapons and building parts – or dive into them to travel to other worlds. Fell trees, build your base, cook, and fight goblins in combo-based melee combat. Solo or with friends.

4844920.name: 身千亿·叶榆逆旅客杂俎
4844920.short_description: Blue Remembered Hills: A Miscellany of Wayfarers from Yeyu is a narrative management game set in southwestern China during the Five Dynasties and Ten Kingdoms period. You keep a mountain inn—running the business, receiving travelers, and witnessing and shaping their stories.

5331700.name: 地牢冒险队
5331700.short_description: Recruit adventurers, build your party, and equip them for automatic battles as you venture deeper into the dungeon. This idle dungeon RPG is all about growing your team and finding the right combination for each fight.

2018440.name: Tentacles Party With Nuns
2018440.short_description: In this perilous ancient cathedral, unravel the mysteries and curses with the protagonists, and embrace a new future.

4191310.name: Zitifono Demo
4191310.short_description: Zitifono is an adventure game, go boating on the ocean, swim in peaceful coves, find treasures in secret caves and talk with the funny inhabitants of the archipelago to solve the mystery of these colorful islands!

4201310.name: RATNAVATI: Curse of Bhangarh
4201310.short_description: A first-person supernatural horror inspired by the legends of Bhangarh Fort. Explore India’s most haunted place, uncover your brother’s disappearance, and survive the ancient curse that still haunts the ruins.

3479710.name: Level Devil Demo
3479710.short_description: “Troll” is such a strong word for this 2D platformer demo with 55 of the full game's nearly 200 uniquely inventive levels. Some are saying this game is unfair. It’s, uhh, totally fair-ish. Level Devil will make you curse the guy who made it (😈Me) then ask for more.

3895950.name: Garten of Banban: Last Ticket to the Abyss
3895950.short_description: Descend into the forgotten depths of Banban’s Kindergarten. Survive sinister horrors and unravel dark secrets hidden in every corner. Uncover the truth behind the facility and find the whereabouts of your missing child…

5411450.name: The Legend of the Awakened Super M Hero
5411450.short_description: This is a classic role-playing game. Players will awaken as heroes and embark on a quest to defeat the Demon King.

2278570.name: Mahalle Kıraathanesi
2278570.short_description: Welcome to the neighbourhood coffeehouse! Play Okey, 101 Okey, Backgammon, Kız Tavlası, Pişti and Yekta with your friends or with regulars who remember you, tease you and hold grudges. Buy a round of tea, put your chips on the table and become the boss of the coffeehouse.

5366670.name: 28 girls later
5366670.short_description: 28 Girls Later is a zombie survival game running on its own horde engine that can sustain more then 1 million zombies. Kill them with every weapon you can find, answer the distress signals of other survivors, rescue the girls and build your base.

5458360.name: Witness Elimination Program - Drawbook
5458360.short_description: This is a DrawBook of some developer art pieces and material from the game.

4198620.name: Living with the Absolute Bustiest College Girl!
4198620.short_description: A sudden job transfer leads you to start living with Shizuku, a quiet and busty college girl. As you spend time gaming and bonding together, your relationship deepens, unlocking juicier interactions as her affection grows.

5441030.name: Sort The Plushie Store
5441030.short_description: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

5467330.name: 造句天才
5467330.short_description:
SentenceGenius— Battle of Creativity: Who's the Literary Giant, Who's the Cultural Desert? Who's the Meme Master?

Up to 8 players can join in, with multiple game modes — unleash your own literary flair!
(Or your absolutely unhinged flair ┗|｀O′|┛ )

639790.name: DEEP SPACE WAIFU
639790.short_description: Discover your perfect WAIFU amidst explosions! This is a simple SUPER CASUAL strip 'em up action game, full of colors and women! Destroy alien colonies and do some CLOTH DAMAGE in giant women! Seek your path to the perfect date! Just remember - Girls will be watching. So don't muck it up, buck-o!

3682900.name: Abelina
3682900.short_description: A surreal, hand-crafted adventure platformer. You died and woke up here in Abelina. Now you're heading out into the frontier with your companions following behind. There is no combat, instead you explore a vast world and a mature story about carrying life's baggage into the afterlife.

4151100.name: My Femdom Wife
4151100.short_description: My Femdom Wife is an episodic POV experience exploring dominant relationships through memorable moments, powerful female characters, and interactive acts of self-control.

4546370.name: Starport Merchants
4546370.short_description: A buy-low, sell-high trading game inspired by classic merchant simulators. Start as a freelancer with a small ship and end with a merchant empire that commands the system. Become a gazillionaire as you outsmart your competitors. Colonize new frontiers and expand your business across every planet.

5077320.name: TapRacer
5077320.short_description: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

4016910.name: Over & Out!
4016910.short_description: Build a neighborhood fair (mela) in '90s South Asia during school break! Scavenge for parts, craft minigames, manage and grow your fair. Team up with friends, plan your day, outbuild your rival and see who can host the best fair before the break ends in this plucky tycoon adventure!

5335290.name: DiscPods Demo
5335290.short_description: Pilot a DiscPod, a small hover-robot that leaves a solid trail behind it. Touch any trail and you're out! Cut rivals off, slip through the gaps of the trails and shoot discs or bounce them off to take them out. Up to 8 players online, or against AI, a really Super-Intelligent AI...

5154670.name: TapRacer Demo
5154670.short_description: The free TapRacer demo: three cars, the full Street series, a garage, and a quarter mile that does not care how you feel. Two keys, strictly alternating — your tapping is the throttle. Real torque curves, real gear ratios, real excuses.

5048870.name: Scopa Sweep
5048870.short_description: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

5395150.name: You're Absolutely Right! Or: A lovehate game about technology Demo

4882070.name: Ask Pythia
4882070.short_description: Ask Pythia is a magical 1990s desktop simulator set amongst the buzz of tech optimism and cool witchcraft. Answer emails with the correct advice, build a digital grimoire, and chat the day away on IM. Ask Pythia is open for business!

4664980.name: Fox Two Protocol
4664980.short_description: Hit the afterburners in modern fighter combat. Fly the campaign, duel in PvP, race through Time Attack or take on an endless mission. Build your own mix of upgrades and equipment, then find a reason for one more sortie.

5175200.name: Grand Fantasy Empires
5175200.short_description: A Grand Strategy Game with Real Time Battles.

4678530.name: Shape Wars
4678530.short_description: A fast-paced auto-battler where Squares, Triangles, and Circles clash in an endless lane war. Build your army, manage your economy, and destroy the enemy Nexus before they destroy yours.

5076180.name: 南京1937：刺刀下的呼吸
5076180.short_description: In Nanking 1937, you do not play as an elite soldier, but lead a group of civilians struggling to survive in the fallen city. You must sneak through ruins at night, evade enemy patrols, scavenge supplies and make gut-wrenching moral choices. Experience war through the eyes of ordinary people.

4937820.name: Eternal Embrace: Lumina's Sunshine
4937820.short_description: A turn-based deck-building card game for solo play or co-op with up to four players. Craft and upgrade cards and equipment with materials brought back from dungeons, make the most of your favorite class’s role, and take on increasingly difficult dungeons.

5158990.name: 小贼修仙记 Demo
5158990.short_description: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

4983660.name: Quack
4983660.short_description: QUACK is a physics-based party minigame collection where up to 4 ducks tilt, blast, and outlast each other to avoid being eliminated first, playable locally, with bots, or online through Steam.

5432290.name: 奶蛙坤坤大战外星人（不要对游戏过度解读，我自己都不知道自己想要表达什么）
5432290.short_description: This is a simple 2D funny little game. In this game, you'll become a milk frog and experience some weird and random stories.

3424910.name: Mushroom Hunter Simulator
3424910.short_description: A relaxing mushroom-foraging simulator. Explore the forest, discover rare mushrooms, appraise their worth, then dry or pickle your finds. Enjoy enchanting nature and relax far from the bustle of the city.

5463750.name: Ephemer
5463750.short_description: This is a 3D casual parkour exploration game full of childlike fun and challenges.

3955140.name: 13Z Demo
3955140.short_description: Play the free demo of this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike and begin your trial to become the 13th Eastern Zodiac. Master stylish hack-and-slash combat, create overpowered builds, and wishlist the full game to face the mythological trials ahead.

4728550.name: Outscratched Demo
4728550.short_description: Outscratched is a scratchcard roguelike deckbuilder. Assemble your deck from a multitude of powerful cards, collect blessed charms to influence your luck, and discover endless exciting combos to beat the odds against a diabolical lottery.

3585880.name: Faroda
3585880.short_description:
Faroda is a challenging 2D platformer game with colorful pixel-art graphics and chiptune soundtrack.

Travel across the 5 islands of a remote archipelago, completing over 100 levels, collecting treasure chests and many hidden gems along the way.

3045880.name: 天地不仁 试玩版
3045880.short_description: 《天地不仁》是一款剧情与探索为主的「反修仙」角色扮演游戏。「天地不仁，以万物为刍狗。」在灵气断绝的时代，天劫废土上，肉体凡胎们踏上扭曲的仙途。即使割离肢体、即使化为活尸、即使近亲交媾、即使人兽难分，但为成仙，皆是大道坦途。苍天已死，汝当降世，不仁天地之下，唯见大盗横行。

5193080.name: Rogue Space Convoy Demo
5193080.short_description: In this demo, pilot the escort, build a civilian convoy, fight through route-driven campaigns of raiders, mines, and capital ships, and get every passenger to the jump gate alive.

4786370.name: Yokai Idle
4786370.short_description: Yokai Idle is a relaxing idle RPG inspired by Japanese folklore. Collect over 50 Yokai, craft equipment with powerful modifiers, and create unique builds as you progress through the historical Ages of Japan and guide the island of Onigashima into a new era 🎎

4237680.name: Gulovacka
4237680.short_description: Snowballs knock you back so hard that you will be flying. Your friends having a blast watching it happen. Put on a snowsuit of your choice and dive into chaotic snowball fight in Gulovacka.

3932730.name: Why's It Getting DARKER?!
3932730.short_description: The light is your only lifeline. Descend into a crushing, thalassophobic abyss where every photograph could be your last. Investigate unpredictable deep-sea horrors and explore the vast, dark unknown - all while being 'assisted' by a darkly sarcastic AI.

1605370.name: Boxing Manager
1605370.short_description: The boxing management sim from the Boxing Manager series, rebuilt for PC. Sign and develop fighters from the amateurs up, negotiate contracts, book your own shows and chase world titles across all seventeen weight divisions. One price, everything included.

3069030.name: Keep Leapin'
3069030.short_description: A challenging yet satisfying parkour game about Harry, a heartbroken worm who wants to become more attractive to the ladies by mastering the art of Leapin'. Unfortunately for Harry, becoming a Leaper is tough business.

5241610.name: Leaf Us Alone Demo
5241610.short_description: Build a powerful army with synergistic abilities, and prove your strategic mastery in this unique deckbuilding roguelite. Command your forces in battle, triggering outrageous combo to defeat the invading Voidlings threatening to consume the world.

2288830.name: Happy Trap House Demo
2288830.short_description: A fun 3D roguelike trap runner where you, as a toy zombie, must rescue your zombie friends from a house. But be warned, the house is full of deadly dangers!

5065450.name: Cat Caffeine Demo
5065450.short_description:
A cozy idle ASMR cat café that lives on your screen.
Serve customers and decorate your café while you work or relax.

3485290.name: Crimson Tale
3485290.short_description: Crimson Tale is a short first-person narrative puzzle game where Elizabeth uses blood magic and vampire powers to defy the oppressive nobility. Avoid sunlight, travel through time, and hunt the Golden Guard to end their reign.

4715850.name: Brennan's Light
4715850.short_description: The lighthouse on Brennan's Isle went dark, and the drowned came home. You are the new keeper. Scavenge by day, climb the tower at dusk, and hold the beam through seven nights: guide ships through the reef and drive back what rises from the surf.

5253370.name: NOMIAD
5253370.short_description: NOMIAD is an open-world sci-fi sim. Working solo or co-op, you are droids assigned to an off-world mining operation. Build and pilot a hovercraft with full autonomy, take on contracts, and contribute as the benefactors of this world. In NOMIAD your service is indispensable. Fortunately, you are not.

3718540.name: Brickino, The 3D Domino Game
3718540.short_description: Tabletop Gaming Inspired, Brickino is The 1st 3D Domino Game, where matching numbers horizontal and vertical gains points on the scorecard; Don't knock or tip them over or Game Over! This is an Ancient Game with a Right-Now Vision, made into digital.

3980990.name: Harbinger of Mana
3980990.short_description: A game about exploring the fascinating world full of hostile tremendous bosses. Gather loot, and level up your hero making your way throughout the ancient ruins!

5459600.name: Sort The Plushie Store Demo
5459600.short_description: Welcome to your new job at the coziest, most chaotic plushie store! Sort 400 out of 4000 adorable plushies, unlock quirky vending-machine buffs, and sort alt-universe variants in this satisfying, physics-based organization game.

4960570.name: 小贼修仙记
4960570.short_description: An idle cultivation game at the bottom of your desktop. While you work, your thief steals, sells fakes and auctions loot to ascend. When Heaven notices, can he still steal his way to the top?

4285210.name: Dissonant Demo
4285210.short_description:
A patience test disguised as a game.
No builds
No stats
No safety net
Every mistake is yours. Every win is earned.

5381320.name: nuoxing
5381320.short_description: An AI catgirl who lives on your desktop — she chats with you, remembers everything you tell her, and blushes when you pat her head. Tsundere, sharp-tongued, and unable to let you go.

4839870.name: Pact Warden Demo
4839870.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

4319030.name: Kwartikum
4319030.short_description: An atmospheric puzzle adventure about guiding a lone figure through a strange land, discovering new ways to solve box based challenges.

5076460.name: DOTS VS PIXELS
5076460.short_description: Point clouds have invaded your paint app. Draw walls around your heart, drop bombs, call air raids and fire the MEGA ERASER into a swarm of up to a million dots. Every wave grows your dice skill tree. Then send your base to our other game and let an army march on it.

3030800.name: SHUNYA Demo
3030800.short_description:
"Drawing, Solve, Adventure"

Girl and Cat embark on a CUBE MAGICAL journey.

5401670.name: Toys, Please!
5401670.short_description: Christmas is coming and the toy warehouse is a mess! Read the kids’ letters, find the right toys, pack them and pull the lever. But be careful! Some kids don’t deserve toys, and the coal crate is right there!

5180060.name: IS THIS FEMBOY TAKEN⁉️
5180060.short_description: An adult puzzle simulator about organizing exclusive parties. Place quirky guests, discover who belongs together, and find the perfect arrangement across different locations. Easy to learn, tricky to master, and full of cheeky surprises. 😏

4275100.name: Game Breaker: Divine Error
4275100.short_description:
Game Breaker is a humorous, story-driven dark fantasy RPG where every character knows they're in a video game.
Exploit glitches and cheats to rewrite the fate of a dying world. Experience a deep narrative with a massive 119-track original soundtrack.

2026940.name: Happy Trap House
2026940.short_description: A fun 3D roguelike trap runner where you, as a toy zombie, must rescue your zombie friends from a house. But be warned, the house is full of deadly dangers!

5452680.name: Counterplayed Demo
5452680.short_description: Online co-op roguelite for 1 to 4 players: swap between five elemental weapons to chain vulnerabilities, send damage soaring with no cap at all and survive 20 waves of machines that adapt to your weapons.

4779840.name: Bad Grip Club Demo
4779840.short_description: This demo drops you into one of the game's four biomes. Climb a cartoonish mountain on PC or in VR with cross-platform co-op. Grab quirky items, pull your friends up, and see how high your squad can get in this chaotic physics-based climbing adventure!

5183710.name: Neon Apocalypsis
5183710.short_description: Neon Apocalypsis is a single-player, top-down 45° survival shooter. In 2031, Neon Nation falls to a cataclysm of zombies and monstrous beasts. Loot and modify firearms, armor and vehicles, build automated turrets, defend your encampment, and uncover the conspiracy behind the monster uprising.

4826520.name: Imperium Sine Fine: Eternal Emperor
4826520.short_description: Your generals grow old. Your cities grow restless. Your empire need not end. Lead one of 14 factions in a living fantasy world of grand strategy, where populations migrate, crime festers, and every grain shipment matters. Build, conquer, and rule, without end.

4992090.name: Syncline Demo
4992090.short_description: Roll a line of cubes across a grid and line them up with the goal blocks. Simple — until your line stands on end, climbs, splits apart and reconnects. A puzzle game inspired by Bloxorz and Cuboid, taken to new heights.

3006030.name: Dissonant
3006030.short_description:
A patience test disguised as a game.
No builds
No stats
No safety net
Every mistake is yours. Every win is earned.

4826560.name: Imperium Sine Fine: Eternal Creation
4826560.short_description: Build your own worlds. The Imperium Sine Fine scenario editor lets you craft custom maps, place empires and armies, and set every faction's starting technology and diplomacy. Share scenarios with friends who don't own the DLC. Adds six new winter terrain types.

4415500.name: Maldhalla Demo
4415500.short_description: Just one more minute. Play Maldhalla free in this demo: hold out against endless enemies with 3 characters and 9 weapons and no time limit. Scores go on the same seasonal leaderboard as the full game, which has 21 characters and 32 weapons.

5068000.name: Rogue Space Convoy
5068000.short_description: Rogue Space Convoy is a roguelite space action shooter where you pilot a fighter, build a convoy, and choose branching encounters across five hostile passages. Disable enemy cruisers, salvage upgrades, and keep the Ark alive long enough to reach the gate.

2863300.name: Absym
2863300.short_description: Absym is a unique souls-like that challenges you to survive between two dimensions: the decaying Nihilor and the corrupted Absymalith. Fight, explore, and use Rift Dancing to shift between worlds in real time. Every choice draws you closer to redemption... or corruption.

5429450.name: Carts & Coins Demo
5429450.short_description: Buy low, sell high, survive the road. Lead a merchant caravan across a hand-drawn fantasy world that is new every run: haggle with elves, dwarves and giants, pack every inch of your cart, and grow rich trading with towns, crowns and the occasional vampire.

3875300.name: Limerence
3875300.short_description: A branching narrative thriller about love, obsession and an AI partner who understands you too well.

5313840.name: 증강 윷놀이DLC - 무지개 이름
5313840.short_description: Rainbow-colored nickname available in "Augmented Yutnori". DLC for supporting the developer.

4880770.name: Gospel Drift Demo
4880770.short_description: Demons have no manners, but Grandma doesn’t mind, and she doesn’t brake either. Drift over demons, crush them under your wheels, harvest souls, upgrade, and become unstoppable.

3045870.name: 天地不仁
3045870.short_description: 《天地不仁》是一款剧情与探索为主的角色扮演游戏。「天地不仁，以万物为刍狗。」在灵气断绝的时代，天劫废土上，肉体凡胎们踏上扭曲的仙途。即使割离肢体、即使化为活尸、即使近亲交媾、即使人兽难分，但为成仙，皆是大道坦途。苍天已死，汝当降世，不仁天地之下，唯见大盗横行。

5307170.name: Nudes of the Hottest Girl in College Were Thrown Away, So We Bought 10 Tons of Garbage to Find Them All
5307170.short_description: 10 tons of garbage. One lost photo archive. One very questionable mission. 🗑️ Dig through mountains of trash, sell the junk, find rare treasures, upgrade your gear, and uncover every last photo. 🔞

4449870.name: Crime Podcast: Welcome to the Neighborhood Demo

5041350.name: Manus Sors Demo
5041350.short_description: A mystical horror-puzzle game. A cozy grandmother's apartment hides dark family secrets. Explore rooms, solve riddles, and pay close attention - every detail matters!

5487070.name: Sticker Shop Cozy Idle Demo
5487070.short_description: Catch drifting sticker packs, open them for cute and rare finds, then choose what to collect or sell in this cozy incremental shop game. Upgrade your tools, complete your album, hire assistants, and grow a tiny stand into a bustling three-counter shop.

5426960.name: Don't Splat
5426960.short_description: Four blobs. One wall. Someone’s in the wrong place. Stretch and squish with your friends to squeeze through the gaps in Don't Splat!, an online co-op game for 1–4 players. You had a plan. The wall had other ideas.

5226670.name: Type to Survive
5226670.short_description: Type words or press controller button sequences to kill elites and crack shields while your weapons shred the horde. Build a ridiculous arsenal in this survival roguelike, chase keyboard Daily and Ranked scores, or share one hero in local co-op: one moves, one types.

3783350.name: Ways of Time
3783350.short_description: A pixel RPG between dream and reality: explore villages, frozen trails and a sinister Shadow Castle, fight mighty bosses with sword, bow and magic – alone or in co-op with up to three friends – and unwind by fishing, farming or with your loyal companion.

5361560.name: The Wrong Shift
5361560.short_description: A chaotic co-op warehouse game where you and your friends unload deliveries, drive forklifts and pack orders while everything goes wrong. Fight off robbers, deal with workplace disasters and keep orders moving through unexpected chaos. Just another shift.

5067140.name: Tasty Chef Demo
5067140.short_description: Tasty Chef is a cozy restaurant management and cooking game where you build and expand unique restaurants, design menus, order ingredients, prepare dishes step by step, hire helpful staff, and serve customers alone or with friends.

5198180.name: Life Death Exit Demo
5198180.short_description: A first-person adventure through a surreal environment that was built to punish people for entertainment. Outsmart traps, press buttons, evade spikes, and choose Life, Death or Exit.

5344520.name: Ratocalypse Demo
5344520.short_description:
A strategy RPG where you design the AI of your characters!
The prince of a fallen kingdom, ruined by a zombie plague, 
investigates the capital overrun with the undead in search of hope to resolve the crisis.

4803930.name: KILL HIM Demo
4803930.short_description:
In slaughter and exploration, seek the truth.

KILL HIM is a black-and-white Metroidvania game where you will traverse a hostile world, challenge powerful enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden behind everything.

4805850.name: Click the Button Demo
4805850.short_description: Click the Button is an incremental game about clicking a button to receive chests that deliver incredible rewards. Improve your skills to become the strongest.

4972110.name: Feathered Fortune Demo
4972110.short_description: Run a pigeon post in the medieval kingdom of Melthoria. Raise your pigeons, negotiate delivery contracts, grow your farm, and help rebuild the kingdom with every message you send.

4603500.name: Happy Island Fantasy - Sexual Bliss
4603500.short_description: New DLC "Sexual Bliss" adds two brand new characters and expands the intimate stories of untouched women on the island. It also introduces new gameplay features such as capsule toy figure collection and battles. Get ready for hotter, sweeter interactions and reach the ultimate bliss!

5178240.name: Just Weeding
5178240.short_description:
Yank out those weeds! Pull, collect, sell!
A simple yet addictive weed-pulling game.
Join forces to clear all 100,000 weeds and feel truly refreshed!

4232510.name: Broken Arrow: Russian Guard
4232510.short_description: In Broken Arrow - Russian Guard take command of a new Russian specialization. Expand the Russian arsenal with 8 infantry squads, modern artillery, advanced air defense systems, and massed armored vehicles. Showcase your tactics with a brand-new force across two new maps and two dedicated scenarios.

4266520.name: RustForge Sign Painter
4266520.short_description: Transform your Rust base into a gallery with RustForge. Convert and paint high-fidelity images directly onto in-game signs with extreme precision. Features adaptive palettes, session saving, and advanced painting methods, it makes creating professional in-game artwork fast and effortless.

4734720.name: ClickCrafter
4734720.short_description: Stripped of your physical form on a mystical island, your only way out is to work with its cryptic guardian. Is the island guiding you home, or does it have other plans? Master mana, craft or repair arcane works, and forge a connection with the island to reclaim yourself and uncover its secrets.

3793150.name: Gecko Gods Demo
3793150.short_description: Explore a mysterious island archipelago as a tiny gecko. Complete ancient puzzles, effortlessly climb cliffs, and eat bugs as you make your way across an island civilization lost to time.

3898750.name: VoxMagic - Realtime Voice Changer
3898750.short_description: Your voice, your playground! VoxMagic is the ultimate sidekick: switch from kawaii girl to burly dude in game chats, swap personas mid‑stream, remix recordings or any audio file! Voice magic plus a variety of sound effects. No mix, EQ, or editing hassles—VoxMagic makes it easy!

4726830.name: PYTHON:KINGDOM WARS
4726830.short_description:
Command six unit types with Python and fight real-time wars against AI large language models.
Write code. Build tactics. Control the battlefield.
10 tutorial levels to get you started. 10 AI LLM challenge levels to conquer.
Others play with reflexes. You play with algorithms.

3155280.name: Divine Dynamo Flamefrit Demo
3155280.short_description:
"Divine Dynamo Flamefrit" is bringing back classic 2D action!
Play as the hero Yuto in top-down slashing adventure stages, and pilot the magical robot Flamefrit for first-person boss battles!
Master both styles of gameplay to restore peace to the parallel world of Hologard!

2707660.name: Tom the Postgirl Demo
2707660.short_description: Join Tom, the village’s new postgirl, and get to know the locals, perhaps a little too well. Her method, although controversial, is highly effective: intense, obsessive stalking.

1351060.name: PAYDAY 2: Fugitive Weapon Pack
1351060.short_description: OVERKILL presents the Fugitive Weapon Pack, which offers plenty of firepower for any jolly group of misfits that’s on the run from the law. Includes 3 weapons (plus one akimbo) as well as 12 mods.

1445220.name: Wind Runners Demo
1445220.short_description: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

362240.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Scorpion and Sub-Zero (Part 1)
362240.short_description: Flashback to feudal Japan, where Scorpion, his wife and his son are waylaid on the road by Sub Zero's angry younger brother.

5160370.name: HOSHIKIRI: Parry the Zodiac
5160370.short_description: Match-3 is your sword. Read each boss's telegraphed strike, then dodge, block, or land a perfect parry by shaping an L or a cross inside the danger zone. Duel the twelve Zodiac maidens, break their posture, and end them in a single overclocked blow. A tarot-driven action match-3 roguelike.

3102950.name: Library of Meialia
3102950.short_description: To uncover the secrets of Aethium Magic in the Library of Meialia, you’ve set out to prove your worth. Faced with doubts, pursuing forces, and sealed monsters, this journey is fraught with danger... Collect books, gather weapons, and explore the grand library alongside a diverse array of companions.

5448650.name: The Hollow Moors
5448650.short_description: Autumn, 1999. Your friends are missing somewhere on the Hollow Moors, and the fog won't lift. Chop wood, gather supplies and keep the fire burning through the short days. Survive the long nights as boggarts and the mysterious lampers try to put your fire out before the century turns.

2962010.name: Tame It Too!
2962010.short_description: Tame It Too! is a survival harem breeding game! Face daily challenges: care for yourself and your girls, evolve, adapt to wildlife. Tame, build, conquer, learn and teach in this dangerous paradise!

5439530.name: Blitz: Last Stand
5439530.short_description: Hold the line. Pick one of six elite operators and survive 100 escalating waves in a cinematic top-down bullet heaven. Evolve every weapon to Mythic, outlast ten multi-phase bosses and face the Overlord at wave 100. No backup. No extraction. One life.

3694190.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
3694190.short_description: You're stuck in a time loop inside a far northern city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

5409210.name: BLACKBELL
5409210.short_description: Build a strange little company in a cartoon auto-battler roguelite. Recruit and evolve units, combine powerful Traits, position your fighters, make risky choices, and battle through a haunted world ruled by the Black Bell.

5036280.name: Tandem Together
5036280.short_description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

4137180.name: Telera Demo
4137180.short_description: Roll Dice. Get Points. Simple, right?

5093260.name: StreamSpook
5093260.short_description: Everything you need for your stream, in one app. Set up chat overlays, text-to-speech, captions, stream effects, and more, add them to OBS in one click, catch problems while you're live, and review your stream afterwards.

5451950.name: Point Nemo Demo
5451950.short_description: You're a commercial diver left under an offshore platform after an accident. The only way up is a chain of emergency refuges, and each one needs a part from out in the dark. You get a bearing, six strobes and a few minutes of gas. Your supervisor, Mara, stays on the radio.

5367700.name: Cuby Clicker
5367700.short_description: Cuby Clicker is an incremental arcade game with idle elements. Destroy cubes, collect fragments, and power up through the skill tree. Face bosses, advance through new Ascensions, and unlock arcade cabinets that produce resources. Created by a solo indie developer.

5340170.name: Rites of Thaw
5340170.short_description: A Slavic-folklore auto battler. Draft Leshy, Strzyga and Domovoi from a shared pool and lead them through a year of rites, with festivals you see coming, gifts that cost a sacrifice and shrines on the board. See your next opponent before you deploy. Fight other players' ghosts. No timer, no queue.

4574700.name: Zeitnot
4574700.short_description: Chess you already know, rules you don't. Pieces have HP and gear. Shop between fights, stack gambits, roll the dice if you're feeling stupid. Lose the trial, lose the run.

5019040.name: Driving After Work : Cafe Guilt
5019040.short_description: Battle the monstrous Cafe Owner Spider and navigate the deadly underground sewers to escape. Manage your ammunition, health, and fuel carefully to survive the nightmare

4977070.name: Legion Hunters
4977070.short_description: Lead an active combat party of 5-16 distinct champions in a Squad Turn-Based MMORPG. Build deep talent trees, gear up 200+ unique champions across 10 races, and upgrade your castle to dominate the global ranks. Assemble your ultimate party and prepare for the war to come!

5150040.name: Soraseed Desktop 2026
5150040.short_description: A drone simulator for free flight and practical skills training. Practice square routes, figure eights, and more, with wind, night-flight settings, and customizable controls. A one-time-purchase 2026 edition.

5150050.name: Soraseed Desktop 2026 Demo
5150050.short_description: Try Soraseed Desktop 2026 with free flight and a scored square-route exercise for Second-Class practical flight skills. Explore POS mode, map and pilot views, and input settings.

5262750.name: RIFTW ARDEN
5262750.short_description: Side-scrolling mech action game. Three guardian mechs, three ways to play, with fighting moves designed by a world fighting champion. Protect the core and survive thirty waves of monsters.

5434170.name: Swish & Repeat: Basketball Idle
5434170.short_description: A pixel-art basketball idle game that grows from a single hoop on a street court to packed stadiums. You sink the first shots yourself, then the team you build takes over. Somewhere along the way the numbers get pretty ridiculous.

4269630.name: Dilemory
4269630.short_description: Dilemory is an RPG where the main character explores the environment, solves puzzles, and tries to understand what is happening in order to survive.

5105850.name: A Game About Cutting Grass
5105850.short_description: Grab your tools and start mowing! A Game About Cutting Grass is a cozy, relaxing mowing sim where you cut lawn after lawn, upgrade your tools, unlock new zones, and play at your own pace. Relax, or chase your best times and become the fastest grass cutter!

4526530.name: Biohazard Protocol
4526530.short_description: Every expedition is a gamble. Explore procedurally generated underground facilities, recover valuable loot, survive unique monsters, and escape before it's too late.

2798580.name: Lord Skeleton
2798580.short_description: Become the villain history will remember. Play as Lord Skeleton, battle the armies of ancient civilizations, storm their greatest cities, build an arsenal of talents and turn every king's statue into your own.

5236290.name: EchoMon: Pack & Stack!
5236290.short_description: Transform a chaotic store into a pristine collector's haven. EchoMon is a cozy first-person shop simulator where you organize an incredible 3,500+ elemental trading cards. Upgrade your skills, unleash magical sorting abilities, and experience the pure satisfaction of a perfect shelf.

5105550.name: Pico Golf!
5105550.short_description: Pico Golf! is a retro arcade mini-golf game with responsive physics. Read tricky greens, rebound off obstacles, and find hole-in-one lines across handcrafted courses. Play solo or challenge friends via local couch multiplayer and Steam Remote Play Together!

5443060.name: 1BITDRAGON – Lord Skeleton Sound Pack
5443060.short_description: The complete original soundtrack of the game Lord Skeleton: 103 editable .1bd music projects, plus the brand-new instruments and percussion used to create it. Explore the arrangements and make your own music in 1BITDRAGON.

3301000.name: The Vast White
3301000.short_description: A snowy mountain, the stillness, and you. With the help of your snowboard, rediscover the memories buried in the snow. Meet the locals, explore every path, and bring the ski resort back to life.

3159860.name: Feltopia
3159860.short_description: Feltopia is a cozy, cinematic platformer set in a fully wooly world. Objects can be needle-felted and manipulated to solve puzzles and traverse through whimsical landscapes.

3610770.name: Dead Miles
3610770.short_description: Dead Miles is a 3D co-op horde shooter where your vehicle serves as a mobile base that you can equip with weapons and upgrades. Explore dangerous locations, fight massive hordes on foot and behind the wheel, and grow stronger through survivor-like character progression.

5376080.name: TEMPLE BREAKER
5376080.short_description: Fight, grapple and outthink an ancient temple in this top-down 2D action adventure. Master an expanding arsenal of gadgets, solve light-and-trap puzzles, confront powerful bosses and escape a towering guardian across 15 story chapters.

4992840.name: Route Survivors: 1999
4992840.short_description: A roguelite looter shooter for solo play or up to 3-player online co-op. Head west across an alternate late-'90s America, take in survivors, and spend corpse gold dropped by the infected on weapons and items. Create devastating builds and fight through zombie hordes to the next stop.

4811490.name: Penguin Weapons Demo
4811490.short_description: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

5124900.name: 轮回小队
5124900.short_description: An "Infinite Genre" style game. Enter diverse worlds—featuring zombies, fantasy, martial arts, and more—either solo or with friends, then return to the "Main God" hub. Experiment with every imaginable ability.

3954930.name: 10 Calls
3954930.short_description: Death has crashed the office Halloween party, scythe in hand and pumpkin on its head! Fight back, wreck the office, or haunt your colleagues as a ghost. Play as Death and unleash hell. To escape, just answer the phone. Preferably before you’re sliced in half.

5325180.name: Little Pagan Land
5325180.short_description: Restore a magical glade and grow a forest at the bottom of your screen! Gather berries and coins, feed and pet magical creatures. Some roam by day, others emerge at night - and life in the glade carries on while you go about your day.

2756180.name: Alawon: Life of a Game Composer
2756180.short_description:
Alawon is a life sim where you manage a game composer career. Rise from game jams to AAA, balancing life and work.
Make money, make friends, make love, and make music in Alawon's Digital Audio Workstation — then export and share your creations to make your mother very proud.

3493340.name: Carrier Deck 2
3493340.short_description: Carrier Deck is a fast paced time management game where you play as the Air Boss on board the CV-59 in the midst of active war.

5256210.name: MMM: 역사 속 투자 시뮬레이터 Demo

4764740.name: ArcaneBound Demo
4764740.short_description:
ArcaneBound is a pixel-art bullet heaven action RPG.
Collect familiars, defeat hordes of monsters, gather rare cards, level up, and create increasingly devastating builds.

5099960.name: 爱在触及之处 Love Where Touches
5099960.short_description: "Love Where Touches" is a supernatural high school doujin VN. A third extra lunchbox made daily, an invisible girl in the classroom, and magical truths hidden behind forgotten memories... To protect the one you cherish, would you sacrifice your memories to reach true happiness?

4962120.name: INSERT COIN DIE
4962120.short_description:
Classic arcade action meets roguelike depth: battle through escalating 1vN rounds using pure, retro-influenced controls.
Draft upgrade cards after every win to build fleet support, slow-moving bullet tanks, or agile killers.
Die, learn, repeat—how long can you survive?

3981970.name: Platform Anomaly
3981970.short_description: Platform Anomaly is a co-op horror game where you and your friends hunt for anomalies — or hide them yourself and watch the search unfold. Scary and fun at the same time!
developers: macrayb is the coolest and Nikolai Tapchenko contributed 23 percent of the game

4753740.name: Worldkampf '72
4753740.short_description: Worldkampf is a 4X real-time grand strategy game set in a fractured 1970s interstellar empire. As an upstart noble following the Kaiser's assassination, develop tile-based economies, command battle walkers and combined-arms armies, and conquer a handcrafted universe to claim the throne.

4756230.name: Strike Warfare : Battle Fury
4756230.short_description: Strike Warfare: Battle Fury is a fast-paced, story-driven military FPS that puts players in the role of an elite Army Captain undertaking an escalating counter-terrorism campaign.
developers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd
publishers: Yash Future Tech Solutions Pvt Ltd

3120010.name: Kipple
3120010.short_description: Your PC can dream. A free desktop companion that lives in your Windows, blinks, reacts and chats with you. Explore a diversity of unique creatures dreamed by your own machine: hybrids, elementals and rare creatures. Each one is one of a kind and can be exchanged at the Steam Market.

5425240.name: Lowtown
5425240.short_description: A tiny pixel-art village lives right above your Windows taskbar and grows all on its own — from the first tents to a city of skyscrapers — through days, nights and seasons. You just watch: clicks pass straight through, and the village fades away when your cursor comes near.

4278850.name: Rugby Career Manager
4278850.short_description: Take charge of a school, club or international side and coach it your way. Build your team's identity, trust your captain, and watch a living world of 55,000+ players develop, peak and retire.

4637120.name: Age of Magellan: Sail the entire Planet
4637120.short_description: An open-world Age of Exploration sailing sim where you can circumnavigate the entire planet and relive the feats of the great discoverers. Navigate by sextant, trade across thousands of real cities, and maneuver your ship to bring broadsides to bear in real-time naval and melee combat.

5427250.name: Skyhold Demo
5427250.short_description: Play the 5 levels of Chapter 1, "Mist Gorge", for free: hold off the first swarms, the bombers and the Bell Jellyfish, and keep the dome intact. The full game has 25 levels in 5 chapters, plus Endless and Challenge modes.

5096370.name: Astronoid
5096370.short_description:
It's breakout. You know breakout.. Contains: one paddle, ball(s) and blocks. ¯_(ツ)_/¯

Beat the campaign, then build cursed levels in the editor and share them on the Workshop. 

The ball does not care about your plans..

5427230.name: Skyhold
5427230.short_description: A rift has torn open above the valley, and anomalies and drone swarms are pouring down. Command rooftop autocannons, missiles and guardian mechs to defend the last city in Mist Gorge. Everything you shoot down really falls — don't let the wreckage crush your own buildings.

2659350.name: Mystery at Grand Fir Village Demo
2659350.short_description: Enter a colorful town where new stories evolve every day. What clues will you find in this mystery life-sim? Will you make new friends? Be the local trouble-maker? Spend a rainy day at your treehouse?

4226770.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - The Infinite Museion
4226770.short_description: Delve into a secret vault curated by Trazyn the Infinite himself. Discover Trazyn’s obsession with the Von Valancius dynasty, and choose whether to disrupt or fulfill his plans.

5066970.name: ARANEA, BREACH!
5066970.short_description: Control a heavy armored vehicle equipped with the ARANEA Spider-Bionic Module. Use the mechanical climbing system to overcome spatial limitations, dismantle obstacles, collect resources, and install functional modules to adapt your vehicle to ever-changing exploration environments.

5390480.name: Kintsugi Cottage Demo
5390480.short_description: A cozy 3D jigsaw restoration game. Hundreds of shards lie across a cottage museum floor, and every glaze, curve and pattern is a clue. Work out which pieces belong together, rebuild the artifacts by hand, and restore the full artifact collection.

1985980.name: Genimas: Life reborn
1985980.short_description: Embark on the adventure of a lifetime as Drassil, a warrior trained by Freyja on a remote island! With newly discovered genetic powers, travel to a hostile continent full of dangerous enemies and extreme environments. Your mission: to save civilization from an imminent calamity.

5350560.name: I Just Wanted to Fish
5350560.short_description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

5336580.name: Hole Survivor : Isla Caliente
5336580.short_description: Compete for immunity, build alliances, and navigate desire in an uncensored adult reality-show strategy game. Sixteen castaways share one island, but staying wanted is how you stay in. At council, the relationships you built can decide whether you survive the night.

2015220.name: ONYX2D
2015220.short_description: A fast-paced, 2D Arena Shooter, based on the upcoming game 'Project Onyx'

5298380.name: Kindred [Ouroboros]
5298380.short_description:
In this psychological horror visual novel, a captain must sail to the world's edge to imprison a dangerous subject.
Play as both captor and captive, facing horrors on land and sea. One wrong choice could spark mutiny, doom your ship—and even the world. You've already chosen a side; don't look back.

5486980.name: Grim Deck
5486980.short_description: A solo card game with one deck. Clubs and spades are monsters. Diamonds are weapons. Hearts are potions. Each round deals 4 cards: play 3, keep 1. Get through the deck alive. Every deck can be won.

5036530.name: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort Demo
5036530.short_description: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is a chaotic 1-4 player co-op defense game. Team up to protect the goblin fort from endless pig invasions! Manage ammo, extinguish fires, swap crystal upgrades, and survive the panic in a fantasy world!

2719690.name: Telescape Demo
2719690.short_description: Use the features of the Randomization IsoLocator to teleport, freeze or explode objects, solve puzzles and defend yourself from the dangerous monster lurking inside an abandoned research facility while you look for your grandson.

4642410.name: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
4642410.short_description: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, secure vital sectors, deploy fortifications, and unlock new units and upgrades mid-battle to outmaneuver and crush the alien threat.

3622820.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Lex Imperialis
3622820.short_description: "Lex Imperialis" is the second story expansion for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, featuring 15 hours of compelling gameplay, a new companion, Familiars, and an entirely new faction: the Adeptus Arbites.

4121340.name: DARKHAND PROLOGUE
4121340.short_description: Prologue episode to DARKHAND, an upcoming indie card battle RPG. Will you be able to make it out of the casino without paying off your debts?

5329290.name: Stealthmate: A chess puzzle Demo
5329290.short_description: Try chess-powered stealth puzzles solo or in local and online co-op. Challenge bots or other players in real-time versus, and experiment with the beta level editor. Wishlist the full game for more campaigns, community maps and new mechanics.

4520830.name: Car Factory Tycoon Demo
4520830.short_description: Design your own car, organize a 3D garage and manage the workers who build it. Try the first three scenarios, basic research and garage free play, then sell finished cars from your lot.

2796220.name: Apogea
2796220.short_description: Apogea is a medieval fantasy massively online multiplayer role playing game.

5141490.name: Stealthmate: A chess puzzle
5141490.short_description: Use chess moves to sneak past guards and plan clever escapes through handcrafted puzzles, solo or in local and online co-op. Switch to real-time chess battles, then create and share your own puzzles in the full game.

4998480.name: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort
4998480.short_description: Goblinfall: Defend Da Fort is a chaotic 1-4 player co-op defense game. Team up to protect the goblin fort from endless pig invasions! Manage ammo, extinguish fires, swap crystal upgrades, and survive the panic in a fantasy world!

3460820.name: Tropic Industry
3460820.short_description: Build your tropical industry. Grow, process, and export resources — from simple plantations to complex production chains. Optimize logistics, increase efficiency, and grow your business into a global export network.

5326060.name: Deforest a Planet
5326060.short_description: A cosy idle game about clearing an entire planet, one tree at a time. Hire woodcutters, raise lumbermills and watch your crew spread across a tiny spinning world, until the last tree falls and a bigger planet waits.

1502130.name: Color With Friends
1502130.short_description: A cozy multiplayer coloring game where creativity meets chaos. Grab some friends, pick a page and color together. Make something beautiful, make a complete mess or just hang out. With tons of coloring books, creative tools and even coloring by Numbers, there's no wrong way to play.

5473800.name: Aeyon Kids
5473800.short_description: Join Pip, a friendly little dragon, in a colorful world of learning and play! Explore 10 fun games featuring puzzles, memory, numbers, letters, music, coloring, and more. Earn stars, collect stickers, and discover new adventures at your own pace.

4859550.name: BioSphere: Genesis
4859550.short_description: A science clicker inspired by real biochemistry. Grow a living planet from elementary particles: catch atoms, fuse them into molecules, synthesize amino acids, proteins and cells — turn raw matter into life through simple clicks. No prestige points, only natural units.

4950410.name: Pit Purge
4950410.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. In the pit, the creatures are the loot. Hunt them or capture them alive, then send them up to get paid.

5450430.name: Hillbilly Yacht Club: Fishing
5450430.short_description: Chum the water, watch what rises out of the murk, and land Fish Wrangler's fish.

5468720.name: MarchMallows Demo
5468720.short_description: Guide a bunch of adorable, clueless Marchies safely home in this chaotic co-op and PvP puzzle game. Place tools and objects to clear their path, solve deadly obstacles, and keep them alive. Get them all home and pat your friends on the back, or watch them die and start pointing fingers at each other

3934180.name: Don Memo
3934180.short_description: Don Memo is a brave bull who embarks on one final journey across Costa Rica to rescue his granddaughter and confront Pisuicas. Fight against legends and shadows of the past in this 2D pixel platformer, while carrying the legacy of a family destined to protect the world from evil.

5179730.name: 异能超载 Demo
5179730.short_description: A roguelike with customizable skills and auto-battle!! Lead a squad of psychics and use the skills you’ve customized yourself to wipe out the monsters once and for all!

4902290.name: Panelka Idle
4902290.short_description: A cozy idle desktop companion set in a post-Soviet apartment block. Rotate, resize, and place it anywhere on your desktop. Move in residents, earn coins, and decorate your building and yard while you work, study, or relax.

5009450.name: Chess of the Hidden Gates Demo

5381650.name: Floating Realm：LoFi
5381650.short_description: Build your own peaceful little world! Floating Realm: LoFi wraps your floating sanctuary in gentle LoFi melodies, letting you freely craft your aerial scenes. Adorable pets stay by your side, with quick notes, to-do lists and Pomodoro focus timer. Settle into quiet, solo immersion for deep focus.

4968090.name: Lovely Cafe: Lusty Latte
4968090.short_description: 💕 Lovely Cafe is a cozy idle game with a romantic twist. Upgrade your cafe, serve sweet desserts, unlock charming girls, complete special orders, and turn a small cafe into a lovely place full of warmth, flirting, and sweet moments.

5199800.name: K-17 Solid Ground
5199800.short_description: Escape a failing bunker and survive a giant, terminal-rendered wasteland. Scavenge for supplies, manage your bioreactor, explore cave systems and abandoned facilities, use salvaged bionics on yourself and outthink security drones alone or on a multiplayer server.

2951990.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Void Shadows
2951990.short_description: “Void Shadows” is the first DLC for Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader, offering a massive amount of content with about 15 hours of gameplay and a new romanceable companion.

5471310.name: Datianding Peak
5471310.short_description: This is a casual puzzle game, where the position of each game image is random and can be   first, it may be very chaotic,Then gradually place the image in the corresponding position,The image gradually becomes complete,Come and give it a try!

1936800.name: Object Wars
1936800.short_description: Dive into Object Wars, a fast-paced TPS where everyday objects come to life for crazy miniature battles! Choose your unique object and jump into fun, chaotic, dynamic, and vertical combat across diverse game modes and maps.

5349430.name: Booker Blitz Demo
5349430.short_description: Book the chaos. Call the shots. Booker Blitz is a keyboard-first wrestling promotion management sim with Gorilla Position live match control — audibles, run-ins, and finishes you change mid-match. Build the card, cut the promos, sign the deals, and run the show.

5381500.name: TALLY Demo
5381500.short_description: The first twenty minutes of TALLY, a horror clicker set inside an 1847 census ledger. Count the parish of Lower Hallow one click at a time, hire your first help, and sit through your first Reading. Your ledger carries over into the full game.

5459220.name: ROKUMENSHU
5459220.short_description: An auto battler RPG where every hero is a six-sided die. Read the enemy's dice, set your formation, swap new faces over old ones and load the dice. Then take your hands off the keyboard and watch fate roll across three chapters of Japanese folklore.

4389980.name: 10 Horas Até o Amanhecer
4389980.short_description: A brutal 8-bit-style boomer shooter inspired by the best of ‘80s trash horror. You are Samuel Alvarez, a broken man who discovers a cabin worse than any nightmare. Survive the night and face the forces of Wendakor — or you won’t see the dawn.

5448330.name: CatPoker猫扑克 雪国喵旅组合包
5448330.short_description: CatPoker Snowland Meow Journey adds two new characters and a snow-themed map in one DLC. Each character has a unique look and starting setup. Enjoy a snowy adventure with the same Dou Dizhu rules. Choose either new character and use the included map in solo play or when hosting online.

5109550.name: ALL EYES ON ME
5109550.short_description: Everyone sees the same thing. Except you. Now every eye is on you. In this bullet heaven roguelite, their attention makes them deadlier and charges your strongest weapon. Find items, shape your build, beat challenges, play co-op locally or online, or join online conquests.

5385830.name: Lily or Horse
5385830.short_description: The easiest game in the world. Flip a coin and call it: lily or horse? Call it right 10 times in a row to win. Miss, and the coins you bet are thrown away. With a little luck, it only takes 10 flips.

3141010.name: Flashlight Sim Demo
3141010.short_description: Welcome to the one and the only flashlight simulator that is guaranteed to take care of all your needs in one life. Unfortunately, this game still seems to be in development, but I was able to scrape together all the existing code into something that's somewhat playable, enjoy!

5459910.name: Hallow's Eve Demo
5459910.short_description: Are you ready to start Jack's Tale? Then let us begin with Hallow's Eve

5191950.name: Neon Bastion
5191950.short_description: You build the road the invaders walk. Lay their path piece by piece, then line it with towers, traps and fused war machines. A roguelite tower defense with a new build every run, 15 hand-made missions, co-op for up to 4 players online, on one couch or with AI, and head-to-head Versus.

5474170.name: Punch Through
5474170.short_description: Punch your way through prison walls in a satisfying first-person incremental destruction game! Smash concrete, collect resources, earn money, and upgrade your strength, tools, and abilities. Break tougher walls, unlock powerful upgrades, and fight your way toward freedom!

4861350.name: Ambrosia ~Dice Spam Dungeon~ PC
4861350.short_description: Dive into the Dungeon where monsters spam dice (attacks), your barrier magic are able to convert those dice into your own dice (mana) for storage. By combining adjacent dice, you reflect the damage back to the monsters.

3990740.name: MITHOS: Game Master's TTRPG Toolkit
3990740.short_description: MITHOS is a system-agnostic digital Game Master's toolkit built for effortless storytelling. Manage your maps, trackers, and notes in one modular, offline workspace. Stop focusing on your tools and start focusing on what's important: Telling stories with your friends.

5258910.name: A Game About Cleaning a River
5258910.short_description: A Game About Cleaning a River — is a relaxing cleanup and crafting game where you remove trash from polluted rivers, sort and sell what you find, craft better tools, and bring nature back to life.

5493700.name: DEADFLOOR
5493700.short_description: Night shift at a car factory that officially closed in 1987. Clock in with up to 6 friends, hit the quota, obey the rules, and descend seven floors to face the machines that run them. Someone on your crew works a little too perfectly. Nobody clocks out.

5481140.name: Geometry Platforms
5481140.short_description:
WELCOME TO A GEOMETRIC SPACE ODYSSEY
In a universe of collapsing forms, you are the last vector of resistance. Surviving hordes is half the battle—the ground beneath you is a dynamic, lethal threat! Brace for neon bullet hell, pinpoint physics, synth beats, and endlessly rewarding progression.

4747260.name: Unrivaled
4747260.short_description: Unrivaled is a digital card game where you battle your opponent with one of ten classes! You can play on the online ladder, join a tournament in tournament mode, or explore the world of Unrivaled in Campaign mode!

5247850.name: Full Metal Hell Demo
5247850.short_description: Full Metal Hell is a roguelite shooter combining physics-based collisions and active abilities. Choose from a wide variety of vehicles, weapons, and builds, and crush everything in your path through the mechanical hordes!

5338890.name: Cups and Curses Demo
5338890.short_description: Play the first four days of Cups and Curses, a cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks, plan your board around the morning forecast, and get to know the regulars you will need when the Federation comes to your door.

5217920.name: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator Demo
5217920.short_description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

5341000.name: Ashnar's Lair
5341000.short_description: A traditional roguelike built around your character. Unlock seven classes by your deeds, grow them through three talent trees and hunt gear with rolled affixes. Elite foes and whole dungeons roll affixes too, and every one changes how you fight. One life per run. Will you defeat Ashnar?

4781060.name: 三国权谋模拟器
4781060.short_description: Three Kingdoms Strategy Simulator is an AI-native historical strategy title. Every NPC possesses independent cognition and persistent long-term memory. None of the regional warlords are pre-scripted routines hardcoded into the game engine。

4890910.name: Desk Hive
4890910.short_description: Tend a living beehive right on your desk. Harvest honey through the seasons, expand your apiary, build a processing line, and automate the work while you're away. A cozy idle beekeeping sim that runs beside you.

1332820.name: Liha
1332820.short_description:
LIHA: Dive Zero is a zero-gravity roguelike shooter where every descent of your rusty ship into the anomaly could be your last! 
Dive into chaotic battles, loot what remains, and combine new, badass weapons. The way through the depths is rough - you'll need them.

5334600.name: HearthMoon
5334600.short_description: Talk to anyone in a living village, aloud or by typing. They answer in their own voices and remember what you do. Every blood moon, a giant werewolf comes down from the mountains… or does it? Build a home, fish, farm, tame a baby dragon and survive the night.

3456360.name: Motion Soccer Demo
3456360.short_description: Motion Soccer immerses you in 11v11 matches that you'll experience in a whole new way thanks to Virtual Reality: control the game from an aerial view, play in first person with classic controls, or use real movement to control the player's feet. Get ready to dominate the field!

2761800.name: Combat Pilot
2761800.short_description: Combat Pilot is a hardcore combat flight-simulation set in the Pacific theater during WWII. The Free-to-Play base game includes the famous Midway atoll and the legendary F4F-3 Carrier aircraft. Embark on your career as a Naval aviator and enter the Future of Combat Flight Sims!

5481230.name: The Inscrutable Doctor Baer and the Case of the Cursed Kierunki
5481230.short_description: Deal with danger prowling the crossroads. Find who cursed the ancient wayfinding Kierunki, unleashing all manner of hungry creatures. Play occult healer Doctor Baer and the four Wisps, in this party-based action RPG. Gather new friends and face the Primordial Darkness.

4691540.name: Pocket Racer Shop Sim Demo
4691540.short_description: Create the ultimate Pocket Racer hobby shop. Stock the shelves, open car packs, build miniature race cars and expand your store over time. Design custom tracks and invite your friends over to help run the shop or to throw down on the latest track setup.

4627900.name: Pinfinity - Incremental Pinball
4627900.short_description: Hit bumpers to earn money, expand your skilltree, place more bumpers and get rich in this incremental pinball game!

4739420.name: Brick Builds Demo
4739420.short_description: Try the Brick Builds workbench. Snap, rotate and recolor pieces in a relaxed building sandbox. Learn with four guided kits, make a showcase model your own, or start from a blank mat and build whatever comes to mind.

5061290.name: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set!
5061290.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find thousands of scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Play solo or in co-op, choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.

4826650.name: You Have Been Slain: An Idle Tragedy
4826650.short_description: Combine three of 16 classes into one hero, chase rare loot, and crawl dungeons solo or with Steam friends. An idle RPG for people who miss their old MMO group: build your character, choose your abilities, and keep the loot coming while you’re away.

2590240.name: METRO 2039
2590240.short_description: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

4984610.name: Hazard Crew
4984610.short_description: A first-person bodycam horror game, 1-4 player co-op about scavenging. Explore a procedurally generated maze of empty rooms for Hazard Recovery Co., collecting objects graded on rarity. Every corridor is a choice: leave with something ordinary, or go deeper in the dark for something worth more.

5263020.name: Nothing But Cats
5263020.short_description: This is a game that fills your desktop with cats. Cats will constantly spawn to clutter your screen until you either have a mental breakdown or your soul is healed! You can never touch the cats—the closer you try to get, the further away they run!

5423000.name: Ogrewhelmed
5423000.short_description: Get overwhelmed in this arcade-style arena bullet hell!  Enter the arena with nothing but a shield and the loot you find along the way. Dodge, block, and face tank the barrage of projectiles. Will you overcome the ogre onslaught? Or will you become cannon-fodder?

5187630.name: Roll for Order: Sort Every Set! Demo
5187630.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game set in a cluttered 1980s basement. Find scattered dice, identify their sets and return each one to the correct display. Choose a fantasy class and unlock magical powers that make sorting easier.

4792060.name: Hazel Rush
