4792060.short_description: You need to explore the world,  outsmart your environment and uncover secrets to unlock new paths to reach your next destination, gather crucial knowledge, craft different structures, and survive hidden dangers.

5260430.name: Unrivaled Demo
5260430.short_description: Unrivaled is a digital card game where you battle your opponent with twelve different character classes and over 400 hand-drawn cards to play with! Fight bosses and explore the world of Unrivaled in Campaign mode!

5432710.name: Gnome Horde: Garden Defense
5432710.short_description: A bazillion garden gnomes. One cottage. Plant sprinklers, compost cannons and pot mortars in your flower beds, give them a target and watch thousands of ceramic gnomes shatter with a satisfying clink. Spend the shards in your garden shed, alone or in co-op with a friend.

5085280.name: Dust Vein Demo
5085280.short_description:
A co-op horror game for 1-4 players set in the dead underground bunkers of Earth.
Collect loot, fulfill the quota, feed the living reactor, and descend deeper and deeper into the mines.

4877420.name: Rec Room: A New Semester
4877420.short_description: Party up with your friends and explore a world of endless fun. Hang out in official rooms, discover community-created rooms, or create unforgettable memories with players from around the world.

5299600.name: Filthy Fly: Horde Survivor Demo
5299600.short_description: The complete Picnic, free. One filthy fly, twenty waves of ants, bees, beetles and medics, nine disgusting weapons to stack and evolve, and The Crumb King waiting at the end. Die, mutate at The Heap, go again. Everything you earn carries into the full game.

3453430.name: Rush Your Band
3453430.short_description: Start as an unknown artist. Record your own songs using your real voice, release them online, grow your fanbase and build your music career.

5189510.name: 降临之地 Realm of Advent Demo
5189510.short_description:
If you love building unique decks, triggering insane combos with simple controls, and watching numbers skyrocket—you'll love Realm of Advent.
In a world ruled by Apostles, craft your build from 300+ cards and relics to ignite addictively wild chain reactions.

5207160.name: High Roller Penny DEMO
5207160.short_description: A bold pachinko-inspired roguelike. With bunny girls. Build your best pegboard with special pegs, balls and passive effects to reach legendary scores. Lose and get executed on the spot. Oh did we mention this is a death game?

4972360.name: Starfall Samurai Demo
4972360.short_description: Starfall Samurai blends slash-based action with incremental progression. Drag the mouse to aim your slash, then release as asteroids cluster together. Clear the screen in one strike, collect carrots, hone your sword techniques, and venture ever deeper into space.

5096800.name: Limbival Demo
5096800.short_description: You went to a carnival for fun, but suddenly realized that you are the real source of entertainment! Luckily, you still have your limbs, so you can escape from here... right?

5147910.name: Gypt - The Eternal Pharaoh
5147910.short_description: Building and management rogue-lite set in ancient Egypt. Assign your artisans, raise your pyramid on a triangular grid, and riddle it with traps. Upon your death, watch your tomb brave 2,000 years of trials against raiders and the wrath of the gods.

4642150.name: This Flash Contains Horrors Demo
4642150.short_description: Psychological horror collection, which includes 5 games: GambleHeart, ROMASHKA, You Are Doxxed, B*tch!, LOOP and COLORFOOD Inc. These are stories about anxiety, pressure, and internal tension linked by a shared atmosphere.

4652640.name: My Child New Beginnings Demo
4652640.short_description: My Child New Beginnings is a parenting simulator where you go through everyday life of growth. After a series of traumatic events that you and your child went through, you now get to rebuild life together in a new region of Norway.

4747790.name: Dummy House Demo
4747790.short_description: First-person psychological horror and survival. Use your camera and sound to identify and repel enemies that mimic humans in total darkness, uncover disturbing secrets, and face increasingly intense nights in an industrial complex with multiple endings and high replayability.

4866750.name: A Northern Evil: Tape One
4866750.short_description: A short atmospheric horror experience set in the remote north of Sweden. Explore an abandoned village where something is deeply wrong, uncover strange clues, and face a lurking evil hidden beneath the quiet surface.

4465780.name: Gear Up Einstein! Demo
4465780.short_description: A strategic roguelite auto-battler for 1-3 players. Travel through time, recruit historical figures, and gear them up with badass equipment for ridiculous combos. Master tactical missions solo or with friends. Ready to save the world?

4466460.name: Oomi’s Nook Demo
4466460.short_description: Oomi’s Nook is a relaxing and heartwarming sticker decor game. Decorate a cozy little room with hand-drawn style stickers according to the drawing or unleash your creativity! Follow the lighthearted everyday life of the adorable Oomi family and watch them live leisurely in the world you create!

3756690.name: 橘香仲夏 Demo
3756690.short_description: 以都市职场生活为背景的百合视觉小说，作为在大城市游戏行业996的独身社畜，想要改变却无能为力的吴依，偶然间得到了一次改变命运的机会……

3777630.name: SnowRunner - Season 19: Research & Restore
3777630.short_description:
Welcome to Switzerland, where major renovation and infrastructure projects are underway! Trek across 3 winter maps aboard 2 powerful new trucks.

Season 19: Research & Restore is included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

4660170.name: Witch Shop Simulator
4660170.short_description: Step behind the counter of your very own sorcery shop. Witch Shop Simulator is a cozy first-person shop management game where you invent and brew custom potions, manage your stock, and keep your shelves full of magical wonders for customers to buy.

3275760.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: West Slavic Attire
3275760.short_description: This cosmetic addition to Paradox Interactive’s award-winning medieval strategy role-playing game introduces new gear for Western Slavic characters of all ranks.

3315500.name: Crusader Kings III: Crowns of the World
3315500.short_description: Step into history’s spotlight with a collection of new crowns, hairstyles and beards in Crowns of the World. What will your royal image be like?

3143230.name: A Liminal Place Public Testing Place
3143230.short_description: Public Testing Place for A Liminal Place R: Chapter 2 (known as The Solitude Project)

3160030.name: Ai 爱
3160030.short_description:
Every ordinary day we live may be a miracle happening in succession.
Play as "Liu Jie" with occupational quirks, spending abstract yet mundane days with partners in the metropolitan hustle. Finally, navigate through your own crossroads...

3196660.name: Sexorcism Demo
3196660.short_description: Sexorcism is an adult game combining roulette and spell-build crafting. As Ely runs out of Mana in battle, you become her exclusive “Provider.” Fight monsters by her side with Spells, Artifacts, and a “special” way to replenish Mana and turn fate around.

2789360.name: Meadgard Demo
2789360.short_description: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends create the ultimate Viking tavern. In this demo, you can hunt mystical beasts by day, cook and serve rowdy patrons by night, and survive the wrath of Norse gods when the mead stops flowing.

2555420.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Mountain Royals
2555420.short_description: Prepare to embark on a legendary journey as we introduce the "The Mountain Royals" DLC for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition. Unlock the rich history and untold stories of the Armenians and Georgians, part of three new campaigns!

3176230.name: Sector Unknown Demo
3176230.short_description: Free demo of the story-rich, isometric RPG Sector Unknown. Escape a prison transport and crash land on the desolate planet of Maku, establish a base, ally with or dominate local factions, and combat a tyrannical organization set on ruthlessly exploiting the sector's resources and inhabitants.

4630010.name: Goblin Kaboom
4630010.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike auto battler. Raise your army, fortify your base and watch invading monsters splatter upon your defenses.

4955980.name: Dairy Empire: Production Simulator
4955980.short_description: Build your own dairy business from the ground up. Milk different animals, process fresh milk into a wide range of products, construct your factory, manage your shop, and build a home in this hands-on crafting and production simulation.

4521770.name: Drunk Woodcutter
4521770.short_description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

5014900.name: Gravity Reversed
5014900.short_description: You were just an ordinary apple... Until you woke up with cat ears... Gravity Reversed is an action platformer where you jump, reverse gravity, and dive your way through each stage!

1005970.name: iVRy Driver for SteamVR (PSVR Lite Edition)
1005970.short_description: Use your Sony PSVR as a VR Headset for your PC. Lets you run SteamVR & Oculus Rift PC VR titles using your PSVR headset.

5450510.name: Liberate : escape game à deux Demo

98820.name: Realm of the Diggle Gods
98820.short_description: Deep within their underground temples, Lord Dredmor plots the next stage in his campaign of merciless brutality and world-terrorizing.

98822.name: Dungeons of Dredmor: Conquest of the Wizardlands

5325980.name: Sayara's Path
5325980.short_description: Join Sayara on a journey through the snow-covered Vad-Hidek to find a way to bring her brother back to the world of the living. Here everyone’s fate depends on the will of the Spirits, and the path to resurrection becomes a trial the result of which is unknown.

4993900.name: Star Stranded Scrappers
4993900.short_description: You've been left stranded on a drifting space station. Fly out solo or with up to 3 friends to scavenge resources, delve into dark derelicts, and fight off swarming aliens, then race home and hold the line with nothing but your own weapons. How long can your crew last?

5128990.name: Hoverslam
5128990.short_description:
Hoverslam is a competitive precision platformer time trial rocket flying in a cave game (What a mouthful!). In other words, space cave race. 
This is not your grandpas casual "Moon Lander" game, there is a high skill cap and it takes practice to get good. Easy to pick up, difficult to master.

4633680.name: Mercenary Brotherhood
4633680.short_description: A deep turn‑based tactics RPG featuring emergent stories, procedural world events, enemy factions, magical loot with drawbacks, and a fully simulated fantasy sandbox. Build your mercenary company,  survive brutal battles, and uncover new content. Solo‑dev indie project with active development.

3564500.name: Lambda Fortress
3564500.short_description: Lambda Fortress is the iconic mod that brings the Team Fortress 2 mercenaries into Half-Life 2 and other Source campaigns for singleplayer & co-op play. Now on Steam!

4567060.name: Retro Districts: In-Between Eras
4567060.short_description: A time machine. A war. A leap into 2225. Humanity now lives in retro districts — neighborhoods dedicated to different decades of the 20th century. Unlock ideas, secrets and places — from cabarets to TV studios, from galleries to protests. Choose your words wisely. Every dialogue shapes your path.

5359080.name: TIDESTEP
5359080.short_description: A 2D puzzle platformer where every grounded jump changes the tide. Move boats and gates with the rising water, cross eight moonlit harbor routes, and guide Maru to the dawn lighthouse. Find hidden shells and reach each bell in fewer jumps.

5007780.name: Bootleg Buddies
5007780.short_description: Run a moonshine still with up to three friends, then haul the crates down dusty backroads before the law catches up. Grow it, stir it, distill it, drive it by hand. Co-op for 1-4 players, or run the whole county alone. Early Access.

5085210.name: Swap Attack Demo
5085210.short_description: Both halves of your cell move as one, in two arenas at once, sharing a single gun. Whoever holds it fights; whoever doesn't, runs. Sling it over the divider before the far side gets overrun. Twenty rounds to the Gatekeeper, then endless.

1603000.name: HEDZ Reloaded
1603000.short_description: An alien retro arena shooter. Beat your competition to steal their abilities, or have your abilities stolen first. Engage in a solo campaign, bring a friend along for splitscreen couch co-op action, or join an online match and see who can keep their HEDZ on their shoulders.

3960500.name: Death & Taxes Multiplayer RPG
3960500.short_description:
Become a trader, a hero, a legend...even a god. 
In Death & Taxes you can pursue anything...but only two things are certain.

5081510.name: Paint The World
5081510.short_description: A casual, first-person painting simulator with multiplayer, timelapse, and unlockable colors, tools and worlds!

5145610.name: 沣都镇 Demo
5145610.short_description: Fengdu Town is a Chinese folk suspense game. You’ll play as the protagonist, Fu Tong, starting from his hometown and gradually unravelling the mystery behind the largest cult in China.

5405270.name: Słownikowa Wyspa
5405270.short_description: Słownikowa Wyspa is a Polish-language educational adventure game. Join Mizuki on a journey across a mysterious island, solve word puzzles, explore unique locations, collect missing book pages, and discover fascinating facts in an illustrated encyclopedia.

5254400.name: SND
5254400.short_description: You are hiding in a locker. Don't panic... It passes in front of you. You stay hidden. Its footsteps fade. Should you get out now, or will it come back? You're trapped in a facility plunged into pitch-black darkness. You can hear it. You can hide from it but you can't kill it...

5159140.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup Demo
5159140.short_description: Free demo of Octbuster, a physics sim meets a tidy-up game. Over 10,000 VHS tapes and an octopus with tentacle arms to scoop them up by the armful. A cart buddy, a kitten army, a buried arcade, and no generative AI. Your save carries into the full game.

5182850.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup Playtest

5328190.name: Wild Draw
5328190.short_description: Play cards. Screw over your friends. Then shoot it out. WILD DRAW is a first-person party game for 3–6 players where every round starts at the saloon table and ends in chaos.

5042370.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
5042370.short_description: A physics sim meets a tidy-up game. Octbuster has over 10,000 VHS tapes and an octopus with tentacle arms to scoop them up by the armful. A cart that follows you, a kitten army that helps, an arcade buried under the mess, Twitch chat in your store, and no generative AI.

3868880.name: Pal Engine - Desktop Companion
3868880.short_description: A living 3D VRM desktop companion — voice & text chat, custom animations, props, and memory-backed personality on your screen. Import VRMs, Pal Engine Cloud or local AI, Photo Booth, and the character store.

2991650.name: DAWN AEROWAR
2991650.short_description: Dawn is an interactive animated adventure about a fighter pilot's last campaign against the Empire that took everything from him. From the War Room, you launch each of the twelve missions, tune the radio until the signal locks, and take off. Every debrief extends the route and unlocks new dossiers.

5374100.name: Frontier Factory
5374100.short_description: Build your automated factory on a frontier planet! Mine resources, plan logistics and research technology as conveyor belts and machines take on the hard work. Build defenses against zombies and roaming powerful creatures, and face the Blood Moon every seven days.

2802090.name: Huanhai: A Career in Ink
2802090.short_description: You're the new assistant magistrate of a county drowning in debt. Read every petition, audit what smells wrong, and bring down the seal: approve, reject, send back, or quietly skim into your Dark Ledger. Seven years of ink decide whether you rise, retire, or are named in a censor's memorial.

5252040.name: 15日僵尸幸存者
5252040.short_description: 《Zombie Survivors on Day 15》 is a semi-open-ended survival game. Facing waves of zombie attacks continuously, the countdown of life begins. You must remain vigilant at all times. Fighting and evolving are the only choices for you to survive.

5256610.name: Business Tycoon
5256610.short_description: Build a business empire across the United States. Create companies, open and upgrade assets. Expand across industries, dominate markets, control a growing share of the economy, and build a trillion-dollar fortune.

3858030.name: Immortal Coil
3858030.short_description: Build powerful decks to confront the Gods in this lane-based, strategy card game. Play the Roguelike Adventure Mode or ascend the Tower of Battle in Gauntlet Mode. Discover wild deckbuilding synergies to unleash spectacular combos against formidable foes.

5006460.name: Chalk Down
5006460.short_description: One substitute teacher. A room full of kids. Complete the lesson, turn around and catch the class mid-prank. Online party game for 4 to 7 friends.

5315260.name: Bollwerk
5315260.short_description: A tower defense game where over 100,000 physically simulated units besiege your fort. Build guns and mortars. Rain down grenades. Let the dead pile up, and pray relief comes in time.

5021430.name: Beat Ten
5021430.short_description: Across the Rhythm Multiverse, anomalies are disrupting the Beat.  Your mission: repair the Beat using YOUR music, one track at a time. Welcome to Beat Ten, where you can play to music you stream!

3692400.name: NuTREEnts
3692400.short_description: NuTREEnts is a strategic tower defense roguelike about growing and expanding your forest. Plant saplings, fend off bugs, and explore a desolate planet while you grow a mighty colony of trees!

5275040.name: Orbit Foundry
5275040.short_description: Build a 2D orbital factory and work toward a new star. Place neighboring machines, time Perfect pulses and Echo rewards, then automate production. Reforge for permanent upgrades and return to build something brighter.

5096660.name: 怪談寺
5096660.short_description: 山の中にてあなたは偶然にも、怪談寺に迷い込む――。そこにいたのは、正体不明の奇妙な4人の人物だった。聞かされる怪談話の数々。王道ホラーから人怖、SFホラー、ホラーコメディなど多岐に渡る怖い話を楽しめます。VHS風画面短編集ホラーノベルゲーム。

4246560.name: PhotoLoop
4246560.short_description: Boot up the world's oldest PC to take photo editing commissions from a colourful cast of virtual strangers. In PhotoLoop, the only thing stopping you is your imagination... and probably your entire editing interface.

2445120.name: EXODIUM Part 1 Demo
2445120.short_description: At the end of the 21st century, surviving humans and loyal robots are looking for ways to escape to another planet.

5319370.name: リリリ・リスポーン Demo
5319370.short_description:
Die, respawn, and step on your own corpse. 
Reiwa Roman’s Kuruma Takahira makes his starring debut in a video game with Re:Re:Re:Respawn, where every death leaves a body — and every body opens a new way forward.

4073500.name: Only Booze: Liquor Store Simulator
4073500.short_description: When an alcoholic opens a liquor store… what could go wrong? Run, manage, and grow your own liquor empire in a dynamic market where prices change daily, trends shift overnight, and your reputation lives or dies on social media. This isn’t just another shop simulator. Welcome to OnlyBooze.

3681220.name: The Light Switch
3681220.short_description: The shadow wants to play with you. It moves quickly, and you have to find it. Be patient, but don't wait too long. Light will be your friend. Don't make the shadow angry.

4662030.name: Unearthly
4662030.short_description: Create your alien and hurl, smash, and blast your way through humanity! Mix 10 weapons with 8 origins, complete randomized missions, collect powerful upgrades, and grow stronger. Build your own playstyle in this action game with light ARPG elements.

5200350.name: Billiards Warrior Demo
5200350.short_description: 《Billiards Warrior》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelite building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

4169900.name: Valehands
4169900.short_description: A cozy incremental management sim about guiding dwarven crews through their daily work and bringing their valley to life.

4799340.name: Nocciolino & The Creamy Adventure
4799340.short_description: Help Nocciolino on a crazy 3D platforming adventure to thwart the evil Chef! Explore vibrant levels where everything reacts to physics, unlock wacky gadgets to overcome insurmountable obstacles, and blast your way through with... hazelnut magic!

5127590.name: Dear Gardener
5127590.short_description: A quiet first-person game about honest work, kind employers with secrets, and a crow who steals. Mow the lawns, trim the hedges, water the flowers and send the harvest to market. Everyone who hires you is lovely. Everyone who hires you is hiding something.

5460140.name: Collateral Glory
5460140.short_description: Two pilots, one 30-story Walker, zero coordination. Each of you runs one leg and one arm: stride into the Civic District as one, trade punches with an Ultrafauna, hoist it overhead together and hurl it down the avenue. Then the Ministry of Public Confidence sends you the itemized bill.

4661040.name: GRIP 2 Demo
4661040.short_description: GRIP XR is a high-speed, gravity-defying futuristic combat racer that pushes driving skill to the limits. Follow-up to GRIP, a spiritual successor to Rollcage.

4100630.name: Pull Me In
4100630.short_description: Pull Me In is a supernatural life simulation where you build a home, form relationships, pursue strange Purposes and survive a town plagued by ghosts, demons, possession and unexplained phenomena. Live an ordinary life in a place where nothing is ordinary.

5308310.name: ERROR：赛博男人和我的奇怪方块战斗 Playtest

4672230.name: BOBABOMB
4672230.short_description: Did you ever blow boba bubbles at your friends? If you haven’t done that before, NOW YOU CAN!! Play as a cute little "Boby". Suck up ammo, slow rivals, and blow them up or knock them into hazards in chaotic playgrounds for up to 16 players!

4963630.name: Bandidos em Brasilia
4963630.short_description: Brazil has fallen. A dictatorship has seized power, and the files that could bring it down are hidden inside an abandoned mansion — with someone inside who doesn't want you to find them.

4033340.name: Castellan of Aurelwatch Demo
4033340.short_description: Get an early look at Castellan of Aurelwatch! Explore a medieval fantasy world, battle enemies in turn-based combat, meet new companions, and begin rebuilding a forgotten outpost.

4902890.name: Daybots
4902890.short_description: Daybots is a co-op colony builder and tower defense game: grow a colony, automate its industry, and hold out against solar-powered robots that freeze when night falls. Command from above or step into any colonist in first person, solo or with up to three friends.

4277960.name: SGS Vietnam War
4277960.short_description: The Vietnam War remains one of the most emblematic conflicts of the Cold War era. Relive, on each side, the epic fight for dominance in this key Southeast Asia conflict from US intervention in 1965 till the Fall of Saigon in 1975.

5179670.name: Synapse Grid
5179670.short_description: A neon light-cycle combat racer where the wall you leave behind becomes the arena. Amber kills. 90-mission campaign, 2–4 player split-screen, online beta (unproven). Free demo out now (beta). Next Fest 19–26 Oct. Release 28 Oct 2026.

5097980.name: Greek Row, Fall Semester
5097980.short_description:
Six houses. Sixty feet of asphalt. One roommate who's never had a date, and your
certainty that you can fix that. A coming-of-age visual novel about the year you learn
you cannot hand a person a life. Three acts, six routes, seven endings.

5253310.name: Gamble Hunters Demo
5253310.short_description: Hunt for 60 seconds, then bet your haul at the casino! Try the free demo of Gamble Hunters, a co-op action roguelite for up to 4 players. Dive into exciting battles, try your luck at casino games, and collect artifacts and boost your stats to prepare for the next hunt.

2796190.name: Pin To Win
2796190.short_description: "Pin To Win" is a pins-building casual roguelike game that allow player to build different powerful combinations easily. Please configure your pins and collect your figurine.

5159570.name: Wildmane: Blood Bay
5159570.short_description: Your horse lives on your wallpaper. She grazes behind your windows, wanders across every monitor, and comes when you call. Usually. Ignore her long enough and she'll let you know how she feels about it. Pet her, play with her, fence her in. She is not productive and she is not sorry.

3077540.name: Love: Fall in Death
3077540.short_description: An FMV interactive romantic comedy where your choices and timing shape the night. Try to impress Ayşil at the bar and navigate a branching story that can lead to love… or total chaos.

4261080.name: Expedition of the Guild
4261080.short_description: Lead your guild into epic raid battles! Recruit heroes from different classes, build your own team, and challenge powerful bosses with unique mechanics. Unlock talent trees, collect endgame gear, and grow from a small squad into the strongest guild. Relive the golden age of MMORPGs!

5015480.name: Beehive Simulator
5015480.short_description: Build and expand the hive of your dreams in this 3D beekeeping and management game. Raise bees, gather pollen, produce honey, upgrade your equipment, explore new environments, and grow your colony into a thriving beekeeping empire.

5453920.name: Hallow's Eve
5453920.short_description:
Welcome to Hallow's Eve
We follow Stingy Jack, on his adventure to possible redemption. 
Come and follow Jack to see where he will go.

4085920.name: AlterMage
4085920.short_description: Step onto the shores of AlterMage, a first-person action-platformer featuring spellblade focused combat. Embark on a harrowing journey to learn sorcery, explore labyrinthian passages within a forbidden citadel, and uncover the truth of a dark past.

5376560.name: Dragon Kingdom Demo
5376560.short_description: Restore a forgotten farm, raise a Baby Dragon, grow crops, face changing weather, explore the mine, and begin bringing the kingdom back to life in this focused demo of Dragon Kingdom.

2616730.name: goblinAmerica Demo
2616730.short_description: A squirmy, bouncy shooter filled with lovely sights and horrible places. Careen across the planet, blast yourself to new heights, and discover the dark tunnels and deep places of a world beneath our own.

4860690.name: 程序员的刻板印象 Demo
4860690.short_description: For years, society has held many stereotypes about the programming profession. In this life simulation game, players can experience a programmer's journey from university to career development. Whether a programmer's life truly matches public perception can be discovered by trying it out.

5328130.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex Demo

4667350.name: 고요였다(Was Silence) Demo
4667350.short_description: A classical guitarist slowly losing his senses. Drifting between dream and reality, he meets three people — each carrying their own silence. A 2D visual novel about what remains when everything fades away.

3781790.name: Eternal Anima
3781790.short_description: Embark on an adventure across eras in this love letter to JRPGs. Journey between the past and present to uncover the truth behind a lost history. Control your fate in turn-based combat by using Future Sight to foresee enemy actions and strategically rewrite the future.

1024640.name: AppGameKit Studio
1024640.short_description: With AppGameKit Studio we've re-imagined the game development user interface with an all-in-one work space. You can now quickly drag & drop assets to visualise your scenes, code with AppGameKit script, easily browse app media, run live debugging sessions, access online help and lots more!

5333130.name: Trick Nor Treat
5333130.short_description: Enter a first-person horror experience inspired by folklore or legend. Explore haunting environments, investigate strange clues, record discoveries in your journal, and survive supernatural encounters. Learn the stories, follow the evidence, and decide what is hunting you before it's too late.

4899190.name: Lifebearers
4899190.short_description: In a battlefield under heavy fire, your only mission is to save lives! Lifebearers is a 2-player co-op rescue game. Step into the boots of medics with a friend: find wounded soldiers, carry them on a stretcher, and reach the safe zone. Coming out in one piece demands tight coordination!

3466770.name: Rogue Battalion Demo
3466770.short_description: Command your troops in Rogue Battalion, a WW2 auto-battler blending strategy and action! Build your forces, unlock upgrades, and use powerful abilities like airstrikes and artillery to survive relentless waves. With meta progression and endless tactics, every run brings new challenges.

5371880.name: Inn Kreeper Demo
5371880.short_description: Run a spooky-cozy haunted inn as a broke lich, stress out your guests, trap them in rooms to turn them into ghost, and sell them online to rebuild your retro game collection.

3655270.name: Wildseed
3655270.short_description: Wildseed is a relaxing game where you grow plants and build your garden into a haven for cute animals. Keep your animals happy and your plants healthy, find rare variants, and discover the ancient secrets your garden holds - one seed at a time.

4891190.name: The Citadel Must Hold
4891190.short_description: Build and defend your Citadel in a fantasy survival RTS. Explore dangerous lands, conquer Places of Power for strategy-changing rewards, and rally your armies against relentless the Monster Tides. Every choice brings you closer to survival... or the fall of your Citadel.

3477210.name: The Retrospection Of Tomorrow ~Demo~
3477210.short_description: A time-travel romance visual novel where sweet dates quickly turn into a high-stakes mystery...as handsome boys around you start dying right before your eyes! Trapped between dreams and memories, fighting fate itself—can you find a way to save everyone? Dear time traveler, welcome home.

5020730.name: RingOut
5020730.short_description: No health bars. Every shot heats enemies up, raising their temperature in degrees (°). The hotter they are, the farther they fly, so heat them up and launch them off the arena to win. A fast, chaotic online arena shooter: 23 fighters, 13 weapons, 29 arenas, 6 modes. Solo vs bots or online.

5094290.name: Haunted House Hellshift
5094290.short_description: Fight through a haunted house full of monsters and traps while a live TV audience watches. Collect eyeballs to open cursed doors, find the exit, and try to make it out alive—solo or with a friend in local 2-player co-op.

5054980.name: Wuxing Demo
5054980.short_description: Free demo of Wuxing: Elemental Array Poker, a feng-shui roguelike deckbuilder where poker hands are placed onto a 3×3 altar and the Five Elements chain between cells. Play the first two seasons, wake the beasts, and take on the Azure Dragon and the Vermilion Bird.

5360490.name: RUNEBLADE
5360490.short_description: A knight against the endless dark. Three oaths, three lands, ten minutes a run — and a King at the end of each. Your weapons strike on their own: all you choose is where to stand. Fall, and the Sanctum keeps what you carried out.

4638730.name: Pillar Of War
4638730.short_description: Chess-inspired armies. Real-time warfare. Dodge projectiles, unleash Pillar abilities and defeat the enemy king in fast tactical battles. Fight online or conquer single-player challenges. No turns. No waiting.

4644490.name: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands Demo
4644490.short_description: Solve tactile three-dimensional burr puzzles on cozy Puzzle Islands. Twist, pull and dismantle handcrafted puzzles in immersive VR or with mouse & keyboard… alongside one curious little bird friend.

5166900.name: ShardStriders
5166900.short_description: Co-op action roguelike for 1–6 players. The power of a shattered world has chosen you: dive into the Shards and fight through hordes of monsters to the Keepers who will not give up what they hold. Every run remakes you — different skills, different gear, a different you.

4367400.name: Prismarch Demo
4367400.short_description: A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy while you fulfill a chess power fantasy - your pieces gain abilities as you construct a juiced up roster capable of surviving the onslaught! Only - seven mysterious prismatic kings stand before you and the one true crown...

3794790.name: Echoes of Nothing
3794790.short_description: Engage in action packed dogfights, explore the vast ruin of a massive colony ship, find powerful weapons, ships and equipment, and decide the fate of existence itself. Dodge bullets, distract missiles and outmaneuver challenging bosses, then retaliate with lasers and artillery.

5205300.name: The Coast is Clear: Tidy up the Beach!
5205300.short_description: Save the turtles and bring the beach back to life! Summer's over, and the visitors have left a mess. Collect and sort litter, upgrade your tools and restore the coral reef in this relaxing cleanup game, solo or with friends.

4901810.name: ハコアタマ
4901810.short_description: A co-op horror game: take control of a HakoAtama, who stacks cargo atop their head, and carry out package inspection and delivery in a world overrun by creatures.
developers: むつむつプロジェクト
publishers: むつむつプロジェクト

4214100.name: Interlocked: Puzzle Islands
4214100.short_description: Solve tactile three-dimensional burr puzzles on cozy Puzzle Islands. Twist, pull and dismantle handcrafted puzzles in immersive VR or with mouse & keyboard… alongside one curious little bird friend.

4656170.name: Just Dying Demo
4656170.short_description: A Roguelite survivor starring streamers. Rescue your followers to stay off the unemployment line, unlock unique characters, stack powerful runes, and become a wrecking ball of total chaos. Learn. Die. Repeat.

4747010.name: OverlayGG
4747010.short_description: Stuck on a boss, quest or build? Search 100,000+ step-by-step guides for 120+ games in a small see-through overlay that sits right on top of your game. No alt-tabbing, no full-screen browser, no ads.

5295220.name: ORI Voice
5295220.short_description: Windows Real-time Voice Dictation IME: press a hotkey to speak, text appears at cursor. Built-in offline Chinese engine; use your own cloud API key for higher accuracy. Also features AI text correction, voice commands, and end-to-end voice chat.

3808810.name: Prismarch
3808810.short_description:
A colorful chess roguelike! Engage in dopaminergic, cinematic strategy as you fulfill a chess power fantasy - 
your pieces gain abilities, and there's no limit to the size of your roster! Before you stand 7 prismatic kings,
each wielding an element of power. Slay them, and ascend the throne!

4568950.name: Beards vs. Claws Demo
4568950.short_description: Dig tunnels, build bridges, and blast your way through walls towards victory in this highly dynamic arena first-person shooter - every obstacle is a potential door

4230530.name: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver
4230530.short_description: The Legend of the Crystal Revolver is a fast paced rogue-like platformer with an emphasis on fluid movement, satisfying combat, and fearsome challenges. With unique abilities to master, tightly generated levels, and the ever-looming threat of Death, each run has something new to experience.

3686600.name: Vast Sands
3686600.short_description: Fight you way through the mutated wasteland to try to save a crazy scientist. Over run by Mutated Bugs, you must uncover the truth of what happened to a scientist and cure him before it's to late, and uncover a secret organization called the Zip's.

5052560.name: BOLO
5052560.short_description: 1-4 player co-op horror about evacuating survivors from anomaly zones.

4758090.name: Select Eleven
4758090.short_description: A single-player, text-based cricket management game. Scout signings, develop players and pick your eleven. Run one of 160 clubs across seven nations through T20 leagues, 50-over cups, promotion, relegation and global club tournaments.

5472020.name: Wizard Castle
5472020.short_description: A quick castle card battle. Play one card a turn to grow your castle to 100 or tear your rival's down. Beat 10 rivals, collect 110 cards to build your deck, then take it online against friends on PC or phone.

4856890.name: Convoluted
4856890.short_description: Solve the mechanisms of a mysterious machine to find the way to its core. Deduce the patterns needed to connect Glimmer to glyphs in a unique logic puzzle system inspired by mathematical convolution.

5435190.name: GomokuZero
5435190.short_description: A five-in-a-row board game with an engine that explains itself: every move comes with the shape it built, the threat it answered and the alternatives it weighed. Learn from ten lessons and 1,680 proven puzzles, review your games move by move, and play ranked online or entirely offline.

5149330.name: UFO Survival
5149330.short_description: Pilot through relentless waves of hostile forces in this fast-paced space-themed, bullet hell, survival shooter. Build your own UFO in the Ship Creator, Survive through a 100-wave campaign, or test your limits in Endless Mode. How long can you survive?

5346300.name: Cultist: The Ritual
5346300.short_description: Atmospheric first-person horror. You are one of 5 victims in a mansion. A quiet escape from your cell while a soulless cultist hears your every step. Then a deadly chase across three floors: two hunters after you, deadlier each night. 7 nights, 7 attempts before ritual. What ending awaits you?

5268280.name: Horse Race Tests: Life is Pain Demo
5268280.short_description: In Horse Race Tests: Life is Pain, feed into your worst impulses in this action packed high score gambling game. Gain abilities to rig races in your favor! Collect virtual figurines of your favorite horses, like Jovial Merryment...

2567300.name: The Purge Revenant
2567300.short_description: After his wife Cristina vanishes during a mountain climb, Colsen Bright is drawn into a multiverse crisis. To save her, he must cross shattered realities, collect fragments of an ancient sphere, and face psychological horrors and mutant abominations that will change him forever.

3856950.name: Bridgelands
3856950.short_description: Bridgelands is an action roguelite where you embark on expeditions with Flora across mysterious islands. Choose your routes, face dangerous creatures, and combine powerful perks to create a new build with every journey.

5332000.name: The Coast is Clear Demo: Tidy up the Beach!
5332000.short_description: Save the turtles and bring the beach back to life! Summer's over, and the visitors have left a mess. Collect and sort litter, upgrade your tools and restore the coral reef in this relaxing cleanup game, solo or with friends.

5361860.name: OrcWay Hogacy
5361860.short_description: Defend your home against waves of zombies, solo or in co-op with up to 4 players. Play as a battle-ready pig: build turrets, shoot, chop, and rev your chainsaw. Collect loot, combine artifacts, and upgrade your skills—just keep the house standing!

5491080.name: Touhou Kourindou: Appraisal Records
5491080.short_description: Run Kourindou, Gensokyo's odd little curio shop. Dig up strange things from the Outside World, work out what they do, and sell them to Marisa, Reimu and the girls of Gensokyo, all while a scarlet mist creeps over the sky. A cozy Touhou Project fan game of appraisal puzzles and haggling.

5254220.name: Pawtings! Hidden Dogs
5254220.short_description: Find hidden dogs in real museum paintings. Explore dozens of artworks, spot the hand-drawn dogs hiding in the details, and watch the color come back into each canvas. Play solo or hunt with up to three friends in a split screen or online. Enjoy a relaxing hidden-object game set to classical music.

4911930.name: The Hungering Lake
4911930.short_description: A village is starving and the lake is taking its children. Fish to keep them alive, but every catch angers what lives beneath the surface. A top-down Finnish folklore horror game about hunger, debt and a name hidden in the logs of the lost.

3414550.name: Fling your Friends TD - Tower Defense
3414550.short_description: Gather your friends, unleash your creativity, and dive into the silly world of Fling your Friends TD, a laughter-filled adventure where strategy meets fun!

4227560.name: Legends of Rock
4227560.short_description: Start as a broke musician. Build your rock band, master songwriting, rehearsals, and gigs, and juggle a day job to pay the bills. Shop for records, instruments, and groceries, recruit bandmates, and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.

5198110.name: Nectarbound
5198110.short_description: A short, active incremental game about being a bee. Collect nectar, earn money, buy upgrades, and squeeze as much as you can out of every run. Day brings flowers. Night brings trouble.

5391770.name: Autonomous System Zero
5391770.short_description: No classes. No pay-to-win. Just you, a terminal, and an internet full of other players. Infiltrate their networks, build your own, and form a collective, knowing any ally could be the leak. A persistent cyberwar strategy game where trust is a mechanic and every server ends in Netfall.

5055850.name: Hearty Haven: Amalgamated
5055850.short_description: Hearty Henrys back and he's stronger than ever along with his pals Moody Moo and Silly Sam! An upgraded magnet watch and so much more! Fight your way down to the depths of this facility while trying to keep your body in one piece

5307510.name: Gravity Chain
5307510.short_description: One impulse. One journey. Leap from planet to planet, chain PERFECTs and trigger Hyperdrive in this space arcade game. Push your personal best in Solo or race another pilot in online Duel Rush, then make your comet your own.

5384900.name: A Cruise for Murder
5384900.short_description: A 3D modern remake of the classic Cruise for a Corpse, along with original music, different plot and 15 puzzles.

4612860.name: Delivery Control
4612860.short_description: You are the night shift supervisor at the warehouse of the postal company. You need to make sure that there is nothing prohibited in the package, but are all parcels worth checking?

5186040.name: Starstack
5186040.short_description: Build an automated planetary factory, design modular warships, then risk them in tactical space expeditions for rare technology and resources. Push deeper for greater rewards—or return home alive and expand your factory. The factory powers the ship; the ship unlocks the factory.

4829570.name: GlowFall
4829570.short_description: GlowFall is a sci-fantasy survival game where light is scarce. You must explore the bioluminescent environment to harvest flora, mine ores, catch aquatic creatures, interact with land creatures, and defeat abyssal entities. Resources gathered along the way can be used to craft helpful items.

2156500.name: Abbey Chronicle: Desktop Cloister
2156500.short_description:
Your daily life is your faith and your abbey. 
Abbey Chronicle: Desktop Cloister is a peaceful idle game that rests at the bottom of your screen. Decorate its rooms, revive its grounds, expand industries, welcome pilgrims — and write your own abbey chronicle while you work, study, or browse.

5053190.name: Warpscape
5053190.short_description: Warpscape is a sci-fi MMORPG set in a vast open universe. Pilot your own starship, explore the galaxy, upgrade your ship, collect rare modules, battle powerful enemies, and join forces with other players.

2131290.name: Iron Frontier
2131290.short_description: A hardcore roguelike strategy game where every battle feels different. Assemble unique armies, research new technologies, and discover deadly synergies. Command your troops to maximize damage. Face moral choices that will determine the fate of mankind.

5332060.name: It'll Hold
5332060.short_description: Play poker hands to build a tower of cards, one floor at a time. Each hand lays a floor piece on the plot. Stack matching suits straight up to grow your multiplier, beat every floor's target and hire a crew on your coffee break. Miss a target and the lot comes down.

5081890.name: Untitled Shop Game Demo
5081890.short_description: The demo version contains 16 missions, two songs per playlist, a limited amount of goods and decorations, 12 NPCs, and the area for decoration is limited.

3803120.name: DWARRF: A Pinball Roguelike Demo
3803120.short_description: Grab your balls and set sail on your 'pirate' minecart into the depths of the mines. Fight enemies in a unique blend of Pinball, Pachinko, and Bubble Shooter whilst collecting game altering balls & relics that ensure no two runs are alike.

3422100.name: Neon Hyperdrive
3422100.short_description: Neon Hyperdrive is a rhythm racer like you've never seen before: drift corners, surf waves, and fly through neon skies to the rhythm of the music. Multiple vehicles, shifting perspectives, and jaw-dropping visuals. Ready to chase the beat?

5377440.name: Fly With Me
5377440.short_description: This is a realistic space flying simulator where you and up to 30 online player fly around the solar system

4280840.name: Roller Coaster Park Simulator
4280840.short_description: Build and run your very own Roller Coaster Park! Play alone or with up to 8 friends in online co-op. Design your own coasters, hire staff and serve your guests... or just mess around. There’s plenty to break, crash and blow up!

4126730.name: Talescape: Write. Branch. Play.
4126730.short_description: Play well-crafted interactive stories shaped by mood and choice, or create your own branching story without coding.

5439740.name: Framed Demo
5439740.short_description: The Framed demo: the campaign's prologue and the endless Farm defense mode. The Hautakorpit gang frames the Salmela brothers for murder, and six years later it's time for revenge. Split screen, online or solo.

5397330.name: Fine Dining Fraud
5397330.short_description: A chaotic co-op cooking game for 1-4 players. Run a fake fine dining restaurant you bought with mafia money: cook badly, serve picky guests, lie your way out of complaints, put out fires and survive the health inspector, all while the Don comes to collect.

5175840.name: The Extractors
5175840.short_description: A co-op horror experience where you and your team explore dangerous environments, collect valuable items, and fight to survive. Work together, take risks, and make it back before it’s too late.

5465770.name: StillGlyph
5465770.short_description: StillGlyph writes title, description and keyword metadata into your images using local models on your graphics card, or through an online provider using your own API key. A clean interface and solid reliability make it an excellent choice for photo enthusiasts and for handling big image libraries.

5433020.name: Hide IN SPACE
5433020.short_description: Join up to 100 other online players to play a game of hide and seek on mars. You get to choose to either be a seeker or a hider. Hiders may hide anywhere across a 1 for 1 scale mars planet.

4480460.name: Renegade Brigade
4480460.short_description: Dive into a vibrant, comic book style heist FPS where the stakes are high and the humor is higher. Answer urgent calls from your mysterious handler to receive stage-by-stage missions, then unleash chaos in a wild, comedy-filled world.

5006540.name: Dead Extraction
5006540.short_description: Explore zombie-infested Tokyo, scavenge resources, and make it out alive. Expand your shelter, manage survivors, and face dynamic threats and deadly bosses in a top-down extraction survival roguelite.

3338980.name: Ichor Online
3338980.short_description: Ichor Online is an Action MMORPG inspired by the classics. Explore a hand-crafted open world, master dynamic combat, craft and trade with other players, and build a character that’s truly your own. No quest markers, no hidden subscription fees, and no pay-to-win.

3760980.name: DeckTerra
3760980.short_description: DeckTerra is a 4X strategy game built around cards. Explore procedurally generated maps, research new technologies, develop your settlements, and raise armies all while building a deck that complements your strategy.

3362010.name: Super Drift Blade Demo
3362010.short_description: Most of your actions have been taken away. In each time loop, slide the mouse to kill monsters, crack the puzzles locked by knowledge, and explore the hidden paths! Go deeper in a limited time and discover the truth of the world.

5362320.name: 涂鸦学院 Demo
5362320.short_description: Doodle Academy is a hand-drawn strategy card auto-battler. Recruit character cards, build powerful teams, combine faction and ability synergies, and upgrade your units through three tiers. Experience the first 10 in-game days of academy adventures and strategic battles in this free demo.

5375590.name: Monsters, Inn Order!
5375590.short_description: Check in for cute monsters and deliciously tangled logic puzzles. Arrange a line of peculiar guests, connect their clues, and chase that glorious “aha!” across 100+ puzzles. Make unlikely friends, uncover a little mystery, and find a place for everyone.

4827180.name: onRails Demo
4827180.short_description: Try onRails. Run it on-track. SimReader connects to your sim automatically, the overlay runs on top without alt-tabbing, and both work in full. Limited access to both setup modules included.

5467110.name: CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard - Supporter Pack
5467110.short_description: Supporter Pack: the Gold camo for every weapon in your armory. It does not shoot harder, reload faster or keep you alive. It is gold. Your purchase funds the development of CastleGuard: Operation Graveyard.

5425300.name: Warstead Demo
5425300.short_description: Try WARSTEAD in this early singleplayer demo: build a medieval settlement, manage production chains and care for your citizens. Play up to 45 active minutes per campaign, with saving and loading. Multiplayer is not available in the demo.

5447360.name: THE MODEL WAR
5447360.short_description: Build models. Control compute. Survive the arms race. Take a garage AI startup global in this satirical tycoon: train and release models, juggle GPUs, talent and data, and fight rival labs for the world market.

4002950.name: Vor'Taar: Invasion
4002950.short_description: Tactics meets rogue-lite meets space: Vor’Taar: Invasion is a rogue-lite tower defense game set on fully 3D orbital battlefields. Defend orbital bases, command a battleship, use powerful abilities, gather resources, face growing waves of invaders and grow stronger with every attempt.

4965690.name: NO WAY DERBY
4965690.short_description: Horse racing with real race physics and runners that make no sense: cardboard horses, rocking horses on wheels, camels. A virtual crowd sets the odds and often gets them wrong. Read the paddock, place your bets, watch the 3D broadcast. Play money only.

5269270.name: RUNGEON: Auto Roguelike
5269270.short_description: Fight through 100 dungeon rooms in this roguelite RPG with automatic turn-based combat. Choose upgrades after every victory, build your hero, defeat powerful bosses, and see how far you can survive.

2960950.name: Choose Cthulhu Files: The Call of Cthulhu
2960950.short_description: What if the choices you make during your investigation awaken ancient beings older than existence itself. Explore the official Choose Cthulhu gamebook adaptation, every decision you take seals the fate of mankind. Will the creeping madness consume you as you uncover the darkest secrets?

4192370.name: Droste Detective
4192370.short_description: A recursive anomaly and psychological horror where you wake up stuck in an office corridor and find out there is a framed photo of the corridor on the wall. There is something very strange about this picture...

5013510.name: Console Dealer
5013510.short_description: Run a second-hand games shop in 2003. Buy dead people's boxes at auction, haggle at the counter, price a shelf the street can afford, and find out what every cartridge was worth to someone. A slow, honest shop sim about margins, people and rent.

5166370.name: Islandry
5166370.short_description: Turn a wild island into a thriving, self-running production network. Gather resources, build farms and machines, automate with drones and conveyor belts, process goods, manage interconnected production, earn profits from trading, and ship your products across the sea in this cozy automation game.

4546340.name: One More Adventure
4546340.short_description: One More Adventure is a hexcrawl roguelike inspired by Nethack and Castle of the Winds.  It is part of the Old School Renaissance (OSR), and has heavy influences from TTRPGs from the 1970s and 1980s.  Each world map and dungeon is new, allowing for a high amount of replayability.

5022830.name: Flight Date Demo
5022830.short_description: Getting everyone in the same place should be easy… right? Flight Date is a logic puzzle that turns seemingly simple meetups into absurdly complicated travel plans. Untangle the logistical chaos, find the right routes, and share in the little moments each meetup leaves behind.

5239420.name: Tater Tube Player
5239420.short_description: Bring your self-hosted Tater Tube Server to Steam and Steam Deck with an artwork-first, controller-friendly player for your library, live channels, resume playback, and Tater Picks.

4862380.name: ServerSync
4862380.short_description: Self host a dedicated server in minutes with no port forwarding or technical setup. Start a fresh save or convert your existing local save. Seamlessly transfer servers between friends to co-host with the same public address, keeping your progress moving forward.

5217700.name: ALL GAS Demo
5217700.short_description: ALL GAS is an endless traffic-weaving roguelike experience on a highway that crumbles behind you as you drive.  Upgrade your vehicle and modify your environment in real-time as you weave through traffic.  Find your line, stay in the flow, and earn your spot on the global leaderboards.

4293800.name: For Good Measure
4293800.short_description: Two measuring tapes stuck together... Why? No time to explain, you have puzzles to solve! Don't let the simple two-button movement controls fool you into thinking it'll be easy. Tackle the puzzles alone or team up with a friend in online or local co-op.

4711120.name: BodyWalk VR Motion Mapper
4711120.short_description: Transform your body into a virtual controller. BodyWalk VR Motion Mapper translates your physical leg movements into standard XInput or WASD inputs. Experience plug-and-play VR locomotion in your favorite games—if a game supports joystick or keyboard movement, you can play it with your body.

2579040.name: Inpulse Demo
2579040.short_description: A precision platformer where you rocket-jump with music notes to move. 100+ demo levels, a level editor, slow motion, and savetates all included. Designed by members of the Kaizo community and built to teach you to win: Master all 7 note types to be come a kaizo master.

5350110.name: Ruler of Empires Demo
5350110.short_description: Experience the official strategy demo! Lead Germany through critical turning points in Campaign Mode, or dominate the map with 15+ playable nations in Conquest Mode. Dive into deep tech trees, resource management, and tactical warfare.

5198470.name: ChronoGallery
5198470.short_description: A desktop aesthetics app blending clock, calendar and photo album. Multiple clock face designs with live decorations like rain, galaxy and snow flowing with time, album views for browsing photos and videos, and one-click light & dark theme switching.

5436270.name: Something Outside Wants You to Die
5436270.short_description: Survive a paranormal home invasion caused by a case of mistaken identity.  Attempt to prove you're not who it seeks as your house degrades and becomes more difficult to navigate.  Something's Outside, but it's only a matter of time until it gets in.

5121070.name: Circle to another motion
5121070.short_description:
Your physical intuition will be put to the test.
Connect the disc to objects using links and alter its circular motion to guide the target into the box.

5494450.name: Lets Bail
5494450.short_description: A relaxing first-person cleanup game, one bucket at a time. Scoop, carry and pour your way through flooded locations, upgrade your bucket, enlist a helpful drone and return each location to their former glory, with floating ducks for company.

5230310.name: Cradle of Ash
5230310.short_description: Co-op survival horror for one to four players, or solo with companions at your side. In Ashbrook the dead get back up unless what is left of them burns. Ration the fuel. Leave no corpse whole. Then open Bloodthirsty Demon Baby Mode, and up to eight friends join as the litter to hunt you.

5444140.name: 浮空秘境：LoFi Demo
5444140.short_description: Build your own peaceful little world! Floating Realm: LoFi wraps your floating sanctuary in gentle LoFi melodies, letting you freely craft your aerial scenes. Adorable pets stay by your side, with quick notes, to-do lists and Pomodoro focus timer. Settle into quiet, solo immersion for deep focus.

5348340.name: Rip It! Card Collector Demo
5348340.short_description: A single-player incremental game where you hunt down 1,809 collectible trading cards. Sell dupes and upgrade your retro-futuristic gear to pull more cards, quicker! Enjoy the satisfaction of ripping packs, filling your binder, and completing the ultimate card collection. It’s time to get cracking!

5386220.name: Trigger Tails
5386220.short_description: One gun from another world changed everything. The wizard became the Demon King, and his dungeon filled with armed monsters. Now four animals give chase. Play solo or in 4-player online co-op. Pick a new path each run, grab powerful weapons and hunt the Demon King deep in the dungeon!

5144200.name: Hurl
5144200.short_description:
HURL is a multiplayer platform game where you battle your friends in a gutty arena.

The winner transforms into a massive worm, and eats away the terrain to create the next map.

5172140.name: MOLTYN Demo
5172140.short_description: Melt a city into the sea. The free demo for MOLTYN: a volcanic island, seven powers of the earth and five story missions, including a kaiju siege and a fight with your own shadow. Every pixel is live matter that runs, cracks and falls. The island sandbox has no timer and no fail state.

4737630.name: Siege Masters
4737630.short_description: Build. Summon. Dominate. In Siege Masters, defense is only half the battle. Facing off against three rivals, you must balance fortifying your base with assaulting enemy lines. Every wall you place shapes the fate of the monsters, and every monster you send out determines your fate.

4410770.name: WOODROT Demo
4410770.short_description: Explore an existential dream in this surreal adventure. As Oswald, wander through burning suburbs and hanging sidewalks to  help piece together the fragments of shattered memories.

4591160.name: Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm Demo
4591160.short_description: This is the demo for Bifröst: Prelude to the Storm. Experience the first 4 chapters of an upcoming dystopian fantasy BL visual novel.

4638510.name: CH13: Rest Stop Demo
4638510.short_description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

4131220.name: AKIBA LOST
4131220.short_description: Thirteen years ago, six girls vanished in Akihabara in the unsolved case “The Akiba Vanishing”. Daiki Shinjo announces a live-action game based on the incident, gathering six women who embody Akihabara’s subculture. But their story begins to seep into reality. Can AKIBA LOST be finished?

4029780.name: Fractured Blooms Demo
4029780.short_description: Cozy life-sim in a horror time-loop. Plates of food. Plates of tomatoes. Plates of pain. Plates of angels. Plates of her legs...

3740330.name: Processor Dev Tycoon Demo
3740330.short_description: Build your own processor empire! Design custom chips, compete with rivals, and dominate the tech industry!

3400060.name: Medieval StartUp Demo
3400060.short_description: Medieval StartUp is a unique mix of tavern management, crafting, and exploration set in a rich medieval world. Manage your tavern, craft unique items, recruit staff, and explore a mysterious marsh full of hidden secrets and rare resources.

3275670.name: Food Truck Empire Demo
3275670.short_description: Order up! Food Truck Empire is a management game where you build your own food truck business. Unlock new recipes, automate production, customize your trucks and compete against rival businesses. The world of flavor is yours to conquer!

2622430.name: DayZ Soundtrack
2622430.short_description: Dive into the eerie world of DayZ with its official soundtrack by Czech composer Dikolson. Available on Steam, it features 10 original tracks, designed to enhance the DayZ experience.

2200970.name: PAYDAY 2: McShay Weapon Pack 3
2200970.short_description: McShay Weapon Pack 3 is available on its own or as part of the Hostile Takeover Bundle.

2218650.name: PAYDAY 2: McShay Mod Pack
2218650.short_description: McShay Mod Pack is available on its own or as part of the Hostile Takeover Bundle.

2266940.name: PngTuber Maker
2266940.short_description: PngTuber Maker is a free pngtuber software that can help everyone become pngtuber with few easy steps. Make your own pngtuber avatar with just 2 images and use it in livestream, recording or anywhere you like.

1420930.name: Movavi Slideshow Maker 8
1420930.short_description: Turn your favorite photos and videos into a captivating slideshow. Add music, special effects, transitions, and stickers, then upload the results to YouTube right from within the program. Creating and sharing videos with Movavi is as easy as 1-2-3!

1008400.name: SEPTEMBER 1999 - Keep the game in your library
1008400.short_description: This DLC adds absolutely nothing to the game. This DLC is meant as a way to keep this game in your Steam library and support the developer.

1087450.name: NTBSS: Master Character Training Pack - Kakashi Hatake (Double Sharingan)
1087450.short_description:
A special training pack for your avatar!

Featured in this "Master Character Training Pack" is the one-and-only Kakashi Hatake (Double Sharingan)!

1087451.name: NTBSS: Master Character Training Pack - Neji Hyuga
1087451.short_description:
A special training pack for your avatar!

Featured in this "Master Character Training Pack" is the one-and-only Neji Hyuga!

1105890.name: Tilesetter
1105890.short_description: Tileset generator & map editor tool - Create your whole tileset instantly.

5422490.name: Your Presence Is Delaying Progress Playtest

935510.name: OMSI 2 Add-On Köln
935510.short_description: As the biggest city in North Rhine-Westphalia, Cologne has an extensive public transit network. The city railway and bus lines are being operated by the Kölner Verkehrsbetriebe AG (KVB).

362270.name: Mortal Kombat: Legacy II: Liu Kang and Kung Lao
362270.short_description: In the present, Stryker treats Johnny Cage's wounds when Liu Kang comes upon them and fights them both. Kung Lao appears, shocked that his old friend is here.

396960.name: Gaokao.Love.100Days - Yes Monitress
396960.short_description: New Story Lines, 61 endings and lots of new CG, all provided in this DLC. And it's FREE, just download and enjoy! :)

5326850.name: Music Empire Tycoon
5326850.short_description: Build your own record label from the ground up, release music, grow your reputation, expand into global markets, and turn a small music business into a worldwide empire. Manage your catalog, discover opportunities, and make the decisions that shape your success.

5092480.name: Goats and Shrubs: Desktop Topiary
5092480.short_description: In this desktop idle game, watch your goats graze on wayward shrubs as you build and personalise your own desktop topiary. Your trusty goats collect leaves for you to spend on upgrades, decorations and new ways to customise your goats and topiary.

29640.name: Aion
29640.short_description:
"It is fantastically gorgeous, with thousands of little details to gorge on."
- , June 2009

"The screenshots don't do this world justice at all. It's true epic fantasy."
- Examiner, June 2009

"The world of Aion is high fantasy at its finest."
- , August 2008!

41019.name: Serious Sam HD: The Second Encounter - Legend of the Beast DLC

4072810.name: No Serial
4072810.short_description: Run an underground weapons workshop. Craft weapons, take risky orders, sell to clients, upgrade your setup, and try not to get caught as the business gets bigger.

5393550.name: Backroom : First Signal
5393550.short_description: Co-op horror in the Backrooms, for 2 to 6 players or alone. Damp yellow halls, buzzing lights, an air filter running out. Mark the walls, stay together, keep talking. But not every voice you hear belongs to a friend, and what you stare at may already be behind you.

3416290.name: A.L.A.R.M. - Autistic Lovely Assassins Rise of the Matriarchy
3416290.short_description:
Take Yachimu Back!

Awaken as Nyx Draven in a fractured world ruled by Olivia's corruption. Fight escalating enemy camps, rescue allies, push back the Mist, and reclaim lost territory. Master Shinobi combat, terraform the land, ride your Hoverboard, and dance your enemies to death!

5180210.name: Ministry of Time
5180210.short_description: A time-traveling customs officer has one job: inspect every traveler, verify their documents, and keep the timeline intact. Spot anomalies, catch timeline violations, and decide who gets through before history falls apart.

4265300.name: Cash the Corpse
4265300.short_description: A co-op 1-4 player tower defense game where you and your crew sneak into zombie-infested zones at night, harvest valuable organs, and sell them on the black market, before the bodies rot and everything goes wrong.

4796380.name: Princess and Conquest - Queen Of Clubs Demo
4796380.short_description: Princess & Conquest: Queen of Clubs is a tavern manager/simulator, with multiple minigames, and many narrative elements! Animated 2D portraits and illustrated backgrounds, mixed to create a colorful world filled with cute and sexy characters, as always in the Princess & Conquest's Kingdom!

4577050.name: ARCASCIAN
4577050.short_description: ARCASCIAN is a minimalist ASCII-rendered fantasy FPS built around fast runs, procedural dungeons, and relentless combat.

5446380.name: Vroom Boom
5446380.short_description: Arcade car combat. Pick your armed car and battle 8 to 12 bot cars until one is left running. Boost, jump and double jump through six arenas, survive waves with a boss every five, or settle it with a friend in split-screen.

1833210.name: Astromine
1833210.short_description: Astromine is a survival mining game about scavenging fully destructible planets. Designed for 1 to 4 players. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, fight robot factions, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

5242530.name: Scottside - Supporter Pack
5242530.short_description: Support the development of Scottside and get exclusive cosmetic content.

5372700.name: Not Another Garbage Simulator
5372700.short_description: A whole city is buried under 118,000 pieces of rubbish. Clear it by hand, then buy the truck, then the roll-off, then the plant. Sort it properly for full pay. Nothing you clean ever comes back — the city stays clean, street by street, until it's yours again.

5486500.name: GraviSmack
5486500.short_description: Bend gravity, skate across impossible surfaces, and smash through swarms in GraviSmack, a movement-driven action roguelite. Build a wild mix of weapons and boons, unlock new characters, and fight solo or with friends.

4863300.name: SLICEFALL
4863300.short_description: A reflex-puzzle game about stacking narrowing blocks until one falls down. Precision timing keeps your blocks wide, while filling rows clears space and boosts your score. Adapt your strategy across various game modes while utilizing power-ups and changing up color palettes.

5474760.name: Debt Clicker
5474760.short_description: A satirical clicker where the goal isn't to get rich: it's to owe as much as possible. Click your credit card, spend what you borrow, sign every loan, and climb from a broke apartment to a mortgage on the Sun and a loan against Reality itself.

4421440.name: Pierrot
4421440.short_description: Pierrot is a first-person psychological horror set in a twisted theater where a small puppet is trapped in its grasp. Violence is routine and you exist only to obey. Forced to harm others Pierrot dreams of tearing his strings. Even as the curtain falls his role never ends.

3091410.name: SCP: Run For Freedom
3091410.short_description: SCP: Run For Freedom is a game based on the SCP Foundation, where you can escape as a D-Class, join Chaos, or contain anomalies as part of the special forces. With PvP, Co-Op and singleplayer.

5462650.name: Rubblebound Demo
5462650.short_description: Rubblebound is a minimalist idle game with roguelite elements. Unleash the balls, build skills, break bricks, upgrade, repeat. And see your power grows in this incremental game.

5489440.name: A Week Before Autumn Demo
5489440.short_description: Pine Hill is a quiet Midwestern college town. Quiet enough that nobody seemed to hear Ginny Nicholson die. Alone with the thoughts in your head, now you just want to know one thing: why?

5467340.name: Fishing and Alchemy
5467340.short_description: Celebrate Soulbind's second anniversary with free DLC! Fish lost body parts from the River of Death, stitch stronger parts together through alchemy, or cook your trophies into meals that grant temporary buffs. Even death brings new opportunities!

5194660.name: Caesar: The Gallic Campaign
5194660.short_description: 58 BC. You are a nameless ranker of Rome's Tenth Legion, crossing eight years of Caesar's Gallic campaign at spear height. No turns: one click is your movement and your strike. Build out of affixes and runes, hunt the titled elites, and see eight chapters through to the epilogue.

4972050.name: Resettle
4972050.short_description: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

5177680.name: Blindfold Bash
5177680.short_description: Don't make a sound! Blindfold Bash is a hide-and-seek party game where the seeker is blindfolded and hunts by ear. Every creaky floorboard, squeaky toy and badly timed fart lights up their screen. Stay quiet, throw decoys and push a friend into harm's way to survive. Public matches, 2-20 players.

3737780.name: TAC: Arcane Titans
3737780.short_description: Take control of the Elder Primordials, cast all the colors of mana you want...just don't go crazy doing it in this Card game of insanity

4433490.name: Hell's Bells Demo
4433490.short_description: In a cathedral beneath Hell, three dominant Sisters await your submission. Choose your path, endure sacred punishment, and unlock forbidden scenes in this dark, stylized visual novel. Obedience isn’t asked for... it’s taken.

1339980.name: Welcome to High School Life of Hell
1339980.short_description: A first-person horror visual novel with point-and-click investigation. Six people are dead and you were there. Search rooms, solve puzzles that never give the answer away, and make the choices that decide whether you walk free or face execution.

5386500.name: Cursor's Tale
5386500.short_description: An incremental game where your cursor becomes a hero. You battle monsters and collect their loot. Upgrade your skill tree, from basic upgrades to game-changing abilities. Craft gear from monster materials you collected to go even further beyond. Get back before night falls.

4236650.name: 不良婚姻惩罚师
4236650.short_description:
"Adultery Marriage Punisher" 
Curing marriage pests!
Investigate. Infiltrate. Snap. Spy. Steal. Outwit.
What is your spouse doing behind your back?
Your evidence, the deadliest sanction.
Now, become the shadow of justice, and unveil every betrayal and infidelity!

4856440.name: RPG MAKER U2U
4856440.short_description: RPG MAKER U2U is the latest entry in the RPG Maker series of easy to use game development tools. With the addition of the new P2D system for adding depth and new light & shadow effects, create world of rich detail and immersion like never before!

3885340.name: AIRI
3885340.short_description: Project AIRI is an open-source desktop AI companion. Import VRM or Live2D characters, chat by text and voice, explore screen-aware interactions, and try experimental Minecraft and Factorio integrations. Cloud AI features require an internet connection and a free AIRI account.

5302550.name: DEADWICK
5302550.short_description: The house should be empty, yet a light is burning inside. Shoot down the dead closing in, rescue the people who were taken, and destroy the source of it all. A first-person horror rail shooter that drives you through the house. Also supports 2-player online co-op.

4572930.name: Just More Doors
4572930.short_description: OPEN THE DOOR TO WIN! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

4919460.name: THE UNREMEMBERED
4919460.short_description: The noon bell hasn't rung. The king died without an heir. You're a wandering sellsword. Swipe left or right through a dark fantasy roguelite. Take a house's coin, buy a tavern rumor, or nurse an old wound for a day. Your choices shape the events and endings ahead.

5319550.name: 文字刷宝录 Text Loot Codex
5319550.short_description: 《Text Loot Codex》 is a loot-driven action RPG where the battlefield is built from text. Position, dodge, and cast abilities, then collect loot to forge a build that’s uniquely yours. You might just be the next Chaos Overlord!

5226290.name: Zenden
5226290.short_description: Zenden is a relaxing puzzle game where you decorate a beautiful Zen garden in every level. Place plants, statues, paths, bridges, lanterns, and many more hand drawn pixel art items for a calming, meditative experience with instrumental music tracks.

5418730.name: Isle of Fools
5418730.short_description: Awoken in uncharted lands and cut off from civilization, alone or with friends search the unknown for a way out. Scavenge for food and set up your tents for the night, your going to be here for a while. But be careful - You're not the only one hunting for food on the island.

5343240.name: Explosive Express Demo
5343240.short_description: Explosive Express is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

5414920.name: Sort of the Apocalypse
5414920.short_description: The world ended. The mess didn’t. Sort over 10,000 scavenged supplies in a cozy first-person organizing game. Transform a cluttered bunker into satisfyingly stocked shelves, earn credits, and unlock upgrades to tackle the mountain of mess.

1594190.name: Mini Meowcraft
1594190.short_description: Mini Meowcraft is a single-player action rpg with familiar mechanics. Join “the Pawlliance” or “the Hiss” and level up your character in bite-sized open world full of quests and hidden secrets.

5355280.name: Only Luck
5355280.short_description: Five sixes is a 1 in 7776 roll. How about 1 in 10? Only Luck is a pixel-art dice clicker: click to charge your throw, toss up to 9 dice, collect 1100 rare combinations and earn prestige chips. Upgrade your table, spin the Wheel of Luck and bend the rules until the impossible roll becomes routine.

4361190.name: SLIME WATCH
4361190.short_description: Bring your desktop and windows into SteamVR and control everything from a watch on your wrist: time, batteries, music, overlays, Space Drag and a VR keyboard. Fully rewritten, smoother than ever.

4891550.name: Fat Chance
4891550.short_description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

2253280.name: Into The Garden
2253280.short_description: Awaken as a stitched cat doll in an eerie manor trapped in a supernatural limbo where time flows backward. Hunted by a blind toymaker, you must use mirror portals, enter painted pocket worlds, and transfer your soul between abandoned toys to survive.

5372430.name: Neuroflip
5372430.short_description: A card-based memory roguelike. Flip cards, remember where each face appeared and match pairs to defeat the Scribe, the Lady and the King. Missing on a new card is free; forgetting a pair you've already seen can cost you dearly.

5426060.name: Quiet Evening: Mosquito Simulator
5426060.short_description: You are a mosquito. Buzz in their ears, bite where they can't reach, and turn their cat, their gadgets and their own fly swatter against them. A comic third-person stealth-flight game: nine chapters, three days and one small, very loud flat.

4832370.name: Rogoz Fishing
4832370.short_description: A meditative fishing sim with deeply detailed fish behavior and habitats. Pick your spot on the depth map, set several rods with different baits, read the bites by the ringing of the bells and land your trophies — in the warm stillness of dawn or under a bright moon.

4988500.name: 5th Frontier, The New Space Race
4988500.short_description:
A 4x Turn-Based Single Player Strategic Space game.

Design and build Your own space ships, planet and battle-stations to conquer the Galaxy.

4125580.name: When Civilians Dig Holes
4125580.short_description: An idle game about digging a hole to the other side of the world.

4817150.name: Christmas CEO
4817150.short_description: Run Santa's Workshop in this cozy management sim. Assign workers, manage resources, survive crisis events, and make enough toys before Christmas.

2932650.name: CrossPieces Arena
2932650.short_description: Build your own deck from chess, shogi, and other pieces. Combine varied abilities and capture the enemy Royal in turn-based online battles. Play across multiple boards, with CPU battles and local two-player battles on the same PC also available.

5331090.name: CozyDuck Idle
5331090.short_description: A cozy idle farm that lives in a small window on your screen. Duck workers harvest, haul and sell your crops while you work or play. Grow the farm, open the Duck Pond, earn Heirloom Seeds and dress your ducks in hats and bows.

4237100.name: Acorn Eater
