4237100.short_description: Acorn Eater is an arcade platformer game inspired by electronic games from the 80's. Your objective as a squirrel is to eat as many acorns as possible to get highest score, while preventing the tree to fall apart. Survive. Climb. Eat. Repeat.

5409700.name: Turbo Drag Racer 3000 Demo
5409700.short_description: Turbo Drag Racer 3000 is a fast-paced retro drag racer with roguelite drafting. Rev your engine, time your shifts, flip on the nitrous, and survive a tournament bracket by drafting race-changing performance perks between heats. Just don't blow your engine.

5216730.name: Turbo Drag Racer 3000
5216730.short_description: Turbo Drag Racer 3000 is a fast-paced retro drag racer with roguelite drafting. Rev your engine, time your shifts, flip on the nitrous, and survive a tournament bracket by drafting race-changing performance perks between heats. Just don't blow your engine.

5345680.name: Gold Fever: Wild West
5345680.short_description: Establish a settlement in the heart of the Gold Rush. Explore the frontier, gather resources, manage your miners and transporters, and compete with bandits for control of valuable gold deposits in this Wild West strategy game.

3555790.name: Dice Tiny Town
3555790.short_description: A cozy dice town builder with a brainy tetromino twist. Three dice decide the shape, building, and nature you fit into your little sketchbook town — the warm yet brain-teasing joy of tetromino placement. Use stars to fine-tune the dice, and satisfy the fussy visitors and animals in town.

3601830.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
3601830.short_description: Silberheim is a tactical collectible card game where card packs are earned, never sold. Build your collection, discover what your cards become as they evolve through play, and explore an ever-changing world through PvP battles, PvE adventures, and community events.

4612060.name: Sex Idler
4612060.short_description: Build a pleasure empire in Sin City! Hire hot beauties, pump up your business together with your entourage, and generate income. The further your relationship goes, the hotter the passion gets. The city has been waiting for you! ❤️‍🔥

5185890.name: Zombies Aren't Real
5185890.short_description: Zombies aren't Real is a horde-defense, strategy game where you deploy military forces in an attempt to quell a quick-spreading zombie infection and save as many civilians as you can!

5315250.name: 不吃鱼 DonEatFish - 月桂仙裳
5315250.short_description: Light up your desktop with an osmanthus-themed set: exclusive Osmanthus Moon Dress look, matching background, plant, and fish basket. Unlock in the Paid Warehouse after purchase and equip anytime.

5409780.name: 4th Supplementary
5409780.short_description: You are trapped in an endless, haunted school loop. Evade the lingering spirit, seal the anomalies, and find a way out before it's too late.

5486010.name: 怪物们的孩子
5486010.short_description: A Gothic grotesque fairytale management and raising sim where you raise the only human daughter in a world full of monsters and help her find a future of her own.

5328070.name: Beat A Boo! Demo
5328070.short_description: Beat A Boo is an online co-op game for up to 4 players, blending roguelike and horror with music. Run from vile creatures, destroy cursed artifacts, capture ghosts, and do the Devil’s bidding.

5190390.name: YULE DADS
5190390.short_description: Yule Dads is a chaotic multiplayer Christmas party game. Gather your friends and trick, grind, and race through the mall to win the last presents before closing time.

5276630.name: 我是城主 / Prefect of the Ancient City
5276630.short_description: Prefect of the Ancient City: an ancient-China idle city-builder. You grow a humble village into a thriving metropolis—plan markets, trade, recruit talents, raise a family, train an army. Balance prosperity with contentment; let it run offline as you build your golden age.

5409010.name: Windowsill Wizard
5409010.short_description: pell is a tiny apprentice wizard who lives at the edge of your screen. you pick his spells and he fixes his tower floor by floor while you work, even with the game closed. he catches falling stars in a jar. about two weeks to the ending

2842970.name: ZDSS: Zombie Drone Survival Show
2842970.short_description: A darkly satirical top-down bullet heaven action roguelike set in a twisted TV show where cloned zombies are slaughtered for entertainment. Command combat drones, deploy deadly traps, build devastating loadouts, and discover powerful synergies as you fight to survive the carnage-filled arena.

3318020.name: Gnawer No. 44 Observation Report Demo
3318020.short_description: Due to "special" work requirements, you've been assigned by your superiors to live in a very remote and desolate villa. You thought your dull and monotonous life would just carry on as usual, but every midnight, strange sounds emanate from the pitch-black attic...What kind of beginning awaits you?

3797790.name: Abyssal Lapidary
3797790.short_description:
A gothic management sim set in a Victorian-inspired underground metropolis. Appraise raw ores, cut exquisite gems, and craft unique jewelry for strange clients. 
Some stones are worth a fortune. Others stare back.

4360750.name: Kingdom's Return: Time-Eating Fruit and the Ancient Monster Demo
4360750.short_description:
A kingdom-rebuilding adventure filled with action and strategy!
Kingdom's Return is an action RPG where you'll adventure to restore your fallen kingdom. Collect materials in 2D side-scrolling adventure stages, then use them in the strategy part to rebuild your kingdom and power up your characters!

5442420.name: SQUIRT GAME 💦 - WALLPAPERS 18+
5442420.short_description: Give your desktop a playful adult twist with this exclusive wallpaper collection for SQUIRT GAME 💦. Featuring eye-catching artwork inspired by the game, this pack is a great way to bring its characters and atmosphere to your screen.

5459930.name: DAYSOWN
5459930.short_description: Learn a trade, earn your first wages, and save for a place of your own. DAYSOWN is a single-player life sim of hands-on jobs, village crafts, growing food, and making a living one day at a time.

5477110.name: 升仙大会
5477110.short_description: Xianxia auto-battler: 42 cultivators, 7 elements, 14 bonds. Eight teams, 100 Embers each — lose them all and you are out. No fixed finish line: fight until you ascend or fall. Your rivals are real lineups left by other players — AI stand-ins when the player pool is thin.

5490890.name: MicroRacers: RC Multiplayer
5490890.short_description: Race miniature RC cars through everyday rooms transformed into exciting racetracks. Master tight corners, challenge other players online, and experience big competition on a small scale.

5278150.name: Number Naughties Demo
5278150.short_description: Awake each night inside a quiet three-bedroom house turned nightmare, forced to complete increasingly challenging scavenger hunts set by unsettling cartoon numbers. Search, hide, and survive as you are stalked by a relentless, unstoppable entity in this terrifying stealth horror experience.

5211390.name: Uninvited: Death March
5211390.short_description: Uninvited: Death March it's a comedic stealth and Survival-Horror game with visuals inspired by ASCII games. Explore a musical complex to find the kid you were suppose to keep safe while surviving confrontations with the creatures that invaded the place.

3851600.name: Pulsebreaker
3851600.short_description: Pulsebreaker is a single-player survival horror game. Manage your scarce resources such as ammo, medicine, and tools to survive.  Skill-based precision tactical combat utilizing headshots, contextual dodges, and melee attacks help beat back the undead. Explore a city teetering on the brink of doom.

4617180.name: LostLuu
4617180.short_description: Play as Cululum and venture into the Land of Last Wishes, where a fairy is said to grant any wish. Explore shadowy forests, fight with steel and magic, and run a little shop trading with lost souls. Gather goods, strike bargains, and pursue the wish that led Cululum into the woods.

5160960.name: ShirocaTriangle
5160960.short_description:
Harness the rock-paper-scissors relationship between Red, Blue, and Green attributes as you defeat enemies in this laid-back, roguelite-inspired 2D side-scrolling action game.
Young witch Shiroca ventures into a mysterious forest in search of her missing roommate...

5481790.name: Large Language Mercenaries
5481790.short_description: A roguelite turn-based battler where you command an AI mercenary, defend your caravan, and time your parries — or watch it all get torn apart. Train your merc, build combos, and fight through three increasingly difficult acts to prove your worth.

5488190.name: Grave Wire
5488190.short_description: Harrowgate has fallen to war machines and the walking dead. Pick a witch, knight, engineer, vampire, goblin bomber or necromancer, grow one weapon into a screen-filling arsenal and carve through endless hordes in this pixel-art survivors-like. Fuse your weapons and topple every district's boss.

3557160.name: After ICEY
3557160.short_description: After ICEY is a 2D side-scrolling action meta sequel in the ICEY universe. After countless cycles, ICEY defeated Judas and left the world, yet cycles remain. Three bound souls await. Follow the arrows, defeat them, and take their soul crystal masks — this is your mission.

3682970.name: HABROMANIA Demo
3682970.short_description: A dreamy Alice in Wonderland-inspired RPG that follows 19-year-old Alice as she tries to escape the surreal, cozy hellscape that is Wonderland—hopefully with her sanity intact.

3687370.name: The Borderless
3687370.short_description: A cozy floating island management sim where you build and expand your own island world from a small platform in the middle of the ocean. Welcome visitors, meet their needs, plan activities, hire staff, earn money, and grow your ocean paradise day by day.

5384950.name: Hentai Clicker: Vespera is streaming
5384950.short_description: Click, collect hearts, and charm Vespera, a very naughty aristocratic vampire. Unlock scenes, outfits, upgrades, voice reactions, and seductive progression in Hentai clicker: Vespera is streaming.

2360820.name: Tempus Vitae
2360820.short_description: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

3231040.name: Between the Lines
3231040.short_description: In this pre-smartphone-era text adventure, use that good ol’ T9 phone to text your way through the highs and lows of school days. Choose replies piece by piece to shape your own story. Friendships grow; feelings get complicated; secrets flicker. Every reply matters—it all happens Between the Lines.

3796420.name: Backframes: Escape Together Demo
3796420.short_description: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

5138990.name: Unharvest
5138990.short_description: Drain the life from everything around you in this reverse-farming incremental game. Infect all that grows, upgrade your plagues, and wither the world until nothing living remains.

5473400.name: Overgrid
5473400.short_description: Overgrid is a tactical tower defense game where capturing the territory is just as important as defending it. Build and upgrade your defenses, capture strategic locations, and unlock new technologies across a 30-mission campaign set in the middle of a war between artificial intelligences.

5164370.name: The Count is Down for Blood Playtest

5483660.name: Marchling Idle Demo
5483660.short_description: Marchling Idle is an incremental idle game. Relax, grow a bigger and bigger army, and watch them crush the enemy.

4832410.name: Ludus Saltuum
4832410.short_description: A third person 3d platformer! Jump forward, unlock skills and buy upgrades! All at your own pace! Handcrafted levels procedurally presented! How far can you get? 🇧🇷

4861430.name: LLM Tycoon
4861430.short_description: It's late 2022 and the AI race just started. Train models with real personalities, fill the map with datacenters, survive the scandals, and get to superintelligence before the rival CEOs who trash-talk you on social media.

5400000.name: Upstart Tycoon
5400000.short_description: An incremental tycoon about getting rich in a crooked city. Play as a thief, a dirty cop, a 9–5 worker or a suburban teen, and climb from nobody to the person Port Vesper can't function without. Every run, the city you left behind has changed.

5448610.name: Durak: Strip & Sex
5448610.short_description: Classic Russian Durak with an adults-only strip twist. Defeat 10 opponents, unlock 100 revealing illustrations and earn achievements. Take on a 100-duel campaign or play a standalone match, with three difficulty levels from laid-back cards to tactical battles.

3039960.name: Near The Sun
3039960.short_description: Near The Sun is a 2D action-adventure game where you slice through enemy lines with sharp dashes and race across a collapsing underworld. Experience a story that changes depending on the order you explore, and discover a way to save a girl from a long-lost "previous world."

3590140.name: Rage & Relics
3590140.short_description: An isometric action RPG where you hunt monsters for gold, XP and loot. Create your own unique playstyle, level up, and collect legendary equipment.

3844300.name: Frame of Suffering
3844300.short_description: Master both man and machine to escape the Ancient Temple. Customize your Hero and a modifiable Combat Frame to slay hordes and gatekeepers. Scavenge tech, uncover the Temple's history, and evolve your build in this Sci-Fi Action RPG. You're a prisoner - freedom lies at the heart of the Temple.

5299940.name: Autork
5299940.short_description: Aut’ork is a strategic auto-battler where you build an army from the ground up. Shape your composition, experiment with powerful combos, and lead your race to victory in PvE or PvP battles.

5418280.name: LSR 12x12 Military Tactics
5418280.short_description: You are the Commander, You have the Control. Dictate & Dominate this 12x12 battlefield; Command units with unique movement & abilities, Build structures to block movement and Line Of Sight. Capture/Destroy the enemy Commander, or use tactical precision to reach the other side. Your Move, Commander.

5440100.name: 101号实验室
5440100.short_description: 101 Lab is a 2D roguelite survival game for 1–4 players. Battle monster hordes as adorable lab creatures, collect weapons, trigger elemental reactions, and unleash powerful skills. Gather resources, build your base, and set up defenses. Team up to take down mighty bosses and survive wave after wave.

2259200.name: Bancroft Academy
2259200.short_description: Bancroft Academy is being remade as Signed in Secret, an 18+ magic-school visual novel by Moar Interactive. Signed in Secret is in production and no build is out yet. At launch it costs $10 one time, and original Steam owners get it free via a Steam update. Details:

3436240.name: Summer Room8
3436240.short_description:
After coming home from work, you find that your own room has become completely unfamiliar...
This is a short adult-oriented anomaly-spotting game inspired by The Exit 8. Your goal is to spot anomalies and escape from a mysterious space.
When you're feeling tired, let Maria, who's sitting on the sofa, help you relax.
As you progress through the game, she'll even start doing some naughty things with you...

3767420.name: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements
3767420.short_description: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.

4576490.name: Casualties: Unknown
4576490.short_description: Casualties: Unknown is an unforgiving cave-exploration survival simulator. Your captors have tasked you with retrieving lost cargo on a foreign planet, explore its 11 layers and do your best to survive diverse hostile environments. You are just one of the thousands of test subjects sent to die.

5357040.name: Minebreak
5357040.short_description: A push-your-luck roguelite about greed, probability, and knowing when to Cash Out. Reveal Diamonds, dodge Bombs, and build absurd combinations for massive payouts.

5452660.name: Hentai Cube Puzzle: Fluffy Sheep
5452660.short_description: A cozy 3D puzzle about untangling lines on a cube. Rotate the cube, find a line with a clear path and pull it free — one by one until the cube is clean. Every one of the 100 levels unlocks a new illustration of a fluffy sheep girl for your reward gallery. 18+

1426060.name: 永恒沉眠 Eternal Slumber
1426060.short_description: This is an AVG game of deduction and suspense. The gameplay is a special spiritual jury system. Players will take the role of female detective or male police officer, traveling between dream and reality, and jointly investigate the years of unresolved “brunette female serial murder case”.

2999040.name: Times of Survival
2999040.short_description: Times of Survival is a co-op zombie survival game with souls-like inspired combat system, set in a post-apocalyptic world. Fortify your base, fight hordes of zombies and battle epic bosses. Explore, craft, and master punishing combat while building your settlement and leading survivors to hope.

4930680.name: Fitness Waifu
4930680.short_description: Fitness Waifu is a puzzle game about charming fitness waifus and a sporty atmosphere. Complete 30 levels, unlock stylish illustrations of girls during workouts, and save all the images in your personal gallery in high quality.

245550.name: Free to Play
245550.short_description: Free to Play is a feature-length documentary that follows three professional gamers from around the world as they compete for a million dollar prize in the first Dota 2 International Tournament.

3170810.name: Strip Club Simulator
3170810.short_description: Strip Club Simulator puts you in the owner's chair of the nightlife scene in this comprehensive business simulation. Starting with a small venue, you'll use smart decisions and strategies to transform your club into the city's most popular strip club.

5464150.name: Hi no Michi
5464150.short_description: Plan the route and place your arrows to guide the spirits of the dead toward the far shore. On the last day of the Obon festival, lanterns are lit to guide the souls back to the other side, but the way is full of obstacles and it is your role to make sure the spirits of the ancestors arrive safely.

4828570.name: Shanking Simulator
4828570.short_description: Fight through historical locations in shank-or-be-shanked multiplayer combat. Defeat your enemies, dominate the lobby, and rise as the ultimate shanker.

4230410.name: Not In My House
4230410.short_description: A 1v4 home-invasion party game. The Thief shrinks the family and sucks them into his gun while he robs the house. The Residents set silly traps, kick him flat and call the police before he banks $5,000. Then the lights go out: flashlights against night vision.

3661320.name: The Lightseeker
3661320.short_description:
The Lightseeker is a 2D pixel-art platformer in which you guide Analú, a young girl seeking her inner light in a world of darkness. 

Explore mysterious caves, shape paths with your lantern, and face trials in a deeply moving journey of self-discovery.

4875550.name: Brassleaf Tactics
4875550.short_description: Command animal armies in a steampunk turn-based tactics game. Capture cities, build your forces and unleash commander powers across hex-grid battlefields. Take on solo missions, challenge friends in local versus, or create your own maps.

4636810.name: What Was Lost
4636810.short_description: A two-player online co-op puzzle game. One of you plays Ben in the family house as it was, the other plays Lily in the same house years later. You can only see your own timeline, so you solve it by talking. Chapters 1 to 6 in Early Access, with more coming in free updates.

2195510.name: Midnight Survivors
2195510.short_description:
Midnight Survivor is a hybrid game combining tower defense and top-down shooter.
Fight demon hordes, gather resources, and secure build points to deploy turrets and traps.
Unlock weapons, defeat enemies to fill your Overdrive Gauge, and turn the tide of battle instantly.

4689770.name: Shadow Gangs Zero
4689770.short_description: Shadow Gangs Zero is an explosive 2D ninja action platformer with hand-drawn pixel art. Play as Dan or Monika, fight solo or together in 2-player local co-op, battle across 43 levels, unleash ninja powers, transform into powerful warriors, and face 6 challenging bosses and 6 massive mini-bosses.

5334930.name: When Civilians Dig Holes Demo
5334930.short_description: An idle game about digging a hole to the other side of the world.

5391510.name: Tea Break Poker Trainer
5391510.short_description: Learn game theory optimal (GTO) poker five minutes a day. Tea Break deals you a hand, a seat and a decision, grades your answer against solver output, and tells you which idea a mistake broke. A study tool for No Limit cash Hold'em, not a poker game: no real money, no wagering.

4956620.name: ASTERSTEAD Demo
4956620.short_description:
Mine. Process. Circulate. Stabilize.
Build an unmanned planetary base capable of surviving every test before humanity takes its first step onto the surface.

5361200.name: Endless Shift: Haunted House
5361200.short_description: A cozy Halloween restaurant game! You're the ghost waiter of a haunted hotel: seat vampires, mummies and werewolves, serve potions and monstrous dishes, and dress up in Halloween costumes, all before their patience runs out!

5369360.name: 迷宫：囚笼    Maze : Captivity Demo
5369360.short_description:
A relaxing puzzle game. 
Combine spells and items to better traverse the maze.
Through the maze trial, we shall select mages who possess both wisdom and talent. Come, contribute your strength to the nation! Seek the final exit and solve the mystery!

5172290.name: Chiki Poki: Rush🎉
5172290.short_description: The cutest cleanup operation in the world. A fast, hands-on incremental game. Take down the copycat "Chippies", collect Star Candy, and keep your Ultimate going forever! Grow stronger with every material you gather — until the "Chippy King" falls!

5445470.name: Primal Nights
5445470.short_description: You wake up to an empty facility, blood on the floor, and experimental dinosaurs on the cameras. Trapped by the mysterious Primal Fog, rescue is five nights away. Utilize your security countermeasures to fend off bloodthirsty predators and survive until help arrives.

4861450.name: Neural Lust
4861450.short_description: Neural Lust is a cyberpunk fantasy adult visual novel where a female investigator is pulled into a conspiracy of hacked neurochips, forbidden magic-tech, corruption, desire, and dangerous choices. Shape her path through justice, temptation, relationships, and power.

5387210.name: Clapitalism
5387210.short_description: Turn a single clap into a worldwide ovation. Clapitalism is an incremental game about growing an audience, engineering louder applause, and filling bigger venues. Take an Encore to restart with permanent Fame, then build an even stronger show.

4139180.name: 陪伴
4139180.short_description: This is an anime-style desktop pet-like software. It will keep you company while you use your computer every day.

4411420.name: 迷宫：囚笼    Maze : Captivity
4411420.short_description:
A relaxing puzzle game. 
Combine spells and items to better traverse the maze.
Through the maze trial, we shall select mages who possess both wisdom and talent. Come, contribute your strength to the nation! Seek the final exit and solve the mystery!

5129130.name: Colony on the Run Demo
5129130.short_description: Start as a single bacterium, multiply into a colony, and race through the human body! Escape white blood cells, evolve, adapt to each organ, and survive the massive antibiotic wave after three minutes in this roguelite action-strategy game.

5306490.name: RPM: Next Drag Racing Simulator
5306490.short_description: Rev up, conquer cities, and rule the streets in RPM: Next drag racing simulator!

5204140.name: a strange journey into the backrooms
5204140.short_description: A strange journey into the backrooms is an atmospheric exploration game focused on an introspective psychological voyage rather than mere survival. Navigate a lethal, endless labyrinth filled with forgotten stories and liminal spaces that stretch beyond the limits of human imagination.

5334150.name: Fix it, Please!
5334150.short_description: July 2000, the PIX CORP tower, the badge window. A bureaucratic roguelike: inspect forms, catch impostors, watch the cameras and bring dead hardware back to life. Three strikes and the run is over. Friday never ends here, and with every loop the tower remembers you a little better.

5262290.name: 胡了吗?
5262290.short_description: Read private clues, bid for tiles, and build a winning hand in this four-player bidding mahjong strategy game. Use distinct character abilities in casual online matches or room-code games with friends. Requires a Steam account, a game license, and an internet connection.

4880810.name: CUMANIOK
4880810.short_description: Become a true "Gospodar" (Master) in a 3D open-world village life simulator! Control your character, drive the iconic countryside diesel wagon, build rural businesses, construct a traditional "Casa Mare" house, and embrace the unforgettable cozy vibe!

4237370.name: LumoraVR
4237370.short_description: LumoraVR is a social VR platform built on Godot Engine, where users can explore, create, and connect in immersive virtual worlds. Featuring real-time world editing and community-driven spaces, it's a platform built for creativity and connection.

2373970.name: Indie Game Farmer
2373970.short_description: Grow crops. Fund your game-making dream. Tend your pixel farm, sell the harvest, and upgrade your tools while dividing each day between farming, part-time work, and game development. Turn your first potato into your first release, and build a living from crops and games.

4903500.name: Specters of the Void Sea
4903500.short_description: Gather your crew and sail the Void Sea in a fully physical, multicrew VR pirate adventure. Engage in brutal PvPvE with flintlock firearms, melee weapons, gesture magic, and naval combat. Sail procedural worlds, patch leaks, and do what you can to survive the entities and players hunting you.

4711530.name: Moon Fishies Demo
4711530.short_description: Moonfishies is relaxing desktop fish simulator. Customize your dream aquarium, catch new fish and breed unique hybrids!

4054220.name: Unleash The Avatar
4054220.short_description: Unleash the Avatar is a visceral soulslike based in India. Play as Vikram, wielding godlike abilities and signature weapons through breathtaking locales against relentless indigenous foes. Master precision combat, unlock transformations, and rise against a world that strikes back.

3288630.name: Academy Life
3288630.short_description: Academy Life is a text-based life simulation RPG set in a dynamic open world where your choices matter.

4578780.name: Hell Wait Demo
4578780.short_description: HELL WAIT is riichi mahjong crossed with roguelike deckbuilding. Stack your jokers. Upgrade your yaku. Try not to deal in. You'll need those fingers.

4863700.name: Anty Crush
4863700.short_description: Lead a tiny ant colony through a giant candy world. Crush sweets, collect crumbs, unlock upgrades, grow your colony, and help the Queen evolve in this cozy incremental game.

5305040.name: Core0 Demo
5305040.short_description: Core0 blends incremental defense with auto-battling combat. Deploy units, combine automatic weapons, and turn each run into permanent upgrades. Experiment with builds and withstand increasingly fierce attacks.

3912780.name: 长干里酒吧 Demo
3912780.short_description: 《长干里酒吧》是一款融合历史与克苏鲁元素的多视角叙事视觉小说。你将扮演六位命运交织的角色——从被网暴的消防员到乱世军人，亲历安史之乱背后的诡异真相。通过“记事簿”系统，在舆图中点亮关键地点，在编年表中填补被篡改的年份，在灵堂中为漂泊的灵魂找到归宿。拼凑六段人生的碎片，揭开隐藏三千年的因果坐标。你的选择将决定宿命能否被打破——遗忘，还是记起？

5312340.name: The Invisible Ruins
5312340.short_description: You came for a lost treasure hidden beneath the ocean floor. You will have to decrypt an ancient language to find the way

4251210.name: Backflip Madness
4251210.short_description: Backflip Madness is a fast-paced, parkour-flavored extreme sports game. Your goal is simple - make tons of spectacular tricks and stunts. Take it to the extreme!

3753320.name: 上元长干行
3753320.short_description: 《长干里酒吧》是一款融合历史与克苏鲁元素的多视角叙事视觉小说。你将扮演六位命运交织的角色——从被网暴的消防员到乱世军人，亲历安史之乱背后的诡异真相。通过“记事簿”系统，在舆图中点亮关键地点，在编年表中填补被篡改的年份，在灵堂中为漂泊的灵魂找到归宿。拼凑六段人生的碎片，揭开隐藏三千年的因果坐标。你的选择将决定宿命能否被打破——遗忘，还是记起？

5450950.name: The Gigglebone Gang: AlphaBonk Farm
5450950.short_description: A is for AlphaBonk! Join Farmer Bonk and the Gigglebone Gang for a trip through the alphabet down on the farm — letters, rhymes, real farm photos and a barnyard full of silly games. A fully restored 1995 Headbone Interactive classic.

5460730.name: The Gigglebone Gang: Infinity City
5460730.short_description: Hop in Zack's taxicab and tour Infinity City with the Gigglebone Gang! 50 stimulating, song-filled early math activities teach kids ages 4–8 counting, shapes, time, money, and problem-solving, and it all feels like play. A Headbone Interactive classic, back for a new generation.

5442080.name: The Gigglebone Gang: Pantsylvania
5442080.short_description: The Gigglebone Gang returns! In Pantsylvania, everybody's pants are serious business. Join the Gigglebone Gang across ten locales and 50 activities — sing-along songs, hidden-object hunts, silly science and interactive stories — in this fully restored 1995 point-and-click edutainment classic.

5460970.name: The Gigglebone Gang World Tour
5460970.short_description: Pack your bags! Rapu and the Gigglebone Gang are off to ten countries — India, Egypt, Japan, Peru and more — for 50 fun activities, songs, stories and hidden-object hunts. See the world without leaving the couch. A restored 1996 Headbone Interative classic.

5464760.name: Velma's Costume Closet
5464760.short_description: Velma and Rapu are off on a twenty-country dress-up tour, and you pick the outfits. Mix and match traditional costumes and have fun with the fully animated skits. Put on a show and print your own paper dolls. A fully restored 1997 Headbone Interactive classic.

5214570.name: Coma Dreams
5214570.short_description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

4568890.name: Legends of Rock Demo
4568890.short_description: Start your rock band and master songwriting, rehearsals and gigs while working a day job to pay the bills. Shop for records, instruments, and groceries, recruit musicians around the city, and earn your place in the Hall of Fame.

3054160.name: ガラスドロップ
3054160.short_description:
A "breaking" merge game!?
Enjoy merging with simple controls! Break glass balls right now!

4596330.name: Shape Survivors Demo
4596330.short_description: Take on swarms of angry shapes in this free bullet-heaven demo. Combine 10 weapons and 10 items into powerful builds, battle the forest’s giant boss, and see how long you can survive.

2179180.name: Hex Party
2179180.short_description: Hex Party is a 1-8 players online and local multiplayer party game. Compete in a board game full of epic friendship-wrecking minigames.

5196410.name: Pussy Parlor
5196410.short_description: Welcome to Pussy Parlor, where ladies can get the bush they’ve always dreamed of! Cut their bush, grow your parlor, attract more customers, unlock new styles, and build your reputation. Make sure your customers walk out with a pussy that they’ll be proud to show off!

5016410.name: Mokomon: Five Elements
5016410.short_description: A Roguelike Auto Battler focused on creature taming and evolution. Choose your Tamer, master the Five Elements system, and break the game by discovering new evolutions and insane synergies to annihilate hordes, defeat bosses, and outmatch other players' builds.

2444400.name: Patch Zero
2444400.short_description: You are a tiny security agent inside a hacked corporate network. Blast through server rooms infested with worms, botnets, trojans and ransomware, pick upgrades, and reach the Core Server in this fast top-down roguelite.

5446550.name: Farm Business Simulator Demo
5446550.short_description: Try the opening of Farm Business Simulator for free: grow your first crops, make goods, deliver orders around town and play co-op with a friend. Your farm carries over to the full game.

5317780.name: NightGlow : Aquarium Shop Simulator
5317780.short_description:
Light up a quiet, dimly lit shop with the glow of your aquariums.

Raise and breed fish, discover new varieties, and build your own aquarium shop. Manage your tanks, sell fish, fulfill customer requests, decorate your space, and slowly grow your little shop in this cozy aquarium management sim.

4905700.name: Atmospheric Labyrinth Demo
4905700.short_description: Search for unusual events inside a labyrinth of usual rooms. Walk through it, and see daily life differently.

5272500.name: When Pigs Fly Demo
5272500.short_description: Build the plane while you're flying it with up to 3 friends! Grapple scrap, bolt it onto your cart, and transform into a plane mid-flight. Dodge wolves, fall constantly, and get to the destination island before the whole thing comes apart.

5260080.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure - Demo

4326740.name: Node Crown
4326740.short_description:
Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom.
Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here! Have fun!

5147000.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure
5147000.short_description: An idle collection RPG that keeps adventuring on your desktop. Build a team of three Dreamspirits, combine roles, skills, equipment, and innate affixes, then push farther through auto-battles, hatching, fusion, and talent progression.

5030490.name: Donatello
5030490.short_description: Turn one 2D character image into animated sprite sheets and a skeletal 2D character for Spine or DragonBones. Use your own art, or create the image in the app. Motion comes from a built-in library or your own clips. Runs entirely on your machine.

3708600.name: Village vs Rock
3708600.short_description: Village vs Rock is a physics based incremental game about crushing mountains. Raise your village of orcs to wage war against the rock that keeps popping up in your backyard. Hurl mammoths, unleash spells, and upgrade everything to DESTROY THE ROCK!

3400130.name: Tombstone Tactics
3400130.short_description: A pixel-art roguelike autobattler where you play the Lich. Raise an undead army from the souls of fallen heroes, set the board, and let it fight. Lose a battle and your army returns; the Lich pays instead. March on the royal family and take it apart, one crown at a time.

4025050.name: Ice Cream Shop Simulator Demo
4025050.short_description: Run a seaside ice cream shop: make ice cream, serve customers, earn money, and unlock new equipment. Expand and customize your shop as each day gets more and more chaotic.

4725370.name: Wavertree Mountain
4725370.short_description: A 2D top-down MMORPG on an island the humans left behind. Choose one of six species, pick a side, and dig a burrow of your own. Gather, craft, build and fight your way across the island, run the local economy with your wares, or just go fishing. You choose.

3839070.name: Neverending AI Storybook - HQ Image Model (Flux)
3839070.short_description: Meet Flux: the AI model that won't turn your princess into a Picasso painting! 😄 High-quality generation with detailed faces, hands with the perfect amount of fingers, and balanced compositions.

5185650.name: Seam Walker Demo
5185650.short_description: Play the opening of Seam Walker for free. Learn a world-carving Tool, find a drifting diner in the void, cut tunnels through shimmering rock, swing across the abyss - and race for the closing portal when the diner jumps without you.

5059030.name: Seam Walker
5059030.short_description: Navigate a fractured void in this story-based first-person platformer using a powerful, ancient piece of tech - the "Tool". Your anchor between worlds? "The Drifting Diner". Wander dimensions and guide displaced wanderers out of the dark to build a warm sanctuary for all kinds of lost people.

3434510.name: 云里物理
3434510.short_description: Physics In Clouds is a high-school physics learning game powered by a real rigid-body physics engine — read the problem, enter your answer, run the simulation, and let the laws of physics grade you.

5363130.name: No More Room in Hell 2 - Scarecrow Pack
5363130.short_description: This Halloween costume is bound to freak out the neighbors

5377740.name: SlimeBreak Demo
5377740.short_description: Tower defense against a horde of thousands of slimes. Build walls, towers and traps along a funnel, pick level cards that bend each run, and watch the mass pile up, split and break through. Spend essence between runs to grow stronger.

5162810.name: Worm Capitalist Demo
5162810.short_description: Worm Capitalist is an incremental game about raising hungry worms, watching them devour everything pixel by pixel, and turning their poop into profit. Feed them, expand your colony, unlock upgrades, boost production, automate the process, and keep growing until the whole world is on the menu.

5307540.name: Mar Demo
5307540.short_description: Millions of monsters are escaping the hole. Stop them with a unique arsenal of towers, nukes, and deep upgrades in this incremental tower defense game.

4896610.name: DISREPAIR — A Tale Beyond Half-Life
4896610.short_description: DISREPAIR is an atmospheric puzzle horror total conversion mod for Half-Life 2. Descend into the radioactive ruins of Black Mesa, document hidden anomalies, and survive what still lingers beneath the abandoned facility.

5066740.name: Ballistic.exe Demo
5066740.short_description: A smuggled segment of the despicably detailed shooting simulator wrapped in a declassified computer program. Three weapons, dozens of cartridges and attachments, and absolutely nothing supernatural.

4422700.name: Don't Play This Demo
4422700.short_description:
Don't Play This is a demo of an indie first-person horror walking simulator..
A scary story caught on camera. Can you play it?

4605390.name: Codename CURE II – Combat Specialist Pack
4605390.short_description: Deploy with exclusive weapons, tactical attachments, and military cosmetics. The Combat Specialist Pack adds new firearms, weapon upgrades, and customizable gear for every class in Codename CURE II.

4380410.name: Trailmakers - Mech Amok
4380410.short_description: Run amok with Mech building using these blocks and skins guaranteed to play into your wildest power fantasies.

3955580.name: SCOPECREEP Demo
3955580.short_description: A whispering flame craves souls. With each offering, your resolve strengthens. Fight spirits, collect their essences, and feed a hunger that may never subside in this short eerie incremental game.

3996640.name: Inky's Sleep
3996640.short_description: Step into Inky’s sleep — a haunting yet enchanting 2D horror-adventure with surreal touches, led by an endearing little cat. Explore dark dreams, unravel uncanny puzzles, and evade otherworldly creatures.

4142420.name: Paradox Tower Demo
4142420.short_description: Explore Paradox Tower and save your future. Only your wits and your loyal demon cat are able to throw down the Coven. Grow stronger, pick your battles, and make smart moves. And if you don't? Travel back in time!

3350930.name: Trifolium Demo: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
3350930.short_description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

3118020.name: Dog Man: Mission Impawsible Demo
3118020.short_description: Join the Supa Buddies on an epic adventure and help chase down the bad guys in the Dog Man: Mission Impawsible Demo!

2321890.name: Swordeye
2321890.short_description: Persistent PvPvE dungeons.  Full loot extraction. 120 tick duel servers. 6-directional blocks and attacks.  Master your sword or die trying.

2513920.name: Zombie Survival Game Online Demo
2513920.short_description: The ZSGO Demo is a peek at our post-apocalyptic, zombie survival, looter shooter. Dangerous weather, Iimited supplies, and zombies lurking in the shadows aren't the only threats on this wasteland. Building, crafting, driving, and more. Do you have what it takes to survive the deadly world of ZSGO?

2058670.name: Viking Life
2058670.short_description: You are an ordinary Viking. Your task is to gather a squad and attack other settlements, after each victory you will have a choice of 4 abilities, each with a unique pumping or talent. After death, you lose all skills and troops.

3760630.name: Battles of Chaos
3760630.short_description: Battles of Chaos is a medieval fantasy real time strategy and tactics hybrid game, blending the best elements of the two genres. Play great, realistic open-field battles or sieges in single-player, cooperative or PvP mode, where the emphasis is on combat, with base building elements.

1833100.name: FrameFusion Motion Interpolation
1833100.short_description: Improve the framerate of any video, gif or group of images by 2X/4X/8X/16X using neural networks generating videos with a high FPS.

5228450.name: Par Under Review
5228450.short_description: What’s left of golf when you take away the swing? Every decision. In the 1930s, as numbered irons arrive, you play golf on paper: a deck of clubs, a pair of dice, and a par to get under. Read the odds, plan for the miss. A turn-based roguelike where the rules come from golf itself.

992490.name: iVRy Driver for SteamVR
992490.short_description: Use your iPhone, Android, GearVR, Oculus, Vive Wave, Pico Mobile or Sony Playstation VR/VR2 headset as a Virtual Reality Headset for your PC. Lets you run SteamVR & Oculus Rift PC VR titles without a dedicated PC VR headset.

3909480.name: PhaigeX: Confiners
3909480.short_description: Welcome aboard, Confiner! As PhaigeX Megacorp’s newest specialist, you’re tasked with curbing the AI incursion into hyperspace sectors. Choose your ship, upgrade your modules, accept commissions, and deploy adaptive stratagems to fend off the relentless AI invasion.

4698170.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws-
4698170.short_description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. Raise them, fight them, reach the top of 2,000 rivals. Calendar, classes and five-generation pedigrees stay as in racing, so little to learn. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, all automatic. Upload one to the Workshop.

4767890.name: PRIDEBLOOD -Born of Claws- Demo
4767890.short_description: Real-world horse racing, swapped for monster battles in a fantasy world. The demo plays a full in-game year, all 48 weeks. Start with two monsters, pick entries from the calendar, face 2,000 rivals. 576 battles a year, up to eight at once, fully automatic. (No breeding or Owners Cup.)

3801210.name: Rebirth TD
3801210.short_description: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

4565950.name: Harbor of Vows Demo
4565950.short_description: A comforting and heartfelt Visual Novel about a young musician struggling to write a simple song. Roki Olsen seems to want nothing more than to sing on stage…truly, when he looks at Elly Hammington, we think he might be lying.

3911250.name: 道渡しのオーレリア
3911250.short_description: 道が失われてしまった世界、『道渡し』のオーレリアが街と心を繋げていく。パネルを置いてスタートからゴールまでを繋げるパズルアドベンチャーゲーム。

5262890.name: Double Skunk Demo
5262890.short_description: The free demo of Double Skunk, a cribbage roguelite. Powerups change what your count pays and one-shot cards shove the rival's peg back. Climb to the Parlor Cup, play the weekly shared deal, then keep your save for the full game.

4783460.name: Double Skunk
4783460.short_description: Double Skunk is a cribbage roguelite. Powerups change what your count pays, and one-shot cards can shove the rival's peg back. Climb a ladder of named rivals, then play the weekly deal everyone shares, or take on a friend online.

5249350.name: Hedge Knight
5249350.short_description: Raise a mercenary company and fight at its head in a medieval fantasy action RPG. Command infantry, archers and cavalry, storm castles, ride dragons and unleash spells that send enemy ranks flying. Recruit, train and conquer across a campaign of rival kingdoms.

4810500.name: Swarm Harvest
4810500.short_description: Congratulations, you're hired! Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

5452330.name: HALFTIME Manager Demo
5452330.short_description: Play a whole season of HALFTIME Manager: pick one of three second-division clubs and lead them through tactics, transfers, stadium expansion and the Merch Lab. Every matchday plays out as a 3D broadcast. Your assistant coach shows you the first steps.

5125940.name: Swarm Harvest Demo
5125940.short_description: Congratulations, you're hired! Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

1941280.name: Colors Live
1941280.short_description: A powerful and fun painting app/game!

4600540.name: Bahamut:Evolution
4600540.short_description: You have stepped into the world of Bahamut. Here, hunger, darkness, and disease follow you like shadows; you must be fully prepared for danger. Go and tame your own Bahamuts — let them build your base and supply power. Lead your Bahamuts and challenge the mightiest beings of this land!

5108700.name: MMOAlone
5108700.short_description: MMOAlone is an Idle-Clicker Game which provides many Features known from Oldschool MMORPGs, including various ways of Equipment Upgrading, Progression and Raids. - Fight, Loot, Upgrade, Repeat.

3230560.name: Storm Settlers
3230560.short_description: A survival citybuilder set in a desert afflicted by relentless sandstorms. Build, farm, research, clear sand and protect your people from the storms. Will you find water or desolation? Will your settlement thrive or be buried in sand?

1580830.name: Lovengrad
1580830.short_description: As a Tourist in an old eastern European village, you find yourself after a Car Accident trying to find a way to get out of the cursed Village.

5108060.name: SPOTREP
5108060.short_description: SPOTREP features MILSIM game mechanics, each dynamically changing how you play. Spotted a stationary target? Call in a GRG based CALL FOR FIRE including method of control and number of rounds. Your AI or player teammates are down? Call in a 4 liner MEDEVAC!

5398720.name: The Scratcher
5398720.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Scratch to fight, push your luck for the JACKPOT and stop before you go BUST. Build a deck of tickets and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.

4243060.name: Wings of Vi 2
4243060.short_description:
Myougi survived. She shattered the sin statues. Now the Seven Deadly Sins walk the shattered realms, and Vi returns, wings reforged, to hunt them down.
The vision is a mix of what I've learned: a precision platformer with fast, fluid combat and more player agency.

5431310.name: Shockline
5431310.short_description: Play as a super-speed dog in a city facing disaster. Race through streets, rescue civilians, and disarm bombs before time runs out. Slow the action to make tight turns, dodge danger, and push for a better score across three modes and three districts.

5299780.name: Elandrake Demo
5299780.short_description: Consume matter and unlock new abilities as you defend a cosmic entity from relentless waves of fleets while she emerges from another reality in this incremental twin-stick shooter.

4716370.name: 超时空怪盗 Demo
4716370.short_description:
是架空世界冒险喜剧！！！你将化身一位土著人，与一位来自20年后的少女一起组成跨时空搭档，前往未来世界冒险并搜集传说中能改变一切的宝物！本作是一款搞笑游戏，目的就是逗笑你让你开心！因此在冒险过程中，你会遇到各种各样让人啼笑皆非的事。
千万不要在喝水的时候游玩本作哦！不然你就………………不渴了呢……

4933680.name: 光不归谁
4933680.short_description: This is the story of the first person in the world to be put to death in an electric chair.

4376910.name: Shiftomino
4376910.short_description: A puzzle platformer where you guide a little soul by shifting it from block to block. Use the power of “Shift” to clear each stage. The protagonist has fallen from a home floating in the sky down to this planet. Just keep moving forward, and someday you might find a way back to the moon.

5385590.name: 光不归谁 Demo
5385590.short_description: This is the story of the first person in the world to be put to death in an electric chair.

4259360.name: Milki Delivery
4259360.short_description: Rebuild a community one bottle at a time in this tiny delivery adventure with your pet cow Milki. Gather resources and upgrade your barn, then bike along dirt paths, breezy meadows, and seaside docks to bring fresh milk back to the sleepy countryside.

5397860.name: Jarnvard
5397860.short_description: A dungeon crawler about knowing when to stop. Beat a floor’s boss, then choose: the stair down, where everything is worth more, or the portal home with what you found. Die, and you lose what you carry. Bank it, and you keep it.

5475310.name: Map: Istanbul
5475310.short_description: Take Carpoli to Istanbul: two shores, two suspension bridges with tolls, ferries across the Bosphorus, an island auction center and a Central Bank that pays out the bridge pool. New rules, new cards, same friendly backstabbing.

4737980.name: Potions & Passions: Therapist for Monsters
4737980.short_description: Manage your spooky potion shop and meet monsters! Solve the tragicomic problems of vampires, werewolves, ifrits and trolls, or pit them against each other. Scavenge ingredients, craft volatile brews, and enjoy this chaotic management simulation!

5164260.name: Ashen Legacy
5164260.short_description: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

3664970.name: Night Creatures
3664970.short_description: Explore a dark, interconnected world as a mysterious shadow. Shape-shift into powerful creatures, uncover lost artifacts and magic, and confront the corrupted Night Creatures as you unravel the truth of your forgotten past.

4354400.name: Railyard Master
4354400.short_description: Build and manage your own railyard. Route incoming trains, operate shunting locomotives, sort freight cars, and keep cargo moving. Expand your tracks, supply industries, and turn a neglected yard into a thriving railway operation.

5231260.name: Holiday Island Stories
5231260.short_description: Take a summer job on the tropical island of Grand Ayapa, reconnect with an old friend, meet an unforgettable cast of women—and stumble headfirst into a murder mystery you are spectacularly unqualified to solve. An adult visual novel filled with romance, comedy, mystery and fully animated encounters.

4689960.name: CarSim Racing
4689960.short_description:
CarSim Racing is a racing game where you start from the bottom with ordinary cars and work your way up to supercars, competing against the best racers!

The game features more than 45 cars across different classes. Each vehicle is unique, with its own strengths and weaknesses.

4986670.name: Just Skill Shooter: Japan
4986670.short_description: Just Skill Shooter: Japan plunges players into a high-stakes first-person shooter experience set across the striking, contrast-filled landscapes of modern and ancient Japan.

4430890.name: Booker Blitz
4430890.short_description: Run a wrestling promotion and book every title picture. Build divisions with standings and number-one contenders, cut promos beat by beat, then sit in Gorilla Position and change the finish live. A keyboard-centric management sim, 100% playable on Steam Deck.

5378860.name: Alandys
5378860.short_description: You hatch as a creature on the Anchor, a floating island under a black sun. Climb the archipelagos in a co-op roguelite where every guardian is a raid-style fight: read the telegraphs, solve the mechanics, grow stronger every run. Solo, with AI teammates or up to 3 online. Free to play.

5308700.name: Syncblade Demo
5308700.short_description: A rhythm game where you can play any song thanks to our advanced music analysis system, or create and share custom levels with players around the world. Play as Akemi, a unique samurai girl, and slash through waves of Zombeats to the beat of the music you love.

770080.name: FortressCraft : Hole
770080.short_description: Dig a hole a thousand metres deep with a lot of ridiculously overpowered tools. Use your army of upgradeable helper robots to ferry ore back to the surface, purchasing upgrades until the world is your (excavated) oyster.

3121930.name: Dimon The Witch's Pervert Assistant
3121930.short_description: Dimon, brutal freelancer and all-time pervert, is now working as a witch assistant after the previous one disappeared due to mysterious circumstances…and little does everyone know about his twisted plan.

5215890.name: Run Man: Wash the Dish
5215890.short_description: Scrub away grime, reveal colorful dish designs, and turn a humble sponge into a cleaning powerhouse. Upgrade your tools, trigger chain reactions, and grow your collection in this satisfying pixel-art dishwashing game. Just one more plate.

4245830.name: ThrustX Demo
4245830.short_description: Start as Santa. Unlock a pig, a cop and more. Beat each other senseless in a chaotic 2.5D brawler, with proximity chat, so you can hear them suffer. New fighters every season with a free season pass. Best of five. May the most unhinged player win.

5219580.name: ARCHSCROLL Demo
5219580.short_description:
An indie action RPG set in a fantasy world. Experience a deep storyline and immersive action featuring beautiful characters and environments!

This is a demo build.

4864810.name: Wild Hive
4864810.short_description: Build your own bee hive in this cozy roguelite. Hatch worker bees, forage nectar and sell your honey on the stock market. The royal crown demands more honey every year! How long will your hive survive?

5306840.name: Keyboard Warriors Demo
5306840.short_description: Keyboard Warriors is a bullet-heaven roguelite typing game, customise your mech and weapon loadout and type out the story of the world to cut down huge hordes of enemies and bosses, powering up with each victory and unlocking new upgrades with every run.

4820800.name: Black Market Dealer
4820800.short_description: A real-time crime management sim where you build a black market empire from a single hustle to a global operation. Buy fronts, launder money, smuggle contraband, set prices, and outrun the Police, FBI, and INTERPOL as your heat rises. Every deal is a gamble between profit and prison.

5206570.name: Scottside Soundtrack
5206570.short_description: The official Scottside soundtrack, featuring atmospheric synthwave, character themes, original compositions, and full-length songs created specifically for the game.

2710530.name: Rug Cleaning Simulator
2710530.short_description: Turn filthy rugs into spotless transformations in a relaxing first-person cleaning simulator. Take on customer jobs, clean rugs step by step, earn money, upgrade your equipment, and grow your own rug-cleaning business.

3763080.name: Rogue Reels
3763080.short_description: Losing is not an option: Gamble your way up in this slot machine roguelite! Upgrade and manipulate the machines in your favor. Enhance your reels, win big and break the bank while defying ever-increasing odds.

5134070.name: Bouncy Ball Battle
5134070.short_description: Bouncy Ball Battle is a chaotic, turn-based online multiplayer game where physics meets strategy. Break through blocks to open up lines of attack, line up your shots, and bounce off walls to knock out your opponents and be the last ball standing!

4742850.name: Wildreach
4742850.short_description: Survive and settle in a wild mountain land. Hunt, fish, farm and cook. Build a home piece by piece as the seasons turn. Wild herds and predators live on their own. No bosses, no ending.

5423200.name: The Scratcher Demo
5423200.short_description: Free demo of The Scratcher, a roguelike deckbuilder where your cards are scratch tickets. Play the Chosen and the Mage, push your luck for the JACKPOT, stop before you go BUST, and climb from the Shantytown to the King's Palace.

4179770.name: Kindling Hour
4179770.short_description: A short psychological horror text adventure guided by a single candle. Random encounters and fragments of lost memories weave a story in the dark. Eerie and unsettling, yet a little cute and quirky. A narrative experience to gently light a fire in your heart.

5307000.name: Overarmed Survivors Demo
5307000.short_description: Try the free demo of this mech arena roguelite. Unlock 5 mechs and 23 weapon forms, evolve your arsenal, and fight through the Hangar. Play solo or with up to three friends in online or local co-op. Dodge bosses and build something overpowered.

4408320.name: BATTLE BEARS GOLD
4408320.short_description:
An award-winning 4v4 third-person class shooter with more personality than sense! The mobile classic millions grew up with is now on PC.

Choose from 11 unique classes, mix hundreds of thousands of loadout combinations, and battle it out online or with friends across 16 wacky maps!

4795660.name: Prison Chain: The Unredeemed Thought
4795660.short_description: A text-driven psychological horror visual novel. You wake up in a strange living room. Two silent men stand beside you. On the wall, blood writes: “Confess your sins, and you shall be redeemed.” Every choice changes the ending. Over 80,000 words in the base game, plus 4 standalone character DLCs.

4661280.name: Curse of Resthaven Demo
4661280.short_description: In the demo for this single-player narrative roguelite, govern a cursed island as you investigate your niece’s mysterious disappearance. Interrogate, trade, upgrade, and embark upon card-based expeditions to uncover dark secrets – before the next cataclysm strikes.

5244070.name: Daydream Cat: DreamSpirits Idle Adventure - Playtest

5340220.name: TRIGGER DRAW
5340220.short_description: Take aim. Draw with a bullet. TRIGGER DRAW is Old Maid with guns and abilities for up to 4 players. Shoot to draw a card, move yours to throw off their aim, and turn the tables with abilities. Miss, and your opponent picks your card. Play online with friends or solo against the CPU.

5320220.name: Ashfall
5320220.short_description:
• Brutal Runs: Fight rivals for resources.
• Total Loss: Die and lose everything on you forever.
• No Handouts: Your bandages are your only medical help.
• Bunker Loop: Bring back scrap to craft weapons.
• Lasting Threat: Cleared zones still have people wandering around.

2869560.name: Amnea28: Two Eternities
2869560.short_description: A group of university students is going to spend a week in the old hotel "Amnea". Within these seven days they have to find out what is hidden behind its facade and to unravel all the mysteries without losing their minds.

3893760.name: Anvira: Forge Defense
3893760.short_description: Turn the battlefield into lava. Fill the sky with meteors. Raise an army of shuriken-throwing ninja golems. Anvira: Forge Defense is a tower defense roguelite about crafting absurd golem builds — and watching endless goblin waves break against them.

4645280.name: 妖魔录 Demo
4645280.short_description: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

4045760.name: Project: home
4045760.short_description: After losing your job, you return to your hometown to rebuild your life—and your family house. But you’re not alone. Two old friends, Lola and Mira, offer to help you renovate… and maybe build something more.

3788590.name: Sign: 碎冠篇
3788590.short_description: Sign is a visual novel series that blends fantasy, urban life, and adventure. The story follows Lyra, a high school girl who encounters Cygnus, a witch from another world. Together, they embark on a journey to reclaim the witch’s lost powers.

3708630.name: Copperfell
3708630.short_description: Journey to Copperfell, a vast magical land teeming with charming villages, interesting characters, and dangerous monsters. Grind 24 skills, craft a huge variety of items, and grow stronger as you explore. Get those level 100s, will you?

5437570.name: Cabin Life
5437570.short_description: Create your character, pick your starting gear, and settle into a rented cabin in this immersive, relaxing life simulator. Forage, work odd jobs, sell junk at the thrift store, and keep yourself fed and clean as you save up for the cabin of your dreams.

5417140.name: RIPSTACK
5417140.short_description: Pull a block. Don't let the tower fall. SURVIVE. RIPSTACK is a first-person physics horror game for 1-4 players about shaky hands, cheating and betrayal. Play solo, online multiplayer, or face up in local co-op!

3330380.name: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side
3330380.short_description: Ad Nauseam is a choice-heavy psych horror / thriller about trauma, identity, love, and sickness. It combines many staples of Adventure, VN, and RPG games with its own flair to create something entirely unique. Solve mysteries, form bonds, blur the line between mind and body, and keep your eyes open.

3276250.name: Mato Fragments
3276250.short_description: You are a photo shop owner moonlighting as an informant in the vibrant, but dangerous streets of Neo City. After harboring a strange fugitive, your skills as an informant are put to the test, as the fate of the entire city rests in your hands.

5029490.name: Evox Ascension
5029490.short_description: Hatch into a vibrant fantasy world and embark on a grand adventure. Explore, battle, evolve, and discover extraordinary new powers as you grow from a tiny hatchling into a mighty dragon.

5251960.name: Blind Man's Buff
5251960.short_description: An asymmetric online hide-and-seek party game. The hunter is completely blind — sound is the only light in his world. Hide, stay still, never make a noise. Play with friends over the internet or hunt bots alone. 2–20 players.

5047340.name: Calcio 98
5047340.short_description: Calcio 98 is a single-player football management game set in the 1998/99 season and created by longtime fans of the classics like Premier Manager 98 or PC Fútbol 7. Lead your club across 18 leagues and 14 cups through tactics, transfers, squad development and finances.

5302740.name: Virtus Arenae Demo
5302740.short_description:
This demo lets you try the solo mode of Virtus Arenae with a selection of pre-built decks. The following features are only available in the full game: PvP matches, ranked play, leaderboards, deck building, and the in-game store.

Wishlist Virtus Arenae to be notified at launch!

4779270.name: モノクリ Demo
4779270.short_description:
White or Black—
A world painted in just two colors.
Toggle the colors of your character and the blocks to "forge" your path to the goal in this brand-new puzzle experience.

5361370.name: The Theory of Humanity
5361370.short_description: One planet, one colony, up to ten commanders - and every one of them wants to run it. Bring a dead world to life, level up your soldiers, raid anomalies for treasure, hunt monsters in the fog and choose who to trust. Make deals. Set ambushes. Play dirty

5408400.name: SHOVEL BRIGADE
5408400.short_description: Shovel Brigade is a free-to-play multiplayer war sandbox. Dig trenches, build bunkers, defend your camp, and survive chaotic battles with friends. Your defenses are destructible, your orders are unpredictable, and your shovel is always ready.

2630480.name: BROODSAC
2630480.short_description: BROODSAC is a 2.5D survival management game where every visitor could save your community or destroy it. Manage your resources, interrogate strangers at your door, and decide who deserves your trust as an invisible threat spreads.

5161530.name: Alice's Desktop Adventure Demo
5161530.short_description: Alice's Desktop Adventure is a single-player idle RPG with online play and free outfit customization. Alice fights automatically and collects loot in the corner of your desktop; idle battles may drop outfits, which enter your Steam Inventory and can be traded with other players on the market.

5360720.name: Escape Your Boss
5360720.short_description: An overworked accountant in a ninja suit takes on his entire company. Fight your way out of Megacorp Tower in a pixel-art action platformer, solo or with up to three friends in online co-op.

2776730.name: Anno Domini
2776730.short_description: "Awakened One, you who behold the two flames, must rouse the king of these lands from his slumber, or the shade of the crumbling world will once again dim your light."

5004990.name: Runtime Terror
5004990.short_description: Runtime Terror is a bullet heaven roguelite where you play the malware. Auto-fire through hordes of antivirus, draft upgrades into builds that break the system, and trigger the Kill Switch when it closes in. How far can you get before you're deleted?

3504490.name: Legacy of Valor
3504490.short_description: Fight as one soldier, command as a general, rule as a lord. Build your ancestral home from ruin into the heart of a kingdom in a grounded medieval RPG of war, conquest and strategy.

5480490.name: Assassination Contracts
5480490.short_description: Assassination Contracts is an action game where you fight through enemy-filled locations, reach powerful bosses, and eliminate your targets. Battle across three unique environments, defeat enemies standing in your way, and complete all assassination contracts.

4784820.name: Eldritch Tricks
4784820.short_description: A cooperative trick-taking game where losing costs you your mind. Each mission removes a suit from the deck — and Dagon plays it against you. Every trick he takes, every investigator loses a piece of themselves. 21 missions. One of you wants the gate open.

5428760.name: Morrowvane
5428760.short_description: A gothic isometric action RPG you can finish in an evening. Walk a province where the dead rise because something is owed, pick one of eight classes, and build it from 128 spells with no dice in the choosing. The narrator notes everything with interest.

3944310.name: ByteCrawler
3944310.short_description: Pick a hero, build your swarm, and hold off enemy waves. Place units, watch your energy, and level up to survive in this lane-defense strategy game!

3893430.name: 终焉与珑同行
3893430.short_description:
《终焉与珑同行》是一段几乎没有剧情的故事。
没有宏伟的冒险、没有奇迹，也没有命运交错。只有在清晨和黄昏之间，反复走过同一段日子。
一起吃饭、说话、沉默，偶尔争吵，偶尔又因为无聊的事笑得喘不过气。
像温水一样的生活，平凡到几乎透明，却又真实得让人想逃。
你总觉得再这样下去，世界也不会改变。但心里某处却在轻轻提醒你——这样下去，不会太久了。
不是因为发生了什么，而是因为什么都不会发生了。
她不会告诉你原因，你也不会问。

4380090.name: HELLO HACKER - Project Daybreak
4380090.short_description: A story-rich hacking sim played inside a real Linux desktop. Recon networks, break web apps, crack crypto, and extract hidden data with tools that behave like the real thing, while an autonomous AI watches the network, learns, and hacks back. The commands are real. So are the consequences.

4087940.name: Veyora
4087940.short_description: Veyora is a medieval open-world RPG with survival and farming elements, created by a solo developer. Choose your place, build a farm, home or base, explore the world, and play alone or together with friends.

5333360.name: Boardroom Wars: Fight for Kashistan Soundtrack
5333360.short_description: The original soundtrack to Boardroom Wars: Fight for Kashistan, composed by Alex Shesha. Includes 15 full-length tracks in MP3 and lossless FLAC, plus an offline music gallery with album art and playback controls.

2679380.name: Adventure Mansion
2679380.short_description: Friends? Randos? Tonight, you're coworkers. Welcome to the world's worst new-hire orientation: Cocoon Panic, a 1–4 player co-op disaster. Explore a sprawling Halloween attraction, destroy alien cocoons before they hatch, and try not to panic when the lights go out.

5363770.name: Chill Pixels
5363770.short_description:
*Life can be overwhelming: take a well-deserved, cozy break.*  
Relax to soothing lo-fi tunes and peaceful ambient sounds while coloring gorgeous pixel art illustrations. Unlock adorable companions, upgrade magical powers in the Zen Workshop, and collect 62 achievements!

4890230.name: I AM MILK
4890230.short_description: I AM MILK is a surreal, branching audio-first narrative game played through headphones with one button. Make split-second choices as a 21:30 minute story unfolds in real time, leading to more than 40 endings. DARKFIELD’s award-winning 3D sound transports you into the middle of this strange world.

4882590.name: Dino Roars
4882590.short_description: Dinosaurs are the apex predators here - and they are never tamed. Build and raid bases with 100 players on one island, loot monuments on land and underwater, and survive lethal biome weather under a limb-based health system. Everything wipes every 30 days.

4928950.name: BudMageddon Demo
4928950.short_description: Grow a cosmic cannabis empire in this chill pixel-art idle-clicker. Plant, grow, harvest, and automate the farm — then prestige across 10 alien sectors from Earth to Andromeda. Pure number-go-up bliss, with a green thumb. 🌱👽🚀

4045070.name: Oneirium
4045070.short_description: Awaken to a realm where dreams and reality blur beyond recognition. As the Awakened One, you must traverse a haunting world of nightmares and fragmented memories, where nothing is certain and every shadow hides unspeakable truths. Traverse the Dream revealing the nature of existence itself.

4627540.name: Kinetic Conundrum
4627540.short_description: What if Rube Goldberg machine was a game? Kinetic Conundrum is a casual puzzle-platformer where you use a cue ball to wrangle target balls through a puzzle and use physics-inspired machines to overcome obstacles.

4484670.name: KimuNote
4484670.short_description: Everything you need to organize your projects and your life in one place.

5304170.name: Monkey Overdrive
5304170.short_description: They took the bananas. Ram your way back! Charge and ricochet through swarms in Monkey's flying saucer. Mix automatic weapons with tactical gadgets, beat bosses and grab bananas in this single-player roguelike action game. Pick upgrades as you fight, then head to the garage to refit your ride.

5210830.name: The Halloway Haunting
5210830.short_description: A first-person co-op horror game for 1-4 players. Explore six abandoned buildings in the town of Halloway, solve the puzzles that turn their lights back on, and get away from the thing hunting you in the dark. Play online, in splitscreen, or alone.

3119830.name: Chaos Bringer
3119830.short_description: Outsmart foes in fast-paced tactical dungeons, then become a raid leader who stops time to command your party. Explore, craft, and conquer giant bosses single-handedly for the ultimate MMORPG-level satisfaction.

5221200.name: Minefield Mayhem
5221200.short_description: Dodge bullets in this new and exciting take on Minesweeper! Collect a variety of power-ups to even the playing field. Play with your friends in online and local multiplayer. You can even brag to you friends using the game's built-in score sharing features.

4849440.name: Sticky Rooms: A hopeful illusion
4849440.short_description: Furniture comes as stickers, so the order matters and mistakes can’t be undone. Clara has left the office to become an interior designer, with thirty jobs ahead of her and a home of her own to decorate at her pace. A new illusion to live in.

4873550.name: BudMageddon
4873550.short_description: Aliens demanded 3 billion KGs of buds or they vaporize The Earth!  Humanity's last hope is You & weed.  a cozy, pixel-art idle/incremental grower.

4639240.name: Gladiator's Revenge
4639240.short_description: A roguelite where you are the gladiator. Pick one of nine fighters, each with a strength and a weakness. Walk the map, choose your fights and rise from slave to champion. Every win brings a new skill. Buy armor you can see on your fighter, and find 100+ items that change how you fight.

4116640.name: Console War Giant
4116640.short_description: Console War Giant is a turn-based management game that puts you in charge of a young company producing video game consoles! The gaming industry is still in its infancy. A place under the sun is yours to claim!

5285160.name: Silk Collector: Tidy Up the Clothing Store!
5285160.short_description: Silk Collector is a cozy organizing simulator where you shelve 4,012 scattered clothes in a magical fashion house. Shelve the clothes to collect silk, then spend it on spells that speed up the sorting. Keep an eye out for the clothes that wander the store like ghosts.

3927170.name: CH13: Rest Stop
3927170.short_description: CH13: Rest Stop is a psychological horror game set in early 2000s Poland. What begins as a calm drive through the woods turns into something you weren't prepared for... Will you find out what awaits at the end of the road?

4563760.name: Console War Giant Demo
4563760.short_description: Console War Giant is a turn-based management game that puts you in charge of a young company producing video game consoles! The gaming industry is still in its infancy. A place under the sun is yours to claim!

5351000.name: I Just Wanted to Fish Demo
5351000.short_description: A stranger, a fishing rod and an island full of closed paths. Fish, explore and help the townsfolk until every shore is yours to fish.

3937680.name: Arcane Shores
3937680.short_description: Arcane Shores is a city-building strategy game infused with magic. Build, defend, and expand your settlement while casting powerful spells that bend nature, restore what’s broken, and turn the tide against your enemies.

4371150.name: Runeline
4371150.short_description: Design, build, and code a factory within the magical world of Runeline! Work on producing increasingly complex products, which will require you to write not just functional but optimized code, all within the simple instructions of the machine core.

5380750.name: Backpack Ascendancy
5380750.short_description: Backpack Ascendancy is a single-player or 2-player co-op inventory roguelite: fit shaped weapons, armor, and relics into a growing grid, link adjacent items for bonuses, and click to swing each weapon yourself in real-time dungeon fights across six biomes and their bosses.

5304760.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive!
5304760.short_description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

5491450.name: The Small Kingdom
5491450.short_description: A top-down action RPG at insect scale. Lead an ant general through a war over the shards of a fallen star: battle shard-empowered princes, absorb elemental power, and rescue soldiers to fight beside you and workers to rebuild the colony.

4483470.name: Outer Empires 2
4483470.short_description: A top-down space MMO where every action shapes a persistent, player-driven galaxy. Trade, fight, explore, and colonise as you build your empire. Run supply chains, wage faction wars, and customize ships in a living economy driven by real supply and demand.

4748030.name: Fuel Station Simulator Demo
4748030.short_description: Are you ready for a first taste of the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel pumps, your shop, and lay the foundation for everything still to come in the full game…

3541820.name: Galactic Space Guard
3541820.short_description: Galactic Space Guard is a turn-based tactics game. Lead your squad of elite soldiers to defend humanity’s space stations, upgrade your squad, prepare for battle, and restore peace across the galaxy!

4512960.name: Star Raker Demo
4512960.short_description: Welcome to Star Raker, a multiplayer social deduction for 4 to 12 players. Take part in a psychological experiment aboard an evacuation ship. Use logic, communication, and social engineering to save the gene pool or survive the paranoia of hidden betrayal.

5433870.name: 百鬼退散
5433870.short_description: Survive a night of Chinese folklore in Ghosts Before Dawn, a pixel-art survivor-like. Wield auto-casting talismans, flying swords, and spirit-banishing gongs. Combine weapons and the Five Elements, brave haunted villages and ghost markets, then face the final bosses after ten minutes of survival.

5467080.name: 强化之王
5467080.short_description: Run a first-person upgrade shop in Upking. Draw collectibles, take commissions, and chase rare traits with every hammer strike. Play it safe or pay to keep a customer’s masterpiece. One more hit could make your fortune—or shatter it.

4504440.name: Star Raker
4504440.short_description: Welcome to Star Raker, a multiplayer social deduction for 4 to 12 players. Take part in a psychological experiment aboard an evacuation ship. Use logic, communication, and social engineering to save the gene pool or survive the paranoia of hidden betrayal.

5195060.name: Two Ants Demo
5195060.short_description: Two slacker ants, one mysterious ball, and a brutally unforgiving climb. Coordinate your movement, master precise jumps, and drag this thing to the top before your friendship implodes.

4542120.name: Neurospasm
4542120.short_description:
A Weird First Person Roguelike Horde Shooter.
Hook your brain into your computer, dive into a game inside a game, unbox and stack unique items, use up to 6 weapons at once, kill weird fleshy enemies, and uncover why nothing here makes any sense

5392910.name: Twin drive Demo
5392910.short_description: Try Twin Drive for free! Team up online and split one car in half: one player drives the front, the other drives the rear. Stay in sync to steer straight, or fight each other into a screeching donut. Play a free taste of the giant stunt tower and race up to 4 cars to the finish.

5441990.name: Floor Show
