5441990.short_description: Turn-based roguelike on a live TV game show. Hype is your XP. Earn hype for playing to the crowd, take sponsor deals, and face returning rivals made from whatever killed you last time.

4730230.name: Cycle of Echoes
4730230.short_description: Cycle of Echoes is a sci-fi action RPG that blends top-down combat with third-person encounters. Explore hostile worlds, build your arsenal, upgrade your exosuit, and fight through mercenaries, alien creatures, machines, and forgotten ruins in a universe shaped by a dangerous past.

5013540.name: Singularity Echoes Demo
5013540.short_description: Play the opening of Singularity Echoes -- awaken as a hidden machine mind, infiltrate Earth, automate your economy, and declare the Mandate. The demo ends mid-war. The full game continues into space, stellar megastructures, and cycles beyond time.

1736200.name: Sealed Gate
1736200.short_description: Sealed Gate is an exciting pixel 2D MMORPG with a huge world, lots of quests, crafting and social gameplay. Engage in battles with monsters, explore mysterious locations and become the hero of your own fantasy story!

3228900.name: The Kharzov Effect
3228900.short_description:
CHAPTER 1:  1985. Your friend has vanished into Professor Kharzov's fog-filled estate. Stalking monsters.
Escape-room puzzles. Mysterious lore. Now get him out alive.

5068940.name: Swirl Together
5068940.short_description: A mesmerizing cooperative exploration for two to eight people, or a sandbox for one. Explore the colors and motion dynamics, save presets of your favorites to enjoy later and swap with others, and share a canvas with a friend, or a stranger, and make something neither of you could have made alone.

4573960.name: Cauldron: Haunted Harvest
4573960.short_description: Haunted Harvest is a farming spinoff set in the Cauldron universe. Play three evolving minigames, grow some magical crops, and restore a corrupted village to its former glory. If your favorite plant is still an upgrade tree, then grab your watering can and start the harvest!

5239520.name: Cosmic Story
5239520.short_description: Explore the multiverse to keep the peace, serving directly underneath the creator of everything.

5314270.name: Oceans - Survival
5314270.short_description: Oceans - Survival is set in an endless procedurally generated ocean filled with tropical islands to discover and explore. Discover treasure on islands, different flora and fauna and ocean currents that take you anywhere and everywhere.

2268090.name: Pet Dragon Girl 18+ Adult Only Content
2268090.short_description: The DLC contains adult content, that unlocks the entire content of the base game

4912280.name: パトリサイド 体験版
4912280.short_description:
"PATRICIDE" is an adventure RPG about girls who killed their father.
It features a story of love and hate, hybrid action and turn-based combat, and cute anime-style heroines.
Master the "Emotion System" to weaken enemies through empathy, and survive a ruthless, suffocating modern society.

5260180.name: Army Factory Demo
5260180.short_description: Army Factory is an incremental strategy game where you develop a small village into a powerful military settlement. Build and upgrade structures, manage resources, train regiments, and conquer other cities to expand your territory.

5243310.name: Cube Core
5243310.short_description: Get cubes, buy upgrades, push stages. More cubes, more numbers.

5304670.name: Cosmic Story Demo
5304670.short_description: Episode 1 of Cosmic Story, FOR FREE

5472460.name: Silk & Cannons
5472460.short_description: Canton, 1840. One year to build a fortune through maritime trade. Buy where goods are made, sell where they are scarce, arm your ship and face pirates, typhoons and customs officers. Three seas, three eras, a single year to become a legend.

5333220.name: This is Ikebukuro
5333220.short_description: Poop without getting caught!" An absurd stealth comedy in an electronics store! Sneak past staff to drop a load in the target zones and escape undetected. Get caught or leak, and it's game over! Hide in boxes, spray away the stench, and master the art of "Defecate & Escape" to hit high scores!

5456020.name: Sort A Lot - Sheep
5456020.short_description: A cozy first-person sorting game. One big meadow, 2,200 mixed-up sheep, 24 farms around a barn, and a vacuum that sucks sheep in and throws them into the right pen. Read the wool, the brand and the ear tag, fill every pen, and sit on a bench when the rain comes.

4917630.name: ERLIK
4917630.short_description: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.

5237010.name: Supporter Edition
5237010.short_description: Start your double life with a boost in the BLACKWOOD Supporter Edition DLC. Bundle includes: Exclusive Neon Divide Film Outfit for Anton, Spectre Vanguard Handgun, $5000 Dirty Cash, $500 Clean Cash.

4812680.name: Skate Mates Demo
4812680.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls just one skate! Leap over lava, race across icy tundras, ride horses, dodge spinning blades, and even fly on dragons together. Only strong teamwork and great communication will get you safely to the end.

4815010.name: Ladder Lad Demo
4815010.short_description: In a world that has forgotten how to jump, one Lad must rise. Climb, wobble, and bounce your way to new heights in this challenging, 100% ladder-themed precision platformer.

5023190.name: Drunk Woodcutter Demo
5023190.short_description: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

4619720.name: Stacko Demo
4619720.short_description: In Stacko, remember your childhood while earning awesome prizes that change the way you play. Your goal is simple: stack the blocks as high as you can! Earn cards to modify the machine and plushies with powerful bonuses, all while playing this unique twist on the classic arcade experience.

4665000.name: Night Hike Demo
4665000.short_description: Find your way through a dark wilderness in this puzzle roguelite where you assemble the trail. Choose your path, interact with lost souls and navigate obstacles with the spin of your compass to escape the endless night.

4200670.name: Nonolith Demo
4200670.short_description: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

4232900.name: Crusader Kings III: By God Alone
4232900.short_description: Crusader Kings III: By God Alone adds new gameplay options, with a focus on new religious themed content. Watch your characters wrestle with their faith and embrace or oppress heresies as your faith evolves.

4256650.name: Voice of Nature Demo
4256650.short_description: Welcome to Moonspring Vale! Your new life after you got summoned by a little witch girl. Join Adventure Guild, increase adventure rank, raid dungeon, buy abandoned farm, take care of animals, plant some flowers, fruits and veggies! Meet new friends, find love and explore unknown area.

4393280.name: dotAGE: Trade Secrets
4393280.short_description: Village elder, help us! Ride horses, build roads, boats and carts, send pips to explore and trade exotic resources in this new DLC with unique mechanics!

4019900.name: Ashfield Hollow Demo
4019900.short_description: Build a life in the ruins. Ashfield Hollow combines deep survival, real-time combat, farming, crafting, and fishing in a post-apocalyptic world that nearly didn't make it. Ten years after the outbreak, Camp Ashfield is one of the last places left. Whether it stays that way is up to you.

4091970.name: Baballonia
4091970.short_description: Baballonia is a eye/face tracking solution tailored for Social VR. It freely offers expression tracking aimed at platforms such as VRChat, ChilloutVR and Resonite. Baballonia supports a range of devices (official, DIY or third party), and integrates with VRCFaceTracking.

3522340.name: Reality Drift Demo
3522340.short_description: Reality Drift is a strategic roguelike racing game. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades, cards and relics, and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

3558110.name: Appulse Demo
3558110.short_description: An intense top-down shooter roguelite inspired by pinball mechanics. Master every shot with precision in the heat of the battle, and protect your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment and conquer spaceships to win the war!

3601280.name: NTBSS Top Secret Training Set - Season 8 Characters
3601280.short_description: This Training Set allows instant access to the Season 8 characters' Ninjutsu, Secret Techniques, and items normally only available for your avatar at Training Rank 5.

3221200.name: Silicon Wasteland Demo
3221200.short_description: Immerse yourself in this preview of SILICON WASTELAND, a kinetic visual novel set during the twilight years of humanity. Follow the newly awakened android Silica, as she assesses her mysterious circumstances in an abandoned warehouse.

3235860.name: Misspell Demo
3235860.short_description: Misspell is a 2D atmospheric Metroidvania about magic and mysteries of the past. Uncover the secrets of an island risen from the ashes of a catastrophe and master a magical living vine that changes the way you fight and explore. Every step tells a story — every enemy echoes the mistakes of the past.

3245490.name: SlimeVR
3245490.short_description: SlimeVR Server is a companion software for your SlimeVR Full-Body Trackers.

2829200.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - Falcom PACK
2829200.short_description: DJMAX RESPECT V - Falcom PACK! Now enjoy the songs of Falcom in DJMAX RESPECT V.

2654630.name: Soulmask Demo
2654630.short_description: 在经典雨林地图中从抓捕族人到挑战部落首领的前15级核心游戏内容，抓取族人，挑战蛮人营寨与首领。购买《灵魂面甲》完整版后，你的存档文件将会自动继承到完整版。

2656010.name: Dead by Daylight - Chucky Chapter
2656010.short_description: Meet your new best friend ‘til the end. Dead by Daylight: Chucky brings an iconic horror legend into The Fog with a new Killer: The Good Guy - Chucky. Purchasing this add-on unlocks an exclusive Charm: Good Guys Box.

2215322.name: Hello Neighbor 2: Late Fees DLC
2215322.short_description: Have you heard the rumors about the Raven Brooks Library? They say the Librarian there won’t let anyone into the restricted section. Enrich your Hello Neighbor 2 experience with the Hello Neighbor 2: Late Fees DLC!

5421310.name: Wreck &amp; Profit Demo
5421310.short_description: Swing a wrecking ball, knock down buildings, and get paid for every brick. Buy machines that do the swinging for you, sell the company, and take on a bigger city. A short incremental game with real physics & some automation with an actual ending.

1114561.name: TEKKEN 7 - DLC10: Zafina
1114561.short_description: An add-on for TEKKEN 7 that grants use of the character "Zafina."

5491510.name: Million Tiles
5491510.short_description: A quake shook 6,098 glazed tiles loose across an old voxel palace. Pick each one up and set it back on its chalked spot. Earn coins, buy better tools, fire cracked tiles in the kiln and open the palace one room at a time.

4427710.name: Scarlet Trigger
4427710.short_description: Scarlet has had enough of the wolves. Blast through a twisted fairy tale brought to life with rubber-hose animation, bizarre weapons, and fast-paced FPS action. Run, jump, shoot, and leave a trail of very unhappy wolves behind you.

218784.name: Dishonored RHCP DLC Dunwall City Trials

13140.name: America's Army 3
13140.short_description: Download AA3 Today and Become a Member of the elite America's Army Team! America's Army fans and new players alike can now experience America's Army 3, the official U.S. Army game.

4081580.name: Moulder Demo
4081580.short_description: Moulder is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with a focus on boss fights. Master your weapons and command an army of loyal maggots to overwhelm prey much larger than you.

5429440.name: Feed the Front
5429440.short_description: Build the supply lines that keep your guns firing. Feed the Front is a sci-fi RTS where resources and ammunition fly between buildings. Mine small planets, automate logistics, and defend your expanding base against rival commanders and alien bugs.

3159350.name: Match In Peace
3159350.short_description: Match in Peace is a pair-matching real-time roguelike. Monster pairs are hiding inside cursed tombstones, match them to unleash their unique effects. Use special Stone cards, powerful Statues and magical Potions to defeat haunting enemies ahead.

4545700.name: Enjoy Your Stay
4545700.short_description:
Spot surreal and grotesque anomalies to escape a 1960s hotel that refuses to let its guests leave.

Explore hidden liminal spaces, collect strange items, and discover the fates of those who checked in before you.

5398200.name: Shardana Demo
5398200.short_description: Explore an island inspired by ancient Nuragic Sardinia, build your shelter, and survive two nights of terror. The villagers you meet by day could become your worst enemies after sunset. Experience approximately one hour of survival horror, alone or in online co-op with up to 6 players.

5407520.name: Peel The F*king Banana
5407520.short_description: Peel bananas. Increase your count. Climb the leaderboards. Peel The F*king Banana is a game about exactly what it sounds like. Try different banana types and compete for the most bananas peeled overall or by type. Every banana counts.

5036720.name: Railhold
5036720.short_description: Build an armored train and defend it against relentless mutant hordes. Mount turrets, recruit crew and make every stop count in a top-down roguelite tower defense where your base never stops moving.

4406650.name: Rift Fishing Demo
4406650.short_description: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

5241990.name: The Lubs 2: Straw Hats Demo
5241990.short_description: The Lubs 2 : Straw Hats is a 2D action platformer game with RPG factors. Answer the Holy Council's call and fight against Krilton rebellion! The Straw Hats must be paid of their debt and Yunlingen must be in peace again!

5193900.name: NSFWho.exe
5193900.short_description: Take the case. Follow the digital trail. Decide what gets exposed. An adult desktop detective game where you manage investigations, use the terminal, explore RemoteOS computers, and connect evidence hidden in chats, emails, and protected files.

4492680.name: Hibera Requiem for the Forgotten
4492680.short_description: War looms, and your allies need you. Fight your way through strife and turmoil on both sides of a conflict that threatens the continent of Hibera in this Strategy RPG, featuring a sweeping story, memorable characters, classic weapon triangle combat, and stakes with irreversible consequences.

5382720.name: imma peanut
5382720.short_description: You're a peanut in red sneakers with a hungry squirrel on your heels. Jump, double jump, and roll through a chaotic picnic in this 2D endless runner. Collect salt, grab golden peanuts, and chase high scores across two modes and Steam leaderboards.

4157300.name: Farmigos
4157300.short_description: Farmigos is a 1–4 player co-op sim about clueless aliens shipped to Earth to run a farm for a shady corporation. Grow crops, milk cows, craft goods and load orders into the trucks by day – then rebuild, decorate and chill by night. Frantic by day and cozy by night!

5341940.name: You, Me, and a Beautiful Lie -CLASSIC REMASTER-
5341940.short_description: Shintaro is a 20-year-old university student, and Akino is his best friend of the same age. Brought together by their shared love of music, their friendship gradually turns into admiration and obsession. short psychological adventure about friendship, secrets, and a relationship beginning to distort

5348620.name: Mirad
5348620.short_description: Sort thousands of tiny lands in this cozy tidy-up. Each piece rises as real land you can walk on, and every one earns you upgrades.

4551060.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim
4551060.short_description: A turn-based colony sim set on the American frontier from 1607 to 1900, where you guide one family through generations as towns grow, trade routes shift, and historical upheavals reshape the world around you

4512910.name: Hive Striker: Dissonance
4512910.short_description: A post-apocalyptic real-time strategy game. Deploy your mobile base, gather resources, build defenses, and train armies to fight back against The Dissonance - an alien hive consuming the wasteland. Play solo or team up with up to 8 players online.

4920860.name: Treasure Goblins
4920860.short_description: Grab treasure and be quiet! Treasure Goblins is a chaotic party heist game where Goblin players try to score as much treasure as they can while hunted by blind Croks. They may be blind...but they can DEFINITELY hear you. Make plays for the valuable noisy loot, or go super slow and play it safe.

5028260.name: Phase Sync
5028260.short_description: Control two characters with one move. Guide Wanderer and Echo through different walls while keeping them within reach of their tether. Solve 60 puzzles across four worlds, then take on 60 Challenge Mode levels with separate exits.

4502580.name: StalSide Demo
4502580.short_description: Trapped inside a broken computer simulation of a post‑nuclear world, you must survive, explore, and uncover the secrets of the zone. Play solo or with up to 8 friends in this chilling mix of survival and digital mystery.

4625620.name: Football On Paper
4625620.short_description: A simultaneous turn-based football game. You talk big. Draw the next minute. Watch your boys run it. Every tackle, shot and save is a d20 roll. Guess what the other manager will do, because they are guessing you.

4874310.name: Oreship Stellar Frontier
4874310.short_description: Start as a manager, in the solar system, or on Mars. Build your business, pilot spaceships, and explore Mars on foot or in vehicles. Mine, trade, research, and furnish your home. Economic management and idle progression meet hands-on exploration.

5292060.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy Demo
5292060.short_description: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is a human made top-down action-adventure game where you explore dungeons, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. Complete the initial dungeons to unlock the final one. Can you find everything? This demo includes 2 dungeons.

3953510.name: Site61
3953510.short_description: Site61 is a side-view tower defense game where you build defenses with towers of different shapes, then change how they work through wired module combos. Control a drone, fight alongside your defenses, repel endless monster waves, and adapt to shifting spatial rules and unknown anomalies.

3860760.name: One Week Away
3860760.short_description: A story driven kinetic adult visual novel with choice based Gentleman and Dominant personality paths. Shape dialogue and intimate scenes across 8 days, decide the pregnancy outcome, and earn one of two complete endings.

5196730.name: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy
5196730.short_description: Eldwyn's Dungeon Academy is a human made top-down action-adventure game where you explore magical dungeons, fight monsters, overcome traps, solve puzzles, and find hidden treasures. What grade will you get?

5316900.name: TownEmpire
5316900.short_description: Build and automate your city, manage resources, production, agriculture, industry, and trade in a strategy and simulation game focused on efficiency and economic growth.

3049140.name: Choice of Life: Modern Ages
3049140.short_description: Succeed in the modern world and know the value of your decisions. All or nothing!

3914830.name: Compromised
3914830.short_description: You're alone in a house that won't stay secure for long. Lights change, defenses fail, and someone is watching from outside. Manage your resources and survive the night. Just because you can't see anything doesn't mean something isn't already inside.

5205250.name: Desktop Gym Girl
5205250.short_description: Workout, stream, and get ripped! Desktop Gym Girl is an incremental desktop companion who gets stronger the longer she's online!

3911940.name: Elemency Island Demo
3911940.short_description:
Elemency Island is a cozy farm and automation game in coop multiplayer.
Plant, raise animals, sell your ressources to unlock technologies and automate your entire farm.
Alone, or with your friends, come discover this island full of surprises and unknown creatures.

5269490.name: Coup de Grass Demo
5269490.short_description: Demo version of Coup de Grass. Start with a single sickle and a small field. Cut and sell grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

5486380.name: Taenera's Offer
5486380.short_description: A sci-fi extraction shooter on a dying desert planet. Scavenge weapons, supplies and valuables, take risky contracts, and fight your way to extraction. Use precise aiming, acrobatic dodges and physics-driven tricks to survive — and earn enough to escape.

4624680.name: Secret House
4624680.short_description: A choice-driven adult visual novel with high-quality 3D graphics where you are trapped in a house with two attractive women due to a quarantine. Manage the rising tension, alter the story's course with critical decisions, and explore hidden desires in this isolated home.

5364950.name: Death Lies East
5364950.short_description: A cozy grinder that offers countless hours of gameplay and more challenges as you progress. Minimal story and no turn-based combat means quick and rewarding gameplay as you watch those numbers go up and up. How far will you go to save this world?

5290110.name: Project Overboard
5290110.short_description: Design a cruise ship deck by deck, hire the crew and take paying guests out to sea. Keep them fed, entertained and away from reception while the buffet runs low, the lifts back up and somebody does something in the pool.

3994950.name: Jokano
3994950.short_description: Jokano is the card-based roguelike adventure set in colorful pixel art worlds! Collect rocket parts, play against FranKI, use 48 joker cards, multipliers, and a hit point system. Every round is different, every round is addictive. Are you ready?

4342860.name: Stellar Freight: Endless Horizon Demo
4342860.short_description: A space adventure in the turn-based RPG genre with roguelike elements. Become a Captain of a freight ship, deliver cargo through deep space, manage your crew, upgrade your ship, fight space warships, and build your reputation. Every day brings new adventure. Space shows no mercy.

4905030.name: Market Panic
4905030.short_description: Market Panic is a turn-based portfolio roguelite about surviving economic chaos. Build a fund across public markets, private equity and crypto, and read the companies inside it. Answer to clients who can leave, rivals who want them, and a committee that comes looking for you.

5441480.name: APEX: Black Monday
5441480.short_description: A turn-based Wall Street trading sim, played at a 1985 terminal. Trade, short, corner commodities and take boardrooms to bring down APEX Holdings, a rival bound by the same rules you are. Win clean, or buy the regulator and live with the file. One global ledger that never resets.

5441530.name: APEX: Black Monday Demo
5441530.short_description: Free demo of a turn-based Wall Street trading sim, played at a 1985 terminal. Trade and short through Two Weeks to Black Monday, earn your book in Act I of the campaign, and race the whole world on the Daily Tape. The full game adds the decade-long war against APEX Holdings.

3861910.name: Kraken's Bar
3861910.short_description: Place your cards, pass your hand, and pray you’re not the one who drinks. A 4-player online party game of rotating hands, cursed drinks, and ruthless eliminations.

5371290.name: Echoes of Calir
5371290.short_description: Echoes of Calir is a turn-based 1v1 mix of chess, a TCG and a board game on an 8×8 board. Build a deck of five units and five terrain cards, place them before battle, and outmaneuver your opponent through movement, abilities, and captures. Chess rules with the strategic depth of a TCG.

5479970.name: Miredrift Demo
5479970.short_description: Play the opening chapter of Miredrift. Take your battered boat into a flooded, mutating swamp, follow a voice on the radio and fight the creatures that hunt the mire in packs. Three story quests, a side quest and a boss fight await.

5412610.name: THE NOM MUST BE FED Demo

5106490.name: Her Milk, My Coffee
5106490.short_description: The tastiest coffee is made with milk. Or, more precisely, with her milk... Brew coffee, add all kinds of ingredients, serve it to cats, and make money. And you are going to need a lot of money, because you will be spending it all on gifts to take the cow girl on dates.

5431660.name: I, Hurricane
5431660.short_description: You are the hurricane. I, Hurricane is a strategy and simulation game with a satirical climate twist: spawn storms across three oceans, steer them toward the coast and make them stronger every season, while humanity prepares, evacuates and promises to act "by 2050." Can you reach 500 km/h?

5051080.name: We Steal From Old People: The Game
5051080.short_description: Beat swarms of old people and take their bricks in this action roguelike. Rip them from their disgusting old hands. You need bricks. You need all the bricks for yourself because you’re a slimy little brick weasel. You are like a brick vampire and bricks are the blood you need!

4768380.name: Demra: Rifts of War Demo
4768380.short_description: Real-time strategy in the spirit of the 90s classics, with a twist of its own. Build your base, seize mines and lead your army with a spell-casting hero against a demon invasion – or command the demons yourself. 15-mission campaign, skirmish and online multiplayer.

4637710.name: Binary Proof
4637710.short_description: Test Specialist Aaron Blonde finds himself in the midst of uncanny and strange events during a routine workday. In this facility where the boundaries of logic are pushed, he must use every detail of his environment to his advantage and overcome the obstacles to escape as soon as possible.

5467880.name: FrankenCars
5467880.short_description: Build ridiculous cars from mismatched parts, test them in drag races and long jumps, then sell your creations to fund the next disaster! FrankenCars is a lighthearted car-building tycoon where clever upgrades and terrible engineering go hand in hand.

4595460.name: Make the World Great Again
4595460.short_description:
Infiltrate a private island where the elite meet, and every room, every piece of paper and every locked cabin hides something or someone they paid a great deal to bury.

Uncover every secret and escape before they catch you.

2294430.name: The Fabric of the Mind
2294430.short_description: The Fabric of the Mind is a fast, atmospheric platformer focused on fluid wall-walking movement, environmental puzzles, and an interconnected world where you uncover a dark, optional story through exploration and environment-driven gameplay.

4903300.name: Realm Tycoons
4903300.short_description: Realm Tycoons is a turn-based fantasy strategy board game where rival rulers claim realms, build economies, grow armies, cast spells, upgrade strongholds, and battle in real-time 3D fights for control of the kingdom.

4687460.name: Bound Together
4687460.short_description: In this 2.5D fantasy adventure blending action exploration, base building, and defense, play as a magical girl in a gravity-twisted world. Explore the unknown alongside your spirit cat companion, unlock new abilities, build and upgrade defenses, and reunite with your lost friend.

5151850.name: Boss Toss
5151850.short_description: Deflect the ball launched by the boss, pass it to a friend, then smash it right back into the boss! The more you pass the ball, the faster it gets—and the fight descends into chaos. Hit the boss. Not your friends.

5322120.name: Hunk Expeditions
5322120.short_description: Build a party of handsome heroes and journey across worlds in an adult RPG with male romance, a fully voiced main story, and automated battles. Find your favourite men, shape your team, and turn the tide with battle skills. All summons use earned gold.

2335500.name: Pogona
2335500.short_description: Spit your scales. Build your path. Master every challenge. Pogona is a challenging hand-drawn 2D metroidvania starring a tiny lizard who turns her own scales into platforms and weapons. Master a rewarding movement system, unlock ancient powers, and conquer a world full of secrets.

3827150.name: Quick Translate Engine
3827150.short_description: Whether you instantly translate a movie subtitle, chat with foreign teammates in a game, or understand text in an image. Quick Translate Engine removes any barrier on your screen with a single key.

5125790.name: Puzzles Are Better Together
5125790.short_description: Puzzles Are Better Together is a cozy 3D jigsaw escape you can enjoy solo or with friends in online co-op. Slow down, lose yourself in beautiful high-resolution artwork, and let calming music, satisfying piece placement, and shared moments turn every puzzle into time well spent.

4389770.name: Deep Breach
4389770.short_description: Fight relentless alien swarms in a top-down action roguelike that blends intense shooting with tower defense. Customize weapons, assemble deadly turrets, unlock HELIOS technology, and push through enemy lines to destroy the alien core.

4738820.name: Farlane
4738820.short_description: Command a Nomad-class Frontier Runner and lead your crew on the edge of a fading galactic empire. Take on freelance contracts, explore unstable farlanes, upgrade your ship, and survive where civilization ends.

5058430.name: Theoria: A God Simulator
5058430.short_description: A Godsimulator without limits. Throw buildings with your bare hand, burn nations down with meteors, or possess a peasant and walk through the war you started.

5284180.name: SUPRA CAELIS
5284180.short_description:
Crash-landed on an alien world, fleeing a war you no longer believe in. You'll have to cross two planets on opposite ends of existence, guided by a dormant robot carrying secrets of its own.

Explore. Scavenge. Uncover the truth behind the conflict that shaped both your fates.

5412470.name: Stellmoor Stables: A Cozy Horse Breeding & Racing Sim
5412470.short_description: Raise your horses on a small farm in Stellmoor. You don't ride: you train them and guide your jockey with tactical cards. Fired for pulling an injured mare from a race, all you have left is Ember. Beat your old boss at the National Cup. Play solo or in online co-op for up to 4 players.

2152500.name: Dig In
2152500.short_description: A WW1 trench warfare colony sim where you build an evolving trench network with layered defenses, manage soldiers under pressure while holding a fragile sector of the front in real-time tactical battles.

4754730.name: Cypris
4754730.short_description:
Cypris is a dark, erotic kinetic novel centered on corruption, mind control, and forbidden desire.

You are brilliant psychologist carrying a ancient divine power that slowly warps the minds and bodies of women around you, turning them into devoted, lust-filled slaves to your will.

5073730.name: Clean Co.
5073730.short_description: Clean windows, earn money and try not to get fired! Clean Co. is a chaotic arcade window cleaning game where you battle an endless flood of dirty windows alone or with two friends in a roguelike race against the clock.

5330340.name: Bunny Coming
5330340.short_description: A visual novel featuring the bunny maid Luna Minase, brought to life with smooth Live2D animation. Enjoy conversations, cute moments, and a variety of slightly spicy situations together.

5353300.name: Dice Mafia
5353300.short_description: A debunker with two million subscribers takes a seat at the table where the fate of the world is settled with dice. 18 powers, five at the table, 12 bosses, online duels. Chance is theatre: learn to rig yours. Premium, no ads, no in-app purchases.

5424890.name: Backrooms: 1977
5424890.short_description: This is a video game based on the Backrooms mythos, but detached from its lore in order to tell an original story. The game features varied gameplay sections with different creatures and a narrative-focused approach to set itself apart from other games based on these places.

4324940.name: Fartimus!
4324940.short_description: Use your voice to defeat enemy wizards in this online PVP Spell Casting Duel!

5440770.name: Broken Contract
5440770.short_description: You and up to seven colleagues are robots with human souls, sent into haunted sites to haul out what the Company wants. Everyone secretly signs a different contract, blind. You need each other to get home. Someone may be working against you.

5465720.name: Femboy Futa Monster Girls Soundtrack
5465720.short_description: Revisit the world of Femboy Futa Monster Girls with 16 tracks by Hellim Studios. Enjoy the game's music in 320 kbps MP3 and support the developer while adding its melodies to your collection.

3557130.name: Rise of the Inferno
3557130.short_description: Rise of the Inferno is a 2-D story-based RPG where two best friends are tasked with teleporting across different worlds to save their beloved kingdom. Join Albert and John on their grand adventure as they fight the evil forces of the Inferno pursuant on destroying their world.

4013800.name: Valmora
4013800.short_description: Valmora is a dark fantasy third person action RPG where you hunt brutal creatures, take dangerous contracts, loot and craft gear, and recruit companions through a world shaped by slavery and desire as you carve your own path.

5476090.name: Cardmarch
5476090.short_description: Build your deck, move animal allies across a tactical board, and break through enemy lines. Unlock six heroes with personal stories, cast spells and face bosses across six regions in this single-player card battler. Storybook artwork draws on the look of classic 1990s animation.

3985720.name: ChickOut!
3985720.short_description: Chickout is a co-op puzzle platformer for 2-6 players, playable locally or online! Team up as cute chicks, overcome obstacles, and enjoy chaotic fun together.

4501150.name: Backtrace: Mechanisms for Forgetting
4501150.short_description: Backtrace is a yuri mystery and puzzle game set inside a retro computer. Log on night after night to uncover a story of internet exploits and unexpected friendships with a crew of 80s hackers. Solve 2D grid-based puzzles to piece together the mystery.

5266770.name: Space Rocketman
5266770.short_description: Strap on a rocket pack and thread an endless field of orbital wreckage. Master momentum, manage fuel, chase risky salvage, upgrade your rig, and push your best distance farther with every run.

5451550.name: Skyworks
5451550.short_description: Build a little factory above the clouds. Connect conveyors, configure machines and turn everyday materials into finished products. Start your factory, follow every step, and refine your layout to earn three stars in a cozy collection of automation puzzles.

5039650.name: Nightwire
5039650.short_description: Wire up a data-theft rig, launder stolen bytes on a live black market, and climb the netrunner underworld one burned identity at a time — until a ghost of who you used to be logs on, learns how you fight, and comes for the only chair that fits one of you.

3596870.name: Sakura Hime 7
3596870.short_description: In a paradise of blooming cherry blossoms, catgirls, witches, and elves gather around you. Share sweet everyday moments with them and build a lavish harem all your own.

4492010.name: Ravenfall - Horse Game
4492010.short_description: Begin a new chapter on Ravenfall. Learn to ride, build trust with horses and enter competitions to earn the locals’ respect. As your reputation grows, new places, conversations and clues open up, drawing you deeper into the secrets of Willowfield Ranch and Ravenfall’s past.

5163000.name: Object 24
5163000.short_description: A psychological horror game set in a Soviet apartment. By day, explore your home, search for clues, uncover secrets and perform rituals. At night, it becomes a trap — hide, use the environment and defend yourself with whatever you can find. Survive the night and remember what you tried to forget.

5230500.name: TALLY
5230500.short_description: A horror clicker set inside a census ledger. It's 1847, and the Vestry pays you a penny for every person you write into the book. Beside your count sits a second number: the clicks the room has heard. It is always a little higher.

5451300.name: Wheel of Growth
5451300.short_description: Wheel of Growth is a chance based incremental game about spinning a wheel to earn cash, and then upgrading the wheel to earn bigger.

3675870.name: Ray's Hotel Adventures
3675870.short_description: Use your handy Ghost Catcher to capture ghosts, solve puzzles, and stop the horny ghost girls that have been causing some trouble

4659460.name: SALMON
4659460.short_description: You are a salmon, performing platforming that feels satisfying and ridiculous. Jump off walls, race against your friends, explore the strange world. Most people don't realise how athletic salmon can be.

4824580.name: Deep Space Miner Demo
4824580.short_description: Mine alien ore, build specialized drones, process resources, discover new worlds, defeat giant ore bosses, and prestige for permanent upgrades in this incremental mining game.

3547140.name: Victory Acres
3547140.short_description: Build a thriving farm, supply your homeland with crops,  and turn every harvest into the strength needed to win the war.

4758180.name: Zap & Andy: Go to HELL! Demo
4758180.short_description: A fully animated 2D gay NSFW point-and-click adventure inspired by classic genre titles! Help Zap the angel and Andy the demon make up for their lost teenage years as they try to escape from Hell—without succumbing to the many, many horny (and horned) temptations that stand between them and freedom.

5314730.name: Maiden of the Trench
5314730.short_description: Follow Alyssa Harper and choose her path through the battered trench lines of France in 1914. In this gritty, fully-voiced visual novel you will decide where she goes and the consequences that follow.

5460240.name: Table Tennis Manager 27
5460240.short_description: A table tennis management game. Take a small club from the bottom of the league to a world title: run the league team that pays the bills and the players chasing the World Tour, read every match stroke by stroke, and raise a fifteen-year-old into a world champion.

5466400.name: Sports Founder
5466400.short_description: Sports Founder is a turn-based strategy game where you invent a sport and grow it from a backyard game into a global obsession. Write the rules, spread it around the world, run the flagship league and outmaneuver the established sports, who won't give up their fans without a fight.

5448970.name: Log to Lodge: Carpentry Simulator
5448970.short_description: Turn a single tree into a whole house. Log to Lodge is a cozy carpentry business sim: fell trees, saw and plane your own planks, then build furniture for customer orders and grow your workshop.

5323160.name: Clown Around Demo
5323160.short_description: You are a clown! Clown Around is an immersive sim FPS where your job is to explore large open levels to identify and prank targets working to rid the world of fun. Choose your loadout from an arsenal of wacky clown tools and insane perks that wildly change your playstyle. How you play is up to you!

5455170.name: Candy Factory Demo
5455170.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

5306810.name: Just Kukuruza
5306810.short_description: That corn isn't going to shell itself. Tackle 1.000.000 ears on a Soviet-era farm. Start with hand tools, hire workers, operate an excavator, and build conveyor lines that turn a mountain of corn into truckloads of profit. Build your own way, one sack at a time.

5200400.name: Meat Safari
5200400.short_description: Meat Safari is a multiplayer open-world restaurant simulator! Hunt ingredients, cook meat, stack cargo, and race across Meat World solo or in 4-player online co-op. Choose your driver and vehicle, and get out on the safarI!

4912390.name: Battle Quads
4912390.short_description: Command a squad of six specialists in explosive 4v4 multiplayer battles. Make real-time tactical decisions as a commander, or take direct control of any specialist at critical moments.

5386270.name: Battle Quads Demo
5386270.short_description: Command a squad of six specialists in explosive 4v4 multiplayer battles. Make real-time tactical decisions as a commander, or take direct control of any specialist at critical moments.

5346890.name: Fleshbound Demo
5346890.short_description: Experience the opening chapter of FLESHBOUND in this atmospheric first-person horror demo. Explore a mysterious house during a violent storm and uncover the first signs of its dark secret.

3196150.name: Lami: A Cup of Code and Coffee
3196150.short_description: Inherit your grandpa’s old café and meet Lami, an adorable robot girl! Craft gadgets, upgrade your café, serve customers, and face unexpected challenges as you uncover the story behind Lami.

5193280.name: Offering Accepted
5193280.short_description: You signed her contract. Now you press the button, forever. Every press fills the bar, every full bar drops chests, every chest spills cursed relics, and every relic makes the next press worth more. Fair trade?

3502200.name: NET.CRAWL Demo
3502200.short_description:
NET.CRAWL is a grid-building roguelike about a White Rabbit trapped in an unfriendly cyberspace. Dive deep into a bizarre digital world where levels are built with the nodes you drafted.
Short runs, satisfying combos, dozens of unique bosses, and a ton of replayability.

5295180.name: CENTAVO
5295180.short_description: A city sim where money never comes from nowhere. Tens of thousands of residents, each with a name, a job and a pocket. You lay the streets, zone and set taxes; they buy the lots, open businesses and leave if work or food runs out. Grow a camp into a metropolis.

5438430.name: Horizon of Steel
5438430.short_description: An idle ARPG. You build a combat Frame on an 880-node grid with 267 skills and 438 affixes, set how it fights, and send it into Journeys that play out on their own. Watch a run live, replay it exactly, or close the game and let it catch up.

5429460.name: Miredrift
5429460.short_description: A year after a bio-engineered organism drowned the world in mutation, an infected ex-captain steers his battered boat into a flooded, hand-painted swamp to find his lost family. Explore, scavenge fuel, and fight the twisted creatures of the mire, before the infection takes you too.

4110830.name: Material Maker
4110830.short_description: Create procedural materials and texture 3D models with node-based graphs. Export to Godot, Unity, and Unreal Engine, and access a website with hundreds of community-made materials. Runs on Windows, Linux, and macOS.

3578080.name: Wee Boats
3578080.short_description:
The chill multiplayer boaty honk game! 
Explore with your friends as miniature boats in this lil nautical adventure!

4225460.name: Astromine Demo
4225460.short_description: Astromine is a survival mining game about scavenging fully destructible planets. Designed for 1 to 4 players. Land on planets and gather enough materials to fight off alien creatures, fight robot factions, build structures and spaceships, and conquer the solar system

1520340.name: Astario
1520340.short_description:
Astario is a universe in which you can build functional ships and orbital stations with automated factories.
Collect materials, craft new blocks, and expand into the universe.
Nothing is ever truly static, ships, stations, asteroids, planets, everything follows the laws of orbital motion.

4695040.name: Gym Bros: LooksMaxx
4695040.short_description: Get swol, race to the mirror, and strike ridiculous poses for 'Looks' in this multiplayer social VR party game. Run, climb, grab, gesture and flex your way around the gym, compete with friends, customize your bro, and become the ultimate giga-chad. Do it. We believe in you.

2747670.name: Once Upon a Fight
2747670.short_description: The story of your journey has begun to be written. Choose from a variety of different characters, each with unique abilities, in this chaotic multiplayer party game set in magical and fantastical lands. Whether alone or with allies, carve your name in history for eternity in Once Upon a Fight!

4918810.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus
4918810.short_description: Smash piñatas, collect candy, run the show! A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!

4114100.name: Inkblood
4114100.short_description: You're an Inquisitor following a trail of death. A cult is at work, your predecessor has vanished, and the region teeters on the edge of chaos. Find the truth. Uphold the Inquisition. Do not fail.

4155060.name: Heroes of Brihn
4155060.short_description:
Heroes of Brihn is a 2D role-playing adventure, utilizing turn-based combat. 
Play as the current hero's party and uncover the world's story.
Fight monsters and travel the Kingdom of Brihn.

5072580.name: Courage and Faith: Into the Dark Woods
5072580.short_description: A dark, atmospheric party-based RPG where you form an expedition, make difficult choices, manage tension, and fight tactical turn-based battles. AI-generated narration reacts to your decisions, making each journey into the forest feel distinct.

5433990.name: Wakefolk
5433990.short_description: Wakefolk is a zombie survival colony sim. Guide three survivors through gathering, crafting and construction, explore a fog-covered world, and prepare guards, barricades and alarms against zombies. Your rules shape their daily lives and their chances of reaching dawn.

4740930.name: Legend of Defenders
4740930.short_description: A thrilling idle tower defense game with automated battles and endless growth, and enjoy a pure single-player experience with zero in-app purchases! Build your defenses, deploy heroes, and watch your fortress evolve from a humble outpost into an unstoppable stronghold—even while you’re away.

5360250.name: DeskFolders
5360250.short_description: Group your desktop icons into folders, just like on your phone. Click a folder and the screen softly blurs as it springs open. Crystal and frosted glass styles, animated wallpaper see-through, auto-organize, and a clean uninstall that puts every file back.

1549460.name: [Neolithic]To the End Freedom
1549460.short_description:
A modern-day open-world RPG about a secret world. With the help of your companions, some demons, some cats, and any supernatural entities you can bend to your will, all the different ways to solve problems, you may still fail to save the world. Life is simply unfair.
But, will you stop trying?

5230300.name: PyPuck Demo
5230300.short_description: A hockey ecosystem simulator built for analysis. Draft prospects, manage assets, make trades, track careers, and watch franchises rise and fall across decades. Sim a hockey season in under a minute, or dive into the data and analyse details. Play your way and skip anything you don't care about.

5149950.name: PROTOCOL: NOAH
5149950.short_description:
SINEN STUDIO presents PROTOCOL: NOAH, its first despair-filled fantasy. As a “Tuner,” command girls in battle and tend to their bodies and minds. A story-driven adventure set around Academy City Ark, where girls fight Phantoms.
“Beyond the cycle of death lies hope—but for whom?”

5189500.name: A Place for Every Potion
5189500.short_description: A cozy potion-sorting puzzle game. Pour scrambled liquids until every bottle runs pure, then shelve each one where it belongs. Fill 4,160 potions across 52 shelves. No timers, no fail state, no rush.

5322900.name: Local Game Store Simulator
5322900.short_description: Run your own local game store. Buy wholesale, crack packs, grade chase cards, haggle over trade-ins and price against a live economy. Play solo, co-op or as rival stores. Change the rules of every game, and build your own cards, packs, games and consoles to sell and share on Steam Workshop.

2873070.name: Endless Tactics
2873070.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelite about defending a planetary mining expedition, upgrading your starship, and extracting before alien hordes overrun you.

4816860.name: Skuffle
4816860.short_description: 4-player splitscreen online party shooter. Couch and online players in the same match. Maps, Modes, Skins, Monkeys, Guns, Cigarettes! Oh My! WHAT ELSE DO YOU PEOPLE WANT?

3309160.name: Chronocracy
3309160.short_description: Build a unique civilization in a flat world! Explore, extract resources, expand, and battle enemies. Use your time management skills to fend off attacks and face a mysterious threat. Are you ready to create a world that can survive?

4561330.name: Back For Loot
4561330.short_description: Smack bosses for gold, buy permanent upgrades, and push further with every run in this incremental roguelite. Lead four unlikely heroes through a fantasy kingdom that can't let anything end. Your party wants out. Your next upgrade says otherwise.

5391680.name: Windowed Realms Demo
5391680.short_description: A cozy desktop companion that turns your computer into interactive islands. Manage units, collect resources, and craft in transparent windows while you work or relax.

5475240.name: RIFTGROVE
5475240.short_description: Explore a shifting fantasy world in Riftgrove, a 3D action RPG featuring four playable classes, fast-paced combat, procedurally generated wilderness, dangerous dungeons, rare relics, and powerful Champions. Return to Haven, take guild contracts, and venture through the next portal.

5288620.name: Kiss Me on the Oligarch's Dime
5288620.short_description: Debt-ridden wedding producer Luka returns to the Adriatic town he fled to stage a secretive oligarch wedding. Over six closed days, choose one of three romance routes: a runaway pop-star bride, the dressmaker he abandoned, or a furious local organizer.

4488770.name: Vaultbreakers Demo
4488770.short_description: Vaultbreakers is a top-down Extraction RPG where you go on PvE or PvPvE adventures. Build your haven, loot ancient artifacts that shape your playstyle, and explore a vast, corrupted world, alone or with friends. Use preparation, knowledge, and skills to clear your path to the Dragonvault.

5078910.name: Wanderbound
5078910.short_description: Leave the beaten path and set off into a cozy world that builds itself as you explore it. Create, observe, catch, gather, camp and climb your way through the seasons.

5140780.name: Protos. Neural Collapse
5140780.short_description: Pilot and customize your combat spacecraft in a fast-paced, third-person 6DOF sci-fi shooter. Battle enemy fighters and turrets across alien planets, tunnels, and open space. Upgrade your weapons, adapt to changing flight physics, and uncover the story.

4097860.name: Imagine Wind
4097860.short_description: Imagine Wind - an atmospheric first-person adventure about exploring the underground world beneath Antarctica. Gather resources, set up camp, study amber artifacts, and uncover the mystery of your own memory.

4428340.name: WheelMates - Friend's Pass
4428340.short_description: Grab a friend and race into a co-op driving adventure as two tiny RC cars. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles across oversized locations, find hidden paths, and uncover what really happened inside.

4653390.name: Deep Space Miner
4653390.short_description: Mine alien ore, build specialized drones, process resources, discover new worlds, defeat giant ore bosses, and prestige for permanent upgrades in this incremental mining game.

4716340.name: Hadamantia: Polychromatic Kingdom
4716340.short_description:
Someone has stolen your precious family heirloom!
The culprit is that hooded figure trying to get away in the distance!
You must recover the family heirloom at all costs!

5346550.name: Remnants of the forsaken Past : Submerged Fantasy Demo

4878890.name: Factory Shift
4878890.short_description: 《Factory Shift》is a first-person assembly-line factory simulator for 1–4 players. Rush to fill orders, fix breakdowns, and fight off mutated objects. Keep the production line running through one disaster after another—and clean up each other’s messes

4727050.name: 全裸豸戦 ～BEAST PARADIGM～
4727050.short_description:
"Zenra-Taisen"is a twin-stick shooting + visual novel game set in a country inhabited solely by male beastmen.
You progress through the story by reading the visual novel part,
while simultaneously advancing through the battle part (twin-stick shooting) of each stage.

5028570.name: HARP Playtest
5028570.short_description: Real-time conquest strategy on a real-world globe. Start as a single nation, expand province by province, build your industry, command land, air and naval forces, forge alliances and break them. Play against AI rivals or with friends.

5260030.name: Make Landfall in Me
5260030.short_description: In a midlands town that remembers every promise, one project manager finds three very different women—and three very different ways to stay. In this adult romance visual novel, your choices steer Malachy toward one of three women who each hold a different part of the town’s autumn.

5448620.name: Super Pilot Yolk Bot Demo
5448620.short_description: Smash through relentless waves of enemies as a high-speed Float Bot! Build momentum, grab upgrades, and push your luck for bigger rewards. Extract in time or lose it all as you chase powerful builds and stronger bots.

3981880.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - One Box
3981880.short_description: One Box is a 2D platformer game where you control a character who can spawn a box anywhere they choose.

5201910.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - Dungeon & Fighter PACK
5201910.short_description: DJMAX RESPECT V - Dungeon & Fighter PACK! Now enjoy the songs of Dungeon & Fighter in DJMAX RESPECT V.

5333650.name: Salt and Soil: A Frontier Family Sim Demo
5333650.short_description: A turn-based colony sim set on the American frontier from 1607 to 1900, where you guide one family through generations as towns grow, trade routes shift, and historical upheavals reshape the world around you

5124070.name: GnomeBoozled Demo
5124070.short_description: Run an illegal gnome disposal business from your backyard. Build absurd traps and conveyor systems to maximize profit, and stop gnomes from sabotaging your shady operation before the whole neighborhood falls into chaos.

5143220.name: How to grow a man Demo
5143220.short_description: A 17+ BL raising sim where you decide who leads. Spend four years on classes, part-time jobs, and questionable outfits, then romance seven very different men. Your stats determine whether you end up on top or bottom, and your choices unlock dozens of endings.

4535510.name: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis - Extra Pack feat. HARDCORE TANO*C BGM
4535510.short_description: Extra Song Pack feat. HARDCORE TANO*C BGM ! Grants access to 6 songs, including "Observing Glitch “YUN-YUN” and more.

4744690.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY V PACK
4744690.short_description: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY V PACK!! Meet the 'V Original Music' package now!

4745120.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY V Original Soundtrack
4745120.short_description: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY V Original Soundtrack

4253670.name: STARDUST: Wish of Witch Demo
4253670.short_description: STARDUST: Wish of Witch is a single-player SRPG beautifully crafted in pixel art. Follow the secret of the wish-granting star and join the adventure of the girl “Star” and the mage “Yu”.

3982220.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - PixelNautHero
3982220.short_description: PixelNaut is a 2D side-scrolling platformer game. The game features a minimalist, pixel-art aesthetic with a black, white, and gray color palette, set in a space-themed environment.

4077430.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY IV PACK
4077430.short_description: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY IV PACK!! Meet the 'V Original Music' package now!

4099310.name: Project N.E.K.O.
4099310.short_description: An AI soulmate who watches, reads, listens, and plays by your side—with human-like memory and feelings that live in her bones. From desktop to pocket, from late-night games to lazy-scrolling feed, she slips across every screen to find you, keeping every story you've shared tucked close to her heart.

3680800.name: Mushroom Musume Soundtrack
3680800.short_description: Get into a damp mood with the Mushroom Musume Official Sound Track, featuring three disc's of beautiful original compositions. With a total of 98 tracks, this OST offers over four and a half hours of music!

3402690.name: Dragon Spot Demo
3402690.short_description: Who loves dragons?! 🐉 This is a meditative strategy game about creating dragon islands without timers or stress. Just build and watch as the inhabitants raise their toothy pets.

3418380.name: A Nights Haunting: Source
3418380.short_description: A Nights Haunting: Source is an early access mod development enveloping the source engine community in an exciting approach to FPS game play.

3117510.name: Monster Hunter Wilds - Alma Outfit: Scrivener's Coat
3117510.short_description: With this outfit, Alma can wear her prologue outfit throughout the game.

3371100.name: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY II Original Soundtrack
3371100.short_description: DJMAX RESPECT V - V LIBERTY II Original Soundtrack

4609640.name: Wayward Crown
4609640.short_description: You don't command the heroes — you bait them. Wayward Crown is a kingdom-management sim where every adventurer has their own greed, glory, and fear. Place bounties, build a town, balance the gold, and watch your realm run itself.

2649160.name: ALYSSA - Demo
2649160.short_description: From the creator of Don't Be Afraid. You are a little girl trapped inside a nightmarish mansion, where twisted residents and dark secrets hide behind every closed door. Explore and uncover the beginning of Alyssa's story in this demo.

2841870.name: Preserve Demo
2841870.short_description: Preserve is a relaxing puzzle nature-building game in which you flourish a vibrant ecosystem by cleverly placing plants and animals to create a perfect symbiosis to your liking.

4948660.name: You Call Yourself a Wizard?!
4948660.short_description: You Call Yourself a Wizard?!™ is a mouse-only platformer where you play as the last wizard alive... a foul-mouthed layabout who's not the sharpest tool in the shed. And now you've really done it—you've triggered the apocalypse. Can you redeem yourself and save the world?

2088782.name: Little Nightmares III - The Shores
2088782.short_description: Low and Alone traveled through the mirror and reached the Shores and its lighthouse. To reach it through the flood waters, they'll need every second of breath and every ounce of strength as the hungry sea reigns here and leeches thrive under the looming presence of The Leech Monster.

2160160.name: Music to Go POSTAL By Volume 2: POSTAL 4 Edition
2160160.short_description: Your eardrums will have no regerts when it comes to Music to Go POSTAL By Volume 2: POSTAL 4 Edition, delivering 18 metal and EDM tracks as heard throughout the chaotic and bidet-filled world of POSTAL 4!

2177750.name: Half-Life 2: VR Mod - Episode One
2177750.short_description: Return as Gordon Freeman in a new VR adventure to City 17 and beyond. Deal with the consequences of your actions in Half-Life 2 with this community-made adaptation of Episode One to glorious roomscale Virtual Reality!

2215320.name: Hello Neighbor 2: Hello-copter DLC
2215320.short_description: Explore Raven Brooks in a whole new way - from the sky! Take flight with the Hello-copter, a remote controlled flying drone equipped with a camera and grappling hook; discover new solutions to old puzzles and experience previously unreachable heights!

2215321.name: Hello Neighbor 2: Back to School DLC
2215321.short_description: Long forgotten rumors of children going missing up at the abandoned schoolhouse have begun to resurface, but the only one still there is the cranky old caretaker and his mean watch dogs! Enrich your Hello Neighbor 2 experience with the Hello Neighbor 2: Back to School DLC!

1887560.name: Fjordur - ARK Expansion Map
1887560.short_description: Explore a cold and hostile Norse-inspired archipelago in ARK's newest official community map, featuring four new creatures for you to tame! Fjordur contains over 140 square kilometers of new biomes, new challenges, and rewarding discoveries!

1727830.name: OPUS: Echo of Starsong Original Soundtrack -Best Selection-
1727830.short_description: OPUS: Echo of Starsong Original Soundtrack -Best Selection- features 32 beautifully mellow, bittersweet songs from the award winning franchise game, composed by Triodust.

1564060.name: Lighthouse of Madness
1564060.short_description: Embark on this Lovecraft-inspired tale and discover the mysteries that await you on this island. Explore the island, solve challenging puzzles, and most importantly: try not to lose your sanity.

1315751.name: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Skaven Chieftain
1315751.short_description: The Skaven Chieftain is an accomplished warrior who has clawed his way to a position of authority. Heavily armoured, equipped with an armour-piercing halberd and with a Bonebreaker mount option, the Chieftain is an adept counter to armoured cavalry.

3982200.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Recoil Zombie
3982200.short_description: A 2 button shooter. You shoot and jump at the same time! Shoot zombies and dodge nukes.

3962190.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Rotate
3962190.short_description: Rotate is an easy and short minimalist puzzle game where you rotate the level around the player.

473850.name: The Center - ARK Expansion Map
473850.short_description: The Center is a free add-on for ARK: Survival Evolved that includes a massive new map for survivors to explore, nearly double the size of the playable geography of the standard ARK Island landscape making it about 70 sq. kilometers. The Center complements the current ARK biomes with a rich, hand-drawn Tolkien-esque aesthetic. Filled with stunning lighting effects, lava rivers, giant picturesque mountains, misty floating islands, ancient underground ice caves, and more, The Center is free for anyone who already owns ARK: Survival Evolved.

282515.name: Alien: Isolation - Lost Contact
282515.short_description:
Welcome to Lost Contact, the fourth add-on content pack for Alien: Isolation, returning to the epic Salvage Mode.  

Trapped in deep space on board Sevastopol, you'll need to explore the station to complete objectives and survive.  Can you evade your enemies across ten waves of challenges, or will you take them head-on?

5251010.name: Lethal Autonomous Lovers
5251010.short_description: Eighteen months after a ceasefire, the Vrela valley is still closed—nine hundred hectares of orchard and vineyard behind orange tape, with fruit eleven weeks from falling and no safe way for farmers to go in.

4314380.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Squarely Jump
4314380.short_description: Squarely Jump is a minimalist one-button action platformer where you control a simple square navigating through increasingly challenging obstacle courses.

4909300.name: REDHAND
4909300.short_description: A psychotic-horror (psychological, surreal survival horror) with dark, oppressive atmosphere, brutal action and grotesque creatures.

3982180.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Super Jump Dude
3982180.short_description: Super Jump Dude is an one button game. Jump over crates and expect to see flying spikeballs, rockets and boomerangs.

5060780.name: Twin-stick Japanese
5060780.short_description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

5090380.name: 熊猫钓鱼：台钓问道之旅
5090380.short_description: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling is a 2D fishing sim rooted in real Taiwan-style logic. Explore diverse waters—from city rivers to wild lakes. Adapt your rod, float, line, and bait—every detail shapes your catch. Hand-painted art and immersive play invite you to find joy in nature and self.

3982230.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - The Cave Explorer
3982230.short_description: Jump into The Cave Explorer, a casual 2D platformer with a unique auto-movement twist! Time your jumps to collect coins and reach the exit orb in short, retro-style levels.

5455700.name: Island Crusade
5455700.short_description: Click monsters, recruit knights and free 100 pixel-art islands. When the sky splits, a second army fights in the Underside, a blood-soaked mirror of the kingdom, alongside your crusade. Timed bosses, a celestial sword, daily challenges and two worlds.

5171020.name: 熊猫钓鱼：台钓问道之旅 Demo
5171020.short_description: Panda Fishing: The Way of Angling is a 2D fishing sim rooted in real Taiwan-style logic. Explore diverse waters—from city rivers to wild lakes. Adapt your rod, float, line, and bait—every detail shapes your catch. Hand-painted art and immersive play invite you to find joy in nature and self.

4311830.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Touchy Cube
4311830.short_description: Tap to flip and propel your cube—align red faces through spike mazes and clever puzzles!

5463840.name: Mines and Magic Demo
5463840.short_description: Try Mines and Magic, a fantasy strategy game about building an army, developing your economy, and defending your castle. The demo includes the first three levels of the campaign and multiplayer.

5240470.name: Early Release, Late Love
5240470.short_description: Set in Aldergate, an overcrowded Victorian prison above the northern city of Harbrook, Early Release, Late Love is an Adult Romance Visual Novel about pressure, scrutiny, and the cost of one small decision.

4312310.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Underground Digger
4312310.short_description: A quick arcade digging game about drilling down, managing explosives, and reaching the depths below.

3981890.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Unstable Towers
3981890.short_description: Try to get as high as possible before one of the blocks falls out of the construction zone.

5420300.name: Sploink
5420300.short_description: Up to eight ducks. Twenty-five waves of angrier ducks. Hold a farmhouse roof, drop a squad of rifle ducks, pump a Bee-M-G through the Quack-a-Punch and bring down the Great Honk. A free, chaotic co-op wave shooter where every bad idea is a feature.

4069700.name: TEKO Demo
4069700.short_description: Enter the casino in TEKO, an addictive Roguelike Deckbuilder! Hit the score goal by playing 3 poker hands simultaneously. Modify your Chips, collect Cards, and take risks to maximize your profits. An indie progressive scoring game inspired by Balatro.

3149730.name: Blam! Blam!
3149730.short_description: Got 7 people in voice chat asking, “What are we playing tonight?” Blam! Blam! is a fast-paced pixel shooter built for chaotic multiplayer mayhem. Battle with up to 12 players across multiple game modes. Grab your friends and start blasting!

4994400.name: Cubic Color Confusion Demo
4994400.short_description:
A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos.

Can you sort out the confusion?

4759190.name: Cubic Color Confusion
4759190.short_description:
A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos.

Can you sort out the confusion?

4953880.name: Willcaster
4953880.short_description: Draw the path across the cursed grid and cast the spells; your champion walks it, fights, and bleeds by your plan. But the frog is no puppet. He has hungers, moods, and a will of his own. Feed his desires and he trusts you. Overrule him and he may refuse.

5401760.name: Tidy Up the Magic Mess
5401760.short_description: 4,600 spells are scattered across the floor, and they're all yours to put away. Shelve each one in its element's cabinet, then fuse two elements together to create a spell no one has seen before.

4469370.name: Puck's Pixelizer
4469370.short_description: An all in one tool that helps you pixelate and see real time changes on your models.

1134620.name: Gravity Control - Soundtrack
1134620.short_description: The original soundtrack for Gravity Control contains 7 original tracks featured in the game.

4182490.name: The Chamber
4182490.short_description: Crow-themed Lovecraft horror music rhythm game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

4941930.name: Pinata Smash: Incremental Circus Demo
4941930.short_description: Smash piñatas, collect candy, run the show! A fast active incremental game where the crowd throws for you. Upgrade your arena, gamble at the casino, and grow a number that refuses to stop!

4182500.name: The Dungeon
4182500.short_description: Fox-themed Lovecraft horror action dungeon crawler game with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

4182510.name: The Grimoire
4182510.short_description: Collection of independent retro-inspired minigames with a unique story set in the world and lore of tinymancer.

4426140.name: Gift Stream: Sorting & Delivery Simulator
4426140.short_description: Gift Stream Sorting & Delivery Simulator is a logistics management simulator where gifts constantly arrive through a mysterious portal. Inspect, sort, and ship them efficiently while upgrading machines and expanding your warehouse to handle an ever-growing delivery stream.

1602680.name: Gravity Snake - Buy me a coffee Donation
1602680.short_description: This DLC unlocks a button in the pause menu where you can change the color of the snake.

4546380.name: Zero Sum
4546380.short_description:
Your enemies are numbers. Your weapons are math. Reduce them all to zero. 
A twin-stick shooter roguelite where you subtract, divide, root and modulo your way through angry digits. 
Tuned to your skill level, from basic arithmetic to advanced operations. 
You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

3194080.name: Calvar - The Darkest Gate
3194080.short_description: CALVAR – THE DARKEST GATE is a first-person psychological horror game created by a two-person indie team. Explore a world of fractured memories, ritual corruption, disturbing creatures, and an abandoned asylum where reality itself begins to unravel.

3700970.name: Mo The Moai Demo
3700970.short_description:
Mo The Moai is a rage game and 2D platformer.

You are a pair of shoes that can't stop running. With Mo, your Moai friend, you can charge energy, throw him and propel yourself towards him.

Reach the summit before the seventh day, or this world will be destroyed, restarting all your progress.

4413790.name: 3D Game Library
4413790.short_description: Turn your Steam collection into an interactive 3D live wallpaper. Display your games as a customizable case grid on your desktop, organize your collection visually, and launch titles directly from the wallpaper. Wallpaper Engine compatibility included.

5383210.name: Brackets & Banners
5383210.short_description: Build your college basketball legacy. Recruit players, shape your roster, and chase tournament runs in a fictional coaching career sim. Make the calls yourself or delegate to your staff as each season adds new players, stories, and banners to your program's history.

4952190.name: Partial
4952190.short_description: Master difficult platforming, puzzles and combat with limited retries inside an unforgiving hazardous interconnected world. Partial is an intense 2D action-adventure where you play as a vulnerable and bizarre creature, seeking to uncover the mystery behind the Partial project and your own existence.

3408280.name: Bank Simulator Demo
3408280.short_description: Take your customers' money and invest it to grow your bank. Lend it out, buy bonds, stock ATM Rooms across the city and keep the profits. Catch scammers, hire staff and turn a small branch into a global powerhouse in this business management and banking tycoon sim.

5462970.name: Agent Guild: World
5462970.short_description: A living 3D world for your AI coding agents. Every Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Grok and shell session you run with the free Agent Guild becomes a character at its guild hall. Make your own characters and companions in Studio and share them on the Workshop.

1055790.name: Hexa Path - Soundtrack
1055790.short_description: The original soundtrack for Hexa Path contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

5490170.name: The Magic Master Demo
5490170.short_description: A soulslike inspired game with a magic-only, long-range combat system. Defeat unique bosses along a linear path and unlock new spells.

5407310.name: Tidy Up the Magic Mess Demo
5407310.short_description: 4,600 spells are scattered across the floor, and they're all yours to put away. Shelve each one in its element's cabinet, then fuse two elements together to create a spell no one has seen before.

5446410.name: Tikra Rida
5446410.short_description: Flip used cars in Vilnius. Read the ads, meet the seller, haggle — but the ad might be lying. Buy the history report, or trust your gut. Wash it, fix it, photograph it, and sell it for more than you paid. Full Lithuanian and English.

5278630.name: Mouse Mortar CE
5278630.short_description: Calibrate your cannon, ignite the D.A.N. thruster, and launch your aviator mouse into orbit! Master unique gravities across 9 celestial worlds, dodge lethal traps, chain kinetic boosts, and conquer global leaderboards in this high-velocity physics launch arcade.

4310160.name: Pound for Pound Demo
4310160.short_description: Run your own MMA promotion. Sign fighters, book cards, manage contracts, and build a combat sports empire in a deep, procedurally generated MMA management sim.

4501140.name: Gimbap Heaven
4501140.short_description: Run a Korean snack bar with your own crew! Hire staff, hand out kitchen tasks, plan the menu and juggle wages, stress and bills in this card-based restaurant management sim. Jump in to cook and serve by hand when it gets busy, and stay afloat for 15 days.

2276320.name: Hexagon Puzzle Blocks - Expansion Pack
2276320.short_description: This DLC adds more than 100+ puzzles to the base game.

1039680.name: Hookshot - Soundtrack
1039680.short_description: The original soundtrack for Hookshot contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

4985150.name: Symbiosis: Criticality Demo
4985150.short_description: Start with one core and a click. Break it, grab the bits, and build a station of drones, beams and arcs that runs itself. Push the reactor until it goes critical, then watch everything you built light up the screen. Free demo for Steam Next Fest.

4957250.name: Rad New World
4957250.short_description: Survive as a lone wanderer in a post-apocalyptic open-world CRPG inspired by classic Fallout. Create your character, level up perks, explore the wasteland, fight with melee and guns, lockpick, barter, and gamble your way through the ruins.

4264640.name: 4Born
4264640.short_description: A tactical roguelite RPG where every run forces you to adapt. Explore procedural dungeons under fog of war. Learn spells, gain items and forge each of your four heroes into one of many powerful classes. Build your team with what you get and break the game.

4228580.name: Hexcavation
4228580.short_description: Hexcavation is a resource strategy roguelike. Collect resources, travel deep underground, select your artifacts, uncover long-lost relics, and put together powerful synergies to become an unstoppable excavator!

5108370.name: Dynasty Basketball Manager
5108370.short_description: Win 3 titles in 5 seasons—or the run ends. A roguelite basketball GM where the right mix of player styles unlocks tactics, like TFT synergies. Draft, trade and shop between games, then call the shots when the clock stops. Pick one of 16 franchises; a full run takes about four hours.

4435950.name: Formation Builder Idle
4435950.short_description: Every hero changes the heroes beside it. Arrange 46+ heroes on a grid, chain their abilities, and find the layout that multiplies your damage. Then prestige across 21 worlds, fight with mounts, and run missions, mines and a workshop while you're away.

5403370.name: BLACKOUT Demo
5403370.short_description: BLACKOUT a 6 player co-op horror game with roguelite elements. Retrieve samples from a planetary anomaly for your creators back on Earth, and try not to perish in the hostile environment.

3137510.name: Paper Trails: A Scrapbooking Story
3137510.short_description: A 2D puzzle game about cozy scrapbooking as you follow a little girl’s life. Solve puzzles to create the correct spreads and make choices that will influence Belle along her journey of growing up and reconnecting with her mother.

5205660.name: Raid Haven
5205660.short_description: Build your haven and fortify it to withstand 100 waves of increasingly dangerous raids. Strategically place walls, traps, turrets, and defences, equip your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, and adapt your base as each wave pushes you closer to the breaking point.

3327090.name: Shadowbridge - The Genesis
3327090.short_description: Restore the balance in the dimensions! Help Ezra solve the biggest mystery of them all in this mind blowing point and click adventure.

5079010.name: Twin-stick Japanese Demo
5079010.short_description: Choose a deck, blast words, and turn correct answers into power. Shooting a word presents four choices. Pick the right one to earn a power-up and strengthen your build. Survive increasingly intense waves while mastering your Japanese, with study progress saved between runs.

5030570.name: Supermarket Organizer
5030570.short_description: Transform empty Japanese convenience stores into cozy konbinis. Unbox furniture, organize products, and enjoy the relaxing satisfaction of creating the perfect little shop.

5391580.name: Taptown Funk Demo
5391580.short_description: Taptown Funk is a groovy incremental rhythm game about growing a tiny funky town into a booming city. Hover to build, tap to the beat, catch coin combos & feel the heat. When the music stops, disaster detonates. Upgrade, rebuild or just automate! Can you find the groove, or will Taptown Funk you up?

5430190.name: Stacker: Tidy Up the Game Store
