5430190.short_description: Stacker is an organizing game where you examine video game covers, identify their genres and sort 2,708 game boxes onto the correct shelves. Turn a messy game store into a perfectly organized space, one box at a time and enjoy the satisfaction of putting everything in its place.

5114030.name: Retro TV Tycoon
5114030.short_description: Take control of a 90s television station in Retro TV Tycoon! Acquire rights to hit sitcoms and cult movies, schedule 24/7 broadcast grids, sign lucrative sponsor contracts, upgrade your newsroom, and expand your antenna transmission network to dominate the airwaves.

4854030.name: Wunderfront
4854030.short_description: In this brutal roguelite survival shooter, death is only the beginning of your evolution. Master a unique mix of historical firearms, experimental gadgets, and secret wonder weapons to execute the monstrosities ruling a ruined WW2 frontline.

5477810.name: Legio Impera
5477810.short_description: Found a Roman colony, run its economy and pay your legions. Legio Impera is a city-building RTS set in Marian Rome: govern a province during the Cimbrian War, subdue Gauls and Germanic tribes, and stop the horde before it reaches Italy.

5246850.name: Playrooms Demo
5246850.short_description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

3355740.name: Legacy of Ashes
3355740.short_description: Dive into a horror adventure where you solve puzzles, explore a mysterious island, battle vicious dinosaurs, and escape terrifying chases—all while uncovering the hidden goals of Nova Corp. Secrets await at every turn.

5387220.name: Derelict Division, LLC
5387220.short_description: A space-salvage game for 1–4 players. Fly out from your crew’s frigate, cut into abandoned ships and haul salvage back to your own ship. Work around power failures, zero gravity and escaping air, then spend what you earn on equipment for the next job.

5059760.name: Die Meeple Demo
5059760.short_description: Die Meeple is a tactical dice roguelite where every roll can change your fate. Choose your hero, upgrade your dice, collect powerful relics, and battle living chess pieces across a hand-drawn board game world full of risky choices and wild synergies.

4589700.name: The Sworn
4589700.short_description:
A deep US police precinct management simulation. You are the Captain. Hire officers, manage your fleet,
respond to a living city, and carry responsibility for every officer under your command. The job has a cost.
So does ignoring it.

5380680.name: ASCEND: The Forgotten Road
5380680.short_description: Walk the Forgotten Road as the Construct, an artificial warrior with an impossible Core. Fight through three lost lands in a hard-but-fair third-person action roguelike: master four weapons, fuse elemental rewards into evolutions and return from every fall a little stronger.

3618480.name: Journey Under The Pyramids
3618480.short_description: Follow in the footsteps of a missing Egyptologist as you explore mysterious passageways beneath the Great Pyramids. Solve over 50 unique and challenging puzzles, uncover ancient artifacts, and discover the truth behind his disappearance.

5430860.name: WiggleTown
5430860.short_description: A first-person social deduction game for 4 to 12 players. At night you work around the village while the Cursed hunt. In the morning you argue it out over proximity voice chat and vote someone out. Hopefully the right person.

3058740.name: Odds Chronicles
3058740.short_description: Defy impossible odds in a tactical roguelite RPG where every dice roll shapes your fate. Master grid-based battles, forge powerful builds, and uncover a world inspired by tabletop adventures.

4908640.name: THW's Calcudoku
4908640.short_description: Fan of Sudoku, logic or puzzles? Try THW's Calcudoku, the most addictive logic game ever according to THW. Unlimited puzzles, no ads, one low price, can it really be true! Yes! Whether you've never heard of Calcudoku, Mathdoku, Kenken or you're an expert, THW's has unlimited puzzles for you.

5365370.name: Survive in Spaceshit - THE REVERSAL
5365370.short_description: The universe is collapsing behind you and your ship is falling apart. In this chaotic 1-6 player online co-op, clear 50+ mini games to complete missions, fight fires, seal breaches and face black holes and aliens. How long can you keep the spaceship together, and can you survive the end of times?

4315790.name: Tomboy Supremacy City
4315790.short_description: Welcome to a city ruled by duels. To claim the throne, you must crush your opponents and make the proudest tomboys bow in submission.

3096320.name: Death and Tactics
3096320.short_description: A post-apocalyptic turn-based strategy game where death is permanent and every decision counts. Experience unique events based on how you play, sell the organs of party members you don't like, transform your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

5335780.name: Joker's Knock
5335780.short_description: A competitive online card game where every player fights for themselves. Draft powerful Jokers, outplay your opponents and climb the Ranked ladder. Easy to learn, hard to master—with fair competition, achievements and cosmetic progression, never pay to win.

3158200.name: Stumble in the Dark
3158200.short_description: You’re a master thief — with none of the skills. Stealth meets slapstick as you stumble through intricate levels, cram your bags full of treasure, and evade the Justice Crew. Flee the scene quickly or discover outrageous secrets in this one-of-a-kind heist adventure.

1576780.name: WWII Online: Chokepoint
1576780.short_description: WWII Online: Chokepoint is an authentic F2P WW2 multiplayer tactical shooter, driven by teamwork and built-in voice comms. Jump in feet first with the US Airborne or join the Wehrmacht and fight to control iconic chokepoints as an infantryman in Europe between 1944-45. Are you ready for WAR?

5135060.name: 沣都镇
5135060.short_description: Fengdu Town is a Chinese folk suspense game. You’ll play as the protagonist, Fu Tong, starting from his hometown and gradually unravelling the mystery behind the largest cult in China.

5376970.name: Farm Business Simulator
5376970.short_description: Turn a small backyard into a farm that supplies an entire town. Grow crops, make goods, deliver orders and expand your business — solo or in co-op with up to 4 players.

5440370.name: Meowstone Siege
5440370.short_description: Command a customizable cat in this 3D tower defense game. Build elemental cannons, research new defenses, deploy cat-piloted aircraft, and repel waves of mice. Face bosses, tackle daily sieges, and create and share maps through Steam Workshop.

5153150.name: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain Demo
5153150.short_description: Defend a neon district from falling infected in a first-person action roguelike. Try 3 Defender classes, protect falling humans, bend time with Focus, and build your defenses through 7 escalating demo waves.

4860880.name: Summer Like a Dream
4860880.short_description: You're spending an unforgettable summer at Hannah's place, surrounded by old friends and new faces. Grow closer to them, explore everything the season offers, and follow where each connection leads. Will you make the most of this summer?

5224400.name: Scallywags
5224400.short_description:
Board your ship, sail the seas and accidentally dismember your friends!
There are ships to loot, enemies to defeat and physics to disobey.

If you get lonely, invite your friends and start plundering the seas together!

2649320.name: Shuffle Waifu Cafe
2649320.short_description: 🍰 Collect waifus, build your staff deck, and run a magical anime cafe! Manage Shifts, level up your girls, play Match-3 Stories, unlock Stories and Dates, and unravel the mystery of a strange new world. Catgirls, Succubi, Vampires, Slime Girls, Dragon Girls, and more!

5436530.name: Soccer Ball Simulator Demo
5436530.short_description: A concussed referee wakes up as a soccer ball. Real physics at soccer ball scale plus one super powered boost. Climb, jump and bash your way through the halls of your subconscious to put an end to the evil referee rigging the sport.

4262250.name: Skyscraper Security: Zombie Rain
4262250.short_description: Defend a neon district from falling infected in a first-person action roguelike. Choose from 4 Defender classes, protect humans, bend time with Focus, and build your firepower through 15 escalating waves.

5419430.name: Horde Below Demo
5419430.short_description: Horde Below is a zombie-themed incremental tower defense game. Fight massive zombie hordes with your towers and your own weapon. Buy permanent upgrades, evolve your towers, and turn the battlefield into pure chaos.

5433360.name: Artificial Intrusion
5433360.short_description: A retro CRT tower defense where rogue AI pixels attack the internet. Place firewalls, CAPTCHAs and traps to survive 20 waves across 10 network nodes, then spend Packets on a huge radial skill tree to harden the web for the next run.

4796520.name: Counter Ducks
4796520.short_description: An asymmetric FPP/TPP shooter with two different game modes. In PvE, hunt ducks solo or in co-op, earn money, and upgrade your gear. In PvP, switch roles and play as a duck against hunters in chaotic 4v4 battles!

3066680.name: Solar Voltage
3066680.short_description: After a huge solar storm destroyed their ship and left them stranded, help Volt and her crewmates escape the dangerous planet filled with deadly robots and a mysterious AI.

3584060.name: BONEBUILDER
3584060.short_description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

5131920.name: Ludus Saltuum Demo
5131920.short_description: A third person 3d platformer! Jump forward, unlock skills and buy upgrades! All at your own pace! Handcrafted levels procedurally presented! How far can you get? 🇧🇷

5174470.name: BONEBUILDER Demo
5174470.short_description: Fight imposing enemies in this 3D third person action roguelike. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

4089060.name: Nereus
4089060.short_description: Nereus — you work for a corporation, maintaining underwater stations, each deeper than the last. But routine maintenance soon turns into a fight for survival, as you begin to realize that beneath the ocean’s depths… you are not alone.

5408930.name: Horde Below
5408930.short_description: Horde Below is a zombie-themed incremental tower defense game. Fight massive zombie hordes with your towers and your own weapon. Buy permanent upgrades, evolve your towers, and turn the battlefield into pure chaos.

4736800.name: Verse of Birth
4736800.short_description: Your words rise as allies in this card-building roguelike auto battler. Collect "Logos" whose form and abilities are shaped by the words you type, craft a build that's yours alone, and fight your way through the dungeon!

4109230.name: Hear My Cult Demo
4109230.short_description: Hear My Cult is an Action RPG with Rogue-Lite and RTS elements where you summon and command minions. This is your first step into becoming a cult summoner and necromancer, customizing an elemental deck of cards to build an army of units while gaining the favors of the Old Gods.

5012600.name: Ticker & Trade
5012600.short_description: Ticker & Trade is a multiplayer financial simulator. Trade stocks, options, and bonds on a real-time global order book. Build player corporations, launch mutual funds, react to market-shifting news events, and rise to the top of the leaderboards. Build your stock market empire!

5198810.name: Idler Coin Pusher
5198810.short_description: Drop coins. Push chips. Build a passive skill tree. a plinko board, a full collectible skin economy with real Steam Inventory items, and coinflips against real players and much more!!

5355460.name: That Damn Grass
5355460.short_description: A co-op lawn game where you start with a nail cutter. Play as a budget robot, cut an enormous lawn, collect the clippings and earn better tools while searching for a lost wedding ring. Work alone or with up to three friends. Yes, scissors are an upgrade.

5404840.name: Dungeonmancer Demo
5404840.short_description: A solo action-exploration dungeon crawler about defeating monsters, collecting loot, and overcoming bosses.

5418460.name: Chronicles Of Jintin
5418460.short_description: Chronicles of Jintin is a 3D fantasy action RPG with manual combat and optional auto hunting. Fight monsters and bosses, collect loot, craft and upgrade your gear, explore dungeons, and grow stronger through idle progression.

5050660.name: The House on Grisewood
5050660.short_description: A top-down survival horror shooter set in a haunted manor. Explore room by room with a failing flashlight, scavenge ammunition and batteries, and fight or evade what stalks the dark. Reach the ballroom and end what laughs there, or hold out in an endless Zombie Survival mode.

5246020.name: Sex Shop Chaos
5246020.short_description: Things are getting hard to keep organized! Run a cheeky adult boutique in Sex Shop Chaos: grab the goods, slide them onto the right shelves, and try not to get yourself in a twist.

4161130.name: Phase Phighter
4161130.short_description: The rabbit hole just punched back. Dive into a chaotic side-scrolling beat ’em up inspired by the first generation of Phase Connect, OriginS. With 7 playable characters and 8 levels of classic beat em up action.

5040240.name: Rampartloom: PvP Tower Defense
5040240.short_description: Tower Defense meets 3v3 Tower Wars. Build mazes with defensive towers, send assault units, and grow your economy in free-to-play team battles. Draft from twelve factions and coordinate with your team to break the opposing defense.

4827290.name: Jacob's Islands
4827290.short_description: Jacob’s Islands is a minimalist pixel art platforming adventure where you explore mysterious islands, uncover secrets, and take time to enjoy the beauty of nature.

3121420.name: Monolith: Dark Matter
3121420.short_description: A round-based FPS for 1–4 players set inside the Monolith — a brutalist complex shaped by living black matter. Fight escalating waves of its marionettes, earn points to unlock new sectors and build your arsenal, and uncover the route to a final encounter.

3184440.name: Finares
3184440.short_description: Go on a journey through a world abandoned by humans. Along the way, meet dogs that have been left abandoned and welcome them into your pack.

4586230.name: Last Inspection
4586230.short_description: Your new duty is to inspect properties before move-in. It does not matter what waits inside — all responsibility will rest on your shoulders alone. Do the job well, and there is a good chance this inspection will not be your last...

3589810.name: Caves of Combat
3589810.short_description: A melee-focused action roguelike with procedurally generated levels, ability synergies, and fast, skill-based combat.

3757660.name: Station 58
3757660.short_description: Piece together a national park scattered across the sky in this cozy puzzle adventure. Play solo or couch co-op as Starla and Shorty, a park ranger and her giant robot friend. Solve alien cube puzzles, rearrange lost parklands, and uncover what fractured the park.

2645300.name: Genimas: Life reborn Demo
2645300.short_description: Embark on the adventure of a lifetime as Drassil, a warrior trained by Freyja on a remote island! With newly discovered genetic powers, travel to a hostile continent full of dangerous enemies and extreme environments. Your mission: to save civilization from an imminent calamity.

5276120.name: 1.76流派传奇
5276120.short_description: 全新传奇《1.76流派传奇》，耗时两年精心雕琢，倾尽心血打造诚意巨献！以原创剧情为灵魂的基础上，它保留了传奇的核心玩法（打怪、升级、爆装备、攻沙巴克）超级大陆为舞台🌏，秉持“不肝不氪”的友好理念🥰，同时增加了魂器、专属装备、不同职业的多种流派等独具特色的新内容，让游戏体验既怀旧又新奇，该版本节奏快，爆率高，材料易得，PK更爽快，主打一个“爽”字，为玩家开启一场别具一格的传奇冒险之旅🚀！！！

5123800.name: I SHALL NAME THE DEAD Demo
5123800.short_description: This demo contains the opening chapter of I SHALL NAME THE DEAD. Speak with the Nameless Dead, uncover their forgotten names, and begin your descent into the Necropolis before the Worm devours you from within.

4586540.name: The Regreening Demo
4586540.short_description: Restore a deserted world in a cozy soilpunk simulation. Grow plants, rebuild wildlife habitats, and revive entire ecosystems. Upcycle abandoned junk into tools and decorations, befriend ancient nature spirits, and hug ALL the animals as you transform a forgotten world into a thriving paradise.

4681790.name: Plobania 47/B Demo
4681790.short_description: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

4823040.name: 明末：力挽狂澜 Demo
4823040.short_description: 正在尝试让地图大战略+AI模拟结合，看看能碰撞出怎样的火花，游戏支持传统大战略地图策略模拟的大部分要素，脱离AI也能自动运行世界，额外的让AI替代了核心的摇骰子阶段，让游戏的自由度更上一层楼。科技，国策，人物，势力以及几乎所有的一切，不再局限于开发者的预设条目和节点。

4279080.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator Demo
4279080.short_description: Run your dream tattoo shop! Provide tattoo and piercing services, customize your shop, and manage staff. Unlock new skills and roam the living city freely on your motorcycle. Buy real estate, fight off thugs, and grow from a small shop into the city's biggest brand!

4403940.name: CONTROL Resonant Digital Deluxe Upgrade
4403940.short_description: Go behind the scenes of CONTROL Resonant with the Digital Artbook, immerse yourself in new music from the Original Soundtrack, and enhance your experience with a unique AWE Mission Outfit, Untapped Artifact (Wallet), and Starter Resource Bundle.

4114220.name: Tempest Rising: The Veti’s Wrath
4114220.short_description: Take command of the fractured Veti to reclaim what is rightfully yours. Subjugate your foes and use them as tools to sacrifice for your goals in the conquest for vengeance against enemies both new and older than humanity itself.

4173700.name: Merry Crisis Demo
4173700.short_description: Three loves. One week. Zero chill. Merry Crisis is an intimate, character-driven romance visual novel about love, loss, and belonging—is home what you left behind, or where you’re headed? The demo thrusts you right into the thick of action.

4230470.name: HMUR Demo
4230470.short_description: Clock in. Survive the shift. HMUR is a brutal, fast-paced FPS where one shot can kill and ammo is precious. An ordinary factory worker must blast his way through a facility gone violently out of control — before he loses his grip on reality.

3747600.name: MK1: Definitive Edition Upgrade
3747600.short_description: Upgrade your Mortal Kombat 1 base game with instant access to the Story Expansion, Kombat Pack, Kombat Pack 2, Mortal Kombat and II Movie Skins, Dragon Krystals, and more!

3875100.name: Anomalous Coffee Machine 2 - NSFW
3875100.short_description: On this DLC, Unlock the Machine's most intimate features and unveil explicit scenes, unfiltered forms, and the darker side of desire—where every sip comes with a price, and every pleasure hides a mutation. Taste what was never meant to be served—where pleasure and horror finally mix.

3540890.name: LUST CURSE 🔞 Demo
3540890.short_description: LUST CURSE 🔞 Demo offers a first glimpse into Lana Wett’s perilous journey on a cursed tropical island. Explore, uncover mysteries, and experience the seductive tension of the curse. Will you resist its pull or give in to temptation? Your choices shape what comes next.

3563230.name: Pardon My French Toast Demo
3563230.short_description: Get bready to sink your teeth into Pardon My French Toast, a 3D platformer starring a slice of toast who covers himself in sweet spreads to get fun abilities.

3238470.name: Days Gone - Broken Road DLC
3238470.short_description: Fight to survive in the definitive Days Gone experience. Face off against hordes of Freakers in the harsh reality of the Farewell Wilderness.

3406030.name: Swan Song Demo
3406030.short_description: Swan Song is a cozy puzzle game that invites you to slow down, listen, and reflect. Set inside a magical music box, each puzzle asks players to place notes on a musical scale. When you turn the key, the composition plays, activating platforms and opening paths that guide a small swan to safety.

3056390.name: HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Pro - Drawing References
3056390.short_description: HAELE 3D - Portrait Studio Pro is 3D facial anatomy drawing reference tool for beginner and advanced artists, with various characters, proportions, expressions, lights and environments. It is an easy to use app to complement tutorials, for those who are learning how to draw faces and heads.

2867630.name: 100 March Cats - Extra Content
2867630.short_description:
By purchasing DLC, you will get extra content in the game 100 March Cats.
Get an extra level with 100 more adorable cats!

5465580.name: Little Groves Demo
5465580.short_description: Take your first steps into Little Groves. Place tiles, grow your first forests and discover how one clever placement can set off a cascade of Harmonies.

3101840.name: Weiss Schwarz Online
3101840.short_description: Battle with cards from your favorite titles! Weiss Schwarz, the world’s No. 1 card game by number of participating titles, is now a video game! With a full tutorial and online battles, players of all skill levels, from beginners to experts, can enjoy the game.

2375830.name: X4: Community of Planets Collector's Edition - Bonus Content
2375830.short_description: This bonus content is exclusively available as part of the X4: Community of Planets Collector's Edition bundle.

1691800.name: Lost Island - ARK Expansion Map
1691800.short_description: Explore the soaring heights and hidden depths of ARK's newest official community map! Lost Island includes 150 square kilometers of spectacular biomes, and three unique real-world creatures for you to tame—Amargasaurus, Sinomacrops bondei, and fan-chosen Dinopithecus!

1542500.name: Mosaique Neko Waifus 4 Free R18
1542500.short_description: R18+ Censorship removal for "Mosaique Neko Waifus 4"

1031140.name: Warhammer Horus Heresy: Legions
1031140.short_description: A card battler based in the rich universe of the Horus Heresy, the origin story of Warhammer 40,000. Play through epic single-player campaigns, take part in draft tournaments based on famous battles, or build your own unstoppable deck and compete in fast and epic duels against players worldwide.

1090165.name: NARUTO TO BORUTO: SHINOBI STRIKER Season Pass 4
1090165.short_description:
Season Pass 4 gives you access to special training from 5 different masters, including Sakura Haruno (Great Ninja War)! Learn new Ninjutsu from each master and receive special items. 
SEASON PASS 4 BONUS: 
Secret Technique: Super Uzumaki Rasengan

1114100.name: Miss Neko - Free DLC
1114100.short_description:
Free DLC of Miss Neko.
Install the free DLC to unlock some adult content :)
When you win, you'll see the girls in different costumes!

4014190.name: Teddy Won't Help
4014190.short_description: One night, your plushies whisper a warning: Three monsters from under the bed will come for you before dawn. The only way to survive is to play their games… and win. Fail, and you won’t live to see the morning.

463490.name: HunieCam Studio Original Soundtrack
463490.short_description: The official digital soundtrack for HunieCam Studio including all 8 tracks from the game and an exclusive bonus track!

5454800.name: Dustline 2D
5454800.short_description: Dustline 2D is a fast-paced post-apocalyptic top-down shooter. Explore devastated wastelands, fight dangerous raiders, and survive in a hostile world. Use firearms, dodge enemy attacks, and battle your way through challenging levels.

5469830.name: Diamond District: Jewelry Shop Simulator
5469830.short_description: Buy gold, catch the fakes and flip the real pieces in your own jewelry shop in New York’s Diamond District. Start with $1,000 and one dusty room, stock your cases, haggle at the counter, craft custom pieces and film celebrities for views. Solo or online co-op for 1 to 4.

5006800.name: Freewill - Sci-Fi Music Platformer
5006800.short_description: Freewill is a linear, rhythm based 3D platformer. Experience songs by Magic Circuit come to life as you jump, slide and wall run in a futuristic landscape.

5023630.name: IRREVERENCE Demo
5023630.short_description: IRREVERENCE is a fast paced top down shooter. Run, shoot, and dive into intense combat with a variety of strange foes in this surreal hotline miami like.

5473270.name: Diamond District: Jewelry Shop Simulator Demo
5473270.short_description: Buy gold, catch the fakes and flip the real pieces in the first days of your own jewelry shop in New York's Diamond District. Start with $1,000, stock silver and gold chains, haggle at the counter and meet a celebrity on day 4. Co-op for 1 to 4, and your shop carries over to the full game.

3239540.name: Kawaii Pancakes: Maid Café
3239540.short_description: Step into the world of Kawaii Pancakes: Maid Café, a charming anime-inspired strategy game where you drop pancakes onto a board and flip rows to score points. Line up four or more pancakes in a row and outsmart your opponent in this fun, fast-paced showdown set in an adorable maid café!

4835980.name: A Story of Questions: Prologue
4835980.short_description: This standalone demo features its own unique, self-contained story separate from the main game. It is a psychological horror point-and-click mystery that blends interactive desk investigation with a choice-driven text adventure. Unlock 12 unique, endings.
developers: Under the Bridge Games by Tim Hertel
publishers: Under the Bridge Games by Tim Hertel

4769840.name: Flakeparty Demo
4769840.short_description: Scoop, position and score cereals to gain enough points in this relaxing, rogue-like deck-builder. Collect quirky cereals with unique effects, use them to play the rule-twisting minigames to gain special toys,buy upgrades to increase your chances and reach the final extra difficult boss round!

5094730.name: 中国棋牌博物馆 Demo
5094730.short_description: Welcome to the free Demo of Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step into 1980s–90s China and play 6 regional games—Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Pao De Kuai, Sheng Ji, Sichuan Mahjong, and Ka Wu Xing—in 3D scenes lit by your clock. Rewind any move against AI. No ads. UI: Simplified Chinese.

4359600.name: That Cat Game
4359600.short_description: Stalk, pounce and climb your way through a handcrafted 2D world as a small cat with sharp instincts. Hunt birds from a crouch, dodge what you can't kill, and earn real cat abilities across 15 levels. Cozy, normal, or feral - three difficulty modes for repeated gameplay.

1561540.name: Ship of Theseus
1561540.short_description: Steal your ship back from other realities, even from yourself. The Theseus is stranded, and every part it needs is held by a crew who needs it too. Rebuild it piece by piece and ask if it is still the same ship. A sci-fi roguelite FPS, solo or online co-op.

1636310.name: Portal: Forbidden Testing Tracks
1636310.short_description: Portal: Forbidden Testing Tracks invites you to delve into an exciting community-created modification for Portal 2. Step into the shoes of Rachel as she embarks on a journey guided by the personality core named "SAIC," through the Forbidden Testing Track, Codename: "Quebeck Seven."

4713660.name: The Last Admiral
4713660.short_description: A turn-based space tactics roguelite with no grid. Your own Alliance cut you off without a shot, so you break away with four ships. Fight from behind asteroids, win hulls from the fleets you beat, mix ships from 14 factions, and take the galaxy sector by sector. Lose the run, keep the fleet.

5379410.name: Boss Toss Demo
5379410.short_description: Deflect the ball launched by the boss, pass it to a friend, then smash it right back into the boss! The more you pass the ball, the faster it gets—and the fight descends into chaos. Hit the boss. Not your friends.

5037510.name: Playrooms
5037510.short_description: Thousands of balls are scattered throughout the playrooms. Someone should put them away, and there's no one here but you. Almost no one.

4958020.name: The Last Admiral Demo
4958020.short_description: A turn-based space tactics roguelite. Take four Alliance ships through the first half of the opening sector: hold turns, fight from cover, scout before you fire, and win hulls and gear from fleets you beat, up to a final defend battle. Lose a run on the way and restart with your ships and gear.

4989370.name: Witch's Last Curse
4989370.short_description: A fantasy RPG about saving a medieval town from a spreading curse as the Witch's Apprentice. Spend your limited daily actions investigating secrets, earning the trust of townsfolk, discovering the ingredients your ritual actually needs, and holding back the thorns before time runs out.

4597080.name: G.H.O.S.T. Ghost Hunt Ops Special Team Demo
4597080.short_description: G.H.O.S.T. — a tactical co-op for 1-4 players. Your main objective: track the Ghost via anomalies and capture it before it collects 7 runes to open the portal. Use Devastators, secure torsional artifacts, and remember—you are there to stop the invasion, not to become its victim.

5392650.name: Pilot Tycoon Demo
5392650.short_description: Play your first week as a regional First Officer in Pilot Tycoon, a pilot career RPG. Bid for your schedule by seniority, handle in-flight emergencies through quick-time events, and manage money, stress and reputation. The full game takes your career all the way to mainline Captain.

4619020.name: まじかるまじっくワールド２
4619020.short_description:
All the main characters are VTubers!!
A 2D pixel-art side-scrolling fantasy magical action game starring the VTuber magical girl Kohaku ♪
One year after the previous incident… Kohaku once again races across the world of Magical Magic World!?

5377460.name: UPSHOT
5377460.short_description: Every shot splits them. Every split makes it worse. UPSHOT is a 1–4 player arena shooter where bouncing balls break into smaller, faster ones with every hit. Clear arena after arena, from basketball courts to metro stations, with weapons from pistols to crossbows to blades, solo or in online co-op.

5391790.name: ASHEEPGAME
5391790.short_description: Free cartoon puzzle mayhem in the spirit of Lemmings: guide a stubborn flock through 218 levels, from a sunny meadow down to Satan's throne room. Dig, build, blow things up – while the soundtrack slides from country to death metal and the bleating turns into a growl.

4929660.name: Stick Wars: The Laneborn Demo
4929660.short_description: Free demo of Stick Wars: The Laneborn. A 2D stickman strategy game on three lanes: you don’t micro troops, you decide gold, deployments and upgrades. 3 campaign levels plus 1v1 online multiplayer.

5020090.name: Real Zombie Survivors
5020090.short_description: Real Zombie Survivors is a co-op top-down arena shooter where you fight relentless hordes of zombies on real-world maps generated from OpenStreetMap data. Choose unique classes, upgrade your arsenal, call in combat robots, and survive the apocalypse solo or with friends on Steam!

5057460.name: PachiRogue Demo
5057460.short_description: Pachinko meets horde survival in a tactile cardboard diorama. Drop balls into cascading peg boards to trigger runaway chain reactions before the climbing army breaches your wall. Draft game-breaking ball synergies, level up RPG stats, and survive the climb.

5212230.name: Veggie Stack Battle Royale Demo
5212230.short_description: Merge your veggies, sabotage your rivals, and be the last one standing! Compete in online battles with up to 10 players, unlock cosmetics and trophies, and unleash chaotic attacks in this multiplayer twist on the hit merging game Veggie Stack.

4919130.name: MONSTERGOTCHI
4919130.short_description: Feed and grow your own monster in the virtual pet game MONSTERGOTCHI! 😀 The type of pet you get depends entirely on you!😮 Explore a dangerous world, find food, and give it to them! 😍 Hurry up, IT'S HUNGRY!

4794110.name: Anomalous Veil
4794110.short_description: You are trapped inside an endless house shaped by memory and guilt. Use mysterious masks to reveal hidden layers of reality, identify anomalies and escape a psychological time loop.

4475530.name: Halls of Taurthos
4475530.short_description: A hand-crafted open-world RPG with no hand-holding. Explore, survive, and carve your own path through the fractured lands of Wyrelande.

4596020.name: Lustful Beauties: Forbidden Pleasures
4596020.short_description: Cute girls. Sexy outfits. Match-3.Yeah, you know where this is going.

5195590.name: Greedy Demo
5195590.short_description: A raccoon co-op horror extraction game for 1-8 players. Infiltrate procedural ruins, loot everything and extract the relic. Mammon, the Greed Demon, is watching… Stay away from his curse!

3335310.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
3335310.short_description: Your daughter has been kidnapped. In the trilogy’s final chapter, enter a nightmare to save her, survive what hunts you, and uncover the Red Nun’s truth through retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation. A modern return to classic survival horror with an Italian neo-giallo twist.

5386650.name: Parcel Cannon
5386650.short_description: Fire parcels into waiting windows, earn cash, and turn a humble cannon into a delivery machine. Upgrade your shots, unlock playful transport routes, and unleash Rush in this colorful physics-based incremental game set across quirky themed neighborhoods.

5326220.name: Ambrosius
5326220.short_description: Ambrosius is a fantasy dungeon crawler where every monster, room and item is an original hand-painted artwork — not a filter, not AI. Fight through ever-shifting labyrinths, let Corruption steer your fate down one of three story paths, and end every battle in a cinematic kill-cam

5305270.name: Letters from the Springs
5305270.short_description: Run a cozy hot spring inn in a mountain valley. Read guest letters, plan menus, prepare tea and baths, and grow your own ingredients. Get to know your travelers, balance the books, and help your little inn flourish, one thoughtful stay at a time.

5364360.name: Grave Rats
5364360.short_description: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Become grave-robbing rats, steal fully physics-based valuables, and stuff them into cursed corpses. Haul your payday past lurking monsters, keep your crew alive, or get canned when your plans fall apart.

4988260.name: World Of Mana II
4988260.short_description: Stop the Necromancer and save the world! In this action RPG, explore every corner of the map to reach the heart of darkness. Defeat monsters to level up, boost your stats, and become a mighty hero. Discover hidden secret areas and loot rare treasure chests. A thrilling 4-hour journey awaits!

4871170.name: Coming Forth by Day
4871170.short_description: Journey through the Egyptian afterlife in this roguelike deck builder. Use the rules to your advantage, or break them, to outwit supernatural foes in an ancient Egyptian board game. Prepare yourself, pharaoh: the Duat awaits.

4843460.name: Aethyr Idle
4843460.short_description: An idle RPG with the build depth of an MMO. Pick one of four classes, climb a talent tree into one of twelve specializations, and write the spell rotation your hero fights with. Then dig into crafting, elements, Mythic+ dungeons and an endless Abyss. It runs while you're away.

3368750.name: Space Calibrator
3368750.short_description: Space Calibrator is a tool that lets you use VR devices from multiple vendors together!

3540610.name: Astral Hunter: Homebound
3540610.short_description: This is a top-down action RogueLite game where you fight hordes of alien creatures with your chosen weapons. Build a unique combat style using various upgrades and items. Capture creatures to use their abilities or harvest materials. Recruit more characters and conquer the planet!

4651690.name: 星源猎手：归航 Demo
4651690.short_description: This is a top-down action RogueLite game where you fight hordes of alien creatures with your chosen weapons. Build a unique combat style using various upgrades and items. Capture creatures to use their abilities or harvest materials. Recruit more characters and conquer the planet!

5073690.name: The Bounty
5073690.short_description: Become a bounty hunter in a strange world crawling with monsters. Take on dangerous contracts, wield unusual weapons, and return from each hunt with the resources you need to rebuild a cozy camp in the wilderness.

5353340.name: False Signal
5353340.short_description: Single-player horror. One of five crew members is an impostor. Take air samples, compare duty records, and inspect the sealed corridors of Kepler Yard. Something can copy the voices on your radio. Find the carrier, then decide what comes out with it.

5458700.name: Hopwood Demo
5458700.short_description: A cozy 2D metroidvania about memory. In this free demo, explore the first two connected regions, learn to punch, roll and double jump, use the Whisper to hear what creatures think, and win back two blossoms of the Old Cherry from bosses who forgot who they are.

4898560.name: Tetromancer
4898560.short_description: Tetromancer is a Tetris battler where the board is your war economy. Clear lines to conjure an army, then command it in real time against wave after wave of invaders. Stack greedily and you'll field a bigger force, but crowd your board and one bad piece can bury you.

5226700.name: We Love Casting Spells
5226700.short_description: Magic fantasy procedural dungeon extractor. Advance solo, or with friends, in procedural dungeons with enemies, traps, and rewards! Fill your satchel, and extract to your sanctum before your magic runs out.

4672030.name: Malignus
4672030.short_description: A dungeon colony sim where you play the dungeon itself: its Boss, its minions and the beasts in its caves. Dig out halls, wire deadly traps, and raid the world above for treasure. Then hold your hoard against the heroes who come to take it back. Play alone or in 2–4 player co-op.

4425390.name: 漱蛹绫吻-Unseam kiss for Violet Rose
4425390.short_description: 《漱蛹绫吻-Unseam Kiss for Violet Rose》是一款视觉小说 讲述了芙翩纱拥有进入他人梦境的能力 她为了回忆与自己失踪的青梅竹马宁嚣逭的点点滴滴而拜访了一位少女的梦境 她请求对方在梦中重新构造出与青梅竹马曾经的日常 只是 凭借单凭她口中宁嚣逭的碎片 并不足以拼凑起一个完整的形象 至此 两人便沿着那些零落的痕迹 拼凑着她尚未成形的归处 在游戏中 你将见证芙翩纱尝试找回她的青梅竹马的故事

1621170.name: Dungeon Cafe
1621170.short_description: Build your dream café... or die trying. In this fast-paced co-op base builder, you’ll cook, fight, and automate your way through a chaotic kitchen as you gather ingredients by slaying monsters and prepare magical meals for the Demon Overlord’s ever-hungry army.

4434640.name: The Long Mine
4434640.short_description: An incremental mining game with fully destructible caves. Every pickaxe strike removes an actual piece of rock. Mine ores, sell them, and buy upgrades. Upgrades are not just +10% damage. Equipment and Curses change how you mine, move and explore. Combine them to create your own build.

5466460.name: Buzzmischief
5466460.short_description: Buzzmischief is a mosquito survival game. Fly into people's homes at night, drink from sleeping humans without getting swatted, and bring the blood home. Spend it on eggs and upgrades to grow a colony across the street. Take too much, though, and someone calls the exterminator.

4860400.name: Please, Tell Me Why?
4860400.short_description: You live alone. At least, you’re supposed to. Go live. Explore your apartment. Talk to your viewers. Everything seems normal—until little things stop making sense. A first-person psychological horror about identity, isolation, and the terrifying price of confronting the truth.

3699850.name: The Devil's Due
3699850.short_description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

3776740.name: Selection Kingdom: Level 1 - Soundtrack -
3776740.short_description: The original sound track of the first chapter in 320 kbps MP3 format, consisting of 10 compositions.

4192410.name: Catstronaut, Félicette's adventures Demo
4192410.short_description:
A 2D platform game set in space, based on gravity and mini-planets, in which you play as Félicette, who travels through space.
You will have to navigate each level, using your skills to manage the gravity of the planets you encounter, jumping, using your jetpack, and other surprises...

2711710.name: Zero Hero
2711710.short_description:
Zero hero is an endless roguelike, each wave of enemies and unique combinations. Collect Waboshi to buy new weapons and upgrades outside the game and get further and further in the challenges with the number of kills and waves.
Challenge yourself with new weapons, new powers and challenges!

5427270.name: Chroma Demo
5427270.short_description: Try the complete first level of Chroma, a roguelike deckbuilder. Combine six elements, recruit mages, and use elemental parchments to reach the target score and defeat the boss. Start another run to discover new synergies.

4854760.name: Sandbox Zombies
4854760.short_description: An action level editor. With zombies. Carefully set up your own elaborate scenarios, or revel in causing chaos. With no innate goal, Sandbox Zombies trusts you to find fun in creativity and mischief. Explore a depth of systems and share your levels with friends.

4942730.name: The Backrooms Experience
4942730.short_description: The Backrooms Experience is a cooperative exploration and survival-horror game built around observation, discovery, and the unknown. Enter liminal environments alone or with others, document what you learn, and survive encounters with the entities hidden within.

5232750.name: Mapping Creator Demo
5232750.short_description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

4999280.name: OneBody: Together
4999280.short_description: One character. A whole team. In OneBody: Together, your team shares the same body. One player moves, another controls the camera, another attacks. Switch roles, manage the chaos, and try not to fall off a cliff together.

5082740.name: Naishitai: The parts I'm missing. Playtest

4989400.name: Halo Wars Community Mod Tools
4989400.short_description: Create and manage mods for Halo Wars: Definitive Edition and Halo Wars 2. Edit scenarios and game data, work with models and animations, and prepare mod files with a free Windows toolkit. Halo Wars 2 support is still in development.

5434050.name: No Sleep Tonight
5434050.short_description: No Sleep Tonight is an incremental game about counting sheep and late-night inspiration. You keep trying to fall asleep, only to get back up to jot down another idea. Your eyelids grow heavier, but the workshop in your head only gets busier…

2468200.name: DDoD
2468200.short_description: DDoD is a solo and co-op action-shooter RPG with gunplay that feels right and charming mutants you’ll love, or hate. Explore a massive open world above and underground. Don’t get charmed; get to work and cleanse the Purple Lands!

5292980.name: Marina Manager Demo
5292980.short_description: In this Marina Manager demo, take charge of a small Mediterranean harbor. Negotiate with arriving captains, handle cargo and accommodation, and dive after crates lost overboard. Complete each job, collect your fee, and make room for the next boat.

4997480.name: Mapping Creator
4997480.short_description: Draw maps, make nations fight and create historical or fantasy timelapses with Mapping Creator: a tool to unleash creativity!

4603740.name: Asana Demo
4603740.short_description: Play Chapters 1 and 2 of ASANA, a sci-fi dark comedy visual novel voiced in English. Build your stats, make choices, and talk to N.E.K.O., your judgmental cat-shaped ship AI. Try live AI conversations and a persuasion challenge. N.E.K.O. is still not impressed.

4192390.name: Catstronaut, Félicette's adventures
4192390.short_description:
A 2D platform game set in space, based on gravity and mini-planets, in which you play as Félicette, who travels through space.
You will have to navigate each level, using your skills to manage the gravity of the planets you encounter, jumping, using your jetpack, and other surprises...

5088140.name: Phantom Line: Prologue
5088140.short_description: Experience the beginning of the nightmare. Phantom Line: Prologue is a co-op (1-4) tactical shooter set in a war-torn Europe with paranormal events. Contain monstrous anomalies, navigate nuclear chaos, and test your squad's survival before the full mission begins.

5167700.name: This Game Socks
5167700.short_description: Find, match, and toss 3,000 socks into the basket with friends. Buy absurd gadgets and upgrade them to make the task easier (or not).

668750.name: Cthulhu's Cleanup Crew
668750.short_description: You’re Employee #1 at Cthulhu’s new reality repair business. Unfortunately, neither of you knows what you’re doing. Clean up impossible disasters with a cosmic paint gun, then run the office: get paid, upgrade your gear and workspace, and try to ignore whatever’s screaming behind the walls.

4962440.name: Pass the Blunt
4962440.short_description: One blunt. A deck full of Bad Trips. Friends you can't trust. Pass the Blunt is a party card game for 2 to 6 players where holding the blunt makes your cards hit harder and your problems twice as big. Last one standing wins.

5328640.name: This Game Socks Demo
5328640.short_description: Mom won't let you touch a video game until you match your socks. In this demo, find, match and toss 5 pairs into the basket, earn coins and buy the Sock Magnet. The full game: 3,000 socks, 13 absurd gadgets and online co-op with friends.

5212610.name: Ad Nauseam - The Wrong Side Soundtrack
5212610.short_description: The full lolratz-made soundtrack of Disc 0, Disc 1, Disc 2, and Disc 4 (when it is finished).

4779490.name: Underfang
4779490.short_description: A psychological horror game where you explore atmospheric dreamscapes. Sprint to survive, manage your stamina wisely, and escape from terrifying nightmares to find your way back to reality, if you can.

4717490.name: Motapon
4717490.short_description: Words are bridges in this chill puzzle game! Help Motapon the dog find their new home, unlock hats and collect fishes along the way !

5455650.name: ドリイ —stairway to heaven— Demo
5455650.short_description: DORII is a psychological horror visual novel about an illegal human cloner who receives an unusual request: recreate a dead son. Raise a human life, confront unsettling truths, and discover what it means to be human. Experience the beginning of the story in this free demo.

3964230.name: Dictapoint — Underground Pharma Simulator
3964230.short_description: They were waiting for a fix — they got you instead. Craft the cure, scale up production, run sales and wage war on the gangs choking this rotting town. Choose: stay honest and die broke, or brew a cure so good they'll crawl to you on their knees.

4697880.name: Rock Band Simulator
4697880.short_description: A first-person rock band life sim where you explore a gritty 1990s neighbourhood, play rhythm-based concerts, get into fights, make bad decisions, and somehow keep your band together.

5426040.name: The Last Visitor
5426040.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel. You are alone in a museum at night, or so you think. Examine paintings, trust your instincts, and decide what is real and what is only in your mind. Every choice shapes how the night ends.

2430710.name: Operator: Observation
2430710.short_description: Take on the role of Colin Nox, a security operator monitoring surveillance cameras for anomalies. What starts as a routine job quickly turns sinister as the anomalies grow more aggressive, invading the houses you watch, breaking into your home, and crawling into your mind.

4828200.name: Vaporware EX
4828200.short_description: It's 199X. Lose the suit, put on a hoodie, and become the name on the box. Craft games feature by feature, squash bugs, push your engine and haggle with publishers in this comfy 16-bit game dev sim, a neon-soaked love letter to the cartridge era.

4538080.name: Kingdom Inc.
4538080.short_description: A minimalist factory / city builder. Design your workflow by harvesting resources, building equipment, outfitting your adventurers, and sending them on dangerous missions. Recover lost territory and unravel the plot that threatens to destroy your kingdom!

4102540.name: Ultimate Girlfriend Experience
4102540.short_description: Your anime girlfriend moves onto your desktop. She watches your cursor, blushes at your touch... dress her, spoil her, and see how far she lets you go.

1500880.name: Random Racing
1500880.short_description: A collection of driving mini-games with unique exaggerated physics. Full cross-platform multiplayer enabled. Invite friends and compete in interesting game modes such as Sumo, Darts, Bomb-Tag and more.

5216850.name: The Big Cleanup : Hotel Palm Beach Demo

4971980.name: Click Cafe
4971980.short_description: An active incremental serving game where you run your own cafe! Wait on tables and serve food as orders keep coming in. Purchase upgrades to expand your cafe and earn even more money!

1281930.name: tModLoader
1281930.short_description: Dig, Fight, and Build your way through the world of player-created mods on Terraria with tModLoader - this DLC makes modding Terraria a reality!

4665590.name: Apotheosis Engine
4665590.short_description: Lost in the void, a space probe awakens to a mind it was never designed to possess. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game about exploring an alien operating system and growing from a simple probe into a digital deity.

3246310.name: 0101 - Counter Bonus Levels 1
3246310.short_description: This DLC includes another 200 bonus Counter levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

3316150.name: The Doll Museum
3316150.short_description: This 2D psychological horror game traps you in a pastel-pink doll museum, where you help Valentine to survive the cruel Doll Queen!

4542840.name: COOKBOT
4542840.short_description: You've been placed as a standard model COOKBOT on the transit ship ZIMA. Cook, bake, pour, freeze, cut and mix food while following recipes. Complete orders from crew members and listen to their stories. But remember - you're not human. The cake is there for company morale.

3415410.name: Project Louisiana - The BOUNDS VR
3415410.short_description: A narrative horror mystery adventure set in a cursed Louisiana mansion. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a long-buried voodoo ritual, guided by a spirit who plays by its own rules.

5356970.name: Rasen Demo
5356970.short_description: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters. Featuring GGPO-style rollback netcode for responsive online matches.

3246300.name: 0101 - Pusher Bonus Levels 1
3246300.short_description: This DLC includes another 200 bonus Pusher levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

5033720.name: Swarmdle
5033720.short_description: A survivors-like roguelite. Fight down through three areas, collect weapons and upgrades, and unlock permanent upgrades between runs. Plus a twelve-minute daily run that is identical for every player in the world.

3940270.name: Bug Factory
3940270.short_description: Build, automate and scale a software factory. Move bugs through Reproduce, Fix, Test and Deploy, eliminate bottlenecks, survive regressions and turn a manual pipeline into an increasingly powerful automated system.

5428780.name: Dusty Relics
5428780.short_description: A cozy first-person archaeology game set in ancient Egypt. Dig through soft sand with your pickaxe, sweep the site with your radar to find buried relic fragments, then carry them to the pedestal and rebuild legendary statues piece by piece.

4565520.name: Booty
4565520.short_description: Booty is a swashbuckling, arcade-y 2D platformer game with Rocket Jumping at its core! Aim, charge, jump, shoot and fly across many islands! Loot treasures, blast enemies and climb to the top! Destroy blocks, speedrun through stages, increase your bounty and unlock gameplay-altering curses!

5055010.name: Life of Pawn: Chocolate and Marshmallow
5055010.short_description: Bounce through a hand-drawn world of sweet chocolate and soft marshmallows! Relax to delightful animations, play at your own comfortable pace, and gently learn real chess tactics along the way. Play cozy, play smart, and watch your tiny pawn evolve! 🍫✨

3246290.name: 0101 - Classic Bonus Levels 1
3246290.short_description: This DLC includes another 200 bonus Crossflip levels, extremely cool, which will make you love the game even more.

4989850.name: 不一样的合成：生生不息
4989850.short_description: Combine cards in a resource management and automation game with a meta twist. Start with water, wind, earth, and stone. Discover recipes, assign workers, and connect production lines as your civilization reaches for the stars. Your world comes alive, and your narrator reacts to your experiments.

5097330.name: Rules for Thee Demo
5097330.short_description: A paperwork game about judging the dead. Read the file, question the soul at the glass, check them against the record, and stamp ASCEND, DESCEND, HOLD or REFER. New rules arrive mid-shift. Enquiries cost time you do not have. Nobody is graded on kindness.

4702610.name: Crimson Animatronic
4702610.short_description: Choose your path, survive, break your mouse from button mashing and reach disturbing endings! In this analog horror visual novel, you play as werecat radio host Daiane, who must survive the Crimson Order, a cursed cult of vampires, and Charkelene Chan, a massive red maned wolf animatronic!

4806020.name: Cloudpaws Demo
4806020.short_description: CloudPaws is a cozy sky trading adventure where you sail an airship, trade goods, farm, fish, and explore floating islands while helping locals and uncovering their mystery✨

5478710.name: EXOSECTOR
5478710.short_description: A space 3D MMORPG on a colossal scale. Up to 100,000 players simultaneously in one persistent, seamless game universe of 10,000 star systems.

1482500.name: Build Fight Game
1482500.short_description: Build Fight Game is a class-based shooter set across a collection of fully interactable voxel environments. Create, destroy, and shoot your way to victory with your team in procedurally-generated multiplayer maps!

3351260.name: H.A.I.N
3351260.short_description: H.A.I.N: Heir of the Ancient Immortal Necromancer is an asymmetrical co-op horror/thriller game for 1–4 players. Explore hostile regions, collect ancient artifacts, and begin the final ritual. But one of you will become H.A.I.N, the betrayer, and trust will collapse.

4959360.name: Crimson Animatronic Demo
4959360.short_description: Choose paths, click, destroy your mouse, survive, and get disturbing endings. Play the prologue in this demo! Survive with Kiki Kirtz and Mini Ki on the streets of Baltimore, dealing and surviving with the vengeful animatronic Charkelene Chan and even worse creatures...

4872960.name: Tipsy Corpse Demo
4872960.short_description:
Zombies, monsters and demonic creatures have taken over the town. Someone has to deal with it.

A twin-stick rogue-lite where your weapons, your cocktails and the environment can become your allies; as well as the friend sitting next to you who won't settle for just watching!

5171780.name: Karakam: Call of The Dark Manor Demo
5171780.short_description: Karakam: Call of the Dark Manor is a first person psychological horror game where you explore a cursed manor of a long forgotten bloodline. Solve riddles, explore the grounds and discover the horror stories hidden within the horror story. Dark Manor summons you, how will you answer it?

5138890.name: Control Tower
5138890.short_description: Good afternoon! We have reviewed your resume and are pleased to offer you the air traffic controller position at the old runway. Your first shift starts tonight. Duties: supervising pilots, maintaining the runway, and preventing unauthorized access.

4573500.name: Arms Race
4573500.short_description: The enemy that kills you robs your grave, takes your build, and comes back next run wearing it. A bullet hell roguelite with no chests, 100+ mutating items, and a different continent's mythology on every floor.

4595290.name: MUPPLED
4595290.short_description: MUPPLED is a multiplayer sandbox platformer where you can build, race, work with, and torment your friends across a variety of different game modes.

5142590.name: Penthouse
5142590.short_description: Penthouse is a Rogue-like horror game where you (and your friends) stumble into a haunted Penthouse in order to pay rent for your boat. As you do, you must find clues and use devices to discover what happened in this Penthouse. Solve the mystery of the Haunting.

5342520.name: Artifical Railways
5342520.short_description: Build and manage your own railway across scenic landscapes. Connect towns, plan timetables, manage your trains, and keep passengers moving as your network grows. Created with extensive use of AI tools throughout development.

5320080.name: Cocaine Smuggler Demo
5320080.short_description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

5241660.name: Backrooms: Project Mapping
5241660.short_description: A unique backrooms experience where all players work together to collectively map the entire Backrooms. Play with up to 4 friends, explore and expand your map in procedurally generated, incomprehensibly massive backrooms.

5116290.name: AeonDeck
5116290.short_description: Take control of Windows audio and system actions with AeonDeck. A lightweight command mixer featuring per-app routing, customizable macro and endpoint shortcuts, dynamic tray gestures, and seamless Serial/LAN synchronization for DIY hardware faders.

4758560.name: BAUSFIGHT
4758560.short_description: BAUSFIGHT is a fast-paced battleground for 2–8 players, packed with short multiplayer modes. Choose a weapon-based class, master its unique abilities, and unleash wild combos to ruin your foes’ day. Fight solo to be the last one standing, or team up with friends and conquer the lobby together.

4973590.name: DeskForge
4973590.short_description: DeskForge turns a cluttered Windows desktop into a command console. Icons and folders go into customisable drawers, or a honeycomb layout that grows ring by ring; clock, memos and system monitor can sit on your wallpaper. It stays beneath every window — never in the taskbar, never stealing focus.

4170350.name: M.A.Y.A
4170350.short_description: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

3140770.name: Hackebein's Object Tracking
3140770.short_description: Bring real SteamVR trackers and controllers onto objects on your VRChat avatar. This streams device poses into VRChat. Set up Trackers in Unity, wear the avatar, and enjoy your time in-game.

4752710.name: Overlap
4752710.short_description:
Fast-paced 2D wave shooter built around the parry. Two
  weapons, a coin shop, nine planets of
  story, and a style meter that punishes the timid. Reach SSS
  rank, clear the campaign, or die trying.

5412570.name: Lost Ball: Homeward Bound Demo
5412570.short_description: One lost ball. One epic journey home. Bounce, roll and blast your way through a 3D world of colourful environments from gritty cityscapes to fantastical worlds. Master new abilities, overcome tricky obstacles and solve challenging puzzles along the way. Ready to roll? Then let’s bounce

850870.name: Hard-Life
850870.short_description: Did you ever think Half-Life was way too easy? Hard-Life corrects that issue.

1785310.name: Dread Wardens
1785310.short_description: Fight on the front line. Build the defenses behind you. Dread Wardens blends third-person action with dark-fantasy tower defense. Master five heroes, combine spells and towers, and survive an endless climb through undead armies—solo or in online co-op for up to four players.

3287510.name: ColorMinis
3287510.short_description: ColorMinis is a creative 3D painting studio for miniatures, characters, creatures and scenes. Explore hundreds of models, paint from every angle, and bring your ideas to life with expressive brushes, tri-color shading and precision tools.

1930320.name: Iron Online
1930320.short_description:
Iron Online is a new indie PvP MMO in Early Access! 

Designed around player vs player world events. 

Join our Discord! The invitation link is available on the game's login page.

5336880.name: This Is the Peace Soundtrack
5336880.short_description: The King has a playlist. Of course he does. Bring home the 9 songs from T-Phone in This Is the Peace: almost 28 minutes of presidential ambition, very modest song titles, and music for your next historic victory.

4898760.name: Bossfall
4898760.short_description: Bossfall is a Sci-Fi Action RPG where you fight the galaxy's most powerful warriors and monsters to claim legendary loot. Shoot and dash through relentless incoming attacks, customize your character's build, and conquer the arena to become the ultimate coliseum champion.

5335100.name: Halloween 2026
5335100.short_description: It's Halloween night. The parents are out until midnight, and you're the babysitter. All you have to do is keep the porch light on and hand out candy.

4360160.name: Horse Race Tests: Life is Pain
4360160.short_description: In Horse Race Tests: Life is Pain, feed into your worst impulses in this action packed high score gambling game. Gain abilities to rig races in your favor! Collect virtual figurines of your favorite horses, like Jovial Merryment...

5378040.name: Tavern: Tidy Up Demo
5378040.short_description:
Warm, handcrafted-looking environments with a medieval atmosphere
Barrels, bread, goblets, meat, pots, and many other diverse items
Relaxing room-to-room gameplay
An inn that expands and unlocks new areas as you clean
Character upgrades
Pressure-free and stress-free gaming experience

5075060.name: 宗门起源 Soundtrack
5075060.short_description: Official Sound Track of Eastern Era

5208630.name: Fart Together Demo
5208630.short_description: Fart Together is a physics-based co-op parkour game where 2–4 players steer the same boat using fart power. Coordinate your direction, timing, and gas power with friends to overcome challenging obstacle courses.

5266780.name: Mythical Whalers Demo
5266780.short_description: Set sail in the shrouded seas. A procedurally generated world where each voyage is unique. Captain a crew of mythical races to face monstrous leviathans and gain status with cunning factions.

4962900.name: Joint Venture: Prison Commissary Simulator Demo
4962900.short_description: Run the prison commissary from behind the window: match IDs to prisoner numbers, obey the guards' daily rules, and fill orders for profit. Then build a contraband empire in drugs, shivs, and smuggled goods, dodging patrols, cameras, and pat-downs. Serve your time, or smuggle your way out.

4443460.name: The Cleaner: Prologue
4443460.short_description: The Cleaner: Prologue is the first chapter of little bird Taki’s journey through a living, hand-drawn paper world of nature. Explore the opening levels, listen for subtle audio cues, and solve puzzles through observation and interaction. Continue the story in the full version of The Cleaner.

4091760.name: Life & Shadow Celestial Call Demo
4091760.short_description:
You are trapped in the observatory of a star-obsessed professor atop Mount Clearveil.
Plan your survival during the day, confront the darkness of the basement at night.
Can you break the ritual and uncover the mystery?

3871340.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine 2 - Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack
3871340.short_description:
Honour your Chapter's proud martial heritage with the Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack!

This Pack contains over 40 cosmetic items from 8 Imperial Fists Successor Chapters.

The Imperial Fists Cosmetic Pack is available as part of the Season Pass 2.

3880120.name: OMSI 2 Add-on Project Numazu
3880120.short_description: Welcome to Numazu — the first Japanese map & bus add-on for OMSI 2 featuring left-hand traffic! Drive through atmospheric Japanese streets, bustling commercial districts, quiet neighborhoods, and the iconic Numazu Port — all within one of Japan’s most charming coastal cities!

3353380.name: Dead by Skill Check
3353380.short_description: A skill check trainer for Dead by Daylight - to hone your skills or just warm up for the day.

3500550.name: Schrödinger’s Call Episode 1 Demo
3500550.short_description: When the world is coming to an end, who would you want to speak to one last time? Schrödinger’s Call is a visual novel that lets you experience the pain and salvation of human connection, as if you were turning the pages of a picture book.

3525720.name: Phoenix's Faye Demo (飞儿)
3525720.short_description: A girl who has practiced martial arts since childhood finds herself, for some unknown reason, trapped in a fantastical world. She must continuously fight to find her way back home! This is a high-difficulty action game featuring intense combat, immersive scene atmospheres, highly oppressive NPCs.

3111040.name: Scary Bingo
3111040.short_description: Horror themed bingo game, draw cards and avoid getting 4 across and be doomed!

2925640.name: Nuclear Sub Demo
2925640.short_description: A realistic nuclear submarine simulator will allow you to take command of your crew and battle your fiercest enemies. Arm yourself with missiles, dive into the ocean and fight for your country

2711470.name: Ghosts of Tabor - UWU
2711470.short_description: The Merchant of Death has some new stock! Prepare to add some kawaii flair to your armory with four weapons and a helmet. Each with varying with vibrant colors!

4638820.name: Contested Space
4638820.short_description: A space roguelike deckbuilder for solo or 2-4 player co-op. Command one of nine factions, deploy stations, and buy new cards mid-fight from a rotating market that reshapes your deck every combat. Build your fleet and conquer Contested Space.

1173590.name: Dominus Galaxia: KS Edition
1173590.short_description: Dominus Galaxia is a 4X space strategy game with a focus on amplifying strategic decisions and minimising non-strategic busywork.

5261530.name: Industeria Demo
5261530.short_description: Build and defend a growing industrial colony on a hostile alien world. Mine resources, automate production lines, expand a massive factory, and protect your territory from relentless alien attacks in this top-down 3D strategy game.

1049240.name: The Elder Scrolls Online - Newcomer Pack
1049240.short_description: Slither into your Tamrielic journey with the Newcomer Pack, featuring an exclusive Salamander pet, 1,500 Crowns for use in the Crown Store, as well as a 150% Experience Scroll to aid in your adventures.

5191500.name: The Big Suck Demo
5191500.short_description: You are the tornado. Tear through farms and cities, turn destruction into cash, and upgrade a tiny breeze into a huge Lightning Storm.

934640.name: World of Warships — Texas Demo (3 days)
934640.short_description: Texas is a tough fighter designed to fend off enemy attacks and break through enemy defenses. She carries good armor, numerous guns, and very effective AA defense for a Tier V ship. Get her for free for 3 days with this special offer and see what she can do for yourself!

5006630.name: Starcore
5006630.short_description: Starcore is a free-to-play voxel fortress-defense roguelite. Build, mine, research, and fight escalating swarms solo or in four-player co-op. Wage team battles in Corenet, or create and share custom scenarios through Steam Workshop.

5309250.name: Until Midnight
5309250.short_description: A strategic rougelike where every decision influences your future. Unlock your board, gather powerful gears and constellations, and play your cards wisely for a chance to survive Until Midnight!

5365780.name: Deckbound
5365780.short_description: Summoned to a world ruled by the Demon Lord, your only power is your deck. Dodge bullet-hell attacks in real time, fight with a 4-card hand, and loot a permanent card collection from procedural dungeons. Teleport home before you lose it all. Solo or 2-4 player co-op.

2804040.name: Screaming Savage Blood Death
2804040.short_description: Take charge as freshly-hired camp counselors and rescue campers from natural nasties, supernatural spooks, as well as a mysterious maniac in a retro side-scrolling survival-horror adventure set in the wetlands of New Jersey. Can you uncover the dark secrets lurking within the Pine Barrens?

4929430.name: ProjeVerse
4929430.short_description: Let little creatures take over your room. They climb up your books and dance on your computer.

2607430.name: Lair of the Locksmith
2607430.short_description: A challenging logic puzzle disguised as a platformer. Unlock doors by combining numbered keys. Outwit the locksmith’s devious dwarvish designs, and rescue your imprisoned goblin friends.

5426820.name: SlimeMan
5426820.short_description: A top-down action game inspired by retro classics! Control a mischievous slime, eliminate the mushrooms on screen, and use explosive slime blobs or consume energy to devour your enemies. Choose your strategy and clear every stage!

5169710.name: Witchkeeping
5169710.short_description: Witchkeeping is a cozy narrative organizing game about a witch urgently appointed to an academy library. Fly your broom, shelve the books by solving their puzzles, and put the wands away. Open the owl’s letters, sort out the valley’s odd troubles, and find out what happened to Madame Vesper.

2414230.name: Tricula Demo
2414230.short_description: Solve intricate puzzles to help Tricula the vampire find his way to his coffin in this grid-based pixel-art puzzle platforming game.

5271510.name: The Lootlands Demo
5271510.short_description: What if Path of Exile played itself? Build your hero, automate the grind, and collect god-tier loot. Even while you sleep.

3507480.name: Heartwood Village: Cozy Co-op Adventure
3507480.short_description: Team up and help Heartwood Village prepare for a festival in a tiny open world whilst exploring, collecting and being silly together and growing your friendships along the way.

5149570.name: Monster Meadows - Online Board Game Demo
5149570.short_description: Zarı at ve büyülü haritayı fethet! Canavar yuvalarını geliştir, eşsiz karakter yeteneklerini serbest bırak ve bu kaotik çok oyunculu parti oyununda arkadaşlarını iflas ettir.

4705870.name: Single Note
4705870.short_description: An atmospheric first-person driving adventure through a strange retro world filled with music, mystery, and psychological tension.

4935110.name: IRU
4935110.short_description: IRU is a cozy creature-collecting adventure that blends open-world exploration and auto-battler combat with roguelike progression. Find and tame magical creatures to assemble a unique team and pervail against the dangers of the world!

5463350.name: Hellobnb Simulator
5463350.short_description: Turn a run-down house on a beautiful Greek island into a thriving vacation rental empire! Renovate, decorate, welcome guests, buy properties, and expand your businesses. Explore island life and build your dream solo or with friends in 4-player online co-op!

5464360.name: Hellobnb Simulator Demo
5464360.short_description: Play the opening chapter of HelloBnb Simulator: renovate a run-down house on a Greek island, turn it into a vacation rental, welcome guests and start your beach business. Wishlist the full game!

4728480.name: Slashbang Vertical Slice
4728480.short_description: Enter Slashbang, a narrative driven, movement-first first person shooter taking inspiration from games like Sonic Adventure, Jet Set Radio, and the Metal Gear series.

5457480.name: Fishwake
5457480.short_description: Eat, grow and survive in a fast-paced underwater arcade adventure. Hunt smaller fish, evade predators, master currents and bosses, and fight your way through 50 handcrafted levels to the top of the food chain.

3580260.name: Siegebound
3580260.short_description: A roguelike auto-battler meets tower defense. Hold your castle against an army that never stops coming. Merge units to evolve them, raise walls to hold the line, and fight alongside your army as a hero.

4871070.name: Shine on Savior Demo
4871070.short_description: Shine on Savior takes place in 2009 in the city of New Delmarr. You play as Roy Rogers who leaves New Delmarr for work for a few months and comes back to see his city overrun with Dregs. Your mission is to save the city of New Delmarr from the Dregs and find the truth of what happened to your city.

5423590.name: SEAMARK Demo
5423590.short_description: Chart your own course in SEAMARK, a maritime adventure of sailing, trading, and naval combat. Visit port towns, buy and sell goods, and command your ship in battle. Discover the world and core gameplay in this demo featuring a portion of the full game.

4731070.name: Kron Wars
4731070.short_description: A persistent space MMO that runs in your browser. No download. No installation. Open a tab and you are in the Frontier. Trade, mine and fight across 2 universes and 12,000 sectors, in an economy that players build. And one mechanic that no other MMO has: war rewrites the map.

5372270.name: Flux Fall
5372270.short_description: Idle pinball meets pachinko in Flux Fall. Drop balls through a glowing peg cascade, use your flippers to keep them in play, and hit ramps to build bigger chains and more coins. Level up every part of the board, upgrade your automation, and keep earning while you're away.

4924290.name: Fire Bug
4924290.short_description: Hold the sun in your hand in this fast-paced arcade game. Play as a magnifying glass and cook swarms of bugs before time runs out. Chain ignitions, defeat tier bosses, and spend your Sparks on upgrades tree to unlock explosive criticals, burn trails, and smoldering spore clouds.

5161770.name: Guardian Above the Domes Demo
5161770.short_description: Guardian Above the Domes is a real-time artillery game built around realistic orbital mechanics. Bombard the enemy from a lone space station, defend the last domed cities on an airless planet, and uncover its lost history alongside a cat-shaped AI.

4953990.name: 第三监视局
4953990.short_description: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

4864430.name: Shine on Savior
4864430.short_description: Shine On Savior is an action platformer that takes you through the city of New Delmarr and kill hundreds of dregs. Anything in this city can be used as a weapon. A ritual has been set in New Delmarr in which all of the humans and dregs resurrect upon death.

5063080.name: Second Screen Gaming
5063080.short_description: Keep compatible games running on your second monitor while you use your main screen. A Windows utility for dual-monitor and multi-monitor gaming, with borderless window placement, background audio, cursor control, and saved per-game settings.

2610350.name: The Big Lez Video Game Playtest

5397990.name: SEAMARK
5397990.short_description: Chart your own course in a single-player maritime RPG. Trade between ports, recruit companions, and build your fleet. Explore distant regions, uncover discoveries and local stories, and brave real-time naval battles as you make your way across the seas.

2380470.name: Ember Throne Online
2380470.short_description: Iris Online is a gypsy-themed fantasy MMORPG featuring over 1000 quests, 22 themed instance dungeons, and a Tarot Card system, providing players with a full-featured PvE and PvP action, complemented by cute anime graphics and a Divination System allowing character buffs and monster transformations.

5014670.name: Тайны Родиона
5014670.short_description: A supernatural adventure with visual novel elements. Explore an antique shop filled with unusual characters, secrets, humor, and heartfelt stories.

4911420.name: ARC Aquarium Demo
4911420.short_description: Play ARC Aquarium for free. Raise and sell 12 fish species, decorate with 10 items and 3 backgrounds, and experience the relaxing aquarium loop.

4683830.name: Typenstein: A Symphony of Keys
4683830.short_description: You are a Doctor Typenstein, who needs to defend his castle every night against the oncoming villagers. TYPE words to attack enemies, LEVEL UP and unlock new skills, UPGRADE your castle by using killed villagers, and SURVIVE till the end of the night.

5200240.name: Enjoy Your Stay Demo
5200240.short_description: Navigate the never-ending hallway of the Hudson: A hotel that doesn’t want its guests to leave. Observe your surroundings, spot irregularities, and choose the correct path to escape.

1656280.name: SYNCHRONIZERS: UNDEAD MARINES
1656280.short_description: "SYNCHRONIZERS: UNDEAD MARINES" blends high-quality Three-Lane Tower Defense with Reverse Tower Defense gameplay. Command your units in a thrilling narrative reminiscent of a StarCraft and Plants Vs. Zombies fusion! Your choices will forge the path to victory—or defeat.

5463710.name: Cards: Tidy Up!
5463710.short_description: Tidy up a room full of scattered playing cards into neatly completed decks. Sort by theme, suit, and rank in this relaxing first-person tidy-up game. Earn upgrades, discover helpful machines for automation, and find your own satisfying way to clear the table.

4401960.name: Morphing Demo
4401960.short_description: Morphing is a 2D adventure puzzle game where you possess the ability of morphing. This power allows you to transform and acquire the traits of certain objects or creatures. Use this unique skill to overcome challenges and explore the world.

5295010.name: Retro Empire
5295010.short_description: Buy filthy retro consoles from strangers, bring them back to life on your workbench and sell them in your own second-hand game shop. Haggle for stock, take on repair jobs, fix up arcade machines and grow the shop level by level. Free one-hour demo.

5306650.name: His Big Bull
5306650.short_description: A little bull for your Windows desktop. Pick from 24 characters, feed him, watch him nap, or take a break with fishing, mahjong and mini-games. Keep notes and clipboard history nearby, and turn your own photos into animated desktop companions.

5332290.name: Build Christmas
5332290.short_description: Build a cozy 3D North Pole village. Connect candy, wooden toy, and plush production chains, house your elves, decorate snowy streets, and load presents aboard the courier sleighs before Christmas Eve. Grow your village and uncover Santa's mystery.

4932120.name: Thimbleweed Park 2
