4932120.short_description: Agents Ray and Reyes are investigating a murder at the Mansion. In a spoof of a classic whodunit, everyone is a suspect and the murderer will be confronted…... If you can find them. Not really a sequel. Not really a prequel. It’s more Thimbleweed Park and just as weird.

4040390.name: D.R.I.F.T. Demo
4040390.short_description: An open-world space simulator where you explore star systems, manage resources, and take contracts to survive. Trade, diplomacy, and risk blend in a dynamic galaxy where every choice matters.

3492640.name: Dark Trip
3492640.short_description: Dark Trip is a gothic horror escape room where you use wicked biomachinery, strange art and your own hallucinations to solve the mystery of an eerie crime. Explore strange rooms, inspect occult locations and laboratory machines, reveal hidden clues through altered visions. Play flat or in VR.

5139560.name: RogueSlot
5139560.short_description:
A dark fantasy roguelite where every battle begins with a spin. Build your hero, bend the odds, and turn a 5×5 slot grid into devastating combos as you fight through a cursed dungeon.

Choose your upgrades carefully—every symbol, relic, and risky reroll can turn a losing run into a jackpot.

5062000.name: Dwarven Outpost Incremental
5062000.short_description: The world's first 3D open-world survival cookie clicker. Mine, chop, and hunt across a living landscape. Teach your dwarf to auto-harvest nearby resources. Research, build, and cook to grow a thriving outpost.

4535370.name: Throughput
4535370.short_description: Wire yourself into a vector-bright city that runs on the beat. The system you built for people develops a pulse of its own. Build the city. Watch it breathe.

877900.name: Clanker Calamity
877900.short_description: A turn-based robot programming race for 2 to 8 players. Load five instruction cards face down, then watch every plan collide with belts, rams, lasers, shafts, and each other on a factory floor that never got the memo. Solo, online, or on the couch with friends in party mode.

5373100.name: Makoto Maze
5373100.short_description: Makoto Maze is a hand-drawn horror adventure about a young girl trapped in a strange maze between life and death, where solving puzzles and exploring a black-and-white world reveals the dark secrets hidden within her family. Some are stained in red.

3967860.name: Rasen
3967860.short_description: Strike with precision, time your deflects and fight flawlessly to your own rhythm. Step into atmospheric PvP or PvE arena duels and fast-paced clashes with a variety of lethal characters. Featuring GGPO-style rollback netcode for responsive online matches.

5338490.name: Defenders of Cinderkeep Demo
5338490.short_description: Defenders of Cinderkeep is a dark fantasy incremental auto-battler. Battle endless waves of orcs, demons, dragons, and other mythic creatures in defense of the last bastion of humanity. Upgrade your heroes and equip them with a variety of spells and powers to unleash upon the demonic hordes.

4993250.name: REaffraid
4993250.short_description: REAFFRAID is a THIRD person SURVIVAL HORROR game where you FIGHT Soldiers, Robots, Zombies and SEXY demon girls with powerful weapons and hand to hand fighting techniques.

4771130.name: The Dark Inside Me - Chapter III
4771130.short_description: A cinematic psychological horror adventure where your choices shape the story. Solve disturbing mysteries, face your inner demons, and uncover the truth in the final chapter of The Dark Inside Me.

4590570.name: Wildcard
4590570.short_description: Wildcard is a fast-paced archery arena shooter where you build overpowered decks and demolish your friends.

4931590.name: All Hands
4931590.short_description: All Hands is a Sci-fi Strategy RPG with Turn Based combat and a focus on relationship management with the Corporate Nations that rule the stars. Journey with your fleet through the universe dealing with the situations that present themselves, and face the reward or consequences of your choices.

5398970.name: Neon Siege
5398970.short_description: Connect the dots, close the lines, obliterate everything caught inside: a real-time, wave-based roguelite. Between waves, expand a massive talent tree, procedurally generated every run.

3769780.name: Among Us Ranked (Unofficial)
3769780.short_description:
Welcome Challenger!
Play with 10-15 players online in a ranked game. Among Us. Discover new maps like Polus Nucléar, Challenger Mira, and Skeld!
(Unofficial mod see store page)

4821770.name: Cold Nights
4821770.short_description:
A quiet house. A long night. Keep the lights on - or find out what happens when they fade.
Cold Nights is a grounded psychological horror about staying calm when your home turns against you. The lights flicker, the power drops, and the silence grows heavier with every minute.

1918070.name: The Apothecary
1918070.short_description: Discover the source of a mysterious plague and build your apothecary in the city of Bloodmill. An epic adventure in a world full of disease and ruin. Explore the city, build your apothecary, create toxic potions, fight corrupt diseased creatures, discover powerful weapons and useful allies.

5333910.name: MATO-STICK
5333910.short_description: MATO-STICK is a physics-based arena brawler for up to four players. Grapple, wall-jump and fight with unusual weapons across moving platforms and destructible cover. Play locally with friends or bots, then choose your own arenas and rules.

3660160.name: To Shake, or Not to Shake
3660160.short_description: Your late grandfather left you his bar. Listen to the order, pick the ingredients, layer and shake — but the bartender drinks too: drink and your hands start to shake, stay sober and the voices in your head won't stop. A story-driven bar sim where every drink comes at a price.

4557820.name: Orb Rush VR
4557820.short_description: Hit incoming orbs with your virtual hands, dodge bombs, and chase high scores in active VR! Seven game modes, three fixed Rush challenges, and a fresh Daily Challenge put your reflexes, precision, and memory to the test.

2640090.name: Arcane Eats
2640090.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a delicious twist. Think like a master chef, balancing resources as you strategically combo ingredients to subdue hungry hordes. Recruit a legendary kitchen crew, and rise through the heroic cooking guilds—before The Hunger consumes us all!

5482120.name: Supermarket In Order
5482120.short_description: Thousands of products lie scattered across the supermarket floor. Pick them up, carry them to the right aisle and shelve every one until all 17 sections are perfectly in order. Complete sections to earn skill points and unlock abilities like telekinetic pull and remote placing.

3616600.name: Grimdelve Demo
3616600.short_description: Play the first hour of Grimdelve. Guide two souls through a dying world beneath a medieval Slovenia and decide who they become. Sneak past strangers, try to understand them, or tear them apart. Become charming manipulators or complete disasters.

4347010.name: Just One Bite
4347010.short_description: A 1~4 player co-op horror game. Your mission is to gather as much food as possible for the humans. But not all food is normal. Can you complete this mission to the very end?

3427770.name: Frontier Forge Demo
3427770.short_description: Survival / management sim. In Frontier Forge you play as a mercenary that have to save the world.

4095200.name: Oxygen Survivors
4095200.short_description: Oxygen Survivors is a side-scrolling roguelite where you control a spaceship supported by up to 6 drones that follow your movement. Fuse your drones together, get upgrades, and survive the final boss before the oxygen runs out.

4130150.name: THE ONES BEYOND
4130150.short_description: Take a temporary job as a doctor at Northvale to search for your missing sister. Interview patients and file reports by day. At night, explore restricted areas without getting caught by security patrols. A story-driven first-person psychological horror game.

5039920.name: Bloody Lens Demo
5039920.short_description: Risk everything for content as you fight to survive a terrifying night in the yard of Hiraldo's Hospital. Escape the grounds to complete your first run, then re-enter the nightmare to hunt for your lost keys—a special, hidden secret is waiting to be uncovered!

3727410.name: FriendOS
3727410.short_description: FriendOS is a 1-3 player action RPG where viruses must die! Strike and batter your opponents in Cartoon Sports Combat, and create the virtual animal avatar of your dreams. Hang out in lobbies with up to 12 friends and team up to protect the world of FriendOS from virus corruption.

5056260.name: BUNNYBALL: Arcade Basketball Roguelike
5056260.short_description: BUNNYBALL is an addictive arcade basketball roguelike game where you create incredible combos by combining balls with special power-ups, collectible cards, and powerful charms. Defeat bosses, break records, and fill the machine with gold.

1403960.name: ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP VR
1403960.short_description:
"ATTACK OF THE EVIL POOP V.R." is the ultimate toilet experience, more frantic than ever!
The crazy Windows and Mac title released last year on Steam, now has a V.R. version too!
(Thank god the smell is not included... Yet!)

3219250.name: Avandalair
3219250.short_description: Rebuild the once mighty human empire in this dynamic base building game. Establish thriving settlements across diverse landscapes, connect them through trade and military alliances, and fight to reclaim your lost legacy.

4958560.name: Helsinki Online
4958560.short_description: Open-world online game set in Helsinki. Drive, fly as a bird, and explore the city with friends.

4056170.name: Filled Up
4056170.short_description: Filled Up is a first-person survival horror/comedy hybrid featuring LGBT characters and themes. After a horrific accident, you awaken in the town of Hunksville, alone. An ancient and corrupt evil has taken over the town - can you save not only your friends, but the town of Hunksville itself?

4541970.name: Smithonion Natural History Museum
4541970.short_description: Smithonion Natural History Museum is an online co-op game about working the night shift at a museum where the exhibits are coming to life. Work alone or bring your friends to put everything back in place before your shift is over!

1879270.name: Into the Crypt
1879270.short_description: Immerse yourself in solo or co-op first-person deckbuilding where cards are your only weapon. Build complex synergies and use cards to physically unlock doors, chests, and interact with the environment while fighting to survive the crypt's powerful and strange enemies.

5175960.name: Dragon Fields Demo
5175960.short_description: Live the simple life in this cozy game where you farm crops, go fishing, play music, raise and mutate dragons, and customize your character!

5279590.name: ANIMITE　Echoes of the Chasm Demo
5279590.short_description: Fight alongside your wolf companion in this turn-based tactical game using gunfire and elemental reactions! Master positioning and elemental bullets. Harvest enemy ingredients to cook and sell from your food truck, but first, survive a grueling extraction phase against massive swarms!

4024470.name: Iskabon
4024470.short_description: A cursed game demo just merged with your PC's OS. Take part in a high-stakes roguelite deckbuilder with a Russian Roulette twist. Push your luck, trigger wild card synergies, and defeat the glitch to free your computer before the system melts.

5166240.name: ANIMITE　Echoes of the Chasm
5166240.short_description: Dive the Chasm: think, fight, scavenge, and get back out alive. A survival tactical RPG that switches between real-time exploration and turn-based combat. Your wolf, and the elemental reactions under your feet, are what get you out of a bad spot.

5431400.name: Zombie Outbreak Simulator
5431400.short_description: The ultimate zombie sandbox. No campaign, no objectives. Pick any city on Earth and unleash hundreds of thousands of zombies in 3D. Send in tanks and troops, fly the jet, drive the mech, or join the horde and burn it all down. Add a tornado, aliens or a black hole, because you can.

5238850.name: Xenogarden Demo
5238850.short_description: Play the Xenogarden demo and experience the core invasion loop: grow your alien network, assimilate structures, defend your heart, and survive escalating human attacks across the First Bloom tutorial and Final Bloom endless mode.

5169730.name: Below The Blades Demo
5169730.short_description: Climb, repair and survive Turbine 46 in a first-person horror game where every handhold matters. Survive a violent storm, manage your grip and stamina, and uncover what happened to the technician who came before you while trying not to get caught by what's crawling around the turbine.

5186670.name: CUMING FEAR Demo
5186670.short_description: It's a Horror Adventure Game + Escape Room with thick 80s Horror Movies Atmosphere. Imagine if Resident Evil, Silent Hill and Granny had a baby... with Hentai

5193870.name: Logic Arrows Demo
5193870.short_description: Logic Arrows is a sandbox game where you design your own mechanisms: from logic gates to an entire computer. Use simple elements to build complex systems, solve engineering challenges and master computer logic.

5301400.name: Bun-G BOP Demo
5301400.short_description: Bun G Bop is a low-stakes high-chaos co-op platformer about flinging your friend with a bungee cord while tagging a big tower. We built this game to be fun for all duos, even ones who suck at platformers.

5308010.name: FAKE ME Demo
5308010.short_description: Model, paint, and blend in! FAKE ME is an online multiplayer hide-and-seek game where you create your own disguise. Use simple 3D modeling tools to build the object you’ll hide as. You can also create your own costume by modeling. Hide from the Seekers or find every Faker before time runs out!

5408680.name: When Chests Rain Tons of Loot Demo
5408680.short_description: An incremental loot game where you drop your heroes onto hordes of slimes. They do the fighting, you grab the loot and fill your treasure chest. When time runs out, it bursts and rains it all back down. Upgrade your army in a huge skill tree and go again for a bigger haul.

4949510.name: Forza Horizon 6 2023 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon 170
4949510.short_description: Forza Horizon 6 2023 Dodge Challenger SRT Demon 170

4993840.name: SPRAWL zero Soundtrack
4993840.short_description: SPRAWL zero - Original Soundtrack, by REVEL

5018820.name: Forgotten - The Source
5018820.short_description: Federico only wanted justice for Jessica. What he found was far worse than revenge. In this first-person horror game, trust your flashlight, rely on your walkie-talkie, and solve puzzles that separate truth from oblivion. This story is the prequel to Forgotten - Whispers of the Past.

4639590.name: Tileburg Demo
4639590.short_description: Tileburg is a game where each tile played has direct effects as well as powerful combos that trigger as soon as the conditions are met. Transform the landscape and develop your city while scoring points. Each turn, the city expands on a random tile!

4677170.name: Too Deep To Quit Demo
4677170.short_description:
Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure!
Start your adventure in the jungle, explore the first biome, and venture deep into the wild on your way to the cursed temple.

4730310.name: Lost Lures Demo
4730310.short_description: Demo of the fishing adventure set in the northern wilderness. Learn fish behavior, read the waters and master your lures. Progress through a skill-based journey of quiet patience. Play solo or join friends online to complete shared missions and fish at your own pace.

4756450.name: Evercursed: Act I
4756450.short_description: Evercursed is a narrative-driven, atmospheric horror experience that delves into the world of sleep paralysis, and the demons that lurk within it. Step into Amelia's haunting nightmares, where the line between dreams and reality is blurred.

4378620.name: Echo Zero Demo
4378620.short_description: Descend into a dangerous, sci-fi underworld in this tower defense roguelike. Explore, gather resources, uncover powerful wargear and upgrades, build and defend your base, and battle a mysterious new species.

3862720.name: Deadliest Pigeon Demo
3862720.short_description: Equip weapons against physics based enemies, swing through chaos with grappling hook and destroy everything in your path to avenge the little chick!

4815200.name: Gore Grind
4815200.short_description: A first-person roguelite horde shooter for 1 to 4 players in couch co-op. The city mutated, the internet is down, and dying costs money. Shoot the horde, bank the cash, and keep working for the only pizza place still open.

3261260.name: Two Falls (Nishu Takuatshina) Demo
3261260.short_description: Explore 17th century Canadian wilderness through the eyes of Jeanne, a French woman who crossed the Atlantic to start anew and Maikan, an Innu hunter trying to discover what’s disturbing the forest. Your choices will shape the traits of the protagonists in this narrative single-player experience.

3296340.name: House Of Decay Demo
3296340.short_description: House of Decay is a PSX-style 3D platformer-metroidvania. Explore a world of demons in search of your missing brother, leap across hellish platforms, uncover secrets, find strange pets, and fight cute monsters 🦷

3479130.name: Sex &amp; Coffee ☕️🤎 Demo
3479130.short_description: Sex & Coffee: Demo Version is a fun, adult visual novel blending romance, magic, and temptation. Play as  new barista in a quirky fantasy world, and explore relationships with unique characters. Experience magical coffee brewing, spicy connections, and adult content!

3132990.name: Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool
3132990.short_description: The "Black Myth: Wukong Benchmark Tool" is a PC benchmark application specifically developed for "Black Myth: Wukong". It evaluates your hardware performance and system compatibility through the real-time rendering of an in-game sequence.

3152580.name: Amarillo's Desktop Pets Demo
3152580.short_description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

1255151.name: PAYDAY 2: Federales Weapon Pack
1255151.short_description: The Federales Weapon Pack DLC includes three new pistols, all of which are capable of full auto fire. Each of these weapons also has an akimbo option. 10 new weapon mods are also included.

4946420.name: She Tells Her Story Demo
4946420.short_description: A visual novel that details the author's experience growing up, covering topics such as friendship, bullying, romance, school, work, and depression.

737000.name: Neverwinter Nights: Enhanced Edition Infinite Dungeons
737000.short_description: Fight your way through the winding warrens of Undermountain, the greatest dungeon in the Forgotten Realms!

5423750.name: TRAPPIST-1
5423750.short_description: A hard sci-fi colony strategy game set in the real TRAPPIST-1 system. Mine, manufacture and build across hex-mapped planets, plan cargo runs on true orbital trajectories, and scan for rival expeditions hiding in the dark. No fleet battles. In space, physics is your weapon.

5391780.name: Griefborn Demo
5391780.short_description: Destroy hordes of unholy creatures using firearms and magical abilities. Create your own build, upgrade your weapons, and unlock new levels!

5432240.name: Seashells & Shovels
5432240.short_description: Volunteer to clean tourist islands and seize the chance to hunt pirate treasure. Sail between 12 colorful islands, bag litter, scrub away paint, follow maps, dig up buried finds, and make your ship a home in a cozy first-person adventure.

5401940.name: Party Bros Demo
5401940.short_description: Party Bros is a chaotic 2-8 player multiplayer party game! Gather your friends and compete in action-packed modes like combat, tag, and hide-and-seek.

5433670.name: Hold the Hex, Sir!
5433670.short_description: Draw the enemy's path, build powerful towers, and defend your castle against thousands of enemies in this roguelite tower defense game. Conquer procedurally generated maps, unlock permanent upgrades, and grow stronger with every attempt!

4926380.name: Orix
4926380.short_description: A 4v4 turn-based tactical RPG built for online play. Draft four heroes, reshape their kits with charms, and outplay a live opponent on terrain you both weaponize: shove foes into lava, traps, and geysers. Fast and lethal, with Survival and Gauntlet modes for solo play.

2628510.name: VOIDWATCH: CrossLust - Prologue DEMO
2628510.short_description: After being transported to a world that is not his own and forced to confront the horrors of Voideo alone, Brian wonders why he's been placed in such an unfathomable situation.

2642390.name: The Whims of the Gods
2642390.short_description: The Whims of the Gods is a strategic, cooperative city-builder created for joint gameplay in online co-op mode. Build and protect the ancient city, face enemies, and manage resources together! 🏠

5332250.name: MALEBOLGE
5332250.short_description: A first person horror descent through the whole of Dante’s Inferno, from the dark wood to the frozen lake. You are the only thing down there that can die: ration the oil in your lamp, slip past what hunts the scent of the living, and carry the names of the damned back out.

4981970.name: The Pineapple Conspiracy
4981970.short_description: A survival reality show for up to 10 players. Gather, craft and build a raft in twenty minutes while saboteurs work against you in secret. Take the confessional and accuse on air: get it wrong and you're out!

5049560.name: Alone at  school:Christmas
5049560.short_description: Alone at School: Christmas is an atmospheric horror walking simulator. Arriving at school before everyone else on Christmas morning, you soon realize that someone, or something, is already waiting for you in the empty halls.

5415090.name: Abandoned Below
5415090.short_description: Face relentless zombie waves in a decaying underground bunker. Fight solo or in co-op for up to four players. Build barricades, unlock new passages, explore and survive as long as you can.

5399320.name: Bamboo Ronin: The Last Cut
5399320.short_description: A retired ronin picking up his sword one last time, and a bamboo forest that has grown over his whole life. Cut your way through it one swing at a time, haul the pieces home, sharpen your blade and find out what's waiting at your old master's grave.

5376710.name: CloudBurst
5376710.short_description: Pilot a heavy airship through a sea of clouds, pull alongside your rivals and fire broadsides. Drift out of the storm and you sink. Up to ten captains over LAN or Steam, six modes, three kinds of terrain, and bots to fill every empty seat.

5071420.name: FreshSheets
5071420.short_description: Clean hotel rooms, satisfy guests, earn money, and work your way up to owning and managing your dream hotel.

5440540.name: Perfect Pitch Paddles
5440540.short_description: A roguelite built on relative pitch. Identify the music interval you hear to earn ammo and freeze your enemy, then spend that window dealing damage. Improve your skills, upgrade your arsenal, and become a master musician. Real ear training, wrapped in an arcade battle.

4010950.name: Fish For The World
4010950.short_description: Fish For The World is a game about managing a fishing company until you rule the world. Start small, hire fishermen to work for you and endlessly grow!

4970730.name: Kintsugi Moon
4970730.short_description: A small rabbit wakes with no memory in ancient Japan. In this hand-drawn, combat-free climb toward Mount Fuji, abilities only work in moonlight. Find the shards of a forgotten past and bring them to a fox who mends them with gold.

5483810.name: Frontline: Hold the Line
5483810.short_description: A WWII tactical roguelite about holding the line. Dig in, deploy riflemen, machine gunners, snipers, tanks and anti-tank guns, then call in artillery and air strikes as waves of enemy infantry and armour crash against your defences.

3779110.name: Argot's Laboratory
3779110.short_description:
Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! 
Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job...
Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

5156660.name: Zaehbet, Draad
5156660.short_description: Translate an unknown language to uncover mysteries and solve puzzles. Use context clues, dictionary notes, and your last two remaining brain cells to understand the plot, make crucial decisions, and build your own dialogue responses. And, hopefully, avoid insulting entire bloodlines in the process.

5402800.name: Argot's Laboratory Demo
5402800.short_description:
Argot's Laboratory (Demo) is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in charge of a high tech science lab! 
Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job...
Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

4567020.name: AMEN: The Quiet Exodus
4567020.short_description: Cursed the womb that bears emptiness beneath its heart. For the child enters the world with the veil upon its face, yet its soul wanders lone in the heavens where God is not. Why then does she not hasten to the place that was prepared for her? Seek the truth in our visual novel.

1999930.name: Never's End
1999930.short_description: Master a deeply systemic battlefield where every force interacts. Move heat to create wind, shift humidity to change the weather, and compress the earth, turning rock into lava. Possess townsfolk, explore an open world, and fight back the ever-creeping Never in this turn-based tactical RPG.

1398920.name: Virtuverse
1398920.short_description: Virtuverse is a Sci-Fi RCE MMORPG. Combining an intuitive economy system with action-based gameplay. Virtuverse has no class restrictions, use any weapon or armour. Those who wish to seek adventure will be able to explore Virtuverse on their own or with friends.

5390890.name: Nexus: Reach
5390890.short_description: Developed by a passionate solo indie dev, Nexus: Reach invites you into a vibrant 2D pixel world. Forage, farm, expand your settlement, and conquer dangerous dungeons as you carve your own path to survival.

5081380.name: FreshSheets Demo
5081380.short_description: Clean hotel rooms, satisfy guests, earn money, and work your way up to owning and managing your dream hotel.

5140990.name: PuPuPoPu Company
5140990.short_description: A cute, wacky top-down PvE extraction shooter. The world's fading, so a duckling with flashy feet and flawless blush starts a paint-spraying company. Blast away pollution in a hail of paint and give this black-and-white world its color back. Rescue critters, pack 'em to go—extract. Clock out!

4113520.name: ALL ADRIFT
4113520.short_description: A Cosmic Surgery RPG where fire gets wet and water burns. This universe is written in Declarations: operate on a sentence, and reality follows. Take your scalpel to species, creeds, even a planet's nature, and your doctored lines become scripture, then cosmic law. Just paperwork, Imperial Agent.

4767900.name: The Tolerance Group
4767900.short_description: You are an operator of The Tolerance Group, monitoring surveillance cameras in various locations, where reality has begun to break. Identify these continuity failures and promptly report them before the world is overwhelmed by horror.

4212960.name: Tisuland
4212960.short_description: Tisuland is a fantasy RPG combining daytime exploration and night-time tower defense. Gather resources, recruit companions, and defend the castle against evolving enemy waves. Your daily choices shape the battles and the fate of the land.

4786300.name: Subjects of Cthullius
4786300.short_description: Explore a distant solar system in a sci-fi adventure where mathematics becomes a real superpower. Solve puzzles, complete missions, upgrade your mathemagical abilities, and uncover a mysterious conspiracy.

4194840.name: Mombo Combo Legacy
4194840.short_description: The most tongue-tastic hero is back! Jump, fight, and complete MOMBO COMBOS in a new journey packed with action, intense challenges, and monstrous bosses. Explore new worlds in this 2D platformer with powerful forms and a mighty army of pets! The world needs our little purple hero once again!

5105260.name: AVXRPG
5105260.short_description: A 2D action RPG of short expeditions from a home town: fight, gather, complete stage quests, and forge your way forward.

5155860.name: Third Bloc
5155860.short_description: A text-based political management sandbox set in the Cold War. Balance the budget, recruit experts, bargain with rival powers, answer telegrams, and drag a poor new republic into the space age. Or bury it in a nuclear one. All in animated ASCII.

5039740.name: Plasma Sky Demo
5039740.short_description: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

3604380.name: Coin Pusher Casino Soundtrack
3604380.short_description: The Official Coin Pusher Casino soundtrack containing over 4+ hours of electronic music.

3142120.name: Timerift Raiders: The Past Awakens Playtest

3294180.name: KOTA: The Survival
3294180.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world abandoned by humans, control robots as they gather resources, fight enemies, and rebuild the planet using recycled materials. KOTA: The Survival lets you revive nature and craft a new future!

5417950.name: The Wrong Village
5417950.short_description: A pixel-art beat 'em up set in a Portuguese village. Take one of four family heroes through eight levels of combos, specials and bosses, solo or in 2-player local co-op. They picked the wrong family.

4539880.name: Stars Of Celestar
4539880.short_description: Brave the unknown in Stars Of Celestar, a 2D action-adventure RPG. Explore the legendary Tower, face formidable creatures, master unique abilities — even with your voice — and uncover the secrets of a world full of mysteries.

3493100.name: Tetrabonk
3493100.short_description: Tetrabonk is a 1–4 player co-op roguelike. Explore procedurally generated locations, fight with swords, bows, or firearms against hordes of enemies and powerful bosses, and build your character through upgrade cards — no run is ever the same.

5171270.name: Goodnight, B Demo
5171270.short_description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

4299040.name: Square Force
4299040.short_description: Run. Shoot. Swear. Repeat. Square Force is a fast, brutal co-op survival shooter where waves escalate, panic sets in, and surviving too long only makes things worse.

4951340.name: Plasma Sky
4951340.short_description: This week, every pilot on Earth flies the same new seeded run: identical enemies, identical drops, pure skill. Flow through alien formations, arm your wingmen, and power up when you can. Out-score your friends in Plasma Sky, an arcade shmup with over 100 handcrafted levels. Blast into the neon sky!

4662140.name: Goodnight, B
4662140.short_description: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore weird, dream-like environments, meet wacky friends, and find secrets to help B discover the ominous truth behind her nightmares!

4954140.name: Warlockle
4954140.short_description: Draft a spellbook from a shop and fight other players in a shrinking arena. Level up spells between rounds, equip gear with build-changing augments, and be the last wizard standing. Over 150 spells, playable online with friends and/or against bots.

4158880.name: Zero Century
4158880.short_description: A TRPG × Visual Novel led by the roll of the dice. You arrive at Seiria Magic Academy just one week before the centennial 'Violet Eclipse.' Immerse yourself in campus life, romance seven heroines, and uncover the world's hidden secrets. Your choices alone will reshape the fate of this world.

3667380.name: LAG KILLS
3667380.short_description: Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house, but little do you know the owner is home, and you're his prey. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE alone or with a friend.

2965720.name: Whiskers Wonderland
2965720.short_description: Whiskers Wonderland has been closed for years — but  Pops needs you to grab something from inside. Dodge traps, solve puzzles, and avoid Mr. Whiskers as you piece together what really happened here. Before a CATastrophe happens!

4161530.name: Eternal Dreams Demo
4161530.short_description: A Rogue AI and alien virus have trapped humanity in a dream-sim.  Craft Poker combos in this Roguelite JRPG; build and BREAK your deck to shatter the illusion. In this Deckbuilder, every hand doesn’t just change fate - it rewrites reality.

5001750.name: Finnish Fishing Simulator
5001750.short_description: Relaxed Finnish lake fishing. Change your lure, try different times of day and weather. From a calm morning to the evening glow, from the northern lights to a storm. Summer, autumn and winter each make the lake look different. No rush, just you, a boat and the water.

5056320.name: Fantorob
5056320.short_description: Fantorob is a futuristic take on classic monster-taming genre. Build robots and fight against your opponents to collect components and upgrade your team in this thrilling turn-based combat RPG with brain-twisting puzzles. Join the journey to become the greatest robot master!

4279000.name: SoundBoard Demo
4279000.short_description: Community-built library: heart the sounds you love or add your own. Organize your way, customize categories, and set shortcuts as you like. The demo gives full SoundBoard access until launch—perfect for testing in calls, streams, and games.

4189160.name: On Love, On Monsters
4189160.short_description: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

4948470.name: Bug Fix Billionaire
4948470.short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and grow your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire with employees, an esports team, loot boxes, and much more.

5383900.name: Curvelicious 2
5383900.short_description: The classic curve game, rebuilt in 3D as a party game for 2 to 4 on one screen or up to 8 online. Your Curve never stops and leaves a solid trail. Box your friends in, blast gaps through their trails and be the last one alive.

3896170.name: Wizard Magic
3896170.short_description:
An autistic wizard and their ADHD familiar go on the adventure of a lifetime.

Make strange friends, battle wizards and monsters, and explore the magical city of Bizzaire in this bite-sized pixel-art RPG!

5263860.name: Bug Fix Billionaire Demo
5263860.short_description: Build the most successful video game store in town! Develop your own games, stock your shelves with the latest hits, and take the first steps toward growing your small shop into the ultimate gaming empire.

4719840.name: 乒乓行
4719840.short_description: A roguelite bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

4088870.name: RoboSquare: Recharged
4088870.short_description: A 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump and slam each other off the map across five chaotic minigames. Your friends are worse than you remember, and the platform is smaller than you think.

4612970.name: A.V.E.N.A Demo
4612970.short_description: Pilot disposable combat drones through the Primal Portal in a sci-fi action roguelike. Customize your drone, fight through various missions, recover research data and alien technology to enhance your drone setup for the next session.

4826620.name: My Useless Hot MILF in the Party
4826620.short_description: Forced into a dangerous expedition before the dungeon opens to the world, explore its depths in a classic first-person dungeon crawler. Train your MILF companion, solve puzzles, battle monsters, uncover secrets, and discover the truth hidden on the final floor.

5289430.name: Super Egg & TCG Card Shop Simulator Demo
5289430.short_description: Run your own TCG Card Shop! Open surprise eggs, collect cards and toy parts, raise birds, stock shelves, and serve customers. Discover shop management and collecting in this demo, with limited content compared to the full game.

5032450.name: Rustil: Eternal Labyrinth Castle - Swimsuit Costume DLC
5032450.short_description: Rustil: Eternal Labyrinth Castle - "Aqua Etoile" Swimsuit Armor DLC

5165210.name: Find The Needle Demo
5165210.short_description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

5215640.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered Demo
5215640.short_description: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

4422320.name: Sovereign Tower Demo
4422320.short_description: Play as the Sovereign of a magical tower in this story-rich, Round Table management RPG. Recruit eccentric Knights, assign quests and balance egos whilst carving out your kingdom's destiny. If destiny doesn’t go your way, keep turning back time, uncover secrets and rewrite fate again and again.

4427400.name: TBH : Task Bar Hero - 3 Stash Pack
4427400.short_description: Adds 3 additional Stash Pages. Provides extra storage space to keep more items.

4836670.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds Season Pass Two
4836670.short_description: 6 Content Packs, featuring even MORE guest characters, vehicles, courses, emotes, and more from iconic franchises.

4235250.name: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ Deluxe Upgrade
4235250.short_description: The Star Wars: Galactic Racer™ Deluxe Upgrade contains three exclusive vehicles, a unique Livery, three Arcade Events, a deluxe Player Banner, and a Digital Art Book.

3136430.name: でびるコネクショん 体験版
3136430.short_description: This is the trial version of 'Devil Connection'.Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Kemono-Summoning Adventure Game

2782070.name: Psychopomp Soundtrack
2782070.short_description:
This is the Original Soundtrack for [PSYCHOPOMP]
Featuring bizarre sounds of all sorts, experience the dark sounds of that endless abyss yourself!

2877690.name: Anne Frank House VR
2877690.short_description: Experience Anne Frank’s hiding place as it was in 1942-1944. Wander through the rooms, where Anne Frank and 7 others hid during WW2. Immerse yourself in her world, her thoughts, and her feelings.

2909790.name: SONIC X SHADOW GENERATIONS: Sonic Jam Legacy Skin
2909790.short_description: A legacy skin for Classic Sonic inspired by his look in Sonic Jam.

3720060.name: CONDEMNED: Nightfall
3720060.short_description: Survival horror set in a dark 1950's NYC. In this social deduction tactical RPG, a curse has fractured a gathering of guests. Will you fight to survive the night as an *Innocent*, or embrace the shadows and hunt your peers as *The Cursed*? Uncover the truth to survive.

4955110.name: Baskets and Blooms
4955110.short_description: Grow what you sell and sell what you grow in this cozy, pressure-free third-person farmer's market simulator. Choose your agricultural identity, nurture your farm at your own pace, play road-trip minigames, and serve customers face-to-face as your small business blooms!

1851920.name: Milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk Soundtrack
1851920.short_description: Full sountrack of Milk outside a bag of milk outside a bag of milk.

4729140.name: Blockfall
4729140.short_description: BLOCKFALL is a first-person shooter in a blocky, fully destructible world made to enjoy with friends. Each round, gain an upgrade of your choice from a randomly selected array to boost your odds of victory. no two matches will be the same!

1610220.name: Otaku's Adventure - The world just keeps circulating
1610220.short_description:
This DLC content is a continuation of the Waifu's story of the main game.
Complete the entire story of the Waifu.

1168280.name: Resident Evil 2 "R.P.D. Demo"
1168280.short_description:
A deadly virus engulfs the residents of Raccoon City in September of 1998, plunging the city into chaos as flesh eating zombies roam the streets for survivors.

An unparalleled adrenaline rush, gripping storyline, and unimaginable horrors await you.

Witness the return of Resident Evil 2.

715670.name: DashPanel
715670.short_description: Create fully customizable dashboard displays for your favourite racing sims on your PC (USB monitors, USB480, VoCore, overlay mode on screen or SteamVR compatible HMD).

530180.name: Party Hard - Dark Castle
530180.short_description: Under the fool mood the ancient creatures awake inside the old castle. Dreadful things are going to happen next. Stop them using your occult powers.

1011850.name: Tideturn
1011850.short_description: TideTurn is a dynamic third person shooter where diverse characters and water-based weapons clash in a fight over the world's oceans! Submerge into water your weapons create to move seamlessly across any surface. Fight the enemy with movement and abilities limited only by your creativity!

5152150.name: Cocaine Smuggler
5152150.short_description: Smuggle illegal cargo across dangerous waters, evade the Coast Guard and DEA, upgrade your planes and boats, and make it home with the cash.

5181320.name: 刀鍛冶 Demo
5181320.short_description: This demo is a first day as a swordsmith's apprentice. Cut charcoal, light the hearth, work the bellows, heat the steel the master prepared, shape a tanto, and hang it on the rack. You cannot finish a Japanese sword here. Folding forge, quenching, and polishing will be implemented in Early Access.

5336380.name: Malibu Club: Cocktail Bar Simulator
5336380.short_description: Run a cocktail bar under a Miami sunset. Read each guest's licence for the order, pour by eye until the gauge turns green, shake, stir, pull a proper pint, and fix up the room between nights. Pixel-art bar sim.

5378250.name: Rooklite
5378250.short_description: A minimalist game about building your board and fighting for checkmate.

5018720.name: LaurEli & the Blood Dipped Manor
5018720.short_description: An Ace Attorney/Danganronpa style Murder Mystery-esque Visual Novel where an unlikely duo must find the vampiric killer stalking the halls of a stormy manor.

5028480.name: OnzeFoot
5028480.short_description: Manager de futebol clássico: assuma um clube num mundo de 8 países e 640 clubes, dispute liga, copa e um Mundial de clubes, negocie no mercado e responda a uma diretoria que cobra resultado. Gratuito para jogar, em Acesso Antecipado.

4356780.name: Screen Stocks
4356780.short_description: Screen Stocks is an online multiplayer trading game featuring a real-time simulated market. Buy, short, and sell stocks to gain unprecedented levels of wealth. Team up with other traders or outsmart them all. It's time to make some money!

4680870.name: MÁG Demo
4680870.short_description: You're a mage with incredible powers and control. But you're fragile. Die and lose everything on you. Your skill is the only progression. If you're good, you don't need to grind, the money comes to you. One mistake and you lose it all.

5117340.name: Old Man's Sushi
5117340.short_description: No free handouts, earn your legacy! Grandpa wants to leave his sushi shop to you, but he doubts you're ready. Catch fresh fish, roll delicious sushi, collect antiques, and clear Grandpa's To-Do List to prove your worth!

4874760.name: Cult of the Red Heifer
4874760.short_description: Horror RPG FPS set in a dystopian United States controlled by a fanatical cult determined to create the perfect Red Heifer. Play as the Firestarter, a normal person who has decided to resist the Cult against all odds

5259350.name: Heartreave
5259350.short_description: A turn-based hack-and-slash where every fight is played with cards. Assemble a party, solo or in online co-op, and craft unique builds by combining cards, passives, talents, relics, creature hearts and island hearts to find the best synergies and push ever deeper.

5428930.name: Ghosts Don't Need Doors
5428930.short_description: Even ghosts dream of freedom! Help a little ghost escape a haunted mansion, where everyday objects hide clues to secret passages. Observe, deduce, and slip through walls to reach the moonlight.

4520520.name: The Time After
4520520.short_description: A post-apocalyptic survival game with a focus on driving and third person shooting. Travel through open world locations on foot and in car while scavenging fuel, scrap, food, guns and ammo to continue the journey south and escape the killing heat. Learn how we ended up here as you journey,

5378020.name: Blamcon's Cyber Range
5378020.short_description: A day at the range for your Light Gun. Six real range target games on an outdoor range in the woods: paper, a speed plate rack, hanging steel, pop-up targets, a dueling tree, and a Texas star. This can be played with a mouse but it is a light gun game first, best played with Blamcon light guns.

4424050.name: Throw a Barrel Down a Hill
4424050.short_description: Throw a barrel down a hill. Buy upgrades. Throw it again. That's the whole game.

5435910.name: VR Fast & Simple
5435910.short_description: Choose videos in the Windows app. Press play on Meta Quest 3. Enjoy flat-screen, 3D, VR180 and 360° playback, with sound in your headset or PC headphones. Requires initial pairing and the same local network. Some files need preparation.

5401100.name: Get The Artifact: Violent Incursion Demo
5401100.short_description: Take on a 60-second contract to retrieve a mysterious Artifact aboard a space station, or test your speed and precision across three short Time Attack runs. Master SuperSprint, Double Jump, and Back Flip, chase better times, and perfect every move. Every fraction of a second counts.

5220800.name: Sandkeeper
5220800.short_description: A cozy sand art game. Pour colored sand into glass bottles one grain at a time: lean the glass to slope the layers, tap it to settle, press in a shell. Pour a bottle for each of the 48 places in your grandfather's book and keep them in his seaside cottage. No score, nothing can fail.

5402040.name: Jade Valley
5402040.short_description:
Clear a quiet Chinese village, one rock at a time. 
Stack stones, carry them to the saw, and discover precious jade in this cozy first-person cleanup game. 
Buy handy upgrades, offer jade to ancient statues, and uncover the valley's secret at your own pace.

5302010.name: クッキング赤ちゃん
5302010.short_description: An adult story and minigame collection featuring Minori. Play eight challenges with clicking, sliding, rhythm, and timing controls. Build your stats, unlock new stages and scenes, and revisit the gallery. Includes difficulty options and repeat modes in supported games.

5246690.name: Feeding Gooble Demo
5246690.short_description: Strap in to your chair and keep Gooble fed, or else! Combo foods, PROVIDE SYNERGY, and push your luck in this roguelite deckbuilder. Your demo progress rolls over to Early Access!

4329970.name: Feeding Gooble
4329970.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about feeding the hungriest little guy. Push buttons, combine foods, and press your luck to keep him sated... or else.

4979990.name: My Army Getting Stronger
4979990.short_description: A short relaxing incremental auto-battler where you grow an unstoppable war machine and grind your way forward through enemy territory. No stress, no micromanagement — just growth, upgrades, and glorious mass battles.

4976010.name: MineMergeMatic
4976010.short_description: Mine, merge, and automate! Combine ores into valuable resources, build compact production chains, unlock powerful machinery, and expand your cave into a bustling mining factory.

4530330.name: Action & Automation
4530330.short_description: Fight on the front line as a Commander in a side-scrolling action-RTS where every Nut is physical. Build self-running machines as Flux or Forge—or infiltrate and turn enemy systems against them as Shade.

5365500.name: The Banishing Act
5365500.short_description: The Banishing Act is a online co-op, horror investigation game. Demons are physically manifesting in the world and the number of haunted is on the rise. Play as a Banisher, find clues to identify Cursed Objects, and perform the Banishing Ritual, sending demons back to the abyss.

4718130.name: Lagrange Front Idle
4718130.short_description: Grow from a mere few ships to thousands of ships fighting in realtime and while you are away. Call down orbital strikes, rip through fleets with chained lightning, or watch from the comfort of your seat as your fleet expands and takes over the universe.

5424260.name: ClipCabinet
5424260.short_description: Organize Steam, OBS Studio, and NVIDIA GeForce / ShadowPlay recordings in one library. Add folders, tag and search clips, watch them in the built-in player, and export MP4.

5249190.name: Yo soy páramo
5249190.short_description: Lead a clan of survivors and manage humanity's last settlement as the world dies. How long can you hold out? Learn, manage scarce resources, make tough choices, recover powerful technology from the old world, and be the last one standing on Earth.

5472200.name: Bee Shrimp Aquarium
5472200.short_description: A 3D aquarium game for watching bee shrimp. Zoom in to see them graze, groom and swim, or feed them and watch them gather. Choose from 12+ aquascapes, change the lighting, and customize the shrimp's patterns, colors and sizes.

5068040.name: Forest Mind
5068040.short_description: Escape the noise of the city and seek refuge in your grandfather's forgotten cabin. But as night falls, the forest begins to reveal something far more terrifying than you expected.

1428960.name: Lore: The Hunt
1428960.short_description: Lore: The Hunt is an online asymmetric (4vs1) horror game where a relentless Hunter protecting their property tries to capture nimble Intruders as they try to break into catacombs under the Hunter's domain. Freerun or fight to escape or hunt down the Intruders using different powers and perks.

4974620.name: As Long As She Forgot
4974620.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game. Play as Marlene, an 86-year-old woman preparing for her family's visit. They're coming. They always do.

5379970.name: Board Kingdom
5379970.short_description: 24 board games in one kingdom. Play Chess, Go, Xiangqi, Shogi, Reversi, Mancala and more against computer opponents. Learn new rules, pick your challenger and build a record in every game.

5393280.name: Scentkeeper: Tidy Up the Perfume Archive! Demo
5393280.short_description: Bring order to a perfume archive of 3,240 bottles, solo or with a friend, in this relaxing first-person organizing game. Read labels, place bottles on the right shelves, develop helpful skills, and watch completed collections light up the archive.

5177570.name: Blade Dodger
5177570.short_description: A 2D arcade style arena survival game. As Spiff, you will sprint, dodge, and use your special abilities to stay alive long enough to make it through different levels and challenges. Features single player, 2-4 player local co-op, and 2-4 player online multiplayer.

4602130.name: Dead Reckoning: The Long Drift Demo

5443580.name: 三国·守关录：烽火镇魇
5443580.short_description: Hold the passes of a nightmare-haunted Three Kingdoms. Build defenses, recruit legendary generals, trigger battlefield mechanisms and turn the tide with tactical spells in pausable real-time tower defense. 18 battlefields, 13 generals, 7 defense types.

5469710.name: Higanbana
5469710.short_description: A co-op souls-like, where a young Samurai and cursed Doll work together to traverse an abandoned land swarmed with Yokai. Together with a spear and magic, they must defeat the challenging foes and unforgiving bosses to restore the Dolls original body and save the Samurai’s village.

689540.name: Endless Reach
689540.short_description: Fly a smuggler's run into a swarm of thousands. Every orb you catch is XP and cargo. Stay and the heat brings turrets, then a boss. Call the jump, hold the zone while the drive charges, and bank it all. Die, and you keep a fraction. The music follows how well you fly.

4859520.name: Smashboom
4859520.short_description: "Smashboom" is a high-speed 3D competitive shooter where you deflect incoming projectiles and use feints to exploit your opponent's openings. Engage in tense mind games, unleash a surprise smash to catch your rival off guard, and take them down!

5427330.name: 動物繁殖研究所
5427330.short_description: Run 43 hands-on experiments, get to know four companions, and build a place for research and everyday life. Choose your words, expand your facilities, cook and rest, and discover your own daily rhythm in this single-player simulation.

5407890.name: Ashley AI
5407890.short_description: No te pide tu atención, se la queda. Una compañera de escritorio con IA para Windows que habla contigo, te recuerda y controla tu PC de verdad ❤️.

3717830.name: GRINDWORM
3717830.short_description: A short horror game where you pilot a grinddozer through a nightmare buried underground. Why are the walls twitching? Is that flesh? Yes. It is. This is no longer mining. This is surgery... DON'T. STOP. DIGGING.

5434190.name: Succubus Crawler
5434190.short_description: An incremental dungeon crawler where a True Ancestor succubus strolls ever deeper, burning everything in her way. She walks and casts on her own. You sidestep, pick upgrades, and pour your gold into a huge sigil tree to push one floor further.

3826890.name: 我的精靈小助理 Demo
3826890.short_description: a personalized desktop application that allows you to upload your own VRM characters, letting them statically accompany you on your desktop.

5352150.name: Stay Tuned
5352150.short_description: Stay TUNEd is a simulation-based game, where you are an audio director, manipulating amateur band members' music to make them sound super super good! Hype up your audience; Boost band members' confidence by helping them out; Get introduced to the band; Enjoy the live concerts!

5042490.name: Space Squadron Command
5042490.short_description: A tactical, dice-based space combat game inspired by tabletop wargames. Plot your maneuvers, activate your squadrons, and fight using an array of ship-to-ship weapons as you build a persistent roster of ships and pilots across a galaxy-spanning campaign.

3555760.name: Brighter than Burning
3555760.short_description: A fast-paced running-focused platformer inspired by classic side-scrollers.

5294150.name: Broadband Architect Demo
5294150.short_description: This is the free demo of Broadband Architect. It is the real game on a smaller map: three real Gloucestershire towns — Bishops Cleeve with Woodmancote, Cheltenham and Tewkesbury — with every system switched on and no time limit.

4987490.name: Cats Love Cakes
4987490.short_description: Run a cozy bakery for cats! Experiment with ingredients, discover new recipes, serve your feline customers, and uncover six interconnected stories, each told from the perspective of a different cat.

5478110.name: Work From Dungeon
5478110.short_description: A tiny adventure moves into the corner of your desktop. Click the mage and her monsters fight and grow stronger while you work. Collect and breed 99 monsters, climb toward the last foe waiting at the very end — an idle RPG you never have to stop for.

3515450.name: Duoshift
3515450.short_description: Defend The Wall on a tactical 11x7 grid using your pair of battle vehicles. Outmaneuver waves of scavenged war machines, unleash game-breaking hacks and chain synergies. Draft, fight, and survive in this endlessly replayable tactical roguelite.

4357130.name: SnatchDeck
4357130.short_description:
Steal, Adapt, Survive!
SnatchDeck is a fast-paced and addicting card game that can be played both casually and strategically. Build a powerful deck on the fly by stealing cards from your opponents mid-round. You'll have to adapt your strategy round by round to avoid death.

5464070.name: Oeee Cafe
5464070.short_description: An online drawing community inspired by the oekaki boards of the 2000s. Draw with classic oekaki painters and replay every drawing stroke by stroke, create or join communities around the topics you love, and draw solo or together with friends on a shared canvas.

5464410.name: Oeee Cafe - Supporter (2026)
5464410.short_description: Oeee Cafe is free, and stays free. The Supporter Pack is a way to help pay for the year ahead. It buys a mark beside your name and a pickle a week to give to a drawing you love — nothing more. Everything else in Oeee Cafe is the same for everyone.

5174850.name: Relocate Motorhome Simulator
5174850.short_description: Drive 60 motorhomes across 12 handcrafted worlds and more than 300 km of road. Deliver RVs, start your own rental company, furnish your home on wheels, cook, adopt a pet and road-trip in cross-platform convoy with voice chat.

5394580.name: HANDSUP Demo
5394580.short_description: Escape a vertical nightmare with up to 4 friends using physics-based parkour. Equip Magic Rings to customize your climb. Don't let go, just keep your Hands Up.

2763570.name: Ultra Auto Gotchimon
2763570.short_description: Build a team of gotchimon, pick their moves and fighting order, then watch them battle on their own. Play the story campaign, take on other players' teams in the PvP Arena, and keep a run going in a small corner window while you work.

5451370.name: Legend of Cina 2
5451370.short_description: This game is made from the foundations of Legend of Cina, it's a turn-based strategy game and has 7 stages and 15 OSTs, each map will introduce a new character. The maximum level is 20 and characters can promote after level 10, they can also learn skills once they reach level 5 and 15.

5204860.name: Advancing Fronts
5204860.short_description: Advancing Fronts is a real-time grand strategy game featuring procedurally generated maps and control over massive armies. Maximize your war industry and produce hundreds of units to overcome opponents in a bid for global domination.

2490830.name: FantasySynth - GrooveBox
2490830.short_description: FantasySynth is a Groovebox Synth that's Fully Controllable by Midi, QWERTY keys, or Gamepad. Easy to use and customize with a 5 Track Pattern based Arranger and Looper for composing entire Masterpieces.

5145990.name: Lost Gaijin
5145990.short_description: Stranded in 1994 Japan with ¥250,000, a paper address, and almost no Japanese, you must interact, travel, and find your way through a persistent AI-directed world that teaches you the language as you play.

4869550.name: AquaDucked!
4869550.short_description: A physics puzzle game about firing a rubber duck out of a cannon and getting it home in one piece. Place hoses, trampolines and fans, aim, fire, see what happens. 270 levels across 10 worlds, golf, a climbing mode, a level editor, and a pond full of levels other people made.

2301090.name: Love Exalt 8372 Demo
2301090.short_description: A furry visual novel about a death game on a train. Read the minds of characters through minigames, choose which perspectives you want to see, and uncover the mysterious lore behind twelve unique characters.

4846110.name: Aegis Defense
4846110.short_description: Aegis Defense is a cyber-themed tower-defense roguelike. Draw cards to place towers and upgrades, then guide a corrupting swarm through the maze you create. Defend your core alone or team up with a friend in co-op mode.

5369150.name: Next Eye
5369150.short_description: Control your PC directly from VR with intuitive gestures and simple interactions. Designed for people who spend hours in VR and don't want to remove their headset just to use their PC. Stay immersed, stay comfortable, and enjoy a smarter way to use your setup.

4757560.name: March of Reveille
4757560.short_description: Turn-based strategy where every Order is a trade-off. Capture cities, command combined forces, and take up to three Orders into a match — each granting one unique strength and one real weakness. Missions, online play, CPU skirmishes, King of the Hill, Domination, and a map editor.

4994750.name: Nick vs the Brick of Ick from space
4994750.short_description: Build an outrageous deck of alien cards and deploy them onto the battle field. Unleash game-breaking combos in this tactical roguelite deckbuilder.

5327880.name: Owl Skips
5327880.short_description: Jokes end when the owl with a skipping rope appears. A cozy one-button roguelite with ridiculous builds and rope-fueled chaos. Charge jumps, stack wild upgrades, chase high scores, and try again. Just one more run. Probably.

5125720.name: Tearable Choices
5125720.short_description: A card roguelite about ripping open booster packs. Crack boxes, rip packs, and score every pack by Attack × Power. Then face the real choice: sell your God-tier Legendary for cash, slot it into your Binder for permanent buffs, or send it off for grading and pray for a Gem Mint 10.

4810770.name: Knightbane Demo
4810770.short_description: Survive 12 minutes. Shatter the terrain to escape, loot its contents, or funnel the horde into a killing trap. Cleanse the lands for boons and ASCEND your abilities: not merely empowered, but altered. An action survivor-like.

4425260.name: AL-Mafia
4425260.short_description: AL-Mafia is an online social deduction game where players lie, investigate, save, silence, and vote each other out. Move through the map at night, use voice and text chat to deceive or defend yourself, and survive across maps with unique elimination systems.

5274910.name: 滑动方块
5274910.short_description:
This game is a simple casual puzzle game. In the game, you use the arrow keys to get all the yellow blocks to the green flag goal to win~
Weird creativity that leaves you wanting more, various traps that keep you on edge, and fascinating mysterious features are waiting for players to explore~

4504750.name: Waste Of Life
4504750.short_description: You crashed on Garb'aaj, a planet made of trash, and you owe money for the ship. Scavenge, swap your body parts one finger at a time, fight drones built from garbage, and recycle the whole planet into a real one. Solo or co-op.

4914230.name: A Tidy Konbini
4914230.short_description: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return over 1000 scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. No Skills, no time limits. Just a relaxing tidy up experience.

4675710.name: Make The Dead Dead Again Demo
4675710.short_description: Lux is dealing with a paranormal outbreak, and every loot drop could be a gun, a jacket or maybe a fresh dye job. She’ll prioritize accordingly. Clear the streets, then make her drop-dead gorgeous. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

4052640.name: Multiworlds Demo
4052640.short_description:
A world torn apart by one mistake, help pull it back into one.

A 2D puzzle game where you jump to different dimensions to put back a world you accidentally tore apart. But you control more than 1 player at a time.

3803820.name: Demon Bluff Demo
3803820.short_description: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

3877860.name: Wove
3877860.short_description: A cozy platforming adventure where you explore various worlds as a small doll-like traveler, solving puzzles and unlocking outfits. Play solo, or share the journey with others along the way.

5424340.name: THREADMILL Demo
5424340.short_description: Write one program for every worker. Grow a robot workforce, share jobs and keep it working through changing supply and power outages. This Demo includes the opening Campaign, The Pipeline and replayable Challenges.

5285320.name: Life of Pawn: Chocolate and Marshmallow Demo
5285320.short_description: We are candy chess pieces in a world made of sweets. Jump, solve, evolve — and learn real chess together.

3962590.name: Beyond Grief
3962590.short_description: An action roguelike set in ancient Egypt where you battle the gods, grow absurdly powerful through build-breaking synergies, kill, die and be reborn. Earning allies, making enemies, and befriending cats along the way.

4338710.name: Delivery Time
4338710.short_description:
Jump! Grind rails! Boost through the city and deliver packages as quickly as you can while also scoring some style points!
Get ready for frantic time trials, loaded with parcels to deliver to happy customers.

5064900.name: Galaxy Audio Visualizer
5064900.short_description: Experience your music like never before in a spectacular galaxy. Constant audio calibration makes every song a distinct visual journey, while deep customization lets you make it truly yours. Enjoy it in a window, fullscreen, or as a desktop wallpaper.

5198350.name: Tavernia Demo
5198350.short_description: Try Tavernia free. A strategy board game for 2–8 players. Answer trivia to claim empty tiles, then beat your opponents in minigame duels to take theirs. Play cards to challenge them to typing races, word puzzles, reaction tests, and more.

5218120.name: Beyond The Blight Demo
5218120.short_description: A first person, 2.5d incremental dungeon-crawler where you loot, upgrade, and grow stronger on the quest to find and defeat the source of the blight.

4731540.name: Spooky Market Demo
4731540.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

4739910.name: Arakure – Hero – FOR HONOR
4739910.short_description: Take on multiple opponents and fight dirty to steal another victory. Wielding tonfas, Arakure packs a punch.

4896360.name: Ceto-7
4896360.short_description: Ceto-7 is a single-player underwater survival horror. Play as a salvage diver navigating a flooded alien mining facility, hunted by an apex predator, and hired to destroy sensitive corporate data. The deeper you go, the harder it becomes to ignore what you've been hired to bury.

4917950.name: Starlit World Demo
4917950.short_description: Help Bo & Kikki save the Starlits from Oli’s evil spell in a cute and chaotic 3D platforming adventure! Discover special suits, fight bosses, and explore magical worlds as you rebuild Starlit Island and complete your sticker album!

4941420.name: Folk-Tography
4941420.short_description: Folk-Tography is a 4-player co-op cryptid photography extraction game. Photograph legendary creatures, investigate paranormal anomalies, manage scarce resources, and survive various dangers to escape with the evidence before the valley consumes you.

4956940.name: Thicc Magic. Perky Prelude
4956940.short_description: The backstory of our kindest, fairest, most humble, and selfless ruler, in the form of a comedic hentai shoot 'em up.

5136900.name: Pathos Demo
5136900.short_description: Pathos is a turn-based fantasy adventure inspired by retro dungeon crawlers. Experience deep, emergent gameplay with modern graphics, sound and a touch-first interface. Extensively customise your character and embark on epic procedurally generated campaigns.

4326980.name: The Hearth and Harbour Demo
4326980.short_description: This short experience introduces you to the world of The Hearth & Harbour by laying the groundwork for its story, establishing the setting of Lewthport, and acquainting you with some of its lively townspeople.

4440380.name: Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership
4440380.short_description: Forza Horizon 6 VIP Membership is your permanent ticket to even more rewards at the Horizon Festival. Enjoy a 2x Credit boost to race rewards, 3 VIP-Exclusive Forza Edition cars, a weekly bonus Super Wheelspin, and special Vanity Items including the Crown Flair, Emote and Car Horn.

4493160.name: Sludgineers Demo
4493160.short_description: Clean, mine and refine pollution in this active incremental game. Cruise through the countryside earning cash and resources, build a refinery, process materials, upgrade equipment, unlock new areas and complete quests.

4590670.name: Prospice Demo
4590670.short_description: Haul cursed cargo across a haunted island, where the terrain can take your life and every road bears the scars of the past.

4627500.name: Borderlands®4 - Loveless the Hacker
4627500.short_description: Play as the all-new Vault Hunter, Loveless the Hacker, and wield her unique Action Skills and skill trees across all of Kairos. This symbiotic assassin shares her mind with a virus that takes the physical form of a vicious pet Wyrm.

3965130.name: Crónicas no Contadas: La Cosecha Demo
3965130.short_description: In this field, what is harvested doesn’t sprout from the earth. Something hides among the cornfields, watching all the time. Explore and dare to see what the earth itself tries to conceal… because this time, you are part of the harvest.

4019140.name: Regions of Ruin: Runegate Demo
4019140.short_description: Embark on an explorative RPG hack-and-slash adventure where you attempt to re-establish a haven for the lost dwarven civilization. Journey across varied lands, help those in need, gather resources and fight off goblins and monsters as you slowly rebuild a home for your people.

4054770.name: Murky Demo
4054770.short_description: Murky is a zany artistic narrative adventure where you solve microgames, cast spells, and alter time to create new timelines as you attempt to rediscover your past in order to escape a world trapped in a three day cycle.

4232860.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: East Asian Wonders
4232860.short_description: Decorate your map with 22 of the glorious structures and locations of East Asia in this cosmetic addition to Crusader Kings III, including natural wonders, holy sites and monuments to royal power.

4232870.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: Celestial Court Attire
4232870.short_description: This cosmetic addition to Crusader Kings III includes new fashions for the cultures of medieval China and many of its neighbors, including Silla Korea, the Jurchen of the northeast and Central Asian nations.

4510350.name: Raspberry's Berry Match Soundtrack
4510350.short_description: This is the soundtrack featuring the four BGM tracks used in the game plus one unused track.

3783770.name: Shadow of the Road Demo
3783770.short_description: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

3820060.name: ARK: Aquatica Original Soundtrack
3820060.short_description: The soundtrack for ARK: Aquatica, composed by Gareth Coker.

3315540.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: Medieval Monuments
3315540.short_description: Discover the great architectural achievements of the Middle Ages with the Creator Pack Medieval Monuments. Created in collaboration with the established Crusader Kings III modder PiGu, Medieval Monuments brings 20 new varied and culturally significant monuments to the game.

3315550.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: Arctic Attire
3315550.short_description: Brave the chill of far northern lands in style with the Arctic Attire Creator Pack, made in collaboration with the established Crusader Kings III modder Aj.

3315560.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: High Medieval Warfare Attire
3315560.short_description: Gird yourself for battle in fancy new gear with the High Medieval Warfare Attire Creator Pack. Developed by renowned modder JedNick, it includes a range of helmets, headgear and armor from the High Medieval Period (roughly 13th and 14th centuries).

3315570.name: Crusader Kings III Creator Pack: Holy Buildings
3315570.short_description: Add greater variety and more historical detail to your map with Holy Buildings: a new Creator Pack from Crusader Kings III modder Kefir úr with imagery for over a dozen religious buildings. From churches to monuments, Holy Buildings brings more regional and religious flavor to your game experience.

3315590.name: Crusader Kings III: Songs of the Realm
3315590.short_description: Crusader Kings III: Songs of the Realm has 13 tracks to accompany your rule, from peaceful courtly melodies to rousing battle themes. Remastered Crusader Kings classics play alongside new arrangements of European folk dances, this Music Pack is the perfect soundtrack for your dynastic ambition.

3138340.name: THRONE AND LIBERTY - Celebration Pack: Gold
3138340.short_description: Celebrate THRONE AND LIBERTY's launch with a Gold Celebration Pack that includes 6,000 Lucent and get the Amarian Ferthur Flight Morph and the Traveler of the Brilliant Night Outfit and Helm and soar into Kastleton in style!

3193720.name: Chrono Ark - High Roller
3193720.short_description:
Casino-themed skins and content will be added to your game!
- Lucy Casino Skin
New Lucy Starting Skill 'Showdown'
- 6 Investigator Casino Skins
- 11 New Investigator VFX
- 15 New Equipment, Relics
- A short casino story involving Lucy and the Investigators

2757440.name: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection
2757440.short_description: TCG: FANTASY Card Collection is a relaxing fantasy card-collecting game. Explore the room, discover thousands of cards, examine rare finds, and carefully organize your collection in cabinets by faction and rarity.

2780000.name: Chrono Ark - Summer Twilight
2780000.short_description:
New Swimsuit-Themed Skins and Content Coming Soon!
- Lucy Swimsuit Skin
New Lucy Base Skill 'Snap!'
- 5 New Investigator Swimsuit Skins
- 10 New Investigator VFX
- 14 New Item

5277000.name: Dejinochi
5277000.short_description: Dejinochi is a tiny virtual pet that lives right on your desktop. Feed it, care for it, watch it grow into different creatures, and eventually say goodbye as it heads out into the world. Old friends might even come back to visit.

5086490.name: Computer Sillow: Jobcersize
5086490.short_description: The Computerian-Workplace-Initative! Need a Job? Need some Excersize? You need some Jobcersize!

508150.name: Primitive+ - ARK Total Conversion
508150.short_description: Primitive Plus is a free add-on for ARK: Survival Evolved that alters the available tools, weapons and structures in the game to reflect what humans could realistically create using primitive technology and resources. This does not simply remove advanced technology from ARK, but instead replaces it with a multitude of new resources, engrams and systems.

261820.name: Estranged: Act I
261820.short_description: Estranged tells the story of a lone fisherman, whose ship is stranded on a mysterious island during a violent storm. Explore the rich environments and meet the curious inhabitants of the island as you find a way back to the mainland.

4932750.name: 公衆電話
4932750.short_description:
You are currently trapped inside a phone booth.
When you pick up the receiver, the number “99” appears on the display, and a countdown begins.
From among the vast number of flyers covering the walls on all four sides, find and peel off two flyers with exactly the same design that aren’t overlapping.

5453170.name: Futaland Love of the Dead Supporter Pack
5453170.short_description: A little support, a whole lot of love! ♡ Support the creator of Futaland Love of the Dead with this supporter pack, containing a single TXT thank-you letter. Thank you for being part of the journey! (づ｡◕‿‿◕｡)づ 💖

5384890.name: Futaland Love of the Dead
5384890.short_description: Flirt with femboy and futanari characters in an 18+ NSFW visual novel mixing romance and zombie comedy. Build relationships through dialogue choices, unlock animated adult scenes, and tackle mini-games where you prepare pizza orders, mix cocktails, solve puzzles, and test your timing.

5453180.name: Futaland Love of the Dead Wallpaper Pack
5453180.short_description: Bring a little Futaland love to your desktop! ♡ This pack contains 8 wallpapers for PC. For anyone who wants to decorate their desktop and support the creator of Futaland Love of the Dead! (｡･ω･｡)ﾉ♡ 💖

5446390.name: Mediotorum
5446390.short_description: Enter Mediotorum, a fantasy world torn by rival factions. Collect cards, forge your deck, and face other players in turn-based duels where every decision can tip the balance of the war.

4626430.name: Toon & Tune
4626430.short_description: A Survival-Crafting Game combining all of your favourite mechanics from different games and genres. Fill your Item Collections, Max out your Weapons and Skills, Complete all Quests, Defeat Bosses, Increase your Stats, or just Build your Island.

4935330.name: Backrooms : The Threshold
4935330.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op investigation horror game where you enter the Backrooms through an experimental gateway. Explore procedurally generated environments, document anomalies, recover valuable artifacts, and survive the unknown.

5468090.name: ManaPop!
5468090.short_description: ManaPop! is a new kind of competitive falling-block puzzle game where you solve puzzles while battling with magic! Clear the falling mana, build up magic power, cast spells, and fight for victory! Japanese only.

5122460.name: Gravefever
5122460.short_description: Punch, gun down, and freeze endless waves of monsters in this survivors-style roguelike. Grow your build from skill branches and capstones, topple mega-bosses to reach new arenas, and bank gold for permanent training. Every run ends in death — the clock is your score. How long can you last?

5467360.name: University Architect
5467360.short_description: University Architect is a management game where you build and run your own university. Build the campus, design the courses, manage the professors, and decide whether to prioritize profits or your reputation.

5343740.name: Gravefever Demo
