5343740.short_description: The free demo of Gravefever. Punch, shoot and freeze your way through endless monster hordes, build your hunter from branching skills and capstones, and topple two mega bosses. Clear it as fast as you can and race the world on the demo leaderboards.

4659660.name: Graveyard Cabin
4659660.short_description: An FMV anomaly horror game. You are a night guard at a desolate graveyard. Monitor the cameras, spot the unnatural, and survive.

4946160.name: ECHIDNA Demo
4946160.short_description: Strip the first two colossal dead titans cell by cell with a full drone/turret fleet, combo Cryo/Burn synergies, then duel each boss live. The full game adds 8 more monsters, deeper tech, remote outposts, and grows the Genome tree even further.

5199210.name: Too Hot To Hold
5199210.short_description: Grab the Ember and RUN! An up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

3429280.name: ATOM RPG 2
3429280.short_description: A New Open-World Era of ATOM Begins! 1,225 km² of the Caspian Wastes! Open-world survival game with a story-rich CRPG soul, co-op or alone, vehicles, sandbox, crafting, and strange encounters.

5436010.name: CluckFront
5436010.short_description: CluckFront is a top-down PvP looter-shooter featuring mutant chickens as the main characters. Choose your combat elevation: hold your ground on a specific tier or storm the heights. Select from a variety of Makeshift weapons, and various maps, and three game modes—either on online or via LAN

4499230.name: Loonyland 2: Winter Woods
4499230.short_description: In this sequel to Halloween Hill, Loony pursues the Happy Stick Witch into the frigid Winter Woods where he must confront a whole new set of problems in Action-RPG gameplay. Craft items, mix potions, cast spells, murder teddy bears, you know the drill!

5271050.name: INNER EKO Demo
5271050.short_description:
A dreamlike first-person platformer about the thoughts you can't let go of.  

Explore a strange world, meet mysterious beings, and face yourself.

5476020.name: DEPOT
5476020.short_description: DEPOT is a 1-6 player co-op horror game about working the worst warehouse shift imaginable. Find the items on your list, load your cart, pack the orders and ship them out, while trying not to attract the things roaming between the shelves.

4232950.name: Charming Blood: Twelve days
4232950.short_description: Embrace darkness as an unwitting vampire in this choice-driven romance. Navigate ancient powers, brewing conflicts, and passionate relationships with four captivating vampires who could become your greatest allies – or something more. When night falls, will you surrender to its dangers?

4554950.name: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder
4554950.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about battling demons with a specialized deck of dominoes! Build your deck from nearly 75,000 possible unique configurations of dominoes, and augment your run with powerful charms and discover diabolical synergies.

2138840.name: Broken Build Simulator
2138840.short_description: Love roguelites? Well so do I! So I made a game that combines them all, with modes like 20 Minutes Till Lunch and Vampire Revivers. Blast away at ridiculous monsters in this highly detailed and accurate simulation of what playing a video game is like.

3951320.name: Sellsword Tales
3951320.short_description: A young warrior leaves home on a journey filled with battles and new encounters. Your choices affect not only the outcome of fights but also the relationships you build. Will they stay friends, or will something more develop? The path is yours to decide…

4986260.name: Cover Up!
4986260.short_description: Hide in plain sight. Cover Up! is an online 30-players hide-and-seek where you are the camouflage: paint your body to melt into the world, hold your nerve as seekers stalk past, and win by being invisible in full view.

5051510.name: OpenSheet 3.5e SRD
5051510.short_description: Create, manage, and level D&D 3.5e SRD characters with powerful rules-aware automation. Build complex characters in minutes, automatically calculate statistics, manage spells and equipment, and keep every modifier accurate in a fast offline desktop application.

4590710.name: Flesh Grinding Demo
4590710.short_description: Grind flesh, gather blood; Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

5260490.name: FUTA gone WILD
5260490.short_description: FUTA gone WILD - is a relaxing Arkanoid-style game where you destroy tiles to unlock hot animations with beautiful futanari.

4381530.name: Space Slinger
4381530.short_description: Space Slinger is an arcade roguelike about a traveler and his recoil-packed gun where you shoot to move. Unlock unique weapons and broken builds as you conquer space one enemy at a time.

4554760.name: Elsewhere Owl Post
4554760.short_description: A cozy resource management game where you sort magical packages and assign them to the perfect owl for successful delivery. Care for your hardworking owls, grow your clientele, and uncover their stories along the way. Discover distant lands as your owls travel far and wide to complete each delivery.

4707090.name: Council & Conflict
4707090.short_description: Assume the role of a national leader in an original world of competing powers, and steer your country through diplomacy, trade, internal politics, and war as crises test your ability to hold the state together and shape the world order. How will you lead?

5342920.name: SpellWeave
5342920.short_description: Build a wand out of spell cards that modify and combine with each other, then fight down through an endless dungeon. Order is everything: a modifier changes every spell after it. No final floor — the run ends when you do.

4020840.name: A Wonderful Cat Life
4020840.short_description: A tiny open-world game where you experience a carefree life through a protagonist who wanders into the world of stray cats.

5377980.name: Raise a Graz
5377980.short_description: Raise and grow your very own Graz! Make him burp, spend your Burpo on increasingly peculiarly snacks, and feed him until he's ready to Asscend. A crude, colorful clicker with goblins, Burpo Frenzies, leeching Giovannis and 2-player online or LAN co-op.

5391910.name: Project 14
5391910.short_description: Project 14 is a short psychological puzzle game filled with bizarre tests, dark humour and unexpected twists. Explore strange environments, uncover hidden paths and decide whether to obey or defy a disturbingly polite system. Your actions shape the experience – and may lead to different outcomes.

1527410.name: Morse Operator
1527410.short_description: The frontline depends on your radio. Tune in to Morse signals, crack enemy ciphers and track contacts on radar. Coordinate rescues and operations under pressure in a radio operator sim where a timely reply can save lives.

3319680.name: Delve Survivors
3319680.short_description:
A blend of classic turn-based roguelike dungeon crawling with the intensity of modern survivors games. 
Set the pace with every step as you unlock multiple dungeons and blast through swarms of enemies! 
Gather loot, customize your build, and learn to survive.. the Delve!

5333690.name: Magic Dragon Fantasy: Story
5333690.short_description: Discover a world of adventure, fantasy, and magic in a vibrant hero quest, top-down retro-style pixel art action-adventure where fast-paced strategic positioning and well-timed attacks determine victory!

5350060.name: ISTAKA
5350060.short_description: ISTAKA is a single-player roguelite deckbuilder where you battle with Okey tiles. Form melds to deal damage, build powerful combos with special tiles, and cheat to turn the tables. Face masked opponents, upgrade your rack, and choose your path to the top as techno beats pulse around you.

5415980.name: Grinner's Diner - Supporter Pack
5415980.short_description: A cosmetic pack to support Grinner’s Diner: a metallic Cryptid Gold uniform, a golden lantern, a golden foraging pack and your name in gold on the end-of-night receipt.

4818440.name: 樸素少女的戀愛直播
4818440.short_description: Return to the countryside and reunite with Shizuka, your shy, unassuming, yet surprisingly busty childhood friend! Run the general store, dress her up, take photos, manage her social media, and help her become a streamer in this steamy romance visual novel!

4992660.name: Scawy Game
4992660.short_description: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

5492190.name: Before it Falls
5492190.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

4007330.name: Fall of the Final Age
4007330.short_description: Take command of the last Stronghold of humanity, fighting back against the advancing monsters. Decide where to prioritize the forces of your Heroes, as the number of turns before the invasion is limited. A turn-based tactical strategy with RPG and roguelike elements.

5409690.name: A Wilder Menu
5409690.short_description: A Wilder Menu is a side-scrolling cooking and restaurant sim. Forage and hunt across islands, mix ingredients to unlock over 100 dishes, and serve dinner aboard your boat. Hire and train staff, hear their stories, and spruce up your place. Doors open tonight. The menu's up to you.

4160300.name: The Artisan of Glimmith Demo
4160300.short_description: The Artisan of Glimmith is a cozy, relaxing puzzle game about coloring stained glass and restoring the artworks of a kingdom above the clouds. Explore a world of handcrafted puzzles designed with intent, where simple rules lead to delightful surprises.

4996690.name: Creature Lab 2
4996690.short_description: Conquer the world in the name of science! Study DNA, create mutagens, and grow mutated limbs to design your own monsters. Send them on missions across the globe, spread panic, collect bodies, samples, and chemicals, then use them in your next experiments.

5160800.name: Find The Needle
5160800.short_description: You have a shovel and a haystack with about six million strands in it. Somewhere inside there's a needle. Dig it out by hand, sell the hay, then spend the money on belts and machines until you don't have to dig anymore.

5318870.name: V-BuddyUltraDeluxe
5318870.short_description:
VBuddy is back, written from the ground up to be more featureful and better than ever!
Feed sweets and tiny people to a cast of colourful characters and unlock new toys, skins and backgrounds for your V-Buddy UltraDeluxe!

4468160.name: Oh No, Meteor!
4468160.short_description: Oh No, Meteor! is a short incremental game. Chop trees with your cursor, send lumberjacks, haulers, and miners to work, then spend wood, stone, and coins on a huge skill tree, talent cards, and artifacts before the meteor hits the town.

459920.name: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter
459920.short_description: Serious Sam: The Third Encounter picks up exactly where 'The Second Encounter' left off, bringing classic run-and-gun mayhem to bold new worlds. Bigger hordes. Bigger guns. One last score to settle with Mental.

881940.name: Guns 'n Goblins
881940.short_description: Face a deluge of monsters in this incremental horde survivor FPS. Build your Bastion, level up your character, and upgrade your arsenal to rise from Apprentice Bell Ringer to Master Dragon Hunter.

2541950.name: Sirens
2541950.short_description: Become a deadly Siren and hunt down the most dangerous sea creatures that have ever swim in the depths of the oceans! Experience a fascinating journey through the world as seen from the perspective of Sirens at various stages of their evolution.

3876560.name: Obsidian Tower
3876560.short_description: Defend the Obsidian Tower in a roguelike tower defense on procedurally generated hex paths. Build crossbows, flamethrowers, Tesla coils and mortars, combine fire, poison, ice and lightning, draft run cards between waves, and spend banked XP on permanent upgrades.

4967120.name: Avlo the Imp Wizard
4967120.short_description: Do the sickest tricks while reaching the finish line the fastest you can!

5035770.name: Evilos
5035770.short_description: Evilos is an action tower defense game where you play as an ancient evil sorcerer battling endless waves of do-gooders. Tear down the kingdom with a vast arsenal of evolvable magic weapons and spells, and bolster your defenses with elite minions across 10 acts. This time, you are the final boss!

5265110.name: Furry Snow Leopard
5265110.short_description: Furry Snow Leopard is a seductive adult puzzle game featuring a charming snow leopard heroine. Uncover her boldest looks, unlock steamy illustrations, and step by step discover what lies behind her cold yet alluring gaze.

5469060.name: Gravity Defied Reincarnation
5469060.short_description: An unofficial remake of the 2004 keypad phone classic. Lean the rider to keep the bike balanced, ride over hills and drops and reach the finish on 30 tracks. Original mode rebuilds the classic physics, Modern mode rides smoother. Four bikes, pixel art and 31 original songs.

304214.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - High Power Cargo Pack

2099730.name: BURN THE WITCH
2099730.short_description:
THEY TOLD ME TO MAKE THE BURN THE WITCH.  ROGUELIKE IN THE DARK FANTASY SETTING.
I'M NOT AGAINST IT

5280830.name: Hyoshi: Rhythm Sumo
5280830.short_description: Sumo is a battle of rhythm. Read your opponent's patterns, strike to the beat of taiko drums, and hold your ground in the ring. Practise the phrases that beat you, find your moment to commit, and return prepared.

5421420.name: Cinderpeak
5421420.short_description: Carry the last flame up a mountain that has gone dark. Cinderpeak is a hard, precise 2D platformer: jump, climb and dash through ten chapters, each with its own rule, with a flame on your head that is starting to remember who put it out.

3999510.name: Siren's Well 2
3999510.short_description: "The Crowley blood stains the mansion's hallways, where voices whisper horrors that time tried to bury."

4946550.name: Deblock
4946550.short_description: A short, satisfying incremental game about breaking blocks. Dig deeper, unlock new tools and upgrades, and break even more blocks.

5429740.name: Console Repair Simulator
5429740.short_description: Inherit your uncle's dusty console shop on a Tokyo back street. Sell new hardware, haggle for used consoles, then open them up on the repair mat: unscrew every screw, find the fault, swap the part, power on. Restore, grade, resell, and turn the top floor into a 90s Game Saloon.

2249460.name: Desynced Demo
2249460.short_description: Desynced is a sci-fi strategy game with fully customizable units and behaviors. Gather, build, research, and explore the unknown. Alone or with friends, unveil the mystery of an AI on the edge of self-awareness and uncover the hidden truth in this blend of strategy, automation, and exploration.

3760790.name: Those Far Stars
3760790.short_description: Discover a vast, procedural galaxy as a lone pilot. Trade, fight and explore alien worlds with turn-based encounters. Upgrade your ship, gather relics, and uncover secrets lost to time and space.

4298170.name: Carry the Pack Rack
4298170.short_description: One car, two drivers! Team up where one controls the steering wheel and the other handles the gas. Overcome obstacles through perfect coordination. Enjoy the chaos with local or online co-op. Can you reach the finish line without crashing?

4563740.name: Outliers: Incrementum
4563740.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

5473490.name: How to Farm
5473490.short_description: A chaotic co-op farming game where the crops don’t always cooperate. Plant strange seeds, wrangle runaway vegetables, and harvest increasingly bizarre plants with your friends as your farm descends into chaos.

5149770.name: Soulful Slide
5149770.short_description: A comfy and cozy sliding ice puzzle game with the twist of throwing snow along the path to solve puzzles. Featuring a combination of tranquil music and colorful art to bring in peaceful winter vibes. Collect gifts within levels to customize your own snowman as well.

4617510.name: Souls Divided
4617510.short_description: A single-player puzzle game where you divide your soul into two forms, each perceiving a different dimension. Switch between them, manipulate ancient instruments, and solve layered puzzles across overlapping realities in a mysterious astral world left behind by a failed civilization.

5218390.name: Oink Splash Party Demo
5218390.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler where bouncy piggies battle across giant inflatable waterparks! Punch, bounce, and inflate your way to victory.

4917830.name: Airstrike Protocol
4917830.short_description: Fast-paced 2D roguelite shooter. Pick from 4 classes, aim with precision, and survive endless waves of enemies. Take down colossal war machines and forge devastating builds as the last line of defense.

5441620.name: Shadow at Noon
5441620.short_description: An interactive sound novel for honkaku mystery fans. No cutscenes, no spectacle: just text, art and sound, with every clue you need on the page. Amesaka, 2015. A rich family's eldest son lies dead at the foot of his stairs; by morning the housekeeper has confessed. Every confession hides one lie.

851720.name: Brain Cell
851720.short_description:
Brain Cell is a co-operative multiplayer adventure game. Play up to 4 players co-op to explore dungeons, complete puzzles, with twisting gravity physics.

Explore huge worlds with friends. Work together to complete mind bending puzzles and defeat bosses.

4468700.name: Basecoat
4468700.short_description: Turn your STL files into painted, VTT-ready miniatures. Automatic shadows & highlights, bucket fill, free paint, custom stamps and more. Export for Tabletop Simulator, TaleSpire or as OBJ.

4087550.name: ミステリ―アドベンチャー　犯人はメイド
4087550.short_description: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

5348420.name: Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator
5348420.short_description: In Tennis & Padel Shop Simulator, run your own racket store! Stock shelves, string rackets, serve customers at the till and haggle over bulk deals. Keep the court in shape so club players book it by the hour, and grow a small shop into the town's favourite racket club. Enjoy padel and tennis!

5057770.name: StoneEra
5057770.short_description: Build a medieval voxel colony in an editable world. Guide villagers, research technologies, craft supplies, trade with a travelling merchant, raise animals, and engineer flowing water. Shape the terrain and create reusable building plans as your settlement grows.

5439370.name: Neverending Descent
5439370.short_description: Descend into an endless dungeon filled with deadly demons, powerful bosses, and valuable loot. Level up, upgrade your abilities, and collect stronger equipment as you fight your way deeper. Return safely with your treasures or risk everything to push further. How deep can you go?

5237830.name: Keycast
5237830.short_description: Show keyboard, mouse and XInput controller input on your Windows desktop. Choose from 86 skins, eight preset layouts and four key effects. Combine layouts, add animal keycaps, and show or hide the overlay with a shortcut.

1823550.name: Bonobros
1823550.short_description: A free strategy game where both sides play at the same time. Plan three actions in secret, then watch everything resolve at once: moves, spells, duels. Take on other players in 1v1, or play solo with lessons and puzzles, including ones made by the community.

5111450.name: Driver Wars
5111450.short_description: A chaotic and satirical late-stage capitalistic driving simulator. In this low-poly 3D world, live out the fantasies and nightmares of countless commuters gridlocked in traffic as you ram, blow up, set ablaze, toss donuts at, honk, grapple, and total hordes of terrible and aggressive NPC drivers.

3079730.name: Cartomancy
3079730.short_description:
Turn-based RPG style experience with emphasis on RNG and hints of team building strategy. Uncover a metaphysical mystery from an unlikely inheritance. Cipher the code and face the powers that may be.

This isn't just a game, It's an initiation.

5397300.name: Bubble Hunters
5397300.short_description: Pop bubbles, dodge danger and master 100 handcrafted levels in this colorful 2D arcade platformer. Play solo or team up with a friend in online co-op, then chase high scores in Survival and Marathon modes.

5066350.name: Hotel Stardust Demo
5066350.short_description: Would you like to win $1,000,000? Survive the night at the Hotel Stardust, capture every anomaly on camera, and the prize is yours. Be careful, some anomalies aren't very friendly.

3613080.name: Bot Colony _redux
3613080.short_description:
Use your mic or type: SAY ANYTHING—the robots understand!
In this sci-fi adventure, talk to characters in your own words and command them to manipulate the world as you hunt a spy.
Explore a tropical island where machines have real personalities and emotions. 
Total conversational freedom.

5395810.name: Voice Notes
5395810.short_description: Talk instead of type. Dictate into any app, say commands like "open Steam", or turn rambling speech into a polished message, prompt, translation, or voice clip. The AI runs on your PC: no account, no API key.

5018410.name: ホロすと！ Demo
5018410.short_description:
”ホロすと！ - Holo-Strike! -” is a stage-destruction, turn-based online co-op PvP game featuring VTubers from hololive.
Choose your favorite character and aim for victory in intense 3v3 online network battles!

4824970.name: Golden Retriever Simple Life Demo
4824970.short_description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

4784510.name: Leviathan: Rhino
4784510.short_description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

5469560.name: I Was Reincarnated with the [Idle] Skill, and Now I Do Nothing Demo

4805970.name: The Kept Fire
4805970.short_description: Your brother’s hiking group vanished. Beyond the cave, the valley is hunting you. The beast only moves when you look away, but stare too long and you go blind. Keep your fire alive, find a way out, and remember: you can survive three encounters. Not four.

5384740.name: CMPNN
5384740.short_description: CMPNN turns your secondary display into a premium PC companion dashboard. Track weather, system stats, gaming sessions, media, devices, timers and more through a modern, touch-focused interface.

1477750.name: SunderBound
1477750.short_description: SunderBound is a co-op top-down shooter with roguelite progression, set in a crumbling mega-tower. Survive floor by floor with a partner you trust, or an AI companion if you’re climbing solo. Every room’s a test. Every upgrade’s earned. And the only way out is up.

5373360.name: SCALING LAW
5373360.short_description: Build an AI company in a psychological-horror incremental game. Label data, train models, expand across a global map, and automate your staff. Read the emails and conversations left behind as success turns unsettling. Five acts. Multiple endings. You can still press the shutdown button.

5492250.name: Before it Falls Demo
5492250.short_description: Enter the long-closed St. Elora Hospital for a final technical inspection before demolition. Restore power, explore the building, and examine the records left behind. Before it Falls is a first-person psychological horror game focused on exploration and environmental puzzles.

4455820.name: Tech Legends Simulator
4455820.short_description: Open a tiny PC shop and grow it into a tech empire. Stock shelves from Amazoom deliveries, ring up customers at a real cash register, build gaming PCs by hand, hire staff, run a LAN café, mine crypto and expand your HQ all the way to the second floor.

4358660.name: Hull Rupture
4358660.short_description:
If the ship stops, humanity ends.

Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

3752410.name: DispatchControl
3752410.short_description: Run a fire and ambulance dispatch center on real-world maps. Answer emergency calls, assess incidents and send the right crews while keeping units in reserve. Play Dispatch Control solo or in online co-op with up to six players, in free play or 16 campaign chapters.

4401490.name: RABIDZ
4401490.short_description: An open-world co-op zombie survival game where the infected mutate every night you survive. Gather, craft, build and fight to see another sunrise.

4751830.name: The Dark West Demo
4751830.short_description: The Dark West is a western occult ARPG set across a dying frontier that is consumed by corruption. Fight to survive with era-specific weapons and dark magic as you face deadly encounters and uncover distinctive items.

1574950.name: Road to Hollow Hills Demo
1574950.short_description: Road To Hollow Hills is an adventure horror game. Explore the environment, collect useful resources, and customize the abilities of your character in order to survive the Road to Hollow Hills.

5010790.name: Burger Shooter
5010790.short_description: Your burger was stolen. Now everyone pays. Dash through fast-paced retro-inspired levels, chain kills to survive, unlock new weapons and upgrades, battle dangerous mafia enemies, and fight your way to the final boss in this adrenaline-fueled FPS.

5188230.name: Ashram Online
5188230.short_description: The world broke a thousand years ago and no one is coming to fix it. Ashram is a classic MMORPG with a survivalist soul: hunt, dismantle and craft every piece you wear. Gather your guild, choose your path... and claim your eternity.

5133900.name: Can 'Em All
5133900.short_description: A juicy first-person incremental game about turning cute creatures into cans. Kill them, collect their bodies, can them, and sell them. Make money, upgrade your weapons and machines, and produce more and more.

5434430.name: Gnome Acres
5434430.short_description: A cozy farming game where a village of gnomes does the work. Draw fields, pick what grows, and watch your gnomes plant, water, harvest and haul every crop through spring, summer, autumn and winter.

3371290.name: Lexy Defense Demo
3371290.short_description: Master legendary heroes in intense top-down combat while commanding strategic tower defenses. Control your champion directly, build and upgrade persistent towers that provide covering fire, then face powerful bosses and massive hordes. Use magic to empower your strategy and turn the tide of battle.

4542740.name: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar
4542740.short_description: Dinghai: The Ocean Pillar is an action RPG-roguelike set in the mythic world of the Classic of Mountains and Seas, where ancient gods, demons, and forgotten powers collide.

4351790.name: Krigo's PlayPlace
4351790.short_description: as a relative of the founder of a children’s playplace, you finally come back to the place many years after it was abandoned and much more..

5261200.name: 幻卡物语：星卡对决 Playtest

3208090.name: Genome Warriors : Resistance to Invasion
3208090.short_description: In this roguelike top-down shooter game, progress by defeating enemies in randomly generated levels. Upgrade your cell, gain advantages with temporary boosts, and try different strategies each time.

3846570.name: Aphasia
3846570.short_description:
Have you ever wondered what happens when we fall into a coma? Why do only some make it back?
Aphasia is a first-person horror where you’re trapped inside your own mind, with no memory of who you are.
As you explore your fractured memories, your sense of guilt won’t let you escape...

4769690.name: Dark Eyes - Super Soldier 2
4769690.short_description: Continue the fight in the Dark Eyes universe as the Super Soldier battles the Delma and the elite Alpha commander. Experience fast-paced combat, massive battles, stealth, upgrades, and powerful abilities in this chaotic sci-fi action shooter.

5132120.name: Lunar Mining
5132120.short_description: Mine, melt, upgrade, repeat. Lunar Mining is a fast, casual incremental game built around tense 15-second mining runs. Smash lunar ore, smelt it into bars, and upgrade your drill between runs. Explore three biomes, battle bosses for rare artifacts, and chase Legendary ores across the Moon.

5134890.name: Lunar Mining Demo
5134890.short_description: Try Lunar Mining for free! Mine ores, upgrade your gear through the Forge and Skills tree, and push through the Surface biome up to level 15, all the way to your first boss fight against the Lunar Worm.

5260970.name: Conductor Cat Demo
5260970.short_description: Conductor Cat is a narrative-driven adventure game about rebuilding a broken world. Gather scrap, build machines, and restore a dying canyon as Griffin the cat. He's journeying home aboard his train, racing to see his father one last time.

5279440.name: Dumbfire Demo
5279440.short_description: Launch a missile and thread it through tight obstacles as fast as you can to take out the target. A physics time-attack flight game. Chase faster and more daring runs for more points. For fans of Superflight and Clustertruck.

5310420.name: No Such Floor Demo
5310420.short_description: Work the night shift at a quiet hotel where routine tasks slowly turn into something far more unsettling. Clean rooms, help guests, manage the hotel, and explore strange events as the elevator begins taking you to floors that should not exist.

5190470.name: Pistonica Demo
5190470.short_description: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

5207450.name: Swarmbreaker Demo
5207450.short_description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

4638350.name: Ballistic Brews Demo
4638350.short_description: Drive tanks and robots in a third-person bullet-heaven roguelike. Drift, shoot, and smash through 15 waves while brewing the ultimate build to take down brutal bosses and elite enemies.

4766280.name: VIRUS_31.EXE Demo
4766280.short_description: Minimalist survivors-like built for short, snack-sized sessions. Pop enemies, earn bits, get stronger.

4845410.name: Chop Loop Demo
4845410.short_description: A 3D incremental lumberjack game where every tree changes the way you play. Unlock unique tree mechanics, control which trees appear with runes and upgrade beavers to automate your harvest.

4873680.name: World of Tanks: HEAT - Launch Soundtrack
4873680.short_description: Dive into the sound of HEAT with the game's official release soundtrack—bold, brutal, and built to get you moving.

4873700.name: World of Tanks: HEAT - Season 2 Soundtrack
4873700.short_description: Step on the blistering soil of Inferno One, the main hotbed of Season 2 "Fire and Ash".

4549920.name: Coastal Cargo
4549920.short_description: Coastal Cargo is a strategy simulation game about becoming the world's best Naval Logistician. Chart trade routes between ports in a sprawling archipelago. Drop boats, start transporting cargo, and earn your rewards. How long can your empire last in this ever more challenging environment?

3896950.name: The Ascent - Artbook + Weapon Pack
3896950.short_description: This DLC gives access to the game's Digital Artbook and to two exclusive weapons.

4819010.name: Ink & Lore
4819010.short_description:
A 99-floor roguelike of cards that vanish the moment they're played.

Lead two guardians of living stationery into a picture book someone stopped drawing. Your cards are finite—choosing when to spend them is life or death.

And at the end of the world waits the one who—

3453690.name: Supercar Collection Simulator Demo
3453690.short_description: Build your own diecast store! Unbox surprise car packs, expand your collection, and join thrilling races on racing tracks. A world of speed and excitement awaits in your store!

2419624.name: Saints Row - Los Panteros American Muscle Bundle
2419624.short_description: Pummel your enemies in style with the Los Panteros American Muscle Bundle.

1888610.name: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven - Part Three
1888610.short_description: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven: Part Three continues your story as you leave your hilltop outside Nightfall, Colorado with your group of survivors and travel to a new haven, a rural junkyard.

1730220.name: PIGFACE MASSACRE
1730220.short_description: PIGFACE MASSACRE is a survival horror game can be played up-to 4 players. While trying to stay alive, uncover the serial killer PIGFACE's bloodcurdling mystery and find out the truth behind events.

4864890.name: Bananageddon
4864890.short_description: Bananageddon is a roguelite in which you will have to create and adapt your equipment to defeat the hordes of animals, who will try to prevent you from getting out with the bananas harvested for your tribute!

1383610.name: Planet Zoo Soundtrack
1383610.short_description: Experience seven continents of wonder with the Planet Zoo soundtrack, by J.J. Ipsen. Travel the globe as you listen to a rich and authentic collection of 18 original songs filled with Planet Zoo’s warmth, charm, and endless creativity.

1033530.name: Forts - Moonshot
1033530.short_description: Take command of the Combined Forces in their battle to beat back a resurgent Black Penguin Oil in Forts’ first DLC. Moonshot DLC features a whole new campaign, new weapons,  features and commanders!

830400.name: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven - Part Two
830400.short_description: Zombie Exodus: Safe Haven: Part Two continues your story as you escape Nightfall with your new group of survivors in search of a safe haven. Continue your story from part one, or skip right to the new chapters with a new character!

5379260.name: REC:REWIND
5379260.short_description:
Set in an American home, REC:REWIND follows a missing husband and the wife who refuses to stop searching for him.
Experience a “reverse loop” horror story, unraveling the truth through the eyes of both of them as you travel deeper and deeper into the past.

3943310.name: My Tradwife is a Femboy?
3943310.short_description: After your company nears collapse, a deal can save it if you marry the heiress of Anemaryn Capital. Lucy seems like the perfect 50s-style tradwife, until you discover she’s actually a femboy. Romance Lucy, Lexi, or both in this comedic, choice-driven visual novel.

5221180.name: Puzzle Simulator
5221180.short_description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

4836710.name: 7 Millimeters Demo
4836710.short_description: Start your journey as a carpenter in a new neighborhood. Take measurements, install furniture and fulfill customer orders. But success attracts trouble; a local gang demands a fee. Refuse, turn your shop into a fortress, and arm yourself to defend your life. will you pay or resist?

5391740.name: Dicebloom
5391740.short_description: Roll the die and wake a twilight garden. Every hit sets off a chain of blooming: plants grow their neighbours, bees fly, seeds sprout and multipliers climb. Build a garden engine that pays a rising debt every week in this cozy dice roguelite.

4901860.name: The Big Suck
4901860.short_description: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Suck up cows, flatten cities, and turn destruction into upgrades. Start with a blade of grass. Keep growing until you tear the planet apart.

5111110.name: Night Drive - Anomaly
5111110.short_description: Night Drive - Anomaly is a supernatural driving horror game where you must navigate a mysterious endless night, spot anomalies, choose the right road, and survive until morning to escape the loop.

4920840.name: Xenogarden
4920840.short_description: Xenogarden is a dark sci-fi strategy game where you spread an alien swarm, build synapse nodes, defend your core, and overwhelm human defenders before they destroy your living network and cut the invasion apart.

5278970.name: Sketchy Warfare
5278970.short_description: A turn-based tactical war game where stick-figure armies from across history collide. Command 11 unique teams, master dozens of units and weapons, and fight through a campaign for every era—from cavemen and pirates to modern soldiers, fantasy warriors, and the armies of the future.

3350860.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
3350860.short_description: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

2640300.name: Evolution Survival
2640300.short_description: Evolution Survival is a survival game where the universe evolves around you. The plants and animals you saw at the beginning will be different at the end, They may not even be there, the star may have gone supernova or shrunk into a white dwarf. Use the time you have to ensure your survival.

4714760.name: Apotheosis Engine Demo
4714760.short_description: A probe, lost in the cosmos awakens after countless years. Using an antiquated retro operating system, grow your probe from a simple piece of engineering to a universal digital deity. Apotheosis Engine is an idle clicker game about becoming a digital GOD.

5408540.name: Puzzle Simulator Demo
5408540.short_description: The one-more-piece jigsaw game. Puzzle Simulator is a dangerously cozy puzzle adventure where you unlock shelf after shelf of boxes, satisfyingly sweep and sort pieces, collect rare charms, and puzzle your own photos.

4562310.name: Ultimate Classic Car Racing 2
4562310.short_description: A fast-paced local multiplayer party racing game for up to 8 players, featuring chaotic battles, multiple game modes, and responsive car controls.

5389640.name: Quota: Hit Your Number
5389640.short_description: Climb the sales ladder from the basement to the corner office. Cold-call, close deals, build a team, run a region — and hit your number every single month. A pixel-art idle career sim about the one figure that decides everything.

5279330.name: Battle Gaze
5279330.short_description: Battle Gaze is a fast-paced 2D retro action-adventure hack-and-slash. Master 5 unique weapons—sword, bow, deadly claws, light sword, and hay fork—unleash fluid combos, and defeat ruthless bosses across dangerous lands to reclaim your ancestral heritage!

4359960.name: Rayborne
4359960.short_description: Rayborne is a puzzle game built around lasers, physics, and real-time light simulation. Solve handcrafted challenges by shaping light itself while uncovering the mystery behind a questionable AI research facility.

4573570.name: Echoes of Stella
4573570.short_description: Echoes of Stella is a first-person horror adventure built around a unique echolocation device. Use it to navigate a distorted mirror world, revealing your surroundings in brief moments of clarity. Time your scans carefully, or risk exposing yourself.

5367380.name: Warcamp Rivals
5367380.short_description: Recruit and equip a fantasy warband in this asynchronous PvP auto battler. Cook, brew, train, and forge gear between battles. Combine traits and powerful Edicts, then test your squad against other players’ saved armies. Climb the ladder to become the best Camp Manager.

5072250.name: Fallen Crowns
5072250.short_description: Four Kings and a Wizard once sealed the Abyss. Then the Wizard betrayed them, and the Kings fell. Rise from nothing and claim their four crowns across a war-torn fortress, storm-wracked skies, a corrupted grove and endless shadow. Grow stronger every run, then face the Wizard King himself.

5157580.name: DUSTBLOOM
5157580.short_description: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build and defend your base, automate your production, haul ore with your truck, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

5019800.name: System Arrival
5019800.short_description: Top-down co-op survival action RPG for 1–4 players in a world the System turned into a game. Earn levels, quests and psychic powers, scavenge the ruins, fight zombies and build an underground bunker for survivors — then find out what the System really wants.

5459330.name: Meow Game Desert Island Survival Demo

5425680.name: Grandpa's Garden
5425680.short_description: Grow weed, roll joints and deliver to your customers in this top-down pixel crime game while the police patrol the streets. Hire dealers and gardeners, launder your money and turn a motel room into an empire. Play alone or with up to five friends.

4349140.name: Traveloot
4349140.short_description: Traveloot is a run-based incremental game where you guide a growing team of adventurers across islands. Gather resources, fight hordes of enemies, unlock branching skill tree, and find new party members to join your team. Play solo or with a friend in local co-op.

5103900.name: Spooky Land Defenders
5103900.short_description: A spooktacular strategic monster defense roguelite. Protect your haunted house from interdimensional corporate real estate investors by collecting horrific monsters, dreadful decor, terrible traps, and bizarre curios. Easy to sink your fangs into, but also a FRIGHTENINGLY deep strategy game!

4894500.name: Minesweeper Maker
4894500.short_description: Minesweeper Maker is a grid based logic game where you can play and create countless puzzles with friends and the community.

4569790.name: Anathema Requiem
4569790.short_description: Anathema Requiem is an atmospheric third-person psychological horror game where you must uncover the mystery of an abandoned cemetery where people vanish without a trace.

4461460.name: Fantasy Blacksmith Simulator
4461460.short_description: Become a Master Blacksmith in this cozy fantasy simulator. Restore and upgrade your workshop, forge magical weapons and armor, craft jewelry, and enchant powerful gear. Meet magical creatures and mysterious figures as you enjoy a relaxing crafting experience, solo or with friends in co-op.

4920640.name: プレア・チェスト
4920640.short_description:
A group of young adventurers set out to dispel the darkness lurking within people’s hearts.
A nostalgic 3D fantasy RPG inspired by the atmosphere of early‑2000s games.

3338850.name: Keyboard Wizards
3338850.short_description: Type to cast. Type faster to survive. Keyboard Wizards is a spell-typing duel: type a card's name to cast it, type your enemy's spell to counter it, and chain spells into combos. Build your deck from 60+ cut-paper cards and battle the monsters of Filipino folklore.

3720620.name: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds
3720620.short_description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

5348130.name: QUIZ BREAKER
5348130.short_description: Five contestants, one hidden Breaker who knows the answers. Race through four-choice buzzer quizzes, discuss suspicious answers, and use your Trigger to expose a suspect. Play with friends or join online alone with bot fill. Japanese-language gameplay.

5277460.name: 诗词防线
5277460.short_description: Poetry Defense blends classical Chinese poetry with tower defense. Lead poets like Li Bai, Du Fu, and Su Shi against insect swarms, answer verse challenges to trigger skills, study ancient texts, unlock poems, and light up poet constellations in your own starry sky.

2483570.name: Castillon
2483570.short_description: Castillon is an RTS + TD base-building strategy hybrid. Gather resources, explore and fortify your defenses during the day. Then survive waves of enemies attacks through the night. Level up, improve your stats, and master 4 schools of magic to become the ultimate wizard warrior.

2493190.name: High Noon Husk
2493190.short_description: A cartoony Wild West shooter for you and your friends. Revolver, sniper, shotgun, crossbow, and melee. Earn killstreaks such as a bull stampede, flaming tumbleweed that bounces off walls, drop a piano or safe on a group of enemies. Five unique game modes, online with friends or solo against bots.

4883810.name: Humani Project - Demo
4883810.short_description: A story-driven, linear Metroidvania set 400 years after the Human-Robot wars of 199X. Hunted by machines and forced into pockets of semi-civilization, the remaining humans are being repurposed into living batteries. Will you be next?

4666820.name: Buffet Simulator
4666820.short_description:
Build your buffet empire! Grow your restaurant from the ground up and expand to become the biggest buffet by yourself or in co-op with up to 4 players. 

Handle the cooking, cleaning, customers, and staffing as you create the most expansive menu possible!

5351630.name: UNLOADED
5351630.short_description: Sort the boxes! Dodge the boxes! THROW the boxes at your friends! 4-8 players, one warehouse shift, zero chance anyone keeps their job.

5382580.name: Rakuworld
5382580.short_description: Draw your own hero and play as it. Your drawings come alive to face hordes of enemies across 11 worlds made of paper and crayon. 36 heroes, 22 bosses, evolving weapons and 1-4 player co-op.

2279280.name: Eldritch 2
2279280.short_description: Minor Key Games' classic horror romp returns in this bigger and better sequel. Eldritch 2 is a first-person stealth action game inspired by immersive sims, roguelikes, and the works of H. P. Lovecraft.

616720.name: Live2DViewerEX
616720.short_description: The best cross-platform Live2D solution, three display modes (Wallpaper / Desktop / Desktop Window), multiple platforms (Windows / MacOS / Android / iOS), high-precision facial capture, and many other features.

4828010.name: Savory Seasons: Brizmere
4828010.short_description: Escape to Brizmere, a simple and cozy haven for the beginning of a new life. Expand your farm, master the harvest and decorate through the changing seasons. Get to know the new world and neighbors, share the fresh harvests and discover the stories that make Brizmere so special.

5445740.name: 灯下行
5445740.short_description: Where Lanterns Lead is a single-player strategy RPG inspired by eerie Chinese folklore. Learn combat skills, combine tactics, manage your monthly growth, and shape your own fighting style through battles and choices.

5152640.name: Traceroute Demo
5152640.short_description: A network-building simulation across the cities of a nation. Lay routers and cables to design your network, balancing bandwidth and latency on a limited budget. Survive sudden traffic surges and DDoS attacks as you connect city after city, learning real networking concepts as you play.

5315470.name: Goldrot Demo
5315470.short_description: A roguelite tower defense where every shot costs resources and every subject has needs of their own. Build production chains, manage your settlement, and keep your defenses supplied to survive increasingly dangerous Viking raids.

5415510.name: 2ndwaves
5415510.short_description: Connect 4+ blocks of the same color to clear them and build chain reactions. The controls are optimized for hard drops. Launch a second wave as you chase your target score. VS mode is also fun.

5321110.name: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom
5321110.short_description: BBBB: Block Block Boom Boom is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek game where hiders become part of the environment while seekers blast suspicious blocks! But watch closely, hider blocks have slightly more beveled edges than ordinary blocks. Can you spot the difference?

5465540.name: First Bag
5465540.short_description:
You are an invisible robber who steals valuables from the map, while the others — the police — hunt you down to catch you.
But you're only invisible while standing still. Move, and you can be seen. Steal money and valuables, furnish your home and level up your skills.

3779980.name: Lanternwood
3779980.short_description: Go on an Auto Battler Adventure with a Party of Heroes, observe them struggle, strategically build their Inventories to synergize with each other and allow them to succeed past any danger. Explore a myriad of Skills, Creatures, Events and Areas in this Auto Battling Fantasy Adventure!

5140930.name: HyperION DAW - Factory Samples
5140930.short_description: Expand Hyperion with a downloadable collection of factory loops, one-shots, drum sounds, effects and production-ready audio material.

5053270.name: Mithril
5053270.short_description: Explore and mine in procedural caves. Master using struts to delve deeper and support the ceiling before it falls. Build automation chains to process ores. Then manipulate lava and trigger Dormancy to crystallise new ore where lava once flowed. Same world. New cave. New dangers. The world remembers.

5024590.name: HyperION DAW
5024590.short_description: HyperION DAW is a modern Windows music production workstation with MIDI editing, VST3 plug-ins, procedural generators, mixing, mastering and a fast creative workflow.

5164920.name: Creepy Meal
5164920.short_description:
Creepy Meal is a co-op exploration, survival, and cooking game where absolutely nothing is safe.
Players must explore mysterious locations, collect  ingredients, drag them back, and cook them into high-value dishes and try not to become part of the menu.

4149030.name: Ad Iterum
4149030.short_description: Ad Iterum is a turn-based top-down 2D roguelike set in a decaying, ever-shifting world. Flesh is fragile, but you can hack it. Enhance your body, embrace mutations, or form ancient blood pacts. Descend into the depths, scavenge what’s left of humanity, and crawl back...if you can. Kill. Die. Repeat.

4984400.name: Towers of Babble
4984400.short_description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

4628270.name: Hollowed Oath
4628270.short_description: Hollowed Oath is a fantasy MMORPG set in the beautiful yet fractured world of Orrathis. Players assume the role of an Oathsworn, choosing three classes to define their own path customizing each ability they choose. Adventure, explore, collect, craft, and battle to uncover the truth behind your Oath.

5397160.name: 魔王·Devil King
5397160.short_description: Conquering the world… how entertaining that would be. I am the fabled Demon Lord, the strongest of all! Why do you foolish humans choose to fight!?

4981370.name: Babylonian Twins
4981370.short_description: The lost puzzle-platformer of ancient Babylon — made in Baghdad in 1993, back as the Definitive Edition in 2026. Freeze one twin to stone while the other dashes, drills and battles through five worlds. Includes the original 1993 Amiga game, fully playable — only on Steam.

4619380.name: Undying Flame Demo
4619380.short_description: Survive a minimalist wave-survival rogue-lite. Keep the fire alive. Read its flame. Defend your fire against creatures that crawl from the dark across endless waves. Every wave survived, the fire grows. Over time, it consumes everything.

3981190.name: Town Crazy
3981190.short_description: Get across town before time runs out in different levels, find shortcuts, and dodge traffic and obstacles. Fast runs, unpredictable collisions, and leaderboard competition.

5074480.name: Sunday Fighter Pilot
5074480.short_description: Take the scenic route or blow stuff up. Fly warbirds and jets across a colorful open world, discover airfields and unlock new aircraft. Enjoy relaxed exploration in Casual flying, or unleash guns and rockets to destroy ground targets and capture territory.

3045070.name: MetalMercs
3045070.short_description: Destroy. Salvage. Repair. Upgrade. PROFIT! A real-time tactical experience where you command your own mercenary outfit of mechs and mercs and adventure through randomly generated missions filled with rewards, glory, and bitter defeat.

5339660.name: Makehuman 2 - Free Halloween Pack
5339660.short_description: A Halloween & Fall Themed Content Pack. Contains clothing, themes, cubemaps, animations/poses, presets and much more.

4872480.name: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid Demo
4872480.short_description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

5201410.name: Genius Simulator Demo
5201410.short_description:
**Play a god-tier genius whose subtle glance is misread as the world's salvation formula!**

In this deck-building Roguelike, turn fanatical overthinking into strategy: observe your opponent's mental flaws, shatter their logic chain, or strike their blind spots for an instant kill!

5242160.name: TWENTY+
5242160.short_description: Draw toward 20. Turn the tables with + cards. TWENTY+ is a head-to-head card game with a shared deck numbered 1 to 11. Draw, stand, or change the target itself. Read your opponent's hidden card and time your + cards to swing the match. Play online or against the CPU.

5118820.name: FIND ALL 10: Greece
5118820.short_description: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

4767790.name: NARNOK: Little Bean Glandoid
4767790.short_description: Dig deep, collect buried treasures, return to the surface, trade with charming friends, unlock upgrades, and keep going deeper as you search for a way home in this cozy digging adventure as Little Bean Glandoid!

5104990.name: NARNOK: Help! I Was Reincarnated as a Brain in a Jar and Need to Plug In My Power Cables
5104990.short_description: im a brain in a jar now and I got these cables that gotta be plugged in but there are many dangerous things in the way, so its always a PUZZLE to solve haha

5476470.name: Cursor Cult Demo
5476470.short_description: Play the Stone Age of Cursor Cult. A tiny pixel tribe lives on an island at the edge of your screen and worships your mouse cursor. Every 20 seconds its priests read your cursor's trail as an omen: farm, build, trade, pray, study, or march to war. Lead them to the dawn of the Bronze Age.

5234110.name: AXE DESCENT
5234110.short_description: Over 600 skills, countless strategies. Build your own unique setup from ever-changing possibilities and venture to the deepest reaches of the Rift in this roguelite turn-based command RPG.

5021240.name: CityGenesis
5021240.short_description: CityGenesis is an authentic city-building simulation where you nurture a living economy. As the ruler of a small city-state, develop your city’s industries and lead your citizens to prosperity.

5376740.name: Look At It
5376740.short_description: A serious simulator about an important job: looking at a statue. Don’t look away. Compete on the global leaderboard to become the world’s greatest statue watcher.

4324420.name: Maxwell's Odyssey
4324420.short_description: Explore the dungeons of an ancient castle in search of a vanished sorceress. Blast through monsters, solve puzzles, and dodge the deadly traps waiting inside.

2663850.name: The Soul of Cosmos（灵魂乾坤）
2663850.short_description: "The Soul of Cosmos"is a dark fantasy adventure game that combines plot choices, tower strategy, and simulation management gameplay. As an extraterrestrial soul, you will coexist with the young girl Yunxi, accompanying her on her journey to find her mother and explore different soul worlds.

5348500.name: Sidetrack — Tiny Trains for Your Desktop
5348500.short_description: A cozy idle railway game that lives along the edge of your desktop while you work. Buy engines and wagons, deliver cargo, fill contracts and blow the whistle for coins as five districts grow along one long line: vans stop at shop doors, windows light up at dusk and boats drift down the river.

4211560.name: Frex: Ambivalence
4211560.short_description: A high-speed action game blending fluid movement and stylish sword combat, as you push through intense stages and confront enemies shaped by a broken world.

4310830.name: The Missing Threads Demo
4310830.short_description:
Who am I, without my memories?
Armed with nothing but the knowledge that I was once a detective,
I face the cases before me, piecing together fragments of truth—
deciding which leads to follow, which voices to trust,
and how quickly I can reach the answer.

4997090.name: KEMONO SCHOOL DAYS
4997090.short_description:
A peaceful school life as gentle as a spring breeze, and a relationship that hangs by a thread.
Where everyday life and thrills collide—
a visual novel about a romance between different species!

5468940.name: Inner Exile Demo
5468940.short_description: Inner Exile is a cinematic FPS psychological horror experience told in a single uninterrupted take. Collect memory objects and solve environmental puzzles to rebuild a traumatic past inside a claustrophobic, mysterious mindscape.

5343810.name: Doomy Downer
5343810.short_description: A cute block hero, dragged down through a grim voxel dungeon. Souls-like combat: read the glint, then parry, clash or roll. At every stair, a gate of flowers or a gate of thorns: mow down a horde in the open, or duel champions in the dark. Your loot is your build. Death is permanent.

5444950.name: Topsmith: Spinning Top Shop Simulator
5444950.short_description: Collect spinning tops, mix parts and take on rivals and tournaments! Run your own top shop, team up with friends in online co-op, or bring your custom build into a 1v1 battle.

5478800.name: Domino Party
5478800.short_description: Stand up thousands of dominoes to build a picture, then watch it all topple in one glorious chain! Make domino art and up to 10,000-piece jigsaws from your own photos with friends, then party in the lodge and playland with 25 mini-games like curling and sled races.

1924230.name: Amata Demo
1924230.short_description: Amata is a fantasy 2D side scrolling action rpg platformer.

4865640.name: Timberworks Demo
4865640.short_description: Timberworks is an incremental factory automation and management game. Start with a small sawmill, automate production, expand your railway network, and build a vast industrial empire.

5070310.name: Pioneers of Pagonia - Echoes of Aldramar
5070310.short_description: Go on an adventurous expedition to the frontier of the southern Pagonian sea. The legendary islands of Aldramar are waiting with monumental ruins, a coarse desert landscape, and the remains of a long-forgotten civilization.

4460330.name: Contact Protocol Demo
4460330.short_description: Contact Protocol is a starship job simulator set aboard a corporate vessel bound for Jupiter. Investigate incoming ships, uncover suspicious activity, and make impossible choices as you protect your crew - while the company watches your every move.

4619520.name: Crown & Coin: The Hundred Years（百年戦争） Demo
4619520.short_description: Survive the Hundred Years' War in 1355 France. A historical ensemble sandbox RPG demo featuring 1,015 real figures.

4216580.name: Bodycam 1997 Demo
4216580.short_description: Bodycam 1997 is a first-person shooter horror combined with psychological, liminal and bodycam elements. Experience the realistic and raw atmosphere accompanied by unreal encounters with nightmarish creatures.

4241410.name: Vipra the Vapor Species Portrait
4241410.short_description: This exclusive portrait comes with Stellaris: Season 10, allowing your empire to take the form of the elusive Vipra, beings of shifting atmosphere and smoke. Available immediately upon purchasing Stellaris: Season 10, it features 5 different phenotypes and ethereal custom animations.

3388180.name: IT Specialist Simulator Demo
3388180.short_description: IT Specialist Simulator demo puts you in the shoes of an IT pro. Fix computers, networks, and printers, manage daily tasks, and climb the tech career ladder—one click at a time!

2820150.name: The Boss Gangster: Criminal Empire Demo
2820150.short_description: Start from nothing and build a criminal empire in a seamless open-world sandbox. Run businesses, manage production chains, recruit your crew, fight rival families, and outsmart the police as every system pushes you closer to becoming the boss.

2098190.name: NAME OF THE WILL Demo
2098190.short_description: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

4300070.name: Warbound Demo
4300070.short_description: Build your ultimate battle deck and lead your armies in epic strategic warfare. Collect powerful cards, conquer rival kingdoms, and rise to become the greatest ruler in WARBOUND!

4980040.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper Demo
4980040.short_description: The free demo of Cube Sweeper: Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Unlimited Easy boards, sixteen Intermediate and Professional boards, daily boards on every tier, and the 25-chapter Learning Journey. Every board is solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Progress carries to the full game.

1663330.name: Street Boy
1663330.short_description: One summer. One handcart. One big race. Help Arlinton hustle around a Jamaican seaside town to build a motorised cart for race day, look after Granny and his friends, and quietly expose the gangster hiding in his community. Play alone, or host and join friends online.

5065490.name: Stranding Echoes
5065490.short_description: STRANDING ECHOES is a minimalist colony sim. Manage the non-corporeal creatures called echo to build your base and survive the heat.

4267200.name: Gene Gone Wild
4267200.short_description: Build your own beast from animal heads, limbs, and tails. GENE GONE WILD is a creature-building survivor roguelite: buy and merge body parts, combine traits and synergies, and grow your gene talent tree as your tiny creature evolves into a walking arsenal.

4944880.name: Cube Sweeper: 3D Minesweeper
4944880.short_description: Classic Minesweeper, carved into three dimensions. Orbit each board and read the numbers around corners and down through tunnels. Every board is guaranteed solvable by logic alone, never a guess. Dig for hidden gems and climb from your first click to Expert.

5369390.name: MMO Guild Manager
5369390.short_description: MMO Guild Manager is a simulation game set in a fictional MMORPG, where your guild fights 5v5 match after match. Take a newly formed underdog guild to the top. Every loss has a reason. Figure it out, rebuild your team, and take down your rival.

2783830.name: Cozy Crest
2783830.short_description: Awaken ancient elemental powers, shape your home, and help villagers bring their island back to life. Settle into this cozy open-world life sim, solo or with up to three friends.

5227720.name: Phoning It In
5227720.short_description: Make good use of words and personas to conceal yourself amid the chaotic workplace, gain your leaders’ trust, steer clear of blame-shifting colleagues, keep learning and mastering skills, and ultimately create your own.

5380650.name: VOXFRAG
5380650.short_description: Retro arcade action meets glowing 3D voxels in this twin-stick arena shooter. Dodge bullets, shatter enemy ships and turn wreckage into upgrades. Build your ship across five sectors, then push further in Overdrive and Endless mode.

4990050.name: Red Father
4990050.short_description: RED FATHER is a PSX-style horror game set in Graham Labs, a mysterious computer research facility. The company's prized supercomputer has gone rogue, killing anyone who might shut it down. Uncover the mysteries Graham Labs tried to hide, and try to make it out alive.

3649840.name: Zombie Police: Midsummer Unhappy New Year
3649840.short_description:
Ancient customs vs. Detective Zomby—what could possibly happen? 
Investigate a tragedy caught on a VTuber’s livestream in a village frozen in midsummer.
Dive into minds, connect testimony in your Journal, and crack the case in this comedy-mystery adventure.

5450470.name: Lost in the Desert with Giant Spiders Demo

5378890.name: Lost in the Desert with Giant Spiders
5378890.short_description: The sand ripples, then splits open in a swarm of giant spiders. In this B-movie desert auto-shooter, read the ground, dodge the eruptions, and evolve your weapons as you push toward the next oasis. And they're only the beginning. Miles from help. Inches from fangs.

5156350.name: The Hunger Below
5156350.short_description: The Hunger Below is a brutal top-down dark fantasy action RPG for solo and online co-op. Forge your own path through an unforgiving medieval world where survival is never guaranteed, choices have consequences, and how you face the horrors ahead is entirely up to you.

5477010.name: Hentai Age Onsen
5477010.short_description: Solve block-fitting puzzles and unlock sexy character scenes as your reward. Find the perfect fit and reveal what awaits beyond each completed board.

5447150.name: Island Tycoon
5447150.short_description: Build your tropical island empire in Island Tycoon! Transport cargo, fly planes, explore oceans, build cities, and play with up to 4 friends.

4840830.name: Enchanted Oceans Inc
4840830.short_description: Take to the seas and help bring life back to a shattered ocean archipelago in this third person ocean adventure created by a marine biologist! Make use of your trusty vessel, deep sea diving skills, and a sprinkling of magic to achieve your goals and help the people of Rhu.

5186570.name: Flat Earth Runner
5186570.short_description: Endless runner. Sentient Yowie. Antarctic ice wall. The New World Order really does not want you finishing the lap. A PS1-style comedy about the dumbest possible way to prove the earth is flat.

4867010.name: Lords of the World
4867010.short_description: Develop your city, expand your armies, and send your kingdom's elite agent across the world to complete dangerous missions.

3680760.name: Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween
3680760.short_description: Woke up in a filthy dungeon? Check. Accused of destroying a holiday? Check. In Yazuke: Destroy The Halloween, battle your way through a ridiculously powerful gang literally named "Halloween". Dismantle the spooky season boss by boss, destroy the candy and tricks, and slay the night!

3758950.name: Death at Fleming Manor
3758950.short_description:
"Your job is to write the death certificate."
Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

4887270.name: When Pigs Fly
4887270.short_description: Build the plane while you're flying it! When Pigs Fly is a physics co-op game for 1–4 players. Grapple scrap, bolt it onto your cart, and transform into a plane mid-flight. Dodge wolves, fall constantly, and reach the destination island before the whole thing comes apart.

3850230.name: 99天生存指南
3850230.short_description: A fast-paced co-op zombie survival action game where players fight through hordes of enemies, unlock random power-ups, build different synergies, and escape together as a team.

4838790.name: 群雄战歌：妖火纪元
4838790.short_description: This retro Chinese pixel RPG is set in a fiend-infested world. Recruit heroes, use dual skill trees and team combos. Explore, battle foes, fight the demonfire plague, banish darkness and raise your battle hymn.

5466570.name: 賴瑞的調酒研究室
5466570.short_description: A single-player visual novel about bar owner Larry and the people he meets. Make choices across multiple character routes and endings, with 40 local save slots and an ending collection. Play in Traditional Chinese or English.

3080370.name: DOCTRINEERS
3080370.short_description: DOCTRINEERS is a turn-based strategy game where no two games are ever alike. Strategize and plan with your unique doctrinal units and adapt to new battlefields in a single-player campaign and online multiplayer.

5404800.name: 营火与远征 Demo
5404800.short_description: Build your camp, grow production, and train soldiers in Campfire & Conquest Demo. Gradually recruit a Paladin, Priest, and Bard. Explore a five-stage mine with a party of up to three heroes across three difficulty levels, then lead your army against the orc settlement.

4047790.name: Bento Story
4047790.short_description: Bento Story is a bento-arranging simulator with a warm story about a girl deciding her future while serving customers and sending them off with a lunch box that says more than words.

5461100.name: 60 Days Adrift
5461100.short_description: Shipwrecked with a girl, fish, cook, gather supplies and brave the weather on a raft. Some catches mutate into monsters: fight them on deck. Decide how to share food and water and whom to help. Get to know her. Will rescue come? Will you reach shore together? What awaits on day 60?

5228090.name: Necro Rising Demo
5228090.short_description: The free demo of Necro Rising. Wake in a pauper's coffin, bind the fallen into a skeleton legion, call three villagers and the ranger Lin Yuan back from the grave, and hold Greywell's lamps through the night. Prologue and first two regions, about 40 minutes.

5333510.name: Bribe The Brave Demo
5333510.short_description: Rule a fantasy realm where heroes don't take orders - they take bribes. Build your settlement, place gold bounties on deadly monsters, and entice autonomous warriors, rogues, and mages to fight for your cause. Expand, defend, and let coin do the commanding in this indirect-control RTS.

5433890.name: Roof UP!
5433890.short_description: Build a cozy floating hex island where every building grows as tall as it is happy. Cottages love trees, windmills love fields, lighthouses love the sea. Place each piece where its neighbors lift it up, and watch your skyline climb through the seasons.

4916510.name: 卡牌大师
4916510.short_description: Card Master is a turn-based deckbuilder built around playing cards. Build poker hands, manage your deck, and cross three nightmare layers. Combine 14 characters with 8 Soul Arts for 112 theoretical builds, then survive randomized battles, events, and escalating Cycles before facing Fate.

4500630.name: Soul Tides Demo
4500630.short_description: Command dark armies in this tug-of-war auto-battler. Build your base, summon units, customize abilities, and push the battlefield toward your enemy’s stronghold. Adapt your strategy each match and dominate in PvP, co-op, or Trials mode.

5176630.name: SUNSTONE: A Tale of the Briar King
5176630.short_description: A top-down action-adventure on an 8-bit cartridge, now seen in 3D. Cross a sunlit country, brave nine tombs, outwit their guardians and recover eight Sunstones. Walk it in the orbital 3/4 view, and take on a new tomb every day.

4252430.name: Atana
4252430.short_description: Atana is a female-led romance visual novel set in late 20th-century America, where you grow alongside your creator, Atana, as an AI.

4803280.name: Little Girls Escapeventures
4803280.short_description:
The girls face some slightly dangerous and perilous situations.
Use your wits to overcome them. But it won't be easy, you know?
Now, witness the fate of these slightly retro girls with your own hands.

4387550.name: International Waters
4387550.short_description: Out at sea, you and your two buds discover a series of mysterious islands. Progress through platformer levels, fight bosses, and escape the cube.

5472910.name: 深渊破坏神
5472910.short_description: Collect randomized loot and shape your build with skills, talents, and gear. Choose from four heroes and explore 75 stages across five continents in side-view battles.

4774370.name: GymPup
4774370.short_description: GymPup is a furry-themed romance narrative game that blends desktop idle gameplay with visual novel elements. Through their journey together, you watch the two protagonists grow and change—inside and out.

5417220.name: Worlds Smash Expedition
5417220.short_description: Blast through 500 puzzle levels across ten illustrated worlds. Rescue astronauts, unleash ship powers and combine special pieces to overcome obstacles and planetary bosses in a colorful space puzzle adventure.

5472880.name: 帝国的第99次重生
5472880.short_description: 1,800+ event cards, 164 troop cards and 151 epic figures anchor this civilization strategy roguelite. Weigh policy, construction and war; choose a starting technology, homeland and faith to shape each new run.

5401820.name: Zombie Crawlers Demo
5401820.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

4692090.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor Demo
4692090.short_description: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where you merge atoms into higher elements, trigger massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.

5436000.name: 《只有她知曉光輝的名字》- 第一章
5436000.short_description: A Hong Kong-made fantasy visual novel with hand-drawn frame-by-frame animation with full Cantonese and English text. Zero, bearer of every sin, flees with an all-knowing goddess and has 30 days to find herself. Each chapter is a film genre, with timed reaction battles, stealth mazes and minigames.

5017820.name: Sir Loot-a-Lot
5017820.short_description: Medieval turn-based loot RPG. Skills are cards dealt each turn—spend 4 AP in any order. Sword, spear, and bow swap as you fight; add poison, fire, or frost; chain duplicates into combos. Forked runs lead through elites, vaults, and merchants to unique bosses. Relics reshape play;

3382700.name: Into the Void Demo
3382700.short_description: Into The Void is an action packed high-speed retro shooter that follows the story of John Void, a man returned from the dead with no memories. Will you uncover the secrets of his life? Or will you simply do as you’re told?

4710440.name: Exodrift
4710440.short_description: Exodrift is a rhythm action roguelite where you are a space delivery driver on the run. Deliver packages, destroy enemies on the beat, and escape hazardous procedurally generated planets.

5292030.name: Bribe The Brave
5292030.short_description: Rule a fantasy realm where heroes don't take orders - they take bribes. Build your settlement, place gold bounties on deadly monsters, and entice autonomous warriors, rogues, and mages to fight for your cause. Expand, defend, and let coin do the commanding in this indirect-control RTS.

5379560.name: SLUP
5379560.short_description: Collect Gems, keep your combo alive, and outrun your own past. Every path you take returns as a moving Past, turning your previous choices into deadly obstacles in this strategic arcade score-attack game.

3985540.name: Raining Lead
3985540.short_description: Twin-stick shooter meets action roguelike in a quest to burn corporate stocks. Mega Giga Corp takes your city. Their stock keeps climbing but you're the correction they didn't hedge against - A constructor of machines ready to burst their bubble. Destroy, loot, upgrade, repeat and lead the revolt.

5019170.name: Desktop Bug Killer
5019170.short_description:
This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves.
Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

2405340.name: Dead On Arrival
2405340.short_description: Step into the shoes of a CSI in Dead On Arrival, the ultimate crime scene investigation game. Analyse scenes, collect evidence, and use real-life forensic tools to solve cases. Test your problem-solving skills and uncover the truth to catch the killer. Do you have what it takes to crack the case?

5105650.name: Love, Death & My Daughter
5105650.short_description: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free game that combines a virtual desktop interface with narrative storytelling. you will repair a memory program within an old software system, gradually recover memories from the past, and come to understand the love a mother left behind in a new light.

5214410.name: Golden Goblin Player
5214410.short_description: Turn your local files into a media platform of your own. Videos, music, audio works, books, images and games in one place — rediscovered through automatic tags, search and recommendations. Play funscripts on their own or in sync with media. Optional hardware support; a complete player without it.

5413320.name: Silver Service
5413320.short_description: Silver Service is a cozy tidying game where you put 11,132 portions back where they belong aboard a cruise liner, solo or with up to 3 friends. Fill your tray, find the right display, unlock upgrades, and to unwind, grab your fishing rod and see what’s hiding under the water.

5051990.name: VIGNETTE Demo
5051990.short_description: A first-person point-and-click psychological horror game. Only the areas illuminated by your flashlight change in appearance. The game progresses through quiet unease and puzzle-solving, without relying on jump scares. A demo is now available (approx. 20 minutes).

4635950.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy!
4635950.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

5226220.name: OddXI
