5226220.short_description: The football sticker roguelike. OddXI is a gloriously daft deckbuilder where you rip open packs of deeply odd footballers, stack their traits into ridiculous combos, and drag your XI through three nerve-shredding seasons against absurd bosses: vegan pirates, a goth band and ancient philosophers.

5385090.name: Mines & Meows: Cozy Minesweeper
5385090.short_description: Play Minesweeper, draw adorable cats, and complete your cat collection! Unwind with relaxing music and feline friends by your side.

4930460.name: FlipBAKA! Demo
4930460.short_description: Flip floor panels and launch monsters—and friends—into the sea! This free demo includes Dungeon Mode through floor 6 with online co-op, up to four characters in Campaign Mode, and one PvP ruleset. Demo downloads are planned to end with Steam Next Fest.

5456810.name: Little Extinctions
5456810.short_description: Three subspecies descended from one gray ancestor meet again in a drought. Every creature carries a gene of three loci that sets its body and its behavior, and it eats, hunts, breeds, and forms packs on its own. As an alien biologist, you observe which lineages survive.

4873180.name: Project Phoenix 涅槃计划 Playtest

4901780.name: Golfcremental
4901780.short_description:
BUILD! GOLF! EARN! BUY!
Turn $50 into your own golfing empire by building custom golf courses and then automating them to get hole in ones. Unlock unique golf course pieces and use them in unique ways to make more money.

4006810.name: Underway: Tales Of A Killer
4006810.short_description:
Some might say that "Underway" is basically a boss-rush fetch-quest. And while they might be right (if ALL of the story is ignored), what if there was a version that fit that inaccurate description a bit more?

Well... Now there is. But not in the way you think...

5317940.name: Studio Zero Demo
5317940.short_description: 《Studio Zero》is a first-person cyberpunk FMV thriller. In a future ruled by megacorporations, every choice you make dictates your fate. Will you shatter the system, become a corporate puppet, or vanish into the neon night? Step in—your choices shape the ending.

5003860.name: Yokai Mart Demo
5003860.short_description: Yokai Mart is a cozy shop simulation game full of mysterious stories. Take over your grandmother’s konbini. The supernatural visitors who come at night and the customers from the village need your help. Little by little, you’ll get to know the place and improve the lives of your guests.

5174700.name: Kick The Piñata! Demo
5174700.short_description: Grab your trusty bat and smash piñatas in this colorful incremental game. Buy weapons, unlock upgrades, rebirth, and build your strangely arranged home. Everything is cute, everything is fine, and the piñatas are definitely not alive.

5213930.name: Vital Decisions Demo
5213930.short_description:
Take charge of a emergency room up to 8 players.
Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. 
Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

5269280.name: The 31st Student
5269280.short_description: Thirty names. Thirty-one desks. Explore a deserted Japanese high school, uncover conflicting records, and confront the memories you helped erase. A first-person psychological horror mystery with three endings. Play on a monitor or in VR.

4693250.name: 蛆之房~悬置之镜之歌~ Demo
4693250.short_description: Aliens turned humans into "maggots" – toiling underground, eating rotten flesh. Xingzhi has a house. Her and her tenants' fates are in your hands. Save Ku Yi? Follow Qi Qian? Each choice leads somewhere else. The road up is stained with blood. The answer is yours.

4257770.name: THE VIG Demo
4257770.short_description:
You'll be "Xie En", infiltrating the traitor's money empire. This urban hunt is a revenge saga where wit is your spear.
Return as "Wu Wei," using rules as your shield in a world of grey. Will you choose love or vengeance?
This lethal game of cash, betrayal and redemption awaits your move.

3841050.name: Sacrifice Sanctuary: The Ritual Maiden's Life With Monsters
3841050.short_description: Chosen by her village to help stabilize a potentially dangerous monster population, Yomi is sent as an offering of the depths of Hell. Can she discover all that Hell has to offer?

3932400.name: Monster Hunter Wilds - Pendant: Trot-along Fledgling
3932400.short_description: Have this adorable Seikret Fledging trot-alongside you!

3949050.name: Frontline Logistics: Isarian Warfare Demo
3949050.short_description:
A tactical survival and outpost management sim driven by dynamic battlefield events.
War isn't just about combat—it’s about the daily lives of your soldiers. Keep logistics running, scavenge every usable resource, and do what you can to ease the harsh reality of life on the frontlines.

2224460.name: Street Fighter™ 6 - Year 1 Character Pass
2224460.short_description:
Year 1 Character Pass
- 4 additional characters
- 4 additional characters' colors: Outfit 1 Colors 3-10
- Bonus: 4,200 Drive Tickets

2109301.name: Resident Evil 4 Treasure Map: Expansion
2109301.short_description:
Discover the hidden treasures that await!
With this map, additional treasures will be placed throughout the game.
Some of these treasures can only be obtained by this method.

1668440.name: Prodeus MIDI Soundtrack
1668440.short_description: Prodeus is a first-person shooter of old, re-imagined using modern rendering techniques. It reaches the quality you expect from a AAA experience while adhering to some of the aesthetic technical limits of older hardware.

1681680.name: Who Stole My Beard? Soundtrack
1681680.short_description: Soundtrack contains all of the music featured in the game Who Stole My Beard?  20 Unique and professionally composed tracks.

1422660.name: 邻居大叔/UncleNeighbor Soundtrack
1422660.short_description: This is about the music that appears in "Uncle Neighbor/UncleNeighbor."

1585800.name: Drova - Forsaken Kin Demo
1585800.short_description: Drova is an Action-RPG inspired by grim dark titles of the genre. Dive through a wall of everlasting fog to discover a society grown from the ashes of a dead empire. The demo offers around 2 hours of playtime.

5391500.name: Ardhan
5391500.short_description: Ardhan is a roguelike deckbuilder where every fight happens on a real board: minions trade, taunts hold the line, weapons break, and the deck you walk out with is never the deck you walked in with. 12 factions, 421 cards, 6 acts, Ascension 1–15 and a Daily Game shared by everyone.

5415340.name: CARVEGRAM
5415340.short_description: Carvegram is a satisfying puzzle game where you carve cute miniature figurines out of blocks. Inspired by 3D nonograms: use the numbers on each line to work out what to break and what to paint in this meditative brain-buster with over 300 puzzles that's easy to learn but hard to put down.

4757810.name: 未知守则 Demo
4757810.short_description: Unknown Rules is an independently created multiplayer online horror game that supports 1-4 players.

5368440.name: DragHunter
5368440.short_description: Link swords, cut down skulls, and build your way out of danger. DragHunter is a turn-based dungeon puzzle RPG where every chain feeds your next upgrade—and every turn gives the dungeon another chance.

5243350.name: Tears of Fire
5243350.short_description: Unravel the mysteries of Tears of Fire! Explore the devastated Kingdom of Eden, face corrupted creatures, and uncover the secrets of a war-torn past in a hand-drawn 2D metroidvania adventure.

5444340.name: Claw and Conjure Demo
5444340.short_description: The Claw and Conjure demo is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG units. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. The demo offers free access to early game units, items, and abilities and allows PvP play for 8 rounds per run

3064330.name: Evoplasm Demo
3064330.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

3135230.name: Esteem - A Saga of the Little Wolf Demo
3135230.short_description: Esteem is an emotional RPG about Laisa, a young wolf cub who must confront her fears and insecurities to save her village. Explore a fantasy world where self-esteem influences battles and challenges. 2nd place in the Best Indie Game award at BGS 2024!

5400510.name: Backrooms Anomaly Project Demo
5400510.short_description: Try the demo of Backrooms Anomaly Project, a first-person anomaly horror game. Explore an endless corridor, spot subtle changes in your surroundings, and decide whether to move forward or turn back. Watch out for what's lurking in the dark.

5327630.name: Lucky's Scratch House
5327630.short_description: Lucky’s Scratch House is a physics-based multiplayer bar hangout. Meet up with friends, shoot pool, play darts and other bar games, and see what happens when you start messing with the place and its regulars.

4725940.name: Backrooms Anomaly Project
4725940.short_description: An anomaly-spotting horror game set in the Backrooms. Explore eerie corridors, study every detail, and spot anything that shouldn't be there. Move forward when everything is normal, or turn back when something is wrong. Avoid the darkness and run when something starts chasing you.

4845620.name: Turbo Turkey: Feathered Frenzy! Demo
4845620.short_description: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this platformer inspired by Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

4966610.name: PRIEST Demo
4966610.short_description: Lead an army as its healer in PRIEST: a fantasy autobattler with an emphasis on healing. Arrange your army, keep them alive, and grow them in strength and number using four talent trees. Battle across 23 campaign levels then see how far you can get in endless mode.

5301830.name: URIEL OS Demo
5301830.short_description: URIEL OS is an audio horror game where the perspective never leaves your screen. Traverse the apocalypse while sealed inside a mechanical vehicle that barely protects you from whatever is outside. Hack devices to manipulate the environment and piece together what happened to a very different Earth.

5048340.name: EXCISA
5048340.short_description: Sit down at a séance table in an abandoned house. Choose a tarot card. Roll the dice. Risk everything to summon the Angel who never lies. Every reach across the table might bring you closer to the truth—or seat something else opposite you. Five chairs. The dead have heard you, too.

5100400.name: EXCISA Demo
5100400.short_description: Take a seat in the EXCISA demo. Choose a tarot card. Decide how many dice to roll. Advance the ritual toward the Angel while five uninvited guests may answer your call. Win the séance—and decide whether to stand up or stay seated.

5224730.name: BeyondTheBorder
5224730.short_description: You have wandered into the city of Aberrants, “Helikar.” To return to the human city of “Engine,” escape the city where Aberrants roam. A horror escape game.

5468860.name: StickPuck GM
5468860.short_description: Build your franchise, shape your league — and prove 200 hockey men wrong. Draft prospects, negotiate contracts and wheel and deal your way up to the trade deadline in a hockey management game that simulates the pros, all whole sticking to a scrappy underdog style that's all its own.

4826490.name: REELS of the DAMNED
4826490.short_description: A slot machine deckbuilding roguelike dungeon crawl. Choose a class, grow your symbol deck, unlock spells and relics, and fight your way to the bottom of the Dungeon!

5276310.name: 【パパたび】パパさ、旅系インフルエンサーで食っていこうと思っているんだ。【体験版】
5276310.short_description: An unemployed dad and his college-student daughter set out to make a living as travel influencers. Puzzle out destinations from clues, pin them on the world map, and grow your channel with videos: geo-guessing meets streamer sim. Aim for one million followers, with 200+ history and geography trivia.

2256350.name: Hunt or be Haunted
2256350.short_description: 6v1 asymmetrical horror. Team up with up to five investigators using professional gear to track the paranormal—or take control of the entity and hunt them down. Watch your sanity, trust your team, and survive the darkness.

2434930.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
2434930.short_description: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and paranormal phenomena from the region.

3114690.name: Broken & Loved
3114690.short_description: Broken & Loved is an interactive visual novel which tells the story of  Evangeline and Rei, two university students entangling their lives in a love story fill with reflection, drama, sweetness and happiness.

4249530.name: Broken & Loved - Adult Content
4249530.short_description: Unlock all the sexual content for Broken & Loved with this DLC!, enjoy of interactive and reactive erotic scenes, with sexual development and dialogues that change base on player agency.

3100690.name: Dust & Diesel: Deadland Delivery
3100690.short_description: Survive in a desolate post-apocalyptic world as a trucker, building your delivery empire. Customize and upgrade your trucks, fight off bandits, and navigate dangerous terrains. Complete challenging missions and uncover the wasteland secrets. Are you ready to conquer the Deadlands?

3113480.name: CardCraft Champions
3113480.short_description: A unique roguelike deckbuilding auto battler with many strategic choices. Customize your cards and discover powerful combinations.

4816420.name: Welcome to Sunnybrook
4816420.short_description:
Welcome to Sunnybrook, an idyllic community where residents come to escape.

Play as a burglar breaking into affluent homes when something prehistoric descends on the unwary residents. Sneak, steal, and survive as you escape a community turned hunting ground that gives new meaning to "eat the rich".

4800420.name: Brewery Simulator Demo
4800420.short_description: Run a medieval tavern, grow ingredients, brew unique alcohols with custom flavor traits, and serve demanding customers. Expand your business, unlock new brewing tiers, and manage the tavern solo or with up to 4 players in online co-op.

1744960.name: 墨卷奇路
1744960.short_description: Mojuan is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder blending deck construction with Qishu board space management. Enter painted scrolls, plan around cards, relics, consumables, and the Nine Gates, and face forest spirits, strange formations, and eerie encounters.
developers: 杭州执棋者网络科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州执棋者网络科技有限公司

4975010.name: Chess Pit
4975010.short_description: Two teams. One giant chessboard. Every kill earns your team a move, then you climb inside a hundred-foot chess piece and drive it across the arena, crushing anyone where it lands. Real-time chess with no turns, no waiting, and a whole lot of gunfire. Take the enemy king to win.

5022210.name: Granule Demo
5022210.short_description: A physics sandbox about Murray, who didn't let a witch merge onto the highway. She sent him to The Granule, and something already lives there. You. Burn, freeze, shock, slice, and mend him. None of it is scripted, and the room is not all there is.

5441690.name: Bandits are Coming
5441690.short_description: A low-pressure tower defense where losing costs nothing but time. Place Cowboys, Dynamite, Flamers, Snipers, and Cannons across 10 levels and 20 waves each — gold and towers always carry through a retry, so you're guaranteed to win eventually. Just build, watch, and rebuild.

4775670.name: Stack & Brew Demo
4775670.short_description: Garden Gingdom is a management simulation game where you brew potions and run your own shop. Craft the potions and magical items your customers request, deliver them on time, collect your earnings, level up, expand your business, and take on bosses!

5421010.name: 피지컬 윷놀이
5421010.short_description: Yut without waiting for turns. Build energy, throw the sticks, stack and capture pieces, and turn the match around with skills.

4054540.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown Demo
4054540.short_description: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown is a story-driven survival strategy game in which the fate of the iconic starship is in your hands. Take the helm, manage the ship and resources, and make difficult decisions. Will you be able to bring home the ship and its crew?

4841640.name: Glowpits: Farmers Arena
4841640.short_description: Explore the world of GlowPits, collect valuable resources, defeat rival explorers, unlock unique characters, and upgrade powerful abilities in a fast-paced arena adventure filled with creatures, challenges, and endless progression.

4937850.name: Big Top
4937850.short_description: Big Top is an active carnival incremental where every shot, throw, and swing earns tickets. Collect game-changing prizes, build powerful combinations, and conquer the carnival on your quest to claim the legendary Super Playbox!

5021760.name: Deck Breaker - A Roguelike Deckbuilder
5021760.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with a focus on deep strategy, synergy and crazy combos. Build your deck as you adventure with over 200 cards and 35 heroes that each warp the rules — designed by a former Hearthstone set-design lead. Free demo out now!

5122020.name: GNAP GNAP
5122020.short_description: GNAP GNAP is a horde roguelite shooter where you pop ominous balloons that keep multiplying. Unlock items, harpoons and grow stronger with each run. Equip your harpoon, max your stats and defeat all the entities keeping you against your will.

5136370.name: Femboy & Futa Maidmare
5136370.short_description: A psychological horror visual novel set in a neon-lit motel. Work the night shift, build relationships with the unusual staff, make choices, and investigate increasingly strange events as the line between memory and reality begins to blur.

5255960.name: ClusterForce Soundtrack
5255960.short_description: The complete ClusterForce soundtrack: 23 tracks, 67 minutes, encoded from the studio masters. As 320 kbit/s MP3 and lossless FLAC.

5264330.name: VibeMarket
5264330.short_description: Run a lone trading card shop in a post-apocalyptic world. Stock shelves, serve customers, rip packs and hunt rare pulls. Grow your scrappy little store, build a collection worth showing off, and keep the lights on for one more day.

5382080.name: His Umbrella Is Dry
5382080.short_description: Hong Kong, 1999. The rain hasn't stopped. Your uncle has left you his paper offerings shop. Fold gold ingots, write names, paint faces on paper figures and serve the customers who come in from the rain. He left one rule: never write a name for a man whose umbrella is dry.

3271120.name: Dragon Khan
3271120.short_description: Dragon Khan is a third-person action RPG set in Ithannar, a world ruled by dragons, where the player controls Botu, a unique green draconate born with wings and elemental power, drawn into a conflict triggered by the disappearance of a dragon Khan and the invasion of the forest domain.

4515280.name: Suzerain Stories: The Neutral Lens
4515280.short_description: I am Ilais Moris, an aspiring investigative journalist in Kyrute, the world's diplomatic capital. As the host of The Neutral Lens, Geopolitico's groundbreaking news program, I navigate personal & professional challenges in a search for my place in a rapidly changing world. What story will you tell?

4592670.name: Kittycat Couture Demo
4592670.short_description: Kittycat Couture is a cozy sandbox dress-up game about making outfits for cats. Style island residents, discover new designers, and fill your closet in this cozy game about appreciating fashion!

3771400.name: Horripilant Demo
3771400.short_description: KILL YOUR GOD. BECOME WORTHY. Horripilant is a chilling idle incremental dungeon crawl through the horrors of a forgotten underworld.

2529630.name: SOUL BET PARTY
2529630.short_description: A 2-4 player dice party game: Yacht scoring, plus character skills that flip the board. Fill thirteen categories with five dice while spending mana to multiply your turn, drain everyone else's total, or re-roll a category an opponent already locked in. The strongest skills cost you your own points.

4841710.name: Finding Buddies
4841710.short_description: Finding Buddies is a romance visual novel where your dialogue choices shape Daniel’s story and relationships. Explore different scenes, meet new characters, and experience a narrative with interactive gameplay moments.

5073610.name: Pegs of Hell
5073610.short_description: A physics roguelike where you build the pachinko board yourself. Place and upgrade pegs, arrange powerful Arcana, split balls, trigger elemental chains and create absurd scoring machines before Hell's rent catches up with you.

5117980.name: Final Armada
5117980.short_description: Build ships block by block, command your fleet in real-time space battles, and choose your path through a roguelike campaign. Upgrade your ships, watch them break apart in combat, and uncover what happened to the galaxy around you.

5379070.name: PIG IRON
5379070.short_description:
PIGIRON is a fast-paced horde shooter with light mech-sim elements. 


Grind your way through hundreds of escaped Bio-engineered Meat Organisms with an arsenal of horrifying flesh-metal contraptions.

5429320.name: End My Dry Spell
5429320.short_description: Lorfeld is a small wine town on the Rhine gorge—and this summer, the river has dropped to a level nobody living has seen. Choose who you stand beside, what you’re willing to pay when you’re wrong, and who stays when the harbour finally starts moving again.

2899350.name: House Of Decay
2899350.short_description: House of Decay is a PSX-style 3D platformer-metroidvania. Explore a world of demons in search of your missing brother, leap across hellish platforms, uncover secrets, find strange pets, and fight cute monsters 🦷

3924680.name: Meco Rocket Simulator (Pro DLC)
3924680.short_description: Support a solo dev with behind-the-scenes extras. Nothing in Meco is locked behind this DLC. You get the 9-track soundtrack, 5 public-domain NASA and NAVAIR engine-design reports collected in one place, 2 showcase 3D-print geometries and 4 “Miku” wallpapers. Requires owning Meco.

5277020.name: Jenoria
5277020.short_description: Create your own Jeno companions, lead them into battle, and build a town together. Explore a voxel sandbox action RPG where you can storm forts, delve into dungeons, and sail the skies in a custom-built airship. Shape your companions, your army, and the world you call home.

5463460.name: Veltarum
5463460.short_description: VELTARUM is a single-player retro FPS built around fast movement and brutal combat. Wall-run through a dark world of towers and chains, fight with guns and a sword, slow time, and face towering bosses. Spend crystals on upgrades between lives and climb again.

4445120.name: William 2
4445120.short_description: Explore a connected world of villages, snowy mountains and underwater passages in William 2, a 2D action-platformer. Complete quests, battle enemies, collect treasures and unlock new paths as you face bosses inspired by the Seven Deadly Sins.

5395940.name: What Remains Inside
5395940.short_description: What Remains Inside is a psychological thriller where your task is to clean a house. Interactable lights, notes, and more lead you to discover the secret within...

4023510.name: Outsail The Sun
4023510.short_description: Conquer dark oceans as the captain of a vampirate crew. Feast on sailor blood for roguelite-style upgrades, fend off mighty sea creatures with your overpowered builds, go treasure hunting, and outsail the sun to achieve bullet-heaven under the night sky!

5239430.name: Monster Mavericks Demo
5239430.short_description: Hunt mechanical monstrosities in a steampunk Wild West. Choose your loadout, gather a posse of up to four players, collect powerful upgrades and deploy combat drones as you explore dangerous frontiers and bring down notorious bosses.

3981570.name: European Deadzone: Polesie Demo
3981570.short_description: The Polesie region of Eastern Europe lies quarantined after a catastrophic event transformed its landscape and inhabitants. As a lone survivor, navigate this sealed nightmare of succubi, ghouls, and twisted horrors. Uncover the truth or attempt to tame the unknown.

5306130.name: Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life
5306130.short_description: "Card Survival: The Slacker’s Life" is a card-stacking + urban survival simulation game.

5161400.name: Littlest Catalyst
5161400.short_description: Command a crew of tiny bots, build a modular space base, and repel relentless alien swarms. Build, upgrade, defend, and don't forget to pet the crew members.

2673600.name: DeskTrack
2673600.short_description: A cozy desktop companion with toy cars and a focus timer. Let a little car cruise while you work or study, earn miles to collect cars and scenery, then build your own tracks or take the wheel for a break.

4635980.name: AdorableCat
4635980.short_description:
A cozy and relaxing desktop companion game filled with adorable cats.
Welcome a variety of cats into your family, care for them, and enjoy everyday life together.

5357970.name: Frontier Tavern
5357970.short_description: Run your own tavern in this first-person business simulator. Serve drinks, restock supplies and keep customers happy. Hire staff to automate daily tasks, unlock new drinks and reinvest your earnings to grow your business in the Old West.

2299490.name: Zombie Warz
2299490.short_description: Zombie Warz is a tower defense RTS game with rogue-lite gameplay elements. Play as the king of a kingdom under siege by zombies and survive to discover their origins.

4266000.name: PortalVR Motion
4266000.short_description: Motion controls for VRChat and hundreds of Steam titles. Use webcam-tracked Joy-Cons, PSMove, your smartphone, or VR controllers you already own. Head, hand, and face tracking bring your whole self to VRChat on Desktop. VR mods unlock motion controls for R.E.P.O., Halo 3, and more.

4605420.name: 虎鲸娘的放置钓鱼物语
4605420.short_description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

4954620.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand Demo
4954620.short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 21 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

4951060.name: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand
4951060.short_description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 22 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

4320650.name: 人妻とカウントダウンASMR性交VR Demo

5440720.name: Her Next Chapter
5440720.short_description: A cozy sticker game about finding your place after graduation. Arrange little objects to build street corners, a rented room, and a dream garden full of cats. Follow a young woman's next chapter, one sticker and one small kindness at a time.

5326190.name: Immortal Path
5326190.short_description: Achievements offer meaningful permanent progression. Clearing any of the 54 unlocks lasting cross-run enhancements, covering eight cultivation systems with 21 passive bonuses and 14 unique Heavenly Mandate mechanics.

5301310.name: Despiry Demo
5301310.short_description: Despiry is a top-down sci-fi roguelite for 1 to 4 players with ARPG-style loot and run-based builds. Explore a hostile alien world, fight swarms, stack relics and passives, and bring back materials for permanent upgrades. There's no end to reach, only how far you go before enemies outgrow you.

1445190.name: DoubleShake
1445190.short_description: Grab, shake, throw, and kick to save your islands from total chaos in this action-packed blast-to-the-past 2.5D Platformer inspired by some of our favorite 5th generation games!

4815690.name: SoleRuler Demo
4815690.short_description: You are a deity from the Heavenly Realm, and you will descend to the mortal world to fight across the three realms.

5097370.name: Despiry
5097370.short_description: Despiry is a top-down sci-fi roguelite for 1 to 4 players with ARPG-style loot and run-based builds. Explore a hostile alien world, fight swarms, stack relics and passives, and bring back materials for permanent upgrades. There's no end to reach, only how far you go before enemies outgrow you.

4904730.name: Achievement Fly Clicker
4904730.short_description: Click flies, unlock achievements, and complete your collection. A simple and satisfying clicker designed for achievement hunters.

4913950.name: Fantasy Camp Builder
4913950.short_description: A cozy campsite building game where you create medieval-fantasy campsites with charming decorations, warm lighting, and a relaxing atmosphere.

4188070.name: 来吃！小兔面包房
4188070.short_description: Start your desktop bakery! Begin with one cookie and a table. Decorate, cook, hire staff, and learn recipes. Serve lively bunny customers, meet quirky characters, and unlock their unique stories and dishes!

5000310.name: ESCAPE FROM TOUHOU
5000310.short_description: A single-player top-down extraction shooter where you command Reimu, Marisa, and Nitori-crash-landed in a war-torn desert-by switching between them in real time. Secure supplies to survive, and with the allied forces' help, restore the dimensional transporter and return to Gensokyo.

5465060.name: Bio-Shooter
5465060.short_description: Medicine vs Germs, inside the human body. Play as glowing living-gel cells and microbes with guns grown from your own body in a fast, class-based online shooter. Battle across the Eye, the Lungs and the Follicles, where blinking eyelids, breathing lungs and sweat floods reshape every fight.

4686970.name: KON-PON SHMUP -Shapeshifter Showdown-
4686970.short_description:
An Item-Building 2D Bullet Hell Shooter Has Arrived!
The unique “ENEMY ATTACK SELECT” system can turn the tide of battle in an instant.
To overcome the disadvantages you face, you’ll need to make smart choices and build the best loadout possible from limited resources.

3640840.name: LANDLORD
3640840.short_description: Ordinary people, ordinary problems, and among them you - the landlord who rents apartments to them... And unfortunately, these ordinary people’s  problems automatically become your problems! Rent apartments, collect rent money, and be prepared! The life of a landlord won’t be easy!

3455210.name: VERISMO Demo
3455210.short_description: A ghost and a carnival clown plot revenge on the man who ruined their lives. An operatic tragedy set in 1920s Sicily. This is the 15 minute prologue demo, with a longer demo in the works.

4553780.name: Crystal Ascend
4553780.short_description: A simple incremental game where you nurture crystal elementals by destroying floating crystals and harvesting aether. Upgrade the skill tree, unlock new abilities to gather resources faster, and build your ultimate crystal companions.

5438680.name: Animal Legends
5438680.short_description: In this Action RPG, catch up to 45 unique pets that fight at your side! Raid dungeons, defeat bosses, build your base and defend it from enemy attacks, and face off in online 3 player Capture the Flag PvP!

5282510.name: Shadow Realms RPG
5282510.short_description: A free dark-fantasy idle ARPG in one persistent world: every player on the same ladder, with web and mobile cross-play on one account. Auto-battle for loot and affix builds, raid server-wide world bosses, climb the endless Eternal, war over clan castles. No energy walls. Power is never for sale.

5226520.name: Sheepscape Demo
5226520.short_description: The free demo of Sheepscape, a cozy sim about one shepherd, one dog and a field full of sheep. Take a Welsh smallholding from five muddy sheep to a flock worth something: herd them, shear each fleece at its best, sell the wool, breed a better flock and earn the deed to your next farm.

4769390.name: Cages: Hidden Worlds Demo
4769390.short_description: A first-person puzzle escape game set in a mansion that holds the remains of a freak show carnival. Meet the former stars of the show, now locked inside intricate contraptions. Venture into surreal worlds lurking between the cracks of reality and solve the workings of complex original machinery.

4802880.name: Fox Stamps Demo
4802880.short_description: Solve puzzles and collect stamps in the demo for this casual nonogram game!

4833720.name: UNDEFEATED: Genesis Demo
4833720.short_description: Experience the signature flight and superhero action of UNDEFEATED: Genesis. Fly freely across a section of Voltissia, wield a variety of superpowers, and face ferocious mutants. Your first step toward becoming the hero who will save this shattered world begins here.

4558510.name: ARK Fantastic Tames Season 1
4558510.short_description: Fantastic Tames Season 1 brings three new companions: Burrowbuck, Cerberax, and Enigmasaur. Tunnel through the earth, tear through the front lines with multi-headed attacks, or mimic stolen creature-forms!

3613770.name: ShaderGlass
3613770.short_description: Tool for applying shader effects on top of Windows desktop for gaming, pixel art and video.

2794290.name: Grimshire Demo
2794290.short_description: A deadly plague threatens the village of Grimshire. Manage your farmland, forage the bounty of the wilds, prevent your harvest from rotting away and keep the root cellar full. Can you help bring the community together and survive?

4927030.name: Last Buzz
4927030.short_description: Last Buzz is a 2–6 player Humans vs. Flies multiplayer game. Steal food, crawl on ceilings, hide in stupid places, and rescue your friends as a fly—or grab the bug spray, lock down the house, and hunt the little bastards before they take over.

5161340.name: 江湖客栈-单人闯江湖
5161340.short_description: 嘿，说你呢！这可不是尔等丐帮能随便进来讨口子的地儿！没有十万银币，休要打这“江湖客栈”招牌的主意。什么？居然凑齐了！但我必须提醒你，鬼方域内弱肉强食，适者生存。一旦回不来，全身行囊、武具都将留在鬼方。汝辈当真要试试？ 单人模式群：879639005

2234650.name: Zotenhold
2234650.short_description: Endless Survival. 24+ Classes. Hordes of enemies, unique skill trees. Thousands of items. 10 Player CO-OP. Can you Survive against the horde?

4999730.name: Fractured Rift: Incremental
4999730.short_description: An incremental RPG auto-battler where you build and customize a team of allies to conquer increasingly difficult floors.

4482580.name: Narcissist Tail Demo
4482580.short_description: You are a player who was called upon to help a strange wolf family escape. Figure out why they were kidnapped. Find hidden secrets with an in-game screenshot system. Battle monsters in bullet hell combat. But most importantly, find a way to out together.

5339880.name: Wizard X World
5339880.short_description:
Wizard X World offers a great experience as one of the best action games for kids.
This game contains of special 3D graphics system helps with imagination.
Prepare yourself and embrace the fantasy world.

5379130.name: Hentai Age Mansion
5379130.short_description: Embark on a timer-free, relaxing puzzle adventure where completing tranquil mosaics unlocks stunning artwork and beautiful portraits of maidens, offering the ultimate stress-free escape.

4540040.name: 琉隐：将魂千军
4540040.short_description: The game is an ancient-style musou roguelike action game. Players will lead a powerful allied squad to charge into enemy lines and resist invasion. As players progress, more mysterious events and ultimate challenges will be unveiled.

5299380.name: Vug: From Caves to Stars Demo

5381010.name: Kiminoseidayo
5381010.short_description: Two to four friends control ONE character, but each of you owns only part of the controls and sees the course through a different camera. Walk, look, jump and dash together across floating toy courses, dodge hammers and a chaser, and when you fall, LAST INPUT shows exactly who pressed what.

3349220.name: Crownslayers
3349220.short_description: Crownslayers is a roguelite turn-based roleplaying game, where you get to control two teams of heroes across separate timelines. Battle your way through a series of universes, bending time and space to affect multiple timelines, and future playthroughs!

4951820.name: More Than  A Woman - Season 1
4951820.short_description: An emotionally charged kinetic visual novel about Hana, an aspiring actress whose relationships and career are slipping through her fingers - until a sudden transformation into a futanari throws her life into chaos and forces her to confront everything she thought she knew.

4955250.name: N.E.O.N. HORIZON
4955250.short_description: Build your own ship from the hull up. Arm it, install a variety of systems, break the rules — then survive relentless waves of escalating threats in this sci-fi roguelite shooter. Experiment with weapons, relics and powerful synergies. Reach Horizon.

3836590.name: The Quantum Mechanic
3836590.short_description: Employed by the Valen Federation in the war against invaders, repair alien technology and solve puzzles with your cat in a solar system on the brink of dimensional collapse. Featuring single-player campaign and online co-op, fight the invaders as a quantum mechanic, or with friends as robot cats.

5184160.name: Geo Bobs
5184160.short_description: GeoBobs is a multiplayer geo location party game! Study a picture, explore a 3D map, and race your friends to find where it was taken. Lock in your guess, earn points based on accuracy, and prove you've got the best eye for detail.

4951200.name: Dungeon Wanderers
4951200.short_description: A 3D action RPG in a dungeon that changes each time you dive in. Read enemy attacks and answer with guards, parries, and dodges. Your playstyle shapes which skills awaken in you. Capture monsters and raise them as companions to fight by your side. Play solo or in up to 4-player online co-op.

5447380.name: 让破落宗门再次伟大
5447380.short_description: 《让破落宗门再次伟大》是一款融合自动战斗、Roguelite构筑与宗门放置养成的3D修仙游戏。穿越后接手破落宗门，亲自走位、闪避，搭配功法与装备，挑战山野中的精英与首领；回山修复设施、炼化战利品、突破境界，招收并培养各具资质的弟子。安排弟子自主修炼、留守生产或外出历练，下线后也能积累收益，再带上护法弟子出山迎战强敌。局内构筑不断变化，宗门与弟子的成长持续保留。从一盏残灯、一座破山门开始，让宗门再次伟大！

3312850.name: Danchi Days Demo
3312850.short_description: Bring your hometown back together in a simple, story-driven adventure set in 2000s Japan! Reconnect with neighbors, surf the web and play minigames in a comedic-yet-bittersweet tale about a girl and her grandma living with Alzheimer's.

5399040.name: Please Handle Gently Demo
5399040.short_description: Please Handle Gently is a pixel-art autobattler card game. Late at night, sit down at the counter for a while — pick out a few figurines, give them a little magic back. A whole cabinet of jingling little things. They're old. Please handle gently.

5023110.name: Galactiball
5023110.short_description:
The next great party game... until someone starts taking it seriously.
Kick your friends into the goal. Dive across the arena for a last-second save. Launch an opponent into an incoming boulder. Play locally with your friends or hit the ladder and show the world what you're made of!

4726670.name: Direlands: Extraction
4726670.short_description: Direlands: Extraction blends looter shooter progression, extraction gameplay, and classic fantasy RPG adventure. Explore dangerous realms through ancient portals, gather powerful loot, and fight your way home—or lose everything you carry.

5443770.name: Desktop Bonsai Towns
5443770.short_description: First world: Cyberpunk Town. A tiny voxel bonsai grows on your desktop for hours while a cyberpunk city builds itself along its trunk and branches. Watch residents live their lives as storms, meteors and giant invaders strike. Unlock pruning shears and collect a variety of bonsai styles.

1859550.name: Raise
1859550.short_description: Rise from the grave in a compact third-person soulslike. Battle undead and bosses, level up your character and master timed arena challenges. Every hit taken costs time; every parry improves your score. Refine your runs and compete on Steam leaderboards.

4984880.name: DELVERS: Dragon's Hoard Demo
4984880.short_description: The complete current build of DELVERS, free. Recruit a roster of hero classes, gear them from a hoard of rolled loot and named legendaries, grow a zodiac skill tree, and send a party of four into the depths to fight on their own. Haul the gold back, reach further. No caps, no timer.

4597820.name: DRENCHED
4597820.short_description: Drenched is a 3D exploration adventure where a burnt-out artist becomes a fish. Switch between the two characters, and traverse two mirrored worlds to uncover her story. Splash puddles on the surface and blow bubbles underwater to explore, solve puzzles, and reconnect her past and present.

1910980.name: Arena of Realms
1910980.short_description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

498310.name: RPG in a Box
498310.short_description: Bring your stories and ideas to life! RPG in a Box lets you create games and other interactive experiences in a fun and simple way. It's a flexible, accessible tool designed for everyone: whether it's your first game or you're an experienced creator, there's something in it for you!

4960380.name: Isle Of Thundir
4960380.short_description: Explore the world, Capture Towns and Villages,  Defeat your enemies in battle. Command troops and level them up. Defend your Towns and villages.

2532010.name: Territorial Hissing
2532010.short_description: Territorial Hissing is a 2D sidescroller adventure about bringing down a corrupt corporation in an otherwise bright and colorful land. Something smells fishy.  Save your home in this comedy adventure!

4928860.name: POOLİMİNAL
4928860.short_description: POOLIMINAL is an atmospheric liminal space horror game set in endless, procedurally generated poolrooms. A Backrooms-inspired descent into thalassophobia, where the real terror lies in the dark water below.

4831660.name: Silver Valley Screams
4831660.short_description: Silver Valley may be full of dark corners, but your stomach won't fill itself. The year is 1975, and your father's disappearance is just the latest in a long string. Arm yourself if you plan to venture forth, find your father, and uncover the truth.

4959060.name: Legacy Miner
4959060.short_description: A 2D mining game about digging your way off a dead planet. Drill deep for rare ores, dodge lava and gas pockets, upgrade your rig, then pool your haul with friends to smelt bars, craft parts, and build the rocket that gets your crew home. Solo or 1–16 players.

2777100.name: GALLANT
2777100.short_description: GALLANT is a multiplayer platform shooter for 2-10 players. Throw vials, draw cards between rounds, and adapt your strategy as your powers evolve. When skill meets luck across the many arenas, only one can claim the title of Grand Alchemist of Fortune!

5408060.name: We Will Die For You Playtest

4865380.name: Monster Cruncher
4865380.short_description: Monster Cruncher​ is a short and satisfying active incremental game. Crush hordes of monsters, gather resources, and feed them into the Crusher. Unlock permanent upgrades through a massive skill tree and meta-progression!

4049520.name: Deaduction Demo
4049520.short_description: A multiplayer murder mystery blending horror, prop hunt, and supernatural powers. Work the night shift in a possessed hotel as an innocent staff member, a poltergeist controlling objects, or a body swapping doppelganger. Earn money to buy tools to uncover the imposters and survive the night shift.

4971300.name: Touhou Smash
4971300.short_description: A 2D platform fighter where the girls of Gensokyo go at it. There are no health bars: damage builds as a percentage, and whoever launches the others past the blast zone wins. Reimu, Marisa, Sakuya and more each fight with their own moves. Up to 4 players, local or online.

5400700.name: Threat Axis
5400700.short_description: An accessible multi-domain strategic military simulator. Command joint naval, air, ground, and subsurface forces in realistic modern combat operations. Threat Axis is the ultimate military command simulation platform for multi-domain modern warfare enthusiasts.

5042300.name: Fernwick
5042300.short_description: Some stories aren't told. They're left behind in the things we keep. In this hand-drawn point-and-click adventure, explore Grandma Junie's keepsake book, inspect the memories she left behind, and piece together the story of Fernwick.

5210610.name: Capital Criminal Demo
5210610.short_description: Start in debt with 30 days to turn things around. Buy low, trade across 12 cities and manage cash, cargo and risk in this free Windows demo of a retro economic strategy game. Replay the complete 30-day career and see how far your deals can take you.

4645180.name: Elecade
4645180.short_description:
Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning.
Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

3598880.name: Infinite Mansion
3598880.short_description:
Infinite Mansion is a Lovecraftian Roguelike with a strong focus on mystery and exploration.  

Send randomized investigators into an procedurally generated Mansion to fight other worldly horrors and solve mysteries in this stylized take on the world and lore of H.P. Lovecraft.

5029670.name: HOPIATE
5029670.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder about day trading stocks in a simulated market. Build a deck of edges, trade a tape that moves in real time, clear the week’s target. Blow the account and the evaluation fee was non-refundable. Your account manager is very supportive. He’s paid on volume.

4080140.name: Capital Criminal
4080140.short_description: Start in debt. Build an underworld empire in this retro economic strategy game. Buy low, trade across 12 cities and weigh police, gang and debt risks. Reinvest in longer campaigns and grow your fortune before the deadline: 30, 90 or 365 days.

4532230.name: Slime Locomotion
4532230.short_description: Inertial sensor-based natural locomotion solution. By capturing human posture, it enables movement in four directions—forward, backward, left, and right—and supports mapping motion signals to SteamVR, keyboard, and controllers, while also supporting hip orientation tracking.

4883070.name: Andrew Labreck's Eden Within
4883070.short_description: Eden Within has fast paced, reaction based combat with a unique fighting style in a hedge maze that the player must navigate through. The embodiment of Greed has taken over the area, and he will not leave easily. Explore to find enhancements, learn to use your portals in unique ways and face Greed.

5437020.name: TALLREAPER DEMO VERSION
5437020.short_description: A seemingly simple task given to you by the Baron, turns into living hell, revealing a dark, surreal and introspective story, as you - a prisoner - are tasked with obtaining a fallen knights sword inside an underground crypt.

4961250.name: みならい王子のみならい防衛
4961250.short_description: You are the prince of a small kingdom. Defend its castles from monsters in this tower defense game!

4956920.name: Thicc Magic. Elves' Perverted Beauty Standards.gif
4956920.short_description: A shoot 'em up where you can rip clothes off. More mana = thicсer thighs! Shilla is a VERY powerful elven sorceress, but the irony is that in elven society, fat is considered ugly!

5454720.name: Dreadmiles
5454720.short_description: Combine weapon modules, destroy obstacles and spread fire in this claymation rogue-lite horde survivor. Choose your route, take on missions and giant bosses, and head back to your truck before the Seep closes in.

4762150.name: Dead Ringer
4762150.short_description: It begins with a phone plugged into a faulty socket and an electric malfunction, it ends with seven dead and one missing... Detective Maxwell Morgan must navigate the testimonies of both the living and the dead to find a murderer before it's too late.

4320880.name: Pillow Punk
4320880.short_description: Pillow Punk is a fast-paced third-person action roguelite built around outrageous pillow combat. Fight escalating enemy waves with melee and ranged attacks, combine abilities with randomized upgrades, and challenge powerful bosses in a chaotic single-player adventure.

5292740.name: Raze the Zombie Horde
5292740.short_description: A single-player top-down zombie shooter across streets, fortresses, beaches and infected facilities. Adapt to two-sided run cards or build up to eight guns firing at once in Loot Arsenal. Develop four heroes and bring a tank, collie or robot dog on standard operations.

5322090.name: InCrimiNation
5322090.short_description: A cutthroat mob twist on the classic property-trading board game. Buy up territories, run protection rackets, launder your dirty cash before the Feds catch on, and settle scores with Turf Wars, Hits, and Arson. Full lobby multiplayer — every player runs their own copy.

4944820.name: The Swamp Daughter Demo
4944820.short_description: Embark on Julia’s journey in this 2.5D eco-apocalyptic adventure of choices, exploration, and puzzles. Explore a dangerous swamp and face tough choices while you uncover her past in this intriguing tale of identity and survival.

4592180.name: MOLOKAUST Demo
4592180.short_description: Venture into a cursed town in this ruthless first-person survival horror game. With a hyper-realistic atmosphere and extreme survival mechanics, you'll need to ration your inventory and confront your worst nightmares to save your wife and daughter.

4601730.name: CryptidCam Demo
4601730.short_description: Head into the spooky woods to lure out and take photos of creatures like The Loch Ness Monster, The Loveland Frogman, Jackalope, and more fan favorite cryptids in this short, light hearted photography adventure.

3700320.name: Mystic Cleaver Demo
3700320.short_description: Wield a long cleaver in a deadly world filled with zombie hordes. Master perfect timing and combo attacks to survive.The game features a unique faded art style, blending cold weapon combat and intense action.Each slash is polished for a smooth and impactful gaming experience.

4917900.name: Coup de Grass
4917900.short_description: Start with a single sickle and a small field. Cut and sell grass, automate your workforce, optimize supply chains, and build a sprawling incremental empire.

4839560.name: Tobias' Inferno
4839560.short_description: Tobias' Inferno is a third-person mascot survival-horror game, where you are the mascot! Caught up in a zombie situation, you must escape the place you call home, while working with friends familiar, and unfamiliar! Explore a mysterious facility, fight the undead and earn your ticket to freedom!

5296850.name: Girlvania Expansion: Legs & Feet
5296850.short_description: Fulfill your need for feet sex and leg love by actively controlling the action: sole licking, toe fucking, footjobs, and solo service with their skilled feet. And if you dress your girls with the finest silk, fishnets, and lace, it will be even hotter!

3066940.name: Immortal Engine
3066940.short_description: A fantasy & sci-fi universe simulator that runs from the birth of the first gods to the death of the last mortal. For those who spend more time in a character creator than playing the game. Design worlds, gods, races, metals, magic and monsters down to the melting point — then simulate it all.

3201480.name: VoiceHealer
3201480.short_description: Cleaner mic audio in one click, with less noise, less headset playback fed directly into your mic, and steady volume. For games, streams, and chat.

4121770.name: The Melty Way Demo
4121770.short_description: You move, you melt. You are a liquid-simulated slime where every move costs you a piece of yourself. Spend your mass to slide, shrink, and dash through pixel-perfect hazards in this challenging precision platformer where size management is critical and your only resource is your own body.

2905730.name: FFFF : Fatal Five Finger Fillet
2905730.short_description:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

5271580.name: Shred Inc.
5271580.short_description: Welcome to the NSA — the National Shredding Agency. Your job: destroy classified files, one sheet at a time. Feed the shredder, hit your quota, climb the ranks. And whatever you do, don't read the paperwork. Some files were just meant to be destroyed.

4671360.name: Grandpa Golf Demo
4671360.short_description: A golf roguelike about making really big numbers. Sink shots, buy powerful items, and build ridiculous score combos as you push deeper into Grandpa Golf’s golf course.

2468690.name: Dungeon Dot Ruby Demo
2468690.short_description: Delve into the Master Dungeon as you explore the unyielding tunnels from a top-down view or hop and bop through expansive caverns in 2d-sidescrolling action! Rest assured, intense battles and big discoveries are to be found wherever you are in this retro-style adventure!

5309420.name: 삼국사기 클래식 (Three Kingdoms Classic: Korea) Demo
5309420.short_description: Lead a kingdom in a strategy game set in Korea’s Three Kingdoms era. Manage officers, troops and diplomacy, then command real-time field battles and sieges—or leave command to your officers. The demo lasts up to 12 in-game months, ending earlier when two or fewer other factions remain.

4478910.name: ひとりあそび
4478910.short_description: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

5043430.name: PROJECT_JUMP
5043430.short_description: A precision first-person movement game. Air-strafe, bounce, and rocket-jump through hand-crafted jump maps with faithfully recreated 2000s-era physics, and chase records on leaderboards that track every route, category, and discipline.

5089120.name: Slimestronauts: Burst Strike Demo
5089120.short_description: Feature subset of Slimestronauts : Burst Strike!  A classic 'drop and match 4 color' game set in space with a variety of new ways to play!

5162170.name: Love, Death & My Daughter Demo
5162170.short_description: Love, Death & My Daughter is a free short-form pixel-art narrative game. Walk through a rain-soaked cemetery, repair system faults, and sift through memories and files. Amid subtle horror and distortion, come to understand the love a mother left behind.

5111470.name: Dubbed
5111470.short_description: Pick a scene. Hand out the parts. Perform it together over your own microphones and get the clip back with your voices on it. Every line records separately, so you can retake the one that didn't land — then watch the finished dub with the whole room.

5378090.name: Nordic Demo
5378090.short_description: Nordic is a PS1-aesthetic "foddylike" cross-country skiing game that can be online or single player.  Nordic captures what makes cross-country skiing great; rhythm & cadence, the calm of nature and exploring the natural world with your friends!  Race, ski and discover the beauty of winter.

5170320.name: BumpBall
5170320.short_description: BumpBall is a turn-based multiplayer football game where you plan your moves, predict your opponents and launch your entire team at once. Master unique squads and abilities in fast, chaotic 4v4 matches.

5104140.name: Solar Arena
5104140.short_description: A 2D top-down versus shooter set in a wraparound space arena. Steer and boost your constantly moving craft, block attacks with a barrier, and fight in battles from 1-on-1 to 1-on-3. Customize your pilot’s appearance, with your chosen look reflected throughout the game.

2350690.name: District Null
2350690.short_description: District Null is a cyberpunk city simulation. Traffic, energy, fire services, police, schools and entertainment all run at the same time.

5410080.name: The Shrink Gun Game
5410080.short_description: Shrink everything and everyone.  Fight your way to downtown, Upgrade and gain new abilities, Stomp the chief of the size police

4033720.name: Loam
4033720.short_description: Loam is a cooperative game in an infinite world where players gather resources, craft equipment, build structures on the land or at sea, explore and fight dangerous creatures alone or with friends.

908770.name: Global Conflagration
908770.short_description: Global Conflagration is a real-time strategy game inspired by the classics featuring modern controls and streamlined mechanics. Build lots of tanks, infantry, helicopters and aircraft to destroy the enemy base.

3702360.name: Pact Warden
3702360.short_description: As a Marchwarden, you travel the southern roads to protect pilgrims and travelers. You will fight multi-phased bosses, shape the storylines of characters, and explore an interconnected world.

4574820.name: Rejected Draft
4574820.short_description: Climb out of the trash and fight your way back to the artist who rejected you. Defeat sketches, steal their strengths, and begin a months-long incremental journey through an ever-growing web of stats, upgrades, prestige layers, automation, and absurd numbers. Easy to start, hard to master.

4762970.name: Spin Tactics Demo
4762970.short_description: The full loop of Spin Tactics in one run: three encounters, then a boss. Everything on the board is yours to change, and what you build with what drops is the whole game.

5173540.name: 热血挂机
5173540.short_description: A retro pixel desktop idle RPG. Warrior, Mage, and Taoist. Auto-combat, offline gains, and it can hide on your desktop.

3856990.name: Spin Tactics
3856990.short_description: A roguelike engine-builder where you rig the slot machine. Everything on the board is yours to change, and a good run turns a lucky spin into an engine that doesn't need luck. No real-money gambling, no microtransactions.

5108270.name: SUMOO
5108270.short_description: SUMOO is a minimalist grid puzzle where numbers slide, meet, and add up. Every stage demands one exact number. Use pits, portals, and multipliers to land on it.

5402750.name: Number Bound
5402750.short_description: Explore, battle, build, and collect in Number Bound, a family-friendly adventure where math and trivia unlock rewards. Play solo or with up to three friends, collect plushies, go fishing, build with nearly fully editable world objects. 3 Mini games including Fox Quest a game in a game!

5339250.name: SpecterMancer Demo
5339250.short_description: A multiplayer horror game for 1 to 6 players set in a dark Victorian era. As a ghost, you must terrify the others and prevent them from escaping alive; as a survivor, explore, solve puzzles, survive, and find a way to escape.

4209850.name: Rustown
4209850.short_description: Five years after the “idiot virus” pandemic, a letter arrives from the father you thought was dead. Rustown is a story-driven stealth adventure about finding him in a slum where the infected live. Evade watchful eyes, follow clues, and discover the stories of those caught up in the city's troubles.

4476160.name: Pachinko Realms: Tiki-Taka
4476160.short_description: Master the pitch in this physics-based soccer pachinko game ! Launch your ball through traditional 3D Pachinko boards, chaining "Tiki-Taka" passes to reach the next stage ! Explore diverse stadium realms, collect tactical power-ups, and face goalkeepers in epic boss fights.

5218140.name: Fertile Crescent
5218140.short_description: A real-time grand strategy game set in the Bronze Age. Lead one of 29 ancient civilizations from a single settler to an empire. Found cities, work the land, research new technologies, advance your culture, and wage war. Will your civilization outlive the age that made it?

4552590.name: Was Silence
4552590.short_description: Was Silence is an atmospheric 2D exploration visual novel about Ian, a guitarist as sound slips away. He meets others who have each lost a single sense, walking a world of silence together — holding on to what still remains.

4786600.name: Ants TD
4786600.short_description: Thousands of ants race for your nest. Dig the paths they follow, block shortcuts with barricades and lure the swarm with fruit, then shoot, burn and blow it all up in a chaotic tower defense.

3855270.name: Colossal Citadels Demo
3855270.short_description: A fantasy strategy, featuring turn-based factory building over procedural resource types. Expand and optimize your network of towns, grow your heroes, and excel in deep tactical seamless auto-battler combat.

5466230.name: Makers' Wake
5466230.short_description: Make your own way in Makers' Wake, a fantasy MMORPG with 15 classes. Shape your character through skills, mastery, and unusual gear. Explore a world its makers left behind, face dungeon bosses with friends, craft and trade, and compete in PvP.

5458330.name: Raid Sky Demo
5458330.short_description: Fly your island, fish, craft, build cannons and unleash debuffs on bot rivals in 15-minute matches. Offline singleplayer only, Easy / Normal / Hard AI. Three ways to score: crystal charge, bonus zone and missions.

5244550.name: Softfall
5244550.short_description: A cozy winter MOBA on a snowy mountain. Two teams of five fight to chase the other team's eagle off the mountain. Quick matches, Easy to learn, and best with friends. The basics come down to: chopping down trees, fishing, and even hiding in the snow.

4980350.name: Everdeep Idle
4980350.short_description: An ARPG-inspired Idle game where the fighting happens automatically, but the build is yours. Choose up to six classes, reshape skills with augments and build-changing loot, and set up triggers and loadouts that react for you. Let it run while you’re busy, or dig into the numbers to min-max.

5320980.name: Defend the Sacred Well
5320980.short_description: Defend the Sacred Well in a single-player action defense game. Choose from three heroes and three maps, combine skills and alliance bonuses, dodge boss attacks, and protect the well through twenty waves. Then take your build into Endless Mode.

5173530.name: Soleil & Suspense
5173530.short_description: Dive into the heart of the southern french region of Provence, in a tiny hamlet where the only people left are seniors gradually growing apart. Shake up their routine to bring them back together at the local café, in a short experience where you're never too old to look towards the future.

1044010.name: Ugaris
1044010.short_description: A free isometric MMORPG built in 2002 on the Astonia 3 engine — still running, still unforgiving, still free. No microtransactions. No hand-holding. Just a brutal old-school MMO kept alive by a community that refused to let it die.

5251750.name: 星糖學園 Demo
5251750.short_description: Read enemy landings, turn cards into a squad on a 5×5 battlefield, and use positioning and Hero Skills to rewrite the outcome of auto-combat in this story-driven magical-academy deckbuilder.

2348250.name: 13Z
2348250.short_description: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

4633980.name: Lethal Love
4633980.short_description:
Turn your love lethal.
Play as Kyoko, a yandere obsessed with her senpai.
Eliminate rivals, make deadly choices and unlock multiple endings with cute arts.
Now on PC with full controller support, enhanced graphics and constant updates. Currently in Early Access.

4326130.name: Spooky Market
4326130.short_description: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

5478910.name: UNKNOWN PASSENGER 47
5478910.short_description: 47 lives lost. 48 bodies recovered. Identify the victims of a fictional plane crash in this text-based deduction mystery. Cross-reference body records, passenger lists, medical reports, and personal effects to give every person back their name.

5195470.name: Crumbeats
5195470.short_description: Revive a silent speaker and rebuild the beat in this music-driven incremental arcade game. Shatter Crumbs, collect Echoes, unlock instruments, and stack upgrades into an evolving groove.

5458350.name: Nidwess
5458350.short_description:
An old-school arcade shoot 'em up set in a surreal, grotesque universe.
Aboard your ship, blast your way deep into an alien parasite's nest. Can you fight your way to the parasite queen and save the world? Switch weapons, Adapt to your surroundings, and discover what lurks in the depths of Nidwess.

5213220.name: Pro Endurance Series: Running Manager
5213220.short_description: Pro Endurance Series Running manager: take your athlete from prospect to legend. Plan training, nutrition, gear and staff, pick your 5K, 10K, half-marathon and marathon races, and live every event in a real-time simulator where you set the pace and tactics.

3786640.name: Fred's Idle Garden
3786640.short_description: A cozy idle farming simulator that hangs out on your desktop while you work, study or just chill 🌻

5389650.name: EVO RNG
5389650.short_description: EVO RNG is slot-machine god-game - draft creatures, press spin and watch your ecosystem hunt, merge and evolve on its own. Collect, chase paylines, food chains and mythic creatures. Game does not contain any real money gambling elements.

4643840.name: Hacker Cats
4643840.short_description: Who needs human hackers when you have cats? Lead a crew of fluffy cybercriminals, hack servers, steal valuable data, research new technologies, and conquer the Internet one paw at a time.

5317700.name: GemCremental
5317700.short_description:
Craft a variety of gems and become the greatest witch!
It's a cozy incremental crafting game.

5291660.name: Withstand The Horde
5291660.short_description: Withstand The Horde is a strategy and base-building game. Raise a walled city, recruit soldiers and hold off waves of enemies - up to 2,500 zombies at once, simulated on your GPU. Build, defend, expand, and withstand the horde.

4692770.name: Extinction Cycle
4692770.short_description: In this wave survival game, you incarnate a soldier testing a new kind of desensitising technology. You will not get out of the simulation until you become the perfect killing machine, welcome to the Extinction Cycle.

4699270.name: Algorithmage
4699270.short_description: A roguelike where you fight through algorithms. This game is meant to teach the basics of algorithms while still having challenging gameplay through deck building and item optimisation. Find new items and spells to use in your algorithms and fight monsters in your way to complete your quest!

5370040.name: Hotel of Seams
5370040.short_description: October 1997. Your grandfather’s lakeside hotel is yours now: a diner, rooms to manage, and two cats. Cook meals and serve your customers, hand out keys to guests, and keep everything clean. Some of the people who check in are not human, and nobody is going to tell you which ones.

3034290.name: Loot Goblin Inc
3034290.short_description: Break into homes, steal valuables, and sell them online to make big cash money! Join the corporate goblin world in this very cool Loot Goblin Simulation!

4755720.name: Pixel Kitten Desktop Demo
4755720.short_description: A cozy pixel desktop pet that brings companionship and comfort. It wanders around, curls up for naps, and gets hungry on its own — you can feed it, brush it, and watch it stretch and yawn beside you while you work. A quiet little companion that stays by your side while you study, work.

3391430.name: ファンタジーワールド ～魔王の想いと真実と～ Demo
3391430.short_description:
Experience the free demo of Fantasy World: The Demon Lord's Truth.

Create your own adventurer, battle through the opening chapter, explore Stage 1, collect equipment, and experience the beginning of this retro-inspired 2D hack-and-slash RPG.
developers: ダイスクリエーション / DiceCreation
publishers: ダイスクリエーション / DiceCreation

4268730.name: Hero's Guild
4268730.short_description: Your heroes are people. They form bonds, take grudges, fall in love, and die permanently. Run a guild of brilliant, emotionally unstable adventurers — and watch their story write itself.

4688450.name: Mysteries of the House (DEMO)
4688450.short_description: You wake up with no memories inside the House, a place where reality bends... lies linger... and someone watching your every move.

5289060.name: Idle of Eternity
5289060.short_description: An idle loot game that sits in the corner of the desktop. In a transparent window, the hero fights, climbs floors and collects gear automatically without getting in the way. 100+ skills, 13 classes, 2,000+ random affixes and three free-to-reset talent trees make for deep buildcrafting.

4924930.name: Islefolk
4924930.short_description: A laidback island colony sim where autonomous villagers do the work. They'll chop wood, farm, mine, and build while also expanding your island tile by tile. No deaths, no fail states, just a colony that grows.

5469330.name: STILLTRACE Demo
5469330.short_description: The first two days of the quarantine and eight waves of co-op. Repair the radio, scavenge supplies and hold the beacon under attack: alone, with a friend or with a bot partner. Your progress carries over to the full game.

4944580.name: 66 Lives
4944580.short_description: You have 66 lives. Survive the Horde, loot ,mine, farm, upgrade town, and raise an army. No tutorial. No story. Just play.

4965360.name: Swing to Win
4965360.short_description: Swing To Win is a chaotic free to play arena brawler where your weapon never stops spinning. Pick one of eight wild heroes, whirl through 1v1, 2v2 and 3v3 battles, protect your leader and knock your rivals into lava, abysses and each other.

2508290.name: Tax-Force
2508290.short_description: Hunt down tax-evading billionaires and rebuild society in a hand-drawn, action-roguelite platformer inspired by 90's comicbooks.

5378470.name: Don't Drink
5378470.short_description:
A strange night. A questionable decision. And a can you probably shouldn't have opened.

Don't Drink offers a small but charismatic world with RPG elements and 'interesting' foes.

5381340.name: N in One 中国骨牌合集：牌九、天九、接龙、顶牛
5381340.short_description: Pull up a chair! Discover 16 domino games, from Pai Gow and traditional Tien Gow to connecting, collecting and matching tiles. Learn with illustrated practice, face two BOT difficulties, and unlock cozy table styles with play-earned points. A single-player collection with local saves.

5271160.name: Sticker Shop Cozy Idle
5271160.short_description: Catch drifting sticker packs, open them for cute and rare finds, then choose what to collect or sell in this cozy incremental shop game. Upgrade your tools, complete your album, hire assistants, and grow a tiny stand into a bustling three-counter shop.

5059390.name: CATpitalist Cafe Simulator Demo
5059390.short_description: Play as Humanoid CATS in this chaotic 4 player co-op simulator as you takeover the coastal city of Los Nyangeles in pursuit of becoming true CATpitalists while helping rebuild the city along the way (kinda).

3350970.name: Greedspire
3350970.short_description: Build powerful gear combos in a push-your-luck roguelike auto-battler. Enchant your gear to +20 or watch it shatter. Move to the next floor, or risk your entire run for richer loot in deadlier rooms. 100 floors. One life. How greedy will you get?

5071850.name: Tavern Game Night
5071850.short_description: Gather 2–8 players for seven online party games in a cozy fantasy tavern. Compete in word games, trivia, dice, drawing and deduction, then put those skills to use in Tavern Race, where challenges can move several players toward victory.

5074200.name: The Bots Want Your Gold!
5074200.short_description: Defend your base from the robotic horde! Mine ores and sell them to make quick cash. Use your hard-earned money to buy weapons, attachments, and equipment that will assist you in defeating the bots! How long can you hold off the horde?

4467420.name: Navinosuke: The Yo-kai Buster
4467420.short_description: The story takes place in an ancient Japan where the balance between humans and Yo-kai has begun to collapse. In this age of chaos, the Onmyo Bureau secretly creates its ultimate weapon — a karakuri Onmyoji apprentice known as “Navinosuke.”

2991030.name: Dicey Chess Demo
2991030.short_description: A chess game in which the throw of the dice decides how far you can move.

5254130.name: Made for Mages
5254130.short_description: Run a magical workshop in a cozy crafting and automation sim. Explore a procedurally generated world, grow enchanted ingredients, decode sealed recipes, and build production lines. Fulfill orders for mages and grow your reputation with every delivery.

2765870.name: My Paper Plane is Better
2765870.short_description: Throw a paper plane into a city built for flight. Every run you finish becomes a track, and other players race your ghost on it. Skim rooftops, thread alleys, pop balloons and chase the longest glide.

5280220.name: Task Bar Cube: Character Pack
5280220.short_description: Task Bar Cube is an enjoyable idle RPG game you can play on your desktop. Unlock 10 exclusive heroes with stronger base stats, plus a permanent gold bonus and a longer AFK chest.

5280250.name: Task Bar Cube: Support Package
5280250.short_description: Task Bar Cube is an enjoyable idle RPG game you can play on your desktop. Unlock 10 exclusive pets with stronger base stats, plus a permanent gold bonus and a longer AFK chest.

5280270.name: Task Bar Cube: Inventory Package
5280270.short_description: Task Bar Cube is an enjoyable idle RPG game you can play on your desktop. Unlock every storage category and every page including extra Steam Inventory pages plus a longer AFK chest.

1808960.name: Firearms Factory
1808960.short_description: Firearms Factory is a WWII strategy game focused on weapon manufacturing and logistics. Starting in 1939, you manage a German war factory, expanding control over key regions by supplying battlefronts. Balance production, logistics, and territorial defense on the path to nuclear weapon development.

4668880.name: Silk & Sorrow
4668880.short_description: A hand-drawn, dark fantasy co-op adventure. Two orphans stumble into a hidden world where all the unwanted from humanity ends up. Together, they must explore a haunting landscape, survive its twisted horrors, and bring back light to the Chrysalis.

4904050.name: Anime Mosaic Puzzle
4904050.short_description: Relax and restore 230 anime-style illustrations in this casual puzzle game. Drag square pieces into place on boards from 3x3 to 8x8, connect matching neighbors, improve your best times, and unlock Steam achievements—without time limits or fail states.

3297390.name: Desire and Consequence
3297390.short_description: A mysterious romantasy adventure visual novel where your choices take you on different paths with over six romanceable characters. You must find the truth about your past, discover the secrets of each character, and navigate the lure of power, romance, and their consequences.

4576290.name: Rifles & Runes Demo
4576290.short_description: A real-time strategy game blending extraction, cards, and fantasy exploration. Lead a modern army through a portal, scout unknown lands, build mines and radar, repel counterattacks, hold your outposts, and extract before the world’s attention overwhelms you.

4385930.name: Satarichi: Heroes De Caelum
4385930.short_description: Join the fight for Caelum in this cooperative action RPG for up to 4 players. Control legendary heroes in real-time combat as you explore an epic world based on Satarichi's original novel. Enjoy the adventure with friends locally or through Remote Play Together.

3858930.name: In The Black Demo
3858930.short_description: Nuclear-powered space combat in the 23rd century! In The Black ™ is an intense, realistic space combat simulator with a serious respect for science. It is laser focused on the pilot experience and features single- and online multiplayer game modes, plus robust ship customization options.

5301090.name: Fishing Town
5301090.short_description: This is a desktop idle fishing game. Collect rare fish, upgrade your gear, and build your own pond and aquarium.

3571940.name: Demon of the time
3571940.short_description: Fight cultists armed with futuristic weapons in a world where ancient Japan collides with broken time. Battle hordes of enemies, collect sacred artifacts, and stop the Demon of Time before reality itself collapses.

5072670.name: Pigeonhole Principle
5072670.short_description: Meet a pigeon who dreams of flying to the Galápagos. That flight needs one thing — the legendary golden sunflower seed. But right now that pigeon has fallen into a stranger's storage room, and is in real trouble. Cook the things around you, wear them, and climb a little higher.

5414980.name: Fix it 18+
5414980.short_description: Repair electronics in a city of superheroes, villains and everyday breakdowns. Take devices apart, replace parts, solder and run your workshop. Meet recurring clients, chat with Riley and Scarlett, and get to know them beyond the counter. An electronics repair sim with adult romance.

3043220.name: Portal: Lost in Aperture
3043220.short_description: This is a mod for Portal 1. Includes new maps, storyline, a whole new Portal experience. After you play the game, every other mod will look simple, balanced and average. Lost in Aperture try to show, that the portal universe can be way bigger, and a lot more, then just solving puzzles.

5112440.name: 霓虹赌途
5112440.short_description: Cyberpunk roguelike slot game. Enter a neon tavern. Roll three numbers 1–9 for winning combos to battle rivals. Collect numbers and tokens to strengthen your build. Explore branching paths, encounter random events, and recover at supply stops. Strategize, spin reels, and create an unbeatable lineup.

2826820.name: Turbo Play
2826820.short_description: A full-scale Video, Image, Audio and Animation editor and sequencer with AI features, 300+ video effects and transitions in multiple languages.

4936160.name: Prop Hazard
4936160.short_description: In worlds where chairs, rocks, and trees hide lethal traps, master agile parkour—jumping and dashing through shifting death-mazes. Use pebbles to find hidden paths, glowsticks to see in the dark, and light to expose lies. The exit waits, but surviving to reach it won't be easy.

5229880.name: Project NEUNLEBEN Alpha Defence Force
