5229880.short_description: An attack by an alien species, emerging from a dimensional rift, has begun! Shoot 'em up your way through 11 levels with the help of the "Alpha Defence Force", consisting of three cybernetically enhanced cats, and defeat screen-sized bosses in this retro 16-bit-inspired Shmup.

5165010.name: NOT Home Free
5165010.short_description: A 4-player online co-op game set in a uniquely crafted liminal world. Pay your bills, fortify your home, and try to survive the uninvited “guests” waiting for you after dark.

4259720.name: BECOME LIFE
4259720.short_description:
A single-player narrative survival experience set in the abandoned landscapes of Gargano, Italy. 
Explore, endure, and uncover what happened after the disappearance where every choice leaves a mark.

4572620.name: Canvas Attack!
4572620.short_description: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

5089070.name: Trouble in Potion High Demo
5089070.short_description: Something went terribly wrong at Potion High. The school fell into the "Non-Dimension" and was placed under quarantine. If you don't break this lockdown, you'll be stuck here forever.

5348180.name: Twisted Childhood Demo
5348180.short_description: Remember the fairy tales you grew up with? Start corrupting them. This demo opens five tales, five different games, and Wishes to bend their rules. Criquet is already waiting for you...

5327250.name: Unhappening Demo
5327250.short_description: Navigate a collapsing world where light is your only protection. Solve physics-based environmental puzzles with the help of temporary companions, and survive the darkness consuming fractured memories of humanity’s final survivor. For fans of Inside, Limbo, and Little Nightmares.

5324450.name: Rotaliate
5324450.short_description: A very simplistic fast paced puzzle game. Single player modes compete for most efficient or fastest time where multiplayer modes fight to be the first to clear their color from the board. Elo style ranking and more play modes coming eventually!

5332740.name: Make the World Great Again Demo

5284770.name: Dr. Tod's Very Good Clinic
5284770.short_description: A chaotic physics-based medical party game for 1–6 players. Carry patients, perform surgery, and try to save lives with your friends as everything goes horribly wrong. No medical license required. Safety first. Probably.

5472130.name: Rocket Punt
5472130.short_description: Blast your friends off floating arenas in Rocket Punt, a chaotic rocket party brawler for up to 10 players. Grab wild weapons, dodge incoming rockets, and fight solo or in teams across seven modes. Play online with friends or practise against bots.

4701970.name: Geometry Rift: Apocalypse
4701970.short_description: The ultimate arcade chaos unfolds in this explosive bullet hell roguelite. Survive thousands of geometric enemies on screen, combine weapons and powers to create absurdly overpowered builds, and blast your way through colossal bosses solo or with a friend.

3056620.name: 拼好车
3056620.short_description: Take your weathered old car and roam the boundless wilderness.Stumble upon abandoned shacks and unique structures along the way, scavenge supplies and resources to survive in this desolate land.

2052300.name: Glaciered
2052300.short_description: Soar the seas at the end of time. 65 million years in the future, the world has frozen over, and the oceans have been sealed under a thick layer of ice. Become a Tuai—a species that evolved from birds—and protect the Everwinter in this futuristic underwater action game.

4818520.name: 江湖大镖客 Demo
4818520.short_description: Survive, explore, build and compete in martial arts Jianghu. Manage your physical and mental state. Construct your sect and defend against nightly raiders. Learn Five Elements internal arts and varied combat skills. Recruit workers and disciples to defeat rivals and expand your power.

5454520.name: Gardenkin
5454520.short_description: Return life to a forgotten community garden. Clear the overgrowth, bring back the water, grow crops and flowers, and welcome seven neighbours back one by one, with a rabbit and a hedgehog lending a paw. A gentle, cozy garden restoration game.

4827000.name: Quarterheart
4827000.short_description: A cozy arcade roguelite. An old coin-op machine you find in the attic, and it still works. Aim true and time your hits in 2–4 minute runs. Every new monster you beat prints a sticker — where you stick it on the cabinet decides what it upgrades or unlocks. Insert coin to play?

3619110.name: BIER RUSH!
3619110.short_description: Carry towers of beer mugs through a packed Oktoberfest hall! Pour, stack, balance and serve: more mugs mean bigger scores and bigger spills. Chase a solo high score or play online with up to 4 players in competitive DUELL and chaotic TEAM SCHICHT co-op.

5319020.name: Art Shop: Tidy Up!
5319020.short_description: A cozy first-person organizing game set in an art shop of rare and beautiful things. Sort 2,942 fine art supplies and artisan pieces in dozens of distinct forms, shelf by shelf, color by color, and unlock skills as the shop becomes a gallery of perfect order.

1039720.name: Super Grower - Soundtrack
1039720.short_description: The original soundtrack for Super Grower contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

3991760.name: Night Portable
3991760.short_description: Night Portable is a night-shift survival horror set in a used game store. Clean, restock, and hide from ■■■ until 6 AM. Play three retro handheld games and cash out for items—or risk losing them. Manage light, noise, and resources as a side-scrolling adventure uncovers the past behind the curse.

5112010.name: Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge (SFC Version)
5112010.short_description: The 1995 Super Famicom version of Wizardry VI: Bane of the Cosmic Forge, ported as-is. Form a party of six, explore a first-person 3D dungeon step by step, and fight turn-based battles. Draw your portraits, train skills, and uncover the castle's secrets. Save anytime.

4914760.name: Heai: Virtual Companion
4914760.short_description: Customize your 3D virtual companion to your liking and let him keep you company every day. Early Access includes character appearance customization, Steam Workshop (mods for AI-powered interaction with him; creating and sharing custom clothing), Pomodoro sessions with him, and lo-fi music.

5212930.name: Task Bar Farm
5212930.short_description: Build a 2-character team, defeat an army across 300 stages, and grow stronger with powerful items and upgrades in this 2D idle strategy RPG.

1039670.name: Super Orb Collector - Soundtrack
1039670.short_description: The original soundtrack for Super Orb Collector contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

5276760.name: THREADMILL
5276760.short_description: Write code that controls an entire robotic workforce. Start with one worker, then scale to 128. Share jobs, feed machines, and adapt when power fails. Test your code in new facilities, then tune it to do more with less.

1039640.name: Super Space Jump Man - Music
1039640.short_description: The original soundtrack for  Super Space Jump Man contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

4779550.name: Stip Demo
4779550.short_description: Assign, undo, deduce! Solve a series of minimalist number puzzles. Use constraints to assign numbers to the correct stips. Navigate the interconnected puzzles to uncover secrets.  Please ignore any odd Stip behavior.

4724580.name: Exhibition of the Heart
4724580.short_description:
Alice is a lonely university student who never got over her first crush, the upright and studious Sylvia. Until one day, she discovers that Sylvia is actually a shameless exhibitionist! Can the timid Alice win her heart? 
Find out in this cute nsfw yuri visual novel!

1610580.name: Supporter Bonus DLC
1610580.short_description: This DLC unlocks a new option in the settings menu where you can change the appearance of the player and choose a different background image.

5176280.name: SplitOut
5176280.short_description:
Split Out - The Ultimate Auto Battle Racing Experience

Embark on an epic journey through the world of rally racing in Split Out, where your dream of becoming the #1 racer in the Race of Champions begins with a single street kart and rise to the global championship glory.

5396300.name: Protocol Z
5396300.short_description: A living zombie sandbox. Watch a whole town go about its day then unleash the outbreak. Play as anyone in first person, swim, fight and drive, spawn zombies, vehicles and buildings anywhere, and call down tsunamis and tornadoes while police and soldiers fight to hold the line in a city that can fall

4246850.name: TitleIt!
4246850.short_description: Turn a photo into the funniest caption. Write, vote and compete in quick online rounds with friends on Steam, Android and the web. Play for free, join with a room code and collect your winning moments. Optional purchases available.

3317720.name: AutoArena
3317720.short_description: AutoArena is a lineup-building auto-chess game. As a fortune-teller, use foresight to acquire divination cards and build your lineup. Engage in multiple rounds of battles against the traces of other fortune-tellers in the Stream of Memories, ultimately guiding yourself toward the right destiny!

5279120.name: Ourself
5279120.short_description: Two players. One body. In this online co-op for 2, you steer one half of a ragdoll and your friend steers the other: one arm, one leg and one camera each. Walk in step, jump on the same beat, carry a box together and climb 400 m into the sky. One slips, you both fall. Voice chat built in.

5359830.name: Faulty Loops
5359830.short_description: A set-and-play logic puzzle game driven by music. Place your units on the grid, press play and watch the playhead sweep across the board, firing each unit on the beat. Clear every enemy in a single loop to repair the corrupted tapes, one instrument at a time.

5001150.name: Chaos Protocol
5001150.short_description: Chaos Protocol is a horror TPS game currently being developed by a solo developer. Players must destroy enemies and corrupted Cores to cleanse the area.

4083940.name: Animal Bookshop: Tidy & Sell
4083940.short_description: An animal themed book organizing game with customers, shop customization, and a whole lot of tidying!

5261670.name: Seri & Yuka with my heart
5261670.short_description:
A healing visual novel about quiet everyday moments by the seaside, in cafés, gardens, and other peaceful places. 
Enjoy delicate watercolor art and soothing music as you observe the characters, surroundings, and passing time, uncovering hidden clues and stories within the silence.

5374190.name: European Airfreight Tycoon
5374190.short_description: European Air Freight Tycoon is an aviation management simulation. Build your cargo airline, coordinate flights across 26 major European airports, manage 18 aircraft, gather resources, construct assembly hangars, trade stocks, and lead your company to the top of Europe.

5318340.name: Sushi Shogun
5318340.short_description: Cook your army. Serve the village. Defend your kitchen. Sushi Shogun mixes real-time strategy with the bustle of a sushi kitchen: combine recipes and ingredients, fulfil orders, and lead a lively sushi army through Japanese-inspired maps.

4515500.name: Seferia Matrix
4515500.short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

4447620.name: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
4447620.short_description: Run a Christmas gift factory with unruly gnomes in this short management game! Wrap gifts yourself, set up production equipment, manage your gnomes, and assign tasks. Turn a chaotic workshop into a smoothly running factory before Christmas.

4612190.name: 세페리아: 매트릭스 Demo
4612190.short_description: A dice roguelike deckbuilder — Lock & Roll five dice to cast spells and explode your damage with 300+ upgrades!

5176000.name: Deadpact Demo
5176000.short_description: Sentenced to death, you're sent into the dark for one last chance at freedom. Solve interconnected puzzles, uncover secrets, face unique enemies with different behaviors, and make choices through dialogue. What you discover and decide will shape your story and determine how it ends.

5271120.name: Tandem Together Demo
5271120.short_description: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

5355130.name: Croissant Simulator Demo
5355130.short_description: Manage your own croissant restaurant. Take orders, prepare fresh croissants, purchase ingredients, manage your inventory, and keep your customers happy. No distractions—just a focused, single-player croissant simulation.

5009770.name: Free Ball Demo
5009770.short_description: Free Ball is a multiplayer volleyball game. Control one player and compete with your team in fast-paced 4v4 matches from an immersive third-person perspective. Choose a character with unique abilities and work with your team to dominate the court.

5074190.name: bet you won't Demo
5074190.short_description: You're a livestream unboxer. Your audience wants you to open the next package. The killer wants you dead. Inspect suspicious deliveries, uncover hidden clues, and survive a series of terrifying events—all while keeping your stream alive. Would you open the next box?

4386300.name: BAKUDO: Boss Rush Demo
4386300.short_description: BAKUDO is a sci‑fi boss‑rush action game fusing high‑octane ball‑sport mechanics with exhilarating combat. Enroll at an elite BAKUDO academy and clash with formidable opponents as you uncover a major conspiracy. When determination is put to the ultimate test, you must tip the scales of destiny.

4560110.name: Scratch The Cat Demo
4560110.short_description: Grab your headphones and step up to the turntable in Scratch The Cat - a vibrant action-adventure 3D platformer. Play as DJ Scratch, explore a sprawling musical world, fight bosses, and reclaim your stolen records. Turn up the volume and set the stage for the purr-fect comeback.

4582420.name: Endacopia Demo
4582420.short_description: Endacopia is a Point-and-Click Puzzle Adventure that is visually reminiscent of early computer edutainment games... with underlying horrors.

5217440.name: FailRooms
5217440.short_description: Experience liminal horror like never before. Inspired by the Backrooms, FailRooms traps you in an endless world of absurd architecture, broken spaces, and things that should never have been built. Laugh while you can. Can you escape a place that was never designed to make sense?

4022690.name: Pinball FX - Williams™ Pinball: Scared Stiff
4022690.short_description: Elvira is back to rattle your bones in the classic Scared Stiff pinball table! Join the Mistress of the Dark herself on a quest to “raise the dead” by completing six spooky tales.

4094290.name: Overgrown Cleaner Demo
4094290.short_description: Build your own restoration business as you trim, mow and clear overgrown spaces, craft tools from salvaged materials, and bring neglected places back into shape one project at a time.

4137980.name: My Helpers Demo
4137980.short_description: My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. FIND THEM by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

4171600.name: The Devil's Due Demo
4171600.short_description: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

3377810.name: 列乌尼斯的挽歌 Demo
3377810.short_description: A Magic Tower-style Strategy RPG with alchemy and progression. Play as Tasia and explore lost ruins with your companions. No unwinnable dead ends — plan your days freely, build your loadout, gather resources, and uncover the truth behind the [Calamity].

4003100.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - 10 Seconds
4003100.short_description: Beat 24 levels in 10 seconds. A traditional 2d platformer.

3256650.name: Foundation Demo
3256650.short_description: Foundation is a grid-less, laidback medieval city-building game with a focus on organic development, monument construction and resource management.

2987180.name: ACTION GAME MAKER G
2987180.short_description: Create full-fledged 2D games without any programming, now with the all-new "Maker Mode" that brings the ease of use the series is known for! Combining the accessibility of the Maker series with the extensibility of Godot Engine!

5364170.name: Still Walking
5364170.short_description: It doesn't run. It doesn't stop. Only one of you can see it. A first-person co-op horror game for 1–3 players: something walks toward you at your pace, wearing anyone's face. Four nights — a town, a motel, a school, a lake. Get out before dawn, or find a way to end it.

2538290.name: It Has My Face Demo
2538290.short_description: IT HAS YOUR FACE. Now it wants your life. Hide, seek, and try to kill your clone in this deceptively simple first-person horror roguelite.

2167465.name: Monster Hunter Rise - "Velkhana Costume" Palamute layered armor set
2167465.short_description: Dress up your Palamute as a Velkhana with this layered armor!

3982240.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Balloon Story
3982240.short_description: Inflate the balloon but don't blow it up

1390430.name: Monster Hunter World: Iceborne - Pendant: MH Riders - Kirin
1390430.short_description: Pendants are special items that you can attach to your weapons. Customize your favorite weapon and show off to your friends with this phantasmal floating Kirin!

1209400.name: Love wish-FREE DLC
1209400.short_description:
Love Wish is an easy, fun and challenging jigsaw puzzle.♪(^∇^*)
Put the pieces together to restore the full picture of the girls. Collect their photos and animations and remember this wonderful moment❤

1241270.name: Monster Hunter: World - MHW:I Gesture Pack: Hype Up Set
1241270.short_description: Enjoy a new, amusing gesture you can use when interacting with other players in the game.

974302.name: Monster Hunter: World - Free Sticker Set: Mingle Hunter
974302.short_description:
Fun stickers you can use when chatting with other players in the game.
Adds new stickers to Monster Hunter: World.

996740.name: Monster Hunter: World - Free Gesture: Happy Hunting!
996740.short_description:
Enjoy a new, amusing gesture you can use when interacting with other players in the game.
Add a new gesture to Monster Hunter: World.

1007090.name: The Burton Equation
1007090.short_description: Time is an equation, and you're here to solve it. 1920s Chicago detective Zachary Burton must defeat the Combine's attempts to influence humanity's past in the 20s, 40s, and 80s, and then achieve victory in the present - all the while pursued by a dark mirror of himself.

2646170.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
2646170.short_description: You are a yucky long-armed thief.  Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

4319040.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Battery Box
4319040.short_description: Collect spawned batteries and deliver them to the central box to keep the power alive.

3982170.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Box Sucker
3982170.short_description: Use your magnet to attract boxes in your direction. Lead the boxes in to the basket, when basket is full you complete the level.

3981870.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Chrome Wheel
3981870.short_description: Colored balls come from the left and right, and your task is to rotate the wheel to hit each ball with its matching color. Red ball? Spin to red section! It's all about timing and accuracy.

5368330.name: Jigsaw Puzzle World - Bicycles
5368330.short_description: Add 24 new puzzles to your Jigsaw Puzzle World game.

4452620.name: Thieves and Gold
4452620.short_description: Smash containers. Grab the gold. Find the hidden keys before time runs out. Recruit a crew of thieves and rob the lord again in this short medieval heist incremental.

4318010.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Coffee Warz
4318010.short_description: Coffee Warz is a chaotic office roguelike where caffeine is life. Fight laid-off employees, janitors, and electricians as you climb randomly generated floors—level up, survive, and claim the office for yourself!

4003090.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Color Shapes
4003090.short_description: Control two cubes at the same time through 20+ colorful levels.

2693950.name: Rifted Worlds
2693950.short_description: A fast-paced Action-RPG that takes place on the floating remnants of destroyed worlds. Discover fragments of your lost world, place them onto the map, and explore! It's time to uncover the truth behind your world's destruction...

4885480.name: Ruler of Empires
4885480.short_description: Command a nation through the age of steel and empire. Ruler of Empires is a turn-based grand strategy game. Seize a nation, rewrite the century, and conquer province by province across lands. Save an empire doomed to fall, or bring the whole world under a single flag.

4994590.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Cube Match Sigils
4994590.short_description: Rotate the cube, match identical faces, and clear every challenge!

1322780.name: Unexpected Tasks
1322780.short_description: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

3982210.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Decepticon Hero
3982210.short_description: A 2d side scrolling shooting game where you can jump, duck, float in the sky and kill robots.

5306880.name: Gross Survivors
5306880.short_description: Play as the grossest survivors in town in this fast-paced top-down roguelite! Armed with raw fart power and other foul abilities, blast through endless enemy swarms across 2 arenas. Collect coins, upgrade your powers, and turn your nastiest traits into ultimate weapons!

4317940.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Dungeon Grove
4317940.short_description: Dungeon Grove is a top-down roguelike dungeon crawler.

4904550.name: Atomic Delivery
4904550.short_description: The General Staff has one objective for you: build an atomic weapon aboard a nuclear bomber. Pilot through hostile skies, refine uranium, run industrial machines, assemble the bomb, keep the aircraft airborne and survive everything standing between you and the Atomic Delivery.

4003120.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Endless Diver
4003120.short_description: Dive into this retro-style 2D pixel art game! Control a snorkel-equipped diver, navigating a vertical underwater world. Collect air bubbles to keep your air meter full and survive.

4714790.name: Concrete Coffin
4714790.short_description: The surface is gone. 11,581 survivors are crammed into an unfinished 10,000-capacity bunker. Balance 6 core resources, make critical choices on advisor reports, manage your workforce, and keep the shelter from collapsing.

4319760.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Excite Drive
4319760.short_description: Excite Drive is a sidescrolling 2.5D parkour game made.

4290080.name: Claw and Conjure
4290080.short_description: Claw and Conjure is an async PvP auto-battler with fantasy RPG flair. Upgrade your town to synergize with your build, then race into battle against real players. Hire assassins, deploy traps, and resurrect exploding minions as you climb the global leaderboards.

5159190.name: Slime Mine Survivor
5159190.short_description: A roguelite action game blending 2D block mining with survivor-like combat. Dig deeper while dodging enemies and creeping poison gas, gather ores and treasure, then upgrade and evolve your pickaxe and weapons to build synergies and dominate enemies and the battlefield alike.

4539570.name: OVR Space Dragger
4539570.short_description: Free and easy to set up, OVR Space Dragger is a dedicated playspace mover for SteamVR games like VRChat. Press a button and drag your world. It’s a great first step into space drag, and an alternative for anyone who finds complicated setups annoying.

3967520.name: Daluob
3967520.short_description: Go solo or co-op to create unique builds. Nothing goes to waste: every successful build is preserved as a permanent "Bloodline." These Bloodlines scavenge gear while you're away and can be inherited by your next character to fast-track your setup and push power limits.

4364220.name: This is not Chess, It's War!
4364220.short_description: Use your voice to command your army and lead them to victory in an intense game of chess!

3970860.name: The Factory Must Fall
3970860.short_description:
Build the perfect factory, then let it go to war!
Draft buildings from a randomized shop, optimize resource allocation and army composition, then watch your factory crush your enemies in this automation autobattler!

5426420.name: Comicalizer
5426420.short_description: Write your plot in a simple form or as plain text, and Comicalizer lays out a full chapter of manga storyboards: panels, camera angles, poses, expressions, speech balloons and effect lines. Direct each shot with real film and manga terms, fine-tune any panel, and export layered PSD files.

5248760.name: The Golden Horde: Survival Demo
5248760.short_description: Enter the world of the Golden Horde and experience its harsh medieval steppe. Gather resources, hunt, craft weapons, armor, and healing items, fight different enemies, and protect your yurt on wheels as you begin your journey.

5341770.name: Yang
5341770.short_description: A short point-and-click adventure following a mysterious invitation. Explore the road to the station, interact with your surroundings, and discover what awaits you at 11:00 PM.

4981020.name: Chess of the Hidden Gates
4981020.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where every card is a Chinese chess move: the horse leaps, the cannon fires over a screen, the pawn crosses the river and never turns back. Every enemy strike marks its target square first. Step aside and it misses. Breach the Eight Gates. Play, or be taken.

4992340.name: Stack Factory
4992340.short_description: Drop pieces, complete lines, and build upward. Shape your blocks into factories, mine zerons to keep your economy running, and hire guardians to fight at your side.

3964730.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Green Gunner
3964730.short_description: Dive into Green Gunner, a fast-paced action game joining the Infinite Game Cartridge Collection. Face off against small tanks, robots, and other foes. Navigate treacherous levels filled with obstacles like sprawling lava pits, treadmills, and deadly lasers.

4505370.name: ギリJumpスターラッシュ Demo
4505370.short_description:
Experience the thrill of clearing obstacles at the very last moment!
Giri-Jump Star Rush is a side-scrolling platform action game built around the concept of "Giri-Jump" (Coyote Jump).

4162710.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Laser Bricks
4162710.short_description: Laser Bricks is a thrilling brick-breaking arcade.

4428910.name: Slots & Skulls
4428910.short_description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Stop the machine to attack, win fights for chests, and upgrade what drops at the forge (if you dare). Or invite a friend and fight them.

4319590.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Monster City Rampage
4319590.short_description: Unleash chaos as a colossal green monster in Monster Rampage!

4003110.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Morph Ranger
4003110.short_description: You are a newly born morph ranger. Get DNA samples to upgrade yourself and your movability.

4303600.name: Infinite Game Cartridge Collection - Neon Proxima
4303600.short_description: Neon Proxima is a top down arena shooter/shoot em up.

5397060.name: Cropocalypse
5397060.short_description: Plant. Grow. Harvest. Outplay. A farming party game for one to four farmers on one field. Spread your roots to wall off rivals, haul your harvest home, raid their stores and guard yours from foxes and bears. When the market bell rings, the farmer who sells the most wins.

4911000.name: 灵魂甜品Soulcake Demo
4911000.short_description: Soul Cake explores diverse romantic themes including LGBTQ+ narratives and female-dominant dynamics, with prominent femdom storytelling woven throughout its branching routes. Is a multi-route romantic exploration AVG title built around visual novel storytelling and exploratory item collection.
developers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own
publishers: 自己的房间  Room of One's Own

4727340.name: Green Mist over Portland Demo
4727340.short_description: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

5312350.name: Trash to Trees:  Tidy up the forest! Demo
5312350.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

5475760.name: 高校野球2100
5475760.short_description: High School Baseball 2100 is a realistic baseball management simulation set in the year 2100. Scout and train players, build your lineup, and lead your team to national glory. Receive coaching offers from other schools and shape your own career as a high school baseball manager!

3334640.name: Time Jump
3334640.short_description: You are a Wrestling Champion. A Kid. A Professor. A Rock. A Ghost. An Evil Maniac. Fight yourself or save yourself. Your choice, Time Jumper!

5341250.name: Groovekeeper Demo
5341250.short_description: Your first shift at the record shop. 924 records just came in and the shelves are empty. Sort them by genre, put a rare one on the turntable and listen. The full shop opens October 30 with 5,260 records.

4551570.name: PAPER STRIKE
4551570.short_description: Draw runes with your mouse in a 3v3 online party arena. Mix spells with instant physical abilities and fight short objective rounds. But drawing means standing still. Finish that rune or move? Choose your moment and push Armageddon toward the enemy camp.

5396640.name: LITTLE KNIGHT: HOMECOMING
5396640.short_description: Return home as a little knight, rescue your neighbors and rebuild your raided village. A storybook 2D action game where combos, charged strikes, rolls and parries carry you through 16 boss fights.

5367590.name: Townworks
5367590.short_description: Townworks is a friendly crafting town builder: design the machines, place your blueprints, and grow a riverside hamlet from crates to home computers. Draw a workshop by hand, belt by belt and arm by arm, then build it all over town.

5412750.name: 别想好好胡 Nope Jong
5412750.short_description: Nope Jong is an online physics party game for up to 4 players. Get ready for a no-holds-barred round of action mahjong on a resort island: hauling tiles, building hands, smashing heads and grabbing Jade, all at the same time. Real mahjong rules. Friendships not included.

4814790.name: EvoX
4814790.short_description:
One island. A hundred ways to die.
Hunt, build, craft and fight your way from stone tools to gunpowder.
The island doesn't keep score. It just keeps going.

5232060.name: GO DUB YOURSELF!
5232060.short_description: Grab a mic and dub over your favourite clips with your friends. Turn any video into a clip pack, share it on the workshop, then battle it out on the couch or online for up to 12 players. Auto score or judge each other, the choice is yours!

4607280.name: Macro Mesh
4607280.short_description: Macro Mesh sits under every game you play. Macros in a node-based programming language, bound to anything. A crosshair you drew. The clip, after it happens. Game servers for your group, a password vault, screen savers. One app instead of five, built by a gamer and steered by gamers.

592350.name: Nvil
592350.short_description: Nvil is a polygon modeling application. Its deep customization ability provides ways for user to create fast and comfortable workflow to suit individual needs.

5454780.name: Dandy Len's Toystore
5454780.short_description: TOYSTORE is a survival horror game in which you must explore an underground shopping mall that was suddenly shut down for unknown reasons. The events take place in the early 90s, and you have been tasked with repairing the elevator that leads to the exit, in order to finalize the closure procedures.

5178010.name: 无尽战斗：放置与构筑
5178010.short_description:
Endless Battle：Idle & Build is an idle loot-farming game with 8 skills, 4 enhancements… Tons of build effects, and unique support companions
Defeat the enemies on every floor and keep climbing. Farm loot whilst the game runs in the background, until you reach—the Realm of the End!

1359380.name: RINGFALL
1359380.short_description: The nations are cut into pieces by the meddling of the all-powerful tech syndicate known as The Ring. To survive in a world plagued by proxy wars and corporate espionage is to play along, and PLAY you will! RINGFALL is an upcoming PVP FPS focused on accessibility, fun, and classic FPS fundamentals.

5194360.name: Super Plants
5194360.short_description: Super Plants is a short tower defense game about planting and growing super plants to defend against pests. Defeat enemies to unlock new plants and abilities, and grow the best defense.

3465820.name: Cyber Siege
3465820.short_description: Take control of a combat mech in an old-school sci-fi shooter. Upgrade your machine and unlock powerful support drones. Face alien creatures and hostile machines alone or with up to 3 friends in local co-op.

5410580.name: Acre of Aces
5410580.short_description: Click a patch, harvest a patch. Build patterns and chains and watch the numbers roll from hundreds to hundreds of millions. Power up your seed cards each night, pick relics that amplify your strategy, and grow one small field into an ever-faster harvest machine. A farming deckbuilder roguelite.

4823460.name: Mage of Corruption
4823460.short_description:
Fight. Upgrade. Corrupt. Become overwhelmingly powerful.
Will you survive the assault... or become the ultimate force of evil?

4701200.name: Flaming Fried Nutrition: Daydream
4701200.short_description: A slow, strange pet-raising game with idle and horror elements, about a girl who loves hamburgers very, very much. Pet her beloved hamburger, feed it, dance for it, ride it. Adopt more hamburgers.

3732120.name: Abyssal Maw
3732120.short_description: Control a sootball to hunt for the insatiable Abyssal Maw. Slay monsters, haul corpses with sootball, earn Corrupted Bone Shards. Trade for upgrades. Survive chaos challenges like lightning storms. As feeding escalates, mutations worsen—balance risks to sustain your fragile survival loop.

5147680.name: PROCEDURE ZERO
5147680.short_description: You uncovered a fraud, so they locked you up. Prisoners are quietly disappearing, and you're next. Sneak past the guards, trade cigarettes for information, fight when you have to, and take over the prison before they come for you.

5410090.name: Totally Invited: Party Heist Simulator
5410090.short_description: Crash parties, blend in with guests, and escape with the valuables in this co-op stealth heist simulator. Then clean up your haul, stock your shop, and set your prices. Turn stolen goods into a growing business, fund your next heist, and watch out for thieves. Apparently, everyone has the same idea.

4999860.name: Runehold
4999860.short_description: Build up defenses, recruit helpers, gather items and defend the stronghold against an ever increasing number and difficulty of enemies who come at night.

5485880.name: Too Many Orbs! Demo
5485880.short_description: Restore a magical collection, one orb at a time. Explore an ornate hall, return scattered orbs to their shelves, reveal artwork, and unlock magical abilities. Choose what to restore in this relaxing first-person demo, with no timer and no rush.

5304930.name: Refluff: Carpet Cleaning ASMR
5304930.short_description: Refluff is a carpet cleaning ASMR sim built on a real fluid simulation. Scrape off dried crust, soak the pile, foam it, brush it, squeegee the slurry out and dry the fibers until the rug is spotless. Hand it over, get paid, upgrade your kit, take the next one.

5392290.name: Too Many Orbs!
5392290.short_description: You fell asleep in magic class. Your punishment? Sort 3,493 magical orbs. Explore a magical orbirary, find where each orb belongs.

4921660.name: みんなでティア表!
4921660.short_description: A party game that gets everyone excited with a tiered chart. Arrange five words based on a given theme, and have other players guess the order. It also includes a viewer-participation mode designed for streamers. With custom genres, the possibilities for themes are endless.

4864950.name: ClickAssist
4864950.short_description: A local Windows click automation utility with profiles, sequences, position picking, dry-run testing, and a compact Mini Controller.

3257100.name: Trials Of Belphegor
3257100.short_description: A pixel art puzzle game where you solve room based challenges using strategic block style movement, unlocking the path to escape through a series of intricate traps and brain teasing RPG Themed puzzles. Can you apply logic and escape or will you fall victim to the trials?

2014280.name: レザリシアストーリーズ
2014280.short_description: "Lezarishia Stories" is a classic command-based JRPG set in a 2.5D world that blends pixel art and 3D visuals. Pursue the stolen Holy Sword and set out on a grand retro-fantasy adventure with a cast of memorable companions!

4045480.name: Drawquarium
4045480.short_description: Draw your very own fish and build a cozy little aquarium. And if you like, set it as your animated desktop wallpaper! Watch your drawings come to life. Feed them, raise them and collect golden scales to unlock new decorations. There's also some handy tools to help you focus and unwind.

5030410.name: Fluffy Alchemist
5030410.short_description: A cozy exploration game about a red panda alchemist. Explore five islands where night never falls, gather ingredients that each behave differently, brew potions and fill your Book of Brews. No timers, no enemies, nothing is ever lost when you fail.

4991520.name: No Hikers Return
4991520.short_description: No Hikers Return is a psychological thriller-drama, not a standard jump-scare horror game. It is a descent into a secluded home where your missing friend may already be part of a much darker collection.

4118000.name: Pest Termina ~ Swarm Defense
4118000.short_description: Build your base turn by turn on a hex world map, then drop into real-time battles against thousands of alien creatures. Command marines, robots and tanks, fortify the gates with turrets, and survive 50 days of an evolving swarm in this low-poly defense roguelike.

4135930.name: 斯凯尔的乌鸦
4135930.short_description: Scared Crow is a 5×5-grid roguelite deckbuilder. Add up to three ability stickers to each card, plan each week before the Boss arrives, and turn humble cards into build-defining powerhouses. Clear a run, challenge other players’ winning decks, and climb the leaderboard.

5378130.name: Awoken Demo
5378130.short_description: Awoken is a story-rich fantasy RPG with real-time pausable combat, developed solo by a veteran developer as a long-running passion project. Investigate a magical disaster that created a dangerous Zone, explore five regions, recruit up to three companions, and shape the world through your choices.

2917360.name: THE BACKWORLDS
2917360.short_description: RUN, JUMP, ESCAPE. Endlessly high buildings of dead ruins are towering over a giant chasm of green mist. But the reality of our world is seeping in, and some familiar places are now stuck there. This is how you are invited there - against your will. Enter the hostile realm of the BACKWORLDS.

3831420.name: Cold Response
3831420.short_description: Explore and survive a war torn Sweden through the eyes of an unknown soldier, alone or with friends.

5096580.name: Warcaste TCG
5096580.short_description: The Warcaste TCG is a tactical sci-fi digital trading card game where battlefield positioning matters.  Choose a Doctrine, command your fleet, and outmaneuver your enemy across a 3 zone battlefield.  Play in story mode, solo play, or online PvP.

4564980.name: SlimeStorm
4564980.short_description: SlimeStorm is a professional danmaku (bullet hell) design tool that lets you create various types of bullet patterns without writing any code. It is especially well-suited for Touhou Project-style danmaku.

5204790.name: Hotel 13 Demo
5204790.short_description: The corridor looks the same every time. But does it really? Maybe something has changed. Observe your surroundings carefully.

4677530.name: Wingspan: Bird Packs Season Pass
4677530.short_description: Grow your collection over time and enjoy even more variety in your avian flock.

5006300.name: SCUM Stalker Outfit Pack
5006300.short_description: Built for prisoners who prowl the wild in pursuit of their prey, the Stalker Outfit Pack unlocks a complete outfit set and an intimidating bone tomahawk for when the hunt gets close.

5052020.name: かくれ鬼: Hide-and-Seek Horror Demo
5052020.short_description:
This is an asymmetrical multiplayer horror game.
Play a 3-minute game of hide-and-seek in an abandoned school at midnight.
With only the beam of a flashlight to guide them through the darkness, the children must play KAKUREONI and bring the Ritual of Reincarnation to an end.

4686560.name: Les aventures extraordinaires d'Alec Orbusier - Acte 1 : Le Tombeau de Taâl Rash'a
4686560.short_description: Alec Orbusier, a none-too-organized university archaeologist, sets off to recover a priceless artifact from a forgotten tomb. Nothing too difficult, really... A 2D puzzle-adventure full of rooms, devious traps, and secrets for the curious.

4367870.name: MaSzyna: LK197 Strzebiń – Woźniki Śląskie
4367870.short_description: The scenery covers the 197 Strzebiń – Woźniki Śląskie railway line. The route includes the entire 13.5 km long line 197 and a section of line 131.

4487250.name: The Tower Must Fall Demo
4487250.short_description: Build an impossible tower. Defend it against endless sieges. Watch it crumble, then rebuild stronger.

4635200.name: SCUM Apex Predator Pack
4635200.short_description: Built for prisoners who want to look like they’ve already conquered the food chain, the Apex Predator Pack unlocks exclusive gear, weapons, charms, base-building items, character customization options, emotes, and selfie poses.

3929780.name: Bio Doll Demo
3929780.short_description: Miyuki awakens in a frozen cryo chamber to find the space facility in chaos—blood-smeared walls, blaring alarms, and undead roaming the halls. Alone, she must survive, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind a vanished experiment. In this nightmare, every choice matters.

4062070.name: 大千世界2 Demo
4062070.short_description: Shipwrecked in Antarctica, survivors cross the frozen glaciers and step beyond an ice wall into the boundless Great Thousand Worlds. A sandbox RPG centered on exploration and experimentation, featuring deeper systems, a vastly expanded world, and long-term progression shaped by player choice.

4108190.name: 喵咪争霸 Demo
4108190.short_description: Claws of Power is a cute, real-time card battle game. With a variety of unique and adorable cat cards, each one could be your key to victory. Strategize by building different decks and using items to overcome challenges and claim the throne as the ultimate cat leader.

3169480.name: Drug Dealer Simulator 2: Casino
3169480.short_description: Take a crack at the high-stakes gambling world! Gain access to a VIP casino hidden away on a remote oil rig. Try your luck in 5 gambling games and challenge your friends. Take on a quest that will turn you into a big-shot casino owner!

3196560.name: Skateboard Knight Demo
3196560.short_description: Hop on a skateboard and casually save the world! Simple controls—just move up or down. Horizontal movement and attacks are all automatic!

3221750.name: The RPG Demo
3221750.short_description: Minimalistic Skyrim + West of Loathing + Supraland. An RPG-lite adventure with intentionally twisted traditional role-playing games aspects, where your choices do matter. Play up to an hour with the demo, and explore the world of The RPG.

1112460.name: CarX Drift Racing Online - Russian Drift Style
1112460.short_description: A city of classic architecture: 300 year old buildings, raising bridges and picturesque parks, it’s all Saint-Petersburg. Its streets have been fenced out for the race so you should get ready to spin your steering wheel to pass a few roundabouts...

340650.name: Elements: Soul of Fire
340650.short_description: The light of the world fades. Evil hearts seek the Power of the Elements - the forces which bind the universe together - thus threatening all of existence. An homage to the 8-BIT era with a charming art style.

4550930.name: 若诅咒以爱之名 Demo
4550930.short_description: A Denpa Bishoujo Psychological Horror Curio: A Visual Novel ❦ Mild Horror, Mild Suspense, and a Hint of Whimsical Madness ❦ We Hope You Find Your Own "Happy Ending" Among Multiple Conclusions ❦ A Major Plot Twist, Perhaps? ❦ Glimpse a sliver of truth in the liminal space between life and death.

5462840.name: One Hop Further
5462840.short_description: Climb through five pixel-art worlds, switching lanes and dodging traps as the void rises beneath you. Unlock over 100 characters or draw your own, then chase a new high score with a keyboard, mouse, controller, or touch screen.

5469010.name: SLOTDOWN
5469010.short_description: Grandpa left you an underground casino, a mountain of debt and a loan shark with a smile. Grow ten wild slot machines floor by floor, make allies or rivals, and outplay the Baron in a pop-art comic incremental. No real money. Ever.

5140020.name: Junkyard Astronauts
5140020.short_description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Highest flight wins the shift. The Moon is 384,400 km up, and your fuel tank used to be a water heater. Online multiplayer, built for 2–4 robots. Mac and PC together.

4448060.name: Soulstonia - Demo
4448060.short_description: Recruit Summoners with minds of their own in this cozy idle RPG. Set idle goals and let your party gather, craft, and fight for you, or take control anytime. Train 20+ skills, summon creatures, and explore a living fantasy world. Free-to-play at launch.

5087270.name: Beautiful Subordinates Kneeling Beside Hero
5087270.short_description: The night shrouds a villa on the outskirts of New York. Jasper Gray returns, and beautiful subordinates such as Yasmin kneel to greet him. In daily life, they report intelligence and execute instructions, while a rift crisis is quietly approaching.

4403780.name: InCowMental
4403780.short_description: InCowMental is a cute and colorful tiny incremental game where you collect milk from your cows to sell it and make cheese. Upgrade your farm, and between upgrades, play mini-games to boost your production and sales!

2829360.name: WN_RPG 1B
2829360.short_description:
It's a JRPG.
A heartwarming world.
Turn-based battle. A simple Mini-games.

5402450.name: Outbreak Checkpoint
5402450.short_description: Outbreak Checkpoint is a survival defense game where your inventory shapes your firepower. Arrange weapons, merge upgrades, and fit attachments into a limited grid. Combine four elements to unleash powerful reactions and hold the line against growing enemy hordes.

3673500.name: Backrooms
3673500.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

4051630.name: Backrooms Demo
4051630.short_description: Escape the backrooms levels as reality warps with every step; listen, for the whispers behind the walls may guide you out. Enjoy an unbelievable co-op Backrooms experience.

2524430.name: Net Raiders - Demo
2524430.short_description:
Net Raiders is a strategic roguelike deck-building game where you play by performing Card Merge.
To survive the dangers of a crumbling virtual world, merge the cards in your hand and find the best moves to defeat the enemies you face!

5363160.name: Halmweit
5363160.short_description: A cozy building game to play alone or with friends. You share one village, one storehouse and everyone who lives there. Chop trees, plant fields, lay a railway and get your village through the winter. There's no fighting, and you can't lose.

5284950.name: Make the 100-year-old underworld queen regain her youth and become my servant-DLC2
5284950.short_description: The alarm in the safe house goes off, the purple-black light tears through the night sky, and the ancient rift awakens. Benjamin faces a consciousness crisis, and the three women are willing to offer everything. Can he maintain the balance and resolve the crisis?

4914310.name: Make the 100-year-old underworld queen regain her youth and become my servant
4914310.short_description: The low-class youth Benjamin awakens the nano power on the verge of death. After saving Ava, he makes a deal with the dying underworld old lady Sophia, making her regain her youth and become his servant, which attracts the attention of Nick Zimmerman.

4631100.name: Arcany
4631100.short_description: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

4647200.name: Ashen Demo
4647200.short_description:
Top-down pixel art action RPG in a world shattered by fire and ash.
Fight creatures born from the Cinder, forge your build with armor sets, then fish, cook and farm to rebuild Braseval.

1818480.name: Midwest90: Rapid City
1818480.short_description: Midwest 90: Rapid City is a tycoon survival sim in a monster apocalypse. Run a roadhouse serving monster meat and choose between profit or the city's survival, because those who fight monsters risk becoming one. How far will you go to stay in business?

4937220.name: GLANCED Demo
4937220.short_description:
Step inside. Infiltrate the manor of porcelain dolls, some are maybe your friends. Steal the key from her cold neck, find the door, and whatever you do, don’t meet her eyes. One glance is enough to lose your body.
GLANCED: forget FPS shooters. Here, just a look...KILLS.
Now, just survive.

4912480.name: ePaperCraft SHIRYU
4912480.short_description: [English Manual Now Available] Draw in 3D, unfold your design into printable parts, and print. With SHIRYU alone, your 3D design becomes a real papercraft model. Includes 70+ models, a Windows interface in 9 languages, and the free SHIRYU Model Photo Studio for owners.

5445180.name: Mochi Cats
5445180.short_description: Rotate and drop pairs of squishy cats, merge matching cats into bigger chonks, and keep grumpy cats apart in this cozy physics puzzle. Chase high scores and unlock new cat looks and rooms as you play.

5371580.name: Hoverwick: Village in the Sky
5371580.short_description: A cozy medieval village floating in the corner of your desktop. Peek in between emails, put up a new house, plant flowers or paint a river, then get back to work. The villagers take care of the rest: they bake bread, go fishing and build snowmen, even when the game is closed.

4918970.name: Miner Survivor Demo
4918970.short_description:
Mine. Build. Survive. Defend.
A fast-paced survivor defense game where you mine gold, build towers and drones, battle massive enemy hordes, and defeat powerful bosses in an ever-changing underground world.

5167340.name: Orca Girl: Idle Fishing Story Demo
5167340.short_description: Enjoy idle fishing with your orca girl companion. Grow crops, craft bait, and collect rare and exotic fish. Decorate your own pixel aquarium and build a cozy desktop island. Play solo or enjoy relaxing fishing trips with friends in multiplayer for up to 8 players.

4816980.name: BROKEN：Survivors  破界：幸存者 Demo
4816980.short_description: This is a fast-paced roguelike hack-and-slash game where weapons, characters, and skills can all be developed independently and freely combined to create your very own build!

4252130.name: 白羊传：无庇护所 Demo
4252130.short_description: 《TheWhiteLamb：NoShelter》 is a first-person horror shooter. In the abyssal depths of consciousness beneath a deep coma, every memory you refuse to face grows into a devouring labyrinth. What you seek to reclaim is not just your memories, but the very self on the verge of shattering.

5208140.name: Twisted Childhood
5208140.short_description: Remember the fairy tales you grew up with? You're going to corrupt them. Every tale is a different game — and make a Wish to bend its rules. Win your rounds... and your favorite princesses will never recover...

5448060.name: Sea Train
5448060.short_description: A calm first-person ride on a little two-car railcar across a shallow, glassy sea. Write today's to-dos, tune the radio, walk between the cars, and let the halts keep time: focus between stations, rest at each one. Rain or shine, there is nowhere you have to be.

5367850.name: Little Spring
5367850.short_description: Compress. Aim. Release. Guide a little spring through the pages of an old patent. Judge slopes, ride moving platforms and set curious mechanisms in motion across 20 handcrafted physics challenges. Unlock six springs, each with a character of its own.

5474370.name: A girl was singing in the church choir…
5474370.short_description: A visual novel about a young woman walking through a strange forest at night.

5372230.name: DeadShare
5372230.short_description: Six seats. Six players. One game show that smiles while it watches you. Make your secret pick, read the room, and stay in your seat while the wheel turns on SIXFOLD, the 2010 TV show nobody was meant to see.

3925750.name: Generic Fighter Maybe
3925750.short_description: A classic arcade-style 2D Fighting Game, wrapped up in a goofy, full-of-energy, stylized presentation that mixes great animation and zany battle moves with simplistic doodles!

5057870.name: The Colour Beyond: A Zeroth Kind Playtest

5236680.name: Fish Battle Champion
5236680.short_description: Fishing roguelite autobattler where every catch could become your next champion. Catch strange fish, discover rare bonuses, collect items, upgrade your team of fishes and fight through increasingly challenging battles.

3311700.name: Orestruck: Space Miner
3311700.short_description: A fast-paced sci-fi First Person Shooter inspired by the classics of the genre. Shoot and kick your way out of the war-torn planet to survive the attack of the space undead. Zombie blood has never splashed so good!

4842780.name: OKeverything: Realm of Humanity-DLC1
4842780.short_description: Ethan, Sophia, and Isabella were designed as vessels and awakened during the resonance between bloodline and consciousness insects. They engaged in a confrontation with Victor and others. The fusion entity defeated the enemies one by one and finally faced unknown dangers.

4059810.name: OKeverything: Realm of Humanity
4059810.short_description: Ethan, a community college history teacher, investigated the school's finances to fight for his daughter's custody. However, he was targeted by the Spade Society and the Veil Club, falling into a desperate situation of a humanity test, struggling to survive with his "sister" and "aunt".

4835450.name: OKeverything: Realm of Humanity-DLC
4835450.short_description: Ethan stands in the blood - stained arena and starts his revenge with Sophia and Isabella. They expose Victor's conspiracy, awaken mysterious powers, and the bloody curtain of the revenge journey is thus drawn.

5192440.name: PactSworn Demo
5192440.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

2554970.name: Hell Games
2554970.short_description: Get ready for Hell Games: In this action packed player vs player arena brawler 4 fallen athletes, once cheaters and dopers, battle it out in the depths of hell. Knock out opponents with sports gear, power up, and strive to be the last one standing.

5131440.name: KESSLER: Orbital Incremental
5131440.short_description: 1983: a killer satellite is put into orbit, then forgotten. 2041: it wakes up, and everything circling the Earth becomes a target. One shot, a cloud of debris, a chain reaction. An incremental pixel-art game where you set off the Kessler syndrome.

5211160.name: KING 4 A DAY - Supporter Pack
5211160.short_description: An optional Supporter Pack for those who wish to support the studio. Includes an exclusive KING 4 A DAY wallpaper.

4689330.name: Anomaly Core: Hospital
4689330.short_description: You are a patient. You should avoid treatment at the old hospital. The crazy doctor's strange methods raise doubts. The treatment may not go as you imagine.

5428430.name: OTAKUS VS NINJAS CD 1
5428430.short_description: Otakus to Japan! The Work Ninja Clan has seized power and banned leisure. Get ready to save Manga, Anime and Videogames! This game is a narrative, rock-driven beat-'em-up. Follow the story of Alex(Mexico), Michael (USA) and Cristina (Argentina), put your heardphones on and enjoy the travel :)

5445840.name: Otakus vs Ninjas Cd 1: Arcade mode + Music Soundtrack
5445840.short_description: Play as Alex, Michael or Cristina in 3 Stages. Full Music in game and or you Pc in hight quality Wav format.

5209250.name: KING 4 A DAY
5209250.short_description: KING 4 A DAY is a small, straightforward roguelike strategy game inspired by chess. Lead four humble pawns across procedurally generated levels, adapt to ever-changing laws, and brave a kingdom of black-and-white roads to rescue the kidnapped White King.

2502870.name: Kanun 1919
2502870.short_description: An action-adventure game set in a dieselpunk world. You are an imperial courier tasked with investigating the disappearance of a special cargo in the sealed-off city of Turov. Uncover its dark secrets and face the unknown. The fate of the city—and perhaps the entire world—rests on your shoulders!

4616300.name: Celestial Routes
4616300.short_description: A third-person space survival game where seamless planet landings meet debt, fuel costs, fines, taxes, base ownership, and rebellion.

5487820.name: World of Stick
5487820.short_description: Build your base. Raise your army. Crush your enemies!

4620680.name: Tokioriki
4620680.short_description: Every person you choose leaves someone else behind. Spend your limited afternoons building relationships, exploring the town, and recording each day in Kanata’s diary—then face timed Shadow Choices as an old book begins to fracture his ordinary life.

5347440.name: Deadshift
5347440.short_description: Spend your last cash on a gun, a perk or a way out. DEADSHIFT is a single-player, top-down zombie survival roguelike. Repair barricades, unlock rooms and evolve your weapons across six maps. Beat the wave-30 boss, then keep fighting in endless mode.

4851450.name: Proud Boss Turns Into Obedient Loyal Maid
4851450.short_description: Ilya, a worker in New York, merged his consciousness with Liu Zihua due to an explosion and gained superpowers. He disguises himself as a low - level employee during the day and investigates the FX Group at night. He also has a complex entanglement with his proud boss, Natalie.

4373050.name: 999 Seconds! Survivors Demo
4373050.short_description:
Reject boring stat stacking!
We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create?
—Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

5435360.name: Candy Factory
5435360.short_description: Build a candy factory on a cake island floating in the clouds. Mould candies, flavour them, top them and send them by road to the Candy Carousel. Chain 59 works into ever sweeter recipes, spin the reward machine, weather gumball storms and sugar quakes, and finish the carousel in five ages.

5374140.name: Bullet Factory
5374140.short_description: A factory that makes bullets, turrets that fire them, and a horde of living scrap that wants your metal. Design your ammo module by module, from junkyard tinkering to the far future, coached over the radio by Granny Odette.

3726100.name: Forestless
3726100.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure that takes you on a journey through the world of fear, armed only with the magical arrow of hope. Explore the vastness of human nightmares, from the foggy lands of loneliness to the mountains of failure.

2370570.name: Standable: Full Body Estimation
2370570.short_description: Standable Full Body Estimation is a method of estimating points of your body that are not currently tracked by 3-point tracking solutions.

5043750.name: Elf Shift
5043750.short_description: Only 4 real time days left until Christmas. Flawlessly pack 10,000 toys, unlock new products, and improve your skills to speed up the production line. Deliver the boxes on time, don't get too curious about the weird things happening around you, and most importantly... do not anger Santa.

4990430.name: Forestless Demo
4990430.short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure that takes you on a journey through the world of fear, armed only with the magical arrow of hope. Explore the vastness of human nightmares, from the foggy lands of loneliness to the mountains of failure.

5346200.name: Towers of Babble Demo
5346200.short_description: Word Game Tower Defense. Spell AXE to harvest wood. Spell FORT to make an armored tower. Every word you spell becomes a tower with unique stats and powers. Every word is also a unique level with procedural challenges. 121,683 levels. Together we must clear them all to reach paradise.

3600740.name: 万象之环
3600740.short_description: "OMNIRING" is an, multi-cycle, strategy role-playing game. Assemble a team of Samsarans, experience stories in vastly different worlds during continuous cycle adventures - battle, interact, make choices, resolve events... Train your team, step into the final battle, and become The detached.

4526560.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms Demo
4526560.short_description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft lanterns and magic potions, fulfil demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

5216600.name: MPE Keys
5216600.short_description: A real-time MIDI keyboard and piano visualizer with a built-in MPE synth and live sheet music. Every note is drawn on the key itself: pressure as color, velocity as brightness, bend as a moving dot, timbre as rings. Scale Lock and chords on keys. No controller? Your computer keyboard plays it.

5486520.name: Wallet Street
5486520.short_description: A first-person stock market sim where the market is rigged, and you're the one rigging it. Trade on the news, buy a blog to spread rumors, lobby against companies, install a puppet president, or skip stocks and win big at the casino.

4245930.name: Amiko Legends
4245930.short_description: A creature-collecting extraction RPG where every expedition is a risk. Charm wild Amiko and fight alongside them across an untamed world shaped by your actions. Push deeper or pull out, but only what you extract is yours to keep.

4206140.name: Deep Dive Dungeon
4206140.short_description: A sword-and-sorcery dungeon built from location cards. Scavenge rare loot, build your deck on the fly to define your playstyle, and break out before it's too late. Play solo or team up with friends!

4070690.name: HeroesSagaZero
4070690.short_description: A muscle wizard who beats foes with a staff, a meathead tank who won't protect allies, a healer who only casts offensive spells. Break every RPG rule! Mix gear, stats, and skills to dream up builds even when you're not playing. A strategic hack-and-slash roguelite RPG with 2.5D pixel-art battles.

4889720.name: IRONWAKE Demo
4889720.short_description: A story-driven psychological horror. Your mind is uploaded into a dormant Soviet industrial robot inside a sealed subterranean bunker. Navigate total darkness using stealth, solve environmental puzzles, and trust the voice on the radio. Uncover the clues and change how it ends.

4474670.name: ControllerMeta
4474670.short_description: ControllerMeta is a professional-grade Windows controller diagnostic and analysis tool designed specifically for hardcore gamers and controller enthusiasts.

4919520.name: MPE Insight
4919520.short_description: A real-time MIDI and MPE visualizer, MIDI monitor and MPE synth for any MIDI keyboard. See every note with its pressure, pitch bend and timbre as visuals, keys and live sheet music. Draw MPE notes, record MIDI, export video and audio. DRIFT adds MPE movement to an ordinary keyboard.

3765610.name: Desktop Pet Engine
3765610.short_description: Place your favorite characters on your desktop!A desktop idle game for work, study, and fun. Summon cute companions to keep you company, vent stress, or collect characters. Quickly access productivity tools like notepads, Pomodoro timers, and task lists—making your desktop lively and efficient!

5290030.name: Spellvoc
5290030.short_description: A chaotic co-op game where 2–4 apprentice wizards use magic to fill orders, on the couch or online. Pull ingredients closer with telekinesis and fire up the cauldron with a fireball. Bridges collapse and trains barrel through, but your creations still have to reach the owl on time!

4636110.name: Subject: Escape
4636110.short_description: Escape a mysterious laboratory in a 2.5D puzzle platformer. Solve challenges, navigate experimental rooms, and find your way out.

4529690.name: Cowgirl Milk Cafe
4529690.short_description: You came to town to sell berries, but ended up managing a café with charming cow girls! Mix delicious cocktails, save the café from going under, and grow closer to your staff — and their attractive boss. Who knew a new job could change your life so much?

4281810.name: Umbra Survivors Demo
4281810.short_description: Umbra Survivors is a dark 3D gothic survivors-like: fight through thousands of creatures, draft rare card upgrades, and forge devastating synergies before the next wave swallows you. Multiple heroes, brutal bosses, and every level-up can twist the run.

5284170.name: 古今東西ダービー Demo

5335240.name: Lusty Tavern Rush Demo
5335240.short_description: Inherit a gutted tavern and build it back. A first-person adult management sim where you pour ale, chase raised hands across a crowded floor, upgrade every room you own, and hire three women worth more than their wages.

5232710.name: OVERPAINT
5232710.short_description: Five minutes. Friendship over. Two to four players stand back to back and paint the same masterpiece. In Sabotage Time, walk over and throw paint at a friend's canvas. In the final Repair Time nobody can sabotage any more — just paint. When the sun goes down, it's over. Real masterpieces.

5392060.name: Pimpin' Around
5392060.short_description: Play as a pimp in the funky 1970s. Run the joint, slap the troublemakers and buy the place before the Pimp Boss buys you.

5135690.name: Meeting the World:AIRA
5135690.short_description: Feeling bored and need a chat? Fascinated by other cultures but can't communicate easily? Want an AI companion to help you out!

5299440.name: Extinction Force Demo
5299440.short_description:
Battle across time to save humanity from giant arachnids in this multiplayer third-person action shooter.
Enjoy the single player campaign or PVE with friends in co-op gameplay online, LAN and split-screen.

4710690.name: Zombie Crawlers
4710690.short_description: Crawl through a haunted mansion and gun down the undead with a deck of cards! ZOMBIE CRAWLERS is a 3D first-person roguelite deckbuilder where your deck is your boomstick. Explore the mansion, uncover its secrets, and face the neverending horrors behind each door.

4885320.name: KICKSHIFT
4885320.short_description: An alternate Rocket League-like game if you are looking for a unique take on the genre, that's built with Rollback netcode.

5398650.name: TRACE IT
5398650.short_description: A cozy paper-style train-track logic puzzle. Use the row and column numbers to lay one railway from entrance to exit; every level has exactly one solution. 500 levels plus Endless, Relax and Daily modes. Finish the line and watch the little train roll out.

5301440.name: KEYLINGS
5301440.short_description: Every key on your keyboard becomes a tiny living creature. The more you type, the more your Keylings grow. They play, fall in love, and sometimes even fight in this charming life simulation. Compatible RGB devices can also react with synchronized lighting.

1587920.name: Undead Development 2
1587920.short_description: Action survival carpentry. Nail anything to anything: drag, nail and build with a physics based barricading system to hold off the horde. A combat focused zombie survival experience for 1-4 players in online co-op.

5351900.name: Animals Hate You
5351900.short_description: This game is a 1-4 player troll game. You have to control the character to escape with friends while every animal in sight tries to snipe you. Top-down chaos, cruel traps, and places that really do not want you to leave.

5001010.name: Reino Visigodo: Conquista de Hispania
5001010.short_description: Forge your kingdom in Visigothic Hispania. Build cities, raise armies, and conquer territories in a real-time strategy game featuring 3D battles, sieges, and decisions that shape your destiny. Three game modes where ambition meets history.

3764220.name: Lone City: The Ashen Archives
3764220.short_description: Not an art book, but a behind-the-scenes journal of Lone City's development—Blueprints, models, decisions and turning points, and the people whose support has brought it this far.

3999250.name: DinoSwarm Demo
3999250.short_description: DinoSwarm is a roguelite where you can hybridize Dinosaurs, fuse Powers and Elements, and more! The Swarm Queen is ready to invade the dimensions and gather as much DNA as she can. She will grant you incredible powers and enhancements. Invade Dimensions to collect DNA, Powers and Elements.

4914970.name: The Winery - Winemaking Simulator
4914970.short_description: Build your own winery, craft exceptional wines, and grow your reputation with every vintage. Unlock recipes, master new technologies, host winery events, and weather the seasons — because great winemaking is an art, and every bottle tells a story.

5477000.name: 犯人当てラジオ Demo
5477000.short_description:
This is a mystery novel game in which you read short mystery stories and identify the culprit.
The trial version allows you to play the full tutorial scenario, "Heise and the Locked-Room Mystery of Grit."
Read short detective stories,
and use cards and charts to deduce the solution.

5232440.name: OKUREK Demo
5232440.short_description:
Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars.
COZY-PICKLE-HORROR experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland.
Preserve what you couldn't save.

5295310.name: The First Pixel Demo
5295310.short_description: A single pixel wakes in the dark. Feed it, shape it, follow the patterns it leaves behind. Somewhere inside the noise are forgotten worlds, lost relics, and a question the pixel was never meant to ask.

5398090.name: Neighbor Duel
5398090.short_description: Here, they’ll snatch items right out of your hands, knock your loot loose with a club to the back, and freeze you for five seconds so they can calmly make off with your grapes. Fight, use cunning, and haul ten items back to your base before your opponent does.

5207390.name: Sobakistan: The Land of Dogs Demo
5207390.short_description: Sobakistan — the land of dogs, is a darkly satirical narrative immersion in a closed-off totalitarian dog state — where any step could send you to prison. Rich story, choices with consequences, bureaucratic card battles, text-based soulslike.

4565880.name: Loot
4565880.short_description: Fight, loot, climb, repeat!  Explore randomly generated dungeons in this ARPG Bullet Heaven.  Fight through endless waves of enemies to find what lies at the top.

4458010.name: Fright Train Demo
4458010.short_description: Fight through a train overtaken by monsters and survive Antarctica’s cold as paranormal special agent Doug Barker in this chilling single-player third-person survival horror roguelike.

4633500.name: King's Haven Demo
4633500.short_description: A combo-driven roguelike, where every Citizen is a card in your deck. Draft a Knight, Vampire, Rat King, Chef or over 100 other unique Citizens to chain together powerful synergies. Construct landmarks, survive seasonal threats and defend your Haven in this quirky roguelike deckbuilder.

3777660.name: SnowRunner - Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 2
3777660.short_description:
The Mercedes-Benz Trucks Dual Pack 2 is now available! Expand your SnowRunner garage with two new behemoths: the Mercedes-Benz NG3850 and the Mercedes-Benz LG1519 6x6 “Mamute”.

This DLC is not sold as part of a SnowRunner Year Pass.

3155140.name: Living With Sister: Monochrome Fantasy - Official Sister Cosplay by MiMi
3155140.short_description: This Cosplay DLC includes images of a cosplayer cosplaying as Sister from the game.

3261920.name: To Kill a God Demo
3261920.short_description: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

3388920.name: SchoolBoy Runaway Demo
3388920.short_description: “You little rascal! Go do your homework!” said your parents and put you under house arrest. Try the demo version of the game, outsmart your parents, and find a way to have fun with your friends!

2109303.name: Resident Evil 4 Leon & Ashley Costumes: 'Casual'
2109303.short_description:
Survive in style with this set of casual costumes for Leon and Ashley.
Your enemies will be too distracted by your expression of individuality to know what hit 'em!

2109304.name: Resident Evil 4 Leon & Ashley Costumes: 'Romantic'
2109304.short_description:
Indulge in a world of bliss with this set of romantic costumes for Leon and Ashley.
Fight with flair. Survive with sophistication.

2109305.name: Resident Evil 4 Leon Costume & Filter: 'Hero'
2109305.short_description:
Protect the innocent with this Leon costume and filter set, inspired by vigilante heroes of old.
Changing screen filters will give the game a nostalgic, retro feel.

1837770.name: Ardenfall Demo
1837770.short_description: Inspired by classic The Elder Scrolls games, Ardenfall is a first-person, open-world RPG of ancient cultures and rival factions. Explore windswept plains and forgotten dungeons, forge your path with steel, magic, or persuasion, and shape the fate of those you meet.

1571590.name: Steel Division 2 - Nemesis #4 - Storming Toulon
1571590.short_description: Lead two new battlegroups to victory in Nemesis: Storming Toulon with Verteidigungsbereich Toulon and 1e Division Française Libre. This Steel Division 2 expansion features many new units, from Free French Légionnaires to Kriegsmarine Marineinfanterie, Flak 38 105mm guns and British carrier planes.

1582830.name: War Thunder - Swedish Starter Pack
1582830.short_description: The implacable Strv m/41 and maneuverable Fokker D.XXI with premium bonuses, 7 days of Premium account and Silver Lions - the best option for the early ranks of War Thunder!

1348670.name: Steel Division 2 - Black Sunday
1348670.short_description: Command a new nation in Steel Division 2’s third massive expansion, Black Sunday, and fight on Romania’s frontier in the summer of 1944. Experience 2 new Army General campaigns and play with 6 new Divisions, including new Romanian, 150 new units, 2 new Aces, 15 new Camouflage skins, and more!

1418230.name: Steel Division 2 - Nemesis #2 - Lvov Offensive
1418230.short_description: Our second Nemesis DLC highlights the Lvov offensive, featuring two new divisions : the German 20. Panzergrenadier & Soviet 10th Gds. Tank Corps, including new units such as Elefant, Tiger (P), Flakpanzer T-34, ... as well as a new ace, Helmut Bruck.

1477780.name: Steel Division 2 - Nemesis #3 - Battle of Rimini
1477780.short_description: Command two new battlegroups in Nemesis: Battle of Rimini: the 1. Fallschirmjäger and 2nd New Zealand Division. This expansion features a new Ace, Greek pilot Marinos Mitralexis, new Greek mountain infantry, Maori soldiers, the Martin Baltimore bomber, Bristol Beaufighter and Re.2005 units

1165510.name: Steel Division 2 - Death on the Vistula
1165510.short_description: Steel Division 2 - Death on the Vistula expands the original game with tons of new content in solo, coop and multiplayer, including a new massive Army General turn-based strategic campaign, 4 new Divisions, 200+ new units, 4 new historical battles and 2 exclusives aces!

1236360.name: Steel Division 2 - The Fate of Finland
1236360.short_description: Steel Division 2 - The Fate of Finland is the second expansion for the popular and expansive World War 2 RTS set on the Eastern Front. The DLC adds a large amount of new content, including a new Army General strategic campaign, 6 new Divisions, 200+ units, 2 new Aces, and 2 new Historical Battles!

5465730.name: Femboy Futa Monster Girls Supporter Pack
5465730.short_description: An optional supporter pack for those who wish to give Hellim Studios extra support. Contains only a thank-you letter in TXT format. Includes no additional game content, scenes, characters, or in-game advantages. Thank you for your support! ♡

5453450.name: Femboy Futa Monster Girls
5453450.short_description: Femboy Futa Monster Girls is an adult fantasy visual novel driven by your choices. Build relationships with six distinct characters, uncover their secrets, and play minigames ranging from card duels to rhythm challenges as you explore branching routes and multiple endings.

5465740.name: Femboy Futa Monster Girls Wallpaper Pack
5465740.short_description: Bring the atmosphere of Femboy Futa Monster Girls to your desktop with 8 PC wallpapers. Personalize your computer while giving Hellim Studios extra support. This pack contains wallpaper files and provides no additional gameplay content.

4414460.name: Greedy Little Kingdoms
