4414460.short_description: A short-run roguelike city builder. Gather timber, craft lanterns and magic potions, fulfil demands from frogs, plague doctors, and swamp dragons. Explore the hex map, survive the King's moods, and find the artefacts that break your economy wide open. Repeat.

5364730.name: Apex Armada
5364730.short_description: A spaceship auto battler where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose from 16 alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

4103220.name: Libra Apocrypha
4103220.short_description: A dark-fantasy deckbuilder with strategic turn-based combat and a haunting narrative of gods, fate, and rebellion.

5402860.name: 勇者喵傳說
5402860.short_description:
《MEOWBOUND LEGENDS: Legend of the Brave Cats》 is an idle RPG starring cats.

A group of cats were transported to another world, where they built Meow Village.

5047850.name: Cosmic Clicker
5047850.short_description: Build a cosmic energy empire in this colorful incremental sci-fi game. Click, automate production, unlock technologies, explore distant planets, collect artifacts, raise cosmic pets, and ascend to unlock permanent upgrades.

4673610.name: Knightoria
4673610.short_description: Take up your sword and become a brave knight! Fight monsters, leap across dangerous platforms, and battle your way through a colorful fantasy kingdom. Reach the end of each level and prove yourself as the kingdom's greatest knight!

4601630.name: FirstPlate Demo
4601630.short_description: Run a restaurant under constant pressure in the FirstPlate Demo. Build and expand your kitchen infinitely, draft new menu cards in an endless survival challenge, and coordinate chaotic service solo or in co-op. Survive as long as you can to climb the global leaderboards!

4774380.name: ErosNet: Glitch in Love
4774380.short_description: ErosNet: Glitch in Love is an erotic visual novel and dating sim with an ironic cyberpunk storyline! Explore biomes, reveal avatars' fetishes, and unlock spicy scenes. Upgrade your PC to transform pixels into juicy 2D art!

4898550.name: Heat: Pedal to the Metal
4898550.short_description: Play your cards strategically and push your engine to the limit in Heat: Pedal to the Metal, the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Manage your speed, master every corner and race through the golden age of 1960s motorsport against friends, Legends and players worldwide.

5204810.name: Day 31 Demo
5204810.short_description: You're already infected. The suppressant is the only thing holding it back, and it runs out on Day 31. Fight through St. Harrow's Hospital wave by wave, trade nerve to a masked thing that calls itself a merchant, and try to see morning.

3604580.name: The Light Of Vertical
3604580.short_description: A Metroidvania-style action adventure set in the collapsing "Sky City." Play as a life form awakening in darkness, explore decaying areas, interact with NPCs, battle bosses, collect cards, and uncover the truth through stylized art and deep storytelling.

4949100.name: Day 31
4949100.short_description: You were bitten hours ago. The clock in your blood is already running — and it isn't a virus. Fight through the waves of the dead, trade your nerve to a demon who was here before the city, and hold onto yourself for one more wave. Turn, and it's over.

4984010.name: DeckCrate
4984010.short_description: A fast, privacy-focused file manager built for your Steam Deck and handheld. Drive it entirely with a controller — D-pad to move, A to open, B to go back — or use mouse and keyboard. Copy, move, batch-rename, compress, preview, and mount images. Zero telemetry, ever.

5263670.name: Leviathan: Rhino Demo
5263670.short_description: Live through the final days of an old man in a small village threatened by an approaching giant Leviathan. An existential horror game about inevitability, loneliness, and a man with nowhere to go and no reason to leave.

5242280.name: Tutor's Gentle Trap-DLC She became my stepmother
5242280.short_description: Late at night, Elena drove back and witnessed an inappropriate scene between her sister and Lawrence. Then the two sisters had a wild night with Lawrence. The next day, Elena removed the foreign object, and finally, Daphne died after seeing the video.

5242450.name: Tutor's Gentle Trap-DLC The Deadly Tenderness of Stepmother and Aunt
5242450.short_description: Early in the morning, Daphne suddenly died of sudden cardiac death. After the funeral, Thomas discovered his father's incestuous relationship with Elena and Alys. Three years later, he witnessed his father's grand wedding to Elena.

5115030.name: The Woodworking Game
5115030.short_description: Run your own woodworking shop, complete customer orders, and craft furniture by hand. Saw and plane lumber, join parts with a freeform nailing system, mix paint, and customize your entire workshop just the way you want.

5214200.name: AbsoluteNeko
5214200.short_description: AbsoluteNeko is a co-op action game for up to four players set in a Japanese neighborhood. Play as stray cats, run along walls, cars and rooftops, slip past patrolling dogs, and regroup before time runs out. Meow to save caught friends, and take pictures of your cats in photo mode.

3160510.name: The Shattered
3160510.short_description: The Shattered is a fantasy roguelite dungeon crawler, where you decide the powers of your opponents. Overcome randomly generated challenges, create a unique set of skills, and uncover the mystery of your true identity.

5301960.name: Tower of Hyakki
5301960.short_description: A Japanese folklore dark fantasy hack-and-slash roguelite. Climb the tower of a hundred demons, cut down the yokai, gather gear, and forge a build of your own. Die, and the tower reshapes itself to wait for you again.

4518290.name: MysteryOS - AXIOM/2
4518290.short_description: A corporate alien OS hides a collective intelligence across three desktops. 60 standalone puzzle apps. 87 achievements. Compliance is mandatory. The Foundation is watching. The Resonance is rising.

5220920.name: Stock Baron
5220920.short_description: Stock Baron is a strategy sim set in a fictional stock market. Become a market titan with vast capital, superior intel and an arsenal of trading tactics. Your moves sway prices, while other market players seize their chances. Enter a battle of wits amid fear and greed, and make your fortune!

4822020.name: Aftergarden
4822020.short_description: Don’t just dodge—blast through the barrage. Build your firepower and push back enemy hordes in a progression-focused 2D shooter. Collect weapons and allies, rethink your formation, then sortie again. Upgrade in town and push farther next run. Quick reflexes help, but smart builds keep you advancing.

5010920.name: OpenSpeedy
5010920.short_description: OpenSpeedy is a free and open-source speed controller for Windows single-player games. you can speed up or slow down any game in real time, no kernel driver required. Switch speeds instantly with customizable hotkeys, five gear presets, and a hold-to-speed mode, putting every game in your control.

5087290.name: Sexy female neighbor and her wet cucumber
5087290.short_description: The unemployed Louis Thompson accidentally catches a glimpse of the private moments of his neighbor, Holly Phillips, through the surveillance. The two then fall into a forbidden love, while mysterious nano-insects quietly set their sights on them.

4074760.name: Clayborn Idle
4074760.short_description: Forge legendary gear, shape its stats, and chase the ideal build in Clayborn Idle – an incremental ARPG where semi-turn-based combat collides with a deep progression system. Build game-breaking combinations, grow your utility skills, and master a world shaped by both battle and craftsmanship.

1763890.name: Clone Clicker
1763890.short_description: Build the clone empire of your dreams. Assign clones to do jobs, increasing your productivity and amassing even more riches with which you may create more clones. Reach for the stars and take the universe (and more) into your clutches.

4300480.name: Time Jump Demo
4300480.short_description: This is the Pre-Demo for TIME JUMP. Can you catch your other self? Want to know a little history of what happens before the actual story? Run run and run again in 3 short levels to catch the evil William Roger and put an end to his destruction.

4696260.name: Operation: Horumus
4696260.short_description: Combine eight modules into 120 defense builds in a deadpan political-satire tower defense. Survive a seven-day story campaign, master a 100-stage maze, and stop every tanker crossing the Strait of Horumus.

5115040.name: Quest Dice
5115040.short_description: A book, a d20, a candle. Quest Dice is a solo pen-and-paper in three stories — write your own books and share them on the Workshop.

5467310.name: Decks of Valor: Fantasy Card Battles
5467310.short_description: Choose from more than 70 ready-made decks and battle fantasy heroes in tactical card duels. Play offline against deck-aware AI, learn in a short interactive tutorial, or enter a 32-deck knockout tournament.

5082660.name: Save the Forest Demo
5082660.short_description: Save the Forest is a tactics roguelite where you lead your squad of villagers in a quest to defeat the admittedly pretty silly evil that has corrupted the forest. Choose and create combos with over 25 units and 150+ skills!

5256670.name: No More Turtles Demo
5256670.short_description: No More Turtles is a plastic-producing incremental game. Start cranking grandpa's machine, loot abandoned warehouses, and pollute your way to saving a world overrun by turtles!

5393650.name: Aquila: All Roads Lead To Rome Playtest

5436330.name: LimeFlesh Demo
5436330.short_description: Humanity has melted into a massive, living mass of flesh. Born from a drop of blood at the bottom of this nightmare, you must push living walls, carve tunnels, and gather resources to escape. A short, tense body horror experience.

5411460.name: Overinflated
5411460.short_description: Run a restaurant as inflatable cooks! Chop, stir and serve before your balloon guests swell with rage and pop. Don't overinflate, dodge the knives, patch holes with tape, and build new rooms and machines. Co-op chaos for 1–4 players, online or on one screen.

5358610.name: Desktop Cozy Cat Tree
5358610.short_description: Build a cat tree right on your desktop. Cats climb the post, leap from the top and bounce off the rides you place, earning gold with every hit. Arrange rides, meet a growing crew of cats and decorate your Cat House in a cozy idle game that plays quietly beside your work.

5339620.name: DEFY
5339620.short_description: Two nations, each certain it is the hero, fight over a beautiful world running out of supply. Blow the bridges, burn the forests, bring the buildings down. Villagers hide in cellars or take up arms, and a downed aircraft falls on what lies beneath it. Real-time strategy for up to eight leaders.

4370100.name: 王之萌国
4370100.short_description:
The world's first simulation management single-player game with an alternate world theme!
The world's first city-building RPG game!Build a home with a catgirl, farm with a dragon maid, and embark on an otherworldly adventure you've never experienced before!
You absolutely cannot miss out on Curry!

4118070.name: A.C.H.E.S.
4118070.short_description: Click, shop and minigame your way to the top. Collect clicks in order to ቻቹቹጋ ፱ነ buy upgrades, unlock collectables and get even more ጋቹረጎርጎዐ፱ነ clicks. Test your skills in a variety of mini games. Discover the story between the cracks. Do you have what it takes to prepare for the Grand Ascension?

5243890.name: PuPuPoPu Company Demo
5243890.short_description: A cute, wacky top-down PvE extraction shooter. The world's fading, so a duckling with flashy feet and flawless blush starts a paint-spraying company. Blast away pollution in a hail of paint and give this black-and-white world its color back. Rescue critters, pack 'em to go—extract. Clock out!

3743260.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
3743260.short_description: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

2685440.name: Laura's secret diary
2685440.short_description: Help Laura, a female merchant masquerading as a gentleman, pay off her debt and keep her desires in check in this quick-response stylel puzzle game!

2692660.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2027
2692660.short_description: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

3463690.name: Sojourn Saga
3463690.short_description: Sojourn Saga is a retro JRPG roguelite where every step through the dungeon is life or death. Build your party, raise evolving companions, master powerful gear and ornament combinations and descend 99 floors through a prison realm ruled by the woman who refused to stay dead

5206070.name: TASMON: Hero Pack 4
5206070.short_description: Recruit both hero pairs of Act 4 and switch them to their Corrupted or Awakened form. Draw the Act 4 reward once more per day (until your eggs are complete) and auto-transmute eggs of chosen rarities every 10 seconds. Includes an exclusive title, friend card and UI theme. All fixed; buy once.

3822240.name: Strange island
3822240.short_description: You come to on a tropical island, unable to remember your name or how you got there. Explore the island and search for answers, but stay alert: someone is watching you, and the more you learn, the harder it becomes to trust your own conclusions.

4538460.name: Hopeless
4538460.short_description: HOPELESS is a first-person psychological horror game where players explore looping, distorted environments, observe subtle changes in reality, and survive an ever-shifting space.

4957380.name: Demockracy
4957380.short_description: Build a political party in a fictional country and play for one thing: win power and keep it. Recruit politicians, conquer regions, win elections. There are clean paths and dirty games. Everyone has a price. What's yours?

5223310.name: Bong N Brawl
5223310.short_description: Dive into a chaotic bullet hell where every second of survival feels amazing! Packed with game-changing upgrades, wildly creative boss fights, and pure arcade fun. Dodge by a hair's breadth, unleash broken builds, and just let loose!

5380450.name: Crosshair Ultimate
5380450.short_description: Make every shot feel better! Crosshair Ultimate lets you build custom animated and reactive crosshairs in seconds. Pick from thousands of ready designs, switch with hotkeys, and upgrade your shooting experience with zero FPS impact and 100% anti-cheat safety.

3769660.name: Iron Stakes
3769660.short_description: Every turn begins with a spin, but luck doesn't have the final say. Reroll, Nudge, and Lock your symbols to unleash devastating attacks. Build custom reels, stack combat mods, and turn bad odds into tactical victories in this turn-based roguelike.

3821910.name: The Blind Warrior
3821910.short_description: The Blind Warrior is a story-driven, third-person action-adventure set in 1860s colonial Java. Play as Barda, a Silat martial artist who fights against tyranny and ancient mysticism in a world inspired by Indonesian folklore.

4668100.name: Athena and the Erotic Trap Dungeon Beyond the Forest
4668100.short_description: Amorous anomalies, treacherous temptations, and a dungeon overflowing with desire threaten your and the town’s chastity! Explore, dodge, and quests your way to uncovering its secrets, or raise your Lewdness Level and surrender to sensual ruin in this Erotic Trap Dungeon RPG!

5243750.name: Doug's Playground
5243750.short_description: Catch fish, ace the minigames to grade your haul, and turn it into playground parts. Stack them on the ship, send them off, and do it again. Draft charms, hire a crew, and when you sink, spend your prestige tokens and sail once more.

4059740.name: Chess Fantasy
4059740.short_description: Chess Fantasy is a 3D chess game where you customize the world around you. Play classic chess or evolve the rules into your own game modes, online or with friends. Battle rivals and complete challenges to unlock new pieces, and build a place that truly feels like home.

4769130.name: Magical Girl: incremental gaiden
4769130.short_description:
Bullet Hell about Magical Girl!
Fight against Shadows and gain resources to upgrade the skill tree! Become stronger and defeat all the Witches! Save humanity in this short magical adventure!

3172250.name: 爪爪谋略
3172250.short_description: Paw and Plot is a lighthearted, hex-based turn-based strategy game. Players follow Latte, a kitten separated from his family, who meets Cantheon—a fallen feline deity hunted by wild cats. By helping Cantheon regain his power, Latte embarks on an adventure to reunite with his family.

5251020.name: 碎物魔塔：开局一只桶
5251020.short_description: “Relic Spire: The Barrel Reborn” is a Tower of the Sorcerer-like strategy game.You start out as just a barrel,explore a monster-infested magic tower.Collect relics,assemble the body.Choose the best route,and conquer the magic tower!No manual input during battles — strategy is everything!

1333620.name: Project Prison
1333620.short_description:
Have you ever thought about the best place to start your criminal empire without any legal consequences?

Now you will finally be able to experience prison life in Project Prison. try to stay alive in a prison which contains’ s the world’s most ruthless inmates.

3238550.name: Age of History 3: Smaller Map
3238550.short_description:
Experience the thrill of grand strategy in a more manageable scale with Smaller Map.
Total Provinces: 5,532

5203070.name: Lustful Beauties: Forbidden Pleasures Demo
5203070.short_description: Cute girls. Sexy outfits. Match-3.Yeah, you know where this is going.

4421910.name: 王之萌国 Demo
4421910.short_description:
You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom.
There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

4986300.name: Apparatus Inspector
4986300.short_description: Apparatus Inspector is a retro OS horror simulation where you are locked underground evaluating synthetic AI robots for anomalies. Chat with infected bots, execute commands, deliver judgement, and hide from physical threats to survive your 5-day shift.

5389730.name: Tamer Tactics
5389730.short_description: Draft, merge and evolve a team of monsters in a tactical PvP auto battler. Scout your Rivals, build Type Synergies and position your team on a hex board, then watch it battle recorded teams from other players. Every Journey is a fresh chance to climb the ranks.

5416910.name: Teddy TV
5416910.short_description: You're the contestant on a deadly TV game show, and every enemy is a teddy bear. Blast through arenas of killer stuffed toys, grab the cash, build a ridiculous loadout and survive the show's star bosses. Then decide: cash out, or risk it all on one more round?

5218790.name: 任意杂货铺

5087470.name: Party Link
5087470.short_description: Party Link is a collection of Russian party games for groups. Launch on a big screen, connect friends from their phones via QR, and pick a show — memes, drawing, bluffing, and guessing games. Original modes with Russian voice-over — ready in a minute, no installs on phones.

5242000.name: Shit Day : Dawn
5242000.short_description:
SHIT DAY : DAWN is a first-person survival horror game set in Republic of Korea.
You will be required to survive the impossible at every moment.

This Shit day dawn.
You must survive.
But will you?
.. it might be impossible...

999570.name: Latin Simulator
999570.short_description: A school week full of Latin and a teacher with gallows humor, who is about to be replaced by AI. Survive five days of minigames, missions and bad decisions, expose the conspiracy, and find out what Friday's exam does to you. And to the school.

5460040.name: EscapeFromSeoul Demo
5460040.short_description: Explore two districts of a sealed-off Seoul in this single-player ASCII extraction survival demo. Fight, loot, upgrade your gear and hideout, and make it back alive. Import your demo progress into the full game.

3685330.name: Orbifold
3685330.short_description: Fight through mind-bending spherical arenas on your own or with friends. Scavenge for weapons, loot and creative upgrades in the twisted remnants of a broken planet. A warped world of inverted mayhem awaits.

5486820.name: I Launch Demo
5486820.short_description: This is a game that lets you relive the experience of what it was like before you were born, alongside your goofy friends.

5142160.name: Mafia Hotel Demo
5142160.short_description: MAFIA HOTEL is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

4684120.name: It Was Not a Suicide
4684120.short_description: A psychological horror detective simulation set in Rainier Falls in 2005. Uncover the truth behind Adele's death by finding contradictions in the case files. Are you brilliant enough to expose the suspects' lies in a single attempt? Because you only get one chance to make an arrest.

2915210.name: Trouble Makers
2915210.short_description: Trouble Makers is the first & only BATTLE SURVIOR where causing chaos is your path to victory. Survive as long as you can, but more importantly, create trouble for your opponents. Dive into 4-player free-for-all showdowns, unleash TROUBLE, and wreak havoc while trying to survive!

2142550.name: Nanokings
2142550.short_description: Nanokings blends bullet heaven and Hack ’N’ Slash into a “Hack & Hell” roguelite experience. Fight waves of enemies, take down bosses, gather resources, and descend into dangerous instances where fast-paced combat takes over. Uncover the truth of a world where death is your teacher.

5118090.name: Poolside Memory Demo
5118090.short_description: A first-person chase horror set in endless liminal poolrooms. This free demo lets you play the opening part of the game — the pool rebuilds itself into a new nightmare every run.

5110510.name: IJIN: History Survivors Demo
5110510.short_description: A Bullet Heaven fought with history's great figures — this is the demo. One figure, one battlefield: survive fifteen minutes against the horde. You only move; attacks fire on their own. All you choose is the mix of weapons and passives. Record and gold carry into the full game.

2160070.name: Forge of the Fae
2160070.short_description: Forge of the Fae is a story-rich pixel RPG inspired by Celtic folklore. Journey through a mysterious world, master the ARC Crystal System to unleash powerful magic, and face dangerous Fae in fast-paced, turn-based battles where your choices shape destiny.

5090990.name: Mafia Hotel
5090990.short_description: MAFIA HOTEL is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

5106760.name: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck
5106760.short_description: Tip-Top Tortoise Truck is a grid-based puzzle game where you rescue toppled tortoises and send them home while keeping track of your fuel! Venture through the arid desert, drive through portals, and find your lost lunchboxes. Will you find out exactly who tipped all the tortoises over?

5143110.name: alda
5143110.short_description: Tragedy strikes Makris, a nation built on the arts industry. Follow Alda, a high school girl, as she confronts a world in flux and the subtleties of the human heart. A new kind of linear visual novel portraying art, religion, society, ideology, and humanity with uncompromising realism.

5396110.name: 诸界竞技场 Demo
5396110.short_description: Arena of Realms blends auto-battling, team building, and tournament management. Recruit fighters, train your roster, and combine equipment and relics to win a 16-team double-elimination tournament. Scout rivals, place wagers, and compete solo or in multiplayer.

3918260.name: Revery Effect
3918260.short_description: Revery Effect is a 2D sandbox adventure! Explore an endlessly generated world, uncover ruins and histories, dig, build, fight, automate, and journey alone or with friends.

5407090.name: SuperButeo
5407090.short_description: Table football inspired by Subbuteo. A turn-based strategy game: manage your energy and calibrate every millimetre. Compete online, climb the divisions and win tournaments. Build your club with its own crest, kits and stadium.

5359770.name: CRIMVEIL
5359770.short_description: CRIMVEIL is a 2D dark fantasy action-survival game. Fight monsters, unleash and upgrade skills, craft weapons, armor, and potions to protect the ancient ring from the black-armored invaders trying to destroy the barrier.

4741650.name: Make A Racket
4741650.short_description: A plane crash has left El Pepra’s black market up for grabs. Build your criminal empire through production, burglary, and car theft. Automate your operation, bring rival gangs to heel, and become the biggest supplier in this satirical open-world crime sandbox.

3281310.name: The Magic Garden 魔法花园 Demo
3281310.short_description: Welcome to a new fantasy world, where you start a new life in this realm. Explore the  mysterious places of this world. Here, you can build farm, meet various   farming, collecting items, and using  items and skills, venture into dungeons to defeat monsters and collect rare items.

5378910.name: DEFY Demo
5378910.short_description: Play the opening of DEFY's story from either side: the Meridian Concord or the Ashpact Horde. Ten training drills, the first three missions of each campaign, villages that hide or fight back, and a world worth fighting over.

5088660.name: Dungeon Miner
5088660.short_description: A 1–4 player online co-op mining game: go down the mine, dig up ore, and carry it back to the ship. Small gear stays on your body, but giant crystals must be carried in your own two arms. Pull the Dungeon Core and the mine starts to collapse. You have three minutes to get the cart back to the ship.

4621760.name: Unregistered Scene Demo
4621760.short_description: Unregistered Scene is a Minesweeper-style anomaly deduction game. As Agent 03, an insurance company agent, investigate scenes where records no longer match reality. Work with a mysterious assistant to identify anomalies and uncover hidden rules.

3138080.name: Some Things Stay Broken
3138080.short_description: A short narrative adventure about repair, family, and a past left unanswered. Talk to customers, inspect objects, and make simple repairs as seven missed calls draw you back to an old phone. Around 30 minutes. Traditional Chinese only.

4687950.name: THORNSPELL Demo
4687950.short_description: Embody a magical florist by placing plants strategically in your garden, and watering them to score points. THORNSPELL is a garden-building roguelike where you will create and unleash chains of magical effects, dispelling the corruption spreading through your home.

4623970.name: Heavyweight Saint
4623970.short_description: Control two bodies bound to one relentless soul in a dark, dystopian Manhattan. Infiltrate restricted zones using social disguises, vertical stealth, and tactical coordination in an atmospheric third-person stealth game.

5197730.name: SHROOMY ISLAND Demo
5197730.short_description: Shroomy Island is a desktop tower defense idle game. Critters automatically gather, craft, build, and patrol, help them run their village and fend off the evil mushroom monsters. Slowly expand and decorate your village, and collect different critters to keep you company while you work or study!

5088360.name: Immigration Simulator
5088360.short_description: Immigration Simulator is an arcade style simulation game that puts you in the seat of an immigration officer, requiring you to correctly match the qualifications that your government is after. How high can your combo streak go without making a mistake?!

5298240.name: Zombie Motel 96 Demo
5298240.short_description: Run a motel and design your own maze in this roguelike defense tycoon. Take in survivors and position them in your maze to repel zombie attacks. Combine rewards and relics as you fight to survive 96 days. If your defenses fall, start over with a new layout and build.

5370360.name: Digging In The Desert
5370360.short_description: You lost your hat in the middle of a vast desert and must keep digging to find it!

5082360.name: Forsaken Fleet Demo
5082360.short_description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

5313990.name: All Rats on Deck Demo
5313990.short_description: All Rats on Deck is an online co-op adventure game where you must navigate a paddle steam boat through dangerous waters. Forced to leave your home, you must work together to operate the boat, scour for resources, and overcome obstacles to reach the ocean.

4635620.name: Gamble With Your Friends Soundtrack
4635620.short_description: The official soundtrack for Gamble With Your Friends! Listen and enjoy these bangers while you gamble your friends away 🎵!

5032380.name: 威小鼠和猪大常：接龙 Demo
5032380.short_description: A card-based roguelike game. Everyone knows how it started, but can you handle this one? Each card needs to be played in a logical sequence to continue the previous one, but now there are 120 cards, each with its own unique rules. One wrong judgment can end the entire game.

4093480.name: Kaiju Princess 2: Poochi Q ASMR ～A Magic Ticket That Grants Any Desire～
4093480.short_description: It’s been almost a year since Pochi-Q met Mr. Chef! Pochi-Q still clings to the busy Chef for cuddles, causing chaos during explorations and leaving him with headaches. She doesn't know a "special surprise" is being prepared.

4347910.name: FINAL FANTASY RESONANCE Digital Deluxe Upgrade
4347910.short_description: This set contains an item that transforms your chocobo's appearance into magitek armor, an item exclusive to this pack that unlocks a certain character's Fel Meteor Limit Burst, and useful items to aid you at the start of your journey.

3056770.name: Watertime
3056770.short_description: A simple reminder to help you drink more water during the day.

2180820.name: RealRTCW German Voices Pack
2180820.short_description: RealRTCW German Voices Pack is a voiceover pack, which makes German characters speak their native language instead of cheesy English.

1810031.name: Steel Division 2 - Reinforcement Pack #13
1810031.short_description: Take command of two brand-new divisions for Steel Division 2 in the free Lucky 13 DLC: the varied Axis Panzerdivision Tatra and the fast-moving Allied Task Force Butler.

1556721.name: Capcom Arcade Stadium：STREET FIGHTER II' - Hyper Fighting -
1556721.short_description:
Add STREET FIGHTER II' - Hyper Fighting - to your Capcom Arcade Stadium game line-up!

Twelve fighters battle it out to see who will be the world's greatest, but the fight is heating up against the four bosses of Shadaloo. Featuring new fighters and the new Turbo feature, this time the fight's even more exciting!

606010.name: Weelco VR
606010.short_description: Weelco VR - Watch, upload and share 360° videos on your Virtual Reality headset.

672870.name: ScreenPlay
672870.short_description: ScreenPlay is an Open Source cross-platform app for displaying Wallpaper, Widgets and AppDrawer.

443730.name: Wargame: Red Dragon - Nation Pack: Netherlands
443730.short_description: In this new expansion for the spectacular real-time strategy game from Eugen Systems, the unique and diverse Dutch units are finally playable! Choose between 80 units and enter into a coalition with West Germany.

445700.name: Darkest Dungeon®: The Musketeer
445700.short_description: The Musketeer is a FREE DLC hero class which was only available to upper-tier Kickstarter backers. She is complete, high quality re-skin of the Arbalest class.

365720.name: Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE)
365720.short_description: The Skyrim Script Extender (SKSE) is a tool used by many Skyrim mods that expands scripting capabilities and adds additional functionality to the game.

5311280.name: Skuffle Demo
5311280.short_description: A split-screen and online party first person shooter. Mutator cards change how every round plays and theres a wide range of weapons to shoot your friends with. Maps are varied and range from small arenas to gimmicks and long distance battles. I think I gave you some of each of those. How generous.

2905310.name: UKNON Jones & Guynelk 2 Demo
2905310.short_description: After Jones' friends are rescued, Jones discovers that his grandfather has mysteriously disappeared. He was looking for a mythical treasure called: "Crystal Cereal". Jones, Guynelk, Elsa and Princess Saphir decide to search for the crystal cereals to find Jones' grandfather.

4492400.name: Click Flip
4492400.short_description: Click Flip is a short incremental game about clicking tiles, earning points, buying upgrades, and causing crazy tile combos.

3798530.name: Deep Breath
3798530.short_description: Deep Breath is a third-person PvPvE extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Team up or play solo, scavenge, fight, and escape in 25-minute missions filled with AI threats, tactical decisions, and fast-paced action.

4828390.name: Forsaken Fleet
4828390.short_description: A first-person pirate horror where a haunted fisherman is drawn into the legend of the Forsaken Fleet. Follow a mysterious compass. Sail through the fog. Explore forgotten places and survive the horrors that should have stayed buried at sea.

5347010.name: 大侠请充值
5347010.short_description: A painterly, top-down wuxia action RPG set in a martial world where even a hero has a price. Find your own way through a riverside town, where martial arts meet everyday life and deadpan absurdity.

5365950.name: Loot Tower Demo
5365950.short_description: Fight, loot, climb, repeat!  Fight endless waves of monsters in this Rougelite Bullet Heaven with ARPG item progression.

5244110.name: Kamira
5244110.short_description: A multiplayer folk horror social deduction game for 4–12 players. Survive the nights in a cursed village where monsters hide among you. Lock your doors, finish tasks, gather clues, and vote at the chapel to burn the guilty on the pyre before the beast strikes again.

5196070.name: Listening Post: Typing Tower Defense (Demo)
5196070.short_description: Master English listening with the ultimate dictation challenge! This real-time tower defense game lets you build and upgrade defenses by typing what you hear. Use 12 tower branches and the Fever system to sharpen your intuition. The faster you listen and type, the stronger your defense!

5381380.name: Chad Billionaire
5381380.short_description: Start broke. Work terrible jobs. Put that cash to work in real estate, businesses, stocks, acquisitions, and crypto until working for money becomes somebody else's problem. The numbers are exaggerated. The financial logic underneath them isn't.

5123310.name: Trash to Trees:  Tidy up the forest!
5123310.short_description: Clean up, sort, recycle, and restore the forest in this cozy tidy-up simulator with over 10,000 trash items. Unlock abilities to improve your efficiency. Enjoy the satisfying experience of bringing the forest back to life at your own pace, alone or with friends.

5126500.name: Benny's Backrooms Demo
5126500.short_description: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

4176000.name: False Myth 2
4176000.short_description: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

5437050.name: Star Purr Demo
5437050.short_description: A cute neon bullet-heaven roguelite. One cat, one catnip trip, ten thousand mice. Auto-fire weapons that mutate at Lv10 and Lv20, two bosses from the cat's dream, and a SSS combo to chase. Play the first chapter free — your wishlist unlocks the rest.

4910360.name: Annie's DineInn
4910360.short_description: A cooking game with cozy themed days and horror themed nights. You and your daughter are now owners of an abandoned motel and diner. Start cooking, renting rooms, and do other work to pay off the loan. But beware of the choices you make as they might come back to haunt you. (Solo developer project)

5367190.name: Apex Armada Demo
5367190.short_description: A spaceship auto battler DEMO where you build a fleet and take on real players. Choose an alien captains to lead your fleet into battle. Spend your gold on ships, guns, shields and other parts. Then watch the battles play out as you climb the ranks to become a Galactic Conqueror.

4515130.name: Veilkeeper
4515130.short_description: A tactical RPG where your army shrinks the deeper you push. Lead fragile expeditions into unstable rifts, secure relay nodes to hold your connection, and build a shard that grows stronger with every return. Decide when to advance, when to retreat, and what you're willing to leave behind.

5406210.name: Phonophobia Demo
5406210.short_description: Awaken at an abandoned railway station in the Phonophobia Demo. Search for clues, solve tactile mechanical puzzles, and restore power to forgotten station. Every noise echoes with danger—survive the opening chapter.

5044450.name: Spiroshader
5044450.short_description: Real-time visuals that dance to your music. Classic MilkDrop presets, and stunning GPU shaders in one playlist. True HDR, a psychedelic webcam mirror with green screen, logo overlays, and OBS-ready output for content creators.

5307960.name: Mannequin: Echoes of Their Minds Demo
5307960.short_description: Work the night shift at a clothing store, dressing mannequins according to instructions. Your job lasts 30 days. With every mistake, the store grows stranger. Unexplained anomalies keep appearing. Can you make it through all 30 days? A job simulator horror game where quiet work meets creeping dread.

5491200.name: Keep Making Games Demo
5491200.short_description: Tycoon for a one-person game studio, starting in 1976. Your only staff: a talking cassette, a bonsai and a chick with a megaphone. Unrealistic, I know. So is taking on the whole games industry alone for 50 years, and that's the plan. Build games from features, beat rivals to the shelves.

4021840.name: Lewd Temple: Hentai Clicker
4021840.short_description: A saucy 2D idle clicker where ancient Egypt meets seductive waifus. Tap to fight, defeat bosses to recruit bold new companions, and upgrade your girls to battle automatically. Chat with them in an in-game messenger and grow your collection.

5330100.name: 2 Forts Demo
5330100.short_description: 2 Forts is a fast-paced fantasy RTS on a hex grid: lead one of two factions, seize the summoning circles and turn the Decider against the enemy castle. Most matches are won in 3 to 5 minutes, against bots or in online PvP.

4696500.name: Poolrooms Museum Demo
4696500.short_description: Explore surreal liminal pool spaces and a strange waterless dungeon.

5373110.name: 迷你电网 Demo
5373110.short_description: Build a power grid across Wuhan's two rivers. Place plants and substations, match voltages and manage limited supplies as demand and policies change. Try Normal mode, a standalone tutorial, circuit switching and backup transfer, with pause controls and local saves.

4315070.name: JDM: Ph4ntom Driver
4315070.short_description: Defeat the Demon King and save the Spirit World from Corruption in this action, racing, supernatural spin-off of JDM: Japanese Drift Master! Drive your JDM ride like a lethal weapon, drift through the corrupted open world, and smash hordes of Youkai as the Hero wielding the power of Destruction.

4660210.name: Poolrooms Museum
4660210.short_description: Explore surreal poolrooms, museums, and endless liminal spaces.

5343820.name: Welcome To HillVeil
5343820.short_description: An atmospheric 3D puzzle exploration game about cheering up the lovely folks of HillVeil and making memories that last a lifetime! . . . . . what is it hiding?

5295660.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack Demo
5295660.short_description: Free demo of Sekigahara 1600. The demo includes six battlefields: Nancy, Bowang, Okehazama, Sekigahara, Gettysburg and Waterloo, plus the interactive tutorial. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game.

5342620.name: Cure The Dead Demo
5342620.short_description: Run a Pharmacy for the infected, brew and mix cures and protect your inventory. Scavenge for resources, stock up the shelves and improve your store. You might have a cure but that doesn't mean you're safe from looters and hungry zombies. Grow your team to protect your store.

5185710.name: Sekigahara 1600: Must Attack
5185710.short_description: Sekigahara, 1600 - and battlefields East and West, from ancient China to the American Civil War. Any unit left in an enemy zone of control must attack: no quiet flanks, nothing held back. Pushing the line is the game. A deep hex-and-counter wargame, yet most battles play in about 30 minutes.

4735200.name: VOID ARMOR: FORM DRIVE
4735200.short_description: A top-down mecha action shooter where you instantly switch between an Energy Blade, rifle, launcher, and defense system to destroy enemy machines. Close the distance to slash, attack from range, or defend against incoming fire. Clear missions, improve your performance, and aim for higher ranks.

5096860.name: PactSworn
5096860.short_description: Fight through hordes of eldritch monsters to purge the source of the corruption! Earn gold, buy weapons, and level up to create unique and powerful builds to cut through the chaos. Unlock different warlocks and weapon sets to explore all the different ways to play!

4611550.name: Artificial Ambition
4611550.short_description: Build an AI company from a 2017 startup into an industry leader. Hire specialists, train models, launch products, and expand your headquarters. Balance compute costs, customer demand, and investor control in a real-time management strategy game.

3091040.name: Haul Yeah!
3091040.short_description: Load it, strap it, drive it. A colourful delivery-driving sandbox for one or two players. Stack real physics cargo, tighten the straps and haul it across a mountain county in split-screen co-op or solo. Build your business with better trucks, custom parts and bigger jobs.

4714080.name: Full Metal Hell
4714080.short_description: Full Metal Hell is a roguelite shooter combining physics-based collisions and active abilities. Choose from a wide variety of vehicles, weapons, and builds, and crush everything in your path through the mechanical hordes!

5352030.name: Last Signal Demo
5352030.short_description: Plan the perfect infiltration. Route a stealth robot past patrols and cameras, hack terminals, operate machinery, and manipulate the environment to create your path. Then execute your plan and watch it play out. Every decision matters.

5255850.name: ネビュラスカイ クロッシング Demo
5255850.short_description: Nebula Sky Crossing is a game that blends 2D side-scrolling shooting—where you pilot a spaceship as a space trader—with station-based trading. Aim to conquer a galaxy filled with dangers such as pirates by mastering piloting skills and upgrades.

5066090.name: Piece and Quiet: A Stained Glass Restoration
5066090.short_description: A cozy first-person game about restoring stained glass. Brush dusty shards, match their shapes and colours, and bring light back to a mountain chapel. Unlock magical upgrades and rebuild six windows at your own pace, with no deadlines or penalties.

5277940.name: Purrfect Beats Demo
5277940.short_description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

4962110.name: Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents Demo
4962110.short_description: This is a Demo Version of Bloomvale: Bouquets & Scents, a cozy 2D game where you grow flowers, craft beautiful bouquets, and blend fragrant perfumes for your customers. A relaxing experience focused on gentle progression, creativity, and cozy daily routines. 🌸🌿

4678370.name: Red Echoes: Berlin Demo
4678370.short_description: Berlin 1918. Amidst the turmoil of the Great War, the fires of revolution burn. With the German Kaiser's reign rapidly coming to an end, lead a group of socialist revolutionaries and attempt to change the course of history. Will you succeed and bring about a better tomorrow?

4682280.name: Burger Bois Demo
4682280.short_description: Become Patty, the accidental owner of a failing food business. Craft tasty (or nasty) burgers, discover new ingredients, and work hard(ish) to redeem your reputation on the way to the best parking spot of all time. Play with your food in this cozy food truck simulator!

4817180.name: 我在地府打麻将：恼热狂欢
4817180.short_description: Demonic Mahjong's new DLC Heatwave Carnival turns sweltering hell into a fiery beach party! Meet 6 new characters, collect nearly 40 Figurines, explore new scenes, and use Scoring to turn tile patterns into rewards before winning a hand.

4183670.name: Shallow Pond Demo
4183670.short_description: Explore a cozy slice of Shallow Pond as you swim, jump, and uncover secrets in this playful 3D platformer.

3615330.name: Hillthorn Demo
3615330.short_description:
A disappearance in a secluded mountain.
A village hiding its secrets.
A detective running out of time.

Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

3454110.name: Starship Troopers: Terran Command - The Eradicators
3454110.short_description: This DLC features the first story campaign built entirely around Territory Mode mechanics: Capture and hold Territory Points. Unlock technologies, deploy new units, and construct defenses—all while fighting an Arachnid AI that adapts its behavior dynamically based on your decisions and performance.

798540.name: Dying Light Original Soundtrack
798540.short_description: Dying Light Original Soundtrack - Immerse yourself in the grim atmosphere of the quarantine zone thanks to the Dying Light soundtrack composed by Techland’s Paweł Błaszczak.

857350.name: CopperCube 6 Game Engine
857350.short_description: CopperCube is a full-featured 3D game engine. No programming needed! Create 3D games and apps quickly. Includes terrain editor, low poly modelling tools, 3D models, precreated game AI, effects and more.

4989340.name: Hive and Harvest
4989340.short_description: Death is dying, and five hives are fighting over the rot that's left. A trading card game about insects you grow from parts, a card at a time. Plant a parasite in an enemy creature, seed it with spores until it changes sides, or just break it and race your opponent to the pieces.

5308610.name: GIG: Specimen Quota
5308610.short_description: Explore abandoned facilities and meet the rescue quota. Form a squad of up to 4 players and save adorable specimens, each with a personality of its own. Careful! Not everything in there is adorable.

5009960.name: Where I am Not
5009960.short_description: A dark fantasy visual novel about memory, choice, and hidden connections. Uncover secrets, meet unusual companions, and discover how much of the world around you can truly be trusted.

4963640.name: Bad Pig House
4963640.short_description: A CRAZY HORROR GAME INSPIRED BY “THE THREE LITTLE PIGS”! GATHER RESOURCES, BUILD BEFORE SUNSET, AND SURVIVE THE NIGHT WITH THE WOLF!

5415560.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket
5415560.short_description: Eat your way through an entire supermarket! Start with snacks, earn money from everything you eat, and buy upgrades to eat faster and devour bigger things. Go from a bag of chips to entire shelves, fridges and even the checkouts. Can you eat the whole store?

4734680.name: Pilgrimage of the Fallen
4734680.short_description: Pilgrimage of the Fallen is an isometric 3D Zelda-like ARPG focused on dungeon exploration. Enter the shattered abyss: navigate multi-layered labyrinths, gather hidden relics to craft alchemical creations, and slay ancient tyrants in methodical, hard-hitting combat.

4993820.name: Out Of Order - A Vending Machine Roguelike Demo

4296960.name: VRCVideoCacher
4296960.short_description: VRCVideoCacher is a tool used to cache VRChat/Resonite videos to your local disk and/or fix YouTube videos from failing to load.

5307930.name: Pierrot Demo
5307930.short_description: Pierrot is a first-person psychological horror set in a twisted theater where a small puppet is trapped in its grasp. Violence is routine and you exist only to obey. Forced to harm others, Pierrot dreams of tearing his strings. Even as the curtain falls his role never ends.

3692020.name: Exodus Core
3692020.short_description: Exodus Core is a hard turn-based tactical game with a dark sci-fi apocalyptic atmosphere. Take control of three massive mechs with the digitized personalities of soldiers and face a Swarm of thinking monsters from the dark. Can you win a hopeless battle?

3825360.name: Zombie Panic!
3825360.short_description: Zombie Panic! was an old prototype survival-horror cooperative Half-Life 1 modification, first released back on Oct 31, 2004 as a beta via ModDB and now re-released officially on Steam for free!

3970080.name: Zombies Hate to Die
3970080.short_description: Precise character slashing, scavenge resources along the way, and upgrade absurd gear. In this Roguelite loop, every escape is a brand-new journey.

5485490.name: Eat Everything in a Supermarket Demo

4932300.name: Lust Tap
4932300.short_description: Lust Tap — cinematic 3D adult clicker. Fill the bar, keep the rhythm, and unlock every scene. Easy to start. Hard to put down.

5434030.name: Frontier: Path of Shadows - Quest and Equipment Pack
5434030.short_description: 12 new weapons, 2 new abilities, and 5 new quests for Frontier: Path of Shadows.

5472960.name: Northgrave County
5472960.short_description: Northgrave County is a third-person multiplayer zombie survival game. Scavenge a 20 x 20 km county, craft from over 450 items, fortify a safehouse, farm, drive and fight for every day on persistent dedicated servers, alone or with friends.

5140550.name: Extravalence
5140550.short_description: Lead a party of living chemical elements through a fractured world where every bond changes the battle. Switch between unique heroes, combine their abilities, manage volatile reactions and restore the stability.

5303460.name: Enamelist: Tidy Up the Pin Collection
5303460.short_description: Enamelist is a cozy tidy-up simulator where you organize over 2,000 unique enamel pins into themed sets on pin boards. Enjoy beautiful artwork as you place each pin back where it belongs.

3119670.name: XEN
3119670.short_description: XEN is a fantasy action game where speed is power.

4212040.name: RoboFarm Demo
4212040.short_description: Build, automate, and decorate your dream farm! Deploy robot workers, unlock powerful upgrades, and watch your crops thrive while you relax, raising profits to your satisfaction. Save and share your creations, tune in with the music, and experience the world of RoboFarm.

5234840.name: 地牢里的圣女不干活
5234840.short_description: In a world overrun by goblins and vampires, you play a knight leading your personal maid-knight order into a goblin dungeon to rescue a saintess in peril, and meet all kinds of adventurers at the tavern. A light, easy roguelike survival tower defense.

4815560.name: Dustpine District
4815560.short_description: Explore and restore a strange forest town while collecting lost items along the way. Check off tasks, fill your home with treasures, meet your new neighbors and uncover Dustpine District's cosmic past!

5429220.name: One Hit Hero Demo
5429220.short_description: One Hit Hero is a boss-rush action game where any hit is fatal, for you and your foes alike. Read attack patterns, block, parry, and dodge to build the power to slay each boss with one decisive strike. Trapped in a sealed dungeon, you must prove yourself by defeating every boss to earn your escape.

2843720.name: Seagulls - Crappy Situation
2843720.short_description: Defend a barely-floating raft in a chaotic solo or local co-op action rogue-lite. Shoot deranged seagulls, scrub the deck, dive for scrap, patch the damage, and buy questionable upgrades before the next wave ruins everything.

4389800.name: Adrift: Survival
4389800.short_description: Adrift is a survival adventure set in a flooded world, where storms, scarcity, and the open ocean shape every choice you make while building a life afloat.

2409460.name: SlimeTenPuzzle
2409460.short_description: Create “10” for a quick, satisfying win in Slime Ten Puzzle, a relaxing brain-training game! Combine four number slimes using +, −, ×, and ÷ to make 10. Enjoy cute slimes while sharpening your mind, with adjustable rules for multiplication, division, negatives, and fractions.

2167400.name: The Mixer
2167400.short_description: The Mixer is a unique take on a rhythm-driven rogue-lite where you create your own custom soundtrack by mixing-and-matching different music loops. Wield your own beat to conquer a dungeon full of rhythmic dangers.

3604040.name: Occult Trap
3604040.short_description:
Within the test chambers filled with horrific traps and unidentified creatures,
you must analyze the creatures’ behavior patterns and use the environment to escape their relentless pursuit.
Search the surroundings to gather items, disable or exploit traps, and forge your path forward.

5429290.name: No more needles
5429290.short_description:
Thousands of people searched haystacks on their farms for needles—and apparently, not carefully enough. 
Now the needles they missed have entered the supply chain. Inspect the bales and stop them before they reach the customers.
Every needle must be removed. Except one very special needle…

4518270.name: Mad Ever After
4518270.short_description:
Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike
FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs,
combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted
fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

4967490.name: Catalyst Core
4967490.short_description: A grid-based roguelike deckbuilder where every move sets up your next reaction. Build your deck, collect Elemental Cores and chain powerful elemental combos to defeat your enemies.

2245130.name: Handshakes: Hands On
2245130.short_description: Handshakes: Hands On is a wholesome puzzle game all about shaking hands. With puzzles designed to foster discovery and gently guide the player towards their own solution, you can play alone or with a friend and get your hands dirty in this simple and surprising puzzler.

3399660.name: Ant Mill Inc
3399660.short_description: Feed the nest. Grow the swarm. Devour the world. A dark incremental ant colony game where one ant becomes thousands. Gather food, upgrade the nest, uncover strange offerings, and fight for survival. Face the HUNGER - or become it...

5419960.name: Cuby Clicker Soundtrack
5419960.short_description: Eleven electronic tracks to accompany you through Cuby Clicker, from your first clicks to the most advanced Ascensions. An arcade-inspired soundtrack packed with synths, driving rhythms, and neon atmosphere.

4780520.name: MaMills
4780520.short_description: The 3D four-in-a-row game I played with my grandmother - now in a digital form. You can outsmart the Machine across five difficulties, solve 40 one-solution puzzles, or challenge a friend on the couch, over LAN or with Steam Remote Play Together.

5428660.name: Time Travelers: Late Ming
5428660.short_description: Lead a group of modern-day time travelers in Hainan, China, in 1629. Build industry, develop technology, shape government, and command armies and fleets. Trade between two eras, forge alliances or wage war, and reshape the fate of the late Ming dynasty.

4106970.name: Tax Return
4106970.short_description: If the suits at the SRI think they can fleece people's taxes, they'd better watch out for the wolf. Join Swindling Steve as you take back your hard-earned money from the SRI's collectors, but watch out for the high rollers behind the scenes.

4563610.name: 悪徳受付嬢エリナ 体験版
4563610.short_description: A receptionist simulation set in a medieval fantasy Adventurers’ Guild, where you review documents and process rewards. To pay for your sick sister’s medicine, will you work honestly—or turn to bribery and embezzlement? Your paperwork and choices will shape Elina’s fate.

5236670.name: COILBREAKER
5236670.short_description: A survivor roguelite where you steer a scrap-metal snake through hordes of machines. Its weapons fire on their own, and where they sit on the head, body or tail changes how they fire.

4982360.name: Brutal Magic Demo
4982360.short_description: BRUTAL MAGIC Fight in fast-paced magic battles where every spell matters. Brutal Magic is a PvP magic combat game where you battle other mages using powerful elemental spells. Fight against AI, challenge your friends in local split-screen and test your skills in one-on-one duels.

4620950.name: XENOFLEKT
4620950.short_description:
XENOFLEKT is a roguelite space shooter where you will turn enemy bullets into your weapons: dash into enemy fire to parry and deflect shots, heal your ship, trigger devastating counter-attacks. 
Unlock parts, plug-in unique perks with satellites, and get ready to master hundreds of deadly synergies.

5369730.name: Karaoke Fails
5369730.short_description: Sing your heart out and fail spectacularly! Karaoke Fails is an online party game for 2–6 friends: take the stage, belt out short songs, and survive a flood of emoji reactions, flying tomatoes and sneaky sabotage. Your friends rate you 1–5. Good luck!

3896980.name: Campsite Architect
3896980.short_description: Build and manage a seaside holiday park. From a simple campground with a bar to luxurious bungalows with a restaurant: you decide what your park looks like. You play as the owner and walk around the park yourself. Every guest and staff member has their own personality, needs and preferences.

3464710.name: Tiny Bomber
3464710.short_description: Survive the countdown in a fast-paced vertical bullet-hell roguelite. Collect coins to extend your run, graze bullets for aircraft-specific boosts, build wild upgrade combos, turn defeated bosses into companion drones, tweak map spawns, and team up in 2-player co-op to push toward the final boss!

5465840.name: Tumble Kart
5465840.short_description: A cartoon kart racer where wipeouts are the highlight. Drift for boosts, trade toy items with rivals, tumble through chain-reaction pile-ups and hunt secret routes across 16 tracks. Race online with bots filling empty seats, or split-screen with up to 4 players on one PC.

5441800.name: Hentai Mayhem : Storymode
5441800.short_description: Cross into my realm, knight. Story Mode drags Hentai Mayhem through the Abyssal Realm: hand-built chapters, real loot, queens who bite back, and me, Lilith, waiting on the Crimson Throne. Break us, and every one of us unlocks her scene.

4987230.name: Melodan
4987230.short_description: Command mythical legions to victory in a fantasy auto-battler where every placement matters. Draft your troops, unlock magical upgrades, set your formations, and let the battle begin. Pure strategy, no clickfest. Prove your brilliance in 1v1 and 2v2 matches, or survive the escalating Co-op Horde.

3917570.name: When The Sun Dies
3917570.short_description: When the Sun Dies is an open-world survival game set in a mysterious post-apocalyptic world, where players explore deadly biomes, survive radiation storms, and upgrade their weapons to face what lies beyond the fog.

3994770.name: 真男人修仙 Demo
3994770.short_description: A college student suddenly found himself transported to a world of cultivation, but due to an oversubscription of “human slots,” he was transformed into a katydid. He was then taken in as a spirit pet by an elder of the Celestial Divinity Sect. Because he was male, he was named “Guo Nan.”

3957900.name: A Day with Wuki
3957900.short_description: Wuki is a real cat, and today the whole neighborhood is his. Slip through open windows, push mugs off tables, hunt mice, complete little cat mischief in every house and collect polaroids of the real Wuki. Or just nap in the sun.

5191630.name: Coin Maker Simulator Demo
5191630.short_description: Enjoy the crafting process in this immersive, relaxing simulator about making money, literally. You've been locked in a dungeon, and your only way to freedom is to craft coins for the King!

3730390.name: It Happened At Night - A New Nightmare Demo
3730390.short_description: While working at a remote site deep in the woods, Chloe becomes entangled in a disturbing mystery that leads her into something far more terrifying than she could have imagined.

4465410.name: MMA Career Simulator
4465410.short_description: Create your MMA fighter, develop their skills, build winning game plans, and promote yourself to a global MMA superstar. Every fight is simulated based on your preparation and in-fight decisions, where smart choices can mean the difference between victory and defeat.

5079620.name: Potions Galore
5079620.short_description: A slow-paced, cozy sorting game, where you organize 2900+ potions in a fantasy alchemy shop. Read the book to learn about each new potion. Use narrative deduction to find the correct placement and tidy up the mess with no power-ups!

4944200.name: Diamonds and Spades
4944200.short_description: Create your own cards and share them with friends in this roguelite card game! Discover powerful combos, collect unique Tarot cards with special abilities, and push your luck to achieve absurdly high scores!

4461260.name: Ball Bugz
4461260.short_description: Ball Bugs is an incremental defense game where you start with a single persistent ball and build up an arsenal of ball firing turrets, artillery and special ball types. Bounce, splat, upgrade and come back stronger until the bugs stop getting through.

5033270.name: Five Signals
5033270.short_description: Your wife is dead, but you can hear her voice on the phone. Follow the coordinates, explore abandoned locations, answer calls from the phone booth, and make your way deeper and deeper into the abyss. Every new call brings you closer to the truth... but you may not be ready to hear it.

3231540.name: FaceTrack
3231540.short_description: Capture facial animations via webcam, video, or audio files for your games, animations, VFX, and others creative works!

3990610.name: Escape Path
3990610.short_description: Navigate through complex non-linear mazes dotted with traps, enemies and unique mechanics to rebuild a protective crystal. Watch and think, because rushing in headfirst will lead you to death! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?

4866390.name: Smawverse Demo
4866390.short_description: A dark fantasy bullet heaven built in Unreal Engine 5. You are a stray cat reforged in iron: kneel to four prophets, stack their blessings until one cat clears the screen, survive streets laid out differently every run, and summon the different bosses to upgrade your spells and gear.

5057340.name: Aquarium Days
5057340.short_description: Aquarium Days is a cozy fish-collecting game with 60 adorable species, 117 appearances, and 18 aquarium scenes. Keep your aquarium in a small window on your desktop, or set it as an animated wallpaper.

4640450.name: Smawverse
4640450.short_description: Cut down the risen dead in this dark fantasy bullet-heaven roguelike. You are Smaw, a stray cat reforged in iron to take back a kingdom unmade by its own keeper. Kneel at nine prophet shrines and stack their blessings into screen-clearing builds. How long can you last?

5220250.name: FaceTrack Demo
5220250.short_description: Capture facial animations via webcam, video, or audio files for your games, animations, VFX, and others creative works!

5421570.name: In for a Penny, In for a Pound
5421570.short_description: Fight through procedurally generated dungeons in an isometric pixel-art action roguelite. Wield firearms, battle enemies in darkness around you, and make different builds with upgrade cards system to reach your best chance of survival. Every floor raises the stakes. How deep can you go?

5121680.name: 火箭工厂 Rocket Factory Demo

5472570.name: Horny Asylum :  The Undercroft
5472570.short_description: New posting: night guard in the flooded cells under the asylum. Watch the cameras, slam the doors, the floor trap and the pipe, and keep the battery alive until 6 AM. If an inmate reaches the booth, she takes her time with you. Make it to morning and you pick who clocks out with you.

4689370.name: Beast Bastion
4689370.short_description: A Roguelite auto-chess tower defense game. Recruit unique units, combine them with towers, and build synergies and builds. Defeat bosses to recruit them into your legion, and craft your ultimate roster through randomly generated runs.

2887810.name: Sentinel Trials
2887810.short_description: Classic round based zombie survival game inspired by old school gameplay. Complete Trials, unlock weapons and perks, then hold your ground against the undead.

5079170.name: 火箭工厂 Rocket Factory
5079170.short_description: Roctket Factory is an incremental game with factory building elements. Players will build machines, manage workers, build assembly lines, and expand their factories in the game until they build rockets and move towards the next destination.

5196220.name: DATE_SIMULATOR.EXE
5196220.short_description:
Go on three exclusive dates with charming girls! Enjoy their company and the cozy moments you share.  
Lost media. This game is not suitable for children or those who are easily disturbed.

4137850.name: Ryze
4137850.short_description: Ryze is an unforgiving, quirky, 2D platformer. Throw yourself to the top, past challenging and diverse biomes. But beware one misstep and the loss may turn out to be high... or low depending on perspective.

5243280.name: A Game About Picking Fruits
5243280.short_description:
Picking apples, eating berries - remember those summer days?
Maybe you did it as a summer job, or helped out in Grandpa's orchard. Now you can go back and relive those days. Pick dozens of different fruits, berries, and grapes, and pack them into boxes.

4832540.name: MultiScope Air Traffic Control
4832540.short_description: Take control of the skies. MultiScope Air Traffic Control is a realistic approach radar simulator where you vector arrivals, sequence approaches and keep them separated from your departures. Use your own voice or the input panels, with pilot readbacks over simulated VHF radio.

4922230.name: 拯救餐厅
4922230.short_description: A fast-paced roguelite restaurant management game! 30days.$1,000,000. Save the restaurant! Build your restaurant, upgrade recipes, hire staff, and create powerful combos. Every run brings new chefs, recipes, and items. Discover hidden synergies, master different strategies, unlock multiple endings!

5040850.name: Stay in Your Lane
5040850.short_description: A side-scrolling real-time strategy game inspired by Age of War and Swords & Soldiers. Mine gold, research your tech tree, summon idiom-powered units that march and fight on their own, and cast spells to turn the tide. Story campaign, puzzle challenges, and online 1v1 and 2v2.

5348940.name: Exo7
5348940.short_description: Build your interstellar empire in Exo7! Colonize new worlds, extract Metal, Silicium, Tridioxid, and Antimatter, build mighty fleets, and explore hyperspace. Choose your faction, conquer raids and bounty hunts, and dominate Sector 7!

5464560.name: HordeNight
5464560.short_description: Coyote City, 1996. The Z virus got out. Nobody else did. Survive nine waves and a boss on five haunted maps in a gory first-person horde shooter: blow the dead apart limb by limb, burn them with a flamethrower, and kill the Necromancer before it raises them again.

4238320.name: GameJam 水群模拟器
4238320.short_description: A story-driven game featuring Chinese-style group chat simulation + Game Jam Survival Guide. You will join an online group and experience the full 21-day game development competition: teaming up, arguing, teammates ghosting, and more. It truly captures the laughter and struggles of indie developers.

5405080.name: Rimfarers
5405080.short_description: A classic turn-based space RPG. Trade between the worlds of five races, take on jobs, hunt pirates, rise in the fleet reserves and play dozens of text quests — while the Silence creeps in from the edge of the galaxy.

4844090.name: Suits of Fantasia
4844090.short_description: A card-battle RPG built on the "trail game": keep playing cards as long as they connect by suit or number, mixed with poker-hand bonuses. Peek at the deck, reorder fate, sneak in a Joker—bend your luck and chase the 52-card Perfect Chain. A comic fantasy quest with a heartfelt ending.

4391880.name: Bounty Monster Trucks
4391880.short_description: Bounty Monster Truck is the game true fans have been waiting for. Design your own Monster Trucks, Make your own tracks in Arenas or Stadiums, including racing and freestyle modes, and many different truck bodies to choose from!

5111590.name: Unlucky Swordsmith
5111590.short_description: Hammer your swords, take on increasingly risky upgrades, and sell your successful creations for profit in this casual swordsmithing game. Failed upgrades shatter your sword, but even the broken scraps can be recycled to improve your forge.

4298200.name: The Caretakers
4298200.short_description: Infiltrate contaminated residences and deal with their mutant pests using the most advanced tech of the 1960s. Set up a base and observe, probe, and most importantly, survive the grotesque creatures in this online co-op horror game.

5088570.name: Jewelmix
5088570.short_description: The classics reimagined! Rearrange and stack falling multicolored columns to align three matching jewels. Test your speed and reflexes to beat the high score and unlock all 60 achievements!

1973210.name: CourseCraze
1973210.short_description: Hover at high speed through loops, halfpipes and wall rides. Chase gold medals, hunt your own ghost, build tracks, share them on the Workshop.

5100020.name: Horde Up Ahead: Survivors TD
5100020.short_description: Tower Defense against massive zombie hordes. Build turrets, defend your tower, and discover roguelite and survivor-like progression.

3698370.name: Knockout Master 2
3698370.short_description: Knockout Master 2 is a choice-driven adult visual novel where you continue your journey as a boxer aiming for the world heavyweight title. The game is packed with sex, romance, drama, and a rich story.

5471970.name: Rubber Stamp Legend
5471970.short_description:
An endless pile of paperwork is waiting for your approval stamp.
Reject shameless "business expenses," outwork your rivals, and from New Hire to Chairman, work until the day you die!

5480890.name: Mayday Airways Demo
5480890.short_description: A 1-4 player co-op airline comedy. Run a tiny island airline with your friends, keep a falling-apart plane in the air, fix it mid-flight and keep a full cabin of passengers happy. Or at least alive.

5331970.name: Last Chance Hurling
5331970.short_description: Hurling with the swing in your hands. Load the stick, drive through the ball, and take whatever strike the defender leaves you: a full swing with time, a jabbed snap under pressure. Fifteen a side, fast and readable. Then let the video review decide whether it was a point.

3377240.name: Slurdle
3377240.short_description: Slurdle is my first game, a collection of six word games for solo play and online multiplayer. Guess words, build them from tiles, search letter grids, spin through phrase puzzles, and add custom packs when you want something new.

4248270.name: Letters Past
4248270.short_description: Play as a postman delivering a letter over a quiet mountain path. See the sights, journal your observations, discover secrets and piece together a story you can't experience all at once.

4739480.name: Homeless Kiosk Simulator
4739480.short_description: You work the night shift inside a small aid booth. People arrive at your window asking for help. Food. Water. Medicine. Sometimes… things that don’t belong in a donation box. Every box you prepare makes the night worse.

5423480.name: Slime, Get out!
5423480.short_description: Slime, Get out! is a fast-paced action roguelite where you battle waves of monsters, collect weapons and upgrades, and create powerful builds. Choose your hero, survive increasingly dangerous enemies, and defeat challenging bosses!

4062130.name: Grimoire of Monsters
4062130.short_description: Co-op bullet heaven for 1-5 players with a twist: one player controls the monsters. Survive the hordes together, or become the Grimoire Master, spawn the swarm, and turn the bosses on your friends. Which side are you on?

3919900.name: Dead Zone Revive
3919900.short_description:
Fight, rebuild, and survive in a zombie apocalypse!
Lead your team in real-time missions, gather weapons, gear, and supplies, and defend your base with tactical RPG and strategy gameplay.

5386780.name: Clanker Buster
5386780.short_description: Build an armed truck, wire your weapons and command your crew in this action roguelike. Raid machine-controlled ruins for supplies and survivors, bring them back to humanity’s last settlement, and unlock permanent abilities for your next expedition.

4750710.name: Terraclysm Survivors Demo
4750710.short_description: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 4 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

4852660.name: Rebirth: Denied Protocol Demo
4852660.short_description: Trapped inside a failed resurrection experiment, a cop must survive grotesque creatures and uncover the truth behind a mad doctor’s obsession in this PS1-style survival horror with fixed cameras and tank controls.

4971440.name: Venison County Demo
4971440.short_description: Grab your sawed-off, cast some sigils, and face the never ending nightmare head on in Venison County. Blast your old neighbors into undead venison giblets, master weapon specific active reloads, and limitlessly combine slain cultists' sigils for their sinful buffs (if you can withstand God's wrath).

4478600.name: How To Destroy A City Demo
4478600.short_description: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

4486370.name: Banana Life Sim
4486370.short_description: Banana Life Sim is a game in which you can become a banana.

4575480.name: 规则怪谈 Demo
4575480.short_description:
Tick tock... Night shift begins.
Welcome to the world of Rules Kaidan. As you complete your tasks, remember the rules of each world at all costs. Never violate the taboos - it's your only way to survive.

4577330.name: Above the Immortality Realm 九界之上 Demo
4577330.short_description: Mo Sheng is an ordinary cultivator who was often bullied and could never surpass the favored genius, Xiao Tianyu. After obtaining an ancient artifact that steals fortune, he swears revenge—taking the women around Xiao Tianyu and seizing his destiny to rise as the supreme ruler. (DEMO)

4650540.name: Dino Epoch: Fantasy Tale Demo
4650540.short_description: 《Dino Epoch Fantasy Tale》A boy who chases mythical beasts in ring-toss adventures explores a brand-new world of fantasy creatures, awakens dormant unknown powers, captures companions across the uncharted realm, uncovers the technological secrets of this fantasy world, builds an ideal homeland.

4335770.name: Loss Prevention Demo
4335770.short_description: Loss Prevention is a social deduction game where you can shoplift your local grocery store with up to five friends. Experience the joy of petty crime as a shoplifter, or keep your eyes peeled for suspicious activity as the shopkeeper. Can you grab all the items on the shopping list?

1302540.name: Diamond Giza
1302540.short_description: Run through the pyramids and grab everything shiny! Explore the mazes and rob the pharoahs and your friends in massive couch co-op mayhem!

3629540.name: Trucker Joe 2 Demo
3629540.short_description: As Trucker Joe, you take control of your own freight company, buying trucks and a wide range of trailers to keep the companies’ supply chains running smoothly! Place the companies strategically on your map to avoid long hauls!

3473210.name: Family Manners
3473210.short_description: Light caresses every corner of the home, and the clock marks the first heartbeats of the morning. It’s just another typical day in the wonderful life of the Evans family… right?

3768800.name: Shopska Salad
3768800.short_description: Defend your grandmother's salad from Bulgarian folk monsters in a first-person tower defense game. Set traps by day, then grab your shotgun to stop anything that gets through at night. Keep the salad fresh for seven nights, solo or with friends.

2778890.name: DCS: Kola Map by Orbx
2778890.short_description: Orbx proudly presents the DCS: Kola map, which covers northern Norway, Sweden, Finland, and the Russian Murmansk Oblast and parts of the Karelia region.

2677570.name: Railway Empire 2 - India
2677570.short_description: Revel in the abundance of colours and the enchanting landscape: Railway Empire 2 – India whisks you into a gorgeous new era. Discover vast, vibrant plains, roaming elephants and bustling mega-cities, all waiting to be transformed by the blessings of the railroad.

2353721.name: SnowRunner - Kenworth W990
2353721.short_description:
Expand your SnowRunner garage with the 2023 Kenworth W990!

This Heavy-class truck brings superior on-road capabilities thanks to its retractable axle and superior fuel capacity.

The Kenworth W990 is not included in the Year 1, Year 2 or Year 3 Pass.

1585813.name: SnowRunner - Season 6: Haul & Hustle
1585813.short_description:
This product is included in SnowRunner - Year 2 Pass.

Explore wild new territories in SnowRunner’s Season 6: Haul & Hustle. Conquer two huge maps with two tough new vehicles as you establish a forestry base deep in the cold wilderness of Maine, USA.

920566.name: Resident Evil 2 - Claire Costume: 98'
920566.short_description:
