Change Claire Redfield's appearance to her original 1998 low-polygon visual look for true nostalgia.

*This can be accessed from the "Costume" menu.

3549030.name: Heavensmith: Dungeon Unbound
3549030.short_description: Explore dungeons in a single-player, turn-based RPG. Learn skills across classes, craft gear with your choice of materials, and lead a party of up to five against bosses. Develop your village and build bonds with your companions.

5353370.name: Animal Farm
5353370.short_description: A colorful online farm game about growing up and protecting others. Hatch from an egg or be born as a kitten or puppy, grow with players around the world, and become a guardian who protects the little ones on the farm.

5089480.name: 2027 毕业生工作
5089480.short_description:
Where should the Class of 2027 go?
(This game is only in Simplified Chinese)

4810350.name: Medusa's Gaze
4810350.short_description: Every death leaves behind a petrified statue of yourself - can you use this to outwit Medusa? A new mind-bending first-person 3D puzzle-platformer adventure game involving light & shadow, life & death.

5424220.name: Backpack Dungeon Delver
5424220.short_description: A challenging dungeon crawler with backpack management and turn-based combat. Fuse components to build powerful combos. From rats to demon lords, how deep can you go? Still in graybox, but already great fun!

4487950.name: Luditect: Game Design Tool
4487950.short_description: Architect your game's soul with Luditect. A professional, node-based workspace designed for game, level, and narrative design. Visualize complex branching stories, manage RPG variables, and centralize your mechanics in one unified environment. Everything you need for game design is here.

3620860.name: Kung Fu Addiction
3620860.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

5400540.name: Kinhenge
5400540.short_description: You don't play a hero, you play a bloodline. Kinhenge is an online survival game that starts in the Stone Age: survive hunger, cold and rain, raise heirs and share a living island with NPCs who have a trade, remember what they live through and build villages of their own.

3730640.name: Kung Fu Addiction Demo
3730640.short_description: An auto-battler RPG where anticipation is everything. Predict your enemies' moves, shape your hero's progression, and channel the souls of ancient warriors to resurrect with a new fighting style as you overcome escalating challenges across multiple combat modes.

4967580.name: Battle Bot Tactics
4967580.short_description: An asynchronous PvP bot-building inventory management auto-battler. Build the perfect bot squad and send them to the arena to battle it out!

2918660.name: Agama versus Bugs
2918660.short_description: Meet the ever-hungry bearded dragon. However, in pursuit of her next meal, she must watch out for various traps and obstacles lurking in the terrarium. Who will win in this adventure? an ever-hungry lizard or crunchy bugs?

4452890.name: Caution Ahead: Part 3
4452890.short_description: Descend into darkness as John, a search and rescue officer, reaches the final destination of his journey. Explore claustrophobic mines in this horror experience that blends atmospheric exploration with stealth-based survival.

5234740.name: Fantasy Auction House
5234740.short_description: Start with 10 gold and trade in 1100 items, from equipment and materials to pets and mounts. Find bargains, set your prices and collect the proceeds. In this single-player trading game, deal with the town's merchants, restock and expand your bags as your business grows.

5461740.name: 地狱回廊 Infernal Corridor
5461740.short_description: An incremental roguelite with automatic, real-time card combat. Carry your flame through the corridors of hell, slay demons and claim your revenge.

5425070.name: 幸运闯魔城 Luck & Doom
5425070.short_description: Your hero stands at the center. Turn the world around them and shape their fate! Build your piece pool, rearrange tiles, collect gear and develop your hero. Every turn costs time. Find your chance to win amid the chaos of fate before the demon lord arrives.

5432760.name: Tiny Worlds: 3D Nonograms
5432760.short_description: Tiny Worlds 3D Nonograms is a relaxing puzzle game. Paint and remove blocks to uncover a little sculpture and step-by-step reveal beautiful dioramas. Take your time to explore varied environments and solve even the most challenging puzzles.

4637020.name: Cubalance
4637020.short_description: In this physics-based puzzler, color matching is only half the battle. Balance scales or launch cubes across the screen with weight-shifting chain reactions. Do you think you’re a master of logic? Meet Gravity. Let’s see how you handle the pressure when the floor starts tipping.

1902860.name: Light Odyssey
1902860.short_description: Light Odyssey is a soulslike boss rush where every battle is a test of mastery. Play as Bandi and fight to restore light to a world consumed by shadows. Face off against towering colossi in three deadly phases that demand precision, patience, and adaptation.

2380330.name: Lethal Justice
2380330.short_description: Restore order in this dystopian city of the future where your choices determine whether you gain the upper hand or succumb to the streets. Fight waves of criminals, mutants and cyborgs while upgrading your firepower. You are outnumbered, not outgunned.

5423780.name: 跑灯魔王 Lamp Demon
5423780.short_description: Recruit monsters, configure your skill pools, and start the chasing lights with one click. Light effects illuminate the board as monsters attack in succession. Defend the Demon Heart against wave after wave of heroes.

4798590.name: Brutal Magic
4798590.short_description: Master devastating elemental magic in this fast-paced third-person fighting game. Chain explosive spells, outplay your opponent, and unleash spectacular magical combat in a visually stunning fantasy world. 1v1 duels where one hit ends the round.

5390410.name: Ritual Break Demo
5390410.short_description: Ritual Break is a co-op boss rush bullet hell where two heroes combine their abilities, manipulate enemy attacks, and face colossal demonic bosses within an ancient ritual arena.

5215220.name: Grimli & Friends
5215220.short_description: A fun, goofy bullet heaven for wonderful people. Play solo, team up with up to 3 friends in online co-op, or fight them in 4-player Horde War. Horde survival, tower defense, and roguelike advancement.

4551420.name: SHOTRUN
4551420.short_description: One shot. One kill. SHOTRUN throws you into a brutal office nightmare where only the fastest survive. Blast your way through and reach The Manager at any cost.

5002190.name: Fly&Goal
5002190.short_description: A casual puzzle game where you play disc golf while navigating holes that showcase the changing seasons. Read the wind to choose your throw, dodge obstacles, and aim to clear all 12 courses, each with 9 holes.

4501970.name: PAC-SIDE
4501970.short_description: PAC-SIDE is a fast-paced pacman-based horror game, where you can meet your old yellow friend! Wait.. It looks like something bad happened with him..

3563470.name: RAEV
3563470.short_description: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.

4509390.name: ◒ Mini Motion Animator
4509390.short_description: A very simple tool for creating little bitmap animations, and even short interactive experiences. Share your masterpieces to the workshop to get feedback.

4481760.name: Stones
4481760.short_description: Stones is a match-3 game about cutting gems. Swap to line up four for a blast, five for a prismatic that clears a whole colour, and chain cascades for the score. Thirty moves is all you get, but big play buys them back. One shared board a day, and eight finishes to earn.

4302300.name: Empire Water Works
4302300.short_description: Empire Water Works is a steam engine simulator based in a water pumping station. Operate and maintain your pumping station day and night, maintain city water pressure and fulfill contracts. Interact with realistic steam, coal-firing, and audio simulation in a vintage setting.

4265140.name: Beat Weaver
4265140.short_description: 3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

4507880.name: Echoes of Elpis Demo
4507880.short_description: Echoes of Elpis is a twin-stick shooter sci-fi roguelike. Upgrade weapons, discover new tech, and uncover a secret past as you battle through Elpis on an epic treasure hunt.

910550.name: MONO CHAMELEON
910550.short_description: Hide-and-seek, tag AND prop hunt on a retro handheld-style screen in four monochrome shades. PAINT yourself into the walls, disguise as a prop, or hunt with the catch-gun. 2–10 players, 5 modes, bots. Streaming? Up to 239 viewers watch from the audience seats and vote.

2884720.name: Echoes of Elpis
2884720.short_description: Echoes of Elpis is a twin-stick shooter sci-fi roguelike. Upgrade weapons, discover new tech, and uncover a secret past as you battle through Elpis on an epic treasure hunt.

4940910.name: Happy Little Farm Demo
4940910.short_description:
Happy Little Farm is a cozy incremental farming game where you grow a small, happy farm with cute animals. Plant crops, care for animals, and enjoy peaceful days.

However, after the sun goes down, it may be best not to check whether the animals are truly happy.

4484440.name: BLOODY RAVE
4484440.short_description: The rave is live. The vampires are real. Survive the night… if you can.

4487360.name: Spinova
4487360.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with slot-machine mechanics set in a world of Slavic mythology. Build and upgrade your symbols, summon Ancients, swear oaths and choose blessings to squeeze insane multipliers out of every spin and push further with each new run

4455180.name: Marble Machina
4455180.short_description:
You wake up in a surreal factory with no memory of how you arrived. Punch cards operate strange machines, floors rise and fall beneath your feet, and teleporters lead who knows where.

You’re fairly sure you haven’t gone mad.

Still, just to be safe, you’d better collect all your marbles.

5313910.name: 暗黑深井 Demo
5313910.short_description: Dark Well is a platformer deck-building roguelike. Every weapon brings its own skill cards — adjust your loadout to shape your deck. Craft gems with wild affixes to empower your cards. Use cards to move, take the angle, dodge the killing blow. Keep going down and explore the sunless depths!

5318020.name: Time Travel Is No Picnic - Playtest

3843190.name: PinUp Archery
3843190.short_description: Stick rubber suction-cup arrows on pinup posters in this simple relaxing comedy archery game. Earn your cupid wings! Read the wind, land the hot spots, chain combos and unlock every Girl of the Month. Made with love by a solo developer.

5134390.name: The Song Must Go On
5134390.short_description: The Song Must Go On is a 1–4 player co-op rhythm platformer. Climb deadly towers, dodge brutal traps, and perform your part of a shared song. Keep the music alive, or the entire band pays the price.

5352070.name: BOP&POP Demo
5352070.short_description: 《BOP&POP》is a satisfying roguelike that blends blind-box matching with deckbuilding. Hatch mysterious eggs, collect cute and powerful Slimes, and pull off Pairs, Triples, Full House, and Board Clears on a 3×3 board. Build your run, multiply your Slimes, and overwhelm BOSSes!

4055030.name: Red Moon Cafe
4055030.short_description: Red Moon Cafe is a story-driven barista sim set in a rough Russian neighborhood. Survive on your paycheck, manage the protagonist's well-being, and save for the essentials. The authentic city and lifelike NPCs are so detailed that the atmosphere and daily grind feel almost like real life.

5194230.name: Feral Eyes
5194230.short_description: A lone feline bounty hunter brings law and order to a frontier town in order to buy back a treasured heirloom.

4741270.name: Happy Little Farm
4741270.short_description:
Happy Little Farm is a cozy incremental farming game where you grow a small, happy farm with cute animals. Plant crops, care for animals, and enjoy peaceful days.

However, after the sun goes down, it may be best not to check whether the animals are truly happy.

4880560.name: Unclaimed
4880560.short_description: It's 1991. You work alone on the night shift at a remote cargo facility. As you sort shipments and complete your tasks, unexplained noises from the hallways, strange images appearing on security cameras, and a growing sense of unease begin to turn your shift into a nightmare.

4925920.name: 獸化論
4925920.short_description: 一款以劇情與系統設計並重的 HD-2D 回合制角色扮演遊戲，核心機制圍繞在碎片與RE 同步率之間風險交換型的戰鬥。 故事背景為人類於南極發現未知能源「碎片」並導入文明體系，大幅推動自動化與效率至上的社會結構，卻同時引發人類逐步獸化的副作用，大量因獸化而無法跟上時代步伐的人便成為被淘汰的一群人，在廢棄的車站建立自己的城市，就此將城市分為了上下層。 玩家扮演上層的研究人員，因摯友在黑市遭殺害而展開調查，並在過程中接觸下層的盜賊、獵人、警察與流浪科學家等派系。

4910160.name: Legend Dary Demo
4910160.short_description: A quirky retro platformer where an ordinary office worker sets out to win the princess's heart. Explore 70 stages across 3 unique worlds, collect keys and stars, earn coins, upgrade weapons, and unlock new characters.

5060000.name: Softwind
5060000.short_description: Unwind with friends, take on trials, and compete in responsive real-time battles. Softwind is a cozy 2.5D top-down action game with playful community spaces, elemental equipment builds, solo and co-op trials, PvP, and arcade soccer.

3674010.name: MULTIMATUM
3674010.short_description: MULTIMATUM is a fast-paced top-down shooter with roguelite elements about unfortunate multiworld adventurers, trapped in isolated worlds. Fight the protagonists’ tormenting past projections and return the blade of God to its owner in order to return home.

4432380.name: Tsuki Journey
4432380.short_description: A relaxing slice of life adventure game where Tsuki travels between beautiful cities, meets new friends, uncovers stories, and fills out collection logs at his own pace, combining cozy idle activities with short, meaningful bursts of progression.

3316080.name: Mine of despair
3316080.short_description: Sentenced to death, then pardoned... into a mining sentence. 1-8 player co-op with proximity voice: dig, pay the prison, come back up alive. You do not kill the monsters here: you understand them, or you die. And something down there blows out the torches, one by one.

4550090.name: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static
4550090.short_description: A horror game, where you found yourself trapped at your job. Leave the office. And remember - The Spider is watching.

5443730.name: 101号实验室 Demo
5443730.short_description: 101 Lab is a 2D roguelite survival game for 1–4 players. Battle monster hordes as adorable lab creatures, collect weapons, trigger elemental reactions, and unleash powerful skills. Gather resources, build your base, and set up defenses. Team up to take down mighty bosses and survive wave after wave.

4002670.name: Sime Returns
4002670.short_description:
Sime Returns is a quirky, darkly comedic action-adventure about a fisherman, his cats, and the island that decided it no longer likes him.
Rescue your cats from furious villagers, and unravel the mysteries lurking beneath the sunny shores of the Adriatic.

5431950.name: Somewhere, Together
5431950.short_description: A quiet refuge on your desktop, alone or with up to eight travelers. Keep a small, borderless window beside your work, or unwind in full screen. Rest by the fire, listen to nature, and create your own scenery. Free to play.

4372150.name: Thieves Guild Master
4372150.short_description: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

2988120.name: Never Be Alone
2988120.short_description: Never Be Alone is an open-world zombie survival game for solo play and seamless co-op. Explore a world reclaimed by nature, protect a fragile safezone, and uncover the truth behind your forgotten past 10 years after the outbreak.

3625230.name: Bloomcraft
3625230.short_description: Bloomcraft is a Garden Creation Simulator. The player's goal is to create a garden that pleases the Flower Queen. The more the Flower Queen likes the garden, the more money she pays for it every second.

5288630.name: Perfect Steel
5288630.short_description: Perfect Steel is a turn based strategy RPG inspired by SNES and PSX era classics. It features grid based combat, class system, world map and a story to explore.

2738170.name: Edge of Memories
2738170.short_description: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

5426410.name: Ranch Attack: Farmer on the Run
5426410.short_description: The goats are back and they have hired a bull. Grab, hurl, and outrun the herd in this updated version of Ranch Attack Classic: a fast, funny  arcade runner with two farmers, a barn full of unlockables, and the original prototype as a bonus.

4629050.name: Eric's Farm
4629050.short_description: Feed 'em... or get BONKED! Toss ridiculous snacks, dodge hangry animals and smash through ten chaotic days in a slapstick 3D farm game. Take on bosses, five minigames and Endless Mode, then unlock The Back Forty: grow crops, drive tractors and build your own farm.

5444540.name: Duskblade: The Caged Sun
5444540.short_description: A silhouette metroidvania. The Masked King raised his mask to the sky and caged the sun's heart; the world has lived at dusk ever since. As the last blade of a fallen Order, fight through 13 regions and 29 bosses with six evolving weapons, and decide what the morning is worth.

4664340.name: Sound of the Night
4664340.short_description: Own a nightclub and build it your way. Collect cash, design your space, manage your staff and reputation, and unlock new entertainment licenses to expand your business.

4716500.name: 中国棋牌博物馆
4716500.short_description: Welcome to Chinese Board & Card Games Museum. Step back into 1980s–90s China and play Dou Di Zhu, Guandan, Sichuan Mahjong, Ka Wu Xing, and more in 3D hometown scenes lit by your own clock. Practice against AI and rewind any move. Buy once, no ads.

4896010.name: Who Heckled?
4896010.short_description: Heckle, hide & hope you don't get caught. Who Heckled? is a 2-8 player online social deduction party game set in a comedy club. Sit among the crowd, heckle whoever's performing on stage with iconic memes, then blend back in. Get spotted and you're out. Grab your friends and figure out Who Heckled?

951840.name: Don't Save the Princess
951840.short_description: An anti-runner in which you control the obstacles instead of the runner. Strike, combo, and upgrade to finally earn the princess some personal time!

5246790.name: Condotta
5246790.short_description: Lead a fifteenth-century mercenary company in Condotta, a historical tactical roguelike. Hire fighters, command them in turn-based battles, and decide what trouble to take on as you travel. Fulfill your contract—and live to collect your pay.

5325940.name: Maker Circuit Demo
5325940.short_description: Learn Electronics Through Play! Build circuits, use LEDs, sensors, motors, and microcontrollers to solve engaging challenges in Maker Circuit. Test, make mistakes, improve your designs, and discover real-world electronics concepts through hands-on learning. Build. Experiment. Become a Maker.

4927070.name: Forged Cards
4927070.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where YOU forge the cards. Slot casts into molds, temper their power, and etch combo inscriptions. Pick your path, battle, bargain, or brave the unknown, then outplay your enemy in simultaneous, position-based combat. Each run is different and each deck yours.

5017760.name: Maker Circuit
5017760.short_description: Learn Electronics Through Play! Build circuits, use LEDs, sensors, motors, and microcontrollers to solve engaging challenges in Maker Circuit. Test, make mistakes, improve your designs, and discover real-world electronics concepts through hands-on learning. Build. Experiment. Become a Maker.

4618680.name: 异世界火锅店模拟器
4618680.short_description: Isekai Hotpot is a cozy hand-drawn restaurant sim. Plan the menu, haggle for ingredients, prep dishes and signature broths, then welcome fantasy guests through a lively dinner rush. Earn coins, read the night's results, and return tomorrow to turn your tiny shop into the village favorite.

3978510.name: Chained Beasts Demo
3978510.short_description: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelite. Fight chaotic battles in the Colosseum while chained to your friends. Brave physical and mental injuries that change how you play. Entertain the blood-thirsty crowd by unleashing your inner beast.

3012160.name: Botworld Odyssey Demo
3012160.short_description: Venture out into a huge open world to discover new bots and collect rare scrap to build them. Deploy your bots in tactical auto-battles on your quest to become the world’s greatest Botmaster.

4445910.name: Dry Meadow
4445910.short_description: Fight, sneak and scavenge through lands left altered after an unknown catastrophe from the Soviet Union. Light fires to stay warm. Drink vodka to stay sane.

5026520.name: POLIS
5026520.short_description: Become mayor of a small Greek town and govern for 17 years. Citizens write you letters for years, the opposition never sleeps, and every promise is remembered. A satirical political city sim where the town never forgets.

5366030.name: Miskatonic University Art Club
5366030.short_description: "A formless chaos, spilling blasphemous bubbles"... what is that supposed to look like?! Illustrate the Necronomicon with the Miskatonic University Art Club in this online draw-and-guess game for 2–12 players.

3636090.name: Blood Curse Legions Demo
3636090.short_description: This is a  RTS game where you primarily control cavalry units in battle. Utilize the vampire's abilities to command in battle, develop unique vampire heroes based on the game's evolving situation, and form a powerful Blood Curse Legion to dominate the world and establish a vampire nation.

4695190.name: Eruin
4695190.short_description: A town has forgotten itself, and so have you. Question its people in your own words: every villager listens, remembers, and answers as themselves. Piece together what was lost and break the spell before the kingdom vanishes with its past.

5275080.name: Match 3 Kingdoms
5275080.short_description: Match 3 Kingdoms is a match-3 roguelike game. Clear tiles to attack, cast skills, and gain resources. Special tiles and chains trigger combos. Runs have random maps, enemies, drops, and rewards. Combine active/passive stratagems, time moves, manage resources to win wars.

4572160.name: Water Margin: Defiance
4572160.short_description: "Water Margin: Defiance" is an action RPG set in the 14th-century Chinese classic "Water Margin" ("Outlaws of the Marsh"). Choose your path between good and evil, fight in fast-paced combat, or strike unseen from the shadows. Step into a world where legend and reality intertwine.

5341970.name: Just bury!
5341970.short_description:
The Trash Keeps Coming.
Run your own landfill!
Take in waste from all kinds of clients, three times a day!
Wash it, sort it, and recycle it!
Too much to handle? Burn it—or bury it.
Just bury it!
But land doesn't last forever.

4986620.name: Just Another Guild Day
4986620.short_description: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

4241580.name: Dawnrazor
4241580.short_description: Step into the decaying world of Kagenovia in Dawnrazor, a story-driven 8-bit action adventure! Take control of Zedekiah, a betrayed knight reborn through parasitic vampirism, as he fights through blood-soaked ruins and biomechanical horrors.

1737370.name: Jurassic Architect
1737370.short_description: Build a cozy dinosaur zoo on the far side of a Portal. Visitors from our world buy tickets to meet real dinosaurs. Shape enclosures, research new species, hire keepers, rangers and vets, and keep fourteen kinds of dinosaurs happy before they start testing their fences.

5062040.name: RuneEra Demo
5062040.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes, and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes, and dungeons.

4745080.name: 克苏鲁围棋教学
4745080.short_description: Go has never been so accessible! With Lord Cthulhu to guide you, playing Go becomes much more enjoyable. Whether you want to get started with Go, improve your skills, or tackle Life and death problems, Lord Cthulhu will keep you company forever!

5042890.name: RuneEra
5042890.short_description: RuneEra is a fantasy colony-management RPG where you build a guild settlement, automate work and production, equip powerful runes and lead parties through a procedurally generated world of quests, factions, dangerous biomes and dungeons.

3190930.name: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey DEMO
3190930.short_description: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey is a 2D action game. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), embarks on a journey to Isekizima (Ruins Island of dreams and romance: as it was written in the tourist brochure). Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying folk music.

5168130.name: Hit or Die
5168130.short_description:
Four players, one table, the number 21. Draw, stand, or bluff. Whoever ends the round
furthest from the target gets the mallet, the anvil, or the revolver. Cheat with scissors,
dice and a syringe you keep in your own drawer. Chips are your health. Last one breathing
wins.

5337760.name: Tamer Survivors Demo
5337760.short_description: Team up with adorable animal companions and combine their abilities to defeat hordes of trash monsters! Evolve a variety of weapons, create a new build with every run, and cleanse a polluted world in this casual roguelite survival action game.

3852760.name: Greek War
3852760.short_description: Greek War is a 3D turn-based tactical strategy game that blends the reasoning of chess with the cunning of tic-tac-toe, all set in a battlefield inspired by the grandeur of Ancient Greece.

5384700.name: Just Weeding Demo
5384700.short_description:
Pull 100,000 weeds! Zone out solo or chill and chat with up to 6 players in this endless weeding sim.

Feed your goat to earn cash and unlock better weeding gear!

5235030.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust Demo
5235030.short_description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

4488440.name: Mini Bash™
4488440.short_description: The spiritual evolution of the iconic online social games of the 2000s. Mini Bash combines exploration, real-time party modes, and action with friends in a living, connected world. Customize your Mini and jump into PvP mini-games or team up in the co-op Dungeon Mode.

5381290.name: ShelfSpace
5381290.short_description: Free up space from your installed games without breaking them. ShelfSpace shows how much each game will free before compressing, skips games that won't shrink, and after an update re-compresses only the files that changed. No admin rights, no account.

2097940.name: Theatre of War: Rearmed
2097940.short_description: Command real-time WWII battles across the complete Theatre of War series, unified on the latest version of its original engine. Experience deep tactical combat, realistic ballistics, and over 100 missions, enhanced for modern systems.

5309090.name: Two-Fifteen
5309090.short_description: A first-person PSX horror game. Your baby is gone, and the things wearing your in-laws' faces are still in the house. Get the lights back on, hide when you hear footsteps on the stairs, and never trust a voice that sounds like someone you love.

5214660.name: OverDoze
5214660.short_description: All Dasha wants is to get some sleep and finish watching her favorite dream. But in a crime‑ridden metropolis ruled by organized crime groups and corporations, that turns into an unattainable dream.

3764760.name: Fish and Chill
3764760.short_description: A cozy idle fishing game where your fisherman catches fish automatically while you relax. Sell your catch, upgrade your boat, and enjoy the calming sea in a transparent, borderless overlay that floats on any desktop.

5187930.name: FOOTBALL EXECUTIVE 27
5187930.short_description: Football Executive 27 is a detailed football management simulation from the sporting director's perspective. Hire coaches and staff, build your squad, scout talent, negotiate transfers and contracts, and shape your club's long-term success.

5446140.name: Clash of Crests - The Sable Cross
5446140.short_description: Take the black cross into the Fenmarch: nine miles of reed, bog oak and standing water, held by clans who have never been conquered. Four offices of the day, four battles, from the Reed Road at Matins to the Black Cross in the Mire at Compline. 83 units of the Teutonic Order.

5429200.name: Arms & Arts
5429200.short_description: A dice-rolling RPG auto-battler roguelike. Pick up a random weapon, chain your own unique skill combos, and fight your way through every enemy and adventure on the road — and above all, keep an eye on your past self.

3098340.name: Shadow of the Matrix
3098340.short_description: Shadow of the Matrix is a fast-paced sci-fi third-person shooter set in a dark space environment. A mysterious enemy sabotages the systems of a colony ship. Fight back, restore control, and save the crew in this story-driven single-player action game.

4184640.name: Zaria
4184640.short_description:
A young family finds itself at the heart of an unprecedented family drama.
Manipulate the all-powerful white and black dices in this turn-based narrative roguelike, and help them get out of this mess.

4069270.name: Bit It
4069270.short_description: A two player couch-coop platformer game: Jump, Fly and Enjoy your time with your beloved one!

5105920.name: Undermoon Demo
5105920.short_description: UnderMoon is a dark fantasy turn-based tactical roguelike RPG. Awaken in a strange moonlit town, build your hero, and climb a shifting tower. Read enemy intent, combine weapons, magic, summons, and elemental reactions, defeat deadly bosses, and uncover why everyone was brought to this world.

4701930.name: Caracol - Wars of Religion in the 17th Century
4701930.short_description: Simultaneous turn-based strategy (WeGo) set in the age of the Wars of Religion and pike-and-shot warfare.

4364840.name: Sinesperia Demo
4364840.short_description: Someone lived a life here. You just can't remember it yet. Explore the dreams buried deep inside your mind to find out who you were.

4133630.name: LineForgeBlackSmith
4133630.short_description:
A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it.
In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

4535960.name: Voxie Survivor
4535960.short_description: Break monster swarms, lockdown rescue missions, and crush apex bosses as you weave through deep story driven chaos. Welcome to a bullet heaven roguelite where survival demands strategy. Master the chaos, it takes a real Voxie Survivor to conquer all!

4933300.name: Blotch
4933300.short_description: Paint yourself to match the scenery and sneak past guards. Explore an island of magical paintings, help its residents save their homes, or bring friends for online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt. Create your own maps and share them on Steam Workshop.

4323480.name: Cube Sweeper
4323480.short_description: Cube Sweeper is a casual relaxing puzzle game. All you have to do is work out which cubes are red and which cubes are empty. Numbers show how many adjacent cubes are red and from that information you can solve all the levels in the game without guessing.

5018790.name: Lazy Drawer: Line Survivors
5018790.short_description: No guns. No swords. No aiming. Your weapon is the path you walk. Enemies touching your trail get shredded — and the instant it closes into a loop, everything inside blows up at once. Survive 15 minutes, slay the boss, grow your charm deck — a survivors-like where walking IS attacking.

3872430.name: SCP: Project Pneuma
3872430.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in the ruins of SCP Foundation Site-63. Sneak past anomalies you cannot fight, scavenge scarce supplies, and piece together what Project Echelon released - because whatever is hunting you knows exactly where you're going.

3981680.name: Carte Blanche
3981680.short_description: Carte Blanche is an original adventure and card game in a fantastic world with the style of Japanese animes. Travel the world in search of the Cards. Collect them, develop them to participate in the Tournaments of the game. Discover the fabulous story of two children who love each other.

5131960.name: Angel Investor Simulator Demo
5131960.short_description: Invest into promising startups with sometimes wacky ideas. Help them grow with your team of experts. Capture the market share with quality product, smart pricing and marketing. Cash out big after the IPO. Compete with the other angels and show them who's the boss.

5152740.name: Paystreak Demo
5152740.short_description: Paystreak is a top-down gold mining tycoon about running your own modern day gold rush. The demo gives you the start of that journey. Work your way from pans and shovels to your first mechanized production chain. You get four seasons to prove you can run a gold mining company.

5214670.name: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www 体験版
5214670.short_description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

5248070.name: No More Room in Hell 2 - Killer Cat Pack

5286800.name: Love: Fall in Death Demo
5286800.short_description: An FMV interactive romantic comedy where your choices and timing shape the night. Try to impress Ayşil at the bar and navigate a branching story that can lead to love… or total chaos.

4888690.name: Ultimate Shortcut Kit - Battlefield™ 6 and REDSEC
4888690.short_description: Instantly master every class with the Ultimate Shortcut Kit. Features the “Mortal Shriek” Dog Tag, “Field Training: Cross Trained” Title, and shortcut kits for all 4 classes, which include unlocks for each mastery level.

4961870.name: Planet Coaster 2: Silver Screen Pack
4961870.short_description: Craft spectacular movie sets and cinematic backdrops to bring your silver screen adventures to life. Create the metropolis of your dreams with striking skyscrapers, rich gold detailing, and sleek stucco finishes.

4539700.name: Unseen - Someone Demo
4539700.short_description: Michael, is a 14-year-old teenager living the ordinary life of a game developer. He usually preferred to work at night because he felt the calm and special atmosphere there. At one point, he needed to leave the room at night but it seems that was a mistake...

4249300.name: ACE COMBAT 8 - Customizable Cosmetic Set
4249300.short_description: This set contains items usable in ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE such as aircraft skins, an online lobby avatar outfit, and an upgrade part for use in Online Mode.

3900520.name: Lami: A Cup of Code And Coffee Demo
3900520.short_description: Inherit your grandpa’s old café and meet Lami, an adorable robot girl! Craft gadgets, upgrade your café, serve customers, and face unexpected challenges as you uncover the story behind Lami.

3935850.name: Onimusha: WotS - Outfit for the Oni Lady: Hinoa
3935850.short_description:
A collaboration outfit for the Oni Lady that supports Miyamoto Musashi!
An outfit reminiscent of the one worn by Hinoa the Quest Maiden from Monster Hunter Rise. It seems like the Oni Lady won't be sending anyone out on a Village Quest though.

4040200.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Return to the Reik
4040200.short_description: Markus Kruber sets forth on a quest to recover his father’s sword, plundered during the fall of Ubersreik… and naturally, the rest of the Ubersreik Five offer their aid.

5461460.name: BazaarBorn
5461460.short_description: BazaarBorn is a second-hand trading simulation. Start with a small junk cart, buy and sell used items, bargain with customers, and grow your business step by step. Make smart deals and turn small profits into bigger opportunities.

3826220.name: Tia：weird hunter Demo
3826220.short_description: This demo of Tia:weird hunter features Chapter One of the full experience. Dive into a hand-drawn 2D world, unleash fast, fluid combos, and take on fierce boss battles that will test your skills. Explore the mysterious "Faceless City" and get a taste of the story, combat, and chaos still to come.

3377850.name: Bloons TD 6: Rogue Legends
3377850.short_description:
Rogue Legends is a rogue-lite adventure across a huge variety of Bloon infested maps.

Build your Monkey Party and make strategic reward choices at key steps to advance. Win and Buy Artifacts to boost your Party's power and defeat the Boss!

3422000.name: Ward Off Evil
3422000.short_description: Ward Off Evil is an open world strategy RPG set in an apocalyptic sword & sorcery world. Create your character, rally an army, and roam the wastes as you battle to avert, or bring about, the end of the Cycle.

3283440.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Verminous Dreams
3283440.short_description: Verminous Dreams is a free new content update for Warhammer: Vermintide 2, containing a three-part adventure, starting with The Forsaken Temple & Devious Delvings.

4745610.name: The One I Saw
4745610.short_description: Return to a house based on the developer's real childhood home in this first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling loops, uncover buried memories, and experience supernatural events influenced by what you notice and what you miss.

2445960.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Karak Azgaraz
2445960.short_description: Karak Azgaraz is a free new content update for Warhammer: Vermintide 2. It contains three remastered adventure maps from the fan-favorite DLC of the first Vermintide game and one brand-new map.

5179990.name: Demiourgos
5179990.short_description: A first-person horror. A man wakes up at 3 AM and the sea starts calling. Every person and every animal has a line of destiny. Can you change them before the great end?

2295860.name: My Singing Monsters - Season of Love Skin Pack
2295860.short_description: Unlock the Season of Love Island Skin available on Air Island. Alongside the cosmetic makeover to Air Island, you'll receive a variety of permanent boosts to your Air Island.

2199500.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - A Treacherous Adventure
2199500.short_description: A Treacherous Adventure is a free new content update for Warhammer: Vermintide 2. It contains a two adventure maps.

1837260.name: For Honor - Pirate Hero
1837260.short_description: Bold, passionate, and the captain, the Pirate hero is coming to Heathmoor this season seeking lost treasures and relics.

5427960.name: 怪異ジャッジ・ナイトメア
5427960.short_description:
ポップで奇妙な怪異調査ADV短編集！
メカクレ青年ハマメが、悪夢のような不思議な世界へ！

5180490.name: Blotch Demo
5180490.short_description: Paint yourself to match the scenery and sneak past guards. Explore an island of magical paintings, help its residents save their homes, or bring friends for online hide-and-seek and Prop Hunt. Create your own maps and share them on Steam Workshop.

1601550.name: Warhammer: Vermintide 2 - Chaos Wastes
1601550.short_description: Chaos Wastes is a free update to Warhammer: Vermintide 2. Explore the unpredictable and dramatic lands of Chaos Wastes in this all-new 1-4 player co-op rogue-lite experience, expanding the Vermintide story in a new game mode.

1585812.name: SnowRunner - Season 5: Build & Dispatch
1585812.short_description: Expand your SnowRunner experience with Season 5: Build & Dispatch. Restore an old TATRA factory in Rostov Oblast, Russia, with two new maps to explore alongside two new TATRA vehicles.

2773760.name: TV Beast
2773760.short_description: TV Beast is a first-person survival horror game from the perspective of a body camera. Confront the TV Beast using a special remote control. Collect materials, solve puzzles, utilize various environmental devices, and upgrade the remote control to overcome the dangers created by the Beast.

5209520.name: Just More Doors Demo
5209520.short_description: OPEN THE DOOR! Question your sanity in this first person exploration and puzzle game. Discover a place where anything you can dream of might just be a door away from you. Go on. Open the door. It's as simple as that!

3724680.name: Gangsters Way
3724680.short_description: Gangsters Way is a dynamic, adrenaline-fueled third-person fighting game where you step into the shoes of street gangster John Brown. Challenge the mafia and earn respect and a place in the criminal underworld through fists and blood.

5477930.name: Boris & the Second Sun
5477930.short_description: Your cat borrowed eight million, built a second sun in the bathroom, and named you guarantor. An absurd comedy visual novel with dubious contracts, a bathtub republic, a turn-based solar puzzle, and three ways to survive the evening.

4850960.name: The King Got Too Much Gold Demo
4850960.short_description: Your royal fountain spits out more gold than anyone could ever spend, and cleaning it up is somehow your job. Sweep coins, sell them, draft upgrades, hire goblins, trolls and a cat, unlock a big web of skills, then feed your whole fortune to the Glutton King. You can never lose. The gold never stops

4575780.name: PortalDesk
4575780.short_description: Turn a cluttered desktop into a calm, organized workspace. Group icons into beautifully styled zones, open any folder as a live folder, and bring everything to the front with one shortcut. Lightweight, and a one-time purchase - no subscription.

5407450.name: SLAP
5407450.short_description: A physics-driven co-op brawler for 1-4 players. Swing your weapon with your mouse, send monsters flying, survive waves and bosses, merge loot into stronger gear, and settle arguments with your friends in arena duels between waves.

3902550.name: Antichrist
3902550.short_description: As a journalist, you made headlines back in 2006 with a groundbreaking story. Years later, an anonymous call tied to that very event leads you to an horror house. But this house may belong to the Antichrist believed to appear at the end of days. You’re chasing a story… but it might be your last.

4730520.name: Forged from Monsters
4730520.short_description: Not every sword begins as steel. Forge weapons from monster parts with hands-on control over every step of the process. Discover surprising effective combinations of creature parts heroes bring to your smithy.

4431120.name: Doomed Crew Demo
4431120.short_description: Co-op Horror (1-4 players). Enemies mimic your teammates, environment lies to you. A brutal corporation promises you freedom, can your team survive the chaos?

5315300.name: DeepCore Breach
5315300.short_description: Thousands of rift creatures. One base. Aim every turret's line of fire, then take the main cannon into your own hands. Take down five bosses across 15 maps, grow stronger between runs, and climb the global leaderboard in Endless. Build and share your own maps on the Workshop.

5342550.name: ATC: Tower & Ground Demo
5342550.short_description: Free demo. Take control of Palma de Mallorca from Approach/Tower and Ground: vector arrivals onto the ILS through storms, run the taxiways and handle real emergencies. Real ICAO phraseology, real aeronautical data and voice control.

5271550.name: Hungry Cataway
5271550.short_description: Chomp your way through levels, dodge enemies and escape! Hungry Cataway is a charming grid-based pixel-art arcade game. Blast through walls with bombs, outmaneuver hazards, and unleash your ultimate vomit attack to clear the path.

4682070.name: Zombobox: Bredo Story Demo
4682070.short_description: It seems like a zombie apocalypse has begun in the world, but it's somehow quiet... Maybe ask an elderly drunked person what happened? He says that he stopped everything, but how?

4164850.name: 全有三国志
4164850.short_description: Back To Three Kingdoms is a turn-based tactical wargame .You play as a food delivery man who travels back to the  the Three Kingdoms period. Assemble an army led by three powerful generals to take on a series of distinct levels . Unlock more unique generals and formidable equipment as you progress.

4550100.name: My Coworkers Are Made Of Static Demo

5411640.name: Elderwood
5411640.short_description: Forge your path in Elderwood, an online fantasy RPG where skills grow through adventure. Master weapons, craft powerful gear, or support allies with bard songs. Conquer clan keeps, brave dangerous PvP regions, and face endgame raids in a world shaped by rivalry, risk, and discovery.

3057340.name: As The Leaves Fall
3057340.short_description: Point-and-click adventure game with a thrilling, Native American-inspired narrative. Use your wit to solve fun and challenging puzzles as you explore and interact with the townsfolk of Birchwood Hollow and the Native reservation. Secrets will be uncovered, and truths revealed, as the leaves fall.

3642760.name: Age of Amelorn
3642760.short_description: Recruit unique units, cast powerful spells, and conquer your enemies in a 2D fantasy strategy adventure. Tackle a challenging campaign or dive into Skirmish Mode to create and customize your own battles.

4867680.name: The Sinkhole
4867680.short_description: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouse—your real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

4889760.name: SCP: Darkwater
4889760.short_description: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

5123340.name: BAKA TAO
5123340.short_description: What begins as an ordinary road trip slowly takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected encounter leaves you searching for answers in the surrounding wilderness.

5410760.name: DungeonVerse Demo
5410760.short_description: DungeonVerse takes you to four unique worlds that have been reduced to gloomy dungeons by a catastrophe. Explore crumbling ruins, mystical places and forgotten cities, battle powerful bosses and collect all the artefacts to restore balance to your world.

5398530.name: Feral Fantasy New Era
5398530.short_description: Explore an open fantasy world in this adults-only sandbox featuring fictional feral characters. Customize your characters, interact with NPCs, build, and engage in magical combat while enjoying the experience at your own pace.

4774410.name: BEAR HORROR
4774410.short_description: Real-time strategy meets dark SCP survival. Play as the self-replicating SCP-1048, also known as the Builder Bear, gather grotesque resources, mass-produce a horrifying army of teddy clones and survive against Foundation personnel.

4676680.name: JEEP HORROR
4676680.short_description: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

5295920.name: Teeth Are Money
5295920.short_description: An incremental horror game about pulling teeth from a living monster. Grip, shake and yank each tooth free, then spend the money on research that turns one hard-won tooth into handfuls at a time. Keep pulling before the contamination fills, and watch the mouth grow.

5482020.name: Blood Soil
5482020.short_description: By day you sow. By night they come for the harvest — so you make them the harvest. Kill monsters ON your crop beds, let the soil drink their blood, and watch it grow at dawn. A brutal farming defense with a shotgun, a scythe and a year of nightmares.

4643500.name: Rex Summons a Meteor
4643500.short_description: A short game about a large rock. You accidentally summoned a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in this silly first-person puzzle adventure.

4945810.name: Odysseus' 13th Ship
4945810.short_description: Play as the forgotten 13th Ship of Odysseus. Cooperate with your friends to ascend the mountain of abstract geometric shapes. Do you have what it takes to reach Ithaca?

5154830.name: FEEDSTOCK
5154830.short_description: Your loot doesn't go in a backpack. It goes into Tally, and she grows. Four of you strip a house room by room and feed all of it to her. Feed her too little and she eats the crew; feed her too much and she won't fit back through the door.

4115900.name: Murino Adventures
4115900.short_description: Survive the fog-filled ruins of Murino. Play as Drun and Ch, uncover Mellstroy’s experiments, and escape—or destroy—the creeping Fog before it consumes everything.

4925050.name: Microwave
4925050.short_description: Microwave food in a dreamy, liminal space by yourself or with friends.

4890890.name: Split Screen Shooter
4890890.short_description:
It's 2009. You are at your bestfriends home, playing on the console of their big brother. A game you are too young to play, at a time where you should be doing your homework.
Thats this game, a generic shooter, but split screen!

5302820.name: Tamagong
5302820.short_description: A monster-raising autobattler where you hatch, feed, and train your monsters, shape their builds, and discover powerful team synergies.

4461570.name: Chinese Childhood Demo
4461570.short_description: Spend an afternoon in a small Chinese town around 1998. Play marbles, buy snacks, and head home when Mum calls. This free demo includes the next school day and an optional Mid-Autumn evening. Choose a boy or girl and take your time.

4890930.name: Big Controller VR
4890930.short_description: Play flat games using fun oversized controllers. Comes with 2 games included, but also works with all your desktop games that have controller support.

4463840.name: Inquisitor Simulator
4463840.short_description:
Command an inquisitorial monastery where faith, alchemy, and… creative interrogation techniques are your primary tools as an Inquisitor.
Contain what can be contained. Purge the rest.
Not everything is evil. Not everything is human. No one expects your judgment to be just every time.
…Right?

4878780.name: Fungi Guards
4878780.short_description: Defend a bioluminescent forest in Fungi Guards, a strategic tower defense game! Deploy and upgrade sentient fungi with unique elemental traits and tactical synergies to repel relentless waves of slimy Slug and Snail Men. Plan, adapt, and evolve your fungal defenders to save your home.

4742450.name: NIGHT MULE
4742450.short_description: Two months behind on rent. An empty fridge. Then, a desperate choice. Step into the high-stakes underbelly of financial crime as a money mule. Withdraw illicit cash, outsmart aggressive robbers, and survive the dangerous streets shift after shift. How far will you go to secure your survival?

5000960.name: Falling
5000960.short_description: In Falling, guide your ball through obstacle courses in free fall. One touch is all it takes to start over. Easy to pick up, tough to master — and create your own levels.

4884970.name: Vermin God
4884970.short_description: A grotesque body horror visual novel inspired by SCP-027, play as the young host of the Vermin God. Wake up in a hidden lab with no memories and experience the terror of a mysterious disease turning your body into a living hive for swarms of pests. Make choices to escape the crawling chaos.

4459990.name: Screen Survivors
4459990.short_description: An idle survivor-like that sits in the corner of your screen.

5230230.name: Board Dynasty
5230230.short_description: Target rival buildings with disasters, race with action cards, or pass a bomb before it explodes. Board Dynasty combines property play, time travel and party modes on a 3D board. Play solo against computer rivals or with up to four local players.

5019020.name: BACKROOMS: PRIMAL
5019020.short_description: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

5295110.name: Gate B7
5295110.short_description: Verify documents, stamp boarding passes, and uphold the regime's strict laws at a dystopian airport terminal. Every decision matters: take bribes to keep your family alive, or stay loyal to survive your 20-day shift. But be careful: Some anomalies aren't found on paper.

4819030.name: Deal Flipper
4819030.short_description: Buy low, sell high. Master the art of the deal. Deal Flipper is a first-person flipping sim where you scour an online marketplace, haggle with sellers in real-time chat, and resell for profit. Every trader plays differently. Read them, outdeal them, and build your empire.

4551840.name: Factory on a Train Demo
4551840.short_description: Mine, craft and extend your Factory on a Train! As you find more resources and unlock increasingly complex recipes, your train grows and your production increases. Choose the right cars to face the challenges of the post-apocalyptic wasteland.

4612760.name: GET RAMMED
4612760.short_description: GET RAMMED is a multiplayer party game with up to 8 players where you play as chaotic goats trying to RAM each other off the stage! Challenge each other with a playful mix of unique maps, power-ups and unexpected events!

4193860.name: 寻仙
4193860.short_description: A single-player, MUD-inspired cultivation RPG with turn-based combat. Create a character, raise a family or join cloud sects. Grow herbs with the Green Bottle, refine treasures in the Basin, and explore with puppets and spirit beasts—from hidden realms to the Black Sea. Simplified Chinese only.

5402010.name: Late Shift Demo
5402010.short_description: Experience found-footage horror through the eyes of a missing cinema employee. Navigate a looping cinema, find anomalies, uncover the truth, and break the loop. Make sure every room is checked... thoroughly, or risk becoming another missing employee.

5048700.name: Hunted Within: Terminal Rust
5048700.short_description: In a wasteland consumed by sandstorms, gravity anomalies, and grotesque biomechanical horrors, blast your way through a brutal survival horror experience to hunt down your worst enemy, the psycho Doctor.

4119600.name: UK Politics Simulator
4119600.short_description: Over 20,000 simulated politicians, journalists and activists. Every one unique. Every one autonomous. Build your career from local councillor to Prime Minister in the most detailed UK political simulation ever created. No scripts. Pure systems-driven gameplay.

4608170.name: Draw & Stow
4608170.short_description: Draw & Stow is a roguelike strategy game combining deckbuilding, inventory management, and item crafting. Make a fortune as a Traveling Merchant, defeat foes as a Villain Hunter, or cook as a Master Chef. Draft cards, manage inventory to trigger chain reactions. The choice is yours!

5046800.name: Lost Mind Demo
5046800.short_description: Lost Mind is a psychological roguelite set inside Ashley’s fractured mind. Explore procedural worlds, collect stars, escape collapsing maps, and face symbolic enemies born from trauma, paranoia, and depression. Every death means she got lost again.

5464180.name: Night Study: Korean Ghost Stories
5464180.short_description: A complete first-person horror game in just 1.44MB — it fits on a single floppy disk. You fell asleep during night study and woke up alone. Learn each ghost's rule, find the keys and escape a Korean high school before dawn.

4684260.name: Girlsnite - Anime Building Battle TPS Demo
4684260.short_description: Girlsnite is a building battle TPS featuring both single-player and multiplayer modes. Choose your favorite anime girl from 4 unique default characters, including our poster girl "Shibu-chan"! Master your editing and building skills to dominate challenging CPU bots and rivals from around the world.

2686820.name: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey
2686820.short_description: isekizima: Ruins and Tails Journey is a 2D action game. Kijino, a cat-eared adventurer with two tails (Nekomata), embarks on a journey to Isekizima (Ruins Island of dreams and romance: as it was written in the tourist brochure). Explore ruins buried in the forest while enjoying folk music.

5260300.name: Full Breach
5260300.short_description: Full Breach is a single-player 2D tactical shooter with door breaching, physics-based combat, and bloody firefights that leave walls and floors covered in blood splatter. Clear buildings, use bullet time and recon vision, unlock weapons, and upgrade your operator.

4310380.name: Underdog’s Comeback: 0DTE Options Game
4310380.short_description: Start with $100 and chase a million-dollar comeback across 100 runs. A roguelike card game of 0DTE options, with post-session downtime in Moonward, where traders share their stories.

5103220.name: Skewered Up!
5103220.short_description: Stack absurd combos onto a skewer. Fill your inventory with unique ingredients and skewer them to discover deliciously broken synergies. Grill, cash out, upgrade your skewer, and serve customers with unique demands in this fast, physical roguelike deckbuilder. Easy to learn. Hard to Master.

5165100.name: Project Slimechan
5165100.short_description: Experience tentacle scenes directly in 3D on PC or in 6DOF VR.

5423790.name: Bastion Rivals
5423790.short_description: Build your stronghold and unleash automatic armies across two lanes. Master four fantasy factions, spells and counters. Ranked and unranked 1v1/2v2 multiplayer, leaderboards and community esports tournaments are planned for launch. Practice solo against AI.

5135070.name: Nightshift; Nowhere
5135070.short_description: Welcome to Nowhere Medical! The pay is terrible, the night shift may be your last, and workplace safety has officially gone off the rails; grab whatever weapons you can find and get the hell out!

5194730.name: 饼干兄弟
5194730.short_description: Cookie Brothers is a 2D top-down action roguelite. Choose a cookie with a signature weapon, survive hordes of dessert monsters, build an arsenal of six weapons, trigger resonances, and branch into distinct professions that evolve your signature weapon and transform each run.

5341020.name: Arid Frontiers
5341020.short_description: Build a frontier colony in this single-player survival sim. Assign settler duties, grow food, craft gear, manage weather and wildlife, research new skills, and explore a dangerous wilderness through expeditions, quests, and emergent stories.

4376800.name: The Water Game
4376800.short_description: The classic water ring toss toy, now living on your desktop. Tap and charge water jets, land rings on pegs, and fill them for jackpots and chain reactions. Upgrade until it's raining rings, or let AUTO keep tossing while you work.

4713220.name: Mystic Seals
4713220.short_description: Battle against terrible foes! Collect mystical powerups! Befriend adorably violent pets! Explore the mysterious Unjima Island and its demon-cursed shrines in a brand new twin-stick Rougelite Co-Op featuring Shrine Maiden Shizuka and her companions!

5381710.name: Train Survivor
5381710.short_description: A survivors-like where you drive the train. Drive an armoured train through a valley overrun by the undead. Couple weapon wagons, pick upgrades and steer through switches while a horde of up to 1,500 skeletons closes in. Survive 15 minutes and face the Demon Lord.

5060230.name: Fat Chance Demo
5060230.short_description: Escape the mansion before it claims you. A 1–5 player co-op horror.

5394070.name: The Usual, Please
5394070.short_description: A short horror cooking game. Run your dead uncle's burger cart on a foggy harbour pier in the 1970s. Cook for the locals, spot the drowned before they reach your window, and find out who really killed your uncle.

5091340.name: Reveria: Act 1
5091340.short_description: Welcome, adventurer! Reveria is a turn-based old school fantasy RPG. Lead a party of up to four aspiring adventurers into the Reverian wilderness. Explore dark dungeons and defeat dangerous foes to complete quests and find treasure. Level up your characters to unlock new abilities. Grow your legend.

4516010.name: Slumber Craft
4516010.short_description: Slumber Craft is a narrative deckbuilder about insomnia, pressure, and self-repair. Plan activities by day; build poker-style hands by night, from high card to full house, chain scores into Sleepiness. 21 nights, branching endings, and an Endless Mode asking how long you can keep weaving the dream.

5132310.name: High Voltage
5132310.short_description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

4489250.name: DREADROOM
4489250.short_description: It was supposed to be just a funny escape room experience... until you realize the incredible truth. In this tense horror puzzle-adventure, solve complex mechanisms, navigate deadly corridors and evade terrifying entities lurking in the dark, while trying to find the true exit.

5402310.name: RemparZ
5402310.short_description: Medieval-fantasy tower defense: raise towers along the roads, upgrade them and hold through five Ages up to the dragons. Then send your army to storm forts held by the computer in the Conquest, defend a shared castle with a friend in Duo and grow your Bastion.

3973010.name: Chinese Childhood
3973010.short_description: School’s out. Play a round of marbles, stop for snacks, and head home when Mum calls. Be a boy or girl in a small Chinese town around 1998, with friends to meet, holidays to spend with family, and trips beyond the neighborhood.

5353560.name: 摆摊之王
5353560.short_description: A cute cartoon leisure party game that can cure a single person and lie flat, and can evacuate four people online for gold! It's leisure and fun to stand and explode coins and get rich!

5061580.name: Puzzle Scorpions
5061580.short_description: This game is a classic puzzle game with multiple levels and beautiful graphics. Enjoy!

5454210.name: Puzzle Scorpions Artbook
5454210.short_description: In this DLC you will find 10 wallpapers from the game. They are in the artbook folder in the folder with the game. Enjoy

5047040.name: Strike Wings Demo
5047040.short_description: A free demo of Strike Wings, inspired by the space shooters of the DOS era. Choose from seven ships, fly 17 battles and begin a voiced story campaign. Learn the ropes in Flight School, take on a 1v1 duel or team up in local split-screen co-op.

4718360.name: Strike Wings
4718360.short_description: A top-down modernized retro space combat epic. Choose from over fifty warships and be part of massive fleet actions with hundreds of ships on the field. Fly for Earth's church-state or the Martian forge that armed it. Play solo, in split-screen co-op, or in max 24-pilot online attrition battles.

5340560.name: Hypnosis : Quiet Nights Demo
5340560.short_description: Hypnosis: Quiet Nights DEMO is a psychological exploration game blending story-driven dialogue and 2D side-scrolling action. Help an insomniac girl sleep, battle cute yet dangerous dream monsters, and explore a journey through sleep, medication, and dreams. Includes the prologue.

4776080.name: Beast Bastion Demo
4776080.short_description: A Roguelike Auto-Chess game Demo. Recruit troops and pair them with defense turrets. Try it now!

5076820.name: Hellbinder: Shibari Secrets Demo
5076820.short_description: Master Shibari, the authentic Japanese erotic art of rope bondage in this adult game! Play a demon tasked by an angel to perform sacred exorcisms on 8 customizable succubi. Featuring deep character customization and multiple game modes, can you subdue these seductive temptresses?

5044890.name: Unburied Demo
5044890.short_description: The free demo of Unburied, a dark-fantasy tower-defense roguelite for 1–4 players, solo or online co-op. Raise palisades by day, hold your keep by night, turn the fight with your captain's Space counter, and survive until dawn turns the dead to ash.

3060830.name: 降临之地 Realm of Advent
3060830.short_description:
If you love building unique decks, triggering insane combos with simple controls, and watching numbers skyrocket—you'll love Realm of Advent.
In a world ruled by Apostles, craft your build from 300+ cards and relics to ignite addictively wild chain reactions.

5197910.name: Happy Happy Little Shop
5197910.short_description: Run a little shop that fixes people's moods. Serve customers, deal with six difficult siblings, and make choices that shape your shop, your family, and the whole town.

5376750.name: 龍Games
5376750.short_description: Independent game game development simulation: You are an independent game developer. You need to determine the needs of the game type, gameplay, storyline, gamers, etc., and make a development plan.

5353020.name: 3D Printing Store Simulator
5353020.short_description: Build and manage your own 3D printing store. Print products, manage filament and inventory, create multicolor prints, assemble finished items, set prices, serve customers, recycle waste, and expand your workshop with better equipment.

5489800.name: Necromancer: Revival of the Dead
5489800.short_description: Raise the fallen and build your own legion of the dead. Command the kings you defeat as elite summons, swap between 8 shot types and unleash screen-filling skills in this dark fantasy survival action game.

3726570.name: Synthwave Burnout VR
3726570.short_description: Synthwave Burnout VR is an explosive arcade racing game in VR, inspired by the aesthetics of the ’80s and synthwave style. Strap on your headset, rev your engine, and blaze through neon-soaked tracks where every move, turn, and crash feels like you’re in the heart of a glowing retro-futuristic storm

5127660.name: The Goblin Path Demo
5127660.short_description: A single-player action RPG about a goblin serving the Demon King. Scout the next party at night, steal their gear, and prepare poisons and traps. By day, defend your lair and loot the heroes you defeat.

3607800.name: Backpack Seeker`s
3607800.short_description: Backpack Seeker’s — a tactical RPG where your backpack decides everything! Collect, combine, and use items in unique ways to win. A living world, a nonlinear story, and hundreds of hidden mechanics await! Ready for an adventure where every item is a step to victory? 🎒⚔️

4015970.name: Princess 8/10
4015970.short_description: Once upon a time, there was a perfectly average princess — 8/10 at best. No singing animals, no magical destiny. Just an annoying father-king and a whole bunch of creepy barons trying to marry her off.

5004440.name: Riddled Together
5004440.short_description: A first-person online co-op puzzle game where communication is the only way to solve puzzles and escape.

5251590.name: Castlefolk
5251590.short_description: Build a medieval kingdom from a small settlement, gather resources, recruit an army, battle dangerous creatures, and expand your realm across a charming pixel-art world.

5071270.name: Punch Rock
5071270.short_description: A casual idle survival game in a small window beside your work. A lone climber wanders a mountain in real time. Give her the day: forage, chop, mine, climb, or camp. Then get back to whatever you were doing. You cannot lose, and the mountain keeps its own time while you're away.

4360290.name: Terraclysm Survivors
4360290.short_description: Terraclysm Survivors is a fast-paced action roguelike sidescroller. Earth is in peril, jump and attack through treacherous stages packed with enemy hordes while building the ultimate loadout. With up to 4 players online, defeat the invaders and survive in this apocalyptic and chaotic challenge!

5409580.name: 废土小饭馆 Demo
5409580.short_description: Open a cozy little diner in a world recovering from the apocalypse! Grow and gather ingredients, cook homemade meals, and serve the townsfolk. Enjoy a heartwarming blend of farming, cooking, and restaurant management in this free demo.

4963020.name: murmures
4963020.short_description: Clara is doing everything she can to stay emotionally stable. But something is hunting her, and every place seems to know what she still refuses to understand. Explore places filled with whispers, gather the fragments and roll your d20s to help Clara find a way out.

5292070.name: Dronefall Demo
5292070.short_description: Dronefall is a deck-building tower defense game where you defend humanity's last cities against relentless drone swarms.

5358150.name: 10 Million Pixels Demo
5358150.short_description: Mine through a world of 50,000 pixels to find the Golden Pixel. A mesmerizing incremental game about exploration and erosion.

5207080.name: How to Train Your Spirit: The Exorcism of a Busty Ghost Demo
5207080.short_description:
Set in the Edo period, you are the last Onmyoji, called to an eerie estate for an exorcism.
The source is a lewd, busty female spirit.
As the final master of a forbidden art, your goal is to bring spirits to climax and purify them.
Yet this one feels different… a hidden truth lies beneath.

5004680.name: Feed The Vessel Demo
5004680.short_description: A Short Active Incremental game where you grow clones in vats, feed them to the entity, butcher and burn them for meat, blood, and ichor, upgrade your ship's stations, push the engine into overdrive, and reach the other side.

4414940.name: Tremen Demo
4414940.short_description: Welcome to the TREMEN demo, an immersive and hyperviolent old-school shooter with modern graphics. Fight your way through two brutalist levels while you butcher every mutant that stands in your way with a wide variety of powerful, upgradable weapons.

4483230.name: SpellChain Demo
4483230.short_description: Create and combine your own spells through a dynamic spellcrafting system. Fight through a hostile kingdom, disrupt its events and grow your magical powers on a quest to slay the king.

4515770.name: Planet Zoo 2: Bonus Content Pack
4515770.short_description: Enhance and adorn your zoo with the Planet Zoo 2: Bonus Content Pack.

4603950.name: Playto: Learn Languages Through Games
4603950.short_description: A PC game translator that teaches you a language as you play. It reads the text and voices on your screen and shows the translation where you want it. AI translates offline on your PC, or in the cloud if your specs are a worry. Review the words you read on your PC or phone.

4249860.name: Starfinder: Afterlight Demo
4249860.short_description: Starfinder: Afterlight is a party-based RPG that brings Paizo's beloved science-fantasy universe to life. Battle across the Pact Worlds, lead a legendary crew where your choices shape their destiny, and well, save the galaxy while you're at it!

3589650.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Nagash – Lords of the End Times
3589650.short_description: Arise and seize the lands of the living as the Supreme Lord of Necromancy, Nagash, in Total War: WARHAMMER III, unleashing his forces of the undead upon the world in his ascension to godhood.

3293610.name: SOVIET SPOOKY TALES: Green Eyes Demo
3293610.short_description: A nonlinear pixel art visual novel set in the 1980s Soviet Union, inspired by Soviet children's spooky stories.

4517780.name: LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON
4517780.short_description:
You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone?
LUNADUN: LUNATIC DUNGEON is an emotional visual novel where choices shape four characters' fates.
'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

4560830.name: Terminal Drift
4560830.short_description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

1179450.name: RISK: Global Domination - Premium Mode
1179450.short_description: Comes with 6 maps, 8 avatars and unlimited tokens for unlimited games forever!

542490.name: RPG Maker MV - Animations Collection I: Quintessence
542490.short_description: Look no further than Animations Collection I: Quintessence to arm your game with dynamic, breathtaking special effects crafted at 60 frames-per-second (FPS).

620610.name: American Truck Simulator - Heavy Cargo Pack
620610.short_description: Test your truck driver skills with new trailers and cargoes included in Heavy Cargo Pack. Take advantage of high-tech trailers supporting steerable axles for safer navigation around tight bends. Challenge yourself with all-new heavy haul duties.

4865560.name: Glyphweaver
4865560.short_description: Glyphweaver is a spellcasting roguelite where you draw every spell yourself! Explore procedurally generated dungeons, unlock new spells, and combine them with powerful modifiers to survive deadly enemies and bosses. No hotkeys. Draw, modify, cast, survive.

5346060.name: Queen's Pact
5346060.short_description: Queen’s Pact is a dark roguelite deckbuilder with auto-battler combat: sacrifice, chain and scale your cards into loops that should not be allowed. Break the game until the Queen is impressed.

5442780.name: The Vigil
5442780.short_description: Seven nights. One open coffin. No one coming to help. Keep the wake for your grandmother in this Romanian folk horror. Light a candle to see what the dead see, finish the old rites in her book, and don’t let her rise.

5163510.name: Bugs & Birdies
5163510.short_description: A cozy survival sandbox with teeth – alone or in online co-op for up to four players. Explore a world of pixel islands, build your farmstead, raise an army of hens and hold the fences together when the beetles come at night.

3897770.name: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals
3897770.short_description: Occult Office: Lofi Rituals is a cozy desktop companion that blends witchy aesthetics and real productivity tools. Plan your day, care for plants, read fortunes, pet magical familiars, customize your desk and avatar, and play minigames during your breaks.

3113800.name: Tower Alchemist: Defend Khaldoria Demo
3113800.short_description: Tower defense meets alchemy: Brew flasks, throw them at your enemies to counter their special abilities, or empower your towers with them. Defend Khaldoria in a fully voiced campaign built around your magical board game. Wishlist the full game now!

4149610.name: Young Suns
4149610.short_description: Build a home on your own spaceship and take it adventuring across a newly liberated Jupiter. A cozy 1-4 player narrative life sim where you explore, salvage, and repair to help a huge cast of lovable characters make society better.

2780750.name: Limbival
2780750.short_description: One moment you're under a guillotine, the next you've lost every limb. The crowd wants a show. You want to survive. Rip the limbs off circus monsters, attach them to yourself, master them, and clear wave after wave to escape the circus.

3076320.name: Chrono Commander
3076320.short_description: Chrono Commander is a real-time strategy wargame (RTS) with time travel in 3.5 dimensions.

3484010.name: Immortum
3484010.short_description: A story-driven sci-fi horror inspired by classic horror. Trapped in a decaying spaceship, escape mind-bending traps, navigate shifting realities, solve puzzles, and uncover an impossible truth — as Romi, a mother desperate to find her dying child. Can you discover the truth before you’re erased?

4786590.name: Lover Completion Plan
4786590.short_description: A 1st-person psychological horror & romance adventure. Amnesiac, you're trapped in a seemingly perfect, cozy room with a girl claiming to be "Haru". Find and "fix" anomalies through daily interaction. Each fix reveals more of the cruel truth. "Complete" this broken world to save her!

5065610.name: Echoes of Eternity 2
5065610.short_description: A difficult isometric bullet-hell continuing the story of Ott, a bot with a recycled consciousness.

4681140.name: MeloDancer Demo
4681140.short_description: A turn-based roguelike with rhythm-infused elements. The melody and pulse rising from the depths grant you strength, empower your choices. With every step, the darkness grows heavier and more enemies emerge from the shadows. Gather power, seek relics

5408130.name: Unfanged: All fight, no bite Demo
5408130.short_description: Unfanged is a 2D action-platformer where you help Dracula's  disappointing son fight back against the injustices he had to face. Jump, suck and stomp your way to the highscores! Stand against fierce boss battles, old acquaintances and new faces alike. Prove to all that dying is easy, living is hard!

4654450.name: SOS! Love~Controlled
4654450.short_description: [SOS! Love~Controlled] is a live-action interactive romance game. You wander into a bar called "SOS" and meet three girls: Hiyori, a rich closet otaku; Naomi, the gentle yet dangerous owner; and Ruina, a withdrawn lolita. A casual night out slowly turns into something far more mysterious.

5448460.name: Deadly Voyage
5448460.short_description:
A chaotic murder party aboard 1930s ocean liners. As a passenger, you must find and kill your target. But be careful. Someone is also hunting you.  

Bonk your target with a champagne bottle, drop a chandelier on them, or slip them a wallet that goes bang. Just don't let security see.

5170860.name: Cleanup Unit
