5170860.short_description: A first-person co-op horror-cleaning game where you explore procedurally generated museums, collect rubbish, scrub filthy floors and walls, manage your power, upgrade your cleaning gear, and survive the monsters stalking the exhibits.

3993260.name: Yes, My Queen Demo
3993260.short_description: The chess roguelike. Play game-changing cards, bend the rules, save your Queen, and escape from the dungeon.

5461060.name: IFRIT
5461060.short_description: A horror game by B.Reader based on Arabian Nights.

5490640.name: Mystical II : Les savoirs oubliés Demo
5490640.short_description: The free demo of Mystical II: the filmed tutorial and the 10 stages of the Village. Buy the falling objects for a gold coin each, gather trios and pairs in your bag, then reveal them with the magnifier before a column overflows.

4860840.name: Don't Hang Up
4860840.short_description: A short visual novel where you play as a payphone that is going through its last night before being shut down. How this night will go is up to you.

5161780.name: Rasterfall
5161780.short_description: An open-world survival crafting game where every pixel is physically simulated and chemically reactive. Explore the world using a wide variety of materials, synthesize new substances, and build automated production lines. Multiplayer supported.

4953280.name: Groovekeeper
4953280.short_description: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

5191090.name: Aegis Vanguard
5191090.short_description: Lead humanity's last hope, a squad of desperate heroes, through a grim, corrupted realm in this dark fantasy strategy roguelite. Master squad combos and grid inventory management tactics. Create builds & synergies to outsmart dangerous threats in a bleak world where our fate rests on your survival.

5179940.name: Ashen Legacy Demo
5179940.short_description: Ashen Legacy is a fast-paced 2D Action RPG set in a dark fantasy world. Master intense combat, unleash powerful skills, defeat deadly monsters, and uncover the legacy buried within the ashes.

5478080.name: STRIKERS PRO LEAGUE
5478080.short_description: STRIKERS PRO LEAGUE is a free-to-play 5v5 online football game where every pass, shot and tackle is down to you. No aim assist: charge your own power, shape the curl with spin and beat your marker. Create your player, join a club and climb the ranked ladder.

5238090.name: NAQOO: BOLTFIRE
5238090.short_description: Fast-paced local arena shooter for 2–4 players on one screen. Shoot, set traps, capture automated turrets, and blow up explosive barrels. Destructible arenas and customizable rules keep every match different, with quick rematches, petty tricks, instant karma, and plenty of laughs.

5226940.name: Tidy Farm
5226940.short_description: Tidy Farm is a cozy organizing simulator where you transform a chaotic farm into your dream homestead. Pick everything up, figure out where it belongs and sort 4,544 Items.

5213370.name: RPG Developer Bakin Horror Decal Pack
5213370.short_description: A horror asset pack featuring 28 decal types (115 variations), including bloodstains, handprints, footprints, talismans, eerie drawings, and otherworldly portals, plus 206 sound effects. Bring crime scenes, haunted locations, and monster-infested ruins to life with chilling visuals and sound.

5435040.name: Mine Rogue
5435040.short_description: Minesweeper logic meets roguelike builds. Dig every safe tile, place soil tiles and attach dozens of Marks, from Dynamite to Frogs and Planets, then watch a single click set off a chain across the board. Survive a Hazard every third floor on the way down to the 24th floor.

1123760.name: Tricky Cow - Soundtrack
1123760.short_description: The original soundtrack for Tricky Cow contains 6 original tracks featured in the game.

4859410.name: Sword of Ace Demo
4859410.short_description: A punishing 3rd-person soulslike action RPG set in a blood-soaked Gothic Horror Victorian world. Step into the armor of a final knight from the Sword of Ace Order, wield your iron sword against terrifying demonic hordes, and fight to survive the grim, mysterious remnants of a fallen civilization.

1086190.name: Tricky Fox - Soundtrack
1086190.short_description: The original soundtrack for Tricky Fox contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

5446610.name: Villa Anzuelo: El Biógrafo de Difuntos Demo
5446610.short_description: Try the opening of this illustrated gothic mystery adventure. Explore, examine clues and accompany Francisco to Villa Anzuelo. This free demo ends as you enter the mansion; continue the investigation in the full game.

5030830.name: Dancing Wings - The Aerobatic Simulator Demo
5030830.short_description: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

5130900.name: Toy Battles
5130900.short_description: Build a squad of toys, stack buffs, and chain game-breaking combos in this roguelite auto battler. Unlock something new each run, endless synergies awaits — break the game!

5333990.name: Habet
5333990.short_description: You were sold onto the sand and walked off it free. Now you own men who stand where you stood. Buy them, train them, send them out to bleed. Every one of them wants what you were given, and however long you last, the sand is waiting.

5046980.name: Rogue Femme
5046980.short_description: Rogue Femme is an adult roguelike deckbuilder set in a corrupt land. Craft a unique deck, discover powerful relics, fight dozens of monstergirls, and hold back the corruption as you try not to be transformed into one of them.

4743050.name: FD 27: Direct Your Football Club Demo
4743050.short_description: A football management game where you're not the coach, you're the club owner. Hire and fire the coaching staff, sign players, negotiate with sponsors, control the finances and build a winning organisation from the boardroom.

4975530.name: Hyper Trigger
4975530.short_description: Build limitless momentum in this stylish, fast-paced parkour platformer. Propel yourself effortlessly across a digital metropolis, eliminating threats and chaining combos to dominate the leaderboards.

1102450.name: Voxel Bot - Soundtrack
1102450.short_description: The original soundtrack for Voxel Bot contains 8 original tracks featured in the game.

5201290.name: 桌面-宜居星球
5201290.short_description: A soothing little planet for your desktop—farm, fish, and enjoy a leisurely life with your   you often find yourself staring blankly at your computer while busy with work and want something that doesn't require mental effort...Welcome to your very own desktop "Livable Planet."

3370640.name: Liminophobia
3370640.short_description: Walking and Swimming Simulator. No monsters. Explore liminal spaces where each level reflects different aspects of your mind. Savor the atmosphere and let your feelings guide you. Relax or feel anxious as you dive underwater. Overcome your fears in uncanny, unnerving, and eerie spaces.

5389360.name: 新説魔法少女+
5389360.short_description: A long-form SRPG set in modern Japan. The strange and fateful story of girls who gained immense power. A simple yet challenging system where you fight by consuming MP to use skills. The individuality of the numerous characters fuses with the story and their roles as units.

5210860.name: Nulphia Demo
5210860.short_description: A top-down action-adventure inspired by the classics. Master physics-based combat, solve intricate environmental puzzles, and explore a non-linear island full of magic and mystery. Download the free demo to play the entire first chapter!

5075420.name: Project TITAN
5075420.short_description: You start with a tiny mech factory, a pile of scrap, and one goal: make money. Manufacture parts, assemble mechs, and take on questionable contracts for clients who don't ask about ethics, just excellent margins. Grow your factory, upgrade your tech tree, and build the ultimate mech: TITAN.

5272040.name: OverDoze Demo
5272040.short_description: All Dasha wants is to get some sleep and finish watching her favorite dream. But in a crime‑ridden metropolis ruled by organized crime groups and corporations, that turns into an unattainable dream.

3519630.name: Live War
3519630.short_description: Live War is a immersive 3D tactical strategy game that combines realistic visuals with intuitive gameplay. Strategically deploy soldiers, vehicles, with the most suitable commander, outmaneuver enemies with smart tactics. Every decision matters—will you claim victory through precision and strategy?

5446440.name: Villa Anzuelo: El Biógrafo de Difuntos
5446440.short_description: A writing commission takes you to a mansion above the sea. Uncover its secrets, listen to its inhabitants and piece together a story in which the dead still have something to say.

4828340.name: Snake: Gridbreaker
4828340.short_description:
There is no tutorial.

And there won't be.

I believe in you. 

I couldn't escape the Grid. Maybe you can.

You are snake who eats apples. 

j/k

You want to escape the grid loop.

BUT the LOOP wants to keep You in.

5419790.name: Bunny Hopper VR
5419790.short_description: Bunny Hopper VR is a fast-paced VR platformer combining parkour, wall-running, precision jumps, and target shooting. Race through futuristic obstacle courses, master your movement, and hit targets on the go. Every second counts!

4772690.name: Cubuild 立方 Demo
4772690.short_description: A puzzle-platformer where you can't jump. Use limited blocks, sprints, and resets to complete the level.

5131600.name: Survindust Demo
5131600.short_description: Play the free demo! Stranded on a tiny island in an endless ocean, you craft new land tile by tile, automate production and grow a bare camp into a self-sustaining industrial base.

2845200.name: SULFUR Demo
2845200.short_description: This is the Demo of SULFUR - a modern old-school action-adventure: Outsmart enemies, find treasure, improve weapons, harness powers. Delve deeper, find answers, make it end.

4892260.name: Snake: Gridbreaker Demo
4892260.short_description: Play the first loop of Snake: Gridbreaker. Defeat the Gatekeeper, unlock Ghost Snake, progress Anomaly Signal, and carry your save into the full game.

2692740.name: Swappy World
2692740.short_description: Two main actions: swipe to move and tap to interact in an open-world survival crafting experience made through cards. Handle your energy tactically to survive as long as possible. Craft weapons, build your base and be prepared to explore a world full of secrets.

5201500.name: NecroSmash
5201500.short_description: A first-person survivors-like for solo or co-op play. Dash, slide, and smash through hundreds of enemies across multi-level arenas, level up mid-run, and face a boss at the end of every level. Clear a run to unlock new classes and new areas to test them in.

5447420.name: Whispering Meadows
5447420.short_description: Whispering Meadows is a cozy farming and life simulation game where you can farm, build, explore, and restore a world consumed by mysterious pollution. Play solo or with friends, grow your dream farm, and bring nature back to life in a charming, ever-changing world.

5405950.name: Memento Reverse
5405950.short_description: A dark fantasy card game born from the classic memory game. Every card fires its effect the moment it is flipped, and what you remember becomes your hand. Battle the CPU, or connect Claude Desktop to play against Claude or watch Claude play its own matches.

4919950.name: EpicSelectly
4919950.short_description: EpicSelectly is a bullet hell shooter where you choose between the dense Red World and the fast Blue World. Repeated choices raise each world's rank and intensify its patterns. Dodge aimed and random bullets, customize Extra Mode's difficulty, and compete on Steam leaderboards.

5394170.name: HACHIKOMA: Underground Stadium No. 8
5394170.short_description: Anime spinning-top battles in an endless underground passage. If something is wrong, turn back. If nothing is wrong, beat the blader who waits and walk on. Spot the anomalies, win the battles and reach the exit 8... if it exists.

4806270.name: What The Cluck
4806270.short_description: Fire eggs. Eggs explode. You go up. That's the whole plan. A Foddian precision platformer about a hen and their stolen golden egg.

1128490.name: General Staff Black Powder Wargaming System
1128490.short_description: The General Staff: Black Powder Wargaming System is the ultimate in simulating 18th and 19th century battles. Built around the MATE AI it comes with dozens of battles (Waterloo, Gettysburg, Little Big Horn (with alternative scenarios including Gatling guns), Antietam, and more.

5152110.name: Desktop Bug Killer Demo
5152110.short_description: This desktop incremental shooter pits you against swarms of mechanical bugs spawning from screen edges to destroy your PC core. Grab weapons and shoot to hold back bug waves. Earn gold each run to unlock a massive skill tree, upgrading weapons, damage, desktop pets, special abilities.

2266890.name: BECROWNED
2266890.short_description: A non-linear survival horror drawing inspiration from the surrealist dark satire of VHS-era Horror and lurid atmosphere of classic Grindhouse cinema. Step into Richard Torrance's shoes and survive a complex web of relationships as you phase between industrial ruins and a tragic fantasy kingdom.

3555880.name: The Soul of Cosmos（灵魂乾坤） Demo

5481830.name: Tank Command Armored Front Pinball
5481830.short_description:
**LOCK. LOAD. FLIP. FIRE!** 💥  
Charge and unleash total battlefield chaos with screaming **ramps**, rapid-fire **spinners**, pounding **bumpers**, smashing **drop targets**, lifesaving **kickbacks**, and explosive **MULTIBALL MAYHEM!** 🌀🎯🔥

**More steel. More fire. More pinball.**

3805820.name: Zangyou: Overtime
3805820.short_description: The workday is over. The building disagrees. Trapped on the 32nd floor of a Tokyo office tower, you must escape a hostile AI that seals exits, shifts corridors, and hunts you through the building.

5306400.name: 海特兰世界
5306400.short_description: Haitland World is a single-player idle RPG that simulates an MMO world. Rule-driven NPCs fight, trade, join guilds and become rivals. Enjoy gear progression, auto-battle and offline rewards. Core gameplay runs locally. Simulated top-ups involve no real money.

5288130.name: DaSong
5288130.short_description:
The Greatest Corrupt Official of the Great Song Dynasty
This is an alternate-history story. You play as Zhao Jiu, starting as a minor clerk. Rise to the throne, meet vivid characters and change the plot with your choices. Though known as a corrupt official, your goal is to save the Great Song.

4693550.name: Дорога Жизни
4693550.short_description: In the winter of 1942, you drive a GAZ-AA truck across frozen Lake Ladoga, carrying supplies to besieged Leningrad. Blizzards hide the road, your engine can fail far from shore, and enemy aircraft patrol the sky. You’ll meet people who need your help, and it’s up to you whether to stop.

4417760.name: Snotty's Sewer Reflushed
4417760.short_description: Enter the sewer one more time! Snotty's Sewer Reflushed is the remastered indie horror where survival is key, and buttons must be pressed.

5230720.name: AstroPoly Demo
5230720.short_description: Explore procedurally generated planets, mine valuable ores, upgrade your gear, and set out for the next world in this space mining game. The demo can be played through the third planet.

5438740.name: Sancta Forma
5438740.short_description: A puzzle game about one shape on a small board. Every move absorbs what you step on. Take your own kind and you grow stronger. Take the wrong kind and you start to come apart. 90+ rites, three hunters, and a Forge for building puzzles of your own.

5064360.name: TreeLine
5064360.short_description: Grow strange trees that don't exist in the wild, chop them down swing by swing, fill the morning truck, and pay off what you owe — one day at a time. A first-person orchard sim about honest work and heavy debt.

3699910.name: Lines of Battle
3699910.short_description: Command armies in tactical battles with simultaneous turns during the Napoleonic Wars. Lead forces through single-player strategy campaigns, master formations and flanking tactics, then test your skills in competitive 1v1 and 4v4 battles.

5312650.name: MONSTERLAY
5312650.short_description: Enter the Monster Repository, where beings from countless worlds gather. Fight in quick attack and defense minigames, make shameless requests, and collect illustrated stories in this adult dark fantasy visual novel.

2818570.name: Glasshouse Demo
2818570.short_description: Feudalpunk CRPG, with Turn-based combat, set in a lockdown apartment block at the dawn of a world war. Investigate the mysterious triple murder next door, fight the Political Conspiracy, and make terrible choices before the flatmates do it for you!

5360900.name: Flopball
5360900.short_description: Flopball is a football party game for up to 6 players online. Score goals, slide into tackles and send your rivals tumbling. Power-ups and wild arena events can turn any play upside down. Team up with friends or practise against bots offline.

5126390.name: 滚滚大画师
5126390.short_description:
A simple color-sense game. Drag hamsters onto matching wheels to charge the art gate and color a famous painting. Clear all wheels to collect it and view it in your gallery.

Beat the final level—your color sense tops 98% of players!

5016780.name: Planet INC Demo
5016780.short_description: Planet-colonizing deckbuilder roguelike! Contract with galactic megacorps for blueprints, drop onto uncharted worlds, and extract maximum profit. Harvest resources from alien terrains and creatures, skyrocket planetary value, and flip the world to the highest bidder!

1378050.name: Second Dawn
1378050.short_description: Sent ahead alone to make a dead world breathe, you print machines, raise heat and air and turn Hearth green. But your warmth wakes a swarm beneath the ruins. Hold the line with turrets, then take the fight to its hives in tanks, walkers and gunships. Survival terraforming for 1–4 players.

2545030.name: Drop Point
2545030.short_description: How long can you last in a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies? Will you team up or go solo?

5042290.name: 巴哈姆特3-龍神之子的墮落
5042290.short_description: Bahamut 3: Fall of the Dragon God's Child is a dark fantasy JRPG where every choice shapes the hero’s fate. Fight tactical battles using positioning, attack ranges, and Action Points, recruit companions tied to the Seven Deadly Sins, and manage weapons, hunger, time, and resources.

1770950.name: Batch Panorama Converter: 360 Image Tool
1770950.short_description: Batch convert real 2:1 360 panorama images, preview them in an offline interactive viewer, and catch invalid files before delivery. Supports JPG, PNG, TIFF, WebP, HEIC, HDR, and EXR inputs for VR, 3D, HDRI, and social workflows.

4523510.name: DAWG - Digital Audio Workstation Game
4523510.short_description: Swap endless scrolling for something fun and creative. Build beats, layer synths, and shape your sound with a full mixer and live FX. With support for MIDI, Steam Deck, and mobile devices, DAWG starts simple and grows with you as you learn across all platforms. Multi platform 4-player multiplayer!

4568320.name: Flesh Grinding
4568320.short_description: Grind flesh. Gather blood. Upgrade. A first-person incremental horror game where you manage a macabre basement. Buy dark upgrades. boost your efficiency. and push your machinery to the limit while avoiding the terrifying entity that watches your every move.

4143640.name: Reef Break
4143640.short_description: Reef Break is a realistic surfing simulation set in an untouched tropical paradise. Read the swell, paddle out through crystal water, and ride real-feeling waves across reef breaks teeming with life. No crowds, no scores, just you and the ocean.

5101010.name: Carnamole
5101010.short_description: You are stuck in a hellish carnival where you are forced to play whack-a-mole to survive. Your captors seem to enjoy making you suffer. Will you survive in this hell hole?

4563410.name: Girlfailure Art Club
4563410.short_description: Fall in love again with the cringey otaku girls who spent their school days drawing in the corner. Packed with 2010s otaku culture, memes, and second-hand embarrassment, this visual novel lets you relive a painfully cute youth with the oddballs of a Japanese art club!

5123580.name: Alienshire
5123580.short_description: Alienshire is a tactical RTS built around short, replayable scenarios. Command your units, manage limited resources, and outsmart the enemy.

5385930.name: Driftfort: The Drowned World
5385930.short_description: Four planks against the deep. Turn your raft into a floating fortress, secure food and water, and automate your supplies. Defend your home against night attacks and explore five sea regions on your journey to a safe coast.

3828950.name: SYNC - One Mecha, Two Pilots
3828950.short_description: Meet dual-brain co-op: Two Pilots. One Mecha. Sync up (or screw up) to crush absurd Kaiju or rival duos in chaotic, over-the-top 2v2 battles.

4596310.name: Outer Flame
4596310.short_description: Outer Flame is a JRPG featuring a rich storyline, extensive exploration, and strategic turn‑based battles. The game presents an authentic, classic role‑playing experience.

5271760.name: Serpent City
5271760.short_description: Serpent City is a turn-based board game of influence, trade and conflict. Accessible rules reward deep strategy: build your economy, outsmart your rivals and turn chance into opportunity. Play against computer opponents, locally with friends or online.

3850670.name: HAUNTED: Escape the Dollhouse
3850670.short_description:
One player investigates a mysterious dollhouse while their friends are trapped inside it. 
A chaotic and highly replayable co-op paranormal investigation for 2–4 players. Share clues, solve occult puzzles, and try not to panic when your friends give terrible directions.

5001770.name: Farmstead Market Simulator
5001770.short_description: Build and grow your own farm and roadside market. Grow crops, raise animals, craft valuable products, set prices, hire employees, stock your shelves, serve customers, and expand your small operation into a thriving business.

5319410.name: My Staff Are Dead! Paranormal Tycoon
5319410.short_description: Build a business empire with a workforce that's already dead. Recruit and train ghosts, run supernatural attractions, and balance profit, reputation and suspicion in this darkly humorous estate-management sim. The guests think it's all special effects. You know better.

3681610.name: DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
3681610.short_description:
In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle.

Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.

4424920.name: ARC Raiders - The Wasp Hunter Set
4424920.short_description: The Rust Belt’s resident trophy hunter. Wearing the shell of a Wasp as a face shield, this masked hunter sees the fearsome ARC for what they really are: parts to be scavenged.

4439370.name: Mechs V Kaijus 2
4439370.short_description: Mechs V Kaijus 2 is an Hybrid Tower/Base defense, with army vs army (tug of war style) tactics. From the cockpit of a mech, to build a huge base with Reactors, Mines and all type of tower army factories and super weapons.

4439740.name: Mechs V Kaijus 2 Demo
4439740.short_description: Mechs V Kaijus 2 is an Hybrid Tower/Base defense, with army vs army (tug of war style) tactics. From the cockpit of a mech, to build a huge base with Reactors, Mines and all type of tower army factories and super weapons.

4498660.name: Arcade Cafe Simulator
4498660.short_description: Build and run your own arcade cafe. Buy and arrange machines, welcome customers, maintain your equipment, serve food and drinks in your restaurant, expand your business, and transform a small arcade into a lively entertainment destination.

5090440.name: Ghostly Late Night Show
5090440.short_description: Step into the role of a mischievous ghost in VR or nonVR adventure show filled with slapstick humor and puzzles. Sneak into Billy’s home, manipulate objects, and set up ingenious traps. Join a supernatural late night show, dazzle your audience of specters, and uncover the touching story of Billy.

5169970.name: No One Gets Through
5169970.short_description: Free demo available! A free-placement tower defense game with roguelite card upgrades. Redirect enemies, choose one of three upgrade cards, and buy upgrades and supplies at the Battlefield Shop. Shape your build and hold the line with overlapping fire.

4489960.name: The Forge: Steel Frontier
4489960.short_description: The Forge is a mech-combat sci-fi action game. Step into the cockpit as mercenary pilot Ivan and fight alongside a mech with a soul—Machine Spirit. Dormant Dragon holds a strange and rare mineral. When wolves come for the ore, you and your mech must choose, and planet's fate hangs in the balance.

4749590.name: EXODUSER: HELL LORD
4749590.short_description: Fight through hordes of demons in a dark fantasy action RPG. Parry color-coded bullet patterns, chain across the battlefield, fuse skills into devastating attacks, and build your own loadout as you climb through seven layers of hell.

2366590.name: Rideshare "Stimulator"
2366590.short_description: Build your rideshare business while navigating real-world traffic, managing your vehicle, and transporting a wide range of unique passengers. Master the streets, keep your car in shape, and deliver every ride, no matter how strange it gets.

5367410.name: 南北朝天下对弈
5367410.short_description: Strategy card game set in China's Northern and Southern Dynasties. Command nine historical rulers and 120 general, minister and stratagem cards across four battle lines - infantry, cavalry, navy and strategy - each scored alone. Every card costs provisions, and your hand carries over between rounds.

5453050.name: しろを塗る Castle Paint Demo

5284970.name: Spirits: Wake Up!
5284970.short_description: SPIRITS: WAKE UP! is a 2–8 player online horror party game. Speak into your mic to chase as a Hunter, or float through retro sewers, complete tasks, and rescue friends as a Ghost. Just don't let your screams give you away!

5283650.name: Postpartum | 산후조리원
5283650.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set over five days in a Korean postpartum care center. The nurse was replaced overnight, and the new one always seems to be holding your baby.

4348240.name: Ashen Knight
4348240.short_description: A dark fantasy survivor roguelike with automatic combat, where every run starts from nothing. Unlock unique heroes, experiment with powerful skill builds, and survive relentless enemy waves.

4682230.name: Aurora Protocol Demo
4682230.short_description: Move in with a family friend, the missing owner of Artimus Corp, a tech mega-conglomerate. As androids act strangely and your dreams unravel, uncover the truth of your past in this adult cyberpunk visual novel where choices shape relationships and a growing harem.

4947300.name: 汉墓飞僵 Demo
4947300.short_description: Chaotic Republican-era China shrouded in dark fog. Play as a wandering Taoist with peachwood tools and cinnabar talismans, defeat ghosts and flying jiangshi to calm evil spirits.

4376980.name: Age of Empires II: DE - The Viking Sagas
4376980.short_description: Unleash the fury of the North and lead the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians into epic Viking battles.

4564160.name: Lens of Lust Demo
4564160.short_description: Who said you can't mix profit with pleasure? Become a lewd photographer in this corny mix of visual novel and business management. Do you have what it takes to enchant the lens...?

4646300.name: Spy Carnival Demo
4646300.short_description: Spy Carnival is a 2-10 player social deception game set in a vibrant, chaotic funfair. Spies hide among the crowd, sabotaging rides and eliminating visitors while blending in with NPCs. Officers must stay sharp, read the crowd and take down the spies before the carnival turns into complete chaos.

3592670.name: Mizi NO! - Paperwork
3592670.short_description: The "Paperwork" DLC adds 20 new objects for Mizi to joyfully destroy—because she knows you won’t be able to resist piecing them back together. 😉

3640620.name: Main Sequence Demo
3640620.short_description: Main Sequence is a first-person space-sim factory builder where you design spaceships, build space stations, and automate everything. Start with a single ship and grow to become an interstellar industrial empire as you leave your mark on the galaxy.

3261900.name: Dinocop Demo
3261900.short_description: In a world where dinosaurs and humans live side by side, you're the one and only Dinocop. And you got a meaty case to crack. In this mystery game set in a day cycle, uncover secrets scattered through time.

2353722.name: SnowRunner - Jack of All Treads Tire Pack
2353722.short_description: You can customize your SnowRunner experience further with the Jack of All Treads Tire Pack, adding over 50 unique tire & rim combinations for your whole fleet!

5294670.name: Murciavania
5294670.short_description: Explore a dark, folkloric Murcia in this 2D metroidvania. Master weapons, perfect parries and incantations, uncover hidden passages and cross into the mirrored Envés. 444 rooms, 47 bosses and two endings. Spanish and English text.

5254900.name: しろを塗る Castle Paint
5254900.short_description: Paint the floors your color and capture castles in this casual 3D arena battler. Explore an open plaza with island minigames and paint puzzles, or build your own stages with the level editor. Play solo against CPU, or jump into online PvP and co-op.

1556706.name: Capcom Arcade Stadium：LEGENDARY WINGS
1556706.short_description:
Add LEGENDARY WINGS to your Capcom Arcade Stadium game line-up!

Humankind is on the verge of being wiped out by an alien supercomputer! With the Wings of Love and Courage from Ares, take flight to save humanity!

1576390.name: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Thorek Ironbrow
1576390.short_description: As a legendary Lord, Thorek Ironbrow leads Ironbrow’s Expedition in his quest to recover the relics and help restore the Dwarf Empire. Thorek can also combine resources at the Anvil of Doom to craft powerful artefacts for his forces.

1392100.name: Automobilista 2 Premium Track Pack
1392100.short_description: Pack including the five original Premium Track DLCs plus a sixth bonus track, featuring laser-scanned versions of these legendary circuits in their modern form along with incredibly faitfhul recreations of their historical layouts throughout the decades

1318180.name: WiccAtriX
1318180.short_description:
Wiccatrix is a story driven ARPG with a spellcrafting system that allows the player to create custom spells to use
in combat and to solve puzzles. Your goal is to explore the lands of Terra and help restore the elemental order back to harmony.

638360.name: Half-Rats: Parasomnia
638360.short_description: A single-player total-conversion Horror modification for Half-Life 1, set in the late 1800's.

382570.name: Glass Wing
382570.short_description: The adventure of a young, scared, but smart girl.

4069200.name: ComboBench
4069200.short_description: System benchmark that detects the bottleneck component in your PC.

5425800.name: AppWheel
5425800.short_description: Hold a shortcut and a wheel of your favorite apps and games shows up right at your cursor.

3857110.name: Oremus
3857110.short_description: This text adventure, beautifully illustrated in pixel art, invites you to explore a medieval abbey filled with secrets. You take full control by entering commands directly on your keyboard through a flexible command parser, allowing for free and immersive interaction.

4841310.name: KnighTD
4841310.short_description: Defend an ever-expanding procedural map where towers buff your units and every boss drops game-changing loot. Choose a class, master Fire, Ice, Lightning, or Physical units, and survive.

5146570.name: Dreadlines
5146570.short_description: Live two of your wildest fantasies: Being employed AND talking to women!      Date your undead coworkers, survive corporate deadlines and try not to lose your soul in this satirical monster office dating sim.

4402990.name: Modificator
4402990.short_description:
A multiplayer extraction shooter built around self-modification. 



Hunt creatures, trade with rival factions, and equip Modificators salvaged from your kills to upgrade health, damage, fire-rate and more,  then extract before someone strips you for parts.

5046850.name: Stellar Nursery
5046850.short_description: Relight a dead sun and tend the worlds that circle it. Earth comes back to life, builds a city you name, and keeps a written record of all that follows. P.O.R.T.I.A., the caretaker who waited a hundred thousand years, keeps the watch with you. A quiet idle game that works while you are away.

1043820.name: Tricky Cat - Soundtrack
1043820.short_description: The original soundtrack for Tricky Cat contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

4440900.name: Theorem 4096
4440900.short_description: Theorem 4096 is a number-merging puzzle game infused with mathematical theorems. Swipe and merge your way from natural numbers to fractions, roots, and infinity — every step connects you to the wisdom of great mathematicians

5319170.name: 은하수
5319170.short_description:
Months after the incident, the protagonist sets out, following the traces left behind by his wife.
To uncover the truth behind that day, and to fulfill his wife’s final request.
A 2D Grappling Anchor Action platformer featuring fast-paced aerial movement and hard-hitting combat, <Milky Way>.

4163520.name: Mermaids are Seafood
4163520.short_description: You're a new hire at a company that sells mermaids as seafood. Bet your blood, navigate conspiracies, and cook for customers in this psychological horror game with 11 endings. Are mermaids more like fish, people, or monsters?

5321510.name: Kimodameshi Online
5321510.short_description: Go live from a haunted school at night. The scarier it gets, the more viewers tune in. But one of you is a traitor. An online test of courage you play over voice chat, set in a Showa-era junior high school frozen since the day of an accident.

4771200.name: Monkey Wave Demo
4771200.short_description: Monkey Wave is a fast-paced action clicker where you defend your banana stash against waves of hostile apes. Click rapidly to defeat primates and epic bosses in solo, co-op, and PvP modes. Deploy strategic abilities and survive the chaos of the jungle.

5361350.name: MURK Demo
5361350.short_description: A bone wrenching blend of brutal melee and ranged combat. MURK is atmospheric combat horror in first person where you fight nightmarish creatures emerging from below. Survive against all odds in the vicious battle against the earth reclaiming itself.

4140490.name: The Gallery: VR Secrets Demo
4140490.short_description: Step Into The Gallery: VR Secrets! Immerse yourself in a VR art gallery where every painting holds a hidden puzzle.

3620450.name: The Gallery - Support DLC
3620450.short_description: Puzzle further in The Gallery with Gallery C, an expansion DLC unveiling a new wing of the mysterious art museum.

2191810.name: Hexdrive
2191810.short_description: Hexdrive is a high-speed endurance racing game where every decision matters. Overtake rivals, manage energy, heat and damage, and build your machine through the HEX lattice to survive long, high-speed races.

3863160.name: Breadwinner - The Loaf Life Simulator
3863160.short_description: Become the Breadwinner in this colourful 3D action-adventure! Explore strange worlds, collect crumbs and mysterious artifacts, solve objectives, avoid deadly traps and face bizarre enemies as you uncover the secrets of the Crumbverse.

5093380.name: Zombie Car: Kaiju Killer
5093380.short_description: Mow down relentless zombie hordes, turn carnage into cash, and upgrade your war rig into an unstoppable death machine! In this action-packed incremental roguelite, every run brings you closer to facing colossal Kaiju bosses. Gear up, smash through, and dominate!

4707800.name: AmaTisMo
4707800.short_description: A visual novel about mental health, depression, and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind and visually impaired players.

4961310.name: Terrahold
4961310.short_description: Build an autonomous colony on a living procedural planet. Gather resources, command robots, reshape the terrain, expand your power grid, and defend the teleporter from an ecosystem that reacts to your growth. Establish the link — or lose everything.

4899050.name: Pokremental
4899050.short_description: Pokremental is an incremental game where you flip poker cards to earn money. Buy cards and upgrades to earn more money, or hire helpers to automate the process. Gamble at the casino or on the skill tree to progress faster.

4546890.name: Noblefold: Kingdoms of Chance
4546890.short_description: Your crown is on the line. Build your kingdom, place your bets, and cheat to keep it all. Put gold, harvests and entire settlements on the table against ruthless creditors in a blackjack roguelike deckbuilder where your kingdom is the ultimate stake.

4507920.name: Cloud Infusion
4507920.short_description: Cloud Infusion is a casual social multiplayer game centered on free, rule-free play. With warm minimalist hand-drawn art and a unique “IV drip” recovery mechanic, it delivers a lighthearted, fun multiplayer experience that embodies gentle courage toward life, companionship, and overcoming hardship.

1858770.name: IsoCubes Soundtrack
1858770.short_description: The original soundtrack for IsoCubes contains 7 original tracks featured in the game.

1833370.name: LawnMower City Soundtrack
1833370.short_description: The original soundtrack for LawnMower City contains 5 original tracks featured in the game.

2138330.name: Cyberpunk 2077: Phantom Liberty
2138330.short_description: Phantom Liberty is a new spy-thriller expansion for the open-world action-adventure RPG Cyberpunk 2077. As cyber-enhanced mercenary V, join secret agent Solomon Reed to unravel a web of shattered loyalties and sinister political machinations.

3717010.name: CookTopia：料理乌托邦
3717010.short_description: A cozy simulation game blending farming, animal care, and cooking. it invites you to a cheerful, colorful world where you shape your utopia through a simple yet dynamic economy. Enjoy quick, satisfying gameplay sessions as you grow crops, cook dishes, and build your dream community!

4604740.name: Planet No More Demo
4604740.short_description: An arcade-incremental game where you DESTROY planets! Build a fleet, upgrade weapons, max out your skill tree and destroy your target slowly. You'll advance deep into the galaxy, strategically shattering planets to their cores to unlock the next celestial.

1185260.name: Planet Lander - Soundtrack
1185260.short_description: The original soundtrack for Planet Lander contains 8 original tracks featured in the game.

5069520.name: Artificially Stupid
5069520.short_description: Blend into a crowd of glitchy office AIs — or hunt the bugs hiding among them. A slapstick social-deduction party game for 2–16 players: copy the crowd, fake your quirks, sabotage the coffee machine, and survive the QA tester's bat.

3806710.name: Puzzle Temptation: Anime Reveal - Ecchi Overflow
3806710.short_description: Dive into a world of flirty charm and subtle seduction with over 140+ new puzzles full of playful ecchi energy.

3926210.name: Puzzle Temptation: Anime Reveal - HOT EXPANSION
3926210.short_description: It’s getting hot in here! Unlock a whole new level of fan service with this spicy image pack.

5427800.name: Robo Dream Party Demo
5427800.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer party brawler set inside a robot's dream, where physics goes haywire. Punch, grab, and throw anything you find, ride robot vehicles, and knock your friends off the map to be the last robot standing!

5236080.name: 重返校园2：首富上学 Demo
5236080.short_description: A UE5 open-world comedy game. Play as a super-rich kid who is accidentally transported from a modern city to a medieval world. Explore both eras, complete quests, interact with NPCs, drive around, start fights, and enjoy a free and absurd time-travel adventure.

5258060.name: 全小将 Demo
5258060.short_description: From a peasant boy in peninsula, to the most powerful man in the nation — and finally, to a criminal facing the judgment of history —— Sixty years of turbulence. One road from a thatched hut to the Blue House. How far will you go?

4557370.name: Morse Depths: WWII Demo
4557370.short_description: Take command of a WWII submarine. Master Morse Code to fire torpedoes, defuse mines, and survive the final siege. From 1942 to 1945, every dot and dash is the difference between glory and the ocean floor.

4165740.name: Vena
4165740.short_description: An automation roguelike where a run fits in one session. Place hexagonal tiles to grow a production organism while the resource demands rise over time. Roll dice in the shop to buy more tiles, and pick perks that change the rules and try to completely break the economy.

3244080.name: CarveLight
3244080.short_description: CarveLight is a turn-based multiplayer artillery game fought on fully destructible terrain. Take turns piloting physics-driven cars, carve the battlefield apart with lasers, grenades, and force fields, and be the last one driving. Play solo, on the couch, or online.

5381820.name: Tidy up me eggs!
5381820.short_description: 3,888 eggs. One cozy coop. A whole lot of sorting. Tidy up and organize a ridiculous variety of cute, silly, and wonderfully weird eggs. Just be careful what you break… the rooster has something to say about it!

4367120.name: 止战之战：The Great War Demo

4422970.name: Morse Depths: WWII
4422970.short_description: Command a WWII submarine and use Morse code to launch torpedoes, intercept threats, and evade mines. Hunt targets through the periscope, expand your fleet, and face giant monsters lurking in the depths.

5412260.name: EverArcane
5412260.short_description: Build a 3×3 grid of spells and watch your young mage obliterate endless monster hordes. Combine six elements, chain reactions and adjacency buffs, defeat ten Guardians, and push through the horde of monsters.

5451700.name: We Are Surrounded
5451700.short_description: Four heroes stand back to back on a floating island as hundreds of monsters close in. Place their rally points, then watch them fight on their own. Spend the loot on five upgrade trees, come back stronger and defeat the enemies.

5356940.name: Hex & Hunters
5356940.short_description: Hex & Hunters is a fast-paced action roguelite where you program your own dungeons and create complex projectiles to battle through rooms of various enemies, unlocking new biomes, items and foes.

4600130.name: Harvest Looper
4600130.short_description: Harvest plants, unlock upgrades, and expand your farming loop through skill trees, perks, and powerful harvesters. Collect fragments, complete Hidden Book sets, and optimize your incremental growth.

5418810.name: OPEN UP! IT'S ME
5418810.short_description: You're ten years old and home alone. Guests are arriving, but not everyone can be trusted. Look through the peephole, ask questions, search for clues, and decide who to let in. Not every guest belongs at your holiday table.

5200620.name: Dungeonbound
5200620.short_description: Dungeonbound is a retro first-person auto-battler dungeon crawler. Send your Warrior, Mage or Rogue into monster-packed depths, watch battles play out turn by turn, and grow stronger every run. Death just sends you home with the loot. Merge gear, buy upgrades, descend again.

2802340.name: Ragdoll Robotics
2802340.short_description: Build ridiculous trap combinations, launch a helpless robot across the laboratory, and watch spectacular chain reactions unfold! Experiment with mines, spikes, turrets, and catapults to solve physics-based challenges and cause maximum chaos.

5400860.name: Hold Morale Demo
5400860.short_description: Play the complete first world of Hold Morale: the Forest campaign with tutorial, every war map event, all 80 modules, and the world boss. A turn-based tactics roguelite where you combine retrofit kits into synergies and hold your army's morale.

2422470.name: Emojis vs Zombies
2422470.short_description: Emojis vs Zombies is an idle desktop zombie defense game! Open packs, collect emoji defenders, upgrade your squad and base, and survive endless waves, even while you're AFK or working!

3529090.name: Astra Bestiary
3529090.short_description: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

5006680.name: Project Athanor
5006680.short_description: Build automated factories to produce and upgrade elemental cards, assemble a six-card deck, then enter survivor-style arenas, collect temporary power-ups, and push through escalating waves for as long as you can survive.

5180580.name: The Inconvenience Store
5180580.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

5148200.name: Ashes Of The Fallen
5148200.short_description:
Ashes of the Fallen is a 2D action hack and slash RPG. Play as Arthur, a fallen warrior fighting his way out of the deepest dungeon. 
Battle deadly enemies, grow stronger, and rise to challenge the God of Time. Claim her crown and make one wish.

4694900.name: Rex Summons a Meteor Demo
4694900.short_description: A short demo about a large rock. Help Rex accidentally summon a meteor. Oops. Now you have to save the first island! Barter with stubborn dinosaurs who only talk in emoji, play some absurd mini-games, and solve puzzles in the first island of Rex Summons a Meteor.

5124180.name: Elastic Races
5124180.short_description:
Realistic Multiplayer Car Racing Game with dozens of tracks, hundreds of vehicles and dozens of drivers.
Turn Based play mode and Simultanious play mode with 6 different play modes, multiple vehicle types, perfect for family and friends game night

4919930.name: 威小鼠和猪大常：接龙
4919930.short_description: In *Willy and Charlie: Solitaire*, players journey through evolving challenges, building powerful decks and using strategy with a touch of luck to defeat opponents. Each match is unique—narrow wins or perfect chains can swing outcomes dramatically.

5396730.name: PrankzPlz!
5396730.short_description: Every great prank starts with a simple idea. Matt’s usually ends in complete chaos.

5306310.name: The Inconvenience Store Demo
5306310.short_description: Explore an endless, procedurally generated furniture store where daylight gives you time to scavenge and build—but after dark, hostile employees begin to hunt. Gather supplies, craft tools, manage your needs, and survive each night.

4596930.name: Mysteries of the House
4596930.short_description: You wake up with no memories inside the House, a place where reality bends... lies linger... and someone watching your every move.

5389210.name: Floorball Manager
5389210.short_description: Take charge of a floorball club in 8 nations. Scout talent, build your lines and watch every shift on an animated rink. Chase titles, the Continental Cup and national-team glory or rebuild the world your way with the full editor.

4143130.name: Fishy Business
4143130.short_description: A story-driven adventure where you captain a fishing boat. Explore a strange island, catch fish, trade and collect records of classical music.

5129260.name: Norselings Demo
5129260.short_description: Guide your Norse clan from Helheim to Asgard through runestone strikes and the rise of a Norseling settlement.

5454470.name: Alice: Defense Demo
5454470.short_description: Recruit heroes, build your team, and face waves of monsters in the Alice: Defense demo. Try a portion of the full game's battles and experiment with your team composition. We're working hard to make the game more fun.

5409020.name: Spin To Win
5409020.short_description: Flick, brake and reverse your way from one tiny fidget spinner to a bustling pixel arcade. Restore machines, build gadget combinations, master mouse driven minigames and spend earned Tickets on chance games and cosmetics.

5465230.name: Townlet
5465230.short_description: A tiny medieval village lives on top of your taskbar. Every file you delete falls from the sky, and its little villagers turn your digital trash into new ideas, buildings and festivals. Watch a lone campfire grow into a walled town while you work.

4135340.name: The Wake (Demo)
4135340.short_description: Set sail on the dark waters of a forgotten archipelago. Catch mutated monsters with customizable gear, master eldritch magic, and fight for survival. Take up arms to fend off sea beasts in an unforgiving Lovecraftian world.

4783310.name: Re:collect
4783310.short_description: In a postwar world where even memories can be used as collateral, you become the owner of a small pawnshop. Speak with customers, judge the value of their memories and belongings, and over 30 days of running the shop, uncover forgotten truths and the story of the protagonist.

5163330.name: RETURN POLICY
5163330.short_description: You work nights at a returns desk. Customers lie, haggle, guilt-trip you and throw punches, and you decide what gets accepted. Save up for a flat, feed the cat, don't go into the warehouse after three. The last guy on this shift went missing. Everyone in town tells it differently

3687130.name: Shards Reunited: Kintsugi - Expansion Pack
3687130.short_description: Expand your serene puzzle journey with 1200 new jigsaw puzzles featuring vibrant Japanese porcelain designs.

5461550.name: Containment Shift Company
5461550.short_description: Run a supernatural factory alone or with up to 9 friends. Care for unpredictable creatures, turn their materials into goods, and meet rising company quotas. Haul cargo, monitor the facility, and survive blackouts and containment breaches together.

976620.name: Enderal: Forgotten Stories (Special Edition)
976620.short_description: Enderal: Forgotten Stories (Special Edition) is a total conversion mod for Skyrim SE. It offers an immersive open world, new skill systems and gameplay with a dark, psychological storyline and believable characters. SE features a new rendering engine, improved lighting, performance and stability.

4738410.name: Silent Abbey
4738410.short_description: Brother Aurelijus, a priest, receives a letter warning that dark forces have taken over the abbey he once served. You set out on a journey toward the abbey, traveling through lands already corrupted by evil.

1340380.name: Kitori Academy
1340380.short_description:
Kitori Academy is a life simulator where you live the adventures of a wizard apprentice with your spirit companion.

Train your magical skills and learn how to brew potions, grow vegetables and catch spells to challenge the curse that lurks in the world.

5253980.name: Simple Football League Manager Demo
5253980.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

4951630.name: Soundway
4951630.short_description: Ride your own music. Soundway transforms any song into a neon roller coaster racing through deep space, with every burst of speed, climb, drop, and turn shaped by the track itself. Catch the beat, build massive combos, dodge hazards, and chase the music across the stars.

4974650.name: Streetwalker Life!
4974650.short_description: In this life sim management play as a young woman stranded with crushing debts. Manage time between odd jobs, street clients, upgrading outfits, gambling, and helping townsfolk. Use your body to earn fast cash to repay your loan before the Debt Collector comes calling!

5392200.name: Kingcrop
5392200.short_description: Gökyüzünde süzülen bir adada çiftlik kur ve doymak bilmeyen Domuz Kral'ı koca bir yıl boyunca tok tut. Komşularını güçlendiren ekinleri, korkulukları ve hayvanları yerleştir, dev zincirleme hasatlar yap ve her oyunda farklı bir çiftlik kur.

5429910.name: Lootmob
5429910.short_description: Smash through monster hordes, grab every drop and come back stronger! A third-person incremental action roguelite where you start naked with a stick and fight your way up to Legendary gear, bosses and new lands. Die. Loot. Repeat.

3947150.name: The Last Key
3947150.short_description: The Last Key is a straight forward casual survival horror game. With 12 levels per difficulty, and AI driven monsters so every time you play the experience will be different. Search for items to help you survive and lost keys to unlock doors. Escape and win your life, or fail and be stuck forever.

4837160.name: Spheromania Demo
4837160.short_description: Bounce, blast, and outlast in Spheromania. A fast-paced arena shooter where drones duel with blasters, mines, and mid-air hops. Manage your energy, dodge the shrinking arena, and be the last sphere hovering. Solo mode or online multiplayer.

4970630.name: Beellionaire Idle
4970630.short_description: In Bee-lionaire Idle, harvest your hives, process the honey, sell your products, and reinvest your profits in your farm. Unlock new equipment, boost your production, and build a honey empire starting from a single hive.

5099850.name: Simple Football League Manager
5099850.short_description: A football management game for people who love football but don't want to spend hours on every detail. Choose from 5,909 clubs, build your team, play in leagues and cups, and get insights from your assistant Rob. Includes 2 difficulty modes, local multiplayer and a customizable database.

4072920.name: True Nightmare - Diner Loop
4072920.short_description:
Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you.
Can you escape?

4839220.name: Friendly Fire Club
4839220.short_description: Blast your friends off the map! A chaotic physics party shooter where every bullet does something ridiculous: flip controls, teleport, launch, blind. Online matches for 2–10 players, or play solo vs bots.

5418550.name: Crossroads: Forgotten Paths
5418550.short_description:
A light-hearted adventure that whisks you around the micro-fantasy land of Bargvia, join The Mages Guild, meet The First Mage,
explore The Undercroft, engage with colourful locals and grind in enemy-filled Micro-Dungeons.

5066920.name: Rerack
5066920.short_description: Rerack is a pinball roguelike on planetary surfaces of rock and neon. Build your own table from bumpers, magnets and sensors, place them on the playfield and rotate them. Beat bosses, collect bonuses and go head to head with your friends.

5021740.name: Starworks Inc.
5021740.short_description: Harness the riches of a star system in this incremental game. Unlock new technologies, transform raw materials, build warships and win an interstellar war !

4939110.name: Chaos Cinema
4939110.short_description: Take over a run-down cinema and bring it back to life. Sell tickets, schedule movies, serve snacks and drinks, manage supplies, clean up the chaos and improve your cinema step by step.

5326430.name: Low Sun
5326430.short_description: Turn-based tactics on colorful 3D miniature battlefields. Capture buildings to fund your army, combine land, air and naval units, and keep them supplied. Use terrain and positioning to break through enemy lines and seize their headquarters.

5490580.name: FRONTLINE ADVANCE: DARK FRONTIER
5490580.short_description: FRONTLINE ADVANCE: DARK FRONTIER is a classic 2D real-time strategy game in the style of the golden age of RTS, but with its own unique identity: three factions, a dark science fiction conflict, and authentic base-building gameplay that players have been missing for years.

1838120.name: DATA_BREAK.exe
1838120.short_description: A darkly humorous horror RPG about an office drone who discovers that there are even scarier things than a life of the 9-5 routine.

5146650.name: PUCKVPUCK Demo
5146650.short_description: Arcade sports with pucks. Boost, slam and charge your shots in SOCCER, knock the other team out in DODGEBALL, or grab a gun in SHOOTER. Up to 8 players on one PC, online with friends, or solo against bots.

5134780.name: CCR - Cosmic Card Realm Demo
5134780.short_description: CCR is a free-to-play online collection game where every draw brings a new discovery. Complete card sets, forge them into unique Relics, and build a museum that grows with you. With no battles or competitive pressure, you can relax, draw a few cards each day, and enjoy collecting for years.

3369220.name: BitBeasts
3369220.short_description: Can you survive humanity's deadliest drones? Build your ship, evolve alien Beasts, unlock powerful talents, and fight through an ultra-hard roguelite space shooter where every run is different.

2484890.name: Deeper Still
2484890.short_description: A hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them. Co-op mode included.

5107310.name: Nicotine & Knives
5107310.short_description: Nicotine & Knives is a top-down pixel roguelike where every run pushes you deeper across shifting dimensions. Fight brutal bosses, wield weapons and items with wild unique bonuses, and gamble your own stats for a shot at power.

5491440.name: FINAL COUNT
5491440.short_description: Clock in for inventory week and scan every box before 6:00 AM. Explore a foggy shipping yard through a store-issued phone, manage its battery, follow radio instructions, and survive five increasingly impossible night shifts.

5246040.name: Debt - This game's cost keeps climbing
5246040.short_description: Debt is a climate-guessing game for which the cost only keeps increasing. Ever. Play with actual global warming data and compete to be the most accurate visionary. One thing is sure, now is the best time to buy the game, as its price will soon increase. All proceeds go to The Nature Conservancy.

4656880.name: PATIENCE IS A VIRTUE
4656880.short_description: Something's hiding in the cassette. Rearrange the words of your enemies to investigate a small-town conspiracy in this mystery puzzle game.

4302320.name: Oreloop
4302320.short_description: Break blocks in a first-person mine for 15 seconds. When the time runs out, spend your ore on a huge skill tree and new pickaxes. Wake up to a fresh, bigger mine. Grow from one slow block at a time to lightning, black holes and drills that break hundreds of blocks.

3034770.name: SUPEv3
3034770.short_description: Create stunning survival FPS games in minutes with our revolutionary game engine! No scripting required—just pure creativity and fun. Bring your game ideas to life effortlessly and focus on what matters: gameplay and map expansion!

5015640.name: Ship or Burn! Сoop express Playtest

5441160.name: Squirrel Defender VR
5441160.short_description: You are the last squirrel standing. Perched on your treetop platform, draw your repeating crossbow and hold off wave after wave of wolves, bees and groundhogs. Build auto-turrets, chain power-ups, defend the tree.

4948940.name: Swarmbreaker
4948940.short_description: Swarmbreaker is an incremental tower defense game where you must defend your base from a giant living wave of alien bugs. Build defenses to block their path, deploy heavy weapons, upgrade your arsenal, and break the swarm!

2994630.name: 子どもたちの庭
2994630.short_description: Welcome to the Reincarnation Ethics Program "Children's Garden." This is a puzzle game where you seek eternal rest.

4979730.name: Void Walkers X64
4979730.short_description: Embark on a classic 2D overhead RPG adventure inspired by the golden era of 16-bit classics. Forge your destiny across five distinct progression paths, master tactical combat, and explore a world where your choices unlock powerful hybrid classes.

5460630.name: Crash Protocol: The Wrong Directive
5460630.short_description: Outsmart malfunctioning robots in a turn-based grid strategy game. Lure them into collisions, use tactical bonuses and Safe Teleport, and master 50 fixed campaign levels, endless Survival waves and a separate ASCII Classic mode.

5228470.name: Hotpot Party
5228470.short_description: Run a hotpot restaurant solo or with up to three friends. Queue ingredients, grab them from the conveyor and serve dinner before it burns. Buy better ingredients and upgrades between days, and try to keep your friends from filling the belt with tofu.

5008320.name: Bit Footballer: The Career
5008320.short_description: You're the player — not the manager. Start on the bench at a fourth-division village ground and play your way up to the title. Every career runs in its own generated world: 74 clubs, four divisions, and a scout who sees everything.

5335480.name: Ratiator
5335480.short_description: Your master vanished the night the lamps went out. Now his gladiator dojo is yours. Raise rat fighters and write their tactics command by command. Arm them with spoons and bottle caps. Climb a ladder of over 2000 living fighters.

4829510.name: Eternal Angler Demo
4829510.short_description: A surreal multiplayer fishing game where you catch strange creatures hidden across fragmented dimensions.

5383300.name: Bullet Glory
5383300.short_description: A neon arena score-attack shooter. Clear bullet storms, unlock 12 ships with distinct specials, team up in local co-op, and study leaderboard replays to push your score higher.

5334520.name: Void Runners
5334520.short_description: Co-op salvage raids for one to four pilots, on one couch or online. Beams link your ships and shred anything they sweep: spread out and swing the web. Crossfire, dodge, revive your crew from escape pods, and build a salvaged ship that breaks the rules, three sectors and three guardians deep.

5087700.name: Super Interactive Cats - Desktop Pets Demo
5087700.short_description: Let adorable cats make your desktop their home! Adopt different breeds, care for them, play with toys, prepare meals, and send them on adventures. Whether you’re working or relaxing, enjoy their lively company throughout the day.

4362170.name: Feed The Forest
4362170.short_description: Use snail powers to grow a desert into a lush forest, and then profit-maximize it to insanity in this active incremental game. Optimize plant layouts to automate production of multiple resources. Hire minions, unlock immoral plants, get ungodly rich, and remember: Blood is a type of juice.

4690580.name: Astral Industrial Complex
4690580.short_description: A space automation game with rogue lite elements. Take the role of a rogue defense drone building up a mining and defense industry in the far reaches of space.

5336650.name: Farm Factory Demo
5336650.short_description: Farm Factory is a cozy farming automation game. Plant six empty fields by hand, then build sprinklers, harvesters, mills, bakeries and conveyor belts until your farm runs itself. Research, upgrade, raise animals, sell on a living market and grow Grandma's farm into a factory that feeds the world.

4084110.name: Bighorn Ramone
4084110.short_description: La final de 1986 que nunca terminó. Atrapado en un traje de mascota del que no puedes escapar. Anima al público y sobrevive a una noche de terror en la cancha mientras luchas por encontrar el camino de vuelta al presente.

3899880.name: Super Money Ring
3899880.short_description: Roll as a ring to the goal as quickly as possible! Race ghosts worldwide for the fastest time on any of the 100+ carefully crafted levels! Find the secrets hidden in every level! Try the demo today!

5046240.name: Helion Conflict
5046240.short_description: Real-time strategy stripped to the decision. Every factory you hold builds without pause - you choose where those ships go, and can turn them in mid-flight. Commander mode adds the war economy: iron and gold networks, turrets, satellites, orbital strikes. Up to eight online.

3363400.name: Escape With Friends
3363400.short_description: Investigate with your friends in this hilarious hand drawn game. Draw your own skin and go on a journey filled with minigames: darts, mini car races, electrical panels... From 2 to 8 players.

5096430.name: Helion Conflict Demo
5096430.short_description: The free demo of Helion Conflict - and during Steam Next Fest it's the full game, with nothing locked. Capture shipyards, split fleets by exact percentage, turn them in mid-flight. Up to eight online. Minutes, not hours.

3727090.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay
3727090.short_description: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D barn buildup and simulation game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, explore beautiful trails, hire and manage staff and build the stable of your dreams!

5466190.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay - Supporter Pack
5466190.short_description: Support the dev team of Horses of Hoofprint Bay! This Supporter Pack DLC contains a digital art book, coloring pages and grants you an exclusive Discord role, for anyone who wants to further support the dev team on top of their game purchase!

4048970.name: Heart of the Bunker
4048970.short_description: The hero ends up in a sealed bunker with futuristic tech. Salvation turns into a trap: systems are silent, doors locked. Good news? There’s a cute girl here. Bad news? The only way out seems to be a suspicious portal that could lead anywhere… or nowhere.

2437790.name: Sol Survivor
2437790.short_description: Build, host, and survive in a persistent multiplayer space sandbox set in the outer Sol system. Construct orbital habitats, manage fragile station systems, and keep your crew alive while expanding through zero-g, Saturn-ring danger, and player-built infrastructure.

3165340.name: All Will Rise
3165340.short_description: The river is a god, and they killed her. It’s time for ordinary people to hold them to account. Manage your team. Mix with ecoterrorists and godmen. Build your deck, follow leads and find allies. Make your case, and win the battle for the future.

3005700.name: The last keeper
3005700.short_description: Take on the role of a lighthouse keeper on a remote island. Maintain the machinery, use the radio and the map to guide ships into the harbor. Survive and uncover the mysteries of Farpoint Island in a horror experience inspired by Voices of the Void and No One Lives Under the Lighthouse.

4949400.name: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES: Tidy Videogame Supermarket
4949400.short_description: MY CAT SCATTERED GAMES is a cozy single-player organizing simulator. Put 5,158 games and consoles back on the shelves, restore your video game store, and free your mischievous cat from the claw machine!

5243000.name: 赛博霓虹：核心协议 Demo
5243000.short_description: Enter a neon-soaked cyberpunk roguelike where a rogue AI is devouring the city network. Choose from four mercenaries, build your deck, install cyberware, and unleash Overclocking. Navigate shifting maps, read enemy intent, and battle through five deadly zones. Take the contract. Breach the core.

4371320.name: Party Time Bowling
4371320.short_description: Strike up the neon-soaked fun in this competitive party sports game for up to 8 players. Bowl, roll, and battle it out in Air Hockey, unlock 100+  ball skins and custom pins with Alley Bucks, and keep the good times rolling.

5440470.name: Wild Cosmic Demo
5440470.short_description: Lead a ragtag group of travelers with unique abilities through challenging maps in outer space.

4882300.name: ChannelVR
4882300.short_description: ChannelVR 360 Console delivers uncompromised environmental realism and infinite spatial depth. Experience flawless architectural spaces and curated real-world locations with fluid precision. An elite, premium visual escape designed for absolute physical presence and complete sensory immersion.

4714060.name: Whiterock Bay
4714060.short_description: Take on a big mystery in this first-person adventure inspired by old-time horrors. Explore the desolate town, face the anomalies, solve puzzles and search for traces of your missing sister in Whiterock Bay.

5263650.name: High Voltage Demo
5263650.short_description: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your own power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, invest in wind and solar power, and keep the city supplied with electricity. Discover the basics, try your luck at the casino, and complete your first power contract.

5182810.name: Internal Breach
5182810.short_description: A high-stakes asymmetric sci-fi survival horror game. Trapped aboard a dark ship, crew members must scavenge vital power cores to escape before being hunted from the shadows by a player-controlled alien stalker. Manage power resources, survive in pitch-black corridors, and try to make it out alive.

5087100.name: THE ASTRONAUT Desktop Idle
5087100.short_description: THE ASTRONAUT Desktop Idle is a cozy desktop idle adventure that lives alongside your day. Explore space, collect stardust, upgrade your little ship, and watch your astronaut continue the journey while you work, study, or simply do something else.

4484810.name: Winter Whiskers
4484810.short_description: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

4712520.name: Cubounce 弹射方块
4712520.short_description: CUBOUNCE is a high-speed physics-based platformer. Launch and swing through challenging levels with precise controls and extreme momentum.

5391380.name: Cash Only Demo
5391380.short_description: Run a coffee shop by day and a drug business on the side. Serve customers, grow product, negotiate dead drops, avoid the cops, and split the work with friends in this co-op crime simulator.

5088970.name: Soul Finders
5088970.short_description: Soul Finders is a third-person survival shooter. Blast through waves of bugs, collect souls, upgrade your character, and face the Queen while storms turn the battlefield against you.

5306660.name: CLOUD PATROL
5306660.short_description: Fly across floating islands, hold off swarming drones, and face down three colossal bosses. Earn coins, unlock stronger firepower, and climb the endless Ascension ladder. This sky is yours to guard. Dive into a fast, exhilarating wave-based first-person aerial shooter.

5402140.name: CLOUD PATROL Ultimate High-Energy Music Upgrade Pack!!!
5402140.short_description: The free music upgrade pack “Ultimate High-Energy Music Upgrade Pack!!!” is now available! This DLC injects 10 brand-new, high-energy tracks into your shooter battlefield, fully replacing the original background music.

4737340.name: Cinema Deals
4737340.short_description: Play as a cashier in a cinema theater! Take orders, print movie tickets, prepare popcorn, drinks and more! And don't forget today's deals!

3923160.name: Realtime Screen OCR Translator
3923160.short_description: Real-time OCR translator for ANY on-screen text - Instantly extracts & translates text from ANY screen area you select. Translations update automatically as the original text changes—perfect for games, apps, and videos. No accounts or setup needed!

5302870.name: Tiny Village : Rebuild up!
5302870.short_description: One dragon sneeze. 5,000 mixed-up coins. Your holiday cancelled. Explore a fantasy museum, inspect coins and find their rightful places in this first-person sorting game. Unlock skills and magical powers to turn a glorious mess into a perfectly organised collection.

4900380.name: The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes
4900380.short_description:
Lurk in the shadows and hunt the shadows.
The curtain rises on The Eminence in Shadow: Phantom Echoes, a full-scale action roguelite game!

5299880.name: Leikkaus
5299880.short_description: One student, one abandoned university, and someone who is after their benefits... or more. Hide. Run. Don't get cut.

3315320.name: Pico Drift
3315320.short_description: Explore the city as your ultimate racing arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

5291710.name: Rebringer
5291710.short_description: A multiplayer survival game set in a recovering post-apocalyptic world. Scavenge, craft gear, drive vehicles, and build your base between safe settlements and hostile bandits. Play online or host your own server with custom rules.

5452390.name: OSAD
5452390.short_description: Experience the end of the world in an alternate-history Poland. As a lone garbage collector, witness the final hours of reality as you know it. This is a short, dark science fiction thriller that will keep you on the edge of your seat.

4954240.name: My Lovely Nurse
4954240.short_description: Spend ten nights in the hospital with the mysterious nurse Lilith. Make choices, complete sensual mini-games, unlock explicit artwork, and watch professional distance turn into mutual desire. Adults only.

5320250.name: 无尽女武神 Demo
5320250.short_description: Endless Valkyrie is a 2D pixel idle RPG inspired by Nordic mythology. Guide a Valkyrie through automatic exploration and combat, configure skills and gear, cross three regions, challenge Bosses, forge equipment, claim Offline Rewards, and Rebirth to preserve permanent growth.

5162500.name: Meridian Strike Demo
5162500.short_description: Command a mercenary mech company in a turn-based tactical RPG. Plan every move on a hex battlefield, manage heat and localized damage, develop your pilots, repair battered machines, and experience the opening operation of Meridian Strike.

2975830.name: Spells Dungeon
2975830.short_description: Spells Dungeon is a roguelike dungeon crawler adventure with multiple endings and a challenging adventure for those who dare to try.

4733210.name: Act! 细胞调律 Demo
4733210.short_description: Free trial version available! Dive into this rhythm game with fully innovative free-input gameplay — relax, immerse yourself, and tune your unique movement in the ocean of the subconscious.

5441580.name: CTRL Chaos
5441580.short_description: 15 singleplayer minigames. Different rules. Total chaos. Blast hooligans with a water cannon, fight space swarms, solve cargo puzzles, build a tower, or grow a garden. Pick your next challenge or play a series.

5260110.name: Second Source
5260110.short_description: Every report on your desk is intelligence or bait. Four artifacts — agency, timestamp, position, text — and a planted one contradicts itself in exactly one. Call it before the clock does, hold the line as DEFCON drops, and when they breach the building, run the extraction on foot.

4792830.name: Max the Unifox Demo
4792830.short_description: Based on dreams from real life, adventure about a guy turning into mysteries fox with a horn. And his horn contains power of the Creator of the Universe. What will our hero use it for?

5148600.name: Balingo Demo
5148600.short_description: Balingo is a bingo roguelike where every ball counts. Buy cards, mark off numbers, and combine tickets, stamps, markers, and marbles to create unique combos and reach increasingly higher scores before you run out of balls.

3389690.name: Lustful Heist
3389690.short_description: Lustful Heist is a harem-focused adult game with action and intense choices. As an amateur racer drawn into the criminal world, you must decide whether to dive deeper into crime or try to pull your new crew out. Your decisions shape your fate and lead to various outcomes.

4824730.name: KAGERO
4824730.short_description: Fight solo or in up to 4-player co-op to destroy the houses that tried to erase you. Harvest the souls of the fallen, grow stronger with every battle, and fuel the ritual to awaken an ancient spirit.

3593120.name: Blastr
3593120.short_description: The best soundboard for your shitposting talent! Play sounds in any game and voice chat. Add sounds with 1-Click with our Chrome Plugin. Cut your sounds in-app for perfect timing and much more! Time to fry the lobby.

5354560.name: Abenteurergildenmeister
5354560.short_description: Lead an adventurer guild through story-driven quests and shape a settlement that grows on its own. Freely place its key buildings and roads. Your main task is to assign the most suitable adventurers to each quest.

5136890.name: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator
5136890.short_description: You and your friends run a dog daycare. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

5467840.name: Clay Rumble
5467840.short_description: Claymation wrestling with hand-sculpted clay fighters. Punch, bodyslam, dive off the top rope, grab the folding chair and settle it outside the ring. Couch brawls for two, six-fighter Clay Rumbles, tag team chaos and tournaments.

2601980.name: Space Scum
2601980.short_description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

4378770.name: Eternal Angler
4378770.short_description: A surreal multiplayer fishing game where you catch strange creatures hidden across fragmented dimensions.

5323270.name: Kennel Chaos: Daycare Simulator Demo
5323270.short_description: You and your friends run a dog daycare. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

3235390.name: Ballerspiel
3235390.short_description: A chaotic comic-style first- and third-person shooter full of clowns. Battle Royale, Ballerball and Clown-Off, 13 weapons including an atomic bomb, vehicles, power-ups and a world where everything breaks. Play online, on LAN without internet, or offline against bots.

5221150.name: Towers & Tentacles
