5221150.short_description: An action tower defense game where you fight alongside your towers. Salvage Scrap from destroyed robots, upgrade your loadout, and repair your crashed ship between waves. Survive long enough to escape.

3258490.name: nanDECK
3258490.short_description:
Software for creating card decks, tokens, and game boards. Customize, use scripting, import from spreadsheets, print on paper/PDF, export for digital playtesting. Compatible with Windows, supported by an active community on Discord and BoardGameGeek.
Current version: 1.29.1

5012530.name: Alchemist's Aisle
5012530.short_description: Scale your local alchemy shop in this cozy shop simulation game. Optimise your store layout, manage your stock, grow your space, and protect your investments from those pesky thieves.

3613550.name: Checkmage!
3613550.short_description:
A chess-based strategy game with casual deckbuilding elements.
Build your deck by trading cards and battling lovable, hand-drawn characters.

1924470.name: Cursed Dungeon Raider
1924470.short_description: Embark on an exploration adventure with spooky and horror elements, tasked with recovering real historical artifacts from excavation sites around the world. Beware of local traps and monsters inspired by the mythology of each region.

4882810.name: BoxParty!
4882810.short_description: BoxParty brings multiple online party games together in one platform. Join friends or strangers, jump into quick matches, bluff, guess, trick your opponents, and discover reimagined game modes with events, jokers, and advanced rules.

4382910.name: WordCrack
4382910.short_description: A challenging word game with CRT terminal aesthetics. Crack words of increasing length in Gauntlet mode. Compete on Steam leaderboards with seeded runs. Regular mode gives 3 lives; Cracked mode is sudden death.

4171280.name: Onlympic Up! Demo
4171280.short_description:
A lightning strike, a torch in your hands, and a voice echoes:
“Your fates are now bound.”
Tied together by a fragile rope — if it snaps, the fall is inevitable.
Jump, climb, solve, slide… but never lose your rhythm.
Only the patient will glimpse the summit.

5375020.name: 位于平行世界的我们 ~ Parallel Hearts ~ Demo

4160400.name: Business is Blooming
4160400.short_description: Grow and sell flowers with the help of magical books to make ends meet in this cozy strategic rouguelike. Create synergistic combos with multiple flowers, books and other items and mechanics at your disposal to survive the ever increasing economy.

5380660.name: Lumenfall
5380660.short_description: The world sank into the Gloom. One island still holds a light. Build a cozy factory high above a sea of clouds, push back the darkness, then take the helm of your own skyship and sail through the mountain passes to new islands — alone or with up to three friends.

5230600.name: Organized Chaos Demo
5230600.short_description: Sort, order, and enjoy a cozy experience as you solve a variety of puzzles. Can you organize this chaos?

4813930.name: MOBA Manager
4813930.short_description: A deep MOBA esports management sim. You're the manager: scout talent, build the roster, manage finances and watch every match play out in real tower-by-tower detail. From local leagues to the World Championship, it's entirely your journey.

4320730.name: Super Onslaught
4320730.short_description: A real time strategy, tower defense game where you can evolve your turrets and give them special abilities.

1822180.name: orrb
1822180.short_description:
orrb is a tile based puzzle exploration game.
where you explore levels, discover rules, place tiles, and when ready, send the orrb on its way.

4276120.name: orrb Demo
4276120.short_description:
orrb is a tile based puzzle exploration game.
where you explore levels, discover rules, place tiles, and when ready, send the orrb on its way.

2210880.name: Please Handle Gently
2210880.short_description: Please Handle Gently is a pixel-art autobattler card game. Late at night, sit down at the counter for a while — pick out a few figurines, give them a little magic back. A whole cabinet of jingling little things. They're old. Please handle gently.

5218370.name: Organized Chaos
5218370.short_description: Sort, order, and enjoy a cozy experience as you solve a variety of puzzles. Can you organize this chaos?

5228340.name: Just a Normal Porcini Hunt
5228340.short_description: A perfectly normal mushroom-hunting game. Walk into the woods, find porcini, punch a fish man, get arrested, ride a boar that charges in porcini and get blessed by a total stranger. Then it gets weird. Made by someone who can’t find mushrooms in real life either.

5412520.name: Just a Normal Porcini Hunt Demo
5412520.short_description: The free sample of a perfectly normal porcini hunt: two hunts, about 25 minutes, a muscle man, a doll and a banana. Suspiciously normal on purpose. The weird part is in the full game, which costs money. Like porcini. Like therapy.

4898270.name: Terminal Closure
4898270.short_description:
Take your place at the tactical station of a spaceship and face a brutal war in the near future for control of the outer planets in this realistic space warfare simulator.
Choose your side and lead your ship into battle, maneuvering and fighting according to the laws of orbital mechanics.

4111820.name: Born of the Moon
4111820.short_description: Trapped in the von Adelstein mansion, one of you has already made a pact with the beast. Born of the Moon is a social horror for 3-6 players. Asymmetrical roles, sabotage, and insanity mechanics are deadlier than monsters. Will you survive until dawn if you can't even trust your own ears?

3082700.name: Sunset Inferno
3082700.short_description: A choice-driven narrative adventure where you are a Recycler: a machine built to hunt war deserters. But when a bomb destroys your transport, it also cracks your programming. Uncover who attacked you before your makers decide you've changed too much.

4936170.name: Alien or Duck!
4936170.short_description: A fast-paced alien sports arcade game! Take control of cosmic saucers, dodge dangerous obstacles, and kick a giant beach ball into your opponent's zone. Fire chaotic magic balls—fire, lightning, and fog—to sabotage your friends in multiplayer or conquer the Single Player Championship!

4800690.name: Streets of Miami VR Demo
4800690.short_description: Streets of Miami VR is a gritty 1980s crime-action VR game where you fight, drive, spray paint, shoot, hustle for money, and survive the streets of Miami in a open world sand box experience built for physical VR gameplay.

4797150.name: Bullets & Boletes
4797150.short_description: Single-player tactical FPS extraction game where you loot materials and mission items that help you progress through a mysterious main story.

5102270.name: Detective Defective
5102270.short_description: You are not a detective. You forged your way into the agency to find out who killed your wife. Investigate crime scenes with nothing marking what matters, take your own notes, and file reports you have to stand behind. What you overlook today shapes what you can understand tomorrow.

5306260.name: Westward Dash Demo
5306260.short_description: The official demo for Westward Dash! Play as Sun Wukong in a brisk 1v1 ink-wash race against the CPU. Play the Classic and One-shot modes, conquer three classic Demon King gates, and sprint to Thunderclap Summit in 10-15 minutes. Wishlist the full game!

5029020.name: Westward Dash
5029020.short_description: Relive the childhood board game of Journey to the West. An ink-wash race for 1-8 players. Roll your dice to avoid peril on every space! One staff to sweep demons aside, one dash die to turn the race on its head. Solo or with friends: nothing is settled until the very last space!

5485240.name: Where Are the Brakes?
5485240.short_description: One shopping cart. Up to four players sharing the controls. Steer, jump and shoot through 10 hazardous stages and two boss battles in this co-op action game. Handle everything solo, or invite friends and find out whether your teamwork can survive without brakes.

4567920.name: Bull Run
4567920.short_description: Trade stocks, short the market, and outsmart AI rivals. Play a match, a 13-scenario campaign, the Daily Challenge, or a Career from your mom's basement. Online with friends on Steam.

4034970.name: Supermrket: Gamestudio
4034970.short_description: Supermrket: Gamestudio: Take control of a video game development studio in this exciting management video game: Decide aspects such as how many developers you will dedicate to a video game, the products in the vending machine, and the style of game you will develop!!

5103780.name: Assault Commander RTS
5103780.short_description: Assault Commander RTS is a fast-paced real-time military strategy game. Fight a 30+ mission story campaign with two distinct factions, build and defend your base, command land, air and naval forces, unleash super weapons and climb the online leaderboards.

3256790.name: Satelital
3256790.short_description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

2748140.name: Lands of Koastalia
2748140.short_description: Lands of Koastalia is a relaxing city building game with a unique building system. As Mayor, your primary mission is to keep people happy. Craft natural-looking villages, manage resources within and across them, explore an island, and meet the needs of your residents.

5017320.name: Satelital Demo
5017320.short_description: A rule-discovery puzzle game where you place alien symbols on a grid. Uncover their logic as you journey through an atmospheric solar system.

4953090.name: Hackagon: Cyber Card Battler
4953090.short_description: HACKAGON is a fast 1v1 cyber card battler. Breach the network with the red team or defend it with the blue team. Cards are played face-down and revealed at the same time, so victory comes from reading your opponent, not moving first. Build your 12-card deck, claim the areas, and take the network.

2861730.name: Food Devils
2861730.short_description: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

4816210.name: Neon Blackfall
4816210.short_description: Build your deck, survive the Blackout, and fight for control of Neurovale. A fast-paced card game with 75 single-player chapters and online multiplayer battles. Lead one of four rival factions and adapt as the city changes between the Neon and Blackfall eras.

4461290.name: Descent Of Lunaris Demo
4461290.short_description: In this prologue, you are tasked with leading a security team and protecting research scientists as they flee from an experiment gone awry. Descent of Lunaris is a classic-inspired grid-based dungeon crawling RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

3824720.name: Descent Of Lunaris
3824720.short_description: Assemble your squad and explore a lunar base where cosmic horrors warp your reality, challenge your strategy, and break your sanity. Descent of Lunaris is a grid-based dungeon crawling RPG inspired by Wizardry and Shin Megami Tensei.

2420700.name: Creej's Corruption
2420700.short_description: Creej's Corruption is a Combat Based First-Person Action RPG set in a pre-apocalyptic suburban town. When reuniting with your family, an ominous building in the distance suddenly collapses causing a massive chain of events. Your brother has been taken. You're the only one who can save him.

5044970.name: Evoruption
5044970.short_description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

4662400.name: Crimson Monarch
4662400.short_description: A modern vampire political narrative where every choice reshapes the city. Rule the Crimson Council, navigate faction intrigue, and survive personal stories of hunger, secrecy, and power in a reactive, state‑driven world.

5425270.name: Last Ante
5425270.short_description: Eight goddesses, sealed by a covenant no force can break. The only way to free them: beat each one at her own table. Strip blackjack against divine rivals sworn to play their best — shatter a seal, and a layer of her vestments falls away. Get as close to twenty-one as you dare.

5289550.name: 妖潮：以杀证道  Demo
5289550.short_description: Try this free cultivation-themed roguelite survival demo. Choose your path, combine weapons, techniques, artifacts and divine abilities, and battle swarms of beasts. Break through realms, face tribulations and strive for ascension.

4840450.name: Fragmenta: Ancient Egypt
4840450.short_description: Restore the lost treasures of Ancient Egypt in a relaxing 3D reconstruction puzzle experience. Every artifact is shattered into a unique arrangement of fragments, offering endless replayability across multiple difficulty levels, from casual sessions to expert challenges.

3567650.name: The Dark Delivers Demo
3567650.short_description: Welcome to Postal Sector 7. As the Night Shift Package Inspector, your job is simple: assess parcels and reject anything not up to code. Stay alert for anomalous dangers and survive long enough to meet your quota by 6AM.

3404030.name: Clogwork
3404030.short_description: CLOGWORK is a factory automation game. Cut, glue and rotate pieces into the shapes you need. Build conveyor belts and logic circuits, prevent jams, and deliver finished shapes to the Core. Build in 2D, or switch to 3D at any time.

5109460.name: Desktop Ball
5109460.short_description: A little physics toy that lives on top of your desktop. Fidget, vent, and mess around with a bunch of weird balls. Fling them, bounce them, dunk them, explode them, or just slosh around in a tiny ocean.

4092130.name: Sacred: Last Pixel of Ancaria
4092130.short_description: Sacred returns as a party-based RPG set in a ruptured and battle-worn post-war Ancaria. Featuring hybrid real-time and turn-based combat, handcrafted 16-bit pixel art, and an open world from the original creators of Sacred. Build your party! Loot everything! Laugh at the rest!

5309970.name: BrickOps Demo
5309970.short_description: Free Early Demo. Play. Build. Customize. BrickOps is a colourful multiplayer arena shooter. Battle over objectives, create your own maps and make your character your own with outfits, accessories and loadouts. Build cover, bring the flag home or light up the sky in Defuse.

2857520.name: Along Came a Dragonfly Demo
2857520.short_description: A mysterious figure, Monsters from another realm, and a war of beasts and men 1000 years ago... Strange creatures from another dimension have appeared all over the land. Explore dungeons, solve puzzles, and capture monsters in this turn-based RPG, and discover a mystery best left forgotten.

5262260.name: Legends of Mahjong
5262260.short_description: Learn and play Mahjong your way. Narrated tutorials, an in-game coach and guided practice hands teach Hong Kong and Japanese Riichi Mahjong, then play against AI opponents with your own house rules and 30 legendary characters.

5391920.name: Innocence Or Money | Season 2 | Episode 4
5391920.short_description: The adventures of Jennifer continue with the fourth episode of the second season. What will Jennifer face in this new episode?

5131830.name: Hero of the Kingdom: Echoes Demo
5131830.short_description: Experience the first chapter of our lovely adventuring RPG. As a humble herbalist, enjoy peaceful days in your home village. Gather nature's gifts, learn your first recipes, and lend a helping hand to those in need. Discover the joy and gratification of good deeds.

5208880.name: Extreme Cleaning Simulator Demo
5208880.short_description: Try Extreme Cleaning Simulator Demo and get a first taste of cleaning the most neglected and disgustingly filthy homes. Remove piles of trash, scrub stubborn stains, and see if you have what it takes for the dirtiest jobs.

5219920.name: みんなでティア表! Demo
5219920.short_description: Can you guess your friend's tier list? Rank five words from S to D, then everyone else tries to guess your order in this online party game. The star player's tier list is always the right answer. Whether anyone else understands it is another story. Play the Food prompts free in this demo.

4690510.name: Warding Witches Demo
4690510.short_description: The Warding Witches Demo offers a classic, unapologetic bullet hell shoot ‘em up challenge while also putting defense into players’ hands. Experience an adrenaline-filled flow alternating between attacking, defending and dodging.

4705920.name: Grandpa Needs Fish Demo
4705920.short_description: Grandpa Needs Fish is a cozy idle clicker game where fortune rides the waves. You are Abraham and you have one mission: catch as many fish as possible. Every cast brings new rewards and every upgrade makes you stronger. Hover, catch, upgrade, and repeat in this satisfying idle incremental adventure.

4731370.name: МурЗавод Demo
4731370.short_description:
Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY!
Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour!
In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

4778120.name: 不/存在的你，和我-莉莉丝鼠标指针
4778120.short_description: Lilith Cursor DLC. Lilith, a character from The NOexistenceN of you AND me, turns into an adorable mouse cursor. Feel free to use it!

4785640.name: 道之华隐 DaoNoKaIn
4785640.short_description:
Don't fear to speak e      lusive words.
The only certainty is that all things present shall fade away in time.
Friends from overseas have recommended consulting relevant reference books during your playthrough of the work.
publishers: 北京道之华隐互联网销售工作室

3947940.name: Wildsite: Demo
3947940.short_description: Crash-land on an alien planet plagued by toxic storms. Experience 2-3 hours of gameplay: gather resources with your Multitool, fight with primitive or plasma weapons, and build a base that you can shrink and move anywhere. Survive solo or team up with up to 3 friends in co-op.

4010590.name: theHunter: Call of the Wild™ - Scotland Hunting Reserve
4010590.short_description: We are going to Scotland! The highlands are home to Celtic legends, old castles, and vast landscapes. Hunt iconic Scottish animals in a reserve where every path winds through history.

1512190.name: Hunternet Starfighter
1512190.short_description: Hunternet is an MMO spacecraft sim where you fight for territory, resources, & key installations during humanity's last civil war. Form player orgs, mine resources, & build fleets. Take a break & fly in friendly races or wargames, but beware an alien foe threatens all.

3629010.name: Strange Antiquities Demo
3629010.short_description: Become the custodian of a store dealing in occult antiquities. Explore the quaint and gloomy town of Undermere, where strange goings-on and dark mysteries abound. Find and identify arcane artefacts, use your collection to aid the townsfolk with their unusual problems — and remember to pet your cat!

1846201.name: Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium: Invincibility
1846201.short_description: Unlocks the option to play with Invincibility and Assisted Play features enabled on any Capcom Arcade 2nd Stadium game.

1829870.name: UAE
1829870.short_description: UAE emulates a range of old home computer systems from the '80s/'90s.

5158480.name: Pointless Climb Demo
5158480.short_description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

886160.name: Respublica
886160.short_description: Create a politician and start your legacy. Run in national and local elections. Create and vote on legislation. Respublica is an online roleplay game, where users can run for office and control the outcome of the world within the game.

684380.name: Mermaid VR
684380.short_description: Mermaid VR is a free VR video player and web browser, which provides you numerous film resources. It is compatible to multiple Operation System and full-format video playing. The professional software is very user-friendly.

4475950.name: System Status: SuperCritical
4475950.short_description: Defend your base by placing towers strategically, forming interconnected systems that depend on one another. Adapt your strategy to different environments and enemy waves, exploiting their weaknesses. In System Status: SuperCritical, resources are scarce and critical failure is always an option.

5466150.name: Fervent: Sovereign Struggle Demo
5466150.short_description: Enter the Boar Territory as the Seventh Apostle in this dark, story-driven action-stealth demo. Infiltrate hostile territory, evade enemy patrols, and survive intense third-person combat as you prepare the way for a god's return.

201274.name: Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Fall of the Samurai - Obama Faction Pack DLC

5429850.name: Write With Shion: Lo-Fi Focus
5429850.short_description: A cozy lo-fi focus companion with a story. Hit play on the Pomodoro timer and Shion, a romance writer, types beside you on a video call. Read her script as it grows line by line, shape the story with your choices on breaks, and unlock new chapters as you focus.

4193010.name: Hypernet Explorer
4193010.short_description: Roguelike immersive sim set in esoteric post Y2K Europe.

5018570.name: SoberUp
5018570.short_description: Pass the bottle or pass out. Hot potato, except the potato is alcohol and your friends are cowards. Sprint, tag, betray, sober up at the well — just don't be the first one to hit 100%.

1009640.name: Lonely Adventure
1009640.short_description: A series of recent incidents code-named “Anomalies” have been recorded throughout the solar system. The player must visit each location of these anomalies, at varying locations in the Solar System to find out if humanity is in danger.

4024120.name: 颂声·市井小神仙
4024120.short_description: This isn’t a wealth game, but an immersive experience warming ordinary town life. From mending the first tile to managing the street’s economic lifeline, every choice reshapes the town’s dawn and dusk. As the inn’s lanterns glow at dusk, your The Moonlit Scroll unfolds slowly...

5208890.name: Don't Pick Up Demo
5208890.short_description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

4237340.name: The City Life
4237340.short_description: A British open-world life sim where you start with nothing, take jobs, build vehicles, buy property, pay rent, and work your way up from trailer park to full city living.

5127480.name: Blue Water Builders
5127480.short_description: Blue Water Builders is a shipyard management and shipbuilding game set during the golden age of industry. Design, build, launch and manage your own fleet as you take a small shipyard from its humble beginnings to a major force in the world of shipbuilding. So, how far will you take your shipyard?

5383750.name: Reapercussions
5383750.short_description: Death is now your day job. Roll your bones, build poker hand variants and reap each Soul before your rolls run out. Stack cursed Relics and Hex Potions into absurd combos as you try and impress in your new role as a Reaper. It looks easy but looks are very deceiving.

5191120.name: PERI.CO
5191120.short_description: 4-player co-op first-person action. Deploy to an ever-changing site, complete missions, take down giant bosses, and get back before time runs out. Spend your pay on gear for the next shift. Dual-arm weapon combos, Q-key skills, debuff contracts, SSD revive system, 9 languages.

5283990.name: Chimpy Protects
5283990.short_description: At night you feel something ominous, you must be courageous and brave to find Chimpy. Something is watching and spirits are haunting you but Chimpy will protect, the soothing light will guide you and he will finally help you sleep.

2991310.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
2991310.short_description: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

4600910.name: Dendron 64
4600910.short_description: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

2853260.name: Randomly Jerk Simulator
2853260.short_description: "Randomly Jerk Simulator" is a roguelite simulation game that uses a slot machine to simulate the parasitic behavior of a jerk who relies on his parents. This game does not contain any gambling behavior or cash transactions.

5385310.name: Kemonomimi Territory
5385310.short_description: There’s only room for one kemonomimi tribe on the island. Recruit your army, claim hexes and capture rival bases to be the last tribe standing. Play this single-player, turn-based virtual board game in VR or on desktop.

5324780.name: KROSTEL: Architecture Bureau Simulator
5324780.short_description: Build and run your own architecture bureau. Hire architects and engineers, compete for contracts, manage projects, finances, contractors, deadlines and risk, then automate the company and grow from a small office into a self-running firm.

5409770.name: Salem 1692
5409770.short_description: A social deduction party game for 4 to 12 players. Join on your phone, accuse your neighbors, and root out the witches hiding in Salem before they turn the whole town against itself. One host screen, no downloads for players, pure social chaos.

5164700.name: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER
5164700.short_description: DANGER ZONE: PRIZE FIGHTER is a fast-paced 2D fighting game with 15 unique fighters, explosive one-on-one combat, cinematic attacks, local versus, training, and a story-driven Prize Fighter mode set in the dangerous world of Velmora.

5406910.name: Ace Academy Tennis Manager 26
5406910.short_description: Run a tennis academy: scout 13-year-old prospects whose ceiling you can't see, plan their season week by week across a 52-week tour and take them all the way to a Grand Slam title. The full game, no ads and no microtransactions.

4976060.name: Toy Worlds Atlas Demo
4976060.short_description: Toy Worlds Atlas is a sandbox game where you play with colours to solve riddles and discover secrets. Each level explores a philosophical topic and subverts  expectations with new colouring mechanics. Made to inspire thought, this game offers a relaxing cognitive reset.

5213850.name: Bullet Hell Zombies
5213850.short_description: Bullet Hell Zombies is a 1-4 player online co-op bullet hell roguelike! Survive waves of enemies round after round, earn cash with every landed shot, and spend wisely to open up the procedurally generated map!

5262450.name: Russpuppy Play & Learn
5262450.short_description: A fun collection of learning games for young children. Practice letters, phonics, counting, shapes, and colors with cheerful music, sound effects, and no game-over screens.

4339840.name: Walking With The Wild
4339840.short_description: Nature so serene… yet so violent. In this adventure-thriller, you are cast into a mystical world with nothing but your mind and body. To survive, you must leverage your five powerful senses and overcome the horrors that surround you. Can you make it home, or will the journey be too draining?

4793230.name: Toy Worlds Atlas
4793230.short_description: Toy Worlds Atlas is a sandbox game where you play with colours to solve philosophical riddles and discover secrets. Made to inspire thought, each level offers a relaxing cognitive reset and subverts expectations with a new colouring mechanic. Can you colour the world in the colours of meaning?

2855020.name: Haymaker
2855020.short_description: Brawl your way through enemies with brutal, fast-paced, physics-driven VR hand combat. Be prepared to sweat it out as you dole out velocity-based damage and use your back and shoulders to deliver kicks and knees. Meet the challenge however you see fit

5467120.name: GEARSMITH
5467120.short_description: A pixel-art action roguelite. Fight through cellars, forests and a lava mine, beat the bosses, and take the gear you find to the forge. Each upgrade gets riskier, and pushing for +10 can break the item for good.

4919780.name: Taoxi: A Desktop Story
4919780.short_description: Tao Xi lives in the corner of your desktop — a fully voiced Live2D companion who'll sit with you through a focus session, keep you company while you space out, and ask if you're still up when it gets late.

5112450.name: PACKING SHIFT
5112450.short_description: Packing Shift is a cozy warehouse online co-op for 1-4 players. Sort the day's deliveries, fill the orders, box them up, and ship them out. Everything is physics-driven, so mind the shelves, mind the rockets, and try not to bury your coworkers under either.

5352700.name: For Some Water
5352700.short_description: There isn't enough water for everyone. As a water distribution officer in drought-stricken Barbunya, you decide who gets water and who goes without. Check documents, enforce government orders, bend the rules, and face the consequences. In Barbunya, every drop comes at a price.

3915860.name: Voiceless
3915860.short_description: An interactive FMV slasher. Emma's sister is gone. The only lead: a serial killer locked in a psychiatric ward. Enter. Find answers. Get out alive.

5469450.name: Tiny Timber
5469450.short_description: Tiny Timber is a 3D cozy idle game that lives on your desktop. Watch a tiny lumberjack chop trees, take breaks, and collect wood. Buy upgrades and grow your little forest while you work or relax.

5416370.name: Dank Nooner
5416370.short_description: A motorcycle game about doing every stupid thing you'd never try in real life. Pull 12 o'clock wheelies through traffic, flip off ramps, crash spectacularly, and race your friends online.

5009230.name: 远航
5009230.short_description: After storms and disease leave only nine people aboard a ship bound for the New World, food and water are running low, and illness has taken part of your memory. Get to know the eight remaining crew members again, face conflict and dwindling supplies, and survive the voyage.

5188830.name: 我在汽车制造厂当老板
5188830.short_description: You've inherited a rusty assembly line. From sourcing a single bolt to developing your own V8, from a "shady workshop" mocked on forums to a household brand name—every design decision is a stone thrown into water. The ripples across the entire media landscape are the real exam.

4437270.name: The Last Embrace: Book One
4437270.short_description: A young girl, a vampire and last of her kind, wakes up after a thousand years to a modern world. A story focused visual novel with adult elements. Mystery, betrayal, loss and violence await! Shape the future of the protagonist and the world itself!

4378580.name: Lisa's Laboratory
4378580.short_description: A puzzle game that adds portal manipulation to block pushing puzzles.  Navigate deadly lasers, complex circuitry, and more as you find your way to the exit.

5367350.name: Pax Germanica
5367350.short_description: inspired by the 1980s monster games, this strategic turn-based wargame will put you at the  head of a great power during the imperialism era. you will chase victory by colonising unclaimed territories trying to maximize profit while using diplomacy to avoid an all-out escalation to the great war.

5234220.name: Double Down & Out Demo
5234220.short_description: The house always wins, so change the rules. Double Down & Out is blackjack where you combine cards and maths to reach your target. Stack buffs, enhance your cards with chips and beat down dealers who play by their own rules.

2505230.name: Dreadwinter
2505230.short_description: Take control of Dreadwinter, your very own magical coffee shop! Explore a vibrant, fantasy world, master your craft, and turn a small café into a legend in this spooky, cozy coffee shop sim!

5198690.name: Balance Due
5198690.short_description: Balance Due is a solo and online co-op fantasy action game where you hunt monsters, gather loot, upgrade weapons, and return to Base Camp before time runs out. Meet each day’s gold quota, manage the shifting Due, and survive long enough to determine your ending.

4885370.name: StarCinder
4885370.short_description: Fast-paced multiplayer space combat where three factions battle across arenas, ore runs, and sector conquest with customizable ships, gunships, squadrons, NPC fleets, and progression.

4837200.name: Serenity
4837200.short_description: Defeat enemies and uncover secrets with the power of music in this Rhythm RPG! Explore a dying world with diverse environments, wrap your head around nightmares, travel through time, make friends, pet cats, and uncover truths lost not only to history, but maybe even the narrative itself.

3852390.name: CubeMate
3852390.short_description: Chess meets the Rubik's Cube. Rotate a 3D cube until every face satisfies a chess challenge: check, checkmate, advantage, equality or a classic solve. 22-level campaign from 2×2 to 5×5, Free Play up to 7×7, a Daily puzzle and shareable seeds.

4094890.name: The Final Cut of Lilith Cunningham
4094890.short_description: Regret has chased Lilith across the years… but a chance to escape is within reach. Drawn in by a message from your estranged daughter, you must reshape reality with a mystical Film Reel to solve a mass vanishing. To erase your guilt, you'll decide what… and who… to leave on the cutting room floor.

5418790.name: MAZE RUSH
5418790.short_description: Race a glowing ball up 18-floor towers of pitch-black mazes. Ride teleports, dodge spikes, smash through walls and outrun the void across 100+ maps and four party minigames, solo or with up to 4 friends online and in split-screen. Then build your own maps and share them on the Workshop.

5369000.name: Crownmason
5369000.short_description: Crownmason is a turn-based, castle-building autobattler: armies fight on their own, and only a dead king ends the match. Seven factions, a card draft, and matches against the AI, on LAN or online.

5058710.name: The Abyss’s Last Breath
5058710.short_description:
The Abyss’s Last Breath: blends survival, escape‑room gameplay and immersive simulation into a unique psychological horror experience.

You control John, the only volunteer in a secret mission to descend to the edge of the Earth’s core.

4394170.name: The Milgram Experiment Demo
4394170.short_description: A single-player moral dilemma simulator where you are judge, jury, and executioner. Investigate subjects through their personal items such as phones, diaries, and voice logs and uncover their darkest secrets. Judge if they fit a mysterious figure's new secret society. Terminate the unworthy.

5259290.name: In the Same Boat Demo
5259290.short_description: Embark on an adventure across the ocean! In this captivating cooperative sailing game, one player commands the ship, while the other is confined to the captain's cabin, solely navigating with the map. Successfully completing your missions will require the crew's adept communication and skill.

5410670.name: Sunkeeper
5410670.short_description: An idle game about looking after a star. Click it to make light, fill the sky with stars, and grow the worlds around it from tribes into spacefaring civilizations.

4676560.name: From Ashes To Glory
4676560.short_description: A dark, turn-based medieval arena RPG. You are a slave forced to fight. Master range, stamina, and timing-based dodges. Choose your weapon, build your skills, and face warriors from seven continents. Every fight is a puzzle. Every mistake costs blood.

4281480.name: MANDALA: TYPE TO DEFEND
4281480.short_description: Type to survive. Defend a glowing mandala against swarms, shooters, and incoming projectiles in a fast-paced typing arcade game. Choose from four attack forms, combine upgrades, unleash devastating chains, and fight through escalating waves.

5341700.name: CrackBound
5341700.short_description: CrackBound is a 3D tabletop companion game based around gem generation and automation. Produce ores, watch stones move on conveyor belts, earn money and develop your growing industrial facility.

4866280.name: Cinnaboi Baked Brawl Demo
4866280.short_description: A flavorful 2D brawler starring Cinnaboi and his crew of food warriors. Fight through interactive kitchens and diners, master unique movesets, and take on friends or foes in PvP, co‑op, or online play. Animated story scenes reveal Cinnaboi’s origins in this chaotic culinary adventure.

3115410.name: Eonheart
3115410.short_description: Explore Eonheart, an enigmatic machine complex in this classic-style 2D Puzzle Platformer where you can create platforms by yourself and manipulate them to traverse the complex, brave dangers, surpass challenges, solve mechanisms, and discover long-lost secrets!

5355850.name: Betrayground
5355850.short_description:
Run from the Taggers. Betray your friends. Try not to be the slowest one left behind.

Betrayground is a chaotic multiplayer party game where every map plays differently, but one rule never changes: someone has to get caught, and hopefully, it’s not you.

5287200.name: 隐序 Hidden Order
5287200.short_description: Hidden Order is a Windows desktop organization and productivity tool. Keep apps and folders in custom collections, find items with search, and stay focused with a timer. A collapsible top bar keeps the time, date, and everyday tools within easy reach.

2319360.name: Memento Dawn
2319360.short_description: A colorful puzzle adventure about a lost child searching for her memories, guiding her through darkness by mastering light and shadow.

4844620.name: Cinnaboi Baked Brawl
4844620.short_description: A flavorful 2D brawler starring Cinnaboi and his crew of food warriors. Fight through interactive kitchens and diners, master unique movesets, and take on friends or foes in PvP, co‑op, or online play. Animated story scenes reveal Cinnaboi’s origins in this chaotic culinary adventure.

5301480.name: Luskandash
5301480.short_description: A turn-based roguelike where your weapon is a slot machine. Change its symbols, install parts, and chain their effects to survive the next fight. Armed with a fork and a colander, Sisyphus descends in search of Luck. The world has given up. He has not.

5066680.name: Enkhbayar's Olympiad Chess: Multi-Board Team Matches
5066680.short_description: Olympiad Chess evolves classical chess into a true 4v4 team esport. Across a shared central Nexus, pieces invade neighboring boards to flank opponents and rescue allies in synchronized team volleys. It's the world's first true multi-board competitive team chess.

4105360.name: The Lucky Hive
4105360.short_description: Texas Hold'Em, but you can shoot your opponents and win. Race through space, out-muscle your friends, and make them fold. Solo or with up to 6 players. The best hand doesn't always win.

4475810.name: Auto Battle Buddies
4475810.short_description: A cozy puppet-show auto battler where you accessorize your heroes with unique gear, build powerful teams, and battle other performers on the grand stage. Customize your puppets, climb the ranks, and create the ultimate Battle Buddies squad.

4498790.name: Hazard Suits
4498790.short_description:
HAZARD SUITS is a 1-4 player co-op, arcade shooter. With acid rain, procedurally-generated maps, and endless waves of zombified robots. Explore abandoned facilities, acquire new loot, survive!
Did we mention it has split-screen!

4599480.name: Soulstack
4599480.short_description: Card-stacking RPG: gather, forge weapons and fight through dungeons. Pick an evolution path for both you and your pet: 48 classes (9 cursed), 140 pet forms. 300+ weapons, from a stone on a stick to a hand-held ballista. Yet still feels like a Jira and Trello child.

4296990.name: CLASHROIDS
4296990.short_description: 50 players. One arena. Instant chaos. A fast-paced PvP twist on Asteroids: blast rocks for resources, claim territory hex by hex, defend it with laser turrets, and upgrade your ship mid-battle — while wormholes, comets and a black hole reshape every fight.

5000550.name: Nitro Nonsense
5000550.short_description: A chaotic party racer for 1, 2, 4, 8, or up to 16 players, locally or online! Race in split-screen or share a top-down view, build custom tracks, and fill them with traps and obstacles when you win. If you lose, don’t worry: you get to upgrade your car and come back stronger for the next round!

3345260.name: Empire in Decay
3345260.short_description: Start a rebellion and fight chess inspired turn-based combats in this roguelike deckbuilder. Upgrade your units and cards wisely. You will need it to progress through the districts of Daandria, the city where the tyrant king awaits you. Save this Empire in Decay.

3938650.name: 战争、冠冕与流血的动物
3938650.short_description: "War, Crown and Bleeding Animals" is a story-driven RPG game from a female perspective. Players determine the fate of the kingdom through crucial decisions, power struggles and scene puzzles, experiencing moral dilemmas and multi-ending narratives in power struggles.

5248090.name: Magic Exhibit
5248090.short_description: Run a Wizard Animal Shop! Shrink dragons and unicorns into voxel terrariums you build by hand. Keep every creature happy and wizards will pay to visit. Take them on tours inside the glass, turn a profit and grow your little shop.

5488240.name: Buildot Demo
5488240.short_description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. The demo contains 20 handcrafted puzzle levels.

4994890.name: Become Blackhole
4994890.short_description: A space incremental game about getting bigger. You are a mote of dust, and every target you shatter makes you heavier. Grow from a chunk of rubble into a meteor, a moon, a planet, a star — and finally a black hole that devours everything!

5346520.name: Lord of the Ants
5346520.short_description: Dig the rock. Raise the walls. Make the swarm walk your road into your guns. Lord Of The Ants is a top-down ant tower defense with rerouting enemy path mechanics. Boss fights, builds, active/passive skills and more.

2658740.name: Island Of Mine
2658740.short_description: Shipwrecked on a mysterious island, you must collect magical crystals to uncover new land and discover powerful stars that unlock new mechanics and resources. Build your village, craft equipment and battle dark creatures as you explore the island's hidden secrets.

5073090.name: Wild Cosmic
5073090.short_description: Lead a ragtag group of travelers with unique abilities through challenging maps in outer space.

4098990.name: Tango District Demo
4098990.short_description: Tango District is a casual, puzzle-based city builder set in a neon-drenched dystopia. Balance spatial placement, manage corporate influence, and navigate corrupt events. Will you build a free paradise, or sell your skyline to the highest corporate bidder?

4515800.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1
4515800.short_description: "The Veil Chronicles: Nix University" is an exciting and vibrant adventure in a well-thought-out author's world, combining the genres of visual novel, RPG, and turn-based combat system.

4641210.name: Get-Out-Hoomanz
4641210.short_description: A chaotic 2-4 player dungeon crawler! Sabotage your friends' dungeons with deadly traps, loot everything in sight, and escape the show alive. Can you survive your friends' hazards or just another human snack?

4904040.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | SET OF ANIMATIONS
4904040.short_description: All images are included in the main game. Buying the animation set is a way to support the developer.

4904020.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | Part 1 Soundtrack
4904020.short_description: Tracks created specifically for the game. Buy this to support the creator.

4714800.name: The Echoes Demo
4714800.short_description: The Echoes is a 1-4 player co-op horror game. To escape a loop, you must observe your surroundings, memorize details, solve puzzles, and survive.

4904030.name: The Veil Chronicles: Nix University | ARTBOOK

4430580.name: But in briefs
4430580.short_description: Reach the exit… until it runs away, everything collapses, and your pants catch fire. Six zones of chaos in a minimalist platformer.

3474240.name: Dracula: The Disciple
3474240.short_description: To cheat death, you must uncover the secrets hidden within Count Dracula’s castle. Only by mastering the occult arts and solving mystical puzzles can you save yourself. Eternal life comes at a price!

4727980.name: BABKA-TERROR ARTBOOK
4727980.short_description: Artbook with sketches, images, and a few words about the making of the game.

5260130.name: GearTopia Demo
5260130.short_description: Supply a war you don't fight. A steampunk factory with no wires anywhere: water, steam, shafts and gears. When flat ground runs out, build downward. Fill the orders of dwarven fortresses — they hold only as long as you keep shipping.

3393720.name: Ramen Shop Simulator
3393720.short_description: Take control of your very own Ramen Shop! Transform a cozy, worn-out Japanese alley back into a vibrant hotspot. From scrubbing floors to cooking the perfect bowl of ramen. Decorate every corner, upgrade everything, and create your unique shop.

4800640.name: Clone. Optimize. Sacrifice.
4800640.short_description: Build a city of science and magic, power up cloned heroes through automated dungeons, inherit their strength through cloning, and recycle the rest for science in this casual idle city-builder with deep RPG progression and competitive auto-battle leagues.

3990720.name: Escape Path Demo
3990720.short_description: Navigate through complex non-linear mazes dotted with traps, enemies and unique mechanics to rebuild a protective crystal. Watch and think, because rushing in headfirst will lead you to death! Ready to take on the challenge and find the pieces before it's too late?

4846880.name: Dogfight Era: Origins
4846880.short_description: Wake up, Pilot! The war has just begun, and the enemy rules the skies. It's time to take the fight to them! Choose from 32 aircraft from the World War I era and soar above famous battlefields. Do you have what it takes to turn the tide of war?

4162890.name: Gnomed
4162890.short_description: Gnomed is a roguelite clicker base defence game where your humble home is the last line of defense. Hold out against 20 chaotic waves of enemies, unlock new abilities, and grow stronger each run!

5245310.name: 挂机魔王 II
5245310.short_description: Idle Demon Lord II combines idle progression with dark fantasy loot hunting. Fight automatically and earn rewards offline. Choose from five classes, each with unique skills and mechanics. Hunt six tiers of gear, customize affixes, gems, runes, and Legendary Powers, and build your endgame character.

5041720.name: Debt Wish
5041720.short_description: You start with $100 and a line of credit. Trade, borrow, bribe, and gamble your way up until you own everything. An incremental finance sim where the debt can be your best friend or worst enemy.

5066320.name: Pointless Climb
5066320.short_description: Escape an impossible abyss as Ilia Movahed in a brutal, parkour climber. Execute precision vaults, wall climbs, and high stakes jumps to reach the summit. There are no checkpoints. one simple mistake will send you tumbling back to the start.

4052330.name: Custom Hero vs Epic Boss beta

5096400.name: Unhex
5096400.short_description: Unhex is a replayable co-op survival-horror game. Your goal is to figure out which demon has possessed the victim, and to exorcise it once you know it. You do this by searching for occult items and observing the possessed’s behavior and interactions with the environment - all without being caught.

5261110.name: Night Market Ring Toss
5261110.short_description: Bring the night market home with Night Market Ring Toss! Try eight stalls and four modes, fine-tune each throw, and collect prizes including 61 original plush designs. Enjoy the stall owner's cute mumbles, with menus and subtitles in five languages. Physics-based, single-player fun.

5213740.name: Scream Operator: Haunted House Manager Demo
5213740.short_description: Run a haunted dark ride from the control booth in this spooky horror management sim. Load guests, trigger scares, route carts, and keep the power alive as the queue surges. Earn cash and prestige to rebuild the mansion, automate the ride, and survive every shift.

5217480.name: Bound to die
5217480.short_description: A dark fantasy co-op action roguelike inspired by Dark Messiah, where the environment is your deadliest weapon. Master brutal melee combat, experiment with powerful builds and synergies, and use the environment to turn every run into chaos.

4850990.name: Lumen Nexus: Core
4850990.short_description: A sci-fi factory automation game where resources move as light instead of belts. Build production chains, expand across asteroid islands, trade your resources, research new systems, and keep your growing factory flowing under rising pressure.

5190580.name: HELENA : Cloud District
5190580.short_description: HELENA: Cloud District is an atmospheric first-person exploration game where you explore a decaying mega-structure to photograph strange plants and uncover fragments of melancholic memories.

5252660.name: Flame, Cats & Kitchen Demo
5252660.short_description: Draw your ingredients, cook them, and feed hungry cats! A cozy cooking game in a colorful paper kitchen. Cut out your creations, add flavor with special crayons, and use heat and stirring to make each guest's meal just right

4970880.name: Black Gold: Star KTV Affairs
4970880.short_description: Run an adults-only KTV—an Asian-style karaoke club with private rooms—where singing often leads to less clothing! Decorate rooms, recruit beautiful staff, mix drinks, and handle fights and songs that turn into “multiplayer cardio.” Bigger rooms mean more people joining the chorus!

4891110.name: The Lost City of Gold
4891110.short_description: The discovery of an adventurer's journal starts you on an unforgettable journey into the heart of an uncharted wilderness in search of the legendary Lost City of Gold.

4545840.name: Tabletop Survivors Demo
4545840.short_description: Tabletop Survivors is a turn-based roguelike card RPG driven by random events, where every playthrough tells a new story. You will survive and fight in a zombie apocalypse, making difficult choices and writing your own survival journey.

4925590.name: Hell Rite
4925590.short_description: A dark dungeon-crawling RPG about venturing into dangerous ruins, defeating enemies, and bringing back powerful loot. Explore procedurally generated dungeons and hand-crafted story locations, uncover mysterious treasures, and grow your character through powerful skills, abilities, and gear.

4415050.name: The Tram
4415050.short_description:
Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s.
Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

5446070.name: Dear Gravity
5446070.short_description: Fold a little hope. Let it fly. Read the wind, refine your paper plane and feel the quiet triumph of a difficult delivery landing just right. From your first window launch to a letter at the lighthouse, go a little further with every throw.

5457850.name: Lullaby for a Titan
5457850.short_description: A titan sleeps beneath your village, and its dreams are your harvest. Build, hum the giant's lullaby on its breath, catch dreams and keep its sleep deep. Every building makes noise; every dream tempts you closer to the edge. Don't wake the giant.

4953420.name: Castronauts
4953420.short_description: Castronauts is a 2D co-op extraction game about hauling alien fish out of dangerous worlds. Assemble a team of up to 6 players to fish together, explore procedurally generated areas, and survive encounters with hostile creatures before the planet collapses around you.

5374460.name: Dark Ages Battle Simulator
5374460.short_description: What happens when 20 skeletons face a dragon? Or an army of goblins challenges a colossal demon? Create your own dark-fantasy matchups, build your armies, and watch monsters, warriors and legendary beasts clash in a brutal cinematic battle simulator.

4943100.name: GOLUBI
4943100.short_description: Embark on a surreal adventure that feels like a strange dream. Explore unusual places, meet their inhabitants, solve puzzles, and piece together the story.

5431060.name: The Hollow Grounds Demo
5431060.short_description: Survive relentless waves of the Hollowed, upgrade your armor and home, unlock and level up powerups, and invest Soulstones into permanent upgrades. Rebirth to grow stronger, fight deadly bosses, complete 50 achievements, explore the Enemy Index, and climb the leaderboards!

5505690.name: Duck Duck Run Demo
5505690.short_description:
The ducks are on the run, and you have 3 minutes to catch them!
Chase them down as they try to escape. Catch ducks to earn coins and unlock new items and upgrades.

5437060.name: Game Master
5437060.short_description: Your tabletop RPG, together on LAN or online. Join and play free with characters, dice, animated movement and session messages. Full Toolkit DLC unlocks campaign creation, grid and gridless maps, content editors and GM hosting. Optional accounts connect your community.

4508110.name: CYBERLIFE
4508110.short_description: CYBERLIFE is an online hacking game played through a terminal, in one world shared by every player. Break into companies, bring your loot back to your localhost, and take the crossroads every other operator has to go through.

2706280.name: Hedenite
2706280.short_description: Hedenite  is a hand-painted adventure through a city that has lost its memory. Befriend whimsical characters, unearth secrets of the past hidden in plain sight, and smuggle yourself uptown!

5109830.name: Brush Rush
5109830.short_description: Paint your own parkour path to escape in this new "Brush Rush" multiplayer, casual, tag game! Runners try to escape by painting 3D paths around a parkour map to hide from the chasers who get super human movement, a paint shotgun, and a pair of boxing gloves. Public matches and streaming is welcome!

3883440.name: FireBirds: Drone Simulator
3883440.short_description: Control various types of military drones, from FPV and bombers to aircraft models and correction drones. Perform combat sorties, destroy tanks, artillery, and enemy drones in a realistic flight simulator.

4442650.name: Mindbreak Demo
4442650.short_description: Mindbreak is an exploration driven tile-based puzzle adventure game about the escape from a corrupted insane asylum. Play as the supernaturally gifted asylum patients as you build and combine their unique abilities to explore and master the vast interconnected asylum.

3926400.name: 星舰骰（Starship Dice）
3926400.short_description: Fill your fleet with different weapons and equipment, and return to base with loot. The fleet will engage in automatic battles in three-dimensional space, and you will plan the star map route and action mode, but it is best to pray for permission from the God of Dice.

3679750.name: Shrine Protectors
3679750.short_description: Deckbuilder Tower Defense meets rogue-lite RTS strategy. Lead your army, crush waves of enemies, and unlock powerful upgrades and passive spells. Combine deckbuilding strategy with tactical army management in this relentless bullet heaven.

3721000.name: Battle Brewers
3721000.short_description: Battle Brewers is a 1-4 player couch party game where you are in charge of brewing potions to defend a castle in multiple chaotic levels. Brew potions that apply buffs, deal damage or spawn units, all to prevent the castle from falling to the incoming waves of different enemies!

4677860.name: The Spectacular Evermore
4677860.short_description: Learn each room of the theatre, spot anomalies, and photograph them to restore the room. Keep your eyes open for anything unusual, from living statues to possessed paintings.

5194610.name: Diseased Demo
5194610.short_description: Build your camp in the freezing cold and make tough choices. Capture walls to expand your borders and send your men to explore. Risk it all for vital resources, as surviving the relentless waves of the Diseased emerging from the dark will be harder than you think.

5201340.name: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe Demo
5201340.short_description: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe is a Live2D, interaction-focused romance simulation game. You find yourself working as a fox spirit's "assistant," living together and taking care of all aspects of her daily life.

5242870.name: DERELIKT Demo
5242870.short_description: DERELIKT is a narrative retro FPS built for fans of claustrophobic PS1-era sci-fi horror.

4893610.name: Gacha Shop Simulator Demo
4893610.short_description: Run a cozy gacha shop! Sell blind boxes and figures, serve customers, expand your store and open a few boxes for yourself. Who knows what rare figure is waiting inside?

5048810.name: Tiny Harbor Demo
5048810.short_description: Tiny Harbor is a cozy desktop fishing management game where you grow your fleet, discover new species, expand production and automate your harbor, all while your little world keeps running alongside whatever else you’re doing.

4671840.name: 来吃！小兔面包房 Demo
4671840.short_description: (Demo)Start your desktop bakery! Begin with one cookie and a table. Decorate, cook, hire staff, and learn recipes. Serve lively bunny customers, meet quirky characters, and unlock their unique stories and dishes!

4767600.name: Working Stiff Armor Set
4767600.short_description: Chop wood, look rad, slay the undead!

4859600.name: Quilt Demo
4859600.short_description: Create a beautiful quilt one patch at a time. Solve handcrafted puzzles inspired by picross, minesweeper, and jigsaw puzzles, and uncover the hidden rules of the world through logic and experimentation.

4463490.name: Guns, Princess and Braves Demo
4463490.short_description: Fast-paced Roguelike: inventory management meets tower defense. As a princess in love with a dragon, strategically layout weapons in limited space. Take direct control in battle to crush "righteous" braves with flashy bullet!

4568340.name: Minesweeper: Next-Gen Demo
4568340.short_description: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

4782110.name: 深空幸存者：无尽星域 Demo
4782110.short_description: "Deep Space Survivor: Endless Starfield" is a survivor-style game. Your interstellar battleship accidentally enters an unknown universe, fighting its way through endless enemies, roaming multiple star systems, and collecting meteor resources to forge your ultimate orbital weapon.

4195830.name: nophenia: original soundtrack
4195830.short_description: songs for a small dream explorer.

3996800.name: Vampire: The Masquerade® - Bloodlines™ 2 -  Loose Cannon
3996800.short_description:
The law is yours to break. Play as Benny Muldoon, Sheriff of a fractured Court. Experience parts of the Bloodlines 2 story from his brutal perspective.

Contains new playable story content, combat mechanics, and a Phyre outfit.

4019310.name: Platform Anomaly Demo
4019310.short_description: Platform Anomaly is a co-op horror game where you and your friends hunt for anomalies — or hide them yourself and watch the search unfold. Scary and fun at the same time!

3737820.name: Time Survivor Demo
3737820.short_description: Time drains your life away. Dodge, dash, and blast through enemies and brutal bosses. Collect resources to stay alive and grow stronger through a massive skill tree, unlocking a lot of new mechanics to master. Fight Time and its Time Keepers. How long can you last?

3445260.name: Bad Trip Demo
3445260.short_description: An atmospheric horror game told through 7 stages, each shaped by a different state of mind. Run, fight, and solve your way through a psychedelic trip swinging between absurd and terrifying, as a grieving man is pulled toward facing his mother's death.

3052290.name: Icarus: Matariki Holiday Mission
3052290.short_description: Unlocks the Matariki Mission, tasking you with helping introduce a new flightless bird species to Icarus. It will have you retrieving and incubating an egg while protecting it from predators.

3116830.name: Pathfinder: Wrath of the Righteous - Visitors from Morta
3116830.short_description: A window into another world has opened among the wastelands of the Worldwound

4087210.name: Red Rain
4087210.short_description: Survive a decimated yet beautiful post-apocalyptic landscape as Allie, a competent survivalist and mother raising her daughter against the backdrop of a broken world.

2857800.name: RetroArch - Geolith
2857800.short_description: Geolith is a highly accurate core for a popular console system released in the early 1990s.

2732710.name: Session: Skate Sim Schoolyard
2732710.short_description: Return to the school benches… to pull off your tricks! The new Schoolyard map just might become your new favourite skate playground.

5052450.name: Desktop Wallet Heroes
5052450.short_description:
An intense idle RPG that unfolds right on your desktop!
Desktop Wallet Heroes is an overlay idle RPG where characters endlessly hunt monsters at the bottom of your screen—without ever interrupting your work or web browsing. 
Continuously upgrade items to defeat enemies and rake in mountains of loot!

2345800.name: RetroArch - ScummVM
2345800.short_description: ScummVM core is allows you to run certain classic graphical adventure and role-playing games.

4916010.name: Shorted
4916010.short_description: Balatro-style scoring on a 9×9 grid. Your deck becomes the board: trace same-color Packets into scoring shapes, install Patches that hack the rules, and rebuild the deck that refills the grid. Six Firewalls stand between you and an overloaded high score.

5080410.name: Cinema Tycoon
5080410.short_description: Build and manage your own cinema empire in Cinema Tycoon. License movies, plan screenings, hire and train staff, run the food court, launch marketing campaigns, compete with rival cinemas, expand to new locations, and grow your reputation on the way to becoming the best cinema owner in the world.

1270830.name: Crystal Isles - ARK Expansion Map
1270830.short_description: A community classic ARK map returns, now updated for the Official Server networks! Crystal Isles is 150 square kilometers of awe-inspiring biomes… Build bases high in forest canopy and floating islands, and tame your own Tropeognathus—ARK’s newest pterosaur—to ride into aerial combat!

1227482.name: RetroArch - CrocoDS
1227482.short_description: CrocoDS was originally an colourful computer core for 1984's PC.

1227485.name: RetroArch - Gearboy
1227485.short_description: Gearboy is one of the greatest way to experience good old handheld system.

821170.name: The Escapists 2 - Dungeons and Duct Tape
821170.short_description: This content requires the base game  on steam in order to play.

4697480.name: Jarred Defense Demo
4697480.short_description: A difficult maze-building tower defense. Protect the kitty from evil robots and endure its unhelpful comments. Force enemies the long way around, push them through lava, and adapt as levels change beneath you. No spells, no card modifiers. A love letter to Warcraft III custom maps and Flash games.

592800.name: Crusader Kings II: South Indian Portraits 5 Year Anniversary Gift

564030.name: The Uncertain: Last Quiet Day Soundtrack and Artbook
564030.short_description: This free DLC contains The Uncertain: Last Quiet Day Soundtrack and Artbook.

5212390.name: The Hollow Grounds
5212390.short_description: Survive relentless waves of the Hollowed, upgrade your armor and home, unlock and level up powerups, and invest Soulstones into permanent upgrades. Rebirth to grow stronger, fight deadly bosses, complete 50 achievements, explore the Enemy Index, and climb the leaderboards!

5420740.name: Outergod Abduction
5420740.short_description: You have been kidnapped by Chtuli, a cute alien yandere who loves you. Hug her, play with her pet Mimi, and find a way out before her love turns into something much worse in this horror survival game!

4121110.name: DARKHAND
4121110.short_description: Enter The Devil's casino, meet dozens of other charming gamblers, and fight your way out for a fortune. Will you ever be able to pay off your debt?

3758440.name: Maja Island
3758440.short_description: Sail through a mysterious open world island in your trusty boat, scavenge for resources to upgrade it, and face off against Maja.

5048020.name: HyperION DAW: Standard Edition
5048020.short_description: Unlimited saving and export, 250 generator and AI credits, and the Photo Editor and Video Editor. A one-time, lifetime upgrade for HyperION DAW.

5343200.name: Guns &amp; Gambits Demo
5343200.short_description: Guns & Gambits Demo is a high-octane chess horde-survival roguelite. Command sentient chess companions, wield devastating firearms, unlock game-breaking gambits, and blast through relentless waves of rogue chess pieces to checkmate the dark monarch in bullet-heaven action.

5027650.name: HyperION DAW: Ultimate Edition
5027650.short_description: Everything in Standard, plus unlimited generator and AI use, the HyperSpectral repair editor and Smart Match. The complete HyperION DAW, as a one-time, lifetime upgrade.

5383230.name: Clash of Crests - The Friar's Scepter
5383230.short_description: Friar Aldwin healed soldiers of every banner for forty years, and kept every wound he could not close. The wrath he never spent is sealed in his scepter, and the Ashen Abbot has found where it is buried. Three chapters, six battles besides, one weapon you may use exactly once.

3122450.name: Cenk The Chopper
3122450.short_description: Cenk The Chopper is a fast paced hack-and-slash game. Fight through hordes of mutants and robots in a world you've made go to hell. Chop 'em up everything you see till the end of it.

5304050.name: Clash of Crests - Dangers and Wonders
5304050.short_description: Two campaigns down the dark roads of the world: hire on with the Delver's Road charter, or swear the Ashen Compact and learn what five schools of magic cost. Brings delve maps, relic wonders, grave events, traps and the Unbound casters to every mode.

4607130.name: CRUD
4607130.short_description: CRUD is an MMO survival horror RPG set in a world devastated by an epidemic. Explore abandoned cities, restore vehicles, build your crew, and raid other players' shelters for valuable resources and gear. There are no truly safe places here - only the people you've chosen to trust.

5198430.name: Everything In Its Place
5198430.short_description: Sığınakta bir şeyler olmuş. Raflar boş, yerler dolu: ilaç kutuları, ampuller, yedek parçalar. 6.336 malzemeyi yerine koyacak tek kişi sensin. Savaş yukarıda devam ediyor. Burası artık senin sorumluluğunda. Acele yok, baskı yok. Kimse seni beklemiyor.

5300620.name: Random Slot Adventurers : Matched Words... Now I'm the Strongest
5300620.short_description: Build a 3x3 slot board in this word-combination strategy roguelike. Combine Subjects, Adverbs, and Verbs to attack, defend, and heal. Explore changing islands, collect words and relics, and shape a build around class traits and synergies.

5402060.name: Clash of Crests - The Maid of Orléans
5402060.short_description: Ride with Joan of Arc from the road to Chinon to Orléans, Reims and the causeway at Compiègne in a fifteen-chapter campaign, then make the choice history never got and rescue her. France, England and Burgundy take the field with bombards, rams and scaling ladders.

4783430.name: Echoes of the Forest
4783430.short_description: Echoes of the Forest is a sensory Adventure-Puzzle where you play a blind musician. Journey through a cursed forest to reclaim your eyes, stolen by a mysterious cult. Navigate using the sound of your flute and the environment, and uncover ancient melodies to overcome the obstacles ahead.

5212870.name: Clash of Crests Demo
5212870.short_description: The old king is dead and the ravens circle. Ride with Sir Roland through The Raven's War - five battles and an interlude of turn-based medieval tactics on hex battlefields, with Saxon, Norman and Saracen troops to lead.

5387970.name: Drop Dead Lucky
5387970.short_description: Every bounce is a gamble. Make yours count. Drop Dead Lucky is a Plinko roguelite where you aim your drops, nudge fate in your favor, and combine charms, runes, and spirits to build huge scores and survive eight escalating antes.

4088370.name: Two Dollar Suits
4088370.short_description: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

4178420.name: Two Dollar Suits Demo
4178420.short_description: Two Dollar Suits combines the very best of the Action-Strategy genre into a fast-moving criminal playground, where players thrive in creativity and exploration. Complete intricate levels and create your own paths using skill, ingenuity, and raw power.

5259270.name: Agastache Rugosa
5259270.short_description: A classic Western-fantasy otome VN. Your closest friend is murdered before a curse can turn them into a monster. Hunt the killer while meeting a devoted younger man, a self-doubting baron, a beautiful apothecary, and a domineering villain.

5271470.name: Crown of Time
5271470.short_description: Rebuild a forgotten kingdom in this dark-fantasy idle RPG. Gather and craft by hand, command Echoes to work while you’re away, and explore Past, Present, and Future. Fight the guardians by hand, gather the crown’s three fragments, and reach the one place that stands outside time.

4658400.name: Pipfiend: The Demonic Domino Deckbuilder Demo

4436400.name: VOICEBOX
4436400.short_description: VOICEBOX is a chaotic 2D proximity-chat co-op game where your mic is the main way to interact. Explore a theme park, solve noisy voice-powered puzzles, and keep your voice boxes away from monsters with up to 6 players.

4859910.name: Kill The Hero
4859910.short_description: A Dungeon Builder, Autobattler and Deckbuilder in one. They call themselves “heroes”. You call them gold suppliers. Dig your domain, build deadly traps, place guards and play powerful cards as ever-stronger “heroes” invade your dungeon. Take their gold and build the World Domination Machine.

5380920.name: ICE TO MEET YOU
5380920.short_description: New Year's Eve, a courtyard of panel apartment blocks, and the "Ice Cup" the neighboring districts want to steal. Team up with friends to pack snowballs, build snow walls, run errands for the neighbors in exchange for tangerines, and fight off waves of attackers until midnight.

4539410.name: Cubie
4539410.short_description: CUBIE is a minimalist puzzle platformer where you control gravity. Each side of the cube offers unique physics based on how you enter it. The world remains the same – only your perspective changes. Can you solve spatial puzzles in a labyrinth where "up" is just a relative term?

3141390.name: GRAFT
3141390.short_description: YOU ARE THE SHIP OF THESEUS. Who, or what, will you be when you escape the Arc? A story-driven survival horror RPG from the makers of the Shadowrun Trilogy.

3113690.name: Ship Miner
3113690.short_description:
Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements.

Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy.

Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

5269690.name: Will It Launch? Demo
5269690.short_description: Try the free demo of this co-op physics sandbox for 1–8 players. Bolt wings and engines onto junk, build a flying sofa, haul cargo between islands, and find out whether your latest bad idea will actually fly.

5380210.name: Biathlon Manager
5380210.short_description: Biathlon Manager is a management sim that puts you in charge of a national biathlon team. Take the helm and lead your team to glory: coach your leaders, nurture young talent, manage your staff and sponsors — and above all, follow the success of the athletes in your care.

5205090.name: Will It Launch?
5205090.short_description: A co-op physics comedy for 1-8 players with proximity voice chat. Turn a bathtub, a sofa or a toilet cabin into a plane and fly cargo between three islands. Your friends help you build it. They also have angle grinders, the shared wallet and, eventually, a bomb.

4383350.name: Travelling Light
4383350.short_description: Travelling Light is a narrative game about four friends, Lars, Leah, Samson, and Ivy, caught in the turbulence of their early thirties. Inspired by real events, this experience lets you step into each perspective as love, friendship, and heartbreak collide.

4796080.name: Compound Interest Demo
4796080.short_description: The networks are dead. The city has fallen. Manage your crew and send them into danger to earn money and respect. Claim turf, control trade, and make allies or enemies as you reshape the fully simulated city of New Sterling.

4835050.name: Troublelings
4835050.short_description: Climb impossible worlds alone or with up to 12 players. Wall-run, swing from physics-driven ropes, fight bosses and survive co-op chaos where helping your friends can go very wrong.

5210800.name: SYSTEM INTRUDER
5210800.short_description: Explore the dark secrets of ASGARD-04 in an immersive retro-cyberpunk survival horror inspired by classic 3D games. Search for clues, solve puzzles, fight enemies, manage limited resources, and survive the horrors lurking within a mysterious research complex.

4394520.name: DoJo Legacy of Zhen
4394520.short_description: Dojo Legacy of Zhen, you don't just fight you change history. A emergent martial arts world where every broken bone and bruised ego creates a ripple effect. Defeat a rival, and his disciples will hunt you. Rebuild your school, master the Grudge Engine and forge a legacy in a world that never forgets

5072380.name: Tiny Fishing Villages
5072380.short_description: Build a cosy Scottish fishing village, manage a hardworking fleet, and grow a thriving coastal community inspired by real locations across Scotland.

3935200.name: North Pole Workshop
3935200.short_description: Explore the magical North Pole Workshop in this festive co-op toy-making game for 1-4 players. Team up with your merry elves and lightly strategize how to complete various toy recipes. Craft, wrap, and deliver toys to Santa's sleigh for all the good boys and girls!

4348280.name: Princess and Conquest - Queen Of Clubs
4348280.short_description: Princess & Conquest: Queen of Clubs is a tavern manager/simulator, with multiple minigames, and many narrative elements! Animated 2D portraits and illustrated backgrounds, mixed to create a colorful world filled with cute and sexy characters, as always in the Princess & Conquest's Kingdom!

2860490.name: ワロタ、俺の家のとなり魔王城www
2860490.short_description: 【Village-Building Action RPG】Reincarnated into a ravaged world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, and swap hats to change classes! But when the Idol Demon King throws a live concert, a massive wave of hyped-up monsters stampedes straight toward your village!

5000230.name: The Scarlet Thread
5000230.short_description: A Victorian manor mystery in fine 1-bit ink, touched with scarlet. Read the accounts of different narrators, examine clothing and ledgers, and re-enact the night. Spotting lies is only part of the case: how much does an honest account really prove?

4643920.name: Hometown Store Demo
4643920.short_description: Experience the charm of a Thai convenience store! Earn your customers' trust, unlock classic products and expand your business into the wider community.

5468730.name: Maple's Secret
5468730.short_description: Pet Maple at his own rhythm, earn upgrades to get away with more, and don't let anyone catch you.

4579930.name: Kepler Protocol
4579930.short_description: Kepler-186e, Humanity's first colony — on a world that is not theirs. Lead the Kaiserreich in turn-based hex strategy against the Ordo Arachnis, a swarm intelligence with no commander. Research, build, supply, fight. Survive.

5077200.name: INCREMINER Demo
5077200.short_description: Build an ever-growing colony of autonomous dwarves in an immense procedural world. Mine deeper, manage resources, unlock explosive weapons and industrial vehicles, and turn a tiny settlement into a screen-filling mining empire.

5269980.name: GAMES Duel（ガメスデュエル） Playtest

5071340.name: INCREMINER
5071340.short_description: Build an ever-growing colony of autonomous dwarves in an immense procedural world. Mine deeper, manage resources, unlock explosive weapons and industrial vehicles, and turn a tiny settlement into a screen-filling mining empire.

5243740.name: The Atrium Demo
5243740.short_description: Mine your way through a vast cave system that watches as you dig deeper each day. Explore diverse biomes, collect valuable resources and craft increasingly powerful tools and upgrades until you are strong enough to reach the end of the tunnel before it collapses on you.

5459290.name: 标记朋友 - 标记大礼包完全版
5459290.short_description: Requires the MarkFriends Progression Pack as well as the free base app. Own both licenses to immediately use all 47 current formal marks. This upgrade alone does not grant complete access. Actual progress is retained.

5459280.name: 标记朋友 - 标记大礼包
5459280.short_description: Get progression access to 35 pack marks in MarkFriends. Unlock them through app running time or accepted sends. Earned progress is retained with no expiry. This DLC does not unlock all marks immediately.

5231220.name: KEDR
5231220.short_description: KEDR is an extraction horror game where you take on the role of a trader in a vast underground complex. Avoid direct confrontations with monsters, search dangerous areas and rooms with extreme caution, use the creatures’ weaknesses to your advantage, and make it out of the complex alive.

4856820.name: Тоskа-74
4856820.short_description: Toska-74 is a psychedelic, open-world survival-horror game set in a fictional 1974 Siberia. In a moment's notice the sky turned grey - and the chairs rose to the ceiling. The Yankees and Commies have settled. Something will be done, no matter the costs.

5115790.name: JETGRAVE
