5115790.short_description: JETGRAVE is a fast-paced side-scrolling shoot ’em up for 1-3 players inspired by the arcade and console shooters of the 16-bit era. Blast through hostile skies, overwhelming enemy forces, massive war machines, and an abomination that should have stayed buried.

4874300.name: 塔尔塔罗斯之刑
4874300.short_description: Side-scrolling 2.5D horror romance game integrated with environmental puzzle-solving mechanics. You wake up as an experiment subject stripped of all memories in an underground research prison, hunted relentlessly by vengeful modified test subjects — until you meet her...

3327000.name: Roguebound Pirates
3327000.short_description: Loot, upgrade & dominate! Your inventory IS your ship in this action roguelike. Customize weapons, create game-breaking synergies, and claim your place as the most overpowered pirate across the seas!

5360510.name: Hold Morale
5360510.short_description: A turn-based tactics roguelite. Lead your campaign across a branching war map, fight grid battles on land, sea, and air, and combine retrofit kits into powerful synergies. Keep your army's morale alive, because if it breaks, the campaign is lost.

2953540.name: Neverseas
2953540.short_description: Neverseas is a tactical action-RPG set in an open sea world. Command your ship, engage in battles, explore the lands beyond the ocean gates, and shape a global conflict between empires. Will you uncover the secrets of the seas—or vanish with your crew in this ruthless war?

1394770.name: Neverlooted Dungeon Demo
1394770.short_description:
Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon in search of its legendary treasure, and face its treacherous, deadly traps. 
Using your creativity and magical items in a highly interactive physics-based world, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers, and be the first to uncover its darkest secrets.

3010870.name: Match Tree
3010870.short_description:
Match Tree is a breathtaking puzzle experience (...it's actually a match 3 game).
Embark on an epic journey with pixie, gnome and witch full of adventure, mystery (huh?) and sheep.
Become the master of combination and create magnificent mansions from trees, flowers and carrots (I swear, it's fun!).

3884530.name: IdleOS
3884530.short_description: An idle hacking game played through a life-like terminal. Run processes, spin up VM windows and compile your own Hacking Mods as you break your way from a school’s network to government servers.

5489510.name: Relic Looter
5489510.short_description:
Explore Ancient Ruins and Mysterious Temples!
Dodge Deadly Traps and Discover Legendary Treasures!
Grab the Loot. Escape Alive!

4554560.name: Under the Heavens: Warring States Saga Playtest

4568000.name: POUND SAND
4568000.short_description: Every pixel simulated, including the machines. Dig into alien planets, build a factory from real blocks, and carve it into any shape you want. Ore sinks and sand rises in the greatest competition in the galaxy. Move it, grind it, melt it, freeze it, sell it, and strip the planet to bedrock.

4602690.name: Under the Heavens: Warring States Saga Demo

3945690.name: The Pact
3945690.short_description: The Pact is a story-rich psychological horror game about family secrets, where you experience a tragic tale of morality, justice, and consequence. Navigate unsettling environments, escape threats, solve puzzles, and run for your life as you slowly discover your family's dark secret and its origins.

4135120.name: Speed Rivals - Model Trains
4135120.short_description: Build wild railway worlds, master fast and risky train driving, complete chaotic delivery missions, and race or cooperate with friends in a multiplayer train game where every track, wagon, and second matters.

5055820.name: SCP Loop
5055820.short_description: You are a SCP Foundation employee. One day, you find yourself going through corridor, which suddenly starts to repeat itself. Explore SCP 970 and maybe you can escape...

4936260.name: WHERE IS MY MIND
4936260.short_description: Uncover the truth behind a mysterious box left at your doorstep. But as the objects inside the house pull you away from reality and drag you into other worlds, prepare yourself for a psychological horror experience where the line between reality and hallucination slowly begins to disappear.

5245930.name: What Have My Cats Done Demo

4944840.name: What Have My Cats Done
4944840.short_description:
Just got home from work, only to be greeted by absolute chaos? 
What Have My Cats Done is a casual puzzle game combining mischievous cats with Tetris-style gameplay.
Unlock missing puzzle pieces, and find out exactly what these furry troublemakers have been up to!

5132990.name: Puppet Mall: Chapter 1
5132990.short_description: Explore the abandoned Puppet Mall, solve puzzles, and uncover the secrets of its dark past. As John, confront the mall's mysteries and discover what really happened there while investigating the story of Mike and Chris. But be careful... You are not alone.

5000190.name: It Just Works
5000190.short_description:
Build your deck. Play your cards. Watch the score explode!
Discover powerful cards, stack multipliers, and trigger wild combos to push your score higher and higher. Collect relics that bend the rules, build broken synergies, and see just how far you can go!

4599700.name: End Quest
4599700.short_description: An isometric co-op action RPG for three. Leo blocks, Arwen shoots, Keshi keeps everyone alive. Take quests into a rainforest where people vanish, up a mountain that has not seen spring in 200 years and into a kingdom that fell overnight. Nobody online? AI companions fill the empty seats.

4336090.name: Bad Tides
4336090.short_description: BAD TIDES is a chaotic 4 player co-op pirate adventure! Explore the seven seas, dive for treasure, upgrade your trustworthy vessel, and fight creatures of myth.

5303890.name: Project Neko
5303890.short_description: Pilot a cat-shaped ship through a neon rhythm tunnel. Hit, hold and trace notes to the beat, chase high scores, and take a loud, unruly cat band from rehearsal room to stage. Unlock partners and songs across four difficulties in this music-driven arcade adventure.

5360590.name: PUZFLO: Run the Line
5360590.short_description: Build it. Run it. Fix it. PUZFLO: Run the Line is a 2D factory puzzle game where you design production lines, uncover bottlenecks, and optimize every detail. Combine conveyors, machines, and stoppers to hit your production target with limited space and cost—and keep the whole line running smoothly.

5268810.name: Flak Simulator
5268810.short_description: Crew a WWII anti aircraft gun with your friends. Spot incoming bombers, call out ranges, set fuses and load each round by hand. Flak Simulator is a firstperson coop simulation where getting a shot on target takes the whole crew.

4960100.name: ChipWits Worlds
4960100.short_description: Colony Sim. Assembly Required. Program real 1980s 65C02 microprocessors inside cute 8-bit robots to mine crystals, fortify your base, and survive a lethal alien planet where every clock cycle burns watts. Tweak starter code, write your own OS, or flash boot disks.

4802230.name: Monster Meadows - Online Board Game Playtest

5278300.name: Aventureiro 95
5278300.short_description: A roguelite RPG inside a retro desktop. Choose your route, build your hero with skills, loot and relics, and face bosses in automatic combat. Unlock four classes, invest in permanent upgrades and return for a new run with tougher challenges.

323880.name: Seedling
323880.short_description: A cozy first-person colony game. Land on a planet you bought on credit (yours, mostly), chop, fish and farm with your own hands, then grow a town of settlers with names, needs and quirks, from the first log to a space elevator. Alone or with up to 3 friends.

5345490.name: Quarantine Lab Sort
5345490.short_description: Restore order to a lab left in complete chaos! Sort over 7,000 items, examine unknown samples in a centrifuge, catch escaped animals, and handle radioactive waste with care. Unlock skills and turn piles of clutter into neatly organized shelves.

5379860.name: Maze Echo
5379860.short_description: Someone here knows what you've forgotten. Explore a sanatorium and its mirror world, piece together lost memories, and decide whom to trust in this psychological horror visual novel. Your state of mind shapes some of the choices ahead.

4715080.name: The Races
4715080.short_description:
The horses aren't real. The money isn't real. The emotional rollercoaster very much is.

Bet, buy, train and sabotage from your phone in this Teletext-era horse racing party game, for a room full of friends or just you and the bots.

4832420.name: Legend of Azure Peak : Wuxia Heroes
4832420.short_description: Turn-based martial arts RPG set in the mid-Ming Dynasty. Play as Cyrus, an Azure Peak disciple, to recruit companion heroes in a corrupt world. Master tactical party-based combat to defeat foes, unravel imperial conspiracies, and choose between personal vengeance and state righteousness.

5313770.name: Rush Math
5313770.short_description: RushMath is a single-player arithmetic arcade game against the clock. Solve random problems, build combos and beat your personal best. Correct answers restore time; mistakes take it away. Earn credits and purchase permanent upgrades.

5162960.name: Pale Static
5162960.short_description: A cinematic first-person survival horror about a squad sent into a town on what looked like a routine rescue operation. By the time they arrive, the town is already in chaos.

5060170.name: Grape by Grape
5060170.short_description: A cozy vineyard idler where your cursor makes vines grow. Turn 14 grape varieties into aged wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez; automate six connected estate stations and fill customer orders. No frantic clicking, no failure—just one more harvest, bottle and upgrade.

4529380.name: VENOY
4529380.short_description: VENOY is a relaxing roguelite real-time strategy game with deep settler logistics, true sandbox freedom and exciting meta progression. Build your medieval colony, optimize production chains and defend it against enemies!

3703300.name: I Checkmate Thee
3703300.short_description: "I Checkmate Thee" is a turn-based puzzle game with limited vision, in the setting and genre of horror and chess. The king is armed with a sword to escape from the confinement of the chessboard. Go through chess games, where every move is a step towards death!

4894600.name: Fairy Tales Survivors
4894600.short_description: Chaos has taken over the world of fairy tales. Lead a squad of storybook heroes through a dark world of all manner of creatures and challenges to save the fairy tales before it's too late.

3625270.name: MateEngine
3625270.short_description: MateEngine is a lightweight desktop companion app with full custom VRM model support. Bring 3D anime-style characters to life on your screen with idle animations, drag and dance features, and low resource usage and open-source.

3677630.name: Sitra Achra
3677630.short_description: SITRA ACHRA is last known game from Celia Stowe, a game designer that disappeared in 1985. Developer Salt + Pixel has salvaged as much of the original code as possible to preserve this once-lost Commodore 64 prototype.

3846360.name: The Goblin Tavern
3846360.short_description: The Goblin Tavern is a dark fantasy open-world RPG where you can explore vast lands, villages, cities, and dungeons. Uncover rich lore through branching storylines, and forge your path with immersive combat by mastering a variety of weapons, magic, or a mix of both.

4251700.name: Away From Home VN
4251700.short_description: The game is an adult visual novel focusing on MILFs, cheating wives and adultery themes. Play as a college student who travels to a new city for a secret investigation. Meet women and end up getting involved in their lives.

4662090.name: Cyberpix '89
4662090.short_description: Enter a retro-futuristic, music-reactive arcade shooter where every beat shapes the chaos. Adapt, survive, and sync with the rhythm as you fight your way through the underworld.

5332130.name: METRO 2039 Deluxe Edition Upgrade
5332130.short_description:
Complete your METRO 2039 experience with future story expansion DLC and bonus digital content. 

• Story Expansion DLC
• Digital Art Book 
• Digital Soundtrack

4124290.name: Demigod Islands: A Puzzle to Die For
4124290.short_description: Vicious demigods demand sacrifices! Take control of captive creatures, explore mysterious islands and solve 50+ mind-bending puzzles in story mode or 20+ unique levels in two-player online co-op. The twist? To please the demigods and uncover their secrets, you must kill yourselves!

2622460.name: The Skyland Chronicles
2622460.short_description: Embrace the curse as a pirate, growing ever more formidable with each tarot power you seize, even as your humanity slips away like sand through your fingers. A DARK FANTASY PIRATE GAME.

4395870.name: Magical Girl ER
4395870.short_description: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

4434410.name: Sin And Serve
4434410.short_description: A hellish shift-based cooking management sim. Review sinner profiles, craft sin-matched meals, and harvest body parts. Meet Satan's brutal quotas and rise through Hell's ranks, or secretly build trust to help souls escape to Heaven. In this kitchen, mercy is the most dangerous ingredient.

5189980.name: Honey or Else
5189980.short_description: Honey or Else is an incremental game about bees forced to make honey for their bear captors - while secretly plotting to free their Queen. Plant flowers, hire bees and upgrade the hive. Sweet, sticky, cute and quietly rebellious.

4118730.name: The Sinful Nuns: Undelivered Prayers
4118730.short_description: We lived lives of prayer and work at a nunnery on the outskirts of town. It was a peaceful and fulfilling existence, but one day, the nunnery was assaulted by a group of armed men. Our days of work and prayer came to an end, and the sisters were kidnapped. My name is Yuri, and I'm one of them.

4370700.name: Lull: Rest After Crying Demo
4370700.short_description: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

4626180.name: INTERNS
4626180.short_description: Life simulator set among medical interns - make friends, get enemies, get caught up in dangerous intrigues, and dont lose yourself in a world where boundaries blur. Charismatic characters, a tense yet comedic plot, lively dialogue, and a raw atmosphere full of temptation.

5201040.name: SNAPTIC
5201040.short_description: SNAPTIC is a physics-based puzzle-platformer that takes place in an offline laptop, and it's up to you to remember the Wi-Fi password.

5325820.name: Widget Engine
5325820.short_description: Arrange on your desktop any of 900+ live widgets, from clocks and music players to charts, weather and 40+ mini-games, floating above your windows or behind them. Build your own from function blocks with no code, then share to the Steam Workshop.

4426320.name: AikoMate
4426320.short_description: Create and take care of your own AI desktop companion that lives on your screen. Customizable the appearance, high quality voice, and personality. Chat naturally in real time and spend time together through playful interactions, care, and conversations that grow more personal as it gets to know you!

4555310.name: Fenestra: my focus, her future
4555310.short_description: Fenestra awakens inside your PC knowing only her name. Work, study, and create with her in this Princess Maker-inspired raising-sim adventure with focus tools. Your focus time fuels her growth; the stats you raise and words you choose shape her personality, appearance, your bond, and her future.

5099920.name: A Little Faraway
5099920.short_description: Some days, you just need a quiet place to be. Come to a little island far away, where you can wander at your own pace, watch the sky change, and discover little wonders. No rush, no expectations, nothing you need to do. Just a beautiful place to stay awhile.

5271610.name: 電脳スイーパー
5271610.short_description: A top-down action survivor set in cyberspace. Sweep virus swarms, stack explosive builds, and clear sector after sector as a firewall defense program.

1506360.name: Tactful Tactics
1506360.short_description:
Plan and act together! A tactical RPG for 1–6 players. Plan simultaneously, build your loadout, and beat foes as a team.

The free demo currently supports Japanese and English. We are considering additional languages based on interest and feedback from players around the world.

5342610.name: Silent Wounds - The Doll : Soundtrack
5342610.short_description: Dive into the chilling atmosphere of Silent Wounds: The Doll with its official 2 track mini soundtrack. As a free game, purchasing this soundtrack is the best way to directly support the solo developer behind the nightmare!

5454400.name: Potion-Making: Path of the Alchemist Supporter Pack
5454400.short_description: A print-ready Fulcanelli miniature plus two in-game cosmetic bonuses: a crown for your token and a special trailing effect.

5464920.name: VHS Chaos - XXX
5464920.short_description: Step into the adults-only section of your video store! This free DLC adds a new neon-lit room and adult-themed VHS tapes to sort and tidy up!

4354320.name: Crime Empire Idle
4354320.short_description: Build your criminal dynasty in a deep idle/incremental game. Run crimes, launder dirty cash, upgrade your empire, use the black market, craft weapons & gear to fight criminal opponents while you balance heat and notoriety.

5024380.name: 三國撞撞樂
5024380.short_description: A Three Kingdoms roguelite auto-battler. Recruit and upgrade generals, build powerful synergies with cards and equipment, and arrange your formation before your team clashes in automatic battles. Test your builds against other players' teams in asynchronous PvP.

2585710.name: Curiosmos
2585710.short_description: Curiosmos is a whimsical space sim where you shape your own solar system by crafting planets, gravity, atmosphere, and life! Embark on an adventure to discover the secrets of the universe in this charming ode to outer space ✶

2190700.name: Altered Alma
2190700.short_description: Altered Alma combines the beloved classic Metroidvania formula with RPG elements, dating sim features, a slick pixel-art presentation, and a gripping story. Whether you want to beat up bad guys, find love, or just explore the beautiful cyberpunk cityscape, Neo Barcelona awaits!

5027130.name: Naughty Nurse Demo
5027130.short_description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

5166380.name: 缚于邪神低语的少女 TheWhisperingGodBoundGirl Demo
5166380.short_description:
这是一部关于爱与救赎的视觉小说。
被墟神选中的那一刻起，沈暮云就不再是人类了。 
杀不死的身体、脑海中永不停歇的饥饿、随时可能失控伤及无辜的力量——这些足以压垮一个少女的东西，她独自背负了多年。
直到那个秋夜，在一条暗巷里，她遇到了那个隶属“第零部门”、嬉皮笑脸却深不可测的陆长明。 
从互相戒备到彼此依靠，两个异类的生活就此交缠。然而平静之下，信徒的阴谋与墟神的苏醒正一步步逼近……

4788070.name: Naughty Nurse
4788070.short_description: Naughty Nurse is a survival horror game. Medical bills are coming due, and the cost of healthcare has risen. Run through several haunted locations to collect the bills, but be careful. A murderous nurse will try to stop you from escaping, giving you a wide variety of effects.

5260550.name: HavenCraft Demo
5260550.short_description: Build a Safe Haven! An alchemy accident has devastated the mainland and the people are looking for a new home. Take the lead and rebuild society, house by house. HavenCraft is a third-person town builder and management game, playable in single- and multiplayer.

4809960.name: WARDOGS - Supporter Pack
4809960.short_description: WARDOGS Supporter Pack offers additional camos and cosmetic content to players who want to help support the future development of WARDOGS. There will be no further monetization of WARDOGS during Early Access. Thank you for considering purchasing the supporter pack!

4854210.name: In Tenebris Demo
4854210.short_description: Experience echolocation in the demo for In Tenebris, a first-person sci-fi horror game. Sound helps you see your surroundings, but it can also attract enemies. Explore a dark research facility, find your way forward, and decide when to break the silence.

4584240.name: Cheap Car Repair: Welcome to Nowhere
4584240.short_description: Meet the local mechanic from the village of "Bumfuck Nowhere". Run your own car repair shop, hustle and cut corners however you can, but be careful! You probably don't want to get on the bad side of the local businessman, Christopher Kingman...

4661180.name: Coal Duty Demo
4661180.short_description: Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners have reportedly escaped. The state does not confirm this.

4214830.name: Dawn Dew - Realm Heart
4214830.short_description: A realm within a realm, it reveals countless faces to different people. Fiction and reality intertwine here, while the heart of this domain quietly awaits convergence. Embark on a journey of the soul, and discover where a reborn spirit shall go.

4339870.name: Goreagulation
4339870.short_description: Deposited into a labyrinth of flesh and metal, you see things others won't believe, experience horrors beyond ordinary comprehension, and witness impossibilities that drive lesser men mad. Only one directive remains evident in your mind - Ascend the Spire. Destroy the Eye.

4389000.name: 개꿈 Demo
4389000.short_description:
Test your sixth sense.
Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks?
Every choice is yours to make.
May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

4620800.name: Massage With Benefits Demo
4620800.short_description: Step into the role of an exclusive private massage therapist operating right from your own home. When a stunning "Young Wife" arrives seeking relief from her daily aches, it’s your job to provide a touch she’ll never forget. Transition from soothing her muscles to make her yours!

3919420.name: Halls of Torment - Boglands
3919420.short_description: Descend into the Boglands—an eerie new stage crawling with drowned spirits, walking trees, and creeping decay. Unlock two new heroes, dozens of quests, new items, abilities, artifacts, and mechanics like Earth and Decay in this grim expansion to Halls of Torment.

4031420.name: The Floor Above Demo
4031420.short_description: A claustrophobic anomaly-horror game where you can only turn, blink, and decide: is it real or not? Survive five endings and uncover Mike’s story.

4689900.name: Speed Rivals - Model Trains Demo
4689900.short_description: A miniature train delivery game where you drive across the map, pick up wagons generated in different locations, and deliver them to the right destination points as efficiently as possible.

1968750.name: Songs of Conquest - Original Soundtrack
1968750.short_description: The Songs of Conquest soundtrack features a plethora of majestic and atmospheric songs for you to enjoy. Perfect for chilling out while reading a book, or why not use it as a soundtrack for your next role playing or board game session?

2130700.name: For Honor - Kensei Hero Skin- Year 6 Season 3
2130700.short_description: Become a demon hunter and wield the Mamono Dagger with this full body customization for Kensei, Yokai Slayer Meiko.

3918200.name: Dual Fire:Walled City
3918200.short_description: Dual Fire Walled City is a story-driven co-op game for two players. Featuring close friends who grew up together in the Kowloon Walled City, only to be pulled onto vastly different life paths by a twist of fate. Get ready to immerse yourself in a classic Hong Kong-style movie.

1882102.name: For Honor - Hero Skin- Year 6 Season 1
1882102.short_description: Journey back to the Golden Age of Heathmoor with the Hero Skin of Ramiel, a full-body customization of the First Warden. Thousands of years ago, in a time of terrible war, Ramiel made a blood pact with a mythical wyvern in order to secure peace and prosperity for Wyverndale.

1299980.name: CursorFX
1299980.short_description: Create stunning animated Windows mouse cursors for your PC with CursorFX! Easily apply skins, shadows, motion trails, and sounds, customize your own, or choose from one of several unique cursors already installed.

1211673.name: DAEMON X MACHINA - Arsenal - "Rabbit 11"
1211673.short_description:
This set contains the following item for use with DAEMON X MACHINA:

Arsenal - "Rabbit 11"

1039811.name: Enhanced Graphics Pack
1039811.short_description: The Enhanced Graphics Pack increases Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition to ultra-high fidelity resolution. Before you attempt to install, please make sure that your system requirements meet or exceed the minimum specs for this content.

1110730.name: Seek Girl - Patch
1110730.short_description: Relax puzzle games to keep you in a good mood.

4928870.name: Feeding the Foxes
4928870.short_description:
The darkest horror visual novel you'll ever play.
THEY. ARE. HUNGRY.
Will you feed them?

5326120.name: Traitors in Town
5326120.short_description: A chaotic multiplayer social deduction shooter where nobody can be trusted. Identify the traitors, deceive your friends, set deadly traps, and turn every round into a battle of wits, bullets, and betrayal.

5453570.name: Put It Away Please Demo
5453570.short_description: “Some Day”: a standalone day made just for the demo. Put the groceries away exactly as the note says, flip the labels to check the dates, and turn around when you hear footsteps behind you. In the full game: five special days of summer break.

347880.name: Kombat Pack
347880.short_description: Kombat Pack grants early access to 4 upcoming playable characters and skin packs: Jason Voorhees, Predator and 2 MK Characters.

388479.name: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Hungarian Paint Jobs Pack

5454570.name: Feeding the Foxes Demo
5454570.short_description:
The darkest horror visual novel you'll ever play.
THEY. ARE. HUNGRY.
Will you feed them?

4967850.name: Chimpanik
4967850.short_description: Chimpanik is a chaotic PvP party game where your voice is your only weapon! Play as an armless monkey, scream into your microphone to unleash shockwaves, and battle up to 8 other players in randomly generated arenas. Anything can happen!

5287300.name: Quiz Bang!
5287300.short_description: 《Quiz Bang! 》is a first-person party shooter for 2–6 players. On this not-so-safe TV show, answer questions or beat minigames to earn ammo. Take on another challenge, or turn around and shoot your friends? A friendly reminder: watch your back while answering.

5251600.name: Fish on the Floor
5251600.short_description: The kids are coming, the tanks are empty, and the manager is furious! Scoop up scattered sea creatures, toss them into the right tanks, and grow your skills in this first-person aquarium scramble. Bring the exhibits to life before the children arrive.

4525890.name: Kick&Rip
4525890.short_description: A cartoon-style skateboarding game where you link grabs, tricks, and grinds in smooth, flowy lines through colorful environments—easy to pick up, satisfying to master, and punishing if you wipe out!

4977280.name: 岛与利维坦测试The Islet and Leviathan PlayTest

5429990.name: Terminal Drift Demo
5429990.short_description: Hold down the cargo bay! In Terminal Drift, automated defense systems handle the trigger, but survival is entirely in your hands. Adapt your load-out and survive 20 relentless waves, because when the Matriarch breaches the hull, firepower alone won’t save you.

5354810.name: FARLINE
5354810.short_description: Keep a train full of survivors alive as it crosses a wasteland ruled by machine beasts. Build rooms inside each car, care for 16 personality types and their stress, send scouts into the ruins, and see how far you can go before the line breaks.

5427530.name: Secondary Life Missions
5427530.short_description: A chaoooootic co-op where you and your friends are sentenced to community service in the woods. Grab, carry and break things, cross missions off your list, ragdoll through nature, and slap your buddies back to life. You might survive, but your friendship won't.

4878690.name: Don't Pick Up
4878690.short_description: Wanted: a reliable technician who follows the rules, handles sensitive information with discretion, and does not ask questions. Fix the phones. Don't look too closely.

5392540.name: Reel to the Stars - Supporter Pack
5392540.short_description: Support the developer with this cosmetic-only pack for Reel to the Stars! Adds an adorable sea turtle boat and ship, a little captain angler, and a golden fishing rod. It only changes how your boat looks - every stat stays exactly the same.

5095450.name: The Funeral of Kay
5095450.short_description: The Funeral of Kay is a visual novel style adventure game. Exiled noble Jun need to launch a space burial for his guardian Kay who died for protecting him. Guide him to the launch site, and reminisce about memories with Kay.

5434550.name: HOLLOWSIM: Industrial Voidline Defense
5434550.short_description: A retro-styled space strategy and simulation game where you build, defend, and expand an industrial foothold in a hostile sector. Manage ships, structures, resources, and escalating threats as you grow from a fragile station into a resilient operation.

5270560.name: Keycap Keycap! Demo
5270560.short_description: Enjoy the satisfying click of every keycap! Collect a variety of keycaps, upgrade your skills, and acquire powerful Relic Keycaps. Keycap Keycap! is a short and satisfying incremental ASMR game.

2983740.name: Animal Game
2983740.short_description: A 2–4 player rogue-lite party brawler where dying makes you evolve. Pick a cute animal. Grab a weapon. Wreck your friends. The catch? Last place gets the wildest upgrades. No lead is ever safe.

4954110.name: Fifth Sun: New Fire
4954110.short_description: Four suns have already died. Yours is next. A survival crafting adventure through Aztec myth: raise a half-buried temple, wake the legends that sleep at ancient altars, and walk the ruins of the dead suns, alone or with friends.

4922150.name: Dungeon Node
4922150.short_description: Dungeon Node is a pixel-art action RPG where you battle relentless hordes, recruit mercenaries, and choose skill nodes to shape your growth. Journey from the forest to the depths of Hell, facing stronger enemies and new choices as you venture deeper.

4673230.name: Breeze Of Adventure
4673230.short_description: Travel across islands, discover powerful weapons, collect armor, complete quests for the Dawn Guild — forge your own path.

5300250.name: GameGame Demo
5300250.short_description: GameGame is a casual multiplayer collection featuring many classic games as well as some originals.

3281110.name: Crooklock
3281110.short_description: You're in a stolen ship, your turret is stuck in one position, and you have the entire Galactic Federation breathing down your neck. An 80's styled shmup that has you shooting and running from the law across fifty nail-biting stages. Can you beat the odds... and your high score?

2894950.name: 塞莉娅传说
2894950.short_description: A fantasy real-time turn-based dungeon RPG. Play as the Arcane Knight, lead 5 heroes with front/back row tactics & magitech. Explore procedural dungeons, collect billions of gear & rune attributes, make choices at Obelisk Stones, rebuild a lost civilization. Native KB&M, remastered for PC.
developers: 杭州太虚映画科技有限公司
publishers: 杭州太虚映画科技有限公司

4228940.name: Chaotic Dungeon
4228940.short_description: Chaotic Dungeon is a pixel-style side-scrolling action Roguelite game. Players adventure through multiple dungeons with different styles and worldviews, using collected props and items to defeat enemies, solve puzzles, and defeat bosses!

5094930.name: Armory Keeper
5094930.short_description: Restore order to a massive armory solo or with friends in co-op! Find and sort over 3,000 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the armory. Place every item on its correct rack and unlock abilities to organize faster and more efficiently.

1753150.name: MoltKeeper
1753150.short_description: Build a creature from parts and watch it fight. Each win pays samples of the parts your enemies wore, until they are yours to research; the rarest are carried only by wild creatures. Release builds into the Wilds to fight other keepers while you're away. A free creature builder and auto battler.

5419590.name: Potion-Making: Path of the Alchemist Original Soundtrack
5419590.short_description: Nine tracks by Alexander Tavrizyan accompanying your journey through the magical world of Potion-Making: Path of the Alchemist.

5301160.name: Baseline Basketball Manager 27
5301160.short_description: Take control of a professional basketball organization in Baseline Basketball Manager. Build your roster, scout prospects, make trades, manage contracts, set tactics and shape your team’s future in a deep, long-term management simulation.

2145110.name: Knights of Braveland - Supporter Pack
2145110.short_description: This is a collection of bonus content for those who want to further support the developers of Knights of Braveland. It won't radically change your game experience, but it will add new features and possibilities.

1779750.name: The House Before
1779750.short_description:
You wake up as a House. Your bones are pipes and tunnels. Your organs are a labyrinth of caves. 
The House Before is a narrative body horror adventure where you play as a monstrous structure filled with strange creatures.

4380470.name: Rules: Motel Horizon Demo
4380470.short_description: Start your job as a night administrator at the mysterious Horizon Motel, where visitors from another world try to pass as ordinary people, and the rules have the highest priority — breaking them leads to… undesirable consequences.

3753740.name: SpaceFabrica
3753740.short_description: SpaceFabrica is a space game focused on exploration, building, and automation. Discover planets and asteroids, gather resources, build your own bases, and create increasingly large and advanced factories. Explore the vastness of space and expand your industrial empire.

5371940.name: One Must Fall 2197: Singularity
5371940.short_description: A free 1v1 robot fighting game: the 1994 classic One Must Fall 2097, rebuilt in HD. 21 giant robots, 15 arenas, a Tournament career with a mech lab, Arcade, Training, and versus on one PC or online with Steam friends. Fight with supers and EX moves, or switch to the original rules.

5124630.name: Souls of Bombarika Demo
5124630.short_description:
Dead? Check. Superpowers? Check. Absolutely no idea what you're doing? Also check.

Possess everyday objects, outsmart an evil witch, and solve explosive puzzles in this quirky supernatural adventure.

5128940.name: PSYCHO CASKET Demo
5128940.short_description: PSYCHO CASKET is the definitive emo RPG. Play as a vampire and make the ultimate decision- the lives of your friends, or those of the entire world? It's been waiting for you. Yes, YOU.

5159910.name: BORE Demo
5159910.short_description: A survival horror game for 1–4 players. Operate a giant drilling machine. Explore caves, collect valuables, and escape the creatures below. Return to the surface to sell what you found and buy upgrades and equipment. Play solo or in online co-op.

4281330.name: My Eerie Lair Demo
4281330.short_description: A dark cozy ‘Romantasy’ furnishing game where a vampire kidnaps his beloved and tries to win her heart by turning his eerie castle into their dream home.

4389360.name: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog Demo
4389360.short_description: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

4534800.name: Leafy Corner Demo
4534800.short_description: Run a cute little plant shop in this cozy and relaxing game. Grow, sell, and care for a variety of real-life plants, help customers find their dream plants, complete orders, and customize your cozy shop just the way you like!

4014000.name: Mouthwashing - Work In Progress
4014000.short_description: Play our old work-in-progress builds of Mouthwashing. They are really broken and buggy. Good luck.

3787600.name: Bullet Ballet Demo
3787600.short_description: Bullet Ballet is a Wild West action FPS game that follows John Maxwell Goldman, a man searching for answers and his missing father. Set in the unforgiving frontier, this comic book-inspired journey places the fate of a father and son in the hands of the Wild West.

5381120.name: Carpet Daddy Demo
5381120.short_description: Turn filthy carpets into satisfying clean stripes in this free first-person cleaning simulator demo. Play the tutorial and your first mission, with a limited selection of tools and upgrades.

3642240.name: Tactical Annihilation Demo
3642240.short_description: Experience turn-based strategy with free-form base building, multi-unit control, colossal units, and powerful battle skills. It captures the depth of an RTS in turn-based form, like Advanced Wars with massive super units!

4635030.name: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
4635030.short_description: Your own paradise lost. You are now this trains conductor. Venture through a hellish train inspired by organic metal and fight your way to the front driver’s cabin in this Roguelike coin-flip Deckbuilder focusing on rhythmic evasion and precise positioning.

1467450.name: The Chronicles Of Myrtana: Archolos
1467450.short_description: The Kingdom of Myrtana is in a dramatic situation. After the major defeat of the royal fleet in the waters of the Eastern Archipelago, the once thriving city of Archolos stood on the brink of crisis. Meanwhile, a young foreigner goes to the island in search of a new, better life.

5436210.name: Rehab Roulette
5436210.short_description: You are Patient №10375. In this hospital, gambling addiction is treated with a slot machine. Spin the reels, choose upgrades, boost your multipliers, and watch your dopamine levels. Try to escape this strange place.

5395930.name: Hello Triangle: Build a GPU
5395930.short_description: Ever wonder how a GPU draws a triangle? In Hello Triangle, you build one yourself. Wire comparators, adders, and multipliers into graphics hardware, press Run, and watch your circuit draw the screen pixel by pixel—from a single triangle up to a rotating 3D cube.

838900.name: Cereal Soup
838900.short_description: Cereal Soup is an MMO-style animal roleplaying game set in the dangerous and strange world of Primordial. Take the role of a completely unique character that grows as you do. Join a tribe, become skilled, make new friends, and change the world; together, for you are never alone.

635550.name: Nocturnal Hunt
635550.short_description:
Be a wolf in a forest full of cruel hunters and rescue your stolen cub. 
Sneak your way through the gloomy woods or rip your opponents apart. No matter how, find your way to Brasov - the village of the hunters and the core of the evil.
Hunt or you will be hunted!

645840.name: Close Your Eyes - The Twisted Puzzle
645840.short_description: You return to a familiar place... Can you solve the puzzle?

4600800.name: Astral Echelons
4600800.short_description: Shoot holes through enemy ships from your seat at the controls of a multi-gunned turret mounted on the bow of a dimension hopping spaceship in this seated VR on-rails spaceship turret shooter!

450470.name: Red Risk (Soundtrack)
450470.short_description: The original soundtrack of the game Red Risk, produced by Igo Carminatti.

4578610.name: OUTPERFORM
4578610.short_description: Wall Street satire meets bullet heaven. Play as The Degen, Bagholder, MLM Hun and nine more meme traders, mow down swarms of red candles, and draft carefully: the upgrades you pass arm the Whale, Pump and Dump and the other bosses waiting for you.

4095120.name: Chaos Company🔥
4095120.short_description: Third-person 2.5D action roguelike where mercenaries fight undeads, monsters, and heretics for money. Take deadly contracts, survive brutal combat, collect loot, and grow stronger with every run.

2570200.name: MedCom Origin
2570200.short_description:
MedCom Origin is a story about russian city in which the pathogen outbreak occurred. PMCs shoot people right on the streets of the city, parks and squares are turned into warehouses for corpses
Welcome to the city, welcome to the hell.

4502760.name: Beeline
4502760.short_description: Slash and dash through tens of thousands of enemies per run in this action roguelite. Call in the hive for support, wield up to five weapons, evolve devastating builds, and combine powerful abilities. Rescue unique bees, build your Hive, and restore your bee kingdom to survive the forces of nature.

3166920.name: Tears Apart
3166920.short_description: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built on five consecutive dash attacks called Tears. Equip upgrades to the Tears you choose, master your combat cycle, and carve through the Decay.

4702040.name: Dear President
4702040.short_description: Ruling a country is easy; surviving is the hard part. Use your stamp to balance the state's four main powers, manage bizarre crises, and avoid assassinations. Every death is a new beginning. Upgrade your skills, sit back at the desk, and try not to get hit by a rock. Permission to panic: Granted.

4070510.name: Luminids
4070510.short_description: A cozy colony-building sandbox you can step inside. Shape the land, build homes and grow food for little creatures with lives of their own. Plan from above, then switch to first person to explore your settlement and the world beyond.

5132810.name: Sector Zero: Freedom
5132810.short_description: A sci-fi incremental simulation where you work as an Imperial slave, build your own business, survive inspections, join unions, and buy your freedom.

5364000.name: Needle: The 1% Challenge
5364000.short_description: Find the needle. One needle is hidden somewhere in a haystack of one million straws. Dig through the pile by hand, feed the hay to the machine, upgrade your tools and search with a metal detector. No automation. No shortcuts. 99% will give up before they find it. Will you?

5309430.name: Time O'clock: The Mask of Crime Demo
5309430.short_description:
The mask of a legendary thief has been stolen. Follow Detective Time in a point-and-click investigation using her watch to witness key moments and uncover who is behind this new wave of robberies. 
Observe the past. Investigate the present. Uncover the truth.

5191700.name: Proppy
5191700.short_description: Sent into the past to preserve video game history, an alien must hide beneath the appearance of a Proppy, survive among the Proppys, and recover consoles and games scattered across a world fractured by time and dimensions.

1111910.name: ODEZIE
1111910.short_description: Found your own rail company and run passenger services on Germany's real railway network: route trains over real tracks, build regular-interval timetables, plan train rotations and crew rosters – and watch every track-access fee hit your balance. Germany is playable at launch.

5388420.name: Jane Doe: Cold Case Division
5388420.short_description: An asymmetric co-op deduction game where you solve cold cases through communication. One player investigates, while the other plays the forensic artist reconstructing the victim's face. Features lite roguelite progression.

5176390.name: Sticky Floors
5176390.short_description: A bartender sim roguelite. Ditch the corporate grind and run the family dive bar. Pour, mix, slide and serve the townsfolk and a few stranger 'patrons' while cards, dice, & patron rewrite the rules every night. Survive 30 nights to earn the deed. Pickled eggs, cats, vomit, and attitude. Enough said.

4783980.name: GUNBOAT-8
4783980.short_description: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.

5213390.name: GUNBOAT-8 Demo
5213390.short_description: Command the ultimate vessel in this 1-4 player fast-paced naval bullet-heaven roguelike! Blast through enemy fleets, collect powerful upgrades, and combine devastating synergies to create wildly overpowered builds before the waves overwhelm you.

5419730.name: Germline
5419730.short_description: Raise 60 species from a single cell to adulthood in a single-player idle game. Build connected organs, automate growth, hunt rare colour morphs and crossbreed your favourites. Expand into habitats and universes, then reset reality for lasting upgrades.

5168190.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle Demo
5168190.short_description: Build routes, solve the first 10 Puzzle levels, and read your rival in hidden-block battles. Play 5 Classic games and 3 Battle matches.

5409440.name: Lucky Anvil
5409440.short_description: a roguelite where your whole run is one weapon. throw crafting orbs at it, clamp the lines you like and reroll the rest, then strike and watch the number roll up. every orb that rolls shows its odds and every boss shows its next move

5299660.name: Arks of Twilight
5299660.short_description: Build a warband of fairy-tale creatures in a single-player auto battler. Choose your Guide, recruit and merge cards, then arrange your formation to face seven rivals. Discover 20 factions and 300 creatures, with automatic battles and decisions between every duel.

3771980.name: Androfoco
3771980.short_description: An FPS with SHOOTING COMBAT! Shooting your enemies a few times will not do! You must hit them with everything you've got so that they can never make it back to the stage. That is where the big money is!

4920300.name: Couch Pirates
4920300.short_description: Couch Pirates! is an easy to play local Wi-Fi party game that allows anyone to play using their phone or gamepad! Chose among four mini-games to battle it out on one desert island. The game is endless, and people may join and leave as they please throughout the evening.

5144960.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
5144960.short_description: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

5075540.name: In that case...
5075540.short_description: Open loot cases, pray for rare drops, and pay off a massive debt before a descending ceiling of spikes crushes you. A first-person gambling roguelike about luck, greed, and survival.

4663730.name: How Empires Work
4663730.short_description:
An incremental grand strategy game about building the machinery of empire. Tax, trade, conquer, and civilise subjects and foreigners alike. Automate it all into institutions that run themselves across centuries of history.
Her Imperial Majesty expects results.

3470500.name: Ember and Blade
3470500.short_description: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

4159350.name: a Dogs Dream
4159350.short_description:
Test your sixth sense.
Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks?
Every choice is yours to make.
May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

3479960.name: The Questness - Light of Ra Demo

2872620.name: Stellarcraft The Prologue
2872620.short_description: Stellarcraft is a thrilling sci-fi tower defense game where you explore planets, gather resources, and fend off enemy threats—solo or in 4-player co-op. Play the free demo now! 🚀

4572120.name: Dirt Clicker
4572120.short_description: Start with a spoon and a dream. Dig up treasures, unlock upgrades, hire adorable helpers and discover the secrets hidden beneath the dirt.

5408210.name: Amiss
5408210.short_description: Amiss is a first-person anomaly-hunting horror set in an endless Soviet apartment block. Spot something wrong? Return to your elevator. All normal? Move on to the next. Make no mistakes, and you only go up. How long can you trust your eyes?

5395880.name: Beeline Demo
5395880.short_description: Slash and dash through tens of thousands of enemies per run in this action roguelite. Call in the hive for support, wield up to five weapons, evolve devastating builds, and combine powerful abilities. Rescue unique bees, build your Hive, and restore your bee kingdom to survive the forces of nature.

5393420.name: Elya
5393420.short_description: Raise a desktop companion in a cozy single-player pet game. Chat, build your bond, collect memories, and customize her with characters, skins, animations, and Workshop creations.

2890810.name: Neon Grid Defenders
2890810.short_description: Neon Grid Defenders is a sci-fi roguelite tower defense game featuring a free and unique upgrade system, decision based path generation and a strong but static difficulty curve. Build your path, place your towers, hook them up with upgrades and melt your enemies!

2808870.name: No Dead Ends
2808870.short_description: You died. Congratulations! Now you’re at the No Dead Ends Bar, and the Barman owns your soul. The price for freedom? $1,000,000. Gamble with the deceased, beat their games, and buy back your soul!

4040750.name: Paradoxical
4040750.short_description: Portals are physical objects. In this mind-bending puzzle game, portals can be carried, repositioned, and used to create impossible connections through space. Uncover the fate of a desert world that sought salvation through portal technology.

4945700.name: Pluck Em! Demo
4945700.short_description: Hunt birds in the Farm biome, master your weapon, and climb the online leaderboard. The demo offers a first look at Pluck Em!’s fast-paced arcade action, with additional biomes, weapons, upgrades, and features available to preview in the menus.

4859830.name: Pluck Em!
4859830.short_description: Fight off annoying feathered pests in this addictive arcade shooter inspired by the classics of the 8- and 16-bit era. Explore strange biomes, discover bizarre bird species, earn medals, upgrade your gear and uncover secrets that are probably better left undiscovered.

4091520.name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence – Digital Artbook
4091520.short_description: 34 page digital artbook with concept art, characters, environments, and behind-the-scenes visuals from Ayasa: Shadows of Silence.

4091500.name: Ayasa: Shadows of Silence Soundtrack
4091500.short_description: A dark, emotional soundtrack inspired by Armenian spiritual heritage and Komitas. Haunting choirs, violin, violoncello, and vocals guide you through Ayasa’s journey across six symbolic lands of hope, love, faith, indifference, greed, and betrayal.

5169220.name: Campsite
5169220.short_description: Warm nights in the evergreen forest, the peace and quiet, the gentle flicker of fire. Too quiet, almost unnatural. Something sinister lurks in the dark. It's faster than you, it's smarter than you, and it wants you out of it's forest. Your only hope to keep the flames from hollowing. Good luck.

5238230.name: Neboslav Demo
5238230.short_description: Fly through a strange dream where you fight, destroy, complete questionable quests, and collect items to become absurdly powerful... and maybe uncover what it all means.

5491580.name: Oink & Coin
5491580.short_description: Smash a mountain of a million piggy banks with up to 3 friends. Pick locks, crack safes and drill bolts to open every piggy, haul them by wheelbarrow, build a piggy factory, then break your way down a seven-floor pit to the gold floor.

4727120.name: 无效化 Demo
4727120.short_description: Winnia is the only child in the sanatorium, spending her days lost in adventurous fantasies. Dr. Kai is a cold, meticulous physician who treats patients and diagnoses difficult cases. Innocent imagination and clinical rationality travel different tracks, yet quietly shape each other.

2591230.name: MEAT-GRINDER
2591230.short_description:
Have a human MEATGRINDER with Obi the freelance hitman! 
Fulfill contracts all over the planet, open a beer, turn off your brain: it's time to kill and solve the financial problems of Obi and her peculiar family!

5362520.name: FortFall
5362520.short_description: Build your defenses. Choose your class. Hold the Core. FortFall is a third-person fantasy defense game for solo play or private online co-op with up to five players. Raise walls, repair the damage, and fight escalating waves with melee weapons, bows, spells, and sentries.

5081180.name: Last Train Temptation
5081180.short_description: Last Train Temptation is an adult visual novel about Max and Yuna, whose seven meetings in an almost empty train car turn shy glances into intimate encounters. Make choices, exchange messages, play varied mini-games, and unlock detailed erotic CGs.

5070300.name: Sveta
5070300.short_description: Sveta is a satirical single player narrative adventure set in the contemporary Serbian city of Novi Sad.

3485200.name: Whatever It Takes
3485200.short_description: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes.

4258790.name: The Gardener
4258790.short_description: Solve over 150 tile based lawn puzzles. Explore the grounds of a forgotten manor. Discover mysterious flora and figure out their rules. Cut grass and have fun!

3156050.name: Special Case
3156050.short_description: Fight the Occupation Forces with Unique Super Powers! Destroy Helicopters, Drones, and Armored Vehicles. Explore "The Strip," protect its people, and rebuild a war-torn world. Welcome to Special Case

2599210.name: BattleSide
2599210.short_description: BattleSide is a 5,000 player MMOFPS persistent Land, Sea, Air, and Space war game where you and your buddies defend and capture control points to gather resources for your faction in battles of endless fun.

5325790.name: Don't Blow UP!
5325790.short_description: Don't Blow UP! brings minesweeper into first person, solo or in co-op for up to 4 players. Dig up tiles, flag mines, and face seven rule-twisting modifiers. One wrong choice can blow everything up.

5400520.name: Our Little Cinema Demo
5400520.short_description: A cozy 2D job sim where you run the ticket booth of a small-town cinema! Play through the first 3 days, take orders on your tablet, seat customers by their traits, handle cash and card payments, restock snacks, and choose which movies play tomorrow. Keep your guests happy and earn those tips! 🎬🍿💕

4943770.name: SAND CRUISER
4943770.short_description: Sand Cruiser is a colony sim in which the colony drives and fights. Your settlement is a land cruiser crossing a dead desert under a red giant sun. Rebuild it deck by deck, keep its crew alive and drill deep, while a blind swarm under the sand reacts to the noise and heat you make.

4444500.name: FUTAHAMMER
4444500.short_description: In the grim darkness of the far future, the girls pack their own heavy artillery. A sci-fi parody arcade breaker where you smash heretical blocks to unlock explicit, uncensored futanari scenes. No diplomacy, no dialogue—just heavy metal physics and massive payloads.

4305930.name: Salmon City Preview
4305930.short_description: Shady deals, intense shootouts and trying to make an honest living. Welcome to Salmon City - a chaotic multiplayer roleplaying experience where every round is a fresh start, every stranger has private agendas and every decision has consequences. Play your role in the twisted theatre of it all.

4978350.name: Core Logistics
4978350.short_description: Core Logistics is a management sim about growing a transport company from a single van into a network across the whole map. Choose which contracts to take, match the right trucks and licenses to each load, and chain jobs together to cut empty driving. When you need to think, hit pause.

4824610.name: Resident Evil Veronica
4824610.short_description:
Resident Evil Veronica is a remake of 2000's Resident Evil Code: Veronica.

In 2027, madness and intrigue, love and hate all combine to create a chilling new entry in survival horror.

2905380.name: The Smashist
2905380.short_description:
A hundred fascist pigs and one revolutionary enter a bar. They form a punch line.
The Smashist is a first-person brawler set in a 1950's tavern with an army of fascist soldiers at the door. Order your drinks, crack your knuckles and beat down every fascist pig that enters the tavern - or die trying.

5340610.name: 16 Bit Gold Demo
5340610.short_description: Build a cozy gold mining business from the ground up. Find as much gold as you can and transform an overgrown plot of land into a thriving mining operation - one gold bar at a time.

5073630.name: Backrooms: Misstep
5073630.short_description: Backrooms: Misstep is a first-person psychological horror game. Explore unsettling liminal levels, complete unique objectives, survive deadly entities, and uncover a path through environments where every wrong turn could be your last.

3229710.name: Hardtrace
3229710.short_description: Hardtrace is a couch‑vs‑couch party game for 12+ players on a single screen. Win by skillfully maneuvering through point‑packed zones or by letting a greedier player do the risky work for you. Use your personal portals to jump across the arena in a fraction of a second.

3398160.name: SUPER DEBT
3398160.short_description: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

4578740.name: Remain Seated
4578740.short_description: you've fallen into an abandoned hospital and have become wheelchair-bound. With limited mobility You must use your resources to find yourself a way out while avoiding any dangers that may lurk within.

3398240.name: SUPER DEBT Demo
3398240.short_description: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

5462220.name: Feudmaker
5462220.short_description: A free-to-play 5v5 MOBA on a fault line that changes as you fight. Fords open and close with day and night, and new paths tear open mid-match. Pick from 34 heroes, then build your own maps, modes and heroes in the same editor Feudmaker was made with.

4576830.name: BUSINGO
4576830.short_description: 1-4 player co-op survival game set entirely on a moving bus. Drive, repair, and defend your vehicle from a pursuing cartel while navigating an infinite, procedurally generated desert.

5461920.name: VULTURE Demo
5461920.short_description: VULTURE is a 4-player co-op horror extraction FPS. Explore abandoned facilities, recover valuable resources, complete objectives, and survive creatures hunting your team. Work together, use specialized roles, and extract before you lose everything.

4657930.name: Dwarven Shift 98
4657930.short_description: Dwarven Shift 98 is an incremental mining game in short timed shifts. Break rock walls layer by layer, each richer than the last, and fill the screen with an explosion of ore and gems.

4831830.name: Toey Weedz Smoke Dead Halloween
4831830.short_description: The single-player Halloween special edition of the beloved long-nosed retro stoner, Toey Weedz! Save the famous rapping cow from her doom, defeat the witch, and experience 9 levels of pure retro FPS madness built on solid shooter gameplay.

5373070.name: Dot Dodge
5373070.short_description: The name is self explanatory: you have to dodge the dots (and every other thing in the game). Dot Dodge is a minimalist music bullet hell where you move your mouse to avoid various hazards.

5417970.name: ConsoleMouse
5417970.short_description: Play GTA 6 in 4K and 120 fps with mouse and keyboard or controller. For PS5 and Xbox, on Windows, macOS and Linux. TV Play and PC Play. GTA VI works from day one. ConsoleMouse ships with a GTA VI profile for PS5 and Xbox. The tuned profile is added on 19 November.

5308360.name: Gestalt Journey
5308360.short_description: An incremental game (a clicker) where everything keeps growing while you decide where to put your resources. And a history lesson: as you play, you learn the real story of Gestalt therapy — its people, theories, books and organisations.

4254050.name: Retroneer
4254050.short_description: You are the Retroneer. Craft circuits, optimise your designs and uncover the secrets at the heart of Amplitude. Combine game-changing Trinkets, powerful Modules, and your own problem-solving skills to generate explosive results in this approachable and deep roguelike resource management game.

5184010.name: Multiplayer Animals Demo
5184010.short_description: A turn-based PVP strategy game. Eliminate all enemy animals before they eliminate yours. Fire bazookas, launch airstrikes, destroy (and construct) terrain, or knock your enemies off the map entirely with a well-placed swing of a baseball bat.

5487520.name: TITANIC PINBALL MAIDEN VOYAGE
5487520.short_description: All aboard **TITANIC PINBALL MAIDEN VOYAGE**! Race through the Grand Staircase, fire up the engines, smash targets, hit sweeping ramps and survive the iceberg in a lavish 1912 ocean-liner pinball spectacle packed with spinners, bumpers, kickbacks and multiball.

4533230.name: Farmed & Dangerous
4533230.short_description: Not another farming game. Plant by night, then defend your crops from dawn to dusk in a first-person roguelite shooter, solo or in 3-player online co-op. Blast crop-hungry crows out of the sky with shotguns, turrets, air strikes and the occasional RPG. Miss the truck's order and the run is over.

4956380.name: The Lighthouse Restaurant
4956380.short_description: The Lighthouse Restaurant is a first-person psychological horror game set in a unique dining spot. Listen to your guests' stories, decide what they eat, shape their fates, and unearth the truth behind your own story.

4717170.name: Renegades
4717170.short_description: Renegades is a party RPG with deckbuilding combat: lead five heroes, each with unique mechanics and their own deck, choose three for each fight, and survive a kingdom coming apart through tactical, story-driven battles. Deep character development in multiple tracks leads to high customization.

5003880.name: IRON EDEN
5003880.short_description: Iron Eden blends Roguelite progression, Loot Shooter mechanics, and deep Mech Customization into a unique experience where every run shapes your machine and your strategy.

5458370.name: Rin: Always By Your Side
5458370.short_description: Rin lives on your desktop, right over your wallpaper. Talk to her by text or voice and she answers with her own voice and expressions. A local AI model is bundled, so you can chat for free and offline. On tiring days or for idle small talk, she's always by your side.

4539670.name: Sudoku Studio Demo
4539670.short_description: Try all 36 Sudoku variants in Sudoku Studio Demo: two puzzles per difficulty (Easy–Hard), Daily and Weekly challenges, tutorials, Practice Mode, and the full assist tools, including custom colors and PDF printing. Progress carries over to the full version.

5061100.name: Smiley Steel
5061100.short_description: Enter Smiley Steel Factory, explore a hidden underground circus beneath Nexora, solve mysteries, and uncover the truth behind an experiment that should have never begun

5406740.name: Corner Cutters
5406740.short_description: Top-down racing with real racecraft. Brake late, look after your tyres, call your pit stop and hold off a field of twenty in the rain. Race open-wheelers, GT cars and one very small roadster on eleven circuits, run a championship of your own, or race friends online.

5442200.name: Pizzarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Shop
5442200.short_description: Pizzarian: Tidy Up the Arcane Shop is a relaxing single-player simulation where your task is to organize 4,000 scattered pizzas and place them neatly on the shelves. Sort, tidy up, and bring order to the arcane shop to achieve perfect organization.

5134290.name: Vox Populi II: 2026-2029
5134290.short_description: Create or choose a character with a fully customizable ideology, campaign in elections across numerous countries, then take control of Parliament and the government to lead your nation as you see fit! Your own objectives will determine your victory conditions!

4962570.name: RADZIMA Demo
4962570.short_description: RADZIMA is a 1-4 player co-op survival horror set in an underground research facility. Find radioactive items, avoid the mutants, and power the elevator reactor to descend deeper - all in service of the Party’s will.

5327990.name: Pro Soccer Management 27
5327990.short_description: Take full control of a football club. Shape tactics, transfers, youth development, staff, finances, facilities, and stadium growth—or risk everything in the underground. Create your own football universe with datapacks, mods, and Steam Workshop.

4828600.name: glitch.exe
4828600.short_description: glitch.exe is a free-to-play hacking horror game where you infiltrate corrupted systems, uncover hidden secrets and piece together a story that was never meant to be found. Explore a unsettling digital world full of mystery, tension and things that should not exist.

5456690.name: Wabi Is Late
5456690.short_description: Wabi is late, and your job is to help her be on time! Every movement matters, so find the optimal route and reach the goal before the timer runs out!

5191690.name: The Undead Lawyer Demo
5191690.short_description: The demo of the hyper-movement action puzzle game where you speed through half of half the game - saving the souls of the damned, reviving them and executing them in specific ways decreed by the gods as fast as you can!

4483750.name: Miguel
4483750.short_description: Help Miguel defend the forest from a mysterious invasion! Use magical mushroom cards to fight back, each with unique art and effects. Build your deck, discover powerful combos, and unlock new cards every run. Fail, get stronger, and try again. Let your mushrooms spread!

5235430.name: Esport Manager: Last Pick
5235430.short_description: Behind every win, a decision. Sign your players, train them, prepare your game plans. Then watch your five players carry them out their own way, because a creative player never plays like a cautious one.

5474930.name: Paladin HC Demo
5474930.short_description: Bu demo, iki kişilik bağımsız ekibimizin tutkuyla geliştirdiği PALADIN HC'nin ilk açık deneyimidir. Oyun esnasındaki hislerini, karşılaştığın hataları ve önerilerini bizimle Steam Topluluk Merkezi üzerinden paylaşmaktan çekinme.

5366950.name: Cravecrops - Farming Defense Demo
5366950.short_description: Grow suspicious experimental plants by day and defend your plantation from hordes of addicted animals by night. Sell your harvest, upgrade your defenses, and expand your operation in this farming defense roguelite.

3110460.name: Verho - Curse of Faces Demo
3110460.short_description:
Verho, a Dark RPG following the tradition of the King’s Field series, takes place after the catastrophic Era of Solitude. Travel to the land of Yariv, find the source of this scourge and face its dangers.
The Demo takes around 4-5h to beat.

2686600.name: Throneheart: Rise of a Dynasty
2686600.short_description: You're the king, and one day you'll die. Throneheart is a medieval dynasty city builder where nothing comes from nothing: your people farm, bake, eat, buy and sell, and every loaf is carried by hand. Turn an empty plot into a realm. Without an heir, it ends. Happy people grow it; angry ones revolt.

4955120.name: Hexa-Gone
4955120.short_description: Pieces are falling, and you need to do something about it! Match like colors together to clear them, and if you make a shape, you’ll earn some points. Points are your score in Singleplayer modes, and are used as a currency in Multiplayer modes. Use them to buy Power-Ups and make a comeback!

4001230.name: In My Orbit
4001230.short_description: Studio Reignbow presents, a chat-sim style otome visual novel. Abandoned in space, all hope seems lost until you receive a strange signal... which installs a dating app onto your computer of all things!? You finally have someone to talk to, maybe you won't die alone and a virgin in space after all!

5225970.name: NSFW Solitaire - Furry Femboy 2
5225970.short_description: 1070 pictures and 20 card sets with erotic furry femboys for NSFW Solitaire

5271220.name: Ungradable: Twisted Card Grading
5271220.short_description: Ungradable is a horror simulation game where the player takes on the role of a card grader at a shady grading company. Use tools to inspect cards for anomalies, seal away their power, survive another shift, and find a way to escape this vicious job.

5404590.name: Toast Flipper
5404590.short_description: Save your family as "Thoasten"! Drag, aim, and flip: In this brutally hard 2D physics platformer, you fling yourself golf-style through a dangerous kitchen, defeat evil bread bosses, and chase the ultimate best time on the global speedrun leaderboard.

3173780.name: Toadled: Eating Frenzy
3173780.short_description: Toadled: Eating Frenzy is an action roguelike with an appetite! Play as a toad and eat everything on your path to grow bigger and mutate into new, disgusting forms. Consuming human flesh? Fair game. Police cars, tanks, missiles? Mild indigestion. Try out hundreds of appetizing build combinations!

2772700.name: OrbGuard
2772700.short_description: Defend Earth against waves of deadly cosmic threats determined to destroy your civilization! In this Rogue-Lite Auto Shooter, you’ll place Celestial bodies and upgrade them to unleash chaos on your enemies. How long will you survive?

3612160.name: Ashen Dungeon
3612160.short_description:
In a world where hope has vanished, lead your expedition and survive to the very end.
Recruit your team, explore the dungeons, and secure resources to build the foundation for survival.
[Expedition Management | Dungeon Exploration | Resource Gathering&Management | Turn-Based Combat | Dice System]

5261980.name: Tourbillon
5261980.short_description: They stole your horse, so you'll seek revenge... on bike! Drift, jump, dodge and rush in this mini futuristic medieval boss-rush game with an original rotation-based physics system! The faster you are, the more damage you deal... and there's no speed limit!

5360050.name: Carnival: Tidy Up!
5360050.short_description: Carnival: Tidy Up! is a cozy fairground restoration sim. Recycle 75,928 pieces of junk, hunt down missing parts, and repair the attractions. Bring the amusement park back to its former glory, then sit back and enjoy the rides!

4926600.name: Steps To The Stars
4926600.short_description: A single player puzzle game following the journey of two stars as they climb to return to the constellation from which they have fallen.

3489340.name: ReBlade: The Death Spiral
3489340.short_description: You are a condemned Synthetic, marked for destruction and trapped in endless resets. In a cyberpunk world inspired by Chinese mythology, harness weapons, chips, and augments to cut through mechanical creatures. Each run brings you closer to breaking the cycle and unravelling the truth.

3672240.name: DEAD or LUCKY: Game of Hearts
3672240.short_description: Two guys will have to cheat, risk their lives, and somehow get along with each other so they don't lose their organs at the casino.

4029090.name: Rizz Dungeon: Skeleton Key to My Heart
4029090.short_description: Fighting is hard, right? Let your party do it for you! Romance Monster Girls and traverse the Dungeon! Hopefully they'll all get along... right?

5463860.name: For We Are Many
5463860.short_description: You are humanity's last line of defense. Build your towers, bring down devastating firepower, and fight on the front lines to protect the seals from the endless hordes of Hell. If they fall, so do Heaven and Earth. Alone or with up to three friends.

5479950.name: Thieves and Gold - Supporter Pack
5479950.short_description: Turn your thief's tools to gold. A small cosmetic pack for players who want to support Thieves and Gold: a gold hammer, gold bombs with a gold explosion and trail, and matching gold HUD icons. Cosmetic only, with no effect on gameplay.

2419910.name: Apartament 1406: Horror Demo
2419910.short_description: Apartment 1406 is an intense horror game, that challenges you to constantly survive in a hostile environment. Collect items to survive against limited ammo and creatures that lurk in the dark. Solve the puzzles and survive in this dark game.

3970690.name: Project Shadowglass
3970690.short_description: A stealth-focused immersive sim set within a dark fantasy kingdom. Plan daring heists, infiltrate forbidden locales, and escape with priceless artifacts. Features revolutionary 3D pixel art graphics and lasting consequences where every action could leave a trail back to you.

4957340.name: Bet on Beta
4957340.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder where you run a tech company, but every sprint is decided on a slot machine. Hire coworker cards for your deck, staff them on the machine, and spin for tickets, epics, and OKRs. From garage startup to IPO.

4985040.name: Symbiosis: Criticality
4985040.short_description: Start with a click. Collect the bits. Build a machine that does the work for you. Grow a reactor full of drones, beams, and automated machinery. Upgrade your firepower and keep collection moving as the screen fills with activity.

5094460.name: Buildot
5094460.short_description: Help Buildot save the world of Godot from the tyranny of the Unreal Union! Solve clever puzzles using diodes, logic gates, and conveyor belts. Beware of slippery surfaces and ice, where a single move can change everything. Full version planned to include 100 levels plus extra challenges!

5137820.name: Pickup Point Chaos
5137820.short_description: Run your own pickup point! Receive, scan, sort, and shelve packages. Find customer pickups, then weigh and label outgoing shipments. Carry several boxes to save time, but customers may knock them down. Handle package rain, fragile items, and explosives—and don’t blow up the place!

5292570.name: Cosmic Dominion
5292570.short_description: Fly your flagship in fast 2D dogfights, then win the galaxy world by world: settle ruins, buy neutral markets, breach and board enemy planets. A guided tutorial, a ten-level campaign, endless scenarios and 13 factions that each fight their own way.

5227650.name: Ration Me Tender
5227650.short_description: An adult romance visual novel set at a coastal desalination plant during a supply crisis. Follow production director Nizar Sabhan through three distinct romance routes as work, marriage, and responsibility collide behind the fence at Ras Mishaal.

5408960.name: Save To Kill
5408960.short_description:
Save to Kill delivers a unique blend of bullet hell and resource management. 

Experience rewarding character progression with permanent upgrades, challenging Hardcore, Enhanced, and Endless Modes.  Featuring tons of unlockables.

3441070.name: HorrorCore Demo
3441070.short_description: Dive into the dark, claustrophobic world of HorrorCore: Maze and Pools of Horror with the free DEMO!

5396420.name: NAME ME IF YOU CAN
5396420.short_description: Read their name. Write it down. Take them out. NAME ME IF YOU CAN is a first-person multiplayer party game where your name is your weakness. Hunt your friends, hide your name tag, and use sneaky gadgets to turn a close call into a last-second comeback.

1887030.name: Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Mega Mix+ Extra Song Pack
1887030.short_description: Adds 72 playable songs from Project DIVA: Future Tone to your game for a total of 250 songs.

4434910.name: HollowCity:EscapeFromSeoul
4434910.short_description: 'HollowCity' is a PvE top-down extraction shooter set in a ruined city. Solo or with up to 4 players, you must explore various zones and gather survival supplies. Hostile humans aren't the only threats to your life. Fight through monsters born from unknown causes and escape safely.

4953360.name: Excuse Me, King!
4953360.short_description: Explain yourself! Improvise an excuse out loud for an embarrassing accusation, sneak in word cards like "butter" and "school lunch", and let your friends rate it from 1 to 5 stars. A party game for 2 to 8 players, on one PC or online with your own voice chat.

4983370.name: FROG IN THE HOLE!
4983370.short_description: Breed frogs, throw them into the hole and get paid. In this incremental sandbox, you'll build physics-based factories, to scale from manual tossing to managing up to 100,000 physics frogs. Master the skill tree and chain combos. What happens to the frogs? BECOME WORTHY.

3204820.name: RippleLoop
3204820.short_description: Skip stones as far as you can in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the ultimate stone skipper.

3545460.name: Single Forever
3545460.short_description:
"This is not a dating sim."

You play as Red, an intern Cupid on the verge of losing both your job and your life. Your mission? Help Lia, a 29-year-old romance rookie, find her first love. Can you survive this near-impossible challenge?

4733590.name: 極上人妻在我身邊
4733590.short_description: Just being invited is enough to enter. Legal access to homes and surveillance control──your privileges as "Veil" building's maintenance technician. Among residents, that gentle, lonely married woman is exactly your type, while other women here are showing interest in you too...

4454620.name: Dot Art Logic Demo
4454620.short_description: Enjoy simple Nonogram (Picross) puzzles! This demo features 1,400+ B&W and Color puzzles. Perfect for steady progress during 5-10 minute breaks.

1905750.name: Hatsune Miku: Project DIVA Mega Mix+ Item Unlock Key
1905750.short_description: The Item Unlock Key maxes out your Diva Points and instantly unlocks all in-game customizations including costumes, hairstyles, and accessories.

4859890.name: Beyond the Masque of the Red Death
4859890.short_description: Explore a gothic, macabre environment and find objects of symbolic significance, in this text-based adventure game inspired by "The Masque of the Red Death" by Edgar Allan Poe. Interact by typing your intentions in text, in an authentically written story that goes Beyond where the original one ends.

3244530.name: Shards Of Armor
3244530.short_description: The stars are yours to explore. Master tactical space combat, trade across distant worlds, and forge your own path through a vast, unforgiving galaxy. Inspired by the spirit of legendary space classics.

4133530.name: Match Morphosis Demo
