4133530.short_description: A challenging roguelike match-3 deckbuilder inspired by Kamen Rider. Combine the strategic effects of your pieces and master your insectoid kaijin form to unleash satisfying infinite combos!

4168160.name: Dajimo Arena: Team Showdown
4168160.short_description:
“Your color is your shelter—until it isn’t.”
Color-swapping 4-team arena FPS where death makes you a drone with power—reshape the map, protect your body, and dive back into the fight. Free. Fast. Chaotic. Powered by GONet.

4986750.name: Sabado
4986750.short_description: Reunite with your favorite classmate, but you can never really graduate from the past... Wander through a nostalgic, shifting maze of old high school memories with a cheerful friend named Chesa. But the exits are vanishing, the hallways are warping, and a silent observer is tracking your every step.

4131100.name: Match Morphosis: Match-3 Roguelike
4131100.short_description: A challenging roguelike match-3 deckbuilder inspired by Kamen Rider. Combine the strategic effects of your pieces and master your insectoid kaijin form to unleash satisfying infinite combos!

4419240.name: Under the Heavens: Warring States Saga
4419240.short_description: A choice-driven narrative RPG set in China’s Warring States period. Rise from a nameless soldier to a legendary general through decisions with permanent consequences. Death is final. History remembers only the survivors.

5195340.name: The 12 CZ: Final Battle
5195340.short_description: All The End and his followers were repelled but fled to the wilds to hide and plague the land. So the CZs united, ventured into enemy territory, slaying demons, collecting artifacts, and fighting together to grow stronger until All The End's utter defeat.

3157380.name: Vagabones
3157380.short_description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

3595730.name: Devil Meat
3595730.short_description: Feed demon flesh to the fanatical saint and guide her to ascension. 『Devil Meat』 is a multi-ending roguelite adventure that demands efficient hunting and growth strategies. What she will become—and whether you will survive—is entirely up to you.

3722130.name: Indigo Park - Chapter 2
3722130.short_description: Your adventure in Indigo Park is only beginning! Now that Rambley has informally hired you on to the company's staff, you'll use your new Rookie Rangler status to explore and repair Oceanic Odyssey, one of the newer additions to the park. Featuring exciting new characters, environments, and story!

4394460.name: Vagabones Demo
4394460.short_description: Vagabones is a class-based roguelike action-adventure game for 1-4 players! Battle fierce foes, play minigames, solve puzzles, and collect treasures as you venture through the Shadowmoon Kingdom to defeat the Calico King!

5352600.name: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition
5352600.short_description: Kaylotia: Dungeon Expedition is a strategy RPG of dungeon exploration, resource management, and auto battles. Choose from six classes, explore randomized dungeons, gather supplies, upgrade skills and gear, plan your route, and prepare the right build before the Boss countdown reaches zero.

5445950.name: NSFW Solitaire - Femboy Wife
5445950.short_description: 696 pictures and 13 card sets with your beloved femboy wife for NSFW Solitaire

4792370.name: Lexip
4792370.short_description: Lexip is a cozy fantasy factory game about magic, rail logistics, and questionable sustainability. Build production chains across the overworld and underground, power machines with local magic, fulfill contracts, and keep Null pollution under control.

5373600.name: Birdie's Backyard Battle
5373600.short_description: Somebody took Birdie's slipper, and she wants it BACK. Build a deck of dog tricks, chuck toys at squirrels, lawn gnomes and one very determined goose, while Cheddar the cat helps... when she feels like it. A cozy, silly roguelike deckbuilder.

5001910.name: Friends Park
5001910.short_description: A co-op puzzle game for up to 2-6 friends where every level plays by its own rules.

5439700.name: Dragstrip Online
5439700.short_description: Pixel art drag racing where the driver who understands the car wins. Pick from 1600+ cars or build one from a bare frame, swap engines, tune every part on the dyno, then prove it on the strip or in highway battles with the police on your tail. Career offline, PvP online.

5058320.name: 苟在魔门求长生
5058320.short_description: A cultivation prodigy trapped in a demonic sect. Survive, scheme, and choose your path—restore the righteous way or become the supreme demon lord. Every choice shapes the story. Rewind, retry, and replay any chapter via the flowchart. No grinding, no combat—just an immersive interactive movie.

4569520.name: 无效化
4569520.short_description: Winnia is the only child in the sanatorium, spending her days lost in adventurous fantasies. Dr. Kai is a cold, meticulous physician who treats patients and diagnoses difficult cases. Innocent imagination and clinical rationality travel different tracks, yet quietly shape each other.

5398040.name: Highway-Formosa
5398040.short_description: Hit the roads of Taiwan in a retro arcade racer. Dodge traffic, grab nitro boosts, and beat the clock in your red convertible. Choose branching routes across six vibrant settings, take on boss chases, and chase high scores to each setting's own soundtrack.

3059040.name: Cat-Astrophy
3059040.short_description: Cat-Astrophy is a fast-paced Action Roguelite that combines frantic combat, precision platforming and unique builds across procedurally generated planets. Every run offers new ways to play, death is permanent. Can you survive the cat-astrophe?

4310010.name: Ghost in the Cloud
4310010.short_description: Dive deep into the Net, build the ultimate deck, install busted plugins, and fight ever more powerful Bots and Avatars in fast-paced tactical combat that combines turn based and real time mechanics, all to realize your wish, or perish trying.

5344800.name: Telma-H:Act One Scene One Demo
5344800.short_description: This demo takes place around the turn of the millennium. The protagonist, a student at a private secondary school, is unexpectedly helped by a mysterious adult woman on his way home one day. He later discovers that she is about to become a new member of his family.

5217970.name: LARP With Your Friends Demo
5217970.short_description: A chaotic 1–4 player co-op RPG where you cast spells with your voice, fight with physics-driven weapons, and adventure up a dangerous mountain with your friends to slay a princess and save the dragon.

4297190.name: Cubito World
4297190.short_description: Your base awaits! Play solo or with up to 4 players to craft, build, farm, and fly. Solve puzzles, hunt hot air balloons, raise animals, and so much more!

4639800.name: Tainted Grail: The Fall of Avalon - Challenge Mode DLC
4639800.short_description: A brand-new way to play for those who crave challenge and unpredictability. In this mode, you'll be offered powerful debuffs at key moments in the story, flipping the roguelike formula on its head. Instead of growing stronger, the game grows harsher with every choice.

4728810.name: The Telwynium: Book One
4728810.short_description: Book One - Winter's Dawn. The first chapter in a 90s fantasy adventure epic from the creator of The Drifter. It's your first night away from Willows Dene, and you have first watch.

4975580.name: StowStow Demo
4975580.short_description: StowStow puts you in a physics-driven warehouse where every box has weight and consequence. Scan cargo, dodge explosions, draft upgrade cards, and build conveyor lines until the chaos runs itself.

4456160.name: Dawn of Defense Demo
4456160.short_description:
Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: 
Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

4585480.name: Entropy Demo
4585480.short_description: Entropy is a tactical turn-based RPG inspired by classic JRPGs. Assemble your party of mercenaries and forge your own path towards an expedition into hell to stop the demonic incursion. Choices you make along the way will determine the fate of your world.

5037670.name: We're Gonna Need More Fireballs
5037670.short_description:
You're gonna need a bigger tower. Then thirty of them. A million bugs are
coming down tunnels the size of a city, and the only correct answer is more
fire. Burn them, rot them, feed them to hungry trees - whatever you do,
don't stop casting.

5168120.name: Football Academy Simulator
5168120.short_description: Run your own football academy! Create personalized training programs, improve your players' skills, rent out equipment, keep your facilities clean, and manage your sports shop. Build a squad from your best trainees and take your academy to the top of the Fantasy League.

4004860.name: Out Fishing Demo
4004860.short_description: Discover the first two chapters of Out Fishing in this playable demo. Fish, build, sell, and upgrade your gear in a first-person horror fishing adventure. Explore an abandoned lake and uncover a forgotten disappearance… but return before nightfall.

4041100.name: A Game About Feeding A Black Hole Demo
4041100.short_description: A short incremental game about feeding a Black Hole matter by destroying Asteroids, Planets, and Stars.

4075280.name: Lessaria - Supporter Pack
4075280.short_description: A set for Special Sponsors of the kingdom.

3651370.name: Sombie
3651370.short_description: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

3426520.name: CyberVerse Demo
3426520.short_description: Dive into a dark cyberpunk world where megacorporations reign and technology merges with humanity. Explore a futuristic megacity, hack systems, fight enemies, and uncover the secrets of digital chaos. Your choices will shape the fate of this world.

3547180.name: The Seance of Blake Manor Demo
3547180.short_description: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery where you play as private investigator Declan Ward and investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane. The demo features the first two playable in-game hours on the Manor grounds.

3616110.name: Hail to the Rainbow Soundtrack
3616110.short_description: Atmospheric soundtrack by Nobody’s Nail Machine, infused with the spirit of science fiction, melancholy, and a retro aesthetic inspired by the VHS era.

3170420.name: MechWarrior 5: Clans - Digital Collectors Content
3170420.short_description: MECHWARRIOR 5: CLANS Digital Collectors Content Includes a Digital Art Book, the full Soundtrack, an Omnimech Technical Readout. Plus exclusive in-game content Platinum Mech Patterns and Timber Wolf WAR Omnimech with unique weapon loadout and skin.

2561520.name: Sniper Elite: Resistance - Target Führer - Lights, Camera, Achtung
2561520.short_description: In a last-ditch effort to sway the favour of the French, Adolf Hitler, leader of the Third Reich, is en route to the Ville du Lac Film Studios to film a series of propaganda shorts.

2338590.name: Russian Fishing 4 - Norwegian Sea
2338590.short_description: Explore the sea and find fish with a powerful marine boat and a fish finder. Use a variety of tackle and bait to achieve the best result. Get new fishing experience and compete with other players.

2015371.name: MultiVersus Founder's Pack - Deluxe Edition
2015371.short_description: Grab a MultiVersus Founder's Pack for a batch of Character Tickets used for character unlocks, exclusive items, and more! With over 18,000 Gleamium worth of content, you won't want to miss out!

1299270.name: Kingdom Two Crowns: Dead Lands
1299270.short_description: Build your kingdom and explore three unique lands covered in mysterious forests filled with secrets and mystery. Kingdom Two Crowns is an atmospheric micro strategy game wrapped in modern pixel art aesthetics. It’s easy to pick up and play with an in-depth campaign mode playable in solo or co-op.

1232621.name: RetroArch - PocketCDG
1232621.short_description: You can host your karaoke nights at your home now!

794110.name: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Alith Anar
794110.short_description: Alith Anar appears as a new High Elf Legendary Lord in both the Eye of the Vortex and Mortal Empires campaigns. Voiced by Hollywood actor Dylan Sprouse, Alith Anar brings a host of unique traits and abilities to High Elf campaign and battle gameplay.

633910.name: Zombie Panic! Source Official Soundtrack
633910.short_description: Zombie Panic! Source Official Soundtrack originally composed by KillahMo in Dec 2007, and later by KaempeLaeske in 2017, introduces you 27 different tracks from the memorable standalone modification Zombie Panic! Source.

643740.name: Crossout - Wasteland Warrior Pack

436082.name: Dying Light- Volatile Hunter Bundle
436082.short_description: Spread terror among hordes of night zombies! Don your fluorescent outfit, equip special weapons, and get behind the wheel of the Volatile Hunter. Prove you were born in the dark, molded by it. The Volatile Hunter Bundle includes: a new buggy paint job, a new character outfit, blueprints for a new sword, baton, maul, and knife. Note: This content requires Dying Light: The Following expansion pack.

464920.name: Surviving Mars
464920.short_description: There will be challenges to overcome. Execute your strategy and improve your colony’s chances of survival while unlocking the mysteries of this alien world. Are you ready? Mars is waiting for you.

353220.name: Fast Detect
353220.short_description: The experimental graphic story Fast Detect takes place in the postapocalyptic Half-Life 2 universe and is shown from the artist's special point of view.

5458970.name: Travelling to Woolokii Demo
5458970.short_description: Solve cases, investigate mysteries, and explore the Island of Woolok in this chapter-based Point & Click / Visual Novel.

4024580.name: Don't Eat Me, Granny
4024580.short_description: Don't Eat Me, Granny! is a dark fairytale stealth-horror set in Bonebog. As a kidnapped boy trapped by a mad old woman, you must escape before she completes an ancient ritual to crash the Moon into the world — with you as the final sacrifice.

4995850.name: The Wake Event Demo
4995850.short_description: Awaken aboard ARGUS Station and uncover the first signs of the Wake Event. This demo includes Modules 01-03, introducing exploration, environmental clues, terminal puzzles, subnet isolation, routing, and the station’s unsettling observation systems.

5454340.name: Travelling to Woolokii
5454340.short_description: Solve cases, investigate mysteries, and explore the Island of Woolok in this chapter-based Point & Click / Visual Novel.

1200310.name: VRocker Demo
1200310.short_description: Use your body to move in any SteamVR game that uses trackpad/joystick 'free locomotion'. VRock to increase immersion, get fit, free up your hands or just to fulfil that desire to look (even more) silly in VR!

4314710.name: Alien Idolz: Rhythmic Idler
4314710.short_description: Alien Idolz is a 4-lane rhythm game with an incremental twist. Hit the notes, harvest love from your alien stans, and exploit the skill tree to break the stats and clear increasingly difficult tracks.

3725330.name: Race Jam Demo
3725330.short_description:
Experience the thrill of the 1990s with Race Jam - an action packed arcade-style racing game! Featuring retro-inspired tracks, high speed gameplay and an authentic throwback vibe.
Race Jam: Exhilarating 90's Arcade Racing like you remember, But BETTER

4837550.name: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
4837550.short_description: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer!  Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels.  Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

5427320.name: Dajimo Arena: Team Showdown Demo
5427320.short_description: Multiplayer arena FPS, no lobby: drop straight into a live match. 1 arena, 4 team colors w/ distinct play styles, abilities + weapons. 6+ players unlock the lethal Outskirts where new weapons await discovery! Developed with Memsight runtime intelligence. Runs on GONet Legendary. Thanks Galore!

3806250.name: Flashes of Chaos Demo
3806250.short_description: A fast-paced, top-down roguelike shooter about building brutal guns. Collect ammo cards, stack modifiers, and load them into any weapon of choice to create your own chaotic cocktail of adrenaline-fueled destruction.

4909330.name: Last Bake
4909330.short_description: You play as a young woman taking a temporary evening job at a bakery on New Year's Eve. Your task is to serve a variety of customers while trying to uncover why, instead of holiday cheer, this place is shrouded in darkness...

3924200.name: The Rat Eater
3924200.short_description: Collect strange loot in this absurd world. Choose your simple rat and turn him into complex killing machine.  Explore unique skill trees, craft items and eat rats. What more would one want?

5354200.name: Deck Drop
5354200.short_description:
Perfect your deck or watch it burn!

Deck Drop is a Roguelike Deckbuilder inspired by Chinese Poker and Balatro.

Can you beat the Tipping Point?

4289950.name: LingoHUD
4289950.short_description: Real-time translation overlay for games, manga, video and chat. Translate on-screen text with one hotkey, turn game or video audio into live subtitles, and speak to type in another language. Runs locally on your PC, no account or API key needed.

1009850.name: OVR Advanced Settings
1009850.short_description: OVR Advanced Settings is a Dashboard Application for VR, that allows you to access many settings. OVRAS also has a myriad of utility features such as: simulated movement, adding smooth/snap turn to any game, video controls for the headset such as brightness, per-app bindings and much more.

5282930.name: BOTCLOPS Demo
5282930.short_description: BOTCLOPS is an explosive 2-4 player co-op action puzzle game! Encounter various strange one-eyed robots, and use blocks to solve and survive the first 2 towers in this 8 level demo.

5314630.name: JUST UNTIL MORNING
5314630.short_description: Rural 17, eleven at night. A gas station in the fog, and the lamps are going out one at a time. A slow-burn first-person horror about a small place after dark, and the night shift that has to keep it lit. Just until morning.

5334650.name: Fishing Trawler
5334650.short_description: Race up to 24 players online to the best fishing spots. Fill your livewell, then race back to bank your catch at the Tackle Hut before sunset. Launch off towering storm waves, craft a faster engine between rounds, and play with friends or rival trawlers. Most fish banked wins.

5381260.name: Terrum DeepDrill
5381260.short_description: Dig deep, keep the drill alive, and sell what you haul. Terrum DeepDrill is a single-player mining job: manage fuel, heat, hull, and cargo while the company bills you for every mistake.

5326750.name: Backrooms Open World
5326750.short_description: Welcome to the first Massively Multiplayer Open World Backrooms experience on Steam. Explore the Backrooms, fight Entities and other Players, join Factions to increase chances of survival and escape.

3949130.name: IN SILICO Demo
3949130.short_description: In a distant future humanity is enslaved in a simulation. Now that you are awake, can you escape from reality too?

3601810.name: Clear the Snow
3601810.short_description: Play with up to 4 friends and help clear the city of snow. Work together using shovels, snow blowers, and heavy machinery to complete jobs and upgrade your gear. Enjoy cozy winter vibes, and the freedom to play your own way!

4659910.name: Idle Squares
4659910.short_description: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

3213350.name: Brownie's Adventure: The Final Resolution
3213350.short_description: An incompetent wizard is tasked with stopping a recently awakened evil entity that just so happens to be trapped inside a (deeply suspiciously heavy) spoon. What follows is a sprawling, absurd 1990s-style point-and-click comedy adventure across bizarre fantasy realms and also North Derbyshire.

4210030.name: W.A.R.D.
4210030.short_description: Assume control of an evil intergalactic megacorporation in this sci-fi tower defense. Build a mining infrastructure on alien moons and exoplanets, exploit their precious resources, and defend your operation against defiant natives.

5342690.name: Keep It Trolling: Fantasy Edition
5342690.short_description: Test your luck and strategy in Keep It Trolling: Fantasy Edition! Roll color-coded dice, match mythical creature cards, and build score streaks. Bank points safely or Keep It Rolling to unlock legendary cards—just beware of the devastating BUST!

5250680.name: Arborist
5250680.short_description: Build a garden, survive the forecast, and follow a trail of birds through wild habitats in this cozy roguelike card game. Discover new cards, tools, and enchantments as you shape unique builds that keep every run feeling fresh.

5429550.name: After Troy Demo
5429550.short_description: After Troy is a turn-based deckbuilding game set in Greek mythology. Explore a hex map, fight enemies, recruit companions and capture cities. Each card has multiple uses. Build your deck with new actions, spells and relics, and combine their effects.

5366920.name: After Troy
5366920.short_description: After Troy is a turn-based deckbuilding game set in Greek mythology. Explore a hex map, fight enemies, recruit companions and capture cities. Each card has multiple uses. Build your deck with new actions, spells and relics, and combine their effects.

4824250.name: Merc Commander
4824250.short_description: Merc Commander is a real-time tactical RPG where you lead a company of mercenary mech pilots. Command your forces in battle, customize and upgrade your mechs, salvage enemy machines, and manage your growing outfit. Inspired by the classic era of mech command games.

4373740.name: 3:33 AM Demo
4373740.short_description: Jump scares beware! At 3:33 AM your phone rings, and the dead are calling. Answer out loud with your own voice. Talk, laugh or scream, and the caller hears your room. Tell the truth and your dark bedroom changes around you. Lie, and it gets darker. Try not to scream.

4978030.name: My Lovely Mime: Silent Affair
4978030.short_description: A temporary backstage job becomes a dangerous affair with Mira, a charismatic mime who speaks most through silence. Help her build a show, hide your secret, make difficult choices, and unlock 5 endings in this adult visual novel.

3922000.name: Neighborhoods
3922000.short_description: Neighborhoods is a cozy city sim where you shape streets to help people thrive, gather, and develop strong opinions about a particular bench. We're reimagining the city builder as a city fixer.

5042540.name: Absolute Sumo
5042540.short_description: A silly online party game where you play a chubby meme animal in a tiny sumo belt and shove everyone else out of the ring. Win rounds to grow from a cute little wobbler into a giant slab of muscle, dodge shifting arenas, and fight over who gets to push who.

5290090.name: Cramped Demo
5290090.short_description:
Eat the pigs to survive this oppressive concrete world.
A short and surreal FPS.

2622140.name: Virtual Handheld
2622140.short_description: Play virtually any game in VR! Virtual Handheld can overlay your non-VR games on top of other VR apps, and convert VR controller input into standard input that non-VR games can understand!

1873240.name: Bomberrage
1873240.short_description: Bomberrage has no classic rules - it's a fast and exciting game where you fight strong opponents or friends in explosive multiplayer battles!

5002950.name: Specters of the Void Sea Playtest

1221670.name: Ormagi Press
1221670.short_description: Ormagi Press is an unconventional horror adventure game that will have you adjust to ever so switching gameplay styles. After losing everything to a calamity that occurred ten years ago, Nathan seeks guidance from a voice beckoning from within the temple on the mountain summit...

5363980.name: Swarm Below
5363980.short_description: A survivors roguelite at the bottom of the sea. Your weapons fire on their own. You just have to stay alive while the reef fills up with eels, sharks and a thousand hungry fish, and whatever is big enough to eat all of them.

4742500.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus
4742500.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

4852420.name: Edicts of the Truthsinger: The Orb of Artemagus Demo
4852420.short_description: Six witnesses, six suspects, and thousands of discoverable lines of dialog. You're the fantasy detective on the case of a stolen magical artifact, and in order to determine the truth you'll have to cross examine, interrogate, and reference all your resources to catch the thief before time runs out.

5285380.name: Risk Trader
5285380.short_description: Survive first. Compound second. Trade simulated markets, manage risk and grow a virtual account across five modes. Explore interactive lessons on risk and position sizing, review your trades, and practice with a local rules-based coach. Play entirely offline.

5165490.name: Glass Tanks
5165490.short_description: Top down 3D retro arcade shooter with sideways physics. Grab a friend for couch co-op against ten genuinely rude AI tanks across 30+ levels, or go it alone and skip the witnesses. Endless customization, class and arcade modes and more keep the game scratching that nostalgic itch for years.

5457410.name: ChessDeck
5457410.short_description: A tense chess roguelike deckbuilder. Draw cards to deploy pieces and move them with real chess moves, break the enemy garrison, and hold your back row against attacks you can see coming. Every piece you lose comes back to haunt your deck.

5312950.name: Lightkeeper: Frozen Bay
5312950.short_description: You are the keeper of a lighthouse on a frozen northern island. Keep the lamp lit, the stove fed and the car fueled. And when the storm comes, don't step out where the light can't reach: a wendigo walks the island at night. And it is listening.

5411480.name: Holdopolis
5411480.short_description: One toilet. An entire city desperate to use it. Build districts, draw queues, deliver paper and haul away waste. Handle breakdowns, strikes and elections in a satirical city builder where one locked door can bring everything to a standstill.

4930650.name: 11 pm
4930650.short_description:
A minimalist factory game that doesn't quite work the way you expect.
Choose modules carefully, place them on your machines, and watch them drastically change how each machine produces.
Build your own factory with its own rules. Optimizing it can become an obsession!

5183140.name: OREBELT
5183140.short_description:
Rocks roll in, you crack them open, coins pile up!
OREBELT is a cozy idle miner where your little mine slowly grows into a mega factory, from coal and iron to blood diamonds, jade and more.

3744870.name: Croakspire
3744870.short_description: Dive into a fortress labyrinth crawling with monsters, defending yourself with your... tongue? As a frog, it's your best bet to traverse this retro-inspired 2D metroidvania title. Collect treasures to gain permanent upgrades, discovering new areas of the massive interconnected map with them!

4961110.name: NEVER TURN BACK
4961110.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game about escaping a seemingly endless tunnel where something is always watching from the darkness.

4995460.name: Tiny Chef
4995460.short_description: A co-op restaurant management sim for 1-4 players. Chop, fry and plate orders against a ticking clock, then spend the takings between shifts on new appliances, conveyor automation, knocked-down walls and a second restaurant across town.

2787670.name: Circular Fever
2787670.short_description: A Classic 4-Key Rhythm Game - Easy to Learn, Hard to Master

4976760.name: The Fixer
4976760.short_description: Football star on Saturday, match fixer the rest of the week. Rig matches for the syndicate, buy the referee, and keep your suspicion from hitting 100. Free demo: play your first 10 weeks, then carry the save into the full game.

5430930.name: Kingdom.py Demo
5430930.short_description: The free demo of  , a town builder you play in real Python. Write the scripts your heroes run: build houses, farm, bake bread, collect taxes, serve merchant ships, hire more heroes and fight off the first bandits.

4556860.name: Kumochi Keeper
4556860.short_description: Become the keeper of your own Kumochi sanctuary! Collect a myriad of whimsical creatures, place them across hand-illustrated zones, and watch them grow! Open Kumochi packs, decorate your world, and build the coziest collection — all at your own pace.

1227481.name: Prosystem
1227481.short_description: The ProSystem emu is an A7800 emulator for the PC. The emulator was (originally) written in C++ using the Windows API and DirectX. It runs the ANTSC and PAL TV standards. It was originally written by Greg Stanton and then updated by others.

5407050.name: Chroma Miners Demo
5407050.short_description: Guide Chrobits as they mine, refine, and collect over 16 million unique colors while automating their work in this relaxing incremental game.

1227444.name: Snes9x
1227444.short_description: Port of upstream mainline up-to-date Snes9x, a portable home console to libretro.

5117910.name: The Way Home - Supporter Pack
5117910.short_description: This DLC adds a bird to the sky when driving home with the default car. It is a purely cosmetic supporter DLC.

4934660.name: The Way Home Demo
4934660.short_description: Drive safely to your destination in a country where even the tiniest tap with your car can put you on death row.

3396440.name: Gumpy Brawl
3396440.short_description: Welcome to Gumpy Brawl, the competitive multiplayer platformer where vintage cartoons meet chaotic action!

3399100.name: Flashes of Chaos
3399100.short_description: A fast-paced roguelike top-down shooter about building brutal guns. Collect ammunition cards, add modifiers, and load them into your weapon of choice to create your own unique experience of pure, adrenaline-fueled destruction.

2342900.name: RetroArch - DirkSimple
2342900.short_description: This is a dirt-simple FMV/laserdisc game player core.

1905200.name: RetroArch - Beetle Saturn
1905200.short_description: Beetle Saturn is a 32-bit, 5th generation videogame console emulator core.

1222637.name: RetroArch - TIC-80
1222637.short_description: TIC-80 is a fantasy computer for making, playing and sharing tiny games.

4345950.name: VOIDCAST
4345950.short_description: Explore an abandoned video store after dark and descend into spaces that defy logic, where warnings and guidance blur into one without escape.

1222633.name: Flycast
1222633.short_description: The libretro core for Flycast, available now for RetroArch Steam!

1227463.name: RetroArch - PX68K
1227463.short_description: This libretro core emulates a popular gaming-focused home computer from the Japanese market in the late 1980s.

2008300.name: RetroArch - Vecx
2008300.short_description: Vecx is an core for the vector-display based video game console.

2734810.name: Core Awakening
2734810.short_description: A top-down retro rogue-like. Explore a world that is slowly being corrupted by an unknown entity. Play solo or up to 4-players. Pick a class and discover, collect and modify dozens of different guns, abilities and upgrades. Find the source of Corruption and stop it from spreading.

1985100.name: RetroArch - FCEUmm
1985100.short_description: FCEU "mappers modified" is an unofficial build of FCEU.

2066880.name: RetroArch - A5200
2066880.short_description: The A5200 core is an optimised version of the A800 core specifically optimized and designed for the A5200 home videogame console.

5465990.name: A Cat Lived Here
5465990.short_description: A quiet, text-based life simulation about sharing a home with a cat. Make small choices, watch the months fill a colorful memory grid, and discover the funny, tender routines that make an ordinary life worth remembering.

1227459.name: QuickNES
1227459.short_description: The libretro core for QuickNES, available now for RetroArch Steam!

5393900.name: FranticFarWest
5393900.short_description: A saloon, cowboys, a sheriff, an outlaw, a table and revolvers. The perfect setting for a frantic debate, with just one question: who will shoot? Deductions, lies, surprises and laughter are all part of this online hidden-role game for 4 to 12 players.

1222638.name: EasyRPG
1222638.short_description: EasyRPG Player allows you to play compatible RPG games from within RetroArch.

5101320.name: First-Person Jigsaw
5101320.short_description: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

4516700.name: Worlds Explorers Demo
4516700.short_description: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

1843610.name: RetroArch - Beetle PCE
1843610.short_description: Comes in three versions: PCE, PCE Fast, and Supergrafx. PCE is a slower, accuracy-oriented version. PCE Fast is a faster but less accurate version. Supergrafx is based on PCE Fast but emulates the Supergrafx.

5114440.name: Kingdom Isles Demo
5114440.short_description: Kingdom Isles is an intense Survival City Builder with Roguelike elements. Build a mighty Kingdom, Trade resources on the market, and defend your Island against increasingly tougher Viking raids! Can you lead your people to victory?

1227457.name: RetroArch - FreeIntv
1227457.short_description: FreeIntv is a libretro core for the beloved video game console from 1979.

3565610.name: The Blackout Project
3565610.short_description: Manage your contry energy requirements, avoid blackouts, sustain industrial developpement, avoid civilization collapsing.

1227452.name: BlastEm
1227452.short_description: BlastEm is an open-source 16 bit emu focused on accuracy and portability.

1227454.name: caprice32
1227454.short_description: The libretro core for Caprice32, available now for RetroArch Steam! Software emulator of the CPC 8-bit home computer series that were manufactured by the British company between 1984 and 1993.

2062460.name: RetroArch - Handy
2062460.short_description: Handy is a video game system emulator that can be used as a libretro core.

5113760.name: Echo Mates
5113760.short_description: To see, you must speak. To speak is to be found. A co-op horror in near-total darkness where every sound sends out a wave that lights the level — and calls whatever lives in it. 1–4 players, real voice, microphone required.

1222630.name: Beetle PSX
1222630.short_description: Beetle PSX emulates a popular 32bit game console released in the mid '90s. Notable features are: PBP and CHD support, software renderer resolution upscaling, Vulkan and OpenGL renderers, high-resolution texture replacement, and dynamic recompilers for increased performance

2010120.name: TGB Dual
2010120.short_description: TGB Dual is an open source handheld emulator core with link cable support.

2004070.name: RetroArch - Gambatte
2004070.short_description: Gambatte is an accuracy-focused, open-source, cross-platform handheld system written in C++.

3005610.name: RetroArch - DOSBox Pure
3005610.short_description: DOSBox Pure, created by Psyraven in 2020, was designed specifically for RetroArch/Libretro.

1227467.name: Desmume
1227467.short_description: Its old name was YopYop DS and the author of the program was YopYop156. The purpose of this core to run Dual Screen games. When DesmuME was first released, it supported home-made games called homebrew. Later, this support was improved. It is still under development.

4939230.name: Helltower Demo
4939230.short_description: A Roguelike RPG mixing spectacular action and rhythmic combat, in a dystopic hell where each soul has to accept their death, and the regrets that come with it.

1222631.name: bsnes
1222631.short_description: The libretro cores for bsnes and bsnes hd beta, available now for RetroArch Steam!

5363220.name: Master of Treasure
5363220.short_description: Sweep an endless procedural coastline with friends and dig up treasure no one has ever seen. Every coin, gem, relic and fossil is generated in 3D and is practically one of a kind. Level up, upgrade your gear, and see how far out you are willing to go for the rarest finds.

5089280.name: Anomaly Center
5089280.short_description: After a wave of layoffs following a murder at the mall, you step in as the night security guard. The job is simple: catch shoplifters and stop anomalies from reaching safe limits. Just remember - DAC has its eye on you.

2004140.name: RetroArch - Fuse
2004140.short_description: The Free Unix S. Emulator (Fuse): an emulator of the 1980s home computer.

4509620.name: Ovis Mollis
4509620.short_description: A cozy pixel farm on your desktop — a whole village with fishing, a casino, and a stock exchange. Grass grows, sheep accumulate wool even while AFK. Shear, sell, pay your mortgage, collect skins from Mystery Box on Steam — and one day robots will do everything themselves.

1227465.name: RetroArch - XRick
1227465.short_description: XRick is an open source implementation of very popular game.

4424600.name: REQUIRED SYNERGY WORKSHOP: Deja Damnation
4424600.short_description: A participant disappears during a mandatory corporate workshop. The System restarts the session but keeps your answers, and the people around you remember how you treated them. A choice-driven psychological horror story about workplace rituals, surveillance, and a reality coming apart.

2862100.name: RetroArch - Vircon32
2862100.short_description: Vircon32 is a virtual game console, inspired by classic 16 & 32 bit systems as well as the arcade era.

5454820.name: SUPER DURAK
5454820.short_description: Durak, the Russian card game everyone's grandmother plays, now with Supercards that break the rules. Bomb an attack, ricochet it to a neighbour, steal your rival's best card with a magnet, or reroll the trump. Play CPU opponents, a friend at the same screen, or anyone online.

4466380.name: Army of the Potomac
4466380.short_description: A digital version of the grand tactical wargame published by GMT Games and designed by Mark Herman. Second in the Civil War Heritage Series, this game includes scenarios for five individual battles covering the period of 1862 to 1864, and two campaign scenarios using eight maps from the boardgame.

1227456.name: NeoCD
1227456.short_description: It is designed with accuracy and portability in mind rather than being all about speed like the the older versions.

1232622.name: SMS Plus GX
1232622.short_description: The libretro core for SMS Plus GX, available now for RetroArch Steam!

5354320.name: Snow Duckies
5354320.short_description: Scoop snow, bring snow duckies to life, and build your own winter village. Upgrade your Duckie maker, grow your flock, and give your duckies jobs, from gathering snow and building to defending their snowy home.

2595110.name: 爱之巢
2595110.short_description: 《爱之巢》是一场关于血肉、爱与救赎、恨与纠缠的冒险。密室逃脱也好、视觉小说也好、电子宠物也好……这些都只是这场冒险的冰山一角。唯一重要的只有……属于你的少女——『晴』，永远在你们的《爱之巢》，微笑着等着你。

1844870.name: RetroArch - Beetle VB
1844870.short_description: An emulator for a portable handheld console released in the mid '90s. It was a virtual reality handset console, and one of the first to showcase stereoscopic 3D graphics.

1227458.name: FreeChaF
1227458.short_description: FreeChaF is a libretro emulation core for the Video Entertainment System designed

3549700.name: Star Squadrons: Galactic Trading Card Game
3549700.short_description: Star Squadrons is a fast-paced, tactical sci-fi card game WITHOUT MANA, where you deploy cards face down, interact nonstop, and win through clever location control. Secure your Founder status ahead of the Kickstarter in early 2027! Play the browser-based Early Alpha now!

4325520.name: Shelf-Made Tycoon
4325520.short_description: A cozy tycoon game about growing a tiny warehouse into a logistics empire. Land bigger deals until trucks, trains and ships bring work to your door. When money gets tight, a crime syndicate pays big for a few unmarked crates. Just hope the driver isn't an undercover cop.

1227442.name: RetroArch - Theodore
1227442.short_description: Theodore for family of 8-bit home computers

1227468.name: gpSP
1227468.short_description: One of the fastest emulators of a very popular 32bit handheld game console released in the early '00s

2234340.name: RetroArch - ep128emu
2234340.short_description: A core for emulating the Z80 based home computers from the '80s.

2246910.name: RetroArch - MojoZork
2246910.short_description: A core for playing text-based interactive fiction.

1227460.name: Picodrive
1227460.short_description: Picodrive emulates a wide variety of classic game consoles from the '80s to the '90s, including an add-on peripheral released for one of the most popular 16bit game consoles in the year.

1843660.name: RetroArch - Beetle Cygne
1843660.short_description: Emulates a handheld game console from the late '90s. It had a D-pad on each side and could be held in both horizontal and vertical orientation.

2301080.name: RetroArch - Numero
2301080.short_description: Numero is a libretro core for emulating the graphing calculators.

1227450.name: GW
1227450.short_description: GW will let you see the time and play a game.

1234350.name: PPSSPP
1234350.short_description: The libretro core for PPSSPP, available now for RetroArch Steam!

1222635.name: Nestopia
1222635.short_description: Nestopia is a portable and cycle-accurate emu written in C++.

5044990.name: Card Duel: Black Rite 卡牌决斗：黑暗仪式
5044990.short_description: Card Duel: Black Rite is a lightweight card roguelike built around Texas Hold'em hand-ranking duels. Use a wide variety of magic cards to rewrite the hand, strengthen your deck, choose among different fates, and ultimately win this dark duel.

4290070.name: Abyssal Merge
4290070.short_description:
Abyssal Merge is a chaotic bullet heaven roguelite where multitasking is your only hope of survival.
As a lone captain in a monster-infested ocean, you must fight off waves of enemies while simultaneously catching and merging the fish in your net to unlock game-breaking weapon synergies.

1876450.name: RetroArch - WASM-4
1876450.short_description: WASM-4 is a low-level fantasy game console for building small games with WebAssembly.

3643460.name: KIYO - Bunny Tyranny Demo
3643460.short_description:
Control the body of Kiyo, a feline ex-predator trapped in a neon-lit, dystopian city dominated by smartphone-addicted bunnies. 
Discover their deepest secrets, and free everyone from their tyrannical grip in this stealthy platform adventure. Experience the beginning of this story in this demo.

5381250.name: Grim Guild
5381250.short_description: You never go on the adventure. You only decide who does. Run the adventurers' guild your grandfather left you: find out what is out there, from dire wolves to a dragon in the old workings, write the contract, and wait at the door to count who comes back. Streaming? Name newcomers after your viewers.

4386910.name: NEUROBROOD
4386910.short_description: «NEUROBROOD» is a visual novel in the cyberpunk‑horror genre. Those touched by the abyss of neurodream never wake up the same.

5461150.name: Gnomebody Told You To Climb Demo
5461150.short_description: Climb with a fire axe. Sit in a watering can. Try to look like this was your plan.

5202380.name: shatAAAAp! Demo
5202380.short_description:
Exponentially bigger waves of cute animals require increasingly absurd means of destruction.
Shoot, burn, electrocute, explode... and make sure no one ever helps you.

4617980.name: Pool Glow Demo
4617980.short_description: Pool Glow is an immersive exploration game inspired by Poolcore. Experience the demo version for a small but complete 'Poolcore' experience.

4680530.name: Train Sim World® 7: Tadami Line: Aizu-Wakamatsu - Tadami Route Add-On
4680530.short_description: With Union Workshop’s Tadami Line, the dense valleys and quaint, trundling rails of rural Japan make their debut in Train Sim World! Explore the stunning Fukushima Prefecture and take on local passenger duties among the mountains.

4699520.name: Into the Crypt Demo
4699520.short_description: Immerse yourself in a first-person 3D roguelike deckbuilder where cards are your only weapon. Build complex synergies and use cards to physically unlock doors, chests, and interact with the environment while fighting to survive the Crypt's powerful and strange enemies.

4169030.name: DownSouth Demo
4169030.short_description: DownSouth is a moral-dilemma platformer RPG where your choices affect your sanity, and your sanity affects how you play.

3978180.name: Driftline Peaks Demo
3978180.short_description: Driftline Peaks is a retro-style touge racer where speed and control collide on winding mountain roads. With arcade inspired physics and a low poly PS1 aesthetic, it captures the thrill of downhill sprints and uphill climbs, balancing tight cornering and controlled slides.

3979620.name: Transport Fever 3: Deluxe Upgrade
3979620.short_description: The Transport Fever 3: Deluxe Upgrade takes your network to the next level with additional iconic vehicles, more world-famous landmarks, new unique wildlife from around the globe, and much more!

4036410.name: HELLMART Demo
4036410.short_description: Supermarket simulator meets horror. Try your first three days working at a 24-hour convenience store in the far North. During the day - serve customers and hit your sales goals. At night - beware of strange visitors. Hide, escape, defend yourself.

4065430.name: Frostpunk 2: Deluxe Edition Upgrade
4065430.short_description: The Deluxe Edition includes a digital copy of the novel Warm Flesh from the upcoming Frostpunk anthology, as well as access to a digital artbook, the epic soundtrack from the game, an exclusive in-game item, and all future DLCs.

3744620.name: AbstractPunk Demo
3744620.short_description: AbstractPunk Demo is the demo version of a wild, punk, trippy soulslike game with unique collage-style graphics. Collect ice from defeated enemies, fight your way through an anti AI revolution-ridden country, and try to find your place in the broken, twisted reality of 2004.

3796360.name: DCS: Marianas WWII
3796360.short_description: The Marianas 1944 terrain freezes the archipelago at a knife-edge moment days before the first U.S. Marine amphibious waves slam ashore in Operation Forager.

3802770.name: BLOODVILLE
3802770.short_description: BLOODVILLE is a short first-person shooter where you play as Cane, a retired hitman dragged back into killing - and slowly losing his mind.

2109470.name: Wild West Dynasty: The New Hope Gazette
2109470.short_description: Welcome to Wild West Dynasty! With the New Hope Gazette you will receive exciting background stories and information about this iconic era as well as first-hand development infos.

2010121.name: RetroArch - BlueMSX
2010121.short_description: blueMSX is a cycle accurate core that emulates all generations of 1983's computers.

1320450.name: Space Simulation Toolkit - DEMO
1320450.short_description:
A particle simulator that uses a graphics card as a supercomputer to calculate physics.

The more powerful the graphics card, the greater the gameplay!

1107180.name: The Messenger - Picnic Panic DLC
1107180.short_description: The Messenger's epic story continues on in a summer vacation DLC full of tropical action!

1110410.name: VEGAS Pro 17 Edit Steam Edition
1110410.short_description: VEGAS Pro 17 Edit - Steam Edition offers more than 30 new features – among them, find new special effects for giving your Let's Plays that special touch. Record your Let's Plays using the brand-new Screen Capture tool and immediately begin editing it in VEGAS Pro 17 - Steam Edition. Let your creativity run free and take your gaming videos to the pro level.

888859.name: NTBSS: Seventh Hokage Costume (Gender-Neutral)
888859.short_description:
Become the envy of every shinobi in the village with this Naruto Uzumaki-styled Seventh Hokage costume!
This costume can be worn by both male and female avatars.

4936650.name: Cult of Echoes
4936650.short_description: Use echolocation to hunt your friends down in an asymmetrical horror game where sound is everything!

4079370.name: Telera
4079370.short_description: Roll your dice, and score increasing amounts of points. Complete the goal target to move to the next level - unlocking new dice, and providing resources to upgrade your existing dice. Roll, Score, Upgrade, and repeat - TELERA provideds a challenge as long as you can complete each level. Good luck!

5019960.name: Forgotten Tavern
5019960.short_description: Run a tavern simulation set in a hidden Korean mountain village. Gather ingredients through unpredictable weather, discover traditional Korean recipes, and serve mystical Dokkaebi and villagers. Get to know your guests by discovering their favourite dishes and unique preferences.

4124030.name: Bloom Demo
4124030.short_description: Bloom is a short point-and-click narrative puzzle game. Step into the role of a housewife haunted by the terrifying Root-Man. Search for keys, unlock doors, and fight to escape. Will you wake from the nightmare, or remain trapped forever?

1238580.name: A800
1238580.short_description: It runs 8-bit computer systems and five thousand two hundred contents.

2388330.name: RetroArch - VirtualXT
2388330.short_description: It is designed to be simple and lightweight yet still capable enough to run a large library of old application and games.

4964870.name: True Nightmare - Diner Loop Demo
4964870.short_description:
Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you.
Can you escape?

776210.name: Afraid Project 2
776210.short_description: What you do in the game becomes reality!

5028850.name: Arena of the Forge
5028850.short_description: Fight. Loot. Forge. Repeat. Arena of the Forge is a pixel art endless arena battler. Fight through waves of enemies and bosses to collect and forge stronger gear in the Arena or enter the Onslaught for a boss rush experience.

5233810.name: OBSIDIAN 7
5233810.short_description: Every town has its stories. In Area 7, most are true. It’s your job to keep them classified. Investigate bizarre cases, solve puzzles & examine evidence with Atlas, the loyal German Shepherd with a nose for clues.

4953640.name: Shoot Some Rocks
4953640.short_description: A bullet hell roguelite about a lonely worker drinking alone in space on Christmas Eve. Survive waves of cosmic chaos, get a cold beer, and face five massive bosses inspired by real space calamities.

4670120.name: Still With Me
4670120.short_description: A psychological horror experience about returning to a place that never forgot you.

3680120.name: Gendo The Gatherer
3680120.short_description: A cozy life sim where you forage, cook and serve your way through Gendo's journey navigating an abundant, ever changing landscape. After long days of gathering goodies, return to your cozy home to prepare, cook and serve your dishes to the local townsfolk. Join Gendo in his life in the countryside.

3879650.name: Lost in Ascension
3879650.short_description: Out of Orbit is a challenging vertical adventure where every jump matters. Navigate floating platforms, moving obstacles and unpredictable paths as you climb towards the unknown.

4912110.name: Mayhem Duck Simulator
4912110.short_description: Are you ready to explore the freedom of being a rubber duck? 🦆 Mayhem Duck Simulator is a relaxing yet chaotic plastic duck simulator. Take control of every duck, rescue special friends, and stir up trouble! Whether you seek peace or pure madness, the entire pool is yours to command! ✨🛸🔥

4985060.name: Mimic Demo
4985060.short_description: Deduce who you can trust in this asymmetrical online survival horror game for up to 10 players. Solve the objectives, survive the killer Android hunting you, and hunt from the shadows as the Mimic; a shape-shifting terror hiding amongst you.

4956460.name: AMERICAN LIFE SIMULATOR
4956460.short_description: Build your business from mowing lawns to owning homes, renting properties, and creating your American dream in an open neighborhood life simulator.

4618670.name: 挂机放置修仙录
4618670.short_description: Build a five-member cultivation party, farm hordes for gear, tackle dungeons and test your limits in endless challenges. Mix your hero's main attack and technique; refine, enchant, reforge and socket equipment. Learn manuals, brew pills and grow your town. A buy-to-play solo idle RPG.

4603810.name: Zenith Expanse Demo
4603810.short_description: Play the opening hour of a living space colony survival sim. Wake your crew, secure water and food, build your first fragile settlements, and survive 50 Sols on a compact 30-star map.

4717180.name: Murder at Monty's Mansion
4717180.short_description: Step into a goofy murder mystery where you play as a detective who cannot speak. Use your notepad to interrogate guests, explore Monty’s mansion, and discover who murdered the butler.

5272130.name: Desktop Ball Demo
5272130.short_description: A little physics toy that lives on top of your desktop. Fidget, vent, and mess around with a bunch of weird balls. Fling them, bounce them, dunk them, explode them, or just slosh around in a tiny ocean.

5482100.name: Villein
5482100.short_description: In this prequel to "Annum Crossroads," navigate a vast, open-world dystopia while battling countless enemies, and the sorcerers who command them.

1209970.name: Blind Descent
1209970.short_description: Blind Descent is an open-world survival adventure into the mysteries of the Martian depths. Play solo or with friends in 4-player co-op as you search for the missing team. Adapt to survive by building custom tools, upgrading your base, and/or mutating in this bizarre alien world.

4989970.name: Domignomes
4989970.short_description: Domignomes is a destruction-based pot-building roguelite, where you draw lines of falling gnomes to blow up plants, rocks, and everything in between. Craft your run from various biomes, choose from powerful items, and set off ridiculous explosion chains!

5322340.name: Gold Master: A Game Company Tycoon
5322340.short_description: A turn-based business simulation about the games industry. Found a studio, hire and lead your team, develop and market games for seven platforms, and guide your company through the decades, one week at a time.

4716310.name: Asterium
4716310.short_description:
Real-Time Multiplayer Space Strategy & Combat

Command a fleet, manage your empire, and dominate the galaxy in Asterium. Colonize new settlements, trade resources, expand your influence, and lead your ships into real-time tactical battles against rival factions.

3755250.name: LifeOverhaul
3755250.short_description: Design, build, and live the ultimate garage life. Create vehicles, trailers, and homes from scratch, customize every detail, and shape your own open world. Play solo or host friends in a growing community-driven sandbox of creativity and craftsmanship.

5433470.name: Drift Goblin
5433470.short_description: A top-down horde survival game where your pickup truck is the weapon. A purple goblin stole Joe's cow, and there are thousands of goblins between you and her. Run them over, spend the loot on hundreds of upgrades for the truck, and go get Betsy back.

5492780.name: Balitti
5492780.short_description: A frenetic movement FPS inked like a manga: run, slide and fly across the map on a kunai rope, tear through hordes in the arenas and chain kills into combos to push your style rank. Insane movement, colossal bosses and worlds where gravity doesn't play fair.

2451700.name: Atrion Project
2451700.short_description:
A hybrid with no memories.
A planet out to kill you.
A demanding sci-fi action game with fast-paced combat and die & retry mechanics.
Fight. Die. Learn. Retry.
Your body is a weapon. Your past, a mystery.

5379290.name: Wickshore
5379290.short_description: Hold the dome! A fantasy defence game where you zap enemies, grow your towns, and survive the night.

5228820.name: BitVoid
5228820.short_description: A 2D pixel-art survival game where you absorb data, evolve your code, and battle malware. Survive in single-player or multiplayer, face powerful bosses, gather collectibles, and complete the codex while exploring a hostile cyberspace to an electronic soundtrack.

4166560.name: BRAKES? No, thanks!
4166560.short_description: Feel like a true road outlaw! "Brakes? No, thanks!" is a dynamic, voxel arcade game, combining crazy ride with spectacular mayhem. Rack up your Penalty score, beat survival and destruction records. Unlock new vehicles and tracks to intensify the road chaos.

5394840.name: Rock Paper Viking Demo
5394840.short_description: You are the sole defender of the Cardboard Castle! Pick up new weapons and magic abilities as you progress. Level up your loot to gain the strength of the Norse Gods, and defeat your foes to claim victory for your kin.

5465870.name: Zombie Mori!
5465870.short_description:
Stack zombies, clear lines, and chase high scores!

Zombie Mori! is a fast-paced falling-block puzzle game packed with quirky zombies! Clear multiple lines, combine zombie types for huge score multipliers, and unlock all 50 zombies in your collection.

The higher you stack, the higher you score!

5044050.name: ONSIGHT
5044050.short_description: A top-down multiplayer shooter with FPS-style limited vision. Walls block your sight, enemies stay hidden, and sound becomes vital. Find weapons, choose perks, outflank opponents and survive with limited lives.

4518610.name: FUTAHAMMER 69000
4518610.short_description: In the grim darkness of the far future, it's time to chill. A relaxing, low-stress sci-fi arcade breaker with a killer soundtrack. Smash heretical blocks, vibe to the music, and unlock explicit, uncensored videos of gorgeous sci-fi women packing their own "heavy artillery."

4772980.name: Dragon Up! Together
4772980.short_description: Jump, climb, and glide your way through dangerous challenges in this co-op dragon adventure. Young and baby dragons must work together using their unique strengths to solve puzzles, overcome obstacles, and reach new heights... Just make sure not to fall. Can you help them find their way home?

2189430.name: Gilded Destiny
2189430.short_description: Forge empires, incite revolutions, and reshape society in Gilded Destiny, the definitive grand strategy game of the Industrial Age. Take command of your chosen nation and lead it to glory through masterful diplomacy, sweeping industrialization, and decisive warfare.

3319470.name: Don Bradman Cricket Jr
3319470.short_description:
FAST. FUN. CRICKET!
Step onto the pitch and feel the thrill of every shot. Don Bradman Cricket Jr is fast, accessible cricket that's easy to learn and rewarding to master. Smash boundaries, outplay opponents and make every run count.

5335930.name: Surf N Destroy Playtest
developers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra

4404410.name: Chicks vs Ducks
4404410.short_description: Tag, push and parkour your friends off the map. Chicks vs Ducks is a 2–10 player online party game: team hunts, free-for-all brawls on rising lava, and co-op egg heists against sharks. Wall-run, dash, grapple and get back up, or drag a friend up with you.

5334590.name: Surf N Destroy
5334590.short_description: Bring a hot knife to a gunfight. Surf to heat your blade, chain wall runs and mantles, and shoot through portals in a combat racer for up to 32 players. Be the last surfer standing, climb the leaderboards, and share your best runs as replays.
developers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra
publishers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra

5414010.name: Surf N Destroy Demo
developers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra
publishers: Frank Rodger Ivan Tom Tom Zebra

3843440.name: Deadzone Aeon
3843440.short_description: Deadzone Aeon is a multiplayer survival-driven fantasy open world with story elements. Mixed within the classic online survival genre, delve into a PVPVE story where deception runs deep and every step draws you closer to the forgotten truths that shaped existence itself.

4656810.name: Reunion Fate
4656810.short_description:
Reunion Fate is a psychological horror game where terror lurks in the places you think are safe.
Use the flame to guide you through the darkness.
Explore familiar and unfamiliar places.
Hide from them.
No one will tell you what you want to hear.

5108820.name: Explosive Express
5108820.short_description: Explosive Express is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op physics game where tiny workers transport unstable bombs through a giant world. Work together, load the van, survive the hazards, and get the bomb home before time runs out.

5387480.name: Shhh, IT!
5387480.short_description: Two juniors, ten dollars and a brilliant plan. Hire developers, ship absurd releases and race to hype if you can, while every rival plans in secret at the same time, lays traps and fights you for the same seats. A card game about IT startups for 2–6 players.

5364780.name: It's Wedgie Time!
5364780.short_description: It's Wedgie Time! is a game all about giving cute girls wedgies - yank, floss, snap, and PULL for points! Unlock outfits, modes, and multiple characters who are fully voiced! What are you waiting for, nerd?! You know what time it is!

3042270.name: Alex's Sketchbook World
3042270.short_description: The RPG where you fight enemies by drawing and coloring them.

4058120.name: Drive UP: Together
4058120.short_description: Co-op climbing for up to 8 friends, built on real driving physics. Thin planks, giant pipes and vertical ramps stand between you and the summit, and every meter is earned. A friendly push saves your run. A friendly push also ends it.

5004380.name: DelveWright
5004380.short_description: A first-person dungeon crawler with a classic turn-based JRPG heart. Explore The Below in real time, then snap seamlessly into pure menu battles. Bank your loot to rebuild your ruined town - or gamble it diving deeper. Death costs only what you didn't bank. The world only grows.

4938340.name: Chronoform Demo
4938340.short_description: A sci-fi precision puzzle-platformer where every death becomes a tool. Replay ghost echoes of your past runs to manipulate machinery, solve intricate timing puzzles, and escape a deadly research facility.

2862160.name: Tribal Towers - Siege of the Shifting Fortress
2862160.short_description: 8 Player Online Co-op. Summoned by a magical tree to free the villagers and root out the evil wizard from the shifting fortress.  Fight through crypts, fire, swamp, earth and air dungeons, loot gear and gain skills.  Challenge bosses, rescue allies, take the wizard down.

5337960.name: Pawnage Demo
5337960.short_description: A chess-fighting game where nothing is captured for free. Every capture drops both pieces into a 3D arena for a real-time 1v1 duel: attack with melee, cast spells, grab powerups! Only the survivor takes the square! An old school, fast-paced 1v1 PVP experience both in local couch-mode or via Steam!

5493650.name: UPG Cubed (Demo)
5493650.short_description: A fast-paced minimalist platformer where precision is everything. Master jumping, wall-jumping and dashing, collect diamonds, beat challenging levels and push your skills to the limit. And create your own levels in UPG Cubed

3255110.name: Grave Seasons
3255110.short_description: Grave Seasons is a narrative farming sim with a terrifying twist – someone in the town is a supernatural serial killer. Farm, romance, and investigate your way through the unsettling town of Ashenridge.

1261770.name: Fairmoon Museum
1261770.short_description: Start your life as a curator in Fairmoon where you'll fix up and fill up a museum in a sleepy town full of interesting residents with lots to say. Customize your character, improve your house and local businesses, and get to know more about this curious little town.

5127020.name: Visions of War
5127020.short_description: The first turn-based tactics game where both you and your opponent can peer into and alter the future. Your space fleet moves and fights semi-autonomously, but only you can leverage oracles to see how the battle will play out and give the key orders to change fate. Are you up to the task commander?

3504510.name: Vesper and The Umbral Passage
3504510.short_description: Vesper the Jerboa embarks on a quest into a foreign dimension, solving ancient puzzles to unlock the secrets of the Umbral Passage, a network of mystical pathways that connects missing worlds. His journey will uncover the truth behind his newfound abilities and the secrets of this new dimension.

2979810.name: POLYARIS
2979810.short_description: Survive the Arctic in this first-person single-player game. Move by skis and boat, stay warm, dry, and hydrated, loot what's left behind, fight enemies, and escape the lonely north by any means. For fans of The Long Dark and other similar survival games.

3995930.name: Carpark Hero
3995930.short_description: Carpark Hero is a 2–8 player PvP racing game where you and your friends race for a limited number of parking spots. If you don’t park your car, you’re eliminated. It builds to a final 1 v 1 showdown where one car is crowned the winner.

4585240.name: urbexophobia Demo
4585240.short_description:
Urbexophobia is a survival horror game for 1 to 4 players.
Survive. Loot. Escape… AND BET IT ALL AT THE CASINO!

4926820.name: Amara
4926820.short_description: Manage and grow your cozy café from scratch in a world full of adorable talking cats. Craft authentic coffee drinks inspired by real barista techniques, upgrade your shop, serve your fluffy customers, and become beloved by all.

4949040.name: LockLine
4949040.short_description:
LockLine is a turnbased tactics boardgame-like about positioning units to outsmart your opponent. Line up three units in a row and you can call down an orbital strike on an enemy. However, they are just as eager to target you!
Each turn you have a choice: do you set up your strike or prevent theirs?

1459270.name: Heart Of Muriet Demo
1459270.short_description: Your faction is in your hands in this 4X real-time strategy game. As a powerful mage in this demo, build thriving settlements and diverse armies to discover the secrets and stories at the heart of Muriet.

3758770.name: Ember and Blade Demo
3758770.short_description: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

3348940.name: Kernel Ridge
3348940.short_description: Dave wanted a quiet weekend in the woods. The AI decided humanity was obsolete. Kernel Ridge is a single player survival game where you scavenge, craft, and survive against hostile machines in a stylised forest wilderness.

3697300.name: . . kill ´em all !
3697300.short_description: A dark psychological FPS that pulls the protagonist through a hostile industrial maze of close-quarters combat and stalking patrols, guided by an AI whose influence blurs the lines between help, manipulation, and truth.

5042600.name: 荒岛时光 Demo
5042600.short_description: On this island, you can grow crops, fish, capture island creatures, mine, chop wood, and craft tools and items. Come explore the island world and experience its peaceful life.

5490860.name: Turf Rumble
5490860.short_description: Conquer the turf! Send your crew to claim tiles, spawn more units and outsmart rival teams in fast isometric pixel-art battles. Play solo against bots or online with friends, in teams of up to 6 players.

4174240.name: Dédale - A Cave Diving Experience
4174240.short_description:
This cave diving expedition was a bad idea. Your heart is racing, lungs are starving for fresh air, and this burrow never seems to end. Keep crawling. 
Dédale is a horror game that plunges you in a cave diving expedition that is bound to go wrong.

4736080.name: CORVIDTALISM: Win at Life
4736080.short_description: Help a lazy low life get back up on his feet. Make him work, use persuasion, ignore his cries, and make choices for him. "Don't say you don't want to win at life."

5377200.name: Chained Pirates Together
5377200.short_description: A cursed skull has chained your crew together, and only a lightning strike at the summit can break it. Climb 1000 meters in this physics-based co-op climbing game for 1–4 pirates, where one bad jump drags everyone down with you.

2987990.name: Ropuka
2987990.short_description: What does the grass hide? Ropuka is a nostalgic adventure into the unknown. Cut grass, explore meadows and forests, and get a chance to befriend wild creatures.

5421090.name: 피지컬 윷놀이 Demo
5421090.short_description: A real-time take on the Korean board game Yut. Throw as your energy fills, collect rolls, stack your pieces, and capture opponents. Choose your timing and race to bring all four pieces home, with three AI difficulty levels to practice against.

4971340.name: Wardwell
4971340.short_description: Wardwell is an idle simulation steeped in Chinese myth. As omens herald Hanba, the drought demon, brave extreme weather, refine rare natural treasures, shelter pilgrims, and restore divine artifacts to face uncanny beings of legend.

3929510.name: Killer Situation
3929510.short_description: On a snowy night just before Christmas, your secure smart home is breached. A serial killer has come for you and you are trapped with him in your own house. Search for items and figure a way out while evading the killer in this short, intense horror experience.

4849240.name: Duel: The Game Show
4849240.short_description: The ultimate 1v1 show game! Step up to the podium and challenge your rival in 6, 9, 12, or 15 rounds. Master 30 varied mini-games testing your knowledge, guessing, logic, memory, and speed. Who will keep their cool, buzz in faster, and claim the ultimate victory?

3998040.name: Fossilfuel 3
3998040.short_description: Navigate an open-world Siberian island overrun by dinosaurs. They brought them back, you’re here to put them down for good in the terrifying third act of the Fossilfuel series!

4074280.name: Tails in Pairs
4074280.short_description: Tails in Pairs is a relaxing, educational game where you match dog breed cards, discover new ones, and explore over 100 narrated profiles. Win levels to unlock cards and build your personal collection, complete with detailed descriptions and rich breed lore, one tail at a time.

5155100.name: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER
5155100.short_description: Build robots, equip factories and defend your headquarters in a strategy auto-battler. Collect parts, refine your army and take on Campaign, Endless Solo, co-op Duo or a Duel with a friend.

4984680.name: Star Claw
4984680.short_description: A claw-machine roguelite where you fling a cat's stretchy paw to grab treasure. Bounce off bumpers and reach each room's cash target before time runs out. Combine powerful upgrades, battle bosses, and unlock new cats and decorations between runs.

5022940.name: Accursed
5022940.short_description: Will you defy your faith to spare the one you love? Fight through a dark, gothic world of side-scrolling action, deadly creatures, and brutal bosses in a modern reimagining of classic retro action games.

4299300.name: Cendres
4299300.short_description: Cendres is an isometric 3D action roguelike. Explore seven floors of procedural dungeons, dodge their guardians’ attacks, and shape your build through loot, forging and skill trees. Every descent is a new attempt.

4974960.name: The Last Station - Baku
4974960.short_description: A first-person psychological survival horror set in the abandoned Baku subway. Explore dark tunnels, solve puzzles, investigate disturbing mysteries, and make emotional choices while trying to survive against terrifying horrors.

4438110.name: Nightmare Conquest
4438110.short_description: Build your monster team, combine skills, and create absurd builds to push farther and farther in this strategic auto battler!

4568400.name: Nomad Drive Demo
4568400.short_description: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

5164190.name: A Journey Rediscovered - Intro Version
5164190.short_description: A VR-PC adventure rhythm game where you're travelling towards immortal life!

5091450.name: Yeetbags
5091450.short_description: Compete and sabotage your friends with superpowered bags with unhinged personalities in this ultimate bag-tossing, multiplayer showdown. YEET. THOSE. BAGS!

5315330.name: Tiny Spellcaster
5315330.short_description: Blast through endless hordes and hold the line against these demons! Tiny Spellcaster is a corner arcade idle shooter with rogue-lite upgrades, where rng and strategic builds help you overpower the rapid swarms of monsters closing in. Master the magic, unleash the chaos!

5265120.name: Lyra Quinn - Black Hole
5265120.short_description: A fast-paced 2D sci-fi arcade shooter. Pilot Lyra through 26 action-packed levels, destroy dangerous space enemies, survive escalating threats, and defeat the final boss in a challenging cosmic adventure.

4953850.name: Cruzado
4953850.short_description: Fight by day. Choose by night. A hand-painted action roguelite on the road to Jerusalem: hold off the horde with crossbow and dash, then spend the night forging gear, drawing tarot cards, winning hearts... or rolling the d20 and praying no one ambushes your camp.

5254910.name: Infall: A Black Hole Incremental Demo
5254910.short_description: The free demo of Infall, a short, relaxing incremental game about growing a black hole. Start smaller than dust and grow through the first stretch of the upgrade tree.

5357850.name: All 4 Naught Demo
5357850.short_description: ALL 4 NAUGHT is a hack and slash roguelike where your party is your build. Recruit 4 heroes and swap between them mid-fight to combine their attacks and party-wide abilities. Delve into the dungeon, battle hordes of monsters, conquer brutal bosses, and build the perfect party!

5107400.name: Voxotron Demo
5107400.short_description: A psychedelic hyper-speed racer with no speed limit and no brakes. Dodge, graze, and boost around a rotating cosmic cylinder where runs last 30 seconds and death is instant. Chase world records, race ghost replays, or play with up to 7 friends.

4463160.name: Once Upon a Katamari - Rolling Live Highlights
4463160.short_description:
Includes:
・10 New Quests
・12 Tracks Katamari Series BGM
・ 6 New Cousins
・18 New Costume Items

4586560.name: Tearoom of Terror Demo
4586560.short_description: Congratulations on your inheritance: one tearoom, one murdered aunt, 13 regulars who know where the *ahem* bodies are buried. Brew tea, bake treats and try not to end up on the menu before Halloween. The free demo serves seven delightful ways to die, dog included.

4956960.name: Helicoid
4956960.short_description: An arcade flight game built on Rocket League's air roll controls. Fly through a neon city threading lines of orbs, rolling through gaps in oncoming laser walls, weaving through traffic, and more. Very hard if you can't air roll yet, but we'll help you learn.

5023510.name: Active Immunity
5023510.short_description: A twin-stick bullet-hell roguelite fought inside the human body. Pilot an immune cell through escalating waves of pathogens, dodge dense bullet patterns, and stack upgrades into synergies that rewrite your build. Choose how each outbreak mutates, then push a run into endless.

3777540.name: Space Scum Demo: Second Life
3777540.short_description: Lead a band of mercenaries through battle after battle in this Sci-Fi, turn-based RPG. Fight your way across different planets, earning loot and equipment to outfit your team – and remember, no option is off the table when survival is on the line.

3589660.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III - Thanquol – Lords of the End Times
3589660.short_description: Mastermind plans of diabolical proportions as Grey Seer Thanquol for Total War: Warhammer III. Leading Clan Scruten of the Skaven, the guileful Thanquol rides to battle atop his faithful Rat-Ogre bodyguard, Boneripper.

3132850.name: Hark the Ghoul Demo
3132850.short_description:
Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters!
HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

3245770.name: Pavlov TV
3245770.short_description: Pavlov TV is a spectator tool for Pavlov and Pavlov Shack. View live Search & Destroy or Push lobbies, or capture replays on your community server and play them back. A full suite of UI controls as well as an API to export match data for streaming software.

2994410.name: World of Tanks Blitz - Resupply Pack
2994410.short_description: Enhance your game with an instant resource resupply. Research vehicles even faster and embark on a journey to win new victories!

2729150.name: Sniper Elite: Resistance - Vercors Vendetta Mission and Weapons Pack
2729150.short_description:
With millions of lives at stake, Harry Hawker must neutralise one final cache of deadly Kleine Blume! To assist you, the M1941 Rifle and the Italian Armaguerra OG-44 submachine gun will be added to your arsenal:
•	The Vercors Vendetta Campaign Mission
•	M1941 Rifle
•	Armaguerra OG-44 Submachine Gun

5356990.name: Coma Dreams Demo
5356990.short_description: Guide a wounded Marine through a nightmare born of his own coma, facing the horrors of war, scarce ammunition, puzzles, and dark labyrinths. Evade a colossal, relentless pursuer, overcome manifestations of his deepest psychological traumas at every stage, and help him wake up and return to reality.

5200920.name: BATTLE: PARTS & POWER Demo
5200920.short_description: Build robots, equip factories and defend your headquarters in a strategy auto-battler. Collect parts, refine your army and take on Campaign, Endless Solo, co-op Duo or a Duel with a friend.
