5433510.name: Dead After Dark Demo
5433510.short_description: Play the Community Center scene from Dead After Dark in Arcade Mode. Grab your light gun or mouse, blast through hordes of zombies, chase a high score, and discover interactive surprises hidden in the environment.

5375770.name: Mox Nox
5375770.short_description: Become the last Reaper in a dark fantasy action RPG built around brutal swordplay and supernatural power. Perfect your parries, turn dodges into counters, summon phantoms and tear through the alliance hunting your bloodline. Claim their souls. Grow stronger. Reclaim your birthright.

5179420.name: Project Screams
5179420.short_description: Project Screams is a 1-8 player online co-op horror game. Memorize the Daycare, spot the anomalies, and make the right call by voting to progress. Miss an anomaly or make the wrong decision, and you'll be sent back to your checkpoint. How far can you make it?

5354520.name: Dead After Dark
5354520.short_description: Dead After Dark is a fast-paced on-rails zombie shooter inspired by classic arcade light gun games. Grab your mouse or light gun, blast through hordes of the undead, chase high scores, and team up with a friend in local co-op.

4067660.name: Port Authority Demo
4067660.short_description: Port Authority is a harbor traffic management game where a calm port spirals into chaos. Draw routes, guide ships, and prevent collisions as traffic overwhelms the harbor.

4519480.name: Outposters
4519480.short_description: OUTPOSTERS is a 1-4 player co-op zombie shooter with a rogue-lite core. Hold the line against escalating waves, then push into the dead city to scavenge weapons and upgrades before the next assault lands.

5082200.name: Jimothy's Adventure
5082200.short_description: Play as Jimothy, a raccoon trying to keep his family fed. Raid trash cans, haul your loot home, and outsmart increasingly ridiculous patrols as a simple night of scavenging turns into an all-out raccoon hunt in this single-player stealth adventure.

5331400.name: Nullwatch Demo
5331400.short_description: Hold your base against waves of geometric nodes in this stationary shooter. Aim, choose what gets deleted first and time every reload. Between nights, upgrade your base, sell salvage, buy better guns and spend skill points before the field fills again.

5108630.name: Wild Wheels
5108630.short_description: Wild Wheels is a fast and frantic kart racer where cute animals play dirty. Pick your racer, hit the track, dodge hazards, grab ridiculous power-ups, and do whatever it takes to reach the checkered flag first.

4811750.name: From Ashes To Glory Demo
4811750.short_description:
A turn-based medieval arena RPG where every dodge matters. Forge your legend as Korkut, 
a young gladiator searching for the truth behind his father's disappearance. Master the 
blade, time your strikes, and rise through the tournaments — or fall in the sand.

4535390.name: Temple Of The Machine God
4535390.short_description: The universe is over. You are the last human alive inside a superstructure orbiting an evaporating black hole and its taking you with it. Can you find the truth about what happened to Humanity and The Machine God while finding a way to escape?

4864740.name: Blood Miner
4864740.short_description: Cute animals. Sharp tools. You are the Ghoul, and the shaft never stops filling. Chop what drops, keep ten rows of glass pipe flowing, unleash the organ-eating dragon, then ascend into faster, nastier runs. An active clicker with a body count. No ads. No timers. One price.

5449310.name: High Wizards
5449310.short_description: Rage bait the gods. You're a floating wizard head with a finger gun and a weed pen, building absurd spell combos with up to 7 friends and fighting through five trippy lands of screaming enemies, giant sandworms and a T-posing Jesus.

4918780.name: grapplin' apples
4918780.short_description: grapplin' apples is a multiplayer grappling puzzle game about exploring various areas, completing puzzles, obtaining collectables, and getting cosmetics for your apple! fight various foes, play mini-games with your friends, do whatever, it's your world!

5230570.name: Wreckums
5230570.short_description: You're a tiny one-eyed space creature. Humanity wants you contained. Dodge volleys, smash human spacecraft with banked Wreckballs, and eat their wreckage to heal and mutate. Build a hungry little menace in this neon bullet-hell action roguelite.

5303110.name: Let Me Die Demo
5303110.short_description: Let Me Die is a short incremental game about a hero trapped in a loop, fighting a monster. Every time you die, you gain the resources needed to push further. Turn death into power. Unlock upgrades, complete quests, create unique builds. Break the loop.

3607230.name: Ridiculous Space Battles
3607230.short_description: RIDICULOUS SPACE BATTLES is the spiritual successor to the first ever autobattler game: Gratuitous Space Battles! After a fifteen year wait, the ridiculously over-the-top and completely unjustified battles in space ARE BACK.

5358190.name: Tales of the Southern Seas
5358190.short_description: Build trade routes, recruit companions and refit your fleet in a single-player sailing adventure set in the late-Ming Southern Seas. Navigate wind, waves and strange encounters. Will you turn the sea into a ledger—or learn to live alongside it?

1938190.name: Pirate Code 2: Reign of the Pirate King
1938190.short_description: An open-world, roguelite, turn-based pirate strategy game with a focus on tactical combat, exploration, and fleet customization. Explore a new world each time you play and fight through an endlessly branching story. Face down a relentless king and restore the Pirate Code!

2951670.name: Total War: PHARAOH DYNASTIES - Assembly Kit

1550920.name: Slime Alchemy
1550920.short_description: Slime Alchemy is a relaxing puzzle game where you must place pieces in specific locations on a hexagonal grid.

5374290.name: Bocage Demo
5374290.short_description: Bocage is a cozy isometric puzzle game where every farm piece has its own needs. Fill the grid tile by tile. Fence in the cow. Grow wheat around the windmill. Rethink each move as the constraints pile up. No timer, no game over.

4407730.name: NEUROBROOD Demo
4407730.short_description: “Neurobrood” is a nonlinear visual novel in the cyberpunk‑horror genre. Those touched by the abyss of neurodream never wake up the same.

3866090.name: Flipping Phantom
3866090.short_description: A puzzle platformer where you can’t jump?! Phase into the ground and flip upside-down to find your way around this spooky playground!

463690.name: Total War™: WARHAMMER® - Assembly Kit BETA

3735340.name: Strength & Sorcery
3735340.short_description:
Strength & Sorcery is a First-Person Roguelite Dungeon Crawler with up to 4-player online co-op. 
Venture into the depths of the Old Castle, battle the darkness within, and send treasure and resources back to the village above to rebuild, grow stronger, and prepare the next villager for descent.

5446000.name: RIMSTRIKE: Incremental Defense
5446000.short_description: Defend the rim! Your rocket glides along a glowing oval rail and fires on its own - you just aim. Shred endless swarms pouring out of the wormhole, collect shards, grow a huge upgrade tree and break through sector after sector of pure neon wire geometry.

5388330.name: Splatterworks
5388330.short_description: Splatterworks is a physics sandbox where every experiment leaves a mark. Build contraptions, stage ragdoll battles, and unleash weapons and hazards on a detailed injury simulation. Create chaos solo or bring friends along for online co-op.

5127890.name: Secret Shelf: Collectible Shop Simulator
5127890.short_description: Run a blind box figure shop: stock the shelves, set your prices, serve the queue. Then open a box from your own stock and cross your fingers for the secret. 290 figures, 32 series, a game hall across the street and up to 4 players in co-op.

3535920.name: Mike goes on hike Demo
3535920.short_description: Leave the city behind in a first-person hiking adventure. Explore mountain trails, take photographs, and fill Mike’s travel journal with memories — from a thrilling zipline ride to a quiet evening by the campfire.

3293290.name: Rage Platformer
3293290.short_description: Rage Platformer (formerly Keni Adventure) is a hardcore platformer featuring difficult levels and challenging puzzles. Master timing, patience, and skill to progress, and unlock achievements to personalize your Steam profile.

3054110.name: Beaux-Arts
3054110.short_description: Beaux-Arts is a surreal horror game about being held prisoner by the residents of a countryside estate. Explore the manor, admire the artwork that adorns your prison, get to know the family and staff. But remember: This place does not care about you.

5149300.name: Chair Chase
5149300.short_description: Chase the chair before someone steals your seat! Chair Chase is a chaotic 2-8 player party game where living chairs run away from you. Jump, dash and push friends aside, then hold on tight to score. Most points after 7 rounds wins! Supports public matches and streaming.

4994390.name: FKC: Fighting Krazy Chickens! Demo
4994390.short_description: They broke his egg... He took it personally. How much revenge does an egg deserve? Join forces with Kraze in this comedic survivor-like where the enemies are your bullets. Turn chickens into weapons, survive endless chicken hordes, upgrade your chicken and fight... Way too many chickens!

5435440.name: Hypernet Explorer Demo
5435440.short_description: Roguelike immersive sim set in esoteric post Y2K Europe.

4145740.name: Dybbuk
4145740.short_description: Cooperate to survive, or become the monster. You must hunt the demon as it strives to possess players and turn them against each other. To weaken the Dybbuk you have to collect ancient Mesopotamian statues and seal it away before it’s too late.

5408250.name: Seaside Scoops
5408250.short_description: Run a little ice cream truck by the sea. Scoop, stack and top every order by hand, earn tips from happy customers, then spend your days in town: stock up, decorate your home and spoil your pets. A cozy seaside job sim.

5403800.name: Golden Pan
5403800.short_description: A cozy gold panning game. Wash the creek gravel, watch the gold settle in your pan, sell your finds in the village, and turn a small empty room into a home. No timers, no failure. Just quiet, golden little days.

4762030.name: Firva: Strings of Fate (Part 1) Demo
4762030.short_description: Firva: Strings of Fate is a story-driven action-adventure set in a dark fantasy world, blending cinematic storytelling, atmospheric exploration, and old-school melee combat with a modern edge. Embarks on a journey of revenge, uncovering the secrets behind her past and the mysterious Strings of Fate.

5303800.name: Fangirl Simulator
5303800.short_description: Create custom characters and ships then support them as a fan! Play through stories and minigames about them, collect merch, create fan content, meet other fans, and help your idol take over the world.

4568720.name: Firva: Strings of Fate (Part 1)
4568720.short_description: Firva: Strings of Fate is a story-driven action-adventure set in a dark fantasy world, blending cinematic storytelling, atmospheric exploration, and old-school melee combat with a modern edge. Embarks on a journey of revenge, uncovering the secrets behind her past and the mysterious Strings of Fate.

3001110.name: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
3001110.short_description: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

5185210.name: The Reverend: A Happyhills Homicide Story
5185210.short_description: Unravel the dark secrets of Reverend Lawrence, known for his appearance in The Happyhills Homicide 2: Out For Blood. Prior to his death, Reverend Lawrence was a devout Christian and an example for the community of Happyhills. Everyone has skeletons in their closets, but some more than others...

4987280.name: Desktop Rave Demo
4987280.short_description:
Desktop Rave is a rhythm/idle/incremental desktop companion that turns the music you play on Windows into game resources!
Like Bongo cat but with each beat of your music playing on Windows!

4834280.name: Toimkonna simulator
4834280.short_description: Toimkonna Simulator is a first-person survival horror and management simulation game set in a military environment. Your duties are: keep the soldiers safe, watch cameras, maintain order, and ensure every room is cleaned before nightfall. Survive before the time hits 6 AM.

5163530.name: Toss Office
5163530.short_description:
Play a new hire at the Department of Disposal.
Toss and shred paper your way up the ladder and hire a team to do your work.
An incremental game about procrastinating.

5415150.name: WebCreep.er
5415150.short_description: Get filthy rich... Without leaving the toilet.

4826760.name: Maze Builder
4826760.short_description: A strategic tower defense where your towers are the maze. Funnel enemies through fire, ice and lightning, spend your gold on stronger defenses or risk investing for bigger payouts, and unlock permanent upgrades to push further into endless waves.

4796120.name: Screenbound Demo
4796120.short_description: Screenbound lets you discover a dual reality through the Qboy! Navigate challenging puzzles and battle through multiple levels in a blend of 2D and 3D platforming that creates the world’s first '5D' platformer.

5078760.name: Uncosy
5078760.short_description: An uncomfortable game about collecting plushies.

5149900.name: Not in Order
5149900.short_description: You report for duty on a train that never stops. A name, a date, a seat, a carriage: everything must match. Check the tickets, report what is wrong. And work out what really happened aboard.

5267350.name: Lattice
5267350.short_description: A Minesweeper roguelite set on an old computer, survive 8 rounds of increasing difficulty while buying upgrades and surviving danger!

2805070.name: Screenbound
2805070.short_description: Screenbound lets you discover a dual reality through the Qboy! Navigate challenging puzzles and battle through multiple levels in a blend of 2D and 3D platforming that creates the world’s first '5D' platformer.

4484070.name: PASTDARK Demo
4484070.short_description: PASTDARK is a horror extraction game with CO-OP up to 4 players with a twist - MADNESS! This makes each of the players see and hear things which are not there. Extract toys and submarine parts by utilizing stealth, teamwork, proximity voice chat and various items before the madness overwhelms you!

664370.name: Still Above: Orbital Refuge
664370.short_description: A 3D space-station survival builder. The Earth below is gone; your station is still falling. Salvage the orbital graveyard, fit out empty hulls rack by rack, and keep air, water, power and fuel flowing long enough to turn one fragile module into humanity's last refuge.

4902150.name: Bellus Party
4902150.short_description: Bellus Party is an early access multiplayer party game where cute cats compete in chaotic mini-games. Inspired by classic party games, Bellus Party focuses on fast, chaotic, and competitive moments that are easy to jump into with friends. May the best cat win!

5052220.name: LIMINAL ROOMS
5052220.short_description: LIMINAL ROOMS is a linear, Backrooms style Co-op puzzle platformer with fun challenges and difficult platforming. Play different levels from the Backrooms or experience new original levels for a fun twist. Help your friends escape with you, or make it as hard as possible for you all.

3202450.name: Don't Fret Demo
3202450.short_description: A sentient guitar trapped inside a nightmare music school. Hide, distract, and survive horrifying creatures as you tune your way through musical puzzles and fractured memories to uncover the truth.

5478200.name: Break the Walls
5478200.short_description: A 1–4 player co-op digging game with a retro 90s shooter look. Punch through voxel walls block by block, vacuum the rubble, crush it into cash and upgrade your fists until no wall can hold your crew. Punch. Upgrade. Escape.

5356890.name: Bloom & Dine
5356890.short_description: Bloom & Dine is a match-3 cooking game where every guest is a cat. Match ingredients to light up the stove, fit each dish onto the board and serve it before patience runs out. Run five kitchens across 99 days, from a tiny pizzeria to a grill terrace by the sea.

5346640.name: Futbolero: Football Career Simulator
5346640.short_description: Eternal idol or washed-up talent? Futbolero blends a football career sim, choice-driven roguelite, and key arcade minigames. Every run is a new life: from the streets to glory, juggling contracts, parties, and dynasties. Play solo or with friends in co-op or competitive PvP.

1721590.name: DEATHGRIP
1721590.short_description: DEATHGRIP is a scifi combat-racer focused on exhilarating speeds and challenging tracks.

5467890.name: Trash Digging
5467890.short_description: Roll a little robot into a mountain of pastel, hand-painted trash and start digging. Tunnel through it, scan for buried treasures, hover over the junk and light your way with lanterns. A cozy, gentle game, made by one person.

4892250.name: Patience Balls Demo
4892250.short_description: Tilt interconnected boards to guide the balls into their holes. Master 20 hand-crafted demo levels across walled Zen Mode and wall-less Patience Mode, unlock custom ball skins and trails, and climb global leaderboards.

1859970.name: Pseudo-Psy Play
1859970.short_description: A 21st Century Noir Horror Game. Pseudo-Psy Play is an eccentric blend of a side-scrolling shooter and a point-and-click adventure. The time has come – face your fears in this bone-chilling story-driven horror game that feels (and looks) like nothing else in the genre. Are you ready, Joseph?

5138100.name: Chick'n Chip
5138100.short_description: Play as Piou, a plucky little chick, in Chick'n Chip: an action-shooter with a heavy dose of rogue-like. Shoot, dodge and collect golden chips to buy the powers you'll need to take down Midas, the tyrant chicken!

4301510.name: Slot Siege
4301510.short_description: Keep the machine spinning and the walls standing. Slot Siege is a chaotic co-op defense game where you gamble your gold for gear and upgrades. Fight off hordes, scavenge resources, and try to survive 10 days of RNG-fueled madness with your friends. Don't go broke. Don't die.

3738120.name: First Age
3738120.short_description: A turn-based strategy card game set in the Neolithic Age. Sacrifice villagers, tame mammoths, and build powerful card synergies to lead your tribe through the threat of the Dark Ages. Will your people stand the test of time?

4593810.name: Pollex
4593810.short_description:
Enter the pit. Bet your fingers. Survive the thumb war.

Pollex is a first-person horror game set in an underground thumb war fight pit. You owe a debt you can’t pay. The only way out is through the ring ,where every match is played for keeps, and the house always takes a cut.

5404420.name: Squall Riders
5404420.short_description: Jet-ski racing where every swell is a ramp. Launch off storm waves, land tricks to charge your boost and outrace four rivals through three storms. Then take on Stunt Park, Splash Ball, Slalom and Big Wave, earn Spray and build your own ski in the garage.

5182130.name: Blinksplay
5182130.short_description: Blinksplay is a multi-monitor layout and audio profile switcher for Windows. Effortlessly rearrange displays, toggle per-monitor HDR, set profile-wide Auto HDR, and bind complete workspace setups to global hotkeys.

4738510.name: Topdeck Duel
4738510.short_description: An incremental card roguelike where every victory expands your deck! Position cards for powerful buffs, claim enemy cards, and merge them to increase their rarity. Accumulate gold for permanent meta-upgrades between runs and master the Topdeck Duel!

1012260.name: Total War: THREE KINGDOMS - Assembly Kit BETA

5382770.name: Ghost Smash
5382770.short_description: Ghost Smash is a 2D ecchi simulation where you train stats, explore haunted rooms, and defeat spectral beauties in arrow-sequence mini-games. Overcome ghost sabotages, use tactical items, reach 100% domination, and unlock all adult scenes for your private gallery.

1932910.name: Cardopolis
1932910.short_description: Cardopolis is a card-based city builder where you play as the Mayor. Build your city card by card, law by law, and sector by sector, while keeping your investors happy by hitting each population goal before time runs out!

5236700.name: Tungsteel
5236700.short_description: Build deadly mech squads in a single-player autobattler with a turn-based strategy map. Combine abilities, set target priorities, and cut enemy supply lines. Capture resources to repair, rearm, and unlock new mechs as you push toward the enemy base.

2338480.name: Parabellum: Artifacts Of War Demo
2338480.short_description: In this first person shooter you play as Dean Edwards a museum curator that collects artifacts from the past after reliving the battle

4924750.name: Village of the Mirror
4924750.short_description: A first-person psychological horror set in a forgotten village where Japanese and Anatolian folklore collide. Explore abandoned places, solve puzzles, uncover the past, and cross Torii gates into the afterlife to uncover the truth.

3925730.name: Furry Roommates
3925730.short_description: A furry visual novel about living with two cute roommates.

1681150.name: Kagami Forge
1681150.short_description: Make visual novels with your mouse: scenes, characters, choices, endings, menus and animations — no code required. Ren'Py runs under the hood: build for Windows, Mac, Linux and Steam, and everything you make stays a plain script you can still edit by hand.

2693760.name: Mystery at Grand Fir Village Soundtrack
2693760.short_description: Listen to a high-quality version of the game's soundtrack on any device anywhere! Rock, swing, jive, jam or relax thinking about your next mystery.

5323360.name: VaultFlow
5323360.short_description: An endless first-person parkour run through a procedurally generated industrial skyline. Sprint, slide, wall-jump and ride steam vents while the city collapses behind you. How far can you get before it catches up?

4964810.name: Minerooms
4964810.short_description: Dig through a surreal underground complex. Offer energy to an ancient statue, upgrade your gear, and blast deeper into the dark. Can you reach the end?

5228530.name: Chick'n Chip Demo
5228530.short_description: Play as Piou, a plucky little chick, in the Chick'n Chip demo: an action-shooter with a heavy dose of rogue-like. Shoot, dodge and collect golden chips to buy the powers you'll need to take down Midas, the tyrant chicken!

4999180.name: 100% Orange Juice - Rinse & Suishou Character Pack
4999180.short_description: This Extra Character Pack for 100% Orange Juice adds 2 new playable characters from developer Orange_Juice -Rinse and Suishou from the Resplendent Wing Private Academy, as well as announcer voices for them!

4813640.name: Bad Magpie Demo
4813640.short_description: You are a magpie with one wing, a missing flock, and an unhealthy obsession with a fallen star. Steal shiny trinkets, cause chaos, and stick your beak where it doesn’t belong.

4198180.name: Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School Demo
4198180.short_description: Class is (back) in session with Escape Academy 2: Back 2 School! Get a first look at next year's curriculum with this new playable demo. Escape from a death-defying introductory puzzle course, kick it with new and familiar faces on campus, and enjoy a sneak peek at our brand new quest system!

4314070.name: FFS: Football Freekick Simulator Demo
4314070.short_description: This is a simple free-kick game in which you kick the ball by literally choosing the contact point, power, and direction between the foot and the ball. There are no hidden stats that magically assist the trajectory for you, so it's actually your skill that matters!

4401470.name: Clicky Islands Demo
4401470.short_description: Clicky Islands is a unique blend of incremental gameplay, clicker mechanics, city-builder elements, and resource management. You play as a governor appointed by the king to discover and develop a new island for his future kingdom.

4442880.name: Airport Contraband Demo
4442880.short_description: Take over the duties of a customs officer in this roguelike-simulation demo of Airport Contraband. Inspect passengers and their luggage, perform body searches and handle the passenger queues of incoming and outgoing flights.

3887680.name: inZOI : Island Getaway
3887680.short_description: inZOI: Island Getaway is inZOI's first official DLC. Swim and snorkel in Cahaya's crystal-clear waters, where vibrant coral reefs, sea turtles, and dolphins await. Unwind at a resort with a variety of relaxing and recreational activities.

3634180.name: X-Magnifier
3634180.short_description: X-Magnifier  is an advanced version of the standard Windows magnification tool, specifically designed to zoom specific areas of game screens.

2809180.name: Goat Simulator 3 - Multiverse of Nonsense
2809180.short_description:
"In a world where everything went wrong (and it was all your fault) you must now help the guardian of the Multiverse to save it before it’s too late.

This is… Goat Simulator 3: Multiverse of Nonsense"

2667960.name: Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising Free Edition
2667960.short_description: Rise to the challenge in Granblue Fantasy Versus: Rising! Try out this powered up, revamped sequel to GBVS for free with the Free Edition. With simplified input options, even newcomers can engage in thrilling and strategic matches!

1908720.name: Half-Life: VR Mod
1908720.short_description: A fan-made highly immersive Virtual Reality mod for the classic Half-Life from 1998.

1747960.name: Planet Zoo: North America Animal Pack
1747960.short_description: Introduce eight amazing new animals to your zoo with the North America Animal Pack! Featuring cougars, moose, beavers and more, it brings a diverse assortment of growling, swimming, and cantering additions.

617810.name: Total War: WARHAMMER II - Mortal Empires
617810.short_description: Mortal Empires is a new grand-scale campaign set across the vast combined landmasses of both the Old World and the New World, enabling you to play as all Races from both games and any owned DLC. This content is free for owners of both Total War: WARHAMMER and Total War: WARHAMMER II.

4168240.name: Clear Red
4168240.short_description: A first-person roguelike buried in a Cold War ICBM bunker under alien siege. Defend the missile. Drill through soil, tunnels, caves and even ancient temples. Collect resources, craft items, upgrade everything. Burn coal to keep bunker running. Find two launch keys. Fire. Kill the mothership. Repeat.

5258780.name: Strashnovekovie
5258780.short_description: 2D action RPG. The game’s unique feature is that instead of the usual character leveling, at each level you’ll be joined by an ally with their own unique abilities. By using your allies’ abilities — you’ll be able to complete the game .

2693750.name: Mystery at Grand Fir Village NeonSynth Album
2693750.short_description: Listen to a high-quality version of the game's NeonSynth soundtrack, on any device anywhere! 80s dream-wave and dance-pop written originally for Grand Fir Village. Includes lyric sheets and game-art wallpapers.

2318580.name: Delivery Issues
2318580.short_description: In Delivery Issues, you do much more than simply deliver packages. It’s a race against time as you meet zany characters, outsmart and outmaneuver befuddling obstacles, and take on a mysterious enemy that will make this otherwise easy job rather difficult.

4739080.name: Rage Garage VR
4739080.short_description: Rage Garage VR is an immersive smashing game set in a garage. Wreck cars with hammers, guns, and thrown props, chain combos into a rage frenzy, and chase high scores while the crew heckles every swing!!

524660.name: RutonyChat
524660.short_description: RutonyChat is a program for receiving messages from chats and notifications from various streaming sites. A faithful assistant to the streamer and video blogger who wants to spice up or spruce up their content.

3849470.name: Winter Wraith
3849470.short_description:
Kingdom and Demons have been at it for a thousand years. You have lived a life of solitude and trained in the Heaven's Fortress.

Now, adventure begins once again. Venture out to beautiful world and take part in adventures ranging from discovering secrets to participating in large field battles.

5081370.name: The Last Contract
5081370.short_description: Escape the arena. Survive what's beyond it. The Last Contract is a stamina-based action RPG: steel, bow, or magic, it's your call. Grow by doing, not by spending points, through a hand-crafted world where your choices actually stick.

4857550.name: Who's Calling?
4857550.short_description: A home invasion thriller where your phone is your main enemy. The everyday routine, office work, and chores turn into a trap when an unknown person starts tracking every step you take. Lock the doors, call the police, and try to survive the final game of hide-and-seek with the stalker.

3471780.name: Space Opera
3471780.short_description: Found colonies, create spaceships from modules, colonize planets, form alliances and destroy your opponents in a turn-based game.

5489130.name: Forsaken: Dark Tribute
5489130.short_description: A brutal voxel co-op horde shooter for up to 4 players. Fight through 12 missions in rotting foundries, alien nests and war factories, hold the line against endless hordes and grotesque elites, and get your squad to extraction alive. Nobody else is coming.

4653380.name: Anvilia
4653380.short_description: Run a medieval blacksmith shop in co-op. Gather resources, forge tools, stock your shelves, and grow a thriving business.

5183520.name: Wish Impossible
5183520.short_description: Wish Impossible is a 1–4 player online co-op physics game where tiny gingerbread cookies sneak into sleeping homes to grant Christmas wishes — without waking anyone up. Move oversized objects, use ridiculous tools, and survive the chaos your friends create.

3049830.name: OUTTA HELL
3049830.short_description: OUTTA HELL is an action-packed FPS set in haunting dimensions of the afterlife. You're Mono — trapped in a corporate purgatory after a life of crime. Dive in guns blazing, slow down the chaos with time-bending combat, or move tactically through the shadows — hell won’t wait, and neither should you.

2802720.name: Yuri's Resolve
2802720.short_description: Yuri’s Resolve is a single-player factory-building game set in Mars' orbit. Salvage wreckage, mine Phobos, construct manufacturing systems, and forge a path back home. Operate from the immersive cockpit of your ship as Yuri’s Resolve delivers a bold, innovative take on the factory building genre.

5394420.name: Roadside Burger Shack Demo
5394420.short_description: Get a taste of Roadside Burger Shack in this first-person cooking demo. Prep ingredients, grill patties, build burgers, manage your stock, and serve customers through a cozy roadside drive-thru.

5109770.name: Dropper
5109770.short_description: Race your friends to the bottom in a first-person freefall for up to 20 players. Dodge obstacles, thread narrow gaps, and find the fastest way through towering courses. Keep dropping with virtually endless course seeds, community creations, and an Endless mode that tests how far you can fall.

651460.name: Total War™: WARHAMMER II - Assembly Kit BETA

5318440.name: LLamas & Alpacas
5318440.short_description: Lead a company of llamas and alpacas in tactical hex-based battles. Develop heroes, equip your squad, and uncover a conspiracy in mountainous Lamapuna. Whole-army turns, magic, and a struggle over shared supplies.

5124730.name: LifeStock
5124730.short_description: You are a god. Mortal lives are stocks. A godlike life-trading strategy game. Draft mortal lives, trade their futures, manipulate fate and wage war against rival gods in a living medieval village.

4080580.name: Paper Veil
4080580.short_description: You are Leo,after a fatal twist of fate, you wake in a twisted underworld where every whisper begs you to surrender. Defy the pull, outwit sinister denizens, and confront mythic, god-like beings as you claw your way back to the light. Good luck… you’ll need it.

4292540.name: Fight Like a Chicken Demo
4292540.short_description: Demo for a Punch-Out!! inspired boxing game. Read your opponent, time your blocks and counters, and land devastating combos. Hand-drawn animation and tight, reactive combat.

5366680.name: Find Wife in a Dungeon
5366680.short_description: pixel-art roguelike: Slay the Spire map + Backpack Battles inventory, and every dungeon queen is a wife to win. Rotate, link and fuse the loot you find into a war machine that fights on its own, then beat each dungeon's queen and win her over.

4141460.name: Fight Like a Chicken
4141460.short_description: A Punch-Out!!-inspired boxing game where you play as Benny Bantam, a rooster fighting through the criminal underworld to find his missing father. Master frame-perfect deflects and counters in this hand-drawn 2D fighter.

4280170.name: Michael Test Demo
4280170.short_description:
This is a test about sin.
An audio-driven horror mystery where you reconstruct the hidden timeline inside a painting through sound and expose the sin concealed within.

5028910.name: PlayCard Football
5028910.short_description: A football strategy card game where you are the coach and the cards are your plays.  Level up your coach with perks, use your team's roster to pick the best play possible against your opponent.  You manage your team, the recruits, their development from high school to college and the pros.

5423620.name: Cabinet Fever
5423620.short_description: Run an arcade from 1972 to 1998. Buy cabinets, set the prices, keep them repaired and play every one of the 31 machines yourself: each is a real, playable game. Grow from a corner nook into a neon megaplex as the years roll by.

4903470.name: Butaro's Overtime Office
4903470.short_description: A desktop companion about escaping the 9-to-5. Adopt Butaro, a burnt-out salaryman who lives anywhere on your screen. Watch him slack off from his mind-numbing job, decorate his office, and upgrade his corporate skills while you work or relax. Will Butaro escape corporate burnout before you do?

1055600.name: Team Fortress 2: VR Mod
1055600.short_description: Team Fortress 2: VR Mod is a fan-made project, which adds full Virtual Reality support to the beloved PC multiplayer classic made by Valve Software. Step into the shoes of all nine original TF2 classes, all faithfully adapted for modern VR gameplay.

4656440.name: Drum Incremental
4656440.short_description: A satisfying incremental game where every click has rhythm. Tap patterns, earn Rhythm Points, unlock new techniques, and build your ultimate setup. No music experience needed — just the urge to keep going.

4430020.name: Hamsteria
4430020.short_description: Hamsteria is a difficult 2-player co-op game where you play as two hamsters in attached wheels. Online co-op, local co-op, and single-player are all supported!

4957840.name: Team Fortress 2: VR Mod Dedicated Server

4788460.name: Affictionate
4788460.short_description: After a year of bad dates and failed job applications, you've nearly given up on the love story you've always written about. One night, you write your perfect man into a notebook... the next day, he becomes a reality. A romance visual novel about identity and the line between fiction and reality.
publishers: Just a single guy publishing this game

3812940.name: Shadow Warren
3812940.short_description: You are a stranger, cast into the darkness of ancient mysteries. As a rabbit, you wander a world where nightmares lurk and rituals are part of an unfathomable game. Survive and follow the voice’s call—but remember: the true will of these powers is forever beyond your understanding.

5465460.name: Crossroads: Forgotten Paths Demo
5465460.short_description: A light-hearted adventure that whisks you around the micro-fantasy land of Bargvia, join The Mages guild, meet The First Mage, explore The Undercroft, engage with colourful locals and grind in enemy-filled Micro-Dungeons.

3172750.name: It Came From Above Us
3172750.short_description: Explore a future Tokyo where cosmic mysteries collide with human fate in the visual novel It Came From Above Us. Follow Rei, a curious high school student, and Mio, an enigmatic scientist, as they uncover a secret that will change humanity forever...

2269410.name: PROFOUND
2269410.short_description: A quirky action RPG made by only one person. Collect gold & loot. Upgrade weapons and armor. Kill enemies and level up your skills.

2907670.name: DR. MATBEN
2907670.short_description: DR. MATBEN is an action-platformer roguelite where you customize your Modgun, explore simulations of your memories, and battle a rogue AI whose plan to save humanity could destroy it.

4131390.name: Exil Island
4131390.short_description: A top-down 2D survival shooter with base building and crafting. Explore procedurally generated islands, secure resources, and defend—or raid—player bases in tense online PvP. Every run reshapes routes, chokepoints, and risk.

5283510.name: Junkyard Astronauts Demo
5283510.short_description: Scavenge a junkyard at night, weld the scrap into a rocket and press the big red button. Get it to space, 100 km up, before the shift ends. Free demo: the whole yard, all four robots and online co-op for 1–4, Mac and PC together.

5363180.name: Tinselwood
5363180.short_description: Build your perfect Christmas town set in a snowy valley. Lay out the homes, markets, and workshops and let the elves do the rest. No budgets, no timers and no way to lose: just lanes, lights, falling snow and Christmas magic.

5387330.name: Smash & Stash
5387330.short_description: Slam the table. Flip the caps. See what you got. A retro 90s collect-'em-all idle game where every pack is a small thrill, every dollar makes your slam hit harder, and a stranger in a long coat keeps leaving new catalogs on your desk.

3503770.name: Meatmare
3503770.short_description: A small meatball shop… Just an ordinary night… Customers come in, place their orders, and you go about your work as usual. But as time passes, you start to feel that something isn't quite right. Small, seemingly insignificant details gradually become more and more unsettling.

5353190.name: Minesweeper: Find All the Bombs in the Minefield
5353190.short_description: Minesweeper goes big. In Find the Bombs, up to 4 players clear a giant minefield together, dig up every mine they flag, conquer guarded bases and fill them with coloured bombs. Or go head to head in ranked 1v1 duels on the same board, or take on the solo Race, where one mistake ends your run.

5378360.name: Futbolero: Football Career Simulator Demo
5378360.short_description: Try Futbolero for free: 1 vs 1 Express Ranked against real people, a whole career in 3 minutes in Quick Mode, the Express career up to age 25 and the Legend mode beta, starting at age 8 in your neighbourhood. Your progress carries over to the full game.

1054190.name: Parkour Bot
1054190.short_description: Parkour Bot is a fast paced, rhythm based, physics platform game, with an unique movement set of main character. Show your skills and get a lot of achievements in 100 dynamic levels.

4975290.name: TEXAS DOMINOES
4975290.short_description: Play classic All Fives dominoes with a Texas twist. Score in multiples of five, control the Spinner, draw from the Boneyard, or block the game.  Play against friends or solo.  Relive your best rounds with game replays, stats, and badges.

2841710.name: Vermin
2841710.short_description: Vermin is a first-person survival horror game about hunting, feeding the heart, and dreaming of death. Trap and hunt mutated creatures, explore a forest in the 1980s soviet union, gather items, craft traps, mutate yourself and maybe... the heart will finally let you die.

3832030.name: BOOST VECTOR EX
3832030.short_description: RUN FAST. Faster than any other. Take control of a Vector Master and sprint in uncompromising pure parkour racing. Hone your style with responsive, flowing controls and break limits in the Premier Vector World Cup. The race, your friends, and victory beckon your arrival... Did I mention it was fast?

4880310.name: Black Hollow
4880310.short_description: Become the doctor the plague fears. Battle infected hordes solo or in up to four-player online co-op in this first-person dark fantasy roguelite. Harvest ichor, unleash volatile alchemy, and forge monstrous builds across four haunted hunting grounds.

5260360.name: Blind Man's Buff Demo
5260360.short_description: An asymmetric online hide-and-seek party game. The hunter is completely blind — sound is the only light in his world. Hide, stay still, never make a noise. Play with friends over the internet or hunt bots alone. 2–20 players.

4876810.name: of MER and MAID
4876810.short_description: Vacuum and mop your way through a world of tyrannical oligarchs and ancient gods as either a mermaid, a demon, a ghost witch, or a dryad. But when a cabal of cultists threatens all, you will need to switch the mop for weapons and spells and embark on tactical turn-based missions to even the odds.

4815540.name: 1930: Tinta & Balas
4815540.short_description: A first-person game of 21 where losing can cost you a bullet. Use items to bend the rules, risk drawing blessed or cursed cards, and face bizarre opponents in a world inspired by 1930s cartoons. Lose all your lives and start over.

5387420.name: Smash & Stash Demo
5387420.short_description: Try the opening of Smash & Stash: slam face-down caps, flip them over, fill your first sets and face the first rivals who come knocking. About an hour of play, and everything you collect carries over to the full game.

5357350.name: Address The Mess
5357350.short_description: Address The Mess is a single-player narrative sim. Clean up the scattered post, use magic, solve puzzles, find props and assemble furniture. Unlock & use magic spells and be unstoppable, or relax and enjoy the narrative sim at your own pace, with a spirit doggo, cat and your friendly mail pigeon.

4678630.name: Scape
4678630.short_description: Scape is a growing platform of multiplayer games. It begins with Gravity: a vertical platformer where you climb alongside up to 100 players in the same broken world at once, with no checkpoints or health bars, just physics and consequence. Reaching the top is not the end.

5326580.name: Stay Extinct
5326580.short_description: The wall was built to keep something in. On a sealed dinosaur island only the hunters are infected: raptors, a T-rex and diving pterosaurs stalk the healthy herds, and you. Build and electrify a base, explore the tunnels below, alone or in 4-player online co-op. First-person retro survival horror.

4993670.name: BattleDirector
4993670.short_description: BattleDirector is an automated broadcast director for sim racing leagues. It reads live telemetry to find the best battles, directs the cameras, and commentates live. Built for league operators running a broadcast PC; for solo drivers it only works in iRacing.

4592470.name: GUTSPILL
4592470.short_description: GUTSPILL is a brutal horror game where you use a hammer and kicks to destroy and cannibalize your enemies using the environment to your advantage. Survive a descent into madness where everything becomes increasingly surreal and visceral.

4179990.name: Agromatic
4179990.short_description: A farming and automation game where your automation is people. Hire workers, pay their salaries, build their houses, and lay out your farms and factories like a town. Produce and sell valuable goods to keep your business profitable. This isn't colony survival, it's running a company.

5296770.name: MaMills Demo
5296770.short_description: Try MaMills free for Steam Next Fest: a cozy 3D four-in-a-row where gravity stacks your cylinders on a 4×4 grid of sticks. Play the Machine on 3 levels, 10 matches each, then face one Grandmaster match on Expert. Hotseat, Beginner Puzzles, the tutorial and our first theme, Halloween, are in.

4972030.name: Initials: END
4972030.short_description: Initials: END is Roguelite card game with massive replayability. Modify the game with augments and cartridges to decide how you want to play and complete amazing combos.

5408940.name: Crew Out
5408940.short_description: Crew Out is a chaotic 1–4 player co-op adventure where you and your friends manage a ship together. Sail across the ocean, explore islands, gather resources, craft, cook, and fight dangerous enemies. When everything goes wrong, teamwork is your only way out!

4252500.name: Agromatic Demo
4252500.short_description: Automated farming sim where specialized workers handle all tasks while you focus on strategic decisions. Design efficient layouts, manage supply chains across zones, and optimize your growing operation.

5337650.name: Cat Knit
5337650.short_description: A warm and cozy desktop cat companion that works alongside you. Every time you press a key or click, your cat will knit in the background. Stay productive and earn bells. Decorate, customize your cat and personal space with cozy furniture, decorations and more.

4597660.name: Outer Rangers
4597660.short_description: Like all cowboys, space wranglers get into a bar fight every now and then. Settle things honorably with your lasso. Or your boot. Or, honestly, whatever else you can find.

5488700.name: SketchBrawl Demo
5488700.short_description: Free demo of Sketchbrawl, an auto-battler: draft squads, deploy them on the grid and watch hundreds of units clash on their own. Play the full Arena with 3 of the 6 factions and face all six as opponents.

2729180.name: Neboslav
2729180.short_description: Fly through a strange dream where you fight, destroy, complete questionable quests, and collect items to become absurdly powerful... and maybe uncover what it all means.

5003580.name: Beneath Eden
5003580.short_description: Build a life and claim your place in a vast medieval fantasy world where prosperity must be earned, journeys carefully planned, and winters endured. This world is called Eden. But its name is not a promise. It is a secret that may only be uncovered by your descendants.

3223030.name: RUIN: Beast City
3223030.short_description: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

4614060.name: Exium: Theia
4614060.short_description: A solo-developed, old-school open-world sci-fi RPG. Explore the hostile world of Theia, complete quests, scavenge for weapons and supplies, survive dangerous creatures and factions, and uncover the secrets of an ancient civilization.

5367790.name: STEEL WING: WEAVEBREAKER
5367790.short_description: In 2091, the military AI network Weave seized the sky, the land and the sea. Three pilots fly three unique fighters, each fighting in real time on their own lane. Back aboard the mothership, they share the days beyond the battlefield, and every choice you make shapes who flies by your side.

4588650.name: Castle of the Zephyr
4588650.short_description: Castle of the Zephyr is a spiritual remake of the classic roguelike Castle of the Winds. Explore procedurally generated dungeons and hand-crafted ruins, master spellbook magic, manage weight-and-bulk inventory, build your classless hero, and race against time to stop an ancient evil from awakening.

5332650.name: . . kill ´em all ! Demo
5332650.short_description: A dark psychological FPS that pulls the protagonist through a hostile industrial maze of close-quarters combat and stalking patrols, guided by an AI whose influence blurs the lines between help, manipulation, and truth.

4967770.name: Fast Point
4967770.short_description: Fast Point is a pickup point business simulator where you start with a small location, a few shelves, and your first customers. Receive deliveries, organize packages in storage, hand out orders, process returns, and make sure the queue doesn't turn into chaos.

4386090.name: How To Destroy A City
4386090.short_description: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

5459020.name: Profile Pack 1 – Sakura
5459020.short_description: 18 animated cosmetics for your Dub Together profile, most of them inspired by Japanese art: 8 nameplates for your lobby row, 4 profile motifs and 6 avatar frames.

3078030.name: Warbound
3078030.short_description:
Build a battlefield that evolves from Stone age battles into futuristic mechanised warfare.
Demo is LIVE

2659170.name: Shadow Pulse
2659170.short_description:
Face terrifying monsters and evade deadly traps in the 2.5D survival horror Shadow Pulse!
Your resources are limited. Madness and death lurk at every step.
Will you uncover the secrets of this post-apocalyptic world?

4312190.name: CRACK
4312190.short_description: Why is there a giant egg in this lab? Your job is simple: crack it open. Don't ask questions. CRACK is a 1-4 player co-op incremental adventure about uncovering what's inside a mysterious giant egg.

5433350.name: Exevia
5433350.short_description: Exevia is a story-driven adult visual novel focused on delivering a cinematic experience with rich world building. The game contains humor, action, sex, romance, horror and drama. Unravel the mysteries of a once mighty empire while meeting multiple love interests along the way.

4357320.name: Above Par
4357320.short_description: Above Par is a physics-based precision platformer about climbing high and falling hard. Master a 4-club toolkit, calculate your trajectories, and get ready to fall... a lot.

4586810.name: The Concrete Sutra #1
4586810.short_description:
A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike.

The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

5207770.name: Seperated!
5207770.short_description: You and your friends have been given a mission to retrieve a giant golden apple from the planet's World Tree! You must climb structures and dodge obstacles to reach the golden apple!

1757100.name: Curse Of Gutterdeep
1757100.short_description: Slaughter your way through hordes of enemies. Fight alone, or with up to 4 players co-op. Complete dungeons and other missions to earn your place next to the king's throne. Upgrade your gear with the loot you bring from the missions, if you make it back that is...

4121650.name: Rite of Osiris
4121650.short_description: Something is hunting you in the dark. Descend into buried Egyptian tombs in a first-person psychological survival horror, where your only light is a dwindling candle and your only hope is whatever scraps you can scavenge and craft before it finds you.

5222230.name: CUBE - The 125 Chambers -
5222230.short_description:
You wake up in a surreal structure composed of identical cube-shaped rooms. 
Deadly traps lie in wait, and mysterious numbers are etched into the walls. 
Navigate through a 5x5x5 labyrinth of 125 chambers, solve the mystery, and find a way out alive in this grid-based psychological escape thriller.

4056390.name: 魔法少女ゆーしゃちゃんと淫獄の迷宮 Demo
4056390.short_description:
Everyone's favorite idol "Yusha-chan" stars in a new turn-based roguelike!
Conquer deep dungeons, grow stronger, and seize victory, or taste a brutal defeat! Guide Yusha-chan, brought to life with fluid Live2D animations, to her destiny. Streamers welcome!

5295570.name: CultGame Alpha Demo
5295570.short_description: Create your own cult, perform forbidden rituals, and crusade against the filthy non-believers. It's time to play god. CultGame is a cult simulator RPG where you start your own cult in a procedurally generated fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

4859970.name: Morning Vale
4859970.short_description: Welcome to Morning Vale, a colorful open-world life sandbox full of places to explore and opportunities to discover. Earn money, make friends, buy your own home, and build a life your way. Enjoy the peace of a small town—or break the rules and see what happens.

5327970.name: Under Investigation
5327970.short_description: Explore the police station to find anomalies. Investigate them to determine if they are real anomalies or simply unstable phenomena.

4909230.name: VERAKORIA
4909230.short_description: Choose your race and class, create a unique build, and battle relentless hordes in VERAKORIA. Collect experience, unlock powerful upgrades, defeat deadly bosses, and survive the escalating onslaught in this pixel-art action roguelite.

4363050.name: Erehwon Demo
4363050.short_description: The gear you acquire completely transforms your party’s roles. Erehwon is a loot-driven dungeon crawler where you progress by reshaping your builds around the gear you find.

4690620.name: Most Scuffed Golf
4690620.short_description:
Tired of the same old mini-golf courses?
In Most Scuffed Golf, you and up to 3 friends build a course that’s entirely your own!
Complete with windmills, ramps, funnels, and the occasional visit from a whale.
The longer the round goes on, the bigger and more chaotic the course gets.

5340240.name: AURORA REQUIEM
5340240.short_description: Year 41 without the sun. Inside the skeleton of a colossal sea creature, the lighthouses burn memories for light. A late-90s-style JRPG with pre-rendered backdrops, three discs, time-gauge battles and a mechanic with a giant wrench who always keeps his word.

4604830.name: Exit Error
4604830.short_description: In this game, if you die, instead of starting over, you move on to the next level. Or something like that.

4234110.name: Silent Numbers
4234110.short_description:
Uncover the past. Rethink the present.
Explore a promising facility that has fallen to ruin, solve puzzles, and uncover memories that make you question what you know. Find a way out while an unknown presence in your mind urges you to act.

4947000.name: Idle Minertia
4947000.short_description:
Idle Minertia is an idle mining game where you dig through caves automatically. Combine mining tools and Enchants to go ever deeper.

Build strategic synergies or steadily collect permanent rewards. Beyond that, 10+ kinds of content await.

A relaxing idle experience, every day.

5409870.name: Everything Must Go! Demo
5409870.short_description: Four broke thieves. One supermarket. One thousand items. Race your friends to steal, sell, and upgrade — then throw groceries at each other until only one thief walks away rich. 4-player online party chaos. Keyboard & mouse.

4794250.name: My Deskmate Douki Cyan
4794250.short_description: Your favorite deskmate is closer than ever. Follow Douki-Cyan through work, workouts, coffee breaks, and lazy afternoons as you experience her daily life from different perspectives. Cute moments, charming expressions, and heartwarming interactions await with your beloved deskmate.

5480070.name: Heroes of Underhollow
5480070.short_description: Descend into Underhollow, a turn-based tactical roguelike where the battlefield is your weapon. Ignite oil, electrify water, and shove enemies into hazards. Choose from three heroes, shape your build, and chart a dangerous route through four dungeon floors.

5286630.name: Padlova Street
5286630.short_description: Guide Kapo through an acid-soaked apocalypse of deadly traps, crawling foes and flying enemies. Padlova Street is a hardcore 2D platformer: time your jumps, risk it for stars and beat your best time. Learn the route with checkpoints in Light or climb the leaderboard in Hardcore.

4512340.name: Headshot Holdout
4512340.short_description: BLAST NAZI ZOMBIE HEADS (with friends)! Headshot Holdout is a retro, roguelite, FPS where squads of 1-4 start with only a rifle and build into zombie killing machines.  There are no automatic weapons and no bullet sponge enemies. Strategy and accuracy are key.

4644400.name: Unstable Nuclear Reactor
4644400.short_description: An incremental hex-puzzle roguelite game where you merge atoms into higher elements, trigger massive chain combos, earn radioactive coins, and manage your ring capacity to survive as long as possible.

4720160.name: CHIP & THE RED STORM
4720160.short_description: Run as fast as you can through this fast-paced 2D side-scrolling platformer! Deal with wacky enemies and bosses covering every track of your path. Sit down by yourself or with friends in this pixel 80's-90's inspired indie game and seal your decided fate of their world.

4048580.name: Crowd
4048580.short_description: Engage with 1-8 players in a fun and fast paced party game! Be the best Actor, by completing daily Tasks and try not to get caught. Every decision matters, so, try to be smarter than your enemies, blending into this NPCs Crowd!

3471750.name: Kitaria Fables 2
3471750.short_description: Team up with new heroes Alice and Dusty as they embark on an epic adventure across the mysterious Arkadera Peninsula. Develop unique combat skills, gather precious materials, forge powerful items, and tend to your growing farm, either alone or with a friend!

4763700.name: Kagenazo
4763700.short_description: Kagenazo is a 3D shadow puzzle game where you build cube shapes, rotate them, and match their silhouettes from multiple angles. Solve over 190 puzzles across 2x2x2, 3x3x3, and 4x4x4 cubes while chasing cleaner solutions, faster times, and higher star ratings.

3716020.name: Boom Cube Demo
3716020.short_description: Break away from traditional 2D Tetris. Control axis-based blocks in a 10×10×10 cubic space, clear lines by filling full rows or columns, and experience the all-new thrill of 3D block elimination.

4184130.name: Foxy Dumplings
4184130.short_description: In Foxy Dumplings, you’ll run your own food truck and make friends along the way. Cook dumplings from all over the world, take good care of your clients, and discover how a meal can mend more than just hunger in this cozy cooking sim. Rise to the top of Foxtagram, one heartfelt dish at a time.

3733710.name: FIRESTARTERS
3733710.short_description: As a convicted criminal in the brutal future of this lightning-paced arcade movement FPS, a government-sanctioned bloodsport is your only hope of redemption. Strategize, skate, shoot, and slay against a gauntlet of genocidal androids for the chance to win your freedom.

4942630.name: FleetForge
4942630.short_description: Your navy has lost the war at sea and your warship is stranded behind enemy lines. Build her cell by cell, fight in pausable real-time battles, and take what you need from the ships you beat. A roguelike shipbuilder for fans of FTL, Void War, Cosmoteer and RimWorld.

5437080.name: Demon Expulsion
5437080.short_description: A short horror game. It looks like a nightmare, but it is not. This is a demon expulsion.

4965470.name: Crownmarked
4965470.short_description: Rebuild a fallen kingdom, raise citizens into adventurers and fight beside powerful companions in Crownmarked: a kingdom-building action RPG set in a fractured fantasy world trapped in an endless cycle of destruction and rebirth.

1110760.name: Causality: Antopolia
1110760.short_description: Survive a collapsing totalitarian regime in this story-rich dystopian RPG. Explore a brutalist semi-open world, master tactical first-person combat, and make critical choices. Shape the fate of the country and your own.

3893290.name: 只狗：路边一条Stray Dog: nobody cares
3893290.short_description: Bark Souls? Sekiinu: stray die once! A stray dog saved by a disgraced knight marches to rescue its captured master. Scorned by all as useless roadside trash, it grips his frayed sword in its jaws and ventures forth.

3996190.name: Project: Haste Demo
3996190.short_description: Project: Haste is a first-person multiplayer parkour arena shooter on skates, where skill, style, and speed reign supreme. After hours, skaters hijack civil spaces using 2000s-inspired tech to wall run, double jump, and power slide through newly created chaos playgrounds.

3146020.name: Resprite
3146020.short_description: Resprite is a professional pixel art and sprite animation tool designed for flexible, efficient workflows and continuous iteration.

5188420.name: Synapse Grid Demo
5188420.short_description: Free beta of Synapse Grid: your trail is the arena. 8 missions, arena vs AI, Steam online and local split-screen. 1.89.0 live: Ring Circuit start is clean, Vantablack at 60, QUICK MATCH finds a host. SPACE opens the bug camera; SAVE sends the report to us.

5320500.name: Task Bar Dungeons
5320500.short_description: A new dark-fantasy Task Bar idle RPG. Six heroes, twelve specializations and hordes that fight back — right in the corner of your screen while you work. Loot, upgrade, rebirth. Free to play, with Steam Community Market trading planned after launch.

3431190.name: Galactic Realms: Quest for the Forgotten
3431190.short_description: Magic meets forgotten tech in a first-person, 1-4 player co-op PvE-only extraction RPG and dungeon crawler. Descend into handcrafted, ever-changing dungeons, risk what you bring, claim rare loot, and extract to keep what you earn. No pay-to-win. No microtransactions.

5491130.name: Cards: Tidy Up! Demo
5491130.short_description: Tidy up a room full of scattered playing cards into neatly completed decks. Sort by theme, suit, and rank in this relaxing first-person tidy-up game. Earn upgrades, discover helpful machines for automation, and find your own satisfying way to clear the table.

5388550.name: Everything Grows Here
5388550.short_description: Run a plant store on an alien moon that may or may not be alive. Harvest wild flora, grow and care for strange plants, and sell them to your friendly neighbors. Just don't think about why the soil has a heartbeat.

5301360.name: Horror Game Creator Demo
5301360.short_description: Build your own nightmare in Horror Game Creator! Design eerie environments, place enemies, add jump scares, and give players a chance to fight back. This demo includes limited content, with additional items available in the full version.

4907590.name: FEED ME MORE BRAINS Demo
4907590.short_description:
The demo of FEED ME MORE BRAINS, a silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains.
Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

5069450.name: Pickpocket Demo
5069450.short_description: Pickpocket is an incremental game about stealing. Learn from your victims, get better loot, and advance through an extensive skill tree. Build your own crime empire!

4298990.name: DEATHMOON Demo
4298990.short_description: A brutal first-person roguelike shooter with fluid combat, responsive movement, and endless build possibilities.

4383890.name: HuntinBuddies Demo
4383890.short_description:
DEMO : You get to play THREE NIGHTS in the forest !

1-4 player online HORROR COMEDY HUNTING game. Hunt wildlife to fulfill objectives, drag massive carcasses with your friends, and evade the creatures that begin hunting you back.

4440630.name: Sweepcremental Demo
4440630.short_description: minesweeper, but with a skill tree.

3629520.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD Free to Play
3629520.short_description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

2877140.name: Solarpunk Tactics
2877140.short_description: Solarpunk Tactics is a tactical card game set in the fractured world of Lumnia. Build your deck, warp time, and outplay your rival in 1v1 battles with no-RNG. Play a narrative-driven campaign or join multiplayer leagues that shape the evolution of the game.

1117860.name: Darkest Dungeon©: The Butcher's Circus
1117860.short_description: The Circus is in town, and the Butcher demands a show! Assemble teams of 4 heroes and compete in the ring in brutal, unforgiving PvP combat against friend and foe. Climb the ranks and show off your prestige while blowing off steam while taking a break from assaulting the Darkest Dungeon below.

644320.name: Halfquake Trilogy
644320.short_description: Welcome to Halfquake, a collection of three Half-Life modifications. You are here to die.

5342720.name: ENROQUIA
5342720.short_description: Chess in a 3D club room. James, your coach, tests you, gives you lessons, and comments on your games. The Academy adapts to your level and turns your mistakes into exercises. Twenty opponents move the pieces by hand and press the clock. In 13 languages, no account needed.

5101960.name: Dungeons & Dynasties
5101960.short_description: Football Manager meets D&D. Heroes die. Dynasties rise. The realm remembers both.Lead an adventuring guild through a living realm where every fixture is a dungeon, every hero can die in it, and every season is written down.

3937740.name: Traitors Demo
3937740.short_description:
A social deduction action game set in a procedurally generated, alien-infested space station.
Repair, loot, scheme and shoot your way through each round. Find the communications room, call for help and evacuate the station before oxygen runs out!

4700290.name: Under the Elm
4700290.short_description: Inherit your grandmother's cabin and the woods she quietly guarded. Forage real mushrooms, brew the remedies she perfected, and tend a village that is slowly forgetting her. Something in the woods is taking what they remember, and only the oldest trees - and her cat - can help you bring it back.

5165990.name: What the K-Drama?!
5165990.short_description:
You were a successful CEO... until you woke up inside the makjang K-drama you once dismissed!
Become chaebol heir ‘Lee Segye,’ win both love and the chairman’s seat,
and turn this 14-episode whirlwind of birth secrets and conspiracies into the perfect happy ending!

5076510.name: モンむすラッシュ
5076510.short_description: Gather Monmusu, train them, and battle! Combine Monmusu and learn skills to build the strongest team! In the asynchronous PvP mode Auto Battle Rush, you can also challenge teams registered by other players!

5104690.name: Longjuice Squeeze Demo
5104690.short_description: Shoot, parry, and slash your way to self-awareness in the Longjuice Squeeze demo, a roguelite fighting game where the winner steals gear from the loser. Get a taste of the full game's billions of builds in single-player, local, or online duels with rollback netcode.

2891790.name: Traitors
2891790.short_description:
A social deduction action game set in a procedurally generated, alien-infested space station.
Repair, loot, scheme and shoot your way through each round. Find the communications room, call for help and evacuate the station before oxygen runs out!

3780970.name: Killer Aces Volleyball
3780970.short_description: The ultimate 6v6 indoor volleyball game! Build a powerhouse from the ground up to challenge the greatest men's and women's teams in the world!

4292000.name: ROGUE COLLECTOR
4292000.short_description: ROGUE COLLECTOR is a hex-grid tactical roguelike where you don't collect gear: you collect the Rogues. Rescue procedurally generated Rogues from dungeons, extract them in time, or lose them forever. Trade your Rogues on a live player-driven marketplace.

5469700.name: Magisword Knight
5469700.short_description: He failed the magic school. He failed the sword school. So he learned both. Magisword Knight is a casual 2.5D action RPG: chain flashy combo juggles, build your hero your way, and take on bosses that each have a mechanic of their own.

5097670.name: HorseHair
5097670.short_description: The game is waiting. The horse is grinning. The house is getting dark. Horsehair is a short point and click horror experience about retro fighting games and uncomfortable familial tensions.

5324320.name: Puzzle Peace: Cozy Jigsaw Puzzles
5324320.short_description: Free-to-play cozy jigsaw puzzles. Solve gorgeous scenes from 40 to 1,296 pieces, sort pieces into trays by edge, color or shape, and come back every day for a new Daily puzzle that everyone plays. No rush - just soft music and the click of a perfect fit on your cozy sunlit table space.

2439280.name: Clockwork Revolution
2439280.short_description:
CHANGE THE PAST. CONTROL THE FUTURE.

Alter the course of history and rewrite the future in this steampunk first-person RPG.

5455830.name: Wrong Mine
5455830.short_description: Trapped deep underground by a broken excavator, you must scavenge labyrinthine mines for parts to escape. Avoid a relentless mechanical spider with electric traps, or betray your crew to claim every reward. Will you work together to survive the dark depths, or leave them behind for the loot?

4406410.name: DARK MACHINE THE GAME
4406410.short_description: DARK MACHINE THE GAME is a team-based mecha action shooter where your custom machine evolves through three combat classes. Clash in up to 7v7 PvP or battle overwhelming hordes in PvE across destructible, ever-changing arenas.

3755560.name: Lots at Stake
3755560.short_description: Build a property development company from the ground up. Find undervalued land, negotiate acquisitions, design profitable estates, navigate planning and construction, finance your projects and sell into a changing property market where every decision affects your return.

5491000.name: EMZOMBED 3 Demo
5491000.short_description: 69 Years have passed since the events of the first 2 games. You and a ragtag group of misfits must struggle to survive zombies and bandits across many challenging levels.

5324370.name: Puzzle Peace - Cozy Critters Pack
5324370.short_description: Twenty adorable animal friends to piece together, from a sleepy bunny in a basket to red pandas at teatime. Comes with its own cozy table, a sleeping-cat centerpiece, and a gentle rainy-window soundtrack.

5451100.name: Puzzle Peace - Cozy Classics Pack
5451100.short_description: Twenty cozy scenes to piece together, from a rainy afternoon at the window to a rooftop garden at golden hour. Comes with a cozy wooden table, a flowering plant and a cup of tea, and a soft, dreamy soundtrack.

5324380.name: Puzzle Peace - Forest Hollow Pack
5324380.short_description: Twenty quiet corners of the woods to piece together, from moss and mushrooms to misty valleys and a frosted winter hollow. Comes with its own rich oak table, a mushroom-jar centerpiece, and an uplifting woodland soundtrack.

5405370.name: Intercept
5405370.short_description: INTERCEPT is a modern air combat game between arcade and simulation. Fly a two-seat fighter jet or single, dogfight enemy pilots, intercept bombers and fight through storms, day and night. Jump in with arcade handling or master full realism as the Cold War returns in 2028.

5431370.name: CATINZACO
5431370.short_description: Marveth burned and its people vanished underground. Descend floor by floor into an abandoned mine where light can't pass through walls, the dead don't rest and every Guild rank opens one more door. A dark-fantasy pixel-art action RPG. What you're looking for lies at the bottom.

3733130.name: Piecekeeper
3733130.short_description: Draft cards, build synergies, and battle through a whimsical and fun roguelike deckbuilder where combining factions creates endlessly replayable experiences.

5245340.name: Archery Pro with James Jean Trickshots Demo

5333560.name: Ribbit Racing
5333560.short_description: Ribbit Racing is a multiplayer racing game where you play as a frog on a bike. Race up to 4 players locally or 8 online. Use your tongue, your wits, and the track to win.

3258590.name: Void Dungeon
3258590.short_description: Dress up your hero and dive into chaotic co-op dungeon runs. Void Dungeon is a 2D hack & slash ARPG where you battle relentless monsters, craft powerful builds, and explore dangerous rifts solo or with up to 4 players.

5244700.name: Wyrmhold
5244700.short_description: Battle to the halls of the dragon's fortress with unique heroes. Four unique decks with distinct play styles. Block, bleed, burn and parry your way to the final boss. Die, draft, climb again.

3645540.name: Havkerman
3645540.short_description: HAVKERMAN X is an open world, post apocalyptic, first person shooter, immersive Sim. Featuring high risk / high reward gunfights, a multitude of weapons and augmentations to collect to hone your playstyle, and a branching story with quests where you can explore and decide the fate of the wasteland.

5066430.name: Sun Smith
5066430.short_description: Assist an ancient derelict technology repair itself.  Harvest power, mine ore, fabricate components, clone colonists, and research technologies.

5455430.name: Let It Snow
5455430.short_description: Grab a shovel and dig into real, deformable snow. Clear your yard scoop by scoop, sell every load to the Snow-O-Matic, upgrade your tools and uncover what winter has buried. A cozy, satisfying snow-clearing sim.

4888060.name: SkyMine Demo
4888060.short_description: Start digging, discover valuable resources, and uncover the secrets of surviving among the mines. This game combines strategy and creativity, offering an exciting experience.

4876010.name: 塔尔塔罗斯之刑 Demo
4876010.short_description: Side-scrolling 2.5D horror romance game integrated with environmental puzzle-solving mechanics. You wake up as an experiment subject stripped of all memories in an underground research prison, hunted relentlessly by vengeful modified test subjects — until you meet her...

5028380.name: The Vestige
5028380.short_description: In THE VESTIGE you play as Alex, a cyborg rebuilt by her father. Fight rogue robots with melee combat and improvised weapons, hack computers and uncover her memories. Take down the Faceless—a tyrant AI who wants to strip humanity of its free will.

4061610.name: Snemovna Demo
4061610.short_description: An absurd survival horror satire set in the Czech Parliament. Sneak through corridors, hide from politicians, and collect real campaign promises in a game full of memes, anti-humor, and bizarre buffs.

5440530.name: Quiver Story
5440530.short_description: You are the last archer of the Quiver Watch. Hold the line, charge your shot, and put down what the mountain sends before it reaches the village.

3647140.name: Food Cart Simulator
3647140.short_description: Flip, slice, fry, and bake every order by hand. Serve 20 street food recipes, from double cheeseburgers to pizza and hot dogs, set your own menu and prices, and grow a rickety old cart into a five-star street kitchen. Then spend your tips at the arcade hall.

3659190.name: TechRunners
3659190.short_description: TechRunners is an open-world 2.5D MMORPG set in the city of New Haven, where survival means climbing to the top. Start from nothing, build your empire, and take on rival TechRunners and Megacorporations. Form a crew to take control of the city or use your talents to climb the arena rankings.

3565810.name: PILED 3D CAD MULTI TOOL
3565810.short_description: Quickly create complex models then export as STEP, 3MF, STL & DXF. 3D print, CNC or laser cut your designs with over 100 generators and utilities including grids, QR, vase, terrain, puzzle, divider, text, pixel, hexagon and much more.

4989520.name: Immortal Zenith: Idle to Ascension
4989520.short_description: An MMO idle cultivation RPG grounded in unique systems and intentional randomness. Your characters meditate, break through cultivation realms, explore, master powerful techniques, collect legendary treasures, and ascend from mortal to immortal.

5302490.name: THE GODDESS TOLD ME: Steal That Loaf of Bread
5302490.short_description:
You died waiting for a train. A goddess reincarnated you as a 5 mm worker ant
with one errand: steal a 72 cm loaf of bread — the whole thing, crumb by crumb —
through a 9 mm crack, without the Human noticing you exist. That's 7,600 crumbs.
Start with one.

4791260.name: hook-kick Demo
4791260.short_description: She ate me! The indignity of this has seemingly left you immortal. Stored for safekeeping (head being so pretty and all) you team up with a couple of bones from a slain wizard and a stretchy pirate-snake named hook in this diminutive demonstration of deadline destitution (I ran out of time, forgive)

4650080.name: hook-kick
4650080.short_description: She ate me! The indignity of this has seemingly left you immortal. Stored for safekeeping (head being so pretty and all) you team up with a couple of bones from a slain wizard and a stretchy pirate-snake named hook in this kicking platformer filled with circles all the way up and down.

4858530.name: Cubersum
4858530.short_description: A cubic spaceship has crashed on a distant planet. Gather the blocks around you, build a new hull from them, and climb ever higher to return to space once again.

4301580.name: Greedy
4301580.short_description: A raccoon co-op horror extraction game for 1-8 players. Infiltrate procedural ruins, loot everything and extract the relic. Mammon, the Greed Demon, is watching… Stay away from his curse!

4935020.name: Farm Bunnies
4935020.short_description: Plant, water and grow fruits and vegetables to fulfill orders. Play with your friends or solo and customize your rabbit. Explore each seasons and discover their set of mechanics in this co-op farming party game.

5383540.name: Saju Friend
5383540.short_description: A small pixel luck cat lives in the corner of your screen. Click to crack a fortune cookie, toss coins, roll dice, check name compatibility or shake an omikuji box for a fortune slip, and collect keepsakes and outfits. For entertainment only.

4335510.name: Horses of Hoofprint Bay Demo
4335510.short_description: Horses of Hoofprint Bay is a lovingly hand-drawn 2D point and click barn buildup game. Take care of your horses, train them to build up their strength and confidence, and compete for prize money! Breed adorable foals, hire and manage staff, and build the stable of your dreams!

5141320.name: Flooball
5141320.short_description: Draw a play, then run it. Flooball is a chaotic and skillful 3v3 arcade football game where you chalk up routes on the board, snap the ball, and take direct control. Dash, dive, or hurling stun rocks at anyone who gets in your way. Online with friends via Steam.

5295080.name: Silent Frequency
5295080.short_description: One night. A dead mountain road. An abandoned radio tower where your grandfather stopped answering. All he left behind: handwritten notes, scattered frequencies and his voice on tape. Bring the tower back to life and listen closely. Something out there is listening back.

3987370.name: KAMIYOGATARI
3987370.short_description: Play as a member of the Imperial Summoner Academy's Hero class, team up with powerful summoners and spirits, and explore the world of O-Yashima, mixing Sci-Fi, fantasy and traditional Japan, in this Summoner-Action RPG featuring strategic magical battles and high speed 2D action.

4336360.name: It Wants You To Stay
