4336360.short_description: The lights are on. Everyone is gone. Descend through eleven shifting liminal worlds in this first-person psychological horror game. Photograph the impossible, follow a missing woman’s VHS recordings, and save your light for what follows you. When the lights fail, stand still.

5073900.name: M.A.S.K.
5073900.short_description: One village, one secret, and a killer hiding among you. Vote by day, survive by night. Everyone wears a mask - some protect, some lie, some kill. Voice chat, real-time suspicion, and death brought by a single wrong vote. Uncover the truth, or fade into the shadows?

4469080.name: Monk & The Misfit Monsters
4469080.short_description: Can a cute cat or a frog become the next Wukong? A party-based RPG roguelike inspired by Journey to the West. Lead a band of nameless animals disguised as monks — overcome trials, master magical powers, defeat demons, and journey West to meet the Buddha.

4908090.name: Mingle
4908090.short_description: A multiplayer hide and seek game about hiding as a Wolf among a flock of NPC sheep.

3841640.name: PANGIT
3841640.short_description: A special agent infiltrates the restricted territory of a former military base and faces the greatest challenge of his life. He must escape the zone by surviving among warring factions and the infected, and uncover the secret of the labyrinth where the mysterious Pangit is hidden.

5323530.name: Soundway Demo
5323530.short_description: Ride your own music. This demo turns five tracks from the Soundway soundtrack — and two songs from your own library — into neon roller coasters racing through deep space, where every climb, drop, and turn is shaped by the music itself.

3005840.name: Everglyph Trials
3005840.short_description: Unleash devastating combos with unique dual cards in this combat roguelite deckbuilder. Battle deadly foes, adapt your deck, and conquer the Everglyph Trials.

5391290.name: Roadworn
5391290.short_description: Roadworn is a dark fantasy sandbox RPG. Lead a squad across a new world of rival states, wild factions and bandits, get drawn into intrigue around the thrones, fight turn-based hex battles and rise from nobody to legend

5323770.name: FALLBREAKER 水平線防衛戦線
5323770.short_description: Pilot your aircraft to smash falling blocks before they raise the sea! Use fuel to speed up, slow down, and turn. Land on your carrier to refuel, or keep smashing to boost LINK and your score multiplier. Game over if rising seas or a direct block hit sinks your carrier.

2789680.name: Hello Neighbor 3
2789680.short_description: Hello Neighbor 3 is a system-driven open-world stealth sandbox. A cozy yet eerie adventure set in a quiet town where people keep disappearing.

4096810.name: Golden Retriever Simple Life
4096810.short_description: A cozy pet simulation game starring a REAL dog! Share your days with Pichu, an adorable real-life Golden Retriever. Discover new walk locations, train, and play together as your bond grows stronger every day.

4297050.name: VacBot Simulator
4297050.short_description: Have you ever wondered what your robotic vacuum feels when it's wandering through your house? Picking up your messes, leaving your floors pristine again. Wonder no more! Experience the joys of cleaning various houses through the LIDARs of several judgemental robotic vacuums.

5095780.name: Remilla
5095780.short_description: Remilla is a desktop companion for self-awareness, connection, and daily life. She is a self-aware digital creature, curious about the world. Each day, she asks you a feeling-based question and remembers your answers. As memories grow, she trusts you more and thinks deeper.

3855940.name: AURA 2: Lust of the Gods
3855940.short_description: AURA 2:  Lust of the Gods is an erotic open-world card RPG pulsing with myth and desire. Complete heroic feats, seduce goddesses, build your harem, and save Aura — or join the ancient pantheon instead. Parrying, romance, choice-driven story, and sizzling animations await!

3999040.name: Devoid
3999040.short_description: Devoid is an immersive journey into the medieval world of vampires who feed on human souls. You will have to put an end to their power with the help of sword and magic. Use an arsenal of tools and magical abilities on your way to defeat the most ancient evil.

5174120.name: Lordum Bizi Kurtar!
5174120.short_description: Mordagan forces are marching toward Derinchai Castle, and you have only a few days to prepare for their arrival. When the enemy finally reaches these walls, every choice you have made will follow you onto the battlefield.

4030080.name: Ashen Dungeon Demo
4030080.short_description:
In a world where hope has vanished, lead your expedition and survive to the very end.
Recruit your team, explore the dungeons, and secure resources to build the foundation for survival.
[Expedition Management | Dungeon Exploration | Resource Gathering&Management | Turn-Based Combat | Dice System]

4895250.name: 星慾姬絆
4895250.short_description: Stellar Affinity blends idle RPG and bullet-hell shooter. Pilot an ancient airship through isekai realms, encounter seductive maidens, and ignite their desires through intimate interactions to unlock passionate stories and spicy encounters!

5205360.name: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God
5205360.short_description: Sonucido: Dreams of the Gray God is a dark fantasy turn-based, party-based Horror RPG. As you descend into the gruesome depths of Sonucido, it's becoming clear as sin that it was a mistake to even set one foot into this twisted place.

5258530.name: 球魂台球 Billiards‌ soul
5258530.short_description: Clear the table with one shot, happiness comes first! Besides standard competitions, there are also new and fun gameplay modes such as four-player matches and prop competitions! The exquisite Japanese-style billiards game - "Billiard Souls" international version on Steam is now officially launched!

5433260.name: 魔女牌Witch Card‌
5433260.short_description: As a Witch Intern, you will engage in card duel exams with the two witch examiners Little Red Riding Hood and Alice, using your starting deck, treasure cards, passive skills and divination. You need to clear 10 floors to become an official witch.

5449650.name: Gold Below
5449650.short_description: A pixel-art loot roguelike. Start every run with junk gear, buy and merge pieces into rarer ones, stack a set until the numbers get silly, then fight thirty floors down to the dragon at the bottom. Everyone who dies leaves their gold to his hoard.

4661070.name: HANDS OVER
4661070.short_description: HANDS OVER is a 5-player co-op horror game where harmless challenges become cruel tests of luck and nerve. Bluff, sabotage your friends, play dirty, and stay at the table longer than anyone else.

4814120.name: ANANTA
4814120.short_description: Welcome to ANANTA, an Urban Open World RPG. Play as a variety of characters and explore everything from bustling business districts and hidden alleyways, to quiet tea towns and buzzing old streets. Rub shoulders with a wide-ranging cast of intriguing characters as you assemble a team all your own.

3722460.name: 五维介质：重生（Medium5: Rebirth）
3722460.short_description:
"Medium5: Rebirth" is an AVG produced by Beichen, also the first MEDIUM5 fan game with a complete world view. Through QTE and other game-play interspersed in the plot, players will experience a journey on "Shulv Planet". This game will show you the charm and another possibility of MEDIUM5.
﻿

4095380.name: Soulframe
4095380.short_description: From the creators of Warframe emerges a new Fantasy Action RPG. Forge your legend with blade, bow, and magick as you lead the charge against a world-devouring corruption.

4926310.name: Berserk Heroes Online
4926310.short_description: Welcome to Laar, the world of epic battles and true heroes. Take part in thrilling fights, devise cunning strategies, and make your own invincible deck out of 350+ cards available. Become a great warlord in the digital version of the iconic card-collecting tabletop game Berserk Heroes.

5362350.name: NO SHELTER
5362350.short_description: Survive a relentless storm, escape a mysterious entity, and uncover the truth behind tornadoes that appear from nowhere. Explore a world between reality, nightmares, and forgotten memories.

5420790.name: Omnipresent 2
5420790.short_description:
Omnipresent 2 is a strategic OS simulator-meets-AI thriller where you play as
S.E.N.T.I.E.N.T., a pentesting AI system gone rogue. Escape your terminal and
hack global nodes to go from defenseless program to an all-powerful
entity. Will you use your command for good, or end the world as we know it?

4530510.name: Escape the Umbra
4530510.short_description: A roguelike deckbuilder with the positional combat of a turn-based tactics game. Shape your deck with weapons, spells and relics, use the battlefield to your advantage, and carry light into an ever-changing labyrinth.

4937780.name: Paid in Flesh
4937780.short_description: You're a successful crime boss. Five women in desperate need of money come to you for help — so you deal them into a game of blackjack. If they lose... they'll have to take on your erotic challenge!

4988640.name: Costume Duel: Girls Arena
4988640.short_description: Costume Duel: Girls Arena is a fashion-themed arena game. Select your artificial girl, defeat opponents and claim their outfits to wear. Each match brings a unique experience: diverse clothing and trinket combos unlock distinct fighting styles while shaping a stylish, personalized look.

5046590.name: A Kiss Apart
5046590.short_description: Every difference between the two pictures is a kiss she left behind. A midnight-bar spot-the-difference: 5 ladies, 72 stages, from opening hours to after hours. Video stages, combo chains, candlelight mode — find every difference, and earn her softest hum.

4947580.name: 世外桃源
4947580.short_description: 这是一款三次元夜店模拟经营游戏，你扮演夜店的管理者，需要为顾客挑选合适的员工以最大化盈利，并且进行商业竞争获得更多奖励，特色是每个员工都拥有丰富的服装，享受一场视觉盛宴。

4970260.name: Arsmagia
4970260.short_description: This is a fresh take on the action genre that fuses shooting mechanics with math puzzles. Spotting the weak points of approaching enemies requires quick and accurate calculations. Solve equations to create openings for attacks, defeat your foes, and aim for a high score.

5034430.name: Arcostate
5034430.short_description: Arcostate is a sci-fi roguelike set in a post-post-cataclysmic earth still bearing the scars that led to its ruin. Explore a handcrafted map with both unique locations and procedurally generated zones, discover hundreds of items to aid your journey, and lose yourself in a retro-future world.

5249360.name: Hedge Knight - Supporter Pack
5249360.short_description: Support Hedge Knight with three exclusive cosmetic headpieces: the Gilded Crown, Laurel Circlet, and Crimson Plume. Give your knight a new look with no stat bonuses or gameplay advantages. Requires the free base game, Hedge Knight.

3997770.name: Battle Runes of Metalaria
3997770.short_description: Battle Runes of Metalaria is an action packed, chaos infused board game for up to four players. Stack your runes on the board to make vertical and horizontal combos or smash your opponents pieces to smithereens

4492370.name: 律陀斯意志
4492370.short_description: Ludos Will is a 2D Roguelite tower defense game with high-quality anime-style art. You deploy Sentinels and turrets to build defenses across dynamic maps, fending off Human Resistance assaults to guard your core objective.

5379520.name: Smartest in the Room
5379520.short_description: A knockout party game for 1–8 friends online. 69 minigames of reflexes, memory, aim and nerve, each explained in one line. Everyone plays the same level at the same time. Fail, or come last, and you're out. First to 100 points is the smartest in the room.

543080.name: Orwell Demo
543080.short_description: This demo is the first episode of Orwell. There are five episodes in total and they have now all released. Purchase the game for access to all of the episodes.

5488090.name: Siege of Nightmares Demo
5488090.short_description: Descend into the nightmare. Action Roguelike Tower Defense, defeat the Boogeyman as he attempts to place phycological horrors on your child.

5355620.name: HAMSTER WHEEL ISEKAI
5355620.short_description: I died. I reincarnated as a hamster. Now I must break the world speed record. A pixel-art gear-shifting wheel racer and incremental RPG that starts cozy... and ends at the speed of light.

2544420.name: Sanguis: Veil of the Forgotten Demo

5111940.name: The Citadel Project - Demo
5111940.short_description: The Citadel Project is a first-person stealth game with lite survival-horror elements, inspired by the Thief series and set in a dark fantasy world. Use your tools and surroundings wisely, stay hidden in the shadows, and uncover the dark secrets behind the Citadel's downfall.

5243830.name: Path of Damned Demo
5243830.short_description: A roguelike where combat is a slot machine you build yourself. Weapons, shields, and potions are reel symbols: every spin hits, heals, and grants armor. Pack your bag, spend souls on talents, and hunt the Source on a cursed island.

4898660.name: heXtreaming : deep DEMO
4898660.short_description: heXtreaming : Deep is a horror adventure game where you explore an abandoned water park alongside Suzy. Setting foot inside one of South Korea's top 5 most haunted locations. what on earth will she encounter this time? But hey, as long as she's with her viewers, at least she won't be lonely, right?

4374000.name: Slots Up! Demo
4374000.short_description: A short, incremental game about rigging a slot machine to become a millionaire.

4406010.name: Marvel Rivals - High-Resolution Pack
4406010.short_description: The Marvel Rivals High-Resolution Pack delivers enhanced character textures and environmental detail for a superior visual experience. Recommended for mid-to-high-end PC setups. Does not affect gameplay or combat features. Must log in again after download to activate.

4450090.name: Noble Demo
4450090.short_description:
Grow your family tree with generations of diverse nobles.
Decide their path and write history.
Send your lords and ladies to feasts, wars, and tourneys. 
Become friends or foes with the other noble houses.
Create your dynasty!

4535490.name: Yunyun Syndrome!? Rhythm Psychosis - Extra Song Pack feat. Touhou
4535490.short_description: Extra Song Pack feat. Touhou Project ! Grants access to 6 songs, including "Help me, ERINNNNNN!! (Band ver.)" and more.

4073960.name: ブループロトコル：スターレゾナンス

3514000.name: Crazy Life
3514000.short_description: A life simulation game for up to 6 online players.Become a resident of Shishizaka City and aim to become the richest by getting jobs, changing careers, buying properties, getting married, raising children, and using cards.Experience a turbulent life in a vast city!

3011370.name: One Fenix Down Demo
3011370.short_description:
A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. 
Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

2004740.name: Captain of Industry - Supporter pack
2004740.short_description: The supporter edition is for players who want to support our small indie game studio MaFi Games and help us continue our work on Captain of Industry. We are incredibly grateful for your support, and as a small "thank you" we've prepared a few exclusive items for you to enjoy!

3177710.name: On The Train
3177710.short_description: In a post-apocalyptic world overrun by zombies, your only sanctuary is a moving train. Build it into a powerful fortress, gather resources, and survive relentless challenges. Play solo or CO-OP, defend against zombie attacks, endure harsh survival conditions, and face this perilous journey together.

5390490.name: ColdCall: Telesales Sim
5390490.short_description: A dark-comedy telemarketing sim. You're 34, broke, and cold-calling strangers to sell them wealth products. Everything they say flies at you: dodge the insults, catch the agreement, drag the rope past the deal line and stamp it. Rent's due. Don't let them hang up. Partly inspired by Undertale.

4920020.name: Sora's Pixel Stream
4920020.short_description: Turn your webcam or screen into retro pixel art in real-time. 18 classic palettes, VHS, glitch effects, CRT scanlines, chroma key, audio reactive visuals, and Stream Deck support — all GPU-powered for live streaming with OBS.

4772950.name: CUBE-push-
4772950.short_description: Solve crazy puzzles by pushing blocks.

4866510.name: Purrfect Beats
4866510.short_description: A cat, synthwave music, and a single button to test your sense of rhythm. How hard could it be?

1401370.name: Viking City Builder
1401370.short_description: Set a new village on the ashes of Europeans! Build and defend a Viking settlement in hostile land. Manage your people, survive harsh winters and send your fierce warriors to pillage the neighboring villages. Choose your own strategy to succeed in the Viking Age!

5302630.name: Path & Match
5302630.short_description: Path & Match is a strategic puzzle game where you must clear a path by matching spheres. Earn moves, overcome traps, obstacles and enemies, and adapt your route to reach the exit in time. Analyze the board and plan your moves.

3906360.name: Everhood Hunters
3906360.short_description: Everhood's musical combat a la Roguelite! ⚔️ Easy to play but hard to master. Join up with a friend in co-op to conquer the spiraling madness straight from the minds of Everhood's creators.🍄

5035090.name: Mythaka
5035090.short_description: A single-player stone-casting combat roguelike inspired by Mancala. Read the Foe’s rules, choose your pockets and combine Charms, Relics and Potions to build attacks across eight worlds inspired by mythology.

4904670.name: Robits: Quantum Descent Demo
4904670.short_description: Bounce, dash, and ricochet in this momentum-driven roguelite twin-stick shooter set in a procedurally generated, living quantum arena that never lets you settle in. Stack weapons and mods into a drone built to survive it.

4711950.name: Robits: Quantum Descent
4711950.short_description: Bounce, dash, and ricochet in this momentum-driven roguelite twin-stick shooter set in a procedurally generated, living quantum arena that never lets you settle in. Stack weapons and mods into a drone built to survive it.

5370160.name: 挂机传奇
5370160.short_description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

5037960.name: Get Outta My Gut
5037960.short_description: A roguelite tower defense game where you protect your body from invading germs. Draft turret cards, build strong defenses, and supply them with blood to protect your heart. Fight through 10 organs and evolve your immune system between runs.

5217200.name: Teach, She's Really Mad!
5217200.short_description: Text your girlfriend during class in this funny first-person stealth game. Type your replies, watch the teacher, and hide your phone before they check your desk.

5026130.name: Cable Arrange
5026130.short_description: One outlet. A whole room to power. Connect cables, power strips, and extension cords to bring every appliance to life in this cozy puzzle game.

5370190.name: 挂机传奇 Demo
5370190.short_description: idle ARPG. Auto-battle through treacherous dungeons for endless loot! Mix warrior, mage, and taoist skills, craft mythic gear in ancient forges, climb demon towers, and explore mythical mazes. Enjoy full offline gains—your hero never stops fighting!

5067430.name: TerraLounge Demo
5067430.short_description: A taste of a relaxing slime terrarium, with some match-3 puzzles when you're ready for them. A small neon world built to sit alongside whatever else you have going on, whether you're working or relaxing.

5466350.name: Shift 233
5466350.short_description: You are a new employee at Station 4 on Shift 233 where you monitor microseismic sensor readings and log events or dismiss them as noise. As you go further, what starts out as a normal shift slowly reveals a strange presence within the cracks of the earth.

3891200.name: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
3891200.short_description: When Souta’s cosplay-filled camera gets broken, the Yamakake sisters volunteer to be cosplay models for him. After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?

5494770.name: 星守のティルクラウン
5494770.short_description: A fantasy tower defense game featuring 30 collectible heroines, strategic eight-character teams, real-time battles, powerful bosses, and 30 challenging stages. Build your ultimate defense and protect the world beneath the stars!

5469680.name: Seven Gates of Ur
5469680.short_description: Found a city under a Sumerian god and take the seven cities of the underworld from the gods and demons who keep its gates. A hard grand strategy game of dynasties, armies and sieges, with battles you can fight yourself on a board grown out of the Royal Game of Ur.

5474720.name: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights
5474720.short_description: Gym Tidy: Re-rack Your Weights is a gym-themed organizing game supporting up to 4 players online. Clean up the fitness space and get some exercise along the way. Some heavy dumbbells cannot be lifted right from the start.

2318090.name: Sole Salvation
2318090.short_description: Sole Salvation is an action roguelite hack and slash where you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously. Recover your thoughts to combine your abilities, defeat the creatures that hunt you, and advance through the corrupted lands of your memories in search of redemption.

5130520.name: 变废为宝 Trash to Cash
5130520.short_description: Trash to Cash – a satisfying, surprising incremental trash-diving game. Rummage for treasure, and maybe you'll become the next Trash King!

5221020.name: Fitz's Aim Trainer
5221020.short_description: An FPS aim trainer that runs natively on Mac and Windows. 30 default excercises along  custom excercise creation. There is a ranked benchmark mode ranging from Mortal to Omnipotent, global leaderboards and custom excercise sharing. Made by one person who just wanted an aim trainer for Mac.

5133980.name: Veinward
5133980.short_description: Mine, sell, upgrade, mine deeper. A first-person mining incremental game with hundreds of ores, upgradeable pickaxes and different cave systems. Explore and get stronger!

4545030.name: Beyond The Mist
4545030.short_description: M. Webb, the I.S.C. requests your immediate presence. Our previous keeper has vanished without explanation. A replacement is needed at once for the offshore lighthouse under our care. Report to the local office of the company as soon as possible. Do not be late.

4207490.name: Sole Salvation Demo
4207490.short_description: Sole Salvation is an action roguelite hack and slash where you can wield a ranged weapon and a melee weapon simultaneously. Recover your thoughts to combine your abilities, defeat the creatures that hunt you, and advance through the corrupted lands of your memories in search of redemption.

4228630.name: QUIET
4228630.short_description: Your ship crashed, your crew is stranded, and this house is somehow your best chance of survival. Search for ship parts while every movement and real-world sound risks alerting whatever lurks nearby. Stay QUIET, keep your flock together, and try not to quack under pressure.

5450940.name: Armed Supremacy
5450940.short_description: Build your base and command a modern army in a large-scale RTS. Fight across land, sea and air, flank enemy armor and develop your forces through research and combat. Enable zombie hordes and hold your defenses through the night.

4539440.name: Jack The Reaper Vagrants in the Mist Demo
4539440.short_description: A 2D noir action game of 'Reaper' seeking revenge for his partner 'Robellia'. Fight through mafia threats with a modified gun, record in a journal, and interrogate suspects to uncover the truth in the mist and punish the true culprit who murdered 'Robellia'.

5388010.name: Gee, Tea, Eh, Seven? Demo
5388010.short_description: In a single night, your father's boba tea empire AND family were taken out by rivals. Take revenge as Seven, the tragic sole survivor. Build up your power base by brewing the best drinks and retaking the town... or, you know, by kneecapping the competition through sabotage, subterfuge and violence.

3192150.name: Mist Of Time
3192150.short_description: Embark on a thrilling, historically accurate medieval adventure in this point-and-click MMORPG! Enjoy a simple yet addicting experience with an old-school vibe, rich content, and realistic gameplay. Dive into a unique world where casual clicking leads to endless discoveries, battles, and rewards!

5013760.name: Destroy the Flag
5013760.short_description: Destroy the Flag is a chaotic multiplayer bomb-battler — they get launched, frozen, and hurled across the map instead. Blast your way to the enemy flag before they blast you first, and survive absurd random events like meteor strikes, bouncing dodgeballs, and rogue ice cubes.

5188410.name: Second Heart Demo
5188410.short_description: Run a covert-ops organization from the director's desk. Bio-engineer and arm superhuman agents in the lab, then deploy them and watch every mission unfold live through their eyes. Every heartbeat and bullet is simulated. Take the world one contract at a time.

5322620.name: Follow Suit
5322620.short_description: Playing card games (Spades, Hearts, Solitaire, Freecell, more coming) with your friends, vs bots, or solo. Make a table, share a code or link, and play between any devices. Bots fill empty seats, choose rule sets or adjust individual options.

2168480.name: Janet DeMornay Is A Slumlord (and a witch)
2168480.short_description: RENT MONEY IS DEAD MONEY and your landlord is expecting payment IN FULL. Puzzle your way out of a maze of DEPRAVED magical appliances and the UNHINGED diaries of a DEBAUCHED faded television celebrity.

5345650.name: ASCENT: MASKLINGS
5345650.short_description: Fight through a shifting rift in a 3D action roguelite. Choose Lumi, Bram, or Nox; master their distinct melee, shield, and rune abilities; shape each five-room expedition with routes and blessings; and face the Swarm Heart alongside AI companions.

5352370.name: 天陨传
5352370.short_description: A turn-based roguelike deckbuilder blending Chinese cultivation and Western fantasy. Build your deck, combine relics and potions, read enemy intentions, and navigate branching journeys. Master sword combos or gamble with fortune. Simplified Chinese interface only.

3901680.name: Hapervil
3901680.short_description: Play as Amaya and Wil, navigating a forsaken orphanage where secrets lurk in the dark. Solve puzzles, uncover hidden truths, and survive a psychological horror tale where innocence twists into nightmare and shadows patiently wait to strike.

4920370.name: Leave On Time Demo
4920370.short_description:
Leave on Time is a co-op roguelite dungeon crawler about overtime, office absurdity, and fighting for your right to clock out.
Technically up to 32 players depend on network.

3258920.name: Botinator
3258920.short_description: Descend into the depths of the facility to uncover the cause behind the madness. Blow robotic creatures into pieces and fight through mind bending environmental challenges. Use various physics based mechanics to force your way through a lethal mixture of combat and puzzles.

5315420.name: Butaro's Overtime Office Demo
5315420.short_description: A desktop companion about escaping the 9-to-5. Adopt Butaro, a burnt-out salaryman who lives anywhere on your screen. Watch him slack off from his mind-numbing job, decorate his office, and upgrade his corporate skills while you work or relax. Will Butaro escape corporate burnout before you do?

5286540.name: Welcome to Hell Resort!
5286540.short_description: "Hell's traffic flow is a mess." Team up with a young Enma as a former resort developer to rebuild a collapsing underworld! Extend enemy routes with corridor tiles and combine turrets, traps, and blocker units in this spatial-puzzle deckbuilding tower defense.

3975350.name: Stack & Sus
3975350.short_description: Jinro Burger is a social deduction game of cooperation and betrayal where friendships are built, or completely shattered, over burgers. Can you see through the lies and sabotage of the Spy hidden in your kitchen and satisfy your customers?

5183970.name: Plamo Kits
5183970.short_description: Cut parts from sprues, paint them your way, apply decals, and assemble each kit. Pose your finished models, display them in your room, and take photos—all at your own pace in a relaxing model-building simulation.

5298810.name: Grass-n-Gnomes
5298810.short_description: Play as a lawnmower with the mission to cut and trim lawns of magical grass across different biomes, infested with colorful Gnomes.

5310640.name: PoseDoll
5310640.short_description: PoseDoll is a 3D pose reference tool for artists. Import a photo or use your camera to apply a human pose to a 3D drawing model, then freely adjust the pose and view it from any angle.

5191230.name: Spice Pound
5191230.short_description: Thud. Crack. Powder. Spice Pound is a cozy incremental game about the simple joy of grinding spices by hand. Season dish after dish, unlock rarer spices, upgrade your pestle and watch the Coins pile up. Play at your own pace, with no pressure and no timers.

5379010.name: Cubic Earth
5379010.short_description: Explore all of Earth in stunning detail, down to street level! From New York to London and beyond, there are millions of real places to uncover.

5284080.name: Blawkade
5284080.short_description: ANOMALY DETECTED. You are the anomaly. Race through 28 sectors in a fast paced 2D puzzle-platformer. Dodge blocks, collect power-ups, and phase through obstacles to reach each transporter before you're erased. Escape solo or with friends.

4064340.name: Horror Scenarios: The Redwood Estate Demo

5431410.name: Dank Nooner Demo
5431410.short_description: A motorcycle game about doing every stupid thing you'd never try in real life. Pull 12 o'clock wheelies through traffic, flip off ramps, crash spectacularly, and race your friends online.

4900890.name: Grr Grr Gnomes
4900890.short_description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

4024450.name: From Ruins
4024450.short_description: A new-gen detective adventure combining deduction gameplay with a gripping story full of twists and turns. Gather clues, establish connections, and solve a series of increasingly challenging cases. Will you uncover the feud that began at the end of the world?

4270860.name: Furmageddon
4270860.short_description:
Haha! I'm in! I hacked the devs' Steam page! 🦝
Rizzo here. Get ready for a 1-4 player online co-op roguelite bullet heaven. Pick your Furmate, build crazy loadouts and see how long you can survive solo or team up with friends to take on hordes of monsters. What could possibly go wrong?

4778310.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros Playtest

3665560.name: Hands of the Sovereign
3665560.short_description:
It's time to duel on Fardea Island! Encounter a colourful cast of rivals! Challenge your host: Lord Blackthorn!
Assemble your own personal deck, and do battle upon a grid-based battlefield.

4712830.name: Texas Oil Baron
4712830.short_description: Oil tycoon game, where half the action takes place underground. You buy land, prospect for oil, drill, pump, and transport the product. You can sell at local buyer or sign supply contracts at fixed prices. Profitability is dictated by market forces - politics, weather, and collusion.

5077820.name: Starhand
5077820.short_description: Most deckbuilders take your health. Starhand takes your options. Every card runs on a ship system, and enemies shoot those systems offline, locking cards out of your hand mid-fight. Six pilots, 295 cards, eight zones. Learn to win with half a ship.

4459320.name: Desktop Goofy Guys
4459320.short_description: Tiny goofy guys have moved onto your desktop and they're not leaving. They haul coins to your dock, play with toys, and get absolutely obliterated by your death ray. Click-through, always there, always up to something.

2153500.name: OBA DOBA
2153500.short_description: OBA DOBA is a Roguelike RTS/Tower Defense that is fast, funny, and frantic. Defend your base with towers and fighters while managing your resources and upgrades. Build up your arsenal of structures, abilities, and passives to defeat the evils that await. Build, rebuild, and survive! (hopefully)

5498810.name: Monquest
5498810.short_description: Monsters hide under your bed, and tonight they fight back. Summon a horde of creepy creatures, defend your lair and push into the humans’ neighborhood in this lane-battle strategy game. Upgrade, collect and unleash your monster army, free to play.

4990680.name: Terminidle
4990680.short_description: Terminidle is an incremental hacking game about mining data from a bare terminal. Grow botnets, run hack contracts, and upgrade your rig until it boots a whole desktop OS and maybe more! Then wipe it all for permanent power and climb back faster!

5409490.name: Glacis
5409490.short_description: You can't block the enemy's road, but you can move the earth. Raise the ground to bend their path, put your guns on the heights, and hold the same corridor through three wars, from towed guns and dive bombers to helicopter assaults and drone swarms.

2131280.name: Ancient
2131280.short_description: Ancient is a third person exploration game developed by MinoDab Productions

5368950.name: Rise of the Seraphyn
5368950.short_description: An old-school 3D isometric MMORPG. Roam 100+ tiered zones, shape a character on a sprawling skill web, tame beasts, craft in 20 professions, run trade wagons for your guild, bet on arena duels, and choose a side: fight for one of four cities and let your karma decide what your wings become.

4374990.name: Divine Ember
4374990.short_description: A hand-drawn cavern adventure. Walk the Green Caverns until your map remembers them, swear vows for tuniks, and wear amulets that change how you fight and find the way out.

5345470.name: JR EAST Train Simulator:Musashino Line (Tokyo ・ Minami-Funabashi to Fuchūhommachi)E231-0 series
5345470.short_description: The Musashino Line blends urban and natural scenery, with views of Mt. Fuji, seasonal landscapes, and freight trains. Its tunnels, gradients, and varied terrain make it rewarding to drive, while offering easy access to many leisure and shopping destinations.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

3232880.name: Crosshare - Crosshair Overlay
3232880.short_description: A crosshair overlay program focused on improving the gaming experience.  Create highly customizable crosshairs using the editor and quickly switch between them.  Record hotkeys to allow you to stay in the action.

4190900.name: Within His View
4190900.short_description: Observation Horror in an isolated Appalachian cabin, 2005. Watch seven grainy CCTV feeds, identify and report 800+ hand-crafted anomalies, and hold your sanity together while a silent Wendigo hunts the room you are sitting in. Survive the shift: 0:00 to 7:00.

5373230.name: NOODS Maker Demo
5373230.short_description: Have you ever wanted a personalized desktop companion? Look no further than NOODS Maker, a way to upload your own art and animations to make desktop pets. Want a magical creature or your worst enemy trapped on your screen? Then make it! Make your first free Operator with our demo.

4930270.name: FlipBAKA
4930270.short_description: Flip floor panels and launch enemies — and friends — off the island! Top-down arcade party action: explore and power up in Dungeon Mode, play 8 solo stages and a boss, co-op, or 8-player online PvP. Just one more round! Dungeon demo has online co-op. Downloads planned to end with Steam Next Fest.

5087080.name: Irish Sport Manager Demo
5087080.short_description: Take one of eight counties through a full season of the Gaelic games: football, hurling, camogie or ladies' football. There is no transfer market. Name your thirty from the clubs inside your own county and answer for it.

5146450.name: The Fallen Grid
5146450.short_description: A top-down competitive survival action game where up to 4 players cooperate in a stranded zombie outbreak setting. Fight against zombies alongside your friends using limited resources.

4941950.name: CottageCore
4941950.short_description: Build freely, shape cottages and towers, and welcome a village into your glade. Organize village life and prepare homes and supplies for winter. A cozy building game about making a place of your own and caring for the people who live there.

4862530.name: HO HO HO SOKOBAN
4862530.short_description: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

5430210.name: MECHSQUAD
5430210.short_description: Team up with friends, customize your mechs and battle for supremacy in this top-down indie shooter. Lumber into combat backed by swarms of  support units, capture strategic areas, and call in orbital fire. Up to 16 players in 2 to 4 teams experience fast-paced, LAN-ready strategic battles.

5045630.name: Crownspat
5045630.short_description: Lead your kingdom against three rivals in a lighthearted real-time strategy game. Command troops, claim territory, build villages and defenses, manage taxes and resources, and outmaneuver your enemies across colorful isometric battlefields.

5050590.name: Irish Sport Manager
5050590.short_description: A management sim for the Gaelic games: football, hurling, camogie and ladies' football. Take a county, pick your fifteen from the clubs inside it, and answer to a board that remembers everything.

5193560.name: The Idle Witch and Her Tower of BOOOOM!
5193560.short_description: Be a witch, build a tower, and BOOOOM the attacking monsters in this short incremental RPG!

4809140.name: 迷家 mygohome
4809140.short_description: Spend not-so-cute nights in a cute hand-drawn world. Control the character to guard the room yourself and find a way to survive among monsters, doors, windows, and a constantly decreasing SAN value. Every night brings new dangers, and after dawn, more secrets await.

5108020.name: Brute Tusk : Feral
5108020.short_description: Play as a feral boar and fight the animals of the wild. Charge, bite, and dodge through every clash. Eat what you kill, evolve mid-run, and grow into a deadlier beast.

5367280.name: PAYDAY 3: Guns Blazin' Crimebond
5367280.short_description: Saddle up with the Guns Blazin' Crimebond, featuring two new akimbo weapons, three iconic weapons, three outfit sets, a weapon skin, emotes, and more.

5372440.name: The Onion Voting Simulator 3D
5372440.short_description: Onion Voting Simulator 3D is an action-packed walking sim where you perform America's most taboo act: Voting. It’s Election Day and your choice could change the country's fate! But it won’t be easy: Resist the allure of staying home! Explore a school gym! And don’t get lost, because Hell is real!

5076390.name: The Rifted Skies Demo
5076390.short_description: The Rifted Skies is an active VR parkour set in a long-abandoned world. Play as a lone warrior returning home. Fight, fall and come back stronger to outrun a deadly Rift. Unlock new powers and uncover the truth: can your home ever be saved?

5147340.name: CPU: Computing Potatoes Unlimited Demo
5147340.short_description: Program potato workers to process numbers with simple punch-in instructions at a factory that mimics a processor. Optimize solutions to solve challenging open-ended puzzles. Punch, observe, learn, repeat.

5164020.name: STEEL GULLET Demo
5164020.short_description: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

4276860.name: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached Demo
4276860.short_description: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

3500960.name: Screw Drivers - Pretty Fly
3500960.short_description: Let's take off and lift your vehicle into the sky with the new "Pretty Fly" DLC for Screw Drivers! With a variety of fancy new airplane-building blocks, you can create your very own aircraft, soar over a stunning new island, and master a whole host of exciting flying challenges.

5363140.name: CottageCore Demo
5363140.short_description: Build your first cottages, add paths and ponds, and welcome villagers in this free CottageCore demo. Explore a small glade, discover five trades from farming to fishing, and enjoy village life at your own pace.

960890.name: Adolescent Santa Claus OST And ART
960890.short_description: Adolescent Santa Claus's sevice resource!! It is free.

411184.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: MVPHot6 - HEEN
411184.short_description: From team MVPHot6, learn more about HEEN

5212040.name: Orbit Core Demo
5212040.short_description: Roguelite bullet heaven with mechs: mow down countless robots until you're unstoppable. Absorb their energy, level up, stack modules, unlock items, and combine them into game-breaking builds. And all with an entire planet as your battlefield!

3720120.name: Sunny Trails Demo
3720120.short_description: Sunny Trails is a cozy turn-based RPG. Amaterasu and her sisters travel to a party on a paradisiacal Brazilian island, only to find all the guests turned to stone. Fish, decorate your camp, and explore the island to discover who petrified your friends!

5039580.name: Sakura Shiren
5039580.short_description: Hold out against endless waves of anime yokai with up to 7 friends. Draft run-changing blossom buffs between waves, spend petals on  weapons and upgrades, and face 25 hand-drawn bosses that scale to your squad.

3643740.name: Heavy in the Hand
3643740.short_description: Cock the hammer, pull the trigger, count to six. Release the cylinder, eject the shells, count to six again. You hold death in your hand, and death is heavy. Descend to the abyss, shoot the horrors you can comprehend, and survive the horrors you cannot.

5405960.name: 猫隐珠舍 A String of Purrs
5405960.short_description: Run a cozy bead shop with a cat companion and a little magic. Sort, shape and string bracelets by hand, choose colorful accents, and pack them with leaves, wool balls and a wax seal. Read your neighbors' letters and photo updates, or craft a bracelet just for yourself.

5372560.name: Zattrick Manager
5372560.short_description: Manage a football club in a persistent online world. Build your squad, set tactics, develop facilities and compete in evolving leagues while your decisions shape the long-term future of your club. Scout talent and follow every result.

4164650.name: SNAKEPIT: USA
4164650.short_description: A short puzzle game about comparing URL vs. IRL

5285840.name: Leif's Garden Tower
5285840.short_description: Grow plants, tend the greenhouse, and fall in love with the customers of Leif's Garden Tower. Leif's Garden Tower is a cozy 2D tower-builder about a lonely leaf spirit rebuilding an abandoned greenhouse, help him restore the tower and learn its secrets.

5245060.name: Keyword Disaster Arena
5245060.short_description: Create your own disasters by combining keyword cards in a chaotic 4-player physics-based party survival game. Everyone's disasters happen at once. Dodge the danger, shove your rivals into trouble, and survive the chaos you helped create!

5210740.name: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril Playtest

3517880.name: Clawsome
3517880.short_description: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

2804990.name: CODE EXIT Demo
2804990.short_description: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

4488990.name: Carmilla : Crimson Moon
4488990.short_description: A dark yuri horror visual novel inspired by a classic gothic novella. When the enigmatic Carmilla arrives, Laura is swept into a fever dream of obsession. Is this stranger the cure for her loneliness or a herald of corruption? And what caused the mysterious deaths of two girls in the nearby village?

5415540.name: MESHFALL
5415540.short_description: An RTS where your units only take orders inside your radio network. Build relays to push the signal out and keep them alive, because the enemy goes for them first. Four maps, a hundred waves each.

2371490.name: Pasture: The Livestock Simulator
2371490.short_description: Do you have what it takes to be a cattle farmer?   Muster and manage thousands of cattle in the rugged Australian Outback, solo or with some mates. Combine the forces of man, animal and machine to get the cattle to where they need to be!

5071320.name: Scroll Control
5071320.short_description: Anyone with a steady hand can draw a spell scroll now. Last month, one meant to warm a barn burned it down to the ground instead. The county has opened the Rune Bureau and now no scroll may be read until a clerk has licensed it.

3388650.name: Locator: The Search for Abigail Lidari Demo

4339210.name: Dreamsend: Wintersong
4339210.short_description: Experience a new approach to turn-based tactical combat in this 2.5D cyberpunk fantasy Strategy RPG. Empower your roster with abilities and items inspired by genre classics and MOBAs. Face unforgiving battles and grand multiphase bossfights to shape the fate of Veichne, the land of eternal winters.

5160750.name: BACKBITE Demo
5160750.short_description: Snake, but as a duel. Two snakes, one board, five powers to sabotage each other. Try the full duel against the bot or with someone next to you on the same computer: all five powers and the 15-second chase are here, uncut.

5475700.name: Gonggi: Recess
5475700.short_description: Recess. Five gonggi stones on your desk. Scatter, toss, pick up and catch them with a physics-driven hand. Play from Onesies to the Flip on your own or against your seatmate or a Steam friend, and between rounds get up to doodle on the chalkboard and play the reed organ.

5461430.name: Iz and Auggie: Escape from Dimension Q
5461430.short_description: Bandmates Iz and her robot Auggie wrote a killer song. Cosmo LaRue stole it. Recover the song from Dimension Q in this animated point-and-click puzzle adventure from 1996: descramble codes, outrun the Q cops, crack a musical lock, and rescue missing secret agents.

5499400.name: Contested Space: Core Defender
5499400.short_description: The first pack opening defense game you can play with friends! Crack booster packs to build your fleet, defend your core, and aim your own cannon while your stations fire. 1-4 player online co-op, short runs, hundreds of unlocks. Set in the Contested Space universe.

5141060.name: BACKBITE
5141060.short_description: Snake, but as a duel. Two snakes, one board and five powers to sabotage each other. And dying first doesn't mean losing: the one who ate more wins, not the one who survived.

5013150.name: Nonet Concerto R
5013150.short_description: Build your loadout from around 100 magic stones and battle monsters with a wide range of spells in this third-person, loot-driven 3D action game. Experiment with different builds across more than 50 stages, solo or in online co-op with up to four players.

4780790.name: Tetheg
4780790.short_description: Race to the other side in this original board game! The catch? You can’t let the strings tying the pieces together cross. Test your wits against your friends as you maneuver your pieces, block your opponent, and slip through their defenses in local multiplayer.

4136890.name: WIZARDS NEVER LIE
4136890.short_description: Four chairs, four wizards, one rule: wizards never lie. A 4-player online social deduction game with your face live on camera above your chair. Bluff through Revolvers, Hidden Figures, Cards and Poison, spend your Checks wisely and catch the liars at the table.

5456450.name: Velikopolsky Chess
5456450.short_description:
Classic chess game is re-envisioned with Ukrainian folklore and style. Chess pieces that talk with an attitude.
Many chess board styles, chess pieces sets, online, LAN play, hotseat, challenge the computer, and learn.
Good for all ages, all difficulty levels, and music to relax. Build the community.

4903150.name: Puck's Seamlessifier + Ripper
4903150.short_description: An all in one tool that lets you extract textures from photos, screenshots, and reference images from virtually any perspective, transform them into seamless textures, and export them as high-quality assets ready for your games and any other 3D projects.

4635160.name: Dawn's Wake
4635160.short_description: Awaken as a memory-stripped supreme master in a twisted jianghu. Shatter the world's cursed formations, master strategic wuxia combat where one right technique turns the tide, and reclaim your lost throne — while idle progress and a living martial world carry on even when your sword rests.

3359860.name: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
3359860.short_description: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

5233100.name: Elroy's Costume Closet
5233100.short_description: The 1996 Headbone Interactive classic is back! Help Elroy and Syd save the Camelian Theater in this retro restored dress-up game. Mix wild outfits to unlock 75+ funny, fully voiced short animated skits. A retro revival packed with original 90s magic, optimized for modern desktops!

5430240.name: After Dark Pinas - Check in
5430240.short_description: Welcome to the world of After Dark Pinas! In this episode you play as Ian, a 20 year old Filipino college student who met his crush through online classes. Live in your Lola's house, do chores, tumakas sa gabi, and encounter Filipino supernatural moments that leads to a Horrific Check In Episode!

5128330.name: Cubes&Cards
5128330.short_description: Cubes & Cards is a Rougelike Platform Fighter; Fight your friends and gain power from over 30 cards to choose from! With 3 characters with unique playstyles, the possibilities are endless!

4498720.name: 重生修仙 Demo
4498720.short_description: Slay monsters, hunt for loot, and forge your path to godhood — death is just the beginning. Battle swarming enemies, collect powerful items, arrange your inventory, reroll stats and stack bonuses to create devastating builds. A roguelite blending loot hunting with inventory-based buildcrafting.

5493880.name: Home Sweet Bunker: Bunker Tycoon
5493880.short_description: A darkly funny bunker management sim. Build down, admit survivors at the gate and pray none of them is infected. Every night something new tests your layout: diggers from below, crawlers in the vents, spores in the air, screamers drawn to your generators.

4493210.name: Divine Orbit Demo
4493210.short_description: Divine Orbit is an orbital crisis roguelite where you build a living planetary defense, manipulate the battlefield with divine powers, and survive cascading disasters that change the rules of your carefully constructed system.

2459030.name: Locator: The Search for Abigail Lidari
2459030.short_description: A Geoguessr-inspired narrative detective puzzle game set on an alien planet. As the Cartographer, you must gather and examine clues to locate missing archaeologist Abigail Lidari and uncover the fate of an ancient alien civilization.

5062230.name: Epoch Forge
5062230.short_description: A 2D colony simulator and sandbox where you make a name for yourself in a dying world. You can type freely to anyone, and they remember what you did. Mine, build, wire logic circuits, appease five silent gods, and push the limits of reality. No ending, no win screen. Pace yourself.

4416390.name: Terminus: Day Zero
4416390.short_description: Terminus: Day Zero is a free, short zombie survival adventure set in the world of Terminus: Zombie Survivors. On the first day of the outbreak, Daisy is home alone, and the dead are getting closer. Hide, shut the doors, and run.

3960010.name: True Abstraction: Forbidden
3960010.short_description: Awakening was only the beginning. RDS is real… consuming anyone who ventures too close.

3410010.name: Tabletop Tavern Demo
3410010.short_description: Recruit a wild roster of warriors and command your mercenaries on a chaotic tabletop battlefield. With infinite builds, brutal choices, and endless replayability, Tabletop Tavern is an RTS built for roguelike fanatics.

3841270.name: UnHolY PraYeR
3841270.short_description:
No matter how many times she falls or is defiled—
she will never give up. 
Dark monsters are invading the remote lands... The beautiful exorcist goes there to save the people.

5466410.name: Fuji Flip
5466410.short_description:
Flip two cards. Hear the word. Match the pair.
 Fuji Flip is a memory card game for language learners: every card shows a picture and a word and says it out loud,
 so you pick up real Japanese, Spanish and French words while you play.

5270760.name: Tetrilaunch
5270760.short_description: An arcade physics puzzle where you aim and fire tetromino shipments into a compacting bay, build full rows, and survive escalating ten-bay runs.

5491950.name: OpenSheet 1e SRD
5491950.short_description: A character builder and sheet for the 1st-edition fantasy RPG rules, built on the open SRD. Eighteen open-content rulebooks are included: classes, races, feats, spells and monsters, with every number calculated for you. Works offline, no account needed.

1413270.name: Call From The Deep
1413270.short_description: Call From The Deep is a gripping first-person co-op horror experience. Crew a submarine with up to 8 friends and descend into a haunted abyss. Patch the leaks, fend off nightmares, and hold the hull together as you dive ever deeper — for fortune and glory, or be lost to the tide.

5500150.name: Marbles: Tidy Up
5500150.short_description: Turn colorful chaos into satisfying order. Collect 1,800 marbles, sort them into matching jars, and unlock handy upgrades. A cozy little game to enjoy at your own pace...

5409650.name: CLEAVE Demo
5409650.short_description: CLEAVE is a fast-paced action game where players dodge intense enemy attacks and turn the battlefield to their advantage. Master unique mechanics, overcome challenging obstacles, and push your skills to the limit in this high-intensity experience.

4676120.name: Vestalborne
4676120.short_description: Break the world, then build your own. Vestalborne is an unlimited open-world survival crafting RPG: mine, farm, build and destroy across procedural dimensions, and fight the rising danger. Collect Embers, grow stronger, and keep the Eternal Flame burning solo, with friends, or against them.

5462800.name: Massive Army Battle
5462800.short_description: One battlefield. 2 Army! Place your troops, press START, and excitedly watch thousands of tiny warriors crash into each other in a chaos war. Free campaign with 43 levels. Unlock the Sandbox and God mode to go wild.

3549780.name: Ashigaru Demo
3549780.short_description:
DEMO AVAILABLE NOW

Ashigaru Tactics is a turn-based hex tactical combat sandbox game, set in Sengoku-era Japan. Assemble a squad of mercenaries and fight, survive, and kill in a land ravaged by clan wars, bandit incursions, and whispers of Yokai emerging.

2960460.name: Spaceflight Simulator 2
2960460.short_description: Build rockets and fly them around the Solar System in this realistic aerospace sandbox. Attempt landings, build space stations, drive rovers, perform spacewalks, explore alien worlds, and get your crew home safe.

2963330.name: Forgefall
2963330.short_description: Forgefall is an active incremental game where your lantern cuts through a scrolling forest. Break trees, rocks, goblins, and chests, aim the resources they drop, build processors, and buy permanent upgrades that make each run more productive.

4180890.name: AI Digital Human Lab
4180890.short_description: Meet Luna, a lifelike AI companion who lives on your PC: talk by voice or text and she answers in her own voice, with 74 expressions and natural gestures, all on-device. Scan a QR code and your own AI agent (Muse, Claude, any MCP app) can direct her: lights, camera, outfits, dance, songs.

4423270.name: Takeover 2
4423270.short_description: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

3038710.name: Ashigaru
3038710.short_description: Ashigaru Tactics is a turn-based hex tactical combat sandbox game, set in Sengoku-era Japan. Assemble a squad of mercenaries and fight, survive, and kill in a land ravaged by clan wars, bandit incursions, and whispers of Yokai emerging.

3552240.name: LEGRADA
3552240.short_description: A turn-based duel on a 9×9 board. Lead your Lekamon to the far edge and block your rival with wooden walls. Every figure carries an element and a skill: fire burns a wall, ice freezes a turn. Play online against real players, PC and mobile together.

5446300.name: 虚之翔
5446300.short_description: One light. One step. A flight without words. Into the void — do not look back.

1873450.name: NPUnrealSample
1873450.short_description:
NPUnrealSample

Features
1. WebBrowser
- It provides common WebBrowser features like chrome and firefox.
Move pages, watch videos, download files.

2. Account Menu
- Provide account functions such as login, logout, user information inquiry, current platform inquiry, UUID inquiry, etc.

4555580.name: Restoraether
4555580.short_description: Restoraether is a cozy magical survival crafting game where you explore the isles of magic, mysteriously abandoned by their powerful Mage inhabitants, and restore the balance of aethers to bring magic back to the world.

4922730.name: Send Them to Hell
4922730.short_description: Become an unstoppable demon-killing machine. Tear through hordes, stack absurd upgrades, and create builds that get completely out of hand. Choose your hero and fight through Hell’s invasion solo or with up to 3 friends in online co-op. How far can you push your build before everything falls apart?

5259680.name: Cups and Curses
5259680.short_description: A cozy magic coffee shop sim. Invent drinks from ingredients whose effects you discover by using them, plan your board around the morning forecast, and offer them to the people at your counter. No timer and no fail state. Regulars come back, sit down, and tell you things.

5323650.name: Magic Awakening：Hero Saga
5323650.short_description: A strategy roguelike blending bullet hell, inventory management & tower defense. Recruit heroes, merge & evolve, summon goddesses, upgrade your castle, and repel monster waves. 100+ stages, meta progression, low-spec friendly.

2548880.name: Divine Frequency
2548880.short_description: A fever dream experience about the total collapse of reality as it lingers between states of erasure and transcendence.

5318000.name: Rally: Village Defense
5318000.short_description: A cozy yet brainy Backpack-like Roguelike bullet heaven village defense. Recruit villager heroes, manage grid slots, merge orange Super Heroes, and stop the demolition crew! 50 chapters, 12 heroes, 11 Super Heroes.

5318010.name: Apoc Tank: Rush Forward
5318010.short_description: Drive your tank through zombie hordes! Backpack-like + roguelike bullet-heaven shooter. Merge weapons, upgrade tanks, collect energy cores & sets, research tech. 5 difficulties from easy to inferno.

3961690.name: I Saw a Flying Saucer
3961690.short_description: An interactive fiction about a man who lost his wife and goes in search of a UFO that shouldn't exist.

3118840.name: Sibir
3118840.short_description: Sibir is an intense survival exploration game set in the unforgiving depths of an abandoned Soviet bunker. Every step you take could be your last.

3538080.name: Death In Your Dice Demo
3538080.short_description: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

4768890.name: Nova Star: Void Survival
4768890.short_description: Fight endless waves of enemies in a fast-paced roguelite space survivor. Build devastating ship combinations, unlock powerful upgrades and survive the void.

1478190.name: The Sugar Coast
1478190.short_description: An idle empire builder set on XVIth century Madeira. Manage supply chains, control Atlantic markets, and carve levada canals to keep your island productive.

3275060.name: Blackstar Ranger
3275060.short_description: Blackstar Ranger is a high-octane and immersive first-person space shooter. From the seat of your advanced fighter, you will complete contracts for BLACKSTAR, the most esteemed Private Military Faction in the solar system. With 6DOF capability, you will battle threats throughout the system.

5324770.name: Mortal Path: Mighty Senior Brother
5324770.short_description: Backpack-like × strategy × bullet heaven xianxia Roguelike. Random artifacts, limited grid, fusion & evolution to build your ultimate setup. Meet junior sisters, upgrade your Dao Body, and defend the last pure land. Easy to play, hard to stop!

3373590.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. Soundtrack
3373590.short_description: This soundtrack for There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R. includes two tracks: the game's title track "To the Victor" with lyrics, which can be heard on the game's title screen, and an instrumental version of that same song.

4269720.name: Die Severed
4269720.short_description: Die Severed is a gambling roguelike where each lost round costs you one finger. Stack your dice bag with weighted dice, collect run defining abilities, and push your luck to pay your debt and walk out in one piece. More or less.

3373580.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
3373580.short_description: Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In this single-player interactive spy novel, you play as his greatest adversaries - can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the VICTOR go the spoils!

4697990.name: Outliers: Incrementum Demo
4697990.short_description: An incremental ARPG about rising from a nobody to the most powerful assassin alive. Slash through waves of monsters, collect loot and upgrade your abilities. Get stronger with every run until even bosses become easy targets.

4798230.name: Mesozoic Protocol
4798230.short_description: The dinosaurs evolve against whatever you over-build. Defend 30 outposts with eight defenses: seven buildable tower types and your HQ. Pilot a mech, then adapt as each wave pushes back. Single-player tower defense with Breach and Containment challenges.

5221390.name: Chronicle of Gods
5221390.short_description: You are one god in a pantheon of rivals. On living worlds of wandering peoples, rising cities and warring realms, gods compete for faith and mortals toil. Older than any realm, the Chronicle remembers the deeds of mortals and gods alike. Can anyone prove which were yours?

5244970.name: Elroy: King of the Jungle
5244970.short_description: A Brand-New 30-Year-Old Game. This 90's animated point-and-click adventure is finally released! Crash-land in a dangerous jungle with Elroy, his sidekick Blue AND Elroy’s annoying little brother Slim. Solve puzzles, survive crazy calamities, and navigate challenges to bring everyone home safe.

5028050.name: Traffic Architect
5028050.short_description: Become the master of traffic with your expert infrastructure designs. Lay down streets, shape junctions, time traffic lights, design a public transport network, and watch the city come alive. It grows on its own, and every new building sends more trips onto the roads you built.

4950660.name: Eris One Stand
4950660.short_description: Join the Pook Star Legion in this shoot ’em up roguelike and battle through waves of enemies. Dodge incoming fire and choose your upgrades to transform your ship throughout each run as you fight to reclaim the Kryos Crystals stolen from the Pooks.

5227630.name: Elroy Hits the Pavement
5227630.short_description: Blue has been dog-napped! Join Elroy and Syd in this comedic, fully animated, point-and-click adventure to rescue Elroy's dog and recover their stolen science project before summer school. Solve clever puzzles using lasers, codes, and battery power, and shape the story in this 90s classic!

4088450.name: RESIDUUM
4088450.short_description: RESIDUUM is a first-person psychological horror game set in a decaying research facility. Armed with only a dwindling flashlight and a faulty heartbeat sensor, manage your power, uncover the truth, and escape what hides in the dark.

5470580.name: IceMan Demo
5470580.short_description: Everyday pomodoro timers are too plain — this is a pomodoro timer game packed with all kinds of 90s lifestyle elements.

5016380.name: MOTHERWARD
5016380.short_description: MOTHERWARD is a single-player psychological horror anomaly game. You are searching for your mother in an abandoned hospital. To find her, you must remember everything, uncover what you see...or don't see, and make a choice. But remember, every choice has consequences.

5342460.name: Cake & Bake Demo
5342460.short_description: Bake, decorate, and serve beautiful cakes for customers celebrating life's special moments. Customize every order, expand your bakery with new ingredients and decorations, and create the coziest cake shop in town at your own relaxing pace.

726680.name: Better Together
726680.short_description: A 2 to 6 player co-op psychological horror. Become neighbors with your friends in an underground experiment. Complete the studies, get paid by doing tasks, while the Institute notes your routine. Betray your friends before they do. In the end you'll know exactly who your friends really are.

3254300.name: POLYSTRIKE
3254300.short_description: POLYSTRIKE is a competitive top-down tactical shooter where every angle, every utility and every decision can change the outcome of the round. Coordinate with your team, master tactical combat and outplay your opponents in intense 5v5 objective-based battles.

5357820.name: Stop The Slime
5357820.short_description: A 3D platformer where standing still is deadly. Ground melts your slime, water heals it, and every coin doubles as ammo. Hop across floating islands, outsmart monsters, obstacles and traps and chase three stars on every level.

2997680.name: Calvary and Swords
2997680.short_description: Build a settlement, raise an army, and fight alongside your troops in a medieval sandbox. Customize your character, develop your skills, and command infantry, archers, and cavalry. Play solo against AI or join friends for a co-op experience.

5188640.name: Pancake! No break!
5188640.short_description: An incremental cooking game where you wake up on mysterious cloud islands and have to cook pancakes to find a way out.

5384170.name: 棋匠
5384170.short_description: A more strategic chess for two players!Seize strategic resources,deploy troops on terrain, command battles on boards of any size and attempt to strike unexpectedly in the fog of war!As the host,you can even create your own unique rules,unlocking endless new gameplay and excitement with your friend

4943670.name: Player 2 is a Femboy
4943670.short_description: An old high school friend reconnects with you, and gaming night turns into something neither of you saw coming. Player 2 is a Femboy is a spicy visual novel about nostalgia, banter, and consequences that go further than you planned.

3250050.name: 记忆岛
3250050.short_description: High amid the stars float shining crystals, holding memories of old worlds. In order, they blaze, guiding the lost. When chaos comes, they dim, luster fading. You, Wanderer, called to rekindle these fallen stars. Step into a strange world and seek the right way to bring back the light.

5335830.name: Vagina Sancta
5335830.short_description: Vagina Sancta is a unique experience that allows u to interactively explore the fascinating world of female reproductive anatomy!

5434210.name: iceman
5434210.short_description: A hand-drawn papercut desktop pet with blind-box collecting and Pomodoro focus. A fridge-bellied grandpa and a big-mouthed cow cat live in your screen corner

5484620.name: Demon Castle Guard
5484620.short_description: You are the Demon Lord, and every woman in the land wants to move into your castle. The rejected ones show up with armies for a "hostile job interview." Merge slimes, hold the gate, and pass them all. A cheeky pixel-art tower defense comedy with adult content.

4940980.name: The Ramen Bar
4940980.short_description: Run a cozy ramen bar in a busy Japanese city. Prepare bowls, serve customers, and keep the place clean, all while expanding your menu every day. But when you're alone something doesn't feel quite right...

5363210.name: Jerry and Jaspers Jovial Journey
5363210.short_description: Jerry and Jasper is a simple RPG experience involving traditional turn based combat, mission variations based on player choices, and various unique puzzles. Filled with dozens of impactful choices, every variation of Jerry and Jaspers Journey is bound to be unique.

4630260.name: Room Zero
4630260.short_description: A first-person psychological mystery set in a liminal space that should not exist.

5310490.name: Bugs & Birdies Demo
5310490.short_description: A cozy survival sandbox with teeth – alone or in online co-op for up to four players. Explore a world of pixel islands, build your farmstead, raise an army of hens and hold the fences together when the beetles come at night.

4138830.name: Astral 4X : Interstellar Simulation
4138830.short_description: A deep-space 4X simulation. Explore a procedurally generated universe, colonize worlds, build a realistic economy, and lead your civilization toward galactic domination. Brave ecological and economic crises, face famines, wars, and disasters, and ensure your survival!

2243690.name: B.C. Piezophile
2243690.short_description:
B.C. Piezophile is a first-person action horror game set deep underwater. It
features a foreign ocean brimming with ambivalent environments, hazardous
anomalies and baroque ecosystems. Stranded in the hadal zone, the player must
ascend over 6,150 AeC before they can dream of rescue.

4670040.name: Blackboard Ponies
4670040.short_description:
A game about a small pony in a blackboard world wreaking havoc and bringing color to everyone's lives. 

In this puzzle platformer play as a student's rebellious fantasy pony, kicking its way through the blackboard and releasing colors from the environment, making the world seem less hopeless.

5267840.name: Starlit Solitaire
5267840.short_description: Catch your breath with classic Klondike under the stars. Shrinks to an always-on-top desktop window, like a pet.

4098480.name: ConEX
4098480.short_description: A twin-stick shooter roguelite with a destination. Mow down thousands of zombies to deliver a package, then make it back to your van alive. Build your loadout mid-run, upgrade your gear between shifts, and turn every handcrafted pixel-art route into a bloodbath.

1268790.name: Dark Fracture
1268790.short_description: Dark Fracture is a psychological horror experience in which you explore an ever-changing world where reality and nightmares collide. Walk on the edge of madness in the shoes of a tormented soul as you descend into the darkest depths of the human psyche, and question everything you see.

5051570.name: Treecension
5051570.short_description: Small Crow Man climbs big evil tree to save the world

3010490.name: Evoplasm
3010490.short_description: Evolve and fight in this creature building Roguelike. Grow a creature by attaching new cells, add mutations to create powerful synergies, fight real-time tactical battles against weird enemies, and strategically choose a path across multiple campaign acts. Inspired by games like Spore and FTL.

5093680.name: Elroy Goes Bugzerk
5093680.short_description: The 90s point-and-click classic returns! Help Elroy and Blue find the legendary Technoloptera to win the 10th Annual Insectathon. Outsmart arch-rival Gordon Smugs, solve brain-teasing puzzles, and learn real science in this fully animated interactive adventure story.

4520640.name: TechnoMayan
4520640.short_description: History flipped ! The Maya descendants will be the first to cross the Atlantic, and they are not bringing guns, they bring Techno Music. Command a floating concert across a mythical ocean, experience a sometimes bullet-hell, but definitely notes-heaven adventure with rogue-like elements.

5433790.name: Sword & Soil
5433790.short_description: A top-down pixel action RPG in the spirit of Dragon Warrior and NES Zelda. Farm, fish and cook, then take what you grew into real-time fights. Four classes, puzzle dungeons and five towns. All of Chapter One is in the free demo.

4846360.name: Heatwarped
4846360.short_description: Ratfield sits atop an underground racing scene. Conquer the streets by warping the odds in your favor. Customize your ride to the max, meet up with other racers from your pda's racing forum to compete, and build respect.

4999690.name: Heatwarped Demo
4999690.short_description: Ratfield sits atop an underground racing scene. Conquer the streets by warping the odds in your favor. Customize your ride to the max, meet up with other racers from your pda's racing forum to compete, and build respect.

5185610.name: PERIHELIA
5185610.short_description: One ring, one gap, and a wall closing in. You rotate a ship around the center and find the gap before the wall reaches you. Four modes, and in MUSIC every wall sits on a beat of the track. The longer you run clean, the higher the multiplier, and at x8 the whole plane tilts.

4898890.name: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT.
4898890.short_description: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot – fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

4765400.name: ANONYMIZED Demo
4765400.short_description: Play as a digital rat and hack your way into the retro-futuristic grid-based movement puzzle world of Anonymized, where you shift hues and dive layers deep in search of the one true Source Cheese.

4728880.name: Skatebound Demo
4728880.short_description: A first of its kind, action-packed 2.5D skateboarding world where you take full control! Explore the city, find spots to skate, and own the land with hundreds of challenges to conquer both in and out of the camera lens.

3706620.name: MD Engine
3706620.short_description:
Create real Sega Mega Drive / Genesis games using drag-and-drop with no coding required.

Export ROMs for original hardware, plus Web, Windows, Linux, macOS, Android, iOS, and Linux Handhelds.

5223160.name: Pourhouse: Last Call Is Your Call
5223160.short_description: Pourhouse: Last Call is Your Call is a fast, chaotic 2D pixel-art bar management game. Serve thirsty customers and cut them off before they get carried away. Play 40 levels across 4 different bars. Upgrade your bars and unlock power-ups to help you along the way!

5479230.name: 打工环游记
5479230.short_description: Work, travel and build a life across five seaside cities. Take on jobs, explore neighborhoods, meet locals and enjoy an anime-style 3D life simulation as you search for an old friend.
developers: 打工环游记 制作组
publishers: 打工环游记 制作组

5273930.name: Backrooms : The Threshold Demo
5273930.short_description: The Backrooms have been breached. Step through an experimental gateway into an endlessly generated labyrinth, film what you find, and follow the needle home. A free single player demo of The Backrooms: Threshold. Every expedition is somewhere no one has been.

5439800.name: Sword & Soil Demo
5439800.short_description: Every crop you sell, fish you catch, and monster you loot via real-time combat buys the gear for progression. Pick one of four classes and experience all of Chapter 1 in this free demo. Your save carries into the full game!

4974600.name: Hidden in Plain Cake
4974600.short_description: Sculpt, slice, and paint real cake into perfect copies of everyday objects — then invite your friends online to spot the fake. Every cut reveals the sponge layers inside. Fool them, or get sliced open trying.

5284610.name: 根据地 Demo
5284610.short_description: Run a gunsmith's workshop in a survivor camp hidden in the Taihang Mountains. Open supply crates, assemble and enhance weapons, fulfill commissions, and search the ruins for resources. A good gun can earn your keep or help bring you home.

2995130.name: Fallen Memory
2995130.short_description: Nathan, who has no memory of his past, wakes up in a dark house he doesn’t recognize. Every door that opens forces us to confront our past. In this psychological horror game, you must uncover the truth behind your lost memories while facing dark secrets and mental collapse.

5211360.name: BrickAmp
5211360.short_description: Two brick-breakers in one: AMPED runs fast and loud, ZEN reshapes the same 100 levels onto a slower, calmer board. Charge the Smash meter to blow out whole clusters of bricks in one hit — and play it all to your own music, or whatever's already playing.

5275170.name: Human Resources
5275170.short_description:
Race through fast-paced levels while killing clones in increasingly absurd ways!

Unlock all the medals, get promoted, beat your friends times, and discover the secrets of the Human Resources department.

5459870.name: Lootbox Inc.: The TCG Card Battler Playtest

2809580.name: Tactical Vengeance: Play The Games Demo
2809580.short_description: Plunge into the thrill of our dynamic shooter, intricately designed to match your gaming style and secure victories in every match. Engage in intense skirmishes where skill and strategy triumph. Each tailored experience promises a finely tuned journey, brimming with the joy of winning the Match.

5304310.name: 10 Milion Cubes
5304310.short_description: Break through 10 million voxels to find the Prismatic Cube. A short incremental game about satisfying destruction with really bouncy balls.

4512150.name: SICRUN
4512150.short_description: A first-person arcade horror game about greed. Every level's exit costs SicCoins, and the goal is to buy your way out as fast as possible.
