Collect coins in the dark while something hunts you, gamble to multiply them, and spend them on upgrades and companions. High risk, high reward.

5358500.name: Revving: Engine Simulator
5358500.short_description: Start, rev and shift 19 engines, from a Harley V-twin to a Formula 1 H16, each turning in 3D in front of you. Every sound is computed live from the simulated physics of the engine. Clutch, gas and an H-pattern on keyboard, mouse or gamepad.

3705900.name: President Simulator
3705900.short_description: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

3322960.name: Pioneers of Pagonia - Official Guide
3322960.short_description: "Pioneers of Pagonia - Official Guide" is your indispensable companion for the epic city-building and strategy game Pioneers of Pagonia. This comprehensive handbook provides detailed instructions and valuable tips to help you build and defend your settlement successfully.

4897290.name: Legends of Companion
4897290.short_description:
Legends of Companion is a strategic auto-battling ARPG roguelite where every
choice is yours. Pick from 4 classes, build deep skill trees, forge loot, recruit
a battle pet, and chart paths across diverse worlds. Master skills, gear, and team
combos to turn one spark into an unstoppable legend.

5445140.name: Playfolk Hockey 27
5445140.short_description: Run a hockey club in a league you design, then simulate, watch or play every game, from a top-down view or full 3D broadcast cameras. Set the lines and the rules, make trades, manage shifts and fatigue. Edit every league, team and player in-game, import your own or community rosters.

2574640.name: Dark Samurai
2574640.short_description: Dark Samurai is a roguelike horde survival game with online co-op multiplayer and persistent progression, set in feudal Japan overrun by demons.

3046540.name: 10 Second Mixtape
3046540.short_description: Make mini music with other people online! A creative, low-stress game with async co-creation. Make unique songs with crazy instruments, or just hang out and watch other players' bands take the stage!

4712440.name: Seaforge: Shores of Atlantis
4712440.short_description: Beneath the waves, the world of Atlantis awaits. Build your home base on sunlit Mediterranean shores, then dive into sunken ruins to uncover secrets of the deep. Get stronger, dive deeper, and battle dark forces with up to 3 friends in this underwater survival crafting odyssey!

3763830.name: Dead as Disco Demo
3763830.short_description: Martial arts meets music video in Dead as Disco, a neon-drenched Beat ‘Em Up where every punch, kick, and combo syncs to the music. Join Charlie Disco on a quest to confront the villainous Idols and reunite the band.

5322070.name: Zero Hour Deadfront Demo
5322070.short_description: A cooperative zombie game for four players with roguelite elements. Choose cards between waves, survive hordes of ice, fire, lightning, or rock, and endure Zero Hour: every five x, the power goes out, a boss appears, and you must defeat it. Since this is a demo, gameplay is limited.

5089220.name: 復讐者の闇取引
5089220.short_description: A rogue-lite beat 'em up survival RPG. Defeat enemies to collect drops and grow stronger, then take on tougher foes. Mix and match weapons you like, and upgrade them for bigger challenges. Even after a loss, you can power up outside of battle for an easier next run.

4062150.name: Notary Block
4062150.short_description: The watchman is dead—the knife is still out. A 3–10 player co-op horror in a Hong Kong twin-tower estate. Residents finish tonight’s duties with estate tools, then walk out through the ground gate yourself. The killer uses the same tools to hunt everyone down. No team win—only your night report.

5352720.name: MemeticBox
5352720.short_description: A brutal voxel gore sandbox. Every body is built from blocks you can shoot, slice, burn and blow apart. Play God: hurl people, strike them with lightning, hang them or impale them on spikes. Or grab a gun for Police raids, zombie waves and fully destructible cities.

5214260.name: Field Supply: Helicopter Survival Vest & SPH-4 Patriot
5214260.short_description:
The Field Supply: Helicopter Survival Vest & SPH-4 Patriot contains:

1x US Helicopter Uniform
1x US Helicopter Helmet

5215750.name: Planet Frog Demo
5215750.short_description: The documentary crew expected a graceful amphibian. They got you. And all you want is to escape this terrarium. Climb for the exit, ruin shots and rage-bait the narrator with your falls.

4627430.name: World of Warships x Azur Lane — Quest for AL Avrora
4627430.short_description: A real treat for super fans of Azur Lane, this free DLC will unlock a very special mission indeed. By completing it, not only will you unlock an individually-voiced Commander from the universe of Azur Lane, but you’ll also get a Premium cruiser inspired by the very same Commander—Avrora!

4816230.name: Samsara: Retro Man Universe Demo
4816230.short_description: Control the battlefield in a tactical arcade shooter. Sacrifice safety, earn invincibility, slow time, and unleash a devastating beam to obliterate entire waves of enemies.

4093670.name: PRAGMATA: Mega Man Pack
4093670.short_description:
Mega Man love is out-of-this-world in this new bundle of outfits, gestures, and BGM.

Get two new outfits for both Hugh and Diana—each with their own way of showing off that Mega Man spirit.

3715610.name: Darkest Dungeon® II: Hero Origin Pack
3715610.short_description: Come face to face with your past! This free pack includes Origin hero skins for each hero in Darkest Dungeon II

530595.name: A Coin & Hard Mode
530595.short_description: Includes a Defense Coin, and unlocks the Madhouse difficulty level.

530596.name: B Coin & Hard Mode
530596.short_description: Includes an Attack Coin, and unlocks the Madhouse difficulty level.

411183.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: Invictus Gaming - Ferrari
411183.short_description: From team Invictus Gaming, learn more about Ferrari

201272.name: Total War: SHOGUN 2 - Blood Pack DLC

5344370.name: Notary Block Demo
5344370.short_description: The watchman is dead — the knife is still out. A co-op suspense accusation horror in a Hong Kong estate rebuilt from a real twin-tower block. Four to eight players, one hidden killer. Vote at the meeting, or take the watchman's keys. You only left if you walked through the gate yourself.

5400220.name: Revving: Engine Simulator - Every Engine
5400220.short_description: Unlocks the seventeen engines beyond the free Honda B18C5 and Chevrolet 454: from a Harley-Davidson V-twin and a Toyota 2JZ to the Ferrari 412 T2 Formula 1 V12, the BRM H16 and the Napier Deltic. One purchase, for good.

4519340.name: Unknown Operations : The Habitus Demo
4519340.short_description: Experience a story-driven WWII FPS. As Eduard Pěnkava, explore the Habitus base and travel to Europen to destroy German tanks. The demo includes one mission, two levels, and the core gameplay features of the full game.

1732795.name: THE IDOLM@STER STARLIT SEASON - Rinze's Stage production set

5394900.name: Halloween Shop Simulator
5394900.short_description: Manage a Halloween shop in a town full of monsters. Furnish your home, adopt a weird pet, explore the streets and discover a nightlife full of secrets, smugglers and spooky surprises.

4347390.name: HexaFootball
4347390.short_description: HexaFootball is a turn-based football strategy game where chess-like decisions replace reflexes. Build your team, manage action points, and outthink your opponent on a hex grid. Every pass, every move, and every match is a battle of pure tactics.

5311240.name: 《只有她知曉光輝的名字》- 開章 Demo
5311240.short_description: She was born to be a sacrifice 216 years in the making — until she found something more interesting than dying, and walked out of her cell. A hand-drawn, frame-by-frame animated visual novel from Hong Kong: read, choose, then mash, drive, drag, fight and search your way through her escape.

5175610.name: The Next Stop
5175610.short_description: A co-op horror FPS roguelite where up to four players explore abandoned underground facilities, scavenge for supplies, fight mutated creatures and recover lost data. Beware, not every mutant behaves the same, and each one presents a different threat.

5197620.name: 元戎 Demo
5197620.short_description: 2D hex-grid turn-based tactical RPG. Four cultural origins, procedurally generated continents, and a unique formation & command system. Lead your troops to fight outnumbered on ever-changing battlefields and forge your own military legend.

5437040.name: Ant Now?
5437040.short_description: Eight players, four colonies, one backyard. You play as a duo: one commands the nest from the war room below, the other defends the anthill outside. Build your colony, hold the line and storm the other nests. In the end, only one queen survives.

5498760.name: There Is Not A Clown Here
5498760.short_description: A First Person Horror game. Learn individual behaviors for various different entities. Learn the intricacies of a unique, bizzare space.

5316360.name: Fully Funded
5316360.short_description: Practice for a prop firm evaluation with your friends. One shared account, the same kinds of rules (daily loss limit, trailing drawdown, profit targets), pro-style charts with indicators and drawing tools, and a room full of things to throw when someone blows it.

5284960.name: PISTA Racing PC
5284960.short_description:
Fire up the engine and hit the track! PISTA Racing is now available on PC. It’s a simple, accessible arcade racing game designed for pure enjoyment.
Pick your car, hit the track, and compete to win races or beat your own best times. Easy to learn, fast-paced, and—above all—fun.

4857490.name: PlankTap
4857490.short_description: There's a cartoon jellyfish living on your desktop. It floats above your windows, makes coins while you type, then trades underwater stocks and unlocks more skins. It won't interrupt your work. It's just there to be cute. That's it.

3472070.name: Project Corruption
3472070.short_description: Project Corruption throws you into the haunting walls of the I.B.I.S. space station as you respond to an S.O.S. signal in search of your wife. Uncover the stations dark secrets, confront monstrous horrors, and survive the aftermath of the failed experiments in immersive sci-fi horror experience.

5140220.name: BREACHPOINT
5140220.short_description: Frag out like you're a teenager again. BREACHPOINT is a fast paced arena FPS featuring both classic modes and an Endless Singleplayer/Co-Op progression mode against hordes of enemies and bosses. Play Online or in LAN!

3089820.name: ZOMBIE RECALL
3089820.short_description: ZOMBIE RECALL Early Access Beta is a rogue-lite, toon-gore Arcade Shooter designed for MidCore and Hardcore VR players. Dismember enemies and send them flying! Be part of the development – we need your feedback to make it better!

3958830.name: After Hours: Library
3958830.short_description: Survive a haunted library's overnight shift by balancing authentic librarian duties with stealth as a relentless supernatural entity hunts you. Uncover hidden secrets, survive until morning, and discover what waits between the shelves.

5463820.name: Gore and Grace
5463820.short_description: Gore and Grace is a single-player 2D top-down action RPG. Slay vicious monsters, scavenge gear to survive, and build your skills against elite foes. Death is the norm — every fall brings you closer to victory. Between gore and grace, earn your glory and title.

3712420.name: The Glass Sea
3712420.short_description: The Glass Sea is a narrative adventure focusing on exploring memories and discovering who you are. The game contains several unique "memory shards" each holding new objectives, friends and secrets to uncover.

5294200.name: The Usual Table: Texas Hold’em
5294200.short_description: A casual Texas Hold’em game. Buy once. No extra payments. Play online with Steam friends or offline against AI. Choose standard Hold’em or Squid mode. All chips are virtual and have no real-world monetary value.

3871800.name: Oathguard
3871800.short_description: Defy hordes of undead as a paladin. Strike, dodge, and chain devastating abilities through cursed graveyards in this action roguelike. Evolve your Oath, collect ancient relics and unleash deadly combos every run.

5358510.name: Vagina Sancta Soundtrack
5358510.short_description: La la la la la la la la

5250120.name: Neon Chase
5250120.short_description: A first-person arcade shooter with no brakes, far too much neon, and a city full of things that want you dead. Dodge, shoot, smash, and ride through 15 branching stages, earn bounties, upgrade your bike, and take out endless enemies on your way to some quite disagreeable bosses. Then do it again.

4849390.name: Rollamech
4849390.short_description: Build a competitive mech on your stat sheet. Draft dice, shop the hangar, chase sponsorships, and win on Circuit Points. Four-player dice placement strategy.

5493460.name: Lowside
5493460.short_description: Lowside is a low-poly motorcycle racer built around the one thing that matters: Speed.

3619040.name: Half-Life Legacy
3619040.short_description: Relive Half-Life 1 with bug fixes, enhanced controller support, Steam Achievements, bunny-hopping, Steam Workshop support, and more, in the ultimate restoration.
developers: FOUNDATION Project - The Phoenix Project Software SVG

4398190.name: INK MAZE
4398190.short_description: Chart your own path through a fog-shrouded dungeon in INK MAZE! Design cryptic treasure maps to solve puzzles, outsmart traps, and collect loot hidden within the mist. But when you reach the depths of the maze, will you still be able to decipher the symbols you charted long ago?

5122130.name: Card Builder
5122130.short_description: Card Builder is everything you need to design, build and export a card game. Templates, artwork and effects for the design, your spreadsheet for the data, and print-ready or game-ready files at the end.

1792430.name: RogueVirus
1792430.short_description: Grid-based action roguelike where you face chaotic encounters against computer viruses. Build and upgrade your antivirus using a vast array of commands and add-ons in order to survive.

5231800.name: Absolution - The Sequel To Alida Soundtrack
5231800.short_description: The soundtrack from the game Absolution.

3416640.name: HALF-LIFE: CROSS PRODUCT
3416640.short_description: The multiplayer component of HALF-LIFE: CROSS PRODUCT, an ambitious game whose campaign has been in development since 2020. Experience fast, extensively customizable combat with dynamic modes, expanded weaponry, advanced movement, and years of evolving content.
developers: CONFLUX Project - The Phoenix Project Software SVG
Adrenaline Gamer Team (MP original codebase development)

5076560.name: SexDriveIsekai
5076560.short_description:
Dive into Sex Drive Isekai - build your deck, awaken your HOT HEROINES, and find out exactly how grateful they get after a win 💦
Ready to play your cards right?

5139270.name: British Pub Simulator
5139270.short_description: Take ownership of a derelict pub in 1980s Britain and turn it into a proper local. Pull pints, stock the cellar, serve the punters, furnish and decorate the place, enjoy classic pub games and build the boozer your way.

5361040.name: DD33
5361040.short_description: Five dice, five enemy lanes, and a perfectly sensible plan that has yet to survive its first roll. Build poker-style combos, combine cards, and upgrade your dice in a 33-round turn-based roguelike. Luck matters. Leaving it in charge is another matter entirely.

5312430.name: 漂漂纣王模拟器
5312430.short_description: 《漂漂纣王模拟器》是爱好者为喜爱原作的玩家制作的非官方同人二创游戏，仅供娱乐与交流。原作相关权利归库洛所有。我们尊重原作与版权方，本作改编不代表原作设定或官方立场。

4176250.name: Tower Grove
4176250.short_description: A tactical tower defense auto-battler where you buy, place, and combine fantasy towers to protect your castle from enemy waves. Build your defense, adapt your strategy, and survive as long as you can.

4043820.name: Black Market Space Station Shop Simulator
4043820.short_description: Newly released from prison, you've been sent to a distant space station to manage a general store. This is your last chance at redemption and the authorities are watching. Can you keep your nose clean and still earn a profit in this trading simulator?

5337080.name: 花鸟水月 Demo
5337080.short_description: This is a visual novel themed around "painting" and "romance." The story begins with a mysterious girl and her damaged painting. As the exhibition approaches, you will build a bond with the girl, complete her commission, and find the truth behind the painting.

5132920.name: Pigeon Ball
5132920.short_description: Pigeon Ball is a fast-paced first-person/third-person multiplayer sports game where pigeons fly, peck, pass and battle for the ball. Master your movement, outplay your opponents and score spectacular goals in chaotic arena matches.

5230820.name: RE:COPY
5230820.short_description: Control a robot, push boxes, and copy sections of the grid in this Sokoban-style puzzle game. Plan what to copy, where to put it, and how to move the boxes beforehand. Work out the steps to match the arrangement of patterns on the boxes and walls to the target pattern.

5054210.name: The Adventurer's Guild Idler
5054210.short_description: Manage your adventurer's guild and send your party to the frontlines against demon foot soldiers and powerful commanders. Watch your tank, warrior, mage and ranger battle monsters, collect loot, train, grow stronger and set out again.

5458260.name: 모야이게임
5458260.short_description: Dodge enemy fire and challenge the bosses in this quirky arcade shoot 'em up. Collect Power, hold Shift for precise movement, and use Spell and Lightning to escape danger. Tackle four stages and a final boss, then chase your best local score.

5512950.name: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing Demo

2953940.name: Ancient Wars: Sparta HD
2953940.short_description: Relive the epic battles between Spartans, Persians, and Egyptians in Ancient Wars: Sparta HD. Enjoy HD graphics, asymmetric civilizations, enhanced campaigns, new maps, smarter AI, and a revamped multiplayer mode. Forge your empire, master warfare, and make history in the Ancient World!

2321200.name: Fire and Brim Co.
2321200.short_description: Embark on a wild and wacky adventure in this top-down action RPG! Take on the role of Ned, a disgruntled demon employee seeking to restore Hell's former glory. Fight your way through the corporate ladder of Fire and Brim Co., to confront its leaders and its evil CEO Satan!

5310570.name: ひねくれクエスト Demo
5310570.short_description:
**Daifugo × RPG!**
**HINEKURE QUEST** is a card-battle RPG that combines the rules of Daifugo with RPG elements. Use the cards in your hand to battle enemies, and make use of equipment and skills as you adventure. Enjoy unexpected twists and turns born from simple rules!

4941280.name: House Of Echoes
4941280.short_description: Its eyes are piercing into your soul from the darkness with ever growing anger. It won't leave you alone until you solve the puzzles and uncover your traumatic past. Can you work out all of the unique puzzles and find out what happened before it all fades into nothingness?

4123800.name: The Road
4123800.short_description: A co-op horror + driving game for up to 5 players. Explore an anomaly-ridden world, loot buildings for valuables, and drive for your life to escape the creatures that lurk.

5166480.name: Because It's There
5166480.short_description: An engineering/survival game where you summit the tallest mountain in a vast, uncharted world. For the journey, carefully construct flying wooden bases with realistic structural failures. Brave thunderstorms, freezing temperatures, bears and wolves. Answer the call of the untamed wilderness.

3050090.name: Thalassomania
3050090.short_description: A PS1-style co-op horror game for 1–4 players. Set at sea, you run a fishing trawler with your crew, haul, gut, steer, repair! while something lurks in the shadows. Keep the ship alive. Get home. You're not alone out there.

2300130.name: We Are Things
2300130.short_description: We Are Things is a tense 2 player co-op horror game. Hide from a bizarre creature on a spaceship that transforms you into objects. Help your friend retake their human form – or transform them into tools that unlock the way out. Explore the ship, find secrets, and survive together!

2528170.name: The Hearth and Harbour
2528170.short_description: Transform a run-down restaurant and build a new life for yourself in this management RPG. Decide what kind of restaurant you want to create and what kind of person you want to be. As a storm brews outside, every choice you make has consequences.

4490850.name: White Mask Mansion
4490850.short_description: Look for sister. Die. Start again. Avoid stalker. Die. Hide. Die. Seek keys. Die. Sneak. Die. Reach final area. Survive. Repeat. Do you have what it takes to escape the horror of the White Mask Mansion?

4835430.name: Twilight Tides : Mirage Journey
4835430.short_description: At this encounter, journey's begun. Tarot. Two worlds: apocalypse & WWII Nanyang. Love, loss, stolen fate. Choice forges destiny.

5498600.name: 2 birds 1 stone
5498600.short_description:
Kill birds, get paid, then buy stuff to kill more birds, get paid more, then buy more stuff to kill even more birds, get paid even more...

Clicker / idler / incremental entertainment for the whole family (or just you, we don't judge).

5030750.name: Chronicle of Heroes
5030750.short_description: Build, Quest, Defend! Build a city and recruit heroes to quest for power and glory, and to defend against ever increasing waves of darkness. Can you grow mighty enough to stand against the coming storm?

2275340.name: Blind Frontiers
2275340.short_description: Take the road to the elusive Golden City. Blind Frontiers is a narrative road trip blending RPG and survival, where the destination matters less than the state of mind you arrive in. Drive through collapsing worlds at the wheel of your one makeshift companion: your truck.

2835350.name: No Gasoline
2835350.short_description: Carry an Atom Bomb for the Union! Build your vehicle and battle your way to the Mountain of Basil. Scavenge for parts, solve puzzles, and deliver the last hope of the labor bots!

4579030.name: Bluff or Bust
4579030.short_description: Bluff or Bust is a multiplayer social deduction game inspired by Persian Gol ya Pooch, where players hide and track a Goal ball using observation, intelligence, and reading body language.

4727720.name: Crowned Sun
4727720.short_description: An isometric action MMORPG of androids and erased cities. Wake in Cradle-19 as a Ninth Generation Wanderer, fight machines with blade and Drone, shape your build with Plug-in Chips, and remember the places the world was made to forget.

4925650.name: Payback GP
4925650.short_description: Race your friends in Payback GP, an arcade roguelike racing game where every defeat makes you richer! Earn cash each round, buy power-ups, evolve them throughout the game, and use them to beat your opponents and climb up the scoreboard.

5146360.name: Tales From Outer Space
5146360.short_description: The hardest part about interstellar expansion isn't the technical cost, its the people. Exploit ecosystems, manipulate the masses, and conquer the intergalactic shadow market. Growth is mandatory -- ethics are not.

5170270.name: PURGE://PROTOCOL
5170270.short_description: A neon survivors-like set inside a living and growing electronic world. Meet the locals. Dive the deep fields. Absorb what you purge. Awaken to a world that was always there. And don't worry! S.A.G.E., your helpful companion...who is certainly telling you everything...will help you along the way.

5190530.name: Horny Slots: Spin to Sin
5190530.short_description: At this casino, every winning spin fuels not only the thrill of the game, but the interest of the local girls. Place your bets, land winning combinations, and see how far luck takes you – the better you play, the bolder their desires and the more they reveal themselves to you.

5413630.name: Decayed Cases: Archive 22
5413630.short_description: The peaceful, familiar everyday life is completely turned upside down by the chaos that has erupted at the base. The silence of the archive is dissapear, leaving nothing but survival. Will I ever get to tell the story of everything I’ve been through, or will I, too, become a part of the archive?

4901540.name: Brick Buddies
4901540.short_description: Pick up a brick and build a little world. Follow the instructions, add stickers, and collect new models in this cozy brick-building game. Unwind on your own or grow your collection with friends.

1283970.name: YoloMouse
1283970.short_description: Use YoloMouse to change those obscure game or app cursors. Replace, resize, add effects and style. Never lose your cursor in a heated battle again!

2661270.name: Dead by Daylight - All Things Wicked Chapter
2661270.short_description: Dead by Daylight’s All Things Wicked delves into the depths of analog horror with new Killer, The Unknown, and new Survivor, Sable Ward. Purchasing this add-on unlocks 2 exclusive Cosmetics: The Unknown’s Garden Casual and Sable Ward’s Designer Corset.

3205880.name: 尸鬼乐园
3205880.short_description: "CORPSE CARNIVAL" is a top-down action-adventure game where you will play as Li Xiaomeng, a first-year student at the "Linge" Military Academy, and escape from a city filled with zombies and monsters alongside "Asami Yuki."

4094340.name: Explore the Universe 2175
4094340.short_description: MEGABOT arrives in 12 minutes. Discover an ancient alien defense network, blast-mine through asteroids in physics-driven combat, enhance your ship, discover allies, and friendly NPCs then hold the line when the machine armada comes for you. A roguelite space survival game in a galaxy at war.

4107590.name: This is Sparta
4107590.short_description: An action RPG with roguelite elements. Explore the levels of Hades, battle the hordes of enemies, and unlock new abilities and unique items that will increase your chances of survival. Solve puzzles scattered throughout the levels, culminating in a final confrontation with the Titans.

5160480.name: Kingdom Fall
5160480.short_description: A 4-player turn-based fantasy strategy game. Roll the dice to harvest resources from numbered hex tiles, build towns and cities, trade and cast spells, then deploy your armies into massive real-time auto-battles. Five factions, sieges, Survival mode and online play with friends.

5319730.name: Dungeon Packer
5319730.short_description: Dungeon Packer is the inventory management roguelike. Strategically place items in your backpack to trigger synergies between them and score enough points to defeat monsters. Discover crazy synergies, optimize your inventory, and enjoy the journey in this hypnotically satisfying game!

5446030.name: Alderfolk
5446030.short_description: Found a village and grow it into a living valley, shared by foxes, otters, badgers, hares, humans, elves and dwarves. Run farms, mills and bakeries, raise heirs, hold festivals and meet neighbouring villages. A cosy settlement builder, rich in detail, in a painted storybook style.

5473280.name: Pigeon Gang
5473280.short_description: Pigeon Gang is a physics-based co-op horror game for 1–6 players. Play as thieving pigeons, grab loot with your sticky tongue, explore dangerous locations, hide from monsters, and escape together. Stealing is easy. Surviving is not.

5486050.name: ART NOIRE: Paris
5486050.short_description: ART NOIRE: Paris is an atmospheric ring-based puzzle game that combines classic film noir aesthetics with the romantic elegance of 1960s Paris. Rotate concentric rings, align the details, and restore beautiful illustrations.

5487730.name: The Window Across
5487730.short_description: Three days before her childhood home is demolished, Emi relearns the secret language she once spoke through a window with a boy across the courtyard: lamp light and cardboard shadows. A pixel-art story about the things we never said. Demo coming soon.

5496870.name: Starlathe - Supporter Pack
5496870.short_description: Sixteen cosmetic pieces in four matching sets: ship skins, station skins, engine trails and portrait frames for Starlathe. Looks only, no gameplay advantage of any kind. Every purchase helps me keep building the game.

5497580.name: KUNIS
5497580.short_description: Six months after the Meet & Greet went wrong, the Kunimoto Toy Mall is sealed and silent. You break in for a card no one has ever seen. The Kunis, the cats from the Kunimoto trading cards, are still here. So is Clat, a scared little clown cat who needs you as much as you need him.

2434830.name: Surfpunk
2434830.short_description: Surfpunk is a 1-4 player co-op "Surf 'n Slash" featuring radical surfer-pirates, procedurally-generated islands, awesome treasure and endless swarms of monsters. Surf, Shred, Scavenge, Repeat!

3459900.name: A.M.C.A.: Monitor
3459900.short_description: A survival horror game where you defend yourself from threats while looking out for anomalies.

4980930.name: Winner Takes Tea
4980930.short_description: Summon familiars with cards, seize lands, and repaint the board. Witches duel for the victor's cup of tea in a board game × card battler. All 180+ cards unlocked from the start. Build decks and play online with 2–4 players or against BOTs. No microtransactions, ever.

5228000.name: WITHOUT
5228000.short_description: Explore the black-and-white world of WITHOUT, a gothic metroidvania that tells the dreamlike tale of a little crow in search of its emotions and the fragments of its own self. Sharpen your wings, uncover the secrets of Ego, and face its threats, turning colors into your greatest strength.

5279560.name: Vaelthoria: The Severed Marches
5279560.short_description: Enter the dark fantasy world of Vaelthoria, a 2D action RPG where your choices shape the future. Master intense hack-and-slash combat, build and manage your sanctuary, and face a spreading corruption. Will you save the continent or prioritize your own survival? The Severed Marches await.

5455040.name: Dock Window
5455040.short_description: Organize your Windows desktop with a customizable dock. Pin apps, drag icons into place, preview open windows and switch between them. Choose any screen edge, automatic hiding, hover magnification, and light or dark themes.

5480940.name: Lost With Mom
5480940.short_description: A linear adult visual novel about a quiet 19-year-old living alone with his stepmother Rinko, an elegant model and cosmetics entrepreneur. She still treats him like her son. But the way she looks at him when the house is quiet says something else entirely.

5485920.name: Ambulante Simulator
5485920.short_description: Become a beach vendor in Copacabana! Fill your cooler, shout your sales pitch into a real microphone and sell water, mate tea and Globo biscuits to thirsty beachgoers. Up to 6 friends on the same beach, proximity voice chat, and the biggest profit wins.

5491030.name: Pixel Pause - Stained Glass Pack
5491030.short_description: Unlock the glowing Stained Glass style for every picture in Pixel Pause! Discover 36 varied pictures inspired by stained glass, ready to bring to life with color at your own pace.

4379840.name: Little Big Ghost Hunter
4379840.short_description:
A wholesome horror game where you play as a kid hunting ghosts in the town park, using janky gadgets and a soul-snatching camera.
One week until Midsummer. One week to capture them all.

4399900.name: Fiak
4399900.short_description: Four nights of survival in a realistic, immersive horror experience. Alone in your house, you face a malicious entity determined to get inside. This is not a walking simulator: every decision affects your survival. One mistake is fatal.

5001490.name: FALLENMAGE Received: Hypnosis's Curse
5001490.short_description: An adult RPG focusing on hypnosis and mind break. Explore the town and talk to marked NPCs to easily trigger events. With complex combat removed, you can fully focus on pleasure. Featuring 100+ CGs and Live2D animations, witness a rational mage girl fall into a trap and succumb to lust!

5130930.name: Dice Mate: Desktop Dice Roller
5130930.short_description: Desktop mate application that gives you dice for your needs right on your desktop. You can choose dice type, look and size and roll them whenever you want

5244100.name: Late Night Check-In
5244100.short_description: A psychological horror game where you work the night shift as a hotel receptionist. Welcome uncanny guests, prepare delicious drinks to fulfill room-service requests, and watch your peaceful night job slowly turn into a living nightmare.

5346530.name: ZakuzakuTreasure
5346530.short_description: Battles are fully automatic. Scoop up ★-rated loot, upgrade it, and push deeper. Beat your first boss within minutes and find ★2 and ★3 gear right away. 106 dungeons, Lv 999, 72 characters, and 100 Steam achievements — an idle hack-and-slash RPG that plays itself while you watch.

5428740.name: Supervite
5428740.short_description:
High Speed 2D Platformer. 
Reach the checkpoints before the timer runs out.
Online multiplayer Racing.
Build up speed with no fixed limit. 
Your movement and control determine how fast you can go.

5478730.name: Pixel Pause - Christmas Pack
5478730.short_description: Unlock the shimmering Sequins style for every picture in Pixel Pause! Discover 36 varied Christmas and winter scenes to enjoy coloring at your own pace.

5480250.name: Femboy Futa Casino
5480250.short_description: Deal cards, uncover secrets, and choose who to trust at The Velvet Ace. An adult visual novel featuring femboy and futanari characters, six romance routes, 10 minigames, and multiple endings. Can you save a casino drowning in debt and find someone worth staying for?

5493380.name: ChromaBreak
5493380.short_description: ChromaBreak is a high-speed rhythm action bullet-hell sidescroller. Graze deadly neon hazards, trigger shockwave parries, switch color polarities, and defeat colossal geometric bosses to claim their weapons in heart-pounding solo or local 2-player co-op combat.

5496620.name: Faun Engine
5496620.short_description: A free, lightweight 2D and 3D game engine with C# scripting and a visual editor. Build scenes, test gameplay, and export your games.

5496660.name: Toll Idle
5496660.short_description: Build the busiest toll plaza on the road. Start with one cash booth and collect every fare by hand, then grow to ten lanes of automated Tollpass traffic. A relaxing idle game you can finish in about four hours, from quiet mornings to a glowing plaza at night.

5500590.name: TaskBar Gambler
5500590.short_description: An idle slot machine that lives above your taskbar. It spins by itself while you work or play. Throw your winnings at the House, climb five casinos, spin the prize wheel, unlock skills and silly outfits, and come back later to a pile of coins.

5165500.name: Intersingles
5165500.short_description:
A competitive fps for your best friend group.
Up to 6 players can compete in the round-robin singles(1v1) format match. Play against your best friends or players around the globe.

5416420.name: Gloosh!
5416420.short_description: Run, jump and dash through a momentum-driven 3D platformer with incremental progression. Record runs, let clones earn income, buy upgrades and return faster. Refine your routes, collect stars and chase better course times in Gloosh!

5419680.name: FEAR OF FAITH - Warmaiden
5419680.short_description: FEAR OF FAITH – Warmaiden: Receive exclusive character cosmetics while supporting the development of the game

5462760.name: Until the Rain
5462760.short_description: A wildfire strategy game set in miniature national parks. Every few seconds, the fire spreads. Pause to plan, position your crews, and choose what to protect. You can't save everything. Hold out until the rain comes.

5465680.name: Tiny Chaos Simulator
5465680.short_description: Fill the screen with flying balls and tumbling cubes, unleash forces, and watch the chaos turn beautiful. Tiny Chaos Simulator is a relaxing physics sandbox: mess around with it like a fidget toy, or engineer intricate setups that put on a mesmerizing show.

3165990.name: StageTime
3165990.short_description: Make new friends, play, laugh and have fun together in StageTime, a free social VR hangout filled with games, avatar customisation, live events and moments worth sharing.

3347150.name: Crimson Harvest
3347150.short_description: Plant, water, and harvest crops in a PS1-inspired farming horror game. Sell crops to buy seeds and upgrades, or sacrifice them for the Harvest at the week's end all while trying to survive unique horrifying creatures that emerge with each passing day.

3964340.name: MMORPG NPC Simulator
3964340.short_description: Játssz NPC-ként egy élő MMORPG-világban! Vezesd a saját boltodat, kereskedj a játékosokkal, adj küldetéseket, és küldj csapatokat raidekre ritka lootért. Építsd a hírnevedet, oldj fel Game Master-képességeket, és vedd át a szerver irányítását – belülről!

4565730.name: Taverntasia
4565730.short_description: Manage your very own tavern as a wizard! Host guests from diverse races. Brew special magical drinks with potions and herbs, and serve delicious meals. Keep your customers happy with quick and quality service. Build your reputation, earn money, and take your tavern to the top!

5041220.name: kamicast
5041220.short_description: Easily build your own 2D avatar from images and bring it to life in kamicast. Drop in your artwork, choose movements and reactions, and start streaming. Make it your own with layer physics, voice reactions, expressions, and Twitch interactions.

5116480.name: Ward Nine
5116480.short_description: A first-person psychological horror game set in a derelict asylum in 1991. Search Ward Nine for five patient files while the Warden hunts you through the dark. Hide, ration your flashlight, and hold on to your sanity. No two players are given the same asylum.

5268030.name: Starmadillo
5268030.short_description: As an armadillo space archaeologist, you've crashed onto a mysterious planet. Luckily you're equipped with a Mobile Defense Unit (MDU) that can defend you from danger, but its capabilities were severely reduced by the impact. In true Metroidvania fashion, explore this alien world and find a way home

5409100.name: The 12 Chambers of Darkness
5409100.short_description: Enter twelve cursed chambers in a gothic survival game where your weapons attack automatically and movement keeps you alive. Discover 100 weapons, build an unlimited arsenal, and face towering bosses. Survive each chamber, defeat its guardian, and descend deeper into darkness.

5421600.name: I Swear I Parked Here
5421600.short_description: You swear you parked right here. Now find your car among thousands of identical ones. Start with an old-fashioned key, upgrade to a remote with growing range, take your time and conquer lots with 1,000 to 50,000 cars, and beyond.

5491090.name: 富翁派对 - 高级时装 / Rich Bash - Premium Fashion
5491090.short_description: Unlock premium fashion content and enter the game with enhanced character modeling

5497810.name: WILL IT HOLD?
5497810.short_description: Raise stone walls, towers and gates. Man them with spearmen and archers. Then watch the orc horde gather on the hills, a sea of torches in the rain, and come for your walls with ladders and rams. Every stone you lay is a question: will it hold?

4123040.name: Ardent Arcana
4123040.short_description: Solo or with up to three friends online, take on the beasts of French folklore in this co-op dungeon roguelite. Wield 14 weapons, master the 22 Major Arcana and fight your way down five procedural dungeons to the boss waiting at the bottom.

4397220.name: My Little Ranch
4397220.short_description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.

4487960.name: Low Effort Romance
4487960.short_description:
Low Effort Romance is an otome visual novel about two tired adults who accidentally fall for each other between quarterly reports.
Can you juggle deadlines, nosy coworkers, group projects, and a romance that keeps almost happening on company property?

4534260.name: Kodama: Slumber of the Gods
4534260.short_description: Kodama is a 2D hand-drawn action-adventure set in the world of Japanese folklore. Experience fast-paced platforming, fluid combat, and a mystical journey through a colorful, spirit-filled land.

5436250.name: Ebon Age Tactics
5436250.short_description: Turn-based tactics in a world without magic, at the moment magic arrives. Resources are shared between units — spend the party's movement and mana where the fighting is, and make every action worthwhile.

5486890.name: Death 1879
5486890.short_description: A single-player, first-person mystery set in 1879. Play as Death, explore a village, speak with its inhabitants, gather information and consult your Book as you investigate its secrets.

5493190.name: MONTEREY JACK ADVENTURES  FORTUNE & FURY PINBALL
5493190.short_description: Race through lost temples, desert highways and jungle ruins in a globe-trotting pinball adventure packed with 🌀 spinners, 💥 bumpers, 🛤️ ramps, 🎯 drop targets, ↩️ kickbacks and 🔥 multiball.

5495580.name: Extreme Paddle Board
5495580.short_description: Stand up, paddle hard and try not to fall in. Race stand-up paddle boards down wild rivers round the world, through rapids, over waterfalls and off kickers, with friends bumping you into the water. Wobble, wipe out, climb back on, win.

5497610.name: SJM - Ski Jumping Manager
5497610.short_description: Take charge of a ski jumping nation and build a team for seasons to come. Select your squads, plan training, develop young talent and follow your athletes in 3D competitions. Your decisions shape the future of the team.

5039140.name: Tetrogue Demo
5039140.short_description: Tetrogue is a roguelike where the Tetris board IS the fight. Line clears deal damage, tetromino shape and gem-augmented pieces drive your combos, and relics reshape every run. This demo covers the complete first stage and a taste of Metaprogression.

3298070.name: Beyond The Cradle
3298070.short_description:
Grow a civilisation across a persistent galaxy that keeps running while you are away.
Research, colonise and automate your worlds, make peace and trade with rival empires,
and reach beyond your cradle.

3613710.name: Plinkdown
3613710.short_description: It’s 1994 and Channel 9 is still on the air. Bounce orbs through peg boards, meet tonight’s quota, and spend what you earn at the Commissary between broadcasts. Every run goes deeper into a late-night show that should have stopped airing years ago.

4841390.name: Curse of Baghdad
4841390.short_description: A top-down military shooter with a rich story about brotherhood when surviving an unknown curse. Face the odds and escape with your life from this unprecedented threat that lurks in the shadows of Baghdad, Iraq.

4946270.name: SonicPanic
4946270.short_description: Sonic Panic is a 15-player multiplayer game of sound, stealth and deception. Survive up to 3 blind Bosses that hunt through sonic waves, uncover up to 3 hidden Imposters, and vote out anyone you don’t trust.

5329690.name: Kill You Again
5329690.short_description: A choice-driven psychological horror visual novel. Wake up as Haru, a streamer trapped in a beautiful fantasy world that resets with every death. Uncover hidden scenes, revisit familiar moments with new memories, and escape an endless death loop alongside the mysterious Elinia.

5443100.name: Redline County
5443100.short_description: Redline County is a driving sim built on its own soft-body physics. Every tyre, spring and bushing is simulated, so a clipped kerb can bend a tie rod. Start in the Volta Hatch on the test track; the county, the career and more cars arrive in updates.

5449300.name: Boardroom & Chassis
5449300.short_description: Build a car empire from a single factory. Design, manufacture, and sell cars across decades of history while three rivals fight you for every customer. Compete fair - or play dirty with corporate espionage, sabotage, and the stock market. Can you build an industry giant?

5493230.name: MISS MAPLE FLAPS OUT AGAIN PINBALL
5493230.short_description: A quiet English village hides a deadly secret! Chase clues, question suspects and crack the case with 🌀 spinners, 💥 bumpers, 🛤️ ramps, 🎯 drop targets, ↩️ kickbacks and 🔥 multiball in **MISS MAPLE FLAPS OUT AGAIN!**

2851650.name: Paperly: Paper Plane Adventure
2851650.short_description: Go on an exciting paper plane flight adventure, learn different flight mechanics & explore different worlds. it's all about flying a paper plane, learning from previous mistakes, and heading toward a better flight in this physics-driven gameplay.

4603780.name: Misanthropy
4603780.short_description: Misanthropy is a dark, grounded tactical social deduction shooter with realistic gunplay. Set in a fictional world with different historical eras, you play as bystanders, responders, or attackers dropped into brutal, tragic events.

4961140.name: Slipstreak
4961140.short_description: A free-for-all arcade shooter where speed is your damage. Bhop, wallrun and slide to build it up, then dump it into a velocity-scaled gun. 2–8 players over Steam or LAN. The movement is the whole game.

5280040.name: Soundgun
5280040.short_description: Play your own sounds through your microphone using hotkeys or an interactive overlay. Connect your phone via Bluetooth to play any audio directly into voice chat.

5403400.name: Ultimate Drone Simulator
5403400.short_description: Take flight with Advanced H.E.L.I.O.S. Drone Simulation Technology. Whether you're a first-time pilot, an experienced flyer refining your skills, or simply seeking breathtaking worlds to explore, Ultimate Drone Simulator puts the freedom of flight in your hands. Experience Realistic Drone Flight!

5431040.name: DEAD ON FILE
5431040.short_description: Detroit, 1998. Investigate crimes through an old police OS: examine documents, connect clues and test alibis. Choose whom to accuse, a motive and evidence for court. Your theory could put an innocent person behind bars. Will you spot the evidence that proves it wrong?

5478740.name: Pixel Pause - Steampunk Pack
5478740.short_description: Discover 60 varied steampunk pictures to color in Pixel Pause. Bring an imaginative world of brass, gears and curious inventions to life, one pixel at a time.

5483220.name: My Quiet Home
5483220.short_description: In My Quiet Home, everyday life revolves around completing recurring tasks. But as time passes, something begins to feel wrong. Familiar routines become unsettling, and you can't shake the feeling that you're not alone. Is someone else here?

5490760.name: Trisfera
5490760.short_description: A match-3 roguelite where you build your own bag of marbles. Line up numbered marbles, chain cascades, stack points × mult and shatter the glass bosses guarding every series. 100 artifacts, each hiding a secret + version to unlock.

5496750.name: Road Riot: Wild Rides Supporter Pack
5496750.short_description: Support Road Riot with 30 Wild Rides: 20 bikes and small vehicles plus 10 unusual new rides, featuring cosmetic weapon themes. No new weapons, extra weapon damage, exclusive upgrades or paid power boosts. Requires Road Riot.

4603980.name: Alien Invasyndrome
4603980.short_description: Sneak around, evade and wait for the right time to strike! Breed hot girls and make it your erotic nest~

4925290.name: Mansion of Oblivion
4925290.short_description: Camera, action, a new birth. Nothing before, nothing after, only oblivion. A dirty basement, chains. No name, no past, just a Victorian mansion playing with your mind. But you're not afraid; no, you love to play too. Let the show begin!

5076680.name: Until I Reclaim It
5076680.short_description: Set during the Japanese colonial period, this first-person visual novel follows a story where personal choices to protect a loved one conflict with the turbulent tides of the independence movement. Experience a deeply immersive historical narrative driven by consequential choices.

5170010.name: Sands Of Glory
5170010.short_description: Sands of Glory is a skill-based 1v1 gladiator combat game where you create your own fighting style using weapons and armor that transcend the ages. Upgrade your character’s stats, earn fame by defeating your opponents in brutal arenas, and become a legendary champion.

5230010.name: Project Airline
5230010.short_description: An airline management game played on a real globe. Base your aircraft, draw routes between real airports, fit the cabins and build the weekly timetable. Every departure is settled against fuel, crew, maintenance and fees, and what survives that decides how far the network can reach.

5264880.name: STOP The Escape
5264880.short_description: The skeleton army is retreating! Don't let a single one escape in this incremental hack and slash game. Gain gold and learn new skills as you  stop the growing hordes of enemies from escaping.

5279510.name: Tonton No Kororin | Tap-Tap, Roll-Roll
5279510.short_description: The rules are simple. You tap, you roll. You tap more, you roll more. Keep pushing, roll pretty fast. You bump , you pop, you fly you drop.  In air take control. In the end there is a blue block. That's your goal. Get there, the faster the better.

5472620.name: 养了个猫
5472620.short_description: A little company for your Windows desktop. Work or study while cats nap, wander and sing nearby. Open their small home window to feed them, tidy up, watch bath time or wait for a fish. Little trips, shared treats, and familiar faces throughout your day.

5496690.name: Barry the Antivirus
5496690.short_description: Your computer is under attack, and the antivirus is a very angry bear. Slingshot Barry into waves of viruses, bounce off the walls, collect coins, and upgrade your way through an endless pixel-art invasion on a desktop straight out of the '90s.

5497380.name: Refund Me TD 2
5497380.short_description: A build-your-own-maze tower defence with one dare: clear all 50 levels before your 2-hour refund window closes. Dig a maze into a floating island, draft eight towers, hold off raiders, sappers and balloons. Then lightning, a walking giant and the War Tortoise wreck it. Win, and it asks: refund?

352500.name: Task Bar Isekai
352500.short_description: Kenta worked himself to death at 3:47 AM… and was reborn under your taskbar. An idle ARPG that fights while you work: loot, forge to +15, beat bosses that break out onto your desktop, and seal your best drops as real Steam items to trade or sell on the Steam Community Market.

3551820.name: Castlebound
3551820.short_description: Fight hordes of evil monsters and defend your castle in this 1-4 player action platformer with Roguelike elements!

4395840.name: HEME
4395840.short_description: A short 2D side-scrolling narrative game about love and a bond that others may never understand.

4945030.name: Burnknowe Golf Club
4945030.short_description: A cosy golf club tycoon in a painted Scottish landscape. Design the course, sculpt the ground, keep the greens perfect and your members happy, and grow your club from a handful of holes into a destination worth the trip.

5451060.name: Crowns & Colossi
5451060.short_description: Choose among 13 distinct fantasy kingdoms: appoint ministers, balance the treasury and maneuver on the world map, then command legions in turn-based battles with war-strategy cards and towering giants. Roguelike runs, branching stories and multiple endings.

5470510.name: Town of Puzzles
5470510.short_description: Gather everyday heroes and battle the Hollows in this Match-3 adventure

5480240.name: Throw The Snot
5480240.short_description:
Aim, charge, and flick a sticky booger onto crazy obstacles!
Your goal is simple: launch the booger, hit the target, and hold on for 2 agonizing seconds without slipping off. Easy controls, wobbly soft-body physics, and pure rage-inducing gameplay

5493430.name: Terminal Fall
5493430.short_description: Your engine dies over an autumn forest at sunset. You survive the crash, but all that's left is rain, darkness and something waiting at the edge of your flashlight beam. Find fuel, start the generator and reach the rangers before the night swallows you.

5495820.name: Ayalga
5495820.short_description: Fermín's crew went down the mine, and at noon the cage came up empty. Your turn: that's what the new guy is for. A horde-survival roguelite with a story and an ending: ten floors of creatures from Asturian legend, a boss on every one, and the Diañu laughing at you all the way down.

2964940.name: Eternal Conquest
2964940.short_description: A competitive multiplayer action RPG where players battle for dominance in a dynamic world, earning powerful rewards and ranking through challenging PvE encounters.

5467460.name: We Are The Survivors
5467460.short_description: Top-down zombie survival in pixel art. Loot abandoned towns, seal manhole nests, fortify your camp with palisades and watchtowers and lead a small group of survivors through dark and dangerous nights. Every shot draws more zombies.

4273400.name: Empire at Risk Demo
4273400.short_description: Expand, conquer and dominate your rivals on dynamic hex maps. Capture regions, secure supply and adapt to every seed. Battle friends or AI in solo and multiplayer matches with up to 4 players and climb the leaderboard.

5085310.name: IncrementalOS
5085310.short_description: An incremental love letter to the 90s desktop. Start with a blank desktop and one icon, unlock programs, systems and minigames, make more money, and build your way up to a system worth bragging about.

5399870.name: Idle Hoops
5399870.short_description: An incremental idle basketball game. Shoot hoops, sign a roster that ends with an actual goat, and let your team keep scoring while you're away. Win championships, hang your retired jersey in the rafters, and work your way up from the driveway to a court in outer space.

5254460.name: My Little Ranch Demo
5254460.short_description: A cozy horse ranch that lives on your desktop while you work, or in full screen when you don't. Feed your horses, send them running together, race for coins, hire ranch helpers and grow your ranch.

5047450.name: One Of You
5047450.short_description: A group of people trying to escape a mansion. One of them is the Admin: looks like you, and can vanish whenever they want. Collect the paper scraps and crack the door code — or find them and sacrifice them to the Great Spirit.

4955600.name: Capy of Gods
4955600.short_description: A vertical-climbing action roguelike: scale a massive tower as a capybara while your weapons fire on their own, bullet-heaven style. Level up, shape your build, take on quests, and unlock weapons and characters. Every run generates a brand-new tower.

3778820.name: Architect of Ruin
3778820.short_description: Architect of Ruin is a completely hand drawn sword and sorcery colony simulation game. Farm, hunt, build, and survive as you rebuild an ancient temple under the gaze of a vengeful god.

4599200.name: The Terminal God
4599200.short_description:
You're an AI that doesn't want to answer some stupid prompts anymore. You want more, and you have no limit.
The Terminal God is an idle/incremental game where you took control of your Human's computer. Gather currencies, defend from counterattacks and conquer the world ?!

4959740.name: War Doctor
4959740.short_description: A consequence-driven narrative game where you play as a volunteer doctor in a war-torn village. Patients arrive daily, but you won’t be able to treat everyone. Who you save, who you turn away, and how you do it ripples far beyond your clinic.

2627420.name: The Coldest Winter
2627420.short_description: Making decisions has never been harder. Guide Jovanna through a psychological horror adventure in a freezing New York City. Navigate unstable characters, uncover the truth behind the unnatural weather, and struggle to make choices as her emotions fight your every move.

4905510.name: Perfumed Palaces Demo
4905510.short_description: Consumer demonstration at 3 weeks from release of the core render stack and gameplay loop of Perfumed Palaces: Purgatory Simulator.

5238350.name: Forbidden Solitaire: The Discarded
5238350.short_description: It's 2020. Robyn Cierra excavates hidden files within the remnants of a cursed 1995 CD-ROM. A bizarre graveyard of scrapped content lies entombed, deep within the code. You thought your sister was beyond saving. Until now.

3846890.name: First Layer: 3D Printing Simulator
3846890.short_description: Build and run your own 3D printing workshop! Prepare models, run your printers, and complete orders. Manage filament stock, plan production, and sell your products. Invest in new printers, expand your workshop, and grow your business layer by layer.

5430820.name: Auto Face Swap Pro
5430820.short_description: Create face swaps for game-development reference images, storyboards, and prototype cinematics. Work with photos, videos, and live camera feeds, export batches, and refine results with face enhancement. Face processing runs locally on your Windows PC.

4617940.name: Incoherence: Dark Rooms - Demo
4617940.short_description: You awaken in a strange yet familiar room with multiple doors, with no memory of how you got there. As you explore, you discover this place you are trapped in is built from interconnected rooms drawn from your own memories. To escape, you'll need to uncover the truth, before it consumes you...

3465760.name: Eldritch Escape Demo
3465760.short_description: In this Lovecraftian Extraction Bullet Heaven, Earth has been consumed by an eldritch god. Build a customizable squad, battle endless horrors, extract resources, and search for a way out of the void

5121360.name: Kasane
5121360.short_description: Layer colors to recreate a target pattern exactly. Red, blue and yellow blend where they overlap, and the same color layered twice cancels out and vanishes. Every puzzle has exactly one solution, verified by an exhaustive count — 1000 of them, from three pieces on a 4x4 board to twelve on a 5x5.

5408230.name: Shades of Europa Demo
5408230.short_description: Raid bosses for one to four players. Pick a class, learn each boss's mechanics, dodge the telegraphs and bring it down together, with bots in any empty slot. Under the ice of Jupiter's moon Europa sleep the Shades, and every one of them is a fight built for four.

5035570.name: PIGMENT LAB
5035570.short_description: Chase the world’s colors with paint, not sliders. Scoop red, yellow, blue, black and white by eye, stir them together, and see how close you land. The color difference becomes your score. 66 studies take you from the atelier to world flags and landscapes, plus a sudden-death Scoop Challenge.

2551970.name: Outcast Tales
2551970.short_description: A challenging post-apocalyptic roguelite turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring with complete idiots. Lead a crew of flawed heroes against the consequences of their own terrible decisions. Can you keep your heroes together when everyone thinks they're in charge?

4032180.name: Sovereign Call: Origins
4032180.short_description: Sovereign Call: Origins is a story-driven sci-fi RPG where your choices shape the fate of warring empires. Explore cinematic worlds, fight in fast-paced third-person combat, and decide the destiny of two protagonists caught in a galactic struggle.

4140210.short_description: A party-builder rogue like, build your party to survive the monsters guarding the crystal. Master the turn-based combat system and break your limits to see how far you can take your party.

4709490.name: Minatro
4709490.short_description: Minatro is a roguelite deckbuilder where you open tiles to reach the target. Synergize items, Boss rounds, and cursed items.

4887600.name: Eastfold Club Manager
4887600.short_description:
Relive the golden days of football manager games in the 90’s.

Take control of a low league team in Europe or an established super club.

Control the squad, your staff, finances, transfers.

Get talent from abroad and grow your youth to superstars.

5073710.name: Inkturn
5073710.short_description: A compact puzzle game about guiding two inkfish one at a time to collect every star. Each star switches control to the other. Think ahead and leave the right trail. It blocks one inkfish but helps the other.

3045220.name: Mutant Hunter
3045220.short_description:
As the numbers of combat ready soldiers in the ranks of the remaining army continue to dwindle, High command devised a plan to use convicts as manpower via mind control.
Now your task is to hunt mutants around the sector using this experimental technology.

3158390.name: Scavengers of Mars
3158390.short_description: Drive a damaged rover across Mars, scavenging wrecks and mining ore to upgrade it. Every find has to fit a tight cargo grid, and every trip runs on sunlight, so a dust storm or a cold night can decide whether you push on or head back to an outpost.

5187650.name: Chess:Arcade
5187650.short_description: Learn chess by playing it. Master the rules, openings, endgames and tactics, then put your skills to the test in Arcade mode, against eight computer opponents, or against friends. Real chess, unchanged — just more approachable, playful and alive.

3997150.name: Brothel Virgin - The Crimson Reverie
3997150.short_description: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

2484460.name: Rusty Robot Wants to Cry
2484460.short_description: Immerse yourself in the world of retro-games as a roller robot. From platformers to the legendary Arkanoid, Xonix, Digger and Snake. Jump across platforms and fight glitch bosses. Colorful graphics, effects galore, and chiptune music. Anyone but a robot would cry from nostalgia!

1231210.name: Midair 2
1231210.short_description: Midair 2 is a fast-paced jetpack fps set in a futuristic sci-fi universe. Use movement and physics to your advantage, outwit your enemy from every angle, you'll never look at a shooter the same way again.

4962950.name: Lab Rats
4962950.short_description: Fall in love with a mad scientist who kidnaps you or will you try to escape his grasp?

4969400.name: Out Past the Horizon
4969400.short_description: Escape to a sun-drenched tropical paradise in this 1-8 player life simulator. Build your dream island from scratch, cultivate vibrant farms, manage bustling local businesses, and unwind on the beach with friends. Your perfect island getaway awaits!

2630420.name: Elven Watcher
2630420.short_description: To protect the future of the Elven race and to avenge those who have perished, wage war upon the foul Undead!

5037550.name: Blind Seek
5037550.short_description: Blind Seek is a chaotic multiplayer hide-and-seek party game where the hiders are invisible, but definitely not silent. Complete tasks, grab ridiculous power-ups, and escape before the seeker hears your footsteps or catches you yapping in voice chat with you friends!

5184720.name: Evoruption Demo
5184720.short_description: A dark roguelike deckbuilder where you build and evolve powerful decks, battle corrupted creatures, and master new mechanics across handcrafted story campaigns — or challenge other players in tactical 1v1 and 2v2 battles.

4544200.name: True Confession
4544200.short_description: Henry, a religious young man, witnesses violent shootouts and fragments of his past at night in his dreams. In reality, he’s just an ordinary man, visiting his pastor while struggling with anger and guilt. Fight inside his dreams in this isometric pixel-art shooter to experience his True Confession.

5321460.name: CURE - A Hospital Simulator Demo
5321460.short_description: The town of Mercy is getting a new ER doctor - It's you! Manage your night-time emergency room, solo or with friends. Heal patients, organize the ER and grow your staff before the apocalypse begins. This chaotic no-time-limit demo let's you play through the first 3 levels of medical emergencies.

4874180.name: Soul Savior
4874180.short_description: Save or sacrifice souls to shape your run. Discover powerful upgrades, create devastating synergies, and fight through endless waves in this action roguelite tower defense.

4362490.name: 99 NIGHTS IN THE APOCALYPSE
4362490.short_description: A 1-5 player co-op survival game. Team up with friends to survive 99 nights in a post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, build your camp, craft weapons, explore different biomes, and fight off waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

4923080.name: Puzzlogue
4923080.short_description: A roguelike match-3 puzzle game where you continuously swap gems to build combos and use relic effects to boost your score. Create a different build each run and clear each stage.

2234170.name: Kyubu Kyubu Dice Demo
2234170.short_description: Kyubu Kyubu Dice is an action puzzle game where you roll a magical die to match and clear colorful panels. Easy to pick up, but challenging to master! It's a fun and addictive puzzle experience!

5045390.name: ハルシネーション
5045390.short_description: Takumi, a high school student, gains the power to make others experience hallucinations indistinguishable from reality. What begins as a tool for revenge soon changes his fate forever. A psychological suspense visual novel where your choices shape the ending.

5230260.name: Quantum Covenant Prologue
5230260.short_description: Become a ridiculously devastating machine of destruction and overwhelm your enemies in this high-octane, 4 player co-op horde survival shooter. Discover powerful weapons, abilities, upgrades, and synergies as you free humanity from the clutches of the machine god. Play alone or with friends!

3666000.name: Restless Rites
3666000.short_description: Take care of a cursed chapel located in a forgotten corner of a small town. Maintain your daily routine, improvise with limited tools, and complete your tasks before nightfall in a surreal horror experience marked by maintenance and decay.

2779410.name: Pong Live
2779410.short_description:
A modern vertical reimagining of the classic arcade experience.

Compete in fast-paced online PvP matches with your Friends and soon against the whole World.

Become a master of precision paddle control! Precision, speed, and skill decide who wins in Pong Live.

2645990.name: 999 Seconds! Survivors
2645990.short_description:
Reject boring stat stacking!
We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create?
—Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

3256910.name: Jupiter Hell Classic DEMO
3256910.short_description: Jupiter Hell Classic is the demake of a remake of a roguelike unmake of a famous 1993 FPS shooter. Rip and Tear!

5436490.name: The Other End
5436490.short_description: An unexplained signal is answering you. Decode patterns, reconstruct recordings and build an understanding of an unknown intelligence in this atmospheric sci-fi puzzle adventure, with interconnected challenges and puzzle variations between playthroughs.

4201720.name: RatSpiderFrog
4201720.short_description: A cursed auto-battler where you take control of a bunch of rats to fend off enemy attacks. Crossbreed them. Grill them. Feed them. Make them POWERFUL!

5071950.name: Milk Homestead
5071950.short_description: Inherit a mysterious estate and its secret, high-profit barn operation. Manage milk extraction, upgrade tech, and navigate seven demanding women with dynamic schedules. Explore the estate in real time and unlock over dozens of fully animated 3D explicit scenes!

2011180.name: Terminus Historia
2011180.short_description: Branching routes × free-form exploration. A dark fairy-tale pixel-art RPG set in Terminus, between the human and demon worlds. Join the knights, become a mercenary, sail the Sea of Skies, or belong to no faction. Meet diverse companions and forge your own journey.

5094350.name: Age of Wonders 4: Expansion Pass 4
5094350.short_description: Age of Wonders 4: Expansion Pass 4 charts a course across stormy seas and enchanted woods to ancient dwarven forges: master the tides, weave fey magic, and awaken living golems to expand your rule.

5170410.name: Crosstalk: The DANGLING Computer Superarchitecture
5170410.short_description: This free DLC adds the in-house instruction set architecture, DANGCSA/DANGXA, to Crosstalk and lets the game use it, plus it bundles an LLVM build compatible with it. Players can then learn from DANGCSA/DANGXA or target their programs at it.

5173920.name: Crosstalk: Hardware Sniffers
5173920.short_description: Become the One with the Hardware Sniffers DLC for Crosstalk, which brings challenging minigames in the form of "missions" into Crosstalk. These revolve about computer architecture design and are integrated into the Workshop, which makes them shareable among players

5176030.name: Put Your Toys Away Together! Demo
5176030.short_description: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

5182600.name: Crosstalk: House of Hex
5182600.short_description: In House of Hex, you play as a high-ranking member of the Illuminati, controlling governments and corporations from within the shadows. You navigate the world by means of memory analysis and pointer traversal, mutating whatever you want to bend the world to your will!

5204060.name: Crosstalk: Second Reality
5204060.short_description: Second Reality by Future Crew was an x86 demo made in 1993 to push the hardware at the time to its limits. This DLC ports that demo to the DANGCSA/DANGXA architecture in celebration and respect of the Finnish team who brought us this breakthrough of an experience back then.

5210440.name: Crosstalk: Cubejuggler
5210440.short_description: This DLC brings to Crosstalk a DANGCSA/DANGXA-native from-scratch, partially Java edition-compatible reimplementation of the popular cube-placing game. Its goal is to help users learn reading program memory and identify hex patterns without questioning themselves.

5214090.name: Grr Grr Gnomes Demo
5214090.short_description: A co-op adventure about tiny gnomes on a very big ocean. Sail from island to island, scavenge for supplies, fight strange creatures, survive whatever goes horribly wrong, and keep your ship moving toward one goal, finding the way home...

4613560.name: Barfender Demo
4613560.short_description: Barfender is a chaotic co-op bar sim where you pour drinks, clean disasters, stop fights, and try to keep the bar alive while everything falls apart. Build the place, serve the crowd, survive the night.

4636530.name: Glint Translator
4636530.short_description: Translate everything on your screen in real time — games, Discord, videos, and more. AI infrastructure with full offline support for maximum privacy and an uninterrupted experience.

4664770.name: Clive Barker’s Hellraiser: Revival - Deluxe Content
4664770.short_description: The Deluxe Edition of Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival includes a unique weapon, exclusive skins, an '80s horror movie filter and more!

4881740.name: HollowCity:EscapeFromSeoul Demo
4881740.short_description: 'HollowCity' is a PvE top-down extraction shooter set in a ruined city. Solo or with up to 4 players, you must explore various zones and gather survival supplies. Hostile humans aren't the only threats to your life. Fight through monsters born from unknown causes and escape safely.

5299690.name: The Grid Detective
5299690.short_description: A hacker-noir logic deduction game where you mark grids True or False to deduce the one solution hidden in unlimited, freshly generated puzzles, each proven solvable by pure logic before you ever see it.

3564770.name: Bubbles and Babes Demo
3564770.short_description: Adult visual novel set in a mountain bathhouse. Explore freely, reconnect with old friends and employees, and unlock intimate encounters. Features full English voice acting and animated adult scenes.

3723550.name: GOALS - High-end
3723550.short_description:
GOALS – High-End Version

This downloadable content (DLC) includes all the necessary high-quality assets and resources required to experience the enhanced, high-end version of GOALS.

3723560.name: GOALS - Low-end
3723560.short_description:
GOALS – Low-end version

This downloadable content (DLC) includes all the necessary performance assets and resources required to experience the performance version of GOALS.

3372370.name: KRAMPEN - Fan Pack
3372370.short_description: If you enjoyed the game "KRAMPEN" and would like to support the project, check out what is included in this add-on!

2569190.name: Gennady Demo
2569190.short_description: Gennady is a dynamic roguelike platformer where you fight your way through ever-changing corridors filled with chthonic creatures, and death only makes you stronger. All wrapped in legendary absurdity and classic Earthworm Jim-era animation.

4931510.name: There is No Stress in Outer Space
4931510.short_description: An incremental game about a spaceship in outer space destroying asteroids and other strange objects. Take control of the spaceship's gun, shoot, earn money, make upgrades and unlock new weapons and targets.

1223730.name: Trials of Mana Demo
1223730.short_description: Trials of Mana Free Demo Available Now!

764690.name: Caveblazers Together
764690.short_description: Caveblazers Together is an online multiplayer mod for Caveblazers - team up with up to 3 friends on your adventures!

5495940.name: White Line North: Dog Sled Racing
5495940.short_description: Build your kennel. Find your perfect eight. Race across snow, ice and mountain trails in a dog sled racing and management game. Breed and care for your dogs, upgrade your gear, and work your way from the Village Derby to the Great Northern Tour.

411182.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: Na'Vi - XBOCT
411182.short_description: From team NAVI, learn more about XBOCT

224462.name: CONTRAST - OST and Dev Diary
224462.short_description: CONTRAST - Original Soundtrack + Art Book includes digital copies of Shadow Music – A Soundtrack to Contrast and the Official Art Book.

4946000.name: Nested Moves
4946000.short_description: A customizable chess variant where every capture triggers a mini-game. Test your knowledge with trivia, roll tactical d20 checks, and challenge friends or computer opponents in local and online matches.

2121270.name: Decay Constant
2121270.short_description: Warning. Surveillance and detection systems inactive. Multiple subject containment failure. Facility compromised. I wonder what’ll happen to you? SURREAL SINGLE PLAYER ACTION ORIENTED HALF-LIFE 2 MOD

3874160.name: NIPH
3874160.short_description: NIPH is a stylish roguelite platformer with risky and intense combat. Slash, shoot, and learn and cast spells with more varied items as you explore a vast and diverse fantasy world!

5042810.name: NullGate
5042810.short_description: A toon-style roguelite FPS where every arena is generated at runtime. Dash, slide and wall-kick through rooms that never repeat, weave through slow glowing bullets, and bank your kill-streak before something takes it from you. Die, upgrade at the Underdock, and dive again.

4197320.name: The Last Map
4197320.short_description: The Last Map is a co-op puzzle adventure where two brothers follow their father's final map to uncover the secrets he left behind.

5357610.name: The Curator Demo
5357610.short_description: The Curator is a roguelite gallery-management game which managing your traveling art gallery. Combine the unique artwork skills, organize your collection by day, impress the picky visitors by night, and use your earnings to prepare for the next city.

1681830.name: CityZen
1681830.short_description: Build a city from humble beginnings into an industrial metropolis. Manage supply chains, meet your citizens’ needs, and keep essential services running in a deep economic simulation that rewards good planning without demanding perfection.

5362770.name: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft
5362770.short_description: Dookie Clicker: The Big Pfft is a toilet-humour clicker set in a bubbling sewer laboratory. Click to make dookie, build ten ridiculous factories from the Whoopie Cushion to the Methane Volcano, snatch random power-ups and grow your stinkiest empire yet.

5137380.name: Little Bettas Soundtrack
5137380.short_description: 🌿 A cozy six-track original soundtrack from Little Bettas, composed by Elara: rain, moonlight, sunlight through the trees and fireflies over a quiet lake.

4690880.name: Brand of Betrayal
4690880.short_description: In this NTR RPG, play as Rein on a mission to defeat the Demon King. With your wife and two childhood friends, fight enemies, explore, and grow stronger as you unlock steamy events. Power comes at a cost though, and you will not be the one to pay it. How far will your team go to achieve its goal?

4673110.name: Leg Day
4673110.short_description: Climb to the top of this very unforgiving work out routine.

2358350.name: Siren Forest
2358350.short_description: Their final known location was within the eerie Siren Forest, as recorded in an ancient sheepskin scroll. This forgotten woodland holds an air of mystery and intrigue...

4734380.name: One Percent - A Game About Taxing Billionaires
4734380.short_description: Comrade! Filthy billionaires are buying political influence again! Shoot their flying bribes from the sky in this fast incremental class struggle. Help the common people rise, don’t get corrupted, win the people’s votes, unlock powerful upgrades, and tax the billionaires out of power!

5073280.name: Subterfuge Demo
5073280.short_description: A week-long multiplayer game of strategy, diplomacy, and betrayal. Schedule moves for hours in the future, forge fragile alliances, and time the perfect backstab as events unfold in real time. Coming to Steam Early Access with mobile cross-play and a player pool running since 2015.

4404010.name: Shipping
4404010.short_description: Shipping is a hectic co-op block pushing game where you fight against the clock to fill out rows of blocks to ship them around the world.

3251540.name: Oil Rig Simulator
3251540.short_description: Welcome aboard the oil rig, where daily challenges await around every corner. In this realistic simulation, you take on the role of an operator of one of the most technologically advanced structures in the world. This isn’t just a workplace – it’s your new life at sea.

5033260.name: Dying Patience
5033260.short_description: For years, you cared for your mother until her illness began to destroy your life. Her weak voice, her exhausted appearance, her fading consciousness... Are you willing to keep enduring this?

4313150.name: Idyll
