4313150.short_description: A 3D voxel fantasy colony sim with online co-op. Build a settlement block-by-block, mine deep for rare resources, craft powerful gear, and defend your colonists from monsters and rival factions.

5070060.name: Robokitties: MEGASTRUCTURE
5070060.short_description: Explore a dying megastructure with your friends as tiny robokitties. Scavenge dangerous loot, survive evil machines, and get back to the lift before the power runs out.

5001830.name: FIRE. HOLD. REPEAT. Demo
5001830.short_description: The only desktop companion shooter on Steam. Your soldier holds the line right on your desktop. Every click and every keystroke fires a shot – fend off endless enemy waves, loot weapons and upgrade your gear while you go about your day.

4903110.name: Soup's Tail Demo
4903110.short_description: Find out what it means to be dead. Explore the mystery of the afterlife, meet new characters, pet the cat, find cards, and earn collectables in this single player, narrative-driven game. As the story unfolds, play cards with those you meet along the way.

4878100.name: Snail's Pace
4878100.short_description: A snail. Some ducks. And lots of weird stuff going on. But oh well, you got a store to run.

4408560.name: Split Happens
4408560.short_description: Manage an old, rundown nuclear power plant with up to 6 friends in online co-op. Fix hazards before you put the reactor in critical condition, manage the chaos to avoid a meltdown, and try not to get in the way of your coworkers.

4202480.name: Gallipoli - Long March Pack
4202480.short_description: The ‘Long March’ pack introduces uniforms and items for Ottoman soldiers inspired by the huge distances travelled while crossing the Sinai Desert. It contains new uniform pieces, equipment and headgear.

5335500.name: Emanet - Kalanların Hikayesi
5335500.short_description: Datça, 1987. Run a seaside left-luggage counter: compare claim tickets, items and the ledger, catch the lies and decide who walks away with what. By night, chase Elif, who vanished seven years ago, through crayon-drawn dreams that regain their colour as you draw near.

2270670.name: Backrooms:Betrayal
2270670.short_description: Maintain reality or watch it collapse. Backrooms: Betrayal is a co-op liminal horror game where the environment is the antagonist. Stabilize shifting sectors against a tide of entropy, but watch your team. Every failure has an explanation, but not every explanation is innocent.

5370890.name: ERLIK Demo
5370890.short_description: A survivors-like rooted in Turkic mythology. Every run drifts between two gods: feed Erlik's corruption for savage power and lifesteal, or rise toward Tengri's light for shields and renewal.

5170580.name: Blend Hunter: Smoothie Bullet Heaven
5170580.short_description: 112 smoothie weapons. Six slots. Discover powerful combos, mow down hordes, and take on towering Bounty Bosses in this colorful 3D bullet heaven. Turn fruit into firepower and build your own recipe for destruction.

4453700.name: The Beckoning
4453700.short_description: Explore an abandoned and decaying village in this immersive first-person psychological horror experience, search forgotten houses and shadowed paths, piece together disturbing clues, and uncover the truth that waits within the suffocating darkness.

5171280.name: Wishbound
5171280.short_description: At 3am, an app called tally installs itself on your phone and starts granting wishes. All of them. A psychological horror story told entirely through a phone screen. 5 nights, 3 routes, 18 endings, some you can only reach by losing on purpose. Every wish is granted. Every wish is owed.

2669470.name: Tekoha: a Tale Among the Stars
2669470.short_description: Tekoha: A Tale Among the Stars is a narrative-driven light RPG following two Indigenous Brazilian sisters on an emotional journey to reunite after a tragic event reshapes their homeland.

3671040.name: Bloodstone Rising Demo
3671040.short_description: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

5360950.name: A Game About Breaking a Wall Playtest

4556190.name: Bye Bye Bonnie
4556190.short_description: Bye Bye Bonnie is a co-op journey for up to 4 players set in a dystopian wasteland. Tee-up a giant talking skull to defy physics, conquer dungeons, help strange NPCs, and find lost siblings. Upgrade your skull to ascend The Tower. Mother is waiting...

2174510.name: Backseat Champions
2174510.short_description: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?

1461470.name: Airborne Ranger: FightOut
1461470.short_description: Gear up in Airborne Ranger: Fightout, a thrilling tactical-action game. Play solo or jump in 4-player co-op as you take on missions behind enemy lines—eliminate targets, gather intel, sabotage infrastructure and rescue hostages. Rely on skill, strategy, and courage to survive and make it out alive!

4057610.name: Camp Manager Simulator
4057610.short_description: Ever dreamed of running your own campground? Turn a quiet lakeside campsite into a thriving resort! Rent out tents, caravans, and bungalows. Unlock fishing, offer ATV and canoe rentals, hire staff, and keep every camper happy.

5127100.name: The Wrong Way Round
5127100.short_description: You’re trapped in a town where every way out brings you back from the other side. Explore with up to 5 friends, uncover the mystery and find a way home before the freezing fog takes over.

5228540.name: Tavern Clicker
5228540.short_description: Run a cozy medieval tavern in this simple clicker. Serve all kinds of guests, unlock new brews, automate your work, and turn a humble alehouse into a tavern worthy of kings!

4239600.name: ATK：画境小镇
4239600.short_description: ATK: Painting Realm Town is a casual and fun auto-battler that integrates tavern chess strategic gameplay, in-depth character development, and random equipment collection. Players can unlock more than twenty distinctive characters with entirely unique styles and personalities.

5332990.name: Roadweave
5332990.short_description: A night atlas you draw roads across. Link towns, untangle jams with junctions and highways, throw bridges, run ferries and air links. Four worlds — from a 16-area island to a map of 120 — and a new map every day.

1985940.name: 深渊奇境
1985940.short_description: In the city of Cynthia, the young girl Eucaly, in order to find her lost past, steps into the abyss at the edge of the city. Along the way, she will experience complex and treacherous emotions, encounter various strange creatures, and finally uncover the deepest secrets of the Abyss.

5304890.name: Ministry of Misery
5304890.short_description:
Ministry of Misery (M.O.M.) is a satirical paper-pushing bureaucracy sim about power, corruption and keeping the country barely functional. 
Cause Misery. Maintain Order. Remain in Power.

5134670.name: PixelMania
5134670.short_description: PixelMania is a multiplayer sandbox adventure where you can build worlds, collect and trade items, customize your character, and explore a growing universe created alongside other players.

5199270.name: Mixed Martial Cards Demo
5199270.short_description: Mixed martial arts-themed card battle game - design a deck and strategy to beat up your opponent across standing-up and grappling fighting. Practice with bots, play with friends or the community.

5003020.name: Pfand Raiders
5003020.short_description: Dash and ride through a rock festival in this absurd, music-driven co-op runner! Dodge obstacles to the beat, loot empty cans ("Pfand"), cash them in for beer and burp everything out of your way. Will you make it to The Butcher Sisters' show in time?

5012930.name: Wealth of Nations: Economic Strategy Demo

5037010.name: BONEWOOD
5037010.short_description: Cut through waves of orcs, undead and other wretched enemies of the realm! Gather your units and equip them with powerful gear, place your traps, level up your hero and unlock new talents. Discover mad builds and insane synergies that will help you defend endlessly! Play solo or co-op!

5451160.name: Chrome Collar: Femdom Protocol Soundtrack
5451160.short_description: The official soundtrack to Chrome Collar: Femdom Protocol: nine instrumental tracks of dark synthwave and neon-noir from a crew's workshop in Nadir. Pulsing analog bass, glassy arpeggios and slow, hypnotic grooves that score every job, every quiet hour and every night under the neon.

4562410.name: KINGS QUARTERS
4562410.short_description: A turn-based strategy board game for 2 or 4 players, with online and local multiplayer. Command soldiers, towers, assassins, and kings to outmaneuver your opponent and capture their king or claim their corner.

5251990.name: かなり里予王求 Re: Return of KUSOGAKI Demo

5349470.name: The Liar King Soundtrack
5349470.short_description: The original soundtrack of The Liar King: 33 tracks for the road of eight castles, with a castle theme, a duel and a Wrath for each cheating king, plus the market, the title and the trailer themes. MP3 320 kbps and lossless FLAC. Included free with The Liar King.

4984230.name: The Car Dimension
4984230.short_description: Delve into The Car Dimension and race against mysterious drivers in death defying tracks with weaponized vehicles. Tune up your machines and go against fierce opponents as you progress through this Racing RPG Roguelite in order to unlock the truth that lies behind.

3551290.name: Tidy Garage
3551290.short_description: Tidy Garage is a relaxing game about organizing a garage. Sort tools, parts, and all sorts of odds and ends, admire their details, and turn a cluttered garage into a pleasant, tidy space at your own pace.

5437230.name: Gambit Grid Demo
5437230.short_description: The Gambit Grid demo: the full Act I, The Paved Courtyard. Eight floors of battles, elites, merchants and mysteries, ending at the Gatekeeper. One life, every synergy, augments, relics and Crowns. Your Sanctum progress carries over to the full game.

4957910.name: Veyrasol
4957910.short_description: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

4653530.name: Red Rising
4653530.short_description: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

5451340.name: Monster Girl Clinic Soundtrack
5451340.short_description: The official soundtrack to Monster Girl Clinic: eighteen instrumental tracks from the clinic where you're the only human patient. Warm piano and nylon guitar for the waiting room, a theme for every resident on the ward, and quiet tension for when something here stops adding up.

3621880.name: Dirtville
3621880.short_description: Welcome to small, sunny and abandoned Balkan town where something is quietly wrong. Upgrade your character, abilities and tools in a cozy place where cleaning and digging is how you investigate the world. Dirtville is a mix of satisfying casual mechanics and story-based exploration.

570740.name: Keep an Eye
570740.short_description: Play as Tom, a robot private detective in a city full of secrets. Find suspects, tail them in disguise, record conversations, take photos, and hack systems in this single-player story adventure. Upgrade your investigative abilities and fight your way out when a case turns dangerous.

5452480.name: Friendly Pharmacy Demo
5452480.short_description: Clock in for a free taste of Friendly Pharmacy, a slapstick pharmacy game for 1–4 players. Fill questionable prescriptions, handle warehouse deliveries and tackle your first printer jam. Includes the first four campaign missions, solo or in online co-op.

5089240.name: Kritsana
5089240.short_description: A Thai anomaly-spotting horror game. In 1997, a man swore something was in his house. His psychiatrist said no. Now the case is yours. Go through his old CCTV tapes, report every anomaly, and figure out why this case never made sense.

4357780.name: 灰色视症 - Greyed-out
4357780.short_description: Protagonist Shen Mo is trapped in a bizarre reality: the girlfriend who verbally destroys him at dawn becomes impossibly tender by night... Is it really that simple? A story of hallucinations, memory, consciousness, thought, action, madness, dissociation, and survival begins...

4509690.name: Hold My Wand
4509690.short_description: Co-op potion brewing for 1–4 players. Gather ingredients, use magic to modify them by tracing spells by hand, fight off enemies, and complete the order. Drink potions for massive power buffs — spiraling your shift into drunken ragdoll chaos.

3030200.name: Bashnya
3030200.short_description: A big apartment block. Eight residents. One escape pod. Bashnya is a top-down action roguelike where everyone seeks a way out — and finds their doom.

4951860.name: Largely Legal Monstrosity
4951860.short_description: Summon then enslave all-consuming astral horrors for profit in this incremental bullet heaven. Craft your build in a race to disrupt ineffectual antiquated market leaders. Between rounds invest in infrastructure to power up and secure your place in the largest monster creation event in history!

5422910.name: 黄泉姫ー喰の赫焉ー
5422910.short_description: “Then, give me your fingers.” There is only one condition for returning from the underworld alive: collect the fingers packed inside a cursed little box. What seems like a simple bargain draws the protagonist into a nightmare with no way back. Can I uncover the horrifying truth and escape alive?

4929260.name: 概率工坊
4929260.short_description: A lottery tycoon simulator. You are the house — design lottery rules, tune payout rates, allocate public benefit funds. Watch NPCs transform from curious passersby into people who can't stop. Behind every number, a virtual life rises or falls. You are not the gambler. You are the house.

5283330.name: Wattverse
5283330.short_description: Generate electricity in Wattverse! Build your power production, unlock powerful upgrades, automate your energy empire, and push your numbers to unimaginable scales in this addictive incremental game.

5451790.name: The Prometheus Saga
5451790.short_description: An unknown fleet is approaching, and only one ship can still leave. Build a colony, hold out against the waves in real time, unlock the secrets of xeno technology, then retake the twelve systems of the Road Home one by one, all the way to the homeworld of those who hunt you.

5308110.name: Farm Story Life
5308110.short_description: Grow crops, care for adorable animals, customize your farm, and build your dream countryside home in this relaxing casual single-player farming adventure.

5457550.name: A Witch's Tidying Journal
5457550.short_description: A cozy first-person tidying game with a touch of magic. Sort books, potion bottles and curious keepsakes in a witch's two-floor cottage. Earn moon dust, learn spells that put whole batches away, and enjoy turning a cluttered home into an orderly one at your own pace.

4382960.name: Snackrifice
4382960.short_description: Feed your hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. You decide which chaotic curses afflict your run as you overcome the many levels of Purgatory.

4504900.name: Slots & Slaughter
4504900.short_description: You're a broke gladiator whose entire kit is locked inside a slot machine. Spin to gear up, gamble on the reroll, and win your freedom. Or die a legend who gambled it all away.

5493890.name: Slots & Slaughter Demo
5493890.short_description: You're a broke gladiator whose entire kit is locked inside a slot machine. Spin to gear up, gamble on the reroll, and win your freedom. Or die a legend who gambled it all away.

4421310.name: Crimswell
4421310.short_description: turn a run-down bar into a full-blown criminal operation. Craft drinks unlike anything else, take shady deals, and expand with illegal properties. Survive the heat from cops and rival crews while you rule the streets of Crimswell. Play solo or with up to 8 friends.

958260.name: DEAD OR ALIVE Xtreme Venus Vacation

4705760.name: Combat Arena Tactics
4705760.short_description: Draft your army and face your opponent in this strategic 1v1 board game. Like chess, we can choose between blitz, rapid, or longer classical matches. What is your ELO going to be?

4528420.name: Farm Of Hope
4528420.short_description:
Build a hopeful farm in rural Africa.
Grow crops, dig wells, help villages survive drought, and transform dry land into a thriving community inspired by real humanitarian stories.

4762690.name: Siege Demolishers
4762690.short_description: Siege Demolishers is a first-person physics destruction game inspired by Crush the Castle and Angry Birds. It reimagines those 2D games as a fully 3D experience with multiplayer.

4927180.name: Throne and Liberty Zenith Celebration Pack: Platinum
4927180.short_description: Harness the power of the deep with a Platinum Zenith Celebration pack that includes 9,375 Lucent and all 10 Tidecaller weapons.

4947160.name: Throne and Liberty Zenith Celebration Pack Bronze
4947160.short_description: Get a mystical new amitoi companion with a Bronze Zenith Celebration pack that includes 1,125 Lucent and an Anima Anise Amitoi.

4795960.name: Urban Explorer: Baldwin
4795960.short_description: A violent storm forces an urban explorer to take refuge in the abandoned industrial district of Baldwin, Wisconsin. What looks like an unexpected jackpot quickly turns sinister. Notes hint at the truth the EPA was sent to cover up. Some places aren't abandoned by accident.

4947170.name: Throne and Liberty Zenith Celebration Pack Silver
4947170.short_description: Race through the wilds and plunge into serene waters with a Silver Zenith Celebration pack that includes 2,875 Lucent, an Empyrean Purpuma Dash Morph, and a Grand Boglet Swim Morph.

4947180.name: Throne and Liberty Zenith Celebration Pack Gold
4947180.short_description: Command the battlefield in style with a Gold Zenith Celebration pack that includes 6,000 Lucent, an Iron Creed Outfit, and a Monarcha Flutterfox Glide Morph.

5024790.name: Paws & Plates: Cozy Cat Cafe
5024790.short_description: Build dream Paws & Plates: Cozy Cat Cafe! Cook delicious meals, serve adorable customers, and grow your tiny cafe into a thriving empire. Hire and train specialized staff, automate your kitchen, and unlock powerful upgrades to maximize earnings. Create the ultimate dining experience today!

5124940.name: The Child Who Serves the Hanul
5124940.short_description: A linear, story-driven 2D adventure set in Korea's Donghak era. Deliver secret letters, evade soldiers, and talk with villagers as the story unfolds through illustrated cutscenes blended with live-action footage, in one boy's coming-of-age journey.

4191960.name: 33 Immortals Demo
4191960.short_description: 33 Immortals is a co-op action-roguelike for 33 players. Jump straight into runs, solo or with friends. Battle hordes of monsters, defeat massive bosses, and grow stronger each run. Use in-game emotes to coordinate and combine powers with your fellow rebels, and face the Wrath of God, together.

5287810.name: Advancing Legion
5287810.short_description: This is a relaxing idle auto-battler game.Starting as a lone hero, gradually recruit powerful subordinates to form a mighty legion, upgrade powerful abilities, and then conquer the entire world.

5084590.name: 星夜茶会
5084590.short_description: Starry Night Tea Party is an asymmetric pursuit game. Play as a Guest, search for clues, brew useful items, and escape the Dream; or take the role of the Demon, draw from a deck of unique cards, hunt the Guests, and harvest their Fear. Multiplayer is in development.

5428580.name: The Death Deliriant Prologue
5428580.short_description: The Death Deliriant Prologue is a first-person survival horror game that blends cosmic horror with realistic mechanics and tells the story of the corpse, who is also the first victim in the main game, Find items to escape while evading enemies, complete mechanical  tasks while facing terror.

3929570.name: General Tactics: An Shi Rebellion
3929570.short_description: In November 755, An Lushan launched a rebellion against the Tang Empire. You will be appointed as the acting Military Governor of Shuofang. Conquer territories on a free-roaming world map, build your armies, develop cities, and navigate various events as you fight to quell the rebellion.

4910040.name: GeForce 8800 GTX Anniversary
4910040.short_description: Relive one of the most iconic graphics cards in history with this semi-interactive high-end cinematic experience of unprecedented visual detail, showcasing the latest NVIDIA RTX graphical features, exclusively for NVIDIA GPUs.

5219640.name: Desk Hunter Demo
5219640.short_description: Try Desk Hunter, a single-player idle RPG with no player trading. Hunt in a compact desktop window, collect gear, and build around skills, growth nodes, scrolls, and familiars. Explore 30 Normal stages and reach hunter level 30.

4744540.name: Iron Bird Demo
4744540.short_description:
Classic vertical scrolling bullet hell × roguelike. 
10 distinct aircraft with unique weapon systems, 10 sub-units, and dozens of cosmic powers. 
Weave through enemy fire and craft the perfect god-run build.

2542850.name: Book of Infinity: 1001 Nights
2542850.short_description: Can you survive an evil King who kills a bride every night by telling stories? A story-crafting game based on a unique narrative system — Become the storyteller Scheherazade from Persian folklore, weave tales to the King through typing, and guide his words to forge magical weapons for your revenge!

1364390.name: Animaze
1364390.short_description: Livestream, chat, or create videos as world-class 2D and 3D avatars. Use one of the over 60 avatars provided or import your own 2D, 3D, VRM, or GLB model. Animaze is powering PuffPuff,  one of the top real-time mocap virtual beings on TikTok with 4.7 million followers.

5041530.name: Put Your Toys Away Together!
5041530.short_description: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

4395240.name: Blade of the Soulway
4395240.short_description: “Blade of the Soulway” is a card-based RPG with a gripping storyline, featuring card collection, character building, equipment crafting, and dungeon exploration. Its unique material gathering and crafting system makes character builds even more diverse.

5410590.name: 真假千金观察手册The record Manual
5410590.short_description: A narrative-driven game about growth, choice and documentation, in which players take on the role of a system, choose their host and help her break free from… to forge a brand-new future

4555210.name: Oar'some Adventures
4555210.short_description: Paddles up, Hosers! OAR'SOME Adventures is a cozy/chaotic rafting and nature adventure for 1-8 players. Casually paddle your way down the river alone, or gather your friends for whitewater mischief and exploration in beautiful, yet dangerous, surroundings.

5396280.name: Cat Customs Simulator Demo
5396280.short_description: Inspect adorable cats at the border! Check passports, verify luggage weight, scan suspicious suitcases, and uncover unallowed items. Spot mismatches, catch smugglers, and decide who gets through customs in this cozy cat inspection simulator.

5353690.name: Angel Legion-DLC Off-Shoulder Sweater (Yellow)
5353690.short_description:
Embark on your adventure with player from all over the world!
Lead your Angel team to reveal the ancient mysteries of Galaxy……
Welcome to Angel legion, a free RPG gacha game with good fun!

3238010.name: Art Attack
3238010.short_description: Art Attack is an action roguelike with a unique paint based combat system, and a distaste for GenAI.

5295090.name: My Friend, the Wickhorn Demo
5295090.short_description: A first-person psychological horror where you care for your cat, maintain an isolated mountain cabin, and uncover the link between your father’s secret past and the ancient curse that has taken hold of your friend.

4676630.name: Chronoscript: The Endless End Demo
4676630.short_description: “Chronoscript: The Endless End” is an exploration-based action-adventure game where you, an editor trapped within a manuscript, must unravel a thousand-year story that writes itself beyond its end—across 2D pages and a 3D manor.

4747450.name: Motel 51: Papers, Keys & Aliens Demo
4747450.short_description: Motel 51 is a motel management sim set near Area 51. Your uncle left you the place, and his debt to the bank. Work the night desk: check IDs and alien transit permits, decide who gets a key. Some guests leave a tip. Others leave a repair bill, and a few bring trouble to your door.

5252990.name: Rust & Shine Demo
5252990.short_description: Rust & Shine is a satisfying incremental restoration game. Mystery antiques arrive buried in rust, clean them, identify them, sell them, and grow a one-man bench into an automated workshop.

4403050.name: NebulArena Demo
4403050.short_description: Build, customize, and unleash your ultimate space platform in NebulArena, a fast-paced, fully automated PvP arena where strategy, design, and destruction collide!

3780140.name: War Thunder - F/A-18C Hornet Pack

2615190.name: MK1: 4k Cinematic Pack
2615190.short_description: Experience Mortal Kombat's 1's cinematic story mode brought to life in breathtaking detail at 4k resolution. Feel every gory fatality and soul-crushing fatal blow like never before!

5403210.name: Nyangdom : Dark Cat Defense
5403210.short_description:
Deploy your cats to hold off endless waves of enemies.
A 2D random defense game where you utilize random draws, passive skills, and perfectly timed active skills.
There is no single meta. Maximize your luck and risk management to dominate the battlefield with your unique composition!

5253240.name: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge
5253240.short_description: Rally Racing VR: Xtreme Speed Challenge delivers immersive first-person PCVR rally racing with responsive steering, physics-based handling, customizable cars, Ghost AI competition, dynamic weather, day-night conditions, and varied off-road tracks across forests, mountains, canyons, snow, and jungle.

5275720.name: 铜风旅团
5275720.short_description: Drive tanks, pilot vintage aircraft, and build your own brigade in a single-player war RPG with real-time combat and tactical pause. Join Haiyan, a self-proclaimed princess, recruit companions through the story, collect vehicles, and craft upgrades on the road to liberating the kingdom.

4838670.name: Heroll: IF
4838670.short_description: Roll the dice, survive the chaos, and rebuild a broken world in this roguelite board-game RPG. Battle through unpredictable loops, recruit adorable pets, face wild events, and grow stronger with every roll.

3946460.name: Shroomy Garden
3946460.short_description: Design a beautiful cozy theme park or water park filled with rides, slides, decorations, and charm. Attract lovable Shroomies who wander around and bring your creation to life. A calm, cozy game about creativity and building your perfect little getaway.

5325800.name: Voluntary Service
5325800.short_description: An online 1-4 player co-op game. Work off your prison sentence in deep space! Board terrifying abandoned spaceships, complete stupidly dangerous missions, and try not to die. Survival is optional, but highly recommended.

2540650.name: Keyframes
2540650.short_description: After chance meetings in your second year of college, decide how you want to spend the last two years of undergrad with your friends— both old and new— in this partially customizable amare visual novel.

5261400.name: 龙之传奇
5261400.short_description: Dragon Legend is a fun strategy match-and-clear game. The evil dragon keeps advancing along the path toward the princess. You need to manipulate colored blocks marked with directional arrows, plan your clearing order and fire projectiles to block the dragon and protect the princess.

4857910.name: Kabebutt Royale
4857910.short_description: Join the Kabebutt Show, a wild TV game show where you bring your girl best friend for a shot at ¥500,000! Five women’s butts are in front of you, and one belongs to your best friend. Play with each girl, examine them through four intense rounds, and make sure you don't pick your bestie early!

5509520.name: EZY Virtual TableTop Builder Demo
5509520.short_description: Join tabletop games for free as a player or spectator with EZY Virtual TableTop Builder Demo. Enter a full-version host's room code and play in 2D. Rules, character sheets and game materials come from the host; no module installation is needed.

1742040.name: Kingslayers
1742040.short_description: Kingslayers is a free-to-play Roguelite featuring both turn based and real time strategy elements. Select your team and choose your skills then jump into a run to see what broken builds you can create!

4919730.name: Demon Egg
4919730.short_description: The roguelike tower defense card game where one card wins the run: Hatch. Grow your economy to afford it sooner, power up your main spell or overwhelm enemies with a swarm. Shape your build through a randomized skill tree and defend your egg until you can pay the price to hatch.

4609150.name: Flakeparty
4609150.short_description: Build the perfect cereal bowl and score insane amounts of points in this relaxing roguelike deckbuilder. Trigger delicious combos, collect quirky cereals, earn toys by playing rule-twisting minigames and eat tasty snacks to help along the way as you reach the highest points!

3432790.name: Non-Euclidean Minesweeper Demo
3432790.short_description:
Touch interface has been supported!

Non-Euclidean Minesweeper is a minesweeper game played in hyperbolic and Euclidean spaces. All the problems are absolutely solvable by logic alone. No guessing is required.

4017880.name: ANOMALITH
4017880.short_description: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

4951420.name: Doomgard
4951420.short_description: Awaken in a forgotten, mist-shrouded wilderness with no memory of your past or your death. Gather resources, craft tools, build shelter, uncover ancient secrets, and try to survive in a world that seems to already know you.

4624920.name: HYPERDROP: A Pachinko Roguelite
4624920.short_description: Build impossible scoring machines in HYPERDROP, a hypnotizing physics-based pachinko roguelite bursting with satisfying chain reactions and game-breaking combos.

2621540.name: Masada
2621540.short_description: Masada is a open world RTS / RPG set in an isolated and exotic nebula.

5385530.name: YASUKE CHRONICLES
5385530.short_description: Fight through history with Yasuke and Napoleon in a 3D action RPG. Cut through crowds with ink slashes, parry powerful bosses, and collect weapons with up to five War Sigils. Forge your favorite weapon, combine relics, and conquer changing battlefields across four difficulties.
publishers: 株式会社ワンコネクト

4558810.name: GameBuilder - Unlock All Levels
4558810.short_description: Unlock Levels 16–50 in GameBuilder Puzzle Platformer and take on more advanced path-building, puzzle-platforming challenges, with a hidden bonus level waiting for players who complete every stage.

4740250.name: Little Dao
4740250.short_description: Little Dao is a 3D eastern fantasy MMORPG where players explore a floating mainland shaped by the rivalry between Ru and Mo, battle otherworldly monsters in real-time combat, complete quests, improve gear and skills, and build guild power with friends.

5010820.name: Up & Up: Pinball & Pachinko
5010820.short_description: A unique combination of pinball and pachinko. Collect pachinko balls, fight your way to the top, and unlock the pachinko board where a hail of points awaits! Play pinball to unlock pachinko. Play pachinko to set a new high score!

5251830.name: Fliprium Demo
5251830.short_description: Turn an opponent's discard into your next artifact. Explore a hex board, collect materials and build crafting chains in this mahjong-inspired fantasy card game. Play solo against bots with four adventurers, lucky charms and dragon crafting in the free demo.

3421190.name: Dwelltris
3421190.short_description: A new take on the classic block-spinning, line-clearning, high-scoring game involving tetrominoes!

5417590.name: KeyQu
5417590.short_description: Turn your keyboard into a customizable desktop companion! Map your favorite sounds, images, and gifs to keys, use built-in presets, or create your own reactions for a setup that's uniquely yours.

2811430.name: CROPSES
2811430.short_description: Cropses is a first-person farming and tower defense game where you grow crops, gather resources, and build defenses to protect your settlement from waves of zombies emerging from the fog. Sell your harvest, upgrade your defenses, and survive long enough to repair your broken-down truck and escape!

5451860.name: The Prometheus Saga Demo
5451860.short_description: An unknown fleet is approaching, and only one ship can still leave. Build a colony, hold out against the waves in real time, unlock the secrets of xeno technology, then retake the twelve systems of the Road Home one by one, all the way to the homeworld of those who hunt you.

5147620.name: Thumb & Tomb
5147620.short_description: Climb an endless tomb on a pocket handheld. A first-person dungeon crawler with real-time fights: read every wind-up, parry, dodge, break shields and chain your FLOW, build your hero from evolving boons, and spend the Souls of every run on new classes, gear and colors.

4363860.name: 别骗我了，宝！
4363860.short_description: 《Let’s Kill This Love》is a first-person interactive live-action game with immersive performances and branching storylines. Players make choices as the protagonist to unlock multiple endings.

4459600.name: PICK A BOO
4459600.short_description: PICK A BOO is an online co-op action game where you use magnetic powers to stick furniture together and haul it out.

5501710.name: Last Vacation
5501710.short_description: Last Vacation is a physics-based multiplayer party game where elderly vacationers fight for seats when the music stops. Grab and throw your rivals, tumble through ragdoll chaos, and dodge environmental hazards in a frantic scramble for a chair.

4914750.name: Sweet Corn Desktop Pet
4914750.short_description:
Interface Name
Core Functions
Desktop Floating Window
Stands on the desktop; click to expand the primary function panel
Primary Function Entry Panel
Displays the core entry points for raising, dressing up, online play, and settings
Raising Operation Panel
developers: Hangzhou Zhuiqu Network Technology Co., Ltd
publishers: Hangzhou Zhuiqu Network Technology Co., Ltd

4223290.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
4223290.short_description:
Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series!
Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

5346250.name: Hackhub: Supporter Pack
5346250.short_description: Support the development of HackHub and get something back: an exclusive Supporter badge next to your name in multiplayer chat and on your profile, plus 24 extra tracks for Scoutify, the in-game music player. Purely cosmetic, with no gameplay advantage.

5352990.name: My Octopus Friend
5352990.short_description: An underwater roguelite for all ages. Dive through nine voxel seas as a little octopus, ink silly sea critters, find 122 treasures to wear and befriend, face nine guardians, and bring the light home to a lagoon you can rebuild and grow.

5275150.name: The Unwritten Book of Fate Demo
5275150.short_description: 《无字命书》是一款东方玄幻叙事冒险游戏。在这个凡人以命为薪、诸神高居云端的世界里，一本无字天书的出现打破了千年的平衡。玩家将扮演天命者，踏上揭开天书真相的旅程，在错综复杂的人神纠葛中做出抉择。游戏融合了探索、解谜与剧情选择，你的每一个决定都将影响世界的命运。面对神与凡人的终极博弈，你将书写属于自己的命书。

3227500.name: Blades of Mirage
3227500.short_description: Face mythical legends in a Southeast Asia-inspired world action-adventure soulslike. Build your playstyle through combination of weapon and runes, choose your best experience then explore ancient realm of brightlands, confront corrupted guardians, and solve intricate puzzles to uncover the truth

5339950.name: GENNADIYYY
5339950.short_description:
A third-person comedy puzzle game about a vlogger. Gennady is trying to get through an ordinary evening: get some bread,

feed his guests using whatever is in the fridge, and record a calm video.

5345370.name: Memory House
5345370.short_description: A quiet home for thoughtful games, illustrated books, and your own memories. Enjoy seven games, from Jigsaw and Mahjong to turn-based strategy, discover collectibles, and keep a personal journal amid music, rain, and the warmth of a fireplace.

5474650.name: The Horror
5474650.short_description:
Of all man's mistakes none compares to The Horror. 


Tremble in its presence, panic, struggle, scream. 
Nothing will prepare you for the horror of The Horror. 


A minimalistic, top down, survival horror. 
Run, strategise and outplay The Horror accross 
multiple maps and modes.

3372610.name: Uncanyon
3372610.short_description: Uncanyon is a puzzle-first adventure that drops you into a forgotten world, tucked into the seam between unparallel realities.

5199190.name: Everest Survival Simulator Demo
5199190.short_description: Survive a full expedition on a 1:1 satellite-mapped Mount Everest. Acclimatize, manage oxygen, cold, fatigue and supplies, pitch your tent at each camp, cross crevasses in the Khumbu Icefall and push for the 8,848 m summit — then make it back down alive.

5190350.name: Automotive Empire
5190350.short_description: Start with one kart in a small garage. Expand your team from karting to the pinnacle of motorsport. Compete against 172 teams in 21 championships. Design every part, build and expand your campus. Enter the road car and racing parts markets and face another level of competition.

5421610.name: Prismhold
5421610.short_description: A card-driven tower defense: draft towers from your deck every wave, merge three copies to evolve them without limit and mix 14 elements to survive endless waves, crowned bosses and flyers. Play solo, co-op on one map, or side by side with up to 6 players.

5117160.name: File Corruption
5117160.short_description: After 30 years, the automated robots at a sorting facility suddenly break down. You take a temporary job at the center until they are fixed. Survive five nights in the horror game FILE CORRUPTION, and stay alert!

5005890.name: Boomimals
5005890.short_description: Battle your friends as chaotic animal tanks in fast-paced local or online PvP! Collect game-breaking upgrade cards, bounce bullets around unpredictable arenas, and outsmart your opponents in booming 2–4 player matches.

4188260.name: Cozy~Fishing Kitten
4188260.short_description: Dive into a cozy, idle fishing experience! Cast your line from a little corner on your desktop. Customize your cute avatar and background, then feed and collect adorable cats of all breeds. Unlock beautiful scenes and jump into multiplayer and sneak in some "chill-time" with friends!

5359650.name: Slitherlink: Line Logic Demo
5359650.short_description: A relaxing logic puzzle about connecting dots into one loop using available numbers as clues. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from thousands more!

5352170.name: Slitherlink: Line Logic
5352170.short_description: A relaxing logic puzzle where you connect dots to make one loop, using the numbers as clues. Every puzzle has exactly one answer you can reach with logic alone, no guessing. Play the daily puzzle or choose from 12,000 more, Easy to Expert.

2840880.name: Father, Son and Holy Guns
2840880.short_description: Holy Guns is a fast-paced roguelite multiplayer game set in a bizarre world where faith fuels firepower and every run tests your sanity!

5176070.name: Bush League Baseball
5176070.short_description: Arcade baseball with real rules and terrible players, in full 3D: bobblehead ballplayers, eight ballparks and Chuck Baseball, a booth announcer who loves every error. Found your own club, build its ballpark, and trade club codes with friends. One or two players.

4832280.name: Kern
4832280.short_description: It's a tower defence game with a skill tree. Play as the pilot that crash the spaceship in the unknown white space. Defend the spaceship from a horde of enemies through multiple stages while fixing the ship to escape from this place.

5278670.name: JUST SHOVEL IT! Demo
5278670.short_description: The free demo: two zones of the yard, a shovel, a snow vacuum and a furnace. Just enough to find out whether this gets its hooks into you.

5282490.name: Guild Life with the Girls Demo
5282490.short_description: A free demo of an adult fantasy guild-management dating sim. Summoned by mistake and exiled to an empty frontier guild, you recruit adventurers, send them on requests and use your strange healing gift, Deep Treatment, to grow close to Lia and Mira. Play the full prologue and seven H scenes.

4920000.name: Beastfolk Barber Demo
4920000.short_description: You're a barber in a city full of beastfolk. Chat with your customers, style their look, help them see something new in the mirror... and in themselves.

4098360.name: Squid Hunt 1923
4098360.short_description: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers – you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

3561120.name: Band Stage
3561120.short_description: Step onto a vibrant, colorful stage and unleash your musical magic with a variety of instruments. Featuring a curated collection of classic hits, our soundtrack spans Pop, Rock, Classical, Electronic, and beyond—guaranteed to hit every note of your musical imagination.

5302590.name: CLETTER Homophone Word Spelling
5302590.short_description: CLETTER Homophone Word Spelling pictures English sounds. 7-color coding (colorful phonics) shows patterns. Spell right → words pop. Each level: tap letters, robot carries them, showing growth + 12 achievements. Switch CN/EN UI. Charts spot weak words & progress. PC numpad adds fun.

5388770.name: Nonoko: Lofi Days - Music Pack Vol. 1
5388770.short_description: Add an 11-track guitar album, 13 animated companion illustrations, and 3 seasonal themes to your desktop. Enjoy Halloween, Christmas, and winter designs while you study, work, or unwind. Requires the Nonoko: Lofi Days base game.

4157340.name: Rainbow Billy: The Book of Fears
4157340.short_description:
Billy is back for an investigative adventure in Summer camp.
Unravel mysterious events in this colorful journey as campers’ worries manifest as Fearlings. Explore the camp, investigate its secrets, and confront those fears through clever puzzles.

4928770.name: Star Conflict: Burrownauts
4928770.short_description: Addictive action roguelite about a space miner with nail-biting bullet-heaven battles. Burrow into ancient planetoids, collect resources, upgrade your ship, and defend your base in the middle of a hostile galaxy.

2697620.name: Combo Devils
2697620.short_description: Combo Devils is an evolution of the platform-fighting genre. Stylish combat, and a cooperative extraction roguelite mode offers content for all player skill levels. An experience that balances accessibility with a high execution ceiling for a dedicated core player base to grow around.

5470930.name: Nell and the Tail Arena
5470930.short_description: Nell and the Tail Arena is a fate-card-driven 2D roguelite action game. Trapped in the arena's prison, Nell must chart her escape: draw and deploy fate cards, defy reversed-tarot curses, and forge a style with four body talent lines and dual-wielded weapons to win every duel the Master arranges.

3596430.name: Bancho the Chef
3596430.short_description:
<Bancho the Chef> is a cooking simulation + adventure game that follows Bancho from <Dave the Diver> during his youth on the road to becoming a sushi master.
Travel through cities across Asia and experience the joy of cooking firsthand as you follow Bancho’s journey and learn unique local cuisines!

5095400.name: Fog Keeper
5095400.short_description: "Fog Keeper" is a tower-defense survival game. You will establish defenses on a fog-shrouded alien world, gather resources, research technologies, hold the Energy Tower against the monster hordes that surge in every night, and uncover the true secrets hidden within.

5394990.name: Wallbreaker
5394990.short_description: Break the walls before they break you. Wallbreaker is an action roguelike where you fight upward against descending structures. Choose a warrior, ranger, or mage, combine items and augments, and find a new way to bring everything crashing down.

4885580.name: Heya! Sumo Manager
4885580.short_description: Heya! Sumo Manager allows you to manage a sumo stable and develop the skills of your rikishi on their road to Yokozuna! Climb from Jonokuchi to Sekitori by organizing the diet, training and tactics of your wrestlers and see them compete in 3D matches.

5429170.name: Broke to Broker
5429170.short_description: Start at 22 with $3,000, a rented room and an empty calendar. Win clients, close sales, post videos that find buyers for years, buy homes of your own, maybe found an agency. A real estate career sim about the one thing money can't buy back: your time.

4073540.name: Wordbound
4073540.short_description: Wordbound is a cozy puzzle game where you transform words into objects to repair a scrambled world. Explore vibrant dioramas full of hidden clues and bring new words to life by arranging magical letter tiles. Discover thousands of handcrafted objects as you become a master wordsmith!

5212310.name: Lord of the Femboys
5212310.short_description: Armed with a suspicious magic ring, save the kingdom of Femborn from an ancient evil draining its vigor. Recruit three impossibly pretty champions who’d rather tease you by the campfire than fight in this comedic, spicy medieval visual novel.

5038060.name: Medieval Bust
5038060.short_description: Assemble a party of powerful heroes, create devastating synergies, and battle through relentless hordes in this fast-paced auto-battler roguelite.

5090250.name: The Float Never Stops
5090250.short_description: A co-op heist where the getaway vehicle is a parade float. Grab boxes of tuna and whatever junk you find on the street, stack it, and pray it doesn’t fall over because this Float Never Stops.

4436260.name: Survivor's Log: N17 Shelter
4436260.short_description:
Survivor's Log： N17 Shelter
The apocalypse has begun.
You must survive until rescue arrives — or find a way to evacuate.
Explore the ruins, manage resources, and face events and the dangers of unknown lifeforms.
Endure to the very end alongside your beloved dog and lover.

4150600.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: E231 series(Suburban Type)
4150600.short_description: The E231 Series (Suburban Type) is a standard-type train following the 209 Series and E217 Series, featuring a completely redesigned control system through the extensive introduction of information technology.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

4841300.name: Vizier
4841300.short_description:
The king holds the power — but the words are yours. 
Advise a young ruler through intrigue, war, and betrayal in a turn-based court drama, where the right counsel shapes a realm and the wrong one ends you.

4463440.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: 209-500 series
4463440.short_description: 209-500 Series operated on the Keihin-Tōhoku/Negishi Line, Keiyō Line, local trains on the Chūō/Sōbu Line, and the Musashino Line. Characterized by a wider body than the original 209 Series, it was designed to increase transport capacity. Enjoy operating 209-500 Series.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

3725550.name: The Ring Of Succubus Queen
3725550.short_description:
Adventurers from all over rush toward the desert castle, seeking the Succubus Queen's buried treasure.

As various adventurers head for the treasure, the player takes on the role of a futanari imp—a lust demon—fighting humans to protect the treasure of the Succubus Queen Mardic.

3532910.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: 185 series
3532910.short_description: Series 185 DC limited express trains were designed and manufactured in 1981 by the then Japan National Railways (JNR). With this vehicle DLC, you can operate the “Limited Express Odoriko”, “Shonan Liner”, “Limited Express Minakami”, “Limited Express Ohayo Tochigi”, etc. from the past.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

5282100.name: Sonus
5282100.short_description: Seek the Sonus Stone while hiding from the Stone Keepers that lurk in the dark. Use echoes to navigate through the dark world, and use special echoes to give you an advantage with their unique abilities.

2260870.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Saikyo-Kawagoe Line (Osaki to Kawagoe) E233-7000 series
2260870.short_description: The Saikyo and Kawagoe Lines are one of the major commuter lines in the Tokyo metropolitan area, running from Osaki Station via Omiya Station to Kawagoe Station.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

3280130.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Yokosuka Line (Kurihama to Tokyo) Series E217
3280130.short_description: The Yokosuka Line is a 23.9 km long line connecting Kurihama Station in Yokosuka City, Kanagawa Prefecture and Ōfuna Station in Kamakura City, Kanagawa Prefecture. We hope you will enjoy the Yokosuka Line DLC.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

2514660.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Yamanote Line (Osaki to Osaki) E235-0 series
2514660.short_description: The Yamanote Line runs in a circle around the center of Tokyo for 34.5 km, taking 59 minutes, and is one of the major lines in the Tokyo metropolitan area, connecting huge terminal stations with world-class passengers.  Digital ATC is used as the security system.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

3996090.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Shōnan-Shinjuku Line (Ōmiya to Zushi) Series E233-3000
3996090.short_description: The Shōnan-Shinjuku Line is the nickname for the route connecting Ōmiya Station in Saitama, and Ōfuna Station in Kamakura via Shinjuku Station. Service began with the December 1, 2001, operating as a route connecting stations like Utsunomiya and Takasaki Station to Zushi Odawara and Atami Station
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

5495420.name: Quiet Lands
5495420.short_description: Survive in the Iron Age north, among endless forests, misty lakes and harsh winters! Hunt, fish, build a shelter and keep your fire burning. Turn your small camp into a thriving village, protect your people, and trade with neighboring villages or fight for your land.

3166710.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Utsunomiya Line (Kuroiso to Tokyo) E233-3000 series
3166710.short_description: Utsunomiya Line is the nickname for trains operating on the 163.3 km long section of the Tohoku Line (between Tokyo Station and Morioka Station) between Tokyo Station and Kuroiso Station. We hope you will enjoy the Utsunomiya Line DLC.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

2553940.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Joban Line (Shinagawa to  Katsuta) E531-0 series
2553940.short_description: The Joban Line runs from Ueno Station in Taito-ku, Tokyo to Sendai Station in Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture, via Chiba, Ibaraki, and Fukushima Prefectures, and is the longest line among all JR lines not named "Main Line.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

5269380.name: NTR life Drawing? Cash for Obedience......!
5269380.short_description: As a manga artist with 120 minutes and a limited budget, negotiate adult "sketching" sessions with your cold assistant, Mari. Manage expenses and physical interactions to break her defenses in this Live2D and ASMR interactive sim. 26 unique stats will trigger up to 10 different endings!

5359140.name: NTR life Drawing? BJ for Obedience......!
5359140.short_description: A straightforward Blackjack showdown! Win at the table to unlock exquisite, smooth Live2D adult animations. With its fast and relaxing pace, use your card skills to unlock all the vivid and realistic erotic scenes!

2602460.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Shin-etsu Line (Naoetsu to Niigata) E129 series
2602460.short_description: Currently, the Shin-etsu Line operating as JR EAST has three sections: between Takasaki Station and Yokokawa Station, between Shinonoi Station and Nagano Station, and between Naoetsu Station and Niigata Station. This DLC includes the section between Naoetsu Station and Niigata Station.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

2844540.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Takasaki Line (Ueno to Takasaki) E233-3000 series
2844540.short_description: The Takasaki Line is a 74.7 km long line connecting Omiya Station in Saitama City, Saitama Prefecture to Takasaki Station in Takasaki City, Gunma Prefecture. This DLC includes the Tohoku Main Line section between Ueno and Omiya stations, for a total length of 101.4 km.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

2210720.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Tokaido Line Outbound (Tokyo to Atami) E233-3000 series
2210720.short_description: The Tokaido Line was Japan's first railroad line, including the line between Shimbashi and Yokohama, which opened in 1872. It is known as one of Japan's most famous lines.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

5179680.name: The Last Helm
5179680.short_description: The Last Helm is a management and trading simulation where you build and run your own shop in a fantasy world. Start from scratch, purchase goods, craft weapons and potions, hire employees, and organize expeditions to expand your shop.

4893760.name: JR EAST Train Simulator:Tokaido Line Inbound(Atami to Tokyo)E233-3000 series
4893760.short_description: The JR East section of the Tokaido Line connects Tokyo, Kanagawa, and Shizuoka. As part of the Ueno-Tokyo Line network, it offers through-services with the Utsunomiya Line and the Takasaki Line. Enjoy diverse scenery ranging from coastal views to Tokyo's urban skyline.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

4583320.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Seibu Railway (Ikebukuro to Hannō) 40000 Series
4583320.short_description: Seibu Ikebukuro Line is a major route operated by SEIBU RAILWAY, connecting Ikebukuro Station to Agano Station, over a distance of 57.8 km. The line features a diverse timetable and a wide variety of train types, including express and commuter services.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

3349810.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Ome Line (Tachikawa to Okutama) E233-0 Series
3349810.short_description: The Ome Line is a 37.2 km long line connecting Tachikawa Station in Tachikawa City, Tokyo, and Okutama Station in Okutama-cho, Nishitama-gun, Tokyo.The Ome to Okutama Station section is known by the nickname “Tokyo Adventure Line".
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

5065400.name: DABANGGU
5065400.short_description: DABANGGU revives Korea’s classic 1970s–80s alleyway team tag. Race through iconic Korean neighborhoods, disguise yourself as street props, evade the taggers, and stage a dramatic jailbreak for your team—solo with BOTs or online with up to 15 players.

3906050.name: Gunblade Ranger Demo
3906050.short_description: Um Roguelite de tiros e ação focado em ataques implacáveis e execuções brutais. Luta na terra devastada, executa inimigos para repor munição, coleciona armas e mutações e cria o teu próprio estilo de massacre. Suporta modo cooperativo local para 2 jogadores.

4240730.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Chūō・Sōbu Line(Local) (Chiba to Mitaka) E231-500 Series
4240730.short_description: The Chūō/Sōbu Line Local trains operate on a 60.2 km route connecting Chiba Station in Chiba City, Chiba Prefecture, and Mitaka Station in Mitaka City, Tokyo. The journey between these two stations takes approximately 1 hour and 30 minutes.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

3938710.name: Tail of Desire: Remastered
3938710.short_description: You are Anik, a pure, innocent young man. In fact, you're the only man in the world! Embark on an adventure of desire and danger, facing horny milfs and evil demons. Your mission is to defeat them, then use your gentle heart to bring them love and redemption. Lift the curse that haunts their souls!

3439840.name: Hiroka Toudou's Whore-o-ic Tale
3439840.short_description: Whore or hero? Body, soul, pride, future... sacrifice it all to become a hero! Protect the city till there's nothing left of you in the ultimate hero-breaking RPG experience!

4110510.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Yokohama Line (Ōfuna to Hachiōji） Series E233-6000
4110510.short_description:
The Yokohama Line is a 42.6 km railway connecting Higashi-Kanagawa Station in Yokohama and Hachiōji Station in Tōkyō.
Enjoy the scenery as the train travels from Ōfuna to Hachiōji, weaving through residential and commercial districts along the way.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

3218760.name: Fornani
3218760.short_description: Explore an ancient island that drifts amongst the raging clouds of a gas giant. Collect various guns and items, solve puzzles, and shoot any thugs or monsters that get in your way. Meet the locals and aid them in their quest to take down Skycorps while they aid you with yours: finding your brother.

4267780.name: Acting Out
4267780.short_description: Make movies with your friends! Acting Out is an online co-op multiplayer game where you film movie scenes. Choose scripts from different genres and cast your actors, then its lights, camera, action! Hit your marks, deliver award-winning performances, then watch your masterpiece on the big screen!

3390940.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Tokaido Freight Line (Nebukawa to Shinagawa,Tokyo） E257-2000,5500 Series
3390940.short_description:
Tōkaidō Freight Line is the common name for tracks on the Tōkaidō Line dedicated to freight trains that are separated from passenger trains (freight lines) and branch lines attached to the main line that are mainly used by freight trains (freight branch lines).
We hope you will enjoy Freight line.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

4635930.name: Abyss Hunter: Lust Awakening
4635930.short_description: By day, the huntresses battle monsters, and by night they SUBMIT and take off their armor JUST FOR YOU 🍒🍑 Strengthen your guild and get closer to SEXY huntresses to unlock steamy dates and EXPLICIT animated scenes 💦 Only you decide what happens next 😈🔥

5424610.name: Bossinator TD
5424610.short_description: Build towers, then grab your weapon and jump into the fight! Bossinator TD mixes classic tower defense with hands-on hero action. Hold the line against hordes, flying beasts, Elites and towering Bosses across multiple worlds — your way.

3811380.name: JR East Train Simulator: Senzan Line(Sendai to Yamagata) E721 Series
3811380.short_description: The Senzan Line is a 58.0 km long line connecting Sendai Station in Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture and Uzen-Chitose Station in Yamagata City, Yamagata Prefecture. The line was named “Senzan Line” after the initials of both Sendai and Yamagata.
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

4933320.name: X-Keepers Demo
4933320.short_description: "X-KEEPERS" is an independent game that combines classic minesweeper logic, apocalyptic rescue, base construction and character development. Interpret digital clues, flag danger, rescue survivors, and build your own safe haven behind the ruins.

5230690.name: Last Man Running Demo
5230690.short_description: Try Last Man Running with up to 4 players in local or online multiplayer. This demo includes one procedurally generated level, all game modes, and a selection of character skins. Bring your friends and give it a run!

4163150.name: SEX ORCgasm
4163150.short_description: Me Orc-Gruk smash out rhythm game for elf-lovers like you! Tap-tap-tap to thumping beat, make pointy-ear girls wiggle wild and unlock steamy adult bang-fest. All-new soundtrack slap like orc club to elf butt, perfect groove for your... special rhythm sessions!

5376600.name: AfterCursor
5376600.short_description: Your cursor leaves copies behind. Now they hunt you. Collect folders, dodge phantom cursors, and chase high scores in an eerie desktop arcade game. Uncover a 50-level story between emails, or test your reflexes in Endless, Maze, Waves, and Relay.

5285410.name: The Grander
5285410.short_description: Settle a 10,000 year war in this comedic Top Down Action RPG where God is just a guy in jeans. Gather powerful weapons and even more powerful allies as you dash, slice, shoot, and bomb your way through a war-torn world. Learn the difference between being God and just playing.

5457670.name: CrossWords
5457670.short_description: Not just a game, CrossWords is a tool to build and save complex custom crosswords. Insert your own words to craft dedicated puzzles, let the auto helper algorithm finish the rest, and compete on global leaderboards.

2476590.name: JR EAST Train Simulator: Keiyo Line (Soga to Tokyo) E233-5000 series
2476590.short_description: 京葉線は全線開業が1990年とJR東日本の中では比較的歴史の浅い路線で、東京都の千代田区と千葉県の千葉市を結ぶ路線です。東京駅～越中島駅間の地下区間を除き、全線に渡って東京湾沿いの高架線を走行しているのが特徴です。沿線は東京湾の埋め立て地として再開発が進んでおり、ニュータウンのほか、テーマパークや大型ショッピングモール、オフィスなどがそびえたっています。
publishers: EAST JAPAN RAILWAY TRADING CO., LTD.

5212560.name: Legion's Hand Demo
5212560.short_description: Legion's Hand is a mahjong-inspired roguelike deckbuilder. Match three identical cards to form a Giant Soldier, or a sequence to form a Regiment. Your hand shapes your army and its formation. Collect 190+ rule-changing relics and send your winning hand into battle.

5356210.name: Merry Nightmares
5356210.short_description: Merry Nightmares is a horror anthology featuring three chilling stories, all united by one theme: Christmas.

4553010.name: Another Ark
4553010.short_description: Embark on an strategy RPG adventure in the land of Macca.  Tackle a variety of maps large and small.  Listen to the original soundtrack, and learn the mechanics to tackle difficult challenges.

3535270.name: Bolt of Whalington
3535270.short_description: A Metroidvania built around discovery and curiosity. Play as Bolt, a Siamese cat exploring a flying castle where you might melt walls with soap, become a rat to talk to enemies, or even rewrite the world’s rules. Explore, experiment, and uncover Whalington’s secrets. Curiosity doesn’t kill this cat.

5056370.name: We Are Good Delivery
5056370.short_description: A first-person action score-attack game about dealing with one spaceship disaster after another. Put out fires, patch hull breaches, handle asteroids and aliens, and survive your 10-minute shift. Protect your cargo and ship as you chase a higher score in this chaotic space delivery game.

4553620.name: Dark Rail
4553620.short_description: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

5085820.name: Idle Necronomics
5085820.short_description: Incremental Idle Souls Gambling Investing Clicker. You are the Necromancer. Reap the living, turn their Souls into supernatural capital, and build an undead operation that keeps the harvest going around the clock.

2500500.name: Survival Of Runt
2500500.short_description: An open-world PvPvE survival shooter where cooperation and betrayal coexist. Choose between Chaos and Order to claim victory, and if you fall, revive as a formidable Mutant Player to hunt down the remaining survivors.

5490440.name: 九霄战机
5490440.short_description: SKY REAVER is a pixel-art vertical shoot 'em up with incremental progression. Dodge bullets, destroy enemies and collect resources. Return to base for permanent upgrades, unlock missiles, wingmen and lasers, and take on 25 powerful bosses with ever-growing firepower.

4777710.name: 口袋修仙 Demo
4777710.short_description: Pocket Cultivation is a strategy cultivation game centered around “Storage Bag Building.” Journey through a vast world of cultivation, collect items that suit your path, and carefully arrange them within the limited slots of your storage bag.

5499530.name: RETURN TO 1990 - Chapter 4: Reckoning
5499530.short_description: Chapter 4 of RETURN TO 1990 (2020–2027). Lead the AI war against global tech giants, survive the pandemic crash, tariffs and the bubble, and face one night on a bridge in March 2027. 20 new episodes and the true ending.

4752720.name: The Shimoda Rift
4752720.short_description: Discover the fate of a Moon Patrol Vehicle and its crew in this top down, off road, outer space, driving simulator horror platform game.

3827390.name: Dinosaur Shakespeare 3: They Are On The Moon Now And It Escalated Quickly - Bloodcore Edition
3827390.short_description: The Saurian Alliance is threatened by The Theropod Empire. That's scary. Our heroes, a ragtag group of dinosaurs from all walks of life (and one that is definitely not a Corgi-Iguanodon hybrid), must band together to fight back against the dark side of The Moon(tm).

4970800.name: Pull the Lever
4970800.short_description: Pull the lever, send a tiny train hauling cargo. Click storms and breakdowns mid-run to protect the take. Chase jackpots, hire staff to automate the dull runs, and grow a living model railroad. You won't know the payout until it arrives.

4839040.name: X-Keepers
4839040.short_description: This is a light strategy simulation game that combines grid-based maps with search, attack, and retreat gameplay. You will play as a guardian of the rescue team, venturing into dangerous areas to find trapped female survivors.

4683480.name: Space Cadets: Engineering Corps
4683480.short_description: Survey planets. Obliterate the locals. Invest in your ship. An action packed rougelite where the engineering crew you hire is either your greatest asset or your worst enemy, sometimes both at the same time. Don't fret, they always mean well.

2996900.name: Dungeons & Desserts
2996900.short_description: Dungeons & Desserts is a roguelite dungeon crawler where you also run a cosy bakery. Journey through candy-themed realms, gather rare ingredients and craft mouth-watering desserts to sell across your counter, cafe and relic room, all while a greedy landlord keeps raising your rent.

5485720.name: Raccoocket
5485720.short_description: Raccoocket is a cheerful, ridiculous rocket-building flight game. Stack cola and Mentos, bottle rockets, old toilets and scrapped missiles into a rocket that looks impossible but pushes like crazy, and launch Xiao Huan the raccoon. Get it right: the Moon. Get it wrong: a short, loud fireworks show.

4650750.name: Amadeus: A Riddle for Thee ~ Episode 2 ~ Reharm
4650750.short_description: Play as Solea, a young Witch who travels on behalf of her friend Amadeus to the place they first met... Welcome to the lonely moors of Augur Pyne. A linear narrative Visual Novel + Adventure Game. Episode 2 of 5.

1352700.name: Dancing with Ghosts
1352700.short_description: Dancing with Ghosts is an uplifting narrative game about learning to live after loss. Befriend a cheery ghost and earn the good karma that recovers her memories by dancing, making roti, and helping your neighbors around a lively Thai river village, finding healing in every connection you make.

4901710.name: In Two The Paint
4901710.short_description: An asymmetric co-op puzzle game where two players are trapped in separate worlds. Explore a 3D mansion in first person and a 2D world of paintings through point-and-click gameplay. Work together to solve puzzles, but with only your voices to communicate. Can you break free from your family’s fate?

4929040.name: Pickup Point Simulator Demo
4929040.short_description: Run your own parcel pickup point and manage the daily flow of deliveries. Scan incoming packages, organize them by number, verify customer identities, and provide fast, accurate service. Grow your business, improve efficiency, and become the neighborhood's most trusted pickup point.

5195300.name: Wolf Mate - School Date
5195300.short_description: Enjoy a fun date with Freya, just the two of you, at the school after the festival has ended!

5269730.name: Expendabots Demo
5269730.short_description: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

4378070.name: Free Stars: Children of Infinity Combat Demo
4378070.short_description: Pilot over thirty unique ships with wild abilities in exciting 1v1 top-down space combat. Strategize your ideal battle roster with the classic ships from The Ur-Quan Masters and all-new characters. Play locally, online, or against a CPU opponent.

4719390.name: Смена
4719390.short_description: Atmospheric simulator of the seller in a night stall of the 1993 model. Immerse yourself in the melancholy of the sleeping area: sell goods, count the change and communicate with customers.

5381850.name: Elevator Button Simulator
5381850.short_description: Step into an elevator, press the buttons, and travel between floors. A simulator built around a small part of everyday life. Enjoy watching the elevator respond to each press.

4035920.name: Train Sim World® 6: Thames Valley: Windsor, Henley & Marlow Branch Lines Add-On
4035920.short_description: Token-up and tackle a trifecta of Thames Valley duties as the Windsor, Marlow and Henley branch lines arrive in Train Sim World courtesy of Incredible Trains! Hop across an iconic trio of tracks aboard Great Western Networker Turbo traction.

4044670.name: Automobilista 2 - Historical Track Pack Pt3
4044670.short_description: The third Historical Track Pack features three 2005-era race tracks.

3301110.name: Total War: WARHAMMER III - The Changeling – Shadows of Change
3301110.short_description: This pack introduces the Changeling, a new Legendary Lord for Tzeentch, usable in both Realm of Chaos and Immortal Empires campaigns, as well as new units, characters, and regiments of renown.

2593180.name: Dragon's Dogma 2: Explorer's Camping Kit - Camping Gear
2593180.short_description: Gain one special camping kit, and make them available for purchase at shops in-game. Efficient without being unduly weighty, this camping kit is favored by explorers traveling far afield.

2327880.name: 纯白医院Whitedary Demo
2327880.short_description: 心理咨询+中二战斗？视觉剧情RPG《纯白医院》登场！在这间非真的医院来场赛博咨询吧——精神和心理问题并没有想象中的那么可怕…真的，是这样吗？

4971460.name: Radia Island
4971460.short_description: Radia Island is a civilization-building survival game. Lead your people to a new land, establish your first town, gather resources, research technologies, advance into the industrial age, and ultimately complete the space program.

4088520.name: MeowFactory
4088520.short_description:
Welcome to the MEOWFACTORY!
Automate production lines and manage limited space to achieve perfection. Connect machines with conveyor lines and minimize hand (well, paw) labour!
In the near and depressing future, when the world is on the verge of destruction, ONLY MEOWORKERS can revive production!

411188.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: Empire - Alohadance
411188.short_description: From team Empire, learn more about Alohadance

4595280.name: 報連喪症候群
4595280.short_description:
1LDKの部屋に閉じ込められ、その部屋で起こる変異から逃れられるか。
なぜ自分の部屋が変異するのか。その変異が意味するものとは。
developers: 合同会社ウィザードトータスゲームス

4724830.name: Cat Ball Arena
4724830.short_description: Cats on skateboards compete in chaotic ball matches across challenging arenas full of traps and hazards. Unlock powerful abilities, master increasingly absurd stages, and outscore your foes in this fast-paced pixel-art party game.

5384880.name: Return of the Lich
5384880.short_description: Return of the Lich is an active tower defence, where you rapidly reposition towers on the fly, spread rot to reclaim your kingdom and race the clock for total domination!!!!

4856160.name: Conquest of Empires 3
4856160.short_description: Conquest of Empires 3 builds a strategy-first world of multi-civilization warfare, where cunning is the only passport, and every player can rely on their intellect to carve out their own empire in an epic sandbox.

5064870.name: Lord of the Tiles
5064870.short_description: Gradually uncover the world, discover new cities, connect them with roads, and turn a humble settlement into a prosperous kingdom. Develop your economy, unlock new mechanics, and explore the map at your own pace — with no combat and no unnecessary stress.

5135800.name: Vǫrðr Forge
5135800.short_description: Vǫrðr is an ambitious game engine for making 2D, 2.5D and 3D games. Easily create the video games you want and release them royalty free. No proprietary art type, easy-to-use interface, built-in RPG systems, day/night cycle, weather, skybox, water, events, and much more. Your multiverse awaits.

3600590.name: The Last Squad
3600590.short_description: The Last Squad is a PvE top-down roguelite zombie shooter for solo play or online co-op with up to 4 players. Play heroes with unique abilities. By day, upgrade skills and boost artifacts in the bunker. At night, take aim, fight through infected waves and defeat bosses. Uncover the source of Virix.

5353530.name: AlpineFall
5353530.short_description: You came to learn to ski. The mountain had other plans. Alpine Fall is a cinematic skiing adventure where you carve, jump, race and explore Mount Oread while uncovering the story buried beneath its snow.

5500050.name: Vacant Realms
5500050.short_description: A fast-paced action roguelite where every run brings new upgrades, crazier builds, and overwhelming hordes of enemies. Fight, adapt, and become powerful

5311580.name: 修仙，然后攻略魔法少女 Demo
5311580.short_description: A visual novel × life-sim RPG in a city where convenience stores and demons share the same streets. Train, work, and win hearts by day; fight through black mist in turn-based combat by night. Ascend as an immortal — or charm your way through. The choice is yours.

5398780.name: もみんちゅ！ ～個人マッサージ店はセイコウ中～
5398780.short_description: A perfect gal suddenly appears at your small personal massage parlor. Make her yours with your signature pleasure massage... Real-time controls make her flesh ripple and deform! Powered by the ultra-realistic MomiMomi Engine. A next-gen hands-on experience that turns you into a first-class masseur.

5172510.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted Soundtrack
5172510.short_description: The arrange soundtrack for 『Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted』 is coming!

4957490.name: Legacy: The Card Game
4957490.short_description: A free 1v1 card game with a twist: both players summon Foes onto one shared field, which either of you can kill for Legacy points. It's your Legend versus theirs to see who can leave behind the greatest Legacy. Use strategy to play cards that help you, hurt them, or add some chaos to the mix.

5500960.name: TRAUMABOX
5500960.short_description: Hunt corrupted clones in a third-person sci-fi roguelite sandbox. Match targets to reports, survive brutal combat and recycle bodies with the Neurocon Bioliquifier. Fight through NEUROSHOCK or build your own experiments in Sandbox.

2837690.name: Dungeons & Dragons: Long Rest Tavern
2837690.short_description: Tired of going on adventures? Build and run the finest tavern in the coziest corner of the Dungeons & Dragons universe. Let heroes face danger, while you turn their tales into your fortune. Every legend needs a long rest.

4245350.name: SatomiChat
4245350.short_description: Every chat from your stream in one window: Twitch, YouTube, TikTok, Kick, VK Video and W.TV. Donations and events right in the feed, text-to-speech, viewer cards and moderation, 16 chat themes for OBS and a game mode that sits over your game. The core features are free.

4294590.name: Endless Tower
4294590.short_description: Climb an endless tower, keep your momentum, and time each jump to reach the next platform. No enemies — just your reflexes and your own record. The tower regenerates every run, so every climb is a chance to beat your best.

4967150.name: HEAVENBREAK
4967150.short_description: A fast-paced third-person roguelite shooter. Hold the line against relentless waves, upgrade your weapons, and create devastating builds with each run.

5172390.name: Witch of Oz
5172390.short_description: Turn poker hands into magic in this card-puzzle adventure. Form spell patterns on a 3×3 grid, overlap them for powerful combos, and experiment with items and card enchantments. Explore a pixel-art Oz with Dorothy and use your magic to help her companions.

5165760.name: The Lost Grotto
5165760.short_description: A roguelite of light and alchemy. Every step down the grotto burns torch fuel. Gather, brew, and read the creatures below to get past them, then use what you've learned to make new discoveries.

5378980.name: Project Wisteria
5378980.short_description: Wisteria is a Windows AI companion that keeps an ongoing conversation and hierarchical long-term memories on your PC. Narrative compression carries context forward, while diaries, memos, and visible thought records preserve what matters. Bring your own API key; API usage is billed separately.

4608850.name: Aetheris Core
4608850.short_description: A fast-paced top-down sci-fi bullet-heaven roguelite where you pilot distinct ships, stack abilities, upgrades, and 50+ relics into screen-clearing builds, then prove your strategy against multi-phase bosses and unstable Rift encounters.

4102030.name: Gravity Goblins
4102030.short_description: A gravity-bending roguelite collectathon where you ascend an ever-shifting tower. Manipulate geometry to your whims, snag some coins, and play the night away at the local arcade! You'll need all the upgrades and trinkets you can gather to discover the secret buried at the top of The Old Stipe...

3949580.name: Lunar Strike
3949580.short_description: A single-player hard sci-fi narrative adventure set on the Moon’s South Pole. Explore humanity’s final lunar colony, face the hostile reality of lunar survival, and decide what deserves to endure when collapse becomes inevitable.

3183540.name: Corrupted Worlds
3183540.short_description: Corrupted Worlds is a sci-fi puzzle adventure that tasks you with navigating a dying solar system full of perils. Survive, solve intricate puzzles, and scavenge for vital resources. Uncover ancient artifacts to reveal the past and saveguard life in the universe.

5380560.name: False Feed
