5380560.short_description: Compare four surveillance feeds and find the one that contradicts the other three. Pause, rewind, and examine the same event from different perspectives in this deduction game. Work through 18 recordings across six work sites at your own pace.

4266100.name: Elixir Shop Together
4266100.short_description: Need a break? Open your own fantasy potion shop with your friends! Gather ingredients, process them, brew potions, and cure the troubles of customers visiting your shop. Add Elixir Shop Together to your Wishlist and prepare to step into a magical world with your friends!

5154860.name: KNUCKLEBOUND
5154860.short_description: KNUCKLEBOUND is a turn-based roguelite deckbuilder. Choose your fighter, build your deck, combine punches, kicks, bleed and poison, collect equipment, and fight your way through the streets to take down the Crime King.

5500000.name: CRIME COAST
5500000.short_description: Chase dangerous money, drive your dream car, and get close to women with secrets—CRIME COAST is an illustrated narrative RPG where business, favors, and gunfire can open the way to a life on your own terms.

5129570.name: Kritsana Demo
5129570.short_description: Monitor retro CCTV footage, spot anomalies, and report them before it is too late in this Thai psychological horror observation game. Uncover the chilling truth behind a psychiatric patient's hallucinations, where trauma blurs into the supernatural.

4938180.name: Lethe
4938180.short_description: A stylish warp-action platformer. Master high-speed teleportation to bypass deadly hazards, strike enemy blind spots, and dominate the battlefield.

5019710.name: Before the Song Falls
5019710.short_description: In 1131, the land lies shattered and the nation is in ruin. Lead displaced people to rebuild their homes, develop production, stockpile supplies, and resist powerful enemies. Survive the chaos of war and protect the countless lives behind you.

5488820.name: My Little Cafe
5488820.short_description: Run your own cozy pixel-art café! Create drinks, discover hidden recipes, hire staff, and decorate your shop. Balance customer satisfaction and running costs as you expand your café and unlock terrace decorating. Your little café story starts with a single cup.

5251970.name: HOMEBODiES
5251970.short_description: Explore and capture beautiful online environments with your friends.

4642490.name: Bazookat
4642490.short_description: A 2D Precision Platformer, where a stylish cat uses a bazooka to rocket jump to solve puzzles! Enjoy blowing stuff up, and reaching new heights!

4808140.name: Drive To The Top
4808140.short_description: Jump, Swing and Boost your way to get to the finish as fast as you can! Try beating the level in both single player and 2-player co-op. How fast can you beat the game?

5482530.name: Shai & Shatta
5482530.short_description: Run a lively Egyptian street kitchen solo or with friends. Brew shai, build ful sandwiches, and master koshary as orders pile up and the neighborhood causes chaos. Cook with up to 4 players locally or 8 online.

4668740.name: Lustflame Bonsai
4668740.short_description: Adult xianxia farming RPG. Cast out of the Sword Sect, you inherit a ruined mountain gate and one spiritual field. Farm, craft pills, take commissions, delve into mystic realms, and pursue exclusive routes with five heroines. The sect is a bonsai; who shares your nights is up to you.

4966420.name: The Bandits of Sierra Fria Demo

3850490.name: Mega Hasan 2
3850490.short_description: Mega Hasan is back! Last time he had to find his own wallet. This time he's here to find other people's crap! Run and jump through 56 levels across 7 worlds. Battle bosses, unlock characters and team up with a friend in local co-op!

5235090.name: 和平战队
5235090.short_description: Peace Squad is a single-player VR shooter amid a deep-space crisis. Use realistic weapon handling, spatial tracking, and tactical movement to complete five missions, from a training base to a space fortress. Face mechanical soldiers, human troops, and drones with rifles and sniper rifles.
publishers: 香港妙音数字科技有限公司

5500160.name: Welcome to Puppy Poker
5500160.short_description: A 52-card poker deck, one Galaxy card, one Puppy card. Each round, 3 of 40 events go live and every card carries a random effect. Build the best scoring combinations, spend your rewards in the shop, and win 15 rounds in a row to become a Puppy Poker Legend.

4514030.name: Wonderking WD
4514030.short_description: The return of classic 2D side-scrolling action! WonderKing is a free-to-play MMORPG packed with flashy combat and deep progression. Advance through diverse classes, master unique combos, and party up with friends for epic boss raids. Start your adventure today!

5405240.name: Isekai Truck: On My Usual Way to School, a Huge TRUCK Hit Me, When I Came To, I'd Been REBORN by a Goddess, While I Was Still Lost, the Archmage Who'd Apparently Summoned Me Said I'm the Chosen HERO, So I'm Off to the GUILD First, I Guess ~Hit by a Truck, I Woke Up in Another World~
5405240.short_description: The title says it all. But if you insist: a first-person dungeon-crawling action RPG where you cast spells by drawing runes with your mouse. Gear up in town, descend floor by floor, defeat monsters and bosses, and make your way to the Demon King.

5379990.name: 天道绘卷——修仙地图模拟器
5379990.short_description: 生成一卷属于你的修仙世界。看人族与妖族修士修炼、突破、探索秘境，见证宗门的兴起、分裂与覆灭。你可以静观岁月，也可以化身天道，赐福修士、改变灵气、投放灵宝，改写世界的命运。

1732710.name: Celesthral
1732710.short_description: Master the art of instant character swaps and high-speed support parries to defy the celestial conspiracy. As the wind god Fei Lian, unite with Jiang Ziya to lead an alliance of demons and men, shatter the chains of destiny, and embark on a god-slaying odyssey for true freedom.

5064330.name: Keyb Out
5064330.short_description: Keyb Out is a roguelite wave defense game about defending your PC from viruses and hackers by using your keyboard as a weapon.

4818620.name: WBS26
4818620.short_description: Run a wrestling promotion in a booking simulator. Build shows, sign talent, grow rivalries and decide who holds the titles. Your choices shape careers, locker-room morale and the future of your company.

3839680.name: BLIGHTFALL
3839680.short_description: ※ FEED THE SHRINES [▰▰▰▱▱] ※ BLIGHTFALL is a fast-moving 1–4 player FPS roguelike. Hold the zone, dash-reap the wounded, stack loot into broken builds, breach the rift, and kill what answers. ⟦ TIME FEEDS THEM // KILL FASTER ⟧

2620510.name: Bamboo Spring: A Story Cast in Bronze Demo
2620510.short_description: After saving an exiled prince of the fallen State of Wei, you are granted an abandoned homestead. Farm the land, raise livestock, fish and hunt, forge bonds with the townsfolk, build a militia, and defend your home against invading forces.

4919060.name: Escape from Track 7
4919060.short_description: The last train is gone, and Track 7 won't let you leave. Watch for anomalies: if something is wrong, turn back; if not, keep walking. One mistake and you start over. A short spot-the-anomaly horror in an eerily real Japanese station, from a series with over 100,000 copies sold.

3958390.name: Project: Haste
3958390.short_description: Break in. Tear it up. Get out before the cops show up. Wall run, slide, double jump and rocket-jump off your own shotgun across places you don't belong. Headshot your friends mid-air and chain eliminations in a lightning-fast 4-player arena shooter you can pick up in a single match.

5498120.name: The Wizard’s Tower and the Bramblekins
5498120.short_description: A cosy exploration and rebuilding game. Your master has blown his tower apart, and you’re the apprentice left to fix it. Find hundreds of scattered pieces, carry them home and put everything back together—with a little help from the Bramblekins. No timers, no combat, no pressure.

4950600.name: HAPPY PROPAGANDA
4950600.short_description: Approve or censor live chat in Happy Propaganda. Balance viewer anger and the host's well-being, choose broadcast topics, and talk off-air. Five days of choices lead to multiple endings.

5394970.name: DAYON
5394970.short_description: DAYON is a sandbox online open-world game set in a near-future city enclosed by a massive wall. Life, ownership, combat, and exploration exist within one persistent world. Build your own life and stories in a city that changes with real-world time.

5477430.name: Block Mercs
5477430.short_description: Block Mercs is a turn-based mercenary company RPG. Recruit fighters, pay wages, manage food and gear, and take contracts across a grim low-poly world. Lost limbs need steel or stranger grafts. Reputation follows you, and so do old grudges. Combat is one line in the ledger; surviving is the book.

5427420.name: Danchi Days Soundtrack
5427420.short_description: The original soundtrack for Danchi Days

3426800.name: Delverium Demo
3426800.short_description: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this survival sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Delve deep to uncover the secret of the invading 'Faults' and restore stability to the land.

4520900.name: The City of Endless
4520900.short_description: A roguelike auto battler with asynchronous PvP. Every run you ride the rails of an infinite city, scavenge weapons, spells and skills, and arrange them into powerful combos. Choose your route as your Rig fights monsters and other players on its own. How long can you keep your life on the rails?

3787110.name: Random Poker Defence
3787110.short_description: A Straight across. A Flush down. Stack their power where they meet. Random Poker Defense is a poker-powered defense game where you summon, rearrange, and combine hands to hold back incoming enemies. Just one more card could complete your perfect setup… but the enemies won’t wait.

5118690.name: Randventure
5118690.short_description: Randventure is a 1-bit, turn-based roguelite played in a single swipe: slide your heroes left or right to make your choices. Build your team of three heroes, journey through three acts, evolve them along the way, and overcome every obstacle on your road.

4760480.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
4760480.short_description: A forgotten cult classic shooter set in an alternate history 1950s Soviet Kyiv, most of the city's population has mysteriously vanished, and horrific monsters roam its abandoned streets. Can you uncover the cause of the catastrophe and set things right?

5324310.name: 1999トコヨビル Soundtrack
5324310.short_description:
Featuring all 25 tracks that bring the world of "1999TOKOYO Building" to life.
 From the main theme of TOKOYO Building, an indoor amusement park on the verge of closing in 1999, to themes for its shady staff, enjoy nostalgic yet subtly unsettling music that evokes the era.

5495700.name: Too Many Chickens
5495700.short_description: Too Many Chickens is a chaotic co-op game for 1-4 players. Chase, grab and throw runaway chickens, haul them to the barn, and turn deliveries into cash. Buy better tools, build chicken-catching contraptions, and pay off the farm’s debt. Your friends might help.

5438830.name: PixelGo
5438830.short_description: Enjoy Go at your own pace in a warm pixel world. Play a relaxed game in single-player mode, solve a life-and-death puzzle, guess the next move in a master's game, or take a quiet moment to review your own. Even if you're new to Go, you can explore one stone at a time.

4018330.name: Lord of Undead
4018330.short_description: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

5381000.name: Snow White and the Dwarf Slaves
5381000.short_description: An idle management game at the bottom of your desktop. Assign dwarves to gather, craft, research, and trade while you work. Pay gold to Snow White, a fearsome dragon, every ten years and guide your settlement through a hundred-year fairy tale.

5404600.name: Please Don’t Break My Dungeon
5404600.short_description: Build a dungeon worth breaking—and a home worth protecting. Play as Nubi, a rag doll defending a tiny room: repair wreckage, revive monsters, place helpers and spring traps on treasure-hungry heroes. Send them fleeing and turn their dropped loot against the next party.

3809820.name: Expendabots
3809820.short_description: Expendabots is a 1–4 player co-op horror-extraction game where expendable robots explore ever-changing islands and terrifying dungeons. Outmatched and vulnerable, you’ll need to stay quiet, hide from hostile creatures, survive the horrors, and extract with your squad before the island is lost.

4947930.name: 英雄变美
4947930.short_description:
Glow up Hero: a card roguelike where beauty = power. Recruit real-world heroes, field 4. Each: 3 standard + 2 ultimate cards (once per battle). 3 energy/turn, unused cards discarded. Glow Up transforms & upgrades all cards. Real origins.

Beauty is justice? No—beauty is power.

5394930.name: 까마귀슬레이어
5394930.short_description: A game where you survive for 20 minutes by using skills and defeating crows.

4039200.name: Exterminauts
4039200.short_description: Exterminauts is a co-op third-person PvE shooter using weaponized power tools and mad-science gadgets to exterminate alien pests. Take on MegaCorp contracts amid energy supremacy clashes, while aliens' thirst for Polymorphic Plasma disrupts plans. Punch In. Clean Up. Get Paid.

4863670.name: Kuaiban!! Magical Girl
4863670.short_description: Your phone is the clapper — wave it, and the party starts. A motion party rhythm game: beat duels, photo-booth co-op, and a single-player story across China. Scan a QR code to play with friends — no app to download. Turn any screen into a party, magical-girl story and all.

5255870.name: Working Dead
5255870.short_description: Run a supermarket for zombies in this first-person simulator, solo or in online co-op with up to three friends. Prepare body parts, set prices and turn spills into blood soda. Get bitten and keep working as a zombie, but your friends will only hear groans through proximity voice chat.

5477370.name: Only Arms: Grab, Sometimes Fall
5477370.short_description: Become a creature made of nothing but two arms, and climb the cliffs. Hook your fingers over rock edges, brace yourself on your palms, and haul your body up with your arms. You might fall. Sometimes.

5053050.name: Digging Up Demo
5053050.short_description: Digging Up is a 1-4 player co-op digging adventure where you drill through a destructible alien planet, gather valuable resources, upgrade your gear, explore underground biomes, and dig your way back to the surface.

5028360.name: ZERO KNOWLEDGE
5028360.short_description: A single-player cyberpunk roguelike deckbuilder where one card can turn a 4×4 board. Build your deck, set up chains of captures, and follow the evidence through hostile networks to expose the intelligence framing you.

1897660.name: The Main Menu
1897660.short_description: The Main Menu is a psychological horror thriller where you wake up trapped in a room with only a corrupted main menu to interact with. Changing the menu physically changes the room around you. Manipulate its buttons and hidden systems to solve puzzles and uncover what controls the screen.

5406570.name: Fish Market Tidy Up
5406570.short_description: Fish Market Tidy Up is a cozy single-player organizing simulator where you sort different species of fish scattered throughout a fish store. Return every fish to its proper place, organize collections by type, unlock helpful abilities, and restore perfect order as efficiently as possible.

5484060.name: Switchroom
5484060.short_description: Up to 6 friends are trapped in a white room full of identical buttons. Every press is a surprise: gravity flips, a bomb lands on someone's head, a friend gets possessed. Sell junk, gamble the team's cash, and buy the $100,000 key to escape. Together, or not.

4521890.name: Kingdoms in Arms
4521890.short_description: Kingdoms in Arms is a strategy game where you build and manage your kingdom. Build cities, outposts and military camps to conquer the whole island. Besiege your enemies castles and bring down their walls with your siege engines like catapults and trebuchets. Control your armies in real time.

2359660.name: Arisen Force: Vonimir
2359660.short_description: Gather allies, fight the shadows, and uncover the secrets of Vonimir. In a land of pixel beauty and epic battles, your legend begins.

2935660.name: Odyssey Fight
2935660.short_description: Runic Legends is a fast-paced 2D Free-for-All MOBA. Master ancient runes and fight in a ruthless arena against champions from 5 warring worlds. There are no teams here! Forge your own path, survive the chaos, and claim absolute supremacy for your dimension

4937640.name: The Offering Hour
4937640.short_description: A strategy-action roguelike where time is your only currency, and your life. Summon monsters to fight cunning hero bosses, cast dark rites, cut deals: every action costs seconds, even opening your grimoire. Then sacrifice three monsters to become a demon and fight in person.

1660440.name: Way To The Woods
1660440.short_description:
A Deer and Fawn must embark on a journey through an abandoned world of the unknown to get home. 
A third person adventure game solo developed by ant tan.
Featuring soundtrack from aivi & surasshu, composers for the show Steven Universe.

5341310.name: AVALON:XIII
5341310.short_description: Build your playstyle with nearly 100 upgradeable cards, hero progression, equipment and potions. Time your cards, blocks and counters in real-time combat. Explore dungeons, then develop Ash City through idle gathering, crafting and building upgrades.

4671960.name: EasyCraft
4671960.short_description: EasyCraft is a VR building sandbox with thousands of real-brick parts at 1:1 scale. Pick up and snap pieces with your motion controllers, build alone or co-create with friends in real time, then publish designs and explore and remix creations from builders worldwide.

5395560.name: Pigeon Idle : GuGuGuGu
5395560.short_description: Catch pigeons and sell them as rotisserie chicken! Or set your hard-won catch free! Run a pigeon rotisserie on your desktop, and let your favorite pigeons play on top of your taskbar.

5316810.name: Indoor Shrimp Farming Simulator Demo
5316810.short_description: Channel your inner shrimp in this totally normal idle-clicker aquarium simulation demo...

5318800.name: Hotel Carnivalia Demo
5318800.short_description: Hotel Carnivalia is a first-person social deduction game for 4-15 players. Roam a gothic hotel on foot, hunt your prey as a predator, or follow the traces left behind to find the predators hiding among you.

5279660.name: ShredDead - Supporter Pack
5279660.short_description:
Take a break from the city and enjoy ShredDead in a Rural setting. Go touch some grass. You’ve earned it.

This cosmetic DLC helps support the development of ShredDead. Thank you!

4427430.name: TBH : Task Bar Hero - Slayer (Class)
4427430.short_description: Unlock the Slayer class for TBH : Task Bar Hero.

4680650.name: Train Sim World® 7: Freightliner BR Class 70 Add-On
4680650.short_description: Throttle up in Freightliner fashion as All Aboard Studios’ BR Class 70 roars into Train Sim World for cross-country cargo service! Take charge of a Powerhaul parade, working engineering trains and hefty freight from the East Midlands and beyond.

3951490.name: The King is Watching: Crowns of History
3951490.short_description: Play as Cleopatra, Taizong of Tang, and Xerxes, three legendary-inspired rulers with radically different playstyles. Master death and rebirth, dominate with devastating defenses, or risk everything for overwhelming power.

4137650.name: Death at Fleming Manor Demo
4137650.short_description:
"Your job is to write the death certificate."
Investigate a mysterious death in a British manor in 1959. Explore eerie scenes, analyze evidence, and complete death certificates and emergency reports. A forensic mystery with art inspired by 1960s European detective comics.

4211230.name: AUDIOMECH Demo
4211230.short_description:
Your MUSIC powers your WEAPONS, and it powers your ENEMIES.
Gameplay synchronizes to any music playing on your computer - yes, even streaming.

4300770.name: Neuron Activation Demo
4300770.short_description: A digital fidget box of dopamine-fueled micro-challenges. Push buttons. Shoot targets. Chain actions for higher scores. Complete all tasks. Don’t ask questions.

3744850.name: ACCIDENTALLY DEMO
3744850.short_description:
A chance encounter. An inevitable murder.
The truth always hides where you least expect it.
Survive the night in this mansion.

3754660.name: 构想彼方 ImagineFuture Demo
3754660.short_description:
"Imagine Future" is a Visual Novel with a campus theme. You will follow the perspective of the protagonist Ji Wang, experience the life of a high school student.
The final examination seemed so far away. one day, it was close at hand.
Standing at the crossroads of life, what choice will you make?

3784790.name: ARCHWIZARD Demo
3784790.short_description:
Fast paced "Hyper Shooter" complemented with esoteric exploration experience. Take a quest to become Arch Wizard: dominate surrounding realms, reverse Time, escape Death, befriend Chaos, face the End of the World.
Knowledge based progression. Full of secrets.

2926420.name: My Dream Setup - Bathroom DLC
2926420.short_description: Do you want to create your dream Bathroom? With the Bathroom DLC it's now possible. You can create any bathroom you want. Any size, any color combination, any budget, shared or separate - it's all up to you.

3103920.name: 暖雪 Warm Snow Soundtrack
3103920.short_description:
'Warm Snow' is a Rogue-like action game with a background set in a dark fantasy world, where the eerie 'Warm Snow' holds sway. 
You will play as the Warrior 'Bi-an' on a crusade against the Five Great Clans, in order to save a world teetering on the brink of destruction.

2637930.name: My Dream Setup - Pets DLC
2637930.short_description: Does your pet also live in your room? With the Pets DLC you can add animals, toys and accessories to your room. Choose your furry friend from the 16 breeds of dogs and cats featured in the DLC. In addition to dogs and cats, you can choose from fish, parrots, hamsters and even a lizard.

1700720.name: Warface: Clutch — Weapon set "Counter-terrorist pack"
1700720.short_description: The set consists of two killer weapons that bring energy to the game. With them, you won’t let your enemy get bored!

5112180.name: 神谕之窗.exe
5112180.short_description: A civilization-building simulation presented through an interface inspired by desktop operating systems. Become the divine steward of an ancient civilization, manipulate windows and resources, raise magnificent wonders, and guide your people through the rise and fall of an age.

5150690.name: Ripe for the Picking☆Summer Beach
5150690.short_description: Use the perverted sunscreen to make the girls fall head over heels for you! Simple shooting × Fully voiced 3D H-scenes! Change outfits, switch backgrounds, and create any situation you desire! Come create some ultra-steamy summer memories!

411187.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: Complexity - zfreek
411187.short_description: From team Complexity, learn more about zfreek

5467590.name: IRON FURY
5467590.short_description: Neon-noir beat 'em up for 1-2 players. Includes PART I: STREETS OF VENGEANCE, PART II: OVERCLOCK and SURVIVAL MODE: two full campaigns, couch co-op, combos, throws, support strikes and 13 boss fights, told in painted comic panels.

4719020.name: Seaside Wash
4719020.short_description: Seaside Wash is a cozy job simulator where you clean, repair, and restore ships from rust and barnacles to pristine condition. Upgrade tools, grow your business, discover rare finds, build your own ship, and enjoy peaceful seaside activities.

4140580.name: Ann's Parlor
4140580.short_description: Awakened from years of slumber, the witch Ann returns to her old cabin, where visitors arrive seeking love, truth, or glimpses of fate. Through crystal-ball readings, you interpret their stories and guide their paths—every choice reshaping their destinies and the secrets that await within.

5195100.name: Tarnish Online
5195100.short_description:
Forget Your Level. Remember Your Skill.

Tarnish Online is an MMORPG without traditional levels, auto-attack, or pay-to-win. Master your weapons, fight alongside loyal companions, and forge your own path through a persistent world where how you play matters more than how long you've played.

5129730.name: 家出少女といっしょ。～ダウナーゲーマーJKとイチャラブ同棲生活～
5129730.short_description: Your cousin, a lowkey high school girl Hikariko, ran away from home and came to live with you! Have a chat, get lap pillows, sleep side-by-side! Enjoy a cool yet super sweet, affectionate yet nonchalant, lovey-dovey cohabit simulator with Hikariko♪

5274570.name: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light Demo

804280.name: Starwake
804280.short_description: Starwake is a free-to-play sci-fi MMO! Crew ships, battle enemies, mine asteroids, craft goods, run businesses, climb navy ranks, and conquer territory in a persistent universe with 75 star systems!

2359820.name: Arisen Force: Vonimir Demo
2359820.short_description:
an A-RPG game featuring exquisite high-definition pixels ,it combines the engaging adventure storyline  with the Stylish Action combat experience.
The trial demo version offers a gameplay experience of the game's prologue, including core elements such as exploration, combat, and team development.

2681870.name: Kidbash : Super Legend
2681870.short_description: In this nostalgic 2D action-platformer roguelike, awaken in a world of forgotten game characters as a hero with no memory of his past. After failing to save a nearby village from destruction, can you rise, rebuild, and discover the true meaning of being a hero?

5135490.name: LumberBoy Demo
5135490.short_description: A woodcutting incremental where you explore different forests, process wood, and keep growing. Start with just a basic axe, max out your stats, and become the greatest lumberjack in the forest!

4710680.name: The Death Deliriant
4710680.short_description: The Death Deliriant is a first-person survival horror game that blends cosmic horror with realistic mechanics. Find items to escape while evading enemies, replace the car battery, jack up the car, and perform other mechanical tasks while facing terror. Once you’re ready, drive the car out of there.

3403690.name: Gumball Hero
3403690.short_description: A fast-paced 3D action roguelike where you play as a gumball machine, shooting bouncing candy to survive waves of enemies. Build your loadout, combine powerful gumballs, and reclaim your mall before it’s too late.

4767430.name: 盛夏的我们
4767430.short_description: Summer nears. A campus photo job brings you to caring beauty Liu Shilin, aloof yet warm artist Li Feier, mischievous model Xia Wei, and childhood friend Le Tong. Together, you plan graduation shoots, each lending your talents, as your own summer romance with four unique girls quietly begins.

5132220.name: Better World
5132220.short_description: Seven evenings in one house. A tired father, five kids, a wife who counts his pills. Take one every evening and everything is lovely — until the walls start writing back. A short PS1-style psychological horror story. Two endings. What did you do, Arthur?

4635180.name: 座敷童カレシILOVEラーメン
4635180.short_description:
「座敷童カレシILOVEラーメン」は、ラーメン作りとハートフルなストーリーを楽しめる”ラブコメノベルゲーム”です。
ラーメンで大切なものを守り抜く、強くて優しいストーリー。

3116440.name: Ligmanauts
3116440.short_description: Classic platforming action brought kicking and screaming into the voice chat era. Roll, bounce, grab, and swing through physics-driven challenges that only work when someone's yelling at someone else. Online or couch, drop in anytime.

5373260.name: Ferro - 3D Audio Visualizer
5373260.short_description: Sound in liquid form. Ferro is a real-time 3D audio-reactive fluid simulation. Shape liquid, light and motion with music, MIDI, automation, or even your microphone. Infinitely customizable, place on your desktop or add to your livestream for an expressive companion to your sound.

5264230.name: Ghost Express Soundtrack
5264230.short_description:
13 original music tracks from the game: Ghost Express composed by Gong Jun.
Thank you for supporting indie game developers !

1628640.name: SYNTHALGIA: Retro Arcade Racing
1628640.short_description: No checkpoint timers — FUEL is your clock. Speed and danger keep you alive. Chase down tankers and cargo trucks to refuel and upgrade. Score big across miles of scenic highways and become #1 on the leaderboard!

5044960.name: Archives of Disorder - Pasture Without Light
5044960.short_description: Twelve years after humanity went blind in one second, survivors live by gentle rules in Haven Seven. Rations always arrive. Names on the list quietly disappear, and sound engineer Elias Ward finds the list has been altered. A narrative adventure about sight, memory and choice.

5222930.name: Ant Tribe
5222930.short_description: Expand your chamber, strengthen your tribe, and put every ant to work, each with its own role — to deliver an endless feast to your Queen!

4781580.name: Vision Quench Demo
4781580.short_description: An online co-op dark fantasy adventure game set in the underbelly of a consumer goods conglomerate mega dungeon. Within its halls you will fight ancient foes and modern horrors. Can you survive long enough to make it to the top?

5088840.name: BABA YAGA: Whispers of the BOOM Demo
5088840.short_description: Escape from Baba Yaga in a surreal forest inspired by Slavic mythology. This demo features a tutorial map that introduces the core mechanics of combat, exploration, and magical glyphs. Map progress is not saved in the demo.

5236800.name: Wool Overflow
5236800.short_description:
A desktop idle game about raising sheep. Hover over them to shear their wool, then collect the tufts scattered across your screen.
Unlock upgrades and grow your little flock to 100 sheep while you work.

4149810.name: Cave Oasis at Shylake Demo
4149810.short_description: Move to a small cave town on a moon in this hopeful futuristic life sim. Try hydroponic farming, sustainable biomass crafting, mix-and-match cooking and decorating, and more. Befriend NPCs from other worlds, support the complex community and ecosystem, and help solve problems that arise.

5498880.name: Sylvaris: Black Reign Demo
5498880.short_description: A dark steampunk Metroidvania built around Overload, a combat system that runs on your own health. Burn your life for power, heal with every hit, and fight your way through a world of iron and machinery.

5317270.name: Mr Chicken's Totally Ethical Farm! Demo
5317270.short_description: Embody Mr. Chicken on the journey to become the most profitable egg farm in the world, all whilst maintaining a totally ethical practice!

4482610.name: Skatebound
4482610.short_description: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

3609100.name: Hero Slayers
3609100.short_description:
Hero Slayers is a roguelite turn-based strategy RPG.
You must shape the fate of Lucy, who finds herself trapped in a crisis from which there's no easy escape due to a single misstep.
Even if you fail, make different choices next time—so that you may reach a better ending.

5429300.name: Closing Time at the Wooden Toy Shop
5429300.short_description: Close up a cozy toy shop by sorting up to 11,520 scattered toys. Fill the shelves, earn upgrades, and use handy abilities. Take a break at Plinko or the coin pusher, or collect wooden animals from the claw machine.

4717320.name: Ram Fights Demo
4717320.short_description: Step into the arena in the free demo of Ram Fights! Take control of a fierce mountain ram, master tactical headbutts, and team up with your friends in Co-op mode. Send your enemies flying with hilarious ragdoll physics in this wild animal brawler.

4785540.name: Widgey
4785540.short_description: Customizable desktop widgets for gamers and power users. Monitor CPU/GPU temps, visualize audio, track news and stocks, and more. Create your own widgets or download community creations from the Steam Workshop.

4333180.name: 80s Horror Survivors
4333180.short_description: Battle endless hordes in an 80s horror nightmare. Stack insane upgrades, break the game, and survive as long as you can.

5444230.name: Sealed Within
5444230.short_description: Trapped in an unfamiliar, hostile, and bizarre bunker, you and your companions must discover the secrets to survival and escape... But something lurks within the chambers that seeks to prevent your freedom. Navigate the environment and complete mysterious trials to unveil the truth.

5326330.name: Before I Turn: Survival Auto Battler Demo

5385920.name: Rails of Revival: China 1889
5385920.short_description: China, 1889–1937. Lay track tile by tile to link mines, mills, ports and cities, and run a supply-and-demand map that breathes. Found your own industries, borrow wisely, ride out wars and revolutions — a railway tycoon where a route is a capacity, not a train to babysit.

4925240.name: SIM
4925240.short_description: You bought your dream home... but it wasn't all you chalked it up to be. As a member of its management committee, rewrite the rules to change the lives of your neighbours and your family for the better in this singleplayer management simulator. Or will you become what you sought to fight against?

3094870.name: Amarillo's Desktop Pets
3094870.short_description: A physics-powered 3D desktop companion engine where crazy ragdoll physics meet living, reactive characters. Import VRM characters, or create your own, and let them live on your desktop.

5166840.name: Character House -Desktop Companion- Demo
5166840.short_description: Character House: Desktop Companion is an idle collection game. Mix and match parts to create a companion that sits with you as you work, syncing with keystrokes, or watches from a corner. Earn rewards offline: pull and craft accessories, shape its personality, and visit friends online!

4352400.name: MageQuit Dungeons
4352400.short_description: Battle across islands of ever-changing creatures as you shape your own growth and attempt to prevent theirs in this co-op roguelike. Counter deadly enemy synergies, alter your abilities, and raise pets to survive while the procedural terrain collapses around you.

5377190.name: Halloweenies Candy Run
5377190.short_description:
Trick-or-treat with up to 4 players. Loot the houses on procedurally generated streets.
Find rare physics based candy and bank it before the Candy KPI catches up with you.
Buy weapons and abilities to help your odds against the horde. Your friends can hear proximity chat, but so can the hunters.

5282970.name: AI 位面旅者：无限世界
5282970.short_description: 《AI 位面旅者：无限世界》是一款由 AI 实时驱动的团队冒险 RPG。你带着队伍在位面之间穿梭：探索区域、完成任务、打怪、升级、招募同伴；也可以在信标塔手填世界观、区域、角色与部队，造一个完全属于自己的位面。剧情、敌人、事件全部由 AI 现场生成，没有两次冒险是一样的。每个角色都有自己的记忆与打算，会按自己的目标行动；你不在的时候，区域里的角色仍在自行流动。角色、装备、技能、血统分 D 到 SSS 品级，敌人与友军部队是成建制的单位；回合制战斗可手动指挥每一次出手。买断制，需自备 AI 服务商 API Key 驱动剧情。

5375520.name: MOMENT
5375520.short_description: Solve puzzles as you compose melodies. Place clockwork launchers, tune their timing and guide balls through colour-changing routes. Each collision plays a note, turning your solution into music. Explore 40 levels, experiment in Free Mode and share your own puzzles.

4283640.name: Bread and Iron
4283640.short_description: A brutal medieval survival sandbox blending crafting, base building, and combat as players struggle against harsh environments and dangerous creatures.

4960450.name: Not Musical Chairs
4960450.short_description: Fight to survive across multiple game modes in a 1-10 player first person party brawler, where music, hidden objectives, scarce weapons, and shifting targets turn every round into a scramble.

4437290.name: Lorenium Orbit
4437290.short_description: Lorenium Orbit is a fast-paced 2D team-based space combat arena where players pilot specialized warships, customize loadouts, and battle in tactical 7v7 matches. Master momentum-based flight, precision aiming, and coordinated fleet strategy to dominate orbit.

4826070.name: 莉莉西亚的地下城 Playtest

5405220.name: 分秒之间：发条乐章 Demo

5038990.name: Pinward
5038990.short_description: Pinball with a roguelite twist. Spend your score on another ball or upgrades that change the table. Choose rewards, build towards bigger scores, and keep your run alive. Play with friends, or create and share your own tables with the included editor.

2976860.name: BABA YAGA: Whispers of the BOOM
2976860.short_description: A dark action game where silence kills. Enter a surreal forest inspired by Slavic mythology. Here, time flows to the rhythm of the moon, and undead horrors leap from the darkness. Craft runes and survive explosive battles with demons among the fractal trees. One, two, three… Baba Yaga watches thee!

5349670.name: Greaselord
5349670.short_description: Build the biggest fast food empire in the world and defend it against three rival chains before the health authorities ban you. Your goal: 80% of the world market across 169 countries, with one of 14 main dishes.

5043660.name: DriveGear
5043660.short_description: DriveGear is a single-player spin-combat action roguelite. Battle through each district in a city-wide tournament.  Route your optimal path, take on contracts, tune your build, battle rivals, and earn your way to the Crown Arena.

5450550.name: Talebinder
5450550.short_description: Fairy-tale villains are breaking out of sealed books. As the tower's librarian, gather spellbooks that fight on their own, slot in charms, and evolve them into your own ultimate build. A bullet heaven roguelite where bosses telegraph their big attacks. Tough, but read them and you can win.

4809720.name: Office TD
4809720.short_description: Office TD is a maze building tower-defense set within a highly dysfunctional office. Foil your co-worker's attempts to make you as useless as they are by arranging hapless teammates and ordinary office equipment in devious cubicle layouts to engineer the ultimate defense.

5440560.name: Dirtborn: Colony Rising
5440560.short_description: Ants are fascinating insects, and they have taught mankind what the power of teamwork can accomplish.  Develop your own colony of ants, dig every tunnel, and protect your queen from the numerous enemies you'll encounter!  No two games will ever be the same and online PvP ensures fun to the thorax!

5495840.name: Mortal Caps
5495840.short_description: A cozy incremental game about the collectible caps of the '90s: slam your stack, flip caps to earn coins, grow the pile to 108, open packs and collect 216 grotesque caps across eight series. Beat the champion of every district and become King of the Yard.

3325490.name: Mighty Miners
3325490.short_description: Mighty Miners is a ridiculously replayable incremental mining game. Go as deep as you can on every run. Mine more and more Mightium, discover weapons, unlock a mighty cast of characters, harvest resources, and complete tasks to become completely unstoppable.

4605840.name: 江湖大镖客
4605840.short_description: Jianghu Bounty Hunter is a solo open-world wuxia management game. Restore your ruined escort bureau with the ancient Mechanism Boat. Manage resources, trade, and fight with tower defense auto-battler gameplay. Seize territories and choose to be either a righteous hero or a ruthless jianghu overlord.

3596130.name: Chaos Coin
3596130.short_description: Your coins are your actions in this roguelike coinbuilder. Slot sequences of coins to shove, evade, and attack in turn-based combat. Fight in pairs using coins unique to each character. Upgrade and replace individual coin faces to build complex combos. Chaos is coming, so use your heads (and tails)!

1297910.name: 世界第一游戏公司
1297910.short_description: If you love games and never stop pushing forward,then The #1 Game Company is where you belong.

4582650.name: Amazing Slot Survivor (A.S.S.)
4582650.short_description: Spin the slot machine and see how powerful you'll become! Luck shapes your arsenal, but only skill keeps you alive in this high-stakes bullet heaven roguelite. Master unique weapons and destroy the Spawners summoning endless hordes, and push your luck to the limit.

4648890.name: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown
4648890.short_description: Intergalactic Puzzle Touchdown is a first-of-its-kind asymmetric turn-based PvP puzzle game fusing the familiar mechanics of classic match-3 games with the excitement of gridiron football. Match tiles to earn yards, dodge your opponent's blockers, and create Big Plays to light up the scoreboard!

5445590.name: Stygian: Outer Gods Soundtrack
5445590.short_description: Experience the cosmic horror of Stygian: Outer Gods through its official soundtrack, featuring haunting melodies and eerie atmospheric compositions inspired by the game’s dark, Lovecraftian world.

4535920.name: Little Casualties
4535920.short_description: Guide tiny named units through deadly terrain with bridges, launchers, and questionable engineering. A chaotic Lemmings-inspired puzzle game where most don’t survive, but new generations keep trying. Sorry, Gerald.

4976420.name: Song of Larithea
4976420.short_description: Larithea is a cute anime RPG about friendship, trust, revenge, and finding your way back from the darkness. Craft your own spells from sigils, then lead a team of five young mages through turn-based battles on a grid. Others have walked their road before. Few found their way back.

4726890.name: 搭搭大战（DaDa Wars） Demo
4726890.short_description: A fantasy strategy game where you build with one hand and command with the other. Adjacent buildings boost each other, with plenty of upgrade choices. The demo includes the full tutorial and one complete roguelike contract, free to finish.

5483250.name: Box Them Cats
5483250.short_description: Box Them Cats is a cozy drag-and-drop puzzle game. Grab wandering cats, sort them into the right-sized boxes, recycle the sneaky trash bags, and take on clients’ challenges to earn goddess blessings.

4728390.name: Sack Investigation
4728390.short_description: Sack Investigation an online multiplayer co-op casual puzzle platforming game. Join with up to 7 of your friends to explore and investigate the innerworkings of a magical and whimsical wizard tower. Find and destroy the cursed objects to progress and upgrade your Sack.

862750.name: Lost Railway
862750.short_description: A co-op 2D quota horror game with cute animals and terrifying monsters. Assemble a team of up to 4 players and venture into the depths of the nightmare for valuable loot, tools and secrets. Because the train must always move forward!

4562970.name: ChimpType
4562970.short_description: Transcribe audio to text with automatic speaker labels for recordings with multiple speakers, 100% on your own computer. No cloud, no uploads, no account. Your recordings never leave your machine. On-device AI starts instantly and uses a fraction of the energy a datacenter would burn.

5489230.name: CyberMate
5489230.short_description: Chat with lifelike AI companions in real time! Ultra-low latency, natural voice conversations with instant interruptions and lip-sync. 100% local, no internet or API fees. Just 6GB VRAM recommended. Customize voices and create avatars from your own photos.

4714160.name: Laser Lode
4714160.short_description: Slice through endless ore veins with a high‑energy laser, listen to the clear ring of rare minerals hitting the ground, and witness your wealth skyrocket from single digits to astronomical numbers. 10 minerals, 80 achievements – an incremental feast reserved solely for the laser.

5154660.name: Grench Boss
5154660.short_description: One goblin wants to become the greenskin boss with a single stolen wrench. Hopeless, right? Well, that goblin is you now. Build walls and turrets, swing your wrench sometimes, and beat the pirate rats. Steal their ship, make it stronger, and let's go back proudly to the tribe who kicked me out!

5323620.name: 4DEAD Demo
5323620.short_description: ‘4DEAD’ is a high-speed roguelike action game where you control the invincible creature “No. 42,” which dies if it doesn't consume prey within 4 seconds. Devour invaders relentlessly to survive! Keep devouring enemies within 4 seconds and save humanity from extinction with your own hands!

3963500.name: Bedrotting Simulator
3963500.short_description: Lock the doors. Reply to her texts. Don't stumble onto the wrong account. Track down your missing friend, salvage your relationship, and survive the nights alone—assuming your mind doesn't break first.

4991200.name: The Offering Hour Demo
4991200.short_description: A strategy-action roguelike where time is your only currency, and your life. Summon monsters to fight cunning hero bosses, cast dark rites, cut deals: every action costs seconds, even opening your grimoire. Then sacrifice three monsters to become a demon and fight in person.

3927390.name: Bore Bore
3927390.short_description: Descend to the center of the Earth and survive beneath toxic skies. Watch out for the creatures. Manage your air, water, and food. Build vehicles to dig deeper. Grow potatoes, gather resources, and design robots to defend and automate your world — the control is in your hands.

5391620.name: Beast Hunt
5391620.short_description: Hunt the Beast through deadly caves in this first-person survival horror game. Read the clues, map your route, and manage light, air, and sanity. Scavenge strange powers, evade giant spiders, and trust your deductions when it's time to take the shot.

3692780.name: Cresata
3692780.short_description:
From the ashes. In the name of vengeance. A revenant shall rise. 
Following a treacherous rebellion, Phaedon of Arsica is imprisoned and left for dead. Freed by a twist of fate, he now hunts down those who betrayed him and his homeland.

5474340.name: Cargo Order
5474340.short_description:
Sort and trade cargo in this turn-based strategy game.
Make every slot count: stack cargo by color and sell full columns to cities that need it.
Donate boosters to cities to reshape supply and boost profits.
Meet your targets within the turn limit, then see how far you can go in Endless Mode!

4821490.name: How to Use
4821490.short_description: No instructions. No hints. Just you, mysterious controls, and over 15,000 possible combinations. Experiment your way through this unique puzzle experience.

5349720.name: Lots of Axos Demo
5349720.short_description: Breed, raise and care for axolotls in a cozy aquarium. Discover rare colors and gills through genetics, hatch eggs, feed your axolotls and decorate the swamp with over 170 items. This is the Lots of Axos demo!

4940080.name: Desktop Truck Simulator
4940080.short_description: Desktop Truck Simulator is a cozy, semi-idle trucking companion that runs quietly in the corner of your screen. Deliver charming cargo, collect lo-fi cassette tapes, take polaroid photos, collect trinkets, rest and socialize at roadside stops in a slow-burn world that respects your time.

5374490.name: Minato Shokudo: Mirage of the Great Clam
5374490.short_description: A cozy Japanese cooking game where you play a ghost with a diner to run and no sense of taste. So you cook everything by the book. Then you row the food across the harbor while it's hot. All 50 dishes come with a real recipe to try at home. One foggy night, the lighthouse goes dark.

5450440.name: Bird Hockey League Demo
5450440.short_description:
Bird Hockey League

Ducks, penguins and their feathered friends take their ancient rivalry to the ice. Dangle past defenders, throw wing-breaking hits and snipe your way to the top of the pecking order.

Up to 6 players: 3-on-3 couch hockey on one screen, online play, or any mix of the two

2368530.name: Forum Mortuorum
2368530.short_description: Take the reins of a Roman gladiator school. Hire and equip your team, freely combining powerful gear effects to create overpowered panoplies. Accept challenges wisely: once in the arena, your gladiators must fend for themselves until they find glory or death!

4869140.name: Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements Demo
4869140.short_description: Harness elemental chains to defeat foes, collect treasures, and craft unique builds in high-risk, high-reward adventures. Witch & Dragon: Hope of Elements is a roguelike with elemental gameplay, RPG mechanics, and turn-based tactics. Join Elise and dragon Pipi on their magical journey.

5459840.name: Buddy System
5459840.short_description: Buddy System is a 1-8 player co-op camping horror game about a pack of Marshfellows who made some bad decisions. Keep the fire lit, survive four increasingly cursed campsites, and if your buddy stops being useful, roast them. The last Marshfellow standing wins.

5289450.name: Tower of Sequence
5289450.short_description: Tower of Sequence is a beginner-friendly anime-style DBG developed by a solo developer.

5012750.name: ハッ崩し ーハクスラ×ブロック崩しー
5012750.short_description: It looks ordinary, but it’s crazy! Destroy everything with a bouncing iron ball! Use a variety of items to keep destroying an endless stream of blocks, zombies, UFOs, and even sushi! Aim for a high score!

5261050.name: Fox Spirit Sweethearts: Complete Edition
5261050.short_description: A high school romance visual novel. Weeks after you free three foxes from a trap, the same three walk into your classroom as transfer students. Spend your afternoons with the kitsune passing as your classmates, and stand with them when the forest is marked for clearing. 39 chapters.

4775430.name: Night of the Idle Horde
4775430.short_description: Eat the world in this idle, incremental homage to B-movie horror classics. Start as a lowly Shambler and grow into a massive horde. Recruit evil little critters to automate brain collection and buy upgrades for your army. Unleash a mini apocalypse with Desktop Companion Mode.

863330.name: RPG in a Box Demo
863330.short_description: Bring your stories and ideas to life! RPG in a Box lets you create games and other interactive experiences in a fun and simple way!

4331960.name: Spectral Map
4331960.short_description: movement based texture adventure with rpg elements.

5281080.name: 水族派對
5281080.short_description: Aquarium Party is a heartwarming underwater simulation and collection game featuring a soothing, healing art style. Step into the role of an aquarium curator, manage your daily life on a cute fish island, and collect over 1,000 types of fantastical, adorable fish.

5484340.name: 想成为股票交易大师
5484340.short_description: Fifty thousand yuan, a losing position, and a boss behind your chair. Trade fictional stocks in a roguelite life sim, judge rumors, dodge scams, build your strategy, and survive quarterly life checks. Simplified Chinese only.

5482730.name: Project Babel Demo
developers: Shenzhen XOBOX Cultural Creative Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shenzhen XOBOX Cultural Creative Co., Ltd.

5438180.name: vlaina
5438180.short_description: vlaina is a cute interactive desktop pet that brings Live2D characters to your work, study & play. Watch it react as you type, click or move the mouse; switch models, resize & reposition to create your own companion that makes every keystroke more fun.

5459620.name: RAYBREAKER Soundtrack
5459620.short_description: The complete RAYBREAKER score: 15 tracks and 45 minutes of spectral synthwave, from the calm of the Observatory through all six bands and their bosses to the finale at the White Point.

5211810.name: King Alone Demo
5211810.short_description: Tower Defence meets minimalist Action Strategy. Ride as the King, protecting everything you have left, and the Queen, blinded by your enemies.

5153550.name: Pokart
5153550.short_description: Play with friends in this poker-based kart racer- Get the best hand and cross the finish line before you lose it!

4566090.name: 飞花剑 Demo
4566090.short_description: A yuri martial arts story set in a fictional setting. Players take on the role of a knight roaming the martial arts world, where you'll encounter exciting duels and encounters with diverse characters, all waiting for your exploration.

4796640.name: UNBEATABLE - The Jamie Paige Content Companion
4796640.short_description: UNBEATABLE - The Jamie Paige Content Companion includes new songs, new characters and new challenges.

3862850.name: Wanted 3D: Dead or alive Demo
3862850.short_description: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a UZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

3965430.name: The Mailroom
3965430.short_description: Survive the horrors of hell’s deadest-end job: a human mail clerk. Process occult specimens, sort infernal mail, repair cursed machinery, and survive your shift in a cozy horror workplace simulator.

1649260.name: VIVE Hub
1649260.short_description: VIVE Hub unlocks additional features for your XR headset by harnessing the power of your PC. No base stations or external sensors needed. PC VR with DisplayPort mode, mixed reality, eye tracking, and full-body tracker support.

920565.name: Resident Evil 2 - Leon Costume: 98'
920565.short_description:
Change Leon S. Kennedy's appearance to his original 1998 low-polygon visual look for true nostalgia.

*This can be accessed from the "Costume" menu.

411186.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: Cloud9 - N0Tail
411186.short_description: From team Cloud9, learn more about N0Tail

5329600.name: A Cat in the Cangaço Playtest

5250820.name: Champions of Miyandir
5250820.short_description: A turn-based card game for up to 4 players that emphasizes deck construction and free-for-all multiplayer interaction, set in the fantasy world of Miyandir. Each card is beautifully crafted with hand-drawn artwork. Build your own decks and challenge your friends.

5421380.name: Paradis
5421380.short_description: An adult card roguelike where the art is the strategy. Every woman in your deck, futa included, scores by what she wears, how she poses and where she is. Chain them into huge combos, outplay the judges, and win the after-hours.

2172350.name: Push a Block
2172350.short_description: A simple but challenging 3D puzzle game.

4270970.name: The Guidelines : Hotel Napoli
4270970.short_description:
“High Pay, Simple Work, Room and Board Provided.”
Trapped in an isolated room, monitor hotel CCTV and report anomalies. As the days repeat, strange events and memories of the past begin to connect. Follow the hotel's manual. It may be your only guide to survival.

4608220.name: Golgothian Demo
4608220.short_description: Golgothian Demo is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder where you build a three-hero party, upgrade cards and equipment, and fight through tactical turn-based battles in a single-player run.

5476460.name: Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者
5476460.short_description: 《Doomsday Survivor 末日幸存者》 is a shooting game with a post-apocalyptic theme. Players will face the threats of zombies and rebels. They need to defend against zombie attacks, go out to explore, collect supplies and avoid the attacks of zombies and rebels.

5348250.name: Tidy Up Frat House
5348250.short_description: The party is over! It's clean up time! Tidy Up Frat House is a cozy clean up simulator. Pick up thousands of items and sort them between trash, recycling, DVDs, and books. Earn cash for each item collected to upgrade your capabilities and even employ some bots!

4424120.name: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe
4424120.short_description: Sugar-Mommied by a Fox Babe is a Live2D, interaction-focused romance simulation game. You find yourself working as a fox spirit's "assistant," living together and taking care of all aspects of her daily life.

4528010.name: Signal Veil
4528010.short_description: Aki Mizuno is a teenager who, after her mother’s disappearance, inherits a phone that vibrates and emits sounds in the presence of entities marked by deep emotional wounds, becoming her only guide within a haunted school, in a journey of classic survival horror rooted in psychological terror.

5281350.name: 无常三国：乱世幸存者
5281350.short_description: Wuchang: Three Kingdoms Survivors is a dark Three Kingdoms roguelite survivor game. Customize your background and destiny talents, ally with deities and summon reincarnated stellar generals. Build unique builds with randomized affix gear & divine bonds, fight through endless enemy hordes.

5478900.name: REBOOT: Retro Game Store Simulator
5478900.short_description: Run your dream retro video game store! Buy, sell, and trade games and consoles, uncover rare collectibles, repair classic hardware, and customize your shop. From bargain-bin finds to priceless treasures, turn your love of gaming into a thriving business!

5231140.name: Everybody MAHJONG!
5231140.short_description: Learn, customize, and play 8 traditional Mahjong rulesets, including Japanese Riichi to Hong Kong and Taiwanese. Features interactive tutorials for beginners, house-rule customization, and solo play or online multiplayer. This is Everybody MAHJONG!

5444560.name: ペンギンの国の壊し方
5444560.short_description: Reshape the Penguin Nation from the shadows. If they notice, you lose.

5008130.name: Sizzling
5008130.short_description:
A relaxing adventure incremental game about a small ball with a short life.
Roll it across a vast paper white world, paint every cell it touches and watch the land grow back. Progress and learn why the world went blank.

4612030.name: 雀神·喵喵麻将
4612030.short_description: This world’s mahjong is actually a medium for summoning ultra-powerful familiars?! A mahjong spirit who crossed over from another world, together with a beckoning lucky cat, will set you on your path to becoming the Avian Deity!

4227410.name: Just a Simple Turn-Based RPG
4227410.short_description: A short and straightforward turn-based RPG where every action matters. Explore, cast spells through quirky enchantments, help the townsfolk, and hunt for treasure, without endless grinding or overcomplicated stories.

3592770.name: Gravitus
3592770.short_description: Enter a massive battlefield where two teams clash over resources, strategy, and firepower. Start as infantry, pilot hover tanks or flying pods, and unleash laser-based combat in a sci-fi warzone reminiscent of classic space battles.

4682610.name: 13th Ball: The Nightmare Shift Demo
4682610.short_description: Work the night shift at an isolated pool bar in this narrative-driven horror simulation game. Complete tasks, endure hauntings, keep your sanity, and uncover secrets.

4166780.name: Irradiant Skies
4166780.short_description: Irradiant Skies is an arcade roguelite blending brick-breaking and bullet-parrying combat. Reflect enemy attacks, chain powerful upgrades, and master unique ships as you ascend through waves of enemies.

4585020.name: Golgothian
4585020.short_description: Build a three-hero party in a dark-fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Queue actions, read enemy intent, trigger class combos, equip survivors, and choose routes through doomed dungeon runs alone or in co-op.

3743680.name: MEOWU ISLAND
3743680.short_description: Meow Island is a management simulation game where you run an island with AI cats. Start from an undeveloped little island,meet cat companions with distinct personalities, farm, fish, gather resources, run a restaurant, attract more visitors, and grow your island into a lively, thriving seaside town.

4166990.name: 藍儂與路卡
4166990.short_description: Find healing from a mundane life by decorating the old house, all while playing personal babysitter for the 'little imp' in the mirror, helping him pass his boring days. In a sliver of frozen, misplaced time, you must find your own happiness.

3988560.name: Astro Loopers
3988560.short_description: What if you could rewind time — and team up with your past self? Astro Loopers is a Sokoban-style puzzle game set in a cosmic universe, where every move echoes through time. Your past characters repeat their actions as time loops stack up — coordinate them to solve increasingly mind-bending stages.

5061500.name: Contested Space Demo
5061500.short_description: Play the complete first act of Contested Space, a roguelike deckbuilder where you build your deck mid-battle. Six playable factions, all ten bosses, every card in the game, and Incursion difficulties that unlock after your first win. Progress carries over to the full release.

5379140.name: 七宗罪饲养日志
5379140.short_description: In a rain-soaked British seaside town, you inherit a mysterious mansion—and an egg of the Seven Deadly Sins. Raise a demon, pursue forbidden romance, and uncover Lovecraftian secrets through branching stories. Will the one you nurture become your lover, or your doom?
developers: 长生树工作室 Tree of Immortality
publishers: 长生树工作室 Tree of Immortality

5062790.name: Dungeon Descent
5062790.short_description: Dungeon Descent is an incremental dungeon crawler where you fight enemies, acquire loot, and descend into increasingly more difficult floors of the dungeon.

4848510.name: Bubble Love
4848510.short_description:
「身為優質男性，控制所有女人是理所當然的。」
反傳統，開局即後宮，戀愛（？）文字遊戲。
developers: Bipolar Madnesser 躁狂抑鬱瘋狂者
publishers: Bipolar Madnesser 躁狂抑鬱瘋狂者

5126830.name: Infinite Loop Demo
5126830.short_description: Infinite Loop—a top-down bullet-heaven survival × idle game where progression is saved permanently and never resets. Its free demo delivers the complete first map, with all progress carrying into the full game.

2921670.name: 卡牌修真：九宫幻境录 Cultivation Realm: Card Survival
2921670.short_description: Cultivation Realm: Card Survival is a cultivation survival game built around card-based interactions. Trapped in a mysterious realm that drains your lifespan but brims with spirit power, you must cultivate, survive, fight, and find a way to escape.

5149130.name: Whispers from Below
5149130.short_description: Trapped in a mysterious mansion, two detectives investigate their mentor's disappearance. With different visions of their surroundings and a shell as their only tool and bond between them, they must cooperate to solve the puzzles, unravel the cult's story, and make it out alive.

2560840.name: Steel Aces
2560840.short_description: The free-to-play tank MMO where skill wins, not spending. Fight battles with historically authentic vehicles, realistic line-of-sight combat and component-based damage. No pay-to-win.

5318250.name: 谋定三国：卡牌单机版
5318250.short_description: Stratagem of the Three Kingdoms: Card Single-Player Edition is a card-builder set in the Three Kingdoms era. Marshal 300 generals and 100+ strategists, read your enemy's units and each campaign, forge the best formation, and land the biggest War Merit. The realm is divided in three; take your seat.

5332430.name: Kur - Endless Descent
5332430.short_description: An auto-battler RPG in the Mesopotamian underworld. Build a party of heroes, gear and level them up, set their formation, then watch them fight on their own through seven Domains and an endless descent. Free to play, in a small window that fits around your day.

4864920.name: Mark My Spell
4864920.short_description: Mark My Spell is a gesture-driven action roguelite about drawing glyphs, typing commands, and building wild spell synergies against a relentless ghost horde.

5066540.name: Law Firm Simulator
5066540.short_description: Law Firm Simulator is a business management sandbox where you build and run your own legal empire. Hire lawyers, take on clients, manage complex cases, expand your offices, and grow a small practice into the city’s most prestigious law firm.

5000500.name: 少女三国志
5000500.short_description: 《少女三国志》是一款融合三国历史与异世界幻想的二次元策略RPG。三国英魂因时空裂隙降临星魂大陆，以少女之身重获力量，与魔魇军团展开跨越世界的战争。收集传奇英魂，组建最强阵容，探索隐藏真相，开启属于你的全新三国篇章。

4914950.name: Wobble World
4914950.short_description: Squish, stretch, and deform. It's bouncy. It's silly. Use the ground as a trampoline and squeeze your way through Wobble World, a physics puzzle platformer.

5423250.name: The Turret and the Hare
5423250.short_description: A cute, chunky auto-shooter tower defense. Your rider's cannon fires on its own: pick the upgrades, grow the tower from wood to steel, send guns on carts to hunt, and blast critter hordes through day, night and storms. 18 riders, VS and co-op with friends.

5039420.name: Meiji Oligarchy
5039420.short_description: Meiji Oligarchy is a historical simulation game that models the political, economic, and military systems of Meiji-era Japan. It spans the period from the assassination of Ōkubo Toshimichi through the Katsura–Saionji era (1878–1912).

3919400.name: 黄莓C HuangmeiC
3919400.short_description: 《HuangmeiC》: a cute, laid-back modern daily visual novel. Play as a new grad, enjoying funny daily life in another world—a light, silly romance! Stress-free job, little to do, great coworkers. No dark stuff or bad endings; just love, growth! Worldview not real—don’t use 3D logic!

3638070.name: Hermit Computer
3638070.short_description: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

5365310.name: Punk Dog Wars MOBA 2D
5365310.short_description: A free three-way MOBA you play with one stick. Walk your punk dog through the streets of Véspera, plant your feet to shoot, and dodge every attack by stepping out of its mark. Defend your Core. Destroy the other two.

2870120.name: Paranatural
2870120.short_description: Welcome to The Unknown, Ghost Hunter! Hauntings are on the rise, and it's your chance to put a stop to them! Team up with fellow ghost hunters or go solo as you identify and exorcise a slew of highly intelligent and sinister entities. Can you survive the Paranatural?

5327160.name: Empty Heaven: Liminal Dream Demo
5327160.short_description: You are a woman exploring liminal spaces as if wandering through a dream, searching for those you lost. Uncover the mystery connecting these ever-shifting realities. No jumpscares or chases. Inspired by Dreamcore and the Backrooms.

5395470.name: QuickDeck
5395470.short_description: Never miss a stream again. Pin your favorite Twitch & YouTube streamers to your desktop — their icons glow the moment they go live, in each streamer's custom color. Click to watch instantly, get notified on stream start. Plus a launcher deck, OBS control, soundboard, and phone remote.

4365560.name: Vixen 357
4365560.short_description: This Sci-fi simulation game is based on exciting story with various events and unique characters and epic battles with dozens of units.

3292730.name: Death In Your Dice
3292730.short_description: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

3455120.name: Everforge Legacy
3455120.short_description: Everforge Legacy is a classic action RPG solo experience, built for players who remember when a world felt like it had secrets worth finding

4455810.name: WPCA: World Phasebound Control Authority
4455810.short_description: Step into the city's shadows as defenders against the paranormal. Your mission: Contain the Phasebound Horrors, the manifested fictions encroaching upon our world and the survival of humanity.

4971790.name: ARC-9
4971790.short_description: Boot up as ARC-9 in this breakneck cyber-runner FPS! Never stop moving as you dash through bullet hells, tear apart rogue machines, and stack game-breaking augments in endless roguelite runs. Die, evolve, and push to the core. Who are you beneath this mechanical shell?

5358980.name: HopelessSchool
5358980.short_description: 1–4 co-op top-down survival. A medical accident sparks a global disaster reaching Ivy High School. Eight students with unique skills leave the safe room, dodging or fighting the living dead while scavenging supplies and clues, hoping to last until rescue. The "truths" lead to 6 endings.

5423190.name: Three Tides
5423190.short_description: After years away, the main character returns to his coastal hometown, only to find his life pulled in three different directions by a mysterious stranger from a cruise, a bittersweet childhood friend, and a free-spirited new flame.

5257280.name: Parry Ping Pong
5257280.short_description: One button. Every ball. No second chances. Parry Ping Pong is a one-button boss rush where you face monstrous foes across a ping pong table. Read the signs of curving, shifting, and phantom balls, and strike at the exact moment. Miss even once, and the fight is over.

5410650.name: 重走西游路
5410650.short_description:
A turn-based strategy roguelite inspired by Journey to the West. 
Pick routes, recruit Guardians, swap scriptures, and command every turn by hand. 
Each wipe burns a life lamp; lose them all and the run ends — but your merit survives into the next reincarnation.

5436890.name: 周天行异录
5436890.short_description: The Crooked Ascent is an auto-battle deckbuilder of Chinese cultivation. Combine hundreds of cards that amplify each other, then watch them fight on their own. Easy rules, endless builds. Climb from Qi Refining to ascension on a finite lifespan, among hundreds of scheming cultivators.

5494600.name: Scrap Crap Simulator
5494600.short_description: Buy pallets of dead electronics, take them apart at your bench and get the gold out. Sort the scrap, soak the boards in acid, melt the mud down and pour the bar. Sell it, buy a bigger pallet, and keep going until the whole building is yours.

5500250.name: The Devil Upstairs
5500250.short_description: Become the devil upstairs! Stomp to the beat, turn Rage into permanent upgrades, and recruit the neighbors you wake. Build a louder crew, unleash powerful combos, and descend through the building in a rhythm incremental game of short runs and lasting progress.

5344930.name: PUMP IT UP RISE - EZ2ON REBOOT : R PACK
5344930.short_description: Enjoy 20 signature tracks from EZ2ON REBOOT : R with newly created PUMP IT UP charts. An exclusive note skin set that recreates the original gameplay screen is also included.

5413420.name: Spellcrawler
5413420.short_description: Spellcrawler is a roguelike tower defense game where you battle endless waves of enemies. Place your spells, manage your mana, and fight to survive. Customize your character to suit your playstyle, get stronger with every run, and push yourself to see how far you can make it.

5417880.name: Otherworld Legends - K'lulu
5417880.short_description: This content requires the base game  on Steam in order to play.

5494150.name: 轮回之塔
5494150.short_description: A gothic pixel-art roguelite survivor. Weapons fire automatically—dodge, weave, and mow down endless undead hordes. Pick 1 of 3 upgrades every run; talents persist through death, so you only get stronger. 6 difficulty tiers, 3 chapters, heroes and companions by your side.

5503430.name: STASIS VOXEL
5503430.short_description: A top-down voxel bullet-hell roguelite. Freeze bullets in mid-air with Stasis, socket rare support gems, and blast through 50 procedurally generated floors as enemies shatter into thousands of flying voxels.

3175750.name: Xenopurge Demo
3175750.short_description: Xenopurge is a tactical auto-battler where you are a Commander tasked with purging the Xenos threat. Operate from a remote command center, issuing indirect orders via multi-screen interfaces. Plan routes, set priorities, and adapt as missions escalate and feel the true weight of being in command.

4904430.name: The Seven Realms: Syren Hal
4904430.short_description:
The Seven Realms is a story-driven adult visual novel.

After encountering a troubling mystery, you must solve it to complete your quest to procure a mermaid's tear.

Your decisions impact how the story unfolds. Will you be successful, or will your choices cause ruin?

5180940.name: Cozy Cups VR
5180940.short_description: Enjoy the career of a barista. Manage your own custom cafe, customize your interior design, and make the entire city your customer!

5196870.name: The Duke of Werlington
5196870.short_description: A mysterious noble invites you to his estate. You have little reason to trust him, but the promise of wealth is impossible to refuse. As a traveling merchant, explore this PSX-inspired interactive fiction set in an 18th-century gothic fantasy.

5359660.name: StackOver
5359660.short_description:
Stack, hold on, higher!
Drop various objects and stack them as high and steadily as possible within the limited space.
Consider the object's weight, balance, and collisions as you stack them, and use various augmentations to overcome dangerous moments.

5456360.name: 昭幽：阴阳渡
5456360.short_description: A tower defense game with team building and online co-op. Recruit heroes, combine synergies, forge equipment and choose Heavenly Gifts. Manage resources between waves, counter invisible and flying enemies, and defend the crossing between two realms, solo or with friends.

5499580.name: Click the Star
5499580.short_description: A relaxing incremental clicker with idle helpers. Click the star, open pods and collect keepsakes. Spend stardust on upgrades, unlock auto-clicking helpers, chain reactions and charged bursts, then carry permanent skills into your next run.

5202700.name: Burger Flipper
5202700.short_description:
You play as a young man who works as a “Burger Flipper” and who struggles with the ordinary
problems of life.
But his life drastically changes when he meets one little fluffy and rude friend.
Will you discover the truth behind his secrets?

5383040.name: Towers for Hire
5383040.short_description: A pixel-art roguelite tower defense game. Monsters are swarming toward the village, and you play as the captain of a band of mercenaries, building towers, sending out guards and holding the line with skills and traps. Mix and match over 100 cards and treasures to shape a company that's truly yours.

5413150.name: 日本麻将
5413150.short_description: Play four-player Riichi Mahjong in a clean pixel-art style. Practice against computer opponents, share a room code with friends, and learn the rules through illustrated lessons. Customize your tiles and enjoy a game at your own pace.

5488370.name: 代号宝石
5488370.short_description: Codename Gem is a side-scrolling roguelike. Clear endless stages, collect stronger relics, and face fiercer monsters. Spend the gold you bring back from each dungeon on upgrades and consumables — or risk it all in a mini-game for a one-shot leap. How far can you go?
publishers: 福州软件职业技术学院

3629430.name: DREADMOOR
3629430.short_description: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.

5466220.name: Immune Commander
5466220.short_description: You are a dendritic cell. Rally neutrophils, charge into bacteria, carry antigen to the lymph node and craft antibodies. A roguelike blend of RTS and tower defense that follows one patient's immune system from age 2 to 72 — built on real immunology.

5477790.name: 憶外
5477790.short_description: 《憶外》 is a short visual novel blending school romance with a mystery surrounding memory. Notice unsettling details in everyday conversations, mark moments that matter, and revisit the past. When a familiar scene unfolds again, will you give the same answer?

4811700.name: Mancalero
4811700.short_description: Mancalero turns the strategy game Mancala into a combo engine: sow fire, lightning, multiplying and black hole marbles, discover synergies, chain extra turns into massive scores, and break each opponent's Score Target before they beat you.

4947730.name: CatBall
4947730.short_description: CatBall is a physics-based roguelite builder: arm your cat, toss it into battle, watch it roll, crash, and swing on its own, and switch weapons at the right moment to send enemies flying.

5167950.name: ToyOps
5167950.short_description: Tiny agents. Giant world. A rookie squad’s first mission goes wrong. In this action-puzzle adventure, dodge traps and enemies, leap across oversized environments, and combine unique abilities—including teleportation—to solve platforming puzzles and infiltrate enemy territory.

5345390.name: Desktop Mate 森カリオペ DLC
5345390.short_description: Mori Calliope of hololive joins Desktop Mate as its first hololive talent! Cool reaper motions, a scythe swing, and a glass of wine. Pat her to summon the Dead Beats and the Grim Reaper. All voice lines are newly recorded by Mori herself, in Japanese and English.

5444520.name: Lutrin
5444520.short_description: Lutrin is a workshop for writing gamebooks: each passage on an open double page, a map of every choice, dice, inventory and character sheet, then the finished book as a website, a single file or a Windows application.

5500480.name: Crate Up
5500480.short_description: Release the hook at the right moment and stack crates as high as you can. A hand-drawn, one-button stacking game where the tower sways, combos set off fireworks and music, and the climb takes you from a forest clearing all the way into deep space.

3800650.name: Spar Kart
3800650.short_description: Spar Kart is a free-to-play fighting game inspired by Mario Kart, Brawlhalla & Super Smash Bros. The game offers a unique blend of casual fun with intricate combat that's both accessible to newcomers and deep enough for competitive players.

5344920.name: PUMP IT UP RISE - RHYTHM PASS PREMIUM : SEASON 2
5344920.short_description: Unlock PREMIUM rewards with RHYTHM PASS PREMIUM : SEASON 2. Earn rewards as you progress through the season, including season-exclusive items such as animated plates, avatars, and emotes.

5489840.name: 孤城守将：放置射击
5489840.short_description: Defend a Chinese frontier fortress in this first-person shooter with idle allies and incremental upgrades. Turn a crossbow into a rapid-fire weapon, recruit defenders, command volleys, and farm behind the walls. Build up your firepower to face four legendary beasts.

5499650.name: カサネメ様
5499650.short_description: 毎年8月、御鴉郷にはカサネメ様が出現する...。怪異が蔓延る集落を探索し、儀式を行うサバイバルホラー。怪異を"観測"し、安全に業務を遂行せよ。

4137380.name: Decromancy
4137380.short_description: Take a perilous journey into the Scottish wilderness in seek of immortality, deal in essence with a nebulous druid known as the Peddler to add to your collection of cards, flavorful foods, and legendary items in this morbidly funny dark fantasy rogue-lite card game.

4942010.name: Astrolobe OS
4942010.short_description: Explore an orbital workspace where the computer is part of the world. Enter Astrolobe OS, manage files and media, move between the physical workstation and desktop, and play Grapple Grid from orbit above Earth.

5466700.name: Cannon War
5466700.short_description: Cannon War is a pixel-art tower-defense strategy game spanning Ancient, Modern, and Future Warfare. Build towers and barricades to reshape enemy routes, combine weapons and targeting strategies, expand your permanent arsenal, and defend your headquarters through a multi-era campaign.

5490470.name: Paid Bloom
5490470.short_description: Your desktop is a garden. Plant a seed, go back to work, and your flowers grow while you type. Look up hours later and the screen is in bloom. Every plant is one of a kind, rare colours are out there to hunt, and nothing ever dies.
developers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.
