publishers: Beijing Star Halo Technology Co., Ltd.

5499810.name: Crown of Jerusalem
5499810.short_description: A historical strategy game of the Crusader states and their Muslim and Byzantine rivals, 1098–1191. Play as Baldwin IV, Saladin or another ruler across five scenarios: govern cities, fight duels and pitched battles, and decide history's turning points, from Montgisard to Hattin.

3650330.name: Ice Cream Shop Simulator
3650330.short_description: Run a seaside ice cream shop solo or in co-op with up to 6 players. Make ice cream, serve unpredictable customers, earn money, unlock new equipment, and expand and customize your shop as each day gets more chaotic.

3458290.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
3458290.short_description: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

3070310.name: Tiny Fishing Club
3070310.short_description: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.

5456840.name: All in Place
5456840.short_description: Slide, bump, and make room. Guide each block to its matching goal in a grid-based puzzle game about planning moves and helping each other along. Combine rebounds, magnets, and split blocks to untangle the board. Undo a move whenever you want to try something else.

4903670.name: Address Direct and Union Search
4903670.short_description: Direct URL access and multi‑engine search in one lightweight tool. Type any URL to open directly – no unwanted searching. Use separate search boxes per engine, or check multiple for union search. Customize engines, switch browsers, history sorted by frequency, password protection.

1897300.name: Eaves
1897300.short_description: An old painter lived out his days in the mountains, painting. His scrolls, left untended, slowly faded—until a charming little painting spirit was born among them, heir to all he knew. With her help, wield pixel stickers as your brush: mend the faded scrolls, paint new ones, bring his world to life.

3404300.name: Snarfles
3404300.short_description: Snarfles is a Turn-Based Tactics game where you play as BOTH SIDES. Strategize to keep everything alive for a set number of turns and bring balance to your broken family.

1955720.name: Breaking the silent lies
1955720.short_description: The man has to relive his trauma from the past to save his idol but the truth is more than meets the eye.

3555740.name: Bandwagon
3555740.short_description: An open-world survivors-lite adventure about building a band and restoring joy to a grumpy world. Assemble unique musical troupes, roam the land fighting off grumps, and complete quests for a growing cast of quirky characters.

4295970.name: Mirage Rebellion
4295970.short_description: The "Treasure" — source of countless mysteries and conflicts. Under royal orders, the protagonists continue to safeguard it. Why is it so important? What power does it hold? Each character’s story unfolds around the secret of the Treasure.

1599610.name: Tiny Planet Protectors
1599610.short_description:
Welcome to the TPPA! 
The galaxy is yours to explore. Unfortunately, you owe the company that owns it. Take strange jobs across alien worlds, discover bizarre anomalies, and build a home at the edge of the universe.

5055800.name: Verdreamia
5055800.short_description: A cozy gardening sim where you create the gardens of your dreams. Plant dreams in twelve places: a meadow, a conservatory, a window of stars. Tend them at your own pace, in your favorite world style, and frame the views you love into your gallery.

4551150.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
4551150.short_description: A binary decision-driven city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

4258970.name: Crawling Desktop Pet
4258970.short_description: Raise a procedural pet on your Windows desktop. Hatch eggs, feed and evolve pets, collect Crystals, unlock toys and scenes, and shape each body part to create a companion of your own. Switch between windowed and transparent desktop modes, enable click-through, or invite friends online.

5396580.name: Cthulhu Descends
5396580.short_description: Survive eldritch hordes in this pixel-art action roguelite. Combine chain lightning, drones and black holes with hero talents and relics to forge powerful builds. Battle through 15 waves, face an ancient god, and push further in Endless Mode and the Boss Tower.

5206180.name: Tiny Fishing Club Demo
5206180.short_description: A cozy desktop fishing companion you can leave beside your work. Fish solo or hang out online with friends, catch rare fish, customize your tiny angler, collect pets, and grow your little club.

4635290.name: Grave Mistakes
4635290.short_description: Manage and supervise the Good Mourning™ Funeral Home in 2-4 player co-op. Grieving families need your attention: prepare bodies for their final viewing, deliver a passionate eulogy, and steal a couple limbs along the way. Dinner has to come from somewhere.

4898130.name: 赌狗牌
4898130.short_description: A Texas Hold'em hand-builder meets tactical card battling. Luck makes you smile, decisions make you win — burst enemies with overflow damage, or duel AI, friends, and players worldwide!

5365590.name: A Game About Clicking A Rock Demo
5365590.short_description: Click on rocks. Dig for ores, smash through boulders and sell precious minerals on a market. Use your hard-earned cash to unlock upgrades, buy better equipment, and expand your operation. Hire workers, customize theirs  uniforms, and automate your growing mining empire.

3301060.name: Desktop Mate
3301060.short_description: A little more joy on your desktop, every day. Always with the characters you love—they sit on your windows, play with your mouse cursor, and respond to head pats. Featuring a built-in alarm and in-game sync, with new officially licensed character DLCs released regularly!

4596660.name: QuilomboZ: Palmares
4596660.short_description: Lead elite warriors like Zumbi and Dandara in a real-time tactics game to defend the legendary "Quilombo dos Palmares". Use stealth, terrain, and coordinated abilities to outsmart Portuguese forces and mercenaries. Channel Orisha powers through the Axé system to overcome overwhelming challenges.

5395500.name: Bleep Wildlife Demo
5395500.short_description: Hunt dangerous animals, return to the tavern, and buy new guns and traps. Complete missions for a mysterious wizard and take on stronger prey.

5040660.name: 策马三国志
5040660.short_description: Uncover the fog of war across sprawling maps, explore uncharted territories, recruit troops and build your army, and seize cities. Make tense strategic decisions within turns limited by action points.

2193790.name: Vtopia
2193790.short_description: Multiplayer co-op, sandbox, survival crafting and building, monster fighting, farming, socializing, mining, fishing, creation, gacha machines, card games — welcome to the VTOPIA.

5345380.name: Desktop Mate IA DLC
5345380.short_description: IA, the virtual artist from 1st PLACE, joins Desktop Mate! Watch her recreate her VOCALOID™3 package illustration pose, admire her favorite sakura mochi, and let a butterfly land on her fingertip. Featuring character voice powered by VoiSona Talk "IA TALK."

3465160.name: 雪ミク「SNOW MIKU 2025 Ver.」 DLC
3465160.short_description: With this DLC, you can enjoy a special snow-themed version of the popular virtual singer “Hatsune Miku” called “SNOW MIKU 2025 Ver.

5040210.name: Desktop Mate 宮舞モカ DLC
5040210.short_description: Miyamai Moca, the speech synthesis software character from AHS Co. Ltd., joins Desktop Mate! Watch her bury her face in her black cat Watson-kun's fur, play detective with a magnifying glass, and offer you tea when the alarm rings. Featuring a newly recorded voice by Mayu Mineda.

5040200.name: Desktop Mate 弦巻マキ DLC
5040200.short_description: Tsurumaki Maki, the speech synthesis software character from AHS Co. Ltd., joins Desktop Mate! Watch her strum and tune her trademark guitar "Musutan," offer you tea when the alarm rings, and burst into star and heart effects when patted. Featuring a newly recorded voice by Manami Tanaka.

4145010.name: Desktop Mate 仕事猫 DLC
4145010.short_description: Work Cat (Shigoto Neko) joins Desktop Mate! Press Ctrl+S to trigger a cheerful “Yoshi!” point-and-call. Enjoy relaxed motions and two switchable voice sets (Fresh Newbie / Seasoned Pro). Your easygoing buddy for office work.

4018680.name: Desktop Mate 紲星あかり DLC
4018680.short_description: Kizuna Akari arrives on Desktop Mate with audio by VOCALOMAKETS. Enjoy her signature star-popping wink, lively peace-sign pose, and music-note sparkle entrance, all on a high-quality 3D model supervised by Juu Ayakura. Bright, cheerful motions bring your desktop to life.

3941640.name: Desktop Mate 結月ゆかり DLC
3941640.short_description: Yuzuki Yukari joins Desktop Mate with audio by VOCALOMAKETS. Enjoy a chance-based “putting on glasses” action with a cute quick-adjust gesture, a seated controller-gaming motion, music-note & sparkle spawn effects, and a high-quality 3D model supervised by Juu Ayakura.

4981520.name: Desktop Mate キズナアイ ~ かまってアイちゃん ver.~ DLC
4981520.short_description: KAMATTE AI, revealed with the song "KAMACHO," joins Desktop Mate! This sweet, pouty, attention-craving side of Kizuna AI features a new outfit and motions by Kizuna AI's official team, for one of Desktop Mate's largest motion counts. Pair her with the original via Multi-Character Mode!

3941620.name: Desktop Mate NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE あめちゃん DLC
3941620.short_description: Ame-chan from Needy Streamer Overload arrives in Desktop Mate. Pair with the OMGkawaiiAngel DLC to unlock a transformation from Ame-chan to OMGkawaiiAngel. Includes subtle, expressive motions. Desktop Mate required.

4745480.name: Desktop Mate キズナアイ DLC
4745480.short_description: The popular Virtual YouTuber, Kizuna AI, joins Desktop Mate! Launching on her birthday with the largest motion count ever in Desktop Mate history, lovingly crafted by Kizuna AI's official team. Enjoy her charming greetings and rich expressive reactions to patting, poking, and alarms.

3533450.name: ずんだもん DLC
3533450.short_description: The beloved character 'Zundamon' is now available as the third DLC character for Desktop Mate, featuring a brand-new 3D model and 28 exclusive motions under the supervision of illustrator Sakamoto Ahiru.

4145060.name: Desktop Mate クロミ DLC
4145060.short_description: Rising in popularity worldwide! KUROMI, the self-proclaimed rival of My Melody, joins Desktop Mate! She looks tough but is super girly at heart. Enjoy her mischievously cute gestures—winking, reading, taking selfies, and dozing off. Experience her charm with character voice.

4791020.name: Desktop Mate 初音ミク「マジカルミライ 2026 Ver.」DLC
4791020.short_description: Hatsune Miku MAGICAL MIRAI 2026 Ver. comes to Desktop Mate! Featuring the "Sonare of the Lake" theme with an all-new 3D model, exclusive motions, and summer effects—shimmering water, sunflowers, and petals. Enjoy singing and performing gestures in a dress adorned with sunflowers and butterflies.

3941610.name: Desktop Mate NEEDY GIRL OVERDOSE 超絶最かわてんしちゃん DLC
3941610.short_description: OMGkawaiiAngel joins Desktop Mate with an all-new 3D model and flashy, streamer-style motions. Combine with the Ame-chan DLC to unlock a faithful transformation from Ame-chan to OMGkawaiiAngel, evoking the original game. Desktop Mate required.

4145000.name: Desktop Mate GUMI DLC
4145000.short_description: GUMI, the virtual artist by INTERNET Co., Ltd., joins Desktop Mate! Beloved by creators since 2009, GUMI comes to your desktop with exclusive motions—sparkling ★, eating cake, singing gestures, and saluting. Pat her for a special carrot effect! Experience GUMI's charm with voice included.

4270570.name: Desktop Mate 東方Project ゆっくり魔理沙 DLC
4270570.short_description: Yukkuri Marisa joins Desktop Mate with a super-deformed, adorable look and a newly recorded distinctive Yukkuri voice. Enjoy cute motions like her hat slipping when hopping and dozing when sitting, plus a brand-new 3D model designed by Nonoko—a budget-friendly entry point for first-time users.

4161240.name: Desktop Mate 東方Project ゆっくり霊夢 DLC
4161240.short_description: Yukkuri Reimu joins Desktop Mate. This super-deformed Reimu has a unique Yukkuri voice and brightens your desktop. A new 3D model, designed by Nonoko, recreates her friendly charm. Enjoy this playful Yukkuri version, distinct from the standard release!

4018660.name: Desktop Mate 東方Project 博麗霊夢 DLC
4018660.short_description: Hakurei Reimu from Touhou Project joins Desktop Mate with exclusive voice lines by Sumire Uesaka, shrine-maiden motions (broom sweeping, purification with ōnusa, gentle floating), a brand-new 3D model, and Nonoko-illustrated wallpapers (with Reimu / background-only).

4018670.name: Desktop Mate 東方Project 霧雨魔理沙 DLC
4018670.short_description: Kirisame Marisa from Touhou Project joins Desktop Mate with exclusive voice lines by Mai Kanazawa, Marisa-style motions (broom twirling, riding broom, adjusting hat), an adorable hat-dropping animation, a brand-new 3D model, and Nonoko-illustrated wallpapers (with Marisa / background-only).

3941450.name: NieR:Automata ヨルハ二号B型 DLC
3941450.short_description: The beloved protagonist of "NieR:Automata," 2B, is now available as a Desktop Mate! You can freely switch between Japanese and English voices and enjoy 2B's charm with voice lines extracted directly from the original game.

3681430.name: 雀魂「ちび一姫」DLC
3681430.short_description: "Ichihime," the beloved mascot of the mahjong game Mahjong Soul, makes her debut as "Chibi Ichihime," a special deformed version exclusive to Desktop Mate. In addition to a variety of movements and expressions on Desktop Mate, she also comes with voice functionality.

4018720.name: Desktop Mate 雪ミク「SNOW MIKU 2026 Ver.」DLC
4018720.short_description: SNOW MIKU 2026 joins Desktop Mate! With the "Shiawase Pâtisserie" (Happy Pastry Shop) theme, her design is adorned with musical notes and sweets. Enjoy exclusive motions like eating bread, supervised voices, and Rabbit Yukine alarms. Features a new 3D model by Crypton.

4145030.name: Desktop Mate ポムポムプリン DLC
4145030.short_description: Winner of the 2025 Sanrio character ranking! POMPOMPURIN joins Desktop Mate! This Golden Retriever boy with his brown beret charms with relaxed gestures—dozing off, grooving happily, winking, and tumbling. Enjoy his easygoing charm with character voice.

4145050.name: Desktop Mate ポチャッコ DLC
4145050.short_description: The legendary POCHACCO, finally comes to Desktop Mate! This curious, clumsy puppy who loves detours charms with lively gestures—hopping around, a butterfly on his tail, and dozing off. Enjoy his cheerful charm with an character voice.

3929250.name: 夏色花梨 DLC
3929250.short_description: This DLC features “Natsuki Karin,” a popular character from singing and text-to-speech synthesis software. It offers two outfits (summer and winter) and newly recorded voice samples by voice actress Miyu Takagi, providing fans with a fresh desktop experience unique to Desktop Mate.

4145080.name: Desktop Mate マイメロディ DLC
4145080.short_description: MY MELODY joins Desktop Mate! This kind, cheerful girl charms with cute gestures—winking, spinning with joy, sparkling eyes, and dozing off. Enjoy her heartwarming charm with character voice.

4145070.name: Desktop Mate ハローキティ DLC
4145070.short_description: HELLO KITTY, Sanrio's iconic character beloved worldwide, joins Desktop Mate! Enjoy adorable gestures like winking, clapping happily, and blushing shyly. Click to receive a special heart gift. With character voice, experience HELLO KITTY's charm on your desktop.

4145040.name: Desktop Mate シナモロール DLC
4145040.short_description: The hugely popular CINNAMOROLL, joins Desktop Mate! This white puppy born on a cloud charms with fluffy gestures—winking, dozing off, grooving, and snacking on sweets. Enjoy Cinnamon's soothing charm with character voice.

3359730.name: 初音ミク DLC
3359730.short_description: The world's most popular virtual singer is now available as the first additional character, available for purchase as additional downloadable content (DLC) on Desktop Mate. Enjoy an unprecedented new experience with Miku on your desktop.

3833190.name: 初音ミク「マジカルミライ2025 Ver.」DLC
3833190.short_description:
Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2025 Ver." DLC Arrives for Desktop Mate!
Get ready to enhance your desktop! The Hatsune Miku "Magical Mirai 2025 Ver." DLC is coming to Desktop Mate, bringing special movements and performances that are distinct from the standard Hatsune Miku DLC.

4791010.name: Desktop Mate MEIKO DLC
4791010.short_description: Virtual singer MEIKO joins Desktop Mate! The world's first Japanese-compatible virtual singer, known for her chestnut bob and red outfit, arrives in a Crypton Future Media-supervised 3D model with cool poses, singing gestures, hair-fixing, waving, and exclusive voice content.

3681420.name: 小春六花 DLC
3681420.short_description: This DLC features "Koharu Rikka," a popular character from singing and text-to-speech synthesis software. It offers two outfits (summer and winter) and newly recorded voice samples by voice actress Yoshino Aoyama, providing fans with a fresh desktop experience.

3833210.name: 巡音ルカ DLC
3833210.short_description: Cool and mysterious virtual singer Megurine Luka is now available on Desktop Mate! You can purchase her as additional downloadable content within Desktop Mate. Enjoy the cool and slightly mysterious charm of Megurine Luka with her newly created 3D model.

3681410.name: 重音テト DLC
3681410.short_description: Kasane Teto Finally Arrives on Desktop Mate! Responding to passionate requests from the Steam community and inquiries for "Kasane Teto implementation," we are thrilled to announce that Kasane Teto is now available as DLC for Desktop Mate!

4640430.name: Desktop Mate 春日部つむぎ DLC
4640430.short_description: Voice-synthesis software character Kasukabe Tsumugi joins Desktop Mate! An 18-year-old "Hyper Saitama Gal" attending high school in Saitama. Watch her fix her bangs with her phone, take selfies, show peace signs, browse video sites lying down, and leap out energetically when alarms go off!

4791000.name: Desktop Mate KAITO DLC
4791000.short_description: Virtual singer KAITO joins Desktop Mate! Known for his dark blue hair and long blue muffler, this male virtual singer arrives in a Crypton Future Media-supervised 3D model. Singing gestures, cool poses, enjoying ice cream, a gentlemanly exit, and exclusive voice content—all created for Desktop Mate.

4018690.name: Desktop Mate 鏡音リン DLC
4018690.short_description: Virtual singer Kagamine Rin joins Desktop Mate with a 3D model supervised by Crypton Future Media. While displayed with "Kagamine Len DLC," enjoy Combo Actions—wave to each other, startle reactions, and Combo Alarm!

4790710.name: Shanhai Phantasm
4790710.short_description: 《山海幻境：无限篇》是一款像素风卡牌RPG游戏，融合了三消特色玩法，放置挂机收益稳定，主打一个白嫖很舒服，微氪会更爽！上班摸鱼很爽，下班放空也很爽！登录直接百抽，每周8张自选英雄保底，所有养成资源均有免费产出途径，一起来沉浸体验探索山海神话的快感吧！

3941630.name: Desktop Mate 花隈千冬 DLC
3941630.short_description: Hanakuma Chifuyu joins Desktop Mate with two switchable outfits (summer & winter) and hairstyle changes. Enjoy characterful motions (reading, removing glasses) and original voice lines by Kaya Okuno. Larkpatch appears during alarm notifications.

4018700.name: Desktop Mate 鏡音レン DLC
4018700.short_description: Virtual singer Kagamine Len joins Desktop Mate with a 3D model supervised by Crypton Future Media. While displayed with "Kagamine Rin DLC," enjoy Combo Actions—wave to each other, startle reactions, and Combo Alarm!

4145020.name: Desktop Mate 雪ミク「JRタワー Ver.」 DLC
4145020.short_description: Snow Miku in a JR Tower uniform joins Desktop Mate! Enjoy exclusive "hospitality" motions: refined posture, grooming, polite bowing, and seated script practice. Rabbit Yukine appears for alarms. Features a new 3D model supervised by Crypton Future Media and Sapporo Station General Development.

4474310.name: Desktop Mate 琴葉茜 DLC
4474310.short_description: Voice-synthesis character Kotonoha Akane joins Desktop Mate! The Kansai-dialect older twin reacts with a surprised "!" on click, scatters petals on jumps, and her ribbon bursts into petals when patted. With "Kotonoha Aoi DLC," enjoy Combo Actions—waving, startle reactions, and Combo Alarm!

4640380.name: Desktop Mate 音街ウナ DLC
4640380.short_description: Otomachi Una, the virtual vocalist by MTK and INTERNET Co., Ltd., joins Desktop Mate! This cheerful girl with her large "Otaman Hat" charms with lively motions—wiggling when picked up, dozing off, adjusting her hat. Pat for hearts and notes, or click to drop her hat!

4239890.name: The White Lamb: No Shelter
4239890.short_description: Psychological horror meets fast-paced FPS combat. Play as the Ego, traverse the looping nightmarish Persona Storm realm of Id (Red Cloak) and Superego (Blue Cloak). Fight twisted trauma echoes, make fateful choices to forge reconciliation, unearth chilling truth in fractured memory.

2960250.name: Tempus Triad
2960250.short_description: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

3891660.name: The House Dreams Along With Them
3891660.short_description: The House Dreams Along With Them is a first person puzzle adventure with an emphasis on interactivity and logic. Sleep and dream in the rooms of a mysterious house. Solve the puzzles to make the dreams real and take a step towards the enigmatic reification of night.

5427560.name: Wild Guard
5427560.short_description: Defend the forest with 20 animal guardians in a pixel-art tower defense game. Place your team on a hex grid, unlock neighboring-animal synergies, choose one of three rewards, and merge matching guardians up to 4 stars across eight regions.

3356420.name: Better Days Pending
3356420.short_description: A courier’s struggle for a better life. Ride your e-bike, deliver food, buy weapons and survive an absurd open world. Explore towns, tune the radio and chase rising payouts through day and night in this single-player first-person action game.

5465340.name: Lianur: Shadows of the Divine Demo

2478130.name: Wild Wild Eden
2478130.short_description: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

4319860.name: Resonant
4319860.short_description: Transcend bodies, time, and worlds. In this narrative hybrid of Point & Click Adventure and 2D Platformer, you are a formless Traveler. Shift between post-apocalyptic ruins and neon cyberpunk cities. Solve puzzles, master platforming challenges, and unravel the nature of consciousness.

4976000.name: Ashen Wild
4976000.short_description: Ashen Wild is a group-first online fantasy RPG, where dangerous travel, camp-based expeditions, distinct classes, and tradable loot make people matter. Bring alternate characters while a party forms; press farther when other players arrive.

4539340.name: The Spaces We Share
4539340.short_description: Unpack a life together. In this co-op experience, you and a partner arrange belongings across changing homes, agree on what belongs where, or don’t.

4890210.name: Mourning House
4890210.short_description: After a terrifying encounter on a lonely road, you awaken inside a mysterious house—and your wife is missing. Explore its dark rooms, solve disturbing puzzles, uncover hidden secrets, and discover what happened before the nightmare consumes you.

4838610.name: Sprout's Meadow
4838610.short_description: Manage a team of adorable Sproutlings in this cozy farming adventure! Assign tasks, automate chores, and turn forgotten land into a lively home. Grow crops, raise animals, and craft goods, then take to the skies in your hot air balloon to trade. Watch your little farm come alive!

1460810.name: Dungeon Munchies 2 餐癮地城：貳度救業
1460810.short_description: Who in their right mind would even WANT to eat cosmic monsters? Find out in this side-scrollin', action-fightin', level-grindin', treasure-lootin', dungeon-munchin' grubapalooza!

5288720.name: Total Football Online - Stars Shine Collection
5288720.short_description: Unlock the Stars Shine Collection and choose your favorite league from Europe's top five to claim an 87+ OVR 25/26 Season Star! Assemble football's elite and build your dream squad today.

5317370.name: Next Station: The Moon
5317370.short_description: Next Station: The Moon is a dark romance choice-based visual novel with horror elements about depression, disappointment, and two gods of death who fell in love with the one soul they were supposed to guide into oblivion.

5142640.name: Sortalis
5142640.short_description: A rogue-like deck-builder built on the classic dice game of Farkle. Build absurd combos and push your luck! Over 250 cards with unique effects that power up your rolls. Play solo runs or play multiplayer draft with friends in a round-robin draft tournament!

4875190.name: Loopquarium
4875190.short_description: Loopquarium is an aquarium roguelite where you assemble a school of fish with unique abilities to repel invading apex predators. Start with a group of guppies, grow your population, and balance predator and prey to discover insane combos every run.

4683720.name: BioEden Demo
4683720.short_description: This is the demo version of BioEden. Step into a cozy management journey as a Keeper and bring life back to a world quietly waiting to be healed. Craft the perfect biome for dozens of wonderful animal species and use your ingenuity to restore your planet, one ecosystem at a time.

4784420.name: Tom Clancy's Ghost Recon Wildlands - Predator Premium Pack
4784420.short_description: The Predator Premium Pack contains 13 exclusive additional clothes and body details, including the iconic Predator Wristblades, 4 accessories, 2 pieces of gear, and 2 weapons.

4868040.name: FATAL FURY CotW - DLC Costume ”Classic Mai Shiranui"
4868040.short_description:
■ FATAL FURY: CotW DLC Costume: "Classic Mai Shiranui"
Unlocks the "Classic Mai Shiranui" alternate costume for Mai Shiranui.

4231450.name: DARK IN LIGHT Demo
4231450.short_description: After finishing work, the protagonist returns home—only to find the city overrun by terrifying creatures. In this survival horror adventure, you must explore ruined streets, collect resources, and fight for your life to save your missing son.

3696060.name: LIP! Lewd Idol Project Vol. 1 Soundtrack
3696060.short_description: Enjoy Lewd Idol Project even more with the original soundtrack featuring music by Slaleky and Francisco Nogueiras. Contains 19 tracks of music from LIP! Lewd Idol Project Vol. 1 and is available in MP3 and FLAC file formats.

3010170.name: Fangtopia
3010170.short_description: Sink your teeth into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a carefree, scare-free world of gentle chills.

3113660.name: Veins Like Tapeworms [DEMO]
3113660.short_description: [2-CHAPTER DEMO] While working at their dead-end job and dreaming of what could’ve been, Demian Zhao discovers a flesh-eating parasite who promises to help them finally live free. They can become the monster of your own making - after all, who needs a moral compass when you have a god in the gutter?

2672570.name: Ultimate Admiral: Dreadnoughts "Multiplayer"
2672570.short_description: Design warships the way you want them, and fight against other players!

2582250.name: ASMBL
2582250.short_description:
Build. Program. Pilot. Compete. 
ASMBL is a multiplayer VR sandbox simulator where you easily snap building blocks to build anything imaginable. Build and pilot planes, trains, cars, and mechs. Put your creativity to the test as you and your friends solve problems and compete together.

4189690.name: 竞技场鸟事多 (SuperBird)
4189690.short_description: SuperBird is a roguelike deckbuilder starring birds and bugs. our cards crawl, grow, and even devour one another. Learn each bug’s quirks, build around them with powerful trinkets, and time your plays to perfection under the arena spotlight. Climb your way to the top and claim the crown!

411185.name: Dota 2 Player Profiles: EHOME - ROTK
411185.short_description: From team EHOME, learn more about ROTK

2822770.name: Dead Faces
2822770.short_description: Dead Faces is a mind bending psychological horror. Unravel Jack's disturbing mind, the faces from his past and the ultimate truth behind his actions. You must remember their faces.

5354360.name: VTuberPro Workstation
5354360.short_description: One image. Your own moving avatar. Skip the rigging commission and start without learning complex rigging tools. Buy once, create unlimited avatars with no generation credits or extra rigging fees. Edit, track and bring your character to OBS in one app.

3476500.name: Thunder of the DemonKing
3476500.short_description: A satisfying defensive-battle game with intuitive controls! Become the DemonKing and and defeat hordes of unique enemies with powerful thunder magic!

5010230.name: Hop's Awakening! Demo
5010230.short_description: Blast through colorful hand-drawn pixel worlds in this action-packed cute 'em up! Play the opening stage plus an alternate Route C stage, battle challenging bosses, discover unique weapons, collect food for score multipliers, and unleash powerful Super Weapons.

5201360.name: Oda's Ordinary Lives
5201360.short_description: Live a thousand lives, make choices, and discover their consequences. From childhood to old age, every encounter, every decision, and every twist of fate will shape a unique life.

3810210.name: North Shore
3810210.short_description: North Shore is a top down skating exploration game in which the player navigates a series of connected waterways. To do so, the player must learn to master the art of skating to effectively navigate through these spaces. As they progress they encounter scenes of natural beauty and danger.

3297720.name: Flying Pigs
3297720.short_description:
Your plane is on fire, you're wounded, but don't give up! You are the last hope to end World War II!
Six pilots with a devastating arsenal! Face the hell of the skies in single-player or co-op, survive breathtaking battlefields, and obliterate colossal bosses in this fast-paced shooter!

4416770.name: 妖魔录
4416770.short_description: Yaoguai Compendium is a strategic roguelike idle game featuring equipment synthesis, build crafting, and tower climbing. It delivers a light-paced, casual experience while offering solid strategic.A strange Yaoguai aura suddenly sweeps across Shenzhou. Cultivation sects march out to roam the world.

5087160.name: BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase Demo
5087160.short_description:
《BLINDFOLD: Sound Chase》 is an asymmetric online tag game where one blindfolded seeker faces off against several runners.
An invisible seeker and runners who are in danger if they make a sound. A simple game of tag turns into a tense psychological battle.

4833790.name: Board Game Creator
4833790.short_description: Create and play games with your friends locally and online. Use phones, tablets, or laptops to control a shared canvas to recreate virtually any board game or card game experience.

2864660.name: CoreVR
2864660.short_description: Welcome to CoreVR! The new Social VR experience for you and your friends. Explore community-created worlds, use custom avatars, and create your own content with Unity. Enjoy VR and desktop mode and endless fun.

4836960.name: Cozy Burg
4836960.short_description: A cozy hex city builder with real people and real jobs. You have to earn every resident: they want nature nearby, a job they can get to, and a street worth living on. You build it from a small hand of cards. Make it beautiful, make it work.

4691400.name: Performance Review: Survivor
4691400.short_description: AI is taking your job and capitalism is trying to kill you. Fight back. This office roguelite throws hordes of coworkers and AI managers at you — snowball office supplies into a screen-clearing build and outlast 30 brutal years of reviews, debt, and firings. Clock in. Get rich. Retire. Maybe.

5345510.name: I'm No Gambling God
5345510.short_description: Witness the birth of a new God of Gamblers! A casino sim + strategy-building online co-op game for 1-4 players. Team up, share goals, build synergies, and beat 5-minute floors to win big. Can you become the God of Gamblers?

5032330.name: Zombie Cropse
5032330.short_description: Zombie Cropse is a cozy gothic idle management game where you plant zombie seeds to grow zombies, automate your graveyard, and raid the living. Build your horde, conquer a branching campaign, and ascend to begin again with permanent power.

5071650.name: DaiDee 大弟
5071650.short_description: DaiDee 大弟 turns Hong Kong Big Two into a solo run for survival. Split 13 cards into unbeatable combos, chain plays to stoke the Flow, and unleash bombs that seize the table. Between rounds, stack Style cards that rewrite the rules. Miss the target and the run is over. Play it smart, play it loud.

5482210.name: Hide & Chisel
5482210.short_description: Carve your body out of marble, and stand as still as a statue! Hide & Chisel is a hide-and-seek game where you carve a block of stone into any shape you can think of. Hide from the Curator and his hammer!

2903590.name: HyperFatal
2903590.short_description: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

4313560.name: Knee Deep!: In Love
4313560.short_description:
You might’ve accidentally found out that your scary roommate, your childhood best friend, and your project partner are obsessed with you and are willing to kill for you.

A romance visual novel filled with yanderes with looks to die for.

4620200.name: Knee Deep!: In Love Demo
4620200.short_description: You might’ve accidentally found out that your scary roommate, your childhood best friend, and your project partner are obsessed with you and are willing to kill for you.

3792170.name: 恋爱音游痴
3792170.short_description: "Love wmc" is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

2573060.name: Farmbotic
2573060.short_description: Get ready to venture into the world of Farmbotic. Prepare to automate the farm work with the help of your trusty bots. Explore and fight your way through the mines. Optimize the transportation of your resources and help the villagers with their tasks. All that alone or with friends!

3499590.name: Code RAPID
3499590.short_description: Code RAPID is a Third-Person Action Mecha game with the focus on real-time high-mobility movement. Fight on the Ondarean front to uncover mysteries of a forgotten planet. Complete missions to earn weapons and parts to build a mech that truly suits your playstyle with deep customization systems.

5107690.name: 卡制工程 Demo
5107690.short_description: Make your first card and take it into battle in this free single-player demo. Learn with the tutorial, combine eight selected skills, build a deck, fight the AI and challenge the first-act Boss of the Endless Workshop.

4733990.name: 極上人妻在我身邊 Demo
4733990.short_description: Just being invited is enough to enter. Legal access to homes and surveillance control──your privileges as "Veil" building's maintenance technician. Among residents, that gentle, lonely married woman is exactly your type, while other women here are showing interest in you too...

5030170.name: Super Froppings
5030170.short_description:
Super Froppings is a jumping frog survival party game for up to 8 players.
Using just two buttons, time your frog's jumps and climb to the highest floors!

5427660.name: Wanderhearth
5427660.short_description: Pack your car, drive through a portal and camp in other worlds. A cozy first-person game: prepare at home, load the trunk in 3D, take photos to sell, and fly a drone. Early build; text is Korean only.

4295070.name: War Of The Worlds Trilogy
4295070.short_description: Will Earth survive? Experience the Martian invasion from three perspectives.  Survive terrifying alien attacks as human, conquer Earth as a Martian, or play the city builder and defend your city against towering Fighting Machines and deadly heat rays. Three games. One war for Earth.

3973040.name: Treeternal
3973040.short_description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

5366230.name: Make Me Whole
5366230.short_description: A letter with no sender, a photo of the doll you lost as a child, and an address: a shuttered doll workshop where the same room keeps repeating. Something off? Sewing machine. Nothing? Take the exit. First-person anomaly-spotting horror about finishing a doll, and what moves when you look away.

4399780.name: Treeternal Demo
4399780.short_description: Chop, upgrade, repeat. Venture into a fast-regrowing forest in this top-down incremental roguelite. Draft cards to expand your level-up deck, recruit woodcutter friends, and scale your logging empire to harvest massive amounts of timber.

5044360.name: Scuttled
5044360.short_description: Your ship is gone. The derelict freighter you found was scuttled by her own crew - but her reactor is still warm. Shoot asteroids, refine ore, and rebuild her gun by gun to escape an asteroid belt that hunts the powered. A finite tower-defense / incremental crafting hybrid with an actual ending.

4260840.name: STRANGER THAN HEAVEN
4260840.short_description: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

5461140.name: Anti-Human: Arcade Demo
5461140.short_description: Drop into the arena, score as much points as possible by hacking, slashing, shooting and casting while dodging enemy fire and performing stylish kills. Prove your worth, test your skill, and do not forget the most important step: Show off your high score to everyone in ANTI-HUMAN: ARCADE!

5084810.name: Touhou: Marisa! Cook It!
5084810.short_description: Reimu praised Sakuya's cooking one time too many, so Marisa announced she would handle the next banquet herself. Build a deck of ingredients, pour it into her magic cauldron, and watch the collisions and danmaku chain out of control. A physics-based deckbuilding roguelike.

4338300.name: 卡制工程
4338300.short_description: Make the card you wish you had. Choose its cost, stats and skills, build a 30-card deck, and test your combinations against AI or in online PvP. Explore the five-act Endless Workshop and share your cards and decks on Steam Workshop. No card packs required.

3725470.name: Primateria: Reburn
3725470.short_description: Primateria: Reburn is a magepunk card battler where you rise from cozy shop duels to world championships. Build decks, trade cards, explore arcane regions, and forge your legacy in a living TCG world.

3827730.name: The Emptiness Inside
3827730.short_description: THE EMPTINESS INSIDE is a first-person psychological survival horror game. A darkness creeps into a man's life, twisting his reality. Plunged into the VOID, a shifting abyss, you must explore mind-bending nightmares, unravel its mysteries, & confront the monsters to escape… or be lost to it forever.

4587850.name: Runecaster's Grimoire
4587850.short_description: Cast poker-pattern spells from elemental runes and power them with a backpack grid of living spellbooks. Every rune strikes a column of your Tome Bag. Arrange tomes, bend boss rules and climb three acts in this turn-based roguelite.

2324090.name: VRHandsFrame
2324090.short_description: VRHandsFrame is an innovative VR overlay app that lets you capture portions of your VR view with intuitive hand gestures.

4894970.name: Bravest!2
4894970.short_description: The sequel to “Bravest!,” the classic front-view RPG that was a hit during the feature phone era!

5366650.name: StackOver Demo
5366650.short_description:
Stack, hold on, higher!
Drop various objects and stack them as high and steadily as possible within the limited space.
Consider the object's weight, balance, and collisions as you stack them, and use various augmentations to overcome dangerous moments.

4220120.name: BrosLand
4220120.short_description: Two brothers go to spend the holidays at their older brother's house. The next morning, he's gone! His AI assistant, Xiron, is here to help find him. BrosLand is a local co-op platformer about doing together what neither can do alone.

4548410.name: 诡校中学实录 Demo
4548410.short_description: A Strange School: multi‑perspective horror puzzle‑RPG. You are Kaishiniang, trapped in a weird other‑dimensional school. Flee ghosts, avoid traps, solve puzzles. Uncover dark campus legend secrets. Survive and escape the nightmare.

5256540.name: Homelessness isn't an option Demo
5256540.short_description: Homelessness isn't an Option is a game about Managing your Business, and earning Money from Selling goods and Bargaining

5456610.name: Gennady Soundtrack
5456610.short_description: This is additional content for Gennady and does not include the base game.

5496180.name: Steel Tide
5496180.short_description: A real-time strategy game with large-scale battles. Raise a base, run an economy, and take the field with tanks, artillery, helicopters, jets and a fleet. No ads. No in-app purchases. No account. Single player works offline.

4620150.name: 던전에 가는건 계약서에 없었는데요?
4620150.short_description:
Dive into cursed grimoires in this isometric hack-and-slash roguelike. 
Chain devastating skill builds, fight through shifting dungeons, and recruit rescued mythic characters to expand your library.

5308570.name: Restless Path
5308570.short_description: A voxel-art soulslike about a lone wolf who sets out to cleanse a dying world of evil. Master precise, stamina-driven combat, forge bonds with those you choose to help, and carry your growing legend through a string of dangerous, half-open realms.

4790190.name: Verdant Requiem Demo
4790190.short_description:
“SRPG in Search of Balance"
On a continent where three nations’ ideals clash, what will you choose, and what will you protect? Verdant Requiem is a SRPG about a war for balance beyond good and evil, featuring detailed 2D maps, branching storylines, resource management, and elemental balance.

4833950.name: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun
4833950.short_description: Tianyan Jie: Relics of Qiankun is a wuxia action roguelike in ink-wash style. Choose your sect, enter the heavenly tribulation, clear linked rooms, and stack secret manuals with Qiankun relics into brutal melee combos. Every run reshapes your build—fight through mist and ink, and survive.

4854190.name: Redline Protocol Demo
4854190.short_description: Redline Protocol is a fast modern-retro helicopter combat game built around low-altitude attacks, tactical objectives, wrap-around battlefields, and escalating chaos.

1407560.name: Hot Mic
1407560.short_description: Your friends have heard your Roman emperor a hundred times. Nobody's ready for your cockerel.🐔 Hot Mic is an online party game played with your voice, for 2 to 8 players. Set your mic ablaze!🔥

3156910.name: Sepulchron
3156910.short_description: Trapped within Astor Manor, you have 72 hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles by day, endure deadly supernatural assaults by night, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening your survival.

5305880.name: The Wonderful World of Goblins Demo
5305880.short_description: This is a turn-based strategy game built around resource management, leader progression, exploration and territorial competition. Lead an goblin faction across a hex-based map, develop your territory, organize your forces and compete with other rulers for wealth, influence and room to grow.

349620.name: BlastZone 2 Demo
349620.short_description: A fast‑paced 2.5D shooter built entirely solo on a custom engine, featuring multiple game modes, ship loadouts, online and local co‑op, and over a decade of continuous updates. Battle alien forces through handcrafted missions, survival challenges, and intense boss encounters.

4936690.name: Hideout Heist
4936690.short_description: A co-op horror heist for 1–4 players. Break into a store after dark, grab fragile physics loot and haul it out before the night shift gets you. Hide in the shadows, outsmart guards and worse, and make the quota. The building is different every night. The fun is the same - brand best.

5018130.name: ~ Touhou Bansho Cards ~ Soundtrack
5018130.short_description: A 36-track collection of music from Touhou Bansho Cards, spanning exploration, story scenes, normal and elite battles, regional bosses, and the final showdown.

4958460.name: Touhou Bansho Cards
4958460.short_description:
Fight to the end! Once a card is played, don't stop. Push the Combo higher, break the damage limit, and blast through anything in your way!
Touhou Bansho Cards is a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect cards, explore the Bansho Card Corridor, defeat Echoes, rescue Gensokyo's girls, uncover the truth.

3362310.name: Echo Punk
3362310.short_description: Echo Punk is a roguelite top-down looter shooter with fast-paced combat, tactical upgrades, and endless replayability. Blast through waves of enemies, collect resources, and upgrade your build -- or die trying.

5107250.name: NOYAKI — CONTROLLED BURN
5107250.short_description:
A casual puzzle game about controlled burning! 
Fire obeys the land and wind: racing uphill, fading downhill, stopping at cliffs and rivers. You choose only when and where to light it. Read the slopes, read the wind, cut firebreaks, move the livestock, and burn the grassland exactly as you meant to.

4791380.name: Game About Breaking A Cube Demo
4791380.short_description: Take on the role of a factory worker oppressed by an evil corporation. Break stranger and stranger cubes in pursuit of ore and truth. Upgrade your tools, explore the underground facility and learn the secret of NullCorp. Later, relax at home with a cold can of drinkable meat.

4985700.name: 18 Summers
4985700.short_description: Mow, trim, weed, and water a suburban yard back to perfect green. Feel the mower's weight, watch the cut line follow you, and find a memory in the grass with every patch you finish. Cozy first-person yard work with something underneath it.

5243400.name: High Stakes Chess
5243400.short_description: A fusion of poker and chess where cards determine the pieces you bring into battle. Bet on each hand, place your pieces, then fight it out on the chessboard.

4313580.name: Scars of the Soul
4313580.short_description: Awaken as Altos, a warrior whose memories were torn apart by the Void. A top-down 2D pixel ARPG with Zelda-like exploration and Souls-like combat: roam interconnected regions, craft Soul Orb builds, and face 20+ bosses.

5015160.name: マジカルラプチャー Demo

5277780.name: Suspect Express
5277780.short_description: Suspect Express is a first-person multiplayer game for 2 to 4 players. Play as an Inspector tasked with identifying the Troublemakers hidden among the passengers, or become a Troublemaker and wreak havoc aboard the train without getting caught before reaching your destination.

5430510.name: Abyssal Starfeast
5430510.short_description: Survive seven days in a sinister deep-sea kitchen. Catch, prepare, cook, and serve fish before your strange customers lose patience. A first-person horror cooking simulator where keeping up with orders is only part of staying alive.

5069580.name: Spray to Grail
5069580.short_description: Spray-paint sneakers layer by layer, finish fast orders, and turn a scrappy bootleg studio into a rare-drop machine. Unlock wild grails, upgrade your gear, fill your collection wall, and chase the perfect pair in this juicy incremental game.

4846750.name: World Order: Global Power Demo
4846750.short_description: Rule any nation in one of the most detailed geopolitical simulations ever created. Balance economics, diplomacy, military strategy, public opinion, and global power as you guide your country through an ever-changing world shaped by your decisions.

5021130.name: SLAUGHTER LOOP
5021130.short_description: Survive endless zombie waves! Slaughter Loop is a high-octane survival game blending bullet heaven and action roguelite mechanics. Choose your unique character, evolve your weapons, create your invincible build with ability cards, and grow permanently stronger in the skill tree.

4895300.name: Hack And Slash Fury 2: Lancelot Betrayal
4895300.short_description: Destroy the dark warriors with your sword at the rythm of heavy metal and see epic cinematics while you master the complex combat system to humilliate your rivals online or offline, here you will find fun, satire, and war created and combined like never before by his developer.

622290.name: 1 multi screen media player gallery video wall photo slideshow wizard app
622290.short_description:
Surround yourself with multiple screens of image slideshows and video players.
Try it out to see how it runs and what’s currently supported; if a feature you want isn't there, I hope you check back later.

5461440.name: Five Blades Deep
5461440.short_description: A deck-building roguelike. Pick one of five heroes and fight down through six themed dungeons, playing your hand in ATB battles. Win new cards from every fight, make the best ones permanent at every boss, and bring the five scattered Blades home to end the Demon for good.

5141740.name: 幼神 Demo
5141740.short_description: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

2345980.name: CultGame
2345980.short_description: Create your own cult, perform forbidden rituals, and crusade against the filthy non-believers. It's time to play god. CultGame is a cult simulator RPG where you start your own cult in a procedurally generated fantasy world with haunting ASCII art.

5373240.name: Junk Rocket Party
5373240.short_description: Grab the junk, build a rocket, and launch! Scramble for scrap on a spinning table, build your own rocket from toilets, sofas and jet engines, then fire them all at once. Farthest flight wins! Ranked online quick match for 2-4, up to 8 with Steam friends, or solo against bots.

5326400.name: Out of Delivery
5326400.short_description: Become a courier robot and take over the city! Race rivals, steal their packages and turn deliveries into multiplayer mayhem. Throw parcels, fight for loot and use unique effects to outsmart your opponents. Deliver, sabotage and rack up credits. Speed, skill and chaos rule the streets!

5143160.name: Zombie Tide Arena
5143160.short_description: Welcome to the Zombie Tide Arena. Draw all kinds of weapons and upgrades, keep strengthening your arsenal and your character, and survive the onslaught in the arena.

5315770.name: Oortbound
5315770.short_description: A co-op space roguelite for 1 to 4 players. Command a fleet, gun down raiders and mine planets while the sun burns toward collapse. When it becomes a black hole, dive in to fight the boss or warp to a richer sector. Survive five sectors as one of five ship classes, each with its own ultimate.

5285140.name: Springs, Eternal Demo
5285140.short_description: Explore a mysterious hot springs in the dead of night and meet the other lost souls who are drawn to this place.

4664400.name: The Matter of Being Demo
4664400.short_description: Set in the world of Cultist Simulator, haunt mortals and escape divine punishment in this unique relationship and resource management game. Strike Faustian pacts, manipulate mortals, and forsake your immortal life. Developed by Common Logic via Weather Factory's Sixth History License.

4797680.name: ZeroEco Demo
4797680.short_description: A psychological horror narrative game in pixel art about routine, memory, and the fear of change. Explore, interpret, and uncover what lies hidden within yourself.

4875130.name: Cold Sweat Demo
4875130.short_description: Cold Sweat is a PvE single player extraction shooter set in a post-apocalyptic world. Collect loot, complete missions for traders, upgrade your base, customize your firearms, and shoot your way through other survivors and the undead.

2842780.name: Moses & Plato - Last Train to Clawville Demo
2842780.short_description:
A murder mystery where you are the main suspect! An ambassador on a peace mission has been killed on board the Clawville Express.
Time progresses as you sniff out clues, eavesdrop on conversations, and interrogate passengers. Can you solve the case before the train reaches the last station? Or else.

2902660.name: 3Souls Parallel Edition
2902660.short_description: In the world of Mustland, each Ánima has a different soul, and they will see, feel, hear and play the world in a different way!

1547940.name: GunSoulGirl-DLC_PATCH
1547940.short_description: This is a first person shooter game, you will accompany the young girl, challenge all kinds of secrets, get weapons, destroy the polluted enemies in the secret. Unlock memories.DLC Contains Some more interesting  CG

1581935.name: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One - M For Mystery
1581935.short_description: Mycroft's agents were outsmarted, and confidential documents have been stolen. You are tasked with locating a shadowy figure known only as M. It appears there is a worthy opponent at large on Cordona.

1581936.name: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One - Beyond a Joke
1581936.short_description: Race to outsmart a daring opponent who targets only rich people.

1581937.name: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One - Saints and Sinners
1581937.short_description: Sherlock is forced to find the boundary between church and state, challenging his commitment to the law and justice.

1581938.name: Sherlock Holmes Chapter One - Mycroft's Pride
1581938.short_description: Big brother Mycroft sends you a series of cases linked to homeland security. Make the Empire proud!

1366600.name: Kawaii Girl2 AddPatch
1366600.short_description:
The Kawaii Girl 2is full of pixel girls! Use beautiful girls to clear several dungeons
Conquer the dungeon, have a fun.The difficulty of the game is a little high.

3979950.name: Wonder Catgirl XXX
3979950.short_description: A three-button banger where landing the cues unlocks catgirl adult videos. Fast arcade, zero fluff.

5196390.name: Lane Siege
5196390.short_description:
> Sack eight castles or die trying. Build your keep on a grid between battles, then
> command the fight live — spending food to field archers, knights and siege engines down
> one brutal lane. Every castle you take pays plunder. Every one after is tougher.

5301620.name: CyberSprawl: Aquarium
5301620.short_description: Build your neon aquarium. Fish, hatch and breed biological, cyborg and robotic creatures. Decorate and manage multiple habitats, sell fish to local NPC buyers, and bring your favorites into Neon Clash beta practice battles in this single-player idle collection game.

4351380.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
4351380.short_description: Ready your laser, rev up those trimmers, and run your own hair removal salon! Utilize cutting-edge salon tech, leaving clients hair-free and feeling fresh. Manage their pain levels, launch ludicrous sales pitches, and sink profits into gear upgrades and employees. Become a grooming powerhouse!

5019180.name: Epic Seven
5019180.short_description:
PLAY THE ANIMATION! A playable anime in your hands, Epic Seven.
A turn-based Hero collection RPG alive with stunning 2D visuals. Collect unique Heroes in the Seventh World and plan your path to victory through elemental effects and skill combinations.
Challenge Heirs worldwide in World Arena PvP.

5237400.name: Emoji : Tidy Up
5237400.short_description: Sort, match, and organize a colorful world of emojis! Discover 2,100 adorable emoji characters, solve relaxing sorting puzzles, and turn chaos into perfect order. Enjoy a cozy and satisfying experience where every move brings joy. Create your own tidy emoji collection!

5039370.name: SubSurvival: SSN-13 "Grendel"
5039370.short_description: A deep, detailed combat submarine simulator with a lo-fi aesthetic.  Manage crew, nuclear reactor, radio, sonar, radar and power all while remaining undetected and completing the mission.

4170430.name: Mount Noire
4170430.short_description:
Get cash, get meds, get home.

Survival horror set in a forgotten ski resort.

5430590.name: Fatespun
5430590.short_description:
Choose a hero, plot a route through a haunted kingdom, and build a formation of cards that fights
for you. A dark romantic card roguelite where every choice on the map and at the table shapes the
run.

5037200.name: just volleyball
5037200.short_description: just volleyball is an online and offline volleyball game with simple controls and deep player expression. take on others in anything from 1v1s & 2v2s to full team-based 6v6 matches. there's no right way to play, it's just volleyball!

5338260.name: We Roll at Dawn Demo
5338260.short_description: Build a floating island by day and defend its Sacred Tree by night in this action roguelite tower-defense game. Roll for new land, place elemental towers, fight as one of seven heroes, and carry permanent upgrades into each new run.

3965290.name: Keep Crafting
3965290.short_description: Keep Crafting is an asymetrical cooperative party game : One player must guide the other players using a manual to craft complex items !

3989950.name: My Death as a Duchess
3989950.short_description: My Death as a Duchess is a survival game where the player embodies a duchess taking control of a cursed duchy. This game combines both narrative intrigue and strategy, alternating phases of managing the duchess's schedule and the unfolding of her day in the form of a graphic novel.

3631230.name: CastleMiner Z : Resurrection
3631230.short_description: The cult survival shooter returns. Rebuilt in Unreal Engine 5, CastleMiner Z: Resurrection brings next-gen visuals, brutal combat, and infinite worlds to explore. Mine, craft, build, and survive against the undead, dragons, and the deadly unknown.

4995720.name: Mikey The Hero: MANIA
4995720.short_description: Run through the stage as Mikey, John, Ralph, Rosever, and Sarah to stop Fred. find the Mystic Gems to determine your ending, and maybe along the way find out some lore of Rosever's past in this all new entry into the Mikey The Hero series.

4823050.name: Broken Cycle
4823050.short_description: Broken Cycle is a dark-fantasy auto-battler RPG that lets you build a team of up to 5 mercenaries and send them to clear dungeons automatically while you engineer their battle tactics and loot, craft, and enchant their gear.

1068820.name: OVR Toolkit
1068820.short_description: OVR Toolkit is a utility application designed to make viewing the desktop in VR simple and fast, it allows for viewing the desktop within VR, mouse input, typing with a virtual keyboard, and quickly switching between windows. You can also control your media, see time, and more!

5435100.name: Water Margin: Rise of the Outlaws
5435100.short_description: A grid-based tactics game adapted from the Chinese classic Water Margin. Lead Lin Chong, Wu Song, Lu Zhishen and other outlaw heroes in 5v5 arena duels and a story campaign built on the novel's famous scenes. Every choice you make changes how the jianghu sees you.

4402300.name: Derby Life: Ranch & Race
4402300.short_description: Derby Life: Ranch & Race is where great racehorses are made, not born. Breed, raise, and train your own on a living open-world ranch, then saddle up and race the World Tour. Roam, fish, explore, compete. Your ranch, your horse, your glory.

5165370.name: Macrostate
5165370.short_description: Expand across a shifting map, bank power for growth and defense, and commit the right share of your reserves to every frontier. Macrostate is a single-player real-time territory strategy game with seeded worlds, AI rivals, and cross-ocean attacks.

5156310.name: Color Factory Demo
5156310.short_description: Connect nodes to generate, transform, and blend colors in a relaxing factory automation game. Discover new recipes, unlock powerful nodes through research, and design increasingly efficient production networks as your color factory grows.

5045050.name: TerraLounge
5045050.short_description: A relaxing slime terrarium, with match-3 puzzles when you're ready for them. A small neon world built to sit alongside whatever else you have going on, whether you're working or relaxing.

5372130.name: Shademarch
5372130.short_description: An async PvP autobattler. Build four heroes from 21 classes, draft the skills and items that change how they fight, then watch them battle other players' teams. Progress through the March, or climb the ranks on an even playing field in the Arena.

4645400.name: Kill The Sun
4645400.short_description: Alone or paired up, take part in a strange game show. Improvise with the tools you’re given. Collect objects. Create a sculpture out of them. Use it to kill the sun. Slip behind the scenes.

2024600.name: Into The Unwell
2024600.short_description: Whack-and-slash your inner demons in this third-person roguelite, set in a rubber hose fuelled fever dream! Play 1-3 players as one of several flawed and heavily medicated misfits.
developers: She Was Such A Good Horse

4833900.name: Hueless
4833900.short_description: The hueless horde is invisible except for their glowing eyes. Wound them and they bleed into full sight. Wizard with a gun. Sling fire, shock, frost, wind, earth, water and gravity or powerful weaponry. Destroyable environments also my dude

4598400.name: 12 Board Games
4598400.short_description: A collection of 12 board games, including Gomoku, Tic-Tac-Toe, Chess, Chinese Chess, Reversi, Draughts, Four in a row, Shogi, Jungle Chess, Junqi, Nine Men's Morris, and Mancala.

5087840.name: Chill Gyaru
5087840.short_description:
Byrd mirrors whatever you're doing. Study and she studies beside you; slack off
and she slacks off too. A desktop-companion idle game about looking after a gyaru
who lives in the corner of your screen — and saving up the deposit to keep her home.

3989650.name: Stop the Press!
3989650.short_description: You run a newspaper in a nation on the brink of revolution. Twist headlines to suit your agenda, upgrade your printing press, mastermind a distribution strategy to grow your readership and evade being censored—or worse—by the Secret Police. With enough influence you can change the course of history.

4607590.name: GummyGom Delivery
4607590.short_description: Carry cargo together on a shared board with your jelly bear teammates! Each movement affects the board’s balance, and a single mistake can bring everything crashing down.

4717780.name: Incremental Heist
4717780.short_description: Destroy and steal everything in your own pawn shop, then claim it all on insurance! Play as a jailbroken dapper cleaning bot, upgrade your crew, and turn increasingly spectacular destruction into increasingly ridiculous payouts.

5222940.name: Fleets of Valor
5222940.short_description: Fleets of Valor is a single-player WWII naval real-time tactics game. Command ships, aircraft and submarines from a tactical map, then take direct control in third-person view during combat. Maneuver fleets, launch carrier strikes, escort bombers and engage in dogfights.

5081680.name: Tribal Survival
5081680.short_description: Protect your campfire by building a tribe of cavemen to fight off endless waves of animals, beasts, and cryptids.

5404700.name: Puzzle Realms
5404700.short_description: Puzzle Realms is a indie 3d first person puzzle game with huge maps. Players must engage their minds to decipher intricate puzzles and unlock the portal to the next mysterious world. Prepare for a journey of logic, discovery, and wonder as you progress through each beautifully crafted realm.

4919880.name: 麦田幸存者
4919880.short_description: Harvest Havoc is an auto-fire action roguelike. Move and dodge as swarms sweep across wheat fields, frost, lava, deserts, and the endless void. Choose weapons and passives every level-up, evolve your build, craft companions, and paint your own map to battle on.

4970830.name: Villion Code
4970830.short_description: Cozy Okada presents a brand-new action RPG set in the near future where humanity teeters on the brink of extinction. Genome editing has ushered in a new age—but is there any hope for the future?

5432630.name: Dread Bids
5432630.short_description: A first-person horror auction. Bid against three desperate rivals on cursed relics, read their nerves and snipe before the hammer falls, then survive whatever you bought. Every night, the poorest guest does not go home.

5334100.name: Moonlight Castle: Easy Idle Defense Playtest

5245110.name: FishyFox
5245110.short_description: Take Dad’s favorite rod on a cozy fishing adventure across lake, river, and ocean. Guide your hook, reel in trophy catches, upgrade your gear, and enter tournaments. Keep your favorite fish in aquariums you can decorate, and fill your journal as you discover new species.

3611780.name: Chaos Movers
3611780.short_description: Team up with up to 8 chaotic movers, complete ridiculous moving contracts, and chase secret personal goals. Work together, protect fragile cargo, or secretly sabotage the job in this funny physics-based co-op party game.
